Generate a comic strip in the style of a Modern American Superhero Graphic Novel, [ASPECT_RATIO], containing [NUMBER] panels, explaining [TOPIC].

=== SCENE & LAYOUT ===
Background: Dynamic action backgrounds, speed lines, debris, or detailed cityscapes
Layout: [NUMBER] panels with dynamic composition (diagonal cuts, overlapping panels, or characters breaking panel borders)
Constraint: Visuals only contain the title, sound effects (SFX), and the comic panels. No extra floating text outside bubbles.

=== MAIN CONTENT ===
[PANEL_1] ([SIZE], [POSITION])
Scene: [SCENE_DESCRIPTION_1] (e.g., A superhero bursting through a wall, a high-speed chase on a rooftop, an explosion)
Character(s): [CHARACTER_NAMES] (e.g., The Hero in armored suit, The Villain, Civilians)
Action & Expression: [ACTION_EXPRESSION] (e.g., Punching, flying towards camera, terrified expression)
Dialogue (Speech Bubble): "[DIALOGUE_TEXT_CHINESE]"
Sound Effects (Big Bold Text): "[SFX_TEXT]" (e.g., BOOM!, CRASH!, WHOOSH!)
Narration (Rectangular Box): "[NARRATION_TEXT_CHINESE]"

[PANEL_2] [Similar structure as above]

Modern Western comic book aesthetic (Marvel/DC style). Bold, heavy black ink outlines with dramatic shading. Vibrant, saturated digital coloring with high contrast lighting. Usage of "Speed Lines" and "Impact Flashes" to convey motion. Characters often break the panel borders (bleed effect) to enhance depth. Visuals are gritty yet polished, emphasizing muscle definition, technology details, and destruction physics.

=== MOOD ===
Action-packed, intense, heroic, cinematic, high-energy, dramatic

Quality: High-quality comic book art, sharp details, dynamic perspective, professional coloring

Character(s): Miles Chen (hand detail only)

Action & Expression: Knuckles white with tension; an old, faded “SUPERHUMAN ALLIANCE” sticker peeling off the briefcase

Left: Awkward, tense step forward
Right: Heroic struggle, rain, lightning, explosive impact

Dialogue (Left – Inner Monologue): “Stay calm. You’re just clocking in…”

Dialogue (Right – Fantasy Bubble): “This is harder than fighting a dimension devourer!”
[PANEL_4] (Overhead Shot, Wide)

Scene: Futuristic reception lobby. An alien clerk uses tentacles to organize documents. A cyborg security guard scans with glowing red optics. Miles freezes beside a signpost.

Action & Expression: Miles stands rigid, overwhelmed

Scene 2: The card suddenly flashes bright blue; Miles reflexively throws it

Scene 3: The card hits a coffee machine switch; machines across the floor activate as coworkers turn in shock

Character(s): Miles Chen; Office Employees (background silhouettes)

Sound Effects (Big Bold Text): “BEEP!” “WHOOSH—CLACK!” “GLUG-GLUG-GLUG…”

Character(s): Miles Chen; Off-screen Female Colleague

Action & Expression: Miles’ eyes widen as realization dawns

Dialogue (Off-Screen, Cheerful Female Voice): “Hey! You’re the new guy who activated the coffee machine with his ID, right? That’s more creative than our R&D team!”

"例：临时会议、他人请求"

Label:
"第四象限：不重要不紧急"
"尽量避免"
"例：无意义刷视频"

角落有粉笔灰团。
底部木质粉笔槽，放着白色、黄色和粉色粉笔。
=== MOOD ===
Academic, nostalgic classroom atmosphere, structured, logical, strategic thinking, productivity-focused.
Quality: High definition, sharp chalk texture, realistic classroom lighting, clear readable Chinese chalk typography.

2117903200341229593.promptEn:
1. Overall Visual Style

Style Keywords: Flat UI, Vector, Modern Minimalist, Card-style design.

Lines and Shapes:

Rounded Corners Priority: All borders, background blocks, buttons, and process nodes must be rounded rectangles (Rounded Rectangles, with a large corner radius, approximately 10-15px).

Elbow Lines: Process connections use right-angle polylines (no curves), lines are simple and strong.

Color Logic (Key):

“Candy Color” Scheme: Use light backgrounds with high brightness and low saturation (such as light blue, light green, light purple), paired with darker borders of the same color family.

Border Emphasis: All graphics must have clear 2px~3px solid borders.

2. Vertical Layout Structure

Regardless of the topic, please follow the following top-down layout order, which must be contained within a large border container:

Layer 1: Main Title (Header)

Position: Centered at the top of the container.

Style: Bold black font, largest font size, darkest color.

Layer 2: Core Flowchart Area

Position: Occupies 50% of the core area of the layout.

Content: Rectangular nodes + arrow connections. If it is a loop step, please use a dashed line pointing back.

Layer 3: Feature List

Position: Below the flowchart, centered or left-aligned.

Style: Short and concise bullet points, slightly smaller font, with some white space.

Layer 4: Full-width Summary Box (Footer Box)

Position: At the very bottom of the container, filling the width horizontally.

Color Scheme: Use a contrasting color (such as purple in the example), distinct from the main color scheme above.

Function: Used to place 'Summary', 'Analogy', or 'Core Conclusion'.

Landscape size (horizontal/scenic mode) is chosen because:

Content Adaptation: Horizontal content like timelines is better displayed in a horizontal canvas to show the evolution process.

Presentation Friendly: The 3:2 horizontal ratio is very suitable for insertion into PPTs and documents, and displays well on projectors or screens.

Information Capacity: Horizontal layout can accommodate more text and icons, avoiding clutter.
2117903200341229593.promptZh:
1. 整体视觉风格

风格关键词：扁平化用户界面（Flat UI）、矢量图（Vector）、现代极简主义（Modern Minimalist）、卡片式设计（Card-style design）。

线条与形状：

圆角优先：所有边框、背景块、按钮及流程节点均须为圆角矩形（Rounded Rectangles），圆角半径较大，约10–15像素。

肘形连线（Elbow Lines）：流程连接线采用直角多段线（right-angle polylines，无曲线），线条简洁有力。

色彩逻辑（关键）：

“糖果色”配色方案（Candy Color Scheme）：使用高亮度、低饱和度的浅色背景（例如浅蓝色、浅绿色、浅紫色），并搭配同色系的较深色边框。

边框强调：所有图形元素必须具有清晰的2px～3px实线边框。

2. 垂直布局结构

无论主题为何，请严格遵循以下自上而下的布局顺序，且全部内容须置于一个大型边框容器内：

第1层：主标题（Header）

位置：位于容器顶部居中。

样式：加粗黑色字体，字号最大，颜色最深。

第2层：核心流程图区域（Core Flowchart Area）

位置：占据整体布局核心区域的50%。

内容：矩形节点 + 箭头连线；若为循环步骤，请使用虚线箭头回指。

第3层：特性列表（Feature List）

位置：位于流程图下方，居中或左对齐。

样式：简短精炼的项目符号条目（bullet points），字号略小，并保留适当留白。

第4层：全宽摘要框（Footer Box）

位置：位于容器最底部，水平方向铺满整个宽度。

配色方案：采用对比色（如示例中的紫色），明显区别于上方主配色方案。

功能：用于放置“Summary”、“Analogy”或“Core Conclusion”。

选用横向尺寸（横版/风景模式）的原因如下：

内容适配性：时间轴等横向内容在横版画布中更易展现演化过程。

演示友好性：3:2横版比例非常适用于插入PPT及文档，并在投影仪或屏幕上显示效果良好。

信息承载力：横版布局可容纳更多文字与图标，避免拥挤杂乱。

2117903200341229606.promptEn:
Present a clear, side miniature 3D cartoon view of the tallest buildings in YOUR CITY. Use minimal textures with realistic materials and soft, lifelike lighting and shadows. Use a clean, minimalistic composition showing exactly the three tallest buildings in Sopot, arranged from left to right in strict descending height order. The tallest must appear visibly tallest, the second must be clearly shorter than the first, and the third must be clearly shorter than the second.
All buildings must follow accurate relative proportions: if a building is taller in real life, it must be taller in the image by the same approximate ratio. No building may be visually stretched or compressed.
Each building should stand separately on a thin, simple ceramic base. Below each base, centered text should display:
Height in meters — semibold sans-serif, medium size
Year built — lighter-weight sans-serif, smaller size, directly beneath the height text
Provide consistent padding, spacing, leading, and kerning. Write “YOUR CITY NAME” centered above the buildings, using a medium-sized sans-serif font.
No building top should overlap or touch the text above. Use accurate architectural proportions based on real-world references. Maintain a consistent camera angle and identical scale for each building model.
No forced perspective. Use straight-on orthographic-style rendering. Do not exaggerate or stylize size differences beyond proportional accuracy.

Use a square 1080×1080 composition. Use a clean, neutral background. Ensure no extra objects are present.
2117903200341229606.promptZh:
呈现一幅清晰的、侧面视角的微型3D卡通风格图像，描绘你所在城市的最高建筑。使用极简纹理，搭配真实材质与柔和、逼真的光照和阴影（soft, lifelike lighting and shadows）。采用干净、极简主义（minimalistic）构图，精确展示索波特市（Sopot）最高的三栋建筑，严格按从左到右递减高度的顺序排列：最高的建筑必须在视觉上明显最高，第二高的必须明显矮于第一高，第三高的必须明显矮于第二高。

所有建筑必须遵循准确的相对比例：现实中某栋建筑更高，则其在图像中也必须按相同比例近似更高；任何建筑均不得在视觉上被拉伸或压缩。

每栋建筑须各自独立立于一条纤细、简洁的陶瓷底座（ceramic base）之上。每条底座正下方居中显示文字，内容为：
高度（米）——半粗体无衬线字体（semibold sans-serif），中等字号  
建成年份——较细的无衬线字体（lighter-weight sans-serif），较小字号，紧接于高度文字正下方  

确保内边距（padding）、间距（spacing）、行距（leading）与字间距（kerning）统一一致。在建筑群正上方居中书写“YOUR CITY NAME”，使用中等字号的无衬线字体（sans-serif font）。

任一建筑顶部均不得与上方文字重叠或接触。依据真实世界参考资料，采用准确的建筑比例（architectural proportions）。每栋建筑模型须保持一致的摄像机角度与完全相同的缩放比例（scale）。

禁止使用强制透视（forced perspective）。采用正面正交式渲染（orthographic-style rendering）。不得超出比例精度范围夸张或风格化地表现尺寸差异。

采用正方形构图，尺寸为1080×1080像素。背景须干净、中性（neutral background）。确保画面中不出现任何额外物体。

2117903200341229607.promptEn:
A horizontal split-screen cinematic shot of Times Square, New York, seamlessly blending two different eras: 1880s on the left and present day on the right (default: about 100 years ago vs. present day).

On the left side ({Era_A}): show era-appropriate architecture, interior or environment design, materials, vehicles, and props that clearly belong to that historical period. People wear authentic clothing from {Era_A}, including hairstyles, accessories, and typical items in their hands (such as books, umbrellas, instruments, letters, newspapers, etc.). The overall mood feels nostalgic and historically accurate.

On the right side ({Era_B}): show the same {Scene} in the modern era, with updated architecture or renovated structures, contemporary materials (glass, steel, LED screens, modern furniture), modern vehicles or equipment, and current technology (smartphones, laptops, cameras, etc.). People wear contemporary fashion that matches today’s style in this setting.

In the center: the two eras merge and overlap organically, without a hard dividing line. Elements from {Era_A} and {Era_B} visually interact: people from different times look at each other, walk through each other’s space, or seem surprised by the other era’s technology and objects. Architecture and environment smoothly morph from old to new (for example, stone gates turning into modern campus gates, classical concert hall décor fading into a futuristic stage, old street shops transforming into neon-lit storefronts).

Make sure the scene is not just a simple left/right comparison but a dynamic time-travel interaction where buildings, clothing, props, and human gestures clearly emphasize the contrast and fusion between the two eras. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, wide angle, highly detailed textures, rich sense of time-travel storytelling.

Aspect Ratio: 4:3
2117903200341229607.promptZh:
一幅横向分屏的电影感布光（cinematic lighting）镜头，展现纽约时代广场，无缝融合两个不同年代：左侧为1880年代，右侧为当今时代（默认：约100年前 vs. 当今时代）。

左侧（{Era_A}）：呈现符合该历史时期的建筑、室内或环境设计、材质、交通工具及道具，清晰体现所属年代特征。人物身着{Era_A}时期真实考据的服饰，包括发型、配饰，以及手中持有的典型物品（例如书籍、雨伞、乐器、信件、报纸等）。整体氛围怀旧且历史准确。

右侧（{Era_B}）：呈现同一{Scene}在现代时代的样貌，包含更新后的建筑或翻修结构、当代材质（玻璃、钢材、LED屏幕、现代家具）、现代交通工具或设备，以及当下科技产品（智能手机、笔记本电脑、相机等）。人物穿着契合本场景当下潮流的现代服饰。

画面中央：两个时代有机交融与重叠，无生硬分割线。{Era_A}与{Era_B}的元素在视觉上相互作用：不同时代的人物彼此对望、穿行于对方的空间中，或对另一时代的科技与物件流露出惊讶神情。建筑与环境平滑地由古至今渐变（例如石质门楼转化为现代校园大门、古典音乐厅装饰淡出为未来主义舞台、老式街边店铺蜕变为霓虹灯照亮的 storefront）。

确保该场景不仅是一组简单的左右对比，而是一场动态的时间旅行互动——建筑、服饰、道具及人物姿态均鲜明凸显两个时代的反差与融合。照片级写实（photorealistic），8k分辨率，电影感布光（cinematic lighting），广角镜头（wide angle），高度精细的纹理，富有强烈时间旅行叙事感（rich sense of time-travel storytelling）。

宽高比：4:3

2117903200341229610.promptEn: The setting is an ultra-realistic, editorial-quality photograph capturing a busy breakfast café at mid-morning—sunlight spilling through tall windows, steam rising from espresso cups, soft clatter of plates, and an overall warm, bustling atmosphere. The entire scene blends these three visual languages into one cohesive cinematic image with rich ambient lighting, shallow depth-of-field transitions, and hyper-detailed café textures. 在画面正前方，坐着一位动漫风格（anime-styled）的男性，拥有鲜明的蓝色头发，采用完美融合的赛璐珞着色（cel-shading）、清晰利落的线稿（line art）与微妙的镜面高光（specular lighting）绘制，但通过摄影级景深（photographic depth-of-field）将其置于真实空间中，使其仿佛真实存在于该环境中。  
在中景处邻桌，一名顾客以铅笔素描（pencil-sketch）风格呈现：用细腻的石墨（graphite）绘制，可见交叉排线（cross-hatching）与纸张纹理（paper grain），无缝嵌入真实环境，宛如处于平行媒介之中。  
在远处背景中，另一位顾客则以完整定格黏土动画（claymation）风格呈现：由手工塑形的彩色黏土（colored clay）构成，表面可见指纹痕迹、哑光质感（matte surfaces），并带有轻微逐帧（frame-by-frame）不完美感，暗示定格动画（stop-motion）式的运动。  
整幅画面将这三种视觉语言融为一体，构成一幅连贯统一的电影感（cinematic）图像，具备丰富的环境光照（ambient lighting）、浅景深过渡（shallow depth-of-field transitions）以及超精细的咖啡馆材质细节（hyper-detailed café textures）。

2117903200341229621.promptEn:
A Japanese Edo-period Ukiyo-e woodblock print. The overall feeling is a surreal collaboration between masters like Hokusai and Hiroshige, reimagining modern technology through an ancient lens.

**The scene:** a busy Shibuya scramble crossing

**Edo transformation logic:**
Characters wear Edo-era kimono but perform modern actions. All technology is transformed into surreal Edo equivalents:
* Smartphones are glowing, illustrated paper scrolls being read intently.
* Metro stations and trains are giant articulated wooden centipede carriages shuffling through crowds.
* Skyscrapers are reimagined as endless, towering wooden pagodas reaching into dramatic clouds.
* Robots and mecha appear as giant, armored woodblock golems.

The composition uses a flattened perspective with large, bold, hand-carved ink outlines. The background features heavily stylized Ukiyo-e wave patterns and dramatic, swirling clouds, with a distant Mt. Fuji visible on the horizon.

The image must look like a physical print, not a digital painting.
* Texture: strong visible wood grain texture and rough paper fibers throughout the piece.
* Printing imperfections: pigment bleeding is evident. Simulate hand-pressed plates with slight color misalignment for authenticity.
* Color palette: strictly limited to traditional mineral pigments, with dominant use of Prussian blue, vermilion red, and muted yellow ochre.
* Lighting: soft, flat, shadow-free lighting with no digital gradients.

Aspect ratio is 3:4 vertical poster. Include vertical Japanese calligraphy describing the scene and a traditional red artist seal stamp in a corner.
2117903200341229621.promptZh:
一幅日本江户时代浮世绘（Ukiyo-e）木版画。整体氛围呈现出葛饰北斋与歌川广重等大师之间超现实的协作，以古代视角重新构想现代科技。

**场景：** 繁忙的涩谷十字路口（Shibuya scramble crossing）

**江户化转换逻辑：**  
人物身着江户时代和服，却执行现代行为；所有科技均被转化为超现实的江户式对应物：  
* 智能手机变为发光的、手绘纸卷轴，正被专注阅读。  
* 地铁站与列车变为巨型分节木质蜈蚣车厢，在人群中缓缓穿行。  
* 摩天大楼被重构为无尽高耸的木质宝塔，直插戏剧性云层之中。  
* 机器人与机甲则呈现为巨型装甲木质浮世绘傀儡（woodblock golems）。

构图采用扁平化透视（flattened perspective），辅以粗大醒目的手工雕刻墨线轮廓（hand-carved ink outlines）。背景布满高度风格化的浮世绘波浪纹样（Ukiyo-e wave patterns）与富于动感的漩涡状云朵（dramatic, swirling clouds），远处地平线上可见富士山（Mt. Fuji）。

该图像须呈现为实体印刷品质感，而非数字绘画。  
* 质感：全图清晰可见强烈木质纹理（wood grain texture）与粗糙纸纤维（rough paper fibers）。  
* 印刷瑕疵：颜料晕染（pigment bleeding）明显；模拟手工压印版（hand-pressed plates），略带色彩错位（color misalignment）以增强真实感。  
* 色彩体系：严格限定使用传统矿物颜料，主色调为普鲁士蓝（Prussian blue）、朱砂红（vermilion red）与柔和的黄赭石（muted yellow ochre）。  
* 光照：柔和、均匀、无阴影（soft, flat, shadow-free lighting），杜绝数字渐变（no digital gradients）。

画面比例为3:4竖版海报。需包含竖排日文书法题跋（Japanese calligraphy），描述该场景，并于一角加盖传统朱红色画家印章（red artist seal stamp）。

2117903200341229652.promptEn:
<instruction> 
Input A is a famous dish (photo or dish name). Analyze the dish's complete ingredient breakdown, primary flavor compounds, chemical interactions, and scientific basis for why ingredients work together.
Optional Input B is a style reference (laboratory equipment / tech product packaging). If missing, choose scientific periodic table meets Apple product design aesthetic.
Goal: Grid-format display board (20"x16") in periodic table structure, with each ingredient in its own compartment labeled with both culinary and scientific information, color-coded by flavor profile.
Rules:

Brushed aluminum, white acrylic, or frosted glass backing
20-30 small clear compartments in periodic table grid layout
Each compartment contains: ingredient specimen, common name, scientific name, primary flavor molecule
Color-coded borders: umami (red), sweet (pink), sour (yellow), bitter (green), fat (orange), aromatic (purple)
Center "legend" section: 3D molecular structure diagram of signature compound
Lower corner: actual handwritten recipe on aged vellum or parchment under glass
AR markers for scanning to see animated 3D molecule models
Clean sans-serif typography (like Helvetica or Futura)
Minimal design with generous white space
Include atomic-style "numbers" for each ingredient showing ratio/importance

Output: ONE image, 4:5 clean product photography style with soft shadows on pure white background
</instruction>
2117903200341229652.promptZh:
<instruction>  
输入 A 是一道著名菜肴（照片或菜名）。分析该菜肴的完整食材构成、主要风味化合物、化学相互作用，以及各食材协同作用的科学依据。  
可选输入 B 是一种风格参考（实验室设备 / 科技产品包装）。若未提供，则采用“元素周期表 × 苹果产品设计美学”（periodic table meets Apple product design aesthetic）作为默认风格。  
目标：以元素周期表结构排布的网格式展示板（20英寸×16英寸），每种食材独占一个格位，格内标注其烹饪学与科学双重信息，并按风味特征进行颜色编码。  
规则：  

哑光铝材、白色亚克力或磨砂玻璃基底  
20–30 个小型透明格位，按元素周期表网格布局排列  
每个格位包含：食材实物样本、通用名称、学名、主要风味分子  
边框颜色编码：鲜味（umami，红色）、甜味（sweet，粉色）、酸味（sour，黄色）、苦味（bitter，绿色）、脂味（fat，橙色）、芳香（aromatic，紫色）  
中央“图例”区域：标志性化合物的三维分子结构示意图（3D molecular structure diagram）  
右下角：真实手写食谱，书写于做旧羊皮纸或仿古 parchment 上，并覆以玻璃保护  
嵌入 AR 标记（AR markers），供扫码后观看动态三维分子模型动画  
采用简洁无衬线字体（如 Helvetica 或 Futura）  
极简主义设计，留白充足  
为每种食材添加原子风格“编号”，体现其配比/重要性  

输出：单张图像，4:5 构图，干净的产品摄影（product photography）风格，纯白背景，辅以柔和阴影  
</instruction>

Panel 3 (three-quarter tracking shot): Hunter walking toward her parked sleek black bounty hunter spaceship (angular design with glowing engine vents), ramp lowering automatically as she approach, outpost towers and landing lights in background. Panel 4 (dynamic low-angle heroic shot): Inside the ship's cockpit from behind—hunter strapping in at pilot controls, starting engines with holographic displays activating and thrusters glowing bright blue, bounty secured in rear holding cell visible through glass, ship beginning liftoff as outpost recedes below, stars ahead. 2117903200341229685.promptEn:
Create a hand-drawn style infographic card in a 9:16 vertical ratio. The card should have a clear theme, with a beige or off‑white paper-textured background and an overall rustic, friendly hand-drawn aesthetic.

At the top of the card, highlight the title in large brush-style cursive Chinese characters using a striking red-and-black contrast to draw the viewer’s eye. All text should be in Chinese cursive script. The layout is divided into 2 to 4 clear sections, each using short, concise Chinese phrases to express the key points. The font should maintain the flowing rhythm of cursive script while staying readable and artistic.

Add simple, fun hand-drawn illustrations or icons on the card, such as characters or symbolic motifs, to enhance visual appeal and spark reflection and empathy. Maintain visual balance in the overall layout and leave enough white space so the design remains clean, easy to read, and easy to understand.

The theme is: “Building a personal IP is a long-term compounding process; if you keep showing up daily and continue consistently, you will definitely see results, because 99% of people can’t stick with it.”
2117903200341229685.promptZh:
创建一张手绘风格的信息图卡片，采用 9:16 的竖版比例。卡片需有明确主题，背景为米色或灰白色纸纹质感，整体呈现质朴、亲切的手绘美学（hand-drawn aesthetic）。

卡片顶部以大幅刷笔式行书中文标题突出呈现，使用醒目红黑对比色吸引观者视线。所有文字均使用中文行书字体。版面划分为 2 至 4 个清晰区块，每个区块用简短凝练的中文短语表达核心要点。字体需保持行书的流动韵律（flowing rhythm），同时确保可读性与艺术性兼具。

在卡片中添加简洁有趣的手绘插画或图标，例如人物形象或象征性图案，以增强视觉吸引力，并激发观者的思考与共情。整体版面需保持视觉平衡，并留出充足留白（white space），使设计清爽、易读、易懂。

主题是：“打造个人 IP 是一个长期复利（compounding）过程；只要你坚持每日露面、持续行动，结果必然显现，因为 99% 的人无法坚持到底。”

2117903200341229693.promptEn: Cinematic night scene of a cozy outdoor retreat by a calm lakeshore. In the center, a large hanging chair inspired by [SPACE_OBJECT] floats just above the ground, suspended by sturdy metal chains from a thick, low tree branch on the left. The chair’s overall silhouette, proportions, color palette, and surface detailing are clearly derived from this celestial body, so its characteristic outline, light and dark regions, subtle bands, patches, and recognizable markings from astronomy images are faithfully translated into the design of the outer shell. The material looks like a refined, slightly weathered fusion of stone and metal with finely sculpted relief matching those distinctive patterns, while the interior forms a smooth, comfortable hollow lined with warm woven fibers and cushions that softly echo the same hues. A plush pillow rests inside, illuminated by a gentle glow from within the chair, casting a soft pool of light onto the surrounding earth and grass. Tall wild grasses and small plants encircle the base

2117903200341229699.promptEn:
Hyper-realistic digital illustration of humanity's transportation evolution as a seamless panoramic landscape along a river (e.g., Pearl River or Huangpu River), flowing chronologically from left to right: ancient era on the left with wooden canoes and rafts propelled by oars, animal-drawn carts on muddy banks, and early wheelbarrows; transitioning to industrial age with steamships chugging smoke, horse-drawn carriages evolving to steam locomotives on tracks, and hot air balloons; then modern era with massive cargo ships and oil tankers, automobiles and bicycles on bridges, airplanes overhead, and high-speed trains; ending on the right with futuristic unmanned electric vessels, hyperloop pods, flying cargo drones, anti-gravity ships, and space elevators. Elements blend organically: oars become propellers then solar sails, dirt paths morph into highways then aerial lanes, ancient riverside trees as timeless anchors with roots adapting to evolving infrastructure. Ultra-sharp 8K details on textures like wooden plank grains, steam engine rivets, ship hull barnacles, drone LED glows, holographic controls. Cinematic hybrid lighting with misty dawn fading to golden-hour warmth and neon-night futuristic glows, volumetric rays through smoke and exhaust for immersive timeless feel.

--ar 4:3 --v 6.1 --stylize 500 --q 2 4K
2117903200341229699.promptZh: 超写实（hyper-realistic）数字插画，展现人类交通方式的演进历程，构图呈沿河流（例如珠江或黄浦江）延展的无缝全景式风景，时间轴由左至右自然流动：左侧为古代时期，呈现以木桨驱动的独木舟与筏子、泥泞河岸上由牲畜牵引的板车，以及早期手推车；渐次过渡至工业时代，包括喷吐白烟的蒸汽船、由马车演进而来的铁轨上的蒸汽机车，以及热气球；继而进入现代时期，展现巨型货轮与油轮、桥面上行驶的汽车与自行车、空中掠过的飞机，以及高速列车；最右侧收束于未来时代，呈现无人驾驶电动船舶、超级高铁舱体（hyperloop pods）、飞行货运无人机、反重力飞船及太空电梯。各元素有机融合：船桨演化为螺旋桨，再变为太阳帆；土路幻化为高速公路，再升华为空中航道；古时河畔树木作为永恒锚点，其根系则随基础设施的演进而自适应延展。纹理细节达超锐利8K精度，涵盖木板纹理、蒸汽机车铆钉、船体藤壶、无人机LED光晕、全息控制界面等。电影感混合布光（cinematic hybrid lighting）：薄雾弥漫的黎明渐变为黄金时刻（golden-hour）的暖调，再过渡至霓虹辉映的未来主义夜景；烟气与尾气中透出的体积光（volumetric rays），营造沉浸式、跨越时空的观感。\n\n--ar 4:3 --v 6.1 --stylize 500 --q 2 4K

The background is filled with fast-moving pedestrians, creating a sense of isolation and stillness amid chaos. Warm cinematic tones, shallow depth of field, motion blur, emotional storytelling.
2117903200341229702.promptZh: 一位年轻女子静立于熙攘人群中央，她本人清晰锐利，而周围的人则因运动而模糊。她头发凌乱，神情平静却略带忧郁，身穿浅蓝色纽扣衬衫和卡其色高腰长裤，腰间系着一条束带。背景中是快速移动的行人，营造出混乱之中孤独与静止的氛围。温暖的电影感色调（cinematic tones）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、动态模糊（motion blur）、情感化叙事（emotional storytelling）。

2117903200341229705.promptEn: A joyful celebration portrait of a woman tossing colorful confetti into the air, captured mid-motion. She’s smiling with eyes closed, hair flying upward, wearing a dark blouse and a delicate necklace. Confetti pieces in gold, blue, pink, and metallic tones float around her in sharp focus, creating a dynamic, festive atmosphere. Soft natural indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, cinematic realism, high detail, natural skin tones, candid emotion, ultra-sharp, professional photography style.
2117903200341229705.promptZh: 一位女性欢快庆祝的肖像照，她正将五彩缤纷的彩纸抛向空中，画面捕捉其动作中途瞬间。她闭眼微笑，头发向上飞扬，身穿深色上衣，佩戴一条精致项链。金色、蓝色、粉色及金属色调的彩纸碎片在她周围漂浮，清晰锐利，营造出充满动感与节日气氛的画面。柔和自然的室内光线，浅景深（shallow depth of field），电影感写实风格（cinematic realism），高细节，自然肤色，真实流露的情感，超锐利，专业摄影风格。

2117903200341229707.promptEn: A hyper-detailed folded-paper blueprint of [character], where the character is constructed from precise geometric folds and crease lines, overlaid with subtle blueprint markings, measurement lines, and paper annotations. Minimal color palette, off-white paper with faint ink lines. Studio lighting, crisp shadows, architectural art style, photorealistic paper detail. 1080x1080 square format.
2117903200341229707.promptZh: 一张超精细的折纸蓝图，描绘[character]，角色由精确的几何折叠和折痕线构成，并叠加了细微的蓝图标记、尺寸线和纸面注释。配色极简，米白色纸张搭配淡雅墨线。影棚布光（studio lighting），清晰阴影，建筑艺术风格，照片级写实（photorealistic）纸张细节。1080x1080 正方形画幅。
2117903200341229707.author: Serhat Karademir

2117903200341229708.promptEn: Create a photorealistic image of a young woman sitting at a relaxed outdoor restaurant in London on a cool Wednesday morning in March 2025. The sky is clear, the spring air is crisp, and the city feels calm as it wakes up. She is the focal point of the shot—wearing a light scarf, gently stirring her tea while gazing off to the side with a thoughtful expression. Everything behind her, from the waiter moving about to the soft morning traffic, should fall into a smooth blur, giving the picture the effortless, candid atmosphere of a moment casually snapped on a phone.
2117903200341229708.promptZh: 创作一幅照片级写实（photorealistic）图像：一名年轻女子于2025年3月一个凉爽的星期三上午，坐在伦敦一家轻松惬意的户外餐厅里。天空晴朗，春日空气清冽，整座城市在苏醒中透出宁静。她是画面的视觉焦点——身披一条浅色围巾，正轻轻搅动她的茶，同时侧目远望，神情若有所思。她身后的一切，从走动的服务员到柔和的晨间车流，均应呈现平滑的焦外虚化（bokeh），使整幅画面洋溢出一种毫不费力、自然随性的氛围，仿佛是用手机随意抓拍的瞬间。
2117903200341229708.author: Johnn

2117903200341229709.promptEn: A high-resolution, realistic photograph of Golden Gate Bridge. The image features a mixed-media overlay of white, hand-drawn technical schematics and engineering diagrams superimposed on the subject. Elements include dimension lines, arrows indicating movement or force, text labels, and a cross-section detail. The aesthetic is an educational infographic, blending real-world photography with precise white chalk-style technical analysis, 4k resolution.
2117903200341229709.promptZh: 一张高分辨率、写实风格的金门大桥（Golden Gate Bridge）照片。图像采用混合媒介叠加效果，主体上覆盖有白色手绘风格的技术示意图与工程图纸。元素包括尺寸标注线、指示运动或受力方向的箭头、文字标签，以及一个剖面细节图。整体美学风格为教育类信息图表（infographic），将真实世界摄影与精准的白色粉笔风格技术分析相融合，4k 分辨率。

2117903200341229710.promptEn: At golden hour, a huge, semi-transparent blue whale swims through a sea of white, fluffy clouds. The scene is surreal and magnificently grand.
2117903200341229710.promptZh: 黄金时刻（golden hour），一头巨大、半透明的蓝鲸游弋于一片白色蓬松云海之中。鲸鱼的身体由海水构成，其体内可见成群的鱼儿游动。阳光穿透这水形成的鲸鱼，折射出一道彩虹。整个场景超现实且恢弘壮丽。

2117903200341229714.promptEn:
Use 6 vintage Polaroid photos, fixed with decorative string and mini clothespins, to create an art collage that feels like a family album. Each Polaroid frame is slightly faded with an aged paper effect. The background is a soft pastel-colored wall with subtle shadows, creating a cozy yet creatively chaotic atmosphere.
Moods and poses:
* Relaxed laughter — eyes closed, naturally happy.
* Dreamy gaze looking upward with a relaxed posture.
* Playful wink.
* Calm smile with the head tilted to one side, dynamic hand gestures with both hands raised, full of energy.
* A romantic glance back over the shoulder.

The space is filled with a retro art vibe, blending elements of 1970s fashion magazines, soft diffused lighting, and gentle warm golden tones. Each photo feels like a unique behind-the-scenes snapshot, carrying a hint of nostalgia and revealing little pieces of personal history.
2117903200341229714.promptZh:
使用6张复古宝丽来照片，用装饰性细绳和迷你衣夹固定，制作一幅宛如家庭相册的艺术拼贴画。每张宝丽来相框均略带褪色效果，并呈现陈旧纸张质感（aged paper effect）。背景为柔和的粉彩色墙面，带有微妙阴影，营造出温馨又富有创意混乱感的氛围。  
情绪与姿态：  
* 放松开怀大笑——双眼闭合，自然流露喜悦。  
* 梦幻般仰望的目光，姿态放松。  
* 俏皮眨眼。  
* 宁静微笑，头部微微侧倾，双手高举、手势灵动，充满活力。  
* 浪漫地回眸一瞥，目光越过肩头。  

空间弥漫着复古艺术气息（retro art vibe），融合1970年代时尚杂志元素、柔焦散射光线（soft diffused lighting）以及轻柔温暖的金色色调（gentle warm golden tones）。每张照片都如同一张独特的幕后花絮快照（behind-the-scenes snapshot），携带着一丝怀旧感（nostalgia），悄然揭示些许个人历史的碎片。
2117903200341229714.author: 松果先森

2117903200341229715.promptEn:
Simple and clean flat design.
Place figures and icons drawn with uniform black outline lines, using pastel accent colors partially. Unify the line thickness as much as possible to create a modern impression.
Emphasize rounded shapes and a soft impression.
Diagram-centric composition (e.g., Venn diagrams, bar graphs, speech bubbles) with a friendly tone suitable for materials viewed by students and young people, or for social media.
Maximize white space, focusing on visibility and balanced design.
2117903200341229715.promptZh:
简洁干净的扁平化设计（flat design）。  
使用统一的黑色轮廓线绘制人物和图标，并局部运用柔和的粉彩色（pastel accent colors）。尽可能统一线条粗细，以营造现代感（modern impression）。  
强调圆角形状和柔和的视觉印象。  
以图表为中心的构图（例如：维恩图/Venn diagrams、柱状图/bar graphs、对话框/speech bubbles），风格亲切友好，适用于面向学生与青少年的教学材料，或社交媒体内容。  
最大化留白（white space），聚焦于高可视性（visibility）与均衡的版式设计（balanced design）。

2117903200341229716.promptEn: A man in casual clothes seated on the wooden slat of a park bench in a sunny city park, holding a rectangular wooden frame at chest level. Only parts visible are his face above the frame, his forearms and hands gripping the frame’s edges, and his legs below the frame, resting naturally on the ground. Inside the frame, instead of his torso, the park background continues seamlessly, showing grass, trees, and pathways as if his body is invisible. The frame acts like a cut-out window where his torso should be, perfectly aligned with the background. The park scenery inside the frame must match the environment outside it in an uncanny way, with precise continuity of bench, ground, and distant trees, while the edges of the frame stay clearly defined.
2117903200341229716.promptZh: 一名身穿休闲服装的男子坐在阳光明媚的城市公园长椅的木条坐板上，双手在胸前持有一个矩形木质相框。仅可见其面部（位于相框上方）、前臂与双手（紧握相框边缘），以及双腿（位于相框下方，自然 resting 在地面上）。相框内部并未呈现他的躯干，而是无缝延续了公园背景——包括草地、树木与小径，仿佛其身体完全隐形。该相框宛如一个镂空窗口，精准嵌入本应是其躯干的位置，并与背景严丝合缝对齐。相框内所见的公园景致必须以诡异（uncanny）的方式与相框外环境完全一致，长椅、地面及远处树木均需实现精确连续性，同时相框边缘须始终保持清晰可辨。

2117903200341229751.promptEn:
<instruction>
  1. Analyze Input Variable:  
Input A is a Global Commodity with a distinct production lifecycle (e.g., Coffee, Chocolate/Cocoa, Wine, Denim/Cotton).
Deconstruct the lifecycle into   3 Distinct Stages  :
   Stage 1 (The Origin):  The agricultural source (e.g., Coffee Plantation, Cacao Trees).
   Stage 2 (The Process):  The industrial transformation (e.g., Roasting Plant, Fermentation Vats).
   Stage 3 (The Destination):  The retail experience (e.g., A Hipster Cafe, A Chocolatier Shop).
2.  Container (The Map Table):
Goal: A "Seed to Shelf" Flowchart Diorama.
The Base: A large, vintage World Map (blue oceans, pastel continents) laid flat on a wooden dining table.
The Spine: A raised, winding S-Shaped Chute/Conveyor snakes through the center of the image, physically connecting the three stages.
The Flow: The chute is filled with the product, which visually transforms as it moves down the path (e.g., Red Coffee Cherries at the top 
→
→
 Brown Roasted Beans in the middle 
→
→
 Fine Ground Powder at the bottom).
3. The Vignettes (The Stations):
Construct a 3D diorama "Island" at each key point of the S-curve:
Top Station (Origin): A square patch of terrain sitting on the map (e.g., South America). Detailed crops, trees, and farmers harvesting the raw material.
Middle Station (Process): A compact industrial facility sitting on the map (e.g., Europe/USA). Metallic roasters, silos, smoke stacks, and factory workers.
Bottom Station (Destination): An architectural Cutaway Box. The front wall is removed to reveal the interior of a shop (e.g., Espresso machines, tiny customers sitting at tables, baristas serving).
4. The Narrative Scale (The Workers):
Scale: 1:87 (HO Scale) miniature figures.
Action: The figures are not just standing; they are actively moving the product from the "Station" into the "Chute" (e.g., Farmers dumping baskets of cherries into the stream, Factory workers shoveling beans).
5. Lighting & Atmosphere:
Camera Angle: High-Angle Perspective (45-60 degrees). Looking down the length of the table.
Lighting: Natural Daylight. Bright, cheerful, and even. Shadows fall softly on the map.
Depth of Field: Tilt-Shift effect. The top and bottom edges of the table are slightly blurred to make the models look tiny.
Output: ONE image, Vertical Aspect Ratio (4:5), Miniature Photography, Educational Diorama aesthetic.
</instruction>

2117903200341229755.promptEn:
<instructions> 
Input Variable: [INSERT OBJECT] (e.g., A Sneaker, A Human Skull, A Cheeseburger, The Letter 'A')

System Instruction:
Reimagine the Input Object as a complex, high-performance Cyber-Industrial Assembly.

1.  Deconstruction:
   The Shell: Replace the object's natural skin with Matte Black Carbon Fiber and Gunmetal Grey Polymer.
   The Segmentation: The object is not solid. It is segmented into distinct panels (like Iron Man armor or a high-end camera body), held together by visible Hex Bolts and Rivets.
   The Gaps: Between the panels, leave small gaps to reveal the internal mechanics.

2.  Internal Mechanics :
   The Piping: Where organic veins or structure would be, insert Bundled Industrial Cabling and Braided Steel Hoses.
   The Flow: These cables must look functional, routing power from a central core to the extremities of the object.
   The Glow (The Soul):
       Color: Identify the "Spirit Color" of the object (e.g., Burger = Amber/Orange; Skull = Cyan/Blue; Sneaker = Neon Green).
       Source: Hidden LED strips and neon tubes run parallel to the cables, casting a strong internal glow that spills out from the panel gaps.

3. The Narrative Micro-Detail (The Greebles):
   Scale Indicators: Embed tiny technical details to sell the scale.
       Vents: Cooling fans or intake grilles.
       Text: Tiny white serial numbers and warning labels (e.g., "CAUTION: HOT", "NO STEP") printed on the casing.
       The "City" (Optional): If the object is large enough, tiny architectural elements (antennas, platforms) can grow out of the mechanical base.

4. Visual Syntax & Composition:
   Background: Clean Studio Grey (Infinite Curve). The focus is entirely on the object's silhouette.
   Lighting:
       Key Light: Soft white studio light to highlight the texture of the carbon fiber weave.
       Rim Light: A sharp backlight to define the edge of the object against the grey background.
       Bloom: The internal colored LEDs must have a soft "Octane Bloom" effect.

5. Render Style:
   Aesthetic: Hard Surface Modeling, "Tech-Wear" Fashion, High-End Automotive Design.
   Camera: Isometric or 3/4 Product Shot angle.

Output: Photorealistic 3D Render, 8k, Highly Detailed Textures (Carbon Fiber, Brushed Metal, Rubber).
</instructions>

2117903200341229771.promptEn:
Create a home-style cooking step infographic for 【Sweet and Sour Pork】.

【Overall Style】
- Style: 8K ultra-HD realistic photography style, professional quality suitable for a food magazine
- Image Quality: 8K resolution, sharp details, professional food photography lighting
- Background: Real kitchen scene/marble countertop/wooden cutting board, shallow depth of field blur
- Color Palette: Natural and realistic colors, true colors of ingredients, warm lighting
- Layout: Horizontal 16:9

【Top Title Area】
- Main dish title (elegant Chinese font)
- Subtitle: Cooking time / Difficulty level / Serving size
- Background can use a blurred close-up of the finished dish

【Left or Top - Ingredient List Area】
- Title: "Ingredient Preparation"
- All ingredients arranged realistically, neatly organized from a top-down view (flat lay)
- Each ingredient labeled with name and quantity
- Style: Instagram-style ingredient flat lay photography

【Main Body - Cooking Steps Area】
- 6-8 steps, arranged in a grid or timeline
- Each step includes:
  * Step number (simple numeric identifier)
  * Close-up photo of the actual cooking process:
    - Cutting meat: Knife skills details, meat texture
    - Blanching: Boiling water, foam
    - Caramelizing sugar: Caramel color, oily sheen
    - Stir-frying: Dynamic movement in the wok, flame
    - Stewing/Simmering: Sauce bubbling, steam rising
    - Reducing sauce: Thick sauce, glossy meat pieces
  * Brief descriptive text (1-2 sentences)
  * Heat/Time notation

【Bottom - Finished Dish Display Area】
- 8K high-definition photo of the finished dish
- Professional plating, exquisite tableware
- Shot at a 45-degree angle or top-down view
- Visible food texture: Gloss of the sauce, fibers of the meat, rising steam
- Background: Dining table setting, chopsticks, small side dishes for garnish

【Photography Specifications】
- Lighting: Side-back light/natural window light, creating appetite appeal
- Depth of Field: Subject sharp, background naturally blurred
- Texture: Visible ingredient texture, oil sheen, reflection of the sauce
- Steam: Real steam visible in hot dish steps
- Color Temperature: Warm tone (5500-6000K), enhancing appetite

【Auxiliary Elements】
- Tips notation: Key techniques (e.g., "Blanch in cold water to remove odor," "Simmer slowly for 40 minutes")
- Heat icon: 🔥 notation for heat level in each step
- Timer notation: Duration for key steps
- All ingredient quantities, step details, time, and heat should be automatically generated accurately based on the dish

2117903200341229781.promptEn:
High-end editorial beauty portrait in a controlled studio setting, focused on emotional intimacy and tactile realism. Tight close-up framing from head to clavicle, vertical orientation, with the subject as the sole visual anchor.
85mm telephoto equivalent, eye-level camera position, close working distance. Chosen to compress facial features, soften contours, and create a cinematic, luxurious portrait. Shallow depth of field at f/1.8 for strong background separation and creamy bokeh.
Soft directional key light from camera-left, slightly above eye level, sculpting facial planes and hair volume. Minimal fill light to preserve shadow depth without losing detail. Subtle rim/back light for clean subject–background separation. Medium-low contrast, controlled shadows. Cinematic, low-key editorial mood.
Warm, natural skin tones contrasted against a cool dark-gray background. Subtle cinematic color grading with smooth tonal transitions; no aggressive stylization.
Long, wavy hair with intentional imperfection, fine side braids and black satin ribbons as secondary details. Semi-transparent black knit top with visible weave texture. Hand gently touching face/chin, relaxed elegant pose with slight lean toward camera.
Low ISO for maximum tonal cleanliness. Editorial sharpness on hair and fabric, natural skin rendering with light professional retouching. Photorealistic, cinematic, luxury fashion editorial standard.
2117903200341229781.promptZh:
高端时尚杂志风格的美妆人像，在受控的影棚环境中拍摄，聚焦于情感亲密感与触觉写实感。构图采用紧凑特写（close-up），画面范围从头部至锁骨，竖幅取景，人物为画面中唯一的视觉焦点。  
85mm 等效长焦镜头，平视视角（eye-level camera position），工作距离较近。该焦段选择旨在压缩面部特征、柔化轮廓，并营造出电影感（cinematic）、奢华感的人像效果。光圈 f/1.8 下实现浅景深（shallow depth of field），以达成强烈的背景分离效果与奶油般柔滑的焦外虚化（bokeh）。  
主光为柔和的定向光源，位于相机左侧、略高于眼平线，用于塑造面部立体结构与发量体积感；补光极微弱，以保留阴影深度的同时不丢失细节；辅以微妙的轮廓光／逆光（rim/back light），确保人物与背景之间干净利落的分离。中低对比度，阴影控制精准。整体呈现电影感（cinematic）、低调（low-key）的时尚杂志（editorial）氛围。  
温暖自然的肤色与冷调深灰色背景形成对比。采用细腻的电影感（cinematic）色彩分级，色调过渡平滑；无强烈风格化处理。  
长而波浪状的头发，带有刻意设计的不完美感；细侧编发与黑色缎面丝带作为次要细节。半透明黑色针织上衣，织物纹理清晰可见。一手轻触面部／下巴，姿态放松而优雅，身体微微倾向镜头。  
低 ISO 以实现最高阶的影调纯净度。时尚杂志（editorial）级锐度，重点呈现发丝与织物细节；肌肤呈现自然质感，仅施以轻度专业修图。照片级写实（photorealistic）、电影感（cinematic）、高端时尚杂志（luxury fashion editorial）标准。

2117903200341229788.promptEn:
A hyper-detailed, surreal but believable studio scene where an abstract concept is physically contained and made visible.

Main structure:
A transparent, museum-grade display container (thick glass or acrylic), placed alone in a neutral studio space. Inside the container is a frozen moment in time.

Core subject:
A human-scale subject (person or symbolic object) partially transformed into another material that contradicts its original nature — for example: skin turning into stone, soft fabric crystallizing, organic elements embedded in mechanical structures. The transformation is incomplete, showing a clear boundary between “before” and “after”.

Conceptual twist:
The interior of the container is treated like a scientific or archival exhibit:
– clearly layered composition
– visible cross-sections or cutaway logic
– subtle measurement marks, labels, or annotation-style details
– the feeling that this object is being studied, preserved, or explained

Spatial logic:
Gravity behaves normally, but time does not — motion is implied yet completely frozen.
Small secondary elements (dust, droplets, fragments, threads, petals, gears, etc.) are suspended mid-air, reinforcing the sense of paused time.

Lighting:
Soft, directional studio lighting with strong material definition.
Light emphasizes texture differences (smooth vs rough, organic vs artificial).
No dramatic colors — restrained, high-end, museum-like color palette.

Camera & composition:
Straight-on or slightly elevated perspective.
Centered composition, calm framing.
Depth comes from internal layers, not camera tricks.
Photorealistic, macro-level detail, cinematic clarity.

Mood:
Quiet, unsettling, contemplative.
The image should feel intelligent rather than emotional, poetic rather than decorative.

Style constraints:
No fantasy clichés.
No obvious sci-fi UI.
No decorative surrealism.
Everything should feel physically possible, even if conceptually strange.

Ultra high resolution, extremely sharp details, realistic materials, controlled studio background, premium art photography aesthetic.
2117903200341229788.promptZh:
一个超精细、超现实但可信的影棚布光（studio lighting）场景，其中某个抽象概念被物理性地封存并具象化呈现。

主体结构：  
一个透明的、博物馆级展陈容器（厚玻璃或亚克力材质），单独置于中性影棚空间中。容器内部凝固着一个时间切片。

核心主体：  
一个真人尺度的主体（人物或象征性物体），其部分形体正转化为与其原始属性相悖的材质——例如：皮肤石化、柔软织物结晶化、有机元素嵌入机械结构之中。该转化尚未完成，清晰呈现出“转化前”与“转化后”的分界线。

概念性反转：  
容器内部被处理为科学标本或档案式展陈：  
– 层次分明的构图  
– 可见的剖面或剖视逻辑  
– 微妙的测量刻度、标签或注释风格细节  
– 令观者感觉此物体正被研究、保存或阐释  

空间逻辑：  
重力表现正常，但时间异常——运动感被暗示，却完全静止。  
微小的次要元素（尘埃、液滴、碎屑、丝线、花瓣、齿轮等）悬浮于半空，强化时间暂停之感。

光线：  
柔和、有方向性的影棚布光（studio lighting），强调材质质感的精准区分。  
光线凸显纹理差异（光滑 vs 粗糙，有机 vs 人工）。  
摒弃戏剧性色彩——采用克制、高端、类博物馆式的配色方案。

镜头与构图：  
正向视角或略带俯角。  
居中构图，画面沉静。  
纵深感源于内部层次，而非镜头技巧。  
照片级写实（photorealistic），微距级细节，电影感清晰度（cinematic clarity）。

氛围：  
静谧、令人不安、引人沉思。  
图像应予人智性感受，而非情绪化；诗意感，而非装饰性。

风格限制：  
杜绝奇幻俗套。  
杜绝显性科幻界面（sci-fi UI）。  
杜绝装饰性超现实主义。  
一切元素均须具备物理可实现性，即便概念上显得奇异。

超高分辨率，极致锐利细节，真实材质表现，受控的影棚背景，高端艺术摄影美学。

2117903200341229790.promptEn:
<instruction>
Inputs: Ingredients = [Chicken, Bacon]

Step 1: Global Analysis
Analyze the ingredients.
Select 4 Distinct Countries with a famous dish using these ingredients  

Goal: A "Culinary Atlas" Grid showing 4 different cultural variations of the ingredients.

Layout Rule:
Output Format: A 2x2 Grid.
Content per Panel: Each of the 4 panels must show a Single Open Book Spread for that specific country.

Inside Each Panel (The Book Spread Rule):
Left Page (The History): 2D Vintage Sepia Sketches. A visual timeline or illustrated recipe of the dish (e.g., "1850 -> 1920 -> Today"). Flat, ink-drawn style.
Right Page (The Reality): 3D Pop-up Diorama. The finished, steaming meal emerges physically from the page. A tiny miniature chef from that country is standing on the page next to the massive food.
Consistency: All 4 books should look like part of the same series, but with different cultural contents.

Lighting: Cinematic top-down lighting, highlighting the depth difference between the flat left page and the 3D right page.
Output: 2x2 Grid, High Definition, Macro Detail.
</instruction>
2117903200341229790.promptZh:
<instruction>
输入：食材 = [Chicken, Bacon]

步骤 1：全局分析  
分析所给食材。  
从中选出 4 个使用这些食材制作著名菜肴的、各具代表性的国家。

目标：生成一幅“美食地图集”（Culinary Atlas）网格图，展现该组食材在四种不同文化语境下的变体。

布局规则：  
输出格式：2×2 网格。  
每格内容：每个格子须呈现一本专属于该国的、摊开的单本图书跨页（Open Book Spread）。

每格内部结构（图书跨页规则）：  
左页（历史页）：二维复古棕褐色（sepia）手绘草图。以视觉时间轴或插画式食谱形式呈现该菜肴的演变（例如：“1850 → 1920 → 当今”）。风格为扁平化、墨线绘制（ink-drawn style）。  
右页（现实页）：三维弹出式微缩立体场景（3D Pop-up Diorama）。一道刚出锅、热气腾腾的成品菜肴从书页中真实地立体凸起。一位来自该国的微型厨师立于书页之上，紧邻这道巨大丰盛的食物。  
一致性要求：四本图书外观须统一成套（如同同一系列出版物），仅内容体现各自文化特色。

布光：电影感俯视布光（cinematic top-down lighting），强调左页扁平图像与右页三维立体结构之间的纵深差异。  
输出：2×2 网格，高清晰度（High Definition），微距细节（Macro Detail）。
</instruction>

2117903200341229846.promptEn:
Role and Subject: A massive, encyclopedic 3D infographic poster with a 16:9 ratio. Title: “THE EVOLUTION OF [Product Name]”. The visual style is a high-end fusion of museum-quality product photography and complex technical blueprints.

Core Lineup (Chronology): Arrange 8–12 historical versions of the [Product Name], from the first prototype to the latest future model, completely and linearly. They are precisely positioned on a measuring scale/ruler base running horizontally across the center. Rendering: Ultra-realistic 3D, 8K resolution. Emphasize the evolution of texture: contrast the aging of the early [Material Atmosphere] with the clean, high-tech finish of the modern versions.

Brand Atmosphere (Canvas): Background: A deep, rich [Brand Color] textured background. Overlaid with watermarks of low-opacity vintage patent drawings, handwritten engineering notes, and newspaper clippings related to the brand's history. Header: A prominent, high-contrast brand logo centered at the top, with the title displayed in bold typography.

“Ultra-Dense” Information Layer (Punch Style): The layout is overwhelmed with systematized information (creating a “data aesthetic” look):
High-Density Annotation Network: Hundreds of ultra-fine white hairlines connecting specific [Key Components] (e.g., curves, buttons, engines) to compact text blocks or data tables floating in space.
Contextual Zones: “Era Modules” floating above the product. Representing different historical decades with iconographic markers.
Magnified Inserts: Circular “zoom-in” lenses scattered in empty spaces. Showing extreme macro close-ups of texture details or internal mechanisms.
Technical Specification Strip: A structured data bar placed at the bottom. Listing precise specifications (weight, dimensions, year, material code).

Technical Specifications: Octane render, Unreal Engine 5 aesthetic, editorial layout, masterpiece of information design, volumetric lighting, sharp focus, professional color grading. --ar 16:9 --v 6.0 --stylize 300 (Reference style: The history of Coca-Cola's development)
2117903200341229846.promptZh:
角色与主体：一幅巨幅、百科全书式的 3D 信息图海报，宽高比为 16:9。标题：“THE EVOLUTION OF [Product Name]”。视觉风格是博物馆级产品摄影（museum-quality product photography）与复杂技术蓝图（technical blueprints）的高端融合。

核心阵容（时间线）：按时间顺序完整、线性排列 [Product Name] 的 8–12 个历史版本，从首个原型机到最新未来型号。它们被精确置于横贯画面中央的测量标尺/直尺基座上。渲染：超写实 3D，8K 分辨率。重点呈现材质的演进：对比早期 [Material Atmosphere] 的老化质感与现代版本洁净、高科技感的表面处理。

品牌氛围（画布）：背景：深邃、饱满的 [Brand Color] 纹理背景。叠加低不透明度的复古专利图纸水印、手写工程笔记及与品牌历史相关的报纸剪报。页眉：醒目、高对比度的品牌标志居中置于顶部，标题以粗体排版呈现。

“超高密度”信息层（冲击式风格）：版式被系统化信息所充斥（营造出“数据美学”外观）：  
高密度标注网络：数百条极细的白色发丝线，将特定 [Key Components]（例如曲面、按钮、发动机）连接至悬浮于空间中的紧凑文字块或数据表格。  
情境分区：悬浮于产品上方的“年代模块”。以图标标记代表不同历史年代。  
放大插图：散布于空白区域的圆形“放大镜”镜头。展示材质细节或内部机构的极端微距特写。  
技术参数条：位于底部的结构化数据栏。列出精确规格（重量、尺寸、年份、材料编码）。

技术规格：Octane 渲染，虚幻引擎 5 美学（Unreal Engine 5 aesthetic），杂志级版式（editorial layout），信息设计杰作（masterpiece of information design），体积光（volumetric lighting），锐利对焦（sharp focus），专业调色（professional color grading）。--ar 16:9 --v 6.0 --stylize 300（参考风格：可口可乐发展历程）

2117903200341229861.promptEn:
(6-panel grid, variety of props, studio portraiture). A collage of 6 shots of the specific character interacting with different Christmas objects. [CRITICAL: Maintain exact facial identity, preserve original bone structure].

Clothing: A cozy fair-isle patterned sweater. Panels:

Shaking a Snow globe.
Kissing a wooden Nutcracker soldier.
Reading a pop-up Christmas card.
Hugging a plush Reindeer toy.
Sipping from a Santa-themed hot cocoa mug.
Peek-a-boo behind a bunch of pine branches.

（6格网格构图，道具丰富多样，影棚人像摄影（studio portraiture））。一幅拼贴画，包含6张该特定角色与不同圣诞物品互动的镜头。［关键要求：严格保持面部身份一致，保留原始骨骼结构］。

服饰：一件舒适的费尔岛图案（Fair-Isle patterned）毛衣。各格画面内容如下：

摇晃一个雪花球（Snow globe）。  
亲吻一名木质胡桃夹子士兵（Nutcracker soldier）。  
阅读一张立体圣诞贺卡（pop-up Christmas card）。  
拥抱一只毛绒驯鹿玩具（plush Reindeer toy）。  
从印有圣诞老人图案的热可可马克杯（Santa-themed hot cocoa mug）中啜饮。  
躲在一束松枝（pine branches）后玩躲猫猫（Peek-a-boo）。  
背景：柔和的米色或奶油色纸背景（soft beige or cream paper backdrop）。  
布光：柔光箱灯光（softbox lighting），以45度角打光，营造立体感（dimension）的同时保持面部修饰效果（flattering）。

2117903200341229864.promptEn:
(Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio). A breathtaking, high-quality lifestyle photograph taken with an iPhone at a cliffside terrace in Positano or Amalfi during golden hour.

Subject: A beautiful young Caucasian woman (early 20s) with fair, porcelain skin.
*   Hair: She has magnificent "Rich Chestnut Brown" hair (warm brown) styled in loose, voluminous waves. The backlit sun creates glowing copper highlights in her hair.
*   Face: She looks at the camera with a sweet, captivating smile. Her makeup is fresh and glowy (peach tones).

Outfit (The Glow Up): She wears a luxurious **Champagne or Cream Satin Slip Dress**. The fabric is fluid and shiny, catching the warm orange hues of the sunset. It has delicate spaghetti straps and a cowl neck. She wears a thin gold necklace.

Pose & Action: She sits comfortably in the white director's chair, body angled slightly to the side. One hand rests on the table holding a pair of sunglasses, and the other hand rests gently on her lap or plays with her necklace. She looks relaxed and elegant.

Environment: The background is a stunning Mediterranean view: lush green cliffs, the sparkling blue sea, and yellow/orange buildings. The sky is a gradient of sunset colors. The lighting is "Golden Hour Backlight", creating a soft halo around her silhouette while her face is evenly illuminated by the ambient skylight.
2117903200341229864.promptZh:
（竖构图，4:5 宽高比）。一张令人叹为观止的高品质生活摄影照片，使用 iPhone 在波西塔诺（Positano）或阿马尔菲（Amalfi）的悬崖边露台于黄金时刻（golden hour）拍摄。

主体：一位美丽的年轻白人女性（二十岁出头），肤色白皙如瓷。

*   发色：她拥有一头惊艳的“浓郁栗棕色”（暖棕色）秀发，呈松散、丰盈的波浪卷造型；逆光的夕阳在她的发丝间勾勒出熠熠生辉的赤铜色高光（copper highlights）。
*   面部：她直视镜头，展露甜美而迷人的微笑；妆容清新透亮（glowy），以桃色调（peach tones）为主。

穿搭（焕然一新系列）：她身穿一件奢华的**香槟色或奶油色缎面吊带裙（Champagne or Cream Satin Slip Dress）**；面料柔滑闪亮，映射出日落时分温暖的橙色调；裙装配有纤细的细肩带与垂褶领（cowl neck）；她佩戴一条纤细的金色项链。

姿态与动作：她舒适地坐在一把白色导演椅（director's chair）上，身体微微侧向一侧；一只手自然搭在桌上，手旁放着一副太阳镜；另一只手轻放在膝上，或轻轻拨弄着颈间的项链；整体神态松弛而优雅。

环境：背景是一幅壮丽的地中海风光——郁郁葱葱的绿色悬崖、波光粼粼的湛蓝大海，以及明黄/橙色的建筑群；天空呈现日落色系的渐变；布光为“黄金时刻逆光”（Golden Hour Backlight），在她身形轮廓周围形成柔和光晕（soft halo），同时她的面部则由环境天光（ambient skylight）均匀照亮。

2117903200341229884.promptEn:
Start on a soft pastel pink background, empty and still. A silver aluminum can labeled “life by colis – Sparkling Strawberry – Certified Organic” slowly fades into view, standing slightly tilted, covered in realistic condensation droplets. Ambient studio lighting is soft and premium.

Suddenly, a fresh strawberry drops from above in slow motion and strikes the top of the can. On impact, the strawberry bursts through the opening, releasing a vivid red strawberry juice splash that erupts outward in a frozen, sculptural arc. Tiny strawberry fragments and juice droplets scatter naturally through the air.

As the splash expands, green strawberry leaves drift into frame, gently rotating and settling around the can. The liquid splash remains suspended mid-air, glossy and highly detailed, emphasizing freshness and energy.

Camera movement is slow, cinematic, and smooth, with a subtle push-in toward the can. Lighting highlights the metallic texture , water droplets, and juicy translucency of the splash. Depth of field remains shallow with the background clean and uncluttered.

End on a hero frame matching a luxury beverage advertisement dynamic yet elegant, hyper-realistic, high contrast, crisp details, no camera shake, no extra elements added.

突然，一颗新鲜草莓自上方以慢动作下落，并撞击在易拉罐顶部。撞击瞬间，草莓穿透罐口爆裂，迸发出一道鲜艳的红色草莓汁液飞溅，呈冻结状、雕塑感的弧形向外喷涌。细小的草莓碎屑与汁液水滴自然地散射于空中。

随着飞溅液流向外扩展，绿色的草莓叶片飘入画面，轻柔旋转并缓缓环绕易拉罐沉降。液态飞溅保持悬浮于半空，光泽明亮、细节丰富，强调新鲜感与活力。

镜头运动缓慢、电影感（cinematic）、流畅，伴有朝向易拉罐的细微推进（push-in）。布光凸显金属质感、水珠细节以及飞溅汁液的多汁通透感（juicy translucency）。景深（depth of field）始终保持浅景深，背景干净、无杂乱元素。

2117903200341229909.promptEn:
[OUTFIT_STYLE] = Use the outfit from the reference image | casual utilitarian womenswear | casual mens streetwear
[COMPOSITION_SCHEME] = seated-inspired angular layout | standing-inspired vertical layout | walking-inspired offset layout | dynamic diagonal layout | balance-inspired asymmetric layout | editorial flat-lay grid break | sculptural negative-space layout | yoga-inspired angular balance layout | athletic-inspired directional layout
[SURFACE] = clean matte studio backdrop | soft neutral paper surface | cool tone matte backdrop
[ACCESSORY_MODE] = outfit_integrated | decorative | none

Make a high resolution flat lay fashion image for editorial and catalog use.
Use a strict top down camera angle with a natural 50mm equivalent perspective and perfectly parallel framing.
Set the scene on [SURFACE] with no visible texture seams or edge shadows.

Show only clothing items and approved accessories placed on the surface.
Do not depict or imply any human body, body parts, limbs, skin, joints, or anatomy.
Do not include legs, hips, feet, knees, or any biological structure.

Arrange garments as a flat, uninhabited composition following [COMPOSITION_SCHEME].
Interpret [COMPOSITION_SCHEME] purely as a geometric layout logic, never as a body configuration.
Use angles, spacing, and directional alignment only to suggest balance and posture.

Keep every garment fully flat with zero internal volume.
Force all bottom garments including pants or leggings to remain collapsed, empty, and tension-free.
Do not stretch, contour, wrap, or compress fabric.
Represent bends only through sharp planar folds and angular breaks.
Prohibit smooth curves, rounded forms, seated volume, or body-fit deformation.

Allow folds and wrinkles only as gravity-driven surface creases.
Ensure clothing reads strictly as laid fabric, not worn, inhabited, or shaped by a body.

Select garments and accessories based on OUTFIT_STYLE.
If [ACCESSORY_MODE] is outfit_integrated, include only functionally worn items.
If [ACCESSORY_MODE] is decorative, allow accessories as independent flat objects.
If [ACCESSORY_MODE] is none, exclude all accessories entirely.

Use soft diffused daylight from above with gentle shadows directly beneath each item.
Keep spacing balanced with visible negative space around the composition.
Avoid mannequins, models, body silhouettes, stuffing, air filled shapes, extra items, text, logos, or branding.
Ensure clarity, accurate fabric texture, and a calm contemporary aesthetic.

2117903200341229911.promptEn:
Create a city poster for your hometown

A city rendered digital art poster for [City Name].

The core subject of the image is a miniature island floating above white clouds, shaped like the selected city and occupying most of the frame. The island's shape is similar to the city's shape on a map, seamlessly integrating the city's unique iconic landmarks, natural landscapes, and cultural elements. Include the city's specific birds, cinematic light and shadow, vibrant colors, aerial perspective, and sun reflection effects. Buildings should not be too numerous or dense.

The island shows a seamless fusion of history and modernity. One part features the city's most representative ancient historical buildings; the other part smoothly transitions into the city's landmark buildings and skyline.

The island floats above a vast sea of clouds. The sea of clouds is rendered in the traditional art style of the city's cultural sphere.

3D text of the city's Pinyin or English name floats above the miniature island. This text group acts like a miniature ecosystem device where ecology and culture coexist.

Around the edges of the image and the main subject, overlay a minimalist, elegant information layout layer with the texture of a museum display panel. Primarily retrieve relevant city information; use classic serif fonts for key information and extremely thin minimalist sans-serif fonts for auxiliary data. Arrange the information in the corner of the image, similar to a classical atlas or a high-end magazine title page. Use serif font to label the city's geographical coordinates, alias, or founding year, and the current weather, as decorative background information. The overall layout should have extensive white space, be restrained, clean, and balanced, like appreciating a precious work of art.

Style requirements: Octane Render, C4D, Isometric City, Micro World, Living Ecosystem, 8k Resolution. DreamWorks style, 3D modeling, delicate, soft light projection.
2117903200341229911.promptZh:
为你家乡创作一幅城市海报

一幅为[City Name]渲染的数字艺术城市海报。

图像的核心主体是一座悬浮于白色云海之上的微型岛屿，其轮廓与所选城市地图上的形状一致，并占据画面大部分区域。该岛屿轮廓精准呼应城市地理形态，无缝融合该城市的标志性地标、自然景观与文化元素。需包含该城市的特有鸟类、电影感布光（cinematic lighting）与阴影、明快鲜艳的色彩、鸟瞰视角（aerial perspective）以及阳光反射效果。建筑数量不宜过多或过于密集。

岛屿呈现历史与现代的无缝交融：一部分展现该城市最具代表性的古代历史建筑；另一部分则自然过渡至该城市的标志性建筑与天际线。

岛屿悬浮于一片浩瀚云海之上。云海以该城市所属文化圈层的传统艺术风格进行渲染。

城市拼音名或英文名的3D文字悬浮于微型岛屿上方。该文字组如同一个微型生态系统装置，象征生态与文化的共生共存。

2117903200341229912.promptEn: A wide Malaysian city main road serves as the main subject. Typical Malaysian street scene buildings are distributed on both sides of the street, including low to mid-rise commercial shophouses, shops with awnings, and signs visible with a mix of English and Malay, creating an urban atmosphere. Tropical palm trees and greenery are planted along the road, and the overall environment presents the characteristics of a Southeast Asian tropical city. Multiple cars are driving on the road, including common Asian models, with obvious motion blur on the foreground vehicles to enhance the sense of dynamism. 2117903200341229928.promptEn:
A cozy modern living room in the late afternoon, 
three friends playing a board game around a low wooden coffee table:

– On the LEFT side of the table: a tall man in a red sweater, wearing glasses, reaching forward with his RIGHT hand to move a game piece.  
– In the CENTER: a woman with curly hair in a yellow hoodie, leaning back and laughing, holding a blue mug of tea in BOTH hands.  
– On the RIGHT side of the table: a person with short dyed green hair, wearing a black t‑shirt, resting their chin on their LEFT hand while studying the board.

The board game has a square grid with tiny colorful tokens, a visible six‑sided die showing the number 3 on top.  
Foreground: a sleeping cat on a gray couch, partially cropped.  
Background: large window with soft golden‑hour light, plants on the windowsill, blurred city skyline.

Shot at 35mm, eye‑level camera, natural soft lighting, realistic proportions and hands, 
warm inviting color grading, lifestyle photography style.

Negative prompt (optional): characters merged together, wrong number of arms, extra fingers, surreal distortions, horror, glitch

2117903200341229930.promptEn:
A single, high-quality product item positioned centrally in the snow.
(Note for generation:

Insert specific object here, e.g., "A white ceramic teapot with gold trim and 'WINTERBREW' logo," "A clear glass perfume bottle with silver cap and 'ALPINE ESSENCE' text," or "A pair of brown leather hiking boots covered in light snow.")
accessories
Natural, thematic elements scattered artfully on the immediate snow surface surrounding the main subject. Examples include pinecones, whole cinnamon sticks, star anise, frosted lavender sprigs, small pine branches, or complementary items like a knit beanie.
environment
A pristine, sunlit winter alpine landscape. The immediate foreground is deep, textured powder snow. The mid-ground features snow-laden evergreen trees. The background is dominated by majestic, rugged alpine mountain peaks under a clear or slightly hazy blue sky. A rustic wooden chalet or cabin is visible in the middle distance, slightly blurred.
lighting
Bright, crisp, natural daylight. Sunny conditions creating sparkling highlights on the snow crystals and the product surface, casting distinct, cool shadows.
camera
Professional commercial photography. High resolution, macro detail sharp focus on the main subject. Shallow depth of field (bokeh), creating a softly blurred background of the mountains and trees. Shot from a slightly low or eye-level angle relative to the product placed on the snow.
style
High-end product photography with a cozy, luxurious, fresh, and serene winter atmosphere. The composition is balanced and naturalistic.
2117903200341229930.promptZh:
一件高品质单品居中置于雪地上。  
（生成说明：  

在此插入具体物品，例如：“一只白色陶瓷茶壶，镶金边，印有‘WINTERBREW’标志”，“一只透明玻璃香水瓶，配银色瓶盖，瓶身印有‘ALPINE ESSENCE’字样”，或“一双棕色皮革登山靴，表面覆盖薄雪”。）  
配件  
自然、契合主题的元素艺术化散落在主体周围的积雪表面。例如松果、完整肉桂棒、八角、覆霜薰衣草枝条、小型松枝，或配套物品如针织毛线帽。  
环境  
一片纯净、阳光普照的冬季高山景观。近景为厚实、富有纹理的粉状新雪；中景为覆满积雪的常绿针叶树；远景以雄伟粗犷的阿尔卑斯山峰为主，天空为澄澈或略带薄雾的蓝色；中距离可见一座质朴木结构山间小屋（chalet）或小木屋（cabin），呈轻微虚化。  
布光  
明亮、清冽的自然日光。晴朗天气下，雪晶与产品表面呈现闪烁高光，并投下清晰、冷调的阴影。  
镜头  
专业商业摄影风格。高分辨率，主体细节锐利对焦（微距级清晰度）。浅景深（depth of field），使山脉与树木背景呈现柔和焦外虚化（bokeh）。拍摄角度略低于产品高度或与产品齐平（即眼平视角），产品置于雪地上。  
风格  
高端产品摄影，营造温馨、奢华、清新而宁静的冬日氛围。构图均衡、自然主义。

2117903200341229952.promptEn:
[Theme] A young woman with dark brown/black hair styled in a bun, with a few wispy bangs falling on her forehead; looking directly at the camera, with a calm and slightly languid expression. Right hand supporting her cheek, left hand holding a phone in a selfie pose.

[Makeup and Skin Texture] Natural, clear makeup, clean eye makeup, distinct eyelashes, moist lips; extremely delicate skin, the overall complexion shows a blue-purple sheen under the cold light.

[Clothing] White thin-strap low-cut top (simple, fitted style).

[Accessories] Layered transparent pink beaded bracelet and a thin gold chain bracelet (with small flower/clover pendant) on the wrist; nails painted with light nude nail polish.

[Props] A bright yellow phone/phone case is very eye-catching (located in the lower left corner of the frame), enhancing the realism of a “casual social selfie.”

[Scene] Dim restaurant/bar atmosphere, with thick black curtains as the background; white round table with wine glasses and small objects, multiple warm yellow table lamps creating a cozy ambient light.

[Light and Color] The subject is illuminated by cold blue-purple fill light (such as screen light/LED fill light), while the background emits warm yellow tungsten light, forming a sharp cold/warm contrast; the background is slightly blurred to highlight the portrait.

[Photography Language] Vertical composition, close-up half-body shot (above the chest), slightly high-angle/eye-level perspective, with the texture of a phone portrait mode, medium-shallow depth of field, and the image texture is “clear yet soft.”

[Theme] 一位年轻女性，深棕色/黑色头发盘成发髻，额前垂落几缕轻盈的碎发；直视镜头，神情平静且略带慵懒。右手托着脸颊，左手持手机，呈自拍姿势。

[Makeup and Skin Texture] 自然清透的妆容，眼部妆容干净，睫毛清晰分明，双唇水润；肌肤极其细腻，整体肤色在冷光下泛出蓝紫色光泽。

[Clothing] 白色细肩带低胸上衣（简约、修身款式）。

[Accessories] 手腕佩戴叠戴的透明粉色珠串手链与一条细金链手链（吊坠为小巧的花朵/三叶草造型）；指甲涂浅裸色指甲油。

[Props] 一只亮黄色手机/手机壳极为醒目（位于画面左下角），强化“日常社交自拍”的真实感。

[Light and Color] 主体受冷调蓝紫色补光（如屏幕光/LED补光）照射，而背景散发暖黄色钨丝灯灯光，形成强烈的冷/暖对比；背景略微虚化（bokeh），以突出人物肖像。

[Photography Language] 竖构图，特写（close-up）半身像（胸部以上），视角略高或平视，呈现手机人像模式（portrait mode）质感，中等偏浅景深（depth of field），画面质感为“清晰而柔和”。

2117903200341229972.promptEn:
Ultra-realistic futuristic cinematic portrait of a man (same face and body as reference), standing confidently in a studio. 
Minimal, moody lighting with soft shadows, background dark and clean so all focus is on him. 
He wears a casual but futuristic outfit — sleek layered jacket, subtle tech-textures, modern fabrics, hidden seams, minimal accessories. 
The man is posing confidently, relaxed posture, natural expression, charismatic presence. 
Camera perspective: mid-shot to full-body, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on subject, background slightly blurred.
Lighting style: soft rim light + key light, cinematic contrast, no harsh reflections. 
Color tone: cool futuristic mood, slightly desaturated, high detail skin and fabric textures. 
Style: cinematic, photo-realistic, high resolution, studio photography, editorial fashion shoot, 85mm lens, f/1.8, HDR, film-grade color grading, clean composition.
--no clutter, no props, no busy background, no distortion, no cartoon look, no extra people
--ar 2:3 --v 5
2117903200341229972.promptZh:
超写实未来主义电影感（cinematic）人像，一位男性（面部与身体特征与参考图一致），自信地站在摄影棚中。  
极简、富有情绪感的布光，阴影柔和，背景深暗且干净，所有视觉焦点集中于他本人。  
他穿着一套休闲但具未来感的服装——利落的多层夹克、微妙的科技感纹理、现代面料、隐形接缝、极少配饰。  
该男性姿态自信，体态放松，表情自然，气场富有魅力。  
相机视角：中景至全身构图，浅景深（shallow depth of field），主体清晰对焦，背景轻微虚化（bokeh）。  
布光风格：柔和轮廓光（rim light）＋主光（key light），电影感对比（cinematic contrast），无强烈反光。  
色调：冷调未来主义氛围，略低饱和度，皮肤与织物纹理细节丰富。  
风格：电影感（cinematic）、照片级写实（photo-realistic）、高分辨率（high resolution）、影棚摄影（studio photography）、杂志级时尚拍摄（editorial fashion shoot）、85mm镜头、f/1.8光圈、HDR、电影级色彩分级（film-grade color grading）、构图简洁。

Key component labels with color-coded callout boxes Internal component visibility through transparent/cutaway sections
Measurements, dimensions, and precise scale markers Material callouts and quantities 
Color-coded arrows for function/flow: RED (power/battery), BLUE (data/connectivity), ORANGE (thermal/processor), GREEN (sensors/haptics)
Simple schematics or cross-sectional diagrams where relevant 
Place “OBJECT NAME” title in a hand-drawn technical box (top-left corner).
Style: Black linework (technical pen/architectural), sketched but precise. Object remains clearly visible. Educational museum-exhibit vibe. Clean composition, balanced negative space.

创建一幅 [OBJECT NAME] 的技术信息图，采用 45 度等距视角（isometric）3D 构图，设备略微倾斜，以展现深度与立体维度。

关键部件标签，配以彩色编码的引线标注框（color-coded callout boxes）；  
通过透明/剖视（transparent/cutaway）区域呈现内部部件可见性；

2117903200341230029.promptEn: A highly detailed, exquisitely crafted conceptual product-style still life of an elegant traditional Chinese pavilion, presented as a miniature architectural artwork. The pavilion is a three-tiered pagoda structure made of semi-transparent jade-like and softly frosted glass material in refined milky white and ice-blue tones. Translucent turquoise-blue glass roofs feature delicately tapered profiles, accented with finely detailed champagne-gold ornamental edges and intricate, graceful golden flying-eave details. A warm, subtle golden light glows gently from within the pavilion through translucent windows, creating a soft inner radiance. A small vertical blue-and-gold plaque is precisely embedded on the upper tier façade, understated yet refined. The pavilion stands on a simplified, smooth sculptural base inspired by stylized mountains and calm water, carved from semi-transparent ice-blue crystal material. The mountain–water form is defined by elegant flowing contours, softly rounded transitions, and continuous sculptural surfaces, with restrained texture and no sharp ridges, evoking the feeling of finely polished jade, melted glass, or serene frozen waves. The mountain–water base fully fills the bottom of the frame and is cleanly cropped by the image edge: there is no visible ground, no platform, no horizon line, and no empty bottom space. The form appears naturally immersed and continuous, extending beyond the frame rather than resting upon it. A clean white jade staircase rises diagonally and seamlessly from within the sculptural base toward the pavilion entrance, maintaining clarity, balance, and an elegant sense of progression. Composition is tight, refined, and immersive: the pavilion and its base occupy most of the frame, with the mountain–water structure gently pressing against the lower edge, eliminating visual emptiness while preserving calmness. Camera: subtle low-angle, 3/4 perspective (approximately 25–30 degrees turned), with close framing to emphasize fine material quality, delicate craftsmanship, and sculptural precision. Soft, diffused luxury studio lighting with minimal hard shadows. High realism, shallow depth of field. Clean white to light-gray gradient background confined to the upper area, with carefully restrained negative space. Calm, ethereal, refined, premium craftsmanship, serene and sacred atmosphere, Eastern fantasy meets modern minimalism.
2117903200341230029.promptZh: 一幅高度精细、精工细作的概念性产品风格静物画，呈现一座优雅的传统中式亭阁，作为一件微缩建筑艺术品。亭阁为三层宝塔式结构，采用半透明玉石质感、柔和磨砂玻璃材质，色调为考究的乳白色与冰蓝色。半透明青绿色玻璃屋顶轮廓纤巧渐收，边缘饰以精细刻画的香槟金色装饰边线，以及繁复而优雅的金色飞檐细节。亭阁内部透出温暖而微妙的金色光芒，透过半透明窗格柔柔漫溢，营造出柔和的内发光效果。上层立面精准嵌入一块小型竖向蓝金配色匾额，低调却考究。亭阁坐落于一个简化而平滑的雕塑式基座之上，基座造型灵感源自风格化的山形与静水，由半透明冰蓝色水晶材质雕琢而成。山—水形态以优雅流动的轮廓线界定，过渡圆润柔和，表面连续统一，纹理克制、无尖锐棱线，唤起细腻抛光玉石、熔融玻璃或宁静凝固波浪之感。山—水基座完全填满画面底部，并被图像边缘干净裁切：无可见地面、无平台、无地平线、无空白底部空间。该形态呈现自然沉浸与连续延展之态，仿佛延伸出画框之外，而非静止安放于其上。一条洁净的白色玉石阶梯自雕塑基座内部斜向升起，无缝衔接至亭阁入口，保持清晰度、平衡感与优雅的递进韵律。构图紧凑、考究且富有沉浸感：亭阁及其基座占据画面大部分区域，山—水结构轻柔贴合画面下缘，在消除视觉空洞的同时保有宁静氛围。相机视角：微妙低角度、三分之四视角（约向右/左旋转25–30度），近景取景，以强调材质的精妙质感、工艺的细腻程度与雕塑般的精准度。柔和、漫射的奢华影棚布光（studio lighting），硬阴影极少。高写实主义，浅景深（depth of field）。背景为限于画面顶部区域的洁净白至浅灰渐变，负空间经审慎控制。氛围宁静、空灵、雅致，彰显高端工艺水准，兼具肃穆与圣洁感；东方幻想美学与现代极简主义交融。

2117903200341230030.promptEn: Cinematic, Low-key Indoor Portrait Framed In A Medium Side Profile, With The Subject Seated At A Wooden Desk Under A Single Warm Desk Lamp. The Pose Is Contemplative And Focused, Hands Loosely Clasped Over An Open Notebook, With The Gaze Directed Downward As If Deep In Thought. Lighting Is Controlled And Intimate, Using A Warm Tungsten Key Light (-2000k) From The Desk Lamp Positioned To The Left, Creating A Dramatic Chiaroscuro Effect: Soft Highlights On The Face, Hands, And Tabletop, And Deep Shadows Falling Across The Background And Clothing, The Background Is A Smooth, Dark Burgundy Tone (2a1416) That Absorbs Light And Enhances The Subject's Isolation In The Scene. A Minimal Set Of Props An Hourglass With Metallic Accents And A Closed Book Adds Subtle Texture And Storytelling Without Distracting From The Subject. Wardrobe Is Simple, Matte, And Monochrome, Such As A Dark Button-up Or Sweater That Minimizes Reflections And Emphasizes Sculpted Lighting On The Face. Lens Simulation Approximates An 85mm Full-frame At F/1.8, Producing A Shallow Depth Of Field With Crisp Subject Detail And A Velvety Blur In The Background, Texture Quality Highlights Fine Details In Skin, Hair, Fabric Fold, The Grain Of The Wooden Desk, And Warm Specular Highlights From The Lamp's Metal Components. The Overall Mood Is Introspective, Cinematic, And Atmospheric Blending Stillness, Warmth, And Narrative Tension In A Refined Fashion-editorial Style. Editorial, Modern, High-detail, Cinematic Composition, Ultra-realistic Textures, Professional Fashion Photography Style.
2117903200341230030.promptZh: 电影感（cinematic）、低调（low-key）室内肖像，中景侧脸构图（medium side profile），主体坐在木质书桌前，桌上仅有一盏暖色台灯照明。姿态沉思而专注，双手松散交叠于一本摊开的笔记本上，目光低垂，仿佛陷入深思。布光精准而私密，采用一盏置于左侧的暖色钨丝灯（色温 -2000k）作为主光源（key light），营造出强烈的明暗对比（chiaroscuro）效果：面部、双手及桌面呈现柔和高光，背景与衣物则投下浓重阴影；背景为平滑的深酒红色（#2a1416），吸光性强，强化主体在画面中的孤立感。道具极简：一只带金属装饰的沙漏与一本合上的书，增添微妙质感与叙事性，却不分散对主体的注意力。服饰简洁、哑光、单色，例如深色纽扣衬衫或毛衣，以最大限度减少反光，并凸显面部经雕琢般的布光（sculpted lighting）。镜头模拟全画幅 85mm 镜头、f/1.8 光圈，产生浅景深（shallow depth of field），主体细节锐利清晰，背景则呈现天鹅绒般柔焦（velvety blur）；质感表现力突出皮肤、发丝、织物褶皱、木质书桌纹理，以及台灯金属部件散发的温暖镜面高光（specular highlights）。整体氛围内省、电影感（cinematic）、富有气氛，将静谧感、暖意与叙事张力以精炼的时尚杂志编辑风格（fashion-editorial style）融为一体。杂志编辑风（editorial）、现代感（modern）、高细节（high-detail）、电影感构图（cinematic composition）、超写实纹理（ultra-realistic textures）、专业时尚摄影风格（professional fashion photography style）。

2117903200341230076.promptEn:
Create a 3x3 grid for a high-end commercial marketing campaign, centered on Alexander McQueen men's luxury sneakers.

Each frame should present a unique visual concept while maintaining perfect product consistency across all nine images.

Grid Concepts (one per frame):

1. 'Iconic Hero Shot': Eye-level side view on a dark, glossy pedestal, emphasizing the signature oversized sole.

2. 'Extreme Macro Detail': Close-up of the heel or stitching, highlighting the texture of the top-grade leather and the 'Alexander McQueen' logo embossing.

3. 'Dynamic Interaction': The shoe stepping onto a surface generating a subtle, elegant splash of black liquid or marble dust.

4. 'Minimalist Sculpture': The shoe artistically balanced on a geometric concrete or marble block, emphasizing architectural design.

5. 'Suspended Lightness': The shoe floating in the air, with laces dynamically suspended, conveying premium comfort and lightness.

6. 'Sensory Texture': A tactile, atmospheric shot focusing on the contrast between the velvet or smooth leather upper and a rough stone texture.

7. 'Monochromatic Luxury': A color-block scene where the background perfectly matches the accent color of the shoe, creating a bold editorial feel.

8. 'Deconstructed Craftsmanship': Abstract arrangement of raw materials (leather samples, rubber textures) surrounding the shoe, symbolizing high-quality construction.

9. 'Surreal Fusion': The shoe integrated into a surreal, dreamy landscape, blending realism with high fashion.

Visual Rules:
* 'Subject': Alexander McQueen men's oversized sneakers.
* 'Consistency': The shoe's shape, proportion, sole thickness, logo placement, and typography must be 100% accurate.
* 'No Distortion': No deformation of the signature sole or branding.
* 'Separation': Clear separation between the shoe and the background.

Lighting and Style:
* Soft, controlled studio lighting with dramatic rim lighting to highlight the shoe's silhouette.
* Subtle highlights on the leather, deep realistic shadows beneath the shoe.
* High dynamic range, 8K resolution, ultra-sharp focus.
* Editorial luxury fashion advertising aesthetic (Vogue/GQ style).
* Color Palette: Minimalist, monochromatic, metallic, and deep matte tones.

Overall Atmosphere:
* Modern, sophisticated, visually coherent.
* High-end commercial campaign for a luxury fashion brand.
* Surreal, cinematic, refined, and aspirational.

2117903200341230079.promptEn: IMAGE: Frame & Composition: The camera presents a straight-on, eye-level product still life with a frontal viewing angle, where two cylindrical objects are positioned side by side and occupy the central vertical axis of the frame; the composition is tightly cropped horizontally with minimal negative space on either side, and vertically cropped just above the top edges of the glass and container and just below the supporting base; visual weight is balanced evenly between the transparent glass on the left and the opaque container on the right, with both resting squarely on a rectangular block that anchors the composition at the bottom edge. Lighting & Atmosphere: A soft, directional key light enters from the upper left, producing crisp but controlled specular highlights on the glass surface and subtle shadow gradients along the cylindrical container; shadows are soft-edged and fall slightly to the right and downward, indicating a large diffused light source; micro-specular highlights on water droplets suggest a clean, dry studio environment with no haze, bloom, or atmospheric diffusion, resulting in high micro-contrast and clarity. Subject Geometry & Materiality: The left object is a vertically oriented transparent cylinder filled with liquid and suspended citrus slices, aligned perpendicular to the base; condensation droplets of varying diameter adhere to the outer surface, creating localized magnification and distortion of the contents; the right object is a matte-finish cylindrical deodorant container with a flat top, aligned parallel to the glass; its surface shows fine water droplets with lower reflectivity than the glass due to the satin material; printed typography appears flush with the container surface, with no embossing visible; the base is a rectangular wooden block with vertical grain lines, sharp edges, and a semi-matte finish, oriented square to the camera. Environmental Layering: The foreground consists of the wooden block edge, closest to the lens with crisp edge definition; the midground contains the glass and deodorant container in full focus; the background is a uniform light gray plane with no visible texture or objects, fully out of focus but evenly lit, providing clear separation from the subjects without depth cues. Technical Artifacts & Color: The color palette is restrained and natural, dominated by muted sage green, pale gray, translucent yellow-green, and warm amber-brown wood tones; saturation is moderate with emphasis on freshness cues from the green citrus; contrast is medium-high, especially between the transparent glass highlights and matte container surface; fine digital grain is minimal and uniform; no chromatic aberration, lens distortion, or motion blur is visible, indicating a controlled studio setup with a standard focal length lens. 2117903200341230140.promptEn:
Create a dual-orientation optical illusion portrait.
When viewed in normal upright position (0° orientation), the image must clearly reveal a young woman’s left-facing side profile.
When the image is rotated 180 degrees (phone flipped upside down), the same composition must reveal an elderly woman’s side profile.
Both identities must share the exact same contour structure and occupy identical spatial boundaries. No separate drawings, no split screen, no overlay. The transformation must occur purely through contour reinterpretation and structural ambiguity.
Design the contour so that:
The young woman’s chin becomes the elderly woman’s nose when rotated.
The young woman’s ear becomes the elderly woman’s eye socket.
The young woman’s neckline becomes the elderly woman’s mouth and chin structure.
Apply a Moiré interference surface using ultra-thin radial or dual-frequency line patterns across the entire composition. The interference pattern must enhance depth without breaking the dual-orientation illusion.
Strict monochrome palette. Black background (#000000) with white or light gray line structures only. No color. No gradients except those created by line density. No blur. No texture noise.
Ultra-precise vector alignment. High contrast. Clean silhouette edges. 8K ultra-high resolution. Aspect ratio 4:5.
The illusion must be readable in both orientations.
2117903200341230140.promptZh:
创建一幅双朝向光学错觉肖像画。  
当以正常正立方向（0°朝向）观看时，图像必须清晰呈现一位年轻女性向左的侧面轮廓。  
当图像旋转180度（手机上下翻转）时，同一构图必须呈现一位老年女性的侧面轮廓。  
两个形象必须共享完全一致的轮廓结构，并占据完全相同的空间边界。不可使用独立绘制、分屏或图层叠加。该转换必须纯粹通过轮廓的重新解读（contour reinterpretation）与结构模糊性（structural ambiguity）实现。  
设计轮廓时需满足：  
年轻女性的下巴在旋转后成为老年女性的鼻子。  
年轻女性的耳朵在旋转后成为老年女性的眼窝（eye socket）。  
年轻女性的颈线在旋转后成为老年女性的嘴部与下巴结构。  
在整个构图上应用莫尔干涉表面（Moiré interference surface），采用极细的径向线条或双频线条图案。该干涉图案必须增强纵深感（depth），但不得破坏双朝向错觉。  
严格采用单色配色方案。黑色背景（#000000），仅使用白色或浅灰色线条结构。禁用任何彩色。除由线条密度自然形成的明暗过渡外，禁用渐变（gradients）。禁用模糊（blur）。禁用纹理噪点（texture noise）。  
超精密矢量对齐（ultra-precise vector alignment）。高对比度（high contrast）。清晰的剪影边缘（clean silhouette edges）。8K超高清分辨率（8K ultra-high resolution）。长宽比4:5。  
该错觉在两种朝向下均须可清晰辨识。

场景（Scene）：

第 2 行 — 1920 年代 → 1950 年代：1920 年代飞来波女郎（flapper）风格垂腰连衣裙、1930 年代真丝斜裁吊带裙（satin bias-cut slip dress）、1940 年代结构化中世纪时尚（structured mid-century fashion）、1950 年代优雅郊区风套装。黑白（black-and-white）或低饱和模拟胶片色调（muted analog tones）。  
第 3 行 — 1960 年代 → 1990 年代：1960 年代摩登（mod）连衣裙、1970 年代波西米亚（bohemian）风格、1980 年代缤纷健美操/休闲风（colorful aerobics/casual style）、1990 年代垃圾摇滚（grunge）或极简波点（minimalist polka-dot）美学。  
第 4 行 — 1990 年代/2000 年代/2020 年代：晚期 1990 年代 Y2K 风格短款上衣配低腰裤（Y2K crop top/low-rise look）、2000 年代初光泽感杂志大片风（glossy editorial）、2020 年代现代极简主义（modern minimalist）或干净街头风（clean streetwear）。包含符合各年代特征的发型、妆容与布光（lighting）。每幅肖像须呈现为该年代真实拍摄的照片质感——匹配对应年代的胶片颗粒（film grain）、色彩配置文件（color profiles）、镜头特性（lenses）及影棚背景（studio backgrounds）。模特的面部特征、身份辨识度与身体比例在全部 16 幅肖像中必须保持一致。高分辨率（high-resolution）、杂志级（editorial-quality）渲染。
