2117903200341230431.promptEn: A young adult male with an athletic build stands on the left side of the frame, facing the camera with a calm, serious expression, a closed neutral mouth, and a direct gaze. His hair is short on the sides and about two to three inches on top, styled pushed back with a natural right-side bias, featuring a matte texture that highlights natural growth patterns, slight waves, and minor flyaways. He is dressed in an unbuttoned, light blue and white vertically striped button-down shirt with dark sunglasses hooked casually onto the placket, paired with rolled-up white chinos and brown suede loafers. Both of his hands are tucked deep into his front pants pockets to frame his waist, with his relaxed thumbs resting outside and lying flat against the pocket seams. He stands straight-on with level shoulders upon a light warm gray floor made of solid, large-format smooth concrete slabs with subtle seam lines. Stretching across the center-right midground is a pristine infinity pool framed by perfectly smooth, matte light gray concrete coping, its bright cyan blue water perfectly still and reflecting the sky overhead. The deep background reveals a majestic forested hill in the top right, heavily populated with thriving olive green deciduous and evergreen trees, all set beneath a clear sky that transitions smoothly from light blue to a pale, warm pink and orange near the horizon. Warm, golden-hour sunlight bathes the scene from a 45-degree angle on the right, providing bright, soft, moderately directional illumination that establishes a serene, luxurious, and relaxed evening mood. This single natural light source creates bright, preserved highlights on the right side of the man's face, his right shoulder, and the glassy surface of the pool, while casting soft-edged, gray-toned shadows across the left side of his face and body that trail slightly out to the left on the ground. The split-complementary color palette perfectly balances the heavy subject on the left with the bright open space on the right. Captured as a realistic, tack-sharp digital photograph with a 35mm or 50mm lens on a full-frame camera at f/4 to f/5.6 to achieve a medium depth of field, the image separates the subject while preserving rich background details. The composition features a clean, grain-free luxury travel and men's lifestyle aesthetic, enhanced by subtle post-processing that gently boosts contrast, color-grades the vibrant pool and golden foliage, lifts shadows in the dense trees, and applies minimal skin retouching, all beautifully framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230431.promptZh: 一位身材健硕的年轻男性站在画面左侧，面朝镜头，神情沉静而严肃，双唇闭合、中性放松，目光直视前方。他的两侧头发较短，顶部发长约为两至三英寸，向后梳理，自然偏向右侧，发质哑光，凸显天然生长纹理、轻微波浪及少许碎发。他身穿一件未扣扣子的浅蓝与白色竖条纹牛津纺衬衫，深色太阳镜随意挂在门襟上；下身搭配卷至小腿的白色卡其裤和棕色绒面乐福鞋。双手深深插在前方裤袋中，以突出腰线，放松状态下的拇指露在口袋外，平贴于口袋缝线处。他正面站立，双肩水平，脚下是浅暖灰色地面，由大尺寸、表面光滑的实心混凝土板铺就，板间接缝线条细腻可见。画面中右部中景位置横亘着一座洁净无瑕的无边泳池，泳池边缘由完美平滑的哑光浅灰色混凝土压顶围合，池水呈明亮青蓝色，水面如镜，平静无波，清晰映出上方天空。深远背景右上方展现出一座雄伟的林木覆盖山丘，密布生机盎然的橄榄绿色落叶树与常绿树，全部置于澄澈天空之下——天空由浅蓝色渐变为地平线附近淡雅温暖的粉橙色调。温暖的黄金时刻阳光从右侧呈45度角洒入画面，提供明亮、柔和且具有中等方向性的照明，营造出宁静、奢华又惬意的傍晚氛围。这一单一自然光源，在男子面部右侧、右肩以及泳池玻璃般平滑的水面上形成明亮而保留细节的高光；同时在男子面部左侧与身体左侧投下边缘柔化、灰调为主的阴影，阴影略微向左延展至地面。分裂互补色配色方案完美平衡了画面左侧厚重的主体与右侧开阔明亮的空间。本图以写实风格拍摄，采用全画幅相机搭载35mm或50mm镜头、f/4至f/5.6光圈，实现中等景深（depth of field），使主体适度分离，同时保留丰富的背景细节。构图呈现干净、无颗粒感的高端旅行与男士生活方式美学，辅以细腻的后期处理：轻微提升对比度，对鲜活的泳池色彩与金色 foliage 进行色彩分级（color-grade），提亮浓密树林中的暗部，并施以极简的皮肤润饰（skin retouching），整体以4:5画幅比例精美构图。

2117903200341230432.promptEn: A young woman with auburn hair tied up in a messy bun, wearing a beige visor, stands on a mountain hiking trail and turns back over her shoulder toward the camera with a warm smile; she wears a color-block windbreaker jacket in dusty rose, sage green, and slate blue, paired with rose-pink hiking leggings, and carries a large teal and black trekking backpack with a water bottle tucked in the side mesh pocket and a black hip belt fastened around her waist; her hands grip the backpack straps near her chest; the background features a sweeping alpine landscape with layered green hills, dramatic gray mountain peaks, patches of wildflowers along the trail, and a bright blue sky filled with fluffy white clouds; natural golden daylight illuminates the scene, shot in a realistic outdoor lifestyle photography style with crisp detail, vibrant colors, shallow depth of field on the background, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230432.promptZh: 一位年轻女子，栗色头发扎成凌乱的发髻，头戴米色遮阳帽，站在山间徒步小径上，微微侧身回眸望向镜头，面带温暖微笑；她身穿拼色防风夹克，颜色为灰玫瑰色、鼠尾草绿和石板蓝，下搭玫瑰粉色徒步紧身裤，背着一个青绿色与黑色相间的大型徒步背包，水瓶插在侧面网状口袋中，黑色腰带系于腰间；双手握在胸前附近的背包肩带上；背景为壮阔的阿尔卑斯山地风光，层叠的绿色山丘、气势磅礴的灰色山峰、小径旁零星分布的野花，以及布满蓬松白云的湛蓝天空；自然金色日光照亮整个场景，采用写实户外生活方式摄影风格（outdoor lifestyle photography），细节清晰，色彩鲜艳，背景呈浅景深（shallow depth of field），竖构图，9:16 画幅比。

2117903200341230433.promptEn: An extremely muscular man stands confidently centered, facing the camera straight on, featuring dark, glossy, slicked-back hair with a single stray curl resting naturally on his right forehead, alongside a short manicured beard and aviator sunglasses hiding his eyes in a neutral, posed expression. He is dressed in a tight, highly textured white knit short-sleeve polo shirt with a collar, paired with dark olive-brown dress trousers, his left hand deliberately tucked into his front left pocket while his right arm rests straight down at his side. He is positioned directly against a slightly textured, matte warm off-white painted concrete wall with a pristine, clean horizontal top edge that creates a shallow spatial depth. Rising behind the wall in the distant background is a vivid sky-blue expanse dotted with scattered fluffy white clouds and the curved top of a weathered metal street light pole extending upward. The scene is illuminated by single-source, bright, hard natural sunlight striking from a high front-left angle, casting highly directional, deep black-to-dark-gray harsh shadows to the right side of his silhouette directly onto the wall behind him, as well as distinct cast shadows under his collar and rigid pectoral muscles. This golden, warm lighting preserves crisp specular highlights on his left shoulder, left bicep, the left side of his face, and along the intricate raised ridges of his white knit shirt, creating a high-contrast, heavily structured, and energetic atmosphere. Captured as a stylized yet realistic digital photograph using a 50mm lens at ISO 100, f/8, and 1/500s for a tack-sharp, grain-free deep depth of field that emphasizes the clothing texture and clean visual style reminiscent of old money resort fashion and fitness influencer aesthetics, featuring high contrast curve post-processing, enhanced clarity on the garments, and warm color grading for his tanned skin tones while keeping the whites strictly neutral, framed in a 1:1 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230433.promptZh: 一位极其健硕的男性自信地居中站立，正面对着镜头，拥有深色、油亮、向后梳起的头发，右额前自然垂落一缕散乱卷发；蓄有修剪整齐的短胡须，佩戴飞行员墨镜遮住双眼，神情中性而摆拍。他身穿一件紧身、高纹理的白色针织短袖Polo衫（带领子），下搭深橄榄棕色正装长裤；左手刻意插在左前裤袋中，右臂自然垂于身体右侧。他正立于一面略带纹理、哑光暖调米白色的混凝土墙面之前，墙面顶部边缘水平、洁净，营造出浅层空间纵深感。墙后远处背景中，是一片鲜亮的天蓝色天空，点缀着朵朵蓬松白云，一根风化金属路灯杆的弧形顶端向上延伸。整个场景由单一光源——明亮、强烈的自然阳光——从高前左侧角度照射而来，在他轮廓右侧投下方向性强、由纯黑至深灰的强烈阴影，直接映在身后的墙面上；同时，在他的衣领下方及紧实的胸肌上也形成清晰的投影阴影。这种金色暖光在他左肩、左肱二头肌、面部左侧以及白色针织衫表面繁复凸起的纹理棱线上，保留了锐利的镜面高光（specular highlights），营造出高对比度、强结构感与充满活力的氛围。本图以风格化却写实的数字摄影方式拍摄，使用50mm镜头，参数为ISO 100、f/8、1/500秒，获得焦点精准、无噪点、景深（depth of field）深远的画面，突出服装纹理与干净视觉风格，呼应“老钱风”度假时尚（old money resort fashion）与健身博主美学（fitness influencer aesthetics）；后期采用高对比度曲线（high contrast curve）、增强服饰清晰度（enhanced clarity on the garments）、对其古铜色肤色进行暖色调分级（warm color grading），同时严格保持白色区域中性不偏色；构图采用1:1画幅比。

2117903200341230435.promptEn: Ultra-realistic luxury fashion editorial portrait of a young red-haired woman with fair freckled skin, natural facial asymmetry, authentic proportions, casting-model appearance, close-up three-quarter view, relaxed expression, gaze directed downward or off-camera. Contemporary editorial makeup featuring diffused metallic champagne-gold graphic eye makeup with organically imperfect edges. Freckles fully visible. Highly detailed skin texture with visible pores, tonal variation, subtle redness, and natural imperfections. Sleek wet-look or loosely pulled-back hair with realistic irregularities. Low-key cinematic lighting, strong contrast, single directional soft light source, deep shadows, dimensional facial contours, dark near-black background with subtle falloff. 2117903200341230437.promptEn: A well-groomed man with a neatly maintained beard stands directly in the center of the frame at a slight forty-five-degree angle, leaning back casually with level shoulders. He is dressed in an off-white linen long-sleeve shirt unbuttoned at the top and matching linen trousers, shaping the loose, slightly wrinkled matte fabric by resting his relaxed left hand in his front trouser pocket, where his thumb hooks naturally over the outer seam beside a thin silver cuff bracelet. His face holds a confident, deliberately posed, subtle closed smile, with relaxed eyebrows and a direct gaze capturing the viewer's immediate attention. Following the natural lines of his relaxed posture downward, the scene transitions into a deeply layered outdoor resort pathway. In the immediate left foreground, the rough, heavily textured brown bark of a thriving palm tree trunk naturally frames the composition. A solid, smooth poured cool gray concrete walkway, bordered by manicured olive-green grass, recedes into a slightly blurred midground, beautifully illuminated by pristine, modern rectangular bollard lights resting on the ground. Behind the subject, a tightly packed vertical light wood bamboo-style slat fence provides a clean textural midground, while the right side is anchored by a pristine modern building wing featuring perfectly smooth, matte warm taupe painted drywall, sharp geometric lines, recessed windows, and a dark structural pillar. Towering in the deep background, a dominant row of thriving, dark green conical cypress trees forms a dense privacy hedge against a twilight blue sky. A serene, sophisticated twilight mood permeates this upscale setting, draped in a cool, desaturated split-complementary color palette where moody, soft diffused lighting cascades gently from above. The cool blue ambient dusk temperature washes over the scene, while the ground bollards emit a contrasting warm orange and yellow accent glow that creates subtle highlights directly along the concrete path. Soft, short, gradual gray shadows pool delicately under the man's facial features and within the natural folds of his linen garments, establishing a calm, low-contrast, and evenly filled atmospheric depth. Captured straight on as highly realistic digital photography mimicking a 50mm to 85mm lens at an aperture of f/2.8 to f/4 with a 1/125s shutter speed, the image balances tack-sharp focal clarity on the subject's face with a medium depth of field that gently softens the background. The sophisticated aesthetic is finalized with intentional post-processing that introduces visible digital noise grain, lifted blacks for a soft cinematic matte fade, slightly desaturated greens, and split toning that pushes cool blues into the shadows and warm golden hues into the practical midtone highlights, all elegantly framed in a 9:16 aspect ratio.

2117903200341230438.promptEn: A handsome, fit man is positioned in a center composition, leaning confidently against a weathered boundary of rough-cut granite stone blocks speckled with gray and white quartz inclusions. He wears a navy blue terrycloth polo shirt with a rich tactile texture, paired with crisp white trousers and a gray baseball cap featuring a small, subtle logo. His medium brown wavy hair shows natural texture as it peeks from beneath the cap, while his eyes are hidden behind round tortoiseshell sunglasses. The man’s right hand rests flat and casually on the top surface of the raw stone masonry with fingers slightly extended, while his left hand rests heavily against the lower edge of the wall near his hip, his wrist displaying a silver steel mechanical sports watch with distinct specular highlights. The scene is set against a deep, layered background of a pristine European alpine lake reminiscent of Lake Como, where the deep blue water shows slight ripples and a small moored motorboat. Beyond the water, a historic hillside town of warm-toned villas cascades steeply toward the shore, framed by towering mountain peaks covered in dormant, brown winter foliage. The atmosphere is saturated with bright, highly directional natural sunlight from a front-right high angle, creating a high-contrast environment with harsh, defined shadows cast deep under the chin and across the left side of the subject’s face and body, trailing over the chiseled edges of the stone wall. Golden warm highlights glint off the subject's right arm, thigh, and the top edge of the granite. This tack-sharp digital photograph captures an Old Money travel aesthetic with a deep depth of field and a straight-on, slightly low-angle perspective, emphasizing a luxurious and structured lifestyle, framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.

2117903200341230442.promptZh: 超写实电影感（cinematic）肖像：一位戴眼镜的年轻女性，夜晚随意坐在城市混凝土楼梯上，身穿全黑色穿搭——黑色敞开式纽扣衬衫叠穿黑色圆领T恤，下搭宽松黑色长裤。深色凌乱发型，发丝柔和打理，面部轮廓清晰，肌肤光滑，透出青春女性的优雅气质。银色矩形吊坠项链悬于细链之上，右手腕佩戴黑色奢华腕表。放松坐姿，一只手臂搁在抬高的膝盖上，另一只手自然置于大腿附近。头部微微上扬并略向一侧偏转，目光远离镜头，神情平静、疏离而沉思。兼具时装模特体态语言与毫不费力的自信，呈现现代街头服饰（streetwear）美学。背景为城市建筑，左侧可见一根混凝土立柱，旁边有一块小型黑色标牌，上面写着“ESCAPE THE ORDINARY”。暗调城市环境，背景中建筑虚化、阴影浓重。浅景深（depth of field）营造柔滑焦外虚化（bokeh），主体分离感强烈。低角度（low-angle）拍摄，使人物显得更高大、更具主导感。柔和漫射的城市环境光混合微妙的电影感布光（cinematic lighting），突出面部结构与下颌线。深邃黑色、低饱和色彩、高对比度，采用奢华杂志级调色（luxury editorial color grading），呈现高端街头时尚（street-fashion）广告大片质感。使用全画幅相机、85mm镜头、f/1.8光圈、ISO 400拍摄；面部焦点极致锐利，皮肤纹理真实，发丝细节丰富，衣料褶皱自然，照片级写实（photorealistic），电影感纵深（cinematic depth），奢华时尚摄影（luxury fashion photography），现代都市杂志风格（modern urban editorial），杂志级精修（magazine-quality retouching），杰作，8K。

2117903200341230443.promptEn: A well-groomed man with a neatly maintained beard stands directly in the center of the frame at a slight forty-five-degree angle, leaning back casually with level shoulders. He is dressed in an off-white linen long-sleeve shirt unbuttoned at the top and matching linen trousers, shaping the loose, slightly wrinkled matte fabric by resting his relaxed left hand in his front trouser pocket, where his thumb hooks naturally over the outer seam beside a thin silver cuff bracelet. His face holds a confident, deliberately posed, subtle closed smile, with relaxed eyebrows and a direct gaze capturing the viewer's immediate attention. Following the natural lines of his relaxed posture downward, the scene transitions into a deeply layered outdoor resort pathway. In the immediate left foreground, the rough, heavily textured brown bark of a thriving palm tree trunk naturally frames the composition. A solid, smooth poured cool gray concrete walkway, bordered by manicured olive-green grass, recedes into a slightly blurred midground, beautifully illuminated by pristine, modern rectangular bollard lights resting on the ground. Behind the subject, a tightly packed vertical light wood bamboo-style slat fence provides a clean textural midground, while the right side is anchored by a pristine modern building wing featuring perfectly smooth, matte warm taupe painted drywall, sharp geometric lines, recessed windows, and a dark structural pillar. Towering in the deep background, a dominant row of thriving, dark green conical cypress trees forms a dense privacy hedge against a twilight blue sky. A serene, sophisticated twilight mood permeates this upscale setting, draped in a cool, desaturated split-complementary color palette where moody, soft diffused lighting cascades gently from above. The cool blue ambient dusk temperature washes over the scene, while the ground bollards emit a contrasting warm orange and yellow accent glow that creates subtle highlights directly along the concrete path. Soft, short, gradual gray shadows pool delicately under the man's facial features and within the natural folds of his linen garments, establishing a calm, low-contrast, and evenly filled atmospheric depth. Captured straight on as highly realistic digital photography mimicking a 50mm to 85mm lens at an aperture of f/2.8 to f/4 with a 1/125s shutter speed, the image balances tack-sharp focal clarity on the subject's face with a medium depth of field that gently softens the background. The sophisticated aesthetic is finalized with intentional post-processing that introduces visible digital noise grain, lifted blacks for a soft cinematic matte fade, slightly desaturated greens, and split toning that pushes cool blues into the shadows and warm golden hues into the practical midtone highlights, all elegantly framed in a 9:16 aspect ratio.

2117903200341230444.promptEn: A handsome male in his mid-30s with an athletic build stands in a confident, deliberately posed stance, his direct gaze meeting the lens with a sophisticated, neutral expression. His medium-length, wavy brown hair is pushed back, revealing natural texture and subtle strands caught in the sun. He is dressed in casual elegance, wearing a fitted, dark charcoal grey button-down shirt with rolled-up sleeves, sharply tailored bright white trousers, and tan suede slip-on loafers. His body is gently angled, weight resting comfortably to the left as his right shoulder leans against a massive stone structure, with one leg casually crossed over the other at the ankle. Both hands are relaxed in front of his waist, loosely clasping the left and right sides of a pair of dark sunglasses, with his fingers lightly gripping the frame. He is anchored in an ancient Mediterranean historical site, specifically leaning against a dominant, highly weathered square pillar in the left foreground constructed of large, irregular, porous grey stone blocks complete with deeply pitted surfaces and visible rough masonry joints. The mid-level spatial depth reveals an earthy tan and brown floor of irregular cobblestones and flat stone slabs. To the right midground sits a worn, rectangular cut-stone block bench with subtle panel details, and just behind it, a classic aged stone archway frames a brightly sunlit, heavily textured interior wall crafted from raw stone and plaster. The scene is bathed in hard, highly directional natural sunlight cascading from the front-left and slightly elevated, creating a warm, energetic, and sun-drenched atmosphere. This intense, golden single-source light sculpts high-contrast, harsh-edged, deep black shadows, deliberately casting the man's silhouette directly onto the rough stone pillar behind his right side and across the cobblestone ground. Bright, preserved highlights strike his left cheek, his left shoulder, the crisp folds of his white trousers, and the vivid ochre and yellow-orange textured earth of the distant arched wall, establishing a split-complementary palette that beautifully contrasts the cool stone greys with warm, vibrant accents. Captured as a photorealistic, tack-sharp digital editorial travel lifestyle portrait using a 50mm lens with a deep depth of field, ensuring both the subject and the architectural background remain perfectly in focus. The aesthetic features a high contrast curve to emphasize the dramatic interplay of hard light and deep shadow, along with a saturation boost on the warm golden and ochre tones to create distinct color separation and emphasize the raw, porous textures of the masonry and clothing fabrics, all perfectly framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230444.promptZh: 一位相貌英俊、年约三十五岁的男性，体格健硕，以自信而刻意摆出的姿态站立，目光直视镜头，神情成熟且中性。他留着中等长度、微卷的棕色头发，向后梳理，展现出自然发质纹理，几缕发丝在阳光下泛着微光。他身着休闲而优雅的装束：一件合身的深炭灰色纽扣衬衫，袖口挽至小臂；一条剪裁利落的纯白色长裤；一双棕褐色绒面革便士乐福鞋。他的身体微微侧倾，重心舒适地落在左侧，右肩倚靠在一座巨大的石质结构上；右脚踝随意地搭在左腿踝部。双手放松地置于腰前，松松握住一副深色太阳镜的左右两侧镜框，指尖轻捏镜架。他置身于一处古老的地中海历史遗址中，具体位置是画面左前方一根占据主导地位、饱经风霜的方形石柱旁——该石柱由大块不规则、多孔的灰色石料砌成，表面布满深坑，粗粝的砌缝清晰可见。中景空间层次展现出一片土褐色与棕褐色的地面，由不规则鹅卵石与扁平石板铺就。右中景处设有一条磨损的矩形切割石凳，表面带有微妙的镶板细节；石凳正后方，则是一座经典的老化石拱门，框住了一面被强烈日光照射的、肌理丰富的内墙——墙面由原始石材与灰泥构成。整个场景沐浴在来自左前方并略带仰角的强烈、高度定向的自然阳光之中，营造出温暖、充满活力且阳光充沛的氛围。这束强烈、呈金色的单光源光线塑造出高对比度、边缘锐利、浓重漆黑的阴影，刻意将男子的剪影直接投射在他右侧身后那根粗粝石柱之上，并延伸至鹅卵石地面。明亮而保留细节的高光则落在他的左脸颊、左肩、纯白长裤挺括的褶皱，以及远处拱墙那富有肌理感的鲜明赭石色与黄橙色泥土表面，由此构建出一组分裂互补色（split-complementary palette），使冷调的石灰色与温暖而鲜活的点缀色形成绝妙对比。本图以照片级写实（photorealistic）风格拍摄，为一幅锐利无比（tack-sharp）的数字杂志式旅行生活方式人像（digital editorial travel lifestyle portrait），采用50mm镜头、大景深（depth of field），确保人物主体与建筑背景均完美合焦。整体视觉风格采用高对比度曲线（high contrast curve），以强化硬光与深影之间富戏剧性的互动关系；同时对暖金色与赭石色进行饱和度提升（saturation boost），从而实现鲜明的色彩分离，并凸显石工结构与服装面料所呈现的粗犷、多孔质感；全图严格按4:5画幅比例构图。

2117903200341230445.promptZh: 一位美丽年轻的女性，目光强烈而柔和，直视镜头。姿势：照片采用自上而下的俯拍角度（平铺俯拍 flat lay 视角）。该女性仰卧于一片郁郁葱葱的绿色草地上，草地上盛开着无数白色雏菊（中心为黄色）。她浓密健康、波浪状的黑色长发向四周自然铺散，发间精心点缀着几朵真实的雏菊，增添美学细节。表情与双手：面部表情沉静、优雅且自信。一只手优雅地置于腹部，另一只手略抬至胸前，以完全自然、符合人体解剖结构的手部姿态，轻柔托住一朵小巧的雏菊。服饰：身着一件高级缎面无袖高腰连衣裙，色调为柔和的淡黄色（浅青柠色系）。面料呈现奢华真丝光泽，柔美反光，凸显顺滑褶皱与高端昂贵的质感。配饰：左耳佩戴一对极简风格、微微闪亮的耳钉，部分被头发遮掩；左手腕戴一条纤细雅致的金色手链。环境与道具：背景：一片丰茂的翠绿草地，数百朵白色雏菊（中心为黄色）自然生长其间。其他道具：主体右上方放置一只高端编织草编托特包，配有深棕色皮革提带与白色布质内衬。包旁摆放一束新鲜粉玫瑰及搭配花材，强化奢华高定野餐（haute couture picnic）美学氛围。光线与技术品质：柔和的自然日光均匀照亮整个场景，在面部形成自然辉光，无生硬阴影。一抹微妙的轮廓光（rim light）勾勒出身体与发丝边缘，优雅地将人物与青草背景分离。高级时装杂志编辑摄影风格（high-fashion editorial photography style），使用85mm镜头拍摄，确保肖像细节锐利而自然。肌肤纹理超写实，清晰呈现细腻毛孔、脸颊柔润红晕，以及精准描绘的飞翼眼线妆容，毫无CGI感。画面采用电影感浅景深（cinematic shallow depth of field），超高清画质（8K分辨率），并叠加细微模拟胶片颗粒（film grain），营造高端典雅美学效果。

2117903200341230446.promptEn: Ultra-realistic summer beach portrait of a young woman with long wavy copper-red hair standing beneath a wooden beach pavilion during golden hour. Warm smile, natural freckles, luminous skin, soft natural makeup, and bright expressive eyes. Behind her are stacked blue surfboards, white sand dunes, beach grass, and a sunlit coastline. Golden-hour sunlight creates warm highlights in her hair and soft shadows across the scene. Coastal cottage aesthetic, beach vacation fashion, lifestyle editorial photography, realistic skin texture, photorealistic, highly detailed, premium travel campaign, wholesome summer atmosphere, natural color grading, 8K quality. 2117903200341230446.promptZh: 黄金时刻（golden hour）下，一位年轻女子站在木质海滩凉亭下的超写实夏日海滩肖像。她拥有一头长而波浪状的铜红色秀发，头戴一顶宽檐编织草帽，帽上饰有装饰性蝴蝶结；佩戴小巧的金色圆环耳环、精致的手链，以及一条低调的金色项链。她身穿一件红白格子细棉布背心，边缘饰有蕾丝，外搭浅水洗牛仔背带裤，其中一根肩带随意松开。面带温暖微笑，脸上有自然雀斑，肌肤透亮，妆容清新自然，双眼明亮富有表现力。她身后是叠放的蓝色冲浪板、白色沙丘、海滨草丛，以及阳光普照的海岸线。黄金时刻（golden hour）的阳光在她的发丝上形成温暖高光，并在整个场景中投下柔和阴影。沿海小屋美学（coastal cottage aesthetic）、海滩度假时尚、生活方式杂志摄影（lifestyle editorial photography）、真实肌肤纹理、照片级写实（photorealistic）、高度细节化、高端旅行广告大片、纯正夏日氛围、自然色彩分级（natural color grading）、8K 画质。风格：照片级写实（photorealistic）。相机：全画幅无反相机，50mm 镜头，光圈 f/2.0，ISO 100，平视视角生活方式人像（eye-level lifestyle portrait），浅景深（shallow depth of field）。布光：黄金时刻（golden hour）自然阳光，柔和前侧光（soft front-side illumination），温暖、欢快、沿海夏日情绪（coastal summer mood）。构图：竖版人像构图（vertical portrait framing），人物居中置于海滩凉亭正下方，背景包含蓝色冲浪板、沙滩、沙丘及海景。画质：8K 分辨率，超高细节，极致真实感。负面提示词：模糊、低质量、低分辨率、解剖结构失真、多余肢体、多余手指、不真实比例、塑料质感肌肤、过度修图、卡通、动漫、CGI、绘画、水印、文字、标志、手部畸形、重复冲浪板、背景杂乱、高光过曝、阴影生硬、图像噪点。

2117903200341230447.promptEn: A medium waist-up framing captures a confident adult male in mid-stride, his chest facing the camera while his head turns 45 degrees to gaze sharply off-camera to the right. He has a warm tan, bronzed complexion and a meticulously groomed, full, dense dark beard. His dark brown to black hair features a crisp high skin fade on the sides and back, blending into one and a half to two inches of length on top that is styled upward and slightly forward with a textured, matte-finish product, displaying natural thickness and slight, non-uniform variations in strand direction alongside a sharp temple line-up. His serious, guarded expression is accentuated by a closed neutral mouth and dark charcoal sunglasses that completely obscure his eyes. He wears a light cornflower blue button-down shirt paired with cream linen trousers. His left hand rests casually downward by his side with fingers naturally curled, adorned with a thin gold chain bracelet on the wrist and a gold ring on his pinky. His right hand is raised to shoulder height, where the index finger gently hooks over the collar of a light cream linen jacket slung over his slightly raised right shoulder, the thumb and remaining fingers pinching the fabric securely. He stands positioned slightly to the right of center in an outdoor Mediterranean setting, balanced by the negative space of a weathered, center-left midground stone archway. This traditional Apulian Trullo entrance is constructed from rough-hewn raw cut limestone and tufa blocks, featuring unfinished dry-stone masonry with deep crevices, irregular chipped edges, aged pitting, and a matte off-white and cream finish with subtle beige and gray undertones, framing a deep black void inside. In the background at the top right, a weathered conical stepped stone roof rises, while a few blurred thriving olive green leaves drop down into the top left edge of the foreground. A sun-drenched, warm Mediterranean afternoon bathes the scene in bright, soft natural sunlight with strong environmental bounce from the front-left, illuminating the subject's right side with a warm golden glow. Soft, gradual shadows fall under his right arm, along the left side of his face and neck, and deep within the stone archway, while preserved specular highlights accent his right cheek, nose, the upper chest of his blue shirt, and the sunlit edges of the textured stone. The split-complementary palette creates a sophisticated mood of relaxed, polished masculinity. Captured straight on at eye level using digital photography with a 50mm or 85mm lens at an aperture of f/4.0 to f/5.6, the shot features a medium depth of field that keeps the subject tack sharp while allowing the background architecture to become slightly softer at the extreme edges. Post-processing includes a gentle contrast curve, targeted sharpening on the hair, beard, and masonry, and color grading that enhances the warm golden hour tones to beautifully contrast the cool blue shirt against the warm stone and skin, all seamlessly framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.

2117903200341230448.promptEn: A young adult male with short textured hair and a neatly trimmed short beard stands facing the camera, dressed in a black t-shirt and beige striped shorts, his eyes entirely concealed by dark sunglasses. He holds a serious, deliberately posed expression with a closed, neutral mouth and relaxed shoulders, leaning back comfortably against a dark wooden structure. His relaxed left hand rests casually on the edge of the wooden bar, displaying a sleek silver watch on his wrist, while his right hand gently grasps a black smartphone resting near his waist against the bar. He interacts seamlessly with the foreground of an outdoor beach club, supported by a deeply textured dark espresso brown slatted wooden bar that features a satin finish, patchy color variations, dust, scuffs, and slight weathered edge wear, rooted on a solid dark gray concrete floor. The deep spatial depth transitions into a beautifully blurred midground showcasing a thriving dominant palm tree with vibrant green fronds on the left, accompanied by worn, closed beige canvas patio umbrellas flanking both sides, subtle lounge beds, and DJ equipment boxes, before giving way to a tranquil background horizon where a calm ocean meets the sky. The relaxed dusk atmosphere is bathed in warm, golden twilight lighting softly diffused from multiple sources above, establishing a calm, low-contrast mood. Short, gray-toned shadows with delicately soft, gradual edges pool naturally under his chin and behind him on the bar, while subtle specular highlights catch gracefully on his forehead, skin, and the metallic face of his watch. 2117903200341230456.promptEn: A confident male in his thirties stands deliberately posed with his body turned at a forty-five-degree angle, centering his weight with level shoulders. His hair features a high taper fade on the sides with a three-to-four-inch swept-back pompadour on top, styled with a matte product that reveals natural texture and subtle flyaways. He wears a dark charcoal gray textured suit over an unbuttoned crisp white shirt. His expression is sophisticated and composed, with a neutral mouth, no smile, and relaxed eyebrows, while his eyes are concealed behind round tortoiseshell sunglasses directed toward the left. His left hand, adorned with a silver watch and a gold ring, has fingers slightly curled as it grasps the left lapel of his jacket. His right hand, styled with silver and black bracelets and a silver ring, rests lightly on the right edge of the jacket near the button, creating an asymmetric visual hierarchy that draws the eye down the open collar to his hands and jewelry. He stands within a pristine indoor luxury interior of medium spatial depth, resting on a floor of solid white marble tile accented by gray veining. In the left midground, a prominent staircase built of matching white marble with gray veins features a glass railing and elegant brass trim. Behind him to the right, dominant warm cream sheer drapes hang in pristine condition, their soft vertical pleats creating vertical light and shadow streaks across the matte fabric. A single source of soft, natural window light streams in from ninety degrees to the camera left, establishing a sophisticated and luxurious mood with a warm temperature. This moderately directional light casts soft, gradual, short gray shadows across the right side of his face and body, while pristine preserved highlights illuminate his left cheek, the crisp white shirt collar, and his metallic jewelry. The ambient fill balances the medium contrast, accentuating a neutral but warm color profile heavily dominated by the charcoal gray of his suit, the crisp white of the shirt and stairs, warm cream drapes, and natural skin tones. Captured in the style of a high-end editorial menswear lookbook and luxury lifestyle photography using an 85mm lens set to f/2.8 at 1/200s and ISO 100, the realistic digital image boasts tack-sharp focus on the subject with a slightly soft background depth of field, finished with a subtle warm color grade, refined contrast enhancement, and localized sharpening on his face and jewelry to ensure a clean aesthetic, all perfectly framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230456.promptZh: 一位自信的三十多岁男性刻意摆出姿势站立，身体呈四十五度角侧转，重心居中，双肩水平。他的发型为两侧高渐变剃短（high taper fade），顶部为三至四英寸长、向后梳理的蓬巴杜造型（pompadour），使用哑光发品打造，呈现自然纹理与细微的碎发。他身穿一套深炭灰色肌理西装，内搭一件未系扣的挺括白衬衫。他的神情成熟而沉稳，嘴唇中性微闭、不带笑容，眉毛放松，双眼隐藏于一副圆形玳瑁色太阳镜之后，镜片朝向画面左侧。他的左手佩戴一只银色腕表与一枚金戒指，手指微屈，轻握西装左驳领；右手佩戴银色与黑色手链及一枚银戒指，轻搭于西装右侧靠近纽扣的边缘，形成不对称的视觉层次，引导观者视线沿敞开的衣领向下移至双手与珠宝。他置身于一处洁净的室内奢华空间，空间景深（depth of field）适中，地面为纯白色大理石瓷砖，饰以灰色天然纹路。画面左中景处，一座醒目的楼梯由同款白大理石（带灰色纹路）构筑，配以玻璃栏杆与典雅黄铜包边。他身后右侧，垂落着大幅暖奶油色透光窗帘，质地 pristine（ pristine），柔软垂直褶皱在哑光布面上投下纵向的明暗条纹。一束柔和的自然窗光自相机左侧九十度方向射入，营造出精致而奢华的氛围，色温偏暖。这束中等方向性的光线在人物面部与身体右侧投下柔和、渐变、短促的灰调阴影，同时纯净保留的高光点亮其左脸颊、挺括白衬衫领口以及金属珠宝。环境补光平衡了中等对比度，凸显中性偏暖的色彩基调：以西装的炭灰色为主导，辅以衬衫与楼梯的 crisp white（ crisp white）、窗帘的暖奶油色，以及自然肤色。图像以高端时尚男装画册（high-end editorial menswear lookbook）与奢华生活方式摄影（luxury lifestyle photography）风格呈现，使用85mm镜头、f/2.8光圈、1/200秒快门速度、ISO 100拍摄；该写实数字图像主体焦点锐利（tack-sharp focus），背景景深（depth of field）略带柔化，最终经微妙暖色调调色（subtle warm color grade）、精细对比度增强（refined contrast enhancement）及针对面部与珠宝的局部锐化（localized sharpening）处理，确保整体视觉干净利落，完美构图于4:5画幅比例之中。

2117903200341230457.promptEn: A cinematic high-contrast black-and-white portrait captured from a three-quarter side angle, featuring a confident man turning his face toward the camera while maintaining intense eye contact. His thick, textured dark hair is naturally tousled, complemented by a neatly groomed beard and mustache. Instead of lowering his sunglasses straight down, he lightly grips one temple of his classic double-bridge aviator sunglasses with his right hand as if about to remove them, revealing one eye more prominently than the other. A bold square signet ring with a dark onyx inlay is visible on his right ring finger. He wears a fitted black button-up shirt with the top buttons undone and sleeves slightly rolled, adding a relaxed yet refined look. Soft directional lighting from behind and to the side creates a dramatic rim light along his hairline, cheek, and hand while a gentle fill illuminates his eyes and facial texture. The background is a dark, softly blurred industrial wall with subtle texture and deep shadows. Ultra-realistic, editorial fashion photography, moody monochrome tones, fine film grain, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, premium luxury campaign aesthetic, photorealistic, 8K
2117903200341230457.promptZh: 一部电影感（cinematic）高对比度黑白肖像，以三分之四侧角度拍摄，展现一位自信的男性正将脸转向镜头，同时保持强烈的眼神交流。他浓密、富有质感的深色头发自然蓬松，搭配修剪整齐的胡 Beard 和胡 Mustache。他并未直接向下摘下太阳镜，而是用右手轻轻捏住一副经典双桥式飞行员太阳镜（aviator sunglasses）的一侧镜腿，仿佛即将摘下，从而更突出地显露一只眼睛而非另一只。右手无名指上可见一枚大胆的方形印章戒指（signet ring），镶嵌深色缟玛瑙（onyx）。他身穿一件合身的黑色纽扣衬衫，最上方几粒纽扣解开，袖口微微卷起，营造出轻松又精致的观感。柔和的定向光线从后方及侧方投射，在其发际线、脸颊和手部边缘形成戏剧性的轮廓光（rim light），同时一道轻柔的补光照亮其双眼与面部肌理。背景为一面深色、轻微虚化（softly blurred）的工业风墙面，带有微妙纹理与浓重阴影。超写实（ultra-realistic）、杂志级时尚摄影（editorial fashion photography）、情绪化单色影调（moody monochrome tones）、细腻胶片颗粒（film grain）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、85mm 镜头、高端奢华广告大片美学（premium luxury campaign aesthetic）、照片级写实（photorealistic）、8K

2117903200341230458.promptEn: A handsome man in a sharp, pitch-black double-breasted suit layered over a crisp white shirt stands perfectly centered in a medium-scale shot, exuding a sophisticated menswear aesthetic in a sharp, pitch-black double-breasted suit layered over a crisp white shirt with a defined V-neckline and a stark black tie. His posture is upright with level shoulders, facing the camera directly, while his head is turned sharply to the left in a strict profile. His sleek, slicked-back hair reflects the intense light, and vintage sunglasses obscure his eyes as he looks away with a serious, deliberately posed expression, his mouth resting in a closed, neutral line. Both of his hands are tucked away, resting relaxed in his suit pockets as he stands isolated against a deeply spacious, minimal coastal background. The top and midground are dominated by a pristine, sky blue expanse completely devoid of clouds, meeting a dark ocean blue at the bottom of the frame that is subtly textured with gentle waves along a perfectly clear horizon line. The scene conveys a confident, formal isolation driven by harsh, highly directional natural sunlight striking from the top right. This bright, hard light establishes a dramatic, cool, and high-contrast color palette, casting deep black, harshly defined short shadows directly under his chin, beneath his nose, and across the left side of his face. Conversely, crisp specular highlights are meticulously preserved on the right side of his face, his hair, and his right shoulder, with absolutely no ambient fill to soften the intense blacks and vibrant blues. Captured on an 85mm lens as a realistic digital editorial photograph from a straight-on perspective, the tack-sharp image features a medium depth of field with zero grain, utilizing camera settings of ISO 100, f/5.6, and 1/1000s. The classic fashion photography influence is finalized by post-processing that applies a high contrast curve, a blue channel saturation boost, and crisp sharpening to highlight the subtle warm skin tones, with the entire composition gracefully framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230458.promptZh: 一位英俊男子身穿剪裁利落的纯黑色双排扣西装，内搭挺括的白色衬衫，以中景构图精准居中呈现，整体散发出精致男士时装美学（menswear aesthetic）。西装为纯黑色双排扣款式，叠穿于挺括白衬衫之上，衬衫领口呈清晰V字形，搭配一条对比强烈的黑色领带。他体态挺拔、双肩水平，正对镜头站立，头部则 sharply 向左转至严格侧脸角度。他头发 sleek、向后梳得一丝不苟，在强烈光线照射下泛出光泽；复古太阳镜遮住双眼，神情严肃、刻意摆拍，嘴唇闭合，呈中性平直线条。双手自然插在西装裤袋中，姿态放松，独自伫立于一片开阔极简的滨海背景之前。画面顶部与中景被纯净天蓝色天空完全占据，无任何云朵；画面底部则为深邃的海洋蓝，沿清晰至极的地平线处，覆有细腻柔和的波纹肌理。整个场景传递出一种自信而正式的孤绝感，由来自右上方的强烈、高度定向的自然阳光所驱动。这束明亮、硬朗的光线营造出戏剧性、冷调且高对比度的色彩氛围，在其下巴正下方、鼻底以及面部左侧投下浓重、轮廓锐利的短阴影。与此同时，其面部右侧、发丝及右肩上则精准保留了清晰锐利的镜面高光（specular highlights），全图无任何环境补光，以维持浓重纯黑与鲜活蓝色之间的极致张力。本图以85mm镜头拍摄，采用正面视角，呈现逼真写实的数字时尚杂志摄影（editorial photograph）风格；景深（depth of field）适中，画质锐利无比，无任何噪点（grain），相机参数设定为ISO 100、f/5.6、1/1000秒。后期处理延续经典时尚摄影（fashion photography）风格：应用高对比度曲线（high contrast curve）、提升蓝色通道饱和度（blue channel saturation boost）、并施以锐化（sharpening），以凸显肤色中微妙的暖调；整幅构图优雅地置于4:5画幅比例之中。

2117903200341230459.promptEn: Ultra-realistic black-and-white editorial portrait, low-angle shot, 4:5 aspect ratio. The man fills about 85-90% of the frame in a medium close-up, showing the head, neck, shoulders, upper chest, upper arms, and part of the forearms, with only a small amount of empty space above his head. A handsome athletic man wearing a plain black fitted ribbed crew-neck short-sleeve sweater. His arms are loosely crossed. His body is turned slightly (20°) while his head is turned slightly to the left and tilted upward, with his eyes looking off-camera toward the upper left, giving a calm, confident, thoughtful expression. Strong hard natural sunlight from the upper left illuminates the left side of his hair, forehead, eye, cheek, nose, beard, neck, shoulder, and front arm, while the right side of his face and ear fall into deep shadow, creating crisp, high-contrast facial definition. Clean plain gray sky background, no distractions. High-contrast monochrome with deep blacks, bright highlights, sharp skin texture, fine-art fashion photography, ultra-realistic, premium editorial quality.
2117903200341230459.promptZh: 超写实黑白杂志风格人像（editorial portrait），低角度拍摄（low-angle shot），4:5 画幅比例。男子以中景特写（medium close-up）占据画面约 85–90%，呈现头部、颈部、肩部、上胸部、上臂及前臂一部分，头顶上方仅留少量空白空间。一位英俊健硕的男性，身穿纯黑色合身罗纹圆领短袖针织衫。双臂自然交叉于身前。身体微微右转（20°），头部略向左偏并微微上仰，双眼视线朝画外左上方望去，神情沉静、自信且若有所思。强烈而硬朗的自然阳光自左上方照射，照亮其左侧头发、额头、眼睛、面颊、鼻梁、胡须、颈部、肩部及前方手臂；右侧面部与耳朵则陷入深重阴影，形成清晰锐利、高对比度（high-contrast）的面部轮廓。背景为干净纯灰天空，无任何干扰元素。高对比度单色影像，暗部深邃、高光明亮、皮肤纹理细腻锐利，艺术时尚摄影（fine-art fashion photography）、超写实（ultra-realistic）、高端杂志级画质（premium editorial quality）。

2117903200341230460.promptEn: Create an ultra-realistic luxury lifestyle fashion portrait in a vertical 4:5 composition, inspired by the refined elegance of Mediterranean editorials and premium designer eyewear campaigns. The image should embody quiet luxury, effortless sophistication, and contemporary masculine style, capturing the atmosphere of an international luxury commercial advertisement. Feature a lean, athletic Mediterranean-European man between 26 and 34 years old with a strong angular oval face, defined masculine jawline, prominent square chin, and warm olive-beige skin with natural pores and a soft matte finish illuminated by warm Mediterranean sunlight. His expression is calm, thoughtful, reserved, and quietly confident, with slightly relaxed lips and his gaze directed away from the camera. His eyes remain hidden behind classic rectangular sunglasses featuring premium matte black acetate frames and polarized charcoal-black lenses with subtle daylight reflections, making the eyewear the hero element of the composition. His hair is medium-length dark chocolate brown with naturally textured soft wavy curls, full volume around the crown, and a slightly wind-swept appearance. A short, well-groomed designer stubble enhances the masculine aesthetic while preserving a natural editorial look. Style him in a tailored black fine-gauge merino wool or premium cotton knit sweater with a high crew neck, reflecting understated luxury and timeless European menswear. The overall wardrobe should communicate quiet luxury, premium casual fashion, and an old-money Mediterranean lifestyle without relying on formal tailoring. Pose the subject standing in a three-quarter profile with his head turned over his shoulder. Frame the portrait from the head to the upper torso with relaxed shoulders and natural body language that conveys effortless confidence and timeless sophistication. Use a tight editorial crop with the subject positioned slightly toward the right side of the frame, allowing generous negative space formed by a clean architectural wall. The visual hierarchy should naturally emphasize the sunglasses, facial profile, textured hair, and black knitwear. Photograph the scene outdoors against a warm beige limestone or stucco wall with subtle plaster texture, creating a minimal Mediterranean architectural setting free from distractions. The environment should feel exclusive, refined, and luxurious through its simplicity. Illuminate the portrait with soft late-afternoon Mediterranean sunlight coming from camera left, complemented by gentle natural fill light reflected from pale stone walls. The lighting should produce sculpted facial shadows, warm highlights across the skin, and a natural commercial finish with medium contrast. Capture the image using a 105mm portrait lens at f/2.8 from eye level to create strong portrait compression, shallow depth of field, and precise focus on the sunglasses, face, and hair texture while rendering the background softly

2117903200341230461.promptEn: A dramatic, high-contrast studio portrait of a man with dark messy hair and a well groomed beard, wearing black rectangular glasses and a dark olive-green collared shirt. He is leaning forward over the curved backrest of a black chair, gazing intently down towards the lens. The entire setting features a striking, solid vibrant crimson-red background wall that transitions into deep shadows toward the lower right, establishing a highly atmospheric and moody character aesthetic. He Is leaning forward with his head tilted down and slightly to the left, resting both forearms on the horizontal backrest of a chair. His gaze is directed downwards towards the camera with a serious, intense expression. He is wearing a smooth woven olive-green collared shirt, fully buttoned up with visible collar points and a center placket. The sleeves are rolled up neatly to his mid-forearms, creating fabric folds near his elbows. A chunky, dark signet-style ring is visible on the index finger of his left hand, along with a dark ring on his right hand. A metallic chain bracelet consisting of small interlocking links is wrapped around his left wrist. An eye-level, medium close-up shot that captures the subject from the waist up, focusing heavily on his facial expression, hair texture, and upper torso. Strong, directional artificial studio lighting coming from the top-left. This illuminates the left side of his forehead, nose bridge, cheek, and the wet sheen of his hair, while casting deep, heavy shadows across the right side of his face and shading the lower half of his body into near-total darkness. A bold, high-contrast color scheme dominated by the vivid red background, the dark olive green of the shirt, and the solid black tones of the hair, glasses, and chair. The background shows a soft vignette effect, appearing brighter on the upper-left and deepening into dark red behind the subject's left shoulder.
2117903200341230461.promptZh: 一幅富有戏剧性、高对比度的影棚布光（studio lighting）肖像，刻画一位拥有凌乱黑发和精心修剪胡须的男性；他戴着黑色矩形眼镜，身穿深橄榄绿色有领衬衫。他身体前倾，倚靠在一把黑色椅子呈弧形的椅背上，目光专注地向下凝视镜头。整个场景以一面醒目、纯色且鲜艳的深红色背景墙为特色，该墙面向右下方渐变为浓重阴影，营造出极具氛围感与情绪化的角色美学。他身体前倾，头部微微下垂并向左轻斜，双臂前臂平放在椅背的水平横档上。他的视线朝下直视相机，神情严肃而强烈。他身穿一件光滑编织质地的橄榄绿色有领衬衫，纽扣全部系紧，领尖清晰可见，前中门襟分明。袖口整齐卷至小臂中部，在肘部附近形成自然的衣料褶皱。左手食指上戴着一枚厚重的深色图章戒指，右手亦佩戴一枚深色戒指。一条由细小环扣相互咬合构成的金属链式手链缠绕于他的左手腕。采用平视角度的中景特写（medium close-up），画面截取人物腰部以上部分，重点突出其面部表情、发丝质感及上半身轮廓。来自左上方的强烈、定向人工影棚布光（studio lighting），照亮其额头左侧、鼻梁、面颊以及头发湿润的光泽，同时在右侧面部投下浓重深邃的阴影，并将身体下半部分隐入近乎全黑的暗影之中。整体配色大胆而高对比：以鲜明的红色背景为主导，辅以衬衫的深橄榄绿，以及头发、眼镜和椅子所呈现的纯黑色调。背景呈现柔和的晕影效果（vignette effect），左上方较明亮，而在人物左肩后方则逐渐加深为暗红色。
2117903200341230461.author: Heisenberg

2117903200341230462.promptEn: A confident man sits centered facing the camera in a crisp white shirt and dark sunglasses, exuding an effortless candid demeanor with a subtle, closed-mouth smile and relaxed eyebrows. His dark, wavy hair, cut to about three to four inches, features a tousled, unstructured volume with a natural matte finish, slight frizz, and visible flyaways. His shoulders are entirely relaxed as his weight rests symmetrically, with his left hand casually resting on a surface and his right hand organically grasping a glass tumbler in a fluid, relaxed gesture. He is layered seamlessly into a deep outdoor coastal setting, framed from above by thriving, dense leafy canopy vines in the foreground. The midground reveals a weathered, rough matte mid-gray stone masonry wall with patchy, visible mortar on the left, alongside a worn industrial fan mounted to the canopy frame on the right. He sits above a gray checkered tile floor, with the scene extending outward to a pristine background ocean marked by a perfectly flat horizon. The monochromatic atmosphere is rendered in a strict black-and-white high-contrast palette where the bright whites of the shirt and sky balance against deep black shadows and mid-gray midtones. Bright, natural light filters down from multiple sources above but strikes with a hard, directional quality, creating dramatic, harshly defined deep black shadows under the lush canopy, across his neck, and down the right side of his face, while meticulously preserving brilliant specular highlights on the shoulders of his shirt and the distant sky to evoke a sophisticated Italian Riviera summer lifestyle mood. Captured as a tack-sharp digital editorial photograph shot straight on at f/4.0, 1/500s, and ISO 100, the realistic image features a medium depth of field and distinct digital noise, refined with high-contrast curve adjustments to emphasize its organic visual style, all framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230462.promptZh: 一位自信的男性居中而坐，正对镜头，身穿挺括的白衬衫，戴着深色太阳镜，神情自然随性，嘴角微扬呈闭口微笑，眉毛放松。他的黑发呈波浪状，长度约三至四英寸，蓬松不羁、结构松散，呈现天然哑光质感，略带毛躁与细小飞发。双肩完全放松，身体重量均匀分布；左手随意搭在某处平面上，右手则以流畅而松弛的姿态自然握着一只玻璃水杯。他被无缝融入一处开阔的户外海滨场景：前景上方由茂盛浓密的叶藤枝蔓构成框景；中景左侧是一面饱经风霜、质地粗粝的哑光中灰石砌墙体，灰浆斑驳可见；右侧则有一台磨损的工业风扇，固定于藤架结构之上。他坐在一片灰色方格地砖之上，画面向外延展至纯净背景——一片澄澈海洋，海天交界线笔直平整。整体氛围为单色，采用严格的黑白高对比度配色方案：衬衫与天空的亮白色与深邃的黑色阴影及中灰中间调形成平衡。明亮的自然光自上方多个光源倾泻而下，但光线具有强烈的方向性，于繁茂藤蔓之下、他的颈部以及面部右侧投下戏剧化且轮廓锐利的深黑阴影；同时精准保留了衬衫肩部与远方天空上耀眼的镜面高光（specular highlights），以此唤起一种精致优雅的意大利里维埃拉夏日生活情调。本图以数码杂志级摄影风格直拍而成，参数为 f/4.0、1/500 秒、ISO 100，成像锐利无比；景深（depth of field）适中，画质带有清晰可辨的数码噪点（digital noise），并经由高对比度曲线调整（high-contrast curve adjustments）精细优化，以强化其有机视觉风格；整体构图采用 4:5 画幅比例。

2117903200341230464.promptEn: A young male adult stands centered, facing the camera straight on with leveled shoulders and a deliberately posed, confident demeanor. He exhibits a subtle closed smile, his relaxed eyebrows resting above eyes that hold a steady, direct gaze. His dark brown, medium-short hair is parted slightly off-center and styled back with a glossy pomade, revealing a slightly wavy texture with volume at the roots and a distinct natural imperfection of a single loose flyaway strand falling gently over his right forehead. He wears a warm beige zip sweater, his arms crossed relaxedly at his chest; his fully visible left hand rests on his right bicep, adorned with a silver watch, while his right hand is tucked under his left arm. He is situated outdoors in a deep, layered spatial setting where the background falls into a soft blur. Behind him in the midground, a vintage Haussmann building rises on the right with classic architectural molding and smooth but slightly textured aged matte plaster walls showing patchy warm beige-gray paint and neon reflections, while solid warm gray concrete grounds the environment. Weathered, leafless winter trees flank the left and center, and a worn black sedan and an SUV with glowing red tail lights navigate near a crosswalk with streetlights at the bottom right. Deep in the right-center background, the pristine silhouette of the Eiffel Tower is brightly illuminated against the sky. The serene Parisian twilight is infused with urban energy and a sophisticated, calm mood, dominated by a complementary palette of warm beige, sunset orange-yellow, charcoal gray, and striking accents of neon green glowing from the base of the architecture. Mixed, multiple soft light sources diffuse gently from above, providing a golden ambient fill with moderate intensity and low, flat contrast. Soft, short, and gradual gray shadows gather subtly under his chin and crossed arms, while preserved highlights catch naturally on his defined cheekbones and glossy hair. Captured as a realistic, tack-sharp digital photograph on a 35mm lens at f/2.8, 1/125s, and ISO 400, the clean, grain-free lifestyle travel aesthetic utilizes a medium depth of field and is elevated by post-processing that applies warm color grading in the highlights, lifted shadows, and enhanced neon green accents, all beautifully framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230464.promptZh: 一位年轻男性成年人居中站立，正对相机，双肩水平，姿态刻意而自信。他面带一丝含蓄的闭口微笑，眉毛自然放松，目光沉稳、直视镜头。他拥有一头深棕色、中等长度的短发，略偏分，用亮泽发蜡向后梳理，呈现出微微卷曲的质感，发根处蓬松有型，额前右侧垂落一缕自然散开的碎发，成为整体造型中一处鲜明的天然瑕疵。他身穿一件暖米色拉链毛衣，双臂在胸前自然交叉：左手完全可见，搭在右上臂，腕间佩戴一只银色手表；右手则藏于左臂下方。他身处户外，背景为富有纵深感与层次感的空间，远景柔和虚化（bokeh）。中景右侧矗立着一座复古风格的奥斯曼式建筑，拥有经典线脚装饰，墙面为平滑但略带肌理的哑光老化灰泥，呈现斑驳的暖米灰调漆面，并映出霓虹反光；地面由沉稳的暖灰色混凝土铺就。左侧与画面中央两侧分布着枝干嶙峋、尚未抽芽的冬日枯树；右下角人行横道旁，一辆磨损的黑色轿车与一辆尾灯泛出红光的SUV正缓缓驶过，街灯伫立一旁。画面右中后方远处，埃菲尔铁塔轮廓洁净清晰，在天空映衬下被明亮点亮。宁静的巴黎暮色中洋溢着都市活力，整体氛围精致而沉静，主色调为互补色系：暖米色、日落橙黄色、炭灰色，以及建筑基座处跃动的霓虹绿色（neon green）作为点睛之笔。多组混合的柔和光源自上方均匀漫射，营造出金色环境光填充效果，强度适中，对比度低且呈扁平化（flat contrast）。细微、短促、渐变的灰色阴影悄然聚拢于他的下颌与交叉的手臂下方；高光则自然地落在他轮廓分明的颧骨与亮泽的发丝之上。本图以写实风格拍摄，采用35mm镜头、f/2.8光圈、1/125秒快门速度、ISO 400参数，成像锐利如针尖（tack-sharp），呈现干净无噪点的生活方式旅行摄影（lifestyle travel aesthetic）质感；景深（depth of field）适中，后期处理进一步提升品质：高光处施以暖色调分级（warm color grading），阴影被提亮（lifted shadows），霓虹绿色（neon green）点缀被强化，最终以4:5画幅比例完美构图。

2117903200341230465.promptZh: 一位年轻成年男性居中正对镜头而坐，面露真挚、欢快的情绪：笑容开朗舒展，眼神放松，眉毛自然舒展。他留着短而略显褪色的头发，身穿一件敞开的米白色亚麻衬衫，布料呈现自然的褶皱纹理。他姿态放松，重心居中，双肩舒缓下沉，双手自然交叠于腰际， resting on his lap（置于大腿上），左手手指相互交扣，右手拇指随意搭在左手手背上。他坐在前景中，身下是一条洁净无瑕、表面完全平滑、哑光浅米白色的石膏台沿，台沿下方是纯白实心混凝土地面。他身后中景展开为一片深邃开阔的空间——幽暗的海水映照着天际明亮的光线。背景经焦外虚化（bokeh）处理，呈现出一幅生机盎然的橙色日落景象：炽烈橙光横贯深藏青色（navy blue）天空，天幕上缀有远处的城市灯火、码头结构，以及右侧几株枝繁叶茂的棕榈树的深色剪影。整幅画面浸润于温暖、明快且高度饱和的互补色配色方案之中，精准传达出轻松惬意的傍晚海滨度假氛围。布光采用极具戏剧性的组合：强烈的硬质正面直闪（intense, hard direct front flash）与落日暖金色逆光（warm golden backlight）并存，营造高对比度（high-contrast）视觉效果，且无环境补光（no ambient fill）。下颌下方、双手之下及双腿后方投下浓重纯黑阴影，边缘锐利分明；而前额、鼻梁及衬衫天然纹理之上，则保留了明亮夺目的高光（specular highlights）。本图以正向视角拍摄，是一张写实风格的数字生活方式旅行摄影（realistic digital lifestyle travel photograph），主体清晰锐利（tack sharp focus），景深（depth of field）适中；图像自带真实数字噪点颗粒（authentic digital noise grain），模拟相机参数为 f/4.0、1/60 秒、ISO 800 并启用直闪补光；后期经对比度增强（contrast boost）与暖色调白平衡（warm white balance）优化，自然构图于 2:3 画幅比例之中。

2117903200341230466.promptZh: 一位留着精心修剪胡须的成年男性，自信而严肃地以45度角侧身站立，位置居画面左半区中心；他双肩平直放松，身着轻盈的双排扣西装，内搭挺括的纯白衬衫。他的发型为两侧渐变褪色、顶部三英寸向后梳理，哑光质感定型，保留自然发质纹理，并带有轻微、写实的碎发飞翘。他展现出精致考究、一丝不苟的气质，面部神情中性、未展笑容，视线微微偏移，望向镜头之外。他刻意摆出的左手置于胸前中部，轻握西装驳领边缘，手上佩戴一枚戒指与一款利落方正的腕表——二者构成视觉层级中的次级焦点。他立于前景紧邻处一道坚实浅灰混凝土与石材砌筑的矮墙之后，以此锚定构图，再向深远空间自然过渡。中景与背景延展开一幅优美虚化的户外城市景观：远处一座风化柔和的穹顶建筑轮廓居画面左半区中心，静卧于广阔均质的开阔天空之下。全图严格采用单色黑白配色方案，主调为明亮浅灰，辅以深灰点缀与纯净高光白色；整体沐浴于明亮、高调（high-key）、自然漫射光之中，光源为单一前上方位置。这层柔润、环境式的光线均匀包裹其面部轮廓，在下颌与驳领下方投下短促、边缘柔和、灰阶渐变的阴影，同时在额头、鼻梁及富有纹理的发顶细腻铺陈微妙而明亮的高光，最终营造出一种优雅都市宁静感与专业沉稳气度。本图以数字摄影方式拍摄，呈现为写实风格的编辑类男装时尚肖像：使用85mm镜头，光圈f/1.8，快门速度1/250秒，ISO 100；正面视角精准聚焦于主体，凭借浅景深（shallow depth of field）使背景融为柔美焦外虚化（bokeh），最终以极低胶片颗粒（film grain）、细微的减光提亮（dodge and burn）后期处理、中等对比度曲线及自然构图的3:4画幅比优雅收束。

His face is framed by dark sunglasses that obscure his direct gaze, complemented by a closed, neutral mouth and relaxed eyebrows. He leans comfortably back against a wall, his body facing the camera while slightly turned to the left with relaxed shoulders. Both hands are deliberately posed, resting casually inside his front trouser pockets; his right hand is tucked deeply, while his left wrist reveals a metallic silver watch with a white face catching the light. The spatial depth is shallow, locking focus on the subject's interaction with the outdoor architectural elements. Flanking him symmetrically in the midground are pristine dark brown window frames, with the left window featuring multiple reflective panes and bordered by a thriving climbing plant displaying dense dark green foliage. In the bottom left foreground sits a small, weathered terracotta pot with a curved rim. Behind him is an aged plaster and stucco wall featuring a rough, matte finish painted in warm beige with subtle peach undertones, showing patchy, weathered color variations and uneven application from prolonged sun exposure. Beneath him rests a solid, light gray stone floor. A bright, golden, single-source natural sunlight washes over the scene from a 45-degree angle, establishing a warm, energetic, and casual mood without any ambient fill. This highly directional hard light creates dramatic, high-contrast deep black shadows with harsh, defined edges cast onto the peach wall to the right by both the subject and the architectural window framing. Specular highlights intentionally strike the crisp folds of the black shirt, the edge of his dark hair, the right side of his face, and gleam sharply off the silver watch face. Captured as a realistic digital photograph with a 50mm lens for a deep depth of field and ISO 100, the shot utilizes a fast shutter speed to freeze tack-sharp details from a straight-on perspective without any film grain. Influenced by contemporary street fashion and social media lifestyle photography, the structured composition is finalized with warm golden color grading, heavily boosted contrast, and intensive sharpening applied to the rustic Mediterranean textures, all flawlessly framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230467.promptZh: 一名年轻男性成年人居中站立于画面中，神情严肃、自信，略带防备。他留着短而深色的头发，蓄有修剪整齐的胡 beard，全身穿着一身全黑色服装：一件长袖纽扣衬衫，袖口卷至小臂，搭配剪裁合体的西裤。他的脸庞被一副深色太阳镜框住，遮挡了直视镜头的目光；嘴唇闭合、表情中性，眉毛自然放松。他舒适地倚靠在墙边，身体正对镜头，同时略微向左偏转，双肩放松。双手刻意摆出自然姿态，随意插在前方裤袋中：右手深插袋内，左手腕处露出一只金属银色手表，表盘为白色，在光线下熠熠生辉。空间景深（depth of field）较浅，焦点牢牢锁定在人物与户外建筑元素的互动关系上。中景左右对称分布着两扇洁净的深棕色窗框；左侧窗户由多块反光玻璃组成，边缘攀附着一株茂盛的藤本植物，枝叶浓密、呈深绿色。画面左下前景处摆放着一只小巧、风化明显的赤陶花盆，边缘呈弧形。他身后是一面老旧的灰泥与石膏墙面，表面粗糙、哑光，涂刷为暖米色，带有微妙的桃色底调，因长期日晒呈现出斑驳、风化的色彩变化和不均匀的涂料覆盖效果。他脚下是坚实、浅灰色的石质地面。一束明亮、金黄、单光源的自然阳光以45度角倾泻而下，营造出温暖、充满活力又随性的氛围，无任何环境补光。这种高度定向的硬光（hard light）在人物与右侧建筑窗框共同作用下，在桃色墙面上投下戏剧性强、高对比度的深黑色阴影，边缘锐利、轮廓分明。高光（specular highlights）刻意落在黑色衬衫 crisp 的褶皱上、深色发丝边缘、面部右侧，以及银色表盘表面，闪耀出锐利反光。本图以写实风格数字摄影呈现，采用50mm镜头拍摄，景深（depth of field）较深，ISO 100，快门速度较快，以正面视角精准凝固每一处细节，无胶片颗粒（film grain）。受当代街头时尚与社交媒体生活方式摄影影响，构图结构严谨，最终经暖金色调色（warm golden color grading）、大幅增强对比度（heavily boosted contrast）及高强度锐化（intensive sharpening）处理，着重强化粗粝的地中海质感，整体完美适配4:5画幅比例。

2117903200341230468.promptEn: A confident young adult male sits squarely in the center of the frame, angled straight toward the camera while leaning slightly to his left in a relaxed, seated posture. He is dressed in luxury Riviera-style casual wear, wearing a beige sand-colored knit polo tucked into linen trousers, with a brown-and-white striped sweater elegantly draped and tied over his shoulders. His left hand rests casually over the pristine back edge of the sofa, fingers softly curled downward and gracefully adorned with a gleaming gold watch and matching gold bracelet, while his right hand rests lightly on his right thigh with organically, naturally curled fingers. He is seated on a pristine white-and-cream outdoor sofa characterized by plush cushions and a visible black metal frame at the back, set upon a solid light gray-beige gravel surface. In the midground to the left, a large, weathered terracotta urn with an ornate lip rests heavily, holding dark soil. The softly blurred background reveals a low, rough-textured plaster wall completely overtaken by dense, thriving dark green climbing ivy, with a sliver of manicured bright green grass lawn peering over the ivy line on the right. The scene is bathed in bright, soft, diffused front lighting from a single natural source, casting a warm golden glow that perfectly captures a calm, affluent Old Money summer afternoon. Preserved specular highlights catch on his forehead, the tip of his nose, and the top ridges of the white sofa cushions, while short, gray shadows with soft gradual edges fall gently under his chin, beneath his arms, and downward from the cushions. The complementary color palette masterfully balances the dominant sand tones of his clothing and the cream furniture against the rich ivy greens and earthy terracotta accents with moderate saturation and medium contrast. Ultra-shallow macro depth of field, luxury fashion editorial photography, handcrafted couture atmosphere, impossible miniature realism, premium photorealistic textures, symmetrical composition, ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic, 8K, no text, no CGI, no cartoon, no fantasy, realistic proportions, square 1:1.
2117903200341230469.promptZh: 电影感微距时尚工坊场景，一位技艺娴熟的年轻女裁缝正用手工精细缝制一件微型高级定制礼服，这件礼服穿在一枚柔软丝绒针垫上端坐的、与她本人完全一致的微缩版自己身上。真人尺寸的女子与微缩人偶拥有完全相同的面容、发型、面部表情以及优雅的米色礼服，营造出无缝衔接的超现实尺度错觉。她正用一只手小心引导一根纤细的缝衣针穿过那件微小的服装，同时用另一只手轻柔地拉紧一根真丝丝线。这件微缩礼服配有精准缩放的纽扣、利落分明的接缝、逼真的褶皱、自然的布料垂坠感以及奢华织物的细腻折痕。工作台面上摆满金色裁缝剪刀、精密镊子、粉笔、尺子、裁剪纸样、线轴以及插在针垫上的各色大头针。温暖的电影感影棚布光（cinematic studio lighting）凸显出真实的皮肤毛孔、织物经纬纹理、丝线纤维细节、抛光金属反光以及柔和阴影。超浅景深（ultra-shallow macro depth of field），高端时尚杂志摄影风格（luxury fashion editorial photography），手工高级定制氛围（handcrafted couture atmosphere），不可能实现的微缩写实感（impossible miniature realism），顶级照片级写实纹理（premium photorealistic textures），对称构图（symmetrical composition），超精细细节（ultra-detailed），超写实（hyper-realistic），8K，无文字，无CGI，无卡通风格，无幻想元素，真实人体比例，正方形1:1。

2117903200341230470.promptEn: A handsome young man with a neatly trimmed dark beard and short textured hair stands facing the camera in a centered, full-body composition. He wears a slightly unbuttoned, bright linen blue shirt and crisp white linen trousers paired with beige suede loafers. His posture is comfortably upright with centered weight and relaxed shoulders, while his hands rest deep within his front trouser pockets in an organic, casual gesture. His expression is candid and calm, featuring a closed neutral mouth and relaxed eyebrows as his eyes gaze casually away to the left. He stands upon a warm, medium brown wooden resort deck where linear planks run diagonally toward the water, anchoring a deeply layered environment. Symmetrically framing him in the midground are pristine, neatly folded and tied olive green patio umbrellas alongside teak wood lounge chairs outfitted with thick olive green cushions and matching headrest pillows. Small, naturally weathered terracotta clay pots are scattered near the loungers. Beyond the deck, a calm horizontal band of smooth water reflects the clear, soft sky blue above, leading to dominant, tree-covered hills rolling from the top right to the center background alongside distant coastline buildings. The scene exudes the serene, warm mood of a relaxed luxury vacation evening, enveloped in natural, diffused golden hour sunlight. Soft, gradual gray shadows pool short beneath the subject and lounge chairs, casting gently to the right. The subject rests in even, warm ambient light, while bright, preserved highlights catch slightly on his right shoulder and face, with direct golden illumination bathing the peaks of the distant hills. The overall complementary palette vividly balances the cool linen blue and crisp white of the primary subject against earthy olive greens and warm woods. Captured straight on as tack sharp digital photography in a structured, contemporary travel influencer aesthetic, the image utilizes a 35mm lens at f/8 and ISO 100 for a deep depth of field that renders both the subject and the sweeping background in pristine, realistic focus. Subtle post-processing applies a gentle warmth to the color grading and lifts the shadows on the subject's face to effortlessly balance the diffused backlighting, culminating in a beautiful composition framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230470.promptZh: 一位英俊的年轻男子，留着修剪整齐的深色胡 beard，短发富有纹理感，正面向镜头站立，采用居中、全身构图。他身穿一件微微解开几粒扣子的鲜亮亚麻蓝色衬衫，搭配挺括的白色亚麻长裤与米色绒面革乐福鞋。他的姿态舒适挺拔，重心居中，双肩放松，双手自然地深深插在前方裤兜里，动作随意而有机。他的神情坦率而沉静：嘴唇闭合、表情中性，眉毛放松，双眼漫不经心地望向左侧。他站在一处温暖的中棕色木质度假露台之上，露台木板呈对角线方向延伸向水面，营造出层次深远的环境氛围。中景中，左右对称地布置着洁净崭新、整齐折叠并系紧的橄榄绿色庭院遮阳伞，以及配有厚实橄榄绿色坐垫和同色靠枕的柚木休闲躺椅。小型天然风化的赤陶土花盆散落在躺椅附近。露台之外，是一条平静水平的光滑水带，倒映着上方清澈柔和的天蓝色天空，并延伸至背景中央与右上角之间——那里是连绵起伏、林木覆盖的山丘，远处海岸线上的建筑若隐若现。整个场景洋溢着轻松奢华假期傍晚的宁静暖意，沐浴在自然、柔散的黄金时刻（golden hour）阳光之中。柔和渐变的灰影短促地聚拢于人物与躺椅下方，并向右侧轻柔投射。人物处于均匀温暖的环境光中；明亮且保留细节的高光略微跃动于其右侧肩部与面部；而直接的金色光照则洒满远方山丘的峰顶。整体互补色系鲜明协调：主角身着的冷调亚麻蓝色与 crisp 白色，与大地色系的橄榄绿及暖调木质形成精妙平衡。画面以正面视角拍摄，呈现锐利清晰（tack sharp）的数码摄影质感，风格兼具结构化与当代旅行博主（travel influencer）美学；使用 35mm 镜头、f/8 光圈与 ISO 100 设置，获得大景深（depth of field），使人物与恢弘背景均呈现清晰锐利、高度写实的焦点表现。后期处理细腻克制：色彩分级施加轻微暖调，同时提亮人物面部阴影，以毫不费力地平衡柔散的逆光效果，最终成就一幅构图优美的 3:4 画幅作品。

2117903200341230471.promptEn: A confident young woman in her late 20s standing full-body in a modern professional office, photorealistic, highly detailed. She has fair skin, striking green eyes, and dark brown hair styled in a stylish messy updo bun with soft loose strands framing her face. She is smiling subtly with a friendly, professional expression. She is wearing a tailored cream-colored blazer over a sage green satin button-up shirt, grey high-waisted tailored trousers with a slim fit, a black leather belt with a silver buckle, and black leather loafers. She carries a brown leather shoulder bag over her left shoulder and holds a tablet (iPad) and some documents/folders in her right hand. She wears a silver watch on her left wrist. The background features a contemporary office interior with warm wood-paneled walls, polished light wood flooring, recessed ceiling lights, potted green plants, a large monitor displaying business charts and graphs, and modern bookshelves. Soft natural and artificial lighting creates a clean, professional atmosphere. Sharp focus, cinematic composition, 8k photorealistic quality.
2117903200341230471.promptZh: 一位自信的二十多岁末期的年轻女性，全身立于现代专业办公室中，照片级写实（photorealistic），高度精细。她肤色白皙，拥有引人注目的绿色眼睛，深棕色头发被精心打理成时尚随性的松散发髻，几缕柔软的碎发自然垂落，轻柔地勾勒出她的脸庞。她微微含笑，神情友善而专业。她身着一件剪裁合体的米色西装外套，内搭一件鼠尾草绿真丝纽扣衬衫；下穿一条灰色高腰修身西裤，配一条黑色皮质腰带，腰带上镶嵌银色扣头；脚踩一双黑色皮质乐福鞋。她左肩斜挎一只棕色皮质单肩包，右手持一台平板电脑（iPad）及若干文件/文件夹。左手腕佩戴一只银色手表。背景为当代风格办公室内景：暖色调木饰面墙体、抛光浅色木地板、嵌入式天花板射灯、盆栽绿植、一台显示商业图表与数据图形的大型显示器，以及现代风格书架。柔和的自然光与人工光源共同营造出干净、专业的氛围。焦点锐利，电影感构图（cinematic composition），8k 照片级写实（photorealistic）画质。

2117903200341230472.promptEn: A young adult male stands centrally positioned with relaxed shoulders and a 45-degree turn, his closed neutral mouth and relaxed eyebrows forming a serious, candidly contemplative expression. His dark, short-to-medium messy textured haircut and stubble beard contrast sharply against his solid black crewneck t-shirt. His eyes gaze thoughtfully off-camera to the left. In the lower foreground, his right hand rests casually, only partially in frame, its fingers gently curled inward towards the palm holding an organic, gentle tension, featuring a prominent metal ring on the pinky finger. At his feet in the bottom left foreground, uneven, jagged coastal stones and sparse tufts of dark weathered grass ground the scene. The deep spatial depth reveals a vast midground of ocean water characterized by rippled surface textures reflecting light and visible horizontal bands of current, where a distant silhouette of a small boat floats to the left. In the deep background, silhouetted rolling landmasses stretch across the top horizon line, creating a vast, isolated natural expanse. A highly directional, hard natural light from a single source hits from a 45-degree side angle, casting bright, preserved highlights on his face and light gray textures across the water, contrasted by deep black, short shadows with harsh defined edges falling on the left side of his face from the viewer's perspective, under his chin, and into the deep folds of his shirt. The high-contrast monochromatic palette of deep blacks, mid-grays, and light grays enforces a serene yet emotionally intense atmosphere of quiet reflection, entirely devoid of ambient fill light. This cinematic, documentary-style portrait is captured with a straight-on perspective using digital photography, simulating a 35mm lens shot at ISO 400 with a fast 1/500s shutter speed to freeze the water ripples and a deep aperture to keep the sweeping background recognizable. The tack-sharp realistic image is finalized with an intense S-curve black and white conversion, crushed blacks, slight dodging on facial highlights, and organic film grain to enhance textural depth, all elegantly framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230472.promptZh: 一名年轻成年男性居中站立，双肩放松，身体向右偏转45度，闭合的中性嘴唇与放松的眉毛共同构成严肃而坦率沉思的表情。他深色、短至中长、凌乱带纹理的发型，与浓密的胡茬胡须，与其纯黑色圆领T恤形成强烈对比。他的双眼若有所思地望向画面外左侧。前景下方，他的右手随意 resting，仅部分入画，手指自然向掌心内微屈，呈现一种有机而柔和的张力，小指上戴着一枚醒目的金属戒指。画面左下角前景处，参差不齐、棱角分明的海岸岩石与稀疏零落的深色风化草丛，将场景牢牢锚定于大地。深远的空间层次中，中景为广阔海面，水面布满涟漪纹理，反射光线，并可见水平方向的洋流条带；远处一艘小船的剪影浮现在左侧。背景深处，起伏连绵的陆地剪影横贯顶部地平线，营造出浩瀚孤寂的自然旷野。一束高度定向、硬朗的自然光来自单一光源，以45度侧角照射，使其面部呈现明亮且保留细节的高光，同时在水面上投下浅灰质感；而从观者视角看，其面部左侧、下颌下方及T恤深褶处则投下浓重、短促、边缘锐利的黑色阴影。高对比度单色配色方案——深黑、中灰与浅灰——强化了宁静却情感浓烈的静默沉思氛围，全图完全摒弃环境补光。这幅电影感（cinematic）、纪实风格（documentary-style）人像采用正向视角（straight-on perspective）以数码摄影方式拍摄，模拟35mm镜头、ISO 400、1/500秒高速快门（以凝固水面涟漪）及大景深光圈（以确保辽阔背景清晰可辨）。图像锐利写实（tack-sharp realistic），最终经强烈S型曲线黑白转换（S-curve black and white conversion）、压暗暗部（crushed blacks）、面部高光区域轻微提亮（slight dodging on facial highlights）以及添加有机胶片颗粒（film grain）以增强质感深度，整体优雅构图于4:5画幅比例之中。

2117903200341230473.promptEn: A handsome, sophisticated man with sharp facial features, a strong jawline, and perfectly groomed light stubble gazes intensely and directly into the lens with a calm, confident expression. His dark hair is swept back with a natural side part, displaying subtle texture where individual strands catch the soft ambient light. He is dressed in a sharply tailored dark suit jacket accented by a dark patterned pocket square, layered over a crisp white dress shirt left casually unbuttoned at the collar. Sitting in a relaxed posture, his hands are raised to mid-chest, gently gripping the inner edges of his jacket lapels in a subtle adjustment, revealing the glint of a metallic wristwatch on his left wrist. He is seated in a plush, curved light-colored upholstered armchair pulled up to a smooth, veined white marble table in the immediate foreground, which holds a closed black leather notebook, a pen, a pair of folded dark-rimmed eyeglasses, and the partial view of a glowing ribbed glass table lamp. Behind him in the midground, the textured, arching fronds of a large indoor palm tree frame his head, while other patrons blur slightly into the ambiance, including a man seated to the left and a blonde woman relaxing at a softly lit table to the right. The background extends into a grand, high-ceilinged interior lounge featuring tall, dramatic dark vertical drapery, imposing architectural columns, and a softly illuminated arched glass display case. Rendered entirely in a rich black-and-white monochrome palette, the lighting is soft yet directional, carving out precise specular highlights on the man's cheekbones, his watch, and the polished marble surface, while deep, velvety shadows gather in the heavy folds of his suit, the curtain pleats, and the distant recesses of the room to forge a moody, luxurious atmosphere. Captured with a classic 50mm lens for an editorial fashion aesthetic, utilizing a shallow depth of field to isolate the razor-sharp subject against the softly blurred environment, processed with a high-contrast tonal range and subtle photographic film grain, framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230473.promptZh: 一位英俊、老练的男士，面部轮廓分明，下颌线坚毅，胡茬修剪得恰到好处、呈浅色；他目光锐利、直视镜头，神情沉着而自信。他深色的头发向后梳理，自然地侧分，发丝纹理细腻，在柔和的环境光下泛出微妙光泽。他身着剪裁精良的深色西装外套，内搭一件挺括的白色正装衬衫，领口随意敞开；外套胸前口袋中插着一方深色图案手帕。他以放松的姿态端坐，双手抬至胸前中部，轻轻捏住西装翻领内侧边缘，做出一个细微的整理动作，左手腕上一只金属表壳腕表随之微微反光。他坐在一张厚实、弧形设计的浅色软包扶手椅中，椅子被拉近至前景中一张光滑、带有天然纹路的白色大理石桌旁；桌上放着一本合拢的黑色皮革笔记本、一支钢笔、一副折叠起来的深色镜框眼镜，以及一盏正在发光的肋状玻璃台灯（仅部分入镜）。中景中，一株大型室内棕榈树富有肌理感、向上拱曲的羽状叶片环绕着他的头部；其他顾客则略微虚化融入背景氛围——左侧坐着一名男子，右侧则是一位金发女子，正倚靠在光线柔和的餐桌旁休憩。背景延伸至一处宏伟的高挑顶室内休息区：高耸而富戏剧性的深色垂直窗帘、气势恢宏的建筑立柱，以及一座被柔光点亮的拱形玻璃展柜。整幅画面采用浓郁的黑白单色（black-and-white monochrome）色调呈现；布光柔和却具有方向性（directional lighting），在男士颧骨、腕表及抛光大理石表面精准塑造出高光（specular highlights），而浓重如天鹅绒般的阴影（velvety shadows）则积聚于西装厚重的褶皱、窗帘垂褶以及房间远处的幽暗角落，营造出忧郁而奢华的氛围。使用经典50mm镜头拍摄，呈现杂志级时尚（editorial fashion）美学风格；采用浅景深（shallow depth of field），使主体锐利清晰，环境则柔和虚化（bokeh）；经高对比度（high-contrast）影调处理，并叠加细微的胶片颗粒（film grain）；构图比例为4:5。

2117903200341230474.promptEn: Create a highly detailed clean vector illustration of a young Kerala woman in a modern branded streetwear style, inspired by high-end anime vector aesthetics with crisp linework, smooth gradient shading, bold color separation, and ultra-sharp edges. She is shown from a low-angle three-quarter portrait, upper body only, with her head turned slightly over her shoulder toward the viewer. She has a subtle confident smirk with relaxed lips, half-open calm eyes, slightly raised eyebrows, soft eyelids, and a composed, self-assured expression. Her posture is relaxed with shoulders naturally lowered, neck gently extended, and chin slightly raised. Long jet-black hair is tied into a messy low bun with loose flowing strands moving naturally in the wind. Add a few thin front bangs framing the face, gently falling across the forehead and cheeks without covering the eyes.She wears matte black circular ear gauges and a premium oversized black high-collar windbreaker jacket with realistic stitched seams, snap buttons, structured folds, smooth nylon texture, subtle reflective highlights, and premium outdoor fashion branding inspired by Kerala urban street culture. A bright golden-yellow premium backpack with padded straps is worn over both shoulders, matching the background while remaining visually distinct through contrast and shading.The background is a completely flat vibrant golden-yellow (#FFD400) with no texture, patterns, gradients, or objects, creating a bold minimalist composition. Use strong color harmony with deep black clothing, rich golden-yellow accents, natural warm skin tones, and clean neutral shadows. Apply high-contrast vector lighting from the upper left, producing sharp highlights on the face, hair, jacket, and backpack while maintaining smooth gradient transitions. Skin tones should be soft warm beige with gentle blush around the cheeks, nose, and ears. Hair should have glossy blue-black highlights. The overall image should have a premium modern branding aesthetic, ultra-clean composition, high visual impact, perfectly balanced negative space, ultra-high resolution, commercial-quality vector artwork, sharp silhouette, flawless proportions, and professional graphic design finish.

2117903200341230475.promptEn: A candid, relaxed profile portrait of a young adult male seated and leaning slightly left, positioned on the right side of the frame. He has dark brown hair styled with a matte finish and organic volume, featuring tapered sides and a naturally wavy, curly top complete with natural imperfections, uneven sections, and a slight frizz that deliberately avoids an overly smoothed appearance. He wears a navy black short-sleeved button-down shirt and off-white trousers. His calm, unsmiling face displays a neutral, authentic expression as his relaxed eyes gaze off to the left. His right hand is raised casually to his collarbone, fingers gently curled inward to lightly touch his neck while revealing a silver watch on his wrist, and his left hand rests organically on the edge of a matte black round table with the index finger slightly extended. The foreground table holds a pristine leather-bound menu, a small round container, and a blue smartphone case, set alongside the worn rattan and wicker texture of his woven chair with a light cushion, all resting on striped light gray and brown wooden floor planks. This deep outdoor seaside lounge setting extends into a midground featuring a blurred but identifiable expanse of ocean water speckled with small anchored watercraft and golden reflections. In the deep background, a weathered, dark island silhouette cuts into the horizon. The atmosphere is bathed in a calm, sophisticated golden hour glow, heavily backlit by a highly directional setting sun that blows out the solar disc and paints the clear open sky in a smooth gradient from sunset orange at the horizon to warm gray-blue at the top. The hard sunlight creates a luminous rim light along the back of the subject's neck and textured hair, casting bright specular highlights across the ocean surface and the silver watch, while ambient fill light provides soft, diffused gray shadows on the front of his face and deep black shadows within the folds of his clothing and under the table. Captured as a tack-sharp digital photograph with a medium depth of field that isolates the subject against the beautiful bokeh background, the image is shot straight on with an aperture of f/2.8, a shutter speed of 1/250s, and ISO 100 to freeze the moment with minimal digital noise. The post-processing features a cinematic color grade that enhances the complementary warm orange and cool blue tones, applying high contrast to establish the harsh defined edges of the distant island silhouette while slightly lifting the shadow exposure on the subject's face to preserve delicate details, all masterfully framed in a 9:16 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230475.promptZh: 一位自然、放松的年轻男性侧脸肖像，他坐着并略微向左倾斜，位于画面右侧。他拥有一头深棕色头发，呈现哑光质感与有机蓬松感，两侧渐变收窄，顶部为自然波浪卷曲发质，带有天然不规则纹理、参差分缕以及轻微毛躁感，刻意避免过度顺滑的造型效果。他身穿一件藏青色短袖纽扣衬衫和米白色长裤。他神情平静、未展露笑容，面部呈现中性而真实的情绪，放松的双眼望向左侧。他的右手随意抬至锁骨位置，手指自然内弯，轻轻触碰颈部，同时露出腕上一只银色手表；左手则自然搭在一张哑光黑色圆形桌沿，食指微微前伸。前景中的桌面摆放着一本崭新精致的皮面装帧菜单、一只小型圆形容器以及一个蓝色智能手机保护壳；桌旁是一把编织藤椅，椅面带有浅色坐垫，藤编材质呈现出经年使用的粗粝肌理；整张椅子置于条纹状浅灰与棕褐色木纹地板之上。这一深景深的户外海滨休憩场景延伸至中景，那里是一片虚化但可辨识的广阔海面，散布着若干系泊的小型船只，并泛着金色反光。远景中，一座饱经风霜的深色岛屿剪影切割于地平线之上。整个氛围沐浴在宁静而精致的黄金时刻（golden hour）光芒之中，主体被高度定向的落日强烈逆光照射，太阳圆盘过曝，澄澈开阔的天空则由地平线处的日落橙色渐变为顶部温暖的灰蓝色。强烈的直射阳光在主体后颈与富有纹理的发丝边缘形成明亮的轮廓光（rim light），并在海面及银色手表表面投下耀眼的镜面高光（specular highlights）；环境补光则提供柔和弥散的灰色阴影，覆盖其面部正面，同时在其衣物褶皱内部及桌下形成深邃的纯黑阴影。本图以数码摄影方式精准捕捉，采用中等景深（depth of field），使主体从前景背景中清晰分离，背景呈现优美的焦外虚化（bokeh）效果；拍摄角度为正对主体，光圈 f/2.8，快门速度 1/250 秒，ISO 100，以凝固瞬间并最大限度抑制数字噪点。后期处理采用电影感调色（cinematic color grade），强化互补的暖橙色与冷蓝色调，通过高对比度凸显远处岛屿剪影的锐利硬边，同时略微提升主体面部阴影区域曝光，以保留细腻细节；全图以 9:16 画幅比例精妙构图。

2117903200341230476.promptEn: Create an ultra-realistic luxury fashion editorial portrait of a fair Mediterranean man in his mid-20s with a slim athletic build, photographed in a minimal black seamless studio. He stands upright in a relaxed pose, facing the camera with his chin slightly raised, projecting a calm, confident, mysterious, and timeless presence. His eyes are hidden behind matte black rectangular designer sunglasses with dark smoke polarized lenses, giving the portrait a refined, modern luxury aesthetic. He has an oval face with a sharp angular jawline, fair neutral skin with a natural matte finish, realistic skin texture with fine pores preserved, thick naturally defined eyebrows, a straight narrow nose, full matte lips, and very light designer stubble. His hair is deep espresso black, styled in messy textured curtains with soft natural waves, controlled volume, and a healthy matte finish. He wears a premium heavyweight black crew-neck T-shirt made from luxury cotton jersey with a tailored relaxed fit, without any accessories, emphasizing understated elegance and quiet luxury. The background is a smooth matte charcoal backdrop fading seamlessly into pure black. Illuminate the subject using a single cinematic softbox positioned 45 degrees to camera-left with subtle overhead fill, creating soft directional light, deep cinematic shadows that preserve facial structure, high contrast, and a very subtle rim light for gentle edge separation. Frame the image as a centered chest-up portrait at eye level in a perfectly symmetrical composition with minimal negative space and a 4:5 portrait aspect ratio. Capture the image as if shot on a Canon EOS R5 Mark II with an RF 85mm f/1.2L lens at f/2.0, 1/200s, ISO 100. Use a color palette dominated by matte black, charcoal, fair skin tones, and soft ivory highlights. Apply neutral-cool luxury fashion color grading with deep rich blacks, controlled white highlights, muted natural colors, and high contrast. Finish with premium editorial retouching that enhances the skin while preserving natural texture and pores, maintaining wide dynamic range, high clarity, and selective facial sharpening. The final image should feel like a high-end campaign for Saint Laurent, Tom Ford, CELINE Homme, Prada, or Vogue Hommes, delivering a minimalist, cinematic, commercial-ready portrait in ultra-realistic 8K quality.

2117903200341230477.promptEn: A striking middle-aged man with an intense, direct gaze looks slightly downward toward the lens, his strong jawline framed by a thick, meticulously groomed beard peppered with subtle hints of lighter brown and gray. His dark brown, wavy hair is styled upward with natural volume and texture, featuring delicate flyaways that catch the ambient rim light. He wears glossy tortoiseshell square-framed eyeglasses, the smooth acetate catching sharp specular reflections from nearby light sources. He is dressed sharply in a rich caramel-brown tailored suit jacket crafted from a heavy, textured fabric resembling wool or felt, layered cleanly over a crisp white collared dress shirt and a solid black tie with a subtle weave. He is positioned outdoors in a classic European urban street setting at night, with a grand, ornately detailed stone building featuring tall, curved bay windows and arched ground-floor doorways looming in the left background. To his right, the environment opens up to a receding city street lined with warmly glowing, out-of-focus streetlamps. The atmosphere is defined by dramatic, high-contrast directional lighting originating from the right, which casts intense, warm amber and sodium-vapor yellow highlights across the right side of his face, the frame of his glasses, and his jacket lapel, while plunging the left side of his features into deep, cinematic shadows in a classic chiaroscuro effect. This sophisticated, moody color profile seamlessly balances the rich earth tones of his attire with the golden luminescence of the urban night, captured with a shallow depth of field that keeps his facial features in razor-sharp focus while melting the distant street architecture and lights into a soft, glowing bokeh, reflecting the technical aesthetic of modern high-resolution low-light street portraiture, all framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230477.promptZh: 一位引人注目的中年男性，目光锐利而直视，微微向下凝视镜头；他轮廓分明的下颌线被浓密、精心打理的胡须所勾勒，胡须中隐约透出浅棕色与灰白相间的细微色差。他深棕色的波浪发向上梳理，呈现自然蓬松感与纹理感，几缕轻盈的碎发在环境轮廓光（rim light）中熠熠生辉。他佩戴一副亮面玳瑁色方框眼镜，光滑的醋酸纤维镜架从邻近光源处反射出清晰锐利的镜面高光（specular reflections）。他身着剪裁精良的浓郁焦糖棕色西装外套，面料厚重且富有肌理感，类似羊毛或毛毡材质；外套干净利落地罩在一件挺括的白色立领衬衫与一条纯黑色领带上，领带表面带有细腻织纹。他置身于夜晚的欧洲经典城市街道外景中：左侧背景里矗立着一座宏伟的石砌建筑，细节繁复华丽，拥有高耸弯曲的凸窗与拱形底层门洞；右侧则延伸出一条渐远的城市街道，两旁街灯散发温暖光芒，在画面中呈焦外虚化（bokeh）状态。整体氛围由来自右侧的戏剧性高对比度定向布光（directional lighting）所定义——这束光在人物面部右侧、眼镜镜框及西装翻领上投下浓烈的琥珀色与钠灯黄（sodium-vapor yellow）高光，同时将左侧面部特征沉入深邃的电影感阴影（cinematic shadows）之中，形成经典的明暗对照法（chiaroscuro）效果。这一精致而忧郁的色彩风格（color profile）巧妙平衡了服饰本身的浓郁大地色系（earth tones）与都市夜景的金色辉光（golden luminescence），并以浅景深（shallow depth of field）进行捕捉：人物面部特征纤毫毕现、锐利聚焦，而远处的街道建筑与灯光则柔化为一片朦胧发光的焦外虚化（bokeh），体现出当代高分辨率弱光街头人像摄影（high-resolution low-light street portraiture）的技术美学，整体构图采用 4:5 画幅比。
