2117903200341230480.promptEn: A handsome man in his early thirties with a serious, contemplative expression gazes intensely off-camera to his left with a subtle squint. His thick, dark brown hair is volumized and swept back, featuring a natural texture with visible flyaways and slight frizz catching the light around the edges. His face is defined by rugged, dense medium-length stubble that darkens naturally around his mustache and chin. He is dressed in a dark grey marled crew neck sweater layered under a glossy, slightly stiff black leather jacket featuring a structured, pointed collar and a distinct silver snap button on the right chest pocket flap. His shoulders are angled subtly in a confident, chest-up posture. Behind him, the shallow depth of field softly blurs an architectural midground and background, revealing out-of-focus whitewashed concrete walls and indistinct recessed dark structural geometry. Diffused, cool-toned natural daylight illuminates the scene, casting soft, realistic shadows beneath his strong jawline and the jacket collar, while producing sharp, bright specular highlights along the sleek, reflective shoulders and lapels of the leather jacket. The dominant color profile relies on the stark, moody contrast between deep blacks, textured charcoal greys, warm natural skin tones, and the bright, muted whites of the background, creating a dramatic, cinematic atmosphere. Captured with an 85mm portrait lens to achieve a shallow depth of field, the hyper-sharp focal plane rests precisely on his facial features and the jacket collar, embodying high-end editorial street photography with a realistic, crisp aesthetic, framed in a 2:3 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230480.promptZh: 一位三十岁出头的英俊男子，神情严肃而沉思，目光强烈地看向镜头外左侧，伴有细微的眯眼动作。他浓密的深棕色头发蓬松向后梳理，呈现自然质感，发丝边缘可见飘散的碎发和轻微毛躁，在光线下泛出微光。他的面部轮廓由粗犷浓密的中等长度胡茬勾勒而成，胡须在上唇与下颌处自然加深。他身穿一件深灰色混纺圆领毛衣，外搭一件光泽感强、略带硬挺感的黑色皮革夹克；夹克采用结构化设计，领口呈尖角状，右胸口袋盖上配有一枚醒目的银色按扣。他双肩微微倾斜，以自信的胸部以上姿态站立。他身后，浅景深（shallow depth of field）柔和虚化了中景与背景中的建筑元素，隐约可见失焦的粉刷混凝土墙面及模糊不清的暗色内嵌结构几何形态。漫射的、偏冷色调的自然日光照亮整个场景，在他棱角分明的下颌线与夹克领口下方投下柔和而真实的阴影，同时在皮革夹克光滑反光的肩部与翻领边缘形成锐利明亮的镜面高光（specular highlights）。整体色彩基调依赖于深黑、富有纹理的炭灰色、温暖自然的肤色以及背景中明亮而低饱和度的白色之间形成的强烈而阴郁的对比，营造出戏剧性、电影感（cinematic）的氛围。画面由一支85mm人像镜头（85mm portrait lens）拍摄，以实现浅景深（shallow depth of field），超锐利的对焦平面精准落在他的面部特征与夹克领口上，体现高端杂志风格街头摄影（high-end editorial street photography）的写实、清晰美学，构图采用2:3画幅比例。

2117903200341230481.promptEn: A confident adult male in his thirties stands in a medium waist-up framing, facing the camera with a relaxed fifteen-degree turn to the left. He has short, textured brown hair styled in a subtle quiff and a neat, short stubble beard, his expression serious yet candid with a closed neutral mouth and relaxed eyebrows visible above round, dark sunglasses that obscure his slightly off-camera leftward gaze. He wears a heavy black crew-neck t-shirt layered beneath a rich black suede zip-up jacket, the sharp focus highlighting the fine, matte grain of the suede fabric and the natural texture of his facial hair. His shoulders are level and completely relaxed, leading down to an organic, casual hand gesture at his lower waist, where his left hand rests with fingers naturally curled holding the edge of the jacket, while his right hand reaches gently across his torso to lightly grasp the jacket zipper and his left hand. He is positioned slightly center-right within a pristine, modern architectural interior characterized by medium spatial depth, balancing perfectly against a dominant midground feature on the left: a series of evenly spaced, warm brown vertical wooden slats that allow soft light to filter through their pristine gaps. Behind him on the center-right, the environment transitions into a perfectly smooth, matte warm taupe and beige painted drywall that fades further back into the subtle shadows of a clean, dark brown doorway frame. The sophisticated, relaxed luxury of the scene is illuminated by warm, golden, moderately directional mixed window and softbox lighting cutting across from a forty-five-degree angle on the left, casting subtle, elegant highlights across his forehead, nose bridge, left cheek, and the left shoulder of his suede jacket. This soft lighting creates gradual gray shadows that naturally shape the right side of his face, pool in the deep folds of his black jacket, and gently fall across the right side of the background, establishing a balanced, analogous palette of warm brown neutrals anchored by heavy rich blacks. Captured with the cinematic polish of modern commercial menswear editorial digital photography, shot straight-on using an 85mm lens at f/2.8, 1/200s, and ISO 400 to achieve a medium depth of field that isolates the tack-sharp subject against the softly recognizable architectural background without digital grain, featuring a warm color balance, a subtle contrast curve that preserves rich black tones, and gentle skin retouching, entirely framed in a 9:16 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230481.promptZh: 一位自信的三十多岁成年男性以中景腰部以上构图站立，面朝镜头，身体自然向左偏转十五度。他留着短而富有质感的棕色头发，发型为低调的蓬松式（quiff），下颌蓄有整洁的短胡茬；表情严肃却坦率，双唇闭合、呈中性状态，眉毛放松舒展，其上方佩戴一副圆形深色太阳镜，镜片遮挡了他略偏向镜头左侧的视线。他身穿一件厚重的黑色圆领T恤，外搭一件质感丰盈的黑色绒面革拉链夹克；画面焦点锐利，清晰呈现绒面革面料细腻的哑光颗粒感，以及面部胡须自然的纹理细节。双肩水平且完全放松，顺势延伸至腰部下方一个随性而有机的手部姿态：左手自然蜷曲，指尖轻搭在夹克下摆边缘；右手则轻柔地横跨躯干，指尖轻轻捏住夹克拉链与左手。他在画面中略偏右居中位置站立，背景为一处洁净现代的建筑室内空间，具有中等空间景深（depth of field）；构图完美平衡于画面左侧占据主导地位的中景元素——一组间距均匀、色泽温暖的棕色垂直木条，木条间留有洁净缝隙，柔光（soft lighting）由此柔和透入。其身后偏右中心区域，环境过渡为一片极为平整、哑光质感的暖灰褐色与米褐色乳胶漆墙面，再向后则渐隐于干净深棕色门框所投下的微妙阴影之中。整个场景散发出精致而松弛的奢华气质，由温暖、金色、中等方向性的混合光源照亮——包括来自左前方四十五度角的窗光与柔光箱（softbox）布光，于其前额、鼻梁、左脸颊及绒面革夹克左肩投下细腻优雅的高光。这种柔光（soft lighting）营造出渐变的灰色阴影，自然勾勒其面部右侧轮廓，积聚于黑色夹克深邃的褶皱之中，并轻柔漫延至背景右侧，构建出以浓郁黑色为基底、和谐统一的暖棕中性色调体系。画面采用现代商业男装时尚杂志数字摄影（commercial menswear editorial digital photography）所特有的电影感（cinematic）质感呈现：正向直拍，使用85mm镜头、f/2.8光圈、1/200秒快门速度、ISO 400参数设置，获得中等景深（depth of field），使主体锐利清晰，背景建筑细节则柔和可辨，无数字噪点；整体采用暖色调白平衡，搭配微妙对比度曲线以保留饱满的黑色影调，并施以轻柔的皮肤修饰处理；全图严格限定于9:16画幅比例。

2117903200341230482.promptEn: A confident man in a beige linen suit and sunglasses sits center-left, angled in a relaxed 45-degree turn while casually leaning to his right. His facial expression is neutral and deliberately posed, with his eyes obscured by dark lenses and his shoulders comfortably dropped. His left hand rests softly on his left thigh with fingers naturally curled, while his relaxed right hand is draped effortlessly over the edge of the boat, its fingers hanging loose. A subtle touch of dark burgundy serves as a striking accent against the textured beige linen of his attire. He sits upon the pristine white fiberglass floor of a boat deck in the foreground, where a highly polished stainless steel railing on the bottom right catches sharp reflections. Just beyond the deck, the midground opens up to a thriving, deep blue sea actively churning with crisp white foam from the boat's wake. The deep spatial depth reveals a slightly blurred background featuring a picturesque coastal town, dotted with pristine terracotta roofs nestled among rolling, tree-lined hills. The scene radiates the sophisticated, energetic mood of a luxurious summer evening on the water, heavily shaped by bright, natural, single-source hard light striking from a strict 90-degree side angle. This golden, warm illumination creates a dramatic, high-contrast atmosphere, carving harsh-edged, deep black shadows under the suit lapels, across the right side of the man's face, and sharply down onto the deck. He wears a highly saturated navy blue unbuttoned linen shirt complemented by clear-framed sunglasses and a single white wireless earbud. His medium-short hair reaches the nape of his neck and is styled in a slicked-back pompadour undercut variation holding a high-shine wet-look pomade that reveals distinct comb marks and organic separation. Natural imperfections give the hair absolute realism showcasing slight flyaways at the crown, uneven texture patterns near the ears, and organic clumping of strands rather than perfect smoothness, with volume concentrated at the front in a natural slightly off-center swept direction. He stands isolated within a deep outdoor urban street environment where the midground and background remain tack sharp. To the left midground, a weathered rough matte red brick building features exposed surfaces, visible mortar lines and multiple windows. The right background is dominated by an aged light gray stone and concrete building with large glass windows, architectural cornices, and dark trash bins resting at the concrete street level. Above it all, a small silhouette of a bird flies against the expansive negative space of a highly saturated sky blue canopy on the top left creating an asymmetric balance. The scene is bathed in bright highly directional hard natural front sunlight emitting a warm golden temperature that establishes a split-complementary color palette of striking warm tans, gray, and cool blues. This harsh single-source illumination carves out deep black short shadows with harshly defined edges under the subject's jaw, inside his shirt collar, and casting sharp angles across the right side of his face and neck. Intense specular highlights gleam on his forehead, the tip of his nose, cheekbones, sunglasses frames, and shirt buttons, entirely devoid of ambient fill to maintain a dramatic high-contrast energetic summer mood. Captured as a realistic digital photograph blending street-style fashion portraiture with contemporary lifestyle imagery from a low angle perspective, the shot is executed with a wide lens at a high aperture for a deep depth of field, an ISO of 100, and a fast shutter speed to freeze details, then treated with enhanced blue and orange-teal color grading, sharp clarity, and high contrast adjustments, framed perfectly in a 4:5 aspect ratio.

He stands with his shoulders angled slightly away from the camera, his head lifted about 30 degrees upward, looking into the distance behind matte black rectangular designer sunglasses with dark smoke polarized lenses. His expression is calm, confident, and effortlessly stylish. He has a strong oval face with a sculpted jawline, light olive skin rendered entirely in monochrome with a natural matte finish, realistic skin texture, dense naturally shaped eyebrows, a straight masculine nose, medium-full neutral lips, and a neatly groomed designer short beard connected to a mustache. His hair is deep black, medium length, naturally curly, thick, voluminous, and softly matte. He wears an oversized premium black insulated puffer jacket made from technical matte nylon with a fully raised high stand-up collar, creating a bold luxury silhouette inspired by Moncler, Prada, Saint Laurent, Balenciaga, Off-White, and Vogue Hommes editorials. The portrait is set against a perfectly smooth, seamless, vibrant saturated yellow studio backdrop, creating a striking selective-color effect. The subject remains completely monochrome while the yellow background retains its full, vivid saturation, resulting in a bold pop-art-inspired editorial aesthetic. Light the scene with a professional studio softbox setup using a large diffused key light positioned 45 degrees camera-left, complemented by subtle fill lighting, medium contrast, clean fashion shadows, and evenly illuminated high-key background lighting. Compose the image as a tight chest-up portrait in a 4:5 aspect ratio, photographed from a slightly below eye-level angle, emphasizing the subject's face, sunglasses, and dramatic jacket collar with minimal negative space. Capture the image using a Canon EOS R5 Mark II with an RF 85mm f/1.2L USM lens at f/2.2, 1/200 second shutter speed, ISO 100, producing exceptional sharpness with soft background separation. Apply premium commercial editorial retouching while preserving natural skin texture, realistic facial details, and fabric textures. Use high clarity, wide dynamic range, deep rich blacks, clean highlights, and high-contrast editorial color grading. The subject should remain fully monochrome while the background stays vividly yellow, creating a modern graphic composition suitable for a luxury fashion campaign. Ultra-realistic, 8K resolution, commercial-ready, minimal editorial styling, selective color, yellow backdrop, luxury puffer jacket, designer sunglasses, modern menswear, bold graphic composition.

2117903200341230495.promptEn: A man stands centrally composed in a medium shot, his body angled in a 45 degree turn with level shoulders and a balanced weight distribution, dressed sharply in a black double breasted tuxedo over a crisp white shirt and collar. His hair is styled in a pompadour with three inches of top volume, tight faded sides, and visible texture from strong hold product, complete with minor natural flyaways. His expression is candid and serious, featuring a closed neutral mouth, furrowed eyebrows, and an intense downward gaze. Caught mid motion in a tense gesture, his left hand extends forward with an exposed wrist and slightly curled fingers adorned with two rings, while his right hand firmly pinches the left shirt cuff with his thumb and index finger to adjust the sleeve. In the blurred foreground at the bottom left, the top of a woman's styled dark pulled back hair is visible, leading into a layered red carpet event setting with shallow spatial depth. Behind the man, a solid light gray carpet grounds the scene, while the deeply out of focus background reveals patchy dark gray silhouettes of a bustling crowd, worn telephoto camera lenses clustered in the top right, and the obscured legs of a bystander in the mid right. A dramatic, high contrast monochromatic black and white color palette infuses the scene with tense glamour. Highly directional hard light from multiple top front sources casts bright, preserved highlights across the man's forehead, nose bridge, and the knuckles of his adjusting hands, while casting harsh, short, deep black shadows with sharply defined edges beneath his chin, along his jawline, and deep within the folds of his tuxedo, balanced by a neutral ambient fill. Captured with straight on perspective digital photography utilizing a fast shutter speed, an open f/2.8 aperture, and ISO 400 to achieve tack sharp focus on the subject amidst minimal digital noise. The realistic, paparazzi influenced editorial style is enhanced in post processing through stark black and white conversion, crushed blacks, and high clarity, culminating in a sophisticated image framed in a 9:16 aspect ratio.

2117903200341230496.promptEn: A stylishly dressed man walks confidently forward toward the camera, his weight naturally shifted and shoulders relaxed as he steps along a landscaped garden path. His short hair, about one to two inches on top, is styled back with a natural-finish product, intricately detailed with natural growth patterns, slight texture variations, and minor flyaways to avoid an artificially flat look, while the sides are neatly trimmed without a deep fade. He wears a dark navy, almost black, long-sleeve quarter-zip knit sweater that contrasts sharply against his crisp, bright white tailored trousers and dark leather dress shoes. His serious, candid expression features a closed, neutral mouth and relaxed eyebrows, his eyes completely obscured by dark aviator-style sunglasses catching subtle, soft reflection highlights on the lenses. His left hand is tucked cleanly into his trouser pocket so that only his wrist, bearing a silver watch, and the edge of his hand are minimally visible, while his organically relaxed right hand is raised to his ear, lightly holding a white smartphone with fingers naturally curled around its back and edges, catching a faint highlight along the top edge of the device. He is grounded in the foreground on weathered, rough-hewn rectangular light gray stone slabs set directly into medium green grass, casting short, faint, soft-edged shadows directly beneath his shoes and slightly behind the pavers. In the midground, a dense, thriving dark green manicured boxwood hedge forms a neatly squared horizontal band, punctuated on the right by two distinct, tall Italian cypress trees projecting vertically into the sky. The deep, slightly blurred background opens up to a sprawling landscape where a calm body of desaturated blue-gray water meets a sweeping, sloping mountain range faintly dotted with small white structures. The environment is bathed in cool, soft, diffused natural daylight from a single overhead overcast sky, casting a calm, moody, and sophisticated atmosphere of quiet luxury. The color profile emphasizes cool temperatures and complementary contrast, juxtaposing the stark black and white of the man's attire against the muted pine greens of the foliage and the desaturated background. Captured straight on at eye level as a highly photorealistic digital photograph using an 85mm lens with a fast aperture, the cinematic editorial shot features tack-sharp focus on the subject with a medium depth of field resolving into soft background bokeh, finished with subtle digital noise, slightly lowered exposure, and crisp cool tones, all beautifully framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230496.promptZh: 一位衣着时尚的男士自信地朝镜头方向阔步前行，重心自然偏移，双肩放松，沿着一条精心打理的花园小径迈步。他头顶短发约一至两英寸长，以哑光质感造型产品向后梳理，发丝细节丰富：呈现自然生长纹理、细微质感差异及少量自然翘起的碎发，避免人工压平的呆板感；两侧则修剪整齐，未采用深渐变（deep fade）处理。他身穿一件深海军蓝、近乎纯黑的长袖四分之一拉链针织衫，与 crisp、亮白的修身西裤及深色真皮正装皮鞋形成强烈对比。他神情严肃而自然，双唇闭合、中性微抿，眉毛放松舒展，双眼完全被一副深色飞行员风格太阳镜遮挡，镜片上泛出柔和、微妙的反射高光。他的左手干净利落地插在西裤口袋中，仅露出佩戴银色腕表的手腕及手部边缘；右手则自然放松，抬至耳畔，轻握一部白色智能手机，手指自然弯曲包覆手机背面与边缘，在设备顶部边缘捕捉到一道微弱高光。他稳稳立于前景，脚下是直接嵌入中绿色草坪中的风化粗凿浅灰色矩形石板，鞋底正下方及石板后方投下短而淡、边缘柔化的阴影。中景处，一排浓密茂盛、深绿修剪齐整的黄杨篱笆构成一条规整的水平带状结构，右侧点缀着两株挺拔高耸的意大利柏树，垂直伸向天空。背景深远且略带虚化，展开为一片辽阔景观：一片去饱和度的蓝灰色静谧水域与一道绵延起伏的山脉相接，山峦上零星散布着若干小型白色建筑。整个环境沐浴在单一阴天顶光所散发的清冷、柔和、漫射的自然日光中，营造出宁静、沉郁又精致考究的低调奢华氛围。色彩配置强调冷色调与互补对比，将人物服饰强烈的黑白配色，与 foliage 的低饱和松绿色及背景的去饱和色调并置呈现。本图以平视角度、人眼高度正面拍摄，是一幅高度照片级写实（photorealistic）的数字摄影图像，使用 85mm 镜头配合大光圈；这幅电影感（cinematic）编辑风格影像主体焦点锐利清晰，景深（depth of field）适中，背景自然过渡为柔和焦外虚化（bokeh），最终成片辅以细微数字噪点、略微降低的曝光值及清冽锐利的冷色调，整体以 4:5 画幅比例完美构图。

2117903200341230497.promptZh: 超写实（ultra-realistic）杂志风格时尚摄影，一位年轻的东亚女性站在无边无际盛开的明黄色油菜花田中央，头顶是澄澈深邃的蔚蓝天空。采用略低角度、三分之四侧脸构图，她正缓缓转头回望镜头，神情平静而梦幻。一只手臂自然伸向观者，仿佛邀其同行，营造出强烈的纵深感与透视效果。她的姿态放松，身体带有微妙扭转，双肩舒展，动作自然流畅。她留有齐肩长丝滑黑发，额前垂着柔和蓬松的空气刘海；肌肤如瓷般光滑，妆容温暖自然，唇色为光泽珊瑚红，眼型为深色杏仁状，脸颊旁有一颗小巧美人痣。她身穿一件精致白色花卉纹样紧身抹胸背心，肩带纤细；颈间系一条白色蕾丝丝带；外搭一件宽松 oversized 蓝色格纹衬衫，随意地滑落于单肩；下着一袭飘逸高腰白色长裙。腕上佩戴一只简约木质手镯。背景中，明黄色花朵绵延至天际线，远处起伏着青翠山峦，夏日晴空万里无云。明亮的黄金时刻阳光在她面部与发丝上投下柔和自然的高光，形成真实阴影、电影感景深（cinematic depth）与浓郁的色彩对比。使用 Sony A7R V 相机搭配 85mm f/1.4 GM 镜头拍摄，浅景深（shallow depth of field）、奶油般焦外虚化（creamy bokeh）、HDR、超精细皮肤纹理、真实布料褶皱、自然发丝细节、逼真光影（lifelike lighting）、高动态范围（high dynamic range）、锐利焦点（crisp focus）、电影级构图（cinematic composition）、杂志风格时尚摄影（editorial fashion style）、高端旅行摄影（premium travel photography）、鲜活色彩（vibrant colors）、8K UHD、照片级写实（photorealistic）、杰作（masterpiece）、获奖摄影（award-winning photography）、无文字（no text）、无水印（no watermark）、无标识（no logo）、无伪影（no artifacts）、无畸变（no distortion）、无多余手指（no extra fingers）、解剖结构准确（anatomically correct）、比例自然（natural proportions）。

2117903200341230498.promptEn: A confident young male model stands centered facing the camera, radiating a posed yet leisurely confidence. He features a medium-short wavy layered haircut, roughly three to four inches on top and reaching the nape of his neck, styled back with a glossy, wet-look pomade that retains its natural texture, revealing delicate flyaways and a slight frizz at the crown. He is dressed in a navy blue long-sleeve knit polo shirt with two crisp white buttons undone, paired with dark trousers. His neutral, closed mouth conveys sophisticated composure beneath black angular sunglasses. His right hand is raised deliberately to his face, with the index finger and thumb lightly gripping the bottom rim of the sunglasses in a precise adjustment gesture, while his left hand rests naturally near his waist with fingers slightly curled inward, partially obscured by his dark trousers and the surrounding shadows. He stands on the outdoor deck of a luxury yacht with warm light brown striped teak wood flooring underfoot. In the pristine foreground to his left, three horizontal tubular bars of stainless steel boat railings and a smooth, glossy white and gray fiberglass curved deck structure anchor the layered composition. Beyond the deck, a deep spatial background reveals a glamorous maritime expanse where a small classic wooden speedboat with a dark hull and passengers in white cruises through the right midground, while two pristine, large white multi-deck superyachts with dark tinted windows and an extended aft deck float in the distant deep blue sea. The sun-drenched Riviera atmosphere is defined by bright, single-source natural sunlight from above, creating a highly directional and energetic hard light. This intense illumination throws a harsh, deep black, long shadow diagonally across the subject's lower torso, right arm, and legs from an off-camera object, establishing an asymmetric, high-contrast visual hierarchy. Cool, highly saturated tones of navy, ocean, and sky blue dominate the monochromatic scene, punctuated by bright white accents and extreme specular highlights gleaming off the chrome fixtures, metal railings, polished fiberglass, and the subject's glossy hair and forehead. Captured as a tack sharp, straight-on digital commercial photograph using a 50mm lens at f/8, 1/1000s, and ISO 100, the realistic image features a deep depth of field with absolute clarity and zero grain, enhanced by blue color grading in the shadows and sky, increased overall contrast, and deep crushed blacks to cement the wealthy luxury lifestyle aesthetic, all perfectly framed in a 2:3 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230498.promptZh: 一位自信的年轻男性模特居中站立，正对镜头，散发出一种摆拍感与闲适感兼具的自信气质。他留着中短波浪层次剪裁发型，顶部发长约为三至四英寸，后颈处发尾齐整，用带有光泽感的湿发造型膏向后打理，保留自然纹理，隐约可见细碎飘起的发丝及头顶轻微毛躁感。他身穿一件藏青色长袖针织Polo衫，领口两颗纯白纽扣解开，下身搭配深色长裤。他面无表情、双唇微闭，黑色棱角分明的太阳镜之下透出沉稳而精致的从容气度。他的右手刻意抬至面部，食指与拇指轻捏住太阳镜下缘，做出精准调整姿态；左手则自然垂落于腰侧，手指微微内屈，部分被深色长裤及周围阴影遮挡。他站在一艘豪华游艇的户外甲板上，脚下是暖调浅棕色条纹柚木甲板。画面左侧前景洁净清晰：三根水平不锈钢船用栏杆呈管状排列，旁有一道光滑、高光感的灰白色玻璃钢弧形甲板结构，共同锚定画面的层次构成。甲板之外，纵深开阔的背景展现一片迷人海景——右中景处，一艘小型经典木质快艇正穿行而过，艇身为深色，乘客身着白衣；远处深蓝海面上，两艘崭新硕大的白色多层超级游艇静静漂浮，舷窗为深色镀膜玻璃，艇尾甲板延伸悠长。阳光明媚的里维埃拉（Riviera）氛围由来自上方的明亮单光源自然日光定义，形成高度定向且富有能量的硬光（hard light）。这强烈光照从画外某物体投下一道浓重、漆黑、修长的阴影，斜跨模特下躯干、右臂与双腿，构建出非对称、高对比度的视觉层级。藏青、海洋蓝与天空蓝等冷色调高度饱和，在单色系场景中占据主导，其间点缀明快的白色高光，并有极强镜面高光（specular highlights）闪耀于镀铬配件、金属栏杆、抛光玻璃钢表面，以及模特油亮的发丝与前额。本图以50mm镜头、f/8光圈、1/1000秒快门、ISO 100参数拍摄，呈现锐利无比、正面直拍的数字商业摄影风格；景深（depth of field）深远，全图绝对清晰、毫无噪点；经蓝色影调分级（blue color grading）强化阴影与天空色彩，整体对比度提升，并压暗至深邃纯黑，以夯实奢华富裕生活方式的美学基调；构图完美契合2:3画幅比例。

2117903200341230501.promptEn: A highly refined contemporary mixed-media portrait style combining an ethereal high-key fashion aesthetic with intricate concentric contour-line artwork inspired by natural growth rings and fingerprint-like topographic patterns. The human subject should retain an elegant, soft, luminous, almost dreamlike presence while the entire visual structure is organically constructed through hundreds of delicate continuous concentric and flowing contour lines. Replace conventional flat shading and ordinary outlines with dense nested curved lines that follow the anatomy and three-dimensional structure of the human form. The lines should naturally conform to the contours of the face, forehead, cheeks, nose, lips, jaw, neck, shoulders, clothing, and hair, creating the illusion that the entire subject is sculpted from flowing rings and fine engraved contours. The line patterns should behave like organic topographic growth rings rather than geometric circles. Lines continuously expand, contract, bend, merge, separate, and change direction according to the underlying form. Around the eyes, nose, lips, and facial planes, the contours become tightly concentrated and delicately curved; across larger surfaces they gradually spread into wider flowing rings. Hair should be constructed from extremely fine flowing contour strands, with hundreds of elongated curved lines sweeping outward and merging into larger concentric patterns. The hair should feel weightless and fluid, almost dissolving into the surrounding background while maintaining an intricate line-based structure. Preserve the reference's soft luminous skin, delicate facial modeling, subtle blush, translucent highlights, pale neutral tones, and graceful editorial beauty. The human form should remain recognizable and aesthetically refined beneath the contour-line construction rather than becoming an abstract pattern. Introduce selective high-density black and charcoal contour areas to create depth and visual emphasis. Lines become progressively darker and closer together in recessed areas and shadow regions, while highlights contain sparse, extremely fine pale-gray lines and larger areas of negative space. This creates tonal values entirely through line density and spacing, rather than conventional painted shading. Allow portions of the contour lines to extend beyond the silhouette, forming expansive organic rings and flowing arcs around the subject. These external lines should gradually fade, break apart, become thinner, and dissolve into the background, creating an atmospheric transition between the human figure and the surrounding space. Use a predominantly luminous ivory, white, soft gray, pale beige, and subtle natural skin-tone palette, with deep charcoal-black lines providing controlled contrast. Maintain a clean, airy, almost monochromatic elegance while preserving subtle full-color skin undertones. The surface should have a fine tactile paper or archival-art texture
2117903200341230501.promptZh: 一种高度精炼的当代混合媒介肖像风格，融合空灵高调（high-key）时尚美学与受自然年轮及指纹状地形图纹理启发的精细同心轮廓线艺术。人物主体应保持优雅、柔和、明亮、近乎梦幻般的存在感，而整体视觉结构则通过数百条细腻连续的同心流动轮廓线有机构建。摒弃传统的平面阴影与普通外轮廓线，代之以密集嵌套的曲线线条，这些线条严格遵循人体解剖结构与三维形体走向。线条须自然贴合面部、额头、面颊、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌、颈部、肩部、服饰及发丝的轮廓，营造出整个主体仿佛由流动环带与精细蚀刻轮廓雕琢而成的视觉幻象。线条纹样应呈现为有机的地形生长环（topographic growth rings），而非几何圆形：线条持续扩张、收缩、弯曲、融合、分离，并随底层形体变化方向；在眼周、鼻部、唇部及面部各朝向平面上，轮廓线紧密聚集且纤巧弯曲；在较大面积表面，则渐次舒展为更宽幅的流动环带。发丝应由极纤细的流动轮廓线束构成，数百条拉长的弧线向外 sweeping 并汇入更大的同心图案；发丝需呈现失重感与流动性，几近消融于背景之中，同时维持繁复的纯线条结构。保留参考图像中柔和明亮的肌肤质感、细腻的面部塑形、微妙的红晕、半透明高光、浅淡中性色调，以及优雅的杂志级（editorial）美感。人物形态须在轮廓线结构之下依然清晰可辨且审美精雅，而非沦为抽象图案。有选择地引入高密度黑色与炭笔（charcoal）轮廓区域，以营造纵深感与视觉强调效果：凹陷区域与阴影部位线条渐趋深暗、间距收窄；高光区域则仅含稀疏、极纤细的浅灰线条及大面积留白（negative space），从而完全依靠线条密度与间距生成明暗阶调（tonal values），而非传统绘画式阴影。允许部分轮廓线延伸至人物剪影之外，形成环绕主体的广阔有机环带与流动弧线；这些外部线条应渐次淡化、断裂、变细，并最终消融于背景之中，营造人物与周围空间之间富有氛围感的过渡。主色调采用明亮的象牙白、纯白、柔灰、浅米 beige 及微妙自然的肤色，辅以深炭黑线条提供可控对比；整体保持洁净、通透、近乎单色的典雅气质，同时保留细腻的全彩肤色底层色调。画面表面应呈现细腻触感的纸张肌理或档案级艺术（archival-art）质感。

2117903200341230502.promptEn: A confident young male model sits facing the camera on the left side of the frame, leaning slightly to his left with relaxed shoulders in an organic, composed posture. His medium-length, wavy hair, measuring roughly three to four inches on top, is swept back and styled with a matte product, featuring distinct natural flyaways beautifully illuminated by the sun. He holds a neutral expression with a closed mouth and a direct gaze through vibrant amber yellow sunglasses. He is dressed in a crisp, bright white shirt that intensely catches the direct sunlight, accessorized with a subtle earbud and a visible belt. His relaxed right hand rests naturally on his leg, revealing a sleek wristwatch. He is positioned against a weathered, warm gray plaster wall detailed with a rough, patchy matte finish and visible scuffs, contrasting with the dark gray stone cobblestones beneath him. The scene recedes with deep spatial depth into a street setting on the right, where a layered visual hierarchy draws the eye from the subject to the background. In the right midground, slightly out-of-focus worn cafe tables and black metal chairs sit beneath a weathered, striped fabric awning in the top right, while small, blurred figures of people dining populate the far background. The atmosphere captures a warm European summer afternoon, sculpted by a single, highly directional natural light source striking from a 45-degree side angle. This warm, golden hard light creates a dramatic, high-contrast chiaroscuro effect, producing blown-out highlights on his face and shirt while casting long, harsh-edged, deep black shadows across the textured wall behind him. The complementary color palette heavily balances the dominant whites and deep shadow browns with warm golden tans and the amber accent of his sunglasses, entirely devoid of ambient fill light. Captured straight-on in a tack-sharp, editorial lifestyle street photography style, the pristine, grain-free digital image utilizes a medium depth of field to isolate the subject. Enhanced with warm color grading and increased contrast at settings equivalent to f/2.8, 1/500s, and ISO 100, the composition perfectly applies the rule of thirds for an asymmetric, left-heavy balance, beautifully framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230502.promptZh: 一位自信的年轻男性模特坐在画面左侧，正对镜头，身体微微向左倾斜，双肩放松，姿态自然且沉稳。他中等长度的波浪发（顶部约三至四英寸长）向后梳理，使用哑光发品定型，几缕自然飘起的碎发在阳光下熠熠生辉。他面无表情，双唇闭合，透过一副鲜艳的琥珀黄色太阳镜直视镜头。他身穿一件挺括、纯白的衬衫，在直射阳光下强烈反光；配有一副低调的无线耳塞和一条清晰可见的腰带。他放松的右手自然搭在腿上，露出一只纤薄精致的手表。他身后是一面饱经风霜的暖灰色灰泥墙，表面呈粗糙、斑驳的哑光质感，并带有明显刮痕；脚下则是深灰色石板鹅卵石路面，与墙面形成对比。画面向右延伸，呈现深远的空间景深（depth of field），过渡为街道场景，视觉层次丰富，引导观者视线从主体自然移向背景。右中景处，几组略带虚焦（bokeh）的旧式咖啡馆桌椅——黑色金属椅与木质桌面——置于画面右上方一块陈旧条纹布遮阳篷之下；远处背景中则有数个模糊的小人影正在用餐。整体氛围捕捉了欧洲夏日午后温暖明媚的光线，由单一、高度定向的自然光源以45度侧角照射而成。这束温暖、金色的硬光（hard light）营造出强烈的明暗对比（chiaroscuro），在他面部与衬衫上形成过曝高光（blown-out highlights），同时在他身后的肌理墙面投下边缘锐利、浓重深黑的阴影。色彩搭配采用互补色方案：以大面积纯白与深影棕色为主调，辅以暖金色棕调及太阳镜的琥珀色点缀，全图完全摒弃环境补光（ambient fill light）。画面采用正向平视构图，以锐利如针尖（tack-sharp）、杂志级生活方式街拍（editorial lifestyle street photography）风格拍摄；图像纯净无噪点、无颗粒感（grain-free），使用中等景深（depth of field）突出主体。经暖色调调色（warm color grading）与增强对比度处理，参数等效于 f/2.8、1/500s、ISO 100；构图严格遵循三分法（rule of thirds），实现非对称、偏左的视觉平衡，最终以 3:4 画幅比完美取景。

Ultra-realistic full-body lifestyle fashion portrait of a beautiful young woman standing casually against a smooth light-gray wall in a modern minimalist interior. 2117903200341230505.promptEn: A waist-up shot of an athletic adult male positioned center-right, exuding a confident, serious, and guarded expression. He is dressed in a crisp white polo shirt, cream pleated trousers secured by a brown leather belt, a silver watch, and dark tortoiseshell sunglasses that conceal his eyes as he gazes far left off-camera. His hair is short on the sides with two to three inches of wavy texture on top, pushed back without a distinct part, showcasing a natural matte finish with slight frizz, varied strand clumping, and delicately backlit flyaways at the crown. His relaxed mouth remains in a closed neutral pose, while his body leans casually back against a slightly worn, matte black chain-link fence with his weight shifted slightly to the left, relaxing his shoulders into the lean. His left hand rests naturally on the fence's top tubular rail, with fingers draped loosely over the curved edge, visible from wrist to knuckles, while his right hand is tucked deep into his front trouser pocket, exposing only a sliver of his wrist and thumb knuckle. Anchoring the lower third foreground, the fence features a thick diamond wire mesh and a cylindrical top bar that catches the sunlight. Behind him, the deep spatial depth transitions into a pristine midground consisting of a manicured olive-green grass tennis court intersected by crisp white painted lawnmower stripes and solid boundary lines, alongside a pristine black tennis net bordered by a thick white canvas top band. The background is anchored on the upper right by an immaculate white clubhouse pavilion boasting vertical structural pillars, architectural molding, smooth painted wood, and a dark gabled roof, balanced by thriving, dense leafy tree canopies on the top left and far right. The atmosphere is saturated in a sophisticated, dramatic outdoor golden hour, defined by a highly directional, singular hard sun source casting bright, warm light from exactly ninety degrees to the mid-left. This creates a high contrast ratio with deep black shadows nestled within the folds of his clothing and harsh, defined long shadows stretching out from the fence across the grass, blanketing the right side of his face and body in dramatic darkness. Conversely, preserved golden-yellow highlights softly illuminate the left side of his face and left arm, while crisp rim lighting accentuates the textured flyaways of his hair and the top edge of the fence rail, all slightly softened by a warm ambient sky fill. The scene employs an analogous color palette with striking neutral contrasts, harmonizing the warm off-white of his clothing with the olive greens of the environment and the dark brown and black accents. Captured through digital photography using an 85mm prime lens from a straight-on, slightly low angle at chest height, the image utilizes an f/1.8 aperture for a shallow depth of field that renders the subject tack sharp while melting the clubhouse and trees into bokeh.
2117903200341230505.promptZh: 一位健硕的成年男性上半身（腰部以上）肖像，位于画面中右位置，神情自信、严肃且略带戒备。他身穿挺括的白色Polo衫、米色百褶长裤，腰系一条棕色皮带，手腕佩戴银色手表，脸上架着深色玳瑁纹太阳镜，镜片遮住双眼，目光投向画幅左远方。他的两侧头发较短，顶部留有两至三英寸波浪纹理的发量，向后梳理、无明显分缝，呈现自然哑光质感，略带毛躁，发丝成簇分布，头顶处细碎发丝被逆光轻柔勾勒。他嘴角放松，保持闭合的中性姿态；身体随意向后倚靠在一道略有磨损的哑光黑色链式围栏上，重心略微偏左，双肩随之松弛地倚靠。左手自然搭在围栏顶部的圆管横杆上，手指松散垂落于弧形边缘，从手腕至指关节清晰可见；右手则深深插进前方裤袋中，仅露出一小截手腕与拇指指节。围栏占据画面下三分之一前景，采用粗密菱形金属网结构，顶部为圆柱形横杆，在阳光下熠熠生辉。  \n他身后，空间纵深感强烈，中景为一片精心修剪的橄榄绿色网球场草坪，草坪上印有清晰的白色割草条纹与实线边界线，另有一道洁净的黑色网球网，网顶镶有厚实的白色帆布包边。背景右上方是一座一尘不染的白色俱乐部凉亭，立有垂直结构立柱、建筑线脚、表面光滑的涂漆木料，以及深色三角形坡屋顶；左上方与远右侧则由茂盛浓密的树冠平衡构图。整体氛围浸润于成熟而富戏剧性的户外黄金时刻（golden hour），光源为高度定向、单一的硬质阳光，自画面正中偏左九十度角直射而来，形成高对比度：衣物褶皱间嵌着浓重的纯黑阴影，围栏在草地上投下锐利、修长的阴影，将他面部与身体右侧笼罩于强烈的暗部之中；与此同时，保留下来的金黄色高光则柔和照亮其面部左侧与左臂，清晰的轮廓光（rim lighting）凸显出他发丝的纹理质感与围栏横杆顶部边缘，所有这些细节又因温暖的天光环境补光而略显柔化。全图采用邻近色（analogous color）配色方案，并以醒目的中性色对比强化协调性——人物服饰的暖调米白，与环境中的橄榄绿、深棕及黑色点缀相互呼应。  \n本图像以数码摄影方式捕捉，使用85mm定焦镜头，拍摄角度为平视略低角度（low angle），取景高度约在胸部位置；光圈设为f/1.8，实现浅景深（depth of field），使主体纤毫毕现，而俱乐部凉亭与树木则融为焦外虚化（bokeh）。

2117903200341230506.promptEn: A young, conventionally attractive male model stands confidently in the center of the frame, positioned straight on to the camera with level shoulders and a deliberately posed demeanor. His meticulously styled hair complements a chiseled jawline and a closed, neutral mouth with relaxed eyebrows, while his eyes look off-camera to the left with a sophisticated, unsmiling expression. He wears a tailored, deep navy blue double-breasted blazer adorned with prominent, warm gold buttons, layered over a crisp white dress shirt with a patterned navy tie and a sharp white pocket square, paired with crisp cream trousers. Both of his relaxed hands rest inside the front pockets of the cream trousers, gently pulling the blazer fabric slightly backward. He stands on a solid expanse of warm beige and brown loose gravel within an upscale outdoor courtyard at twilight. The background falls into a medium depth of field with a beautifully blurred, deep spatial arrangement. In the left midground sits a thriving, rounded topiary bush in a dark classical planter subtly illuminated by ground-level pathway lights, while the left background features an aged, rough matte dark stone building with a paned glass arched window emitting a warm interior light. To the right midground, dense, dark olive green sculpted hedges form a structural boundary next to a vintage black iron streetlamp casting an amber glow from its dual bulbs in a glass housing, all framing a large leafy tree situated directly behind the subject in the center background. The scene exudes an elegant, wealthy aesthetic bathed in a moody, high-contrast twilight atmosphere. A 45-degree front-left softbox key light wraps smoothly around his features, preserving sharp specular highlights on the bridge of his nose, the pristine white shirt collar, and the gold blazer buttons, while casting short, deep black shadows with soft gradual edges on the right side of his face, beneath his jawline, and inside the structural folds of the navy blazer. 2117903200341230514.promptZh: 一幅中景特写（medium close-up），腰部以上肖像，描绘一位成年地中海男性，肤色呈温暖的古铜色，下巴上留着短胡茬，神情自信而略带戒备的冷峻；他挺胸直面镜头，头部向右偏转四十五度。他身穿一件米白色、带有自然褶皱的亚麻衬衫，纽扣解开至深处，形成自然的V字领口，露出一条纤细的金色项链；佩戴一副透明镜框的太阳镜，镜片为深色，遮蔽了他的目光。他的深棕色头发顶部留有两到三英寸的蓬松发量，两侧渐变收窄，使用略带湿润感与光泽感的造型产品打理，凸显出浓密自然的波浪与不规则卷曲，伴有自然的碎发与几缕松散发丝轻柔垂落于前额。他的姿态放松而居中，双臂自然下垂、位于画面之外，双肩水平且略微向后倚靠在一座饱经风霜的历史建筑上。背景柔和虚化（bokeh），呈现出温暖浅米色的粗切石灰岩环境：右侧中景处矗立着一根巨大、表面粗糙多坑的雕琢石柱基座，左侧则是一面历史久远、风化斑驳的石砌建筑立面，向远处退去。一束明亮、单一光源的直射硬光（hard sunlight）从左前方顶部以四十五度角投射而来，为整个场景注入阳光充沛、优雅的欧洲夏日暖意。这束高度定向的光线在他太阳镜镜片下方脸颊、衣领投向胸口、下颌线下方以及发卷深处投下浓重深黑的阴影；同时，在其额头、鼻尖、颧骨、锁骨及发卷峰顶保留了清晰锐利的高光（specular highlights）。本图以高端时尚杂志风格的数字摄影方式直视拍摄，机位与视线齐平，采用85mm镜头、f/2.8光圈，具备浅景深（shallow depth of field），使主体清晰锐利（tack sharp），完美呈现有机亚麻织纹与细腻皮肤毛孔，并将人物从建筑背景中分离出来；整体经暖金色调色（warm golden color grade）与高对比度曲线（high contrast curve）强化，构图采用2:3画幅比例。

2117903200341230515.promptEn: Ultra-realistic IMAX-level Netflix-style cinematic fantasy portrait, 4:5 vertical frame, use the uploaded image as the primary facial reference with maximum face consistency, create a young woman leaning dynamically toward the camera while reaching one hand directly forward into the foreground, her extended hand appearing dramatically larger due to strong perspective and shallow depth of field, fingers naturally spread as if playfully reaching toward the viewer, her other arm positioned naturally closer to her body, upper body leaning forward with an energetic spontaneous posture, wearing a soft beige flowing draped outfit wrapped naturally around her upper body, messy high bun with abundant textured strands escaping around the crown, temples and sides of her face, several fine flyaway strands lifted naturally around her head, surrounded by dramatic frozen splashes of vivid turquoise, red, pink, golden-yellow and orange paint-like fluid forms sweeping upward and outward around her body, individual droplets suspended sharply in the air, colorful fluid arcs creating a dynamic circular frame around her, bright neutral background visible between the splashes, highly detailed translucent liquid surfaces with realistic reflections and refractions, strong foreground-background depth separation, cinematic perspective, crisp facial detail with the reaching hand gradually becoming softer toward the closest foreground due to lens depth, realistic motion energy frozen at the exact moment of the splash, sophisticated studio lighting with soft frontal illumination on her face and subtle highlights along the wet fluid droplets and hair strands, vibrant but naturally balanced colors, realistic fabric texture, natural photographic detail, cinematic depth of field, high dynamic range. Facial Expression: her eyes are wide open and looking directly into the camera with a bright playful gaze, eyebrows naturally raised with excitement, mouth opened into a broad genuine smile showing her upper teeth, lips naturally stretched by the smile, cheeks noticeably lifted and rounded with natural smile lines forming around the eyes and mouth, creating a joyful spontaneous energetic expression.
2117903200341230515.promptZh: 超写实 IMAX 级、Netflix 风格的电影感奇幻人像（cinematic fantasy portrait），4:5 竖构图，以上传图像作为主要面部参考，确保最大程度的面部一致性；塑造一位年轻女性，身体充满动感地前倾朝向镜头，同时将一只手直接向前伸入画面前景，因强烈透视与浅景深（shallow depth of field）效果，其伸出的手在视觉上显著放大；手指自然张开，仿佛俏皮地伸向观者；另一只手臂自然收近身体；上半身前倾，姿态富有活力且即兴自然；身着柔软米色流动垂坠式服饰，自然包裹上半身；凌乱高发髻，大量富有质感的发丝从头顶、太阳穴及脸颊两侧散落；数缕纤细的飘散发丝（flyaway strands）自然扬起环绕头部；周身环绕戏剧性凝固的飞溅颜料状流体——鲜明青绿色、红色、粉色、金黄色与橙色流体向上向外奔涌扩散；单个液滴清晰悬停于空中；多彩流体弧线在她周身构成动态环形画框；飞溅间隙可见明亮中性背景；液体表面高度精细、半透明，呈现真实反射（reflections）与折射（refractions）；前景与背景之间具有强烈纵深分离感（strong foreground-background depth separation）；电影感透视（cinematic perspective）；面部细节锐利清晰，而伸出的手部则因镜头景深（lens depth）作用，越靠近最近前景越渐趋柔和；动作能量真实凝固于飞溅发生的精确瞬间；精致影棚布光（studio lighting），面部受柔和正面照明（soft frontal illumination），湿润流体液滴与发丝边缘带有微妙高光；色彩鲜活但自然均衡；织物纹理真实可感；自然摄影级细节；电影感景深（cinematic depth of field）；高动态范围（HDR）。  \n面部表情：双眼圆睁，直视镜头，目光明亮俏皮；眉毛因兴奋自然上扬；嘴部张开，展露宽畅真挚笑容，露出上排牙齿；双唇因笑容自然延展；双颊明显上提并圆润隆起，眼周与口周形成自然笑纹，整体呈现欢快、即兴、富有活力的表情。

2117903200341230516.promptEn: A young adult male with dark curly hair sits casually at a 45-degree angle towards the right, gazing downward through geometric sunglasses with a serious, focused, and candid expression. He is dressed in a fitted warm gray long-sleeve crewneck shirt, maintaining relaxed, perfectly level shoulders. His right hand holds the top right edge of a dark open menu, his thumb resting naturally on the front cover pointing slightly upward while his fingers remain organically tucked behind. The scene unfolds on a waterfront restaurant patio, where he sits straight on at eye level behind a wooden table in the immediate foreground. This table arrangement features an empty pristine clear wine glass catching bright light reflections, a small worn light-wood traditional pepper grinder, a new clear glass olive oil bottle containing dark golden oil, a white plate with a cloth napkin, a vintage woven wicker chair back exhibiting a light tan and pale blue-green pattern, and a smooth dark olive-green pot blooming with vibrant white Kalanchoe flower clusters. Behind him, a worn silver metallic patio umbrella pole extends vertically out of frame, giving way to a deep, gently soft background revealing a Mediterranean seaside environment with distant landmasses under a cloudy blue summer sky, alongside massive multi-deck white luxury motor yachts featuring dark tinted windows and radar domes resting on deep ocean blue waters. The atmosphere is illuminated by bright, highly directional hard natural sunlight striking from the front and top right at a 45-degree angle, bathing the scene in a warm golden light with absolutely no ambient fill. This intense single light source creates an energetic, highly saturated, and high-contrast environment, casting short, deep black, harsh-edged shadows under his chin, onto his cheeks from his sunglasses, and beneath the foreground objects, while preserving crisp specular highlights on his textured hair, shoulders, the rims of the glassware, and the brilliant white yachts. The luxurious, breezy seaside dining aesthetic is captured as a medium-shot editorial digital photograph with a clean, structured visual style and a complementary palette emphasizing deep ocean blue, warm gray, crisp white, and warm wood tones. Shot with a 35mm lens at f/4 and a fast 1/1000s shutter speed at ISO 100 to ensure tack-sharp focus on the subject while retaining context in the distinct but naturally blurred background, the image utilizes post-processing that enhances blue and white saturation, slightly lifts shadows to maintain the dark shirt's detail, and warms the overall white balance to emphasize the sunny Mediterranean atmosphere, all perfectly framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230516.promptZh: 一名年轻成年男性，深色卷发，随意地以45度角朝右坐姿就座，透过几何造型太阳镜向下凝视，神情严肃、专注且自然真实。他身穿合身的暖灰色长袖圆领衬衫，双肩放松且保持完全水平。右手握持一份深色打开菜单的右上边缘，拇指自然 resting 在封面正面并略微向上翘起，其余手指则有机地收于封面后方。场景设定在一家临水餐厅的露台，他正坐于画面正前方，与观者视线齐平，身后是一张木质餐桌。这张餐桌布置包括：一只洁净无瑕的透明葡萄酒杯，正捕捉明亮的光线反射；一只小型、略显磨损的浅色木制传统胡椒研磨器；一只崭新的透明玻璃橄榄油瓶，内装深金色橄榄油；一只白色餐盘配一块布质餐巾；一把复古编织藤椅靠背，呈浅褐色与淡蓝绿色相间的图案；一只光滑的深橄榄绿色陶盆，盛开着生机勃勃的纯白长寿花（Kalanchoe）花簇。他身后，一根略显磨损的银色金属露台遮阳伞杆垂直延伸出画框，背景则柔和渐变为一片深邃而柔美的地中海海滨环境：远处是云层笼罩下的蔚蓝夏日天空下的陆地轮廓，以及停泊在深邃海洋蓝色水域上的多层白色豪华机动游艇，游艇配有深色镀膜车窗与雷达罩。整个氛围由明亮、高度定向的硬质自然阳光照亮，光源来自画面右前方与上方，呈45度角投射，将场景浸染于温暖的金色光芒之中，且完全无环境补光。这一强烈单光源营造出充满活力、高饱和度与高对比度的环境，投下短促、浓黑、边缘锐利的阴影——位于他的下巴下方、太阳镜在脸颊上投下的阴影，以及前景物体下方的阴影；同时保留了他富有质感的头发、肩膀、玻璃器皿边缘及耀眼洁白游艇表面的清晰高光。整幅画面呈现出奢华而微风轻拂的地中海海滨用餐美学，以中景（medium-shot）编辑风格数字摄影呈现，视觉风格干净、结构严谨，配色方案互补协调，强调深海蓝、暖灰、明净白与温润木质色调。使用35mm镜头、f/4光圈、ISO 100感光度与高速1/1000秒快门速度拍摄，确保主体绝对锐利对焦，同时保留背景清晰但自然虚化的空间层次；后期处理增强蓝色与白色饱和度，略微提亮阴影以维持深色衬衫的细节表现，并整体调暖白平衡以强化明媚的地中海阳光氛围，最终以4:5画幅比例完美构图。

2117903200341230517.promptEn: A well-dressed handsome male stands perfectly centered in a classic portrait pose, taking a mirror selfie. He maintains a serious, deliberately posed expression with a closed neutral mouth and a direct gaze. His glossy, medium-short hair features a classic gentleman's cut with a deep side part and a subtle front quiff, styled with a slightly wet pomade finish that still reveals natural flyaways and stray hairs along the top crown and sides, with moderate volume at the front hairline that slicks flatter towards the back. He wears a deep black double-breasted blazer over a light blue button-up dress shirt, complemented by a white pocket square and off-white pleated trousers. His right hand rests casually tucked into his trouser pocket, revealing only his thumb, wrist, and a polished gold wristwatch, while his left hand is held at chest height, securely gripping the edges of a white smartphone with his index finger relaxed along the back. He is framed symmetrically within a pristine, large oval mirror that reflects a deep, luxurious upscale dressing room. The background showcases perfectly smooth, matte warm cream walls with structurally clean recessed alcoves and polished gold brass floor-to-ceiling vertical architectural divider poles. Above, a light oak wood ceiling accent panel features a single recessed spotlight, while the midground to the left reveals a smaller oval mirror reflecting a pristine white sink vanity, a minimalist silver faucet, and a dark cylindrical bottle resting on the counter. The atmosphere is sophisticated, confident, and private, bathed in warm, golden mixed lighting from diffused overhead sources and ambient room fill. This soft light casts short, gradual gray shadows under his chin, beneath his jacket lapels, and inside his shirt collar, while catching subtle specular highlights on his forehead, nose bridge, the white phone case, his gold watch, and the brass background fixtures. The complementary color palette strikes a high-contrast balance between the warm creams of the background and the deep blacks and off-whites of his attire. Shot with tack-sharp digital photography mimicking a 24mm equivalent smartphone lens at f/2.2 for a medium depth of field, the pristine, grain-free image channels a clean menswear editorial and lifestyle influencer aesthetic. The rendering employs an ISO 100 exposure with spot metering on the face, enhanced by warm color grading that pushes yellow and cream tones, along with subtle clarity adjustments to retain the rich texture of the black blazer fabric, all beautifully framed in a 9:16 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230517.promptZh: 一位衣着考究、相貌英俊的男性以经典肖像姿势完美居中站立，正在拍摄一面镜子中的自拍照。他神情严肃、姿态刻意，双唇闭合呈中性状态，目光直视前方。他拥有一头富有光泽的中短发，采用经典的绅士剪裁，带有深侧分线与前额微翘（front quiff），并以略带湿感的发蜡定型；发丝自然蓬松，头顶与两侧可见细微的飞翘发丝与散落碎发，前额发际线处体积适中，向后逐渐服帖扁平。他身穿一件深黑色双排扣西装外套，内搭一件浅蓝色纽扣衬衫，配一条白色口袋巾与米白色褶皱长裤。他的右手随意插在裤袋中，仅露出拇指、手腕以及一只抛光金色腕表；左手则抬至胸前高度，稳稳握持一部白色智能手机边缘，食指自然放松置于手机背面。他被框定于一面洁净无瑕的大型椭圆形镜面中央，镜中映出一间深邃奢华、高端精致的更衣室。背景为质地细腻、哑光质感的暖米色墙面，配有结构简洁的嵌入式壁龛，以及从地面延伸至天花板的抛光金色黄铜竖向建筑隔断立柱。上方，浅橡木色天花板装饰板中央设有一盏嵌入式射灯；中景左侧另有一面较小的椭圆形镜子，映出洁净纯白的洗漱台、极简风格银色水龙头，以及台面上一只深色圆柱形瓶体。整体氛围优雅、自信且私密，沐浴于温暖金调的混合光线之中——光源来自柔化的顶部照明与环境补光。这柔和光线在他下颌下方、西装翻领下方以及衬衫领口内部投下短而渐变的灰调阴影，同时在额头、鼻梁、白色手机壳、金色腕表及背景黄铜构件表面捕捉到细腻的镜面高光（specular highlights）。互补色系在背景暖米色调与服饰深黑、米白色调之间达成高对比平衡。本图采用锐利清晰的数码摄影（digital photography）风格，模拟等效24mm智能手机镜头、f/2.2光圈下的中等景深（depth of field），画面洁净无噪点、无颗粒感，呈现出干净利落的男装时尚杂志（menswear editorial）与生活方式博主（lifestyle influencer）美学。渲染采用ISO 100曝光值，以面部为测光点（spot metering），辅以增强暖调的色彩分级（color grading），着重提升黄色与米色表现，并通过细微清晰度调整（clarity adjustments）保留黑色西装外套面料丰富的纹理细节；整幅画面以9:16画幅比（aspect ratio）完美构图。

2117903200341230520.promptEn: A confident handsome male in his twenties is positioned centrally, captured from a low angle in a leaning posture with his weight shifted and shoulders level. He wears a thick black leather aviator jacket featuring a striking, large tan shearling collar, layered over a gray turtleneck and paired with black trousers. His face displays a deliberately posed, sophisticated expression with a closed mouth, relaxed eyebrows, and squinting eyes. His left hand is clutched at lower chest level holding a pair of black leather gloves with knuckles visible, while his right hand rests gently over the left with his thumb visible, organically securing the gloves. He leans against a pristine white stone balustrade with turned concrete pillars and a flat handrail that crosses the foreground. The deep spatial depth reveals a crisp, affluent outdoor estate setting. Behind the subject, a dominant classic estate building rises, featuring a perfectly smooth matte off-white painted facade, architectural molding, a dark slate roof, dormer windows, and white-framed windows with dark glass. A tall, thriving conical evergreen tree towers over the center roofline, flanked by large deciduous trees on the left, while a light gray solid tiled walkway occupies the foreground right. The scene is bathed in bright, highly directional natural hard daylight from a single source, creating a cool, energetic, and high-contrast atmosphere dominated by rich blacks, crisp whites, and a vibrant clear sky blue background. Deep black, harsh-edged dramatic shadows are cast sharply under his chin, on the right side of his face, across the right side of his jacket, and along the balustrade. Meanwhile, bright preserved highlights illuminate the left side of his face, his hair, the textured tan shearling collar, and the left facade of the pristine white building. The image is executed as a tack sharp, realistic contemporary men's fashion lifestyle editorial, shot digitally on a 35mm to 50mm lens at an f/5.6 to f/8 aperture with a fast 1/1000s shutter speed at ISO 100 to cut the bright daylight. The post-processing features a high contrast color grade with crushed shadows for deeper blacks in the clothing, slightly pushed whites, and enhanced saturated sky blues, culminating in a clean, old money luxury aesthetic framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.

Ultra high-resolution photorealistic street photo at dusk (blue hour) in Shibuya, Tokyo, at the famous scramble crossing. Full-body shot in a vertical composition, standing near the curb on the sidewalk, relaxed posture with one hand in a pocket, shoulders slightly tucked in.

Oversized faded wide-leg blue jeans with heavy distressing and large rips around the knees. Red-and-black basketball-style sneakers, black laces. Crosswalk white stripes visible, evening warm light on the pavement, no rain.

Natural skin texture (no heavy beauty filter), subtle pores, realistic hair strands. Cinematic color grading (warm highlights, slightly cool shadows), HDR, crisp detail, low noise, 8K quality, vertical 9:16, full body in frame, no cropping.

2117903200341230529.promptEn:

STYLE: Create a premium stylized miniature diorama whose terrain base blends naturally with the environment so cliffs, forest floor, and flowing water form a continuous sculpted model. The entire diorama including the terrain base should float freely in mid-air without resting on any table or platform. Surround the diorama with a blank single-color environment that contrasts with the scene so the miniature stands out clearly. Use stylized resin waterfall effects, compact architecture, warm lantern glow, and dense foliage clusters. Include miniature villagers, birds, baskets, shrubs, and path props to reinforce handcrafted collectible scale. Lock the render to a 4:3 aspect ratio.  

CAMERA: Use an isometric camera angle positioned high enough to clearly view the terrain layers and structures. Frame the entire floating diorama so the full base and environment are visible from top to bottom and side to side with comfortable margins.

2117903200341230554.promptEn:
A macro photograph of an expensive, luxury wristwatch, the 'WASI – W Eclipse Edition'. The watch has a prominent two-tone case made of brushed titanium and polished rose gold with angular, complex lines. The crown, also in rose gold, has a micro-engraved 'W' emblem. The watch is placed in a three-quarter view, angled towards the right, on a highly reflective black marble surface with prominent white veining, which shows a partial reflection of the watch and its band.
​The dial is deep obsidian black, radiating a subtle sunburst pattern from the center. Its defining feature is a large, sculptural, open-worked 'W' structure made of polished metallic components that arches across the center, revealing the intricate mechanical gears of the movement beneath it. The floating 'W' serves as a dominant central element. The hours are marked by applied rose gold hour markers, with Roman numerals '12', '3', and '6'. Minute markers are visible along the outer edge. The brand name 'WASI' is minimalistically engraved at the 12 o'clock position in brushed platinum lettering.
​The hands are skeletonized and geometric, made of polished rose gold with integrated ice-blue luminous material that glows softly. There are two main hands and a central seconds hand. The strap is black matte crocodile leather with a polished rose gold deployant clasp that also has a micro-engraved 'W' insignia.
​In the background, slightly out of focus, are luxury elements including a black velvet-lined box and a wooden panel with the text 'WASI' clearly engraved, suggesting a display. The lighting is dramatic and cinematic, with soft highlights and deep shadows that emphasize the varied textures, making it look like a high-end Swiss watch advertisement.

表盘为深黑曜石色（obsidian black），从中心向外散发出细腻的日辉纹（sunburst pattern）。其标志性特征是位于表盘中央的一座大型立体镂空“W”结构，由抛光金属部件构成，呈拱形横跨表盘中央，下方显露精密机械机芯（movement）的复杂齿轮结构。这座悬浮式“W”成为视觉主导的中心元素。时标为镶嵌式玫瑰金时标，12点、3点与6点位置采用罗马数字“12”、“3”、“6”；分钟刻度可见于表盘外缘。品牌名“WASI”以极简风格镌刻于12点位，字体为拉丝铂金（brushed platinum）材质。

2117903200341230566.promptEn: [NATURAL OBJECT] dissected as if by a master naturalist who found it in the wild. Split and pinned open like a specimen, but lit as if Caravaggio worked for National Geographic. Every internal structure glowing with its own material truth. Cross-section so sharp it feels violent. 2117903200341230569.promptEn: Prompt: Preserve their real facial features, bone structure, eye shape, nose shape, lips, and overall facial identity - the face must clearly match the uploaded person. Do not alter age, ethnicity, or facial proportions. Reference image required, face identity lock. A close-up portrait of an uploaded person subject, their torso and head enveloped in massive, voluminous, sculptural fabric folds. The subject faces forward, head tilted slightly downward, looking up directly into the lens with a direct gaze, relaxed jaw, subtly parted lips, and slight tension in lower eyelids. They are surrounded and partially obscured by sweeping layers of structural fabric, which is stiff yet lightweight, intensely pleated and crinkled, holding structural arches, deep crevices, and sweeping folds around them. A few loose strands of hair escape the fabric wrap, resting flat against the cheek. Makeup features a matte, unreflective skin texture. The setting is a minimalist studio with a plain off-white background. The face is framed within an aperture of fabric, offset slightly to the right with negative space on the left. The camera is at eye-level, creating an architectural framing using textile volumes. Soft, directional studio light comes from camera-left, creating gradient shadows within the fabric crevices and gentle modeling on the right side of the face. The mood is sculptural, serene, and editorial. The color palette features deep emerald green for the fabric, off-white for the background, and natural skin tones, with high color contrast between the green fabric and light background, and soft tonal contrast on the face. Photographed with a medium format digital camera and an 85mm lens at f/5.6. The face and foreground fabric are sharply in focus, with slight blurring on the furthest background folds. The style is avant-garde editorial portraiture, photorealistic, with minimal film grain. No CGI, no cartoon, no Al glow. Full color.
2117903200341230569.promptZh: 提示词：保留其真实的面部特征、骨骼结构、眼型、鼻型、唇形及整体面部身份——面部必须与上传的人物清晰匹配。不得更改年龄、种族或面部比例。需提供参考图像，锁定面部身份。一张上传人物主体的特写（close-up）肖像，其躯干与头部被巨大、蓬松、具有雕塑感的织物褶皱所包裹。主体正对镜头，头部略微下倾，目光直视镜头，表情直接、下颌放松、双唇微微张开，下眼睑略带紧绷感。主体被层层流动的结构性织物环绕并部分遮蔽；该织物质地挺括却轻盈，密集褶皱且表面布满细密皱痕，能支撑起结构性拱形、深邃沟壑及恢弘延展的褶皱。数缕发丝从织物包裹中自然散落，平贴于面颊。妆容呈现哑光、无反光的肌肤质感。场景为极简主义影棚，背景为纯浅白色。面部被织物围成的开口框住，该开口略偏画面右侧，左侧留有负空间。相机处于人眼高度，利用织物体积构建建筑感构图。柔和、有方向性的影棚灯光来自相机左侧，在织物沟壑内形成渐变阴影，并在面部右侧营造柔和的立体塑形效果。整体氛围兼具雕塑感、宁静感与时尚杂志感（editorial）。色彩方案以深翠绿色（emerald green）表现织物，浅白色（off-white）作为背景，肤色保持自然，织物的深翠绿与浅色背景之间形成高色彩对比，而面部则呈现柔和的明暗对比。使用中画幅数码相机搭配85mm镜头、f/5.6光圈拍摄。面部及前景织物锐利清晰，最远处的背景褶皱略有焦外虚化（bokeh）。风格为前卫时尚杂志风（avant-garde editorial）人像，照片级写实（photorealistic），胶片颗粒（film grain）极少。不含CGI、非卡通风格、无AI辉光（Al glow）。全彩。

2117903200341230570.promptEn: A high-resolution portrait of a stylish man in the uploaded image with a well-groomed beard, captured during the golden hour. He is wearing classic black wayfarer-style sunglasses and a dark chocolate-brown, heavy-knit sweater with visible loop textures and raglan stitching. He is leaning casually against a sleek metal and glass balcony railing, looking off-camera toward a hazy urban horizon. The background is a soft-focus, cinematic cityscape featuring towering skyscrapers blurred into a warm, atmospheric bokeh. The lighting is soft and directional, coming from the side and back, creating a brilliant rim-light effect on his hair and the right side of his silhouette. The color palette is dominated by warm earth tones, deep browns, and glowing amber highlights from the setting sun, creating a serene and sophisticated mood. Focus is sharp on the subject’s profile and the coarse texture of the knitwear, with a shallow depth of field.
2117903200341230570.promptZh: 黄金时刻（golden hour）拍摄的一张高分辨率人像，主角是上传图像中那位时尚男士，蓄着精心打理的胡须。他戴着经典黑色威弗尔（Wayfarer）风格太阳镜，身穿深巧克力棕色厚针织毛衣，毛衣表面可见明显的线圈纹理与插肩缝线。他随意倚靠在一条流线型金属与玻璃材质的阳台栏杆上，目光望向画外朦胧的城市天际线。背景为柔焦、电影感（cinematic）的城市景观，高耸入云的摩天大楼被虚化成温暖而富有氛围感的焦外虚化（bokeh）。光线柔和且具有方向性，来自侧后方，在他的发丝及剪影右侧勾勒出明亮的轮廓光（rim-light）效果。整体色调以温暖的大地色系为主，深棕色与落日映照出的辉光琥珀色高光交相辉映，营造出宁静而精致的氛围。焦点精准落在人物侧脸及针织面料粗糙的纹理上，景深（depth of field）较浅。

2117903200341230571.promptEn: Ultra-realistic cinematic product shot of a premium honey jar placed inside a shallow wooden hollow surrounded by tall wild wheat and tiny yellow meadow flowers, captured from an intimate low-angle macro perspective with slight cinematic depth, transparent glass jar filled with luminous deep golden honey, topped with a satin bronze metallic lid and a narrow cream seal strip crossing vertically over the cap, minimal luxury label reading “HUNSET”, jar lightly touched by thin climbing ivy strands for a refined organic detail, one realistic honeybee hovering near the front glass surface while another rests on a wheat stem behind the jar, environment set in a quiet countryside field during late afternoon, warm sunlight filtering through wheat stalks from behind creating glowing translucency inside the honey and soft halo edges around the jar, foreground with blurred wheat tips and soft natural bokeh, distant background fading into creamy green and amber tones, shallow depth of field with extreme sharpness on jar textures, visible honey thickness, subtle glass reflections, detailed plant fibers and pollen particles in air, cinematic luxury advertising mood, shot on 90mm macro lens, f/2.2, ultra-detailed natural textures, premium organic brand campaign style, 8k resolution, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341230571.promptZh: 超写实电影感（cinematic）产品静物图：一只高端蜂蜜罐置于浅木制凹槽中，周围环绕着高耸的野生小麦与细小的黄色草甸花朵；采用亲密低角度微距（macro）视角拍摄，带有轻微电影感景深（depth of field）；透明玻璃罐内盛满透亮深金色蜂蜜；罐顶配哑光青铜色金属盖，盖上垂直覆有一条窄幅奶油色密封条；极简奢华标签，印有 “HUNSET”；罐身轻触几缕纤细攀爬常春藤枝条，增添精致有机细节；一只逼真蜜蜂悬停于罐体正面玻璃表面附近，另一只静栖于罐后小麦茎秆上；场景设定于宁静乡村田野，时间是傍晚时分；温暖阳光自后方穿透小麦秆，在蜂蜜内部形成发光半透明效果，并在罐体边缘勾勒出柔和光晕；前景为焦外虚化（bokeh）的小麦尖端，背景自然柔焦，渐变为乳白色与琥珀色调；浅景深（shallow depth of field），罐体表面纹理呈现极致锐利清晰；蜂蜜浓稠质感清晰可见；玻璃表面呈现微妙反光；植物纤维与空气中悬浮花粉颗粒细节丰富；整体氛围为电影感奢华广告（cinematic luxury advertising）风格；使用90mm微距镜头（macro lens）拍摄，光圈f/2.2；自然纹理超精细；契合高端有机品牌推广活动（premium organic brand campaign）视觉调性；8k分辨率；无文字；无水印。

2117903200341230572.promptEn: "A high-resolution photograph of a baby tiger cub, viewed head-on with an intense, curious gaze, peeking over a textured, dark green surface that matches the background. The cub's large brown eyes, full of wonder and innocence, are a prominent feature, drawing the viewer's focus. Its rounded ears are perked up, catching the light and emphasizing its attentive expression. The cub's front paws, with visible pads and small claws, rest on the ledge, positioned symmetrically on either side of its face. Its striking orange-gold fur is detailed with dark, well-defined black stripes, forming distinct patterns on its forehead, cheeks, and around its eyes. Soft, white fur accents are on its cheeks, inner ears, and chest. The cub's long white whiskers spread out prominently from its muzzle. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the textures of the cub's dense fur, the shine in its eyes, and the pebbled texture of the green surface it is peeking over. The focus is critically sharp on the cub's eyes and face, capturing fine details in its fur, whiskers, and eye structure. The depth of field is shallow, rendering the rich green background as a smooth, uniform bokeh, free of any distracting details, to isolate the subject. The style is that of a professional wildlife portrait, with a natural yet intimate feel, as if a momentary glimpse into the cub's world. The composition is balanced and tight on the cub's head and paws, filling the lower portion of the frame."
2117903200341230572.promptZh: 一张高分辨率照片，正面视角拍摄一只幼年老虎（虎崽），眼神专注而好奇，正从一块肌理丰富、深绿色的表面后探出头来，该表面与背景颜色一致。虎崽一双大大的棕色眼睛充满惊奇与纯真，是画面最突出的特征，牢牢吸引观者的视线。它圆润的耳朵竖立着，捕捉光线，进一步强化其专注的表情。虎崽的前爪——掌垫与细小爪子清晰可见——稳稳 resting 在边缘上，对称地分置于面部两侧。它醒目的橙金色皮毛细节丰富，缀有深色、轮廓分明的黑色条纹，在额头、脸颊及眼周形成独特图案。脸颊、耳内及胸部点缀着柔和的白色绒毛。它长长的白色胡须从口鼻部显著向外伸展。布光柔和均匀，凸显虎崽浓密皮毛的质感、眼睛中的光泽，以及它所探出的那块绿色表面的鹅卵石般肌理。焦点精准落在虎崽的眼睛与面部，精细呈现其皮毛、胡须及眼部结构的细微之处。景深（depth of field）较浅，使浓郁的绿色背景化为平滑均质的焦外虚化（bokeh），不带任何干扰性细节，从而突出主体。风格为专业野生动物肖像（wildlife portrait），自然且富有亲密感，仿佛短暂一瞥便闯入了虎崽的世界。构图均衡紧凑，聚焦于虎崽的头部与前爪，占据画面下部区域。

2117903200341230576.promptEn: A high-resolution studio photograph featuring two female models posing against a solid dusty rose background. On the left, a model with dark hair wearing a light brown felt fedora hat, a patterned plaid trench coat in shades of light blue, white, and brown over a pale pink lace-hemmed slip dress, and silver metallic chunky-heeled platform sandals with pastel pink socks. On the right, a blonde-haired model wearing an open solid pale pink long coat over an olive green slip dress, holding a pink and white checkered patterned clutch bag, and a silver necklace, and wearing light beige pointed-toe ankle boots. The models are centered within a large, empty white square polaroid-style frame, as if it is a physical prop framing their upper bodies and heads, with their legs and shoes extending below the frame, still against the dusty rose background. Both models look directly and engagingly at the camera with warm expressions. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the textures of the fabrics. The composition is clean and focused solely on the models, their apparel, and the central white frame, with all surrounding space being a clean, uninterrupted dusty rose color. The style is a minimalist fashion editorial photograph.
2117903200341230576.promptZh: 一幅高分辨率（high-resolution）影棚人像摄影，画面中两位女性模特以哑光玫瑰灰（dusty rose）纯色背景为衬。左侧模特黑发，头戴浅棕色毛毡宽檐软呢帽（felt fedora hat），身着浅蓝、白与棕三色格纹风衣（plaid trench coat），内搭淡粉色蕾丝下摆吊带裙（lace-hemmed slip dress），脚穿银色金属质感厚底坡跟凉鞋（metallic chunky-heeled platform sandals），配淡粉色短袜（pastel pink socks）。右侧模特金发，外披一件敞开的纯淡粉色长款大衣（solid pale pink long coat），内搭橄榄绿吊带裙（olive green slip dress），手拎一只粉白方格纹手拿包（pink and white checkered patterned clutch bag），佩戴一条银色项链（silver necklace），脚穿浅米色尖头及踝靴（light beige pointed-toe ankle boots）。两位模特居中置于一个硕大的空白白色正方形宝丽来风格相框（white square polaroid-style frame）之内，该相框宛如实体道具，框住其上半身与头部，而双腿与鞋履则延伸至相框下方，仍位于哑光玫瑰灰背景之上。两位模特均直视镜头，神情温暖且富有感染力。布光柔和均匀（soft and even lighting），精准凸显各类面料的纹理质感。构图简洁干净（clean composition），焦点完全集中于两位模特、其服饰以及中央的白色相框；画面其余所有空间均为纯净、无中断的哑光玫瑰灰（dusty rose）色块。整体风格为极简主义时尚杂志大片（minimalist fashion editorial photograph）。

2117903200341230577.promptEn:
An ethereal, high-detail outdoor portrait of a young woman seated on a moss-covered, ornate wrought-iron garden bench in a dreamy forest setting. She has long, braided, wavy brown hair and a soft, curious expression as she gazes at a delicate, glowing blue butterfly resting on her outstretched left index finger.
She wears a cottagecore-inspired dress in light blue and white, featuring wide satin straps, a sweetheart neckline, and a structured white bust panel adorned with intricate blue floral embroidery, ribbon details, central flower appliqués, and small black bow accents. The skirt includes a sheer white tulle overlay decorated with tiny blue floral sprigs.
Her right arm rests gently by her side, while her left arm is raised toward the butterfly. She accessorizes with a light-blue beaded headpiece with a soft veil and small pearl floral earrings.
The environment is lush and magical, with soft, dappled natural light filtering through trees. Fine details are visible in the embroidery, moss texture, and the butterfly’s wings. Shot with a shallow depth of field, creating a soft, dreamy bokeh background of blurred foliage. Ultra-realistic, cinematic, 8K resolution.
2117903200341230577.promptZh:
一位年轻女子的空灵、高细节户外肖像，她坐在梦幻森林场景中一座覆盖青苔的华丽锻铁花园长椅上。她留着长长的棕色波浪辫发，神情柔和而好奇，凝视着停在她伸出的左手食指上的一只纤细、泛着蓝光的蝴蝶。  
她身穿一件田园风（cottagecore）灵感的浅蓝与白色连衣裙，配有宽幅缎面肩带、心形领口，以及一块结构分明的白色胸面板，上面饰有繁复的蓝色花卉刺绣、丝带细节、居中花朵贴布装饰和小巧的黑色蝴蝶结点缀；裙摆则覆有一层轻盈的白色薄纱，其上点缀着细小的蓝色花卉枝芽。  
她的右臂自然垂落于身侧，左臂则抬起朝向蝴蝶。配饰包括一顶浅蓝色珠饰头饰，搭配柔雾感面纱，以及小巧的珍珠花卉耳环。  
环境郁郁葱葱、充满魔幻气息，柔和斑驳的自然光线透过林间枝叶洒落。刺绣细节、青苔肌理及蝴蝶翅膀的精微纹理均清晰可见。采用浅景深（depth of field）拍摄，背景为虚化的枝叶，呈现柔和梦幻的焦外虚化（bokeh）。超写实风格，电影感（cinematic），8K 分辨率。

电影感黄金时刻（golden hour）人像。年轻女子站在山坡上，处于魔法时刻（magic hour），面朝镜头，身后城市天际线泛着琥珀色与紫色光芒。一袭流动的香槟色真丝及膝连衣裙在自然微风中飘动。头发散落，随风轻扬。她直视镜头——眼神柔和而富有情绪，嘴角浮现一丝微妙的、略带震撼的微笑。太阳恰好位于她身后的地平线下方——天空呈现温暖的橙紫色。她的面部精准捕捉到最后一缕暖光。使用 Sony Venice 拍摄，85mm 变形宽银幕镜头（anamorphic）。

2117903200341230580.promptEn:
A cinematic, black-and-white portrait of a young couple. A woman with long, wavy hair and a pearl necklace leans her head against a man with short, textured hair and light stubble. They are looking directly at the camera with a soft, neutral expression.
​Composition & Style:
​Framing: Medium close-up shot, centered, with the couple leaning over a rustic, weathered wooden table.
​Lighting: Soft, natural side-lighting coming from a nearby window, creating gentle highlights on their faces and deep, artistic shadows.
​Aesthetic: Timeless, classic photography. High-contrast monochrome with a rich range of grey tones and fine film grain.
​Setting: An elegant, slightly blurred interior with classical architectural details, like a large ornate mirror and a fluted column in the background.
​Texture & Wardrobe:
​Man: Wearing a thick, knitted crew-neck sweater with visible wool texture.
​Woman: Wearing a dark, elegant dress paired with a delicate pearl necklace.
​Environment: The wooden table should show significant aging, with visible cracks and a distressed patina to contrast with the smooth skin of the subjects.
2117903200341230580.promptZh:
一部具有电影感（cinematic）的黑白肖像，描绘一对年轻情侣。一位长发波浪、佩戴珍珠项链的女子，将头倚靠在一位短发蓬松、留有浅色胡茬的男子肩上。二人直视镜头，神情柔和而中性。  
构图与风格：  
取景：中景特写（medium close-up），居中构图，情侣倚靠在一张质朴、饱经风霜的木质桌面上。  
布光：柔和的自然侧光（soft, natural side-lighting），来自附近一扇窗户，在二人面部形成柔和高光，并投下深邃而富有艺术感的阴影。  
美学：永恒经典的摄影风格。高对比度单色（high-contrast monochrome），拥有丰富的灰阶层次与细腻的胶片颗粒（film grain）。  
场景：一处优雅的室内空间，背景略带焦外虚化（bokeh），带有古典建筑细节，例如一面大型雕花镜与一根凹槽柱。  
质感与服饰：  
男子：身穿一件厚实的针织圆领毛衣，羊毛纹理清晰可见。  
女子：身穿一条深色优雅连衣裙，搭配一条精致的珍珠项链。  
环境：木质桌面应呈现显著的老化痕迹，包括清晰可见的裂纹与做旧质感的包浆，以此与人物光滑的肌肤形成对比。

2117903200341230581.promptEn: A confident young adult male stands perfectly centered facing the camera, dressed in a dark bomber jacket over a light t-shirt and light trousers, his eyes completely concealed by thick dark sunglasses above a neutral, closed mouth. His strikingly textured quiff, with short clipper-faded sides transitioning to a two-to-three-inch top pushed back and slightly to the right, features straight to slightly wavy natural sectioning held by matte clay, revealing slight front unevenness and delicate natural flyaways catching the light against the dark background. Deliberately posed, his right hand is casually tucked into his trouser pocket, while his left arm bends at the elbow, raising his hand to mid-torso with the wrist turned outward to prominently display a luxury dark chronograph watch, his fingers softly curled inward against his jacket with the thumb resting lightly along the top edge of the curled index finger. He stands in a pristine outdoor commercial plaza defined by a floor of light gray concrete slabs intersected by dark linear expansion joints. In the left midground, a dominant, glossy black Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon SUV commands the space, showcasing a distinctive rectangular grille, a carbon fiber hood scoop, and a glowing round headlight with a halo DRL. Extending into the deep background on the top left is a modern architectural facade of perfectly smooth, dark gray glass and vertical metal fins deeply reflecting the surrounding environment, while to the right, a pristine wide-tiered concrete staircase ascends, bordered by a minimalistic metal handrail casting diagonal shadows. The entirely monochromatic, high-contrast black and white scene exudes a dramatic, polished urban luxury mood, illuminated by an intensely bright, highly directional natural sunlight striking from a 45-degree angle on the right. This hard light sculpts brilliant specular highlights onto the right side of the man's face, the bright concrete ground, and the glossy black paint of the car's hood and fenders, while simultaneously casting medium-length, deep black shadows with harsh, defined edges onto the ground to his left, across the left side of his face and jacket, and deep within the vehicle's grille. Captured as a realistic, tack-sharp digital streetwear editorial photograph from a straight-on perspective, the image utilizes a 35mm or 50mm lens at f/8 and 1/1000s shutter speed with ISO 100 to achieve a deep depth of field that seamlessly keeps the subject, vehicle, and architecture in perfect focus, enhanced through stark post-processing that crushes blacks, boosts whites, and aggressively elevates clarity, all seamlessly framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230581.promptZh: 一位自信的年轻成年男性完美居中站立，正对镜头，身穿深色飞行员夹克，内搭浅色T恤与浅色长裤，厚实的深色太阳镜完全遮住双眼，嘴唇中性闭合。他引人注目的纹理化油头（quiff）造型：两侧为短发渐变（clipper-faded），顶部长度约两至三英寸，向后并略偏右梳理，发丝呈自然直发至微卷，以哑光发泥定型，前额略显不均，细软自然的碎发（flyaways）在暗色背景映衬下捕捉光线。姿态刻意而放松：右手随意插在长裤口袋中；左臂于肘部弯曲，手抬至躯干中部，手腕向外翻转，清晰展示一只奢华深色计时码表（chronograph watch），手指轻柔内收贴于夹克表面，拇指轻搭于卷曲食指上缘。他立于一处洁净的户外商业广场，地面由浅灰色混凝土铺板构成，其间穿插深色线性伸缩缝。画面左中景处，一辆主导性的亮黑色梅赛德斯-奔驰G级越野车（Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon SUV）占据空间，其标志性矩形格栅、碳纤维引擎盖进气口，以及带光环式日间行车灯（DRL）的圆形发光大灯清晰可见。左上远景延伸出一座现代建筑立面：表面为极致平滑的深灰色玻璃，配以垂直金属鳍片，深度反射周边环境；右侧则是一座洁净宽阔的阶梯式混凝土楼梯向上延伸，边缘配极简金属扶手，在地面投下斜向阴影。整幅画面为全单色、高对比度的黑白场景，散发戏剧性、精致都市奢华氛围，由来自右侧45度角的强烈、高度定向自然阳光照明。这种硬光（hard light）在男子面部右侧、明亮混凝土地面及汽车引擎盖与翼子板的亮黑色漆面上塑造出耀眼的镜面高光（specular highlights），同时在其左侧地面、面部左侧与夹克左侧、以及车辆格栅深处投下中等长度、浓重纯黑、边缘锐利分明的阴影。本图以写实风格、锐利如钉（tack-sharp）的数字街头服饰（streetwear）杂志摄影（editorial photograph）方式拍摄，采用正面视角（straight-on perspective），镜头焦距为35mm或50mm，光圈f/8，快门速度1/1000秒，ISO 100，以实现大景深（depth of field），使人物主体、车辆与建筑无缝合焦；再经强烈后期处理强化效果：压暗黑色（crushes blacks）、提亮白色（boosts whites）、激进提升清晰度（aggressively elevates clarity），最终以4:5画幅比无缝构图。

2117903200341230582.promptEn: A high-fashion editorial photoshoot of a stylish woman leaning casually against a modern geometric wall. She is wearing a bold red blazer, matching red-orange trousers, a black-and-white patterned top, and white sneakers. She has a confident relaxed pose with hands in pockets, looking slightly upward. The background is a vibrant abstract wall with large geometric blocks in yellow, blue, red, and white, creating a strong modern art aesthetic. 2117903200341230594.promptEn: An athletic male model stands center frame in sophisticated smart-casual menswear, leaning backward with his weight shifted back and down against a weathered stone balustrade, his left leg crossed cleanly over his right ankle. He wears a fitted, striking maroon textured polo shirt tucked into tailored cream trousers, paired with brown suede tassel loafers worn without socks, and a silver watch with a dark dial. His voluminous modern quiff hair is brushed back—measuring three to four inches on top and tapering to shorter faded sides with a slightly visible deep left part—styled with a matte product that preserves its bounce while allowing natural imperfections, individual strands, and slight flyaways to break the outer silhouette. His face projects a confident, serious demeanor with a closed neutral mouth and eyes concealed behind dark wayfarer-style sunglasses, his shoulders level and slightly pulled back. His arms are folded across his chest in a relaxed but formal pose; his right hand rests visibly on his left bicep with the fingers gently separated and draped naturally over the fabric, while his left hand is mostly tucked underneath with only the knuckles faintly visible. In the immediate foreground, the warm grey, porous carved limestone balustrade features classic bottle-shaped pillars detailed with environmental staining, dark buildup in deep carved crevices, and faint water stains from rain exposure. Behind the balcony, the midground falls into a softer focus, revealing an active Parisian city street bustling with blurred pedestrians, dark traffic, and a distinct bright red vehicle. The deep background opens up to a grand European cityscape lined with vintage beige limestone Haussmann-style facades featuring wrought-iron balconies, tall repetitive windows, and mansard roofs, ultimately drawing the eye up to a distant classical monument with columns and a ribbed dome, softened elegantly by atmospheric perspective. The scene is illuminated by a single broad source of soft, diffused light from a desaturated overcast sky, casting a bright but low-contrast, flat illumination that perfectly complements the maroon, cream, and limestone grey palette. Subtle specular highlights catch the top of the model's hair, his shoulders, and the top edge of the stone railing, while faint, soft-edged shadows form gently under his crossed arms, in the crevices of the stone pillars, and as a slight drop shadow on the warm grey stone balcony floor, cultivating an atmosphere of sophisticated urban luxury. Captured through a 50mm to 85mm portrait lens at an f/2.8 to f/4.0 aperture, the digital photography achieves a medium depth of field that isolates the tack-sharp subject from the structurally recognizable but softly blurred architectural background, refined with subtle post-processing utilizing a clean, warm neutral color grade, enhanced textural clarity on the clothing, a slight vignette, and a cinematic matte finish on the high

2117903200341230595.promptZh: 电影感街拍（cinematic street photography），黄金时刻（golden hour）下，一名年轻女子静立于熙攘城市街道中央；她面部锐利对焦，而周遭行人呈运动模糊（motion blur）疾步掠过，营造出混乱中的孤独与静止感。她妆容自然，发色浅金、柔软微卷；身着简约白色衬衫与深色西装外套。背景为两侧高耸的城市建筑与公交车，暖调阳光自后方透射，为其发丝勾勒出柔和光晕（halo effect）轮廓光。浅景深（shallow depth of field），50mm镜头视角（50mm lens look），高动态范围（high dynamic range），真实肌肤质感（realistic skin texture），细微胶片颗粒（subtle film grain），对称构图（symmetrical composition），引导线（leading lines）汇聚于主体，神情忧郁却沉静，超写实（ultra-realistic），杂志时尚摄影风格（editorial fashion photography style）。
2117903200341230595.author: Sairah

2117903200341230596.promptEn: ​A vertical charcoal and graphite portrait of a handsome young man with wavy, tousled hair, sitting on a wooden stool and playing an acoustic guitar. He has a warm, gentle smile and is looking down at the strings with a focused yet relaxed expression. The style is traditional fine art with visible charcoal strokes, soft blending, and high-contrast shading. The background is a cozy, dimly lit room with blurred bookshelves and a window, creating a soft, atmospheric 'bokeh' effect in charcoal. Rich textures on his sweater and the polished wood of the guitar, rendered on textured cream-colored paper.
2117903200341230596.promptZh: 一幅垂直构图的炭笔与石墨肖像画，描绘一位相貌英俊的年轻男子，他留着波浪状、略显凌乱的头发，坐在一只木制矮凳上弹奏一把原声吉他。他面带温暖而柔和的微笑，目光低垂注视琴弦，神情专注却又放松。风格为传统美术（traditional fine art），可见明显的炭笔笔触、柔和的晕染效果，以及高对比度的明暗渲染。背景是一间温馨而光线幽暗的房间，书架与窗户均呈模糊状，以炭笔营造出柔和、富有氛围感的焦外虚化（bokeh）效果。他的毛衣与吉他光洁的木质表面均呈现丰富质感，整体绘制于带有纹理的米色纸张之上。
2117903200341230596.author: Minahil

2117903200341230597.promptEn:
Set against a deep black background of near-absolute void, the composition features a striking portrait where the face is partially revealed through controlled cinematic lighting rather than being completely hidden. A soft, directional key light gently illuminates the front contours of the face, while sharp, elegant edge lighting glows in brilliant white along the jawline, cheekbones, and nose bridge, creating a refined silhouette.
The figure wears brown round sunglasses with sleek silver-rimmed frames that subtly catch and reflect light, adding warmth and visual focus. The lenses should have a faint reflective glow, not overpowering but clearly visible.
Maintain a strong contrast between light and shadow, but ensure that subtle facial structure—like the nose shape, lips outline, and slight skin texture—remains visible in low light. Avoid crushing blacks; preserve shadow detail with a soft fill light at very low intensity.
Lighting style: cinematic, high contrast, soft rim light + low-intensity fill light, studio-controlled shadows, no overexposure.
Mood: mysterious, minimal, premium editorial, with a balance between anonymity and recognizability.
Captured in a 4:5 aspect ratio, centered composition, ultra-clean background, no noise, no grain overload, sharp details on lit edges, smooth falloff into shadow.
2117903200341230597.promptZh:
以近乎绝对虚无的深黑色背景为衬托，构图呈现一幅引人注目的肖像：面部并非完全隐藏，而是通过受控的电影感布光（cinematic lighting）部分显露。柔和、有方向性的主光（key light）轻柔地照亮面部正面轮廓；同时，锐利而优雅的边缘光（edge lighting）沿下颌线、颧骨与鼻梁呈现出明亮的白色辉光，勾勒出精致的剪影。

人物佩戴棕色圆形太阳镜，镜框为流畅的银色边框，能微妙地捕捉并反射光线，增添温暖感与视觉焦点。镜片应呈现轻微的反射辉光，不压倒性，但清晰可见。

保持强烈的明暗对比，同时确保细微的面部结构——例如鼻形、唇部轮廓及轻微的皮肤纹理——在弱光中依然可见。避免黑场死黑（crushing blacks）；以极低强度的柔光补光（fill light）保留阴影细节。

布光风格：电影感（cinematic）、高对比度（high contrast）、柔化轮廓光（soft rim light）＋低强度补光（low-intensity fill light）、影棚可控阴影（studio-controlled shadows），无过曝（no overexposure）。

氛围：神秘、极简、高端杂志风（premium editorial），在匿名性与可识别性之间取得平衡。

以 4:5 画幅比拍摄，居中构图，背景极度干净，无噪点、无过度胶片颗粒（grain overload），受光边缘锐利清晰，明暗过渡平滑自然（smooth falloff into shadow）。

2117903200341230599.promptEn:
This is a high-end fashion magazine cover for "GLAXY" featuring a young woman in a striking, deep pink haute couture gown. The dress is crafted from a rich, heavy satin with a structured corset bodice and a high halter neck, accented by dramatic, oversized fabric roses on the shoulders that create a bold, sculptural silhouette. The model is captured in a confident, editorial pose with her hands on her hips, her long wavy brown hair cascading over her shoulders.
​The composition utilizes soft, professional studio lighting that emphasizes the lustrous texture of the pink fabric against a minimalist, neutral cream background. Elegant serif typography in black and soft silver frames the model, featuring headlines like "GRACE & POWER: Modern Femininity Redefined" and "The Ultimate Lifestyle Issue." The overall aesthetic is one of cinematic luxury and sophisticated fashion photography, characteristic of a premium editorial publication.
2117903200341230599.promptZh: 这是一期高端时尚杂志《GLAXY》的封面，主角是一位身着醒目深粉色高级定制礼服的年轻女性。礼服采用厚重丰盈的缎面材质制成，上身是结构感强烈的紧身胸衣，领型为高领挂脖式，双肩饰有夸张硕大的布艺玫瑰，营造出大胆而富有雕塑感的轮廓。模特摆出自信的杂志编辑风格姿势，双手叉腰，浓密波浪状的棕色长发自然垂落于肩头。  \n画面构图采用柔和专业的影棚布光（studio lighting），凸显粉色调面料的光泽质感，背景为极简中性的米奶油色。优雅的衬线体（serif）字体以黑色与柔雾银色呈现，环绕模特排布，标题文字如“GRACE & POWER: Modern Femininity Redefined”和“The Ultimate Lifestyle Issue”。整体视觉风格兼具电影感奢华（cinematic luxury）与精致考究的时尚摄影气质，体现出顶级杂志刊物的编辑水准。
