2117903200341230600.author: Özge Döner

2117903200341230601.promptEn: Use the uploaded reference image as the facial identity base. Preserve exact facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle (slightly wavy, styled with loose strands falling on the forehead), trimmed beard, and sharp jawline. Maintain a realistic, masculine appearance with natural skin texture and no over-smoothing. A cinematic, ultra-realistic portrait of the same young man standing in a crowded urban street during golden hour. Shot in a side-profile (3/4 angle), mid-close framing. His expression is calm, introspective, slightly distant—eyes softly focused ahead as if lost in thought. Lighting & Atmosphere: Strong golden-hour sunlight from behind creates a dramatic rim light halo around his hair and shoulders. Individual hair strands glow with warm highlights. Subtle wind moves his hair naturally. Add cinematic lens flares, soft light leaks, and atmospheric haze. Wardrobe: Replace formal attire with a casual modern outfit: fitted dark t-shirt or lightweight jacket, visible backpack strap over one shoulder, fabric subtly catching warm sunlight. Environment: Busy urban street scene with motion-blurred pedestrians in the background. The crowd is out of focus, creating separation and depth. Background filled with warm tones—amber, orange, gold—with darker silhouettes for contrast. Camera & Technicals: Shot on 85mm lens, f/1.8 aperture, shallow depth of field, creamy cinematic bokeh, subject sharply in focus, background heavily blurred. Color & Grade: Kodak Portra-style color grading, warm highlights, soft shadows, high dynamic range, subtle film grain for realism. Mood: Cinematic, emotional, introspective, slightly nostalgic, urban solitude. Style Tags: ultra-realistic, cinematic lighting, volumetric light, backlit portrait, golden hour, lens flare, shallow depth of field, 8k, photorealistic, film still
2117903200341230601.promptZh:
以上传的参考图像作为面部身份基础。保留精确的面部结构、肤色、发型（略带波浪，松散发丝垂落于额头）、修剪整齐的胡须以及清晰的下颌线。保持写实、阳刚的外观，皮肤纹理自然，不进行过度磨皮。同一青年男子在黄金时刻（golden hour）站在拥挤的城市街道上所拍摄的电影感（cinematic）、超写实（ultra-realistic）肖像。采用侧脸（3/4角度）、中近景构图。他的神情平静、内省、略带疏离——目光柔和地望向远方，仿佛陷入沉思。  
照明与氛围：强烈的黄金时刻阳光从后方照射，在其头发与肩部形成富有戏剧感的轮廓光（rim light）光晕；单根发丝泛出温暖高光。微风自然吹拂其发丝。添加电影感镜头眩光（lens flares）、柔和的漏光（light leaks）及大气薄雾（atmospheric haze）。  
服饰：将正式着装替换为休闲现代风格服装：合身的深色T恤或轻便夹克，单肩可见背包背带，面料细腻反射温暖阳光。  
环境：繁忙的城市街道场景，背景行人呈运动模糊效果。人群失焦，营造主体分离感与景深（depth of field）。背景充满暖色调——琥珀色、橙色、金色，并以较暗剪影增强对比。  
相机与技术参数：85mm镜头拍摄，光圈f/1.8，浅景深（shallow depth of field），柔滑的电影感焦外虚化（bokeh），主体锐利清晰，背景大幅虚化。  
色彩与调色：柯达Portra风格（Kodak Portra-style）色彩分级，暖调高光，柔和阴影，高动态范围（HDR），辅以细微胶片颗粒（film grain）增强照片级写实（photorealistic）感。  
情绪：电影感（cinematic）、情感化、内省、略带怀旧、都市孤独感。  
风格标签：超写实（ultra-realistic）、电影感布光（cinematic lighting）、体积光（volumetric light）、逆光肖像（backlit portrait）、黄金时刻（golden hour）、镜头眩光（lens flare）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、8k、照片级写实（photorealistic）、电影剧照（film still）

2117903200341230602.promptEn: A hyper-realistic charcoal and graphite portrait of a handsome man with thick, dark curly hair. He is leaning his head against his hand in a pensive, intense pose. Use deep chiaroscuro lighting to create dramatic highlights on his face and forearm, with the background dissolving into heavy, textured black charcoal strokes. Every detail is meticulously rendered: the individual curls of his hair, the subtle stubble on his jaw, and the reflective moisture in his eyes. The style should feel like a traditional fine-art sketch on textured paper, featuring visible cross-hatching and blended smudges for depth. Monochrome, high contrast, moody, and cinematic.
2117903200341230602.promptZh: 一幅超写实（hyper-realistic）炭笔与石墨肖像画，描绘一位英俊男子，他拥有一头浓密、乌黑、卷曲的头发。他正以沉思而强烈的姿态，将头倚靠在手上。运用强烈的明暗对照法（chiaroscuro）布光，在其面部与前臂上营造出富戏剧性的高光，背景则消融于厚重、富有肌理感的黑色炭笔笔触之中。每一处细节均被一丝不苟地刻画：发丝间根根分明的卷曲、下颌上细微的胡茬，以及眼中反光的湿润感。整体风格应仿若一幅绘制在带纹理纸张上的传统美术素描，清晰可见交叉排线（cross-hatching）与用于表现纵深感的揉擦晕染（blended smudges）。单色、高对比度、情绪化、电影感（cinematic）。

2117903200341230603.promptEn:
A surreal, ultra-premium studio product scene featuring a pair of oversized deep burgundy leather luxury handbags placed diagonally on a polished reflective surface. The bags are crafted with smooth Italian leather, gold-plated hardware, embossed monogram patterns, and subtle stitching details, giving a high-fashion couture aesthetic.

The background is a rich gradient of dark plum fading into warm champagne gold, with soft cinematic lighting creating a luxurious glow and refined shadows.

Three miniature women interact with the oversized handbags, enhancing the surreal scale contrast. All women wear elevated fashion looks (tailored black blazers, silk tops, fitted trousers) with statement sunglasses, styled in tones of burgundy, gold, and black to complement the product.

One woman stands on the left adjusting a sleek golden chain attached to the handbag, grounded and composed. Another woman is suspended mid-air holding onto the chain strap, leaning playfully against the bag’s curved surface. The third woman stands confidently on the right atop the base of the bag, posing with elegance and authority.

The chain strap flows across the composition in a soft curve, guiding the viewer’s eye and adding motion.

Composition is cinematic and balanced, with generous negative space in the upper frame. Focus is razor sharp on the handbag textures, with a shallow depth of field softly blurring the background.

Style: ultra-realistic, luxury editorial campaign, surreal scale, high-fashion product photography
Camera: 85mm lens, eye-level angle, shallow depth of field
Lighting: soft diffused studio lighting with warm highlights, subtle reflections on leather and metal
Aspect ratio: 9:13 vertical
2117903200341230603.promptZh:
一幅超现实、超高规格的影棚产品场景，画面中一对超大尺寸的深酒红色皮革奢侈品手袋以对角线方式置于抛光反光表面上。手袋采用顺滑的意大利皮革制成，配以镀金五金件、压印单字母组合图案（monogram）以及细腻隐现的缝线细节，呈现出高级时装高定（haute couture）美学。

背景为浓郁的深李子色渐变为暖香槟金色的渐变色，辅以柔和的电影感布光（cinematic lighting），营造出奢华的辉光与精致的阴影。

三位微缩女性人物与超大尺寸手袋互动，强化超现实的尺度对比。所有女性均身着高阶时尚造型（剪裁合体的黑色西装外套、真丝上衣、修身长裤），佩戴醒目太阳镜，整体造型色调选用酒红色、金色与黑色，与产品相呼应。

其中一位女性立于画面左侧，正调整一条连接手袋的纤薄金色链条，姿态沉稳而从容；另一位女性悬浮于半空，手握链条肩带，俏皮地倚靠在手袋弧形表面；第三位女性自信立于画面右侧的手袋底部，姿态优雅而富有权威感。

链条肩带以柔和曲线贯穿整个构图，引导观者视线并增添动态感。

构图具有电影感（cinematic）且均衡，画面上方留有充裕的负空间。焦点精准锐利地落在手袋纹理之上，景深（depth of field）极浅，背景呈现柔和虚化。

风格：超写实、奢侈品杂志广告大片、超现实尺度、高端时尚产品摄影  
相机：85mm镜头，平视角度，浅景深（shallow depth of field）  
布光：柔和漫射式影棚布光（studio lighting），带有温暖高光，在皮革与金属表面呈现细腻反光  
画幅比例：9:13 竖构图

2117903200341230604.promptEn: A high-fashion cinematic portrait of a beautiful woman with a vintage 1960s-inspired aesthetic. She has voluminous, dark mahogany wavy hair styled in a classic beehive with a thick white headband and a rounded fringe. She is wearing stylish dark tortoise-shell cat-eye sunglasses tilted down, revealing sharp winged red eyeliner and intense green eyes. Her makeup is flawless with matte mauve lipstick, paired with long almond-shaped nails painted deep glossy red. She is wearing a simple white off-the-shoulder top against a neutral grey studio background. High-end photography, 85mm lens, f/1.8, sharp focus on facial details, elegant and sophisticated mood.
2117903200341230604.promptZh: 一幅高级时装电影感（cinematic）肖像画，描绘一位拥有1960年代复古美学风格的美丽女性。她拥有一头浓密、深红木色（dark mahogany）波浪卷发，以经典蜂巢式（beehive）发型盘起，佩戴一条宽厚的白色发带和圆润的齐刘海（rounded fringe）。她戴着一副时尚的深玳瑁色（dark tortoise-shell）猫眼形（cat-eye）太阳镜，镜片略微下滑，露出锐利的红色猫眼眼线（winged red eyeliner）与富有张力的绿色双眸。她的妆容无瑕，唇部涂有哑光梅紫色（matte mauve）口红，双手修长，指甲呈杏仁形，涂有深邃闪亮的正红色（deep glossy red）甲油。她身穿一件简约的白色露肩上衣（white off-the-shoulder top），背景为中性灰色影棚布景（neutral grey studio background）。高端摄影（high-end photography），85mm镜头，光圈f/1.8，面部细节焦内锐利（sharp focus on facial details），整体氛围优雅而精致（elegant and sophisticated mood）。
2117903200341230604.author: Calira

2117903200341230605.promptEn:
Close-up portrait of a beautiful woman with dark hair, wearing a shimmering gold metallic silk jacket. She has vibrant orange eyeshadow and glossy red lips. High-contrast cinematic lighting with dramatic shadows cast across her face. 85mm lens, f/1.8, high-fidelity, Vogue editorial photography style, hyper-realistic skin textures, soft bokeh background, warm color palette, 8k resolution.
Key Aesthetic Elements Detected:
Lighting: The "chiaroscuro" effect (high contrast between light and dark) creates that sharp shadow line across the eyes, which is a hallmark of dramatic studio photography.
Materiality: The jacket uses terms like "metallic," "lamé," or "liquid gold" to achieve that specific high-specular reflection.
Makeup Palette: The prompt specifically targets "sunset tones"—bronze, orange, and deep reds—to contrast with the dark background.
Composition: A "tight crop" or "headshot" framing using a long focal length (like 85mm) to minimize facial distortion and soften the background.
2117903200341230605.promptZh:
特写（close-up）肖像，一位黑发美女，身穿一件闪耀的金色金属质感真丝夹克。她化着鲜艳的橘色眼影，唇色为亮泽的红色。高对比度电影感布光（cinematic lighting），面部投下富有戏剧性的阴影。85mm镜头，f/1.8光圈，高保真，Vogue杂志编辑摄影风格，超写实（hyper-realistic）皮肤纹理，柔和焦外虚化（bokeh）背景，暖色调配色方案，8k分辨率。  
关键美学要素识别：  
布光：明暗对比法（chiaroscuro）效果（明暗之间的高对比度）在眼部形成锐利的阴影分界线，这是戏剧性影棚摄影的标志性特征。  
材质表现：夹克使用了“金属感”“亮片织物（lamé）”或“液态金（liquid gold）”等术语，以实现特定的高镜面反射效果。  
妆容配色：提示词明确指向“日落色调”—bronze、橘色与深红色——用以与深色背景形成对比。  
构图：采用“紧凑裁切”或“头部特写”式构图，搭配长焦距镜头（如85mm），以最小化面部畸变并柔化背景。
2117903200341230605.author: Ozair AI

2117903200341230606.promptEn: A photorealistic macro photograph of a miniature woman the size of a mouse walking gracefully through an enormous field of tall, lush green grass blades that tower over her like a dense jungle, she walks beside a ladybug that is the same size as her, ground-level perspective showing her tiny scale against the giant grass and scattered wildflowers, hyper-detailed realistic textures on every blade of grass and flower petal. The woman has the classic 1950s nostalgic pin-up look with voluminous blonde bouffant hairstyle in an elegant updo, fair skin with a luminous dewy glow, rosy cheeks, striking blue eyes looking upward, glossy red lipstick, and delicate dangling earrings. She wears a 1950s nostalgic outfit: a vibrant yellow polka-dot fitted bodice with white ruffled off-shoulder straps and a full flared teal skirt with shiny metallic silver trim and buttons, accentuating her figure in perfect period style. Precise lighting style; bright natural daylight under a clear blue sky with strong directional sunlight creating crisp specular highlights and glossy reflections on her skin, hair, shoulders, and clothing, giving her a shiny luminous almost wet-look glow; soft diffused fill light that gently models her face and body without harsh shadows; high contrast, vibrant saturated colors, and cinematic depth of field with beautiful creamy bokeh from out-of-focus grass blades, sunlight filtering through the grass, and distant flowers. Extremely realistic, photorealistic rendering, no cartoonish or stylized elements, intricate details, sharp focus on the woman, natural outdoor field environment, masterpiece quality.
2117903200341230606.promptZh:
一张照片级写实（photorealistic）的微距摄影图像：一位体型如老鼠般大小的微型女子，优雅地穿行于一片浩瀚茂密的高大翠绿草丛之中，草叶高耸入云，宛如浓密丛林将她环绕；她身旁爬行着一只与她等大的瓢虫；画面采用地面视角，凸显她相对于巨草与散落野花的渺小尺度；每根草叶与每片花瓣均呈现超精细写实纹理。  
该女子拥有经典1950年代怀旧海报女郎（pin-up）风格：蓬松丰盈的金色蜂窝式盘发（bouffant），优雅挽起；白皙肌肤泛着莹润水光（luminous dewy glow）；双颊绯红；明眸湛蓝，目光向上凝望；唇涂亮泽正红口红；耳垂佩戴精致垂坠式耳饰。  
她身着1950年代怀旧风格服饰：明黄色波点收腰紧身上衣，配白色荷叶边露肩肩带；下身为全幅喇叭形青绿色裙摆，缀有闪亮金属银色镶边与纽扣；整体剪裁完美展现其身形，精准还原时代风貌。  
布光精准考究：晴朗蓝天下的明亮自然日光，强方向性阳光在她的肌肤、发丝、肩部及服装表面形成清晰锐利的镜面高光（specular highlights）与光泽反射（glossy reflections），赋予她一种闪亮通透、近乎湿漉感（wet-look）的辉光；辅以柔和漫射补光（soft diffused fill light），细腻塑造面部与身体轮廓，不产生生硬阴影；高对比度、高饱和度的鲜活色彩；电影感景深（cinematic depth of field），背景失焦的草叶呈现柔美奶油质感焦外虚化（creamy bokeh），阳光穿透草叶间隙洒落，远景野花朦胧虚化。  
极度写实，照片级写实（photorealistic）渲染，无任何卡通化或风格化元素；细节繁复精微；焦点锐利集中于女子主体；自然户外田野环境；杰作级品质。
2117903200341230606.author: Mystique Licorne 🇨🇦

2117903200341230607.promptEn:
A high fashion magazine studio editorial shot set against a dark, solid seamless backdrop in deep charcoal to near black tones, designed to create maximum contrast and dramatic visual impact. The environment is minimal and controlled, removing all distractions so the subject and motion remain the sole focus of the composition.

Lighting is built around a hard direct strobe flash setup, producing intense highlights and deeply defined, razor sharp shadows. The flash freezes every element in motion with extreme clarity, capturing texture, depth, and impact in a single suspended moment. The lighting style is crisp and sculptural, emphasizing edges, contours, and airborne particles with precision.

The camera uses a SUPER ultra-wide 12mm lens, placed very close to the subject to exaggerate perspective and create a powerful sense of distortion and immediacy. A low angle viewpoint enhances drama, making the model appear larger than life and amplifying the feeling of instability and motion.

The model is captured mid stumble, moving forward with uncontrolled yet elegant momentum. One arm is thrown outward instinctively to regain balance, while the body leans into the motion, creating tension and dynamic asymmetry. Facial expression reflects urgency and focus, consistent with high fashion editorial intensity.

In the hand, a compact powder and blush palette is slipping loose, captured at the exact moment of release. The product is breaking apart in motion, contributing to the narrative of controlled chaos. A dramatic powder cloud explodes outward in mid air, forming a soft, textured plume that contrasts with the hard lighting and sharp shadows.

Makeup brushes scatter through the frame, each frozen individually in space, adding rhythm and directional flow to the composition. Fine powder particles float and disperse, catching strobe highlights like suspended dust in air.

The overall aesthetic is clean, high contrast, and meticulously retouched, maintaining luxury fashion magazine standards while emphasizing kinetic energy, unpredictability, and visual impact in a single frozen editorial moment.
2117903200341230607.promptZh:
一张高级时装杂志工作室专题摄影，以深炭灰至近黑色的纯色无缝背景为衬托，旨在营造极致对比度与戏剧性的视觉冲击力。环境极简且高度可控，彻底消除一切干扰元素，使主体与动态成为构图中唯一焦点。

布光采用硬质直射闪光灯（strobe flash）组合，产生强烈高光与轮廓锐利、定义深邃的阴影。闪光瞬间凝固所有运动元素，以极高清晰度捕捉质感、纵深与冲击力，定格于一个悬停的瞬间。布光风格明快而富有雕塑感（sculptural），精准强调边缘、轮廓及悬浮于空中的微粒。

相机搭载 SUPER 超广角 12mm 镜头，紧贴被摄主体放置，以夸张透视关系，营造强烈的畸变感与临场感。低角度（low angle）视角强化戏剧性，令模特呈现超凡尺度，并放大失衡感与动态张力。

模特正捕捉于踉跄中途，以失控却优雅的动势向前行进。一只手臂本能地向外甩出以恢复平衡，躯干顺势前倾，形成张力十足的动态不对称构图。面部表情流露紧迫感与专注力，契合高级时装专题摄影（editorial）所要求的高强度表现力。

手中一款紧凑型散粉与腮红调色盘正滑脱而出，定格于释放的精确刹那。产品在运动中解体，强化“受控混沌”（controlled chaos）的叙事逻辑。一团极具戏剧性的散粉云雾在空中猛然炸开，形成柔软而富质感的羽状云团，与硬朗布光及锐利阴影构成鲜明对比。

化妆刷散落于画面之中，每一支均被单独凝固于空间，为构图增添节奏感与方向性动势。细微的散粉颗粒悬浮、弥散，在闪光照射下如空气中悬浮的尘埃般熠熠生辉。

整体美学风格简洁、高对比度，并经精细修图（retouched），严守奢侈品时装杂志的制作标准，同时在单帧冻结的专题摄影瞬间中，凸显动能、不可预测性与视觉冲击力。

2117903200341230608.promptEn: A close-up portrait of a gorgeous young woman with dewy, glowing skin and soft natural makeup, centered composition. She has dark, slightly messy hair styled in a loose, wet-look updo with strands falling across her face. Her eyes are striking, softly lit with warm tones. She wears translucent red futuristic visor-style sunglasses sitting low on her nose, revealing her eyes. Large glossy red heart-shaped earrings hang from both ears. Her lips are slightly parted, glossy and full, holding a bright red, heart-shaped lollipop with a white stick. The candy has a shiny, wet texture with visible reflections. Lighting is strong, directional sunlight casting sharp shadows and highlights across her face and accessories, creating a high-fashion editorial look. Style is fashion photography, beauty editorial, hyper-detailed, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, high resolution, cinematic lighting, sharp focus on face and candy.
2117903200341230608.promptZh: 一位绝美年轻女性的特写（close-up）肖像，肌肤水润透亮、妆容柔和自然，构图居中。她拥有一头深色、略显凌乱的秀发，以松散湿发感（wet-look）盘发造型，几缕发丝垂落于面颊。她的眼睛极具表现力，以温暖色调柔光照明。她佩戴一副半透明红色未来主义护目镜式（visor-style）太阳镜，镜架低置于鼻梁，露出双眼。双耳垂挂硕大闪亮的红色心形耳环。双唇微启，丰盈亮泽，含着一支鲜红色心形棒棒糖，白色棒身清晰可见。糖果表面光泽湿润，反射效果明显。布光为强烈定向日光，在她面部与配饰上投下鲜明阴影与高光，营造出高级时尚杂志（high-fashion editorial）风格。风格为时尚摄影、美妆杂志大片（beauty editorial）、超精细（hyper-detailed）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、85mm镜头、高分辨率、电影感布光（cinematic lighting）、面部与糖果锐利对焦（sharp focus on face and candy）。

2117903200341230609.promptEn: Luxurious glossy fashion photography. A stunning brunette in a form-fitting dark burgundy velvet dress is sitting on marble steps. Behind her back rises a hyper-massive, gigantic peacock. The bird’s color is a deep obsidian black, while the “eyes” on its enormous, fully fanned tail feathers shimmer with glowing rose-gold. The peacock’s huge tail fills the entire background of the frame, enveloping the girl like a royal dome. Macro detailing of every shimmering feather and the velvet fabric. Shot from a slight low angle to emphasize grandeur. Soft directional lighting, 35mm lens, 8K, hyperrealism, Vogue cover aesthetic.
2117903200341230609.promptZh: 奢华闪亮的时尚摄影（fashion photography）。一位惊艳的棕发女子身穿修身深酒红色天鹅绒连衣裙，坐在大理石台阶上。她身后矗立着一只超巨型、庞大的孔雀。鸟身呈深黑曜石色，而它巨大且完全展开的尾羽上那些“眼斑”则闪耀着发光的玫瑰金色。孔雀巨大的尾羽填满画面整个背景，如皇家穹顶般将女孩环抱其中。对每一根闪烁的羽毛与天鹅绒面料进行微距细节（macro）刻画。采用轻微低角度（low angle）拍摄，以强调宏伟感。柔和的方向性布光（soft directional lighting），35mm镜头，8K，超写实主义（hyperrealism），《Vogue》封面美学（Vogue cover aesthetic）。
2117903200341230609.author: Dr. Samia

2117903200341230610.promptEn: Ultra-realistic 8K close-up portrait of a rugged man with wet skin glistening under dramatic cinematic lighting. Intense focus on one eye with sharp blue iris detail, wet strands of hair falling across the face, moisture droplets illuminated by warm orange and golden highlights. Strong texture of skin and beard captured with extreme clarity, high contrast between light and shadow, evoking a powerful and dramatic atmosphere. Hyper-detailed, photorealistic, cinematic style.
2117903200341230610.promptZh: 8K 超写实特写（close-up）肖像，描绘一位面容粗犷的男子，皮肤湿润，在强烈的电影感布光（cinematic lighting）下泛着光泽。聚焦于一只眼睛，蓝色虹膜（iris）细节锐利清晰；湿发 strands 贴面垂落，水珠在暖橙色与金色高光照射下熠熠生辉。皮肤与胡须纹理强劲有力，以极致清晰度呈现；明暗对比强烈，营造出震撼而富戏剧性的氛围。超精细、照片级写实（photorealistic）、电影风格。

2117903200341230613.promptEn: Create a cinematic high fashion editorial portrait inspired by luxury fashion magazines and modern runway campaigns. The scene takes place inside a professional photography studio with a completely dark seamless backdrop in deep matte black, creating a dramatic and minimal environment that allows the lighting and movement to dominate the frame. The overall aesthetic should feel energetic, chaotic, glamorous, and artistically controlled, like a premium Vogue or Balenciaga editorial captured at the exact explosive moment of impact. Use a SUPER ultra wide 12mm lens perspective to exaggerate depth, scale, and motion. The composition should feel immersive and distorted in a stylish cinematic way, with strong perspective stretching near the edges of the frame. Add a dramatic dutch tilt camera angle to create visual tension and fashion-forward intensity. The model should appear caught completely off guard during the instant a metallic balloon explodes beside them. Their shoulders are raised defensively, body slightly recoiling backward, while both hands partially cover the face in a spontaneous reflex reaction. Despite the chaotic movement, the pose must still feel elegant, expressive, and fashion editorial rather than comedic. At the center of the composition, a metallic balloon bursts violently in midair, releasing an explosive shower of reflective metallic confetti. The confetti should be frozen perfectly in motion using hard strobe flash photography, with every tiny reflective piece appearing razor sharp and suspended in the air around the subject’s face, hair, and outfit. Some confetti pieces should fly directly toward the camera lens to enhance depth and realism. The frozen particles should create a sense of dynamic energy while adding sparkle and texture throughout the image. Lighting should use a harsh direct strobe flash with ultra crisp detail, deep shadows, strong contrast, and dramatic highlights across the skin, clothing, and floating confetti. The model should wear a luxurious high fashion jacket with glossy textures, metallic details, or structured tailoring that reflects light beautifully. Hair should move naturally from the explosion impact while remaining stylish and controlled. Emphasize cinematic realism, glossy magazine aesthetics, premium fashion styling, dynamic motion, sharp facial detail, dramatic atmosphere, and luxury editorial production quality throughout the entire composition.
2117903200341230613.author: Dr. Samia

2117903200341230614.promptEn: A waist-up portrait of a young adult male standing perfectly centered and facing the camera directly, exuding a confident yet approachable demeanor with a subtle closed smile. His eyes and eyebrows are completely concealed behind thick-rimmed black acetate sunglasses, framed by dark, matte over-ear headphones. He is clad in a heavy black overcoat layered over a light heather-grey hoodie, his shoulders level in a poised stance. His arms are clasped at his chest in a classic, relaxed crossed-arms posture, where his right hand rests over his left forearm with the fingers slightly curled inward and hidden inside the deep fold of the coat sleeve, while his other hand remains tucked securely beneath his right bicep. Behind him, an outdoor urban setting unfolds with deep spatial layers, beginning with thick, cylindrical metallic suspension cables that stretch diagonally from mid-left to mid-right, providing a smooth, reflective structural framing. The midground features the dark blue-grey water of the flowing River Thames, textured with slight surface ripples and reflections. Stretching across the distant background is a sweeping cityscape mixing weathered brick facades, historic domes, and modern glass blocks, dramatically anchored in the top right quadrant by the towering, pristine pyramidal glass structure of The Shard, detailed with a subtle red crane near its tip. The scene captures a crisp, clear day defined by highly directional, hard natural sunlight striking from the front-left at roughly a 45-degree angle from above. This intense illumination creates a high-contrast, energetic atmosphere, casting deep black shadows with harsh, defined edges under the subject's chin, along the right side of his face, deep inside the interior folds of his black coat, and across the right side of his hoodie. Stark highlights are perfectly preserved on his left cheek, the top rim of the grey hoodie, and the gleaming metallic bridge cables. The complementary color profile relies heavily on the striking contrast between the highly saturated clear blue sky—which transitions in a smooth gradient from a darker zenith to a lighter horizon dotted with scattered fluffy white clouds in the mid-left quadrant—and the neutral, deep tones of his urban streetwear. Rendered in the clean, structured, and realistic style of modern lifestyle influencer photography, the digital image boasts tack-sharp focus on the subject while employing a medium depth of field that leaves the distant background architecture slightly soft yet distinctly recognizable. The straight-on, eye-level perspective mimics a standard portrait lens shot at a fast shutter speed, enhanced by high-contrast post-processing that slightly crushes the blacks to emphasize the rich texture of the overcoat while keeping the vivid blue hues in the sky exceptionally vibrant, with the entire composition beautifully framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230614.promptZh: 一位年轻成年男性腰部以上的肖像，他完美居中站立，正面对着相机，神情自信而亲切，嘴角带着一丝含蓄的闭口微笑。他的眼睛和眉毛完全被一副宽边黑色醋酸纤维太阳镜遮住，镜框外侧配有哑光深色包耳式耳机。他身穿一件厚重的黑色大衣，内搭一件浅灰褐色连帽衫，双肩水平，姿态从容。双臂在胸前交叠，呈经典而放松的抱臂姿势：右手覆于左前臂之上，手指微微向内蜷曲，隐没于大衣袖口深邃的褶皱之中；左手则稳稳 tucked 在右肱二头肌下方。他身后是一处户外城市景观，空间层次丰富：前景为粗壮的圆柱形金属悬索，自画面中左方向中右方斜向延展，形成平滑且具反射感的结构框架；中景为深蓝灰色的泰晤士河河水，水面泛起细微涟漪，并映出天光；远景则铺展开一幅恢弘的城市天际线，融合了斑驳的砖墙立面、历史悠久的穹顶建筑与现代玻璃体块，其中右上象限矗立着高耸洁净的金字塔形玻璃建筑——碎片大厦（The Shard），其顶端附近隐约可见一台微小的红色塔吊。整个场景呈现晴朗通透的天气，由来自左前方、约从上方45度角投射的强烈自然直射阳光所定义。这种高强度光照营造出高对比度、富有活力的氛围，在人物下颌下方、面部右侧、黑色大衣内部褶皱深处以及连帽衫右侧投下浓重、边缘锐利的纯黑阴影；同时，左侧脸颊、灰褐色连帽衫顶部边缘以及闪亮的金属桥索表面，则精准保留了强烈的高光。整体色彩搭配以互补色为主：高度饱和的澄澈蓝天——自天顶较深的蓝色渐变至地平线较浅的蓝色，中左象限点缀着几朵蓬松的白色云朵——与人物都市街头服饰所采用的中性深色调形成鲜明对比。图像以现代生活方式博主摄影（modern lifestyle influencer photography）所特有的干净、严谨且写实的风格呈现，数字成像主体清晰锐利（tack-sharp focus），并采用中等景深（medium depth of field），使远处的建筑群略带虚化却仍轮廓分明。正面平视视角模拟标准人像镜头（portrait lens）拍摄效果，快门速度较快，并经高对比度后期处理（high-contrast post-processing）略微压暗暗部（slightly crushes the blacks），以凸显大衣丰富的质感，同时令天空中的蓝色异常鲜活明艳；整幅构图以4:5画幅比完美框取。
2117903200341230614.author: Picts by AI

2117903200341230615.promptEn: A male model stands centered and straight-on, exuding a serious, confident presence with his face featuring an even five o'clock shadow and a closed, neutral mouth, his gaze relaxed yet focused and directed away to the viewer's right. His hair is a three-to-four-inch medium-short classic taper cut with a layered top, swept back and parted slightly off-center to the left, styled with a matte paste that controls the naturally slightly wavy texture while revealing individual piecey strands, natural density variations, and minor organic flyaways along the hairline and crown for authentic imperfection. He is dressed in an oversized, textured dark espresso brown leather zip-up jacket with wide open collars over a crisp white crew-neck t-shirt, paired with warm tan trousers. His level shoulders and centered weight frame his meticulously positioned hands, both clad in dark espresso brown leather gloves; his left hand lightly pinches the left lens rim of a pair of round tortoiseshell sunglasses featuring dark purple-grey tinted lenses, while his right hand gently holds the right arm and hinge area with slightly curled fingers, suspending a fine gold-brass chain lanyard draped elegantly down across his torso. Directly behind him in the shallow midground stands a pristine outdoor architectural column made of smooth, matte painted plaster, boasting a crisp pure white surface and a perfect vertical corner line entirely devoid of scuffs or cracks. The scene is bathed in bright, highly directional natural sunlight striking from a forty-five-degree angle slightly top-down from the viewer's left, producing a dramatic, high-contrast atmosphere without any ambient fill. This hard light carves harsh, defined, deep black shadows under his jaw, beneath the jacket collar flaps, on the right side of his nose, and casts a heavy geometric shadow across the pristine white wall on the right, while meticulously preserving bright highlights on his forehead, nose bridge, right cheekbone, hair texture, and the top edges of the leather jacket shoulders. The overall mood is sophisticated and structured, heavily influenced by minimalist architectural fashion campaigns, balancing a neutral base with warm monochromatic accents. Captured as a high-end menswear editorial photograph, the image utilizes an 85mm lens at an aperture between f/5.6 and f/8, ISO 100, and a fast shutter speed to achieve tack-sharp, grain-free focus with a medium depth of field. The straight-on perspective is refined through post-processing with a high contrast curve, crisp sharpening to emphasize the leather grain and hair strands, and a neutral white balance ensuring deep, clean blacks, all perfectly framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230615.promptZh:
一名男性模特居中直面镜头站立，神情严肃而自信；面部留有均匀的五点式胡茬，双唇闭合、表情中性；目光放松却专注，朝向观者右侧。  
他的头发为三至四英寸长的中短经典渐变剪裁（taper cut），顶部层次分明，向后梳理并略偏左分线，使用哑光发膏定型，既控制了天然微卷的发质，又展现出清晰的缕缕发丝、自然的发量疏密变化，以及发际线与头顶处细微有机的碎发，呈现真实而不完美的质感。  
他身穿一件 oversized 的深意式浓缩咖啡棕（espresso brown）纹理皮革拉链夹克，衣领大开，内搭一件挺括的纯白圆领T恤，下身搭配暖色调卡其色长裤。  
双肩水平、重心居中，双手经过精心定位：双手均佩戴深意式浓缩咖啡棕皮革手套；左手轻轻捏住一副圆形玳瑁纹太阳镜的左镜框边缘，镜片为深紫灰色调；右手则以微蜷的手指轻握右镜腿与铰链部位，并悬垂一条纤细的金色黄铜链条挂绳，优雅地斜跨于胸前。  
他正后方的浅景中景处，矗立着一根洁净的户外建筑立柱，由光滑哑光涂料粉刷的石膏制成，表面为纯净无瑕的白色，垂直转角线条锐利精准，毫无刮痕或裂纹。  
整个场景沐浴在明亮、高度定向的自然阳光之中——光线从观者左侧上方约四十五度角斜射而来，营造出戏剧性强、高对比度的氛围，且无任何环境补光。  
这种硬光在下颌下方、夹克衣领翻折处、鼻梁右侧投下浓重、轮廓清晰、深黑的阴影，并在右侧 pristine 白墙面上投下厚重的几何形阴影；同时精准保留了前额、鼻梁、右颧骨、发丝纹理以及皮革夹克肩部上缘的明亮高光。  
整体情绪精致而严谨，深受极简主义建筑风格时尚广告大片影响，在中性基调中融入温暖单色系点缀。

2117903200341230618.promptEn:
Ultra-realistic full-body fashion portrait of her with long dark brown hair and soft wispy bangs, walking through a vast field of blooming Pink wildflowers under natural daylight. She is captured from a slightly low-angle perspective, creating a cinematic editorial feel. She wears an elegant flowing light-Pink chiffon gown with delicate embroidery, sheer billowing sleeves, subtle lace detailing, and realistic fabric movement from a gentle breeze. The dress has a tasteful thigh slit and layered translucent textures that catch the sunlight naturally.

She holds a fresh handpicked bundle of vivid Red wildflowers close to her chest while walking gracefully through the meadow. Her makeup is soft and refined with natural glowing skin, subtle peach blush, feathered brows, soft brown eyeliner, glossy muted rose lips, and realistic skin texture with visible pores and fine facial detail. Her expression is dreamy and contemplative, looking slightly away from the camera.

Golden sunlight filters through scattered clouds in a bright blue sky, creating realistic highlights and soft shadows across her face, hair, and dress. The wind gently lifts strands of hair and flowing fabric. Foreground flowers are softly blurred with realistic depth of field, while distant wildflowers fade naturally into the background. Cinematic photography, ultra-detailed realism, luxury fashion editorial aesthetic, realistic anatomy, realistic hands, natural proportions, HDR photography, shallow depth of field, shot on a full-frame mirrorless camera, 85mm lens, f/1.8, high dynamic range, photorealistic textures, soft atmospheric lighting, Vogue-style outdoor editorial shoot, no fantasy elements, no CGI look, no anime style.
2117903200341230618.promptZh:
超写实全身时尚人像，她拥有一头浓密的深棕色长发和轻盈蓬松的刘海，在自然日光下穿行于一片盛开着粉红色野花的广阔田野中。采用略低角度视角拍摄，营造出电影感（cinematic）的时尚杂志编辑风格（editorial feel）。她身着一袭优雅飘逸的浅粉色雪纺长裙，裙身饰有精致刺绣，袖子轻盈通透、随风鼓起，细节处点缀细腻蕾丝，布料在微风中呈现真实自然的动态褶皱。裙装设计含恰到好处的大腿开衩，以及多层半透明材质叠加，能自然捕捉阳光。

她一手轻捧一束新鲜采摘的鲜红色野花，紧贴胸前，步态优雅地穿行于草甸之中。她的妆容柔和精致：肌肤呈现自然光泽感，腮红为淡雅蜜桃色，眉毛如羽毛般轻盈，眼线为柔和棕色调，唇色为哑光柔雾玫瑰色，皮肤质感高度写实，清晰可见毛孔与细腻面部细节。她的神情梦幻而沉思，目光微微偏移镜头方向。

金色阳光穿透晴朗蓝天中零散分布的云朵，在她面部、发丝与裙装上投下真实高光与柔和阴影。微风轻拂，发丝与衣袂随之微微扬起。前景野花经焦外虚化（bokeh）处理，呈现真实景深（depth of field），远景野花则自然渐隐于背景之中。电影感摄影（cinematic photography）、超精细写实（ultra-detailed realism）、奢华时尚杂志编辑美学（luxury fashion editorial aesthetic）、真实人体解剖结构（realistic anatomy）、真实手部刻画（realistic hands）、自然人体比例（natural proportions）、HDR摄影（HDR photography）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、使用全画幅无反相机（full-frame mirrorless camera）拍摄、85mm镜头、f/1.8光圈、高动态范围（high dynamic range）、照片级写实（photorealistic）纹理、柔和氛围光（soft atmospheric lighting）、《Vogue》风格户外时尚杂志拍摄（Vogue-style outdoor editorial shoot）、无幻想元素、无CGI观感、非动漫风格。

Goal: Create a realistic 3D character reference sheet for a cute plush-like creature named bioluminescent cream forest cub, designed for consistent video generation.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 character sheet on a matte medium-gray studio background, soft diffused lighting, subtle floor shadows, high-resolution photorealistic fur rendering.

Subject details: The character is a small chubby teddy-bear/cat hybrid with a round oversized head, short rounded body, tiny arms, stubby legs, cream-colored dense fuzzy fur, glossy dark olive-brown eyes with bright catchlights, a tiny dark brown nose and mouth, faint pink cheeks, one thin curled hair sprout on top of the head, small rounded ears that glow bioluminescent green inside, and a short tail with a glowing green tip. The overall mood is adorable, soft, and toy-like, with realistic fiber texture and gentle translucency in the glowing green areas. Use warm cream, bioluminescent green, and soft pink blush.

Layout: Arrange the sheet in two main rows. Top row contains exactly 3 full-body turnaround views, evenly spaced and labeled in small white uppercase text: 1) “01 FRONT” showing the creature facing forward, 2) “02 3/4 LEFT” showing a three-quarter left view with the tail visible behind, 3) “03 BACK” showing the back view with rounded head, back fur, small arms, legs, and glowing tail tip. Bottom left contains an expression sheet with exactly 3 vertical framed panels labeled “EXPRESSION SHEET” above and captions below: 1) “01 NEUTRAL” with calm forward-facing eyes and closed small mouth, 2) “02 BATTLE FURY” with the face area covered by a centered opaque beige square block, 3) “03 SHOCK” with raised ears, wide eyes, and open surprised mouth. Bottom right contains a color palette column labeled “COLOR PALETTE” with exactly 5 rectangular swatches and labels: 1) “CREAM FUR” beige fur texture, 2) “BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN” glowing green gradient, 3) “PINK CHEEK” rosy pink texture, 4) “DARK BROWN OUTLINE / NOSE” dark brown swatch, 5) “WHITE HIGHLIGHT” white swatch.

Text style: Small clean sans-serif uppercase white labels, minimal technical character-sheet typography, aligned precisely and unobtrusively.

2117903200341230652.promptEn: A hand-painted vintage Chinese tourist food map poster in watercolor and ink wash style, shown from a bird’s-eye view over a misty mountainous county landscape. The composition is a stylized illustrated map of 缙云, with pale rice-paper texture, soft beige background, green-gray mountains, winding rivers, country roads, old towns, scenic rocks, bamboo leaves, and pink flowers framing the corners. Large artistic Chinese calligraphy title at the upper left reads 缙云 山野美食暴走地图, with a small subtitle ribbon below reading “黄帝缙云·人间仙都”. Add a poetic text block on the left in Chinese: “山水缙云，仙都奇境 百味乡野，烟火人间 跟着美食，遇见缙云 一城山水，一口乡愁”. In the center is the main county town labeled “缙云县城”, surrounded by illustrated routes connecting scenic destinations and local dishes. Include exactly 12 numbered food stops, each with a realistic painted bowl or plate of food placed on the map near its location, with orange circular numbers and Chinese labels plus a short one-line description. The 12 stops are: 1 “河阳土爽面” with description “山野本味，宾客烟火”; 2 “笕川笋干菜” with description “时令山珍，晒干留香”; 3 “缙云烧饼” with description “炭炉焦香，卷云招牌”; 4 “敲肉羹” with description “鲜香软糯，地道乡味”; 5 “岩下炖汤” with description “石材慢炖，暖身养胃”; 6 “溪鱼鲜” with description “山水河鲜，鲜掉眉毛”; 7 “壶镇扁食/落菜” with description “古法胶味，越吃越香”; 8 “葛根豆腐” with description “山野清润，解腻爽口”; 9 “山粉饺” with description “皮薄馅足，山野风味”; 10 “苦槠豆腐” with description “山林珍味，自然本鲜”; 11 “农家焐年糕” with description “糯香浓郁，儿时味道”; 12 “老街米糕” with description “清甜米香，古法手工”. Mark exactly 8 place labels on the map: “新建镇”, “壶镇镇”, “大洋镇”, “仙都景区”, “河阳古民居”, “岩宕书房”, “蛟龙大峡谷”, and “缙云县城”. Paint recognizable scenic clusters with white-walled black-roofed traditional houses, steep karst peaks, bridges, and terraced terrain. Add a small legend box at the lower right with exactly 5 items labeled “山脉”, “河流”, “主要道路”, “乡镇”, and “景点地标”, plus a sixth food icon label “美食推荐”. Include a decorative compass rose nearby. Overall mood is elegant, artisanal, nostalgic, and premium, like a cultural tourism poster combining local cuisine guide and scenic map illustration, with highly polished composition and refined Chinese branding.

Core Subject: [use the uploaded image, keep the details, typography and structure locked 100%]

Layout & Composition: A professional industrial design presentation sheet. The image should be organized into a clean grid system.

Top Row: A 3x3 layout showing top-down flat lay views and close-up macro details of materials.

Middle Section: Three hero shots of the product standing upright in different color ways (Matte Black, Arctic White, and accented variants). The products should be slightly tilted to show depth and form.

Bottom Section: A dynamic "floating" composition featuring two products overlapping at opposing angles to showcase the front and side profiles simultaneously.

Environment & Lighting: Set against a minimalist, neutral studio gray background. Soft top-down lighting with realistic contact shadows. High-end product photography aesthetic.

Style & Finish: Matte textures, clean silhouettes, and sharp edges. Leave designated blank areas on the product surfaces for "Placeholder Branding" and "Graphic Mockups." 4k resolution, Unreal Engine 5 render style, hyper-realistic, clean aesthetic.

2117903200341230666.promptEn: Create a vintage illustrated travel poster in traditional Chinese for 阿里山國家風景區, designed as a one-day itinerary infographic with a split vertical layout. The left panel is a parchment-textured itinerary card in warm beige with ornate gold Art Nouveau borders and dark brown typography, and the right panel is a dramatic painted fantasy-realism map scene of a mountain journey at sunrise and sunset tones. At the top of the left panel, large headline text reads 阿里山國家風景區一日遊. Beneath it, include a short centered tagline in traditional Chinese: 「一座高山，五個經典景點。難忘的奇幻旅程。」 with a small decorative mountain divider. The left panel must contain exactly 5 numbered itinerary stops stacked vertically, each with a circular black-and-gold number badge, a small vignette illustration, a bold location name, a time in parentheses, and a short Chinese description. The 5 stops are: 1. 「阿里山車站」 at 「(8:00 AM)」 with a wooden mountain railway station illustration and description 「開啟探索神木與森林的旅程。」 2. 「阿里山森林鐵路」 at 「(9:30 AM)」 with a red-and-black steam train illustration and description 「穿越森林，體驗百年林鐵風情。」 3. 「神木區棧道」 at 「(11:30 AM)」 with giant cedar trees and elevated wooden boardwalk illustration and description 「漫步千年巨木下，感受森林靈氣。」 4. 「姊妹潭」 at 「(1:30 PM)」 with a tranquil forest lake and pavilion illustration and description 「欣賞靜謐湖光，聆聽自然樂章。」 5. 「小笠原山展望台」 at 「(4:00 PM)」 with a wooden observation deck above clouds at sunset illustration and description 「觀賞壯闊山景與雲海，欣賞日落。」 The right panel should depict a continuous glowing golden path winding through exactly 5 numbered map markers that match the left panel labels in order, with black-and-gold marker plaques reading: 1 「阿里山車站」, 2 「阿里山森林鐵路」, 3 「神木區棧道」, 4 「姊妹潭」, 5 「小笠原山展望台」. Show stop 1 as a rustic alpine wooden station perched on a cliff among pine forests; stop 2 as a small steam locomotive traveling on a curved mountain railway with smoke drifting upward; stop 3 as towering ancient red cypress trees with a spiral and zigzag wooden walkway around the trunks; stop 4 as an emerald lake surrounded by dense forest with a small pavilion and arched bridge; stop 5 as a lookout deck on a peak above a sea of clouds, facing a glowing sunset. The environment should feature layered mountain ranges, mist-filled valleys, evergreen forests, golden-hour light, luminous cloud seas, and a romantic painterly atmosphere with rich detail. At the bottom right, add a decorative compass rose labeled N, E, S, W, plus a dark green and gold information box with exactly 2 stats in traditional Chinese: 「總距離 ~9公里 / 5.6英里」 and 「預計時間 全天 - 14,500步」. Overall style: premium tourism poster, painterly digital illustration, nostalgic national-park brochure aesthetic, highly detailed, warm sepia and gold accents, elegant composition, readable Chinese text, vertical 2:3 poster.

2117903200341230688.promptEn: A polished children's pop-up book advertisement on a dark studio background, featuring an open hardcover book with thick white pages and a teal-green cover lying on a tabletop. From the center fold, a highly detailed white paper origami T-rex bursts upward in a dynamic roaring pose, mouth wide open with sharp triangular teeth, tiny clawed arms raised, thick folded legs planted in layered paper jungle foliage, and a segmented tail extending backward. The dinosaur should look handcrafted from crisp folded cardstock, with visible geometric paper panels and clean origami seams. Behind it, the right-hand page stands partially upright and catches a dramatic shadow projection of the T-rex profile, creating a large silhouette with open jaws; also include small paper-cut scenery on that page: 3 flying pterosaurs and a simple mountain landscape. Surround the dinosaur base with dense cut-paper plants and grass emerging from both pages. Light the scene with a cinematic warm spotlight from the upper left, leaving the background in deep navy to black, with soft realistic shadows cast across the book and onto the raised page. At the top center, include bold white ad typography in stacked lines reading DINOSAURS POP UP ADVENTURE, with a white ribbon banner below that reads A WORLD OF WONDER IN EVERY PAGE. At the bottom center, place 4 evenly spaced circular feature icons with captions in white: an open book icon labeled "AMAZING POP UP DESIGNS", a hand icon labeled "HANDCRAFTED WITH CARE", a shield icon labeled "DURABLE & KID FRIENDLY", and a light bulb icon labeled "INSPIRES IMAGINATION". Premium toy catalog style, cinematic product photography mixed with paper craft illustration, centered composition, high contrast, ultra-clean, whimsical, family-friendly, realistic paper texture.

To the right of each circle, place short Japanese explanatory text. On the right side of the page, add 2 product callout labels in serif English with thin leader lines: "HAT" near the upper-right hat with a short Japanese description below, and "COAT" near the lower-right side of the coat with a short Japanese description below. Keep the layout airy and balanced, with elegant negative space, refined magazine styling, realistic garment textures, and a modern outdoor-luxury aesthetic.

2117903200341230691.promptEn:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet [VISUAL STYLE] Monochrome grayscale composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture. 
[GRID LAYOUT] Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression. [CHARACTER] Use image1 as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions. [WARDROBE] The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a well-fitted top paired with a short, flowy skirt. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale. [PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME] Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”) Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions [MOTION INDICATORS] Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation. [RENDER QUALITY] High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose. [RESTRICTIONS] No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter—only the dancer and instructional elements.

2117903200341230713.promptEn: Create a premium e-commerce product advertisement in a clean botanical skincare style, featuring an open gift box of MONSTER 皮肤精华 centered on a light stone tabletop. The packaging is pale sage green and off-white with a minimalist luxury aesthetic, soft matte finish, and delicate watercolor leaf illustrations inside the lid and on the sachets. The box lid is open upright, showing elegant typography: the large brand line MONSTER 皮肤精华, a secondary line 7天舒缓肌肤, smaller Chinese copy beneath, and 3 small circular feature icons aligned horizontally in the center area. Inside the box, show exactly 4 flat sheet-mask sachets stacked on the left and exactly 5 slim glass serum ampoules standing in a row on the right, each with silver caps and vertical label text. On the front lip of the box, print the same product branding in small refined type. On the right side of the composition, place exactly 3 vertically stacked line-art benefit icons with bilingual labels: a leaf icon with 舒缓修护 and the English subtitle "SOOTHING REPAIR", wavy water lines with 水润保湿 and the English subtitle "HYDRATING", and a balance scale icon with the Chinese label "平衡肌肤" and the English subtitle "BALANCE". Surround the scene with a serene natural spa environment: soft-focus green branches entering from the upper left and upper right edges, moss-covered stones on both sides, subtle leaves in the foreground, and diffused daylight on a warm ivory background. Use a balanced front-facing composition, gentle shadows, high-end commercial lighting, crisp packaging detail, muted green palette, and a calm, trustworthy, premium skincare advertisement look.

2117903200341230718.promptEn:
Create a clean vertical technical workflow infographic on a light gray background, using a minimalist modern product-diagram style with rounded white cards, thin colored outlines, simple vector line icons, dark navy text, and navy connector arrows. The composition is a single centered top-to-bottom flowchart with 7 numbered main steps, plus 2 parallel cache-group panels branching from step 4 into step 5, and a thick dark return arrow on the far left looping from the bottom back to the top. Use crisp sans-serif typography, generous spacing, subtle pastel accent colors, no gradients, no shadows, and presentation-slide clarity.

At the top center place step card 1 with a blue outline and a code/chat icon on the left. Title text: "1. chat completions request". Subtitle beneath: "conversation_id + cache_salt + new suffix messages".

Below it place step card 2 with a blue outline and a document/list icon. Title: "2. Frontend conversation ledger". Subtitle: "lease same id + track committed messages".

Below it place step card 3 with a cyan outline and a database-with-magnifier icon. Title: "3. Exact conversation cache lookup". Subtitle: "conversation_id  committed turn state".

Below it place step card 4 with a purple outline and a branching scheduler icon. Title: "4. Scheduler cache attachment". Subtitle: "set num_computed_tokens + attach committed state".

From step 4, branch downward into 2 side-by-side group panels.

Left group panel: a pale green rounded container titled "Full-attention KV cache group". Inside it, stack 2 inner cards. First inner card has a green block-grid icon, title "Committed block refs", subtitle "share aligned full KV blocks". Second inner card below has a green layered-sheets icon, title "Tail COW copy", subtitle "copy unaligned KV tail". At the bottom of the green panel add small footer text: "paged K/V tensors for transformer layers".

Right group panel: a pale purple rounded container titled "Mamba terminal-state cache group". Inside it, stack 2 inner cards. First inner card has a purple database/network icon, title "Committed terminal state", subtitle "exact state at committed length". Second inner card below has a purple wavy-lines icon, title "Request-owned terminal copy", subtitle "copy SSM + conv state". At the bottom of the purple panel add small footer text: "align-mode terminal state placement".

Merge both group-panel outputs into a centered step card 5 with a blue outline and a microchip icon. Title: "5. Hybrid model execution". Subtitle: "run only the uncached suffix". Inside the bottom area of this card, include 2 pill-shaped labels side by side: "Transformer layers" and "Mamba layers".

Below it place step card 6 with a blue outline and a sparkle icon. Title: "6. Decode assistant tokens". Subtitle: "stream response token by token".

Below it place step card 7 with a warm yellow-orange outline and a database-with-check icon. Title: "7. Commit completed turn". Subtitle: "publish pending state or discard on failure".

Add a thick dark navy loop arrow running down the far left side, entering step 1 near the top from the left and returning from step 7 at the bottom back upward. Along this left loop, near the lower half, place stacked annotation text: "next request reuses committed conversation head".

Add 2 dashed publish arrows rising upward from step 7 toward the cache-group panels: one green dashed arrow on the left pointing to the green cache panel, labeled "publish new state"; one purple dashed arrow on the right pointing to the purple cache panel, also labeled "publish new state".

Keep the exact total count of 7 numbered main cards, 2 cache group panels, 4 inner cache cards, and 2 pill labels. Preserve a portrait aspect ratio similar to a conference-slide architecture diagram.

2117903200341230721.promptEn: A cute hand-drawn animal illustration in a soft watercolor and colored-pencil storybook style, viewed from directly above. Two ferrets are curled together snugly inside a square pet bed with high padded sides. The left ferret is a pale cream color with fluffy fur, a pink nose, round glossy black eyes, and a gentle sweet expression; its long body curves around the other ferret protectively. The right ferret is a sable ferret with a dark brown body, warm tan underfur, a cream face mask, pink nose, and bright black eyes, smiling slightly with tiny teeth visible and one small paw raised near its chest. Their bodies form a cozy spiral composition, touching cheek to cheek. The bed has a soft light gray inner cushion and dark charcoal-black outer sides, with visible fabric texture and softly shaded folds in each corner. Around them are 4 pink doodle hearts and 4 sparkle or emphasis marks in a playful sticker-like style, adding a kawaii mood. Use a warm off-white paper background with subtle beige wash, delicate textured edges, fine fur detail, soft lighting, charming pastel accents, and an overall adorable affectionate feel.

2117903200341230737.promptEn:
Shot with a high-definition underwater camera, this prompt captures real underwater natural scenery in a clear shallow stream next to a tropical primeval forest.

Vertical composition, 3:4 aspect ratio, medium-to-long shot. The lens is slightly below the water surface, showing the shimmering bottom of the water surface above with realistic water wave refraction and natural reflections.

Sunlight shines diagonally into the water from the top right, forming soft beams and underwater spots. Dark reflections and shadows of large tree branches occupy part of the composition in the upper right.

In the middle is clear and quiet stream water with slight suspended particles and 5-8 native freshwater small fish swimming naturally, mainly gray-silver and light brown, varying in size and distance, not forming an organized school. On the stream bed, deep green, yellow-green, and brownish-green water plants grow naturally, swaying gently with the current, distributed naturally unlike an artificial aquarium.

The bottom consists of gray-brown fine sand, gravel, pebbles, and several naturally shaped stones with slight algae marks and signs of water erosion. Multiple springs at the bottom show fine sand billowing slowly from small holes, creating light sand clouds and local water disturbances, not white smoke, steam, or large bubbles.

Natural landscape live-action photography, high-end natural documentary feel, close to National Geographic ecological photography. Features transparent water, natural lighting, restrained colors, realistic underwater optical effects, slight graininess, natural depth of field, and high-definition details.

No people, no buildings, no artificial traces, no text, no borders, no LOGO. Avoid CG feel, aquarium look, seabed coral, exaggerated fish schools, oversaturated greens, dreamy lighting effects, or plastic water plants.
2117903200341230737.promptZh:
使用高清水下相机拍摄，该提示词捕捉热带原始森林旁一处清澈浅溪中的真实水下自然景观。

竖构图，3:4 画幅比，中远景。镜头略低于水面，呈现上方水面波光粼粼的倒影，具备真实的水面波纹折射（water wave refraction）与自然反射（natural reflections）。

阳光从右上方斜射入水，形成柔和光束与水下光斑。粗大树枝的深色倒影与阴影占据画面右上方部分区域。

画面中央为清澈静谧的溪水，含少量悬浮微粒；5–8 条本地淡水小型鱼自然游动，主色调为灰银色与浅褐色，体型与距离各不相同，未形成有组织的鱼群（school）。溪床生长着深绿色、黄绿色与褐绿色的水生植物，随水流轻柔摇曳，分布自然，不似人工水族箱布置。

溪底由灰褐色细沙、砾石、卵石及若干天然形态的石块构成，表面带有轻微藻类痕迹与水流侵蚀迹象。底部多处泉眼从小孔中缓缓涌出细沙，形成轻盈的沙云与局部水流扰动，非白色烟雾、蒸汽或大气泡。

自然景观实拍摄影（natural landscape live-action photography），高端自然纪录片质感，贴近《国家地理》（National Geographic）生态摄影风格。呈现透明水质、自然布光、克制的色彩、真实水下光学效果（underwater optical effects）、轻微胶片颗粒感（graininess）、自然景深（depth of field）及高清晰度细节。

无人物、无建筑、无人工痕迹、无文字、无边框、无 LOGO。避免 CG 感、水族箱观感、海底珊瑚、夸张鱼群、过度饱和的绿色、梦幻式布光效果（dreamy lighting effects）或塑料质感水生植物。

2117903200341230738.promptEn: Using REFERENCE_0 and REFERENCE_1 as messy handwritten study-note sources, convert the content into a clean vertical Japanese educational infographic for quick sharing with teachers. Preserve the core topic about designing reading lessons for narrative texts, but organize it visually instead of reproducing the notebook pages. Create a polished white-background layout with navy section headers, rounded cards, simple flat icons, arrows, checkmarks, and color-coded boxes. Add the main title 読む力を育てる授業デザイン and subtitle 〜描写を根拠に、ズレを起点として、解釈を深める授業〜. Structure the infographic into exactly 7 numbered sections plus a final summary band: 1) lesson basic structure with four steps labeled 事実（描写）→ 解釈 → 意味づけ → 自分の言葉, 2) three stages of learning depth labeled 低：表面的理解, 中：解釈の形成, 高：意味の再構築, 3) question design with good-question conditions, question flow, and concrete example prompts, 4) points for improving dialogue quality with two comparison cards labeled NG and 目指す対話 plus keyword chips 比較, 関連づけ, 再解釈, 5) the teacher’s most important role centered on making “ズレ” visible with cards for concrete actions and NG actions, 6) assessment and observation with two cards labeled 見るポイント and 方法, and 7) meta viewpoints for lesson improvement shown as five connected cards: 前の教材との接続, 言葉への感度を上げる, 初発のズレを活かす, 「納得の共有」をつくる, 学びを振り返る. End with a prominent summary statement 描写を根拠に、ズレを起点として、解釈を深める授業 and three check items: 根拠をもとに読みとる, 対話で考えを広げる, 自分の言葉で意味づける. Make the result look like a professionally designed Japanese teaching handout, not a photo of notes.
2117903200341230738.promptZh:
以REFERENCE_0和REFERENCE_1为杂乱的手写学习笔记素材，将其内容转化为一份简洁的纵向日语教育信息图，便于快速与教师分享。保留关于“叙事类文本阅读课教学设计”的核心主题，但采用视觉化方式重新组织内容，而非直接复制笔记本页面。创建一份精致的纯白背景版式，使用深蓝色作为章节标题色，搭配圆角卡片、简约扁平化图标、箭头、对勾符号及彩色编码方框。添加主标题“培养阅读能力的教学设计”和副标题“——以描写为依据，以认知偏差为起点，深化解读的教学——”。将信息图结构化为严格编号的7个部分，外加一个最终总结条带：  
1）课程基本结构，含四个步骤，标注为“事实（描写）→ 解读 → 赋予意义 → 用自己的语言表达”；  
2）学习深度的三个阶段，标注为“低：表层理解，中：解读建构，高：意义重构”；  
3）问题设计，包含优质问题的条件、问题链流程，以及具体示例性提问；  
4）提升对话质量的关键要点，含两张对比卡片，分别标注为“不恰当做法”和“理想对话”，并附关键词标签“比较”“关联”“再解读”；  
5）教师最关键的角色——使“认知偏差（ズレ）”显性化，配两张卡片，分别列出具体可操作行为与不恰当行为；  
6）评估与观课要点，含两张卡片，分别标注为“观察重点”和“方法”；  
7）用于课后改进的元视角，以五张相互连接的卡片呈现：“与前一教材的衔接”“提升对语言的敏感度”“善用初始认知偏差”“构建共识性认同”“反思学习过程”。  
结尾处突出显示总结句：“以描写为依据，以认知偏差为起点，深化解读的教学”，并列出三项检查项：“基于依据进行阅读理解”“通过对话拓展思考”“用自己的语言赋予意义”。整体效果须呈现为专业设计的日语教学讲义，而非手写笔记的照片。

2117903200341230741.promptEn: Using REFERENCE_0 as the character base, create a clean animation movement sheet that turns the character into a full-body jump sequence study while preserving the same outfit, badge, bald head, shoes, stylized ink-and-color illustration look, and the censored/blurred face treatment. Expand the view from the cropped portrait into a wide beige paper-textured layout with a ground line, subtle motion lines, small impact marks, and instructional typography. Add the title text SQUASH AND STRETCH at the upper left with the subtitle JUMP SEQUENCE — 7 STAGES. Show exactly 7 numbered poses arranged left to right across the page: 1 “ANTICIPATION (CROUCHING)” with the character crouched and arms back; 2 “EXTREME SQUASH (COMPRESSED)” with a deeper compact crouch; 3 “EXTREME STRETCH (TAKEOFF)” with the character elongated upward, arms raised, feet leaving the ground; 4 “APEX (MID-AIR ARC)” with the character tucked in midair; 5 “STRETCH (DOWNWARD ACCELERATION)” with the character stretched vertically while descending; 6 “SQUASH (IMPACT LANDING)” with the character compressed on landing, one hand touching the ground; 7 “RECOVERY (RETURN TO STANCE)” with the character standing relaxed with hands in pockets. Use bold black uppercase labels under each numbered stage, keep consistent character proportions across poses except for the intentional squash-and-stretch deformation, and make the sheet read like a professional 2D animation reference chart.
2117903200341230741.promptZh: 以 REFERENCE_0 为角色基础，制作一张干净的动画动作分解图（animation movement sheet），将角色转化为一套完整的全身跳跃序列研究（full-body jump sequence study），同时保留原服装、徽章、光头、鞋子、风格化的水墨设色插画（ink-and-color illustration）视觉效果，以及面部打码/模糊（censored/blurred face）处理。将原裁切肖像视图扩展为一张宽幅米色纸纹背景布局，添加地平线（ground line）、微妙的动态线（motion lines）、微小的撞击痕迹（impact marks）及说明性排版文字（instructional typography）。在左上方添加标题文字“SQUASH AND STRETCH”，副标题为“JUMP SEQUENCE — 7 STAGES”。页面从左至右横向排列恰好 7 个带编号的姿态：1 “ANTICIPATION (CROUCHING)”，角色蹲伏、双臂后摆；2 “EXTREME SQUASH (COMPRESSED)”，更深、更紧凑的蹲姿；3 “EXTREME STRETCH (TAKEOFF)”，角色向上拉长、双臂高举、双脚离地；4 “APEX (MID-AIR ARC)”，角色于空中蜷缩，处于抛物线顶点；5 “STRETCH (DOWNWARD ACCELERATION)”，角色垂直拉长、向下加速下落；6 “SQUASH (IMPACT LANDING)”，角色落地时压缩变形，单手触地；7 “RECOVERY (RETURN TO STANCE)”，角色放松站立，双手插兜。每个编号阶段下方配以粗黑大写标签（bold black uppercase labels），除刻意表现挤压与拉伸（squash-and-stretch）形变外，各姿态中角色比例须保持一致；整张图须呈现专业二维动画参考图表（2D animation reference chart）的阅读逻辑与专业感。

2117903200341230746.promptEn: Extreme macro photograph of a single large teardrop-shaped dewdrop suspended from a diagonal spider silk strand at sunrise, with the dewdrop acting like a lens and clearly refracting an upside-down green forest and the glowing sun inside it. The spider web crosses the frame diagonally from lower left to upper right, with many tiny bead-like dew droplets along the silk and additional fine web strands forming delicate geometric lines in the foreground and right side. Warm golden sunlight sits softly blurred in the background to the left, creating circular bokeh, subtle lens flare, and a dreamy woodland atmosphere. Use a shallow depth of field with razor-sharp focus on the main dewdrop and nearby dew beads, creamy blurred trees and foliage behind, natural greens and amber highlights, photorealistic detail, 100mm macro lens look, f/2.8 aperture, sunrise backlighting, high dynamic range, realistic optics, no text, no people.
2117903200341230746.promptZh: 日出时分，一枚巨大的泪滴状露珠悬挂在一条斜向蛛丝上，呈现极致微距摄影（extreme macro photograph）效果；露珠宛如透镜，清晰折射出倒置的绿色森林和内部发光的太阳。蛛网从画面左下角斜向延伸至右上角，蛛丝上缀满细小珠状露珠，前景与右侧还有额外纤细的蛛丝，构成精巧的几何线条。左侧背景中，温暖的金色阳光柔和虚化，形成圆形焦外虚化（bokeh）、细微的镜头光晕（lens flare）以及梦幻般的林地氛围。采用浅景深（shallow depth of field），主露珠及邻近露珠呈刀锋般锐利对焦，后方树木与 foliage 呈奶油般柔焦（creamy blurred），自然绿色调搭配琥珀色高光，照片级写实（photorealistic）细节，100mm 微距镜头（macro lens）视觉效果，光圈 f/2.8，日出逆光（sunrise backlighting），高动态范围（high dynamic range），真实光学效果（realistic optics），无文字，无人物。

2117903200341230748.promptEn: Create a photorealistic overhead close-up of a hand-embroidered design in a round wooden embroidery hoop on a warm wooden craft table. The hoop contains beige linen fabric with a finished raised satin-stitch cockatiel angel mascot in the center: a cute plump yellow cockatiel with orange cheek circles, glossy black bead-like eyes, a pink beak, cream belly, gray-and-white wings, brown outline stitching, pink feet, and a tall swept crest. Behind the bird is an iridescent hologram-style burst made from dense metallic thread strokes in pale blue, aqua, lavender, silver, mint, and yellow, like a collectible sticker background. Add exactly twelve gold star motifs: three integrated around the top title lettering and nine scattered through the holographic burst. At the top of the hoop, embroider small black text "NO.001" at upper left and "ホログラム" at upper right, then a bold red raised Japanese logo reading ビックリマン with black and gold outline, and beneath it rounded pink-and-gold raised lettering reading オカメエンジェル. Show the embroidery process context: faint blue sketch lines still visible on the right side of the fabric, a loose pale yellow thread and one needle resting on the right side of the hoop, one small printed reference card at the lower right showing the same cockatiel design, a pincushion with multicolored pins near the bottom edge, small gold embroidery scissors and a metal thimble near the bottom center, and many neatly wound embroidery floss skeins around the hoop with visible number labels such as 753, 725, 676, 231, 225, 232, 153, and 310. Use warm natural studio lighting, shallow depth of field, crisp macro textile detail, visible thread texture, realistic shadows, handmade craft aesthetic, Japanese nostalgic sticker-card energy, square composition.

2117903200341230751.promptEn: Create a photorealistic luxury product photograph of a single perfume bottle centered on a glossy wet black marble surface with fine white and gold veining. The bottle is faceted clear glass with a rounded-square octagonal silhouette, filled with rich amber golden-brown perfume, visible internal reflections, tiny air bubbles, and vertical refraction lines; it has a short neck and a smooth cylindrical brushed-metal champagne gold cap with a small minimalist monogram on top. Surround the bottle with scattered water droplets and several larger shallow puddles that create mirror reflections and subtle rainbow caustic highlights. Use dramatic golden hour backlight from the upper rear, casting warm sunbeams through a peach-orange background haze, strong rim highlights on the glass, sparkling specular points on the wet stone, and a crisp reflection of the bottle in the foreground. Shoot at table height with a premium advertising look, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the bottle, cinematic contrast, ultra-detailed glass and liquid physics, elegant black-and-gold color palette, square composition, no visible label text, no hands, no extra products.
2117903200341230751.promptZh: 创作一张照片级写实（photorealistic）的奢华产品静物图：一只香水瓶居中置于光洁湿润的黑色大理石台面上，石面带有细腻的白色与金色纹理。瓶身为切面透明玻璃，轮廓呈圆角方形八边形，瓶内盛满浓郁的琥珀金棕色香水，可见内部反射、微小气泡及垂直折射线；瓶身配有短颈，瓶盖为光滑圆柱形哑光金属材质，呈香槟金色，顶部饰有小巧极简风格单字母缩写标识。瓶周散落水滴，并分布若干较大而浅的水洼，形成镜面倒影及微妙的彩虹焦散高光（caustic highlights）。采用来自后上方的戏剧性黄金时刻（golden hour）背光，暖色阳光穿透桃橙色背景薄雾，玻璃边缘呈现强烈轮廓光（rim highlights），湿润石面闪烁着高光点（specular points），前景中瓶体倒影清晰锐利。拍摄高度为桌面水平，呈现高端广告质感，景深（depth of field）浅，焦点精准落在瓶身，具备电影感对比度（cinematic contrast），玻璃与液体物理效果超精细，配色优雅，以黑金为主色调，构图为正方形，瓶身无可见标签文字，画面中无人手，无其他额外产品。

2117903200341230752.promptEn: Create a premium photorealistic beverage advertisement featuring a single tall slim aluminum can of AURORA sparkling water standing upright at the center on a shallow reflective water surface. The can is matte warm off-white with fine condensation droplets covering it, a subtle gold rim at the top, minimalist luxury typography, and visible label text: “AURORA”, “SPARKLING WATER”, “PURE • CRISP • REFRESHING”, “PREMIUM”, “500ml”, plus a delicate gold mountain line illustration. Use a serene neutral spa-like setting with beige stone and plaster materials: a large circular stone arch or cutout on the left behind the can, soft ripples and reflection in the water below, one smooth oval beige pebble on the right, and one airy dried botanical branch with tiny seed heads reaching in from the upper right. Add a small white Pollo.ai logo in the top-right corner. Lighting should be warm golden morning sunlight with soft botanical shadows cast across the background wall and can, elegant high-end product photography, shallow depth of field, natural highlights, calm atmosphere, creamy beige monochrome palette, ultra-detailed condensation, realistic reflections, square composition, no people.
2117903200341230752.promptZh: 创作一则高端照片级写实（photorealistic）饮品广告，画面中央直立摆放一罐纤细高挑的铝制AURORA气泡水罐，置于浅层反光水面之上。罐身为哑光暖调米白色，表面覆盖细腻水珠（condensation droplets），顶部饰有微妙金色环边，采用极简主义奢华字体；罐身标签文字清晰可见：“AURORA”、“SPARKLING WATER”、“PURE • CRISP • REFRESHING”、“PREMIUM”、“500ml”，并配有一条精致金色山形线条插画。背景为宁静中性、类水疗会所（spa-like）氛围，材质为米色石材与灰泥：左侧罐后设一座大型圆形石拱门或镂空结构；水面下呈现柔和涟漪与倒影；右侧置一枚光滑椭圆形米色卵石；右上方轻盈伸入一枝空气感干植物枝条，缀有细小种荚。右上角添加一枚小型白色Pollo.ai标志。布光采用温暖金色晨光（warm golden morning sunlight），背景墙面与罐体投下柔和植物阴影（soft botanical shadows）；呈现优雅高端产品摄影（elegant high-end product photography）风格；景深（depth of field）浅；自然高光；氛围沉静；奶油质感米色单色色调（creamy beige monochrome palette）；水珠细节超精细（ultra-detailed condensation）；反射真实可信（realistic reflections）；正方形构图（square composition）；画面中无人物。

2117903200341230760.promptEn: Create a high-end cinematic character design sheet intended for a premium film production. The layout should feel like a curated art direction board rather than a rigid template. Avoid symmetrical grids, uniform spacing, or overly structured presentation. Instead, the composition should feel organic, slightly asymmetrical, and thoughtfully arranged like a real Hollywood concept pitch. Design a grounded, realistic human character with believable body proportions, natural imperfections, and expressive performance-driven presence—like a professional actor captured during emotional and physical performance moments rather than a posed mannequin. Use a bright, clean, and well-lit background that enhances clarity and gives the sheet a fresh, modern studio feel. Include: • Full-body turnaround views (front, 3/4 front, side, back, 3/4 back) • Multiple expressive facial studies from different angles showing emotional range • A cinematic hero portrait with strong character focus • Detailed breakdown of costume, accessories, and key props • Close-up studies of materials such as fabric texture, skin detail, and surface realism • Handwritten-style annotation notes, production markings, and design insights •A clear height reference scale integrated naturally into the composition The character should feel like a real person existing in a film world—authentic, grounded, and emotionally alive rather than stylized or overly idealized. Art direction style: Semi-realistic cinematic design, high-budget film production quality, soft natural studio lighting with a bright tone, subtle depth of field, realistic material rendering, and emotionally readable expressions. Presentation should feel like a professional concept art portfolio used in major film pre-production. Consistency requirement: Maintain perfect continuity in facial identity, body proportions, hairstyle, outfit design, and material details across all angles and studies.
2117903200341230760.promptZh:
为高端电影制作打造一张高规格电影感（cinematic）角色设计图，用于优质影片项目。版式应呈现为精心策划的艺术指导板（art direction board），而非刻板僵硬的模板。避免对称网格、均等间距或过度结构化的呈现方式；构图应显得有机自然、略带不对称，并经过深思熟虑地编排，如同真实好莱坞概念提案中的效果。设计一位脚踏实地、高度写实的人类角色，具备可信的身体比例、自然的微小瑕疵，以及由情绪与肢体表现力驱动的存在感——如同专业演员在情绪与身体表演瞬间被捕捉下来，而非摆拍的人体模型。使用明亮、洁净、光照充分的背景，以增强画面清晰度，并赋予设计图清新现代的影棚布光（studio lighting）质感。包含以下内容：  
• 全身多角度转面图（正面、三分之四正面、侧面、背面、三分之四背面）  
• 多个不同角度的表情特写（close-up）研究，展现丰富的情绪跨度  
• 一张电影感英雄肖像（cinematic hero portrait），强调强烈的角色聚焦  
• 服装、配饰及关键道具的详细分解图  
• 材质特写（close-up）研究，包括织物纹理、皮肤细节及表面真实感（surface realism）  
• 手写风格注释、制作标记与设计洞见  
• 一个自然融入构图的清晰身高参考标尺  
该角色应让人感觉是真实存在于电影世界中的人物——真实可信、脚踏实地、情感鲜活，而非风格化或过度理想化的形象。艺术指导风格：半写实电影感（cinematic）设计，高预算电影制作品质，柔和自然的影棚布光（studio lighting）并带有明亮色调，微妙景深（depth of field），真实材质渲染（realistic material rendering），以及情绪可读性强的表情（emotionally readable expressions）。整体呈现应类似大型电影前期制作中所使用的专业概念艺术作品集（concept art portfolio）。一致性要求：所有角度与研究图中，面部身份、身体比例、发型、服装设计及材质细节须保持绝对连贯统一。

2117903200341230762.promptEn:
Please generate a high-quality "Urban Line Atlas Poster."

This image is designed based on the visual language of a "monochrome urban line-drawing travel poster," featuring a complete composition with a large top title, mid-view street depth, core landmarks, flanking buildings, foreground figures, and a bottom signature block.

[Theme City]
City Name: Yichun
English Main Title: FOREST LINE ATLAS / YICHUN CHRONICLE
Chinese Title: Yichun · City of Forests
Country/Region: Heilongjiang Province, China
Core Landmarks: Lesser Khingan Mountains forest, Korean pine forest sea, Wuying National Forest Park observation tower
Street Scene: Small forest town streets, residential intersections with wooden buildings, forestry city atmosphere
Emotional Theme: Commuting moments in the morning mist
Main Color Tone: dark green + dark grey line drawing
Aspect Ratio: 3:4 vertical

[Overall Positioning]
This is a work that serves as a travel souvenir poster, an urban visual guide, an architectural line manuscript, and an editorial design cover. The image needs to present Yichun's unique temperament as a "city in the forest," with both urban recognition and a sense of real street life—not a standard travel poster or a single landmark illustration, but a visual archive piece of collectible value.
[Composition Design]
The top is a strong title area using the large English title "FOREST LINE ATLAS," supplemented by the subtitle "YICHUN CHRONICLE." A numbering system (e.g., No. CN-HLJ-YC-01) and brief coordinate info can be added, with a modern and design-oriented layout.
The middle is the urban street主体, using a deep street perspective composition with a slightly low angle, the road extending into the distance and gradually entering the forest area.
The core landmark is the forest observation tower or the silhouette of the Lesser Khingan forest in the distance, clear but not overly prominent, naturally blending into the street scene.
Add local architectural details on both sides: wooden houses, forestry bureau-style buildings, residential blocks, small shops, bus stops, streetlights, utility poles, simple road signs, etc., forming high-density urban information.
The foreground includes lifestyle elements: pedestrians in autumn/winter clothing, people on bicycles, residents with shopping bags, small vehicles, and fallen leaves on the ground to enhance the seasonal atmosphere.
A separate signature area at the bottom is designed as a city archive label structure, containing "YICHUN / HEILONGJIANG / CHINA" and a simplified city info module or map index-style layout.
[Text System]
The top main title is clear and eye-catching. Keep only 2–4 clear readable texts in the image (e.g., "Yichun Station," "Forestry Road," "Bus Stop"), with other signs using abstracted Chinese strokes or symbolic characters to avoid gibberish. The overall text system should be unified, restrained, and integrated into the design structure.
[Visual Style]
The overall style uses monochrome or a very limited two-color line drawing on an off-white or warm white paper texture. Lines are precise, clean, and layered, with the feel of an architectural pen manuscript and screen print texture. Foreground lines are slightly thicker, background lines thinner, with figures and objects being simple but recognizable. The style is restrained and sophisticated.

[Innovation Requirements]
Incorporate design variations in: title naming system, top layout structure, slightly low-angle street perspective, fusion composition of forest and city, bottom archive-style information module, and expression of autumn fallen leaf atmosphere.
[Avoidance Matters]
No ordinary travel poster style, no watercolor, impasto, or cartoon/chibi styles, no cyberpunk, no high-saturation colors, and no cheap souvenir style.

Please generate an independent, complete, high-definition, clear-lined vertical urban line-drawing poster with a sense of collectability and series identity.

2117903200341230764.promptEn: Create a bright square VTuber “good morning” social media frame in a soft anime watercolor style, with a wide open center-right area of clear blue sky for placing a character or photo. The scene is a cheerful spring morning landscape viewed from a leafy garden: sunlit green branches and small white blossoms frame the top-left and left edge, with glowing lens flare, drifting petals, white feathers, and scattered green leaves across the sky. Add exactly 7 birds: 3 small birds perched on a flowering branch at left-middle, colored blue, white, and yellow; 3 birds perched on a rustic wooden sign at bottom-left, a brown sparrow, a pale yellow cockatiel with orange cheeks, and a blue budgerigar; and 1 swallow flying in the upper-right sky. In the upper-left, place elegant white hand-lettered script reading Good Morning!, decorated with tiny leaves and sparkles, with a teal ribbon underneath containing the Japanese text 素敵な一日になりますように♪. At the bottom-left, make a weathered wooden plank sign wrapped with small flowers, vines, a white laurel motif, and a feather, with white script text Bind Week and a smaller date line 5.10 (Sat) - 5.16 (Fri). The background should show a soft distant town, lake or river, and pale mountains under fluffy white clouds, with daisies and yellow flowers blooming in the lower-right foreground. Use a fresh pastel palette, airy composition, high detail, gentle sunlight, clean decorative typography, and leave the center of the sky mostly uncluttered for overlay use.
2117903200341230764.promptZh: 创作一幅明亮的方形VTuber“早安”社交媒体边框，采用柔和的动漫水彩风格（anime watercolor style），画面右中部留出一大片清澈的蓝色天空区域，用于放置角色或照片。场景为从繁茂花园视角眺望的一幅欢快春日清晨风光：阳光洒落的翠绿枝条与细小白花沿左上角及左侧边缘构图；天空中加入发光的镜头光晕（lens flare）、飘落的花瓣、白色羽毛以及散落的绿色叶片。画面中需精确绘制7只鸟：左中部一根盛开花枝上停着3只小鸟，颜色分别为蓝色、白色和黄色；左下角一块质朴的木质标牌上停着3只鸟，分别为一只棕色麻雀、一只脸颊橙色的浅黄色鸡尾鹦鹉（cockatiel）和一只蓝色虎皮鹦鹉（budgerigar）；右上空飞翔着1只燕子（swallow）。左上角以优雅的白色手写体书写“Good Morning!”，文字点缀细小叶片与闪光粒子，并在其下方配一条青绿色丝带（teal ribbon），丝带上印有日文“素敵な一日になりますように♪”。左下角设一块风化木质板标牌，缠绕着小型花朵、藤蔓、白色月桂纹样（laurel motif）及一根羽毛，标牌上以白色字体书写“Bind Week”，下方另有一行较小字号日期“5.10 (Sat) - 5.16 (Fri)”。背景呈现柔和朦胧的远方小镇、湖泊或河流，以及浮于蓬松白云之下的淡雅远山；右下前景处盛开着雏菊与黄色花朵。整体采用清新粉彩色调（pastel palette）、通透轻盈的构图（airy composition）、高细节（high detail）、柔和阳光（gentle sunlight）与洁净装饰性字体（clean decorative typography），并确保天空中央区域基本保持简洁空旷，便于后期叠加使用。

2117903200341230766.promptEn: Create a clean technical system diagram of a residential greywater recycling system for toilet flushing. Show three water sources on the left: kitchen vegetable washing sink, bathroom wash basin, and washing machine. Each source connects through a diverter valve to either the original sewer drain or the greywater recycling line. The greywater line goes into a pre-filter module with coarse mesh filter, sediment trap, washable cartridge filter, and grease separator for kitchen water. Then show a low-level greywater collection tank with overflow pipe to sewer, high and low water level sensors, and inspection cover. From this tank, show a greywater transfer pump sending water upward into a large white plastic storage tank. The large tank has low, middle, and high water level sensors, overflow to sewer, drain outlet, optional UV disinfection module, and ventilation. From the storage tank, show a pump or gravity outlet feeding the toilet cistern. Include a backup clean water supply with air gap and backflow prevention to the toilet cistern. Show a Raspberry Pi 4 controller connected with signal lines to sensors, solenoid valves, pumps, leak sensor, and alarm. Use blue arrows for water flow, red arrows for overflow/emergency drain, dotted black lines for electronic control. Style: modern engineering schematic, white background, labeled components, clear arrows, minimal but detailed.
2117903200341230766.promptZh: 创建一幅简洁的技术系统示意图，展示住宅用灰水（greywater）回收系统用于冲厕。左侧显示三个水源：厨房蔬菜清洗水槽、浴室洗手盆和洗衣机。每个水源均通过分流阀（diverter valve）连接至原始污水排放管或灰水回收管线。灰水管线接入预过滤模块，该模块包含粗网滤网（coarse mesh filter）、沉泥阱（sediment trap）、可清洗滤芯式过滤器（washable cartridge filter）以及针对厨房用水的油脂分离器（grease separator）。随后显示一个低位灰水收集水箱，配备溢流管（接至污水管）、高/低水位传感器、检修盖（inspection cover）。从此水箱中，绘出一台灰水输送泵，将水向上泵入一个大型白色塑料储水箱。该大型储水箱配备低、中、高三档水位传感器，溢流管（接至污水管）、排水出口、可选紫外线消毒模块（UV disinfection module）及通风口。从该储水箱出发，绘出一条由水泵或重力驱动的出水管路，向马桶水箱供水。同时显示一套备用洁净水源，经空气隔断（air gap）及防回流装置（backflow prevention）接入马桶水箱。图中需包含一台 Raspberry Pi 4 控制器，通过信号线连接至各类传感器、电磁阀、水泵、漏水传感器及报警器。水流方向用蓝色箭头表示，溢流/应急排水用红色箭头表示，电子控制线路用黑色虚线表示。风格要求：现代工程原理图（modern engineering schematic），纯白背景，各组件带标注，箭头清晰，整体简洁但细节充分。
2117903200341230766.author: Ryder Shang

2117903200341230768.promptEn: Create a modern isometric illustration sheet on a clean light gray background, showing a seamless grid of cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance icons with soft shadows, glossy 3D materials, rounded edges, and a blue, white, gray, red, and orange accent palette. Use a wide horizontal canvas, evenly spaced rows and columns, with no border or watermark. Include exactly 15 discrete icons arranged in a 3-row by 5-column grid: top row: 1) a blue padlock with silver shackle and black keyhole, 2) a blue shield badge with a white check mark and metallic rim, 3) a silver key angled diagonally, 4) a dark smartphone-like biometric panel showing a glowing blue fingerprint scan line, 5) a desktop monitor login screen with a lock icon, password dots, and a blue button labeled “LOGIN”; middle row: 6) a white document page with folded corner, blue lock icon, and label “ENCRYPTED”, 7) a red brick firewall with an orange flame in front, 8) a white surveillance camera with blue lens mounted on a small wall bracket, 9) an ID badge with clip, portrait thumbnail, text lines, and barcode, 10) a red triangular warning sign with black exclamation mark; bottom row: 11) a dark server stack with colored status lights and a blue shield check badge in front, 12) a clipboard checklist labeled “COMPLIANCE” with green checkboxes, 13) a dark smartphone facial-recognition screen showing a wireframe face, scan brackets, and “VERIFYING...” text, 14) an alert dashboard card labeled “ALERT” with a magnifying glass inspecting the list, 15) a gray safe/vault box with round combination dial beside a white policy document labeled “POLICY” with gray lines and green check mark. Keep all icons consistent in isometric perspective, miniature object scale, polished SaaS/security branding style, crisp edges, ambient occlusion, and subtle contact shadows. Text should be minimal and legible only where specified. Theme customization: security and compliance; primary color customization: deep blue; background customization: light gray.
2117903200341230768.promptZh:
在干净的浅灰色背景上创建一幅现代等距视角（isometric）插图图集，展示一组无缝排列的网络安全、隐私与合规图标，图标带有柔和阴影、光泽3D材质、圆角边缘，并采用蓝、白、灰、红与橙色作为强调色。使用宽幅横向画布，行列均匀分布，无边框、无水印。图中须精确包含15个独立图标，以3行×5列网格整齐排列：  
第一行：1）一把蓝色挂锁，配银色锁链与黑色锁孔；2）一枚蓝色盾牌徽章，中央为白色对勾，边缘呈金属质感；3）一把银色钥匙，呈对角线倾斜摆放；4）一块深色智能手机风格生物识别面板，显示一条发光的蓝色指纹扫描线；5）一台台式显示器登录界面，含锁形图标、密码圆点及一个标有“LOGIN”的蓝色按钮；  
第二行：6）一张白色文档页面，带折角、蓝色锁形图标及标有“ENCRYPTED”的标签；7）一堵红色砖墙防火墙，前方跃动着橙色火焰；8）一台白色监控摄像头，配蓝色镜头，安装于小型墙面支架上；9）一枚带夹子的ID工牌，含人像缩略图、多行文字及条形码；10）一枚红色三角形警示标志，中央为黑色感叹号；  
第三行：11）一组深色服务器机架，配有彩色状态指示灯，前方贴有一枚带蓝色对勾的盾牌徽章；12）一块剪贴板式清单，标有“COMPLIANCE”，其复选框为绿色；13）一部深色智能手机面部识别界面，显示线框风格人脸、扫描框及“VERIFYING...”文字；14）一张告警仪表盘卡片，标有“ALERT”，画面中放大镜正检查列表内容；15）一个灰色保险柜/金库箱，旁置圆形组合转盘，旁边是一份白色政策文档，标有“POLICY”，文档上有灰色线条与绿色对勾。  
所有图标须保持统一的等距视角（isometric）、微缩实物比例、精致打磨的SaaS/安全品牌风格、清晰锐利的边缘、环境光遮蔽（ambient occlusion）及微妙的接触阴影（contact shadows）。文字仅在指定位置出现，且须简洁、清晰可读。主题定制：安全与合规；主色调定制：深蓝色；背景定制：浅灰色。
