2117903200341230769.promptEn: Create a Pixar-style 3D animated cinematic still on a 16:9 widescreen canvas, set on an old urban rooftop at blue-hour dusk with a glowing city skyline in the background. In the center foreground stand two stylized construction or repair workers with friendly proportions: a young man on the left with short tousled brown hair, a cream rolled-sleeve work shirt, tan work pants, brown work boots, a belt, and a leather tool bag in his left hand; a young woman on the right with long auburn hair, a light blue denim work shirt, fitted blue jeans with rolled cuffs, brown work boots, a utility belt with tools, and a large rolled blueprint held diagonally across her chest. Pose them close together as if discussing a rooftop renovation, facing the viewer with relaxed confident body language. The rooftop should include exactly 5 notable prop groups: one weathered concrete utility wall with vents and pipes on the left, two potted plants near the left wall, one low brick parapet across the back, one rooftop water tower on a building to the right, and one large potted plant with broad leaves on the far right. Add wet reflective patches, scattered small debris, vents, pipes, and warm window lights. The skyline should feel like a whimsical New York-inspired metropolis with art deco skyscrapers, antennas, and softly lit windows. Use high-quality Pixar-like 3D rendering, soft rounded character shapes, cinematic depth of field, warm rim lighting, teal-blue evening sky, subtle volumetric haze, glossy puddle reflections, and a polished family-animation look. No text, no logos, no watermark.
2117903200341230769.promptZh: 在16:9宽屏画布上创作一幅皮克斯（Pixar）风格的3D动画电影感静帧，场景设定于蓝调时刻（blue-hour）黄昏时分的一座老旧城市屋顶，背景为光芒闪烁的城市天际线。画面中心前景站立着两名风格化、比例友好的建筑或维修工人：左侧是一名年轻男子，棕色短发略显凌乱，身穿米色卷袖工装衬衫、卡其色工装裤、棕色工装靴，腰系皮带，左手拎着一只皮革工具包；右侧是一名年轻女子，长发赤褐色，身穿浅蓝色牛仔工装衬衫、合身蓝色牛仔裤（裤脚卷起）、棕色工装靴，腰系带工具的多功能腰带，胸前斜抱一张大幅卷起的蓝图。两人站位靠近，姿态自然，仿佛正在讨论屋顶翻新工程，正面朝向观者，肢体语言轻松而自信。屋顶需精确包含5组显著道具：左侧一道风化混凝土设备墙，配有通风口与管道；靠近左墙处有两盆盆栽植物；后方横贯一道低矮砖砌女儿墙；右侧一栋建筑顶部设有一座屋顶水塔；最右侧设一株大型阔叶盆栽植物。添加湿润反光斑块、零散小碎屑、通风口、管道，以及暖色调的窗户灯光。天际线应呈现充满奇趣的纽约风大都会意象，包含装饰艺术风格（art deco）摩天楼、天线阵列，以及柔和点亮的窗格。采用高品质皮克斯式3D渲染，角色造型圆润柔和，电影感景深（depth of field），暖色轮廓光（rim lighting），青蓝色傍晚天空，微妙的体积雾（volumetric haze），光泽感水洼倒影（glossy puddle reflections），整体呈现精致打磨的家庭向动画（family-animation）视觉风格。不包含文字、无商标、无水印。

2117903200341230770.promptEn:
Goal: Create a visually stunning modern recipe card for Mojito, presented as a luxurious tropical social-media recipe poster.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 portrait layout, bright white background with soft beach-and-ocean blur behind the hero drink, airy margins, watercolor lime-green splashes around the edges, subtle mint leaf textures, gold ornamental line accents, and a fresh upscale cocktail-bar aesthetic.

Layout: Top-left title area with a tiny gold cocktail icon, the small uppercase label “CUBAN SUMMER DRINK,” a huge flowing dark-green script title “Mojito,” then the tagline “cool • citrusy • refreshing.” Under it add a short description: “A classic Cuban cocktail with crisp mint, zesty lime, and a splash of sunshine.” Add a handwritten line: “Sip. Relax. Repeat.” On the right side place a tall crystal highball glass filled with crushed ice, lime wedges, mint leaves, bubbles, and condensation, garnished with a lime wheel and mint sprig; include tropical palm shadows and limes/mint on the table.

Ingredients section: Create one elegant bordered card labeled “INGREDIENTS” with exactly 6 ingredient rows, each with a small watercolor-style icon and text: 1) “1 Lime” with subtext “cut into wedges,” 2) “10–12 Mint Leaves” with subtext “fresh & fragrant,” 3) “Soda Water” with subtext “to top up,” 4) “2 tsp Sugar” with subtext “adjust to taste,” 5) “60 ml White Rum” with subtext “(2 oz),” 6) “Crushed Ice” with subtext “as much as you love.”

Tip card: To the right of the ingredients, add one smaller pale-green bordered card with mint illustration and exactly 2 text blocks: top label “TIP” with the note “Lightly crush mint — don’t over-muddle,” and bottom label “PERFECT BALANCE” with “1 Lime : 2 tsp Sugar” plus handwritten text “sweet, citrusy, just right!”

How-to section: Along the lower half, add the heading “HOW TO MAKE THE PERFECT MOJITO” and exactly 5 numbered illustrated steps connected by small gold arrows: 1) muddling mint, sugar, and lime in a glass with a wooden muddler, caption “Muddle mint leaves with sugar and lime. Gently press to release the flavors.” 2) filling a glass with crushed ice, caption “Fill glass with crushed ice. Crushed ice = maximum chill.” 3) pouring white rum and soda water into the glass, caption “Pour white rum and soda water. Add rum, then top up with soda water.” 4) stirring with a bar spoon, caption “Stir gently for balanced flavor. Mix lightly to keep it refreshing.” 5) finished mojito with mint sprig and lime wheel, caption “Garnish with mint sprig and lime wheel. The final touch of summer.”

Footer: Add small uppercase text “REFRESHING • VIBRANT • TIMELESS” and handwritten gold script “Made for sunny days and good vibes!” with a small heart doodle. Decorate the corners with watercolor lime slices, mint sprigs, ice cubes, bubbles, and splashes.

Visual style: Minimal yet artistic, polished editorial recipe-card design, watercolor botanical accents mixed with realistic cocktail photography, fresh lime green, mint green, white, pale aqua, and muted gold. Use elegant serif/sans-serif typography paired with large hand-lettered script for the title.

Constraints: Keep all text legible, maintain the exact counts of 6 ingredient rows, 2 tip-card text blocks, and 5 numbered preparation steps. No people, no watermark, no extra recipe steps, no clutter.
2117903200341230770.author: Mr Das

2117903200341230771.promptEn:
Goal: Create a black-and-white manga page with exactly 2 stacked panels showing a cute small dog discovering a computer keyboard and reacting with excitement.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, portrait orientation, two equal horizontal panels separated by a thick black gutter, clean black border around each panel, grayscale screentone shading, hand-inked line art, polished modern manga style.

Main character: A small, adorable puppy with floppy ears, large sparkling eyes, a white stripe down the face, darker patches on the head and body, a fluffy raised tail, and a collar with a round ring tag. The dog is seated at a desk in an office chair, facing a desktop computer. Use cute mixed-breed puppy resembling a Jack Russell terrier.

Panel 1: The dog sits behind a wooden desk, looking surprised and curious at a large desktop monitor on the left. A keyboard lies in front of the dog. The dog’s mouth is slightly open, eyes wide, with exactly 3 surprise marks above its head. Background: a cozy home office with a window and curtains on the far left, a framed landscape picture on the wall, a small potted plant on a cabinet, and bookshelves on the right. Include one vertical oval speech bubble on the right side containing the Japanese text これは何?. Mood: confused curiosity.

Panel 2: Same dog, same desk and computer setup, now leaning forward happily and pressing the keyboard with one front paw. The dog smiles broadly with tongue visible, eyes shining, tail lifted. Add dynamic radial speed lines in the background and sparkling effects around the keyboard. Include exactly 8 sparkle effects around the dog and keyboard area. Include one vertical oval speech bubble on the left side containing the Japanese text ピカピカだ!. Mood: delighted discovery.

Objects and counts: Exactly 2 manga panels; exactly 1 dog appearing in both panels; exactly 1 desktop monitor; exactly 1 keyboard; exactly 1 office chair; exactly 2 speech bubbles total; exactly 3 surprise marks in panel 1; exactly 8 sparkle effects in panel 2; visible background items include 1 window, 1 framed picture, 1 potted plant, and 2 bookshelves or bookcase areas.

Visual style: Monochrome Japanese manga, expressive cute animal character, detailed fur texture, screentone gradients, crisp ink outlines, dramatic but family-friendly expressions, clean readable composition. Keep the speech bubbles vertical and the Japanese text hand-lettered in black. No color, no watermark, no extra panels, no extra characters.
2117903200341230771.author: ふったん＠副業とAIと漫画大好き

2117903200341230772.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cyberpunk e-commerce desktop first-view landing page for NEXA, promoting a limited-time CYBER FLASH CAMPAIGN in a neon futuristic style.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 website hero screen, dark black/navy background, full-bleed cyber grid floor receding in perspective, glowing magenta and cyan circuitry framing the edges. High contrast, glossy reflections, electric neon bloom, futuristic HUD aesthetic.

Layout: Top navigation bar with the brand logo on the left and exactly 5 navigation items on the right: “SALE”, “FEATURE”, “ITEMS”, “FAQ”, and a bordered neon button “CHECK NOW”. The hero section is split into two columns: left text-and-CTA area, right large promotional banner graphic.

Left hero content: Add a small rounded pill label reading CYBER FLASH CAMPAIGN. Main headline in Japanese and English: “今だけの” above huge bold “FLASH SALE”, white letters with hot-pink glow. Below it, two short Japanese description lines: “対象アイテムが期間限定でスペシャルプライス。” and “7/15(火) 13:59までの限定オファーをお見逃しなく。” Add a neon outlined limited-time bar with a clock icon and text “LIMITED TIME : 7/15(火) 13:59まで”. Beneath are exactly 2 CTA buttons: a hot-pink filled glowing button “今すぐチェック ›” and a cyan outlined button “対象商品を見る ›”. At the bottom of the left column, show exactly 3 small benefit chips with icons: truck icon “送料無料”, user icon “会員限定特典”, gift icon “数量限定”.

Right promotional graphic: A large square/near-square neon poster card with a glowing magenta border and cyan HUD corner details, set slightly right of center. Inside the card, show a futuristic city street at night with skyscrapers, magenta/cyan lights, and a perspective grid road. Center a large neon alarm clock outline containing bold stacked text “FLASH SALE” and cyan text “LIMITED OFFER”. Front face details: On the main front view, include exactly 4 visible feature groups: a small round camera lens near the top center; a square black display/window below it showing two cute cartoon eyes; a large circular illuminated doorbell button below the display with a white glowing ring; and a horizontal speaker grille near the bottom made of short black slits in multiple rows. 画布：宽幅横向16:9构图，置于浅灰色无缝影棚背景上，带柔和地面阴影，正交投影（orthographic）产品渲染风格，无人物，无品牌水印。

主体：一款紧凑型矩形电子设备外壳，圆角设计，哑光浅灰色塑料材质，边缘略带倒角，照片级写实（photorealistic）3D CAD渲染效果，表面带有细微粗糙纹理。

布局：从左至右均匀排布，精确展示5个独立外壳视角：1）极薄的左侧侧视图，直立摆放，顶部叠置两个圆形扬声器或传感器格栅；2）主正面视图，直立摆放，略带倾斜角度，清晰展现功能性细节；3）窄幅侧视图，带内凹USB-C接口；4）后盖板视图，直立摆放，四角带螺丝孔，侧面带切口；5）打开状态的后部壳体/外壳内部视图，顶部隔间中安装有电子元器件，底部隔间为空。

正面细节：在主正面视图中，精确包含4组可见功能部件：顶部中央附近为一枚小型圆形摄像头镜头；其下方为一块方形黑色显示屏/视窗，显示两只可爱的卡通眼睛；显示屏下方为一枚大型圆形发光门铃按钮，外围带白色发光环；底部为一条水平扬声器格栅，由多排短小黑色细缝构成。在主体左侧边缘添加两个小型圆形侧向开孔。

内部电子元件：在打开的后部壳体内，精确包含2块电路板及可见走线：顶部电路板标注为ESP32-CAM，并配有小型摄像头模块；底部电路板标注为DFPlayer Mini。电路板周围布置整齐的黑色、白色、灰色与红色导线。内部设有一条水平分隔搁板，将电子设备舱与下方更大的空腔隔开。打开的壳体内四角添加四根螺丝柱/螺丝孔。

风格：照片级写实（photorealistic）3D产品可视化，高细节工业设计概念，来自左上方的柔和影棚布光（studio lighting），轻柔环境光遮蔽（ambient occlusion），锐利清晰边缘，真实塑料材质表现，中性灰色调配色，浅但清晰的阴影，居中构图。

约束条件：严格使用5个产品视角，所有物体保持直立姿态，不得出现手部，除两块电路板上的标注文字外不得添加任何额外文字，不得出现Logo，不得添加装饰性背景物件。

2117903200341230795.promptEn: A realistic editorial lifestyle photograph capturing a young muscular man with a center-parted wavy brown hairstyle, wearing a long-sleeve navy blue polo shirt, wide-leg pleated khaki beige trousers, and grey-blue trail running shoes. He bears a serious, candidly authentic expression with relaxed eyebrows, his eyes looking away to the right of the frame. He leans heavily backward and to the right against a waist-high structure, his body turned forty-five degrees relative to the support, with legs casually crossed and shoulders subtly tilted downward on the leaning side. His right hand rests naturally atop the rounded edge of the structure, fingers draped loosely over the dark metal. He is positioned on a grey and brown loose gravel pathway bounded by a flat grey stone border in the foreground. He leans against an ornate, weathered dark brown and black cast-iron railing featuring vertical bars and decorative central medallions, accented by bright green climbing ivy intertwining near its base. Beyond the railing unfolds a deep, scenic European lake vista, featuring calm, pristine, dark greenish-blue waters in the lower right. The expansive background reveals towering dark green Mediterranean cypress columns, lush forested hills, and classic vintage stucco villas painted in warm pale yellow and peach, topped with terracotta orange tiled roofs and shuttered windows, including a boathouse nestled directly on the shoreline. The mood is serene, calm, and sophisticated, bathed in soft, diffused natural daylight filtering from an overcast sky above. This low-contrast, moderate-intensity light casts short, gradual grey shadows beneath his shoes and subtle shading under the railing, while gently pulling a soft sheen from his hair and natural highlights from his skin. The split-complementary color palette elegantly balances the navy and khaki wardrobe against the deep forest greens and terracotta architectural accents. Captured with an 85mm lens at an aperture between f/4.0 and f/5.6 at ISO 100, the straight-on shot features a tack-sharp subject isolated against a slightly soft yet fully recognizable background, finished with a subtle color grade leaning toward classic film tones that slightly desaturates bright colors for an organic, clean aesthetic, all framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230795.promptZh: 一张写实风格的杂志生活方式摄影照片，捕捉一位年轻健硕男性：中分波浪棕色发型，身穿长袖深蓝色Polo衫、阔腿褶皱卡其米色长裤，以及灰蓝色越野跑鞋。他神情严肃而自然真实，眉毛放松，目光看向画面右侧。他身体大幅向后并向右倚靠在一条齐腰高的结构上，身体与支撑物呈四十五度角，双腿随意交叉，倚靠一侧的肩膀微微下倾。他的右手自然搭在该结构圆润的边缘上，手指松散垂落于深色金属表面。他站在前景中一条灰褐色松散碎石小径上，小径边缘由平整的灰色石条围合。他倚靠的是一道装饰繁复、饱经风霜的深棕与黑色铸铁栏杆，栏杆配有垂直立柱及中央装饰性徽章，栏杆基部缠绕着鲜亮翠绿的攀爬常春藤。栏杆之外，是一幅纵深开阔的欧洲湖泊风景：右下方为平静澄澈、深绿偏蓝的湖水。广阔背景中可见高耸挺拔的深绿色地中海柏树柱状林、郁郁葱葱的森林山丘，以及经典复古风格的灰泥别墅——墙面涂刷温暖的浅黄色与桃色，屋顶铺覆赤陶橙色瓦片，窗户装有百叶窗；其中一座船屋直接坐落于湖岸线上。整体氛围宁静、平和而雅致，沐浴在柔和漫射的自然日光之中，光线来自上方阴云密布的天空。这种低对比度、中等强度的光线，在他鞋底投下短而渐变的灰色阴影，并在栏杆下方形成微妙的明暗过渡，同时轻柔地勾勒出他发丝的柔和光泽与肌肤上的自然高光。画面采用分裂互补色（split-complementary）配色方案，优雅平衡了服装中的深蓝与卡其色，与背景中浓郁的森林绿及建筑上的赤陶色点缀相映成趣。使用85mm镜头、光圈f/4.0至f/5.6之间、ISO 100拍摄，正面平视构图，主体锐利清晰（tack-sharp），背景略带柔焦（slightly soft）但仍完全可辨识；最终经细微调色处理，倾向经典胶片影调（classic film tones），对鲜艳色彩略作去饱和（slightly desaturates bright colors），营造有机、干净的视觉美学，整体以3:4画幅比例构图。

2117903200341230796.promptEn: A young adult male stands in a deliberately posed 45-degree turn with relaxed shoulders, wearing a classic deep black tuxedo, bow tie, stark white shirt collar, and crisp pocket square. His handsome, serious face is captured in profile as he looks away, featuring a closed, neutral mouth and relaxed eyebrows. His thick, medium-short hair is brushed behind the ears and swept straight back in a low-volume, classic taper without a prominent side part, heavily styled with a firm-hold pomade that creates a wet, glossy finish with visible comb lines, while a slight separation of strands near the crown and back reveals natural texture despite the heavy product. His left hand is thrust casually into his left trouser pocket, exposing a pristine white French cuff and a metallic dress watch on his wrist. He stands on deep shadow-black grass beside a pristine vintage automobile dominating the bottom right foreground, featuring glossy stark white paint, a chrome circular side mirror, and a visible interior dashboard in warm brown tones. The deep spatial background reveals faint, blurred white vehicle headlights glowing distantly on the mid-left horizon line, while the weathered, intricate branch networks of bare deciduous trees are silhouetted against the top right sky. A harsh, highly directional artificial flash from the front-left pierces the sophisticated, mysterious atmosphere of wealthy detachment, casting deep black, harsh-edged shadows heavily across the right side of his face, neck, and dark suit. Bright specular highlights catch sharply on his illuminated cheekbone, jawline, nose bridge, and the curved chrome and paint of the vintage car. The cool, high-contrast, desaturated complementary color palette is dominated by deep foreground blacks that contrast fiercely with the stark white car and accents, set against a twilight blue sky that fades into a warm amber horizon gradient reflecting softly on his skin tones. Shot straight-on as a realistic, tack-sharp digital photograph blending paparazzi-style night portraits with an elegant old-money cinematic aesthetic, utilizing a 35mm to 50mm lens at f/4 to f/5.6, a 1/100s shutter speed, and ISO 800 to 1600. The deep depth of field editorial image is finalized with crushed blacks, lifted midtone contrast, a slightly cooled ambient white balance, and atmospheric digital film noise, framed in a 3:4 vertical aspect ratio.
2117903200341230796.promptZh: 一名年轻成年男性以刻意摆出的45度侧身姿态站立，双肩放松，身穿经典深黑色燕尾服、蝴蝶结领结、纯白色硬挺衬衫领口和整洁利落的口袋方巾。他英俊而严肃的面容以侧面轮廓呈现，目光望向画外，双唇闭合、表情中性，眉毛自然舒展。他浓密、中等长度的短发被梳至耳后，并向后整齐梳理，整体造型低蓬松度、经典渐变收束（taper），无明显侧分线；使用强定型力发蜡精心打理，呈现出湿亮光泽质感，并可见清晰梳痕；尽管使用了大量发蜡，头顶与后脑处发丝仍略显自然分离，透出原本发质纹理。他的左手随意插在左裤袋中，露出一截洁净无瑕的法式袖口及腕上一只金属材质正装腕表。他伫立于浓重阴影般的纯黑草地上，身旁是一辆占据画面右下前景的崭新复古汽车，车身涂装为高光纯白，配有镀铬圆形侧视镜，车内仪表盘清晰可见，呈温暖棕色调。深远的空间背景中，中左地平线上隐约浮现远处车辆模糊而微弱的白色前大灯；右上天空则映衬出枝干嶙峋、细节丰富的落叶乔木枯枝剪影。一道来自左前方的强烈、高度定向的人工闪光灯刺破画面所营造的精致而神秘的疏离感氛围，于他面部右侧、颈部及深色西装上投下浓重、边缘锐利的纯黑阴影。明亮的镜面高光（specular highlights）精准捕捉在他受光的颧骨、下颌线、鼻梁以及复古汽车弯曲的镀铬表面与漆面上。整体采用冷调、高对比度、低饱和度的互补色配色方案：前景深邃的黑色与刺眼的白色汽车及点缀色形成强烈反差，背景则是暮色蓝调天空，渐变为暖琥珀色的地平线，柔和地映照在他肤色之上。本图以正面直拍方式摄制，是一张写实、锐利如针尖般清晰（tack-sharp）的数码照片，融合狗仔队风格夜间人像（paparazzi-style night portraits）与优雅的老钱电影感美学（elegant old-money cinematic aesthetic），使用35mm至50mm焦距镜头，光圈f/4至f/5.6，快门速度1/100秒，ISO 800至1600。这张景深（depth of field）深远的杂志级图像最终经调色处理：压暗纯黑（crushed blacks）、提升中间调对比度（lifted midtone contrast）、环境白平衡略微偏冷（slightly cooled ambient white balance），并叠加大气感数字胶片噪点（atmospheric digital film noise），以3:4竖构图比例裁切完成。

2117903200341230798.promptEn: A young adult male leans casually against a weathered stone balustrade, his relaxed shoulders and shifted weight conveying candid ease. He is dressed in a light grey tailored suit paired with a deep navy, unbuttoned open-collared shirt. His hair is cleanly slicked back with product, catching a gentle sheen. Behind aviator sunglasses, his gaze is focused sharply off-camera to the left, accompanied by a serious expression with his mouth slightly ajar as if caught mid-breath. His hands are loosely clasped at his waist; the left hand rests with fingers wrapped lightly over the right, its thumb extended forward, displaying a rectangular silver dress watch with a light blue-grey leather strap, while only the thumb and index knuckle of the right hand remain visible beneath. He is positioned in a deeply layered outdoor lakeside terrace setting. In the bottom left foreground, vibrant crimson red geraniums and dark foliage burst from a worn black metal planter box on a railing. To his lower right in the midground, the weathered warm off-white plastered stone pillar, detailed with subtle scuffs and matte grey undertones, supports a classic stone urn planter filled with green shrubbery and a solitary white flower. Stretching out behind him, pristine slate blue lake water ripples with choppy surface texture, revealing a small white boat in the far-left distance. Rising steeply in the deep background are mountains densely carpeted in thriving forest green trees, heavily interspersed with small white houses and villas clinging to the hillside. The scene exudes a sophisticated, quiet luxury, bathed in cool, moody natural light from an overcast sky acting as a giant softbox. Diffused lighting pours gently from above, creating a low-contrast illumination that casts faint, soft-edged shadows beneath his suit lapels, under his hands, and provides subtle modeling on the right side of his face. Crisp specular highlights form soft reflections on the aviator lenses and cast a gentle sheen on the watch face. The color palette relies on desaturated cool greys, slate blues, and forest greens, sharply punctuated by the vivid crimson accents. Captured as tack-sharp, grain-free realistic digital editorial photography from a straight-on perspective, utilizing a 50mm to 85mm lens at an aperture between f/4 and f/5.6, creating a medium depth of field that keeps the subject crisply in focus while atmospheric haze slightly softens the distant mountains. Cinematic post-processing applies cool color grading, desaturates the greens and blues, lifts the black point for a matte finish, and selectively enhances the red floral tones, all beautifully framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341230798.promptZh: 一名年轻成年男性随意倚靠在一道饱经风霜的石制栏杆上，他放松的双肩与偏移的重心传递出自然随性的神态。他身穿一套浅灰色剪裁合体的西装，内搭一件深海军蓝、未系扣的敞领衬衫。他的头发用发蜡整齐地向后梳拢，泛着柔和光泽。他戴着飞行员墨镜，目光锐利地望向镜头外左侧，神情严肃，嘴唇微张，仿佛正处在呼吸中途。双手松散交叠于腰间：左手轻覆于右手上，手指自然环握，拇指向前伸展，露出一只长方形银色正装腕表，表带为浅蓝灰色皮革；右手仅拇指与食指指关节部分从左手下方隐约可见。他置身于一个层次极为丰富的户外湖畔露台场景中。画面左下前景处，鲜亮的猩红色天竺葵与深色 foliage 从一只磨损的黑色金属花箱中蓬勃而出，花箱置于栏杆之上。他右下方中景处，一根暖调米白色灰泥石柱表面布有细微刮痕、呈现哑光灰色底色，柱顶承托一只经典石质瓮形花盆，盆中栽有青翠灌木与一朵孤零零的白花。他身后延展开去，是一片洁净的板岩蓝色湖水，水面波纹起伏、肌理略显粗粝，在极远左端可见一艘小白船。纵深背景中，山势陡峭耸立，密布生机盎然的森林绿树木，其间错落散布着大量白色小屋与别墅，依附于山坡之上。整个场景流露出精致而静谧的奢华感，沐浴在阴云密布天空所营造出的冷调、情绪化自然光之中——天空宛如一只巨型柔光箱。漫射光线自上方轻柔倾泻，形成低对比度照明，在他西装翻领下方、双手之下投下淡而柔和的阴影，并于他面部右侧塑造出微妙的立体感。清晰的镜面高光在飞行员墨镜镜片上形成柔和反光，亦在腕表面盘上泛起淡淡光泽。整体色彩方案以去饱和的冷灰、板岩蓝与森林绿为主，由鲜明的猩红色花卉作为强烈点睛之笔。本图以精准锐利、无颗粒感的真实主义数字杂志摄影（editorial photography）风格拍摄，采用正面平视视角，镜头焦距为50mm至85mm，光圈设定在f/4至f/5.6之间，营造中等景深（depth of field），使主体清晰锐利，同时大气薄雾令远景山脉略呈柔焦效果。电影感（cinematic）后期处理应用冷色调分级（color grading），对绿色与蓝色进行去饱和，提升黑场（black point）以达成哑光质感（matte finish），并有针对性地强化红色花卉的色调，最终以4:5画幅比例完美构图。

2117903200341230800.promptEn: A confident young handsome male sits upright with a slight lean forward, angled forty-five degrees to the left in the pristine white leather seat of a classic wooden boat. He wears a highly textured warm brown linen double-breasted suit jacket over a crisp white collared shirt with exposed cuffs, accessorized with classic dark round tortoiseshell sunglasses masking a neutral, serious expression with firmly closed lips as he gazes off-camera. His medium-length wavy brown hair is pushed back with a windblown, unstructured texture, showcasing natural imperfections, distinct flyaways, and organic volume without a defined part. His left hand firmly grips the ten o'clock position of a pristine, glossy mahogany steering wheel featuring rivet details and chrome spokes, fingers wrapped securely around the rim with knuckles slightly visible, while his relaxed right hand rests casually on a chrome and black throttle lever beside him with fingers gently draped. He is navigating deep turquoise-blue lake water characterized by choppy white wakes, surrounded by the boat's luxurious interior featuring pristine white leather seating with visible piping and stitching. In the deep background, large sloping green mountains are softened by atmospheric blue haze and distance under a clear, expansive sky blue horizon. The energetic, luxurious scene is bathed in bright, highly directional mid-day natural sunlight hitting from the front-top-left, creating a highly saturated, high-contrast palette of warm browns and cool blues. Harsh, deeply defined black shadows carve into the fabric folds, under his jaw, across the right side of his face and neck, beneath his arms, and deep inside the boat cockpit, while brilliant specular highlights punch bright reflections onto his hair, nose, the wooden steering wheel rim, chrome fittings, and the water surface. Captured from a straight-on perspective from the adjacent passenger seat using a full-frame digital camera with a 35mm lens, an aperture of f/5.6 for a medium depth of field that keeps the subject and boat tack sharp while smoothly falling off toward the distant alpine mountains, and a fast shutter speed to freeze the motion. This hyperrealistic, Slim Aarons-inspired editorial lifestyle photograph features an enhanced contrast S-curve, a slight warming filter to emphasize the sunlit atmosphere, boosted clarity on the clothing and wood textures, and is perfectly framed in a 3:4 vertical aspect ratio.
2117903200341230800.promptZh: 一位自信、年轻、英俊的男性端坐于一艘经典木质船舱内 pristine white leather 座椅（纯白皮革座椅）上，身体微微前倾，朝左偏转四十五度。他身穿一件质感丰富、暖棕色亚麻双排扣西装外套，内搭一件挺括的白色立领衬衫，袖口外露；佩戴一副经典深色圆形玳瑁纹太阳镜，遮住中性而严肃的表情，双唇紧闭，目光望向画外。他中等长度的棕褐色波浪发被向后梳理，呈现被风吹拂、不加雕琢的自然纹理，显露天然瑕疵、明显翘起的碎发以及有机蓬松感，无明确分缝线。他的左手紧握在光洁闪亮的红木方向盘十点钟位置，方向盘带有铆钉细节与镀铬辐条，手指牢牢环握轮缘，指关节略显突出；右手则放松地搁在身旁的镀铬与黑色油门杆上，手指自然垂落。他正驾驭着深青绿色湖水，水面泛起碎白浪花；船舱内部奢华精致，可见 pristine white leather 座椅（纯白皮革座椅）、清晰的包边与缝线。远景为大片倾斜的苍翠山峦，在澄澈开阔的天蓝色地平线下，被大气蓝雾与距离柔化。整个充满活力又奢华的场景沐浴在明亮、高度定向的正午自然阳光中，光源来自前左上方，营造出高饱和度、高对比度的暖棕与冷蓝配色。强烈而轮廓分明的黑色阴影刻入布料褶皱、下颌下方、面部与颈部右侧、双臂下方，以及船舱内部深处；同时，耀眼的镜面高光（specular highlights）在发丝、鼻尖、木质方向盘轮缘、镀铬配件及水面迸发出明亮反光。画面以邻座乘客视角正面拍摄，使用全画幅数码相机搭配 35mm 镜头，光圈 f/5.6，实现中等景深（depth of field），使人物与船体细节锐利清晰，背景阿尔卑斯山脉则自然虚化过渡；快门速度足够高，以凝固动态。这是一幅超写实风格、受 Slim Aarons 启发的杂志级生活方式摄影（editorial lifestyle photograph），采用增强对比度的 S 型色调曲线（S-curve）、轻微暖调滤镜（warming filter）以强化阳光氛围、提升服装与木材纹理的清晰度（clarity），并以 3:4 纵向构图（vertical aspect ratio）精准取景。

His head is turned forty-five degrees to the right, his eyes completely concealed by dark black sunglasses above a neutral, slightly open mouth. His medium-length, dark layered hair flows to the top of his ears in a pushed-back style, parted slightly off-center with a distinctly realistic, matte texture that reveals a slight natural wave and visible, unpolished flyaways catching the breeze. He wears a crisp, warm white half-zip sweatshirt, perfectly paired with matching white sweatpants. His relaxed right hand gently wraps around the tan grip tape and black base handle of a tennis racket resting against his inner right thigh, while his left hand rests gracefully on the racket's throat between his legs, fingers curving loosely over a yellow-green tennis ball. He is seated on a modestly worn black metal folding chair with a canvas seat, grounded on a vibrant terracotta-red crushed clay tennis court textured by crisp white painted lines, sweeping brush marks, and scattered footprints. The meticulously layered environment expands deeply behind him, beginning on the mid-left with a pristine white slatted park bench bearing folded white towels beside thriving, manicured evergreen boxwood bushes sculpted into perfectly smooth, round domes. On the mid-right, a pristine black mesh tennis net with a thick white top band stretches across the court, guiding the eye toward a distant, dark matte chainlink. while a weathered metal truss stadium light post rises in the upper left background near a distant pristine Alpine building with a red dormer roof beneath a light blue sky. The scene is enveloped in an energetic, sun-drenched summer atmosphere, illuminated by a single source of bright, hard natural sunlight blazing from the top-left. This highly directional, warm golden light creates dramatic, high-contrast illumination, casting deep black, harshly edged shadows under his chin, inside the folds of his clothing, and stretching intricate tree silhouettes across the foreground clay toward the lower right, while preserving brilliant highlights on his right shoulder, the crown of his hair, his upper thigh, and the bridge of his nose. Captured as a clean, structured editorial lifestyle photograph using a 35mm to 50mm lens straight-on at seated eye level, the image maintains tack-sharp focus on the subject with high clarity and a slightly softer but highly detailed background depth of field, enhanced by a warm color grade that enriches the triadic palette of vibrant reds, bright whites, and lush greens, ultimately framed in a 3:4 portrait aspect ratio.
2117903200341230801.promptZh: 一位年轻健硕的男性随意坐在画面正中央，身体微微前倾，双肩放松，手肘靠近膝盖，整体呈现出沉静、自信且坦率观察的美学气质。他的头部向右偏转四十五度，双眼完全被一副深黑色太阳镜遮住，下方是一张神情中性、微微张开的嘴。他留着中等长度、深色、层次分明的头发，向后梳理至耳尖上方，发缝略偏中心，发质呈现高度写实的哑光质感，隐约透出自然微卷与未经修饰、随风飘动的碎发。他身穿一件挺括温暖的纯白色半拉链运动衫，搭配同色系白色运动裤。他放松的右手轻轻环握一支网球拍的浅褐色防滑胶带握把与黑色底柄，球拍斜靠在他右大腿内侧；左手优雅地搭在双腿之间的球拍颈部，手指松缓地环绕着一颗黄绿色网球。他坐在一把略显磨损的黑色金属折叠椅上，椅面为帆布材质，椅子稳置于一片生机勃勃的赤陶红色压碎红土网球场上——球场表面可见清晰的白色涂绘界线、挥洒般的笔触肌理以及零星散落的脚印。精心分层构建的环境向他身后纵深延展：画面中左方是一张洁净纯白的条状公园长椅，上面叠放着几条白色毛巾，长椅旁是枝繁叶茂、修剪精致的常绿黄杨灌木，被塑造成表面光滑、轮廓浑圆的球形；画面中右方是一道洁净的黑色网球场网，顶部配有一条厚实的白色顶带，横贯整个球场，并将视线引向远处一道深色哑光材质的菱形网格围栏；左上方背景中矗立着一根饱经风霜的金属桁架式体育场照明灯柱，其旁远处是一座洁净如新的阿尔卑斯风格建筑，屋顶设有红色山花窗，天空则为淡蓝色。整个场景洋溢着充满活力、阳光充沛的夏日氛围，仅由左上方单一光源——强烈、硬朗的自然日光——进行照明。这束高度定向的暖金色光线营造出戏剧性的高对比度照明效果：在他下颌下方、衣物褶皱内部投下浓重、边缘锐利的纯黑阴影，并将错综复杂的树影投射至前景红土表面，朝向画面右下方延伸；同时保留了他右肩、头顶发冠、大腿上部以及鼻梁处耀眼的高光。本图以干净、结构严谨的杂志风格生活方式摄影（editorial lifestyle photograph）方式拍摄，采用35mm至50mm焦距镜头，正面平视、与坐姿人眼齐平取景；主体保持焦点精准、细节锐利，背景则呈现景深（depth of field）略柔和但高度精细的虚化效果，并通过暖色调调色强化画面三原色配色方案——鲜明的红色、明亮的白色与葱郁的绿色，最终以3:4竖构图比例成像。

The striking complementary color palette beautifully balances the bright whites of his clothing and warm peach skin tones against the deep black interior and clear blue sky. Captured as a photorealistic digital photograph reminiscent of high-end old money automotive lifestyle content, the tack-sharp image utilizes a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/2.8 and a fast shutter speed to isolate the subject from the slightly softened stone background, enhanced with crisp post-processing to deepen the contrast and sharpen facial hair and fabric textures, beautifully framed in a 1:1 square aspect ratio.

一位自信英俊的男性肖像，下颌线轮廓鲜明，面部带有浅淡胡茬；他正对镜头端坐，双肩水平，神情威严而严肃，目光直视前方，眼睑放松且微微眯起，双唇闭合、呈中性状态。  
他的短发两侧采用渐变式剃短（tapered fade），顶部留有二至三英寸长度，向上向后打理成富有纹理感的油头（quiff），呈现哑光质感，清晰展现自然发丝分缕、轻微不规则波浪纹路，以及几缕细小碎发在背景映衬下被光线勾勒出的轮廓。  
他身穿一件高纹理、半透明的亮白色纽扣衬衫，肩头随意搭着一件光滑的纯白色针织衫。  
他坐在一辆深色豪华汽车内部，倚靠在一张洁净无瑕、浅灰色哑光曲面运动座椅上，座椅集成头枕。  
深色车内环境以非对称方式框构画面：可见洁净的黑色织物顶棚，以及位于右上方的矩形黑色扶手握把（嵌入式设计）；乘客侧车窗则透出一幅中等景深（depth of field）的画面——晴朗湛蓝的天空，以及一面由粗凿浅棕色与米褐色石块堆砌而成的风化外墙，石块间填满厚重灰浆接缝。  
明亮、高度定向的金色自然阳光自左前方以四十五度角斜射入内，为整个场景铺洒温暖、充满活力且奢华的光辉。  
这种硬光（hard light）略带大气弥散（atmospheric diffusion），营造出高对比度的电影感氛围（cinematic atmosphere）：在他下巴下方、鼻翼右侧及右脸颊投下浓重、短促而深邃的纯黑阴影；同时在其左脸颊、鼻梁、额头及 crisp 白衬衫领口处保留明亮、锐利的高光。  
醒目的互补色配色方案完美平衡了服饰的明快白色与肌肤温暖的桃粉色调，与深邃黑色车内环境及澄澈蓝色天空形成强烈对照。  
本图以照片级写实（photorealistic）数字摄影风格呈现，令人联想到高端“老钱风”（old money）汽车生活方式类影像内容；画质锐利精准（tack-sharp），采用全画幅相机搭配 85mm 镜头、f/2.8 光圈与高速快门，使主体从略微柔化的石墙背景中脱颖而出；后期处理进一步强化对比度，并锐化面部胡须与织物纹理细节；最终以 1:1 方形画幅（square aspect ratio）精美构图。

Small uppercase tagline: “TRAVEL • EXPLORE • LIVE”

Use sophisticated dark teal typography, clean spacing, premium editorial design, balanced hierarchy, highly legible text, and tasteful minimal decoration.

Avoid: distorted people, extra limbs, unrealistic architecture, excessive saturation, blurry details, cartoon appearance, fake-looking water, cluttered typography, logos, watermarks.

The deep, luxurious background reveals a high-end hotel lobby or lounge, featuring a pristine high-gloss black grand piano with its lid down and a large leafy green Ficus plant near a window in the left midground, balanced by plush, curved mustard yellow armchairs and a glowing conical table lamp on the right. 2117903200341230815.promptEn:
Retro Hong Kong cha chaan teng portrait, 90s Hong Kong film still aesthetic, candid documentary vibe.

Subject: A 25-year-old adult East Asian female with an oval face, thin eyebrows, and dark pupils; fair skin preserving fine pores and natural textures, rejecting plastic-like smoothing; light makeup with reddish lips. Long black hair draped over shoulders with naturally curled ends, strands falling by the face.

Expression: Eyes looking off-camera to the left, relaxed and lazy demeanor, a faint smile at the corners of the mouth, like being caught daydreaming in the afternoon.

Clothing: Cream white pure cotton short-sleeved shirt with one button open at the collar; dark brown high-waisted corduroy wide-leg pants; black thin belt; pearl earrings. Outfit is clean and sharp, with vintage vibes hidden in details.

Pose/Action: Sitting in a window-side booth at a cha chaan teng, body slightly turned towards the window, one elbow resting on the table holding a steaming silk stocking milk tea, the other hand casually supporting her chin. Relaxed posture, not stiff.

Props: On the table are pineapple buns, shrimp dumplings in bamboo steamers, metal milk tea cups, menu boards, wooden chopstick holders.

Environment: Foreground features slightly blurred milk tea cups and steamers; mid-ground shows the subject and booth table; background reveals the interior of the cha chaan teng—green mosaic tile walls, red neon sign 'Cha Chaan Teng', old-style ceiling fans, glass cabinets displaying egg tarts and pastries; distant diners appear as soft blurs.

Lighting: Warm yellow indoor pendant lights as main light, color temperature around 3200K, wrapped in a thin haze of cooking oil smoke; cool daylight from outside serves as rim light, creating warm-cool contrast. Soft highlights reflect on glass cabinets and tiles.

Camera: 50mm prime lens, f/2.0, half-body shot, eye-level slightly low angle, shallow depth of field, subject clear while foreground/background naturally blurred, slightly handheld casual framing, film grain, Kodak Gold film simulation, Eastmancolor palette.

Mood: Nostalgic, slow-paced afternoon laziness, like a frozen frame from an old Hong Kong movie.

Quality Tags: ultra detailed, photorealistic, cinematic, high resolution, natural skin texture.

Negative Constraints: No oil painting, No anime, No 3D render, No cartoon, no deformed hands, no plastic skin, no oversaturated colors, no text artifacts, no watermark.
2117903200341230815.promptZh:
复古香港茶餐厅肖像，90年代香港电影剧照美学，纪实风格抓拍氛围。

主体：一名25岁东亚成年女性，鹅蛋脸，细眉，深色瞳孔；肤色白皙，保留细腻毛孔与天然肤质纹理，拒绝塑料感平滑处理；淡妆，唇色偏红。长黑发垂落肩头，发尾自然卷曲，数缕发丝垂于脸颊旁。

表情：双眼望向画幅左侧镜头外，神态放松慵懒，嘴角浮现淡淡笑意，仿佛午后走神被偶然捕捉。

服饰：米白色纯棉短袖衬衫，领口解开一颗纽扣；深棕色高腰灯芯绒阔腿裤；黑色细腰带；珍珠耳钉。整体穿搭干净利落，细节中暗藏复古气息。

姿态/动作：坐在茶餐厅靠窗卡座内，身体略朝向窗外扭转，一只胳膊肘支在桌上，手持一杯热气升腾的丝袜奶茶；另一只手随意托住下巴。姿态松弛，毫不僵硬。

道具：桌上摆放菠萝包、竹制蒸笼盛装的虾饺、金属奶茶杯、菜单板、木质筷子架。

环境：前景为略微虚化的奶茶杯与蒸笼；中景呈现主体与卡座桌面；背景展现茶餐厅内部——绿色马赛克瓷砖墙面、红色霓虹招牌“Cha Chaan Teng”、老式吊扇、玻璃橱柜陈列蛋挞与糕点；远处食客呈柔和虚化状。

布光：以暖黄色室内吊灯为主光源，色温约3200K，笼罩于一层薄薄的厨房油烟微 haze 中；室外冷调日光作为轮廓光（rim light），营造暖-冷对比。玻璃橱柜与瓷砖表面泛出柔和高光。

相机：50mm定焦镜头，f/2.0，半身构图，视平线略低角度（low angle），浅景深（depth of field），主体清晰，前景与背景自然虚化，略带手持感的随性取景，胶片颗粒（film grain），柯达金胶卷（Kodak Gold）模拟效果，伊斯曼彩色（Eastmancolor）影调。

氛围：怀旧感十足，午后慢节奏的慵懒，宛如一帧凝固的老香港电影画面。

画质标签：超精细（ultra detailed）、照片级写实（photorealistic）、电影感（cinematic）、高分辨率（high resolution）、天然皮肤纹理（natural skin texture）。

负面约束：非油画风格，非动漫风格，非3D渲染，非卡通风格，无畸形双手，无塑料感皮肤，无过度饱和色彩，无文字畸变，无水印。

2117903200341230817.promptEn:
Theme:
1920s Art-Deco opulence and high-society elegance at twilight.

Subject:
A Caucasian woman in her late twenties with a slender, graceful build, standing alone on a high-rise penthouse balcony.

Person · Expression:
Defined facial structure with high cheekbones and a soft jawline. Her eyes are partially closed in a serene, contemplative expression, framed by long dark lashes. Her hair is a deep auburn with golden highlights, styled in thick waves cascading over one shoulder. The skin features a natural, soft texture with subtle pores and light freckles on the shoulders.

Clothing · Pose:
An emerald-green silk satin evening gown with a backless design and thin spaghetti straps. The skirt features high side slits that reveal the movement of the fabric. She is posed in a relaxed weight shift, with one hand resting on an ornate wrought-iron railing and the other holding a crystal champagne flute at chest height. Her head is tilted back slightly, savoring the atmosphere.

Background · Light:
An Art-Deco balcony with polished marble floors overlooking a sparkling city skyline. The scene is illuminated by the golden hour sun positioned behind the subject, creating a pronounced rim-light effect and making the silk appear translucent at the edges. The background transitions into a deep twilight blue sky with antique street lamps glowing below.

Composition · Camera:
A medium-full vertical shot from an eye-level perspective with a slight low-angle tilt. The composition follows the rule of thirds, using a shallow depth of field to maintain sharp focus on the subject and the condensation on the glass while the city becomes a soft, creamy bokeh.

Texture · Style:
Ultra-photorealistic rendering with a focus on material contrast: the cool, reflective marble and wrought iron against the warm, soft texture of the skin and the liquid sheen of the satin gown. The color palette is a rich blend of emerald, gold, amber, and deep evening blues with a vintage cinematic grade.
2117903200341230817.promptZh:
主题：  
1920年代装饰艺术（Art Deco）风格的奢华感与黄昏时分上流社会的优雅气质。

主体：  
一位二十多岁末期的白人女性，身形纤细而优雅，独自伫立于高层顶层公寓的阳台之上。

人物·表情：  
面部轮廓清晰，颧骨高挺，下颌线条柔和。双眼微闭，呈现宁静而沉思的表情，由浓密深色睫毛勾勒。发色为深赤褐色，带有金色挑染，厚重波浪卷发倾泻于一侧肩头。肌肤呈现自然柔润质感，带有细微毛孔与肩部淡淡的雀斑。

服饰·姿态：  
一袭祖母绿色真丝缎面晚礼服，露背设计，配以细 spaghetti 细肩带。裙摆两侧开高衩，随动作显露布料流动感。姿态放松而富有重心偏移感：一手轻搭于繁复锻铁栏杆之上，另一手在胸前高度持一只水晶香槟杯。头部微微后仰，沉浸于此刻氛围之中。

背景·光线：  
装饰艺术（Art Deco）风格阳台，铺设抛光大理石地面，俯瞰璀璨城市天际线。画面由位于主体后方的黄金时刻（golden hour）夕阳照亮，形成鲜明的轮廓光（rim-light）效果，使真丝边缘呈现半透明质感。背景渐变为深邃的暮蓝色天空，下方古董街灯泛出暖光。

构图·镜头：  
中近景竖构图，采用平视视角并略带低角度仰拍。构图遵循三分法（rule of thirds），使用浅景深（shallow depth of field），确保主体及玻璃杯表面凝结的水珠清晰锐利，而城市背景则化为柔滑、奶油般的焦外虚化（bokeh）。

质感·风格：  
超照片级写实（ultra-photorealistic）渲染，强调材质对比：清凉反光的大理石与锻铁，对比温润柔软的肌肤质感，以及缎面礼服所呈现的液态光泽。色彩方案融合祖母绿、金、琥珀与深邃的傍晚蓝，辅以复古电影感调色（vintage cinematic grade）。

2117903200341230828.promptEn:
A breathtaking and extremely complex world-building infographic masterpiece conceptualizing the "Fundamental Differences between Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism", designed as a profound ancient Oriental mythological manuscript.
Background: Pure white vintage textured canvas with a light beige aged parchment base color, subtle frayed edges, and water stain textures.
Core Layout: Central vision uses a grand "vertical egg-shaped layered structure", with Buddhism, Taoism, and Confucianism layers from top to bottom.
Margins: Four corners are decorated with fine micro-illustrations featuring ancient observation notes, ritual implements, and runes.
Colors: Low-saturation sage green, light gold, and off-white as main tones; overall light and soft without harsh high-saturation colors.
Details: Architectural lines, landscape brushwork, lotus patterns, and cloud layers are clearly visible and exquisitely detailed.
Seamless Fusion: The three layers transition naturally through clouds and flowing water; the Buddhist halo, Taoist Taiji mist, and Confucian scholarly aura connect seamlessly.
Style: Classical ink line art + low-saturation digital watercolor, with a light Chinese-style ancient book manuscript texture.
Text Annotations: Authentic Traditional Chinese characters in a mottled vintage Song typeface. Each annotation includes a short title + a line of poetic description, connected to corresponding details by dark gold hair-thin lines with no overlapping pointers.
Aspect Ratio: 3:4 vertical format, independent and complete.

Title Area (Top): `儒釋道·根本區別` (Confucianism, Buddhism, Taoism: Fundamental Differences)
Central Layer Labels:
Top "Buddhism": `釋`, `Relationship between man and self`, `Selflessness, governing the heart, letting go` 
Middle "Taoism": `道`, `Relationship between man and all things`, `Non-action, governing the body, being open-minded` 
Bottom "Confucianism": `儒`, `Relationship between man and man`, `No ego, governing the world, taking responsibility` 
Side Annotations:
Left: `Purity`: pure heart and clear mind, cutting off troubles; `Stillness`: following nature, returning to the original heart; `Respect`: respecting responsibility, active involvement in society.
Right: `60+ Spiritual Cultivation`: looking lightly at gain/loss; `35-55 Conduct`: living with flexibility, following laws; `7-35 Actions`: forging ahead, building careers.
Bottom Summary: `The balance between being in the world and being out of the world is high-level life wisdom.`

2117903200341230836.promptEn: A vintage American comic-book page in a faded 1950s romance-adventure style, printed on slightly yellowed paper with visible halftone texture, inked panel borders, and soft weathered colors. The page contains exactly 5 panels arranged in a classic comic layout: 1 wide top panel, 2 middle panels side by side, and 2 bottom panels side by side. In the top panel, show a sunny coastal boulevard in Miami, with turquoise water on the left, a sailboat offshore, pastel Art Deco buildings in the distance, tall palm trees, and a pink classic convertible driving along the waterfront. A stylish couple sits in the car, and large dramatic comic title lettering reads “ART IN MIAMI!” with a small caption box at the top saying “MIAMI, SATURDAY AFTERNOON…”. Add two speech balloons: “READY TO SEE SOME ART?” and “ALWAYS!”. In the second panel, an interior car view from behind the couple as they drive down Ocean Drive, showing colorful pastel buildings and palms ahead; the man has dark hair and a blue shirt, the woman wears sunglasses, a pink dress, and a lavender headscarf. Include a caption box reading “WE DROVE DOWN OCEAN DRIVE…” and speech balloons saying “LOOK AT THOSE COLORS…” and “MIAMI FEELS LIKE A PAINTING!”. In the third panel, show the couple approaching the entrance of a modern museum with the visible wall text “MIAMI ART MUSEUM”, glass doors, and people inside; add a caption box reading “THE EXHIBIT WAS AT A MODERN MUSEUM…” and a speech balloon saying “LET’S GO!”. In the fourth panel, place the couple inside a gallery viewing large abstract paintings in bright pastel blocks and shapes, with a small sculpture on a pedestal nearby; add a caption box reading “INSIDE, THE ART SURROUNDED US.” and speech balloons saying “I LOVE HOW BRIGHT AND BOLD IT IS.” and “IT FEELS LIKE MIAMI… VIBRANT AND FREE!”. In the fifth panel, show the couple outside again by the water with the skyline, palm trees, and a sailboat in the background, standing close together in the sun; add a caption box reading “WE STEPPED OUT INTO THE SUN…” and a small closing narration box at the bottom right saying “A BEAUTIFUL DAY.” Include speech balloons saying “THAT WAS PERFECT.” and “ART, SUN, AND MIAMI… CAN’T BEAT IT!”. Use hand-lettered uppercase comic text, black outlines, slightly imperfect vintage printing registration, muted pinks, aquas, sandy beige, and seafoam green, with a nostalgic warm romantic mood.

One of her arms is replaced by an enormous heavy mech limb that is far larger than her body, extending toward the viewer. The arm is built from layered white armored plates, exposed joints, cables, bolts, pistons, and segmented machinery, with scratches and grime for a worn combat-industrial look. The hand has exactly 4 massive clawed fingers touching the wet ground, each ending in long black-red talons, with red internal lights glowing through vents and gaps across the knuckles, wrist, and forearm. Add dangling black cables beneath the upper arm and subtle red light leaks around the elbow and shoulder mechanisms. Her other sleeve hangs normally at her side. She wears dark shorts or a skirt beneath the coat and oversized fluffy white leg warmers around her lower legs, with bare feet visible on the reflective pavement. The alley is dense with pipes, conduits, cables, vents, and old signage, including teal-green vertical neon signs in the background, creating a moody cyan backlight. Rain falls through the scene, puddles reflect teal and red light, and tiny orange-red sparks scatter near the claw tips on the ground. Use a muted palette of dirty white, charcoal, teal, and crimson, with cinematic contrast, highly detailed linework, gritty textures, atmospheric fog, and a haunting futuristic dystopian mood. Make the character a hooded mech-arm girl, with dirty white outerwear, crimson red mechanical lights, and teal green alley signage.
2117903200341230839.promptZh: 一幅黑暗赛博朋克（cyberpunk）风格的动漫插画，描绘一名身形娇小、气质诡异的女孩，深夜伫立于一条狭窄、雨水浸透的巷道中，采用富有戏剧性的低角度（low angle）构图，使她那条 oversized 的机械臂占据画面前景并形成视觉主导。她身着一件宽大的白色连帽外套，外套表面印满补丁状符号、示意图与工业标识，兜帽在她脸上投下浓重阴影。她的面容极简、如人偶般精致：黑色直发齐耳，肤色苍白，双眼为两枚泛着白光的圆形瞳孔，无可见虹膜或瞳孔，神情静默而毫无情绪。其中一条手臂被替换为一条巨大沉重的机甲义肢，体积远超她自身躯干，朝观者方向伸展。该义肢由层层叠叠的白色装甲板构成，裸露的关节、线缆、螺栓、活塞与分段式机械结构清晰可见，表面布满刮痕与污垢，呈现历经实战与工业磨损的粗粝质感。义手共有四根粗壮带爪的手指，指尖触抵湿滑地面，每根手指末端均延伸出修长的黑红色利爪；红色内部光源透过指节、手腕与前臂各处的通风口与缝隙隐隐透出。上臂下方垂悬数根黑色线缆，肘部与肩部机械结构边缘则有细微的红光渗出。另一侧衣袖自然垂落于身侧。外套之下，她穿着深色短裤或短裙，小腿裹着 oversized 的毛绒白色护腿，赤足踩在具有镜面反射效果的湿漉漉路面上。巷道内密布管道、线槽、电缆、通风口与老旧招牌，背景中可见青绿色垂直霓虹灯牌，营造出忧郁的青色背光（cyan backlight）。雨丝贯穿整个场景，水洼倒映青色与红色光芒，利爪尖端附近的地面上零星迸溅着细小的橙红色电火花。整体采用灰暗克制的配色：脏白（dirty white）、炭黑（charcoal）、青绿（teal）与深红（crimson），辅以电影感对比度（cinematic contrast）、高度精细的线条（highly detailed linework）、粗粝质感（gritty textures）、氛围雾效（atmospheric fog）以及萦绕不散的未来主义反乌托邦（futuristic dystopian）阴郁气息。角色设定为“兜帽+机甲臂少女”，外衣为脏白色，机械部件内置深红色光源，巷道招牌为青绿色。

2117903200341230841.promptEn: A dramatic vertical Japanese stage-play poster in luxurious dark fantasy anime style, featuring a single androgynous young actor in a half-body portrait against a nighttime city skyline with glowing high-rise windows and soft bokeh lights. The character has long straight hair in deep black with vivid teal-turquoise inner glow and streaks, glossy highlights, and strands flowing across the shoulders. They wear an elegant black high-collared costume with subtle brocade texture, a fitted dark coat, black leather gloves, and a jewel-like diamond-shaped turquoise pendant at the throat set in ornate gold. One gloved hand is raised near the collar in a poised theatrical gesture. The mood is mysterious, romantic, and slightly gothic, with cinematic rim lighting from behind, strong contrast, gold sparkles, and luminous accents in the hair and costume. Use a refined magazine-quality key visual composition with decorative gold filigree corners and a premium theatrical poster layout. Leave space for Japanese typography integrated into the design: at upper right, small text "夜空に輝く、唯一の星。", then "主演俳優" and the actor name "夜乃 宙" with small romanization "SORA YORUNO" beneath; along the left side, a vertical quote reading "この役に、すべてを捧げる。闇さえ、愛に変えてみせよう。"; near center-lower, small text "幻想ロマン・ステージ" above the large glowing gold title "夜の檻に囚われた光" with a small subtitle beneath "—それでも、君を愛した。"; include a dark teal rose motif and thorny circular ornament near the title. At the bottom left, add the date block "2025 6.20 FRI - 6.29 SUN" and venue "天穹シアター". At the bottom right, add a bordered ticket box with "チケット一般発売 5.10 SAT 10:00~". Center bottom credits in Japanese: "原作・脚本 霧月 澪", "演出 七海 翼", "音楽 深月 奏". Along the very bottom, add the tagline "—光か、闇か——。愛が、運命を選ぶ。—". Emphasize polished poster typography, layered depth, elegant fantasy drama branding, and a consistent face and atmosphere suitable for a theatrical promotional campaign.

2117903200341230843.promptEn: A cinematic, ultra-detailed noir-style scene of 7 anthropomorphic domestic cats gathered around a round green felt poker table in a dim, smoky backroom bar. The central cat is the boss: a serious tabby wearing a dark pinstripe suit, white shirt, tie, black fedora, and black sunglasses, calmly smoking a thick cigar with dramatic smoke curling upward into the overhead lamp. Around him sit 6 other cats, each holding playing cards and dressed like underworld gamblers: on the far left a gray tabby in a textured flat cap and round dark sunglasses; next a ginger cat in a dark fedora, chunky gold chain, and dark glasses; to the right of center a fluffy gray cat in a brown fedora; further right a white-and-tabby cat in a dark New York Yankees baseball cap and pendant necklace; in the near right foreground a striped cat in a fedora and sunglasses seen in profile; all styled as mobsters. The table is crowded with exact poker details: 7 cats total, each with cards in paw, multiple stacks of red, blue, white, and black poker chips, scattered US dollar bills, a short whiskey glass in the front right, and 5 community cards face up in the middle. Use warm amber overhead lighting from a single large hanging lamp, deep shadows, richly textured fur, realistic whiskers, reflective sunglasses, and dense atmospheric cigar smoke. Background should be a dark wood-paneled gambling den with framed vintage posters and signs including a large poker poster on the left and an "ALL IN OR FOLD" sign on the right, plus bottles on shelves. Composition is eye-level and slightly wide-angle, centered on the smoking cat, with a gritty, luxurious gangster mood, photorealistic, dramatic depth, high contrast, and filmic color grading.
2117903200341230843.promptZh: 一部电影感（cinematic）、超精细的黑色电影（noir）风格场景：7只拟人化的家猫围坐在一间昏暗、烟雾缭绕的后室酒吧中一张圆形绿色毛毡扑克桌旁。中央的猫是老大：一只神情严肃的虎斑猫，身穿深色细条纹西装、白色衬衫、领带，头戴黑色软呢帽（fedora），佩戴黑色太阳镜，正从容地抽着一支粗雪茄，浓烈的烟雾戏剧性地向上盘旋，升入头顶悬挂的灯具。围绕他坐着其余6只猫，每只都手持扑克牌，衣着打扮如同地下世界赌徒：最左侧是一只灰虎斑猫，戴着肌理感强的平顶帽（flat cap）和圆框深色太阳镜；其右侧是一只姜黄色猫，头戴深色软呢帽（fedora），佩戴粗金链与深色眼镜；居中偏右是一只毛茸茸的灰色猫，头戴棕色软呢帽（fedora）；再往右是一只白底带虎斑纹的猫，戴着深色纽约洋基队（New York Yankees）棒球帽与吊坠项链；近景右前方是一只条纹猫，头戴软呢帽（fedora）与太阳镜，以侧脸呈现；所有猫均以黑帮分子（mobster）风格造型。桌上布满精确的扑克细节：共7只猫，每只猫掌中握有扑克牌；多摞红色、蓝色、白色与黑色扑克筹码；散落的美元纸币；右前方一只矮威士忌酒杯；中央摊开5张公共牌（community cards），正面朝上。采用暖琥珀色（warm amber）顶灯照明，仅靠一盏大型悬垂灯具提供光源；阴影浓重；毛发纹理丰富细腻；胡须真实自然；太阳镜具有反射效果；雪茄烟雾浓密且富有氛围感。背景为深色木镶板打造的赌博窝点（gambling den），墙上悬挂复古海报与标牌，包括左侧一幅大幅扑克主题海报，右侧一块“ALL IN OR FOLD”标牌，以及架子上陈列的各色酒瓶。构图采用平视视角（eye-level）并略带广角（wide-angle），画面中心聚焦于正在吸烟的猫；整体氛围粗粝而奢华，充满黑帮气息；照片级写实（photorealistic）；景深强烈（dramatic depth）；高对比度（high contrast）；具备电影感色彩分级（filmic color grading）。

2117903200341230844.promptEn: A whimsical, photorealistic action shot of a penguin riding a carnival roller coaster in broad daylight. The penguin is centered in the frame, black and white with a sleek body, wearing a bright red safety helmet and blue wraparound goggles, beak wide open in an excited scream, with both flippers stretched outward like it is enjoying the ride. The roller coaster car is small and glossy black with vivid yellow-to-orange flame graphics along the sides and a silver safety bar across the front. The car is tipping down a steep curve on a bright orange track in the left foreground, creating strong motion and energy. In the background, show a colorful county fair with rainbow-striped tents, a large Ferris wheel lit with multicolored lights, tall amusement rides, and a pink cotton candy stand with a visible “COTTON CANDY” sign. Use a shallow depth of field and slight motion blur in the background to emphasize speed, while keeping the penguin and coaster car sharp. Bright saturated colors, playful surreal humor, dynamic composition, sunny outdoor fairground atmosphere, high detail, cinematic realism.
2117903200341230844.promptZh: 一幅奇思妙想、照片级写实（photorealistic）的动作镜头画面，描绘一只企鹅在白天乘坐游乐园过山车的场景。企鹅位于画面正中央，黑白配色、身形流线，头戴鲜红色安全头盔，佩戴蓝色环绕式护目镜，喙部大张，发出兴奋的尖叫，双鳍向外伸展，仿佛正尽情享受这场飞驰之旅。过山车车厢小巧而富有光泽，通体为黑色，车身两侧绘有从明黄色渐变为橙色的火焰图案，车前横置一根银色安全压杆。车厢正倾斜着冲下一段陡峭弯道，位于画面左前方的亮橙色轨道上，营造出强烈的动感与能量感。背景展现一场缤纷多彩的县集市：条纹如彩虹般的帐篷、一座由多色灯光点亮的巨型摩天轮、高耸入云的游乐设施，以及一座粉红色棉花糖摊位，摊位上清晰可见“COTTON CANDY”标识。采用浅景深（shallow depth of field）与背景轻微运动模糊（motion blur），以强化速度感，同时确保企鹅与过山车车厢锐利清晰。色彩明亮饱和，风格诙谐超现实，构图富于动感，呈现阳光明媚的户外集市氛围，细节丰富，电影感写实（cinematic realism）。

Make the main headline dominate the left and center: gigantic white glowing text “AI×” above even larger white glowing text “動画編集”, with thick blue neon outer glow, slight italic forward motion, beveled 3D shading, and dramatic perspective. In the upper right, add a circular holographic interface with the letters AI in the center, surrounded by concentric rings and tiny HUD marks. Near it, include exactly 3 floating app-style icons: a play button icon, a square “Pr” icon, and an audio waveform icon, all glowing blue. Across the lower right, show a sleek angled video editing monitor displaying a neon city night road scene with a play symbol overlay; beneath the preview, include a timeline with exactly 4 visible tracks: 2 rows of video thumbnails and 2 colored audio bars, one magenta and one cyan-green. Add a tall solid blue vertical rectangle near the top center-right as a placeholder block. The subject has short, wet-looking black hair with messy layered strands and wears a retro-futuristic armored suit: glossy worn red shoulder plates and upper armor, brushed silver metal back plating with rounded panel lines, two flexible ribbed metallic tubes running from the upper back into circular ports, a black shiny undersuit on the arms and sides, a white padded neck seal, and a red waist section with subtle gold trim at the wrist. The armor should feel practical and used, with light scuffs, scratches, and realistic reflections. Place a rectangular privacy blur over the visible side of the face, centered on the head profile. 2117903200341230848.promptEn: A dramatic anime-style cyberpunk witch standing on a dark rooftop high above a dense futuristic city at night, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The main subject is a petite young witch girl with pale skin, short icy blue bobbed hair, pointed elf-like ears, and glowing red eyes, wearing a sly confident smile. She raises a black wand overhead in her right hand, with a dangling orb charm at the tip glowing faintly purple and red. Her oversized crooked witch hat is black with purple lining and covered in stitched patches, warning labels, straps, and white graphics including a large “404” and a skull emblem. She wears a black and purple techwear outfit: oversized hooded jacket with many straps and tags, black crop top with “404” on the chest, layered belts, short bottoms, fishnet on one leg, black lace-up combat boots, chokers, and metallic accessories. Several hanging straps and tags visibly read words like “WITCH 404,” “404,” and glitch-themed markings. Beneath and beside her, a large glowing violet magic circle mixed with hacker interface aesthetics is projected on the rooftop floor, filled with occult rings, sigils, a central skull symbol, and scattered neon system text such as error-code fragments, creating a fusion of sorcery and digital corruption. Emerging from the circle is 1 large armored summoned figure: a black futuristic demon-knight or robotic familiar with jagged reflective armor, a narrow purple-lit visor, and a heavy weapon held in one hand, partially dissolving into purple energy shards and smoke. The background shows a sprawling rainy megacity of apartment towers and industrial rooftops, packed with windows, balconies, cables, signs, and haze. On a nearby building wall is a giant vertical graffiti-style sign with 3 readable elements: “404”, “Witch”, and “ERROR NOT FOUND”, plus a smaller “E404”. Additional purple neon glitch text and symbols are scattered across rooftops and in the air. Use a dark palette of black, indigo, and deep violet with sharp magenta-purple highlights, cinematic contrast, reflective wet surfaces, dense detail, and a high-end polished illustration style. The mood is occult, edgy, stylish, and dangerous, combining urban fantasy, hacker aesthetics, and magical summoning.
2117903200341230848.promptZh: 一位戏剧性的动漫风格赛博朋克女巫，站在夜晚一座高耸于密集未来主义都市之上的幽暗屋顶上，视角略带仰角。主体是一位娇小的年轻女巫少女，肤色苍白，留着短款冰蓝色齐耳发，拥有尖尖的精灵般耳朵，双眼泛着红光，脸上挂着狡黠而自信的微笑。她右手高举一根黑色魔杖，杖尖悬挂一颗发光的球形挂饰，泛出微弱的紫红色光芒。她戴着一顶 oversized（超大号）且歪斜的女巫帽，帽子为黑色，内衬紫色，表面布满缝补补丁、警示标签、绑带以及白色图案，其中包括一个醒目的“404”字样和一枚骷髅徽章。她身穿一套黑紫色科技感服饰：一件 oversized 连帽夹克，配有大量绑带与吊牌；一件黑色露脐上衣，胸前印有“404”；多层腰带、短款下装、一条腿穿着渔网袜、黑色系带战斗靴、多条项圈，以及金属质感配饰。数条垂挂的绑带与吊牌上清晰可见文字，例如 “WITCH 404,” “404”，以及故障艺术（glitch）主题的标记。在她身下及身侧，屋顶地面上投射出一个巨大的泛着紫光的魔法阵，融合了黑客界面美学，阵内布满神秘学圆环、符文、中央一枚骷髅符号，以及散落的霓虹系统文字——如错误代码片段，营造出魔法与数字腐败交融的视觉效果。从该魔法阵中浮现一名大型装甲召唤体：一位黑色未来主义恶魔骑士或机械式使魔，身覆锯齿状反光装甲，面罩狭长且泛着紫光，单手持握重型武器，身体正部分溶解为紫光能量碎片与烟雾。背景展现一座广阔雨夜巨型都市，遍布公寓塔楼与工业风屋顶，密布窗户、阳台、缆线、招牌与薄雾。邻近一栋建筑外墙上，有一幅巨型垂直涂鸦风格标识，包含三个可辨识元素：“404”、“Witch”与“ERROR NOT FOUND”，另有一处较小的“E404”。更多紫光霓虹故障文字与符号散落在各处屋顶及空中。整体采用以黑、靛蓝与深紫为主的暗色系，辅以鲜明的洋红-紫色高光，电影感对比（cinematic contrast）、反光湿润表面（reflective wet surfaces）、高度密集细节（dense detail），以及高端精致插画风格（high-end polished illustration style）。氛围兼具神秘学（occult）、锋利感（edgy）、时尚感（stylish）与危险感（dangerous），融合都市奇幻（urban fantasy）、黑客美学（hacker aesthetics）与魔法召唤（magical summoning）。

2117903200341230849.promptEn: A vibrant Japanese comic-style cover illustration with two anime characters standing side by side against a split pink-and-blue pop graphic background filled with stars, dots, music notes, hearts, spark lines, and playful doodles. At the top, place a huge bold Japanese title in thick black and brown kanji with white outline and pink shadow reading 夜坂さんと茶藤くん, arranged in an energetic layered composition inside a fluffy cloud-like title shape. The left half of the background is pink and the right half is light blue, with a diagonal dividing rhythm and decorative manga-cover accents. Show exactly 2 characters from about mid-thigh up. On the left is a rebellious teenage girl with a straight black bob haircut and blunt bangs, pale skin, punk-rock fashion, and a slightly annoyed withdrawn pose with one hand near her mouth. She wears an oversized black zip hoodie over a red-and-black horizontal striped shirt, a red plaid pleated skirt, fishnet stockings, and a black heart-shaped choker. Add exactly 2 vertical Japanese speech balloons: on the left, うるさいのはキライ。 in a pink outlined balloon; on the right, そのセンスもっとみんなに届けたいです… in a blue outlined balloon. 2117903200341230855.promptEn: A cinematic anime-inspired digital illustration set at night inside a cozy artist's room with large window panes and a warm city glow outside. On the left, a young male artist with dark brown messy hair sits at a cluttered desk in side profile, leaning forward with one hand near his mouth and the other drawing with a pen on a tablet or sketchbook. The desk is covered with exactly 1 pen cup filled with pencils, 1 coffee mug, 1 open laptop or pen-display showing a sunset landscape, 1 spiral sketchbook with manga-style character drawings, 2 additional drawing books or pads, 1 small stack of about 4 books, and many scattered art cards and printed illustrations. On the right, a luminous ethereal anime girl made of blue-white light appears life-sized, facing the artist with both hands gently extended toward him. Her form is translucent, delicate, and composed of glowing contour lines, starry particles, and flowing strands of light, with long windblown hair and a soft dress-like silhouette. Between them, a magical stream of golden and white light spirals upward from the artist's desk into the air, connecting creator and creation. Inside this swirling ribbon are exactly 12 to 16 floating image fragments and sketch pages: monochrome character sketches, scenic sunset paintings, small photo-like panels, and tiny icon-like cards, all orbiting in a curved arc from lower center to upper left and upper center. Around the upper half of the image, dozens of glowing musical notes float through the air, mixed with sparkling particles, creating the feeling that inspiration has become visible sound and memory. The palette is rich warm gold and amber on the artist's side, contrasted with cool electric blue and white on the spirit girl's side, with dramatic rim light, volumetric glow, intricate particles, and a dreamy emotional atmosphere. Composition is vertical, highly detailed, intimate, and poetic, evoking the relationship between you and me as artist and imagined muse, where drawings, music, memories, and fantasy physically manifest in the room. Add a small handwritten note card on the desk with 二人だけの物語, and display one prominent artwork on the desk and one floating scenic panel using sunset sky over a distant city.

一部电影感（cinematic）的动漫风格数字插画，场景设定在夜晚，一间温馨艺术家工作室内，拥有大面积窗格，窗外是温暖的城市夜景辉光。  
左侧，一位年轻男性艺术家坐在杂乱的书桌旁，侧脸朝向画面，深棕色凌乱短发，身体前倾，一手靠近嘴边，另一手正用钢笔在数位板或速写本上作画。  
书桌上摆放着：恰好1个笔筒，内装铅笔；1只咖啡杯；1台打开的笔记本电脑或数位屏，屏幕上显示一幅日落风景画；1本螺旋装订速写本，内页绘有漫画风格人物；2本额外的绘画本或画纸垫板；1小叠约4本书；以及大量散落的艺术卡片与印刷插图。  

右侧，一位由蓝白色光芒构成的空灵动漫少女以等身大小浮现，面朝艺术家，双手轻柔地向前伸展。  
她的身形半透明、纤细，由发光的轮廓光（rim light）、星尘微粒与流动光丝构成，长发随风飘扬，身着柔和裙装般的剪影轮廓。  

二人之间，一道金色与白色的魔法光流自艺术家书桌盘旋升腾至空中，将创作者与创作之物联结起来。  
在这道旋转光带内部，恰好漂浮着12至16枚图像碎片与速写页：黑白人物速写、风景日落绘画、照片风格小画格，以及图标式微型卡片——全部沿一道弯曲弧线环绕运动，从画面下中部延伸至左上部与正上部。  

画面顶部半区，数十个发光音符悬浮于空中，混杂着闪烁微粒，营造出“灵感已化为可见之声与记忆”的氛围。  

配色方案：艺术家一侧为浓郁暖金色与琥珀色，与灵体少女一侧冷峻的电蓝色与纯白色形成强烈对比；整体运用戏剧性轮廓光（rim light）、体积辉光（volumetric glow）、精细微粒（intricate particles），并弥漫着梦幻而富情感的氛围。  

构图呈竖幅，高度细致，私密而诗意，唤起“你与我”之间艺术家与想象缪斯的关系——在此空间中，绘画、音乐、记忆与幻想皆具象为真实可触的存在。  

在书桌上添加一张手写便签卡，上面写着“二人だけの物語”；  
并在书桌上展示一幅醒目画作，同时让一幅风景画板悬浮于空中，画面为远方城市上空的日落天空。

2117903200341230856.promptEn: A cinematic vertical photo of a hand holding up a large balloon wine glass filled with a sparkling golden-yellow citrus cocktail in a lush indoor greenhouse bar. The drink is backlit by warm late-afternoon sunlight, making it glow translucent amber. Inside the glass there is 1 visible citrus wedge, and at the rim there is 1 fresh mint garnish cluster. The hand enters from the lower left, delicately gripping the stem, wearing 1 chunky translucent amber bracelet. The setting is dense with tropical greenery, hanging ferns, and vine-covered walls, with a bright greenhouse roof structure visible overhead and 2 warm exposed hanging bulbs softly glowing in the background. Use shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, strong sun rays filtering through leaves, soft haze, and rich green-and-gold color contrast. Add a blurred foreground leaf or plant along the right edge to frame the composition. The lower background should suggest a busy café or cocktail lounge with indistinct people, but keep them heavily out of focus. Photorealistic, elegant lifestyle photography, moody yet sun-drenched, shot from a low angle looking upward at the raised glass, high detail on condensation, glass reflections, and the luminous drink.
2117903200341230856.promptZh: 一张电影感（cinematic）的竖构图照片，画面中一只手从左下角伸入，优雅地握住一只盛满气泡金黄色柑橘鸡尾酒的大气球形葡萄酒杯，场景位于一座郁郁葱葱的室内温室酒吧。饮品被温暖的午后夕阳逆光照射，通体透出半透明琥珀色光芒。杯内可见1片柑橘切片，杯沿装饰有1簇新鲜薄荷叶。手部轻握杯茎，佩戴1只厚重半透明琥珀色手镯。环境布满热带绿植、垂挂的蕨类植物以及藤蔓覆盖的墙面；上方可见明亮的温室屋顶结构，背景中还有2盏暖色调裸露式吊灯柔和发光。采用浅景深（shallow depth of field）与柔滑焦外虚化（bokeh），强光光束穿透叶片洒落，整体笼罩一层柔雾，绿色与金色形成浓郁对比。在画面右侧边缘添加一片模糊的前景叶片或植物，用以框定构图。底部背景应暗示一家热闹的咖啡馆或鸡尾酒 Lounge，其中人物轮廓模糊不清，但需大幅失焦。照片级写实（photorealistic），呈现精致生活风格摄影（elegant lifestyle photography），氛围略带情绪感（moody）却沐浴于阳光之中；采用低角度（low angle）仰拍高举的酒杯，对冷凝水、玻璃反光及发光饮品等细节要求极高。

2117903200341230857.promptEn: A cozy anime-style interior of a traditional Japanese soba restaurant, viewed from table height in a booth, with two young women seated across the near corners of a rectangular wooden table and facing the viewer in a casual dining snapshot. The left woman has long straight pastel lavender with cyan highlights hair with glossy strands and soft bangs, and wears a white kimono-style top with bright blue trim and a deep blue obi-like sash skirt; she is slightly curvy, sitting on the left red vinyl bench, turned a little toward the camera, raising her left hand in an open friendly wave. The right woman has a sleek short bob in dark brown to black with a purple underlayer visible near the ends, red rectangular glasses, small earrings, a fitted charcoal-gray long-sleeve scoop-neck top, and light blue jeans; she sits on the right red vinyl bench, leaning slightly toward the table and holding chopsticks in her right hand as if about to eat. Place 2 large black bowls of soba on the table, one in front of each woman, both filled with dark broth, noodles, sliced duck meat, and chopped green onions; add 1 clear water glass near the center back of the table and 2 small condiment dishes beside it. The restaurant should feel warm and nostalgic, with wooden paneling, a shoji-style window on the left, a small potted plant on the windowsill, a back counter with condiments and utensils, and a navy noren curtain on the right bearing large white Japanese text "蕎麦" and smaller vertical text "手打ちそば". On the back wall, show 7 vertical wooden menu boards with Japanese dish names and prices, including labels such as "もりそば", "ざるそば", "かけそば", "たぬきそば", "肉そば", "天ぷらそば", and "鴨南蛮そば". Use clean polished anime rendering, crisp line art, soft warm lighting, detailed food illustration, rich wood textures, and a friendly everyday outing mood.
2117903200341230857.promptZh: 一间温馨的日式动漫风格荞麦面馆室内场景，以卡座中餐桌高度视角呈现：一张长方形木桌近角两侧各坐着一位年轻女性，面朝观者，呈现随意用餐的快照感。左侧女子留着长直发，发色为淡薰衣草紫，发梢带有青绿色挑染，发丝富有光泽，刘海柔和；身穿白色和风上衣，配亮蓝色滚边与深蓝色类似腰带的围裙式下装；身材略显丰腴，坐在左侧红色乙烯基长凳上，身体微微朝向镜头，左手抬起，掌心朝外，做出轻松友好的挥手动作。右侧女子留着利落短波波头，发色由深棕至近黑色，发尾隐约透出紫色内层；佩戴红色矩形眼镜与小巧耳饰；上身穿着合身的炭灰色长袖圆领上衣，下身搭配浅蓝色牛仔裤；坐在右侧红色乙烯基长凳上，身体略向前倾靠近桌面，右手持筷子，姿态仿佛正要开始用餐。桌上放置两只大型黑色荞麦面碗，分别置于两位女子正前方，碗中盛有深色汤底、荞麦面条、切片鸭肉与葱花；在桌面后方中央附近放置一只透明水杯，并在其旁摆放两只小型调味碟。整间餐厅应营造温暖怀旧氛围：墙面为木质镶板，左侧设纸拉门（shoji-style）窗户，窗台上摆有一盆小型盆栽；后方设一柜台，陈列各式调味料与餐具；右侧悬挂藏青色暖帘（noren），其上印有大幅白色日文文字 \

2117903200341230860.promptEn: A hyper-detailed cinematic isometric miniature city model of Burj Khalifa rising dramatically from the center of a square architectural master-plan board, presented like a luxury urban planning maquette on a black background. The composition shows one dominant ultra-tall silver skyscraper in the exact center, surrounded by a dense ring of modern high-rise towers, illuminated roads, bridges, and glowing warm city lights. Curving turquoise-blue water features and artificial lakes wrap around the central district in multiple connected pools and canals, with one large circular fountain-like feature near the tower base and several small island shapes visible in the water. In the lower right quadrant, include a large low-rise complex with rounded geometric roofs and subtle green-lit sections, connected by multilane roads and looping interchanges. The entire city sits on one square beige map board engraved with faint street grids and planning lines, with the board edges clearly visible and slightly raised. Viewpoint is a high three-quarter isometric angle, centered and symmetrical, with the tower extending far upward into negative space. Lighting is dramatic and luxurious: warm golden edge lights on buildings and roads, cool reflections in the water, crisp metallic highlights on the central tower, and a deep black void surrounding the model. Style should feel like a photorealistic architectural visualization mixed with a premium collectible scale model, extremely intricate, sharp, polished, and elegant.
2117903200341230860.promptZh: 一座超精细、电影感（cinematic）的等距视角（isometric）微缩城市模型，哈利法塔（Burj Khalifa）戏剧性地从一块方形建筑总体规划板正中央拔地而起，整体呈现方式如同一件置于黑色背景上的奢华城市规划沙盘模型（maquette）。构图以正中央一座主导性的超高层银色摩天大楼为核心，周围环绕一圈密集的现代高层塔楼、照明道路、桥梁以及散发暖光的城市灯光。蜿蜒的青绿色水体与人工湖以多个相互连通的水池与运河形式环绕中央城区，塔楼基座附近设有一处大型环形喷泉状结构，水中可见若干小型岛屿形状。右下象限包含一座大型低层建筑群，屋顶呈圆润几何形态，并配有柔和的绿色照明区域，该建筑群通过多车道道路与环形立交系统相连。整座城市坐落于一块方形米色地图板之上，板面蚀刻有细微的街道网格线与规划线，板边缘清晰可见且略高于板面。视角为高位三分之四等距视角（isometric），居中对称，中央塔楼大幅向上延伸，进入负空间。布光富有戏剧性且奢华：建筑与道路边缘泛出温暖金色轮廓光（warm golden edge lights），水面呈现冷调倒影（cool reflections），中央塔楼表面具有锐利的金属高光（crisp metallic highlights），模型四周为深邃纯黑虚空（deep black void）。风格应融合照片级写实（photorealistic）建筑可视化与高端收藏级微缩模型（premium collectible scale model）质感，极度繁复、锐利、光洁且优雅。

2117903200341230861.promptEn:
A polished vertical infographic poster in elegant East Asian editorial style, themed around the fire signs of the zodiac using one consistent female character reimagined in three different costumes. Cream parchment background with thin ornamental borders, small corner flourishes, tiny sparkles, and warm red-orange-gold accents throughout. Large Chinese headline at the top reading 十二星座角色清單｜火象星座, with a smaller subheading beneath reading 熱情・行動・勇氣, and a decorative flame icon at the top right. The layout contains exactly 3 stacked profile panels with rounded rectangular borders and generous margins: Aries on top, Leo in the middle, Sagittarius on the bottom. Each panel is split visually with the character on the left and a text/spec area on the right, plus a zodiac symbol badge on the far left and a small constellation diagram on the far right.

Use the same young East Asian woman in all 3 panels, slim build, long dark hair in a high ponytail, shown from about thigh-up to waist-up, facing slightly toward camera, styled as a fashion-model zodiac character sheet. Keep facial features neutral and refined, clean beauty lighting, soft airbrushed illustration-photo composite look.

Panel 1: Aries. Chinese title and English subtitle: "牡羊座 Aries". Dominant color scheme: vivid red with warm coral highlights. Zodiac symbol badge shows Aries glyph. Constellation on the right. Behind the character, faint circular mystical line art and flame motifs. Outfit: sporty warrior idol styling with a white crop top, red open short-sleeve jacket with gold trim, red belt, and red wrist wraps or fingerless arm accessories. Pose: confident, energetic, one fist raised near the shoulder and the other hand on her hip. Include exactly 6 info lines with small circular icons before each line, all in Chinese: 1) "元素：火" 2) "概念：點火者，直覺先行" 3) "性格：熱情、直接、好勝" 4) "行動原則：先衝再修正" 5) "戀愛傾向：心動就追，喜歡熱烈互動" 6) "人際怪癖：嫌節奏太慢時會自己接手".

Panel 2: Leo. Chinese title and English subtitle: "獅子座 Leo". Dominant color scheme: gold, champagne, and soft amber. Zodiac symbol badge shows Leo glyph. Constellation on the right. Background includes radiant sunburst styling and a faint majestic lion illustration silhouette behind the character. Outfit: glamorous regal gown in pale gold with ornate embroidery, jeweled bodice details, flowing translucent cape sleeves, elegant necklace, and a small crown or tiara. Pose: poised and queenly, one hand lightly touching the chest or collarbone, shoulders open, projecting confidence and star power. Include exactly 6 info lines with small circular icons before each line, all in Chinese: 1) "元素：火" 2) "概念：舞台中心，自帶光芒" 3) "性格：大方、自信、要面子" 4) "行動原則：先定氣場，再帶隊前進" 5) "戀愛傾向：喜歡被偏愛，也樂於寵人" 6) "人際怪癖：明明在意，卻要裝沒事".

Panel 3: Sagittarius. Chinese title and English subtitle: "射手座 Sagittarius". Dominant color scheme: rust red, burnt orange, brown leather, and warm ivory. Zodiac symbol badge shows Sagittarius glyph. Constellation on the right. Background features faint compass-circle graphics and flame accents. Outfit: adventurous archer styling with an ivory blouse, red scarf, brown leather harness straps, utility belt, and arm bracers. Pose: dynamic action shot drawing a bow, arrow aimed to the right, with a small glowing spark at the bow grip or arrow rest. Include exactly 6 info lines with small circular icons before each line, all in Chinese: 1) "元素：火" 2) "概念：自由旅人，邊走邊發現" 3) "性格：樂觀、坦率、好奇" 4) "行動原則：先出發，路上再找答案" 5) "戀愛傾向：喜歡輕鬆真誠，不愛被綁住" 6) "人際怪癖：聊到一半常被新鮮事帶走".

Overall design should feel premium, feminine, mystical, and collectible, like a social-media-ready zodiac character list poster. Use elegant serif-style Chinese typography for the main sign names and italic calligraphic English for Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius. Keep all text crisp, aligned, and readable. Add one small decorative fire emblem centered near the bottom border. Aspect ratio 3:4 portrait.

2117903200341230862.promptEn: A polished studio head-and-shoulders LinkedIn profile portrait of a man centered in frame, facing straight toward the camera with a neutral, confident expression, cropped from the upper chest to just above the head. He has short dark brown hair with a slightly textured top, visible ears, and light stubble beard along the jaw and chin. He wears 2 clothing layers: a dark charcoal tailored blazer over a plain white crew-neck t-shirt. The background is a deep black seamless studio backdrop with a subtle soft vignette and no visible props. Use professional corporate portrait photography styling, soft directional key light from above and slightly to one side, gentle rim separation on the shoulders and hair, realistic skin texture, sharp focus on clothing and neck, shallow depth of field, high contrast, clean premium retouching, natural color grading, and a modern executive-yet-approachable look suitable for a LinkedIn profile photo. Compose it symmetrically, minimal and elegant, with the subject isolated against the dark background, photographed as if with an 85mm lens in a high-end studio.
2117903200341230862.promptZh: 一张精致的摄影棚头肩部 LinkedIn 个人资料肖像照，画面中心为一名男性，正对镜头，表情中性而自信，构图从胸部上方裁切至头顶上方。他留着短深棕色头发，发顶略带纹理，耳朵清晰可见，下颌线与下巴处有浅色胡茬。他穿着两层服装：一件深炭灰色合身剪裁的西装外套，内搭一件纯白色圆领T恤。背景为深黑色无缝摄影棚背景布，带有微妙柔和的暗角（vignette），无任何可见道具。采用专业企业级人像摄影（corporate portrait photography）风格：主光为柔和的定向布光（directional key light），来自上方并略微偏向一侧；肩部与发际线处有柔和的轮廓光（rim light）分离效果；皮肤质感真实；服装与颈部清晰锐利对焦；景深（depth of field）较浅；高对比度；干净高级的修图（premium retouching）；自然的色彩分级（color grading）；整体呈现现代、高管气质兼具亲和力的视觉风格，适合作为 LinkedIn 个人资料照片。构图对称、极简而优雅，人物孤立于深色背景之中，拍摄效果模拟高端摄影棚中使用 85mm 镜头所摄。

2117903200341230866.promptEn:
A high-end cinematic transformation artwork displayed in five vertical panels, showing a luxury perfume evolving from raw essence into a sculptural masterpiece, each panel separated by thin black dividers.
Panel 1 (Origin): A premium glass perfume bottle resting on a dark reflective surface, surrounded by raw ingredients like rose petals, oud wood, citrus peel, and mist, soft studio lighting, elegant shadows.
Panel 2 (Release): The perfume begins to diffuse into the air, visible fragrant mist swirling upward in fluid motion, forming soft organic shapes, glowing particles and vapor trails.
Panel 3 (Transformation): The mist starts shaping into a semi-formed silhouette (abstract human figure or flowing fabric), blending liquid, vapor, and light, luminous and dreamy.
Panel 4 (Abstraction): The form becomes fully abstract — flowing ribbons of scent turning into sleek glass-like curves and fluid geometry, dynamic motion frozen mid-air.
Panel 5 (Transcendence): Final form — a luxurious sculptural perfume bottle or abstract glass statue inspired by the scent’s essence, polished, reflective, with glowing highlights, sitting on a minimal pedestal.
Style: ultra-detailed, photorealistic to abstract progression, deep black background, gold and silver accents, soft glow, high contrast lighting, glossy reflections, cinematic luxury aesthetic, perfume ad style, 4K quality, sharp focus.
2117903200341230866.promptZh:
一幅高端电影感（cinematic）转化艺术作品，以五幅垂直排列的画格呈现，展示一款奢华香水从原始香精逐步演变为雕塑级杰作的全过程，各画格之间以细黑色分隔线隔开。  
画格 1（起源）：一支高端玻璃香水瓶静置于深色反光表面之上，周围环绕玫瑰花瓣、沉香木、柑橘皮与薄雾等原始原料，柔焦影棚布光（studio lighting），优雅阴影。  
画格 2（释放）：香水开始向空气中弥散，可见芳香薄雾以流畅动态向上盘旋，形成柔和有机形态，并伴有发光微粒与蒸汽轨迹。  
画格 3（转化）：薄雾开始塑形为半成形剪影（抽象人形或流动织物），融合液体、蒸汽与光线，通体发光，梦幻朦胧。  
画格 4（抽象）：形态完全抽象化——香气化作飘逸丝带，转为光滑如玻璃般的曲线与流体几何结构，动态凝固于半空。  
画格 5（升华）：最终形态——一支奢华雕塑感香水瓶，或一件受香调本质启发而创作的抽象玻璃雕像，表面高度抛光、强反射，带有发光高光，静立于极简底座之上。  
风格：超精细刻画，从照片级写实（photorealistic）到抽象的渐进式表达，深邃纯黑背景，金与银色点缀，柔和辉光，高对比度布光（high contrast lighting），镜面般光泽反射（glossy reflections），电影感奢华美学（cinematic luxury aesthetic），香水广告风格（perfume ad style），4K 质量，锐利焦点（sharp focus）。

2117903200341230868.promptEn: A soft, airy promotional hero image for a Japanese home cooking class on a warm off-white background, styled like a minimalist lifestyle flyer. On the left half, show 2 people: an adult woman and a young girl cooking together at a white kitchen counter, both with calm, natural poses and gentle body language. The woman stands slightly behind and to the left of the child, leaning in supportively while helping guide the girl's hands as she slices a cucumber on a wooden cutting board with a kitchen knife. Their faces are intentionally obscured with soft rectangular blur blocks. The woman has dark brown hair tied in a low ponytail and wears a loose white blouse with a natural linen apron. The girl has dark hair in a high bun and wears a light short-sleeve top with a matching beige linen apron. On the counter, include a clear glass mixing bowl with salad, a folded striped kitchen towel, a wooden bowl of vegetables on the far left, a small wooden tray or plate with colorful vegetables in front, and a small potted green herb plant near the center-right edge of the cooking area. Visible produce should include sliced cucumber on the board and whole vegetables such as tomatoes, leafy greens, mushrooms, lemons or yellow citrus, and green peppers or cucumbers, arranged in a fresh, wholesome way. On the right half, leave generous negative space and place elegant Japanese headline text in a refined serif style: お料理教室開講. Beneath it, add 2 lines of smaller Japanese body text: はじめてさんも、もっと楽しみたい方も。 一緒に『おいしい』を作りましょう。. Surround the composition with 7 delicate hand-drawn dark gray doodle elements: 1 small leafy sprig on the far left, 1 hanging line at the upper left with 5 kitchen tools suspended from it (a frying pan, a spatula, a ladle, a peeler or slim utensil, and an oven mitt), 1 cluster of 2 floating leaves in the upper right, 1 small cooking pot icon on the right, 1 whisking bowl icon with tiny hearts near the lower middle-right, and 1 long single-line flourish sweeping across the lower right. Use soft natural daylight, muted beige and cream tones, shallow depth of field, clean editorial photography, gentle shadows, and a calm family-friendly premium aesthetic suitable for a cooking class landing page or poster.

A vivid aurora arcs across a star-filled sky over distant mountain ranges. Three travelers stand on the bridge in a triangular composition. In the center foreground, a pale white-haired girl in a flowing white robe and cape walks toward the viewer, holding a staff with a red ring ornament; her expression is calm and mysterious. On the left, a tall woman with very long dark purple hair and a dark cloak turns slightly away, looking toward the structure. On the right, a red-haired young man in a brown coat stands with his back angled to the viewer, carrying a large dark weapon. The bridge is weathered, cracked, and lined with glowing cyan inlaid paths and runic strips, with stone pillars and balustrades on both sides. Add large title typography in the upper right, with a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it reading 灰銀のアウロラ. Add a small Japanese tagline in the lower left reading 旅は、記憶の先へ続いている。. Beneath the hero image, place a horizontal strip of detailed monochrome and muted-color concept sheets showing exactly 8 grouped design panels: 1 white-haired heroine full-body costume turnaround sheet, 2 white-haired heroine face-expression sheet, 3 heroine accessories and gear sheet, 4 purple-haired woman outfit turnaround and detail sheet, 5 red-haired man outfit turnaround and weapon sheet, 6 architectural exterior elevation sheet of the observatory, 7 architectural interior and structure reference sheet, 8 circular mechanical diagram sheet. Along the bottom, place exactly 4 environment thumbnails: 1 ruined mountain road landscape, 2 icy-blue bridge or aqueduct environment, 3 distant hilltop approach to the sanctuary, 4 towering cathedral-like interior hall. Overall style: premium anime game art pitch board, highly detailed, painterly, dramatic lighting, cool blue and cyan palette with white stone and subtle orange title accents, polished layout, epic fantasy sci-fi atmosphere.

2117903200341230870.promptEn: A cinematic wide shot of a lone astronaut standing on a rocky ledge and facing away from the camera, looking out across an immense red desert plain on a Mars-like planet. The astronaut is centered in the lower middle of the frame, wearing a realistic white EVA spacesuit with subtle gray panels, a life-support backpack, heavy boots, and dark gloves; the helmet is not visible from the front because the figure is seen from behind. The landscape is vast and barren, covered in rust-red dust, scattered stones, and low rock formations, with a rugged cliff edge on the left foreground, sparse rocky mounds across the middle distance, and hazy mountain ranges stretching along the far horizon. Use soft warm peach and terracotta tones, thin atmospheric haze, and gentle late-afternoon light that casts a long shadow behind the astronaut’s feet. The mood is solitary, awe-filled, and exploratory, like the opening frame of a sci-fi film about first contact with an alien world. Photorealistic, high detail, ultra-wide composition, natural cinematic color grading, epic scale, minimalism, no buildings, no vehicles, no text, no HUD, no other people.

Along the bottom margin, include the page number "068", the date "APRIL 2025", and a row of small walking elephant silhouettes. Add subtle botanical flourishes, leaves, and light decorative strokes throughout.
