2117903200341230876.promptEn: A high-end commercial skincare product photo on a light marble bathroom counter, centered on a clear glass dropper bottle filled with warm amber-orange serum. The bottle is covered in realistic condensation droplets and has a white rubber pipette top with a shiny metallic gold collar. The front label is elegant and minimal, reading HydraGlow with smaller lines Vitamin C Serum - 30ml and Brightening & Anti-Aging Formula, plus a simple gold botanical lotus-style logo above the brand name. Soft natural morning light streams in from the side, creating gentle highlights, subtle shadows, and a clean luxury spa atmosphere. In the blurred background, include 1 ribbed clear glass vase with green leafy branches on the left, 1 stack of 3 folded white towels on the right, 1 shallow white dish with faint gold veining on the left foreground, and 1 small white bowl with a thin gold rim on the right foreground. Use shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the bottle, neutral cream and white palette, premium e-commerce advertising aesthetic, photorealistic textures, and refined wellness branding style.
2117903200341230876.promptZh: 一款高端商业护肤产品照片，拍摄于浅色大理石浴室台面上，画面中心为一支透明玻璃滴管瓶，瓶内盛有温暖的琥珀橙色精华液。瓶身覆盖着逼真的冷凝水珠，配有白色橡胶滴管头和闪亮的金属金色环状瓶口。正面标签设计优雅简约，印有品牌名“HydraGlow”，下方小号字体标注“Vitamin C Serum - 30ml”及“Brightening & Anti-Aging Formula”，品牌名正上方配有一个简洁的金色植物莲花风格标志。柔和的自然晨光从侧面射入，形成轻柔的高光、微妙的阴影，营造出洁净奢华的水疗中心氛围。背景虚化（bokeh）中包含：左侧1个带竖条纹的透明玻璃花瓶，插有绿色枝叶；右侧1叠3条折叠的白色毛巾；左前景1个浅口白色碟子，表面带有隐约可见的金色纹理；右前景1个小白色碗，边缘镶有细窄的金色边线。采用浅景深（shallow depth of field），瓶身清晰锐焦，整体配色为中性米白与纯白，呈现高端电商广告美学，照片级写实（photorealistic）质感，以及精致的健康养护品牌风格。

2117903200341230877.promptEn: A black-and-white manga page spread with 5 panels on a clean white background and thin black gutters, drawn in highly detailed modern seinen/shoujo hybrid line art with soft screentones, reflective highlights, and a quiet melancholic mood. The setting is a nighttime music studio classroom with large windows showing a city skyline full of lit buildings against a dark sky. Main subject: a slender high school girl with very long straight light hair and blunt bangs, delicate features, and a serious introspective expression, wearing a Japanese school uniform consisting of a white button-up shirt, loosened striped ribbon tie, and plaid skirt, seated and playing a solid-body electric guitar that resembles a Stratocaster. In the large upper-left panel, show her in three-quarter view holding the guitar across her lap, left hand on the fretboard and right hand near the pickups, surrounded by studio equipment including 1 drum kit in the back left, 2 stacked guitar amplifiers on the right, and a wall sign reading "Beat Box" near the door. In the narrow upper-right panel, show a close-up of the guitar neck and her fretting hand, with the small vertical Japanese sound effect text "トン…". In the tall middle-right panel, show a close side-profile close-up of the girl looking down at the instrument with a pensive, almost disappointed expression, with the night city lights blurred through the window behind her. In the lower-left panel, show 1 teenage boy in a school blazer and loosened tie, seated indoors and turned slightly to the side; his face is obscured by a large soft gray rectangular censor block, and beside him is 1 vertical speech balloon containing the Japanese text "……やっぱり違う". In the lower-right panel, show a closer view of the same boy from the chest up against a soft bokeh screentone background; his face is again obscured by a large gray censor block. Add printed page numbers centered at the bottom margins: "5" under the left page and "6" under the right page. Emphasize a subtle narrative theme of realizing that the sound feels wrong, as if this is a continuation page from a dramatic school-band manga. Keep everything monochrome, polished, cinematic, and emotionally restrained.

2117903200341230878.promptEn: A surreal high-fashion editorial photograph on an empty roadside in a bleak Icelandic-looking landscape under a flat gray overcast sky. Center the composition on a small brutalist concrete bus stop shelter with stained weathered walls and a simple bench inside, and place 1 slender adult man inside the shelter wearing a tailored black suit, black shirt, and black shoes, standing casually and looking to the side. Draped over the entire bus stop is 1 enormous oversized puffer jacket in vivid burnt orange, inflated and tent-like, forming a monumental sculptural canopy over the shelter; the collar gapes open above the roof, the sleeves slump down on both sides to the wet pavement, and the glossy quilted nylon shows realistic wrinkles, puffed chambers, seams, snaps, and fashion-product detail. The road in the foreground is dark and rain-slick, with subtle reflections and a cold damp atmosphere. In the background, show low barren hills with traces of snow and a remote windswept shoreline feel. Shoot it like a luxury magazine fashion campaign with cinematic realism, centered framing, muted natural light, strong contrast between the monochrome environment and the orange coat, minimal color palette, slightly monumental scale distortion, and crisp editorial photography detail.
2117903200341230878.promptZh: 一张超现实主义的高端时尚杂志风格（high-fashion editorial）摄影作品，场景设定在一片荒凉、类似冰岛地貌的空旷路边，天空阴沉灰暗、云层低厚。构图以一座小型粗野主义（brutalist）混凝土公交候车亭为中心：亭壁斑驳陈旧、带有污渍，内部设有一条简易长凳；亭内站着一位身材修长的成年男性，身着剪裁合体的黑色西装、黑色衬衫与黑色皮鞋，姿态随意，侧目而望。整座公交候车亭被一件巨大超大号羽绒服完全覆盖——该羽绒服呈鲜明焦橙色（burnt orange），充气饱满、形如帐篷，构成一座宏伟的雕塑式顶篷；衣领在亭顶上方大幅张开，两只袖管分别垂落于亭子两侧，直至湿漉漉的人行道地面；羽绒服表面为高光压花尼龙材质，真实呈现褶皱、蓬松填充腔室、缝线、按扣及高端时尚单品（fashion-product）级别的精细细节。前景道路深暗、雨水浸润，泛着细微反光，整体氛围清冷潮湿。背景中可见低矮荒芜的山丘，覆有零星残雪，并透出遥远、风势强劲的海岸线气息。以奢侈品牌时尚广告大片（luxury magazine fashion campaign）的规格拍摄：采用电影感写实风格（cinematic realism）、居中构图（centered framing）、柔和自然光（muted natural light）、单色环境与橙色外套之间形成强烈对比、极简色彩方案（minimal color palette）、略带纪念碑式的尺度畸变（slightly monumental scale distortion），以及锐利清晰的时尚杂志摄影级细节（crisp editorial photography detail）。

2117903200341230880.promptEn: Create a hyper-realistic commercial product splash shot of a large white plastic whey protein tub labeled PUREZZA and WHEYPRO, floating slightly above a glass filled with thick chocolate protein shake. The tub is centered, angled slightly to the right, with a clean glossy surface and a bold blue, white, and black label design. The label should prominently read “100% WPC PROTEIN MILK” and include small nutrition callouts such as “82G PROTEIN,” “2G SUGAR/SERVING,” “119% RDI OF VC,” “100% CHOLINE,” a circular “GMP” badge, a black strip reading “WHEY MILK PROTEIN CONCENTRATE,” another strip reading “LOW SUGAR / LOW FAT / RICH NATURAL,” and a flavor tag reading BLACK COOKIES FLAVOUR. Surround the tub with an explosive upward and outward splash of glossy chocolate liquid, with dramatic arcs, droplets, and suspended motion frozen in midair. Include exactly 5 whole chocolate sandwich cookies flying around the product and multiple broken cookie chunks and crumbs scattered throughout the scene, with one partially visible cookie near the lower right and another near the upper left. The glass at the bottom should be only partially visible, transparent, and overflowing from the impact of the splash. Use a high-contrast studio background with a dark deep blue gradient on the left fading to bright white on the right, cinematic rim lighting, crisp reflections, ultra-sharp focus on the tub, and detailed texture in the liquid and cookie crumbs. The overall look should be premium sports nutrition advertising, dynamic, energetic, and suitable for a hero image on a modern ecommerce fitness website.
2117903200341230880.promptZh:
创建一张超写实（hyper-realistic）商业产品飞溅特写图：一只大型白色塑料乳清蛋白罐悬浮于一杯浓稠巧克力蛋白奶昔上方，罐身标有 PUREZZA 和 WHEYPRO 字样。罐体居中，略微向右倾斜，表面洁净光亮；标签采用醒目的蓝、白、黑配色设计， prominently 显示 “100% WPC PROTEIN MILK”，并包含小型营养信息标注，例如“82G 蛋白质”、“每份含 2G 糖”、“维生素 C 达每日推荐摄入量（RDI）的 119%”、“100% 胆碱”，一个圆形“GMP”认证徽章，一条黑色条带标注 “WHEY MILK PROTEIN CONCENTRATE,”，另一条条带标注 “LOW SUGAR / LOW FAT / RICH NATURAL,”，以及一个风味标签，注明“BLACK COOKIES FLAVOUR”。  
围绕蛋白罐，呈现一场向上及向外爆发的、富有光泽的巧克力液体飞溅效果，包含戏剧性的弧线、飞散的液滴，以及悬浮于空中的动态凝固瞬间。  
场景中需精确包含 5 枚完整的巧克力夹心饼干，环绕产品飞舞；同时散布多块破碎的饼干碎块与细小饼干屑；其中一枚饼干部分可见，位于画面右下角；另一枚位于左上角。  
画面底部的玻璃杯仅部分可见，呈透明状，因飞溅冲击而满溢。  
背景采用高对比度影棚布景：左侧为深邃的深蓝色渐变，向右逐渐过渡为明亮纯白；辅以电影感轮廓光（cinematic rim lighting）、清晰锐利的倒影、蛋白罐主体超锐聚焦（ultra-sharp focus）、液体与饼干碎屑纹理高度精细。  
整体视觉风格应体现高端运动营养品广告质感，动感十足、活力充沛，适合作为现代电商健身网站的主视觉图（hero image）。

2117903200341230881.promptEn: A cute pastel anime illustration of a young elf girl streamer or office worker sitting at a desk and typing on a mechanical keyboard in a cozy bedroom workspace, shown from a front three-quarter view with a large black computer monitor in the left foreground partially blocking her body. She has long wavy orange hair with glossy highlights, pointed elf ears, and a small red flower hair clip on the right side, wearing a light blue pajama-style blouse covered in red heart prints with a very frilly white lace collar and a shiny red ribbon bow at the neck. Her hands are on the keyboard, nails painted soft pink, and she sits in a rounded pink desk chair. Above her head is a speech bubble containing a large question mark, suggesting confusion while working at the computer. The room is soft, bright, and feminine, with a pale pink and cream color palette, shallow depth of field, and delicate line art. In the background, include 1 framed wall picture with a pink animal and heart motif, 1 small potted plant near the center-left, 1 plush toy on a shelf behind her, 2 sticky notes on the upper right wall, one with a plus sign and one reading がんばろう!, 1 blue cat figurine or plush on the right shelf, 1 small potted plant on the right, 4 pastel binders or books on the lower right shelf, and 1 white mug with a pink heart on the desk in the lower right corner. The computer monitor should have a subtle glowing blue heart icon on its back, and the keyboard should have RGB lighting. Clean polished cel-shaded anime style, high detail, soft ambient lighting, cozy gamer desk atmosphere, pastel kawaii decor, 4k illustration.
2117903200341230881.promptZh: 一位可爱的粉彩色系动漫风格插画，描绘一名年轻精灵女孩，身份为直播主或办公室职员，正坐在舒适卧室工作区的桌前，用机械键盘打字；画面采用正面三分之四视角构图，左前方有一台大型黑色电脑显示器，部分遮挡她的身体。她拥有一头长而波浪状的橙色秀发，发丝带有光泽高光，尖尖的精灵耳朵，右侧佩戴一枚小巧的红色花朵发夹；身穿浅蓝色睡衣风格上衣，布满红色爱心图案，领口配有极富蕾丝感的白色荷叶边及一条闪亮的红色丝带蝴蝶结。双手置于键盘之上，指甲涂成柔和的粉色；她坐在一把圆润的粉色办公椅中。她头顶上方有一个对话框，内含一个巨大的问号，暗示她正在电脑前工作时感到困惑。房间氛围柔和、明亮且富有女性气质，主色调为淡粉色与米白色，景深（depth of field）较浅，线条细腻精致。背景中需包含：1幅装裱好的墙面挂画，图案为粉色动物与爱心主题；1盆小型盆栽，位于画面中左位置；1只毛绒玩具，置于她后方的置物架上；右上方墙面上贴有2张便利贴，一张印有加号（+），另一张写着“がんばろう!”；右方置物架上摆放1只蓝色猫咪造型摆件或毛绒玩具；右方另置1盆小型盆栽；右下方置物架上陈列4本粉彩色系活页夹或书籍；桌面右下角放置1只白色马克杯，杯身印有粉色爱心图案。电脑显示器背面应呈现一枚微光泛蓝的爱心图标，键盘需具备RGB背光效果。画面采用干净、精致的赛璐珞着色（cel-shaded）动漫风格，高细节刻画，柔和环境光（soft ambient lighting），营造温馨的玩家书桌（gamer desk）氛围，装饰风格为粉彩色系卡哇伊（kawaii）风，4K插画。

2117903200341230882.promptEn: Ultra-realistic satellite view from space, a clean modern editorial layout of 9 vertical panels arranged side-by-side on a white background, together forming the word "MADPENCIL", each panel containing one letter created entirely from natural Earth topography, no artificial text overlays: Panel 1 (M): rugged mountain ranges and deep valleys forming a sharp, angular "M", rocky textures, high elevation shadows Panel 2 (A): winding river cutting through dense green forest forming an organic "A", strong contrast between water and vegetation Panel 3 (D): desert dunes and wind-sculpted sand patterns shaping a smooth "D", warm tones, soft gradients Panel 4 (P): agricultural farmland grids and patchwork fields forming a structured "P", geometric patterns clearly visible Panel 5 (E): glacier and ice formations carving a crisp "E", bright whites and icy blues, fractured textures Panel 6 (N): braided river system across floodplains forming "N", branching channels with natural flow lines Panel 7 (C): coastal shoreline and ocean edge shaping a curved "C", waves and sediment gradients visible Panel 8 (I): narrow canyon or straight river cutting through terrain forming a minimal "I", strong vertical emphasis Panel 9 (L): volcanic terrain with lava flows forming an "L", dark rock with glowing red/orange lava accents top-down satellite perspective, NASA Earth observation style, hyper-detailed textures, realistic geography, consistent scale and lighting across all panels, minimal clouds, high contrast, sharp focus, subtle atmospheric haze, natural color grading, ultra high resolution 8K, clean spacing between panels, modern gallery-style composition, visually cohesive but each panel distinctly different biome, letters clearly readable yet organically integrated into terrain

2117903200341230883.promptEn: A polished anime fantasy key visual in a wide cinematic composition, showing a serene young heroine on the right half of the frame against a vast sky kingdom. She is a beautiful teenage girl with long silver-white hair, large clear blue eyes, pale skin, and a calm, slightly wistful smile as she turns her head back toward the viewer over her shoulder. Her hair is very long and windblown, with soft layered bangs and a side ornament: 1 blue crystal hairpiece with silver filigree and trailing blue ribbons. She wears an elegant white-and-blue fantasy outfit with 4 visible main garment elements: 1 white hooded cape draped over her shoulders, 1 deep blue inner dress or tunic, 1 ornate silver armored shoulder and upper sleeve section with engraved details, and 1 blue gemstone brooch set at the chest. The background is a luminous high-altitude fantasy world filled with bright clouds, blue sky, and floating islands; include 3 prominent floating architectural elements: 1 large central floating landmass with castle structures, 1 tall narrow spire emerging from the lower left clouds, and 1 distant towered island near the center. In the upper left sky, depict 1 majestic white dragon with wings spread, flying diagonally above the title area. Add a large stylized Japanese title on the left side with metallic silver and glowing blue typography, reading 白竜の翼と青き記憶, with decorative wing motifs integrated into the lettering. Beneath it, add 2 smaller lines of subtitle text in Japanese, centered left: 第１話 and 白銀の空隙. Scatter a few white glowing feathers or petals in the air. Use a cool palette of white, silver, and luminous azure, highly detailed linework, soft cel shading, crisp highlights, ethereal lighting, and the feel of a premium light novel cover or fantasy anime promotional poster.
2117903200341230883.promptZh: 一幅精致的动漫奇幻主视觉图（key visual），采用宽幅电影感构图（cinematic composition），画面右侧为一位宁静的年轻女主角，背景是浩瀚的天空王国。她是一位美丽的少女，拥有长长的银白色头发、清澈明亮的湛蓝色大眼睛、白皙的肌肤，正微微侧首回眸望向观众，神情平静而略带怅惘。她的长发随风飘扬，额前是柔和分层的刘海，一侧佩戴一枚蓝色水晶发饰，镶嵌银色镂空雕花，并垂下几缕蓝色丝带。她身着一套优雅的蓝白配色奇幻服饰，可见四大主要衣装元素：1件披于肩头的白色连帽斗篷；1件深蓝色内搭长裙或束腰外衣；1套装饰繁复的银色铠甲式肩甲与上臂护甲，表面刻有精细纹样；以及1枚镶嵌于胸前的蓝色宝石胸针。背景是一个光芒四射的高空奇幻世界，布满明亮云朵、蔚蓝天空与悬浮岛屿；需包含3个醒目的悬浮建筑元素：1座中央大型悬浮陆地，其上建有城堡结构；1座细高尖塔自左下角云层中拔地而起；以及1座远处带塔楼的悬浮岛屿，位于画面中央附近。左上方天空中，描绘1条威严的白色巨龙，双翼展开，呈对角线姿态飞越标题区域。在画面左侧添加大幅风格化日文标题，字体为金属银色并泛出幽蓝辉光，文字为“白竜の翼と青き記憶”，字形中融入翅膀装饰图案。标题下方，居左居中添加两行较小的日文副标题：“第１話”与“白銀の空隙”。空中零星散布数片泛白光的羽毛或花瓣。整体采用冷色调配色方案，以白色、银色与辉光青金（luminous azure）为主，线条高度精细，使用柔和赛璐珞着色（cel shading），高光锐利清晰，光线空灵缥缈（ethereal lighting），呈现高品质轻小说封面或奇幻动漫宣传海报（fantasy anime promotional poster）的质感。
2117903200341230883.author: ぬる（温）

2117903200341230884.promptEn: A 4-panel comic strip in bold retro Sunday funnies / 1980s pop-art style, thick black outlines, halftone textures, vibrant saturated colors (hot pink, cyan, yellow, teal), dynamic comic lettering. Main character: A stylish young woman with wavy mint-green hair, wearing oversized black sunglasses and a pink polka-dot strapless top. Confident expression, glossy lips, dramatic lighting. Secondary character: A cute chibi-style character in a full penguin costume (dark blue body, white belly, yellow beak hood), big sparkling eyes, small body, playful and mischievous vibe. Panel 1 (close-up, bold intro): Zoomed-in portrait of the woman, hair slightly blowing. Bright comic burst background. Text: “THE WIND IS NO MATCH FOR MY SHADES!” Speech bubble: “Bring it, breeze.” Panel 2 (beach chaos begins): Beach setting with strong wind—palm trees bending, hat, towel, and drink flying. Woman standing confidently. Penguin character appears at the side. Text box: “BEACH DAY!” Speech bubble: “Ha! Nice try, wind.” Small penguin text: “awk!” Panel 3 (wind intensifies): Stronger gusts—trash can tipping, seagull mid-air, debris flying. Woman still composed, hair dramatically flowing. Penguin laughing mischievously. Text box: “STRONGER!” Speech bubbles: “Is that all?” / penguin: “hee hee!” Panel 4 (final punchline): Reveal a big electric fan wearing sunglasses blasting air dramatically. Woman surprised. Penguin proudly next to fan. Text box: “ULTIMATE BOSS.” Speech bubbles: “Wait… no!” Big comic text: “YOU GOT BLOWN AWAY!” Caption at bottom: “RESPECT THE FAN.”
2117903200341230884.promptZh:
一幅四格漫画，采用大胆复古的周日连环画风格 / 1980 年代波普艺术（pop-art）风格，粗黑轮廓线，半色调（halftone）纹理，色彩鲜艳饱和（亮粉、青色、黄色、蓝绿色），动态漫画字体（comic lettering）。  
主角：一位时尚年轻女性，波浪状薄荷绿头发，佩戴超大黑色太阳镜，身穿粉色波点无肩带短上衣；神态自信，唇色亮泽，戏剧性布光（dramatic lighting）。  
配角：一只可爱的 Q 版（chibi-style）角色，全身穿着企鹅服装（深蓝色身体、白色肚皮、黄色喙状头套），眼睛又大又闪亮，体型娇小，整体氛围俏皮又淘气。  

第 1 格（特写 close-up， bold intro）：  
女子面部特写，头发微微飘动；背景为明亮的漫画爆炸纹（comic burst）；文字：“THE WIND IS NO MATCH FOR MY SHADES!”；对话框：“Bring it, breeze.”  

第 2 格（海滩混乱开始）：  
海滩场景，强风肆虐——棕榈树弯曲，帽子、毛巾和饮料被吹飞；女子稳稳站立，神态自信；企鹅角色出现在画面一侧；文字框：“BEACH DAY!”；对话框：“Ha! Nice try, wind.”；小号企鹅文字：“awk!”  

第 3 格（风力加剧）：  
更强阵风——垃圾桶倾倒、海鸥腾空、杂物纷飞；女子依然镇定自若，头发剧烈飘扬；企鹅正淘气地哈哈大笑；文字框：“STRONGER!”；对话框：“Is that all?” / 企鹅：“hee hee!”  

第 4 格（最终笑点）：  
揭晓一台戴墨镜的巨型电风扇正猛烈送风；女子露出惊讶表情；企鹅骄傲地站在风扇旁；文字框：“ULTIMATE BOSS.”；对话框：“Wait… no!”；醒目大号漫画文字：“YOU GOT BLOWN AWAY!”；底部图注：“RESPECT THE FAN.”
2117903200341230884.author: NOOR

2117903200341230885.promptEn: A richly detailed fantasy workshop illustration in a wide cinematic banner format, crowded with playful young apprentice characters gathered around an elderly master in the center. The scene has a magical artisan studio atmosphere with warm amber lighting, glowing runes, floating icons, scrolls, framed artworks, and shelves full of tools and curios. At the top center, a dramatic black brushstroke banner carries large hand-painted gold lettering reading GPTImage2Skill. In the middle sits an old sage-like teacher with white hair in a topknot and a long white beard, wearing layered tan and gray robes, seated calmly on a low stool as if mentoring the group. Around him are 8 chibi-style apprentices with exaggerated expressive faces, black hair tied in small topknots, colorful traditional outfits in purple, green, red, orange, yellow, blue, and teal, each proudly presenting a different creation. Count and show exactly 8 apprentices plus the central master. On the far left, one purple-clad child kneels and holds a framed anime-style action portrait with electric blue effects. Above left, one green-clad child raises a drink poster featuring a matcha beverage and East Asian typography. Near lower left-center, one apprentice in green presents a clean schematic page with small UI-like boxes and diagrams. Near center-right, one orange-red-clad child holds a realistic luxury perfume bottle product shot. To the right of that, one yellow-orange child presents a realistic bird photograph with soft bokeh. Upper center-right, one cheerful child lifts a tablet or framed mobile app screen showing a clean interface. Far right lower side, one blue-clad child displays a dark-themed analytics dashboard full of charts and graphs. On the upper right, a tall regal figure in ornate white-and-gold robes and crown-like headpiece stands holding 2 framed fantasy artworks: one darker landscape scene and one moonlit city or temple scene. Include exactly 2 artworks in this upper-right display. Scatter glowing floating UI-style icons around the room; include exactly 6 floating icon/sign elements: a puzzle-piece icon, a network-node icon, a code window, a cube icon, a glowing sign reading "PLUGIN" beside a puzzle icon, and a glowing star sign reading "SKILL". Also add 2 magical scroll banners with glowing edges, one near the top right and one across the bottom foreground, both covered in stylized code-like colored lines. The environment should feel like a blend of ancient atelier, fantasy library, and creative AI studio, with stone arches, wooden beams, distant mountainous scenery visible through openings, and golden magical particles swirling through the air. Highly polished digital illustration, dense composition, whimsical epic tone, saturated jewel colors, dramatic rim lighting, crisp detail, painterly textures, fantasy promotional poster quality.
2117903200341230885.author: Wildminder

2117903200341230887.promptEn: Create a surreal lifestyle fashion advertisement poster for crocs. Vertical composition, photorealistic, golden-hour outdoor lighting. A young woman sits relaxed on a grassy lakeside meadow filled with small white daisies, leaning against an enormous oversized foam clog in a pale sage green color. The giant shoe should dominate the scene like a playful sculpture, positioned behind her at a slight angle with the heel strap raised upright and visible round logo rivet on the side. Show realistic Crocs-style details: ventilation holes on top, textured molded foam surface, thick sole, front ports, and side perforations. The model wears matching light green clogs, white scrunched crew socks, a muted sage green cropped tank top, high-waisted cream patterned shorts, an open loose white shirt draped off her shoulders, and a simple necklace. She has dark hair in a messy bun and reclines with one knee bent, gazing upward in a carefree pose. Background: calm lake, distant green hills or low mountains, and a bright blue sky with large soft cumulus clouds. Use a clean editorial ad aesthetic with cheerful, airy summer vibes, shallow depth of field but enough clarity to keep both the model and giant clog sharp. Add centered white brand text at the top: large rounded lowercase logo reading crocs with a small trademark symbol, and beneath it a white slogan line reading Come as you are. Comfort follows.. Emphasize harmony between the model's outfit and the shoe color palette, aspirational comfort, whimsical scale contrast, and polished commercial photography.
2117903200341230887.promptZh: 为Crocs创作一幅超现实生活方式时尚广告海报。竖构图，照片级写实（photorealistic），黄金时刻（golden hour）户外布光（outdoor lighting）。一位年轻女性轻松地坐在长满小白雏菊的湖畔草地上，倚靠在一只巨大夸张的泡沫洞洞鞋上，鞋身为淡鼠尾草绿（pale sage green）色。这只巨型鞋应如一件俏皮雕塑般主导画面，置于她身后并略呈倾斜角度，鞋跟带竖直抬起，侧面可见圆形品牌铆钉标识。呈现真实的Crocs式细节：鞋面通风孔、肌理感模塑泡沫表面、厚实鞋底、前部通气孔以及侧面穿孔。模特脚穿同色系浅绿色洞洞鞋，配白色褶皱中筒袜、低饱和度鼠尾草绿短款背心、奶油色高腰印花短裤、敞开宽松的白色衬衫自然垂落于肩头，并佩戴一条简约项链。她黑发扎成凌乱丸子头，单膝微屈斜倚而坐，仰头凝望，姿态自在随性。背景为平静湖面、远处青翠丘陵或低矮山脉，以及晴朗湛蓝天空中大朵柔和的积云。采用干净利落的杂志编辑风（editorial ad aesthetic），传递欢快轻盈的夏日氛围；景深（depth of field）较浅，但需确保模特与巨型洞洞鞋均清晰锐利。顶部居中添加白色品牌文字：上方为大型圆润小写字体logo“crocs”，右侧附小型商标符号™；其下为一行白色标语：“Come as you are. Comfort follows.”。强调模特服饰与鞋款色彩系统的和谐统一、可向往的舒适感、奇趣的尺度对比，以及精修打磨的商业摄影（commercial photography）质感。
2117903200341230887.author: UxUi Tega (Design & Ai)

2117903200341230889.promptEn: A high-end fashion editorial poster in a vertical 9:16 format, set inside a serene futuristic circular gallery with smooth beige stone walls, a large round skylight in the ceiling, soft diffused warm lighting, and a sculptural circular platform at the center. The image shows 7 versions of the same young East Asian woman with long dark wavy hair, each styled as a different personality archetype, arranged around the circular platform in an elegant symmetrical composition. The central and largest figure sits on the edge of the platform facing forward, wearing a loose ivory-white button-front blouse and matching relaxed trousers, calm and introspective, becoming the visual anchor. Around her are 6 alternate style personas: 1 woman on the left in a soft cream dress with hair in a bun, gentle and approachable; 1 woman at the back center standing in a sleeveless black tailored outfit, cool and rational; 1 woman on the upper right seated in a light beige cardigan and pale skirt or trousers, casual and relaxed; 1 woman on the lower left in a sharp black blazer and dark outfit, urban minimalist; 1 woman on the lower right in a taupe oversized suit, mature and confident; 1 woman at the bottom front crouching in a cozy cream knit and loose light pants, everyday comfort style. All seven figures have the same identity but different styling, mood, and pose. Use a muted neutral palette of ivory, cream, taupe, beige, stone gray, and black, with soft atmospheric haze, cinematic depth, luxury magazine aesthetics, minimalism, and polished skin. Add elegant Chinese typography integrated into the composition: top headline 你不只有一种样子 with smaller English subtitle Explore your style spectrum. Place 6 Chinese style labels with short descriptive taglines near the surrounding personas: 温柔氛围, 清冷知性, 松弛韩系, 都市极简, 轻熟气场, 日常休闲. At the bottom add the Chinese call-to-action 你最想成为哪一个？ and smaller line 评论区告诉我. Premium poster design, fashion campaign feel, graceful composition, soft focus, refined and aspirational.
2117903200341230889.promptZh:
一张高端时尚杂志风格的竖版9:16海报，场景设定在一座宁静的未来主义圆形画廊内：墙面为光滑的米色石材，天花板中央设有一扇大型圆形天窗，光线柔和、漫射、温暖，展厅中央设有一座雕塑感圆形展台。画面呈现同一年轻东亚女性的7种不同形象版本，她拥有长长的深色波浪发；每位形象均代表一种不同的人格原型，围绕中央圆形展台呈优雅对称式布局。居中且尺寸最大的人物坐在展台边缘、正向面对观者，身穿宽松的象牙白纽扣前襟衬衫与同色系垂坠长裤，神情沉静而内省，构成视觉锚点。环绕她分布着其余6位风格迥异的人物形象：  
1位位于左侧，身着柔雾米色连衣裙，发髻盘起，气质温柔亲切；  
1位立于后方正中，身穿无袖黑色剪裁精良套装，神态清冷理性；  
1位坐于右上方，身着浅米色开衫与浅色半裙或长裤，姿态随意松弛；  
1位位于左下方，身着利落黑色西装外套与深色服饰，呈现都市极简（urban minimalist）风格；  
1位位于右下方，身着灰褐色超大号西装，气场成熟自信；  
1位蹲踞于正下方，身穿舒适奶油色针织上衣与宽松浅色长裤，体现日常休闲（everyday comfort）风格。  
全部七位人物共享同一身份，但造型、情绪与姿态各不相同。整体采用低饱和中性色调：象牙白、米白、灰褐、米色、石灰色与黑色；画面带有柔和空气感薄雾（soft atmospheric haze）、电影感景深（cinematic depth）、高端时尚杂志美学（luxury magazine aesthetics）、极简主义（minimalism）与精致肌肤质感（polished skin）。  
在构图中融入典雅中式排版：顶部主标题为“你不只有一种样子”，下方配以较小字号英文副标题“Explore your style spectrum”。在环绕的六位人物旁分别添加六个中式风格标签，每条附简短描述性标语：温柔氛围、清冷知性、松弛韩系、都市极简、轻熟气场、日常休闲。  
底部添加中文行动号召语：“你最想成为哪一个？”，其下另加一行小字：“评论区告诉我”。

2117903200341230897.promptEn: A stylized humorous editorial illustration of a chaotic office on fire, rendered in warm orange, amber, and smoky brown tones with cinematic lighting and painterly detail. Center the scene on a frazzled office worker seated at a desk, wearing a wrinkled olive-green button-up shirt and a loose black tie, holding a black coffee mug near his face. Replace the face with a plain rectangular censor block in a warm skin-toned color. Give him messy dark brown hair and black rectangular glasses visible from the side. Above him on a stained beige wall, place a large bold black sans-serif quote in two centered lines that reads this is fine. everything is fine., with a hand-drawn red underline beneath it. Fill the room with visible black smoke curling from the ceiling corners, a red emergency alarm light glowing in the upper left, and a ceiling smoke detector in the upper right. On the left wall, include a crooked framed poster of a cute hanging dog with the text "HANG IN THERE!". In the lower left foreground, show a black wire trash bin engulfed in bright flames containing a sheet labeled "PLAN" with 3 checkbox items reading "do thing", "do thing", and "do thing". Put a dark desk nameplate near the front edge reading "chaos coordinator". On the desk, scatter many loose papers, sticky notes, a pen, binder clip, and general office clutter. Place a central paper labeled "DEADLINES (yikes)" in red handwriting. Add a green sticky note near the bottom left reading "call back someday maybe". To the right, place an open gray laptop with a yellow sticky note on it that says "good job me :)". In the lower right foreground, show a tipped-over beige coffee cup spilling dark coffee across papers and over a simple red line chart. On the right wall, add a whiteboard titled "TODAY:" with exactly 4 checklist items: "survive", "coffee", "pretend", and "check email (ugh)". Below it, include a wilted dead office plant in a pot and a small sticky note on the wall reading "IT'S FINE". The overall mood should be absurdly calm despite obvious disaster, with satirical corporate burnout energy, detailed smoke, embers, cracked walls, and a polished digital illustration finish.

2117903200341230898.promptEn: A high-impact YouTube thumbnail about HARNESS ENGINEERING in the AI age, 16:9 format, split-screen composition with 2 male presenters shown from the chest up, one on the left and one on the right, both facing forward in office or studio settings. The left presenter has dark hair, wears glasses and a white-and-blue striped shirt, seated in a desk chair with shelves and books blurred in the background. The right presenter has short dark hair, wears glasses and a light blue striped button-up shirt, speaking into a large black microphone, with a softly lit tech-themed background. A glowing electric-blue diagonal slash divides the two halves. In the center, overlay a futuristic circular AI icon with the letters “AI” inside a microchip-like interface, glowing neon blue. Add subtle HUD graphics on the right side: 3 upward chevrons near the top right, 1 gear icon at mid-right, and a faint grid of dots. 2117903200341230901.promptEn: A 2x5 storyboard grid of 10 frames for a 15-second photorealistic CGI animated short film, BBC Planet Earth documentary aesthetic, macro cinematography, rich greens and golden hour light, natural soft shadows, extreme scale shifts from micro to macro. Theme: a single seed's journey blown by wind, surviving a storm, slowly growing into a great tree full of life. Frames: (1) extreme wide autumn forest, single seed released from a tall tree, golden bokeh background; (2) macro tracking shot - seed floating through air, passing insects and leaves, delicate and small; (3) slow-motion impact - seed lands on soft soil, dirt particles scatter, raindrop falls beside it; (4) surreal underground macro - roots beginning to grow in darkness, microscopic and beautiful; (5) wide dramatic shot - violent storm raging, everything uprooted, but the seed's spot stays still; (6) macro close-up - first green sprout breaking through soil, morning dew on tip, sunlight catching it; (7) accelerated growth sequence - sapling rising, seasons shifting, light and shadow changing, alive; (8) wide shot - juvenile tree now standing, birds arriving, leaves rustling gently in wind; (9) medium warm shot - children playing in the tree's shade, a bird building a nest in the branches; (10) mirror wide shot - framed from the angle of the original tall tree, the new great tree now stands in its place circle of life.
2117903200341230901.promptZh:
一个2×5分镜网格，共10帧，用于一部15秒的照片级写实（photorealistic）CGI动画短片，风格致敬BBC《地球脉动》（Planet Earth）纪录片，微距电影摄影（macro cinematography），浓郁的绿色调与黄金时刻（golden hour）光线，自然柔和的阴影，尺度在微观与宏观之间剧烈切换。主题：一颗种子随风飘散，历经风暴，最终缓慢成长为一棵生机勃勃的参天大树。各帧如下：  
(1) 极远景（extreme wide）秋日森林，一颗种子从一棵高大的树上飘落，背景为黄金时刻（golden hour）焦外虚化（bokeh）；  
(2) 微距跟拍镜头（macro tracking shot）——种子在空中飘浮，掠过昆虫与树叶，纤细而渺小；  
(3) 慢动作（slow-motion）撞击瞬间——种子落在松软的土壤上，泥土颗粒飞溅，一滴雨滴落在其旁；  
(4) 超现实地下微距镜头（surreal underground macro）——根系在黑暗中初生，显微尺度却美得惊人；  
(5) 戏剧性远景（wide dramatic shot）——狂暴风暴肆虐，万物连根拔起，唯独种子所在之处岿然不动；  
(6) 微距特写（macro close-up）——第一抹嫩绿的芽尖破土而出，顶端凝着晨露，阳光恰好将其点亮；  
(7) 加速生长序列——树苗拔地而起，四季流转，光影变幻，充满生命力；  
(8) 远景（wide shot）——幼树已然挺立，鸟儿陆续飞来，叶片在微风中轻轻摇曳；  
(9) 中景暖调镜头（medium warm shot）——孩童在树荫下嬉戏，一只鸟在枝杈间筑巢；  
(10) 镜像远景（mirror wide shot）——以最初那棵高大树木的视角取景，如今这棵新生的参天大树已屹立于其原位，生命轮回圆满。
2117903200341230901.author: 𝐌

2117903200341230903.promptEn: A high-end studio advertising photo of a single aluminum soda can standing upright at the exact center of the frame on a wet reflective black surface, shot straight-on at product height. The can is dark navy to black metallic with heavy cold condensation droplets and a sleek modern label. The visible label has 4 text elements: a white water-drop icon near the top, the large word REFRESH in bold condensed uppercase with a subtle red outline, the smaller line CHILLED COLA beneath it, and the lower line ICE COLD. A dramatic crown-like water splash explodes around the can from both sides and behind it, with dozens of frozen droplets suspended in midair, crisp high-speed photography style, dynamic arcs and scattered beads of water, plus smaller splashes at the base. Lighting is cinematic and commercial: strong cool white rim lights from both sides, glossy specular highlights on the aluminum, deep shadows, bright reflections in the splash, and a dark moody background fading to near-black. Emphasize ultra-sharp detail on the can and splash, premium beverage advertising, refreshing icy mood, photorealistic macro product photography, vertical composition, shallow depth of field but with the main splash sharply frozen, luxury e-commerce hero image quality.
2117903200341230903.promptZh: 一张高端摄影棚广告照片：一罐铝制汽水罐竖直立于画面正中央，置于湿润反光的黑色表面上，以产品高度平视拍摄。罐身为深海军蓝至黑色金属质感，表面凝结大量冰冷水珠，贴有时尚现代的标签。可见标签包含4处文字元素：顶部附近为一个白色水滴图标，其下为加粗紧凑的大写单词 REFRESH，带细微红色描边；再下方为较小的一行文字 CHILLED COLA；最下方为 ICE COLD。一圈戏剧性的皇冠状水花从罐体两侧及后方猛烈迸发，数十颗水滴悬浮于空中，呈现清晰锐利的高速摄影（high-speed photography）风格，水滴轨迹动感流畅，水珠散落纷飞，罐底另有若干细小飞溅水花。布光兼具电影感（cinematic lighting）与商业感（commercial lighting）：两侧投射强烈冷白色轮廓光（rim lights），铝罐表面呈现高光光泽（glossy specular highlights），阴影浓重深邃，水花中映出明亮反光，背景幽暗沉郁，渐隐至近黑色。突出罐体与水花的超精细细节，高端饮品广告风格，清爽冰凉氛围，照片级写实（photorealistic）微距产品摄影（macro product photography），竖构图，浅景深（shallow depth of field），但主体水花须清晰凝固，达到奢侈品电商主视觉图（luxury e-commerce hero image）品质。
2117903200341230903.author: Creative Diffusion

2117903200341230904.promptEn: A high-end lifestyle e-commerce photo of a stylish woman walking along a quiet Parisian street in autumn, captured from behind in a candid editorial moment. She is centered slightly left, mid-stride on a cobblestone-and-pavement sidewalk, turning her head gently toward the elegant Haussmann apartment buildings lined with wrought-iron balconies and flower boxes. She wears a long tailored wool coat in camel beige, dark straight-leg trousers, and dark brown leather ankle boots, with a structured leather crossbody satchel in warm tan hanging at her hip. She has shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair and holds a folded newspaper or magazine in one hand. The street includes exactly 6 black metal bollards visible in the foreground and midground, scattered dry autumn leaves on the ground, and tall trees on the right side with golden-brown foliage. In the background, softly blurred pedestrians walk down the boulevard, and a corner café with the visible sign CAFÉ LE PARISIEN appears on the left, with the same café name faintly repeated farther down the street. Warm golden-hour lighting, shallow depth of field, natural skin tones, creamy background bokeh, refined neutral color palette, luxury travel editorial styling, realistic photography, vertical composition, 4:5 aspect ratio, premium advertising image quality.
2117903200341230904.promptZh: 一张高端生活方式电商照片：一位时尚女性在秋日静谧的巴黎街道上行走，以纪实杂志风格（editorial）从背后抓拍。她略微偏左居中，正迈步于鹅卵石与沥青混合铺就的人行道上，轻柔转头望向一侧优雅的奥斯曼式公寓楼——建筑外立面配有锻铁阳台和花箱。她身着一件驼色羊绒长款修身大衣、深色直筒长裤，以及深棕色皮革及踝靴；髋部斜挎一只暖米色结构感皮革斜挎小方包。她留有齐肩波浪深棕色头发，一手持一份折叠的报纸或杂志。街道前景与中景共出现恰好6根黑色金属护柱，地面散落着干燥的秋叶，右侧矗立高大树木，枝叶呈金褐色。背景中行人身影柔和虚化（bokeh），沿林荫大道缓步而行；左侧可见一家街角咖啡馆，招牌清晰显示“CAFÉ LE PARISIEN”，同一店名亦 faintly 重复出现在街道更远处。温暖的黄金时刻（golden-hour）光线，浅景深（shallow depth of field），自然肤色，奶油质感背景焦外虚化（bokeh），精致中性色调配色，奢华旅行类杂志风格（luxury travel editorial styling），写实摄影（realistic photography），竖构图，4:5画幅比例，高端广告图像品质。

2117903200341230905.promptEn: Using the provided floor plan reference image, convert the 2D black-and-white architectural plan into a clean photorealistic 3D isometric real-estate floor plan render while preserving the original layout, room sizes, labels, and the side-by-side composition of the 1F and 2F plans. Add realistic wall thickness, light wood flooring, soft neutral wall colors, doors and windows with depth, and fully furnished interiors appropriate to each room. Keep all visible Japanese room labels in place, including 1F, 2F, 洗面所, 浴室, 収納, 階段下収納, ホール, 玄関, トイレ, L.D.K (18.0帖), 洋室 (6.0帖) for 2 rooms, ウォークインクローゼット (3.0帖), and 主寝室 (6.0帖). Stage the 1F with 1 kitchen, 1 dining table set for 4, 1 living area with sofa and coffee table, 1 toilet, 1 bathroom with tub, 1 wash area, and small plants. Stage the 2F with 3 sleeping/work rooms total: 1 bedroom with a single bed, 1 room with a desk and chair, and 1 master bedroom with a double bed, plus 2 storage spaces and 1 walk-in closet with shelving. Use a bright catalog-style presentation on a plain light background, viewed from a slightly elevated angled top-down perspective, suitable for a property sales brochure.
2117903200341230905.promptZh:
参照提供的平面图参考图像，将二维黑白建筑平面图转换为干净的照片级写实（photorealistic）三维等距视角（isometric）房地产平面图渲染图，同时保留原始布局、房间尺寸、标注文字，以及一层（1F）与二层（2F）平面图并排呈现的构图方式。添加真实的墙体厚度、浅色木纹地板、柔和中性色调墙面、具有纵深感的门窗，以及符合各房间功能的全套室内陈设。所有可见的日文房间标注均须保留在原位，包括：1F、2F、洗面所、浴室、収納、階段下収納、ホール、玄関、トイレ、L.D.K (18.0帖)、洋室 (6.0帖)（共两间）、ウォークインクローゼット (3.0帖) 和 主寝室 (6.0帖)。  
一层（1F）布景包含：1 个厨房、1 张可供 4 人用餐的餐桌椅组合、1 个带沙发与咖啡桌的起居区、1 个厕所、1 个带浴缸的浴室、1 个洗漱区，以及若干小型绿植。  
二层（2F）布景包含：共 3 个睡眠/工作房间——1 间配有单人床的卧室、1 间配有书桌与椅子的房间、1 间主卧（配有双人床），另加 2 处储物空间及 1 个带层架的步入式衣帽间（ウォークインクローゼット）。  
采用明亮的商品目录风格（catalog-style）呈现方式，背景为纯浅色，视角为略高于水平线的倾斜俯视角度（slightly elevated angled top-down perspective），适用于房产销售宣传册。

2117903200341230906.promptEn: A massive isometric exploded-view environment sheet showing a dense collection of modular retro urban buildings and room cutaways on a clean white background, rendered like a highly detailed game asset breakdown or architectural kitbash catalog. The image contains 20 main assembled structures or room modules, each separated into floating parts: 1 small gabled house with blue roof, 1 dark blue square building, 1 small rust-red house, 1 cylindrical weathered tower building, 1 white two-story house with blue roofs, 1 warm wood-paneled corner room, 1 compact study or office room, 1 bedroom, 1 dining room with balcony, 1 café or kitchen room, 1 narrow storefront room, 1 small lit alcove room, 1 large concrete stairwell block, 1 small tiled washroom, 1 medium concrete stair-and-landing block, 1 larger concrete stair platform block, 1 narrow concrete corridor or service block, 1 large empty concrete room, and 1 blue vending machine pair area. Surrounding all modules are hundreds of separated components arranged neatly in exploded fashion: roof panels, corrugated awnings, wall segments, doors, shutters, windows, stair flights, railings, balconies, signboards, pipes, antennas, utility poles, lamps, vents, meters, tanks, planters, flower boxes, benches, crates, air conditioners, cabinets, fences, street barriers, buckets, jars, utility boxes, and small street props. The style is painterly but precise, with cozy amber interior lighting contrasting against worn concrete, oxidized metal, chipped paint, rust-red and deep blue roofs, teal-green trim, and aged urban textures. Emphasize miniature diorama realism, isometric perspective, exploded assembly presentation, many floating parts evenly spaced around each structure, highly legible silhouette separation, soft studio shadowing, extremely intricate detail, concept-art polish, and the feeling of a comprehensive environment asset sheet for a side-street neighborhood in a nostalgic Japanese retro urban district. Include exactly 20 major modules, with the lower edge lined by many small props and potted plants, and keep the overall composition balanced across the full canvas. Use a crisp white background, no framing, no people, no vehicles except 1 bicycle, and no text labels.
2117903200341230906.promptZh: 一幅巨大的等距视角（isometric）爆炸图环境素材图，展示一组密集排列的模块化复古城市建筑及房间剖面结构，置于纯白背景之上，渲染风格类似高度精细的游戏资产拆解图或建筑拼贴（kitbash）目录。图像包含20个主要组装完成的建筑或房间模块，每个模块均被分解为悬浮于空中的独立部件：1座带蓝色屋顶的小型坡屋顶房屋、1座深蓝色方形建筑、1座小型锈红色房屋、1座风化圆柱形塔楼建筑、1座带蓝色屋顶的白色两层房屋、1间暖木饰面转角房间、1间紧凑型书房或办公室房间、1间卧室、1间带阳台的餐厅、1间咖啡馆或厨房房间、1间狭长临街店面房间、1间小型点亮壁龛房间、1座大型混凝土楼梯井模块、1间小型瓷砖铺装盥洗室、1座中型混凝土楼梯与平台模块、1座更大的混凝土楼梯平台模块、1条狭长混凝土走廊或设备间模块、1间大型空置混凝土房间、以及1处蓝色自动售货机成对布置区域。所有模块周围环绕着数百个分离式组件，以整齐的爆炸图方式排布：屋顶板、波纹状雨棚、墙体段、门、百叶窗、窗户、楼梯段、栏杆、阳台、招牌、管道、天线、电线杆、灯具、通风口、计量表、储罐、花槽、花箱、长椅、箱子、空调外机、橱柜、围栏、道路隔离墩、水桶、罐子、配电箱，以及各类小型街道道具。整体风格兼具绘画感（painterly）与精确性，温馨琥珀色室内照明与磨损混凝土、氧化金属、剥落油漆、锈红色与深蓝色屋顶、青绿色装饰线条，以及陈旧城市肌理形成鲜明对比。强调微缩模型场景真实感（miniature diorama realism）、等距视角（isometric perspective）、爆炸式装配呈现（exploded assembly presentation）、各结构周围均匀分布大量悬浮部件、高辨识度剪影分离（highly legible silhouette separation）、柔和影棚阴影（soft studio shadowing）、极致繁复细节（extremely intricate detail）、概念艺术级精修质感（concept-art polish），以及一种怀旧日本复古城市街区中小巷邻里环境的完整资产图谱氛围。图中须严格包含20个主要模块，底部边缘排列众多小型道具与盆栽植物，整体构图在整幅画布上保持均衡。使用清晰纯白背景，不加边框，不出现人物，不出现车辆（仅保留1辆自行车），且不添加任何文字标签。

2117903200341230908.promptEn: Create a single full-body chibi codex avatar mascot on a clean white background with faint icy blue paint splatters and a soft frozen-ground shadow. The character is a small futuristic robot in an oversized dark navy-black hooded parka and chunky boots, rendered as a high-detail 3D digital illustration with painterly texture, glossy sci-fi materials, cyan rim lighting, and a cold arctic color palette. The hood is round and helmet-like, framing a black rounded-rectangle visor face with two sleepy half-lidded glowing cyan eyes and no mouth, giving a calm unimpressed expression. Add exactly 7 translucent jagged ice crystals protruding from the top and sides of the hood, with the tallest crystal at the center top, glowing electric blue edges, frosty refractions, and snow-like speckles. Put exactly 2 glowing atom emblems on the suit: one large cyan atom symbol on the left side of the hood and one smaller atom symbol on the chest/left shoulder area. The torso armor is puffy and segmented with cyan circuit-like accents, small luminous panels, scuffs, scratches, and the glowing chest text DL. In the character’s left hand, show exactly 5 stacked translucent glowing cyan crystalline data sheets or code pages fanned together; in the right hand, show exactly 1 open miniature laptop angled toward the viewer, with a cyan-on-black screen filled with tiny unreadable code lines. Use a centered composition, cute proportions with a large head and short limbs, dramatic icy blue highlights, detailed snow/ice texture on the ground, and a premium mascot-avatar look suitable for a developer profile picture. Customize the avatar as ice codex robot, with deep navy blue armor and cyan blue lighting.
2117903200341230908.promptZh: 创建一个全身的Q版（chibi）典籍（codex）吉祥物头像，置于纯白背景上，背景带有淡淡的冰蓝色颜料飞溅痕迹，以及柔和的冻土阴影。角色是一个小型未来主义机器人，身穿 oversized 深海军蓝-黑色连帽派克大衣和厚重靴子，以高细节 3D 数字插画风格呈现，具有绘画感纹理（painterly texture）、光泽科幻材质（glossy sci-fi materials）、青色边缘光（cyan rim lighting）以及冷调北极配色方案（cold arctic color palette）。兜帽呈圆形、头盔状，框住一张黑色圆角矩形面罩脸，面罩上有两只半睁着的困倦发光青色眼睛，无嘴，呈现出平静而略带不屑的表情。在兜帽顶部及两侧，精确添加 7 枚半透明锯齿状冰晶，其中最高的一枚位于正顶部中央，冰晶边缘发出电蓝色辉光，具备霜冻折射效果（frosty refractions）与雪粒状斑点（snow-like speckles）。在服装上精确放置 2 枚发光原子徽章：一枚大型青色原子符号位于兜帽左侧，一枚较小的原子符号位于胸/左肩区域。躯干护甲蓬松且分段式设计，配有青色电路状装饰（cyan circuit-like accents）、微小发光面板、刮痕与磨损痕迹，以及胸口发光文字 DL。角色左手持恰好 5 张堆叠并扇形展开的半透明发光青色水晶数据页或代码页；右手持恰好 1 台打开的微型笔记本电脑，朝向观者倾斜，屏幕为黑底青字，布满细小不可读的代码行。采用居中构图（centered composition），比例可爱——头大、四肢短，搭配戏剧性冰蓝色高光（dramatic icy blue highlights）、地面精细的雪/冰质感（detailed snow/ice texture），整体呈现高端吉祥物头像（premium mascot-avatar look），适合作为开发者个人资料图片。将该头像定制为“冰典（ice codex）机器人”，装甲为深海军蓝，照明为青蓝色。

2117903200341230909.promptEn: A photorealistic vertical portrait of a young East Asian male office worker seated at a modern office desk, looking calmly and directly at the camera with a soft neutral expression. He has medium-length layered dark brown hair, slightly wet textured, parted with loose bangs, smooth pale skin, delicate facial features, and a fashionable clean appearance. He wears a oversized black blazer over a plain white T-shirt with a blue lanyard and visible employee ID badge hanging at his chest. His hands rest on the keyboard of a space gray laptop with a black Apple logo on the left side of the desk. 2117903200341230920.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vibrant 2x2 poster grid of four miniature 3D city street-food stands, each shown as an isometric diorama on a small rounded sidewalk base, with bold city-and-food titles above each scene. The image should feel like collectible toy miniatures rendered in polished clay/plastic 3D, highly detailed, cheerful, and social-media friendly.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition divided into exactly 4 equal quadrants by thick black cross-shaped dividers. Each quadrant has a solid bright background color and one centered food-stand diorama with a large playful title at the top.

Layout and sections: Use exactly 4 food stands:
1. Top-left: Tokyo Ramen Stand. Red background. A compact Japanese ramen shop with red lanterns, Japanese signage, a glowing red ramen sign, wooden storefront, noren curtains, stools with customers eating at the counter, small crates, a bicycle, cherry blossom accents, and a tiny ramen bowl icon under the title.
2. Top-right: Mexico Taco Stand. Green background. A Mexican taco stall with terracotta roof tiles, a large sign reading “TACOS,” green-and-white striped awning, customers on stools, taco ingredients at the counter, cactus plants, a red pickup truck parked beside it, streetlamp, menu boards, and a small taco icon under the title.
3. Bottom-left: NYC Hot Dog Cart. Yellow background. A New York hot dog cart with metal cart body, blue-and-yellow umbrella, illuminated “HOT DOG” sign, condiment bottles, pretzels or buns, one customer standing in front, subway entrance railing, trash can, street pole with signs, pedestrian signal, and a small hot dog icon under the title.
4. Bottom-right: Paris Crêpe Kiosk. Sky-blue background. A Paris crêpe kiosk with dark green vintage booth, striped awning, sign reading “PARIS CRÊPES,” customers gathered around the counter, chalkboard menus, ornate streetlamp, flowers, a leafy tree, bicycle, wicker basket, bollards, and a small crêpe icon under the title.

Visual style: Cute isometric 3D render, miniature diorama / toy model aesthetic, high detail, soft ambient occlusion, warm tiny lights, crisp shadows, saturated colors, rounded edges, realistic but stylized materials, thick playful white or black display lettering depending on contrast, slightly puffy retro typography.

Text content: Titles must be large, legible, and centered near the top of each quadrant. Keep the main shop signs readable where possible: “TACOS,” “HOT DOG,” and “PARIS CRÊPES.” Japanese shop signs can use authentic-looking Japanese characters. Avoid adding extra captions outside the four titles and shop signage.

Constraints: Exactly 4 quadrants and exactly 4 diorama food stands. Keep each stand fully visible within its quadrant, with no overlap across the black dividers. No watermark, no logo, no photorealistic humans, no extra panels.

2117903200341230921.promptEn:
Goal: Create a stylized animation character design sheet for Cyclist, an endurance road cyclist in a clean semi-realistic 3D/painted concept-art style.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 character sheet on a warm beige paper-textured background, with subtle grain and thin slate-blue guide lines. Overall look should feel like a professional animation model sheet, clean but hand-painted, with soft shadows under the feet.

Main layout: On the left two-thirds, show exactly 5 large full-body turnaround poses of the same slim young male cyclist with face intentionally obscured by a simple vertical blurred skin-tone rectangle: 1 front view, 2 front three-quarter view, 3 left side view, 4 back view, 5 back three-quarter view. The character is tall, very lean, mid-20s, with short tousled brown hair, narrow limbs, fair skin, and a focused athletic posture. Outfit: fitted royal blue short-sleeve cycling jersey with high collar and a small white triple-stripe logo on the chest/back, black cycling shorts, black fingerless cycling gloves with blue wrist details, white crew socks, and white-and-blue road cycling shoes.

Expression panel: In the upper-right, create a boxed panel labeled “EXPRESSIONS”. Inside it, show exactly 6 cropped bust/head expression portraits arranged in a 3 by 2 grid. Each portrait uses the same blue cycling jersey, brown hair, and obscured face rectangle; vary head angle and hair silhouette slightly while keeping a consistent character model.

Lower turnaround miniatures: Along the lower center, show exactly 4 smaller full-body poses of the cyclist wearing a black-and-white road cycling helmet: 1 back three-quarter view, 2 side view facing right, 3 back view, 4 side view facing left. Keep the same outfit, shoes, gloves, and slim proportions.

Color and prop area: At lower-left, include exactly 6 vertical color swatches, stacked top to bottom: royal blue, near-black, off-white, light skin peach, brown hair, muted blue-gray. Beneath or beside them, include exactly 3 simple outline icons separated by thin vertical dividers: 1 road bicycle, 2 cycling helmet, 3 water bottle.

Information box: At lower-right, include a thin-lined rectangular data card with the following text in all caps, monospaced or technical lettering: “CHARACTER: CYCLIST”, “AGE: MID 20'S”, “ROLE: ENDURANCE RIDER”, “PERSONALITY: FOCUSED, DETERMINED, DISCIPLINED”, and a small bottom-right ID number “001”.

Visual style: Semi-realistic stylized character concept art with elongated proportions, painterly shading, crisp clothing seams, subtle fabric texture on the jersey and shorts, warm neutral lighting, precise model-sheet spacing, and muted blue-gray typography. Keep faces covered/anonymous, no extra characters, no scenery, no watermark.

2117903200341230922.promptEn:
Goal: Create a sleek monochrome brand guidelines cover for UtopikAI Studio, presenting it as a premium AI studio visual identity system.

Canvas: Square 1:1 format, black charcoal background with subtle grain, faint vignette, and thin technical drafting lines. Use a minimal futuristic editorial layout with generous negative space.

Layout: Add a very thin rectangular border close to the canvas edges, with tiny corner ticks, small crosshair marks at the top center, left middle, right middle, and bottom center, and faint dotted vertical guide marks near both side edges. In the upper left, place small spaced uppercase text “UTOPIKAI STUDIO”; in the upper right, place “BRAND GUIDELINES”. In the center, build a large geometric construction grid: a 2-by-2 square grid with faint circular arc segments and quarter-circle curves, like logo construction guides. Overlay the main logo lockup across the middle-lower portion of this grid.

Logo lockup: Use a white abstract icon to the left, made from four square tiles containing curved quarter-circle cutouts, forming a symmetrical modern mark. To the right, set the wordmark “UtopikAI” in bold clean geometric sans serif, bright white, with “Studio” smaller and lighter aligned under the right side of the wordmark. Count exactly 2 logo elements: 1 abstract icon and 1 two-line wordmark.

Main title area: In the lower left quadrant, place the large title Brand Kit in white, set in a clean modern sans serif. Directly beneath it, add the subtitle Visual identity system in smaller muted gray text. Under the subtitle, add one short thin horizontal white line and one longer very faint gray line.

Footer: Along the bottom edge, add small technical footer labels: left “VERSION 1.0”, center “VISUAL IDENTITY SYSTEM”, and right 2024. Connect the footer area with thin angular drafting lines and subtle horizontal rules.

Visual style: Premium black-and-white brand kit cover, minimalist, tech-luxury, precise Swiss grid design, high contrast white typography, subtle gray construction lines, crisp vector-like rendering, no mockup perspective.

Constraints: Use exactly 5 main text groups: top-left studio label, top-right guidelines label, central logo lockup, lower-left title/subtitle block, and bottom footer metadata. Keep all text sharp and legible. Avoid extra colors, photos, people, shadows, or decorative clutter.

2117903200341230923.promptEn:
Goal: Create a clean brand exploration board for a fictional SaaS landing-page builder called Neito, showing the same website and brand identity system repeated in exactly 4 color directions.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 white canvas, arranged as a 2×2 grid of four complete brand/website mockup panels with generous white space. Each panel is nearly identical except for the accent color and soft blurred gradient decorations.

Layout: Each of the 4 panels contains exactly 2 main areas: a large landing-page mockup on the left and a narrow brand-guide column on the right. The four accent themes are: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 orange, 4 purple.

Landing-page mockup details: At the top left place the logo mark as two forward slashes followed by “Neito” with a small star/spark symbol. Across the top navigation place exactly 5 items: Product, Templates, Pricing, About, and a black rounded “Get started” button. Center a large editorial serif headline: “Words become landing pages.” Below it add small gray supporting copy about turning ideas and content into beautiful ready-to-share landing pages, then a black pill button reading “Start for free”. Under the button place exactly 3 small feature chips with icons: “No code”, “Quick setup”, and “Always in sync”. Behind the hero headline use a huge airy blurred circular gradient ring in the panel’s accent color.

Bottom website cards: Under each hero section place exactly 3 rectangular content cards with thin borders and rounded corners. Card 1 reads “Build pages from your ideas.” with a small black pill button “Try Neito”. Card 2 reads “Launching soon.” and includes a small rounded email/input pill plus a black “Notify me” button and a thin abstract circle-line graphic. Card 3 is numbered “01” and reads “Type your thoughts.” with small descriptive text and a large cropped blurred accent-color ring in the lower right.

Brand-guide column: Add a small heading “BRAND IDEA” and a short Japanese-style paragraph block in small black text. Below it create exactly 4 labeled sections separated by thin gray horizontal rules: COLOR PALETTE, TYPOGRAPHY, VISUAL LANGUAGE, and a sample card. In COLOR PALETTE show exactly 2 circular swatches labeled Main and Accent; the Main swatch is near-white and the Accent swatch matches the panel color, with a small hex-code label beside each. In TYPOGRAPHY show exactly 2 type specimens: a large serif “Aa” labeled for headlines and a smaller sans-serif “Aa” labeled for body text. In VISUAL LANGUAGE show exactly 4 circular tokens labeled Flow, Connection, Simplicity, and Flex, with one or more using the accent color as a blurred ring. The final sample card reads “From thought to landing page.” with small subtext and a cropped blurred accent-color ring.

Visual style: Minimal premium web-design presentation, monochrome typography, lots of white space, thin light-gray dividers, subtle shadows, soft frosted gradients, editorial serif headline paired with tiny modern sans-serif UI labels. Keep everything crisp like a Figma brand exploration screenshot. Use Words become landing pages. as the main repeated hero headline, blue, green, orange, purple for the four color variants, and 16:9.

Constraints: Show exactly 4 panels, exactly 3 bottom website cards per panel, exactly 2 brand areas per panel, exactly 2 color swatches per brand guide, exactly 2 typography specimens per brand guide, and exactly 4 visual-language tokens per brand guide. Do not add photos, people, device frames, dark backgrounds, or extra panels.

City Wall: A single pale concrete apartment-city wall rising beyond an empty grassland, so large that the top disappears into blue-green fog and the window rows merge into one continuous vertical face. Cool morning mist, soft diffused light, restrained pale gray and muted green palette, repeated apartment rows softened into texture, one dark rectangular gate far above the ground. Deep blue night haze, faint warm window texture as a thin distant seam, matte concrete slabs, soft reflections, silence. 3. City Gate: A single stacked apartment-city gate cut through a world-scale city dam, so large that both vertical edges leave the frame and the city details merge into one quiet inhabited cliff. 16:9 frontal long shot across an empty pale salt flat, 65 percent blank foreground and fog-bright sky seen through the colossal rectangular opening, two tiny vehicles stopped at the threshold on a thin road; first read is the empty salt flat, second read is the city gate. White haze, soft overcast light, pale concrete and blue-gray shadows, repeated window bands as quiet surface texture, the far side of the opening dissolving into mist. 2117903200341230929.promptEn: Create a polished product mockup showing a cozy winter campfire wallpaper adapted across three Apple-style devices. The wallpaper illustration should resemble a cute Japanese crayon-anime style without logos: five small cartoon children and one small white dog gathered around a bright campfire in a snowy pine forest at night, with falling snow, deep navy-blue trees, warm orange firelight illuminating the characters and snow, and a soft magical winter atmosphere. The main character is a round-faced child in a red winter sweater standing behind the fire, surrounded by four friends: one with dark spiky hair on the left, one in a brown coat at lower left, one curly-haired child in pink on the right, and one child in a green hood at lower right; the white dog sleeps or curls up near the fire in front. Show exactly three devices on a light gray studio background, each inside a rounded white display card with soft shadows: one large laptop mockup centered at the top, one tablet mockup at bottom left, and one smartphone mockup at bottom right. On all screens, display the same wallpaper composition, cropped appropriately. Add realistic lock-screen UI overlays: large time 9:38, date Friday, November 15, small status icons, and subtle translucent widgets. The tablet should include a translucent weather widget on the upper left showing Cupertino and 45°; the phone should include three circular widgets below the time and two small bottom lock-screen icons. Use clean high-end Apple product rendering, black bezels, thin device frames, rounded corners, soft ambient shadows, sharp screen detail, and a balanced wallpaper-preview layout suitable for desktop, tablet, and mobile backgrounds. Avoid brand logos, watermarks, extra text, or additional devices.
2117903200341230929.promptZh: 创建一款精致的产品样机图，展示一款温馨冬日篝火壁纸在三款苹果风格设备上的适配效果。壁纸插画应呈现可爱日式蜡笔动画（crayon-anime）风格，不含任何品牌标识：五名小型卡通儿童与一只小白狗围坐在雪夜松林中的一簇明亮篝火旁，雪花飘落，深海军蓝（navy-blue）色松树高耸，温暖的橙色火光（orange firelight）照亮人物与积雪，整体氛围柔和梦幻，充满冬日魔法感（magical winter atmosphere）。主角为一名圆脸儿童，身穿红色冬装毛衣，站在篝火后方；其四周环绕四名小伙伴：左侧为一名黑发刺猬头儿童，左下方为一名身着棕色大衣的儿童，右侧为一名粉衣卷发儿童，右下方为一名戴绿色连帽衫兜帽的儿童；小白狗则蜷卧或酣睡于篝火正前方地面。画面中须精确呈现三台设备，置于浅灰色影棚背景（studio background）之上，每台设备均置于一张带柔光阴影（soft shadows）的圆角白色显示卡（rounded white display card）内：一台大型笔记本电脑样机居中置于顶部，一台平板电脑样机位于左下角，一台智能手机样机位于右下角。所有屏幕上均显示同一张壁纸构图，按各设备屏幕比例精准裁切。添加逼真的锁屏界面（lock-screen UI）叠加层：超大时间显示“9:38”，日期显示“星期五，11月15日”，状态栏小图标，以及半透明（translucent）且视觉轻量的小组件（widgets）。平板屏幕左上方需加入一个半透明天气小组件，显示“Cupertino”及“45°”；手机屏幕则需在时间下方排列三个圆形小组件，并在锁屏底部添加两个小型图标。采用高端洁净的苹果产品渲染（Apple product rendering）风格：黑色边框（black bezels）、纤薄设备边框（thin device frames）、圆角设计（rounded corners）、环境柔光阴影（soft ambient shadows）、屏幕细节锐利清晰（sharp screen detail），整体壁纸预览布局（wallpaper-preview layout）均衡协调，适配桌面、平板与移动设备三种背景尺寸。禁止出现品牌标识（brand logos）、水印（watermarks）、额外文字或其它设备。

2117903200341230932.promptEn:
Split architectural visualization, vertical 3:4 composition, perfect structural alignment between the two halves.

Top half, dark luxury blueprint: deep navy / charcoal blue background, thin glowing beige-gold lines, walls drawn with a slight 3D extrusion, clean modern sans-serif labels, soft ambient glow. Floor plan shows 3 bedrooms (left, right, bottom-right), a central living room, kitchen plus dining at top center, 2 bathrooms, a garage connected on the left side, a front porch, and a backyard pool with deck. Include furniture outlines (beds, sofa, dining table), door swings, window placements, circulation paths, and exact proportions.

Bottom half, photorealistic render of the same house: modern single-story design, flat layered roof, smooth concrete walls with wood panel accents, large glass windows. Layout must match the blueprint exactly, garage on the left, main entrance aligned with the living room, pool in the backyard matching the blueprint footprint, window placements corresponding to each room, bedroom volumes visible externally in correct positions. Suburban neighborhood setting with green lawn, minimal landscaping, a clean driveway leading to the garage, and a matching pool deck. Golden hour lighting, soft natural light with realistic shadows. Slightly elevated front perspective, 35mm architectural lens.

Hard rules: room positions identical between blueprint and render, no extra structures, all doors and windows align logically, pool size and placement match exactly. Avoid mismatch, fantasy elements, unrealistic proportions, or a cluttered environment.
2117903200341230932.promptZh:
分屏式建筑可视化，竖构图 3:4，两半画面之间结构完全对齐。

上半部分为深色奢华蓝图：深海军蓝／炭灰蓝色背景，纤细的泛光米金线条，墙体以轻微三维挤出（3D extrusion）方式绘制，采用简洁现代的无衬线字体（sans-serif）标注，整体带有柔和环境辉光（ambient glow）。平面图显示 3 间卧室（分别位于左侧、右侧、右下角），中央为起居室，厨房加餐厅位于顶部中央，2 间浴室，车库连接于左侧，前方设门廊，后院配有带露台的泳池。需包含家具轮廓（床、沙发、餐桌）、门扇开启方向、窗位布置、动线路径，以及精确比例。

下半部分为同一住宅的照片级写实（photorealistic）渲染图：现代单层设计，分层式平屋顶，光滑混凝土墙面搭配木纹饰面，大面积玻璃窗。布局须与蓝图完全一致——车库位于左侧，主入口与起居室对齐，后院泳池位置及尺寸须与蓝图中泳池轮廓完全吻合，各房间窗位一一对应，各卧室体块须在外立面上准确呈现其位置。场景设定为郊区社区，配绿色草坪、极简景观、通向车库的整洁车道，以及与泳池匹配的露台。黄金时刻（golden hour）照明，柔和自然光搭配真实阴影。略高于人眼的正前方视角，使用 35mm 建筑摄影镜头（architectural lens）。

硬性规则：蓝图与渲染图中各房间位置必须完全一致；不得添加额外构筑物；所有门窗逻辑对齐；泳池尺寸与位置须完全一致。禁止出现错位、幻想元素、不真实比例或杂乱环境。

2117903200341230934.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vintage travel-poster infographic for Umeda, Osaka, Japan, combining a simple skyline illustration, large decorative typography, an isometric landmark map, and travel-ad copy.

Canvas: Vertical poster, about 2:3 aspect ratio, warm ivory paper background with a thin double-line ornamental gold border and clipped art-deco corner details. Use clean vector line art, muted pastel colors, subtle grain, beige shadows, and a retro Japanese tourism poster feel.

Layout: Top section is a wide rectangular sunset skyline panel with a turquoise-to-pink-to-orange gradient sky, flat beige city silhouette, the Umeda Sky Building centered, and a two-car train on tracks at the lower right. Middle section has one huge word, UMEDA, in bold outlined block letters filled with miniature city scenes; add a tan offset shadow and small handwritten Japanese note arrows near the right side. Main section is an isometric illustrated area map of Umeda with labeled landmarks and connecting leader lines. Bottom section contains location/date text, a large Japanese slogan, a bold English slogan, access information, railway line legend, must-see list, URL/hashtags, coordinates, and a small circular map inset.

Top skyline details: Include exactly 3 main skyline elements: 1 tall Umeda Sky Building with two linked towers and a bridge-like top, 1 simplified beige urban skyline stretching across the horizon, and 1 modern train made of exactly 2 connected cars.

Large typography details: The word UMEDA must contain exactly 5 giant letters, each filled differently: U with the Umeda Sky Building, M with modern buildings and greenery, E with a red ferris wheel, D with tall office towers, and A with urban street/building fragments. Use thick dark brown outlines, warm beige inner outlines, and colorful fills.

Isometric map landmark count: Show and label exactly 10 landmarks around the central map: 1 Umeda Sky Building, 2 Grand Green Osaka, 3 Grand Green Osaka (Umekita Park), 4 HEP FIVE Ferris Wheel, 5 LUCUA, 6 Grand Front Osaka, 7 Yodobashi Umeda, 8 Hankyu Department Store, 9 Hanshin Department Store, 10 Osaka Station. Also include exactly 1 additional label, Whity Umeda, near the lower left walkway area. The map should include towers, shopping complexes, station buildings, plazas, a green park with trees, curved pedestrian paths, and a red ferris wheel as the most saturated object.

Bottom text content: Use the heading “OSAKA, JAPAN | UMEDA 2026”. Below it, place the Japanese slogan そうだ、梅田行こう。 in large bold black type. Under that, write “UMEDA — LET’S GO!” in very large bold uppercase letters. Add the subtitle “VIBRANT STREETS. INCREDIBLE FOOD. ENDLESS MODERN ENERGY.” Add access text: “Access: 関西国際空港 → JRはるか（最速約45分）”. Include a rail legend with exactly 5 colored line items: JR Line, Hankyu, Hanshin, T, and Y. Add the must-see line listing: “Must-See: Umeda Sky Building · HEP FIVE Ferris Wheel · Grand Green Osaka · Yodobashi Umeda · Grand Front Osaka · Osaka Station · Hankyu Department Store · Hanshin Department Store · LUCUA · Whity Umeda”. Add small footer text “osaka-info.jp    #UmedaOsaka    #VisitOsaka” and coordinates “34.701°N 135.496°E”.

Map inset: Bottom right contains exactly 1 circular street-map inset with pale roads, light green blocks, blue waterways, a red location pin, and a tiny compass marker.

Style constraints: Keep the illustration intentionally simple and clean, with thin black-brown outlines, flat fills, minimal shading, and a hand-drawn travel guide aesthetic. Avoid photorealism, 3D rendering, excessive detail, extra labels, logos, or watermarks. Preserve the visible Japanese text exactly where specified while keeping all other design instructions in English.

2117903200341230935.promptEn: Create a square abstract kaleidoscopic geometric artwork in a strict two-color palette of vivid crimson red and soft bubblegum pink. The composition is perfectly symmetrical on both vertical and horizontal axes, with an additional diagonal mirror feeling, filling the entire canvas edge to edge. Use sharp flat vector-like triangular polygons only, no gradients, no outlines, no shadows, and no texture. Build the image from nested triangles and recursive fractal triangle clusters: 1 central diamond-shaped medallion made of many tiny red and pink triangles, 4 pointed triangular spires extending from the medallion toward the top, bottom, left, and right, 4 large mirrored corner rosette structures containing dense miniature triangle mosaics, 4 long diagonal fractal bands running from the center area toward the corners, and 8 large pink star-like polygon arms radiating around the center. The overall impression should resemble an origami mandala, a crystalline tessellation, or a Sierpinski-triangle kaleidoscope, with alternating red and pink triangular facets forming a bold symmetrical abstract pattern. Keep the design crisp, high contrast, flat, mathematically precise, and decorative, with no text, no border, no objects, and no recognizable figures.
2117903200341230935.promptZh: 创作一幅正方形抽象万花筒式几何艺术作品，严格采用两种颜色：鲜艳的深红色（crimson red）和柔和的泡泡糖粉色（bubblegum pink）。构图在垂直轴与水平轴上均完全对称，并附加对角线镜像感，画面铺满整个画布，边缘无缝衔接。仅使用锐利、扁平、类似矢量图形的三角形多边形，禁止渐变、描边、阴影及任何纹理。整幅图像由嵌套三角形与递归分形三角形簇构成：1个中央菱形徽章，由大量微小的红色与粉色三角形组成；4个尖锐的三角形尖塔，分别从徽章向上、下、左、右四个方向延伸；4个大型镜像式角落玫瑰花结结构，内含致密的微型三角形马赛克；4条长对角线分形带，从中心区域向四个角落延伸；以及8条大型粉色星状多边形臂，围绕中心呈放射状分布。整体视觉效果应类似折纸曼陀罗（origami mandala）、晶体化镶嵌（crystalline tessellation）或谢尔宾斯基三角形（Sierpinski-triangle）万花筒，红与粉三角面交替排列，形成大胆而对称的抽象图案。设计须保持清晰锐利、高对比度、扁平化、数学级精准且富有装饰性；禁止添加文字、边框、物体或任何可识别的人物形象。

2117903200341230948.promptEn:
Goal: Create a clean horizontal lighting comparison sheet titled LIGHTING RESPONSE TESTS, showing the same futuristic fashion model under five different studio lighting setups.

Canvas: Wide 16:7 presentation board on a light gray-white background, minimalist editorial layout, thin white gutters between image panels, subtle black border along the bottom edge.

Layout: Place the title in the upper left in uppercase black sans-serif letters. Below it, arrange exactly 5 equal vertical portrait panels from left to right, each containing the same full-body front-facing female model standing centered. Under each panel, add a two-line caption with the setup name in uppercase and the color temperature or color note below it.

Subject details: The model is a tall slender woman with a neutral symmetrical pose, arms relaxed at her sides, hair pulled back, face intentionally softly blurred or featureless. She wears a glossy iridescent translucent couture gown: high collar, sleeveless sculpted metallic bodice, reflective liquid-plastic surface, long sheer cape-like skirt panels flowing to the floor, pearlescent silver-white fabric with strong specular highlights. Keep the outfit identical in all five panels; only the lighting and background tones change.

Five lighting panels, exactly:
1. SOFTBOX — Daylight / 5600K: bright high-key white studio background, soft even daylight, pale pearly reflections.
2. RIM LIGHT — Cool / 6500K: dark blue-gray background, cool blue rim light outlining the model and dress edges, icy highlights.
3. GOLDEN HOUR — Warm / 3200K: warm beige-brown background, amber golden illumination, soft sunset glow through the translucent skirt.
4. NEON CITY — Cyan / Magenta: dark urban blue background, strong cyan light from one side and magenta-pink light from the other, vibrant neon reflections across the gown.
5. LOW KEY — Dramatic / 4500K: nearly black background, dramatic low-key lighting, silver highlights and deep shadows.

Visual style: Photorealistic fashion lighting test, glossy reflective materials, cinematic studio render, sharp full-body composition, professional lookbook comparison, clean typography, no extra logos or watermarks. Use iridescent translucent silver couture gown with flowing sheer cape panels and a front-facing neutral runway stance.
2117903200341230948.promptZh:
目标：创建一张干净的横向布光对比图，标题为 LIGHTING RESPONSE TESTS，展示同一位未来主义风格时尚模特在五种不同影棚布光（studio lighting）设置下的效果。

画布：宽幅 16:7 展示板，浅灰白色背景，极简主义杂志风格版式，图像面板之间留细白边距（gutter），底边沿有一道微妙的黑色边框。

版式：标题置于左上方，使用大写黑色无衬线字体。标题正下方，从左至右并排排列恰好 5 个等宽垂直人像面板，每个面板中均为同一全身正面站立的女性模特，居中构图。每个面板正下方添加两行图注：第一行为布光方案名称（大写字母），第二行为色温值或色彩说明。

人物细节：模特为高挑纤细女性，姿态中性且左右对称，双臂自然垂于身体两侧，头发向后梳拢，面部刻意做柔焦处理或呈无特征状。她身穿一件光泽感强、虹彩渐变、半透明的高级定制礼服：高领设计，无袖、金属质感立体剪裁上身，表面如液态塑料般高反射，下摆为修长通透、披风式裙片，垂落至地面；面料呈珠光银白色，具有强烈镜面高光（specular highlights）。整套服装在全部五个面板中完全一致；仅布光方式与背景色调发生变化。

五种布光面板，严格如下：
1. SOFTBOX — 日光 / 5600K：明亮高调纯白影棚背景，柔和均匀的日光照明，呈现淡雅珠光反射。
2. RIM LIGHT — 冷调 / 6500K：深蓝灰色背景，冷蓝色轮廓光（rim light）勾勒模特与礼服边缘，高光如冰晶般清冽。
3. GOLDEN HOUR — 暖调 / 3200K：暖米褐色背景，琥珀色黄金时刻（golden hour）光照，柔和日落余晖穿透半透明裙片。
4. NEON CITY — 青色 / 品红色：深都市蓝背景，一侧投射强烈青色光，另一侧投射品红-粉红色光，礼服表面映出鲜活霓虹反射。
5. LOW KEY — 戏剧化 / 4500K：近黑色背景，戏剧化低照度布光（low-key lighting），银色高光与浓重阴影并存。

视觉风格：照片级写实（photorealistic）时尚布光测试，高反光材质表现，电影感影棚渲染（cinematic studio render），清晰锐利的全身构图，专业型录（lookbook）式对比效果，排版干净，无额外标识或水印。采用虹彩渐变、半透明银色高级定制礼服，搭配流动感强的通透披风式裙片，以及正面中性T台站姿。

2117903200341230953.promptEn:
Goal: Create a clean technical architecture diagram explaining YOLOv13 as a one-page educational slide, showing how an input image flows through Backbone, HyperACE, Neck, FullPAD, and Head detection outputs.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape infographic on a white background, crisp vector style, thin colored outlines, rounded rectangles, arrowed connectors, and readable sans-serif text. Use a left-to-right pipeline with supplementary modules below the main path.

Layout: Start at far left with a small stacked thumbnail illustration labeled “Input Image (3, H, W)”, then an arrow into a large blue Backbone panel. Place the green Neck panel in the upper center, the purple Head panel on the right, HyperACE in the lower left-center, FullPAD in the lower center-right, and a boxed explanatory caption along the bottom.

Main pipeline sections and exact element counts:
- 1 Input Image stack at far left, shown as layered landscape photos.
- 1 Backbone panel titled “Backbone” with subtitle “(built from DS-C3k2 blocks)”. Inside it, show exactly 5 vertically stacked DS-C3k2 block boxes labeled B1, B2, B3, B4, B5. Put “/2” downsampling markers between each adjacent block, for exactly 4 downsampling labels. Add side output arrows: B1 and B2 go right and are labeled “B1 (unused)” and “B2 (unused)”; B3, B4, and B5 go right in blue and are labeled “B3 (C3, H/8, W/8)”, “B4 (C4, H/16, W/16)”, and “B5 (C5, H/32, W/32)”.
- 1 HyperACE module below the Backbone, orange outline, titled “HyperACE” with subtitle “(Hypergraph-based Adaptive Correlation Enhancement) Eq.8-11”. Inside it, include one dashed rounded note box saying “Models cross-scale and cross-position high-order and low-order correlations”. Blue lines from B3/B4/B5 feed into HyperACE. HyperACE outputs an orange arrow to a small orange 3D cube labeled “Y” and “Correlation-enhanced feature”.
- 1 Neck panel in the upper center, green outline, titled “Neck” with subtitle “(built from DS-C3k2 blocks)”. Inside it show exactly 6 DS-C3k2 block boxes arranged in a 2-column by 3-row grid. Use black arrows between blocks, with exactly 2 yellow upsample boxes labeled “↑ 2×” and exactly 2 purple downsample boxes labeled “↓ 2×”. Include 3 blue circular input junctions on the left edge of the Neck and 3 green/purple circular tunnel markers below or beside the grid.
- 1 FullPAD legend module below the Neck, red outline, titled “FullPAD” with subtitle “(Full-Pipeline Aggregation-and-Distribution) Eq.12-13”. Show exactly 3 legend rows: “Backbone–Neck tunnel (Backbone-to-Neck connection)” using blue dotted arrows and blue hollow circles; “In-Neck tunnel (the internal layers of the Neck)” using green dotted arrows and green hollow circles; “Neck–Head tunnel (Neck-to-Head connection)” using purple dotted arrows and purple hollow circles. Connect the cube feature into FullPAD with an orange arrow, and draw dotted blue/green/purple tunnel routes upward and rightward to the Neck and Head.
- 1 Head panel on the right, purple outline, titled “Head” with subtitle “(Detect x3)”. Inside it show exactly 3 vertically stacked Detect boxes: “Detect (stride 8)”, “Detect (stride 16)”, and “Detect (stride 32)”. Each receives one arrow from the Neck and outputs to the right as H3, H4, H5 with labels “H3 (scale 1/8)”, “H4 (scale 1/16)”, and “H5 (scale 1/32)”.

Color coding: Backbone lines and panel in blue, Neck in green, Head in purple, HyperACE in orange, FullPAD outline in red. Main arrows are solid; FullPAD tunnels are dotted/dashed with hollow circular nodes. Use subtle pastel fills for module boxes.

Bottom caption: Add one wide rounded rectangle spanning the lower width. Text: “Classic YOLO is a one-directional Backbone → Neck → Head pipeline.” Then on the next line: “YOLOv13 adds HyperACE and FullPAD on top of it to enhance feature representation and information flow.” Color the words Backbone blue, Neck green, Head purple, HyperACE orange, and FullPAD red.

Constraints: Keep all labels legible, align sections neatly, preserve the exact counts of blocks and detect heads, avoid extra modules, avoid photorealism except for the small input image thumbnail, and do not add a watermark.

2117903200341230955.promptEn: Zone 1 (top-left): Rembrandt lighting, key 45° elevated camera left, fill -45° camera right 0.5x, dramatic triangle on shadow cheek Zone 2 (top-center): Butterfly lighting, key overhead slightly front, fill reflector under chin, butterfly nose shadow, beauty editorial Zone 3 (top-right): Split lighting, hard key 90° camera left, zero fill, half face in shadow, noir mystery Zone 4 (bottom-left): Loop lighting, key 30° elevated camera left, fill -30° camera right 0.3x, small nose loop shadow, natural commercial Zone 5 (bottom-center): Rim lighting dominant, hard backlight 170° camera right gold gel, hair glow, edge separation, heroic silhouette Zone 6 (bottom-right): Clamshell lighting, butterfly key overhead + large soft fill from below 45°, zero shadows, porcelain skin, high-end beauty
2117903200341230955.promptZh:
区域 1（左上）：伦勃朗布光（Rembrandt lighting），主光（key）来自相机左侧 45° 高位，辅光（fill）来自相机右侧 -45° 位置、强度为 0.5 倍，阴影侧脸颊呈现戏剧性三角光斑（dramatic triangle on shadow cheek）  
区域 2（中上）：蝶形布光（Butterfly lighting），主光（key）略偏前方、正上方照射，辅光（fill）为置于下颌下方的反光板，鼻下投出蝶形阴影（butterfly nose shadow），美妆杂志风格（beauty editorial）  
区域 3（右上）：分割布光（Split lighting），硬质主光（hard key）来自相机左侧 90°，无辅光（zero fill），半张脸处于阴影中，黑色电影（noir）神秘感  
区域 4（左下）：环形布光（Loop lighting），主光（key）来自相机左侧 30° 高位，辅光（fill）来自相机右侧 -30°、强度为 0.3 倍，鼻侧呈现细小环形阴影（small nose loop shadow），自然商业风（natural commercial）  
区域 5（中下）：轮廓光（Rim lighting）为主导，硬质逆光（hard backlight）来自相机右侧 170°、加金色色片（gold gel），发丝泛光（hair glow），边缘分离（edge separation），英雄式剪影（heroic silhouette）  
区域 6（右下）：蛤壳式布光（Clamshell lighting），蝶形主光（butterfly key）来自正上方 + 大型柔光辅光（large soft fill）自下方 45° 补光，无阴影（zero shadows），瓷肌质感（porcelain skin），高端美妆（high-end beauty）

2117903200341230956.promptEn:
Goal: Create a minimalist Swiss-style exhibition poster for a generative nature bonsai show, centered on a realistic bonsai tree in a ceramic pot, combining botanical photography with precise algorithmic diagram graphics.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, off-white warm paper background with generous negative space, crisp print-design finish.

Main subject: A single mature bonsai tree, photorealistic, placed slightly below center. The tree has a thick twisted dark brown trunk, exposed roots, dense bright green pine-like foliage arranged in layered horizontal pads, moss-covered soil, and a shallow round gray concrete ceramic pot with subtle stains and shadow. The bonsai should look like a premium product photograph integrated into a design poster.

Typography: Use thin modern sans-serif uppercase typography, black and dark gray only. The main headline at upper left reads “BONSAI SYSTEM” in very large thin letters over two lines. Above it, small text reads “GENERATIVE NATURE” and “SERIES 01”. Below the headline, write “GENERATIVE FORM”, then a small three-line list: “ALGORITHM”, “VARIATION”, “EQUILIBRIUM”. On the upper right, write “TOKYO 2026”. On the lower left, write the event dates as three stacked lines: “MAY 08 / JUN 21 / 2026”, with 2026 much larger. Under that, add “AT” and “TOKYO GENERATIVE LAB”. Near the left middle, add the small slogan “NATURE IS THE ORIGINAL ALGORITHM.” Add vertical Japanese text beside it: “盆栽系統”. At bottom center, include exactly 5 tiny numbered index labels: “01 SEED”, “02 GROWTH”, “03 FORM”, “04 BALANCE”, “05 TIME”. At bottom right, include “WWW.GENERATIVE-LAB.JP”.

Geometric layout: Overlay a delicate technical diagram system in very light gray and black around the bonsai. Include exactly 1 large faint circle centered behind the tree, exactly 1 vertical centerline running from top to bottom, exactly 1 horizontal line crossing the composition through the foliage area, exactly 2 small black circular nodes on the horizontal line, exactly 1 rectangular grid panel in the upper right behind the foliage, exactly 1 fan of many thin curved contour lines sweeping down from the upper right, exactly 1 smaller nested curved-line corner motif near the lower right, exactly 2 dotted matrix blocks made of tiny black dots, exactly 2 small pale gray square blocks, and exactly 1 narrow solid black vertical rectangle near the upper-right grid.

Layout details: The poster should feel mathematically composed and editorial, with the bonsai occupying the center-lower area and the typography aligned to strict margins. Use thin divider strokes and short horizontal rules as accents. Maintain a clean monochrome graphic system with the only strong color being the green bonsai foliage.

Visual style: High-end museum poster, Japanese design influence, Bauhaus/Suisse typography, generative algorithm diagram aesthetics, precise vector overlays, subtle paper texture, photorealistic plant and pot, no clutter.

Constraints: Keep all text sharp and legible, do not add extra plants or people, do not add a watermark, use exactly one bonsai tree and one pot, preserve the sparse off-white background and black geometric design language.
