2117903200341231122.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vintage tarot card design sheet showing exactly 2 cards side by side: the front of a tarot card on the left and the matching card back on the right.

Canvas: Landscape composition on a transparent-background checkerboard preview, with both cards vertically oriented, evenly spaced, and centered. Use aged cream paper, muted ink, weathered edges, and a hand-illustrated antique tarot aesthetic.

Left card, front design: A classic tarot card titled TEMPERANCE with the Roman numeral XIV in a small top plaque. The card has an ornate botanical border with vines, small flowers, stars, and corner linework. In the center stands a serene feminine figure in a flowing pale teal Greco-Roman style dress with a thigh slit, barefoot in shallow water, pouring liquid from one golden cup into another. The face is softly indistinct and painterly rather than detailed. Behind her are a radiant halo, scattered stars, a crescent moon, distant mountains, a river, flowers, grasses, and a small cute stone-cat statue on a pedestal at the right side. The lower title band contains large serif text reading TEMPERANCE.

Right card, back design: A matching ornate tarot card back with no title text. Use the same aged parchment tone and thin dark green-gold border. The center contains one large circular compass-star emblem: an 8-point star inside concentric circles, with a dark teal ring decorated with small gold dots. Around it, add a symmetrical sunburst of many fine rays extending outward. Include small vertical ornamental dots and diamond marks above and below the circle, plus geometric corner brackets and small square corner ornaments.

Visual style: Antique occult illustration, Art Nouveau-inspired tarot engraving, muted teal, sage green, ochre gold, cream parchment, fine ink hatching, slightly faded print texture, subtle stains, realistic paper grain, handmade line art.

Constraints: Show exactly 2 cards: 1 front card and 1 back card. Keep both cards the same size and orientation. Preserve the readable text TEMPERANCE and XIV. Do not add extra cards, hands, mockup shadows, modern UI, or watermarks.

2117903200341231124.promptEn:
Generate a four-panel grid collage of ultra-photorealistic editorial lifestyle vignettes, all featuring the same young woman with long dark brown wavy hair, clear glowing skin, dewy no-makeup makeup, a fit toned physique, serene composed expression with a gentle smile. She wears matching ribbed beige/cream activewear: variations include a sleeveless crop top with high-waisted leggings, and a long-sleeve crop top with high-waisted leggings, comfortable high-quality fabric.

Shot on a DSLR with a prime lens around 50mm or 85mm at f/1.4, shallow depth of field producing creamy bokeh, sharp focus on the subject in every frame, ultra-high resolution photorealistic textures, editorial lifestyle aesthetic. Lighting is soft, diffused, warm natural daylight coming from large windows. Overall mood is calm, serene, balanced, sophisticated, peaceful, rejuvenating. Style is minimalist, high-end, contemporary, clean and aspirational.

Color palette: dominant warm beige, cream, white, marble grey. Accents: green plants, gold fixtures and details, natural wood tones, and a soft purple smoothie. Materials throughout: white marble, light wood, stone, ceramic, glass, linen.

Panel 1, Modern Luxury Kitchen: white marble island and countertops, white shaker cabinets, gold hardware, integrated wine fridge, large window. She stands at the island with her body angled slightly, looking down while whisking a hot beverage in a small ceramic bowl with a wooden whisk, gentle steam rising. A mug marked with the letter "H" sits beside her.

Panel 2, High-End Bathroom: large backlit mirror, white marble vanity, white walls, an orchid plant on the counter. She stands facing the mirror, one hand applying a skincare product to her face with a cotton pad. Around her: a skincare bottle, a lit Diptyque candle, a whole coconut, and glass jars.

Panel 3, Minimalist Wellness Space: textured beige walls with curved arches, a stone water fountain, eucalyptus arranged in a vase. She performs a full-body stretch, arms extended overhead, head tilted back, eyes closed. A large perfume bottle is visible in the scene.

Panel 4, Bright Cafe Corner: round white marble table with a cane chair, large window overlooking a quiet street. She sits at the table, smiling softly while eating avocado toast and holding a fork. On the table: a purple smoothie in a glass, an Assouline book, small notebooks, and a few small flowers.

Final composition: a clean four-panel grid collage, sharp focus on the subject in each panel, editorial lifestyle photography, minimalist high-end contemporary feel, aspirational wellness vibe.

2117903200341231126.promptEn:
Goal: Create a dreamy vintage scrapbook poster for a Korean cafe drink, centered on a layered iced Pistachio Rose Latte with a romantic pink-and-pistachio color palette, Pinterest-style cafe diary aesthetic, and handwritten annotations.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, warm window-side natural light, cozy wooden cafe table background, soft bokeh, cream paper textures, torn edges, washi tape, paper clips, pinned instant-photo frames, doodles, stickers, rose petals, pistachio crumbs, and delicate gold sparkle marks.

Main subject: Place one tall clear glass latte in the center on a beige ceramic saucer. The drink has exactly 4 visible layers from bottom to top: pale rose pink rose syrup, white fresh milk, muted pistachio-green sauce with ice cubes and condensation droplets on the glass, and fluffy pale pink rose cream foam. Top the foam with exactly 5 garnish types: a dried rosebud, crushed pistachios, dried rose petals, tiny pink crumbs, and scattered green nut dust. Add white hand-drawn arrows labeling exactly 4 drink layers: “Rose Cream (so fluffy!)”, “Pistachio Sauce”, “Fresh Milk”, and “Rose Syrup”. Add tiny handwritten text near the bottom of the glass: “stir & enjoy!♡”.

Top title collage: At upper left, make a large torn cream paper title card taped with pink patterned washi and green tape. Text on the card: “Creamy & Dreamy♡” above a large hand-lettered title “Pistachio Rose Latte”, with “Pistachio” in olive green and “Rose Latte” in dusty rose red. Beneath it, add a green brush-stroke label containing Korean text “피스타치오 로즈 라떼”. Decorate with a pink bow sticker, a small rose doodle, hearts, and sparkles. Attach a narrow pink note on the right edge with exactly 5 lines: “soft”, “sweet”, “nutty”, “floral”, “♡”, plus a round stamp reading “CAFE DIARY” and handwritten “love this!”.

Left ingredient card: Add one torn notebook-paper card on the left labeled “Ingredients”. It must list exactly 6 ingredients with tiny icons: “Pistachio Sauce”, “Rose Cream”, “Fresh Milk”, “Rose Syrup”, “Ice”, and “Dried Rose & Pistachio”.

Right recipe card: Add one small taped beige paper card on the right labeled “How to make ♡”. It must show exactly 7 numbered steps: “Add ice to the glass”, “Pour rose syrup”, “Add fresh milk”, “Add pistachio sauce”, “Top with rose cream”, “Sprinkle pistachio & dried rose”, and “Stir and enjoy”. Add a tiny pink bow doodle at the bottom.

Photo and memo elements: Include exactly 2 Polaroid-style photos: one at the upper right showing a window, pink roses in a glass vase, and a pink cup of coffee, captioned “Sunday mood ♡”; one at the lower left showing baby’s breath flowers, pink roses, and pistachios, captioned “little things make big days ♡”. Include exactly 3 small sticky-note style pieces: a pink heart tag at mid-right reading “Treat yourself Today! ☺”; a small note near lower-left center reading “it’s giving...” followed by exactly 3 bullet lines “soft girl”, “cafe vibes”, “happy” with a bear face; and a bottom-center illustrated cafe diary card with Korean text, a cute bear, a drawing of the latte, labels “my favorite color combo!”, “Pistachio”, “Rose”, and hashtags “#cafevibes  #pistachiolover  #roselatte”. Include one bottom-right “DAILY MEMO” checklist clipped with a gold binder clip, containing exactly 5 checked items: “good coffee”, “pretty flowers”, “favorite song”, “sweet treat”, “me time”, ending with “= perfect day ♡”.

Surrounding props: Add cookies on a plate at the bottom left, a gold spoon with a pink gem-like handle near the bottom center, scattered dried rose petals and pistachios, a lace doily texture under the glass, and a small bowl or cup of pistachios at the bottom right. Use soft blush, sage green, cream, warm brown, and muted gold throughout.

Visual style: Photorealistic central drink blended with hand-drawn scrapbook graphics, Korean cafe mood board, analog paper collage, watercolor doodles, textured stationery, soft film grain, warm highlights, shallow depth of field, cozy and healing atmosphere.

Constraints: Keep all text legible and hand-lettered, preserve the exact counted cards, lists, labels, Polaroids, and sticky notes, avoid modern UI elements, avoid extra drink glasses, no watermark.

2117903200341231127.promptEn:
Goal: Create a printable paint-by-numbers worksheet showing a cartoon living room scene with a child-like character standing in the center, designed as clean black-and-white line art with numbered regions and a color legend.

Canvas: A4 portrait page at 300 DPI, white background, thin black outer border, crisp vector-like outlines, no shading except the tiny color swatches in the legend. The main illustration fills the upper roughly 70% of the page, and the instruction/color-key panel fills the bottom roughly 30%.

Main illustration layout: Draw a cozy living room in simple rounded cartoon style. Center: one standing cartoon character with large round eyes, small dot nose, worried wavy mouth, hood or helmet-like hair/head covering, short-sleeve shirt, slim arms, long pants, and bare feet. Left: one sofa with two seat/back cushions, one armrest visible on each side, and one small throw pillow. Above the sofa: one framed wall picture containing a small landscape with hills, sky, and one tree. Right of the character: one side table with a lamp on top and one drawer; behind/right is one tall potted plant with exactly 10 visible leaves. Far right: one camera on a tripod aimed at the character, with a screen/body, lens/buttons, and exactly three tripod legs. Background includes a wall, a large window on the right with vertical panes, a floor with wood plank lines, and a large rectangular rug in the foreground.

Numbered paint areas: Place black numbers inside the line-art regions throughout the scene, using numbers 1 through 14. Use many repeated numbers on matching surfaces. Keep the numbers legible and centered in their shapes. Match the apparent assignments: 1 for beige wall areas, 2 for light gray head/hood areas, 3 for yellow skin/limbs, 4 for black camera/tripod details, 5 for white shirt and camera screen, 6 for blue sofa, 7 for tan pillow, 8 for brown picture frame, 9 for sky blue window/picture sky, 10 for green plant/tree leaves, 11 for cream lamp/rug interior, 12 for teal rug border, 13 for wood-brown floor/table/plank areas, and 14 for beige plant pot.

Bottom instruction panel: Add a horizontal divider line above the legend. Center a bold title reading Instructions. Under it, add smaller text reading Paint the areas with the matching colors.. Below, arrange exactly 14 color legend entries in three neat columns. Each entry has a number, a small filled color square, and an English color label. The 14 entries must be: 1 Beige, 2 Light Gray, 3 Yellow, 4 Black, 5 White, 6 Blue, 7 Tan, 8 Brown, 9 Sky Blue, 10 Green, 11 Cream, 12 Teal, 13 Wood Brown, 14 Beige (Pot).

Style constraints: Make it look like a polished printable worksheet for children, with smooth uniform black outlines, rounded friendly shapes, lots of enclosed regions suitable for coloring, no gradients, no realistic textures, no extra text, no watermark. Subject can be customized as a worried cartoon child-like figure, setting as cozy living room, and palette as 14-color paint-by-numbers palette.

2117903200341231131.promptEn:
Goal: Create a polished anime storyboard sheet for a fictional 10-second trading card battle anime sequence, designed like a cinematic ad storyboard made from five horizontal panels.

Canvas: Landscape 16:10 white storyboard page with thin gray table borders, a centered Japanese headline at the top reading 10秒トレーディングカードバトルアニメ 絵コンテ, a thin red line accent near the top left, and a small angular red logo-like mark in the top right.

Layout: Use a three-column storyboard grid. The left column is narrow and contains red cut labels plus timing. The center column is wide and contains cinematic anime stills. The right column is a white notes column with camera direction and action notes. There are exactly 5 horizontal rows, separated by light gray lines.

Visible cut list: 1) Cut 1, 0.0s-2.0s: wide establishing arena shot. 2) Cut 2, 2.0s-4.0s: medium-close shot of the protagonist activating a card device. 3) Cut 3, 4.0s-6.2s: extreme close-up of a card thrust toward the viewer. 4) Cut 4, 6.2s-8.5s: whip-pan summoning scene with a dragon hologram appearing. 5) Cut 5, 8.5s-10.0s: final low-angle hero-and-dragon shot.

Subject details: The protagonist is a fiery red-haired teenage anime boy wearing a red-and-black battle jacket, fingerless gloves, and a glowing mechanical card duel device on one arm. The summoned monster is a crimson armored dragon with huge wings, jagged horns, glowing red crystal chest core, and ember-like highlights. The arena is a futuristic packed stadium at night with blue neon spotlights, a glowing duel field, massive audience stands, and a giant VS screen. The main card art shows a red demonic dragon emblem and fiery energy.

Center-panel imagery: Cut 1 shows the full stadium duel field with the red-haired protagonist on the left, an opponent in white far away on the right, giant red and blue card banners, and a large glowing “VS” display in the background. Cut 2 shows the protagonist grinning confidently, holding up a red dragon card while red energy coils around the wrist-mounted duel device; intentionally obscure or soften the exact face area as if motion-blurred/censored. Cut 3 shows a sharp close-up of one intense red eye and the raised dragon card, with rack-focus depth of field and explosive red particle streaks behind it. Cut 4 shows a red magic circle covering the arena floor as the dragon materializes in holographic flame beside the protagonist. Cut 5 shows the protagonist standing heroically beside the fully formed dragon, both lit from below by red embers and dramatic battle light.

Right-column text notes: For Cut 1 write “wide shot / dolly in / audience cheers, introduce protagonist”. For Cut 2 include the red Japanese quote 「来い、紅蓮王ドラグレイザー！」 followed by “medium-close-up / fearless smile / device activation”. For Cut 3 write “extreme close-up / rack focus / thrust card toward camera”. For Cut 4 write “whip pan / hologram summon / dragon appears”. For Cut 5 write “low angle / orbit shot / decisive cut”.

Visual style: High-energy modern shonen anime, glossy digital painting, cinematic lighting, red and blue color contrast, intense lens flares, speed lines, sparks, holographic particles, dramatic perspective, crisp storyboard presentation, professional production-board clarity.

Constraints: Keep exactly 5 storyboard rows, exactly 3 columns, and preserve the timing labels. Do not add extra cuts, extra characters, watermarks, or unrelated UI elements.

2117903200341231137.promptEn:
Goal: Create a monochrome anime action storyboard sheet for an animation fight sequence, full of rough sakuga energy: gestural, dynamic, and readable, like a choreography bible for animators. The subject is a long-haired robed spear warrior performing a spear-and-water combat ritual across exactly 12 panels.

Canvas: Wide horizontal storyboard board, 16:9 ratio, divided into an exact 3x4 grid with thick black panel borders. Each panel has a black number badge in the upper-left corner, numbered 01 through 12, with hand-lettered uppercase titles and small color-coded annotation notes.

Visual style: Grayscale ink-and-pencil concept art with loose sketch lines, dramatic motion blur, wind-torn cloth, flying hair, splashing water, ruined coastal towers, hanging lanterns, birds in the sky, and cinematic camera angles. Keep the art mostly black, white, and gray, but overlay clear colored animator annotations: red for camera movement, blue for body mechanics, green for weapon arc, orange for impact or lantern reaction, and purple for timing or hold beats. Annotation arrows should be hand-drawn, bright, and readable.

Layout and panel content: Include exactly 12 storyboard panels:

01 — SPEAR PLANT REVEAL: The warrior stands upright on flooded stone, spear planted vertically into the water. Distant towers and seabirds behind. Red arrows show a low front wide camera move, blue notes show still stance, green arrow shows spear vertical, purple rings at the feet show stillness.

02 — TIDE BREATH: Medium side shot. The warrior extends the spear horizontally while cloth and hair flow in the wind. Red note: medium side. Blue arrows: arms rise, inhale. Green arrow: spear lifts parallel. Purple timing mark: breath hold.

03 — FIRST SWEEP CUT: Dynamic tracking-wide shot of the warrior lunging into a wide sweeping spear cut, water exploding at the feet. Red annotation: tracking wide. Blue arrows: hip rotation, low sweep. Green arc sweeps left to right across the panel. Purple note: release.

04 — SPIRAL ENTRY: Overhead or high-angle spin view. The warrior rotates in a 360-degree spiral, robes forming circular motion. Red note: orbit follow. Blue: spin 360. Green: spear orbital loop. Purple: snap at top.

05 — SALTWATER STEP: Ground-tracking shot. The warrior steps forward through shallow seawater, spear trailing outward, ripples spreading. Red: ground tracking. Blue: cross step forward. Green: water ripples outward. Purple: weight shift.

06 — PILLAR VAULT: High-angle follow shot as the warrior vaults or leaps near a tall broken pillar. Red: high angle follow. Blue: upward vault, body extend. Green: spear trails below. Purple: airborne beat.

07 — DOWNWARD PLUNGE: Front low push-in. The warrior drives the spear downward into the ground or water, creating a violent burst. Red: front low push-in. Blue: two-hand strike descend. Green: spear vertical down. Orange: impact burst. Purple: hit snap.

08 — BLADE SPIN RECOVER: Wide side view recovery stance. The warrior pivots low while the spear loops tightly around the body. Red: wide side view. Blue: behind-back loop, recover stance. Green: tight spear loop. Purple: reset breath.

09 — LANTERN PASS: Rear three-quarter composition with the warrior passing under hanging lanterns, spear extended across the frame. Red: rear 3/4. Blue: tip graze precise line. Green: spear tip path. Orange: lanterns sway, chain reaction. Purple: soft snap.

10 — TIDE SILHOUETTE: Extreme low wide shot. The warrior poses dramatically on a broken stone platform against a towering wave. Red: extreme low wide. Blue: full body pose. Green: spear overhead arc. Purple: hero pause.

11 — ROBES-TO-WATER CUT: Tracking front shot. The warrior slashes downward through water, robes whipping into the motion. Red: tracking front. Blue: slide descend steps. Green: robes trail through water. Purple: controlled flow decay.

12 — RITE UNFINISHED: Wide hero shot at sunset or pale dawn. The warrior stands facing the horizon, spear leveled forward, ocean ruins and a glowing sun in the distance. Red: wide hero shot. Blue: stand and level forward. Green: spear leveled at horizon. Purple: forward intent.

Text content: Use hand-lettered English titles exactly as listed for all 12 panels. Add small colored notes inside each panel, matching the listed red, blue, green, orange, and purple annotations. Optional main design emphasis: water-spear choreography with readable animation planning arrows.

Constraints: Exactly 12 panels in a 3x4 grid, no extra panels. Preserve the locked annotation color key: red camera, blue body, green weapon arc, orange impact, purple timing. Keep the image mostly monochrome with only the annotation colors vivid. Avoid polished clean lineart; keep it rough, energetic, cinematic, and storyboard-like.

2117903200341231138.promptEn: Please generate a high-end Chinese knowledge architecture infographic with a vertical 9:16 composition. The overall visual language is fixed as: light cream-white grid paper background + cover-level oversized bold title + high-saturation blue-purple-magenta gradient keyword capsule bar + white-base black-bordered structural modules + colorful small capsule labels inside modules + blue arrow closed-loop connections. This is not an ordinary flowchart or a tech UI panel. Please generate a high-end infographic similar to a high-quality knowledge blogger's course cover, knowledge payment system diagram, or methodology architecture poster. The overall style must be restrained, clean, and highly orderly, but local colorful labels must be striking enough to make the image richer and more layered than an ordinary black-and-white architecture diagram. 1. Fixed Visual Style: Background: Use a light cream-white grid paper background with very fine, light gray grid lines. No gradients, dark backgrounds, heavy shadows, glassmorphism, skeuomorphism, tech HUD, or cyber UI. General Vibe: Minimalist, restrained, rational, and orderly structure. Black and white skeleton with colors used only for keyword bars, small labels, emphasis blocks, and blue arrows. 2. Top Title Area Layout: Top description sentence (small centered text extracted from content), Oversized bold Chinese main title (the largest visual element with high visual impact), and a Horizontal high-saturation gradient keyword capsule bar (blue to purple to magenta transition with 3 core keywords separated by white dots). 3. Main Module Structure Rules: 3-layer structure (3 + 3 + 4 modules). Total of 10 white-base modules with black borders and small rounded corners. Blue Arrow Loop Rules: Use medium-high saturation blue arrows to show the flow from top to bottom and returning to create a closed loop. 7. Text Hierarchy: Clear weighting from the main title (thickest/largest) to the gradient bar text, module titles, and then body text. 8. Final Acceptance Criteria: Ensure grid background, top description, oversized title, gradient keyword bar, 3+3+4 module structure, colorful labels, and blue closed-loop arrows are all present and satisfy the style requirements. 9. Prohibitions: No gradient/dark backgrounds, no large color cards, no glassmorphism, no complex illustrations, no PPT or mind map styles, and no gray arrows. 10. Visual style: Premium Japanese anime food commercial look, highly detailed semi-realistic cooking illustration, glossy highlights, shallow depth of field, dynamic action framing, orange firelight and golden egg tones, crisp textures on rice, scallions, diced meat, wok metal, and wooden cutting board.

Storyboard panels, exactly 12 in this order:

3. Close-up of hands cracking one egg over a clear glass mixing bowl, yolk and egg white falling with sparkling highlights.
4. Close-up of beaten eggs being vigorously whisked with chopsticks in a glass bowl, swirling bright orange-yellow liquid.
5. Hot black wok over open flames, oil being poured in a thin golden stream, steam rising.
6. Pour beaten egg into the sizzling wok; the egg begins to scramble and bubble into soft golden curds.
7. Toss rice, diced meat, scallions, and egg together in the wok; ingredients fly upward in a dramatic midair arc.
8. High-energy wok-tossing shot surrounded by intense orange flames and sparks, golden fried rice scattering in the air.
9. Extreme appetizing close-up of finished fried rice with glossy individual grains, yellow egg pieces, green scallions, and browned meat cubes.
10. Wider kitchen action shot: a cook’s hand sprinkles seasoning from above into the steaming wok while the fried rice cooks over flame.
11. Hero plating shot: a neat dome mound of golden fried rice on a white plate with a subtle patterned rim, steam rising, warm kitchen background.
12. Final close-up spoonful shot: a metal spoon lifts glossy golden fried rice with egg, scallions, and a large cube of meat, with the plated rice blurred behind it.

Constraints: Keep the grid layout exact with 12 distinct panels, chronological left-to-right and top-to-bottom storytelling, no visible text, emphasize gold, amber, orange firelight, deep black wok, fresh green scallions, make the dish look rich, hot, and delicious.

2117903200341231146.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vintage botanical photo-chronicle contact sheet titled The Slow Garden: A Rosemary Chronicle, documenting the life cycle of rosemary from dry pot to harvest.

Canvas: Square 1:1 poster on warm aged parchment paper, subtle stains and speckles, soft cream background, thin dark-green panel borders, handwritten field-journal typography. Use a large decorative serif/calligraphy headline centered at the top.

Layout: Arrange exactly 12 photographic panels in a clean 4-column by 3-row grid. Each panel has a handwritten green stage label above it, a short uppercase camera-direction caption below it, and an italic poetic quote beneath the caption. Add small downward arrow marks along the far left and far right margins to suggest time passing.

Panel details, count exactly 12:
1. Stage label: "Dormancy". Image: a terracotta pot on a windowsill filled with cracked dry soil, no plant visible. Caption: "WIDE · OVERHEAD · FIXED CAMERA". Quote: "Winter's silence, the seed waits."
2. Stage label: "Dormancy". Image: macro view of a terracotta pot rim and dark soil with a single water droplet running down the clay side. Caption: "MACRO · SLOW MOTION DROP". Quote: "First drop, awakening memory."
3. Stage label: "Germination". Image: low-angle close photo of a pale tiny shoot emerging from dark soil. Caption: "LOW ANGLE · TIME-LAPSE FEEL". Quote: "Root first, shoot later."
4. Stage label: "Germination". Image: close-up of a small cotyledon seedling with two green leaves rising from soil, soft bokeh background. Caption: "CLOSE-UP · COTYLEDON FOCUS". Quote: "Breaking ground, it took seven days."
5. Stage label: "Growth". Image: macro of young rosemary leaves with rim light, dew-like texture on needle edges. Caption: "MACRO · LEAF EDGE RIM LIGHT". Quote: "Every leaf, a map of aroma."
6. Stage label: "Growth". Image: close-up of a human fingertip gently touching a tender rosemary sprig. Caption: "CLOSE-UP · FINGERTIP CONTACT". Quote: "A gentle touch, handful of fragrance."
7. Stage label: "Growth". Image: overhead photo of a woody rosemary branch with green branching needles. Caption: "OVERHEAD · BRANCHING STRUCTURE". Quote: "One year bone, two years flesh."
8. Stage label: "Flourishing". Image: medium shot of a rosemary plant in a terracotta pot with small purple-blue flowers and a bee approaching or hovering near the blooms. Caption: "MEDIUM SHOT · BEE ENTRANCE". Quote: "When flowers open, the whole garden arrives."
9. Stage label: "Flourishing". Image: wide shot of rosemary on a rustic wooden surface in golden sunlight, strong leaf shadows across the boards. Caption: "WIDE · LIGHT & SHADOW CONTRAST". Quote: "Dialogue of light and leaf, repeated daily."
10. Stage label: "Flourishing". Image: close-up of pruning shears cutting a rosemary stem while a hand holds the sprig. Caption: "CLOSE-UP · SCISSORS & STEM". Quote: "Pruning is not an end, it's another beginning."
11. Stage label: "Harvesting". Image: medium shot of a bundled rosemary bunch hanging upside down in a rustic shed or wooden room to dry. Caption: "MEDIUM SHOT · HANGING DRY". Quote: "Drying time, leave it to the wind."
12. Stage label: "Harvesting". Image: wide still-life composition with dried rosemary spilling from a small linen drawstring pouch beside a terracotta pot. Caption: "WIDE · STILL LIFE COMPOSITION". Quote: "Aroma sealed, awaiting the next awakening."

Visual style: Photorealistic macro garden photography mixed with hand-crafted editorial scrapbook design, shallow depth of field, soft natural window light, earthy terracotta browns, rosemary greens, muted purple blossoms, warm sunlight, gentle film grain, slightly imperfect handwritten annotations.

Constraints: Keep the grid aligned and readable, use exactly 12 panels and no extra panels, avoid modern UI elements, avoid watermarks, avoid logos, preserve the vintage botanical journal feeling. Make all visible text legible and in English.

2117903200341231153.promptEn:
Create a vertical, richly detailed anime storybook illustration of cute pet birds mining emerald crystals on a sunny mountain cliff. The scene is a cheerful fantasy mining site with rocky terrain, sparkling green gems, wooden equipment, and a bright blue sky. Use a warm, polished Japanese anime style with soft outlines, expressive faces, luminous highlights, and high-detail natural textures.

Canvas: vertical 2:3 composition, tall poster framing, bright daylight. Put the sun in the upper left with lens flare, blue sky and white clouds behind jagged green mountains. The rocky cliff rises up the right side and background, with a dark mine entrance in the mid-right rock face and a small wooden lookout platform near the upper right.

Main subject: In the center foreground, place a joyful cream cockatiel with yellow crest and orange cheeks, wearing a miner belt with small tools and pouches, holding up one oversized faceted emerald crystal that sparkles with a starburst. This central bird is the largest figure and the focal point.

Bird count and roles: Show exactly 9 cute birds on the ground/cliff plus 4 small seabirds flying in the sky. The 9 main birds are: 1 central cream cockatiel proudly lifting the giant emerald; 1 blue-and-white budgie on the right reading an old treasure map with a red X; 1 dusty pink Java sparrow on the left drinking from a blue water bottle; 1 small pale yellow chick at lower left-center wearing a yellow scarf and holding a pickaxe; 1 teal-and-blue budgie at the bottom left wearing a tiny backpack; 1 green peach-faced lovebird at lower left holding a hammer; 1 green peach-faced lovebird at lower center-right using a pickaxe on the stones; 1 small white cockatiel on the right with a pink flower near its head, standing by a mine cart full of gems; 1 tiny white bird wearing a yellow miner helmet on the high wooden platform.

Environment and objects: Include a rustic wooden crane on the left with ropes and a suspended metal cage bucket. Include exactly 2 wooden mine carts or crates filled with emeralds: one near the right bird and one at the lower right. Include 1 hanging lantern glowing at the bottom right, 1 wooden sign at bottom left with a simple crystal drawing and small bird doodle, 1 broken wooden rail or beam across the bottom foreground, and 1 coiled rope tied to a post. Place emerald crystals throughout the scene: 1 giant emerald in the central bird’s wings, 1 large embedded emerald on the right cliff, 1 medium emerald cluster beside the mine entrance, 1 crystal cluster in the right mine cart, 1 crystal cluster in the lower-right crate, 1 cluster near the green bird with the hammer, 1 cluster near the green bird with the pickaxe, 2 clusters along the lower foreground, and small green sparkle flecks on the cliff.

Mood and lighting: Make everything whimsical, adventurous, and optimistic. Crystals should glow translucent emerald green with bright white specular glints. Use sunlit rim lighting, soft shadows, warm highlights on feathers, and detailed rocky textures. Keep the birds round, adorable, and expressive, with oversized glossy eyes and tiny feet.

Customizable details: The main crystal color should be emerald green. The central bird species should be cream cockatiel. The setting should be sunny mountain emerald mine. The art style should be polished Japanese anime storybook illustration. The mood should be cheerful treasure-hunting adventure.

Constraints: no humans, no text labels except the simple crystal drawing on the sign, no watermark, no photorealism, no dark horror tone, keep the composition dense but readable.

2117903200341231157.promptEn:
Goal: Create an ultra-high-quality anime cooking storyboard sheet for a 15-second food video about jiggly extra-thick soufflé pancakes.

Canvas: One wide horizontal 21:9 storyboard sheet with a black outer border and thin black grid lines. Arrange exactly 12 panels in chronological order, in a 3-row by 4-column grid. Each panel is cinematic, warm, golden, highly detailed, with shallow depth of field, glossy food highlights, steam, sparkles, and realistic anime-style rendering.

Visual style: Premium Japanese anime food commercial look, painterly-realistic textures, close-up camera angles, warm morning kitchen lighting, amber reflections, soft bokeh background, appetizing macro detail, no captions, no panel numbers, no watermark.

Storyboard panels, exactly 12:
1. Ingredient flat lay: eggs in a wicker basket, milk, flour, sugar, butter cubes, vanilla, honey or syrup, berries, cream, and bowls on a rustic wooden table.
2. Egg separation close-up: hands crack an egg over a glass bowl, bright yolk suspended while egg white drips down.
3. Meringue whipping: electric beaters whip glossy white egg whites into stiff peaks, with splashes and sparkling highlights.
4. Batter folding: a spatula gently folds fluffy meringue into pale yellow pancake batter in a glass bowl.
5. Butter melting: a cube of butter sizzles and foams in a frying pan over a blue gas flame.
6. Batter piping/pouring: thick soufflé batter is poured into a tall mound in the pan, forming a soft spiral shape.
7. Covered steaming: the thick pancake cooks under a glass lid in the pan, condensation and steam visible, pancake rising high.
8. Flipping moment: a spatula lifts and flips a tall golden soufflé pancake, showing a browned top and airy sides, with flying crumbs and steam.
9. Browning close-up: extreme close-up of the pancake surface becoming evenly golden and crisp around the edges.
10. Stacking: three thick soufflé pancakes stacked on a white plate in a cozy sunlit kitchen, perfectly round and fluffy.
11. Final plating: stack topped with a square pat of butter and glossy syrup pouring down, surrounded by strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, powdered sugar, and a small whipped cream garnish.
12. Eating shot: fork cuts into the pancake, revealing soft airy interior; syrup flows over the cut edge, berries around the plate, dramatic appetizing close-up.

2117903200341231162.promptZh:
一张抓拍风格照片：一位年轻女子倚靠在上海石库门建筑上层的老虎窗开放式窗台边，真实日常生活摄影，自然抓拍瞬间。中景上半身构图，从下方中等距离仰拍——她将前臂搁在窗沿上，于傍晚时分眺望屋顶之下的街巷。

东亚裔年轻女性，二十出头。杏仁形双眼，带有自然双眼皮，眼尾略长；目光朝外、微向下投向下方弄堂，柔和而从容，神情流露着一种无需匆忙奔赴某处的闲适感。鼻梁挺直而精致，鼻梁纤细。肤色为白皙至浅米色（NC10–NC20）——在温暖的黄金时刻（golden hour）侧光下可见皮肤次表面散射（subsurface scattering），颧骨、鼻梁及一侧裸露肩头呈现细腻的镜面微高光（specular micro-highlights），粉底颗粒感（foundation powder grain）清晰可辨。洁净素颜的夏日肌肤，唇部泛着蜜桃色光泽，睫毛自然卷翘。

她身穿一件鼠尾草绿色短款罗纹针织吊带背心，配细可调节肩带；下着牛仔超短迷你裙。锁骨处佩戴两条精细叠搭的金色细链，长度略有差异。头发松散地半夹起，用爪形发夹固定，数缕发丝自然垂落于下颌线周围。她以一手轻托下巴，另一只手臂沿窗沿伸展——这是俯视街巷时最典型的姿态：既不无聊，也不警觉，只是纯粹沉浸于夏日时光之中。老虎窗窗框为老旧深色木制，略带风化痕迹；玻璃为旧式窗格，带有岁月沉淀的轻微光学畸变（optical distortion）。下方铺展着石库门建筑的屋脊线与烟囱顶。越过这些古老瓦片，在远处虚化的金色远景中，上海中心大厦与环球金融中心（SWFC）塔楼的标志性剪影在薄雾中浮现，呈暖琥珀色轮廓——现代与历史毫无歉意地共存于同一画幅之内。两三根发丝被屋顶午后微风轻轻吹离原位，自然而不刻意的不完美细节，并非几何对称分布。

温暖的低角度黄金时刻（golden hour）侧光，琥珀色光线勾勒出她的颧骨、裸露肩头顶部与金链轮廓；窗框在她小臂上投下修长阴影。整体氛围柔和而温暖，静谧满足——这是上海女孩独享的夏日傍晚私密欢愉，自弄堂上方静静凝望。阴影区域带有微妙的ISO 400胶片颗粒（film grain），呈现摄影噪点质感，而非CG渲染般的平滑感。画幅比例2:3。无水印、无文字叠加；非卡通、非数字绘画、非插画、非动漫风格。

Main subject: A small wide-eyed child adventurer wearing a bright blue hooded cloak, rugged boots, and a large woven basket backpack filled with acorns, berries, leaves, and forest trinkets. 10. Wide shot of the child running away across a narrow wooden suspension bridge high in the mushroom forest canopy.
11. Long shot of the child standing triumphantly on a huge orange mushroom cap above the forest, small against a sweeping magical landscape.

2117903200341231184.promptZh:
真实日常生活摄影，自然抓拍瞬间。一位年轻女性在横跨苏州古典园林荷花池的窄木制九曲桥上迈步行走的三分之二身长肖像。她正轻柔驻足——一只脚略向前伸，目光低垂望向水面。下方铺展着大片深绿色荷叶，叶缘缀有雨珠；水面上映出淡青色天空倒影。她右侧是一道经年变暗的低矮木质栏杆。

东亚裔年轻女性，二十出头。杏仁形双眼微垂，神情略带思索——既未微笑也未不悦，只是安然临在、全神沉浸。鼻梁挺直而雅致。晨间园林清冷光线中呈现白皙肤色。发髻优雅高挽成堕马髻，发顶交叉别着两枚细长发簪，耳际别一朵小白花。妆容轻盈雅致——近乎素颜，唇色为极淡中性色调。即使在清冷晨光下，皮肤次表面散射（subsurface scattering）依然可见，双颊透出淡淡内在暖意，镜面微高光（specular micro-highlights）被压低且柔和，细腻的粉底颗粒感清晰可辨。

她身穿一件无袖改良式旗袍，浅鼠尾草绿——一种低饱和、略带灰调的竹青色，非浓艳色调；立领配浅灰绿色盘扣，裙摆剪裁略宽松，垂坠柔顺，长度及小腿中部。双手自然垂于身侧，右手靠近栏杆。木桥桥板因岁月与湿气浸润而呈深色；荷花池占据画面下部背景，圆润荷叶层层叠叠，盛夏丰茂。远处岸线可见灰色园林砖墙及依稀垂柳轮廓。鬓角两三根细发被水边园林空气轻轻吹拂移位，弧度细小、不规则而柔软。

晨光自左侧方向投射——呈现清晨特有的冷暖过渡光色，在桥板上投下修长柔和阴影，并勾勒出下方荷叶外缘轮廓。水面倒影提供二次散射补光——淡雅而弥散——柔化了栏杆下方阴影区域，赋予整幅场景格外温润的 luminosity（光感）。整体氛围宁静从容，园林正沉浸于私密的晨间时刻。荷花池阴影区与深色桥木色调中带有微妙 ISO 400 胶片颗粒（film grain），呈现摄影噪点质感而非 CG 渲染般的平滑感。画幅比例 2:3。无水印，无文字叠加，非卡通风格，非数字绘画，非插画，非动漫风格。

2117903200341231188.promptEn:
Goal: Create a dark cinematic storyboard/contact sheet for an action-fantasy steampunk sequence starring Kai, continuing from a previous final frame with no reset: same stormy refinery environment, same lighting, same character position and wardrobe continuity.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 storyboard sheet, approximately 1200×675, black background with thin black gutters. Arrange exactly 12 widescreen panels in a 4-column by 3-row grid. Each panel has a cinematic frame above and a black caption strip below with small condensed white uppercase type, including a numbered shot title and two short description lines.

Visual style: Gritty high-detail concept art, dark dieselpunk/steampunk industrial fantasy, ash-filled sky, brown-black metal palette, orange power-cell glow, lightning-like energy arcs, smoke, dust, sparks, ruined refinery towers, massive machinery, collapsing platforms, dramatic low-key lighting, dynamic camera angles, film storyboard presentation.

Main character details: Kai is a spiky-haired young male warrior in ragged layered tactical clothing: dark cloak, straps, leather armor, metal gauntlets, utility belts, wind-torn scarf or coat tails, soot and grime on face, intense expression. He carries or activates a glowing cylindrical power cell with orange core energy. Keep him consistent across all panels.

Storyboard layout and text content: Include exactly 12 discrete panels with these labels and visible descriptions:

01. CONTINUATION - FINAL FRAME HOLD
Kai stands atop the refinery tower, type-R power cell activated.
Storm clouds gather. Wind builds.

02. CLOSE ON KAI
The power cell glows brighter.
Surface cracks. Pressure symbols illuminate.

03. EXTREME MACRO
Mechanical seams open.
Energy leaks. Electric arcs dance.

04. WIDE ENVIRONMENTAL
Distant refinery towers activate one by one.
Industrial lights ignite across the horizon.

05. LOW ANGLE
Massive smokestacks erupt, pressure valves release steam.
Ancient machinery awakens.

06. MEDIUM SHOT
Kai shields from the shockwave.
Coat and straps violently whip.

07. DYNAMIC SHOT
The platform beneath Kai begins to collapse.
Metal fractures spread.

08. HEROIC LEAP
Kai jumps from the collapsing tower.
Huge scale. Industrial city behind him.

09. TRACKING SHOT
Kai lands on a moving crane arm.
Debris falls through frame.

10. WIDE REVEAL
The ground erupts.
A gigantic industrial salvage automaton emerges.

11. EXTREME WIDE
Kai is tiny.
The automaton towers over the refinery wastes.

12. FINAL ICONIC SHOT
Kai raises the pneumatic cutter.
Power cell energy flows through the weapon.
The titan is fully awakened.
Dust storm engulfs the refinery city.

Shot-specific imagery: Panel 1 shows Kai from behind on a high circular railing overlooking a vast industrial wasteland, holding a small orange glowing cylinder. Panel 2 is a close-up of his gloved hand holding the glowing power cell near his face, with one soft blurred vertical rectangle obscuring part of the face area. Panel 3 is an extreme close-up of a metal machine surface marked with a large R, glowing orange cracks and arcs. Panel 4 shows a wide refinery skyline with many towers lighting up. Panel 5 uses a low angle on smokestacks venting steam and flame. Panel 6 shows Kai bracing against a violent blast with debris flying. Panel 7 shows a collapsing steel platform and tiny Kai amid fractured girders. Panel 8 shows Kai suspended mid-leap surrounded by shattered debris. Panel 9 tracks him crouched on a crane arm with chains and falling rubble. Panel 10 reveals a huge circular mechanical automaton head or torso rising from dust, orange core glowing. Panel 11 is an extreme wide silhouette of Kai on a bridge facing the towering automaton. Panel 12 is the heroic finale with Kai standing foreground, orange power glowing through his raised weapon, giant machine and refinery chaos behind him.

Constraints: Use exactly 12 panels, exactly the listed captions, no extra panels, no logos or watermarks. Maintain consistent character, environment, stormy lighting, orange energy motif, and black storyboard caption strips throughout.

2117903200341231193.promptEn: Create an ultra-tall vertical photorealistic image, about 1:4 aspect ratio, showing a massive silver heavy-lift rocket launching straight upward from a launch pad. Center the rocket perfectly against a nearly pure white overexposed sky, with the nose cone near the top and the base near the lower middle. Use a dramatic vertical 2:3 composition, extreme high-angle perspective looking down into glowing canyons of buildings, with the character dominating the foreground and centered slightly right. She has short tousled deep violet hair with yellow-gold underlayers and streaks, sharp golden eyes, pale skin, a serious defiant expression, and a small black headset microphone at her cheek. Outfit: black tactical streetwear with gold accents, including a high-collar oversized hooded jacket, cropped black top with strap details, choker, fingerless gloves, loose cargo pants, knee padding, heavy boots, belts, zippers, brass snaps, and a shield-like geometric insignia patch on the sleeve. Lighting is moody neon purple and amber, with strong rim light on hair and jacket edges, glossy fabric highlights, rain-damp rooftop reflections, and dense detail in the city windows. Background: towering skyscrapers packed with tiny lit windows, glowing purple holographic billboards, orange warning UI graphics, and a vast night skyline fading into darkness. Include exactly 4 prominent holographic screens: 1 large purple portrait screen of the same girl on the upper left, 1 smaller purple emblem/abstract symbol screen on the lower left, 1 orange warning triangle screen on the upper right, and 1 purple waveform/data screen on the mid-right. Style should be polished Japanese anime key art, intricate linework, cinematic depth, luminous cyberpunk atmosphere, ultra-detailed background, sharp focus on the character, no visible watermark, no extra readable text beyond abstract UI marks.
2117903200341231194.promptZh: 创作一幅高细节的动漫赛博朋克主视觉图，主角为灯火葵（Tomoshibi Kii）的短发版本：一位神情凌厉的年轻女性，蹲伏在摩天大楼屋顶狭窄的边缘上，俯瞰下方密集的未来主义都市夜景。采用富有戏剧性的竖构图（2:3），以极高的俯视视角向下拍摄，呈现建筑群如发光峡谷般的纵深感；人物占据前景并略微偏右居中。她留着凌乱的深紫短发，发内层与挑染为黄金色，双目锐利呈金色，肤色苍白，神情严肃而充满反抗意味，脸颊佩戴一副黑色头戴式麦克风耳机。服装为黑色战术街头风，缀以金色装饰：高领 oversized 连帽夹克、裁短的黑色上衣（带肩带细节）、项圈、露指手套、宽松工装裤、护膝、厚重靴子、多条腰带、拉链、黄铜按扣，以及袖子上一枚盾牌状几何徽章贴片。光影氛围阴郁而富张力，主色调为霓虹紫与琥珀色，发丝与夹克边缘有强烈的轮廓光（rim light），织物表面呈现高光质感，屋顶湿润反光映出雨痕，城市窗户细节密实丰富。背景为林立的摩天大楼，布满细小的亮窗，紫色全息广告牌熠熠生辉，橙色警告 UI 图形醒目浮现，浩瀚夜空天际线渐隐于幽暗之中。画面中须精确包含 4 块显著的全息屏幕：左上方为一块大型紫色肖像屏，显示同一女子；左下方为一块较小的紫色徽章/抽象符号屏；右上方为一块橙色警告三角形屏；右中部为一块紫色波形/数据屏。风格需为精修的日系动漫主视觉艺术（Japanese anime key art），线条细腻繁复，具备电影感纵深（cinematic depth），散发光芒四射的赛博朋克氛围（luminous cyberpunk atmosphere），背景超精细，人物主体锐利聚焦，无可见水印，除抽象 UI 标记外不出现任何其他可读文字。

2117903200341231195.promptEn:
Goal: Create a monochrome cooking storyboard illustration showing the preparation and serving of a Japanese-style katsudon rice bowl, drawn like a detailed manga storyboard or recipe process sheet.

Canvas: Wide horizontal aspect ratio, about 2.4:1, white background, arranged as exactly 12 rectangular panels in a clean grid: 6 panels across the top row and 6 panels across the bottom row. Thin black borders separate every panel. No captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark.

Visual style: Highly detailed pencil sketch and light watercolor-wash look, mostly grayscale with subtle warm beige tones in the egg sauce and fried cutlet. Fine crosshatching, visible paper texture, realistic hand-drawn food textures, steam, highlights on oil and sauce, cinematic close-up framing in every panel.

Subject: A step-by-step cooking sequence for katsudon, featuring sliced onion, breaded pork cutlet, simmering egg sauce, rice, and garnish. Use realistic adult hands when hands appear, cropped close to the food.

Panel layout and exact panel count: Show exactly 12 panels, ordered left to right, top row then bottom row:
1. Close-up of hands slicing a pale onion into thin crescent slices on a cutting board with a large kitchen knife.
2. Close-up of a breaded pork cutlet on a cutting board, held with tongs, covered in coarse crispy crumbs.
3. Close-up of the fried cutlet being cut into thick strips with a knife, fingers holding it steady.
4. Top-down close-up of clear liquid or broth being poured into a round metal pan, creating circular ripples.
5. Close-up of sliced onions simmering in bubbling broth in the pan, steam rising.
6. Close-up of the sliced cutlet being placed on top of the onions in the pan by hand.
7. Close-up of beaten egg mixture being poured over the cutlet and onions, creamy ribbons spreading through the pan.
8. Close-up of a metal lid covering the pan while steam surrounds the edges.
9. Close-up of a large bowl filled with fluffy white rice, rice grains clearly defined.
10. Close-up of the cooked cutlet, onion, and soft egg mixture being slid from the pan onto the rice bowl, strands of egg stretching.
11. Close-up of the finished bowl being sprinkled with thin dark seaweed strips and green garnish on top, steam rising.
12. Close-up serving shot of chopsticks lifting one saucy slice of cutlet with soft egg dripping, the rice bowl visible underneath.

Composition constraints: Keep each panel tightly framed and food-focused; maintain consistent lighting and hand-drawn pencil shading across all panels; make the sequence readable as a recipe storyboard; do not add text labels, numbers, extra panels, utensils not described, or colorful modern graphics.

2117903200341231196.promptEn:
Goal: Create a highly detailed vertical composite photo showing the life progression of the same Chinese male from birth to adulthood, with six separate age-stage figures arranged in a rising diagonal timeline. Maintain strong facial-structure continuity across all six versions of the same person, while making age, body size, clothing, posture, and hairstyle appropriate for each stage.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 portrait composition, cinematic studio-photography quality, warm golden light in the upper right fading into cool blue-gray mist in the lower left, subtle starry dust and smoky atmospheric background, soft depth of field, elegant inspirational tone.

Layout: Arrange exactly 6 figures from bottom-left to top-right, increasing in age and height. The youngest baby is at the bottom-left foreground, the toddler stands above and slightly right, the elementary-school child stands behind, the teenager stands higher in the center, the young adult is upper-right center, and the mature adult is tallest at the top-right. Use overlapping bodies and scale changes to create a continuous life staircase.

Subjects: Exactly 6 visible versions of the same male:
1. Newborn, 0 months: sleeping infant wrapped in a pale blue swaddle, lying on a fluffy cream blanket at the bottom-left.
2. Curious toddler, 1–2 years: standing child in a dark blue striped one-piece outfit, small hands raised slightly, short black hair.
3. Happy elementary-school student, 6–8 years: child wearing a navy polo shirt and backpack straps, standing confidently.
4. Teenager, 14–17 years: school-age boy wearing a navy zip-up hoodie with a school crest, white shirt, striped tie, neat short hair.
5. College-life young adult, 20–30 years: young man wearing a crisp white open-collar shirt, modern short black hair, relaxed posture.
6. Confident mature adult, 57 years: tall mature man in a dark business suit, white shirt, tie, pocket square, standing upright and dignified.

Text content: Add exactly 6 translucent rounded-rectangle Chinese labels on the left side, each connected to the matching figure by a thin horizontal line and small dot. Use white serif-style Chinese text. The labels must read, from top to bottom: 「自信的57岁成年人（成人）」, 「大学生络的年轻人（20-30岁）」, 「青少年（14-17岁）」, 「快乐的小学生（6-8岁）」, 「好奇的幼儿（1-2岁）」, 「熟睡的新生儿（0个月）」.

Visual style: Photorealistic composite portrait, high-end commercial retouching, soft rim light, realistic clothing texture, natural skin tones, coherent lighting across all age stages, gentle mist around the lower figures, warm halo around the adult at the top-right.

Constraints: Keep exactly six figures and exactly six matching labels. Do not add extra people, panels, borders, logos, watermarks, or unrelated objects. The faces should be visible and consistent unless intentionally anonymized with plain skin-tone rectangular blur masks over each face.

2117903200341231197.promptEn:
Goal: Create a nostalgic pastel Japanese height-difference comparison illustration for two best friends, with a central measuring ruler and cute profile poses.

Canvas: Vertical portrait image, soft pale pink paper-textured background, delicate brown line art, watercolor/anime fashion illustration style, gentle vintage stationery aesthetic. Add a faint small “Ai” mark in the upper-left corner.

Layout: Center a tall decorative height ruler from 0 cm to 200 cm, topped with the vertical Japanese title 「身長計」. Place exactly 2 full-body girls in side profile facing each other: the shorter girl on the left and the taller girl on the right. Draw dashed horizontal guide lines from each girl’s head to the ruler. Add exactly 2 ornate name-and-height cards near the top, one left and one right. Add exactly 2 cloud-shaped thought bubbles near the lower sides, one for each girl. Add a small bottom plaque centered under the ruler.

Central height ruler details: A narrow cream-colored vertical ruler with ornate corners and thin brown border. Mark every 10 cm from 0 cm to 200 cm with labels: 0 cm, 10 cm, 20 cm, 30 cm, 40 cm, 50 cm, 60 cm, 70 cm, 80 cm, 90 cm, 100 cm, 110 cm, 120 cm, 130 cm, 140 cm, 150 cm, 160 cm, 165 cm, 170 cm, 180 cm, 190 cm, 200 cm. Include small tick marks between labels. The shorter girl’s dashed line aligns at 150 cm, and the taller girl’s dashed line aligns at 160 cm.

Left character: A petite girl named ひな, height 150cm. She stands in profile facing right, hands relaxed at her sides, wearing a white short-sleeve blouse under a dark blue denim overall dress, loose white socks, and black high-top sneakers. She has long dark brown hair in a high ponytail with soft strands and a small scrunchie. Her face is intentionally obscured with a soft square blur.

Right character: A taller girl named あおい, height 160cm. She stands in profile facing left with a relaxed posture, hands in pockets, wearing an oversized beige knit sweater, loose faded blue jeans, and black-and-white low-top sneakers. She has long dark brown hair tied in a high ponytail with wispy bangs and flowing strands. Her face is intentionally obscured with a soft square blur.

Text content: Use Japanese text exactly as visible. Left top card has “Name”, 「ひな」, “Height”, “150cm”. Right top card has “Name”, 「あおい」, “Height”, “160cm”. Left thought bubble says 「あおい、まだ背が伸びた？羨ましいな…」. Right thought bubble says 「ひなはこのままで可愛いよ♡」. Bottom plaque says 大親友, with a small heart icon on each side.

Style constraints: Keep the illustration delicate, soft, and feminine; use muted browns for outlines and text, cream panels, and pastel pink background. Maintain clean readable typography with a Japanese serif feel. Do not add extra characters, extra cards, extra speech bubbles, or additional decorative objects beyond the hearts and simple ornamental borders.

2117903200341231198.promptEn: Create a meticulously detailed vertical composite studio photograph showing the life progression of the same female person from birth to mature adulthood, with all ages sharing the same recognizable identity, facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, and family resemblance. Canvas: portrait orientation, about 3:4, cinematic fine-art photography. Composition: arrange exactly 6 versions of the same person in a diagonal ascending timeline from the lower left foreground to the upper right background, each progressively larger and older, partially overlapping like a layered generational portrait. The 6 labeled stages must be: 1) “Newborn Baby (0 Months)” at the bottom left, swaddled in a soft white blanket and lying curled in a shallow nest-like wrap; 2) “Toddler (1–2 Years)” seated just above, wearing a navy-and-white striped long-sleeve shirt, curly dark hair, small bare legs visible; 3) “Cheerful School Kid (6–8 Years)” standing behind the toddler, wearing a navy polo shirt and carrying a pink backpack strap over one shoulder; 4) “Teenager (14–17 Years)” behind the school kid, with long dark hair, wearing a dark navy hoodie; 5) “College-Age Young Adult (20–30 Years)” behind and to the right, wearing a crisp white button-up blouse, confident neutral pose; 6) “Confident 57-Year-Old Adult (Adult)” tallest at the upper right, with long wavy salt-and-pepper hair, wearing a black blazer over a white collared shirt. Add small elegant white serif labels beside each figure on the left or near the corresponding head, matching the exact stage text above. Lighting and mood: dramatic Rembrandt-style studio light from the upper right, warm golden rim light on the right side, cool blue shadow tones on the left, soft haze and brown smoky atmosphere rising from the lower right. Background: painterly textured gradient backdrop transitioning from deep blue on the left to warm amber-brown on the right, with subtle vignette. Faces should be visible, realistic, and consistent across ages, with natural skin texture and age-appropriate hair, proportions, and clothing. Use photorealistic detail, shallow depth of field, premium portrait retouching, no extra people, no watermark, no border, no additional text beyond the 6 labels.
2117903200341231198.promptZh: 创作一幅精心雕琢的垂直构图影棚合成照片，展现同一女性从出生到成熟成年的生命历程；所有年龄段均须保持可识别的同一身份、面部结构、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色及家族相貌特征。画布：人像竖构图，比例约为3:4，电影感（cinematic）精细艺术摄影（fine-art photography）。构图：在画面中自左下前景至右上背景，沿对角线方向排列恰好6个该女性不同年龄阶段的形象，构成一条递进式上升的时间轴；每个形象依年龄顺序逐级变大、变年长，并呈层叠式部分重叠，形如代际叠加肖像。这6个标有文字的阶段必须为：1）“Newborn Baby (0 Months)”位于左下角，裹在柔软的白色襁褓中，蜷身卧于浅窝状包裹内；2）“学步期幼儿（1–2岁）”坐于其正上方，身穿海蓝与白色条纹长袖衬衫，卷曲的深色头发，露出细小的赤裸双腿；3）“开朗的小学生（6–8岁）”立于幼儿后方，身穿海蓝色Polo衫，单肩斜挎粉色背包带；4）“青少年（14–17岁）”立于小学生后方，长而深色的头发，身穿深海蓝色连帽衫；5）“大学龄青年（20–30岁）”位于小学生后方偏右位置，身穿挺括的白色纽扣衬衫，姿态自信、神情中性；6）“自信的57岁成年人（成年期）”体型最高，位于右上角，长而波浪状的灰白相间发丝，身着黑色西装外套，内搭白色立领衬衫。在每位人物左侧或其头部附近添加小巧雅致的白色衬线体标签，文字内容须严格对应上述各阶段名称。布光与氛围：采用戏剧性的伦勃朗式（Rembrandt-style）影棚布光（studio lighting），主光源来自右上方，右侧边缘施以温暖金色轮廓光（rim light），左侧投射冷调蓝色阴影，整体笼罩柔和薄雾，并有棕褐色烟霭自右下角缓缓升腾。背景：手绘质感渐变幕布，由左侧深蓝色平滑过渡至右侧暖琥珀棕色，辅以微妙暗角（vignette）。所有面部须清晰可见、高度写实且跨年龄段一致，呈现自然肌肤纹理，以及符合各年龄段特征的发型、身体比例与服饰。采用照片级写实（photorealistic）细节表现、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、高端人像精修（premium portrait retouching），画面中不得出现额外人物、水印、边框，亦不得添加除上述6处标签外的任何其他文字。

2117903200341231224.promptEn:
Goal: Create a detailed vintage illustrated visual reference sheet for Croissant in a warm hand-drawn Studio Ghibli style, like a pastry-making guide from an old cookbook.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 composition on warm cream parchment paper, with thin brown rounded panel borders, muted sepia ink outlines, soft watercolor shading, and cozy bakery lighting. Use an off-white background with subtle paper texture.

Header: Large bold hand-lettered title at the top left reading “CROISSANT”. Beneath it, smaller uppercase subtitle: “VISUAL REFERENCE SHEET – STUDIO GHIBLI STYLE”, flanked by small decorative leaf sprigs.

Layout: Divide the sheet into 5 main areas: 1 large ingredients panel on the upper left, 1 tools panel on the lower left, 1 color palette strip along the bottom left, 1 large finished croissant showcase panel on the upper right, and 1 making process panel with 5 numbered steps on the lower right.

Ingredients panel: Label the panel “INGREDIENTS”. Show exactly 6 ingredient illustrations arranged left to right, each with a bold uppercase label and a short note: 1) raw dough ball, smooth and pale, dusted with flour; 2) flat beaten butter, pale yellow and cold; 3) rolled out dough, thin and even rectangular sheet; 4) dough triangle, before rolling; 5) raw crescent, unbaked and pale soft; 6) baked croissant, golden and flaky with caramelized surface.

Tools panel: Label the panel “TOOLS”. Show exactly 5 tools arranged left to right: 1) wooden rolling pin, captioned for rolling dough evenly; 2) pastry knife with wooden handle, captioned sharp blade for clean cuts; 3) metal baking tray lined with parchment paper; 4) pastry brush with wooden handle, captioned for egg wash application; 5) brick oven with glowing fire, captioned high heat for baking.

Finished croissant panel: Label it “FINISHED CROISSANT”. Show one large finished croissant on a white oval plate, angled slightly from lower left to upper right. The croissant is oversized, glossy, golden brown, crescent-shaped, with many visible laminated layers, darker caramelized ridges, flaky cracks, toasted spots, and a soft shadow on the plate.

Making process panel: Label it “MAKING PROCESS”. Include exactly 5 vertical numbered cards from left to right, each with a dark circular number badge and a small illustration above text: 1) “BEAT BUTTER FLAT” showing a square block of butter on parchment, note that butter is beaten between sheets until flat and even in a square; 2) “WRAP AND SEAL” showing dough folded around butter, note to place butter in the center of rolled dough and seal edges tightly; 3) “FOLD AND ROLL” showing a folded laminated dough stack, note to fold dough and roll out and repeat several times to build layers; 4) “CUT AND SHAPE” showing long dough triangles and a raw crescent, note to cut into triangles and roll up from base to tip; 5) “EGG WASH AND BAKE” showing several croissants on a baking tray, note to brush with egg wash and bake until golden and flaky.

Color palette strip: Label it “COLOR PALETTE”. Show exactly 7 circular color swatches with names and hex codes: 1) Dough Cream #F5ECD7, 2) Butter Yellow #F5C518, 3) Baked Gold #D4A55A, 4) Caramel Crust #8B5E3C, 5) Flaky Interior #FAF3E0, 6) Parchment White #F9F6F0, 7) Char Brown #3D1F0A.

Typography and style: Use bold condensed hand-drawn uppercase lettering for labels, smaller neat handwritten captions, dark chocolate-brown ink, rounded cream label tabs, and consistent old-fashioned bakery reference-sheet design. Keep all illustrations charming, clean, and readable, with soft painterly shadows and warm amber highlights.

Constraints: Include no people, no photorealism, no modern UI elements, no watermark, and no extra sections beyond the described 5 main areas. Keep all visible English text legible and spelled correctly.

2117903200341231226.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cute vertical slice-of-life Chinese webcomic about a boy measuring his height and realizing he has grown, in a soft hand-drawn manga style.

Canvas: Tall vertical comic page, roughly 2:3 aspect ratio, white paper background, thick slightly wobbly black panel borders, watercolor pencil texture, light pastel colors, expressive chibi proportions, clean but sketchy line art.

Main characters: A young boy named unnamed boy, about 10–12 years old, short messy black hair, pale skin, rosy cheeks, wearing an oversized light blue T-shirt, loose blue-gray pants, and white sneakers. A cute anthropomorphic measuring tape device named measuring tape companion, shaped like a round mint-green tape measure with a white face, huge sparkling eyes, blush, tiny side knobs, and a flexible yellow measuring tape tongue/arm.

Layout: Use exactly 8 comic panels arranged in an irregular vertical strip layout. Panel 1 is a large panel at top left; panels 2 and 3 are stacked at top right; panel 4 is wide middle-left; panel 5 is middle-right; panel 6 is a full-width dramatic reaction panel; panels 7 and 8 are the bottom row, left and right.

Panel details and visible text, exactly 8 panels:
1. Large top-left panel: The boy stands in his bedroom near a desk and wall, looking down and tugging the hem of his oversized shirt as if surprised it feels shorter. Add a vertical wall mark labeled “去年” meaning last year. Speech bubble: “咦？裤脚变短了…”
2. Top-right panel: The boy sits at a desk facing the cute tape-measure companion, who smiles excitedly with sparkles around it. Speech bubble from the companion: “量量看！”
3. Right column second panel: The boy stands straight against a wall with a book balanced on his head while the measuring companion sits by his feet with its tape stretched upward like a height ruler. Speech bubble from the companion: “别踮脚。”
4. Middle-left panel: Side view close-up of the boy nervously facing the measuring tape, sweat drops on his cheek; the tape bends upward from the companion’s mouth toward the wall. Add the wall label “去年”. Speech bubble from boy: “不会吧…”
5. Middle-right panel: Close-up of a vertical height ruler with centimeter markings around 166–171, showing last year and this year comparison. Red handwritten label “今年!” at the top, black label “去年” lower down. The companion looks thrilled beside it. Speech bubble: “过线了！”
6. Full-width dramatic panel: The companion’s huge sparkling eyes appear on the left while the boy on the right gasps with wide eyes and sweat, hand on chest. Big red handwritten announcement text in the center: “长高7厘米!” Speech bubble from boy: “真…真的?”
7. Bottom-left panel: The boy happily reaches up to a high shelf to grab a box labeled “巧克力饼干”, with motion ghosting showing his stretching movement. Speech bubble from boy: “我够到了—” Smaller speech bubble near him: “咦…声音也怪怪的？”
8. Bottom-right panel: The boy holds the cookie box, startled by his own voice, with a red impact burst above his head. The measuring companion on the right is shocked, sweating and holding out its little tape. Large red sound effect: “咳!” Caption bubble near bottom: “长高第一天。”

Visual style: Warm humorous coming-of-age tone, Chinese manhua strip aesthetic, rounded speech bubbles, handwritten Chinese lettering, soft gray shadows, pale blue room details, minimal background furniture, no photorealism, no 3D render, no extra panels, no extra characters, no watermark.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal thumbnail, dark premium editorial look, high contrast, no border or watermark.

Put the main headline in the center-right, large and layered over the dark background. Place the product lineup on the far right bottom on a dark stone pedestal.

Top group: a black slanted rectangular banner with small bold white Japanese text: 「どれ選べばいいか分からない男へ。」 Main group: very large white Japanese Mincho-style serif text with subtle drop shadow: 「女性100人が」 on the first line and 「ガチで選んだ」 on the second line. Highlight group: large metallic gold serif text with quotation marks: 「30代の清潔感」, followed below by large white text: 「の正解。」 Make the gold phrase the strongest focal point after the model.

All products are unlabeled, minimal, premium, and softly rim-lit.

Visual style: Dark charcoal-blue background with a diagonal spotlight beam from the upper right, subtle smoky haze around the center text, premium black-and-gold color palette, realistic commercial photography, glossy but restrained highlights, crisp typography.

Customizable headline parameters: Use どれ選べばいいか分からない男へ。, 女性100人が\nガチで選んだ, 「30代の清潔感」, and の正解。.

Constraints: Keep the composition uncluttered, ensure all Japanese text is large and legible, do not add extra labels to the products, do not add logos, do not add more than one person, and keep exactly 4 visible product containers.

2117903200341231228.promptEn: Create a Pixar-style 3D animation storyboard image in 4×2 grid layout (4 columns × 2 rows, numbered left to right, top row first), containing exactly 8 panels with thin black borders (3px). Overall image aspect ratio 9:8 (e.g., 2160×1920); each panel is a strict 9:16 vertical composition. Background: white. Each panel labeled with a bold black number (top-left inside frame). Visual style (apply consistently to all panels): high-end 3D animated feature film look, soft rounded shapes, subsurface-scattering skin, big expressive eyes, dreamy bloom lighting, clean pink-and-white pastel palette with champagne-gold accents, soft natural window light, premium luxury K-beauty vibe. Recurring elements (keep identical in every panel): - Character: cheerful young woman, stylized 3D animation proportions, warm brown bob hair, rosy cheeks, white knit top, friendly big eyes. - Product: "KINU" luxury serum — tall slender thick-walled frosted crystal glass bottle with subtle vertical facets, a rose-gold metal collar at the neck, a weighty rose-gold dropper cap, and a small embossed label with gold-foil serif logotype. - Packaging: rigid magnetic-closure box in pearl-white with champagne-gold trim, blush-pink satin lining inside. - Setting: bright white vanity table with pink and gold accents, soft morning light. Exact content for each panel: Panel 1: Luxury unboxing — the pearl-white magnetic box opening to reveal the bottle nestled in blush-pink satin, her hands lifting it out gracefully, delighted expression in soft focus behind. Panel 2: Hero close-up — the KINU bottle now standing on the vanity, faceted frosted glass softly glistening in the morning window light, rose-gold collar catching a warm highlight, shallow depth of field. No falling or rolling drops. Panel 3: Macro close-up — the rose-gold dropper nozzle releasing one perfect glistening drop, light refracting through it like morning dew. Panel 4: Texture demonstration — a glossy translucent drop spreading on the back of her hand, fingertip gently touching it, silky jelly-like sheen. Panel 5: Application — she pats the serum onto her cheeks with both hands, eyes closed, serene smile, tiny sparkle particles in the air. Panel 6: Glow shot — close-up of her smiling face with dewy, luminous-looking cheeks catching the window light, happy relaxed expression. Panel 7: Experience shot — she leans back in her chair hugging the bottle lightly, eyes closed in contentment, soft pink-and-gold bokeh background. Panel 8: Final recommendation — she faces the camera holding the bottle beside her face, bright wink and warm smile, gentle push-in framing. Overall: ultra-sharp quality, professional storyboard style, consistent character and product design across all 8 panels. No watermarks. No extra text outside panel labels. quality: high Shot count: 8 | Duration: 15s | Aspect ratio: 9:16 Use the provided 8-panel Pixar-style 3D animation storyboard @kinu_storyboard.png as direct sequential visual keyframe reference for the entire 15s cinematic animation. Follow the exact panel progression, composition rhythm, and emotional pacing from the storyboard while smoothly interpolating all motion between poses with high-quality feature-animation motion. Maintain the SAME character and product throughout every shot — identical facial identity, warm brown bob hair, white knit top, rosy cheeks, and the identical KINU luxury serum bottle: tall faceted frosted crystal glass, rose-gold metal collar, rose-gold dropper cap, gold-foil embossed label, same bright white vanity room with soft morning window light in every shot. VOICE: A single Japanese female voiceover — young, soft, warm and friendly review tone. Only 4 short lines across the whole video, placed as noted below, with calm pauses between them. No lip sync required; the character does not speak on camera. Delivery is unhurried and gentle. STYLE: Pixar-quality 3D rendering, soft squash-and-stretch, expressive character acting, dreamy bloom lighting, clean pink-and-white pastel palette with champagne-gold accents, glossy liquid simulation, subsurface-scattering skin, refined luxury commercial mood, cinematic depth of field, smooth editorial transitions, unhurried elegant pacing. FOCUS: liquid and texture realism (serum sheen, silky spread), premium material detail (frosted glass facets, rose-gold metal, satin lining), gentle elegant hand movement, charming facial expressions, consistent product design, soft sparkle particles. [0s – 1.8s] SHOT 1 — LUXURY UNBOXING. The pearl-white magnetic box opens smoothly to reveal the KINU bottle nestled in blush-pink satin. Her hands lift it out gracefully, her delighted face in soft focus behind. Camera: fixed, shallow depth of field. [1.8s – 3.5s] SHOT 2 — PRODUCT HERO. She sets the bottle down on the white vanity. It stands still, faceted frosted glass softly glistening in the morning window light, rose-gold collar catching a warm highlight. No falling drops. Camera: slow push-in. Voiceover (bright, Japanese): "New serum, KINU." [3.5s – 5.5s] SHOT 3 — NOZZLE MACRO. Extreme macro of the rose-gold dropper releasing one perfect glistening drop, light refracting through it like morning dew. Camera: fixed macro. [5.5s – 7.5s] SHOT 4 — TEXTURE DEMO. A glossy translucent drop spreads slowly on the back of her hand, her fingertip touches it gently, silky jelly-like sheen stretching. Camera: slow orbit. Voiceover (soft, Japanese): "Melts in smoothly like silk." [7.5s – 9.5s] SHOT 5 — APPLICATION. She pats the serum onto her cheeks with both hands, eyes closed, serene smile, tiny sparkle particles drifting. Camera: gentle push-in. [9.5s – 11.5s] SHOT 6 — GLOW SHOT. Close-up of her smiling face, dewy luminous-looking cheeks catching the window light, happy relaxed expression. Camera: slow push-in. Voiceover (happy, Japanese): "Moisturized and bright impression." [11.5s – 13.5s] SHOT 7 — EXPERIENCE. She leans back hugging the bottle lightly, eyes closed in contentment, soft pink-and-gold bokeh glowing behind her. Camera: slow pull-out. [13.5s – 15s] SHOT 8 — FINAL RECOMMENDATION. She faces the camera holding the bottle beside her face, gives a bright wink and warm smile. Camera: gentle push-in to medium close-up. Voiceover (cheerful, Japanese): "Check it out!" Avoid: jitter, distortion, blur, deformation, character drift, robotic voice. NO SUBTITLES. NO TEXT ON SCREEN. NO CAPTIONS. NO OPENING TITLES. NO END TITLES. NO WATERMARKS. NO UI ELEMENTS. NO SPEECH BUBBLES. All storytelling is conveyed through cinematic visuals, the 4 Japanese voiceover lines specified above, and soft ambient sound design (gentle room tone, subtle liquid and fabric sounds, light airy background music).

2117903200341231229.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vertical pixel-art sci-fi music sequencer interface showing four cute monster audio tracks, like a retro game synth dashboard.

Canvas: Tall portrait mobile screen, 720×1200 style, dark navy background with glowing rounded rectangular panels and crisp pixel-art edges. Use a limited neon palette with cyan, mint, red, purple, and yellow accents. Everything should look like high-resolution pixel art, with subtle scanline/dither texture and no photorealism.

Layout: At the very top, create one wide rounded header bar. Inside it place exactly 6 discrete control/readout elements: 1 small alien/robot face icon on the left, 1 dotted equalizer readout beside it, 3 square transport buttons in the center showing stop, play, and record icons, and 1 dotted menu/grid indicator on the right.

Main track area: Stack exactly 4 horizontal rounded track panels, each with a left track number and a vertical level meter, a monster character on the left, a circular dotted status control in the middle, and a large rotary knob on the right.

Track 1: Label number “1”. Mint/teal theme. The creature is a sleepy squat round monster with small horns/spikes, closed eyes, lying down, with “Z Z” sleep marks above it. The middle control is a dotted circular ring with a small center dot. The right knob has a pale yellow arc and one mint indicator dot near the top.

Track 2: Label number “2”. Red theme. The creature is a red one-eyed monster standing aggressively, mouth open with teeth, one arm raised and casting a crackling magical red orb above its hand. The middle control is a red dotted ring with a solid red center dot. The right knob has a red arc and one red indicator dot.

Track 3: Label number “3”. Cyan theme. The creature is a blue dancing one-eyed monster wearing headphones, smiling with a toothy mouth, arms raised, with exactly 2 floating music notes near its head. The middle control is a cyan dotted circle containing a play triangle. The right knob has a cyan arc and one cyan indicator dot.

Track 4: Label number “4”. Purple theme. The creature is a purple energetic monster with multiple ghosted afterimage duplicates behind it, big eyes, waving arms, small sparkle marks around it. The middle control is a purple dotted circle containing a play triangle. The right knob has a purple arc and one purple indicator dot plus a tiny triangular tick at the top.

Bottom mixer section: Create one wide rounded bottom panel. On the left, include exactly 1 square album-art tile with a glowing mint border, showing a floating mossy cube planet or asteroid with small orbiting rocks and tiny stars. To the right of the album art, arrange exactly 5 square effect buttons in one row: 1 purple concentric-circle/radar icon, 1 cyan vertical waveform/spectrum icon, 1 green pixel burst icon, 1 yellow audio waveform icon, and 1 yellow ringed planet icon. Beneath those buttons, add exactly 2 horizontal audio meters: the left meter has a microphone icon followed by green-to-yellow vertical bars, and the right meter has a speaker icon followed by green-to-yellow vertical bars, separated by a thin vertical divider.

Text content: Only include the visible track numbers “1”, “2”, “3”, and “4”; do not add readable labels or words besides the two “Z” sleep marks. Use abstract pixel icons rather than detailed typography.

Style constraints: Retro 16-bit pixel-art UI, dark futuristic synth console, glowing outlines, rounded panels, clean symmetry, high contrast, playful monster characters, no watermark, no realistic 3D rendering. Make the main accent color palette customizable: mint cyan, hot red, purple, deep navy, retro monster music sequencer.

2117903200341231230.promptEn: Create a clean premium product photograph of black Sennheiser over-ear wireless headphones standing upright at a three-quarter angle on a seamless light gray studio background. The headphones have a thick padded black leather headband with subtle stitching, soft oval memory-foam ear cushions, matte black yokes and hinges, and large circular earcups with a satin radial-brushed finish. Show exactly two earcups, one in front and one partially behind; the front earcup displays small centered white text reading SENNHEISER, and the upper hinge plate shows the stylized Sennheiser logo. Include small visible details: one USB-C port on the lower left earcup, tiny microphone/indicator holes, and realistic seams where the pads meet the cups. Layout: On the far left, place the title block reading “NEFRA” with the subtitle “— Desert Oracle —” and a short lore paragraph: “A wandering oracle from the endless dunes. She reads the flow of fate in the shifting sands and guides lost souls toward their destiny.” Beneath and beside this text, show one large full-body hero illustration of the character facing forward, holding the staff vertically. At the bottom left, include a color palette row labeled “COLOR PALETTE” with exactly 7 circular swatches: burnt terracotta, orange ochre, pale sand, warm ivory, taupe gray, near-black charcoal, and metallic gold.

Center turnaround section: Show exactly 3 smaller full-body model views labeled “FRONT”, “SIDE”, and “BACK”. They should depict the same character in consistent costume and proportions, standing neutrally, showing outfit construction from each angle.

Right reference section: At the upper right, include one large “HEAD CLOSE-UP” portrait showing her face, white hair, feather plume, gold forehead ornament, amber eyes, and heavy gold rectangular earrings. Below it, create an “EXPRESSIONS” row with exactly 3 small bust portraits: neutral serious expression, happy closed-eye smile, and surprised open-mouth expression.

Bottom reference section: Add an “ACCESSORIES” row with exactly 4 isolated accessory studies: a gold choker/headband-like jewelry piece with dangling tassels, an amber pendant necklace with tassels, a pair of cylindrical gold earrings, and a belt/waist ornament with chains and tassels. Visual style: High-end Japanese anime fantasy concept art, clean crisp linework, soft cel shading blended with painterly rendering, ornate gold material detail, delicate fabric transparency, luxurious desert-priestess design language, balanced negative space, consistent character proportions across all views.

Constraints: Keep all labels in English uppercase serif text; include exactly 1 hero full-body illustration, exactly 3 turnaround full-body views, exactly 1 head close-up, exactly 3 expression portraits, exactly 4 accessory items, exactly 2 staff-detail drawings, exactly 1 pattern-detail inset, and exactly 7 color swatches.
