Add exactly 2 separate yellow exclamation marks to the upper right of the kitten, exactly 2 small yellow sparkle icons, one on the left and one on the right, and exactly 3 short white motion lines near the right cheek. Use a vibrant anime sticker style, clean vector-like line art, warm orange gradients, high contrast, playful expression, no extra objects, no background pattern, no watermark.
2117903200341231291.promptZh: 在透明背景上创作一个可爱的卡哇伊（kawaii）贴纸插画，主角是一只兴奋的柴郡猫（chibi）橘色虎斑小猫，正做出夸张的反应。小猫居中、正面朝向观者，拥有橘色条纹毛发、奶油色口鼻部与腹部、粉红色内耳、巨大闪亮的琥珀色眼睛（含星形高光）、玫瑰色腮红、张开的快乐而惊讶的嘴巴，以及双前爪高举贴于脸颊。为整个角色及图形添加粗白边贴纸轮廓，并在外围配以细暗色阴影/边缘。左上方精确放置1个大型漫画文字“OMG!”，使用加粗圆润的黄橙色气泡字体，带黑色描边与白色外描边。右上方精确放置2个独立的黄色感叹号；左右两侧各精确放置1个小型黄色闪光图标（共2个）；右脸颊附近精确添加3条短白色动态线。采用鲜明活泼的动漫贴纸风格（anime sticker style），干净如矢量图般的线稿（vector-like line art），温暖的橘色渐变（orange gradients），高对比度（high contrast），俏皮的表情（playful expression），不添加额外物件、无背景图案、无水印。
2117903200341231291.author: eXphinx

2117903200341231293.promptEn: Create a photorealistic vertical portrait of a young East Asian woman sitting on lush green grass in a sunny park, leaning beside the thick trunk of a large tree on the right side of the frame. She has long straight black hair, fair skin, delicate natural makeup, and a calm slight smile while looking directly at the camera over her shoulder. She wears a flowing white halter sundress with an open back and thin tie straps; the translucent layered skirt spreads softly across the grass. Her body is seated in profile facing left, knees bent, hands resting near her lap while holding a black smartphone. The background is a bright green park with exactly 3 visible small tree trunks in the distance, dense leafy shrubs, dappled sunlight, and deep natural shadows under the canopy. Use realistic smartphone photography aesthetics, natural summer daylight, high detail in grass and bark texture, soft skin tones, gentle backlighting from the upper left, shallow-to-medium depth of field, candid elegant composition, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Avoid text, watermark, extra people, exaggerated glamour styling, or artificial studio lighting.
2117903200341231293.promptZh: 创作一幅照片级写实（photorealistic）的竖构图人像，画面主体为一名年轻东亚女性，坐在阳光明媚的公园中茂盛翠绿的草地上，身体倚靠在画面右侧一棵大树粗壮的树干旁。她拥有一头乌黑顺直的长发、白皙肌肤、精致自然的淡妆，面带平静而略含笑意的表情，微微侧身，目光越过肩头直视镜头。她身穿一袭飘逸的白色挂脖式夏日连衣裙，裙装后背敞开，配有纤细系带；半透明多层叠褶的裙摆轻柔铺展在草地上。她的身体呈左侧侧面坐姿，双膝弯曲，双手自然置于膝旁，手中握持一部黑色智能手机。背景为明亮青翠的公园景致：远景中清晰可见恰好三根小型树干，灌木枝叶浓密，阳光透过树叶形成斑驳光点（dappled sunlight），树冠下方投下深邃自然的阴影。采用真实智能手机摄影美学风格，自然夏日日光照明，草地与树皮纹理高度精细，肤色柔和，左上方施以柔和逆光（gentle backlighting），景深（depth of field）为浅至中等，构图呈现随性而优雅的抓拍感，竖幅 4:5 画幅比例。避免出现文字、水印、额外人物、过度华丽的时尚造型或影棚布光（studio lighting）。
2117903200341231293.author: Siyu

2117903200341231294.promptEn:
Goal: Create a dark, premium tech carousel slide promoting Social media carousels as video, branded as DSIV Music, with a cinematic desktop-production setup and instructional marketing copy.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, about 900 × 1200 px, black charcoal background with subtle grain, thin gray border, faint geometric arcs, crosshair marks, dotted grid accents, and warm amber highlight lines.

Layout: Use a left-heavy editorial layout with a product mockup on the right. Top left shows the brand text “DSIV” with “MUSIC” beneath it; top right shows “DSIVMUSIC.COM”. Under the brand, place the slide number “04” with a thin horizontal rule. Below that, add a small outlined amber pill label reading GPT Image 2 + HyperFrames. The main headline occupies the left center in very large bold white sans-serif type across four lines. Beneath it, add the subheading: Turn matching image slides into TikToks, Reels, and Shorts with motion, captions, and timing.

Right visual: Show a realistic dark monitor angled slightly in perspective on a desk, with a keyboard and small audio/control device in shadow. On the monitor, display a carousel-to-video editing interface: exactly 5 vertical slide cards across the top, numbered 01, 02, 03, 04, and 05. Card 01 reads “3 Codex prompts” with smaller text “music producers can actually use”; card 02 reads “Most AI prompts are too broad.”; card 03 reads “Generate better MIDI variations”; card 04 reads “Build a session roadmap”; card 05 is partially cropped and begins with “Turn...” as if continuing offscreen. Below the cards, show exactly 3 labeled timeline rows: “CAPTIONS”, “MUSIC / VO”, and “TRANSITIONS”, with beige caption blocks, an orange audio waveform, and small purple/gray transition blocks.

Middle-left section: Add a small amber divider line, then the spaced uppercase label “WHY IT WORKS”. Under it list exactly 2 benefits, each preceded by a circled plus icon: “One idea, many formats” and “Fast repurposing”.

Bottom section: Add a large rounded rectangle prompt box outlined in amber. Header text inside the box says “MAX PROMPT”. Body text uses a monospaced typewriter style and reads: “Generate 5–8 matching carousel slides for [TOPIC] with consistent typography, spacing, and visuals. Then create a HyperFrames sequence with slide timing, transition ideas, kinetic captions, music/VO timing, and deterministic render settings for a vertical short-form video.” End with a small terminal-style “>_”. Bottom left footer reads “@DSIVMUSIC”; bottom right has a small abstract circular DSIV-style mark.

Visual style: Sleek black-and-white SaaS/creator-economy aesthetic, high contrast typography, warm amber accents, subtle photographic realism on the monitor and desk, clean modern Swiss grid composition, cinematic lighting, crisp legible text, no extra logos beyond DSIV branding.
2117903200341231294.author: DSIV

2117903200341231295.promptEn:
Goal: Create a refined vertical exhibition poster combining a fashion-style photographic portrait with a minimalist line-art portrait for SILENCE IN FORM.

Canvas: Portrait orientation, approximately 3:4 aspect ratio. Use a warm ivory, beige, taupe, charcoal, and soft black palette with a quiet luxury editorial mood.

Layout: Split the design into 2 stacked sections. The top section occupies about 45% of the canvas and contains a realistic photographic portrait. The bottom section occupies about 55% and contains exhibition typography on the left with an illustrated portrait on the right. Keep generous negative space and clean margins.

Top section: Show a young East Asian male model from the chest up, centered slightly right, looking down toward the viewer with a calm, distant expression. He has medium-length wavy black hair, natural skin texture, soft lips, and a sculptural face. He wears an oversized off-white wool coat or robe with a high folded collar and broad shoulder volume. Lighting is soft directional sunlight from the upper left, casting muted shadows on a textured beige wall background. The photography should feel realistic, editorial, and understated.

Bottom section: Use an ivory background. On the right, create a large monochrome ink line illustration of the same model, cropped from upper torso to head, with expressive thin black contour lines, simplified facial features, and loose wavy hair. Add broad abstract coat shapes in beige, cream, taupe, and charcoal black beneath the line work, echoing the top garment. The illustration should overlap the right half and extend close to the lower edge.

Text content: Place exactly 6 visible text groups on the left side of the bottom section: 1) small uppercase label "EXHIBITION" near the top left; 2) very large elegant high-contrast serif title "SILENCE IN FORM" stacked on two lines; 3) spaced numerals "2024" below the title; 4) a short thin horizontal divider line; 5) small uppercase subtitle stacked as "PORTRAITS IN CONTEMPORARY IDENTITY"; 6) small uppercase venue text near the lower left reading "VERIDIAN GALLERY LONDON". Use refined editorial typography: the main title in a Didot/Bodoni-like serif, all other text in a small widely tracked sans serif.

Visual style: Minimalist museum poster, high-fashion editorial photography, fine-art exhibition branding, quiet neutral tones, paper-like texture, balanced asymmetry, crisp typography, no bright colors.

Constraints: Keep the top portrait photographic and the bottom portrait illustrated. Do not add extra people, extra text groups, logos, borders, watermarks, or decorative elements beyond the single divider line and abstract coat shapes.
2117903200341231295.author: シンナリナスビ

Premium Crispy Potato Wedges Product Commercial Storyboard

FORMAT:

  - Product: Crispy Potato Wedges
  - Audio: Frying + Crispy ASMR

2117903200341231297.promptEn: Create a realistic food photography image of tamago kake gohan, Japanese steamed white rice topped with a raw egg in a rustic ceramic bowl. The bowl is centered in the foreground on a warm wooden table, filled with glossy short-grain white rice and one cracked raw egg on top: a vivid orange yolk sitting intact in the middle, surrounded by translucent egg white spreading into the rice with a light soy-sauce tint. Use a shallow depth of field and natural soft window light, with appetizing highlights on the yolk and individual rice grains clearly visible. In the background, place exactly 2 supporting props: a small glass soy sauce dispenser with dark liquid on the left, slightly blurred, and a ceramic bowl containing exactly 3 brown eggs on the right, also blurred. In the lower left foreground, include exactly 1 pair of wooden chopsticks resting diagonally beside a small dark chopstick rest. Style the scene as a high-resolution Japanese home breakfast photo, warm tones, realistic textures, no text, no hands, no people, no packaging, no extra utensils.
2117903200341231297.promptZh: 创作一幅逼真的日式食物摄影图像，主题为“玉子かけご飯”（tamago kake gohan）：一只质朴的陶瓷碗中盛放蒸制白米饭，其上覆盖一颗生鸡蛋。碗居于前景中央，置于温暖木质桌面上，碗内盛满油亮短粒白米饭，顶部有一颗敲开的生鸡蛋：一枚鲜橙色蛋黄完整居中，半透明蛋清轻柔漫延入米饭，并泛出淡雅酱油色调。采用浅景深（shallow depth of field）与自然柔和的窗光（natural soft window light），蛋黄表面呈现诱人高光，每一粒米饭纹理清晰可见。背景中精准放置2件辅助道具：左侧为一只装有深色液体的小型玻璃酱油瓶，略带虚化；右侧为一只陶瓷碗，内盛恰好3枚棕色鸡蛋，同样虚化。画面左下前景处，精准放置1双木筷，斜向摆放，旁置一只小型深色筷架。整体风格设定为高分辨率日式家庭早餐摄影（high-resolution Japanese home breakfast photo），色调温暖，质感真实，画面中无文字、无人手、无人物、无包装、无额外餐具。
2117903200341231297.author: みどり🐲Midori Tatsuta

2117903200341231298.promptEn:
Generate a 16:9 landscape, pure white background illustrated guide to Qipao structure and craft details. The overall style is a modern minimalist illustration page + high-end clothing structure research drawing + New Chinese Style minimalist clothing analysis page. The image should be clean, bright, restrained, and exquisite, with a clear sense of design and sharability.

Set up a complete title explanation area at the top, with simple and high-end typography and ample white space:
Main Title: "Modern Modified Sleeveless Qipao"
Subtitle: "Illustrated Guide to Structure and Craft Details"
Top style description line: "New Chinese Minimalism | Off-white Jacquard Silk | Auspicious Cloud Hidden Flower Pattern | Off-white Base - Light Gold Piping"
Top-right series label: "New Chinese Style Series"

Background must be pure white, not off-white, not rice paper, no vintage paper texture.

In the center is an adult Oriental female, aged 22–32, with an elegant, modern, and restrained temperament. Facial features are delicate and intellectual, with soft contours and a clear Oriental aesthetic. Hairstyle is a simple low bun. The pose is natural and stable, front-facing or slight 3/4 angle, showing the full body. Arms should not block the garment structure. The focus is on displaying the Qipao, not a portrait photography.

She wears a modern modified sleeveless Qipao in New Chinese Minimalism style with a slim-fit streamlined silhouette. Specifications:
Collar: Low stand-up collar
Opening: Simplified diagonal opening
Button type: Minimalist straight frog button
Sleeve: Sleeveless
Length & Slit: Mid-calf length, medium slit
Fabric: Off-white jacquard silk
Pattern & Craft: Auspicious cloud hidden flower jacquard
Main color & Piping: Off-white base + Light Gold piping

The central Qipao must clearly show: low stand-up collar, diagonal opening line, minimalist frog buttons, sleeveless shoulder contour, waist darts, slit position, and hem piping.

Distribute 7 local breakdown modules on the left and right sides, strictly matching the central Qipao in color, fabric, pattern, piping, and structure. Focus areas: neckline, opening line, sleeveless shoulder, waist dart, slit, jacquard texture, and piping craft.

Modules mix three forms: structural enlargement (neckline, opening, shoulder, slit), craft macro view (texture, piping, buttons), and structural line drawing (waist darts).

Use fine, hand-drawn dashed unidirectional arrows with small dot anchors to connect modules to the central figure. Style: elegant and restrained, not high-tech infographic.

Label each module with brief Chinese names only: 领厘 (Neckline), 襔线 (Opening Line), 无袖肩部 (Sleeveless Shoulder), 腰省 (Waist Dart), 开衩 (Slit), 提花纹理 (Jacquard Texture), 滚边工艺 (Piping Craft).

Add small samples at the bottom: off-white jacquard silk fabric, light gold piping color swatch, minimalist frog button sample.

Overall visual emphasis: purity, modern structural feel, New Chinese Minimalism, delicate jacquard layers, high-end off-white and light gold palette, design research page feel, and sharability.

Lighting: soft and bright, like a high-end fashion design display, clearly presenting silk textures, piping thickness, and tailoring details.

Negative Constraints: No ordinary portrait poster feel, no e-commerce white background product shot feel, no messy layout, no long descriptions, no thick arrows, no technical straight lines, no blocking the garment structure, no inconsistency in details, no incorrect slit position, no blurred textures, no plastic texture.
2117903200341231298.author: 李岳

2117903200341231299.promptEn: Create a square Spotify playlist cover in a bold vintage screen-printed poster style for a pirate funk mix. Use a near-black background with a limited palette of distressed cream and vivid red-orange. The main subject is a stern pirate captain shown from the waist up in left-facing side profile, positioned in the upper and middle area, with a full black beard, long braided hair with small beads, a hoop earring, a large tricorn hat bearing a skull-and-crossbones emblem, and a high-collared coat with thick cream outlines. His right hand grips a large wooden ship wheel on the right foreground. Behind him, include exactly 2 pirate symbols: one skull-and-crossbones emblem on his hat and one larger skull-and-crossbones on a dark sail flag to the right. Add a huge distressed red-orange moon in the upper left, partially cropped by the canvas edge. Add thin rigging lines and sail shapes in the background. In the top-right corner, place a red-orange outlined rectangular badge containing the text 1 HOUR in bold condensed uppercase red-orange letters. The bottom half is dominated by enormous stacked block typography: first line FUNK in cream, second line GUERRA! in red-orange, both in heavy uppercase sans-serif with tight spacing, filling almost the full width. Make the composition high-contrast, gritty, slightly weathered, like a retro punk/funk album cover or playlist thumbnail, with clean vector-like ink shapes, rough speckled texture, sharp dramatic lighting, and no extra text or logos.
2117903200341231299.promptZh: 为海盗放克（pirate funk）混音歌单设计一张正方形 Spotify 歌单封面，采用大胆复古的丝网印刷海报风格（vintage screen-printed poster style）。背景为近黑色，配色受限于做旧奶油色（distressed cream）与明艳的红橙色（vivid red-orange）。主体是一位神情严厉的海盗船长，呈腰部以上、向左的侧面半身像（left-facing side profile），位于画面中上部；他蓄满浓密的纯黑色胡须，留有长辫发，发辫末端缀有细小珠饰，戴一只圆环耳环（hoop earring），头戴宽檐三角帽（tricorn hat），帽上印有骷髅交叉骨 emblem（skull-and-crossbones emblem），身穿高领外套，外轮廓以粗重的奶油色线条勾勒。其右手紧握位于右下前景的一只大型木质船舵（wooden ship wheel）。他身后需精确呈现两个海盗符号：一为帽上的骷髅交叉骨 emblem，二为右侧一面深色帆旗（dark sail flag）上更大的骷髅交叉骨 emblem。左上方添加一枚巨大且做旧的红橙色月亮（distressed red-orange moon），边缘被画布裁切。背景中加入细绳索线条（rigging lines）与帆布形状（sail shapes）。右上角放置一枚红橙色描边矩形徽章（rectangular badge），内含文字“1 HOUR”，使用加粗、窄体、大写、红橙色字体。下半部分由巨型堆叠式方块字体（stacked block typography）主导：第一行为奶油色“FUNK”，第二行为红橙色“GUERRA!”，均采用厚重无衬线大写字体（heavy uppercase sans-serif），字间距紧密，几乎铺满全宽。整体构图需高对比度（high-contrast）、粗粝感（gritty）、略带风化痕迹（slightly weathered），风格类似复古朋克/放克专辑封面或歌单缩略图，图形轮廓清晰如矢量墨线（clean vector-like ink shapes），叠加粗糙斑点纹理（rough speckled texture），光影锐利而富有戏剧性（sharp dramatic lighting），不添加任何额外文字或标志（no extra text or logos）。
2117903200341231299.author: Sawchang

2117903200341231300.promptEn: Create a dramatic black-and-white Japanese manga panel featuring a cute hamster in extreme close-up, centered slightly to the right, shown from chest up with tiny clenched paws raised in panic. The hamster has huge round shocked eyes, arched worried eyebrows, an open oval mouth with two front teeth, visible whiskers, one large ear on the upper left, soft fluffy fur rendered with dense screentone dots, fine hatching, and multiple sweat drops on its forehead and cheeks. Use classic high-contrast manga inking: thick black outlines, detailed stippling, crosshatching, speed lines sweeping horizontally across the background, and explosive black radial burst effects around the speech balloons. Include exactly 2 vertical Japanese speech balloons: one tall spiky white balloon at the upper right with the text やることが…, and one larger tall spiky white balloon at the lower left with the text やることが多い……!!, including small furigana-like characters beside the first kanji if possible. The composition should feel anxious and comedic, as if the hamster is overwhelmed by too many tasks. Use a square canvas with a thin black manga panel border, no color, no grayscale wash beyond screentone texture, no watermark, and no extra characters or extra text.
2117903200341231300.promptZh: 创作一幅戏剧性的黑白日本漫画分镜，画面中心略偏右为一只可爱的仓鼠的特写（close-up），仅展示其胸部以上部分，双前爪紧握并高高举起，呈现出惊慌失措的状态。仓鼠拥有巨大而圆润、充满震惊感的眼睛，眉毛向上拱起、流露担忧神情，嘴巴呈张开的椭圆形，露出两颗门牙，胡须清晰可见，左上方竖立着一只硕大的耳朵；毛发柔软蓬松，以密集的网点（screentone）圆点、精细的排线（hatching）表现；额头与脸颊上分布着数颗汗珠。采用经典高对比度漫画描线（manga inking）风格：粗重的黑色轮廓线、细致的点画（stippling）、交叉排线（crosshatching）、背景中横向扫过的速度线（speed lines），以及围绕对话框（speech balloons）向外迸发的放射状纯黑爆炸效果（radial burst effects）。画面中须包含恰好两个垂直排列的日语对话框：右上方为一个修长尖刺状的白色对话框，内文为「やることが…」；左下方为一个更大、同样修长尖刺状的白色对话框，内文为「やることが多い……!!」，若可能，请在第一个汉字旁添加类似振假名（furigana）的小型假名标注。整体构图需传递出焦虑又滑稽的情绪，仿佛这只仓鼠正被过多待办事项压得喘不过气。使用正方形画布，边缘配有细黑色漫画分镜边框（manga panel border）；画面不含任何色彩，除网点（screentone）纹理外不使用灰度渐变（grayscale wash），无水印，且不得添加额外角色或文字。

2117903200341231301.promptEn: Create a high-end photorealistic product render of CODEX tokens as futuristic silver coins on a glossy dark surface. Show exactly 5 discrete coins: 4 coins stacked horizontally on the left in a short pile, and 1 large coin leaning upright in the foreground on the right, partially overlapping the stack. The upright coin should dominate the composition, with a ridged reeded edge, brushed matte silver metal, beveled rims, concentric circular grooves, and embossed lettering around the rim: CODEX at the top and BUILD THE FUTURE at the bottom. In the center of each coin, emboss a rounded-square app-icon panel containing a cloud-shaped logo with a terminal prompt symbol, like a greater-than chevron and a short horizontal dash. The left stack should show the top coin face at a shallow angle with the same cloud-terminal emblem and faint rim text, while the coin edges reveal crisp vertical ridges. Use dramatic blue studio lighting with cool cyan highlights, deep navy shadows, soft reflections on the tabletop, and a smooth blue-to-lavender gradient background. Macro product photography look, sharp focus on the upright coin, shallow depth of field on the stacked coins, premium crypto-token aesthetic, no extra objects, no watermark, square 1:1 composition.

2117903200341231302.promptEn:
Goal: Create a wide character concept sheet for VESPER, a semi-realistic anime cyberpop idol combat girl with sonic powers.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 white studio sheet, high-resolution, clean negative space, polished concept-art presentation with light sketch annotations. Use black, white, glossy charcoal, pale pink, and hot magenta accents.

Main character: Center-left full-body hero pose of a young anime girl with pale skin, freckles, confident fearless expression, detailed gray eyes, and messy twin tails in white and pastel pink. She wears oversized futuristic black horn headphones with tall antenna-like spikes, a puffy white techwear jacket with straps and buckles, black glossy fitted leggings, layered belts and harnesses, pink plush charm accessories, chunky pink-and-black platform boots, fingerless black gloves, and long pink ribbon streamers. She holds a microphone stand like a stage weapon. Add pink heart hair clips and magenta energy accents.

Left column: Place the huge vertical title text "VESPER" in bold black block letters along the far left edge. To the right of it include three short info lines: "ROLE: Sonic Disruptor", "CORE MOOD: Fearless Energy", and "VISUAL SIGNATURE: Horn Headphones & Magenta Waves". Beneath that, include a Turnaround section with exactly 3 small full-body views: front view, back view, and side view. Below it, include a Silhouette Study section with exactly 3 black silhouettes matching those same views. At the bottom left, include an Expression Study strip with exactly 4 close-up face panels: confident smirk, shouting performance expression, downward calm focus, and shy/intense lowered gaze.

Right side: Create a Pose Study section across the upper right with exactly 4 action pose vignettes, each with handwritten labels: "Sonic Blast" showing her projecting a circular magenta sound-wave ring, "Leap & Strike" showing her airborne with ribbons and mic stand, "Tune Up" showing her interacting with a speaker/amplifier on the floor, and "Stage Presence" showing a strong standing singer pose with mic stand.

Bottom right: Create a Detail Study row with exactly 5 boxed close-up panels, labeled "Horn Headphones", "Jacket Buckle", "Plush Charm", "Platform Boots", and "Magenta Wave". Show one detailed object per panel.

Visual style: Semi-realistic anime illustration, delicate linework, glossy material rendering, fashion design sheet aesthetics, pink watercolor-like energy strokes, subtle gray shadows, handwritten annotation labels, sharp but airy composition.

Constraints: Keep exactly 1 main large full-body figure, 3 turnaround figures, 3 silhouettes, 4 expression close-ups, 4 pose vignettes, and 5 detail panels. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, or background scenery.

2117903200341231303.promptEn: Create a polished vertical anime illustration of Ena, a cheerful young woman cooking prunes in a bright modern kitchen. She has long flowing honey-blonde hair, large vivid blue eyes, soft blush, and a gentle happy smile. She wears exactly 5 visible outfit pieces: a cream knit cardigan, a light blue vertically striped button-up blouse, a navy knee-length skirt, pink house slippers, and no visible jewelry. Show her standing at a stainless-steel kitchen island with an induction cooktop, holding a wooden spoon above a small silver saucepan filled with glossy dark purple prune compote; include subtle steam and a red heating ring under the pot. In the foreground, place exactly 9 visible loose dried fruits around the bowl and cooktop: 4 dark purple prunes, 3 brown dried prunes or dates, and 2 reddish-brown wrinkled dried fruits. Add one clear glass bowl filled with mixed dried prunes and brown dried fruit on the counter. The kitchen should be clean, white, and sunlit, with tiled walls, white cabinetry, a large window on the left, soft greenery outside, exactly 3 small potted herbs on the windowsill, a sink and faucet beneath the window, a stainless range hood on the upper right, and open shelves holding plates, bowls, mugs, a wooden cutting board, and small jars. Include a small cutting board with a knife on the right counter. Use delicate line art, soft cel shading, pastel colors, realistic kitchen perspective, warm natural morning light, and high-detail anime rendering. Vertical 9:16 composition, waist-to-full-body view, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.
2117903200341231303.promptZh: 创作一幅精致的竖版动漫插画，描绘恩娜（Ena）——一位开朗活泼的年轻女性，正在明亮现代的厨房中烹煮西梅。她拥有一头柔顺飘逸的蜜金色长发、一双大而明艳的蓝色眼睛、淡淡的红晕以及温柔愉悦的微笑。她身上清晰可见的服装共5件：米色针织开衫、浅蓝色竖条纹纽扣衬衫、藏青色及膝裙、粉色家居拖鞋，且不佩戴任何可见首饰。画面中她站在不锈钢厨房岛台旁，岛台上设有一台电磁炉；她手持一把木勺，悬于一只盛有光泽深紫色西梅酱的小银色炖锅上方；锅中需呈现细微蒸汽，锅底可见红色加热圈。前景中，在碗与灶台周围须清晰呈现9颗散落的干果：4颗深紫色西梅、3颗棕色干西梅或椰枣，以及2颗红褐色皱缩干果。台面上另置一只透明玻璃碗，内装混合的干西梅与棕色干果。厨房整体洁净、纯白、阳光充沛，墙面铺贴白色瓷砖，橱柜为纯白色，左侧设一扇大窗，窗外可见柔和绿植，窗台上整齐摆放恰好3盆小型香草盆栽；窗下为水槽与水龙头，右上方悬挂不锈钢抽油烟机；开放式置物架上陈列盘子、碗、马克杯、木质砧板及小罐子。右侧台面上另放置一块小型砧板，其上搁有一把刀。画风采用细腻线稿、柔和赛璐珞着色（cel shading）、粉彩色调、写实厨房透视、温暖自然的清晨光线，以及高细节度的动漫渲染（anime rendering）。竖构图，比例9:16，取景范围为腰部至全身，画面中不含文字、无水印、无额外人物。

2117903200341231304.promptEn:
Goal: Create a minimalist Japanese promotional poster demonstrating a photo-to-miniature poster transformation service, using a tabby cat photo as the example.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster on a warm off-white background, centered composition, lots of negative space, soft editorial design, refined Japanese lifestyle aesthetic.

Layout: At the top center place the Japanese headline 「この一枚が」 in thin gray handwritten-style typography. Below it, show the original photo as a landscape rectangle: a tabby cat with a red collar sitting at a window ledge at night, looking upward, warm indoor lighting, shallow depth of field. Under the photo, center the text “YOUR PHOTO” in small spaced serif capitals, then a thin downward arrow.

Main demonstration: Below the arrow, place a larger vertical poster mockup. Its upper half repeats the same original cat photo unchanged. Its lower half becomes a miniature diorama illustration: the same tabby cat transformed into a small realistic figure sitting on a tiny beige platform beside a tall white wall/door frame, softly lit, with subtle shadows on an ivory background. Add small editorial text on the lower-left of this mini poster reading “Quiet Watcher” with tiny unreadable specification text beneath it, and tiny catalog-style marks in the lower-right.

Bottom text: Under the mockup, center a bold Japanese line 「こうなる。」, then a smaller gray line 「1枚 480円 ／ 数分で完成」, and finally the website “miniato.jp” in spaced lowercase serif letters.

Visual style: Minimal premium product ad, muted beige and gray palette, clean spacing, thin typography, soft shadows, photographic upper image, realistic miniature lower rendering, quiet and elegant mood. Use exactly 2 visible image panels before the bottom copy: 1 original landscape photo and 1 transformed vertical poster mockup. The transformed mockup contains exactly 2 stacked sections: the unchanged photo on top and the miniature diorama on bottom.

Customizable details: Use a tabby cat with a red collar, この一枚が, こうなる。, 1枚 480円 ／ 数分で完成, and miniato.jp.
2117903200341231304.promptZh:
目标：创作一张极简主义日本风格宣传海报，展示照片转微缩模型海报（photo-to-miniature poster）服务，以一只虎斑猫照片为例。

画布：竖版4:5比例海报，暖调米白色背景，居中构图，大量留白，柔和的编辑设计（editorial design），精致的日式生活美学（Japanese lifestyle aesthetic）。

布局：顶部中央放置日文标题「この一枚が」，采用纤细灰色手写风格字体。其下方展示原图，为一张横幅矩形照片：一只戴红色项圈的虎斑猫于夜晚坐在窗台边，仰头向上看，室内灯光温暖，景深（depth of field）较浅。照片下方居中排布文字 “YOUR PHOTO”，使用小号、字间距宽松的衬线体大写字母；随后是一条纤细向下的箭头。

核心演示：箭头下方放置一张更大的竖版海报样机（poster mockup）。其上半部分完全复现同一张原始猫照片，不做任何改动；下半部分则转化为微缩场景插画（miniature diorama illustration）：同一只虎斑猫被重塑为一个逼真的微缩人偶，端坐于一个微小的米色平台之上，平台旁立着一面高大的白色墙壁／门框，整体柔光照明，在象牙色背景上投下细腻阴影。在该微缩海报左下角添加小型编辑文字 “Quiet Watcher”，其正下方附一行极小、不可读的规格说明文字；右下角添加微小的目录式标记（catalog-style marks）。

底部文字：样机下方居中排布加粗日文短句「こうなる。」；其下为一行较小的灰色文字「1枚 480円 ／ 数分で完成」；最下方以字间距宽松的小写衬线体呈现网站地址 “miniato.jp”。

视觉风格：极简高端产品广告（minimal premium product ad），低饱和米色与灰色配色，干净的间距，纤细字体，柔和阴影；上半部为摄影图像（photographic），下半部为写实微缩渲染（realistic miniature rendering），整体氛围静谧而优雅。底部文案之前，画面中须严格呈现且仅呈现2个可见图像面板：1张原始横幅照片 + 1张转化后的竖版海报样机。该转化样机须严格由上下堆叠的2个部分构成：上方为未改动的原照片，下方为微缩场景插画。

可定制细节：使用戴红色项圈的虎斑猫；文字「この一枚が」；「こうなる。」；「1枚 480円 ／ 数分で完成」；以及网站 “miniato.jp”。

2117903200341231305.promptEn: Create a photorealistic architectural interior rendering of a modern Japanese-inspired living room and small work area, viewed from a fixed wide-angle camera at standing eye level from the front-left corner looking diagonally into the room. The space has warm walnut wood flooring, smooth off-white plaster walls, a muted beige ceiling, and a dark charcoal stone-textured accent wall on the right. Along the left wall place exactly 6 tall narrow vertical windows with black frames, bringing in soft overcast daylight and faint suburban houses and greenery outside. In the foreground place a low, long L-shaped sofa in warm taupe woven fabric with wooden legs and exactly 3 visible cushions: one large back cushion section, one chaise seat section, and two loose square throw pillows near the corner. In front of it place a rectangular mid-century wooden coffee table with rounded corners, tapered legs, a lower woven shelf, exactly 2 stacked books, and 1 small potted green plant. On the right accent wall mount 1 large thin flat-screen TV with a dark screen and slim gray side frame. Toward the back center, create a compact raised work nook partially hidden by a white structural wall, with exactly 1 wooden desk, 1 black ergonomic mesh office chair, 1 computer monitor, 1 small desk lamp, and warm wood flooring continuing through the area. At the rear-right, add a decorative partition of exactly 10 vertical wooden slats in front of a large black-framed window, with a small built-in shelf holding exactly 3 tiny decor items or plants. Use black ceiling track lighting with exactly 5 visible spotlights distributed along two tracks, turned on subtly but dominated by natural daylight. Overall style: minimal warm modern Japanese with mid-century wood furniture, realistic materials, clean uncluttered staging, balanced neutral tones, soft shadows, high-end residential design visualization, no people, no text, no logos, no exaggerated decoration.
2117903200341231305.promptZh: 创建一张照片级写实（photorealistic）的现代日式风格室内建筑效果图，展现一间起居室及小型工作区，视角为固定广角（wide-angle）镜头，位于站立眼高、房间前左角位置，呈对角线方向向室内拍摄。空间地面为暖色调胡桃木地板，墙面为平滑的米白色灰泥墙，天花板为柔和的米褐色，右侧设一面深炭灰色石材肌理饰面墙。左侧墙面布置恰好6扇高而窄的竖向窗户，窗框为黑色，引入柔和的阴天自然光，并隐约可见窗外郊区住宅与绿植。前景放置一张低矮修长的L形沙发，面料为暖灰褐色编织材质，配木质腿，且清晰可见3个靠垫：一个大型靠背垫、一个贵妃榻坐垫，以及靠近转角处的两个松散方形抱枕。沙发前方放置一张矩形中世纪风格木质咖啡桌，圆角设计，锥形桌腿，下方设一层编织层板，其上整齐叠放恰好2本书籍，并摆放1株小型盆栽绿植。右侧饰面墙上悬挂1台大型超薄平板电视，屏幕为暗色，侧边框为纤细的灰色。后方中央区域设置一处紧凑型抬高式工作角，部分被一堵白色结构墙遮挡，内含恰好1张木质书桌、1把黑色人体工学网状办公椅、1台电脑显示器、1盏小台灯，地面延续暖色木纹地板。右后方增设一道装饰性隔断，由恰好10根竖向木质格栅组成，其前方为一扇大尺寸黑框窗；隔断底部嵌入一小层板，上置恰好3件微型装饰品或小型盆栽。天花板采用黑色轨道射灯系统，共两条轨道，每条轨道上清晰可见恰好5盏射灯（总计10盏），灯光微亮，但整体以自然日光为主导。整体风格：极简、温暖、现代日式（minimal warm modern Japanese），融合中世纪木制家具（mid-century wood furniture），材质表现高度真实（realistic materials），布景简洁无杂乱（clean uncluttered staging），色调平衡中性（balanced neutral tones），阴影柔和（soft shadows），高端住宅设计可视化（high-end residential design visualization），画面中无人物、无文字、无商标、无夸张装饰。

Ultra-realistic high-end commercial advertisement of a premium luxury wristwatch placed on a dark walnut desk inside an elegant modern office at sunrise. The watch is positioned naturally on a sophisticated leather watch stand, featuring a polished stainless-steel case, detailed mechanical dial, realistic metallic hands, subtle reflections on the sapphire crystal, and finely textured leather strap.

In the background, a large floor-to-ceiling window reveals a realistic city skyline slowly illuminated by the first morning sunlight. Soft golden sunlight enters through the window and naturally falls across the watch, creating precise highlights along the metal edges and realistic shadows on the wooden surface. A premium fountain pen, a closed leather notebook, and a few minimal office accessories are arranged naturally around the watch, creating an authentic executive lifestyle setting.

Extreme attention to realistic materials and small details: individual dial markings, realistic brushed and polished metal surfaces, accurate glass reflections, subtle fingerprints and natural micro-imperfections, realistic leather grain, physically accurate shadows, natural ambient light, authentic depth of field, soft background bokeh, professional studio-quality product photography combined with real environmental lighting.

Shot with a professional full-frame camera, 85mm lens, f/2.0 aperture, natural cinematic color grading, realistic exposure, premium luxury watch campaign aesthetic, sophisticated and believable, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, 8K resolution, sharp focus on the watch, realistic proportions, vertical 9:16 composition, no fantasy elements, no surreal effects, no floating objects, no distorted watch face, no random numbers or text, no watermark.

2117903200341231307.promptZh:

2117903200341231312.promptEn:
Goal: Create a wide horizontal diptych comparing two Buddhist mural composition strategies in an aged Dunhuang / Chinese temple fresco style, showing the difference between a flat repetitive figure wall and a layered sacred assembly scene.

Canvas: Extra-wide panoramic image, about 2:1 aspect ratio, split vertically into two equal panels with no modern border, both panels painted on weathered tan plaster with faded mineral pigments, cracks, patina, and antique hand-painted texture.

Left panel: Depict a flat frontal mural filled with exactly 48 nearly identical seated Buddha figures arranged in a strict grid of 6 rows and 8 columns. Each Buddha has a round green-blue halo, dark blue hair, calm face, orange-red robe, and seated meditation pose. Keep the figures similar in size and spacing so the panel feels visually crowded and wall-like. Add decorative hanging canopy fabric at the top and a narrow floral border along the bottom. The background should be shallow, with almost no spatial depth.

Right panel: Depict a layered Pure Land / Buddhist court assembly with clear hierarchy, depth, and breathing space. Place exactly 1 large central Buddha seated on a lotus pedestal beneath an ornate circular mandorla and hanging canopy, making this the first visual focus. Flank the central Buddha with exactly 2 standing bodhisattvas, one on each side, wearing jeweled crowns, green and gold garments, and halos. Add exactly 14 larger foreground and midground monks seated or kneeling in orange-brown robes, arranged in curved rows that lead the eye toward the central Buddha. Behind them, include two distant crowd groups of many smaller worshippers on the left and right, intentionally reduced in scale and detail to create depth. Include layered mountains, cloud banks, temple pavilions at the far left and far right edges, lotus flowers, rocks, and soft misty pathways receding into the background.

Visual style: Ancient Chinese Buddhist mural, inspired by Dunhuang Pure Land paintings, Chaoyuan Tu-style hierarchical crowd composition, and Song/Yuan temple fresco aesthetics. Use muted mineral colors: ochre, sienna, cinnabar red, malachite green, teal blue, faded gold, ivory, and smoky gray. Lines should be delicate but aged, with hand-brushed outlines, flattened perspective, decorative symmetry, and subtle atmospheric depth on the right panel.

Composition intent: The left side must feel repetitive, dense, and spatially flat; the right side must feel organized, ceremonial, and deep, with hierarchy, foreground-middle-background separation, and intentional empty space around the central deity.

Text: No captions, no labels, no watermark, no modern typography.

Customizable subject: The central figure may be Buddha; the mural tradition may be Dunhuang Pure Land Buddhist fresco; the left grid count must remain 48; the right main assembly should keep 14; use an antique palette dominated by ochre, cinnabar red, malachite green, teal blue, faded gold.

2117903200341231326.promptEn:
Goal: Create a monochrome Japanese manga page about a quiet office woman gradually opening up after meeting a stray cat, in a sentimental slice-of-life style. Use vertical manga page, black and white, 4:5 aspect ratio.

Canvas: Full-page manga layout with clean black panel borders, grayscale screentones, fine ink linework, soft shading, realistic urban backgrounds, and expressive but restrained character acting. The reading direction and text boxes should feel like a Japanese manga page, with vertical Japanese dialogue and narration.

Main subject: A young Japanese office woman, unnamed heroine, early 20s, shoulder-length straight black hair with bangs, gentle tired eyes, wearing a cardigan over office clothes and carrying a shoulder bag. She begins lonely and withdrawn, then becomes warmer and more confident. The supporting subject is exactly 1 black-and-white stray cat with round eyes, a fluffy chest, and a slightly scruffy but cute appearance.

Layout: Use exactly 9 distinct panels arranged in a dense manga grid.
1. Top-left panel: the woman sits at an office desk, resting her cheek on her hand, looking tired beside a computer monitor and papers. Add a thought bubble and vertical narration.
2. Top-right wide panel: she walks through a city street with buildings and pedestrians behind her, holding her bag strap, looking reserved. Add two tall narration boxes.
3. Middle-left panel: she crouches in an alley or side street and offers food in a small dish to the stray cat. The cat eats while she watches shyly. Add a speech bubble.
4. Middle-right panel: the cat sits alone beside a wall in the alley, looking directly at the viewer. Add a small cat sound effect and a tall narration box.
5. Lower-middle-left panel: in the office cafeteria or workspace, the woman smiles while talking with coworkers; include desks, monitors, and background people. Add a vertical narration box and a speech bubble from another person.
6. Lower-middle-right panel: close emotional panel of the woman smiling with closed eyes while petting the cat, cheek close to its head. Add a cat sound effect and two narration boxes.
7. Bottom-left wide panel: the woman sits at her desk holding a drink, smiling brightly with eyes closed; coworkers chat in the background. Add a small vertical speech bubble.
8. Bottom-center narrow panel: close-up of the cat’s face with partial hand/petting detail, used as a reflective transition. Add two narrow vertical narration boxes.
9. Bottom-right wide panel: sunset rooftop or riverside overlook from behind; the woman sits beside the cat, both facing a city skyline and dramatic sunburst clouds. Add two narration boxes, one near the sky and one near the lower center.

Text content: Include Japanese vertical manga text in the panels. The central theme should be a lonely ordinary office worker is saved emotionally by a stray cat and learns to connect with people. Use narration similar in tone to: “I am an ordinary office worker anywhere,” “I am not good at talking to people,” “I met one stray cat near the company,” “At first I only watched from a distance,” “Little by little the distance closed,” “Thanks to that child, I became able to look forward,” and “Someday I want to become someone who can give something back.”

Visual style: Authentic seinen/shoujo slice-of-life manga, hand-drawn ink, detailed city and office backgrounds, grayscale tones, subtle hatching, cinematic emotional pacing, clean white gutters, no color, no watermark. Keep the woman and cat consistent across all panels, with the cat appearing in exactly 5 panels: eating, sitting alone, being petted, close-up, and sitting beside her at the skyline.

2117903200341231327.promptEn:
Goal: Create a whimsical two-part aesthetic poster about a cute cloud character, combining a real-sky photo scene on top with a hand-drawn scrapbook guide below.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster. The top half is a realistic outdoor sky photograph; the bottom half is a cream paper illustration panel with a soft grainy texture.

Top scene: A bright blue daytime sky with a few small white clouds. In the center, one fluffy white cloud is turned into a friendly character using simple black graphic features: exactly 2 dot eyes, 1 curved smiling mouth, and 2 raised bone-like arms angled upward from the left and right sides. The mood is light, airy, relaxed, and childlike. Use natural sunlight and keep the sky spacious.

Bottom panel title: Handwritten title centered near the top: Cloud Friend. Add a small blue star to the left, a red heart to the right, tiny blue sparkles, and a wavy blue underline beneath the title.

Bottom layout: Arrange exactly 9 small illustrated vignettes in a loose 3-by-3 grid, each with a handwritten numbered caption underneath. The style should look like colored pencil, crayon, and ink on warm off-white paper.

Nine vignettes and captions:
1. “hello!” — a small smiling cloud character inside a rough blue scribble patch, with two black arms and a tiny red heart.
2. “happy face” — a simple face made of 2 black dot eyes, 1 black smile, and 2 soft pink blush circles.
3. “arms up” — two separate black bone-like arms raised like a cheering gesture, with small blue motion marks and a red doodle accent.
4. “very blue” — a rounded rectangle of textured blue crayon sky containing exactly 2 small white clouds.
5. “soft & fluffy” — a pale gray pencil sketch of one fluffy cloud outline, with a small red heart.
6. “warm sun” — a yellow-orange circular sun with short radiating rays.
7. “gentle breeze” — light blue flowing wind lines with a small swirl and red doodle accent.
8. “daydream view” — a tiny simple landscape with exactly 2 green trees, a green ground line, and a small red-roof house outline.
9. “good mood” — a cheerful doodle cluster containing 1 blue star, 1 pink heart, 1 mint green cloud, small dots, and red accent lines.

Footer text: Centered along the bottom in small handwritten lettering: Look up. Little joys are floating around. followed by a small red heart and blue dots.

Visual style: Mix realistic photography in the top half with naive hand-drawn journaling in the bottom half. Use soft blue, cream, black, pastel pink, yellow, mint, and red accents. Keep all text handwritten, imperfect, casual, and charming.

Constraints: Preserve the exact two-panel composition, the exact count of 9 numbered vignettes, and the friendly minimalist cloud face. Avoid extra characters, logos, watermarks, or dense text.

2117903200341231328.promptEn:
Create a minimalist ceremonial information poster around any given theme. The first impression must be a large area of warm white empty space where the main title is precisely centered, engaging in solemn alignment with three thematic symbols: transform the core name, participants, or keywords provided by the theme into a large thin-stroke title at the top, a set of recognizable abstract logos in the center, and solid color blocks on both sides; semantics may change but order remains constant. Retain high-ratio whitespace, vertical central axis, upper-lower zoning, and the pause feeling of thin black horizontal lines; arrange all elements restrainedly like an exhibition catalog or international institutional yearbook. Use high-contrast fine serifs or equivalent glyph structures for the main text, with open counters, slender strokes, sharp terminals, and spacious rhythm, maintaining a slender skeleton, loose tracking, clear recognition, and calm breathing when switched to any writing system, rather than copying a specific Latin font. Extract two high-purity representative colors from the theme for hard-edged squares; use only black lines and minimal solid geometry for the central logo; keep the background as slightly paper-textured warm white, avoiding gradients, shadows, and decorative textures. Place subtitles and small explanatory text at a lower center of gravity at the bottom, with footer micro-information pressing the edges, creating a contrast where grand themes are tamed by museum-style whitespace; failure symptoms include crowded elements, chaotic colors, thick fonts, realistic icons, or the poster losing its cold ritual order.

Set the theme to "City Public Library Open Day" for a public cultural institution event main poster: use indigo blue and cinnabar red as the two high-purity square colors; abstract opened book pages and door arches with black lines in the center, letting the symbol group fall steadily below the title along the vertical axis; place the main title in the center of the upper half, with subtitles and dates forming a sparse two-level information hierarchy below, retaining large areas of warm white whitespace and thin black line pauses; aspect ratio is vertical 3:4.
2117903200341231328.promptZh: 围绕任意给定主题，创作一张极简主义仪式感信息海报。第一印象必须是大面积暖白色留白空间，主标题精确居中，以庄重的对齐方式与三个主题符号形成呼应：将主题所提供的核心名称、参与方或关键词，转化为顶部的大号细线描边标题、中心一组可识别的抽象标识，以及左右两侧的纯色色块；语义可随主题变化，但结构顺序恒定不变。保持高比例留白、垂直中轴线、上下分区布局，以及细黑横线所营造的停顿感；所有元素须如展览图录或国际机构年鉴般克制排布。主文字采用高对比度的纤细衬线体（fine serifs）或等效字形结构，要求字腔开阔（open counters）、笔画纤细、末端锐利（sharp terminals）、节奏舒展，整体维持纤长骨架、宽松字间距（loose tracking）、清晰可辨性，以及切换至任何文字系统时均能保持沉静呼吸感（calm breathing），而非照搬某款特定拉丁字体。从主题中提取两种高纯度代表色，用于硬边方形色块；中心标识仅使用黑色线条与极简实体几何图形；背景为略带纸张肌理的暖白色，禁用渐变、阴影及装饰性纹理。副标题与小型说明文字置于底部较低视觉重心处，页脚微信息紧贴边缘排布，由此形成宏大主题被博物馆式留白所驯服的对比效果；失败症状包括：元素拥挤、色彩混乱、字体粗重、写实图标，或海报丧失其冷峻的仪式秩序感。\n\n主题设定为“城市公共图书馆开放日”，面向公共文化机构活动的主海报：采用靛蓝（indigo blue）与朱砂红（cinnabar red）作为两种高纯度方形色块；中心抽象标识由黑色线条构成，表现展开的书页与门拱造型，使标识组沿垂直中轴线稳定下落，位于标题正下方；主标题置于上半区域正中央，副标题与日期在下方构成疏朗的两级信息层级，保留大面积暖白留白空间及细黑横线停顿；画面纵横比为竖版 3:4。

2117903200341231335.promptEn:
Goal: Create a luxurious vertical product photography poster showing 9 premium perfume bottles inspired by Antoni Gaudí architecture, arranged in a perfect 3×3 grid on a glossy white marble surface.

Canvas: Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio, studio product shot, warm champagne-gray background with soft circular bokeh lights, shallow depth of field, high-end advertising look, clean spacing between rows and columns.

Layout: Exactly 9 distinct perfume bottles, evenly arranged in three rows of three. Each bottle sits upright, front-facing, with its own ornate label and sculptural cap. Use realistic glass, ceramic, enamel, polished gold metal, reflections, refractions, and subtle shadows.

Subject details: The bottles are uniquely shaped and Gaudí-inspired, with organic biomorphic curves, trencadís mosaic patterns, Art Nouveau gold filigree, stained-glass colors, and architectural silhouettes.

Bottle list, counted exactly 9:
1. Top left: Tall cathedral-spire bottle with pointed gold finial, blue-purple stained-glass mosaic panels, gold ribbed framing, label text “SAGRADA BLOOM”.
2. Top center: Round aqua-blue glass bottle with swirling teal and gold fluid curves, transparent domed blue cap, label text “GAUDÍ’S MUSE”.
3. Top right: White ceramic pear-shaped bottle with flared sculptural neck, multicolor trencadís mosaic tiles in orange, blue, cream, and red, label text “TRENCADÍS WHISPER”.
4. Middle left: Skull-shaped bottle inspired by Casa Batlló, turquoise and cream bone-like organic openings, gold bulb cap, label text “CASA BATLLÓ”.
5. Middle center: Amber-gold oval bottle with green leaf reliefs, organic vine-like gold ornamentation, flame-shaped green and amber cap, label text “ORGANIC REVERIE”.

2117903200341231336.promptEn:
Create 4 independent "Japanese Editorial Coffee Posters" belonging to the same series, but each must have different subject representations, composition paths, and visual events; do not just change colors or brand names.

All four images share the visual language of modern Japanese museum publications, independent design exhibition posters, and restrained editorial design. The aspect ratio is unified as 9:16 vertical portrait, output independently without collage. The background is unified as warm ivory paper with very subtle real paper fibers and low-intensity printing grain. Use a palette of warm ivory, ink black, coffee brown, and a touch of dark vermilion; neon, high-saturation gradients, and commercial gloss are prohibited.

All posters use a few circular visual anchors, thin measurement lines, arcs, registration marks, and structural markers. Lines must serve the subject and reading path, not become random decoration. Text uses only short, readable English labels; do not generate long pseudo-text, random logos, QR codes, or watermarks.

Image 1: Pour-over coffee. Ceramic dripper and glass server in a calm three-quarter tabletop view. Top left features a large circular detail showing coffee bloom and concentric ripples; bottom right shows real equipment; water flow is translated into a measurement arc. Add short label "COFFEE STUDY 01 / POUR OVER".

Image 2: Cold brew coffee. Transparent tall cup of iced coffee on the left, add a vertical slice showing layers of coffee, ice, and reflections; use fine vertical lines to establish a cool rhythm. Add short label "COFFEE STUDY 02 / COLD BREW".

Image 3: Latte. Handmade ceramic cup at bottom right, behind it place an offset disc cropped by the edge, echoing milk foam swirls; add two small material detail circles. Add short label "COFFEE STUDY 03 / MILK FORM".

Image 4: Coffee beans and tools. Roasted beans, hand grinder, metal scoop, and folded paper bag form a diagonal object map in isometric three-quarter view; thin outlines and route nodes connect objects, retaining large white space. Add short label "COFFEE STUDY 04 / ORIGIN / TOOL / ROAST".

All four images must maintain realistic textures of coffee, glass, ceramic, metal, paper, and wood; clear subjects, natural lighting, mature editorial typography. Prohibit ordinary cafe menus, messy collages, fixed grids, average layouts, cheap plastic 3D, complex UI, garbled text, excessive props, and watermarks.

Final output is 4 independent 9:16 posters, maintaining series unity while ensuring distinct differences in subject, composition, visual focus, and interaction mechanisms.

2117903200341231337.promptEn:
Please generate high-budget, realistic Ming-style Hanfu wedding photos based on the user-uploaded clear life photos. Real identity features including face shape, feature proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, age, temperament, and height difference must be preserved. Each image must clearly show the same real couple; avoid face-swapping, 'internet celebrity' fake faces, excessive Westernization, over-smoothing, or obvious AI artifacts. The theme is Ming-style wedding aesthetics: dignified, magnificent, and ceremonial.

Character Settings:
Bride: Bright red Ming-style wedding attire (Phoenix crown, gold-woven large-sleeved shirt, jacket-skirt). Patterns of phoenix, peony, and auspicious clouds. Hair is center-parted in a low bun or classical bun. Dignified high-end makeup with red lips.
Groom: Bright red round-collar robe with rank patch. Wears a black gauze cap (Wusha hat). Upright, scholarly, and ceremonial appearance. Angles must vary including front and 3/4 profiles.

Fixed Attire & Continuity:
The couple must wear the same fixed set of clothing throughout the entire series. Structure, patterns, and primary colors (Red + Gold) must remain consistent across different shots to simulate a real wedding shoot.

Scene & Lighting:
High-budget indoor wedding studio or ancient building. Elements: red curtains, Ming furniture, palace lanterns, 'Double Happiness' symbols. Cinematic lighting in warm red-gold tones with candlelight accents. High-end quality resembling professional samples.

Prompt 01: Main Ceremony Poster. Full-body shot. Couple stands in the center. Dignified expressions, looking at the camera. High-profile ceremonial feel.
Prompt 02: Mutual Gaze. 3/4 body shot. Solemn moment before bowing. Bride is shy; groom is focused.
Prompt 03: Groom Adjusting the Crown. Candid interaction. Focus on the delicate Phoenix crown and the groom's gentle care.
Prompt 04: Lifting the Veil. Moment of revelation. Groom lifts the red veil; mutual eye contact with a sense of wonder.
Prompt 05: Ritual Wine Ceremony. Half-body shot. Solemn cross-arm drinking ritual. Focused, dignified expressions.
Prompt 06: Walking with Lanterns. Dynamic full-body shot. Walking through a corridor with palace lanterns. Sense of flow and atmospheric space.
Prompt 07: Groom-Lead Portrait. Formal sitting shot. Highlights the groom's presence alongside the bride. Noble and steady.
Prompt 08: Window Close-up. Quiet, intimate moment. Bride hides slightly behind a round fan. Soft window lighting, emotional closing shot.
2117903200341231337.promptZh:
请基于用户上传的清晰生活照，生成高预算、写实风格的明代汉服婚礼照片。必须保留真实人物特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄、气质及身高差。每张图像须清晰呈现同一对真实新人；避免换脸、网红式假脸、过度西化、过度磨皮或明显AI痕迹。主题为明代婚礼美学：庄重、华美、仪式感。

人物设定：  
新娘：明制大红婚服（凤冠、织金大袖衫、褙子+马面裙），纹样含凤凰、牡丹与祥云；发式为中分低髻或古典髻；妆容端庄高级，唇色朱红。  
新郎：明制大红圆领袍，配补子；头戴乌纱帽（Wusha hat）；仪态挺拔、儒雅、庄重；构图角度需多样化，包含正面及3/4侧脸。

固定服饰与连贯性：  
整套系列中，新人必须始终穿着同一套固定服饰。服装结构、纹样及主色调（红色+金色）须在不同镜头中保持一致，以模拟真实婚礼拍摄效果。

场景与布光：  
高预算室内婚礼影棚或古建实景。元素包括：红帷幔、明式家具、宫灯、“囍”字符号。电影感布光（cinematic lighting），暖调红金色为主，辅以烛光点缀。画质高端，媲美专业样片。

提示词 01：主仪式海报。全身构图。新人立于画面中央。神情庄重，直视镜头。高规格仪式感。  
提示词 02：对望时刻。3/4身构图。拜堂前肃穆瞬间。新娘略带羞涩；新郎专注沉静。  
提示词 03：新郎正冠。自然抓拍互动。聚焦精致凤冠及新郎轻柔呵护之态。  
提示词 04：掀盖头。揭晓时刻。新郎掀起红盖头；二人目光交汇，流露惊叹与悸动。  
提示词 05：合卺酒礼。半身构图。庄重交臂共饮仪式。神情专注、端严。  
提示词 06：提灯同行。动态全身构图。穿行于悬挂宫灯的廊道之中。富有流动感与空间氛围感。  
提示词 07：新郎主导肖像。正式坐姿构图。凸显新郎气度，同时兼顾新娘。尊贵而沉稳。  
提示词 08：窗边特写（close-up）。静谧亲密时刻。新娘微微藏身于团扇之后。柔光窗影，情绪收束的终幕镜头。

2117903200341231338.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vertical social-media food review poster that turns a casual restaurant table photo into an Instagram-style barbecue feast cover, with playful hand-drawn Chinese marker annotations and arrows.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, warm indoor restaurant lighting, close-up overhead three-quarter angle. The background is a dark wooden table with a softly blurred chair and wall behind it. Use a rich brown, orange, and golden color palette with high contrast, glossy food highlights, and shallow depth of field.

Main layout: Center the composition on a rectangular metal grill tray filled with skewers and roasted items, angled from lower left to upper right. Behind the tray, place a small black handled pot filled with spicy beef stew. At the bottom edge, partially show sauce dishes and side dishes cropped by the frame. Leave dark negative space at the top for large handwritten title text.

Show exactly 4 visible small sauce bowls at the bottom: one red chili oil sauce, one bright orange sauce, one green chopped scallion or herb sauce, and one small pale tofu or garnish bowl.

Handwritten graphic overlays: Add colorful doodles in white, yellow, pink, and orange, as if drawn with paint markers. Include exactly 8 annotation clusters: 1 large headline at the top left, 1 pink speech-bubble badge at the top right, 1 arrow label pointing to the beef pot, 1 arrow label pointing to the roasted chips/fish on the left, 1 arrow label pointing to the skewer platter on the right, 1 label near the bottom left for small side dishes, 1 label near the lower right for crispy skewers, and 1 decorative underline beneath the headline. Add small stars, hearts, sparkles, curved arrows, and scribble accents around the text.

Text content: Use a big playful Chinese headline in thick hand lettering: 今天也要 开心心干饭呀!. Put a pink outlined speech bubble at the top right with the badge text 聚会首选 氛围感拉满~. Add a label above the pot reading 香辣过瘾 牛肉锅~. Add a left label reading 烤馍片 焦香酥脆~. Add a right label reading 烤串拼盘 种类超丰富!. Other small labels should be rendered as casual Chinese-style food review callouts, but keep them secondary and less dominant.

Visual style: Photorealistic appetizing food photography combined with hand-drawn editorial doodles, like a trendy Chinese restaurant recommendation post. Food should look freshly grilled with oil sheen, sesame, chili flakes, char marks, and steam-like warmth. The typography must feel hand-lettered, imperfect, energetic, and cute, not like a clean digital font.

Constraints: No people, no brand logos, no watermark, no extra UI frame. Keep the food realistic and the annotations legible, with the headline as the largest text element.

2117903200341231339.promptEn: Create a hyper-realistic premium travel-art campaign titled: "A COUNTRY IN A NOTEBOOK." IMPORTANT: Do NOT create a normal travel poster. Do NOT create a miniature city. Do NOT create a map. Instead, create the feeling that an entire country is emerging from the pages of a traveler's sketchbook. CORE CONCEPT An open handmade journal rests on a large wooden desk. The pages appear alive. Famous locations rise directly from the paper as three-dimensional worlds. The boundaries between drawing and reality become impossible to distinguish. Some buildings remain pencil sketches. Others transition into fully realized architecture. Roads flow out of ink lines. Rivers emerge from watercolor paint. Forests grow from brushstrokes. The country appears to be building itself. WORLD DESIGN Every landmark should feel handcrafted. Not miniature toy-like. Instead: architectural-maquette realism. Museum exhibition quality. Some structures are: fully completed, partially sketched, still being painted, emerging from blueprint lines. The image should reward close inspection. Tiny details everywhere. HUMAN SCALE Hundreds of tiny explorers travel through the pages. People: taking photographs, sketching landscapes, riding bicycles, sitting in cafés, exploring markets, crossing bridges. Each tiny figure should tell a story. VISUAL DETAILS Include: handwritten travel notes, torn ticket stubs, passport stamps, coffee rings, compass drawings, route markings, pressed flowers, old postcards, penciled annotations. Everything should feel collected during years of travel. LIGHTING Warm late-afternoon sunlight entering through a nearby window. Long shadows across notebook pages. Golden highlights on architecture. Dust particles visible in the air. Museum-like atmosphere. COLOR PALETTE Warm parchment, Cream paper, Soft graphite, Watercolor blues, Terracotta, Forest green, Golden sunlight, Muted travel-journal tones. CAMERA High-angle three-quarter perspective. The viewer sees both: the notebook itself, the entire miniature world emerging from it. Large-scale depth. Macro-photography realism. Tilt-shift subtlety. Premium travel-advertisement quality. STYLE Blend: luxury tourism campaigns, architectural concept art, handmade sketchbooks, National Geographic storytelling, premium editorial photography. FINAL FEELING The final image should feel like an entire country was lovingly reconstructed from memories, sketches, and adventures inside a single notebook. Viewers should want to zoom in for several minutes discovering tiny stories hidden throughout the world.

2117903200341231340.promptEn:
Goal: Create an epic dark-fantasy world map illustration for a perilous quest route, shown as a cinematic aerial panorama rather than a flat diagram.

Canvas: Ultra-wide 16:9 landscape image, high-resolution, dramatic matte-painting style, no border, no title text, no labels, no legend.

Layout and geography: Show one vast coastal kingdom from a high bird’s-eye view. In the lower center, place 1 enormous fortified medieval harbor city with dense rooftops, tall gothic towers, stone walls, docks, and tiny ships. To the far right, place 1 jagged volcanic island or black mountain chain with glowing orange lava and smoke. Across the upper third, place 1 massive vertical ice wall stretching horizontally across the entire land, with frozen waterfalls and sheer blue-white cliffs. Beyond the ice wall, show 1 frozen wasteland plateau full of snow, ruined towers, distant castles, and mountains under storm clouds. Between the city and the ice wall, show 1 broad dark forest region, 1 branching river delta, scattered villages, roads, ruins, and rocky hills. Surround the land with a stormy dark ocean, waves, mist, and small ships.

Route overlay: Add exactly 1 continuous glowing red hand-drawn travel route line, thin but bright, with small white-edged red arrowheads. The route begins near the harbor city, travels across the sea toward the volcanic island, then bends back to the city, winds north through the walled city, crosses wetlands and forests, passes through a narrow gate or gap in the ice wall, and continues as a winding path across the frozen plateau toward the distant north. Include exactly 13 visible arrowheads along the route: 3 over the sea toward the volcano and back, 3 around and inside the harbor city approach, 3 through the forested central land, 1 at the ice-wall passage, and 3 across the snowy northern plateau.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed cinematic fantasy concept art, realistic scale, desaturated blue-gray palette, cold storm lighting, moody clouds, volumetric fog, sharp terrain detail, miniature architectural detail, glowing lava contrast, crisp red route overlay like a strategic campaign map. The mood should feel dangerous, epic, and suitable for a fantasy game reveal or quest-planning visual.

Constraints: No readable text anywhere, no UI panels, no compass rose, no character closeups, no modern buildings, no watermark. Keep the red route clearly visible without making it look like a road; it should sit on top of the painted map as an annotated quest path.

2117903200341231341.promptEn: Create a photorealistic architectural interior rendering of a modern minimalist ice cream shop named Some ice, viewed from the front seating area looking toward the service counter in warm late-afternoon sunlight. The space is tall and narrow with cream plaster walls, gray concrete flooring, a gray textured back wall, white square-tile counter, warm wood ceiling canopy, hidden cove lighting, and soft shadows from tree leaves cast across the left wall and floor. Place the large shop logo above the counter, dark gray letters with a small yellow accent. The service area contains exactly 1 white tiled front counter, 1 large silver desktop computer on the counter, 1 staff member behind the counter wearing a cream shirt and beige apron, and 4 illuminated menu boards on the back wall labeled Signature, Sweet, Yogurt, and Classic with dessert photos. On the right wall, include exactly 3 wooden retail shelves displaying small branded paper bags or boxes. On the left wall, include exactly 3 framed promotional posters under a slim brass wall light, one featuring a cute mascot and the text Have Someice Day. Furnish the customer area with exactly 6 round café tables total: 2 in the left foreground, 2 smaller tables along the left middle wall, and 2 on the right side; include exactly 10 visible chairs total, mostly warm bentwood chairs with chrome legs plus 1 pale yellow chair and 1 black chair on the right. Add a staircase and narrow passage receding into the back left, with wood stair treads, a black metal railing, and a glimpse of brick wall and glass door at the far rear. Use a calm Scandinavian-Japanese café aesthetic, natural materials, realistic global illumination, soft depth, clean composition, no people except the single staff member, no clutter, no watermark, 3:2 horizontal aspect ratio.
2117903200341231341.promptZh: 创建一幅照片级写实（photorealistic）的现代极简主义冰淇淋店“Some ice”建筑室内渲染图，视角位于前部座位区，朝向服务柜台，呈现温暖的午后夕阳光线。空间高而窄，墙面为奶油色灰泥，地面为灰色混凝土，背景墙为灰色肌理墙面，服务柜台为白色方砖铺贴，天花板为暖木色遮罩式顶棚，配有隐藏式灯槽照明，左侧墙面与地面上投射出树叶形成的柔和阴影。在柜台正上方放置大型店铺标志，文字为深灰色，带一处小面积明黄色点缀。服务区域包含：1个白色瓷砖铺面的正面柜台、1台置于柜台上的大型银色台式电脑、1名站在柜台后的店员（身着奶油色衬衫与米褐色围裙），以及背景墙上4块点亮的菜单板，分别标注“Signature”、“Sweet”、“Yogurt”和“Classic”，并配有甜点图片。右侧墙面上设置恰好3组木质零售层架，陈列小型品牌纸袋或纸盒。左侧墙面上设置恰好3幅装框宣传海报，位于一根纤细黄铜壁灯下方，其中一幅海报含可爱吉祥物形象及文字“Have Someice Day”。顾客区陈设总计6张圆形咖啡馆桌：左前方2张，左中段墙面沿墙布置2张较小桌子，右侧布置2张；共配置总计10把可见座椅，主体为暖色调曲木椅配镀铬椅腿，另含1把浅黄色椅子与1把黑色椅子，均置于右侧。后左方加入一段楼梯与狭窄通道，向深处延伸，踏步为木质，扶手为黑色金属，远景可瞥见砖墙与玻璃门。整体采用宁静的斯堪的纳维亚—日式咖啡馆美学（Scandinavian-Japanese café aesthetic），强调天然材质、真实全局光照（global illumination）、柔和景深（soft depth）、干净构图（clean composition），除单名店员外不出现其他人物，无杂乱元素，无水印，横幅比例为3:2。

2117903200341231343.promptEn:
8K UHD hyper-realistic commercial food photography, 3:4 aspect ratio. 6 scenes, each on its own solid or gradient background:

Scene 1, Döner slice explosion: Traditional Turkish döner (beef and lamb mix), paper-thin ribbons spiraling outward mid-air, white garlic sauce and red chili sauce splashing, fresh parsley leaves floating. Deep crimson red background.

Scene 2, Dürüm wrap floating: Premium dürüm cut in half and floating vertically, cross-section revealing döner meat, lettuce, tomatoes, onions layered inside, white garlic yogurt sauce drizzling elegantly, subtle spice particles drifting. Warm terracotta orange background.

Scene 3, Sauce pour drama: Mound of freshly sliced döner with crispy charred edges, thick creamy garlic yogurt sauce pouring from above frozen mid-flow, spicy red chili sauce drizzling alongside in thin crimson streams, sliced tomatoes and parsley below, heat vapor rising. Dark charcoal black background.

Scene 4, Deconstructed composition: Toasted lavash bread pieces, döner slices, tomato slices, lettuce leaves, and onion rings all suspended separately at varying heights, glossy sauce ribbons connecting elements artistically, ultra-fine spice dust in the air. Muted sage green background.

Scene 5, Rotating spit close-up: Extreme close-up of vertical döner tower on spit, large döner knife frozen mid-slice, fresh slice falling away, charred bits and seasoning particles in air, heat vapor rising from the fresh cut. Rich golden amber background.

Scene 6, Overhead plate explosion: Top-down view, all ingredients bursting upward in circular pattern, döner slices, french fries, grilled peppers and tomatoes, fresh parsley, sumac, lemon wedges, sauce droplets spraying, elements at varying heights with some rotating. Deep burgundy red background with vignette.

Global: controlled studio lighting emphasizing meat texture and char marks, shallow to medium depth of field, rich contrast, warm savory tones, natural shine, appetizing color grading. No text, logos, people, hands, cartoon style, or plastic-looking food.
2117903200341231343.promptZh:
8K 超高清（UHD）超写实（hyper-realistic）商业美食摄影，3:4 画幅比。共 6 个场景，每个场景均置于纯色或渐变背景之上：

场景 1，旋转飞散的烤肉片：传统土耳其烤肉（牛肉与羊肉混合），纸薄状肉条在空中呈螺旋状向外飞散，白色蒜味酱汁与红色辣椒酱飞溅，新鲜欧芹叶漂浮其中。深绯红色背景。

场景 2，悬浮的卷饼（dürüm）：高品质卷饼垂直悬浮并从中切开，横截面清晰展现内部烤肉、生菜、番茄与洋葱的层层叠放结构，白色蒜味酸奶酱优雅滴落，细微香料颗粒缓缓飘散。暖陶土橙色背景。

场景 3，酱汁倾倒戏剧感：一堆新鲜切片烤肉，边缘酥脆焦化，浓稠顺滑的蒜味酸奶酱自上方倾泻而下，凝固于半空流动瞬间；同时，辛辣红色辣椒酱以纤细深红细流形式沿侧边滴落；下方铺有番茄片与欧芹叶，热气蒸腾上升。深炭黑色背景。

场景 4，解构式构图：烘烤过的拉瓦什（lavash）面包碎块、烤肉片、番茄片、生菜叶与洋葱圈各自悬浮于不同高度，富有光泽的酱汁丝带艺术化连接各元素，空气中弥漫超细香料粉尘。低饱和鼠尾草绿色背景。

场景 5，旋转烤架特写（close-up）：垂直烤肉塔（döner tower）置于烤架（spit）上的极致特写（extreme close-up），大型烤肉刀正冻结于切割中途，一片新鲜肉片正脱离主体下坠，焦化碎屑与调味颗粒悬浮空中，新鲜切口处热气蒸腾上升。浓郁金琥珀色背景。

场景 6，俯视餐盘爆炸：自上而下的视角，所有食材以环形图案向上迸发——烤肉片、薯条、烤甜椒与番茄、新鲜欧芹、红莓粉（sumac）、柠檬角、酱汁液滴喷射飞散；各元素处于不同高度，部分呈旋转状态。深酒红色背景，带暗角（vignette）效果。

全局要求：精准控制的影棚布光（studio lighting），突出肉类纹理与焦痕；景深（depth of field）为浅至中等；高对比度；温暖醇厚的风味色调；自然光泽；诱人食欲的色彩分级（color grading）。画面中不得出现文字、商标、人物、手部、卡通风格，或塑料质感的食物。

2117903200341231344.promptEn: Create a photorealistic horizontal vintage snapshot of an elderly female gardener harvesting red grapes in a lush backyard cottage garden. The scene shows exactly 1 gardener standing and bending forward, her face softly anonymized with a natural blur, wearing a short-sleeved faded floral dress, beige gardening gloves, black flats, and holding pruning shears near a hanging bunch of grapes above a metal wire basket. Include exactly 1 gray lop-eared rabbit sitting upright beside her, wearing a green knitted sweater with two white stripes, looking up toward the grapes. Visible garden elements: 1 shallow stone birdbath on the left, 1 wooden trellis covered with grapevine leaves, 4 terracotta flower pots with blooming geraniums and petunias in the foreground, 1 wire basket filled with grapes, 2 visible grape clusters, 1 weathered white wooden shed in the background, 1 blooming pink rose bush, 1 coiled green garden hose on the shed wall, and 8 irregular stone path slabs leading through soil and straw mulch. 2117903200341231344.promptZh: 创作一张照片级写实（photorealistic）的横向复古快照，描绘一位老年女性园丁正在郁郁葱葱的后院小屋花园中采摘红葡萄。画面中恰好有1位园丁站立并向前弯腰，面部以自然模糊方式柔和匿名化处理，身穿短袖褪色碎花连衣裙、米色园艺手套、黑色平底鞋，手持修枝剪，靠近悬垂于金属丝编篮上方的一串葡萄。画面中需包含恰好1只灰毛垂耳兔，直立坐于她身旁，身着绿色针织毛衣，毛衣上有两条白色条纹，正仰头望向葡萄。可见的花园元素包括：左侧1个浅口石制鸟浴盆；1座木制藤架，覆满葡萄藤叶；前景中4个赤陶花盆，栽有盛开的天竺葵与矮牵牛；1个装满葡萄的金属丝编篮；2串清晰可见的葡萄果穗；背景中1座风化泛白的木制小棚屋；1丛盛放的粉红色玫瑰灌木；小棚屋墙面上盘绕着1根绿色花园软管；以及8块不规则形状的石板铺就的小径，蜿蜒穿过泥土与稻草覆盖层。采用温暖的午后晚期自然光线、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、真实质感、泥土感的绿色与棕色色调、富有魅力的奇趣写实风格（charming whimsical realism），以及怀旧的印刷照片质感（nostalgic printed-photo look）。图像以奶油色毛边复古纸框（cream deckle-edged vintage paper border）构图，边缘带有轻微阴影与磨损的边角。画面中不得出现文字、水印、额外动物或额外人物。

2117903200341231345.promptEn: Create a polished square promotional hero graphic for an online class about using ChatGPT for commercial product visuals. Canvas: 1:1 aspect ratio, dark navy-to-charcoal gradient background with a subtle studio floor reflection and soft vignette. Center the composition on a premium blank t-shirt floating in midair, rendered as a realistic 3D product mockup with smooth fabric texture, short sleeves, rounded collar, and no logos. Lighting should be dramatic studio-soft with warm golden rim light from the left and cool electric blue light from the right, creating a high-end ecommerce product photography feel. Surround the product with glowing gold circuit-board traces, small luminous nodes, and scattered bokeh particles, suggesting AI prompt engineering and automated commerce workflows. Add exactly 3 semi-transparent dark glassmorphism code-terminal windows around the product: one upper left, one upper right, and one lower left/lower right area split visually by perspective; each window has rounded corners, tiny red/yellow/green window dots, faint monospace code snippets, and subtle blur, but text can be mostly decorative except the upper-left terminal title should read “$ prompt engineering terminal”. Make the terminals look like prompt and JSON/code panels controlling the product render. At the bottom center, add large clean typography with the title “ChatGPT” in white and the subtitle “Foundations” in warm gold. Overall style: commercial-grade tech course thumbnail, premium Shopify/ecommerce product visual, cinematic lighting, crisp high-resolution render, balanced negative space, no watermark, no extra logos, no people.
2117903200341231345.promptZh: 为一门关于使用 ChatGPT 生成商业产品视觉图的在线课程创作一张精致的方形推广主视觉图。画布：1:1 纵横比，深海军蓝至炭灰色渐变背景，带微妙的影棚地面倒影和柔和暗角（vignette）。构图中心为一件悬浮于空中的高端纯色 T 恤，以逼真的 3D 产品样机（product mockup）形式呈现，具有顺滑的织物纹理、短袖与圆领设计，且无任何标识（logo）。布光需采用富有戏剧感的影棚柔光（studio-soft lighting），左侧配暖金色轮廓光（rim light），右侧配冷调电蓝色光线，营造高端电商产品摄影（ecommerce product photography）质感。在产品周围添加发光的金色电路板走线（circuit-board traces）、微小的发光节点（luminous nodes）及散落的焦外虚化（bokeh）粒子，暗示 AI 提示工程（prompt engineering）与自动化商业工作流（automated commerce workflows）。在产品周围精准放置 3 个半透明深色玻璃拟态（glassmorphism）代码终端窗口：一个位于左上方，一个位于右上方，第三个位于左下方/右下方区域，通过透视视觉分割；每个窗口均具圆角、微小的红/黄/绿三色窗口控制点、隐约可见的等宽字体（monospace）代码片段及细微高斯模糊（blur），其中文字整体可作装饰性处理，但左上角终端窗口标题须显示 “$ prompt engineering terminal”。使这些终端窗口呈现为控制该产品渲染的提示词（prompt）与 JSON/代码面板（JSON/code panels）。在画面底部中央添加大号简洁排版：主标题为 “ChatGPT”（白色），副标题为“Foundations”（暖金色）。整体风格：商用级科技课程缩略图（tech course thumbnail）、高端 Shopify/电商产品视觉图（ecommerce product visual）、电影感布光（cinematic lighting）、清晰高分辨率渲染（crisp high-resolution render）、均衡的负空间（balanced negative space）、无水印、无额外标识（logo）、无人物。

2117903200341231346.promptEn: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic full-body fashion portrait of a stylish fair young Pakistani woman standing in a modern upscale café lounge, shown from head to shoes in a relaxed three-quarter side pose with her hands gently clasped at waist level. Her face is softly anonymized/blurred, and her dark hair is tied back in a neat low ponytail. She wears exactly 7 visible outfit and accessory elements: a blue-green oversized plaid cropped button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, a fitted white inner top, a sheer white dupatta with pale pink edging draped around her shoulders and flowing down her back, high-waisted light-wash wide-leg jeans, clean white low-top sneakers, a gold wristwatch, and small stud earrings. Use ultra-modern 2026 modest streetwear fashion with premium fabric texture and realistic stitching. The setting is a warm beige café interior with large bright windows on the left, soft sofas and seated customers in the background, a curved cream counter on the right, shallow depth of field, golden ambient lighting, and a polished tiled floor. Include exactly 4 blurred background people: one seated woman at the left foreground table, one seated person near the left window, and two seated men near the counter on the right. Shoot like a high-end editorial lifestyle photograph using an 85mm lens, natural window light, creamy bokeh, realistic proportions, detailed denim texture, soft shadows, and a warm cinematic color grade. Avoid text, logos, watermarks, extra limbs, distorted hands, or exaggerated facial features.
2117903200341231346.promptZh: 创作一幅超写实（hyper-realistic）电影感（cinematic）全身时尚人像，描绘一位时尚、肤色白皙的年轻巴基斯坦女性，伫立于一家现代高端咖啡馆休闲区，以轻松的四分之三侧身姿态从头至脚完整呈现，双手自然交叠于腰际。她的面部经柔和匿名化/模糊处理，深色头发整齐束于脑后，形成低马尾。她身上共呈现恰好7件可见的服饰与配饰元素：一件蓝绿色 oversized 格纹短款纽扣衬衫，袖口挽至小臂；一件合身的白色内搭上衣；一条半透明白色杜帕塔（dupatta），边缘缀有浅粉色滚边，轻柔披覆于双肩并垂落于背部；一条高腰浅水洗阔腿牛仔裤；一双洁净的白色低帮运动鞋；一只金色腕表；以及一对小巧的耳钉。采用2026年超现代端庄街头风（modest streetwear）造型，面料质感高级，走线真实可辨。场景为暖米色咖啡馆室内，左侧设大面积明亮落地窗，背景中有柔软沙发及就座顾客，右侧设一道弧形奶油色吧台，景深（depth of field）较浅，环境光呈金色，地面为抛光瓷砖。背景中须包含恰好4位虚化人物：一位坐在左前方桌旁的女性，一位坐在左侧窗边的就座者，以及两位坐在右侧吧台附近的男性。拍摄风格仿照高端杂志生活方式摄影（editorial lifestyle photograph），使用85mm镜头，依赖自然窗光，焦外虚化（bokeh）如奶油般柔滑，人体比例真实，牛仔布纹理细节丰富，阴影柔和，整体采用温暖电影感（cinematic）色调分级。禁止出现文字、商标、水印、多余肢体、手部畸变或夸张面部特征。

2117903200341231347.promptEn: Vertical badge-style portrait, pure black background, deep tech aesthetic. East Asian female, early thirties, face sharp and calm, eyes slightly upturned, as if staring at some deep truth beyond the frame — a silent insight. Black hair neatly pulled back into a low bun, with a loose strand of hair faintly appearing like data threads in the blue rim light. No glasses, eyes are the absolute focus: a faint cyan-blue bio-fluorescence glows inside the dark iris, suggesting deep cognition and insight. Clothing: A neatly tailored midnight blue high-collared long coat, with geometric seam lines faintly visible on the fabric like circuit traces; a matte texture with a subtle iridescent sheen. Simple dark undergarment. No accessories except for a minimalist geometric brooch at the neckline in the shape of a micro-prism. The figure is encased in an asymmetrical metal frame: brushed dark titanium texture, beveled edges, with precise wear textures on the surface, embedded with faint pulsing cyan light lines. Diamond/prism decorative elements at the top and bottom of the frame. Background: A giant glowing deep blue prism suspended behind the figure, decomposing an invisible beam of light into fine cyan and purple spectral arcs surrounding the portrait. The outer layer consists of concentric thin rings with a subtle hexagonal grid texture, echoing neural network topology. Soft volumetric light diffuses from behind, creating an atmosphere of deep exploration. Lighting: Chiaroscuro — the right side of the face lit by cold cyan light (technology, clarity, logic), the left side hidden in deep shadow, retaining a faint warm undertone (humanity, curiosity, the warmth beneath rationality). Skin shows pore-level realistic texture, as if some inner energy glows slightly beneath the dermal layer. Text at the bottom of the badge "DS Agent", refined minimalist sans-serif metallic font, with a subtle gradient from deep blue to cyan, slightly recessed into the metal base plate. Art Style: Cinematic character concept, intellectual sci-fi, Dark Academia fused with Cyberpunk, high-end concept art, 8K, hyper-realistic, rich material rendering, volumetric lighting. 1:1, rounded rectangle.
2117903200341231347.promptZh: 竖版徽章式人像，纯黑色背景，深科技（deep tech）美学。东亚女性，三十岁出头，面部轮廓锐利而沉静，双眼微微上扬，仿佛凝视着画框之外某种深邃的真理——一种无声的洞见。黑发整齐束于脑后成低髻，一缕松散发丝在蓝色轮廓光（rim light）中若隐若现，形如数据流线。不戴眼镜，双眼为绝对视觉焦点：深色虹膜内泛起微弱青蓝色生物荧光，暗示深度认知与洞察力。服饰：剪裁精良的午夜蓝高领长外套，面料上隐约可见几何缝线，形似电路走线；哑光质感，表面泛有微妙的虹彩光泽。内搭简约深色贴身衣。除颈线处一枚极简几何胸针外，无其他配饰，胸针造型为微型棱镜。人物被嵌入一个不对称金属边框中：拉丝深钛金属质感，倒角边缘，表面带有精准刻画的磨损纹理，并嵌有微弱脉动的青色光纹。边框顶部与底部饰有钻石/棱镜状装饰元素。背景：一枚巨型发光深蓝色棱镜悬浮于人物后方，将一束不可见光分解为环绕人像的纤细青色与紫色光谱弧线。外层由同心细环构成，环面带有微妙六边形网格纹理，呼应神经网络拓扑结构。柔和体积光（volumetric lighting）自后方弥散，营造深层探索氛围。布光：明暗对照法（Chiaroscuro）——面部右侧受冷调青色光照明（象征科技、清晰、逻辑），左侧隐于深影之中，但保留一抹微弱暖调底色（象征人性、好奇心、理性之下的温度）。皮肤呈现毛孔级写实纹理，仿佛真皮层之下有某种内在能量微微透出辉光。徽章底部文字 \
