2117903200341231389.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cinematic action film storyboard sheet for a noir cyberpunk sword-fight sequence starring Kage.

Canvas: Wide landscape storyboard page, monochrome black-and-white ink sketch with gray wash shading, aspect ratio about 16:9. Use a clean 2 row x 2 column grid with exactly 4 rectangular panels, thin black panel borders, and a white caption strip along the bottom of every panel. Each panel has a bold frame label in a small white box at top-left: exactly 4 labels, S1, S2, S3, S4.

Visual style: Detailed hand-drawn cinematic storyboard art, gritty manga/comic influence, heavy crosshatching, rain, wet reflections, smoky atmosphere, dynamic camera framing, motion arrows, impact bursts, speed lines, and handwritten storyboard notes. Mostly grayscale with subtle cold blue-white glow only on the sword slash trails. No full-color rendering.

Setting and subject details: A rainy neon-lit futuristic city street at night, crowded with vertical signs and tall buildings. Preserve visible Japanese-style signs including 「死神」 and 「未来ホテル」 on background billboards. The hero is a dark-haired lone swordsman in a torn flowing cloak, armored gauntlet, dark tactical clothing, and boots, wielding a glowing katana. Enemies are armored soldiers with helmets, rifles, pistols, and heavy tactical gear.

Layout and panel contents: Use exactly 4 storyboard panels. Panel S1: wide low-angle static establishing shot in the rain, hero centered with back/three-quarter view, cloak whipping, glowing sword held down, soldiers closing in from foreground left and right plus midground; add a handwritten arrow and label reading “KAGE” above the hero. Panel S2: medium snap action close shot, hero lunges horizontally and draws the sword in a bright slash, striking a helmeted soldier in the head/upper body, with an impact explosion, flying debris, a gun thrown aside, and one large curved motion arrow. Panel S3: wide fast-track chaos shot, hero spinning through a squad at center with a circular glowing blade trail; multiple soldiers are blasted backward around him, muzzle flashes and impact bursts on both sides, speed lines radiating outward, and comic sound effects “BRAKKA!”, “TAK!”, “TAK!” near firing enemies; include three bold white motion arrows around the action. Panel S4: low-angle static aftermath shot, hero crouched on one knee in the rain with one hand on the ground and sword extended horizontally, surrounded by fallen soldiers and debris; wet street reflections dominate the foreground, vertical neon signs glow behind him, and the pose reads victorious.

Caption strip text: Each panel bottom strip must contain exactly 3 text areas: left frame label, middle camera/action tags, right scene note. S1 strip: “S1 | WIDE | LOW ANGLE | STATIC | Establish. Enemies close in.” S2 strip: “S2 | MEDIUM | SNAP | Kage draws and strikes first.” S3 strip: “S3 | WIDE | FAST TRACK | Kage slices through the squad. Speed. Chaos.” S4 strip: “S4 | LOW ANGLE | STATIC | Aftermath. Kage stands victorious.”

Constraints: Countable elements must match: exactly 4 panels, exactly 4 top-left frame labels, exactly 4 bottom caption strips, exactly 1 central hero, and a visible squad of armored enemies in multiple panels. Keep the image as a production storyboard sheet, not a polished movie still. Avoid extra panels, extra frame labels, watermarks, logos, or unrelated text.

2117903200341231390.promptEn: Create a highly realistic studio creature concept image of a hybrid quadruped resembling a powerful black bull or bison with a massive muscular body, short dark fur, heavy folded skin around the neck, sturdy legs, split hooves, a thin tail with a tuft, and a raised shoulder hump. The creature’s head is transformed into a delicate white deer-like face enclosed inside a large perfectly transparent glass sphere, like a biological helmet or orb. Inside the sphere, show an intricate luminous branching antler system: countless ivory-white coral-like antler branches radiate upward and outward, with translucent wet organic textures, tiny pearl-like nodes, and fine vein-like tendrils continuing back into the black shoulder area. The visible head should have a calm pale face, small ears, dark eyes, and a narrow muzzle, contrasting sharply with the dark body. Add exactly one main creature, one transparent spherical helmet, one pale deer-like head, one large branching antler crown, four visible legs, and one tail. Use deep charcoal black, porcelain white, and neutral light gray. Compose the creature in a full-body three-quarter side view facing right, centered on a seamless gray studio backdrop with soft floor contact shadow. Lighting should be soft, diffused, and high-end photographic, emphasizing glossy glass reflections, velvety fur, sculptural anatomy, and subtle biomechanical organic details. Style: hyperrealistic cinematic creature design, museum specimen photography, elegant surrealism, no text, no humans, no extra animals, no environment props.
2117903200341231390.promptZh: 创作一幅高度写实的摄影棚生物概念图：一只混合型四足生物，形似强健的黑色公牛或野牛，拥有庞大肌肉化的躯体、短而深色的毛发、颈部厚重褶皱的皮肤、粗壮的四肢、分趾蹄、一条末端带簇毛的细长尾巴，以及隆起的肩峰。该生物的头部被转化为一张精致的白色鹿类面容，并完全包裹在一个大型、完全透明的玻璃球体内，形如生物头盔或玻璃球罩。球体内部呈现一套复杂发光的分枝状鹿角系统：无数象牙白珊瑚状鹿角分枝向上及向外辐射延展，表面具有半透明湿润的有机质感、微小珍珠状节结，以及纤细如血管的藤蔓状细丝，向后延伸进入黑色肩部区域。可见的头部应呈现平静苍白的面容、小巧的耳朵、深色双眼与窄长口鼻，与深色躯体形成强烈对比。画面中须严格包含：一个主体生物、一个透明球形头盔、一张苍白鹿类面孔、一顶大型分枝状鹿角冠、四条清晰可见的腿、一条尾巴。色彩限定为深炭黑色、瓷器白色与中性浅灰。构图采用全身三分之四侧视角度，生物面朝右侧，居中置于无缝灰色摄影棚背景之上，脚部与地面接触处投下柔和阴影。布光需柔和、漫射、高端摄影级，着重凸显玻璃的镜面反光（glossy glass reflections）、毛发的天鹅绒质感（velvety fur）、雕塑感解剖结构（sculptural anatomy）以及微妙的仿生有机细节（subtle biomechanical organic details）。风格：超写实电影感生物设计（hyperrealistic cinematic creature design）、博物馆标本摄影（museum specimen photography）、优雅超现实主义（elegant surrealism）；画面中不得出现文字、人类、其他动物或环境道具。

2117903200341231391.promptEn: A minimalistic advertising poster about food in a modern Italian style with Japanese layout aesthetics, preserving the exact compositional structure: two large rounded vertical geometric color blocks arranged diagonally along the composition, food photography with a view from above. The upper left block is a hero dish: fresh tagliatelle pasta with truffle cream and parmesan cheese on a light ceramic plate, with thin slices of black truffle, olive oil and microgreens, premium restaurant service. The lower right block is the second hero dish: slow—stewed ossobuco with saffron risotto on a matte dark plate, with rich sauce, gremolata and fresh herbs, modern author's Italian cuisine. Floating side dishes and appliances are neatly arranged around each dish: vintage cutlery, linen napkins, sprigs of rosemary and thyme, cherry tomatoes, slices of parmesan, miniature saucepans with olive oil, fresh handmade focaccia, olives and spices. Large typography in modern Italian style is aligned to the upper right, the text is entirely in English : the name of the restaurant, the names of the dishes and the prices. Small text with prices is placed next to each dish. Airy editorial is a negative space system, a soft pastel commercial palette with shades of cream, terracotta, olive, sage and graphite. Clear asymmetrical visual hierarchy, premium restaurant branding aesthetics, cinematic soft shadows, modern menu presentation in poster format. The subtle signature in the footer is naturally integrated into the bottom of the composition. Pure vertical composition, ultra detailed, premium branding, realistic food styling, soft cinematic dim green lighting, Italian cuisine editorial poster design, minimalism.
2117903200341231391.promptZh:
一张极简主义的食品广告海报，呈现现代意大利风格，并融合日本版式美学，严格保留原始构图结构：两个大型圆角垂直几何色块沿画面呈对角线排列，配以俯拍视角的食物摄影。  
左上色块为主推菜品：新鲜宽面（tagliatelle）搭配松露奶油酱与帕尔马干酪，盛于浅色陶瓷盘中，点缀薄切黑松露片、特级初榨橄榄油及微菜苗，体现高端餐厅服务水准。  
右下色块为第二主推菜品：慢炖牛膝骨（ossobuco）配藏红花烩饭，盛于哑光深色餐盘中，佐以浓郁酱汁、格雷莫拉塔（gremolata）及新鲜香草，展现现代主厨风格的意大利料理。  
环绕每道主菜，悬浮式陈列配餐小食与厨具：复古刀叉、亚麻餐巾、迷迭香与百里香枝条、樱桃番茄、帕尔马干酪薄片、盛有橄榄油的迷你炖锅、新鲜手工佛卡夏面包、橄榄及香料。  
现代意大利风格的大号字体排布于右上方，全部文字使用英文：餐厅名称、菜品名称及价格。  
各菜品旁标注对应的小号价格文字。  
通透的编辑式留白系统（airy editorial negative space system），采用柔和的商业性粉彩色调，包含米白、赤陶色、橄榄绿、鼠尾草绿与石墨灰等色系。  
清晰的非对称视觉层级，高端餐厅品牌美学，电影感柔焦阴影（cinematic soft shadows），以海报形式呈现的现代菜单设计。  
底部自然融入低调签名，无缝嵌入构图底端。  
纯粹竖向构图，超精细（ultra detailed），高端品牌调性，写实风格食物造型（realistic food styling），柔和电影感昏暗青绿色布光（soft cinematic dim green lighting），意大利料理主题编辑类海报设计（Italian cuisine editorial poster design），极简主义（minimalism）。

2117903200341231392.promptEn: Create a full-body ultra-photorealistic portrait of an adult man standing centered on a narrow woodland path in a magical enchanted forest at golden hour. The subject wears a loose off-white linen tunic with a deep open collar, matching relaxed linen pants, and dark hiking shoes; his hands rest casually in his pants pockets, posture upright and calm, facing the camera. Surround him with dense lush green foliage, mossy rocks, small pale wildflowers, twisting tree trunks, and a shallow sparkling stream running beside the path. Warm sunlight pours from behind the subject through the tree canopy, creating strong golden backlighting, volumetric sun rays, rim light on the clothing, long shadows on the forest floor, and a dreamy cinematic glow. Add numerous tiny floating golden firefly-like light particles throughout the forest, especially around the midground and background. Use a vertical portrait composition, eye-level camera, full body visible from head to shoes, realistic proportions, natural fabric texture, detailed leaves and moss, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, and an ethereal fantasy atmosphere. Keep the scene photorealistic rather than illustrated, with no text, no watermark, no extra people, and no animals.
2117903200341231392.promptZh:
创作一幅全身超照片级写实（ultra-photorealistic）肖像，描绘一名成年男性伫立于一条狭窄林间小径中央，背景为魔法 enchanting 森林，时间设定在黄金时刻（golden hour）。主体身穿宽松的米白色亚麻束腰外衣，领口深开；下搭同色系宽松亚麻长裤及深色登山鞋；双手自然插在裤袋中，体态挺拔而沉静，正对镜头。  
周围环绕浓密繁茂的翠绿 foliage、覆满青苔的岩石、细小淡色野花、盘曲虬结的树干，以及沿小径一侧蜿蜒流淌的浅水粼粼溪流。  
温暖阳光自主体后方穿透林冠洒落，形成强烈的金色逆光（golden backlighting）、体积感光束（volumetric sun rays）、衣物边缘的轮廓光（rim light）、森林地面拉长的阴影，以及梦幻般的电影感辉光（cinematic glow）。  
在整个森林中添加大量微小漂浮的金色萤火虫状光粒子，尤以中景与背景区域为密集。  
采用竖幅人像构图（vertical portrait composition），相机处于平视高度（eye-level camera），完整呈现从头部至鞋尖的全身形象，比例自然真实，布料纹理细腻可辨，叶片与青苔细节丰富，景深（depth of field）浅，高动态范围（high dynamic range），整体氛围空灵奇幻（ethereal fantasy atmosphere）。  
确保画面为照片级写实（photorealistic），而非插画风格；不添加文字、无水印、无人物（除主体外）、无动物。

2117903200341231394.promptEn: Create a polished studio fashion portrait of a confident young Black man standing in a 3/4 pose against a rich warm burnt-sienna and terracotta textured studio backdrop. Frame him from mid-thigh upward in a vertical portrait composition, body angled slightly to the viewer’s left, shoulders relaxed, one hand tucked into his trouser pocket and the other arm resting naturally at his side. He wears a sophisticated formal outfit: an ivory-white jacquard dinner jacket with subtle floral paisley texture, wide shawl lapels, a single black button, flap pockets, crisp white dress shirt with black studs, oversized black velvet bow tie with a small gold-and-black oval brooch at the center, black pocket square, fitted black trousers, a silver wristwatch, and a textured black flat cap. 2117903200341231394.promptZh: 创作一幅精致的影棚时尚肖像画，描绘一位自信的年轻黑人男性，以三分之二身姿站立于富有质感的暖调烧赭色与赤陶色影棚背景前。采用竖构图，画面截取其大腿中部以上部分；身体微微朝观者左侧倾斜，双肩放松，一手插在裤袋中，另一只手臂自然垂于身侧。他身着一套考究的正装：象牙白提花晚礼服夹克，表面带有细腻的花卉佩斯利纹样，宽大的青果领（shawl lapels），单颗黑色纽扣，带盖口袋；内搭挺括的白色正装衬衫，配黑色饰钉； oversized 黑色丝绒蝴蝶结领结，中央镶嵌一枚小巧的金黑双色椭圆形胸针；黑色口袋巾；合身的黑色长裤；银色腕表；以及一顶带有纹理的黑色平顶帽。采用柔和的、来自左前方的影棚布光（studio lighting），以凸显夹克面料纹理并营造轻柔阴影；肤色真实自然，剪裁精良，呈现高端杂志编辑风格（high-end editorial styling），浅景深（shallow depth of field），服装细节锐利清晰，整体氛围为高端杂志肖像感（premium magazine portrait mood）。背景保持简洁，仅保留绘画感纹理（painterly texture），不添加文字、无商标、无道具、无人物。

2117903200341231396.promptEn: Create a warm, cute, highly polished anime-style café illustration of an extremely round golden-and-white hamster sitting on a wooden table and eating fluffy chiffon cake. The hamster is the central subject, oversized and plush, with glossy black eyes, small rounded ears, a pink nose, tiny paws holding one cube of sponge cake, soft white whiskers, and orange-brown fur patches over a creamy white belly. In front of it is a white plate holding exactly 4 food items: one large upright slice of golden chiffon cake, one swirl of whipped cream, one whole red strawberry with green leaves, and scattered cake crumbs. The setting is a cozy morning patisserie with golden sunlight streaming through a window on the left, soft depth of field, creamy beige walls, warm highlights, and a dreamy wholesome mood. Add a pale pink café mug on the lower left printed with a simple hamster-face logo and the text “SORA City Patisserie.” Add a small glass vase of daisies and tiny pink flowers on the left. In the background on the right, include a chalkboard sign with the large text “SORA,” the subtitle “City Patisserie,” and the handwritten English lines “Good morning!” and “Have a sweet day” with small heart doodles. Also show a cake stand with a strawberry-topped cake under a glass dome and a softly blurred pastry display shelf. Overlay large handwritten Japanese text near the upper left reading おはよう, in thick rounded brown lettering with a white outline. Add exactly 3 decorative doodles around the greeting: one smiling sun near the top center, one small peach heart beneath it, and one orange outlined heart on the left. On the lower right, place a small standing menu card with Japanese text reading “ふわふわ シフォンケーキ ♡ おすすめ!” with tiny floral decorations. Use a square composition, soft bokeh, pastel orange and cream color palette, gentle rim lighting, crisp adorable character detail, appetizing cake texture, no extra characters, no watermark.
2117903200341231396.promptZh: 创作一幅温暖、可爱、高度精致的动漫风格咖啡馆插画：一只极其圆润的金白相间仓鼠坐在木桌上，正在享用蓬松的雪纺蛋糕。仓鼠是画面中心主体，体型夸张、毛绒感十足，拥有亮黑色眼睛、小巧圆润的耳朵、粉红色鼻子、正用微小前爪捧着一块海绵蛋糕方块、柔软的白色胡须，以及覆盖在奶油色腹部之上的橙棕色毛斑。仓鼠正前方是一只白色餐盘，盘中精确摆放4件食物：一大块直立的金色雪纺蛋糕切片、一团漩涡状鲜奶油、一颗带绿色叶子的完整红草莓，以及散落的蛋糕碎屑。场景设定为温馨的晨间法式甜品店，左侧窗户透入金色阳光，景深（depth of field）柔和，墙面为奶油米色，暖调高光，整体氛围梦幻而纯真。左下角放置一只浅粉色咖啡杯，印有简洁的仓鼠脸标志及文字“SORA City Patisserie.”。左侧另置一只小玻璃花瓶，插有雏菊与细小的粉色花朵。背景右侧设有一块黑板招牌，上方以大号字体书写“SORA,”，副标题为“City Patisserie”，下方手写英文短句“Good morning!”与“Have a sweet day”，并配有小巧的心形涂鸦。此外，还可见一座蛋糕架，其上摆放着顶部饰有草莓的蛋糕，并罩于玻璃圆顶之下；另有一排烘焙展示架，呈柔和焦外虚化（bokeh）效果。在画面左上方附近叠加大幅手写日文文字“おはよう”，采用粗圆润的棕色字体，带白色描边。在该问候语周围精确添加3个装饰性涂鸦：顶部中央一个微笑太阳、其正下方一颗小桃心、左侧一个橙色描边的心形。右下角放置一张小型立式菜单卡，其上日文文字为“ふわふわ シフォンケーキ ♡ おすすめ!”，并配有微小花卉装饰。采用方形构图，柔焦焦外虚化（bokeh），配色为柔和的橘色与奶油色，辅以轻柔的轮廓光（rim lighting），角色细节清晰可爱，蛋糕质感诱人可口，画面中无其他人物，无水印。

2117903200341231397.promptEn:
Goal: Create a futuristic vertical tech poster announcing AI 2026, centered on a glowing artificial-intelligence brain made of neural network lines and circuit traces.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, dark navy-to-black background, high contrast, crisp sci-fi lighting, no border or watermark.

Layout: Put an enormous bold uppercase headline at the top reading AI 2026. Use a heavy condensed sans-serif font with white-to-icy-blue gradient fill, bevel-like highlights, and electric blue outer glow. Directly below it, add a thin glowing divider line and the small spaced uppercase tagline: INTELLIGENCE. INNOVATION. INFINITE POSSIBILITIES.

Main subject: In the center and lower half, draw one large side-view human brain silhouette formed from hundreds of luminous blue nodes and connecting lines, like a digital neural constellation. The brain should glow intensely with cyan, electric blue, and white points of light, with denser bright nodes scattered throughout. From the bottom of the brain, vertical circuit pathways descend into a circular holographic portal or target-like light source at the bottom center.

Background: Fill the entire background with subtle printed-circuit-board traces, microchip paths, small dots, tiny squares, and faint interface markings. The circuitry should radiate around and behind the brain, mostly thin neon-blue lines on black, with some brighter connection points.

Side feature panels: Include exactly 6 small icon-and-label feature blocks, three on the left and three on the right, aligned vertically beside the brain. Left side from top to bottom: 1) microchip icon labeled “LEARN ADAPT”, 2) abstract brain/flower network icon labeled “THINK CREATE”, 3) globe icon labeled “CONNECT TRANSFORM”. Right side from top to bottom: 4) rising bar chart icon labeled “DATA DRIVEN”, 5) shield with lock icon labeled “TRUST SECURE”, 6) three-person group icon labeled “HUMAN CENTERED”. Use small cyan line icons with uppercase stacked labels and thin horizontal divider lines.

Visual style: Premium cyberpunk infographic poster, sharp vector-meets-3D rendering, glowing blue holographic effects, radiant lens flares, detailed circuitry, symmetrical composition, clean readable typography, ultra-detailed, high resolution.

Constraints: Keep all visible text spelled exactly as specified, make the headline very legible, use only the 6 side feature blocks listed, avoid extra labels, avoid logos, avoid photographic people.

2117903200341231398.promptEn: Create a cinematic cyberpunk anime action scene in a rainy neon-lit alley at night. The setting is a dense futuristic Japanese city alley with reflective cobblestone pavement, heavy rain, puddles, mist, exposed pipes, hanging cables, umbrellas in the background, and many vertical neon signs with Japanese/Chinese-style characters in pink, cyan, blue, orange, and purple. Use a dynamic wide 16:9 composition, dramatic perspective, high contrast rim lighting, motion streaks, rain splashes around the fighters’ feet, detailed armor and cloth folds, glowing reflections on the ground, dark blue atmospheric shadows, and polished high-end anime concept art quality. 2117903200341231407.promptEn:
Goal: Create a full-body character design turnaround sheet for a gritty cyberpunk-western bounty hunter named Vane, emphasizing realistic worn materials, dust, grime, and lived-in clothing.

Canvas: Wide horizontal concept-art sheet on a plain warm off-white studio background, no scenery, no props except worn clothing and accessories. Use soft neutral lighting and subtle contact shadows under the boots.

Layout: Show exactly 4 full-body standing views of the same male character, evenly spaced left to right: 1) front view facing camera, 2) three-quarter front view turned slightly to the viewer’s right, 3) strict side profile facing right, 4) back view. Keep proportions consistent across all four views and align the feet on the same ground line.

Subject details: Adult rugged male bounty hunter with messy short dark hair, lean build, weathered posture, and a realistic human body. The face should be deliberately obscured by a soft rectangular blur/censor block in the first three visible-face views, while the back view shows only the back of the head. Outfit includes exactly 7 main visible clothing/accessory elements: 1) long distressed oxblood-red duster coat with high collar, frayed hem, patched shoulders, seams, worn cuffs, and dirty leather texture; 2) dark charcoal button-up shirt beneath the coat; 3) circular brass pendant or ring amulet hanging at the chest; 4) brown leather belt with square metal buckle; 5) faded gray-green work trousers, dusty and creased; 6) rugged brown lace-up boots, scuffed and muddy; 7) one dark fingerless glove on the character’s right hand, visibly worn and dirty.

Visual style: Photorealistic character concept art with high material realism, detailed leather grain, fabric fraying, stitching, dirt, scratches, sweat-darkened cloth, grime in seams, and believable wear. The coat color should be weathered oxblood red; the setting should feel like a cyberpunk western world without adding futuristic gadgets. Use muted earthy colors and a grounded, practical costume-design presentation.

Constraints: No text labels, no weapons, no hats, no extra characters, no dramatic background, no cinematic action pose. Keep the design clean, centered, and readable as a professional turnaround reference sheet.
2117903200341231407.author: Samuel C. Okanume

2117903200341231408.promptEn:
Goal: Create a wide comparison image showing three side-by-side Japanese beauty serum promotional banner variants for the modern Japanese skincare brand NOBUNOSUKE, advertising a Rakuten Happy Bag sale.

Canvas: Horizontal 3-panel comparison layout, approximately 1200×500 px. Add a black header strip across the top with three white lowercase labels centered over each panel: exactly 3 labels, left to right: “low”, “medium”, “high”. Below the header, divide the image into exactly 3 equal vertical banner panels separated by thin dark gaps.

Overall visual style: Luxurious Japanese modern cosmetics advertising for women in their 30s–40s. Use an elegant palette of ivory, deep vermilion red, muted gold, warm beige, and subtle black accents. Backgrounds should feel like premium washi paper with gold flecks, wave patterns, red circular motifs, folding fans, plum blossoms, mizuhiki cord ornaments, and glossy water reflections at the bottom. Typography should mix large elegant serif English lettering with small refined Japanese copy.

Required repeated elements in every panel: exactly 1 brand logo near the top, exactly 1 large “HAPPY BAG” headline, exactly 1 red circular Rakuten-limited badge reading “楽天限定”, exactly 1 discount offer showing 20%OFF, and exactly 1 main product display with skincare serum packaging.

Panel 1, labeled low: Compose a cream-and-red banner with a large red sun circle behind the product on the right. Place the brand logo and small Japanese brand text at top center, a large gold “HAPPY BAG” headline on the left, a red “楽天限定” badge near the upper right, and a product set consisting of exactly 2 items: one amber glass dropper serum bottle with gold cap and white label, and one tall white product box beside it. Add white plum blossoms and a partially open gold folding fan around the product. Add Japanese copy under the headline, then a small red tag reading “今だけ” above a large red “20% OFF”. Put a red footer strip along the bottom with small white Japanese text indicating limited quantity and sale ending when sold out.

Panel 2, labeled medium: Compose a cleaner ivory banner with red curved paper shapes at the left bottom and right side, gold flecks, floral motifs, and a red folding fan in the upper right. Place the brand logo at top center, large dark red “HAPPY BAG” headline centered-left, and a red “楽天限定” badge at the upper right. Show exactly 4 product items centered-right: two tall cylindrical bottles with gold caps, one shorter serum bottle with pump/dropper styling, and one white rectangular box behind them with a red mizuhiki cord decoration. Add a discount block at lower left reading small vertical Japanese text “最大” and large “20% OFF”. Add two lines of small Japanese seasonal beauty copy near the bottom center.

Panel 3, labeled high: Compose a deeper luxury banner with cream background, red-and-gold arch brushstroke behind the product, red fan and plum blossoms on the right, and reflective water at the bottom. Place the brand logo at upper left, a small gold bow/mizuhiki motif above the headline, and a large red “HAPPY BAG” headline on the left. Add a red circular “楽天限定” badge at upper right. Show exactly 2 product items on the right-center: one black glass dropper serum bottle with gold cap and dark label, and one tall white product box beside it. Add small Japanese copy under the headline, a vertical red tag reading “特別価格” next to a large gold-red circular discount area showing “20% OFF”, and a dark red footer strip with small white Japanese text about limited quantity and sale ending when sold out.

Constraints: Keep all three panels visually similar but not identical, as if comparing low, medium, and high quality outputs of the same prompt. Maintain crisp premium product-ad composition, readable main English text, realistic cosmetic packaging, refined Japanese ornamentation, and no extra panels or watermarks.

2117903200341231409.promptEn:
Goal: Create an editorial beauty portrait collage of an adult East Asian woman in a refined studio fashion style.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 layout, high-resolution, divided into exactly 3 image panels by thin white borders: 1 large panel occupying the full top half, and 2 equal smaller panels side by side on the bottom half.

Subject details: The same adult woman appears in all 3 panels. She has long glossy dark brown to black hair in soft loose waves, side-parted with voluminous curls, fair luminous skin, elegant neck and collarbones, natural rosy lips, and a calm sophisticated presence. She wears an ivory champagne satin button-up blouse with an open collar and pearl drop earrings with small gold details.

Panel count and composition: Exactly 3 portraits. Panel 1, top large portrait: upper-body studio portrait from chest up, subject centered, shoulders relaxed, facing camera, long waves falling over one shoulder, blouse catching silky highlights. Panel 2, bottom left portrait: closer side-profile or three-quarter crop from shoulder up, face turned left, hair cascading around the cheek and shoulder, pearl earring visible, satin blouse collar prominent. Panel 3, bottom right portrait: intimate close-up from lower face to upper chest, lips and jawline visible, one hand gently touching the chin or lower lip, pearl earring and blouse collar visible.

Lighting and background: Warm editorial studio lighting with soft directional sunlight, gentle shadows, and a romantic muted rose-pink backdrop. Add a curved or arched shadow shape on the wall for depth. Use warm rose, peach skin tones, ivory satin, deep espresso hair, soft gold highlights.

Visual style: Photorealistic luxury magazine beauty editorial, polished skin texture, glossy hair detail, shallow depth of field, soft contrast, elegant feminine mood, clean composition, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Constraints: The subject must be an adult. Keep the face naturally beautiful and consistent across all panels. Maintain the exact 3-panel collage structure with thin white dividers, vertical smartphone-friendly crop, and cohesive lighting across all portraits.
2117903200341231409.promptZh:
目标：创作一幅成人东亚女性的时尚杂志美妆肖像拼贴画，呈现精致影棚时尚风格。

画布：竖构图 2:3 比例，高分辨率，由细白边精确分割为 3 个图像面板：上方大面板占据整个上半部分，下方小面板均分下半部分并左右并排。

人物细节：同一位成年女性出现在全部 3 个面板中。她拥有长而柔亮的深棕至黑色秀发，呈柔和蓬松波浪状，侧分，带丰盈卷曲；肤色白皙透亮；颈部与锁骨线条优雅；双唇自然粉润；神态沉静而富有 sophistication（成熟魅力）。她身穿象牙香槟色缎面纽扣衬衫，领口敞开，佩戴垂坠式珍珠耳坠，耳坠带有小巧金色细节。

面板数量与构图：共 3 幅肖像。面板 1（上方大肖像）：胸以上上半身影棚肖像（studio portrait），人物居中，双肩放松，正对镜头，长波浪发丝垂落于一侧肩头，衬衫呈现丝滑高光。面板 2（下方左肖像）：更近的侧脸或三分之二视角裁切（从肩部向上），面部向左微转，发丝如瀑倾泻于脸颊与肩头，珍珠耳坠清晰可见，缎面衬衫领口突出。面板 3（下方右肖像）：亲密特写（close-up），取景范围自下颌至胸部上缘，清晰展现双唇与下颌线，一手轻触下巴或下唇，珍珠耳坠与衬衫领口均可见。

布光与背景：温暖的时尚杂志影棚布光（studio lighting），融合柔和定向日光，阴影轻柔，背景为浪漫低饱和度玫瑰粉色；墙面添加弧形或拱形阴影以增强景深（depth of field）。整体色调采用暖调玫瑰色、蜜桃色肌肤、象牙色缎面、深浓意式浓缩咖啡色（espresso）发色，以及柔和金色高光。

视觉风格：照片级写实（photorealistic）高端时尚杂志美妆专题风格，肤质细腻精致，发丝光泽丰富，浅景深（shallow depth of field），对比柔和，气质优雅柔美，构图简洁干净，无文字、无标识、无水印。

约束条件：人物必须为成年人。面部需保持自然美感，并在全部面板中高度一致。严格维持精确的三联画拼贴结构（含细白分隔线）、适配竖屏手机浏览的裁切比例，以及所有肖像间统一协调的布光（studio lighting）。
2117903200341231409.author: Eric Kang - Vogue AI

2117903200341231410.promptEn: Create a hyper-realistic high-fashion editorial photograph in a vertical 4:5 frame set inside a grand surreal white marble gallery. The scene features a luxurious neoclassical interior with polished marble floors, tall cream-white arches, carved columns, soft daylight, subtle statues in the background, and warm cinematic shadows. In the lower left foreground, place one seated Hollywood-style male fashion model with curly dark hair, a thick beard, and a strong masculine presence, wearing a sharp black suit, open-collar white dress shirt, black trousers, and glossy black leather dress shoes; he sits casually on a low white marble plinth with one hand braced behind him and one leg bent, looking upward into the surreal installation. Around him, suspend exactly five large circular white marble portal frames like floating mirrors/windows, each with thick beveled stone rims and dark reflective interiors, showing close-up alternate versions of the same bearded male model with different poses and emotions: 1) upper left portal, small, the man leans forward with one hand near his face; 2) center portal, largest, dramatic close-up of curly hair, beard, and hand near chin; 3) upper right portal, partial close-up in profile wearing a dark suit; 4) lower left portal, smaller close-up with serious shadowed expression; 5) right side portal, large close-up cropped at the cheek and collarbone with intense moody lighting. Make the portals overlap the architecture and each other with believable depth, reflections, and occlusion, as if revealing parallel cinematic portraits. Visual style: hyper-realistic, luxury fashion campaign, masculine cinematic beauty, controlled surreal chaos, marble texture detail, shallow depth of field in the portraits, warm beige and ivory palette, black suit contrast, natural museum-gallery lighting, elegant editorial composition. Use no text, no logos, no watermark, no extra people, and keep the model’s face visible rather than covered. Optional customization: model identity can be described as an unnamed Hollywood-style bearded male model, outfit as black suit with an open-collar white dress shirt, setting as white marble, mood as surreal masculine cinematic perfection, and number of portals as five.
2117903200341231410.author: Cherry 2.O

2117903200341231411.promptEn: An elegant fashion editorial portrait of a young woman with a tousled chin-length dark brunette bob, seated in a relaxed yet refined pose while gently cradling a bouquet of blush pink lilies, anemones, and delicate seasonal blooms. Soft lavender flowers appear out of focus in the foreground, adding a dreamy layered depth and a natural cinematic frame. Wardrobe & Styling: Flowing satin camisole dress in a rich fuchsia-rose tone with slender shoulder straps and a graceful silhouette. Delicate floral stud earrings in soft pink hues paired with understated gold rings for a refined luxury touch. Beauty look inspired by modern East Asian editorial trends, featuring luminous peach blush swept across the cheeks and lightly over the bridge of the nose, softly diffused crimson gradient lips, subtle smoky brown eyeshadow, and naturally defined lashes. Voluminous dark brown textured bob with loose waves and feathered curtain bangs softly framing the face. Photography: Captured with a Canon EOS R5 or Leica M11 for exceptional detail and natural color reproduction. 85mm f/1.2 portrait lens creating an ultra-shallow depth of field with silky, creamy background separation. Gentle window light from a north-facing source produces flattering illumination, smooth skin texture, and a radiant glass-skin finish without harsh shadows. Art Direction: Neutral studio environment with flowing beige drapery and minimal styling to emphasize the model and floral arrangement. Muted vintage-inspired color grading with restrained saturation, warm natural skin tones, and striking contrast between the vivid pink dress and lush green stems. Fine editorial detail, soft organic textures, subtle film-like character, luxurious magazine-quality composition, photorealistic finish.
2117903200341231411.promptZh:
一幅优雅的时尚杂志风格人像摄影，主角是一位年轻女性，留着凌乱感的齐下巴深棕发短发（bob发型），以轻松而精致的姿态端坐，双手轻柔环抱一束淡粉色百合、银莲花及精致时令花卉。前景中淡紫色花朵呈焦外虚化（bokeh）状态，营造出梦幻般的层次感与天然的电影感画框（cinematic frame）。  
服装与造型：一件垂坠感强的缎面吊带连衣裙，色调为浓郁的紫红色玫瑰色，配有纤细肩带与优雅剪裁轮廓。搭配柔和粉色调的精致花卉造型耳钉，以及低调的金色指环，呈现精致奢华质感。妆容灵感源自当代东亚时尚杂志趋势：双颊与鼻梁轻扫光泽蜜桃色腮红，唇部采用柔和晕染的深红色渐变效果，眼妆为细腻烟熏棕色眼影，睫毛自然分明。丰盈浓密的深棕色纹理短发（bob发型），带有松散波浪与如帘幕般轻柔分层的刘海，温柔勾勒面部轮廓。  
摄影：使用佳能 EOS R5 或徕卡 M11 拍摄，确保卓越细节表现与自然色彩还原。85mm f/1.2 人像镜头营造超浅景深（depth of field），背景分离效果丝滑柔润。来自北向窗户的柔和自然光提供讨喜的照明效果，呈现平滑肌肤质感与透亮“玻璃肌”（glass-skin）妆效，无生硬阴影。  
艺术指导：中性色调影棚环境，配以流动感米色帷幔，造型极简，以突出模特与花艺构图。采用低饱和度复古风调色，肤色温暖自然，鲜艳粉红裙装与饱满翠绿花茎形成强烈对比。精细的杂志级细节、柔和有机质感、微妙胶片感（film-like character）、奢华杂志品质构图、照片级写实（photorealistic）成像效果。

2117903200341231412.promptEn: Create a vertical 2:3 high-detail anime fantasy illustration of a silver-haired battle maiden in a ruined gothic cathedral during combat. The character is centered in a dynamic low-angle three-quarter pose, leaning forward with one arm extended to the right holding a huge translucent circular shield or magical glass barrier, and the other arm lowered to the left with a heavy mechanical gauntlet cannon emitting smoke and orange heat. She has long flowing silver-white hair, pale skin, a calm serious expression with half-lidded eyes, and delicate white floral head ornaments with ribbon-like streamers whipping through the air. Her outfit is a dark, ornate, tattered gothic dress with lace trim, layered white underskirt, black bodice, armored sleeves, and frayed cloth strips swirling around her. The environment is a vast collapsed stone cathedral with pointed arches, broken stained-glass windows, crumbling walls, distant ruined towers, dust, fog, rubble, and shafts of cold daylight. The shield is an oversized oval disk of clear glass-like energy with etched concentric circles and radial patterns, catching bright highlights on the right side of the image. Use a monochrome gray, ash, ivory, and charcoal palette with small warm ember sparks and glowing orange accents. Style should be painterly Japanese anime concept art, extremely detailed linework, dramatic motion, cinematic lighting, high contrast, watercolor-and-ink texture, atmospheric smoke, flying debris, no visible text, no watermark, no border.
2117903200341231412.promptZh: 创建一幅竖构图、2:3 比例、高细节的动漫奇幻插画，描绘一位银发女武者在一座毁坏的哥特式大教堂内战斗的场景。角色居中，呈动态低角度三分之四视角姿势：身体前倾，右臂向右伸展，持有一面巨大且半透明的圆形护盾或魔法玻璃屏障；左臂垂向左侧，佩戴一副沉重的机械臂铠火炮，正喷出烟雾与橙色热浪。她拥有长而飘逸的银白色长发、苍白肌肤、神情沉静严肃，双眼微眯；头戴精致的白色花卉头饰，饰有丝带状飘带，在空中激烈飞舞。她的装束是一袭深色、繁复且破损的哥特风长裙，饰有蕾丝边，内搭层叠的白色衬裙，黑色紧身胸衣，覆甲袖管，以及随风翻卷的破布条。环境是一座宏伟却坍塌的石砌大教堂，可见尖拱结构、破碎的彩绘玻璃窗、剥落的墙壁、远处倾颓的塔楼、尘埃、薄雾、瓦砾，以及几道冷色调的日光光束。护盾为一枚超大椭圆形能量盘，通体如透明玻璃，表面蚀刻同心圆与放射状纹样，在画面右侧捕捉到明亮的高光。整体采用单色系灰、灰白、象牙白与炭黑配色，仅点缀少量暖色调余烬火花与发光橙色细节。风格为富有绘画感的日本动漫概念艺术（Japanese anime concept art），线条极度精细，动作富于戏剧张力，电影感布光（cinematic lighting），高对比度，水彩与墨线混合质感，氛围烟雾弥漫，碎屑纷飞，画面中无任何可见文字、无水印、无边框。
2117903200341231412.author: 空想製作所/AI４コマ漫画

2117903200341231413.promptEn:
Goal: Create a playful summer lifestyle photo collage featuring a young woman with short dark hair wearing a blue-and-white striped sleeveless top and light shorts enjoying watermelon in a sunny park, decorated with hand-drawn white doodles and casual handwritten English words.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 image, arranged as an exact 3 by 3 grid of 9 equal rectangular photo panels with thin white borders between panels. Use soft natural daylight, fresh green grass, shallow depth of field, and a bright airy summer color palette.

Layout and panel count: Include exactly 9 panels:
1. Top-left: the woman sits cross-legged on grass holding a large watermelon slice in front of her face, with a white fence and cloudy sky in the background; doodles include a smiley face, short rays, the word “Hi!”, and small splash marks.
2. Top-center: close-up still life of several watermelon slices on a plate or tray beside an orange bag; doodles include a crown-like squiggle, sparkle marks, and the handwritten word “Sweet!”.
3. Top-right: side view of the woman sitting on grass, smiling toward or holding a watermelon slice near her mouth; doodles include “Hello!”, quotation marks, a swirl line, and a heart.
4. Middle-left: close-up portrait crop of the woman holding a small fork or skewer with a tiny watermelon cube; doodles include radiating marks and a large question mark.
5. Middle-center: close-up of the woman holding a watermelon slice near her mouth, face mostly centered and partially obscured by the fruit; doodles include dotted lines, a heart, and a small smiley face.
6. Middle-right: the woman sits on grass holding a watermelon slice up to her face; orange bag nearby; doodles include “Nice Day!”, a wavy underline, quotation marks, short grass strokes, and small sparkle lines.
7. Bottom-left: wider overhead-leaning shot of the woman reclining or sitting on a picnic cloth on grass with watermelon and orange bag; doodles include a curved arrow, smiley face, small hearts, and motion marks.
8. Bottom-center: tight portrait crop of the woman holding an orange hat or orange bag close to her chest or face, with soft grass background; doodles include small hearts, a curved white stroke, and a large number-like squiggle.
9. Bottom-right: overhead shot of the woman lying or reclining on grass with one arm raised, orange bag beside her, and a watermelon slice near her hand; doodles include a speech bubble saying “Yummy!”, small dash marks, and a heart outline.

Subject details: The subject should appear cheerful, relaxed, and candid, like a summer picnic travel-photo shoot. Keep the face softly anonymized or blurred, while preserving the pose, hair silhouette, outfit, and body language. Use fresh red watermelon slices with black seeds as the recurring prop in multiple panels, and include a bright orange tote bag or sun hat in several panels.

Visual style: Realistic photography, soft film-like tones, slightly overexposed summer highlights, green park setting, casual social-media collage aesthetic. Add white hand-drawn doodles as if sketched with a marker on top of the photos: hearts, arrows, smiley faces, sparkles, squiggles, quotation marks, and short handwritten words.

Text content: Use exactly these visible handwritten English words across the collage: Hi!, “Sweet!”, “Hello!”, “Nice Day!”, and “Yummy!”. Keep the lettering informal, white, and doodle-like.

Constraints: Maintain the exact 9-panel grid, thin white dividers, no extra panels, no watermark, no app interface, no captions outside the collage, and avoid adding additional readable words beyond the specified doodle text.

2117903200341231415.promptEn: Create a vertical dark romantic gothic anime portrait of an androgynous young man with silver-white long layered hair, soft bangs covering part of the face, and a loose low side ponytail tied with a black ribbon. He has pale skin, delicate features, downcast tired eyes with long eyelashes, and a melancholic, dreamy expression. Show him in a close waist-up composition, wearing a refined white Victorian blouse with billowy sleeves, buttoned cuffs, and a narrow black necktie. His slender gloved hands are raised to his mouth, gently holding and partly biting a cluster of deep blood-red flower petals; include exactly three loose red petals falling or resting on his clothing. Place him behind a sheer black lace veil entering from the left side, with ornate floral lace texture partially obscuring his face and torso. The background is an antique oval mirror or carved frame with baroque ornamentation, surrounded by flowers: exactly three white orchids on the right side and multiple dark red peony-like blossoms behind him. Use a muted monochrome sepia-gray palette with selective deep red accents on the petals and flowers, soft diffused lighting, high-detail linework, elegant manga illustration style, delicate shading, moody gothic atmosphere, intricate fabric folds, ornate frame details, shallow depth, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341231415.promptZh: 创作一幅垂直构图的暗黑浪漫哥特风（gothic）动漫肖像画，描绘一位雌雄同体的年轻男子：银白色长发呈层叠式造型，额前垂落柔软刘海，部分遮挡面部；发束松散地低侧扎成马尾，以黑色丝带系紧。他肤色苍白，五官精致，双眼低垂略显疲惫，睫毛纤长，神情忧郁而梦幻。画面采用腰部以上近距离构图，他身着一件考究的白色维多利亚式（Victorian）衬衫，袖子蓬松，袖口系扣，颈间系一条细窄黑色领结。他修长的手戴着手套，双手抬至嘴边，轻柔地托住并微微咬住一簇深血红色的花瓣；其衣物上须恰好呈现三片散落或静置的红色花瓣。他身后左侧延伸入一幅轻薄黑色蕾丝面纱，繁复的花卉蕾丝纹理部分遮蔽其面部与躯干。背景为一枚古董椭圆形镜子或雕花镜框，饰有巴洛克式（baroque）繁复纹样，镜框周围环绕花朵：右侧恰好三朵白兰花，他身后则分布多朵深红色、牡丹状的盛开花朵。整体采用柔和的单色棕褐灰（sepia-gray）色调，仅花瓣与花朵处点缀选择性深红色；光线柔和弥散（soft diffused lighting）；线条精细高细节（high-detail linework）；风格为优雅的日漫插画（elegant manga illustration style），阴影细腻（delicate shading），氛围阴郁哥特（moody gothic atmosphere），布料褶皱繁复（intricate fabric folds），镜框雕饰华丽（ornate frame details），景深浅（shallow depth）；画面中无文字，无水印。

Top typography: Place a huge, heavy, blocky black Chinese headline centered near the top reading 提示词宝藏站. Above and around it add minimal black decorative marks: one large four-point star at upper left, thin horizontal lines, a dotted line near upper right, and tiny diamond markers.

Add exactly 1 gold ring on the left, exactly 2 large faceted diamonds near the left and right sides, exactly 1 small floating rounded-square tile with a white geometric cube logo on the left, and exactly 1 matching rounded-square tile with a black cube logo on the right. 2117903200341231418.promptEn: Create a romantic vertical photorealistic portrait of a young woman sitting elegantly on a cozy lakeside garden terrace at golden-hour sunset, smiling softly at the camera with natural skin texture, soft makeup, warm brown eyes, and long chestnut-brown hair worn half-up with loose straight lengths over one shoulder. 2117903200341231418.promptZh: 创作一幅浪漫的竖构图照片级写实（photorealistic）肖像画：一位年轻女子优雅地坐在湖畔花园露台之上，正值金色时刻（golden-hour）日落时分；她面朝镜头，微微含笑，肌肤呈现自然纹理，妆容柔和，暖棕色双眸，栗棕色长发半盘起，松散垂落的直发披于一侧肩头。她身着一袭飘逸的 blush-pink 色薄纱蕾丝长裙，饰有精致花卉刺绣，袖子修长垂坠；坐在一张奶油色钩针编织布艺沙发之上，沙发配有花卉图案抱枕。一只毛茸茸的白色长毛猫卧于她膝上，双眼湛蓝明亮；她双手捧着一本摊开的复古花卉主题书籍，置于猫身前方。背景是一处令人屏息的隐秘湖畔花园：平静湖面倒映低垂夕阳，远山呈青蓝色，柔雾般的粉彩色天空缀以蜜桃色云朵，挺拔如柏树的乔木，以及远处湖岸线上温暖的焦外虚化（bokeh）灯光。露台以枝叶繁茂的枝条框景，上方悬垂发光串灯；右侧为一根木质立柱，悬挂纸灯笼并攀附粉色花朵；她身后则是一道石砌栏杆，沿栏杆盛开着缤纷花卉。前景中须精确包含 6 个彼此分明的桌面/道具元素：1 个玻璃花瓶插着粉色鲜花、1 个散发白光的灯笼、1 叠共 3 本堆叠的书籍、1 个花卉纹样茶杯配碟、1 朵置于桌面上的小粉玫瑰、1 张圆形木质边几。采用梦幻感电影感布光（cinematic lighting），暖调日落轮廓光（rim light），柔和景深（depth of field），粉彩与金色为主色调，风格优雅且具田园小屋风（cottagecore），织物纹理高度精细，人体解剖结构真实可信，神情宁静安详，竖向 2:3 构图，主体居中，画面不含文字，不含水印。

2117903200341231419.promptZh:
创作一幅超可爱、高端的3D Q版（chibi）风格肖像画，描绘一名年轻女孩与一名年轻男孩分别坐在两张独立的现代圆形矮凳上，面对面近距离坐于一处温暖阳光洒落的室内花园咖啡馆中。女孩坐在左侧，男孩坐在右侧；两人都微微前倾，一手肘支在膝上，下巴轻托于单手掌心，透过时尚小巧的黑色圆框太阳镜 playful 地微笑对视。采用夸张的可爱Q版（chibi）比例：大而富有表现力的眼睛、小巧的鼻子与嘴巴、如洋娃娃般柔润的肌肤、 oversized 的头部、紧凑精巧的躯干，以及具备皮克斯（Pixar）品质的精细3D渲染效果。  
女孩拥有一头浓密的深棕色长发，松散地盘成高髻，多缕波浪长发自然垂落，发髻上恰好装饰着5朵清晰可见的白色雏菊（每朵中心为明黄色），并佩戴小巧的悬垂式耳饰。她身穿酒红色条纹长袖衬衫、高腰阔腿黑色长裤，脚踩厚底白色运动鞋。  
男孩则拥有一头蓬松的深棕色卷发，左耳佩戴一枚小巧黑色耳钉，身穿酒红色短袖立领衬衫、宽松黑色阔腿长裤，脚穿白色运动鞋。  
两张矮凳均为圆形软垫凳，椅面为焦糖棕色皮革材质，细长的金色金属椅腿底部配有环形脚踏。  
场景设定于一间温馨现代、温室风格的室内空间：左侧设有多扇高大落地窗，金色时刻（golden-hour）阳光倾泻而入；地面为光洁可反光材质；室内摆放盆栽绿植，垂挂藤蔓缠绕，上方点缀暖色串灯；窗外可见柔和的粉色调花朵；背景中有一处虚化的置物架与一盏黑色壁灯；画面右侧摆放一只插有粉色花朵的花瓶。  
采用电影感浅景深（shallow depth of field）、温暖琥珀色布光（warm amber lighting）、柔焦焦外虚化（soft bokeh）、柔和轮廓光（gentle rim light）、精细刻画的织物褶皱、光泽反射效果，整体氛围浪漫而俏皮。  
竖构图人像（vertical portrait composition），全身视角（full-body view），人物居中对称布局，无文字，无水印，无额外角色。

2117903200341231421.promptEn: Create a vertical storybook-style watercolor illustration of a soft plush doll named Mimi sitting on an antique wooden writing desk in a cozy old library. 2117903200341231421.promptZh:
创作一幅竖版绘本风格的水彩插画，描绘一只名为米米（Mimi）的柔软毛绒玩偶，端坐在一间温馨古老图书馆中的古董木质写字台之上。玩偶居中构图，呈全身像，拥有一个硕大圆润的Q版（chibi）头颅、娇小的坐姿身体、天鹅绒质感布料、浅奶油色毛绒肌肤、齐耳短发且发色为柔和粉彩调、齐刘海、两只硕大的蓝色刺绣风格眼睛、小巧中性微张的嘴、脸颊泛着淡淡红晕，以及一对猫耳——耳内衬为粉色布料。玩偶身着黑白女仆装：白色荷叶边发带、黑色长袖连衣裙、白色荷叶边围裙、袖口与裙摆镶有奶油色褶边饰、黑色毛绒小鞋，领口系一枚紫色丝绒蝴蝶结。

画面氛围应温暖怀旧、富有触感，着重表现毛绒面料的蓬松感与手工缝制毛绒玩具的接缝细节。背景为细节丰富的古董书房：左侧是一扇洒入暖光的窗，右侧是摆满古籍的深色木质书架，玩偶正上方悬挂一幅复古装裱油画，写字台上堆叠着几册年代久远的书籍。

前景写字台上须精确呈现5件醒目物品：1张手写羊皮纸、1瓶黑色墨水、1支白色羽毛蘸水笔、1支置于黄铜烛台上的燃烛、1件小型繁复黄铜器物。

采用从左侧窗射入的金色午后阳光，辅以柔和阴影、棕褐色（sepia）主调、奶油色高光，以及细腻的水彩铅笔线条（watercolor pencil linework）。构图比例为竖版9:16，采用特写（close-up），毛绒玩偶位于画面正中央，写字台上的物品则构成前景下部的框架式布局。

2117903200341231422.promptEn: Serene golden-hour portrait of a young woman sitting in a sunlit meadow of white daisies, eyes gently closed, face tilted toward warm sunlight, long wavy dark hair with daisies tucked behind her ear, wearing an ivory cable-knit cardigan over a flowing cream dress; vertical composition, subject slightly off-center following the rule of thirds, shallow depth of field with soft bokeh in the foreground daisies, crisply detailed midground figure, distant rolling hills and a small cottage softly rendered in the background. Warm sepia-tinged color palette: soft creams, muted sage greens, pale yellows and honey light; rim lighting and subtle volumetric sun rays, delicate lens flare and soft film grain. Painterly anime-realism hybrid: ultra-detailed facial features, realistic hair strands, textured fabric stitches, intricate daisy petals, gentle brushwork for landscape, cinematic soft contrast, dreamy nostalgic mood, 35–50mm focal feel, wide aperture shallow focus, high-resolution, finely detailed atmosphere.
2117903200341231422.promptZh: 宁静的黄金时刻（golden hour）肖像画：一位年轻女子坐在阳光普照的白色雏菊草地中，双眼轻闭，面庞微微仰起朝向温暖的阳光，长而微卷的深色秀发，耳后别着几朵雏菊，身着米白色绞花纹开衫，内搭一袭飘逸的奶油色长裙；竖构图，主体略微偏离画面中心、遵循三分法构图原则，浅景深（depth of field），前景雏菊呈现柔和焦外虚化（bokeh），中景人物轮廓清晰、细节锐利，远景为起伏的山丘与一座小屋，以柔和笔触虚化呈现。暖调棕褐色（sepia）系色彩方案：柔润的奶油色、低饱和度的鼠尾草绿、淡雅的明黄色与蜜糖般的光线；轮廓光（rim lighting）与微妙的体积光（volumetric sun rays），细腻的镜头眩光（lens flare）与柔和的胶片颗粒（film grain）。绘画感动漫写实混合风格（painterly anime-realism hybrid）：面部特征超精细刻画，发丝真实可辨，织物针脚富有质感，雏菊花瓣纤毫毕现，风景部分采用轻柔笔触，电影感柔和对比（cinematic soft contrast），梦幻怀旧氛围，35–50mm焦距感，大光圈浅焦（wide aperture shallow focus），高分辨率，空气氛围细腻入微。

2117903200341231423.promptEn: Create a premium black and white educational photography composition poster about the Golden Ratio in visual storytelling. Design the poster as a vertical cinematic collage with a dark charcoal background, thin white borders, realistic documentary photography, soft film grain, high contrast monochrome lighting, and clean editorial typography. Use four photo panels. Top large panel: Show children riding bicycles and walking on a rural dirt road, with fields, trees, mountains, and a soft cloudy sky in the background. Place the children toward the left side of the frame. Overlay a large clean white golden spiral and golden ratio grid, with the spiral curling toward the children as the main focal point. Add yellow title text: “GOLDEN SPIRAL”. Add white annotation text on the right: “SECONDARY OBJECT ON THE CURVE”, with a thin blue arrow pointing to a blurred object on the spiral curve. Bottom left panel: Show a close up black and white portrait of a young boy’s face with dramatic lighting and one eye as the main focus. Overlay a white golden rectangle grid with nested rectangles around the eye. Add yellow title text: “GOLDEN RECTANGLE”. Add white caption text: “THE LEFT EYE WAS CHOSEN AS THE CENTRE OF INTEREST”. Bottom right upper panel: Show an emotional black and white portrait of a mother holding a child. Use cinematic documentary lighting. 2117903200341231425.promptEn:
Goal: Create a black-and-white manga page about a fashionable young man meeting a tiny anthropomorphic hamster friend at a busy indoor shopping plaza.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, roughly 2:3 aspect ratio, clean white page with thin black outer border and thick black gutters. Highly detailed monochrome pen-and-ink line art with screentone-style shading, realistic architectural perspective, elegant shoujo/seinen manga character rendering.

Layout: Use exactly 6 panels. Panel 1 is a wide establishing shot across the full top width. Panel 2 is another wide panel below it. Panel 3 row has two panels: a narrow close-up of the man on the left and a wider hamster panel on the right. Panel 4 row has two panels: a narrow vertical hamster-hand gag panel on the left and a wider final panel on the right.

Setting: A modern indoor mall or station concourse with glossy tiled floors, tall glass storefronts, crowds of pedestrians, overhead direction signs, a circular indoor fountain, and a clothing store in the final panel. Include English signage such as “Central Plaza” on a directional sign and “SELECTED MEN'S WEAR” above the clothing shop, plus a small “NEW ARRIVAL” sign near the shop entrance.

Characters: The main human character is a tall handsome young man with tousled wavy dark hair, sharp eyes, a calm aloof expression, wearing a black long coat over a black turtleneck with a long scarf and pendant necklace. The small companion is a round fluffy hamster wearing a tiny beret and bow tie, holding or standing near a smartphone, expressive and cute.

Panel details: Panel 1: Wide establishing shot of the shopping plaza fountain from a distance. Many pedestrians walk around. The tiny hamster sits on the rim of the circular fountain, looking down at a smartphone, with small sound text near it. Panel 2: Medium-wide shot showing the handsome man in the left foreground, facing slightly right, noticing something; the fountain with the tiny hamster appears on the right side in the background. Panel 3 left: Tight close-up of the man’s face, serious and slightly puzzled. Panel 3 right: Close shot of the hamster on the fountain rim, waving one paw energetically while standing on or beside the smartphone. Panel 4 left: Comedic close-up of a human hand pinching and lifting the hamster gently by the tiny beret; the hamster dangles with startled paws. Panel 4 right: Final medium-wide shot in front of the menswear shop. The man stands in profile, holding the hamster on his open palm while looking toward the store window with suits and racks of clothes.

Visible text and effects: Include exactly 8 text elements: 1) the overhead sign “Central Plaza”; 2) small Japanese sound effect てちてち near the hamster in panel 1; 3) speech bubble from the man in panel 2 reading ん？; 4) silent speech bubble in panel 3 left reading “……” ; 5) hamster speech bubble in panel 3 right reading あ、こっちだよー; 6) large Japanese sound effect in panel 4 left reading “わしっ”; 7) small hamster speech bubble in panel 4 left reading “え？”; 8) final speech bubbles in panel 4 right: the man says “……ハムスターに似合う服を見に行くから服屋から回るぞ” and the hamster replies “えぇ…………”.

Style constraints: Do not use color. Keep the page polished and cinematic, with delicate hatching, realistic crowd silhouettes, crisp panel borders, detailed clothing folds, and expressive manga faces. The hamster should remain tiny compared with the man, creating a humorous contrast. Avoid extra panels, extra dialogue, watermarks, or modern UI overlays.

2117903200341231434.promptZh: 竖构图 2:3 超高细节幻想系动漫肖像画，描绘一位空灵的年轻女子，置身于繁花盛开的魔法花园中。她拥有一头长长的白金色秀发与柔和的刘海，肤色苍白而莹润，双眼湛蓝、硕大而精致，神情宁静略带忧郁；以三分之三侧面姿态端坐于花丛中，一手轻抬至脸颊旁，另一手低垂置于画面前景。为她穿上一件华丽的黑色哥特式高级定制礼服：材质包括透明蕾丝、刺绣花卉网纱、飘逸薄纱，饰有繁复藤蔓状纹样、金丝细工装饰、丝带流苏，以及缀于袖口与裙摆上的粉色花朵。头戴一顶戏剧感十足的黑色蕾丝与枝条编织而成的花冠或头饰，缀有微小珠子与花瓣。以大量粉色樱花、牡丹及纤细枝条环绕其周身；画面中须精确呈现三簇醒目的花团：一簇大型花团位于右下前景，一簇花团框构左上背景，一簇花团环绕其右袖与裙摆。采用右上方电影感逆光（cinematic backlighting）、朦胧辉光、飘浮花瓣、闪烁微尘、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、柔焦焦外虚化（soft bokeh）、黑色蕾丝与粉嫩花朵之间的高对比度、浪漫童话氛围、织物纹理极致精细、构图典雅，不添加文字，无水印。

2117903200341231435.promptEn: Create a photorealistic full-body lifestyle portrait of a young East Asian woman with long dark hair leaning casually against a weathered concrete wall inside an old industrial loft. She wears an oversized black T-shirt, loose black cargo pants, and black high-top sneakers with white laces, with a small silver necklace, hands in her pockets, one knee bent and one foot resting against the wall. Outside the windows, show a softly blurred city skyline at sunset. Compose vertically in a cinematic editorial fashion, subject positioned slightly left of center, with strong depth of field, realistic skin texture, natural fabric folds, moody urban atmosphere, high dynamic range, 35mm documentary photography look, shallow background blur, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341231435.promptZh: 创作一幅照片级写实（photorealistic）的全身生活风格人像，画面主体为一位长发乌黑的年轻东亚女性，她随意倚靠在一座老旧工业风阁楼内部斑驳的混凝土墙边。她身穿一件宽大的黑色T恤、宽松的黑色工装裤，以及一双黑色高帮运动鞋（配白色鞋带），颈间佩戴一条小巧的银色项链；双手插在裤袋中，一膝微屈，一只脚轻抵墙面。她的神情平静而沉思，目光望向窗外透出暖光的窗户，不直视镜头。场景设定为一处宽敞、带有废弃感的阁楼空间：墙面石膏开裂、油漆剥落，配有高大的黑色金属框工厂式窗户，地面铺着磨损的木质板条地板，窗台右侧摆放着一排盆栽绿植。窗外呈现日落时分柔和虚化的城市天际线。运用温暖的黄金时刻（golden-hour）阳光从窗户斜射入内，投下修长阴影，在她的发丝与面部勾勒出轮廓光（rim light），并在地板与墙面上映出浓郁的琥珀色高光。采用竖构图，以电影感编辑风格（cinematic editorial fashion）呈现，人物略偏画面左侧居中位置；景深（depth of field）强烈，皮肤质感真实，织物褶皱自然，整体氛围阴郁而富有都市气息，具备高动态范围（HDR），呈现35mm纪实摄影（documentary photography）视觉效果，背景焦外虚化（shallow background blur），画面中无文字、无水印。

2117903200341231436.promptEn: Create a vertical anime-style summer illustration of a fashionable young woman floating or dancing weightlessly among towering white cumulus clouds in a vivid cobalt-blue sky. She is shown full body from a low upward angle, centered diagonally with one arm stretched high above her head making a delicate hand gesture, the other arm extended outward, one leg long and straight downward and the other bent back playfully. She has short tousled black bob hair, pale skin, a calm dreamy expression, glossy eyes looking upward, orange-red drop earrings, and a small beaded bracelet. Outfit: an oversized light blue and white vertical striped button-up shirt tied in a knot at the waist, sleeves rolled loosely, a bright blue crop top underneath, high-waisted white shorts with a white belt, white scrunched socks, and light blue canvas sneakers. The background is filled with dense stylized clouds outlined in fine ink with pale blue shadow hatching, leaving patches of intense blue sky. Include exactly 2 small orange-and-white passenger jets: one in the upper right leaving a sweeping white curved contrail, and one in the lower left flying through blue streaks with a thin trail. Use clean Japanese anime line art, crisp ink outlines, airy composition, saturated summer blues, soft cream skin tones, minimal shading, dynamic poster-like framing, and a nostalgic 1990s manga illustration mood. Add a tiny handwritten signature and date near the bottom right reading June 29, 2026 Oyagi. No extra characters, no cityscape, no text besides the signature/date.
2117903200341231436.promptZh:
创作一幅竖构图的动漫风格夏日插画，描绘一位时尚的年轻女性在湛蓝色（cobalt-blue）天空中高耸的白色积云（cumulus clouds）间无重力漂浮或轻盈起舞。采用低角度仰视视角呈现其全身形象，人物呈对角线居中构图：一只手臂高举过头顶，做出纤细优雅的手势；另一只手臂向外伸展；一条腿笔直向下伸长，另一条腿则俏皮地向后弯曲。她留着短而蓬松的黑色波波头（bob hair），肤色白皙，神情平静梦幻，双眼 glossy（水润光泽），目光向上凝望；佩戴橙红色水滴形耳坠，手腕戴一只小巧的串珠手链。  
服饰：一件 oversized（宽松版型）的浅蓝与白色竖条纹衬衫，于腰际打结，袖口随意卷至小臂；内搭一件明快蓝色的露脐上衣（crop top）；下穿高腰白色短裤，配白色腰带；脚穿白色堆堆袜（scrunched socks）和浅蓝色帆布运动鞋（canvas sneakers）。  
背景由密集、风格化的云朵填满，云朵以精细墨线勾勒轮廓，并用淡蓝色阴影排线（shadow hatching）表现体积，同时留出数块浓烈饱和的湛蓝色天空空隙。画面中须精确包含 2 架小型橙白双色客机：一架位于右上方，正划出一道宽阔弯曲的白色尾迹（contrail）；另一架位于左下方，正飞越数道蓝色光 streaks（streaks），拖着一条细长尾迹。  
整体采用干净利落的日式动漫线稿（Japanese anime line art）、清晰锐利的墨线轮廓（crisp ink outlines）、通透轻盈的构图（airy composition）、饱和浓郁的夏日蓝色调（summer blues）、柔和奶油质感的肤色（cream skin tones）、极简阴影（minimal shading）、富有张力的海报式构图（dynamic poster-like framing），并营造出怀旧的 1990 年代漫画（manga）插画氛围（nostalgic 1990s manga illustration mood）。  
在画面右下角附近添加一枚微小的手写体签名及日期，内容为：June 29, 2026 Oyagi。  
不出现额外人物，不出现城市景观，除签名/日期外不添加任何其他文字。

2117903200341231437.promptEn: Create a dreamy high-detail anime fantasy portrait of an ethereal young adult woman floating in a dark cosmic void, surrounded by translucent glass objects. She has silvery platinum blonde very long wavy hair drifting weightlessly, pale porcelain skin, soft blue-lavender eyes, delicate features, and a calm melancholic expression. She wears a flowing pearl white satin camisole slip dress with thin straps and a sheer iridescent robe in pale mint, cyan, and lavender; the fabric should look weightless, glossy, and semi-transparent with shimmering caustic reflections. Pose her reclining diagonally from upper left to lower right, left hand raised holding one glowing crystal sphere, right arm resting on a large transparent rectangular prism. Surround her with exactly 12 visible glass spheres or bubbles: 1 large sphere in her left hand, 1 large partial sphere at lower left, 1 large sphere at lower right, 1 medium sphere near the top left, 1 medium sphere near the upper right, 1 medium sphere near the bottom center, 1 small sphere at her waist, 2 small spheres near the upper center, 2 small spheres on the right side, and 1 tiny sphere near the lower right edge. Also include exactly 5 large transparent crystal prisms: 1 tilted rectangular block at upper left, 1 faceted polyhedron behind her head on the right, 1 huge diagonal slab in the upper right corner, 1 rectangular block under her right arm, and 1 dark partial prism in the lower left corner. Use moonlit violet, icy blue, and opalescent cyan lighting, strong rim light, prismatic refractions, starry speckles inside the glass, soft glow, bokeh, and painterly ultra-polished rendering. Vertical 4:5 composition, no text, no watermark, no extra characters, elegant celestial atmosphere.
2117903200341231437.promptZh: 创作一幅梦幻般的高细节动漫奇幻肖像画，描绘一位空灵的年轻女性漂浮在幽暗的宇宙虚空中，周围环绕着半透明的玻璃物体。她拥有一头银白铂金色的极长波浪发，无重力般轻盈飘散；肌肤如瓷般苍白；眼眸呈柔和的蓝紫色；五官精致；神情平静而略带忧郁。她身穿一件垂坠感强的珍珠白色缎面吊带衬裙，外罩一件薄透的虹彩长袍，色调为淡薄荷绿、青色与紫罗兰色；布料需呈现无重力感、光泽感与半透明感，并带有闪烁的焦散反射（caustic reflections）。她的姿态为斜向躺卧，从画面左上方延伸至右下方：左手抬起，托举一颗发光水晶球；右臂 resting 在一块大型透明长方体棱镜上。围绕她布置恰好12个可见的玻璃球或气泡：左手托举1颗大型球体；左下角1颗大型局部球体；右下角1颗大型球体；左上角附近1颗中型球体；右上角附近1颗中型球体；画面底部中央附近1颗中型球体；腰部位置1颗小型球体；上部中央附近2颗小型球体；右侧区域2颗小型球体；右下边缘附近1颗微小球体。另加入恰好5块大型透明水晶棱镜：左上角1块倾斜的长方体；她头部后方右侧1块切面多面体；右上角1块巨大的对角斜置板状棱镜；她右臂下方1块长方体；左下角1块暗色局部棱镜。采用月光紫、冰蓝色与乳光青（opalescent cyan）照明，强轮廓光（rim light），棱镜折射效果，玻璃内部嵌有星点状微粒，整体散发柔和辉光，焦外虚化（bokeh），以及富有绘画感的超精细渲染（painterly ultra-polished rendering）。竖构图，比例4:5；画面中不含文字、水印及额外角色；营造优雅的天界氛围。

2117903200341231438.promptEn: Create a vertical cinematic photorealistic portrait of a young East Asian woman in a moody garden setting, shown from the waist up in a three-quarter pose, looking down and to the left with a calm, melancholic expression. 2117903200341231439.promptEn: Create a cinematic fantasy street illustration in a richly detailed hand-painted anime concept-art style. A tall anthropomorphic bear-like wanderer named the masked winter lamplighter stands full-body in the foreground on a wet cobblestone alley at night, facing slightly left while looking forward. The character wears a bulky patched purple long winter coat with a white fur collar, dark blue layered clothing, belts and straps across the torso, heavy gloves, baggy pants, and rugged boots. The head is a fluffy white bear hood or mask with small rounded ears, black eyes, tiny orange cheek dots, and a prominent orange circular respirator-like muzzle; below it is a mechanical mouthpiece with exactly 6 visible blue-glass circular lenses or valves arranged on the chest/mask area. Add exactly 2 round insignia patches on the upper front of the coat, one on each side, plus several worn tan repair patches and scuffed seams. The character holds exactly 1 ornate black staff-lantern in the right hand, topped with a pagoda-shaped metal lantern glowing warm amber. The setting is a narrow old European-fantasy market street with crooked timber-and-stone buildings, cool blue shadows, and warm golden shop lighting. On the right, place exactly 1 bakery display window glowing intensely, filled with visible bread and pastries, hanging glass lamps, and a wooden counter; include a loose shop sign with stylized unreadable lettering above the window. On the left background, show exactly 2 distant hooded pedestrians walking away, exactly 1 small storefront sign, and exactly 2 warmly lit upper windows. Use dramatic contrast between cold moonlit blues and warm amber light, wet reflective cobblestones, intricate ink-like linework, painterly textures, slightly exaggerated proportions, high detail, no modern objects, no readable text, no watermark.
2117903200341231439.promptZh:
创作一幅电影感（cinematic）奇幻街景插画，采用细节丰富、手绘风格的动漫概念艺术（anime concept-art）表现手法。  
一位高大的拟人化熊形流浪者——“戴面具的冬日点灯人”——全身立于前景，站在夜晚湿漉漉的鹅卵石小巷中，身体微微朝左，面朝正前方。  
角色身着厚重、多处缝补的紫色长款冬衣，领口镶有白色毛皮；内搭深蓝色层叠服饰；胸前横贯多条腰带与背带；佩戴厚实手套；下穿宽大长裤与粗犷靴子。  
头部为毛茸茸的白色熊形兜帽或面具，配有小巧圆润的耳朵、黑色眼睛、脸颊上各有一颗微小的橙色圆点，以及一枚醒目的橙色圆形呼吸器状吻部；其下方为一机械式嘴部装置，在胸/面具区域精确排列着6枚可见的蓝色玻璃圆形透镜或阀门。  
在大衣前襟上部左右两侧，各添加1枚圆形徽章补丁；另添加若干磨损的米褐色修补布片与刮擦痕迹明显的接缝。  
角色右手持1根华丽黑色杖式灯笼，顶端为一座宝塔造型金属灯笼，散发温暖琥珀色光芒。  
场景设定为一条狭窄的古老欧洲奇幻风市集街道，两侧建筑为歪斜的木石结构，阴影呈冷调蓝色，店铺灯光则为暖金色。  
右侧放置1扇烘焙店橱窗，强烈发光，内可见面包与糕点、悬挂式玻璃吊灯及木质柜台；橱窗上方配一块松散悬挂的店铺招牌，其上为风格化且不可读的文字。  
左侧背景中呈现2名披斗篷的远距离行人，正背向离去；1个小店面招牌；以及2扇透出暖光的上层窗户。  
运用强烈的冷色调月光蓝与暖色调琥珀光之间的戏剧性对比（dramatic contrast），湿滑反光的鹅卵石路面，精细如墨线般的勾勒（ink-like linework），富有绘画感的肌理（painterly textures），略带夸张的比例（exaggerated proportions），高度细节化（high detail），不含任何现代物品，无任何可读文字，无水印。

2117903200341231440.promptEn: Create a realistic promotional product photo of a fictional Japanese soccer snack called Blue Strike, styled like a limited-edition trading-card snack campaign. The scene is shot from a slightly overhead angle on a warm wooden table. Center-left is a glossy metallic blue snack bag with crimped top and bottom edges, dramatic starbursts, stadium lights, gold speed lines, and soccer ball graphics. The bag front features a cheerful anime-style Japanese teenage girl soccer fan/player, Airi Yuki, with short dark bobbed hair, wearing a blue Japan-inspired soccer jersey with number 14, a blue scarf, and a white plaid skirt, smiling and waving while holding a soccer ball. Large bold Japanese package lettering reads 「ブルーストライク」 with smaller text 「サッカースナック」, a yellow badge reading 「第1弾」, and a comic burst reading 「キラカード 当たりあり!!」. Include a small printed mini card preview on the lower-left of the bag labeled SSR and 「おまけカード 1枚入り」. To the right and lower foreground, place exactly 2 collectible trading cards: the front card is a holographic gold-bordered SSR SECRET card showing the same girl holding a soccer ball, with Japanese name text 「結城愛梨」 and English name “AIRI YUKI”; behind it, partially visible, is a dark blue stats card with a silhouette soccer player and the number 14. Scatter exactly 4 ridged potato chips around the packaging and cards: two chips stacked at upper right, one whole chip near bottom left, and one partial chip peeking near the left edge. Use photorealistic lighting and textures for the table, chips, plastic bag wrinkles, foil shine, and holographic card reflections, while keeping the character art polished anime style. Color palette: electric blue, navy, metallic gold, white, and warm brown wood. Make it look like a real snack product advertisement for watching a Japan vs Brazil soccer match. No real brand logos, no watermark, no extra cards or chips beyond the counted items.
2117903200341231440.promptZh: 创作一张照片级写实（photorealistic）的虚构日本足球主题零食「Blue Strike」的促销产品图，风格模仿限量版集换式卡牌零食营销活动。画面以略带俯视的角度拍摄，背景为暖色调木质桌面。画面中左部中央位置放置一只高光金属蓝零食袋，袋体顶部与底部边缘呈压纹收口状，袋面印有戏剧性放射状星芒、体育场灯光图案、金色速度线以及足球图案。零食袋正面绘有一位开朗活泼的日系动漫风格（anime style）日本少女球迷/球员——结城爱梨（Airi Yuki），她留着深色齐耳短发，身穿蓝色日本风足球衫（印有数字14）、蓝色围巾与白色格纹短裙，面带微笑并挥手致意，同时手抱一只足球。包装正面大幅加粗日文标题文字「ブルーストライク」，下方较小字号标注「サッカースナック」；另有一枚黄色徽章标有「第1弾」；还有一枚漫画式对话气泡，内文为「キラカード 当たりあり!!」。在包装袋左下角，附有一张小型印刷版迷你卡预览图，标注「SSR」及「おまけカード 1枚入り」。在包装袋右下方前景处，精准放置2张收藏类集换式卡牌：前方卡片为全息金边SSR SECRET卡，画面主体为同一少女手抱足球的形象，日文姓名标注「結城愛梨」，英文姓名为“AIRI YUKI”；后方卡片部分可见，为深蓝色数据卡，印有剪影风格足球运动员形象与数字14。在包装及卡牌周围散落恰好4片带棱纹的薯片：其中两片叠放在右上方，一片完整薯片置于左下方近底端处，一片残缺薯片从左侧边缘微微露出。整体采用照片级写实（photorealistic）布光与材质表现——包括桌面质感、薯片纹理、塑料袋褶皱、金属箔反光以及全息卡牌反射效果，但人物插画须保持精致动漫风格（polished anime style）。配色方案：电光蓝、藏青色、金属金、纯白与暖调棕木色。整体呈现为真实零食产品广告，用于宣传日本队对阵巴西队的足球赛事。不得出现任何真实品牌标识、水印，亦不得添加清单所列数量之外的额外卡牌或薯片。

2117903200341231441.promptEn: Create a full-body studio character portrait of a futuristic brutalist sci-fi operative standing front-facing in a neutral power pose, centered on a tall vertical canvas. The character is an anonymous armored wanderer, wearing a matte black long hooded trench coat inspired by heavy brutalist architecture: severe straight silhouette, thick fabric, minimal seams, three visible small metal toggle clasps down the chest, and a split lower front revealing dark tactical clothing underneath. The helmet should look like weathered concrete and carved stone, with rough gray-white cracked surfaces, angular cheek plates, and a single horizontal glowing orange visor slit across the eyes; add warm orange light reflecting inside the visor and subtle landscape-like texture in the glass. Show exactly 12 major visible gear elements: 1 long hooded trench coat, 1 full-face concrete-textured helmet, 1 glowing horizontal visor, 2 heavy forearm bracers, 2 mechanical gloves, 1 utility belt, 3 belt modules/pouches, and 2 bulky armored boots. The pants are black leather or coated tactical fabric with wrinkled knees and structured panels. The gloves, bracers, belt pouches, and boots are gray-white chipped concrete armor with black mechanical joints and small orange indicator lights near the soles. Use dark charcoal gray seamless studio backdrop, dramatic low-key lighting, soft frontal fill, subtle rim light around the hood and shoulders, realistic materials, high contrast, sharp details, gritty cyberpunk mood, symmetrical composition, no text, no logo, no weapons, no extra characters.
2117903200341231441.promptZh: 创作一幅全身工作室风格角色肖像画，描绘一位未来主义粗野主义（brutalist）科幻特工，正面站立于高竖向画布中央，摆出中性而富有力量感的姿态。该角色是一位匿名的装甲漫游者，身着哑光黑色长款连帽风衣，设计灵感源自厚重的粗野主义建筑：轮廓硬朗笔直、面料厚实、接缝极少，胸前可见三枚小型金属按扣，下摆前侧开衩，露出其下深色战术服装。头盔外观仿若风化的混凝土与雕凿石材，表面呈粗糙的灰白色并带有裂纹，面颊护甲呈尖锐几何造型，双眼位置设有一条横向发光橙色目镜狭缝；目镜内部反射温暖橙色光芒，并在玻璃表面呈现微妙的类地貌纹理。画面中须清晰展现共12个主要可见装备部件：1件长款连帽风衣、1顶全覆式混凝土质感头盔、1条发光横向目镜、2副厚重前臂护臂、2只机械手套、1条工具腰带、3个腰带模块/包具、2双笨重装甲靴。裤装为黑色皮革或涂层战术织物材质，膝盖处有自然褶皱，且具备结构化裁片。手套、前臂护臂、腰带包具及靴子均采用灰白色剥落混凝土装甲材质，配有黑色机械关节，靴底附近设有微小橙色指示灯。背景为深炭灰色无缝影棚背景，采用戏剧性低调布光（low-key lighting）、柔和正面补光（soft frontal fill），在兜帽边缘与肩部施加微妙的轮廓光（rim light），材质表现真实，高对比度，细节锐利，整体氛围粗粝而具赛博朋克（cyberpunk）气质，构图对称，不出现文字、无标识、无武器、无额外人物。

2117903200341231442.promptEn: Create a whimsical square anime-style illustration of a cute giant custard pudding creature sitting calmly on a flat mossy rock in the middle of a tropical rainforest stream during heavy rain. The character is a glossy golden flan shaped like a squat frog, with closed relaxed eyes, a tiny puckered mouth, small rounded front limbs and hind feet, and translucent caramel sauce dripping down from the top. On its head place exactly 2 dessert toppings: one swirl of whipped cream and one bright red cherry with a stem. The creature should look serene and friendly, like an original mascot character, with soft highlights, wet reflections, raindrops sliding down its body, and tiny splashes on the caramel surface. Surround it with dense jungle foliage, large wet green leaves, one cluster of red tropical leaves on the left, misty depth in the background, and an orange-brown rain-filled stream flowing around the rock. Add visible diagonal rain streaks throughout the scene and water droplets on leaves and stone. In the upper right, add the Japanese greeting text こんにちわ in rounded playful lettering, warm orange-brown fill with a thick white outline, slightly tilted. Use a highly polished digital painting style with soft cinematic lighting, saturated greens and warm custard yellows, shallow atmospheric depth, adorable fantasy creature design, no humans, no extra characters, no watermark.
2117903200341231442.promptZh: 创作一幅奇趣的正方形动漫风格插画，描绘一只可爱的巨型蛋奶冻生物，安静地坐在热带雨林溪流中央一块扁平的青苔岩石上，此时正下着倾盆大雨。该角色是一只光泽感十足的金黄色焦糖布丁（flan），外形酷似一只矮胖的青蛙，双眼闭合、神态放松，嘴巴微小而微噘，前肢短小圆润，后足亦小巧浑圆，顶部有透明焦糖酱缓缓滴落。在其头顶精准放置两种甜点配料：一团打发奶油漩涡，以及一颗鲜红带梗的樱桃。该生物应呈现宁静友善的气质，宛如原创吉祥物角色，带有柔和高光、湿润反光、雨滴沿身体滑落，以及焦糖表面细小的飞溅水花。周围环绕茂密的丛林植被、大片湿漉漉的翠绿叶片，左侧有一簇红色热带叶片，背景呈现雾气弥漫的景深，一条橙褐色、雨水充盈的溪流环绕岩石流淌。全场景添加清晰可见的斜向雨丝，叶片与岩石上附着水滴。右上方添加日语问候语“こんにちわ”，采用圆润俏皮的字体，暖橙褐色填充，粗白描边，略带倾斜。采用高度精细打磨的数字绘画风格，搭配柔和电影感布光（cinematic lighting）、饱和度高的绿色与温暖的蛋奶冻黄色、浅层大气景深（shallow atmospheric depth）、可爱奇幻生物设计，画面中无人类、无额外角色、无水印。

2117903200341231443.promptEn: Create a photorealistic ultra-wide mountain landscape at golden hour: a rugged dirt hiking trail begins in the lower right foreground and curves down through an alpine slope, bordered by mossy grass, low shrubs, wild vegetation, and large rounded gray granite boulders. Tall dark evergreen pine trees stand on both sides, with a dense conifer forest filling the valley below. In the middle distance, show a calm reflective mountain lake with a smaller connected inlet, nestled between forested ridges. In the background, depict three sharp rocky mountain peaks with striated gray stone faces and small patches of lingering snow, the tallest peak slightly right of center. The sun is low near the left horizon, partly above a distant ridge, casting strong warm orange light, long shadows, lens flare rays, and glowing highlights across the trail, rocks, trees, and mountain faces. The sky has dramatic soft clouds with orange, peach, and blue tones. Use cinematic HDR lighting, high detail, realistic depth, crisp foreground texture, wide-angle composition, natural colors, no people, no buildings, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341231443.promptZh: 在黄金时刻（golden hour）创作一幅照片级写实（photorealistic）超广角（ultra-wide）山地景观：一条崎岖的泥土徒步小径始于右下前景，蜿蜒向下穿过高山草甸斜坡，两侧分布着苔藓覆盖的草地、低矮灌木、野生植被以及大量圆润的灰色花岗岩巨石。高大深色的常绿松树矗立于小径两侧，下方山谷中则布满茂密的针叶林。中景处展现一座平静而具有倒影效果的高山湖泊，湖畔连着一处更小的入水湾，静卧于林木覆盖的山脊之间。背景中呈现三座陡峭嶙峋的山峰，岩面呈条纹状灰色岩石质地，并散落着几处尚未消融的积雪；其中最高的一座山峰略偏画面中心右侧。太阳低悬于左侧地平线附近，部分露出远方山脊之上，投射出强烈的暖橙色光线、长长的阴影、镜头眩光（lens flare）光束，以及照亮小径、岩石、树木和山体表面的辉光高光。天空布满富有戏剧性的柔云，色调融合橙色、桃色与蓝色。采用电影感HDR布光（cinematic HDR lighting）、高细节、真实纵深感、清晰锐利的前景纹理、广角（wide-angle）构图、自然色彩，画面中无人物、无建筑、无文字、无水印。

2117903200341231444.promptEn:
Goal: Create a polished Japanese real estate sales brochure flyer for a condominium listing, suitable for a property appraisal or sales proposal.

Canvas: Portrait A4 flyer, clean luxury real-estate design, white background with deep navy and muted gold accents. Use elegant Japanese Mincho-style serif typography for headings and readable sans-serif for tables and body copy.

Top hero section: Fill the upper half with a wide low-angle exterior photo of a modern high-rise condominium under a clear blue sky. Overlay a dark navy translucent information block on the left and a dark navy price box on the top right.

Main listing text in the left overlay: Show the building name and unit prominently: 「ザ・パークハウス 渋谷美竹」, 「301号室」. Beneath it show the address: 「東京都渋谷区渋谷1丁目17番6号」. Then list exactly 5 property specs separated by thin gold rules: dedicated area 「50.00㎡（約15.12坪）」, floor plan 「2LDK」, construction date 「2015年3月」, floor 「3階／15階建」, and other listing details as compact real-estate facts.

Top-right price box: Dark navy rectangle with white text reading 「販売価格」 and the large price 「7,980万円」 with small 「（税込）」.

Center headline: Large centered Japanese headline in navy: 「都心の利便性を享受する、上質な都市型レジデンス。」 with a thin gold horizontal divider below.

Feature icon row: Create exactly 5 evenly spaced feature columns with muted-gold line icons and Japanese labels. The 5 icons are: 1) train icon, label 「JR『渋谷』駅 徒歩4分の好立地」 with subtext about Terminal station convenience; 2) apartment building icon, label 「2015年築の築浅マンション」 with subtext about Mitsubishi Estate Residence Park House series; 3) sun icon, label 「南向き・角部屋」 with subtext about sunlight and ventilation; 4) lock icon, label 「オートロック・防犯カメラ完備」 with subtext about security; 5) three trees icon, label 「落ち着いた住環境」 with subtext mentioning Aoyama and Omotesando within living range.

Middle content panels: Use two side-by-side bordered cards with navy title bars. Left card title 「エリアの魅力」 with a paragraph describing the convenience of being 4 minutes from Shibuya Station and a calm residential environment. Include exactly 4 small landscape thumbnail photos along the bottom, each with captions: 「JR渋谷駅（徒歩4分）」, 「渋谷ヒカリエ（徒歩5分）」, 「宮下公園（徒歩9分）」, 「青山通り（徒歩8分）」. Right card title 「資産価値・将来性」 with a paragraph about scarcity and asset value near Shibuya Station. Inside it place a beige sub-box titled 「期待できるポイント」 containing exactly 4 checkmark bullet points: 1) 「渋谷駅徒歩4分の希少価値」, 2) 「再開発エリアの将来性」, 3) 「築浅マンションによる維持管理の安心感」, 4) 「需要の高い2LDK・南向き角部屋」.

Bottom section: Create exactly 3 bottom blocks. Left: a property overview table titled 「物件概要」 with multiple rows for location, access, sale price, dedicated area, floor plan, construction date, floor, structure, total units, management type, management company, parking, and other notes. Middle/right: a bordered staff comment card titled 「担当者コメント」 with a simple gray silhouette portrait and Japanese sales comment explaining the 4-minute Shibuya location, southern corner room brightness, and recommendation to visit. Far bottom: a full-width dark navy contact footer with a phone icon and large number 「0120-123-456」, company name 「株式会社リビブル不動産販売　渋谷センター」, address and license text in small white type, plus a white contact-person box on the right reading 「担当」 and 「リビブル 太郎」.

Visual style and constraints: Make it look like a finished premium Japanese real-estate brochure, not a wireframe. Keep all text crisp and aligned, use navy #003057, white, light gray, and gold accent lines. Maintain a professional editorial grid, balanced margins, realistic building photography, small realistic urban thumbnails, no extra logos, no watermark, no QR code, and no unrelated decorative elements.

2117903200341231445.promptEn: Create a vertical cinematic triptych made of exactly 3 stacked horizontal panels, all showing the same elegant young East Asian woman with black hair in a low ponytail inside a modern airport terminal at golden hour. Panel 1: a wide establishing shot in a vast glass-walled airport concourse with a polished reflective stone floor, high ceiling, flight information boards on the left, check-in counters, distant travelers, large windows on the right, an airplane visible outside, warm sun streaming in from the right, and the woman standing full-body near the center wearing a beige trench coat over a black suit and white shirt, slim black trousers, black heels. Panel 2: a realistic shoulder-up portrait of the same woman turning back over her shoulder toward the camera, soft shallow depth of field, blurred airport lights behind her, natural skin texture, delicate earrings, loose strands of hair framing her face, calm thoughtful expression. Panel 3: an extreme macro close-up of one of her eyes, showing detailed eyelashes, eyelid texture, tear line, glossy cornea, and a crisp reflection inside the iris of the airport concourse and the small full-body woman standing in it. Use photorealistic editorial fashion photography, high dynamic range, warm natural sunlight, cinematic contrast, accurate perspective, detailed reflections, no captions, no logos, no watermark. Canvas should be a tall vertical image with the three panels evenly stacked edge-to-edge, approximately 9:16.
2117903200341231445.promptZh:
创建一幅竖构图的电影感三联画，由恰好3个上下堆叠的横向面板组成，所有面板均展现同一位优雅的年轻东亚女性，她留着黑色低马尾，在黄金时刻（golden hour）的现代机场航站楼内。  
面板1：一幅广阔的定场镜头（establishing shot），场景为一座拥有玻璃幕墙的广阔机场候机大厅，地面为抛光反光石材，天花板高耸，左侧为航班信息显示屏，设有值机柜台，远处可见旅客，右侧为大型落地窗，窗外可见一架飞机，温暖阳光从右侧斜射入内；女子立于画面中央附近，全身入镜，身着米色风衣，内搭黑色西装与白色衬衫、修身黑色西裤及黑色高跟鞋。  
面板2：一幅写实的肩部以上肖像，同一女子正转头回望镜头，景深（depth of field）浅且柔和，背景中机场灯光虚化，皮肤质感自然真实，佩戴精致耳饰，数缕松散发丝轻拂面颊，神情沉静而若有所思。  
面板3：对其一只眼睛的极致微距特写（extreme macro close-up），清晰呈现睫毛细节、眼睑纹理、泪线、富有光泽的角膜，以及虹膜内映出的清晰倒影——倒影中可见整个机场候机大厅，以及其中那个微小但完整的全身女子身影。  
采用照片级写实（photorealistic）的杂志时尚摄影风格，高动态范围（HDR），温暖自然阳光，电影感对比度（cinematic contrast），精准透视，细节丰富的反射效果，不添加任何文字说明、标识或水印。  
画布应为高纵幅图像，三个面板严格等高、无缝上下堆叠，整体比例约为9:16。

2117903200341231446.promptEn:
Goal: Create a 2-row by 4-column comparison grid showing a transformation from realistic child and teen portrait photos into cute 2D anime-style sketch drawings.

Canvas: Square vertical-ish social media image, clean white background, 4 equal columns separated by thin white gutters. The top row is full-color realistic photography; the bottom row is black-and-white line art. Each column pairs one person above with their matching cartoon sketch below.

Layout: Use exactly 8 panels total: 4 realistic portraits in the top row and 4 corresponding manga sketches in the bottom row. Crop all subjects as front-facing bust portraits, centered in each column. Keep the top row photographic and softly lit; keep the bottom row as clean black ink line art on white with no color fill.

Top row subjects, left to right: 1) a young girl with a straight dark brown bob haircut and blunt bangs, gentle smile, beige coat over a white shirt, softly blurred outdoor background; 2) a teenage boy with messy tousled brown hair, subtle freckles, relaxed smile, black hoodie, neutral indoor background; 3) a teenage girl with long wavy light-brown hair, blue-green eyes, soft smile, cream knit top and small pendant necklace, warm neutral background; 4) a little girl with light brown pigtails tied with pink hair ties, bright toothy smile, pink sweater under denim overalls, green outdoor bokeh background.

Bottom row sketches, left to right: 1) matching anime girl with bob haircut and bangs, large sparkling eyes, open cheerful smile, blazer-like coat and shirt; 2) matching anime teen boy with spiky messy hair, big eyes, small smile, hoodie with drawstrings; 3) matching anime teen girl with long flowing wavy hair, large eyes, open smile, knit neckline and pendant necklace; 4) matching anime little girl with twin pigtails, big round eyes, open happy smile, sweater and overall straps with buttons.

Visual style: The photo row should look realistic, high-resolution, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field, soft daylight. The sketch row should look like polished Japanese manga/anime character line art, adorable proportions, oversized eyes, expressive faces, clean varied line weight, minimal shading, white negative space.

Constraints: No captions, no logos, no watermark, no extra people, no additional panels. Preserve the exact 4-column pairing and make each sketch clearly reinterpret the person directly above it. Use realistic children and teenagers transformed into cute anime sketches, with a wholesome magical childhood feeling.

2117903200341231447.promptEn:
Create an elegant café lifestyle portrait of a fashionable young woman relaxing at an outdoor café in a modern urban setting. The composition feels intimate, relaxed, and luxurious, inspired by premium lifestyle campaigns and European café culture.

The subject sits comfortably in a café chair beside a round gray marble table. Her legs are crossed naturally beneath the table. Her left elbow rests on the chair arm while her left hand gently supports her chin in a thoughtful pose. Her head turns gracefully to the left as she looks away from the camera with a calm, effortless expression, conveying quiet confidence and understated elegance.

She has naturally wavy dark brown shoulder length hair styled in a soft, slightly tousled bob with subtle volume and loose strands framing her face. She wears sleek black rectangular sunglasses with a refined minimalist design.

Her outfit consists of a relaxed black short sleeve open collar linen shirt with the top buttons casually undone, tucked into high waisted cream tailored trousers with a modern wide leg silhouette. She completes the look with a stainless steel wristwatch, a delicate silver ring, and small gold hoop earrings, creating a timeless luxury aesthetic.

On the gray marble café table sits a black ceramic cappuccino cup with detailed latte art, a clear glass of water, and a modern smartphone. A small amber glass bottle and subtle green foliage decorate the table, adding warmth without distracting from the composition.

Behind her is a contemporary European style café featuring black framed glass windows, warm ambient interior lighting, dark brick walls, elegant wooden furniture, and a softly blurred restaurant interior that creates natural depth. The atmosphere feels cozy, refined, and cinematic.

Lighting is soft natural daylight with gentle shadows and warm interior highlights spilling through the windows. Captured with an 85mm prime lens at f/2, shallow depth of field, premium editorial photography, realistic skin texture, subtle Fuji 400H film color grading, luxury lifestyle aesthetic, crisp fabric details, cinematic realism, soft bokeh, natural tones, high dynamic range, ultra realistic, 8K.

Negative Prompt: Overexposed lighting, cluttered table, excessive props, text, watermark, logo, distorted anatomy, AI artifacts, unrealistic reflections, cartoon, illustration, low resolution, oversaturated colors, exaggerated makeup, blurry face, extra fingers, extra limbs, duplicate objects, plastic skin, unnatural pose.
