Style should feel like a premium fashion magazine cover or luxury menswear campaign, minimalist, expensive, cinematic, sharp focus, realistic skin texture, clean grooming, no jewelry, no visible logos, no text, no watermark. Use a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, full-body framing with the chair fully visible, sophisticated monochrome palette, elegant contrast, professional studio photography quality.
2117903200341231521.promptZh: 创作一幅超奢华时尚杂志风格的人像摄影作品，主角是一位年轻黑人男性，留着短而紧贴头皮的发型，肤色为光滑的中等棕色，五官对称，神情沉静自信，拍摄于暗调高端时尚摄影棚内。竖构图全身像，主体略微偏右居中，直视镜头，目光从容笃定、充满自信。他身穿全套黑色定制服饰：合身的无领正装衬衫、高腰褶皱长裤、光亮黑色乐福鞋；一件黑色西装外套随意搭在右肩上，右手轻握靠近锁骨处的驳领；左手自然搭在画面左下角单张黑色真皮休闲椅的椅背上。姿态为站立式，一条腿优雅地交叠于另一条腿前方，整体姿态松弛却富有力量感，符合高端时尚杂志的造型要求。背景采用无缝炭灰色至纯黑色影棚背景布，带微妙暗角（vignette），地面投下柔和阴影；采用精致的低调布光（low-key lighting）：主光源为来自前左方的大面积柔光灯，辅以轻柔补光以保留面部细节，对椅子皮革与鞋面施加精准控制的高光，呈现饱满浓郁的黑色并清晰展现面料纹理。整体风格应如顶级时尚杂志封面或奢侈男装广告大片，极简主义、昂贵感十足、电影感（cinematic）、焦点锐利（sharp focus）、皮肤质感真实、仪容整洁清爽，不佩戴任何首饰，服装上无可见品牌标识，画面中无文字、无水印。采用竖版4:5画幅比例，全身构图且椅子完整入镜，配色为考究的单色系（monochrome palette），对比优雅，具备专业影棚摄影（professional studio photography）品质。
2117903200341231521.author: Abkr Sadiq

2117903200341231522.promptEn: A high-quality 3D character design sheet featuring a young male adventurer in an anime-inspired style. The layout consists of four distinct views arranged horizontally against a clean, neutral light gray studio background. From left to right: the first view is labeled 'FRONT' showing the character standing with arms slightly out; the second is labeled 'RIGHT' showing a side profile; the third is labeled 'BACK' showing the rear view; and the fourth is a close-up bust shot labeled 'HEAD 3/4'. The character has messy dark blue-gray hair and large amber eyes. He wears a short teal-blue capelet with white crescent moon patterns on the sides and a central circular bronze clasp over a white collared shirt with rolled sleeves. A brown leather strap crosses his chest diagonally. He wears dark navy cargo pants with multiple pockets, a brown belt with a small leather pouch, fingerless dark gloves, and tall cream-colored boots with brown straps and buckles. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the smooth textures of the clothing and skin.
2117903200341231522.promptZh: 一张高质量的 3D 角色设计图（character design sheet），呈现一名年轻男性冒险者，采用动漫风格（anime-inspired style）。构图由四张独立视角图横向排列组成，背景为干净、中性的浅灰色影棚背景（studio background）。从左至右：第一张标注为“FRONT”，展示角色直立站立姿态，双臂微微外展；第二张标注为“RIGHT”，展示右侧侧面轮廓（side profile）；第三张标注为“BACK”，展示背面视角（rear view）；第四张为特写（close-up）半身像，标注为“HEAD 3/4”。角色拥有一头凌乱的深蓝灰色头发和一双硕大的琥珀色眼睛。他身披一件短款青绿色小斗篷（teal-blue capelet），斗篷两侧饰有白色新月图案，中央配有一枚圆形青铜搭扣（bronze clasp），斗篷内为一件带领白衬衫，袖口卷至小臂。一条棕色皮质肩带（brown leather strap）斜跨胸前。下装为深海军蓝多口袋工装裤（dark navy cargo pants），配一条棕色腰带（brown belt）及一只小型皮质小包（small leather pouch）；双手戴深色露指手套（fingerless dark gloves）；脚穿高筒米白色靴子（tall cream-colored boots），靴面配有棕色绑带（brown straps）与搭扣（buckles）。布光柔和均匀（soft and even lighting），凸显服装与皮肤的平滑质感（smooth textures）。
2117903200341231522.author: Lio K

2117903200341231523.promptEn: Create a photorealistic vertical image of a miniature painter studio scene featuring a young woman artist seated at a warm wooden desk beside a large sunlit window. She has long wavy chestnut-brown hair, light-to-medium skin, delicate features, and wears a crisp white button-up blouse with black trousers. Show her in left-side profile, calmly focused, holding a very fine paintbrush as she paints the face of a tiny full-body figurine that resembles herself. The figurine stands upright on a clear acrylic display base with a small front label reading MINIATURE SELF; it wears a white top and dark pants. The desktop should be richly detailed with exactly 5 visible painting tools and supply groups: 1) several fine brushes laid horizontally in the foreground, 2) a cup of upright paintbrushes on the right, 3) small paint bottles and dropper bottles near the keyboard, 4) a white paint palette with mixed colors, and 5) a dark desk lamp casting warm light over the miniature. In the background, include exactly 3 collectible toy figures on or near the desk: 1) a tan bear-like art toy, 2) a black bear-like art toy, and 3) a gray small character figure with X eyes. Place a large desktop monitor on the right showing a digital reference board with multiple portrait and full-body photos of the same woman in a white blouse, plus a keyboard beneath it. Behind her, add softly blurred wooden shelves with books, framed artwork, and cameras. Use shallow depth of field, cinematic warm afternoon light, soft bokeh, realistic skin texture, natural posture, high-end editorial photography, 85mm lens look, cozy creative studio atmosphere, precise miniature-painting detail, no fantasy elements, no extra text except the label on the base.
2117903200341231523.promptZh: 创建一幅照片级写实（photorealistic）的竖构图图像，描绘一个微缩画家工作室场景：一位年轻女艺术家坐在一张温暖木质书桌旁，书桌紧邻一扇洒满阳光的大窗户。她拥有一头长而波浪状的栗棕色头发，肤色为浅至中等色调，五官精致，身穿一件挺括的白色纽扣衬衫与黑色长裤。呈现她的左侧侧脸轮廓，神情平静专注，手持一支极细的画笔，正在绘制一个全身微缩人偶的面部——该人偶外形与她本人相似。人偶直立于一块透明亚克力展示底座上，底座前方贴有小标签，文字为 MINIATURE SELF；人偶身穿白色上衣与深色长裤。桌面需细节丰富，清晰可见共5组绘画工具与物料：1）前景水平摆放数支精细画笔；2）右侧立置一支装有画笔的杯子；3）键盘附近放置若干小型颜料瓶与滴管瓶；4）一块白色调色板，上面混合着多种颜色；5）一盏深色台灯，投射出温暖光线笼罩微缩人偶。背景中须精确布置3个收藏级玩具人偶，位置均在书桌之上或紧邻书桌：1）一只米褐色熊形艺术玩具；2）一只黑色熊形艺术玩具；3）一个灰色小型角色人偶，眼睛为X形。右侧放置一台大型台式显示器，屏幕上显示数字参考板，其上有多张同一女子身穿白色衬衫的肖像照与全身照；显示器下方配有一台键盘。她身后添加木质书架，呈柔和虚化效果，架上陈列书籍、装框画作与相机。采用浅景深（shallow depth of field）、电影感暖调午后光线（cinematic warm afternoon light）、柔焦外虚化（soft bokeh）、真实肌肤纹理（realistic skin texture）、自然体态（natural posture）、高端杂志摄影风格（high-end editorial photography）、85mm镜头视觉效果（85mm lens look）、温馨创意工作室氛围（cozy creative studio atmosphere）、精准微缩绘画细节（precise miniature-painting detail），不含任何奇幻元素（no fantasy elements），除底座标签外不添加额外文字（no extra text except the label on the base）。
2117903200341231523.author: Mahnoor Fatima

2117903200341231524.promptEn: Create an ultra-realistic graphite pencil sketch of a beautiful young South Asian woman sitting beside a large window inside a luxurious vintage train carriage, shown from the waist up in a vertical portrait composition. She has a calm, soft expression, slightly smiling, looking out through the window toward the left side of the image rather than at the viewer. Her long, flowing hair is parted near the center and blown gently to the right by wind from the open window, with many fine individual strands rendered in pencil. She wears an elegant embroidered traditional South Asian outfit, a flowing dupatta draped over one shoulder and across her lap, small jhumka earrings, bangles, and delicate floral patterns throughout the fabric. Her hands rest in her lap holding a small closed book or diary with an oval ornament on the cover. The setting is an ornate vintage luxury train interior with polished dark wood paneling, carved trim, a cushioned seat back bearing a decorative monogram emblem, framed wall details, and a small classic wall lamp in the background. Through the window, show a detailed mountain valley with snow-capped peaks, pine-covered slopes, a winding river, trees, and distant fields. Use only monochrome graphite pencil tones on textured off-white paper, with highly realistic facial shading, soft highlights, fine crosshatching, layered pencil gradients, intricate textile embroidery, and atmospheric depth outside the window. The mood should feel romantic, nostalgic, serene, and cinematic. No color, no modern objects, no text, no watermark, no extra people.
2117903200341231524.promptZh: 创作一幅超写实的石墨铅笔素描，描绘一位美丽的年轻南亚女性，坐在一节豪华复古列车车厢内的一扇大窗旁，采用垂直人像构图，仅呈现腰部以上部分。她神情平静柔和，略带微笑，目光望向窗外，朝向画面左侧，而非直视观者。她拥有一头长而飘逸的秀发，发线近中分，被敞开的车窗吹入的微风轻轻拂向右侧，大量纤细独立的发丝均以铅笔精细刻画。她身着一套优雅刺绣的传统南亚服饰，一条轻盈的杜帕塔（dupatta）垂搭于一侧肩头并覆于膝上，佩戴小巧的朱姆卡耳环（jhumka earrings）、手镯，织物上遍布精致的花卉图案。她的双手安放于膝上，捧着一本合拢的小书或日记本，封面上饰有椭圆形装饰纹样。场景为雕饰繁复的复古豪华列车内部：光洁深色木质镶板、雕花边饰、带有装饰性单字母组合徽标（monogram emblem）的软垫椅背、带画框的墙面细节，以及背景中一盏小型经典壁灯。透过窗户外，展现一处细节丰富的山间谷地：白雪皑皑的峰顶、松林覆盖的山坡、蜿蜒的河流、树木与远处的田野。仅使用单色石墨铅笔色调绘制于带纹理的米白色纸张上，面部明暗过渡高度写实，高光柔和，辅以精细的交叉排线（crosshatching）、多层叠加的铅笔渐变（layered pencil gradients）、织物刺绣的复杂纹理，以及窗外景致的大气纵深感（atmospheric depth）。整体氛围应浪漫、怀旧、宁静且富有电影感（cinematic）。不得出现色彩、现代物品、文字、水印或额外人物。
2117903200341231524.author: Arina Ai

2117903200341231525.promptEn: Create an ultra-realistic museum-quality graphite pencil sketch portrait on warm off-white textured drawing paper. The subject is a beautiful young South Asian woman shown from the chest up in a three-quarter view, looking downward with a soft closed-mouth smile while holding a single fully bloomed rose close to her nose. She has long dark hair gathered into a loose messy bun with wispy strands around her face, delicate facial features, and small stud earrings. She wears black rectangular-round eyeglasses with warm amber-tinted lenses as the only subtle color accent, plus a formal dark blazer, white collared shirt, and black tie. Her left hand gently holds the rose stem near her chest; the flower is large and detailed, with exactly 1 fully bloomed rose head, 1 long stem, and 6 visible leaves. Render the rose petals, leaves, fingers, hair strands, glasses, blazer, shirt collar, and tie with highly detailed pencil shading, crosshatching, smudged graphite gradients, fine linework, and realistic paper grain. Use a soft natural composition with the rose on the left side of the face, the woman centered slightly right, and faint loose sketch construction strokes fading into the background. Keep the image monochrome graphite except for the amber glasses lenses, avoid text, avoid watermark, and maintain an elegant romantic fine-art portrait mood.
2117903200341231525.promptZh: 在暖色调的米白色纹理绘图纸上，创作一幅超写实、博物馆级品质的石墨铅笔素描肖像。主体是一位美丽的年轻南亚女性，胸部以上构图，呈三分之四视角，微微低头，唇部轻闭、面带柔和微笑，右手持一朵完全盛放的玫瑰贴近鼻尖。她留有长而深色的头发，松散地挽成一个凌乱发髻，面部周围垂落几缕细软发丝；五官精致，佩戴小巧的钉状耳钉。她戴一副黑色矩形圆角眼镜，镜片为暖琥珀色（amber-tinted），是画面中唯一的微妙色彩点缀；身着正式深色西装外套、白色立领衬衫与黑色领带。她的左手轻托玫瑰花茎，位置靠近胸前；花朵硕大且细节丰富，严格包含：1朵完全盛放的玫瑰花头、1根修长花茎、6片清晰可见的叶片。需以高度精细的铅笔排线（crosshatching）、揉擦渐变（smudged graphite gradients）、细腻线条（fine linework）及真实纸张肌理（realistic paper grain），细致刻画玫瑰花瓣、叶片、手指、发丝、眼镜、西装外套、衬衫领口与领带。采用柔和自然的构图：玫瑰位于面部左侧，人物主体略偏画面右侧居中；背景中隐约可见松动的手绘辅助线（loose sketch construction strokes），并逐渐淡出。全图保持单色石墨风格，仅镜片保留琥珀色；禁止添加文字，禁止添加水印；整体氛围须典雅浪漫，呈现高雅艺术肖像（fine-art portrait）格调。
2117903200341231525.author: Arina Ai

2117903200341231526.promptEn: Create a vertical graphite pencil portrait on warm off-white textured paper of a young woman shown from the chest up, centered and facing forward. She has long, softly wavy dark brown hair parted near the middle, smooth youthful facial features, large expressive eyes, full natural eyebrows, a small straight nose, and a subtle closed-mouth smile. She wears oversized black rectangular eyeglasses with translucent amber-yellow tinted lenses; one hand is raised to the left side of the glasses as if adjusting the frame, showing slim fingers and a small ring. Add delicate jewelry: exactly 3 visible pieces, a ring on the raised hand, a thin bracelet on the wrist, and layered fine necklaces with one small round pendant. Dress her in a slightly shiny collared button-up blouse with soft folds and open neckline. Render the image as a highly detailed realistic charcoal-and-graphite sketch with fine crosshatching, visible pencil construction lines, softly shaded skin, detailed hair strands, and subtle smudging; keep the background minimal with faint rectangular guide lines and sketch marks. Use mostly monochrome gray pencil tones, with the eyeglass lenses the only warm colored accent. Maintain a calm, elegant studio portrait mood, symmetrical composition, no text, no watermark, no photorealistic color background.
2117903200341231526.promptZh: 在暖色调的米白色纹理纸张上绘制一幅竖构图的石墨铅笔肖像，画面主体为一位年轻女性，呈现胸部以上、居中且正对镜头。她拥有一头长而柔顺的深棕色波浪发，发线接近中分；面部轮廓光滑年轻，眼睛大而富有表现力，眉毛自然浓密，鼻梁小巧笔直，嘴角微微上扬，呈现含蓄的闭口微笑。她佩戴一副 oversized 黑色矩形眼镜，镜片为半透明琥珀黄色；左手抬起至眼镜左侧镜框处，仿佛正在调整镜架，露出纤细的手指和一枚小戒指。添加精致的首饰：恰好 3 件可见——抬手上的戒指、手腕处的一条细手链，以及多层叠戴的纤细项链，其中一条带有一枚小巧的圆形吊坠。她身穿一件略带光泽的立领纽扣衬衫，衣料呈现柔和褶皱，领口微开。整体以高度细致的写实风格炭笔与石墨素描呈现，包含精细的交叉排线（crosshatching）、清晰可见的铅笔结构线、柔和过渡的皮肤阴影、细致刻画的单根发丝，以及微妙的擦涂（smudging）效果；背景极简，仅保留 faint 矩形辅助线与草图标记。整体主要使用单色灰阶铅笔色调，唯独眼镜镜片为画面中唯一的暖色调点缀。保持沉静优雅的影棚肖像（studio portrait）氛围，采用对称构图，不添加文字，不添加水印，背景不可为照片级写实（photorealistic）彩色背景。
2117903200341231526.author: Arina Ai

2117903200341231527.promptEn: Create a cinematic sci-fi pastoral scene titled by mood, “Where the Robots Came to Wonder”: a highly reflective chrome humanoid robot sits cross-legged in a wildflower meadow at golden hour, positioned left of center in the foreground. The robot has a smooth mirror-sphere head with no face, polished silver anatomical plating, exposed mechanical neck details, and a calm meditative posture. One hand rests on its lap while the other is raised delicately, index finger extended, holding or greeting a tiny ladybug perched on the fingertip. Its mirror surfaces reflect the meadow, sky, and distant hills. In the right midground, show exactly 1 large abandoned rugged robot or mech wreck, partially reclined and overgrown with grass and wildflowers, suggesting nature reclaiming machinery. The setting is a lush rolling countryside with exactly 1 seated chrome humanoid robot, exactly 1 tiny insect on its finger, exactly 1 derelict mech in the background, and abundant daisies and purple wildflowers in the foreground. Use warm golden-hour sunlight, soft clouds, distant blue-green mountains, shallow depth of field with blurred flowers near the camera, realistic high-detail 3D rendering, cinematic composition, peaceful wonder, no text, no logos, no humans, no city skyline, no weapons firing.
2117903200341231527.promptZh: 创作一幅以情绪命名的电影感科幻田园场景 “Where the Robots Came to Wonder”：一名高反射率的镀铬人形机器人于黄金时刻（golden hour）盘腿坐在野花盛开的草甸上，位于画面前景偏左位置。该机器人拥有光滑的镜面球形头部，无面部特征；银色抛光解剖学风格装甲板；颈部机械结构细节外露；姿态宁静，呈冥想状。一只手掌平放于膝上，另一只手轻柔抬起，食指伸展，指尖停驻或迎接一只微小的瓢虫。其镜面表面映出草甸、天空与远方山丘。在画面右侧中景处，精确呈现1个大型废弃粗犷型机器人或机甲残骸，呈半倾倒姿态，被青草与野花覆盖，暗示自然正逐步收复机械造物。场景设定为葱郁起伏的乡村地貌，画面中须严格包含：1个静坐的镀铬人形机器人、1只停驻于其指尖的微小昆虫、1台背景中的废弃机甲，以及前景中大量雏菊与紫色野花。采用温暖的黄金时刻（golden hour）阳光、柔和云朵、远处蓝绿色山脉、浅景深（shallow depth of field）——近处花朵虚化；写实风格高细节3D渲染；电影感构图（cinematic composition）；氛围宁静而充满惊奇感；画面中不得出现文字、标识、人类、城市天际线或正在发射武器的画面。
2117903200341231527.author: Derya Unutmaz, MD

2117903200341231528.promptEn: Create a vertical cinematic street-fashion portrait of VLNS mascot, a full-body humanoid character standing on a sunny sidewalk outside a cute dessert shop. The character has one oversized glossy spherical helmet head covered in bright psychedelic graffiti colors, with one jagged purple triangular visor/mouth shape, two circular side headphone-like ear modules, and one glowing teal light spot on the face. The body wears a black cyberpunk streetwear outfit: one shiny black leather jacket with gray spiky faux-fur shoulders, one black hoodie, one pair of baggy black cargo pants, two black gloves, and two iridescent high-top sneakers with purple laces and a visible “C” emblem on each tongue. Add neon paint splatters in pink, yellow, green, and purple across the jacket and pants, multiple small alien/skull patches, a visible “VLNS” text patch on the sleeve and another on the cargo pocket, and one dangling chain with one white skull charm on the right side. The character holds exactly one transparent purple dessert pouch containing soft-serve ice cream with both hands at chest height. Background: charming storefront with large glass windows, warm bakery lights and pastries inside, purple-and-white striped awning, pastel balloons and lanterns, potted flowers, leafy trees, blue sky, and soft afternoon sunlight. Use a low-angle 35mm fashion editorial look, shallow depth of field, realistic materials, vibrant color grading, crisp subject focus, natural candid pose, and a magical everyday cinematic atmosphere. Prioritize consistent character identity and full-body visibility; no extra characters, no cropped feet, no watermark.

围绕手机布置若干半透明悬浮功能组件：左侧为一枚胶囊形工具栏，内含恰好 5 个元素——一枚纸飞机/滤镜图标，以及四枚圆形色块，颜色分别为白色、浅灰色、黑色与藏青色；右上方为一张玻璃拟态（glassmorphism）音频卡片，配有播放按钮及 5 条横向文字转录行，其中 2 行为黄色高亮标记；右中部为一张磨砂质感（frosted）音频波形卡片，中央带一颗发光圆形光球，周围环绕蓝色波形图；右下方为一张磨砂质感（frosted）操作工具栏，内含恰好 5 枚图标——文档、下拉箭头（chevron arrow）、分享、云上传、信封。

2117903200341231530.promptEn:
Goal: Create a dense Japanese infographic ranking AI image generation tools as a 2026 tier list, with a premium black, navy, and gold tech aesthetic, designed for social media sharing.

Canvas: Square 1:1 poster, high resolution, dark black background with subtle blue grid lines and glowing cyan/gold accents. Use bold Japanese typography, sharp table borders, star ratings, crowns, badges, and app-logo style icons. Overall look should feel like a professional comparison chart made after extensive testing.

Header: Large title at top: 「AI画像生成ツール Tier表」 with “AI” and Japanese text in white, “Tier表” in gold. Add a gold badge on the upper left reading 「2026年 最新版」. Above the title, add the small line 「保存必須！迷ったらこれを見ればOK」. Under the title, add a blue outlined subtitle bar: 「用途別に最強が一目でわかる 完全ガイド」. Add a small gold crown near the title.

Top-right selection box: Add a bordered panel titled 「選び方のポイント」 with exactly 4 checkbox bullet items: 「何を作りたいかで選ぶ」, 「得意・不得意を理解する」, 「目的に合わせて使い分ける」, 「迷ったら上位から試す」.

Main layout: A large comparison table fills most of the image. Left side has tier bands, middle has ranked tool rows, right side has star-rating columns and price notes. Use exact tier groups: SSS 「圧倒的最強」, SS 「非常に優秀」, S 「優秀」, A 「特化型で強力」, B 「用途次第で活躍」. Use large tier letters in gold, cyan, green, purple, and pale blue respectively.

Main table rows: Include exactly 8 ranked tools, each with a circular rank medal, a square logo icon, a tool name, a short Japanese description, and several small colored feature tags. The rows are:
1. GPT Image 2 — description 「総合力No.1の最強モデル」, logo resembling the OpenAI knot mark, rank medal gold with “NEW” label.
2. Seedream 5.0 Pro — description 「広告・商用クリエイティブ最強」, blue spiral logo.
3. Nano Banana — description 「リアル写真・人物・商品に最強」, yellow banana logo.
4. Muse — description 「映画のような世界観・コンセプトアート」, purple M logo.
5. Ideogram — description 「文字デザイン・タイポグラフィ最強」, black abstract brain/typography logo.
6. Flux — description 「イラスト・アート・CG表現が得意」, blue triangular Flux logo.
7. Recraft — description 「ロゴ・アイコン・ベクターに最強」, black-and-white R-like logo.
8. Imagen 2 — description 「自然風景・写真の再現に強い」, multicolor Google G logo.

Rating columns: Use exactly 8 comparison columns with Japanese labels: 「総合力」, 「リアル/人物」, 「イラスト/アート」, 「文字/デザイン」, 「編集/加工」, 「商用利用」, 「使いやすさ」, 「料金目安(月額)」. Fill each row with gold star ratings, including half/empty stars where appropriate, and compact monthly pricing notes in the final column. Keep the table legible but information-dense.

Bottom section: Add a horizontal “best by use case” guide titled 「用途別 最強早見表」. Include exactly 7 crowned cards, each with a number, category, logo, tool name, and short verdict:
1. 「リアル人物」 — Nano Banana — 「圧倒的リアル」.
2. 「広告・商用」 — Seedream 5.0 Pro — 「商用品質No.1」.
3. 「総合力」 — GPT Image 2 — 「なんでも高水準」.
4. 「シネマ・世界観」 — Muse — 「映画レベル」.
5. 「文字・デザイン」 — Ideogram — 「文字が綺麗」.
6. 「イラスト・アート」 — Flux — 「アート表現が得意」.
7. 「ロゴ・アイコン」 — Recraft — 「ベクター最強」.

Bottom-right recommendation box: Add a glowing panel titled 「迷ったらこれ！」 with a lightbulb icon and the message 「まずは上位から 3つ使えば ほぼ全てカバーできる！」.

Footer: Add two dark bordered note boxes. Left box with target icon and two bullet notes: 「1つのツールにこだわらず、目的に合わせて使い分けるのが最強の戦略！」 and 「プロほど複数のツールを組み合わせて、クオリティを最大化しています。」 Right box with bookmark icon and text: 「保存して、いつでも見返せるようにしよう！」 and 「アップデートされたらまた最新版に更新します！」 Include a tiny disclaimer line about pricing and ratings being estimates as of 2026.

Visual style: Sleek cyber dashboard, black glass panels, thin neon blue dividers, gold highlights, dense but organized layout, crisp Japanese text, app icons in white rounded squares, star ratings in metallic gold, no photographic background, no people.

Constraints: Preserve the exact count of 8 ranked tools, 5 tier bands, 8 rating columns, 4 selection tips, and 7 bottom use-case cards. Make all text sharp and readable. Do not add extra tools, extra cards, watermarks, or random English labels.

2117903200341231531.promptZh: 超写实电影感（cinematic）肖像：一位美丽的年轻女性，身着华贵深绯红色真丝纱丽（saree），搭配同色无袖上衣，上衣饰有细腻的花卉提花刺绣，纱丽边缘为柔和的金色镶边。她伫立于一座遗产宫殿走廊中一根精雕细琢的象牙色石柱旁，正值黄金时刻（golden hour），目光轻柔望向远方，神情平静而梦幻。她的头发梳成整齐的低发髻，点缀一朵新鲜的红玫瑰，数缕松散卷曲的发丝轻拂面颊。肌肤光滑透亮、自然光泽，富有表现力的棕色双眸，柔粉双唇，妆容极简。温暖阳光穿过繁复雕花的贾利（jali）镂空图案，在她的面部、颈部、肩部、上衣及纱丽上投下精细的花卉阴影。柔和的电影感逆光（cinematic backlight），奶油质感焦外虚化（bokeh），浅景深（shallow depth of field），背景中奢华的遗产建筑风格呈现虚化效果，构图优雅，暖金色调色（warm golden color grading），真丝纹理高度精细，照片级写实（photorealistic）肌肤，自然面部比例，HDR，8K，单反相机（DSLR）画质，85mm人像镜头，光圈f/1.8，面部超锐利对焦，高端杂志时尚摄影（premium editorial fashion photography），竖构图9:16。

Ultra-realistic editorial fashion portrait of a playful young woman with a short layered chestnut-brown bob haircut and straight blunt bangs, soft natural makeup with rosy blush, subtle freckles across the nose, glossy pink lips, long curled lashes, winged eyeliner, and a small pastel blue star sticker on one cheek. Minimal light gray seamless studio background with soft, diffused daylight-style lighting, clean editorial setup, shallow depth of field, crisp facial details, natural skin texture, vibrant yet pastel color grading, premium fashion magazine photography, 85mm lens, f/2, ultra-high resolution, cinematic composition.

Create a 4-image expression series while keeping the outfit, hairstyle, accessories, lighting, framing, and background identical:
1.Curious expression: Looking upward with wide eyes and puckered lips in an “ooh” face. Floating oversized pastel buttons (heart, butterfly, flower, star) around the subject, soft foreground bokeh.

2117903200341231532.promptZh:
超写实杂志风格时尚人像，一位活泼的年轻女性，留着短款层次感栗棕色波波头，齐直厚重刘海；妆容自然柔和，脸颊泛着玫瑰色红晕，鼻梁上散布着细微雀斑，双唇涂有亮粉色唇彩，睫毛卷长浓密，眼线呈猫眼式（winged eyeliner），一侧脸颊贴有一枚淡蓝色小星星贴纸。

她身穿一件 oversized 炭灰色西装外套，饰有色彩缤纷的超大纽扣；内搭一件浅蓝与白色相间的条纹衬衫；一条鲜红色条纹领带松散地打成结；佩戴一条纤细银质心形吊坠项链。头上戴着一顶手工做旧牛仔布王冠，缀有各色纽扣、亮片、补丁，以及清晰可见的橙色缝线。

极简浅灰色无缝影棚背景，采用柔和漫射式日光风格布光，干净利落的杂志级拍摄设置，浅景深（shallow depth of field），面部细节锐利清晰，肌肤纹理自然真实，配色鲜明而柔和（vibrant yet pastel color grading），高端时尚杂志摄影风格，85mm 镜头，f/2 光圈，超高分辨率，电影感构图（cinematic composition）。

创作一组共 4 幅的表情系列图像，保持服装、发型、配饰、布光、取景构图及背景完全一致：  
1. 好奇表情：仰视姿态，双眼睁大，嘴唇微噘呈“哇”（ooh）状；画面中漂浮着数枚 oversized 柔和粉彩色纽扣（心形、蝴蝶形、花朵形、星形），前景焦外虚化（bokeh）。  
2. 不耐烦表情：双手正调整牛仔布王冠，双眼向上翻动，嘴唇略带嘟嘴，流露俏皮的挫败感。  
3. 顽皮表情：将一根红色棒棒糖棍含于唇间，单侧眉毛微微上扬，斜眼凝视并露出狡黠微笑。  
4. 甜美表情：双目轻闭，面带温暖笑容，头部轻轻倚靠在一只手上，传递出可爱而宁静的情绪氛围。

面料纹理高度精细，牛仔布缝线与毛边效果真实可辨，纽扣装饰色彩饱满鲜活，色彩还原精准卓越，整体呈现柔和粉彩色调（soft pastel aesthetic），风格奇幻俏皮（whimsical fashion styling），受卡哇伊（kawaii）启发的杂志风格人像（kawaii-inspired editorial portrait），商业级美妆摄影（commercial beauty photography），屡获殊荣的时尚专题摄影（award-winning fashion editorial），超照片级写实（ultra-photorealistic），8K 分辨率，HDR。

2117903200341231537.promptEn:
Theme: 
One Step Toward the Cloud Castle

Subject:
Portrait 4:5 aspect ratio. A woman pulling a cream-colored carry-on suitcase while extending one leg forward on a breakwater overlooking a blue sea, positioned slightly left of the lower center. The figure and suitcase occupy about 35% of the frame height. The upper 65% is dedicated to the sky and a giant cloud castle, leaving a strong sense of openness.

Character and Expression:
A natural and realistic woman. Soft brown hair tied in a low ponytail, with bangs and loose strands blowing to the right in the sea breeze. Her face is turned slightly toward the camera with a gentle, modest smile. Her gaze is directed between the distant sky and the sea.

Clothing and Pose:
A cream-colored short-sleeved sailor collar dress. The collar and hem have thin dark blue piping, the waist is neatly cinched, and the knee-length flared skirt billows lightly in the wind. White crew socks and white low-top sneakers. With her left hand, she pulls the telescopic handle of a small cream-colored carry-on case backward, the case tilting so its two wheels lift. She stands on the breakwater with her right leg and extends her left leg almost horizontally forward. Her right arm flows naturally backward, with her center of gravity positioned directly above her right leg.

Background and Lighting:
A calm blue sea with a low horizon. Only a few small silhouettes of ships in the distance. A massive cumulonimbus cloud spreads across the sky, its upper part naturally connecting into the shape of a creative aerial castle. The castle is an asymmetrical composition of slender towers, round towers, cloud corridors, bridges, and translucent spires. An original design that is fairy-tale-like but not reminiscent of any specific work. The outline of the castle emerges not as a building itself, but through the density and shadows of white clouds. Strong midday sunlight shines from the upper left, brightly illuminating her left shoulder, cheek, skirt, and the top of the case. Shadows fall shortly toward the lower right, with faint blue reflected light from the sea surface filling in her lower body.

Composition and Camera:
A full-body photograph from a low eye level. A light sense of compression equivalent to an 85mm lens. The person is placed in the bottom 1/3, and the cloud castle is placed large in the upper center. Sufficient space is maintained from the top of the person's head to the castle, with some margin left from the top of the castle to the top edge of the frame. The breakwater is depicted as a horizontal line crossing the very bottom, and the boundary between the sea and sky is slightly below the person's waist. Focus is clearly set on the person and the suitcase, with only the distant ships lightly blurred.

Texture and Style:
A transparent summer photographic expression. Unified by a clear cyan-blue sky, near-pure white clouds, and cream-colored clothing and case. Skin retains a natural texture, avoiding excessive skin smoothing. The cloud castle has a soft three-dimensional feel and light transmission, maintaining a sense of reality as if it appeared by chance in a photograph. A refreshing and bright high-key tone, delicate wind movement, and light film grain.

Negative:
Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, mismatched leg lengths, poor contact with the suitcase, floating, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, symmetrical castle, castle too similar to existing works, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin.

2117903200341231542.promptEn:
Goal: Create an ultra-wide 3:1 cinematic storyboard keyframe for a one-take action chase sequence in an underground parking garage, showing the full route, character blocking, pursuit relationship, conflict points, and final exit in one continuous panoramic scene.

Canvas: Horizontal 3:1 aspect ratio, dark realistic film still style, approximately 1200×400 composition. Use a dim concrete basement parking lot labeled B2, wet reflective floor, fluorescent ceiling lights, parked black cars, concrete pillars with yellow-black hazard stripes, directional road markings, and a bright ramp exit at the far right.

Main action: Depict a young man in a black jacket, black pants, white sneakers, carrying a black backpack being chased by a larger middle-aged man in a brown jacket and dark pants. Show the same two characters repeated across the continuous space as sequential action poses, not as separate panels. The protagonist begins at the elevator on the far left, runs through the car area, dodges behind a pillar, slips past parked cars, uses an obstacle area to slow the pursuer, then sprints toward the bright exit ramp on the far right. Add a third silhouette-like runner only at the far-right exit if needed to emphasize the final escape.

Layout and movement graphics: Overlay a thick yellow curved route arrow running from left to right across the entire image, with arrowheads marking direction. Add a dashed blue path around the cars and pillars to indicate alternate movement. Add a hatched circular blind-zone mark near the pillar labeled as a blind spot. Add small annotation arrows pointing to the obstacle area near caution signs and carts.

Numbered storyboard labels: Place exactly 10 yellow circled numbers with small white handwritten-style Chinese captions along the top edge, evenly spaced from left to right. Use these exact visible step captions: ① 电梯开启 / 察觉异常; ② 加快脚步 / 穿过车位区; ③ 追逐者现身 / 开始追赶; ④ 柱后堵截 / 挡住去路; ⑤ 抓住背包; ⑥ 贴柱急转 / 甩开追逐者; ⑦ 侧身穿过 / 车辆窄缝; ⑧ 追逐者被迫 / 减速绕行; ⑨ 推倒障碍 / 阻挡追击; ⑩ 冲向出口 / 拉开距离.

Bottom timeline: Add a black semi-transparent horizontal timeline strip across the bottom. It must contain exactly 7 time markers and event labels from left to right: 00:00 电梯开启; 00:05 察觉跟踪; 00:10 追逐者现身; 00:16 柱后堵截; 00:20 贴柱挣脱; 00:26 穿缝穿过; 00:32 障碍阻挡; and at the far right 00:42 冲向出口. Use a thin yellow line with small arrowheads and dots.

Scene details: Include an elevator doorway at far left with B2 signage, several parked cars, multiple concrete support columns, a narrow gap between vehicles, trash carts or cleaning carts, yellow caution wet-floor signs, and a bright white daylight exit ramp at far right with an overhead exit sign. Use Chinese parking-garage signage where visible, such as B2 and 出口 EXIT.

Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic action storyboard, moody cool-gray color grading, high contrast, wet concrete reflections, motion-blur hints on running figures, sharp environmental details, yellow annotation graphics resembling a director's blocking plan, handwritten white Chinese notes, tense thriller atmosphere. Make it look like a finished previsualization board for Underground Parking Garage Chase.

Constraints: Keep the composition as one continuous wide space, not comic panels. Show exactly 10 numbered top annotations, exactly 8 bottom timeline events including the final 00:42 marker, and maintain the same protagonist and pursuer across all repeated poses. Do not add logos, watermarks, or unrelated text.

2117903200341231545.promptEn:
Goal: Create a Chinese classical mythology cinematic storyboard poster titled 《嫦娥仙子·瑶池荷上舞》九宫格分镜图, showing Chang'e performing an elegant continuous classical dance on giant lotus leaves in the heavenly Yaochi pond.

Canvas: Square 1:1 poster, arranged as an exact 3×3 grid with thin dark divider lines, like a film director's storyboard contact sheet. Add a narrow decorative bottom title strip with small ornamental flourishes and the centered Chinese title. Each panel should feel like a standalone fantasy painting while also connecting into one complete dance sequence.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed cinematic Chinese myth fantasy, moonlit blue-silver palette, romantic and ethereal, soft mist, sparkling water reflections, luminous full moon, starry night sky, distant golden palace pavilions and lanterns, lotus blossoms and broad lotus leaves across the heavenly lake. Use realistic digital painting with delicate silk textures, high detail, gentle glow, and graceful motion blur in flowing fabric.

Main subject: Chang'e fairy, a beautiful Chinese goddess with long black hair, ornate silver-and-jade hair ornaments, pale luminous skin, serene expression, and a layered flowing white and ice-blue Hanfu dance costume with translucent gauze sleeves and long ribbons. She dances barefoot or lightly standing on enormous lotus leaves above reflective water.

Layout and panel content: Include exactly 9 numbered panels, each with a circled number in the upper-left corner and Chinese stage directions in white/gold calligraphy-style text. The 9 panels are: 1) “月下登场” — Chang'e enters under the moon, standing side-on on a giant lotus leaf, veil trailing behind her. 2) “轻扬云袖” — she raises both cloud sleeves, arms opening outward, silk sleeves floating in the air. 3) “俯身掬水” — she bends down to touch or scoop water, droplets and ripples sparkling beside the lotus leaf. 4) “莲步轻移” — she steps delicately across the lotus leaves with one arm extended, hem and ribbons sweeping low. 5) “旋转舒展” — central spinning pose, dress and sleeves spread in a circular whirl, add white motion arcs around her. 6) “轻跃回身” — she leaps and turns back, skirt and ribbons flying dramatically to the side. 7) “举臂望月” — she raises one arm toward the full moon and gazes upward, a proud elegant silhouette. 8) “缓缓收势” — she slows and gathers the dance, seated or lowering gracefully on the lotus leaf with relaxed flowing sleeves. 9) “仙姿定格” — final iconic pose, standing tall with one arm lifted, moon and Milky Way behind her, dress settling into a majestic finish.

Text and graphic details: Use the Chinese panel titles exactly as listed, plus short smaller Chinese descriptive lines under each title to mimic a storyboard annotation. Add white hand-drawn curved arrows and motion trails in several panels to show the choreography. Bottom title strip text should read 《嫦娥仙子·瑶池荷上舞》九宫格分镜图. Keep the typography elegant and legible, but the image should remain primarily visual.

Constraints: Use exactly 9 panels in a 3×3 arrangement, one goddess figure per panel, consistent costume and face across all panels, consistent moonlit Yaochi setting, no modern objects, no extra panels, no watermark, no logo.

2117903200341231548.promptZh: 创作一幅柔和、明亮的动漫风格插画，描绘雪莲——一位长着猫耳的可爱少女，正安静地坐在阳光洒满的卧室或书房书桌旁读书。她拥有一头极长、柔顺飘逸的银白色长发，发间点缀着淡青色挑染；耳朵是大而蓬松的猫耳；眼睛湛蓝明亮，带有星光般高光；神情羞涩而平静，双颊泛着淡淡的红晕，面容精致，具有孩童般的娇嫩特征。在她两侧各系一个蓝色丝带发结，每个发结上都装饰着小巧的金色铃铛挂饰。她身穿一件纯白无袖上衣，衣缘带有细腻荷叶边，领口缀有一枚小小的青色蝴蝶结；外搭一件半透明宽松白色开衫，自然滑落于肩头；下身是一条蓝色格纹裙，搭配白色过膝袜。她端坐于书桌旁一张圆形矮凳上，双手捧着一本摊开的淡蓝色硬壳书，低头凝视书页，仿佛正专注研读。书桌左侧整齐叠放恰好四本书：最上方为一本青绿色书，其下依次为一本浅米色书、一本深绿色书，最底部为一本蓝色书。背景是一间温馨舒适的房间：左侧设有一扇高大的窗户，垂着轻盈的蓝色薄纱窗帘，温暖明亮的晨光倾泻而入；右侧是一排白色书架，上面陈列着色彩缤纷的书籍与小型物件，整体呈柔和焦外虚化（bokeh）效果。整体采用梦幻式高调布光（high-key lighting）、镜头光晕（lens flare）、漂浮的微尘粒子以及彩虹色焦外虚化（bokeh）光斑；发丝周围泛有半透明辉光；色调为柔和的粉彩色系；景深（depth of field）柔和；发丝细节丰富；线条干净利落，具典型动漫风格；最终呈现为缥缈空灵、类似 NovelAI 风格的完成效果。竖构图，比例 2:3；人物居中略偏右；书桌位于前景；整体氛围宁静安详，专注阅读。避免出现文字、水印、额外人物、手部畸变、书籍结构异常或额外耳朵。

2117903200341231549.promptEn: Subject: Hands counting clouds. Subject: A vertical 4:5 photographic portrait. Under a bright summer sky, on the rooftop of a city apartment, a woman with a natural atmosphere is leaning against a white railing. The figure is positioned slightly below the center of the screen, including the upper body to above the knees, and the upper half of the screen is a wide margin of blue sky. Character/Expression: Short dark brown bob hair. Thin bangs and hair around the face flow lightly to the side in the wind. Eyes closed, quiet expression with mouth relaxed. Natural complexion and small highlights on cheeks, clean Japanese-style makeup. The face is slightly downward, giving a gentle impression as if catching the dazzling summer sun. Clothing/Pose: A white sleeveless summer blouse. Fine pintucks on the chest, modest lace on the cuffs, and a light transparency of thin cotton. Below is a reddish terracotta-colored high-waisted skirt. Bring both elbows close to the inside of the railing and hang both hands forward. The figure's own left and right fingertips naturally bend loosely and fall along gravity on the railing. The shoulders and neck are relaxed, and only the ends of the hair and clothes sway slightly in the wind. Background/Light: The background is a rooftop where a group of low-rise apartments in the city can be seen blurred in the distance. The sky is bright light blue, with only a few small natural white clouds floating in the sky. The main light is strong summer sunlight from the upper left of the screen. The face, shoulders, and top of the blouse are brightly lit, and sharp shadows fall on the railing and skirt. Composition/Camera: The camera is slightly lower than chest height and closer to the front. Use a medium telephoto lens to shallowly blur the background and focus on the texture of the person's face, hair, hands, and clothes. Leave a large sky margin above the person's head, and cut the lower end naturally in the middle of the skirt. Texture/Style: Realistic photographic expression. Carefully describe the transparent summer air, natural skin texture, thin cotton fibers, fine roughness of the white railing, and soft wrinkles of the skirt. Colors are centered on white, blue, and terracotta, with a light contrast like a bright and clean Japanese film photograph. Negative: Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of hands and feet, breakdown of joints, poor contact with the railing, floating objects, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled characters, logo, watermark, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin.
2117903200341231549.promptZh:
主体：双手数云。主体：一幅竖构图 4:5 的摄影人像。明亮的夏日天空下，在城市公寓楼顶，一位气质自然的女性倚靠在白色栏杆上。人物位于画面略低于中心的位置，取景范围涵盖上半身至膝盖以上，画面顶部留出大面积蓝色天空作为留白。  
角色/表情：深棕色短发齐耳波波头。额前细碎刘海与脸颊两侧的发丝被微风轻轻吹向一侧。双目轻闭，神情宁静，嘴角放松。肤色自然，面颊带有细微高光，妆容为干净的日系风格。面部微微低垂，呈现出一种温柔感，仿佛正迎向耀眼的夏日阳光。  
服饰/姿态：一件白色无袖夏日衬衫。胸前有精细的褶裥（pintucks），袖口饰有含蓄的蕾丝，薄棉材质透出轻盈的透明感。下身为偏红陶土色的高腰裙。双肘贴近栏杆内侧，双手自然前垂。人物自身的左右指尖自然松弛弯曲，顺应重力垂落于栏杆之上。肩颈放松，仅有发梢与衣角在微风中轻微摇曳。  
背景/光线：背景为楼顶，远处可见一组城市低层公寓，呈虚化效果。天空为明亮的浅蓝色，仅零星漂浮着几朵自然的白色小云。主光源为来自画面左上方的强烈夏日阳光。面部、肩部及衬衫上部被充分照亮，清晰的阴影投射在栏杆与裙面上。  
构图/镜头：相机位置略低于人物胸部高度，且稍靠近正面。使用中焦远摄镜头（medium telephoto lens），以浅景深（shallow depth of field）虚化背景，焦点精准落在人物面部、发丝、双手与衣物的质感上。人物头顶上方保留大片天空留白，画面底部自然截取于裙身中部。  
质感/风格：写实主义摄影表达（realistic photographic expression）。细致刻画通透的夏日空气、自然的肌肤纹理、纤薄的棉质纤维、白色栏杆表面细腻的粗粝感，以及裙装柔软的褶皱。色彩以白、蓝与陶土色为主调，明暗对比轻柔，呈现如明亮洁净的日系胶片摄影（Japanese film photograph）般的观感。  
负面提示词：不自然的面部、不自然的眼神、多余手指、缺失手指、手足融合、关节结构崩坏、手与栏杆接触不良、悬浮物体、违背重力现象、透视错误、阴影与光源方向矛盾、乱码文字、商标、水印、过度皮肤修饰、塑料感肌肤。

2117903200341231550.promptEn: Create a polished anime-style illustration of a young hotel attendant standing in the luxurious lobby of a grand hotel. 2117903200341231550.promptZh: 创作一幅精致的动漫风格插画，描绘一位年轻酒店服务员站在一家豪华大酒店的奢华大堂中。角色是一位开朗的年轻女性，齐肩暖栗棕色短发，刘海柔和，眼睛大而明亮、呈蓝色，面带温柔微笑，以放松的三分之四正面姿态面向观者。她身穿一件优雅的白色制服连衣裙：长蓬袖、合身袖口、高领、颈间系一枚硕大的皇家蓝色蝴蝶结，蝴蝶结上别有一枚椭圆形蓝色宝石胸针；腰部为结构化蓝色腰面板，配有恰好四颗银色纽扣；两侧为蓝色侧板；肩部饰有类似肩章的细节；裙摆下摆与袖口附近带有微妙的灰色星爆状刺绣。她左手提着一只结构分明的蓝白配色手提包，仅用包带提握。场景设定于一座富丽典雅的经典酒店大堂：光洁的大理石地面、高耸的米色大理石立柱、暖金色水晶吊灯、右侧设有一张深色木质前台，台上摆放两盏发光的台灯，背景墙可见金色字母标识“GRAND HOTEL”。左侧布置一张圆形木质小桌，桌上置一大型深色花瓶，内插一束白百合与绿植；背景中可见休闲椅与暖光壁灯。采用精细的日式动漫渲染风格（Japanese anime rendering），线条干净（clean line art），柔化赛璐珞着色（soft cel shading），布料褶皱刻画细致，环境光线温暖，大理石地面呈现优雅倒影，整体氛围体现高端待客之道（sophisticated hospitality atmosphere）。构图为横向16:9画幅，中景至半身构图（medium-full body framing），取景范围从头部至膝盖以下，人物略微偏右居中；背景细节丰富但氛围柔和空灵。避免出现额外人物、额外手袋、手部畸变、文字杂乱或现代休闲服饰。

2117903200341231551.promptEn:
Subject:
Fingertips Chasing Bubbles

Main Subject:
Vertical 3:4 photo. A woman sitting in a tatami-matted Japanese room is placed prominently in the center, captured from the top of her head to her waist. The person occupies about 75% of the frame, reaching both hands toward the camera while trying to touch soap bubbles floating in front of her.

Character and Expression:
A woman with natural transparency. Hair is a dark brown shoulder-length medium bob, with the ends moving slightly outward and thin bangs falling naturally onto the forehead. Fine stray hairs are left around the face. The head is slightly tilted, with clear eyes looking just above the camera. Lips are slightly parted in an expression of quiet surprise and curiosity. Pale coral-toned makeup, natural skin texture, and subtle color on the cheeks.

Clothing and Pose:
A light yukata with pale blue and pink small flowers scattered on a white background. A dusty rose pink obi at the waist. The body faces forward, sitting with relaxed shoulders. Both elbows are bent, hands extended toward the lens, and fingers spread naturally. Palms face slightly inward, capturing the moment of trying to enclose a central soap bubble. The hands are closer to the camera than the face, appearing large due to perspective.

Background and Light:
Wooden-framed shoji screens on the left, an open veranda and lush garden in the back right. A single transparent ramune bottle with a blue stopper is placed on the bottom left of the tatami. Soap bubbles of various sizes float in the foreground, around the person, and in the background, with iridescent reflections on their surfaces. Warm natural light streams in from the garden side at the back right, illuminating the hair silhouette, cheeks, shoulders, and the backs of the hands. The shoji side is in soft shadow, with reflected light from the garden gently lifting the shadows on the face.

Composition and Camera:
A close-up portrait shot from nearly the same height as the person's eye level. Primary focus on the face, with the hands and foreground bubbles lightly blurred. A triangular composition with hands at the bottom center and the face behind them. A small amount of negative space above the head, leaving shoji and the garden on the sides. Equivalent to 85mm, shallow depth of field, with large soft bokeh in the background.

Texture and Style:
A Japanese-style photographic expression capturing a summer afternoon. Naturally warm color tones, soft contrast, and delicate film grain. The skin is not excessively processed, leaving fine downy hair and light transmission. Naturally depicts the thin film of bubbles, the cotton texture of the yukata, and individual strands of hair.

Negative:
Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, asymmetrical eyes, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, overly stiff hands, unnatural joints, structural failure of the yukata, shadows inconsistent with the light source, excessive skin smoothing, plastic-like skin, gibberish text, logos, watermarks.
2117903200341231551.promptZh:
主体：  
指尖追逐泡泡  

主要主体：  
竖构图 3:4 照片。一位女性坐在铺有榻榻米的日式房间中，画面以她头顶至腰部为范围，居中突出呈现。人物占据画面约 75%，双臂向前伸展、双手朝向镜头，试图触碰漂浮在她面前的肥皂泡泡。  

人物与表情：  
一位具有自然通透感的女性。发色为深棕色，中长发齐肩波波头，发尾微微外翘，薄刘海自然垂落于额头；面部周围保留细碎的飞毛。头部略向一侧倾斜，双眼清澈，目光略高于镜头位置；嘴唇微张，流露出安静的惊讶与好奇神情。妆容为淡珊瑚色调，肌肤呈现自然纹理，脸颊泛起淡淡红晕。  

服饰与姿态：  
一件浅色浴衣，白色底面上散落着淡蓝与粉红色的小花图案；腰间系一条灰玫瑰粉色的腰带（obi）。身体正对镜头，坐姿放松，双肩自然下垂；双肘弯曲，双手朝镜头方向伸出，手指自然张开；掌心略向内收，捕捉正欲合拢包裹中央一颗肥皂泡泡的瞬间。双手比面部更靠近镜头，因透视关系显得较大。  

背景与光线：  
左侧为木框纸拉门（shoji），后右方为敞开的檐廊与繁茂的庭院。榻榻米左下角放置一只透明弹珠汽水瓶（ramune bottle），瓶塞为蓝色。大小不一的肥皂泡泡漂浮于前景、人物周围及背景中，表面泛着虹彩反光。温暖的自然光从后右方庭院侧斜射入，勾勒出发丝轮廓、照亮脸颊、肩部及手背；纸拉门一侧处于柔和阴影中，而庭院反射光则轻柔提亮面部阴影。  

构图与镜头：  
近似人物眼平高度的特写（close-up）人像拍摄。焦点主要集中于面部，双手与前景泡泡轻微虚化（defocused）。采用三角形构图：双手位于画面底部中央，面部位于其后方。头顶上方留有少量负空间，纸拉门与庭院分别位于画面左右两侧。等效焦距 85mm，景深（depth of field）较浅，背景呈现大面积柔和焦外虚化（bokeh）。  

质感与风格：  
日式摄影风格，捕捉夏日午后氛围。色调自然温暖，对比度柔和，带有细腻胶片颗粒（film grain）。肌肤未过度修饰，保留细微绒毛与透光感；真实呈现泡泡薄膜的纤薄质感、浴衣棉质纹理，以及每一根独立发丝。  

负面提示（Negative）：  
不自然的面部、不自然的眼神、不对称的眼睛、多余的手指、缺失的手指、粘连的手指、过于僵硬的手部姿态、不自然的关节结构、浴衣结构失真、阴影与光源方向不一致、过度磨皮、塑料感肌肤、乱码文字、商标、水印。

2117903200341231552.promptEn: Create a cinematic surreal 3D render of a giant floating double cheeseburger suspended in deep outer space, centered slightly left of frame. The burger has exactly 5 visible food layers: a smooth rounded top bun with tiny sesame-like pores, an upper melted cheddar cheese slice drooping over the edge, a thick dark beef patty, a second melted cheddar cheese slice, and a rounded bottom bun; make the cheese glossy orange-yellow with soft folds and the patties rough and textured. Use a dark blue and violet starfield background with countless tiny stars, one small bright golden star below the burger near the lower center, and a luminous spiral galaxy/nebula sweeping diagonally behind it in the upper right. Lighting should be dramatic and realistic, with warm highlights on the bun and cheese from the front-left and cool blue rim light from the space background. The composition is widescreen 16:9, minimal and iconic, no text, no people, no plate, no packaging, no watermark, with shallow cinematic depth and high-detail photorealistic CGI.
2117903200341231552.promptZh: 创作一幅电影感（cinematic）超现实主义3D渲染图：一个巨大的悬浮双层芝士汉堡漂浮在深邃的外太空，构图居中偏左。汉堡恰好呈现5层可见食物结构：顶部是光滑圆润的面包胚，表面布满微小的芝麻状气孔；其上是一片融化的切达奶酪，边缘微微下垂；接着是一块厚实深色的牛肉饼；再覆盖一层融化的切达奶酪；最底部是另一块圆润的面包胚。奶酪需呈现光泽感的橙黄色，并带有柔和褶皱；牛肉饼则需表现粗粝、富有纹理的质感。背景为深蓝色与紫罗兰色交织的星域，缀满无数微小星辰；汉堡正下方靠近画面底边中央处，有一颗小巧明亮的金色恒星；右上方背景中，一道发光的螺旋星系/星云呈对角线方向延展。布光须富戏剧性且真实：来自左前方的暖色调高光点亮面包胚与奶酪表面，同时来自太空背景的冷蓝色轮廓光（rim light）勾勒出汉堡边缘。画面采用宽银幕16:9比例，构图极简而具标志性，不包含文字、人物、餐盘、包装、水印；景深浅（shallow cinematic depth），细节丰富，采用照片级写实（photorealistic）CGI技术。

She has large brown eyes, pale skin, a small neutral expression, and wears a white T-shirt under a black pinafore dress with a tiny heart hairpin near her right ear. Count the visible celebration items clearly: 1 birthday cake with 1 lit candle and 6 large strawberries on top, 1 model ferry, 2 wrapped gift boxes, 1 teddy bear with floppy ears and a red bow, 1 vase of flowers, and 1 red balloon floating on the right. The room background should have muted purple walls, soft pasted rectangles like posters or photos, a warm window shape on the left, and faint heart decorations. Use a dreamy painterly Japanese illustration style with gentle brush texture, warm candle glow, low-contrast pastel colors, soft shadows, and an intimate melancholic birthday mood. Make the image vertical 2:3, centered composition, no extra text except the ferry label HeartLand Ferry, no watermark, no photorealism.
2117903200341231553.promptZh: 创作一幅柔和的动漫风格（anime-style）生日插画：一位安静的年轻女孩，留着长长的黑发，坐在一间光线昏暗、氛围温馨的房间里的木质桌旁，一手托腮，若有所思地凝视着面前一块圆形草莓奶油蛋糕，蛋糕上插着一支点燃的蜡烛。她有一双大大的棕色眼睛，肤色苍白，表情淡然、略带中性，身穿一件白色T恤，外搭一条黑色背带裙，右耳附近别着一枚小巧的心形发卡。前景中放置一艘可爱的玩具模型渡轮，标有 “HeartLand Ferry,”，船体为白色，甲板为绿色，下部有一道橙红色条纹，烟囱为橙色与深蓝色相间，摆放在蛋糕前方。清晰统计画面中可见的庆祝物品：1块生日蛋糕（含1支点燃的蜡烛和顶部6颗硕大的草莓）、1艘模型渡轮、2个包好的礼品盒、1只耳朵松软、系着红色蝴蝶结的泰迪熊、1只插花花瓶、1只漂浮在画面右侧的红色气球。房间背景为低饱和度的紫色墙壁，墙面贴有柔和的矩形图案，形似海报或照片；左侧有一扇散发暖光的窗形轮廓，墙面上还隐约点缀着心形装饰。整体采用梦幻感十足的日本手绘风格（painterly Japanese illustration style），笔触轻柔富有绘画质感，烛光温暖柔和，色彩为低对比度的粉彩色调（pastel colors），阴影柔和，营造出私密而略带忧郁的生日氛围。图像比例为竖构图2:3，采用居中构图，除渡轮标签“HeartLand Ferry”外不添加任何额外文字，不加水印，不追求写实主义（photorealism）。
2117903200341231553.author: Matsubon

2117903200341231554.promptEn: Create a vivid summer coastal scene in polished anime-realistic illustration style, vertical 2:3 composition. In the foreground at the lower left, place a round white café table holding exactly 1 tall clear glass of sparkling lemon soda with ice, visible bubbles, condensation, and exactly 1 lemon wedge inside; sunlight casts crisp palm-leaf shadows across the table. On the right side, show a glossy bright red vintage convertible sports car parked beside a white seaside building, with the driver-side door open, black dashboard, tan leather seats, steering wheel visible, chrome wheels, and strong reflections of palm fronds on the car body. The building has white stucco walls, a deep roof eave, turquoise-blue window frames, large reflective glass panes, and sharp tropical shadows. Overhead, include palm leaves entering from the top edge, casting long shadows on the wall and car. The background opens to a quiet oceanfront road running into the distance along a bright blue sea, with white railings, cobblestone pavement, low waves, a distant shoreline, and a dramatic deep blue sky filled with towering white cumulus clouds. Use intense midday sunlight, high contrast, saturated cyan ocean and sky, clean resort atmosphere, crisp linework, detailed reflections, and no people, no logos, no readable text, no watermark. Emphasize the feeling of drinking an ice-cold lemon soda after a hot day at a seaside café.
2117903200341231554.promptZh:
以精致的动漫写实风格（anime-realistic illustration）绘制一幅生动的夏日海滨场景，竖构图，比例为2:3。  
前景左下角放置一张圆形白色咖啡馆桌子，桌上摆放一杯高脚透明玻璃杯，内盛气泡柠檬苏打水，杯中可见气泡、水珠凝结（condensation）效果，并恰好含有一片柠檬切片；阳光投下清晰锐利的棕榈叶阴影（palm-leaf shadows），横跨桌面。  
右侧展示一辆亮面鲜红色复古敞篷跑车，停靠在一座白色海滨建筑旁，驾驶员侧车门敞开，可见黑色仪表盘、米褐色皮革座椅、方向盘，以及镀铬轮毂；车身表面强烈反射出棕榈叶枝条（palm fronds）的倒影。  
该建筑采用白色灰泥墙（stucco walls）、深挑檐（deep roof eave）、青绿色窗框（turquoise-blue window frames）、大面积高反射玻璃窗（reflective glass panes），以及鲜明锐利的热带阴影（tropical shadows）。  
画面顶部边缘延伸入几片棕榈叶，其长影投射于墙面与车身之上。  
背景展现一条宁静的滨海道路，沿明澈湛蓝的海水向远方延展，道路配有白色栏杆、鹅卵石铺装路面（cobblestone pavement）、低矮波浪、远处海岸线，以及一片戏剧性的深蓝色天空，天空中布满高耸蓬松的白色积云（cumulus clouds）。  
采用强烈的正午阳光（intense midday sunlight）、高对比度（high contrast）、饱和度高的青蓝色（saturated cyan）海洋与天空、洁净的度假氛围（clean resort atmosphere）、清晰锐利的线条（crisp linework）、精细刻画的反射（detailed reflections），画面中不得出现人物、商标、可读文字或水印。  
着重传达“在炎热夏日的海滨咖啡馆畅饮冰镇柠檬苏打水”时那种沁凉舒爽的感受。

2117903200341231555.promptEn:
Goal: Create a tall editorial sports poster concept for NEBULA RELAY, blending monochrome athletic photography with oversized cutout typography.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 9:16 aspect ratio, clean white border, high-fashion performance-advertising composition.

Main subject: A single Black male sprinter in side profile, captured mid-run and leaning forward with explosive motion. He has short textured black hair, a focused expression, defined muscular arms and legs, and wears a white sleeveless running singlet, white compression shorts, and white running shoes. In his rear hand he holds a bright cyan-blue relay baton, the only strong color accent in the image.

Background: Moody grayscale outdoor setting with a reflective water surface at the bottom, distant dark mountains on the horizon, and soft cloudy sky haze. Keep the scene cinematic, minimal, and atmospheric.

Layout and typography: Fill almost the entire poster with enormous ultra-bold condensed uppercase sans-serif letters spelling NEBULA RELAY. Arrange the words in two stacked lines: “NEBULA” on the upper half and “RELAY” on the lower half. The letters act like large vertical stencil windows and overlays, with the runner visible through and between the letterforms. Use white negative space between strokes and a dark-gray photographic fill inside the typography, creating a sliced editorial mask effect. Ensure the runner crosses both lines of text, with his torso near the center-right, baton near the lower-left of the upper word, and extended leg stepping through the lower word.

Brand marks and small text: Include exactly 3 small text/graphic elements: 1) a tiny abstract black logo at the top-right with the words NEBULA RELAY beneath it, 2) a narrow vertical tagline along the right edge reading PRIVATE MOTION / SIGNAL IN TRANSIT, and 3) a tiny vertical date marker near the bottom-left edge reading 2026 with a short horizontal line beside it.

Visual style: Premium Nike-like sports campaign poster, modern Swiss grid influence, sharp high-contrast black-and-white photography, dramatic rim lighting, clean whitespace, precise kerning, bold condensed typography, subtle film grain, no clutter.

Constraints: Use exactly one athlete, one baton, one top-right logo mark, one vertical right-edge tagline, and one bottom-left date marker. Do not add extra athletes, extra logos, extra colors, or additional promotional copy.
2117903200341231555.author: Bankai Sauce

2117903200341231556.promptEn:
Subject:
fingertips reaching for the sea

Main Subject:
A single adult woman with a mature model-like physique stands slightly to the right of the center on a seaside terrace on a hill overlooking the summer sea. The figure occupies about 60% of the screen in full-body view, supporting herself on one leg while lightly kicking the other back and stretching both arms diagonally towards the top right.

Character/Expression:
An adult woman with a natural and sophisticated atmosphere. Long dark brown hair in loose waves flows backward in the sea breeze. Thin bangs with fine strands around the face. Face tilted slightly toward the top right, gaze fixed on the tips of her reaching fingers. Mouth slightly open with a calm, expansive expression. Bright ivory-beige skin with natural color and texture. Makeup includes rose-beige blush, delicate lashes, soft brown eyebrows, and translucent pink-beige lips.

Clothing/Pose:
Light white summer set. The top is a thin-strapped V-neck crop top with subtle gathers and lace transitions at the bust and hem. The back is tied with a thin ribbon. The bottom is a high-waisted short tiered mini-skirt made of thin cotton. It spreads naturally to the left in the wind, with soft ruffles at the hem. Standing on her right leg, lifting the left leg behind with a bent knee. Arms extend smoothly forward from the shoulders, wrists slightly flexed, and fingertips relaxed and open. Footwear consists of delicate ivory strap sandals.

Background/Lighting:
A vibrant turquoise blue sea and a large arching coastline stretch below, with green hills, white buildings, and small seaside townscapes in the distance. The ground is a safe stone-paved observation terrace. A low white wall and wooden railing create a boundary with the sea, with a few tropical plants at the edge of the foreground. Clear weather around noon in summer. Strong natural light from the top left illuminates the front of the face, shoulders, arms, and legs. Shadows fall to the bottom right, with faint reflections from white walls and floor. Sparkling light on the sea surface.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Full-body portrait with the person slightly right of center, leaving wide blue sky above. Sufficient margin at the bottom, with the raised leg creating horizontal movement to the left. Camera position is slightly below waist height at a slight low angle. Natural compression of a medium telephoto lens, keeping the person sharp and softly blurring the distant coastline. Focus on eyes and face, shallow depth of field but coastal shape remains recognizable.

Texture/Style:
Bright, translucent, realistic summer fashion photography. Carefully expresses the thinness of white fabric, fine wrinkles, hem movement in the wind, individual hair strands, and natural skin texture. Blue sky, sea, and white clothing provide color contrast; fresh saturation without being overly flashy. Clean and airy, like a resort feature in a magazine.

Negative:
Looking like a minor, unnatural physique, exaggerated chest, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, mismatched leg lengths, shadows inconsistent with light source, gibberish text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin.

2117903200341231557.promptEn: Create an ultra-detailed cinematic fantasy environment: a vast celestial library inside a gothic cathedral-like observatory, with towering dark wood bookshelves rising into immense vaulted arches and ornate bronze-gold filigree. The scene is a wide panoramic interior, viewed from floor level, with a polished black marble floor reflecting warm candlelight and flowing bands of blue starlight like a river of galaxies across the ground. Include exactly three prominent spiral staircases: one grand sweeping staircase on the right with glowing step lights, one central spiral staircase wrapping around a tall cylindrical book tower, and one smaller staircase on the left side. Add enormous arched windows opening directly onto outer space, showing nebula clouds, stars, planets, and a bright spiral galaxy outside the upper left window. Include exactly two glowing blue celestial orbs on pedestals or tables, and exactly two open illuminated books on the right foreground reading desk. The architecture should feel impossibly tall and layered, with balconies, bridges, circular platforms, carved railings, stained-glass domes, gold dust motes, soft volumetric sunbeams, and magical atmosphere. Use a rich palette of deep mahogany, antique gold, midnight blue, and luminous cosmic cyan. Style: epic high-fantasy concept art, hyperrealistic, intricate, atmospheric, sharp details, dramatic wide-angle composition, no people, no readable text, no watermark.
2117903200341231557.promptZh: 创作一幅超精细的电影感奇幻场景：一座哥特式教堂风格天文台内部的浩瀚天界图书馆，高耸的深色木制书架直插宏伟的拱顶穹顶，饰以繁复的青铜金色镂空雕花。画面为广角（wide-angle）全景式室内视角，从地面高度取景，光洁的黑色大理石地面映照出温暖的烛光，以及如银河之河般流淌于地面上的蓝色星光带。画面中需包含三座显著的螺旋楼梯：右侧一座宏伟的弧形大楼梯，台阶自带发光效果；中央一座螺旋楼梯环绕着一座高大的圆柱形书塔；左侧一座较小的螺旋楼梯。加入巨大的拱形窗户，直接通向外部宇宙，左上侧窗户之外可见星云、群星、行星以及一个明亮的螺旋星系。画面中需包含两颗发光的蓝色天界球体，分别置于基座或桌面上；右前景阅读桌上需有两本摊开且被照亮的书籍。建筑应呈现出不可思议的高度与层次感，包含阳台、廊桥、环形平台、雕刻栏杆、彩绘玻璃穹顶、漂浮的金粉微粒、柔和的体积光阳光束，以及充满魔力的氛围。色彩运用浓郁而丰富：深红木色、古金色、午夜蓝与辉光宇宙青。风格：史诗级高奇幻概念艺术（epic high-fantasy concept art）、超写实（hyperrealistic）、细节繁复（intricate）、氛围感强（atmospheric）、锐利细节（sharp details）、戏剧性广角构图（dramatic wide-angle composition），画面中无人物、无可读文字、无水印。
2117903200341231557.author: Zephyra Leigh

2117903200341231558.promptEn: Create a square 1:1 black-and-white 1930s rubber-hose cartoon scene with faded sepia toning and aged film texture. Center a cheerful anthropomorphic tuxedo cat named Milo performing on a small wooden theater stage at night, drawn with thick hand-inked outlines, rounded limbs, white gloves, oversized oval eyes, a big open smile, pointed ears, whiskers, and a white belly and paws. The cat is in an exaggerated squash-and-stretch dance pose: one leg crossed forward, tail lifted behind, left arm raised high holding a straw boater hat with a dark band, right arm stretched outward in a welcoming gesture. The setting is an old vaudeville street-stage corner: wooden floorboards curve across the foreground, four glowing footlights line the front edge, heavy theater curtains and a decorative proscenium column frame the right side, and a framed poster leaning on the right reads “MILO IN ONE NIGHT ONLY!” in large vintage serif lettering. In the background on the left, show a cobblestone alley with soft-focus old buildings, a tall ornate streetlamp, a small fire hydrant, and a hanging sign that reads “PUDDLE ALLEY” with a small paw print. Use a monochrome palette of charcoal black, warm gray, cream highlights, and sepia stains; add organic film grain, dust flecks, subtle scratches, dark rounded-corner vignette, uneven cel-paint shading, and controlled line boil. Keep the composition charming, theatrical, hand-drawn, and authentically vintage; avoid modern CGI, glossy 3D rendering, bright color, clean vector edges, or contemporary typography.
2117903200341231558.promptZh: 创作一幅正方形（1:1）黑白画面，呈现1930年代橡胶软管（rubber-hose）风格卡通场景，带有褪色的棕褐色（sepia）调色与陈旧胶片质感（aged film texture）。画面中央是一位名叫米洛（Milo）的拟人化礼服猫，于夜晚在一座小型木质剧院舞台上表演；角色采用粗犷的手绘墨线（hand-inked outlines）、圆润的四肢、白色手套、硕大的椭圆形眼睛、夸张张开的笑脸、尖耳、胡须，以及白色肚皮和爪子。猫咪摆出极度拉伸压缩（squash-and-stretch）的舞蹈姿态：一条腿向前交叉，尾巴高高翘起于身后，左臂高举，手握一顶草编圆顶礼帽（straw boater hat），帽带为深色；右臂向外伸展，呈欢迎姿态。场景设定为一处老旧的杂耍（vaudeville）街头舞台角落：前景中木质地板呈弧形延伸，舞台前缘排列四盏发光的脚灯（footlights），厚重的剧院帷幕与装饰性镜框式台口立柱（proscenium column）框住右侧；右侧倚靠着一张装裱好的海报，以大型复古衬线体（vintage serif lettering）写着“MILO IN ONE NIGHT ONLY!”。背景左侧展现一条鹅卵石小巷，建筑呈柔焦（soft-focus）效果，包括几栋老式楼宇、一盏高大繁复的街灯、一只小型消防栓，以及一块悬挂招牌，上面以小爪印为点缀，写着“PUDDLE ALLEY”。整体采用单色配色方案：炭黑色（charcoal black）、暖灰色（warm gray）、奶油色高光（cream highlights）与棕褐色污渍（sepia stains）；添加有机胶片颗粒（film grain）、浮尘斑点（dust flecks）、细微划痕（subtle scratches）、深色圆角暗角（dark rounded-corner vignette）、不均匀赛璐珞手绘阴影（uneven cel-paint shading）及受控线条抖动（controlled line boil）。构图须保持迷人、戏剧化、手绘感强且真正复古；避免现代CGI、闪亮的3D渲染（glossy 3D rendering）、明艳色彩、干净矢量边缘（clean vector edges）或当代字体（contemporary typography）。
2117903200341231558.author: Okan Can

2117903200341231559.promptEn:
Goal: Create a refined Japanese product advertisement for a home-furniture-style cat carrier, designed like a calm lifestyle catalog page for cat owners.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 banner, warm off-white background, soft natural daylight, beige and navy color palette, minimal premium Japanese design. Use realistic product photography mixed with clean editorial layout.

Main headline text: Large handwritten-style Japanese calligraphy at top left: よりそう猫キャリー. Under it, smaller Japanese subheadline: いつもの居場所が、そのまま持ち出せる。. Add a small centered decorative diamond divider beneath the subheadline.

Main visual: Center-right hero product shot of a rectangular cat carrier that looks like a small side table or ottoman. The carrier has rounded corners, light wood top board, beige woven fabric body, short tapered wooden legs, side handle, and a large rounded rectangular front opening. Inside the opening, show one fluffy long-haired gray tabby cat sitting calmly on a cushioned bed, looking forward. On top of the carrier place exactly 3 tabletop items: two stacked neutral-colored books, one ceramic cup, and one glass vase with leafy green branches. In the background, include a beige table lamp, a small side table with a cup and saucer, and a pale sofa, all softly blurred.

Left feature column: Place exactly 3 horizontal feature rows on the left, each with a navy circular icon inside a beige rounded square and Japanese explanatory text. Row 1 icon: house; text: 「いつもの場所だから、猫が慣れやすい」. Row 2 icon: medical bag with cross; text: 「通院の日も、慌てずそのまま持ち出せる」. Row 3 icon: sofa; text: 「部屋に置いても、キャリーらしく見えにくい」.

Right feature card: Add a white rounded rectangle card on the right with a thin beige border, divided into exactly 3 stacked feature blocks separated by dotted lines. Each block has a navy circular icon and Japanese text. Block 1 icon: small table with cup; heading 「小物を置ける天板つき」, body 「お気に入りの小物を飾ったり、サイドテーブルとしても。」. Block 2 icon: airflow waves; heading 「通気しやすい側面設計」, body 「両側面に通気孔を設け、快適な空気の流れを確保。」. Block 3 icon: cat inside a house outline; heading 「落ち着きやすい半閉鎖構造」, body 「適度に視線を遮る設計で、猫が安心して過ごせる空間に。」.

Bottom strip: Create exactly 3 numbered lifestyle panels across the lower third, each with a beige number circle and Japanese captions. Panel 1 number 「1」, heading 「ふだん」, subtext 「部屋でくつろぐ」, image of the carrier beside a sofa with the cat inside. Panel 2 number 「2」, heading 「通院」, subtext 「そのまま外出」, image of a person carrying the carrier by its handle near a bright window. Panel 3 number 「3」, heading 「もしもの時」, subtext 「すぐ持ち出せる」, image of the carrier near a doorway with a bag beside it.

Footer: Center a Japanese sentence in elegant serif type: 「毎日使うものだから、猫にとっても、人にとっても、無理なく部屋になじむかたちを目指しました。」 At the bottom center add tiny text 「商品紹介」. At bottom right place a dark navy rectangular button with white Japanese text: 発売準備中, decorated with subtle olive leaf sprigs on both sides.

Visual style: Premium Muji-like Japanese lifestyle advertising, airy spacing, soft shadows, realistic textures, natural linen, light wood, muted beige, deep navy icons, clean typography. Keep all Japanese text legible and accurately placed. No extra logos, no watermark, no additional products, no people except the partial person in panel 2.
2117903200341231559.author: posi_posi

2117903200341231560.promptEn: Create an epic cinematic fantasy environment concept art scene of an ancient elven treetop city built into colossal rainforest trees, with ornate Art Nouveau elven Gothic architecture. Use a wide panoramic 16:9 composition viewed from an elevated wooden balcony and bridge in the foreground, looking across a deep misty forest valley. Show towering tree trunks supporting elegant suspended houses, domed teal-green roofs, stained-glass arched windows, gold filigree trim, carved wooden balconies, lanterns glowing warm amber, and multiple rope-and-wood suspension bridges spanning between trees. Include exactly 7 visible humanoid figures on the foreground walkway: four robed figures gathered on the left, one lone figure standing near the center railing facing the vista, and two smaller figures farther left near the bridge entrance. The scene should feature lush emerald foliage, hanging vines, blue-green magical light glowing from hollow tree openings, scattered purple bioluminescent plants, many distant waterfalls cascading through the forest, soft volumetric fog, and cool morning light filtering through the canopy. Make the mood awe-inspiring, serene, ancient, and magical, with extreme environmental detail, layered depth, atmospheric perspective, realistic textures, cinematic lighting, and ultra-detailed high-fantasy matte painting quality. Customize the setting as an elven forest citadel, the primary roof color as deep turquoise patina, the lighting mood as misty blue dawn with warm lantern glow, and the magical glow color as cyan blue. No text, no logos, no modern objects, no sci-fi machinery.
2117903200341231560.promptZh: 创作一幅史诗级电影感幻想环境概念艺术场景，描绘一座建于巨型雨林巨树之上的远古精灵树冠城市，建筑风格为繁复华丽的新艺术运动（Art Nouveau）融合精灵哥特式（elven Gothic）风格。采用宽幅全景16:9构图，视角位于前景中一座高架木质阳台与桥梁之上，俯瞰一片幽深朦胧的森林山谷。展现高耸入云的树干支撑起优雅悬浮的居所，屋顶呈青绿色圆顶状，拱形彩绘玻璃窗，金丝镂空雕花边饰，手工雕刻木质阳台，灯笼散发温暖琥珀色光芒，以及多座由绳索与木材构成的悬索桥横跨于树冠之间。前景步道上须精确呈现7个可见人形角色：左侧聚集着4位披袍人物，正中央栏杆旁独立伫立1位面向远景的人物，桥入口处更左侧远处另有2位体型较小的人物。场景中需包含茂盛的翠绿色 foliage（植被）、垂挂藤蔓、树洞中透出的蓝绿色魔法辉光、零星散布的紫色生物荧光植物、众多远距离自林间倾泻而下的瀑布、柔和的体积雾（volumetric fog）、以及晨光透过林冠洒落的清凉光线。整体氛围应令人敬畏、宁静、古老且充满魔力，具备极致的环境细节、层次丰富的景深、大气透视（atmospheric perspective）、写实纹理、电影感布光（cinematic lighting）以及超精细高幻想风格（high-fantasy）的哑光绘画（matte painting）品质。将设定定制为精灵森林要塞（elven forest citadel），主屋顶色调设为深青绿色铜锈色（deep turquoise patina），光影氛围设为薄雾笼罩的蓝调黎明（misty blue dawn）并辅以温暖灯笼辉光，魔法辉光颜色设为青蓝色（cyan blue）。画面中不得出现文字、标识、现代物品或科幻机械装置。

2117903200341231561.promptEn: Create a wide cinematic fantasy underwater cityscape of Atlantis, seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint as if looking into an immense submerged valley. The scene shows a grand ancient palace complex with exactly 5 prominent domed structures: one huge central cathedral-like dome, two medium domes flanking it, one smaller dome in the left midground, and one smaller dome on the far right. Include exactly 2 tall spire towers rising behind the architecture, a long arched aqueduct bridge crossing the middle distance, and a stone avenue leading toward the central palace. Add exactly 4 prominent statues: a large sea-king statue on the right holding a trident, a robed statue on a pedestal near the left side of the avenue, a smaller central pedestal statue in the foreground, and a distant guardian statue near the palace entrance. Surround the ruins with coral reefs, seaweed, ancient columns, broken temples, glowing blue bioluminescent plants, and weathered stone covered in algae. Include marine life with exactly 3 large sharks in the upper water, one school of many tiny fish near the upper right, and one foreground school of 7 glowing blue fish in the lower left. Lighting is dramatic turquoise-blue underwater sunlight, with strong rays streaming down from the surface, volumetric haze, sparkling particles, caustic highlights, deep shadows, and a magical ancient-civilization mood. Use an ultra-detailed digital matte painting style, epic scale, realistic fantasy architecture, ornate domes, Baroque and classical ruins, rich teal/cyan palette with hints of gold and coral, high contrast, sharp foreground detail fading into misty depth. No text, no people, no modern objects, no frame or watermark. Aspect ratio 16:9.
2117903200341231561.promptZh: 创作一幅宽幅电影感（cinematic）奇幻水下城市景观，描绘亚特兰蒂斯，视角略高于水平面，仿佛俯瞰一片巨大的淹没山谷。画面呈现一座宏伟的古代宫殿群，其中恰好包含5座醒目的穹顶结构：一座巨大、教堂式中央穹顶（dome），两侧各一座中型穹顶，左中景一座小型穹顶，最右侧一座小型穹顶。建筑后方矗立恰好2座高耸尖塔（spire tower），一座长拱形引水渠桥（aqueduct bridge）横跨中景，一条石砌大道（stone avenue）通向中央宫殿。添加恰好4座醒目雕像：右侧一座持三叉戟（trident）的大型海王雕像，大道左侧附近基座上一座披袍雕像，前景中央一座小型基座雕像，以及宫殿入口附近一座遥远的守卫者雕像。废墟四周环绕珊瑚礁、海藻、古柱、坍塌神庙、散发幽蓝生物荧光（bioluminescent）的植物，以及覆满青苔的风化石材。加入海洋生物：上层水域恰好3条大型鲨鱼，右上方附近一群数量众多的微小鱼类，左下前景一群7条发光蓝鱼。光线为富戏剧性的青 turquoise-蓝水下日光，强光束自水面倾泻而下，伴有体积雾（volumetric haze）、闪烁微粒（sparkling particles）、焦散高光（caustic highlights）、深重阴影（deep shadows），整体氛围充满魔法感与古老文明气息。采用超精细数字遮罩绘画（digital matte painting）风格，史诗级尺度（epic scale），写实奇幻建筑（realistic fantasy architecture），繁复装饰性穹顶（ornate domes），巴洛克（Baroque）与古典（classical）风格废墟，浓郁青绿/青蓝色（teal/cyan）主色调，点缀金与珊瑚色，高对比度（high contrast），前景细节锐利，随景深渐隐入朦胧雾气（misty depth）。无文字，无人物，无现代物品，无边框或水印。宽高比16:9。

2117903200341231562.promptEn:
Goal: Create a high-end fantasy warrior character sheet for a young Japanese male knight, designed for AI drama or game production.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 composition, dark neutral gray studio background, realistic cinematic lighting, no decorative border. Divide the image into 4 vertical panels: 3 full-body turnaround views on the left and center, and 1 close-up portrait panel on the right.

Layout: Show exactly 4 character views. View 1: full-body front view, standing upright and facing camera, shield on the left arm and sword held downward in the right hand. View 2: full-body left side profile, sword angled downward and round shield visible on the arm. View 3: full-body back view, showing the cape and rear armor silhouette, sword held downward at the right side. View 4: close-up three-quarter bust portrait on the right, intense eye contact, sword raised diagonally across the chest in the foreground. Add a small white label near the bottom of the portrait panel reading exactly: 3 (GPT Image 2).

Subject details: The warrior is a serious young adult man with messy spiky black hair, sharp dark eyes, lightly weathered skin, and a stern focused expression. He wears ornate dark navy-black plate armor with bronze/gold trim, layered shoulder pauldrons, leather straps, metal gauntlets, greaves, black boots, and a tattered dark cloak. The chest armor has a circular sunburst emblem with a red jewel at the center. The round shield is dark blue and bronze with radial metal segments and a central red gem. The sword is an ornate silver fantasy blade with angular cutouts, gold accents, and several small red gem inlays.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic fantasy concept art, premium character turnaround sheet, detailed metal scratches, worn leather, subtle dirt and battle wear, realistic fabric folds, dramatic but controlled studio light, crisp focus, high resolution, cinematic realism similar to a AAA RPG character design.

Constraints: Keep the same character, armor, shield, cloak, and sword consistent across all 4 views. Use exactly 4 views and exactly 1 visible text label. Do not add extra characters, extra weapons, logos, watermarks, UI elements, or background scenery.
2117903200341231562.promptZh:
目标：为一名年轻的日本男性骑士创作一张高端奇幻战士角色设定图，专用于AI戏剧或游戏制作。

画布：宽幅横向16:9构图，深中性灰色影棚背景，电影感布光（cinematic lighting），无装饰边框。将画面划分为4个垂直面板：左侧与中间为3个全身多角度视图，右侧为1个特写（close-up）肖像面板。

布局：精确展示4个角色视角。视角1：全身正面视图，直立站立、正对镜头，左臂持盾，右手持剑垂于身侧。视角2：全身左侧侧面轮廓视图，剑斜向下持握，臂上可见圆形盾牌。视角3：全身背面视图，展现披风与后部盔甲剪影，剑垂于身体右侧。视角4：右侧特写（close-up）三分之二身像，眼神凌厉直视镜头，前景中剑斜向横跨胸前。在肖像面板底部附近添加一个小型白色标签，内容严格为：3 (GPT Image 2)。

角色细节：该战士是一名神情严肃的年轻成年男性，黑发蓬乱尖耸，双眼锐利深暗，肤色略带风霜感，表情坚毅专注。他身穿繁复的深藏青-黑色板甲，配青铜/金色镶边，层叠式肩甲，皮革束带，金属护手，胫甲，黑色战靴，以及一条破旧的深色斗篷。胸甲中央饰有圆形日芒纹章，中心镶嵌一颗红色宝石。圆盾呈深蓝色与青铜色，带有放射状金属分段结构及中央一颗红色宝石。佩剑为一把华丽银色奇幻长剑，具棱角状镂空设计、金色装饰，以及数颗微小的红色宝石镶嵌。

视觉风格：超写实（hyper-realistic）奇幻概念艺术，高端角色多角度设定图（character turnaround sheet），精细呈现金属刮痕、磨损皮革、细微尘土与战斗痕迹、真实布料褶皱，富有戏剧性但受控的影棚光线，焦点清晰，高分辨率，电影级写实感（cinematic realism），风格接近AAA级RPG游戏角色设计。

约束条件：全部4个视角中，角色本体、盔甲、盾牌、斗篷与佩剑须完全一致。仅使用恰好4个视角，且仅在肖像面板中显示恰好1处可见文字标签。不得添加额外角色、额外武器、标志、水印、UI元素或背景场景。

2117903200341231563.promptEn:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the base room photo, create a realistic interior-design makeover mockup for the back wall of the home gym while keeping the existing gym equipment, camera angle, room proportions, floor mats, treadmill, TV position, inversion table, dumbbells, ropes, and exercise ball in place.

Goal: Replace the unfinished spotted wall area with a polished modern gym feature wall.

Wall transformation: Add exactly 2 main wall sections: 1) a warm vertical wood-slat accent panel on the left behind the TV and treadmill desk, and 2) a large floor-to-ceiling rectangular mirror on the right with a warm wood frame. Add soft warm LED strip lighting around the feature wall edges and behind/along the wood slats for an upscale cozy gym look.

New elements to add: Mount a slim black soundbar directly below the TV. In the mirror reflection, show a clean adjacent room/hallway with exactly 5 visible reflected decor/equipment elements: a potted indoor tree, a framed wall picture, a wooden door, a dumbbell rack, and a kettlebell. Make the reflection plausible for the room geometry.

Style: Photorealistic renovation preview, warm ambient lighting, modern Scandinavian/home-gym aesthetic, natural wood tones, clean beige walls, realistic shadows and reflections.

Customizable details: Use warm oak for the slat wall and mirror frame, warm white LED, large floor-to-ceiling rectangular mirror, and modern cozy home gym.

Constraints: Do not remove or redesign the existing exercise machines and accessories. Keep the same perspective and overall layout. Do not add people, logos, posters with readable text, or unrealistic architectural changes.
2117903200341231563.promptZh:
以 REFERENCE_0 作为基础房间照片，为家庭健身房后墙制作一张照片级写实（photorealistic）的室内设计翻新效果图，同时保留现有健身器材、相机角度、房间比例、地垫、跑步机、电视位置、倒立机、哑铃、跳绳和健身球。

目标：将未完工的斑驳墙面区域替换为精致现代的健身房特色墙。

墙面改造：添加恰好两个主要墙面区域：1）位于电视与跑步机桌后方左侧的暖色调垂直木格栅饰面板；2）位于右侧的大型落地矩形镜，配暖色调木质边框。在特色墙边缘以及木格栅后方/沿木格栅加装柔和暖白 LED 灯带，营造高端温馨的家庭健身房氛围（upscale cozy gym look）。

新增元素：在电视正下方安装一条纤薄黑色条形音箱。在镜面反射中呈现一间整洁相邻的房间/走廊，其中须清晰可见恰好 5 个被反射的装饰/器材元素：一株盆栽室内树、一幅有画框的墙面挂画、一扇木门、一个哑铃架、一只壶铃。确保该反射效果符合房间几何结构，具备合理性。

风格：照片级写实（photorealistic）翻新预览、温暖环境光（warm ambient lighting）、现代斯堪的纳维亚风/家庭健身房美学（modern Scandinavian/home-gym aesthetic）、天然木色（natural wood tones）、干净米色墙面（clean beige walls）、真实阴影（realistic shadows）与真实反射（realistic reflections）。

可定制细节：木格栅墙与镜框采用暖橡木（warm oak），LED 灯为暖白光（warm white LED），镜面为大型落地矩形镜（large floor-to-ceiling rectangular mirror），整体呈现现代温馨家庭健身房（modern cozy home gym）风格。

约束条件：不得移除或重新设计现有健身器械及配件；保持相同透视角度（perspective）与整体布局（overall layout）；不得添加人物、商标、海报（含可读文字的海报）或不切实际的建筑改动。

2117903200341231564.promptEn: Create an ultra-realistic luxury editorial portrait in a vertical 4:5 frame of a young Black man facing the camera from the chest up. He has a calm, confident, neutral expression, direct eye contact, smooth dark brown skin, short neatly trimmed black hair, and refined studio portrait retouching that still preserves natural skin texture. Dress him in exactly 4 visible wardrobe elements: a voluminous gray fur coat with a wide plush collar draped over the shoulders, a crisp white dress shirt, a black paisley silk tie, and a black wristwatch with a round dark dial on the wrist of the hand gripping the coat lapel. Pose: one hand lightly clutches the fur collar near the chest while the other arm remains lower and mostly out of frame, creating a poised high-fashion stance. Use dramatic luxury studio lighting with soft frontal key light, subtle rim highlights along the fur, gentle shadows on the face, and crisp detail in the coat fibers. Background: dark charcoal-gray mottled studio backdrop with a smoky painted texture and no props. Style: photorealistic high-fashion magazine cover aesthetic, premium editorial portrait, sharp eyes, realistic fabric and fur texture, shallow depth of field, rich contrast, elegant color grading, no text, no watermark, no extra accessories, no distorted hands.
2117903200341231564.promptZh:
以竖构图 4:5 比例创作一幅超写实（ultra-realistic）奢华时尚杂志风格人像，画面主体为一位黑人青年男性，胸部以上正对镜头。他神情平静、自信且中性，目光直视镜头，肤色为光滑的深棕色，头发为短而整齐修剪的黑色发型；采用精致的影棚布光（studio lighting）人像修图，同时保留自然的皮肤质感。  
服装需精确呈现 4 个可见服饰元素：一件蓬松的灰色毛皮大衣，配有宽厚柔软的毛领，自然垂落于肩部；一件挺括的白色正装衬衫；一条黑色佩斯利花纹真丝领带；以及一只戴在手上的黑色腕表，表盘为圆形深色，该手正轻握大衣翻领。  
姿态要求：一只手轻轻抓住胸前附近的毛皮领口，另一只手臂位置较低且大部分位于画框外，营造出从容优雅的高端时尚站姿。  
用光要求：采用戏剧化奢华影棚布光（luxury studio lighting），主光源为柔和的正面关键光（soft frontal key light），毛皮边缘带有微妙的轮廓高光（subtle rim highlights），面部投下轻柔阴影，大衣纤维细节清晰锐利。  
背景：深炭灰色斑驳影棚背景布，表面带有烟雾状手绘肌理，无任何道具。  
风格要求：照片级写实（photorealistic）高端时尚杂志封面美学，顶级时尚杂志风格人像（premium editorial portrait），双眼锐利清晰，织物与毛皮质感真实可触，浅景深（shallow depth of field），高对比度，优雅的色彩分级（elegant color grading），画面中无文字、无水印、无额外配饰、无手部畸变。

2117903200341231565.promptEn: Create a full-body kawaii anime VTuber-style illustration of a cheerful cat-eared girl mascot, centered on a clean white background with pastel magical effects. The character is a petite teenage-looking anime girl with silvery lavender-blue wavy shoulder-length hair, soft bangs, bright cyan-blue eyes, rosy cheeks, and an open happy smile. She has large cat ears with pink inner ears and dark outer tips, decorated with ornate gold-and-white floral hair accessories, small chains, beads, and a pink ribbon bow. Pose her dynamically as if floating or skipping forward: one hand raised close to the viewer in a friendly wave with five fingers visible, the other arm extended outward, one leg straight down and the other bent back playfully. Outfit: pastel blue oversized cropped jacket with puffy sleeves and white drawstring bows, pale blue shirt, white asymmetrical overall-style skirt/shorts dress with visible straps, buttons, seams, a white belt with crossing straps and small gold bow charm, layered light-blue ruffled shorts underneath, one white knee sock, one oversized blue leg warmer with bow details, and light blue-and-white sneakers. Add a tied ribbon accessory and small dangling charm at the hip. The color palette should be soft baby blue, white, pale pink, and gold accents, with delicate cel-shaded anime rendering, clean line art, glossy eyes, soft gradients, and high-detail clothing folds. Surround her with a circular aura of pastel pink and blue sparkles, glowing starbursts, bokeh dots, and floating heart-shaped petals; include exactly 3 large pink heart petals, 5 medium blue heart petals, and many tiny pink petals and miniature flower shapes scattered around the frame. Make the composition vertical, full body visible from head to shoes, airy and bright, with no text, no watermark, no extra characters, and a polished Japanese mobile-game character key visual look.
2117903200341231565.promptZh: 创作一幅全身kawaii动漫风格VTuber形象插画，主角是一位开朗的猫耳少女吉祥物，居中置于纯白背景上，并配有柔和的粉彩色魔法特效。角色是一位娇小的、看似青少年的动漫少女，拥有银紫色蓝调波浪齐肩发、柔顺的刘海、明亮的青蓝色眼睛、红润的脸颊，以及一张张开的开心笑容。她长着一对大猫耳，耳内为粉色，耳尖外侧为深色，猫耳上装饰有繁复的金白色花卉发饰、细链条、珠子以及一只粉色丝带蝴蝶结。姿态需富有动感，仿佛正在漂浮或向前跳跃：一只手高举至靠近观者的位置，以五指清晰可见的姿态友好挥手；另一只手臂向外伸展；一条腿笔直向下，另一条腿则俏皮地向后弯曲。服装包括：一件粉彩色蓝调超大号短款夹克，袖子蓬松，配有白色抽绳蝴蝶结；一件浅蓝色上衣；一条白色不对称背带式裙裤连衣裙，可见背带、纽扣与缝线；一条白色腰带，带有交叉背带及一枚小巧的金色蝴蝶结挂饰；裙裤下叠穿一层浅蓝色荷叶边短裤；一只白色及膝袜；一只超大号蓝色腿部护套，饰有蝴蝶结细节；以及一双浅蓝与白色相间的运动鞋。在臀部添加一枚系带式丝带配饰及一枚小巧悬挂式挂饰。整体配色应为柔和的婴儿蓝、白色、淡粉色与金色点缀，采用精细的赛璐珞着色（cel-shaded）动漫渲染风格、干净利落的线稿、光泽感眼睛、柔和渐变效果以及高细节度的服装褶皱表现。围绕角色布置一个圆形光晕，内含粉蓝双色柔光亮片、发光星芒、焦外虚化（bokeh）光点，以及漂浮的心形花瓣；画面中须精确包含3枚大型粉色心形花瓣、5枚中型蓝色心形花瓣，以及大量微小粉色花瓣与迷你花朵形状，散落在整个画框周围。构图采用竖版，完整展现从头部至鞋尖的全身形象，整体氛围轻盈明亮，不添加任何文字、水印或额外角色，呈现精致考究的日系手机游戏角色主视觉（key visual）风格。
