2117903200341231566.promptEn: Create a cute pastel storybook illustration of a chubby golden-brown hamster sitting under a tipped-over wooden crate like a tiny trap on a light wooden floor. The hamster should have fluffy orange and cream fur, oversized glossy teary brown eyes, pink cheeks, tiny paws held nervously to its chest, little pink feet, a small open worried mouth, and an embarrassed expression. The wooden crate is propped up on the left by one rough stick tied with one rope knot and a cord leading down to a bait pile; the crate roof has hand-drawn writing that says FREE SUNFLOWER SEEDS!, a downward arrow, and a small sunflower doodle. In front of the hamster place exactly 34 visible sunflower seeds: 26 clustered in the main bait pile and 8 scattered around the floor, with a few tiny crumbs. Add exactly 2 blue sweat drops near the hamster and one thought bubble in the upper left containing ... I can't believe I fell for that.... Background: warm cream wall, soft depth of field, one blurred potted plant on the left, and one small framed hamster picture with a heart on the right. Visual style: adorable Japanese kawaii children’s-book watercolor mixed with clean digital line art, warm beige and honey tones, soft shading, rounded forms, gentle humor, no harsh outlines, square composition.
2117903200341231566.promptZh: 创作一幅可爱的粉彩童话书插画：一只圆滚滚的金棕色仓鼠坐在一个翻倒的木箱下，木箱像一个微缩陷阱，地板是浅色木质。仓鼠应有蓬松的橘色与米白色毛发、 oversized（超大）且泛着光泽的含泪棕眼、粉嫩脸颊、紧张地抱在胸前的细小爪子、粉红色的小脚丫、微微张开的担忧小嘴，以及羞窘的表情。木箱左侧由一根粗糙木棍支撑，木棍上系着一个绳结，一根绳索向下延伸至诱饵堆；箱顶手绘文字“FREE SUNFLOWER SEEDS!”（免费葵花籽！）、一个向下的箭头，以及一朵小型向日葵涂鸦。在仓鼠正前方放置恰好34颗清晰可见的葵花籽：其中26颗聚集成主诱饵堆，8颗散落在地板各处，并附带几粒细小碎屑。在仓鼠附近添加恰好2颗蓝色汗滴，左上方添加一个对话框，内含文字…… I can't believe I fell for that.……  \n背景：暖米色墙面、柔和景深（depth of field）、左侧一株虚化的盆栽植物、右侧一幅镶框的小型仓鼠画像，画框上带一颗爱心。视觉风格：可爱日本卡哇伊（kawaii）儿童读物水彩风格，融合干净的数字线稿，暖米褐色与蜂蜜色调，柔和阴影，圆润造型，温和幽默感，无生硬轮廓线，正方形构图。

2117903200341231567.promptEn:
Goal: Create a side-by-side comparison image showing an ancient illuminated manuscript page before and after restoration, inspired by the Book of Kells, with the restored version looking far cleaner, brighter, and more ornate than the damaged original.

Canvas: Wide horizontal black background, approximately 16:9. Place two large vertical manuscript panels side by side with generous margins: the left panel is the damaged original, the right panel is the restored reconstruction. Add a small centered label under each panel: left label “Original”, right label “Restored”.

Layout: Use exactly 2 main panels. The left panel occupies the left half and sits inside a white photo-like border. The right panel occupies the right half and is larger-looking, crisp, and framed by a pale parchment page edge. Both panels show the same general manuscript-page composition: a tall decorative border, a left text column, and a right illustration column.

Left panel, damaged original: Show a faded, weathered manuscript page photographed on a grayish archival background. The parchment is brown, stained, frayed, and translucent in places, with torn edges, missing corners, water damage, darkened seams, and uneven discoloration. The design is barely legible: a vertical text block on the left with dark medieval calligraphy, faded red and gold initials, and a right column with two ghostly miniature illustrations that are almost erased. The ornamental border should be visible but worn, dirty, and incomplete. Include one small dark circular blemish or hole near the center-right of the original page. Keep the whole left image muted, low contrast, and degraded.

Right panel, restored version: Show a vividly restored illuminated manuscript page on warm cream parchment. The page has a highly polished medieval Celtic style with abundant gold leaf, red, green, black, and orange ornament. Use an ornate architectural frame with interlacing knotwork, geometric panels, round medallions, and a domed arch at the top. The restoration should look idealized and too pristine, with sharp lines and saturated colors.

Restored page element count: Include exactly 1 large outer decorated manuscript frame; exactly 1 domed arch at the top filled with Celtic spiral ornament; exactly 4 protruding side ornaments on the frame, one at each side midpoint and corner-like extension; exactly 1 left vertical text column containing 10 lines of pseudo-Latin uncial calligraphy with decorated initials; exactly 2 rectangular narrative miniature illustrations stacked vertically in the right column; exactly 3 circular medallion ornaments overlapping the central divider and side frame; exactly 4 small square gold decorative blocks, placed near the top, center, lower center, and bottom of the frame.

Text and lettering: The manuscript text should resemble medieval Insular script and pseudo-Latin, not modern readable typography. Use decorative initials in green, red, gold, and black. Suggested visible pseudo-text can include “Scooc”, “infiricipio”, “Sicloi”, “thoratio”, “chomias”, “abysus”, “Zorozobat”, “ipsemagenu”, “bubliuns”, “Qauncor”, “habacautum”, “Zacchäus”, and “uenufurcanos”, but it may remain partly nonsensical as long as the style matches.

Visual style: Museum-comparison presentation, archival documentary on the left and idealized digital restoration on the right. High contrast between decay and restoration. The restored page should include obvious metallic gold leaf highlights, clean parchment, Celtic knots, evangelist-manuscript styling, and intricate medieval ornament.

Constraints: Do not add extra panels, people, UI controls, watermarks, or explanatory captions beyond the two small labels. Keep the comparison balanced and centered on a plain black background.
2117903200341231567.author: Samuel Ferrero.

2117903200341231568.promptEn: Create a whimsical ultra-detailed architectural diorama of a Greek island dog sanctuary inspired by Santorini, on a clean white studio background with soft natural lighting and realistic miniature-model proportions. The scene is a compact hillside cluster of smooth whitewashed cave houses, rounded arches, curved staircases, terraces, balconies, and small chapel-like towers with vivid cobalt-blue doors, shutters, railings, trim, and domed roofs topped with tiny crosses. Include exactly 6 golden retrievers: 1 large happy golden retriever sitting in the main arched doorway with open blue double doors, 1 puppy sitting at the base of a large olive tree on the left, 1 golden retriever perched on a thick olive tree branch, 1 small retriever peeking over a central upper balcony, 1 retriever looking out from a rounded upper-right tower window, and 1 retriever sitting on the right-side staircase landing. Add a large ancient olive tree growing from the left side of the architecture, lavender bushes, potted plants, small shrubs, stone steps, lantern wall lights, a tiny fountain on the lower left, a small pet memorial plaque with a paw print, and dog-themed decorative details such as a bone sign and bowls near the lower right. The architecture should feel like a luxurious Mediterranean pet village with clean stucco texture, soft shadows, rounded organic forms, layered depth, and photorealistic yet storybook charm. Use Santorini-inspired whitewashed Greek island village, golden retrievers, cobalt blue, luxurious Mediterranean pet sanctuary, and clean white studio background. No people, no visible text, no watermark, keep all dogs anatomically realistic and friendly.
2117903200341231568.author: Zephyra Leigh

2117903200341231569.promptEn: Create a highly detailed photorealistic fantasy architectural scene on a clean white background: an ornate French Gothic château transformed into a luxurious cat mansion. The mansion is symmetrical and cream-colored limestone, with dark blue slate mansard roofs, many steep spires, dormer windows, carved balconies, arched openings, balustrades, sculptural trim, and ivy climbing parts of the facade. In front, a grand central staircase curves down to formal gardens with clipped hedges, urn planters, small fountains, stone statues, cypress trees, and decorative low walls. On the left, a massive ancient oak tree grows beside the mansion, its trunk twisting upward and its dense green canopy filling the upper-left side. Include exactly 9 realistic long-haired gray tabby cats: 3 cats in the oak tree, one leaping from a branch, one perched on the trunk, and one climbing with tail raised; 1 cat resting on the low terrace near the tree; 1 large majestic Maine Coon-like cat lying prominently on the central front steps as the focal point; 1 cat visible in an upper left tower window; 1 cat visible in an upper right tower window; 1 cat sitting on the rounded right-side balcony; and 1 cat peeking from the far-right arched window. Use soft daylight, crisp architectural detail, natural shadows, elegant storybook realism, balanced frontal composition, no people, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341231569.promptZh: 在纯白色背景上创作一幅高度精细的照片级写实（photorealistic）奇幻建筑场景：一座华丽的法国哥特式城堡被改造成一座奢华的猫咪宅邸。该宅邸呈对称布局，由米色石灰岩砌筑，配以深蓝色石板材质的孟莎式屋顶（mansard roofs），拥有众多陡峭尖塔、凸窗（dormer windows）、雕花阳台、拱形开口（arched openings）、栏杆（balustrades）、雕塑感装饰线脚（sculptural trim），以及攀爬于部分立面上的常春藤。宅邸前方，一座宏伟的中央楼梯呈弧形向下延伸至规整的花园，园中设有修剪整齐的树篱、瓮形花盆、小型喷泉、石雕、柏树及装饰性矮墙。左侧，一棵巨大的古老橡树紧邻宅邸生长，其树干盘旋向上，浓密青翠的树冠占据画面左上方区域。画面中须精确包含9只写实风格的长毛灰虎斑猫：3只位于橡树上——一只正从枝头跃下，一只静栖于树干，一只正攀爬而上且尾巴高高翘起；1只卧于靠近橡树的矮露台；1只体型硕大、仪态威严、类似缅因猫（Maine Coon）的猫，醒目地躺卧于中央正门前的台阶上，作为视觉焦点；1只可见于左上方塔楼的窗户内；1只可见于右上方塔楼的窗户内；1只坐于右侧圆弧形阳台；1只从最右侧拱形窗户中探出头来。采用柔和日光（soft daylight）、清晰锐利的建筑细节（crisp architectural detail）、自然阴影（natural shadows）、优雅如童话绘本般的写实风格（elegant storybook realism）、均衡的正面构图（balanced frontal composition），画面中不得出现人物、文字或水印。
2117903200341231569.author: Zephyra Leigh

2117903200341231570.promptEn:
Goal: Create an ultra-detailed miniature diorama of a traditional Japanese wooden mansion designed as a luxurious Shiba Inu estate, viewed straight-on in a wide product-photography composition on a clean white background.

Canvas: Wide horizontal image, about 16:9, centered object with the full diorama base visible, no cropped edges. Use crisp studio lighting, photorealistic miniature craftsmanship, high-resolution details, shallow but readable depth, and a clean isolated white backdrop.

Main subject: A multi-level traditional Japanese ryokan-style house made of warm cedar wood, shoji screens, glowing interior windows, carved beams, railings, gray ceramic kawara tile roofs with ornate ridge caps, and several connected balconies and annexes. The house should feel like a handcrafted architectural model, combining realism with whimsical dog-themed charm.

Layout: Place the large mansion across the back and middle of the diorama, with the tallest central roof near the top center. Add smaller attached buildings on the left and right. In the foreground, create a landscaped Japanese garden with a pond, arched wooden bridge, stepping-stone path, stone lantern, red torii gate, bamboo fencing, rounded rocks, trimmed bonsai shrubs, moss, and a small stone basin. Add a blooming cherry blossom tree on the far left with pale pink flowers extending above the roofline.

Dogs: Include exactly 12 Shiba Inu dogs, all tan-and-cream with curled tails and cute alert expressions. Distribute them as follows: 3 Shibas looking out from the large upper-center window/balcony, 1 Shiba standing on the upper-left terrace, 1 Shiba looking out from the upper-right tower balcony, 1 Shiba in a lower-left balcony room, 1 Shiba visible at the central lower balcony/window, 1 Shiba looking out from the lower-right small house window, 3 Shibas walking or standing on the arched wooden bridge in the foreground, and 1 large seated Shiba beside the red torii gate at the front right.

Garden details: The pond should sit in the lower-left and center foreground, with dark reflective water, scattered pink petals, smooth stones, and exactly 6 visible koi fish in orange, white, and black. The bridge crosses the pond from left-center toward the middle. Add carefully arranged miniature rocks, mossy islands, low shrubs, and bamboo fences around the oval display base.

Text content: Place one small vertical wooden sign near the seated Shiba at front right with the Japanese text 柴苑. Keep the text dark and legible, carved or painted on the sign.

Style: Photorealistic premium collectible diorama, extremely detailed Japanese architecture, warm natural wood tones, soft golden window glow, realistic dog fur, delicate cherry blossoms, museum-quality miniature model, clean commercial product shot, no people, no watermark, no extra text.

Customizable details: Make the estate a traditional Japanese Shiba Inu mansion; use Shiba Inu dogs; set the season to spring cherry blossom season; use a pure white studio background.
2117903200341231570.author: Zephyra Leigh

2117903200341231571.promptEn: Create a vertical anime-style watercolor illustration of a cute teenage girl seen from a slightly low, close-up three-quarter angle against a bright blue sky with soft white clouds and a faint diagonal airplane contrail. The girl has long flowing pale blonde hair, large glossy green eyes, rosy cheeks, and a shy, thoughtful expression with one hand raised near her mouth. She wears a red baseball cap with subtle plaid stitching and a small dark bow or ribbon at the back, two small flower hairpins on one side, and a side braid tied with a tiny white bow. Her outfit consists of exactly 5 main visible clothing/accessory pieces: an oversized white zip hoodie slipping off one shoulder, a pale yellow short-sleeve top, a green plaid pleated mini skirt, a red crossbody sling bag with black strap and silver zipper pulls, and the red cap. Make the fabric loose and airy, with wind pushing her hair and hoodie outward to the right. Use delicate thin brown line art, soft pastel colors, translucent watercolor washes, paper grain texture, gentle bloom, and a dreamy light summer atmosphere. Keep the composition cropped dynamically from head to upper thighs, with no text, no extra characters, no photorealism, and no harsh shadows.
2117903200341231571.promptZh:
创作一幅竖构图的动漫风格水彩插画，描绘一位可爱的少女，采用略低角度、特写（close-up）、三分之四视角，背景为明亮的蓝色天空，缀有柔和的白色云朵和一道淡淡的斜向飞机航迹云。  
少女拥有一头长而飘逸的浅金色头发，一双硕大闪亮的翠绿色眼睛，脸颊泛着红晕，神情羞涩而若有所思，一只手轻轻抬至嘴边。  
她戴着一顶红色棒球帽，帽身带有细腻的格纹缝线，帽后缀有一枚小巧的深色蝴蝶结或丝带；一侧发间别着两枚小花发卡；另有一条侧边辫子，末端系着一枚极小的白色蝴蝶结。  
她的穿搭由恰好5件主要可见的服装/配饰组成：一件 oversized 白色拉链连帽衫，滑落于单肩；一件浅黄色短袖上衣；一条绿色格纹百褶迷你裙；一只红色斜挎小包，配有黑色肩带与银色拉链头；以及那顶红色棒球帽。  
布料需呈现宽松轻盈之感，微风将她的头发与连帽衫向右吹拂飘动。  
采用纤细柔和的棕色线稿、柔嫩的粉彩色调、半透明水彩晕染、纸张肌理质感、轻柔的水彩晕开效果（bloom），整体营造出梦幻般的夏日光影氛围。  
构图需动态裁切，范围自头部至大腿上部；画面中不得出现文字、不得出现额外人物、不得呈现照片写实风格（photorealism）、不得出现生硬阴影。
2117903200341231571.author: Neve

2117903200341231572.promptEn: Create a vertical monochrome/sepia anime-style album-cover illustration of a slender young pianist seated with their back mostly to the viewer at a glossy black grand piano in an old European study. The pianist has pale silver-white tousled medium-length hair tied into a small low ponytail, wears a fitted black suit, and is mid-performance with both hands on the keys. A small hamster sits on the ornate music stand of the grand piano, facing the pianist like a tiny attentive audience. The room is richly detailed and realistic: tall leaded-glass windows on the left with sheer bright daylight streaming in, heavy curtains, dusty sunbeams, dark wood floor, wall molding, framed pictures, a coat stand, and a tall bookcase packed with books behind the raised piano lid. Include exactly 1 pianist, 1 grand piano, 1 piano bench, 1 hamster, 2 tall window panels, 1 large bookcase, 1 foreground teacup and saucer, and 1 cluttered writing desk corner with pens and stacked books. Use dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, strong backlight from the windows, reflective black piano surfaces, fine line-art detail blended with painterly realism, muted sepia grayscale tones, melancholic intimate atmosphere, cinematic composition, high detail, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341231572.promptZh: 创作一幅竖构图的单色/棕褐色（sepia）动漫风格专辑封面插画：一位身形纤细的年轻钢琴家背对观者而坐，正在一架光亮的黑色三角钢琴前演奏，场景设定在一间古老的欧洲书房内。钢琴家拥有一头苍白的银白色中长发，略显凌乱，扎成一个低垂的小马尾；身着合身的黑色西装；双手正按在琴键上，处于演奏中途。一只小仓鼠端坐在三角钢琴雕花繁复的谱架上，面朝钢琴家，宛如一位专注聆听的微缩观众。房间细节丰富、写实逼真：左侧为高大的铅条玻璃窗（leaded-glass windows），透入轻盈明亮的日光；配有厚重窗帘、浮尘可见的斜射光束、深色木地板、墙面线脚、装框画作、衣帽架，以及一架高大的书柜——书柜紧靠掀开的钢琴顶盖后方，内部塞满书籍。画面须严格包含：1位钢琴家、1架三角钢琴、1张钢琴凳、1只仓鼠、2扇高窗窗格、1座大型书柜、前景1只茶杯及杯碟、1处杂乱的写字台边角（含多支钢笔与堆叠的书籍）。采用戏剧性明暗对比（chiaroscuro）布光，强逆光来自窗户方向，钢琴黑色表面呈现高反射质感；精细线描（line-art）细节与绘画感写实（painterly realism）风格融合；整体色调为低饱和棕褐色灰度（muted sepia grayscale tones）；氛围忧郁而私密；构图具电影感（cinematic composition）；高细节（high detail）；画面中无文字、无水印。

2117903200341231573.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vertical monochrome Japanese manga page about a true-story style hamster father going overboard with a child’s summer homework poster.

Canvas: Tall portrait manga page, about 9:16, sepia ink on warm off-white paper, hand-drawn crosshatching and pencil-like linework, thin black panel borders, nostalgic Showa-era storybook atmosphere.

Layout: Use exactly 6 stacked horizontal comic panels. Interior setting is a cozy wooden room with floorboards, bookshelf, potted plant, curtains and window, art supplies, a large sheet of drawing paper, paint tray, bucket, brushes, and mugs. Keep all dialogue in Japanese speech bubbles and narration boxes.

Characters: Two fluffy hamsters. The child hamster is small, round, cute, black glossy eyes, no glasses, drawing earnestly with a brush. The father hamster is larger and rounder, wearing small round glasses, holding a mug at first, then a brush, becoming increasingly intense and focused. Both are rendered as realistic-cute hamsters rather than humanoid mascots.

Panel details: Panel 1 shows the child hamster facing a blank poster sheet on the floor, art supplies on the left, curtains and bookshelf behind. Add a vertical narration box on the right reading 「ハムスターの夏休みの宿題は『自由研究』の課題ポスターの提出が必要だった」 and a speech bubble from the child reading 「今年も緑化ポスターを描こう」. Panel 2 shows the child hamster drawing trees on the large paper while the father hamster with round glasses stands nearby holding a mug and watching. Panel 3 shows father and child side by side over the poster; father points or comments with a bubble 「ポスターか」 and the child replies 「うん、夏休みの宿題」. Panel 4 shows the father asking to borrow the brush, facing the child across the paper; include a question mark over the child’s head, father bubble 「ちょっと貸して」 and child bubble 「うん？」. Panel 5 is a close-up of the poster becoming extremely detailed: dense forest scenery with many trees and foliage, father’s paw holding a brush at the upper right, child bubble on the left 「おお……！お父さん上手！」. Panel 6 shows the father hamster completely absorbed, sweating and hunched over the poster, drawing an incredibly elaborate forest with dramatic speed lines; the child hamster behind him looks shocked and panicked. Include scattered art supplies, paint tray and bucket. Add a jagged speech bubble from the child reading 「お父さん……!!そしたらハムスターが描いたポスターじゃなくなっちゃう!!!お父さん!!お父さん!!」 and a bottom caption box reading 「ラストの２日で描き直した」.

Visual style: Vintage Japanese newspaper manga, soft sepia monochrome, detailed fur texture, expressive faces, gentle comedy pacing, realistic room perspective, no modern digital coloring, no watermark.

Customizable elements: The homework theme is greenery poster; the main characters are father and child hamsters; the father accessory is round glasses; the final poster subject is dense forest scenery; the bottom punchline caption is ラストの２日で描き直した.

2117903200341231574.promptEn: Ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a young woman sitting alone in the corner booth of a vintage diner on a rainy night, leaning against a rain-covered window as blurred city lights glow outside. Wet streets reflect red brake lights, white headlights, and cool blue neon, creating dreamy bokeh through raindrops on the glass. She has long, naturally tousled dark hair, minimal makeup, soft expressive eyes, and wears a deep burgundy knit sweater layered beneath an oversized black wool coat. Quiet, melancholic expression with relaxed posture, one shoulder resting against the window, subtle wind-blown strands framing her face. Warm tungsten diner lighting softly illuminates her skin while cool blue city light spills through the rain-covered window, creating cinematic color contrast. Authentic reflections on the glass, natural skin texture with visible pores, soft film grain, shallow depth of field, moody atmosphere, intimate storytelling, Kodak Portra 800 color palette, warm amber and teal tones, 50mm lens, f/1.4, slow shutter with realistic light trails outside while the subject remains perfectly sharp, editorial fashion photography, emotional realism, photorealistic, HDR, 8K, no CGI, no illustration, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341231574.promptZh: 雨夜中，一位年轻女子独自坐在复古餐厅角落卡座里的超写实电影感（cinematic）肖像：她倚靠在布满雨水的窗边，窗外城市灯光模糊晕染。湿漉漉的街道映出红色刹车灯、白色车头灯与冷调蓝色霓虹，玻璃上雨滴形成梦幻般的焦外虚化（bokeh）。她拥有一头自然蓬松的深色长发，妆容极简，眼神柔和而富有表现力，身穿深酒红色针织毛衣，外搭 oversized 黑色羊毛大衣。神情安静而忧郁，姿态放松——一侧肩膀轻倚窗面，几缕微风拂起的发丝轻柔勾勒面部轮廓。餐厅内温暖的钨丝灯（tungsten）柔光映亮她的肌肤，而窗外冷调蓝光则透过覆雨玻璃漫入室内，营造出电影感色彩对比（cinematic color contrast）。玻璃表面呈现真实反射，肌肤纹理自然，可见毛孔，叠加柔和胶片颗粒（film grain），浅景深（shallow depth of field），氛围阴郁，叙事私密，采用 Kodak Portra 800 色彩风格，暖琥珀色与青绿色调并存，50mm 镜头，f/1.4 光圈，慢速快门捕捉窗外真实光迹，主体则保持绝对锐利，杂志级时尚摄影（editorial fashion photography），情感写实（emotional realism），照片级写实（photorealistic），HDR，8K，无 CGI，无插画，无文字，无水印。

2117903200341231575.promptZh: 超写实（ultra-realistic）时尚杂志人像摄影，一位年轻女性站在现代都市蓝调时刻（blue hour）的一家大型玻璃橱窗旁。玻璃表面呈现微妙的反射效果与层次分明的双重曝光（double-exposure）效果，远处车流形成柔和的红白光轨、彩色焦外虚化（bokeh）以及电影感动态模糊（cinematic motion blur）。她身穿 oversized 炭黑色西装外套，内搭修身黑色上衣，下着浅水洗高腰牛仔裤，佩戴银色圆环耳饰，发型为松散随性的盘发，额前垂落几缕轻盈的修饰脸型的碎发。神情沉静自信，直视镜头，妆容自然，姿态放松，一手插在裤袋中。玻璃上的反射自然融合，不遮挡面部特征。柔和的机顶闪光灯（on-camera flash）凝固人物主体，而城市背景则因慢速快门（slow shutter）保持虚化。高端时尚杂志摄影（premium editorial fashion photography），《Vogue》广告大片美学（Vogue campaign aesthetic），真实都市氛围（authentic urban atmosphere），自然肌肤质感（natural skin texture），高动态范围（high dynamic range），真实反射（realistic reflections），浅景深（shallow depth of field），细微色差（subtle chromatic aberration），梦幻辉光（dreamy glow），丰富对比度（rich contrast），低饱和冷色调为主、暖色霓虹点缀（muted cool tones with warm neon accents），85mm 镜头，f/1.8，1/10 秒慢速快门，ISO 400，电影感色彩分级（cinematic color grading），超精细（ultra-detailed），照片级写实（photorealistic），8K，无 CGI，无插画，无文字，无水印。

2117903200341231576.promptEn:
Subject:
Profile in blue

Subject:
A single adult woman standing on a sunny beach. The person is placed slightly left of center in a vertical 2:3 fashion portrait, capturing her from the chest to the top of the head. She wears a vivid blue outer garment dropped low from both shoulders, creating a striking contrast between her white V-neck clothing and the blue sea.

Person/Expression:
A natural Japanese woman with a calm, mature atmosphere. A dark brown blunt bob almost black, showing the neck clearly. Bangs and hair ends flow lightly to the right in the sea breeze. Her head is tilted slightly forward, face in a profile looking to the right. Eyes cast slightly downward, with a quiet, composed expression and lips slightly parted. Transparent thin beige skin, coral-colored lips, delicate eyeliner, and natural eyelashes.

Clothing/Pose:
An ivory white V-neck dress with thin shoulder straps. The neckline is deep but elegant, with a soft ribbed thin fabric naturally following the curves of a mature body. A vivid cobalt blue light jacket is lowered to above the elbows, revealing the shoulders and collarbones. Shoulders are relaxed, with the upper body slightly twisted to the left. Delicate drop earrings with small transparent stones dangling from thin gold chains at the ears. A delicate necklace with a small single stone at the neck.

Background/Light:
The background consists of a deep blue sea extending to the horizon and a clear sky. A small blurred silhouette of an island in the far left, and a white seaside railing at the bottom. Strong natural light from around noon shines from the upper left, creating bright highlights on the hair surface, left shoulder, collarbone, and cheeks. Soft blue reflected light on the right side of the face, with natural faint shadows under the nose and chin. Fine reflections of light sparkle on the sea surface, clearly separating the blue of the sky and the sea.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 2:3, medium close-up focused on the bust. The person occupies about 75% of the screen, with a bit of sky above and empty sea to the right. The camera is at eye level, slightly higher than the chest. 85mm equivalent medium telephoto lens, with shallow depth of field accurately focusing on the eyes and profile, while smoothly blurring the sea and island in the background.

Texture/Style:
High-quality summer fashion photography. Natural skin with visible texture and fine hair, without excessive skin retouching. Precise depiction of fine fabric weave, light wrinkles in the blue jacket, and small reflections from metal accessories. A high-saturation but clean color tone centered on blue and white, fresh contrast, and delicate film grain.

Negative:
People who appear underage, unnatural breasts or body shapes, excessive exposure, unnatural faces, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of limbs, broken joints, clothing digging in, disappearing shoulder straps, mismatched accessories, unnatural gravity, shadows inconsistent with the light source, text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.
2117903200341231576.promptZh:
主体：  
蓝色侧影  

主体：  
一位成年女性独自站在阳光明媚的海滩上。人物在竖构图2:3比例的人像中略偏画面左侧，取景范围从胸部至头顶。她身穿一件鲜艳的蓝色外衣，衣领低垂于双肩，与白色V领内搭形成强烈对比，同时呼应身后湛蓝的海水。  

人物/表情：  
一位气质沉静、成熟的日本女性。深棕色齐耳短发近乎黑色，清晰露出颈部。刘海与发梢在海风中轻柔地向右飘动。头部微微前倾，面部呈右侧 profile（特写），视线略向下，神情安静而从容，双唇微启。肤色为通透的浅米色，唇色珊瑚红，眼线纤细，睫毛自然。  

服装/姿态：  
象牙白V领连衣裙，肩带纤细。领口深邃却优雅，柔软的细罗纹面料自然贴合成熟女性的身体曲线。一件明快的钴蓝色轻便夹克下拉至手肘上方，露出肩膀与锁骨。双肩放松，上半身微微左转。耳垂佩戴精致的垂坠式耳环，细金链末端悬垂着几颗透明小宝石。颈间佩戴一条纤细项链，吊坠为一颗小巧单石。  

背景/光线：  
背景为延伸至地平线的深蓝色大海与澄澈天空。画面最左侧远处有一座轮廓模糊的小岛剪影，底部可见一道白色海滨栏杆。正午前后强烈的自然光自左上方照射，在发丝表面、左肩、锁骨及脸颊形成明亮高光。面部右侧泛起柔和的蓝色反射光，鼻下与下巴处呈现自然淡影。海面细碎的光斑清晰闪耀，使天空之蓝与海水之蓝明确分隔。  

构图/相机：  
竖构图2:3比例，以胸像为主的中景特写（medium close-up）。人物约占画面75%，上方留出少许天空，右侧留出空旷海面。相机位于人眼高度，略高于胸部。使用等效85mm中焦镜头，景深（depth of field）较浅，精准聚焦于双眼与侧脸轮廓，同时使背景中的大海与小岛柔滑虚化（bokeh）。  

质感/风格：  
高品质夏日时尚摄影。肌肤呈现自然纹理与细微绒毛，无过度皮肤修饰。精细刻画面料细腻织纹、蓝色夹克上的轻微褶皱，以及金属配饰上的细小反光。以蓝白为主调的高饱和度但干净色彩，清新对比鲜明，并带有细腻的胶片颗粒（film grain）。  

负面提示：  
未成年人形象、不自然的乳房或体型、过度暴露、不自然的面部、不自然的眼神、多余手指、缺失手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、衣物勒痕、肩带消失、配饰不匹配、违背自然重力的效果、与光源不一致的阴影、文字、商标、水印、过度皮肤修饰、塑料感肌肤。

2117903200341231577.promptZh: 创作一幅温暖的杂志风格夏日人像海报：一位年轻女性斜躺在阳光普照的向日葵花田中一张黄白格子野餐毯上。她拥有一头浓密的深棕近黑色长发，妆容柔和自然，面带温柔微笑，双颊各贴有一枚小巧的黄色花朵贴纸；她以略带俯视的特写（close-up）角度直视镜头。她身穿一件精致的白色细肩带蕾丝连衣裙，头戴一顶宽檐编织草帽，帽檐边缘垂有松散流苏，在她脸上投下斑驳光影。她双手捧着一台黑色无反相机，镜头硕大，置于胸前附近。画面中需包含恰好7个主要可见道具/场景元素：1顶草帽、1台黑色相机、1张黄白格子野餐毯、1只黄色长方形野餐包或书本（位于左侧）、1片绿色叶菜或花束叶片（靠近左下角）、1小簇橙黄色花朵（靠近底部）、背景草地中2株清晰可见的向日葵。采用明亮的正午夏日阳光、茂盛青翠的草地、柔和的金色高光、浅景深（depth of field）、轻盈浪漫的生活方式摄影（lifestyle photography）、自然肌肤质感、梦幻却写实的色彩。添加杂志风格排版：左上方为大型白色斜体衬线体标题“SUMMER BLOOM”，其下方三行小号白色文字分别为“Live in the sunshine”、“Dream in the flowers”、“Grow with joy”；右下方添加手写体黄色签名式短语“sun-lit days”，旁配一枚极简小花涂鸦。竖构图，比例4:5，高分辨率时尚野餐美学，画面中无其他人物，无水印，双手与相机无畸变。

2117903200341231578.promptEn:
Goal: Create a monochrome anime character reference sheet for a teenage high school boy with one full-body standing pose and exactly 4 separate bust expression variations.

Canvas: Portrait-oriented white canvas, clean empty background, high-resolution black-and-white manga pencil/ink style with soft gray shading and sketchy line-art texture.

Layout: Place 1 full-body character illustration on the left, occupying most of the height. Place exactly 4 bust portraits stacked vertically on the right, evenly spaced from top to bottom. No labels, no captions, no decorative background elements.

Subject details: The character is a slim, average-height Japanese anime high school boy with messy layered black hair, slightly tousled bangs, sharp but youthful eyes, pale skin, and a protagonist-like presence. He wears a summer school uniform: short-sleeved white button-up shirt with subtle wrinkles, loosened dark necktie, gray straight-leg slacks, black belt with metal buckle, and glossy black loafers. The shirt is slightly rumpled and the tie hangs casually to create a natural everyday-student look.

Full-body pose: The full-body figure stands relaxed with one hand in his pants pocket and the other hand lifted near chest height with loose fingers, facing slightly toward the viewer. His expression is calm and faintly smiling.

Expression variations: Include exactly 4 bust portraits on the right: 1) bright laughing smile with eyes closed and open mouth, 2) angry shouting expression with intense eyes and open mouth, 3) sad or troubled expression with downturned eyes and a small frown, 4) confident mischievous smirk with narrowed eyes. Each bust keeps the same hairstyle, uniform shirt, and loosened tie, cropped around the shoulders or upper chest.

Visual style: Detailed shonen manga character art, clean confident linework, delicate crosshatching, expressive hair strands, subtle grayscale shading on clothing folds, polished yet sketch-like character sheet presentation. Keep proportions elegant and natural, with strong facial expressiveness.

Constraints: Use only black, white, and gray tones. Include exactly 5 discrete character drawings total: 1 full-body standing pose plus 4 bust expression portraits. Do not add text, color, props, school background, watermark, signature, or extra characters.
2117903200341231578.promptZh:
目标：为一名青少年高中男生绘制一张单色动漫角色参考图，包含一个全身站立姿势和恰好4种不同的半身表情变体。

画布：纵向白色画布，干净空白背景，高分辨率黑白漫画铅笔/墨线风格（manga pencil/ink style），采用柔和的灰色阴影（soft gray shading）和略带草图感的线条纹理（sketchy line-art texture）。

布局：左侧放置1个全身角色插画，占据画布大部分高度；右侧垂直堆叠放置恰好4个半身肖像，从上到下均匀分布。不添加任何标签、说明文字或装饰性背景元素。

角色细节：该角色是一名身材纤瘦、中等身高的日本动漫风格高中生，拥有凌乱分层的黑色头发、略显蓬乱的刘海、锐利而富有青春感的眼睛、白皙肤色，以及主角般的气场。他穿着夏季校服：短袖白色扣衬衫（带有细微褶皱）、松开的深色领带、灰色直筒西裤、配金属扣的黑色皮带，以及光亮的黑色乐福鞋。衬衫略显皱褶，领带自然垂落，营造出真实日常学生的形象。

全身姿势：全身人物呈放松站立姿态，一手插在裤兜中，另一手抬至胸前高度、手指自然松开，身体微微朝向观者。面部表情平静，略带浅笑。

表情变体：右侧需包含恰好4个半身肖像：1）明亮开怀大笑，双眼闭合、张嘴；2）愤怒呐喊，眼神凌厉、张嘴；3）悲伤或困扰，眼睑下垂、微蹙眉头；4）自信狡黠的 smirk（smirk），双眼微眯。每个半身像均保持相同的发型、制服衬衫及松开的领带，构图裁切至肩部或上胸部区域。

视觉风格：细致的少年漫画（shonen manga）角色绘画，线条干净有力（clean confident linework），辅以精细的交叉排线（crosshatching），发丝表现富有表现力（expressive hair strands），服装褶皱处采用微妙的灰度阴影（subtle grayscale shading），整体呈现精致却略带手绘感的角色表（character sheet）效果。人物比例需优雅自然，面部表情表现力强。

限制条件：仅使用黑、白、灰三色。总共包含恰好5个独立角色绘图：1个全身站立姿势 + 4个半身表情肖像。不得添加文字、色彩、道具、校园背景、水印、签名或额外角色。

2117903200341231579.promptEn: Create a richly detailed square fantasy illustration in the style of a vintage engraved storybook plate with hand-colored ink washes. In the foreground, show a young male traveler from the chest up, positioned left of center, with dark wavy hair with pale moonlit highlights, strong brows, tan skin, and an upward, contemplative gaze toward the starry sky. He wears a rough medieval cloak in warm brown over a pale hooded tunic or scarf, with heavy cross-hatching, etched shadows, and textured fabric folds. Behind him, create a vast nocturnal medieval city of tightly packed steep-roofed houses, narrow towers, chimneys, and tiny glowing amber windows. On the right side of the horizon, make an immense Gothic cathedral-castle rise above the city, with many spires, flying buttress-like details, needle towers, and warm lights in selected windows. The sky is deep indigo-black and filled with exactly 25 prominent golden eight-point stars of varied sizes plus dense tiny speckled starlight; place a large full moon in the upper left, cream colored and cratered. Add moody blue-gray clouds behind the cathedral and along the skyline. Include a stone parapet or wall along the lower right foreground to suggest the traveler is standing on a high overlook. Use a limited palette of midnight blue, ochre gold, sepia brown, cream, and muted gray, with dramatic moonlit rim light, old-world romantic fantasy atmosphere, meticulous linework, visible paper grain, no modern objects, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341231579.promptZh:
创作一幅细节丰富、正方形的奇幻插画，风格仿照复古雕版印刷故事书插图，采用手绘着色墨水 wash（水墨晕染）技法。前景中，描绘一名年轻男性旅人，仅显示胸部以上部分，位于画面偏左位置；他拥有深色波浪卷发，发丝带有苍白月光映照的高光，眉骨突出，肤色为古铜色，目光向上凝望繁星点点的夜空，神情沉思。他身披一件粗粝的中世纪斗篷，呈暖棕色，斗篷下是一袭浅色连帽束腰外衣或围巾；斗篷与衣物均以浓重交叉排线（cross-hatching）、蚀刻式阴影（etched shadows）及富有质感的布料褶皱表现。  
他身后是一座广袤的中世纪夜间城市，房屋密集、屋顶陡峭，夹杂着细窄塔楼、烟囱，以及无数微小却透出琥珀色暖光的窗户。在地平线右侧，一座宏伟的哥特式城堡大教堂拔地而起，凌驾于整座城市之上；建筑布满尖塔、飞扶壁式结构（flying buttress-like details）、针状塔楼（needle towers），并有若干选定窗格透出温暖灯光。  
天空为深靛青近黑（deep indigo-black），缀有恰好25颗醒目、大小不一的金色八芒星（golden eight-point stars），以及密布如尘的细碎星光（dense tiny speckled starlight）；左上方绘一颗硕大的满月，呈乳白色（cream colored），表面可见陨石坑（cratered）。 cathedral 后方及天际线沿线添加情绪化蓝灰色云层（moody blue-gray clouds）。  
右下前景处加入一道石砌矮墙或城垛（stone parapet or wall），暗示旅人正伫立于一处高耸的观景台。  
整体采用受限调色盘：午夜蓝（midnight blue）、赭石金（ochre gold）、赤褐棕（sepia brown）、乳白（cream）与低饱和灰（muted gray）；运用戏剧性月光照亮的轮廓光（rim light），营造古老世界浪漫奇幻氛围（old-world romantic fantasy atmosphere），线条刻画精微考究（meticulous linework），纸面肌理（paper grain）清晰可见；画面中不得出现现代物品、文字或水印。

2117903200341231580.promptEn:
Goal: Create a premium vertical e-commerce beverage poster for an iced caramel sea-salt latte / dessert drink, with a cool crystalline summer aesthetic and bold Chinese typography.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, high-resolution commercial product photography style. Use an icy pale-blue background with bright daylight, sparkling highlights, water droplets, and flying ice fragments. The composition should feel refreshing, cold, glossy, and high-end.

Layout: Place the main product glass in the lower-right half, tilted slightly to the right and cropped close for impact. Surround it with large transparent blue ice cubes in the foreground and background, including exactly 5 prominent ice blocks: one large block at bottom left, one large block at bottom right, one medium block behind the cup on the right, one medium block behind the cup on the left, and one small floating cube near the left side. Add small ice shards and droplets scattered through the air. Reserve the upper-left area for typography. Add a black bottom footer bar occupying about 7% of the canvas height.

Subject details: The drink is a clear cylindrical glass filled with dark coffee at the bottom, milk and cream swirling above, topped with thick white foam. Golden caramel sauce drips down the foam and glass. Add amber sugar crystals on top of the foam and around the ice; show exactly 9 clearly visible amber crystal chunks on the foam and rim area. The glass surface has condensation beads and cold mist. Use strong macro product lighting, crisp reflections, and shallow depth of field.

Text content: At the very top-left, add a small thin white slogan: 烘焙新品  清凉上新. Below it, create a huge bold block-style Chinese headline in two lines: first line in white, 海盐焦糖; second line in deep navy blue, 拿铁. Under the headline, add a rounded blue gradient pill button with white text: 限时尝鲜  第二杯半价. In the bottom black footer bar, center widely spaced white uppercase text: BAKERY LAB.

Typography style: Use heavy geometric sans-serif Chinese characters with a chunky, squared, slightly futuristic look. The headline should be very large, clean, tightly kerned, and slightly shadowed for separation. The promotional pill should have a glossy blue-to-cyan gradient and rounded corners.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic commercial food photography mixed with graphic advertising design; icy crystal aesthetics, high contrast between deep coffee browns, caramel amber, bright whites, and cool blues. No watermark, no extra logos, no additional text beyond the specified four text areas.
2117903200341231580.promptZh:
目标：为一款冰镇焦糖海盐拿铁/甜品饮品创作一张高端竖版电商饮料海报，呈现清凉晶莹的夏日美学风格，并采用醒目的中文排版。

画布：竖版3:4海报，高分辨率商业产品摄影（commercial product photography）风格。背景采用冰感浅蓝色，明亮日光照明，带有闪烁高光、水珠及飞溅的冰晶碎片。整体构图需传达清爽、冰凉、光泽感与高端质感。

布局：主产品玻璃杯置于画面右下半区，略微向右倾斜，并以特写式裁切增强视觉冲击力。前后景环绕大型透明蓝色冰块，共精确布置5块显著冰块：左下角1块大冰块，右下角1块大冰块，杯子右侧后方1块中等冰块，杯子左侧后方1块中等冰块，以及左边缘附近1块悬浮小冰块。添加细小冰屑与水滴，散落于空中。左上区域预留用于排版文字。底部添加黑色页脚条，高度约占画布总高的7%。

主体细节：饮品盛装于透明圆柱形玻璃杯中——底部为深色咖啡，中上部为牛奶与奶油交织旋绕，顶部覆盖厚实白色奶泡。金棕色焦糖酱沿奶泡及杯壁缓缓流淌。奶泡表面及冰块周围点缀琥珀色糖结晶；奶泡与杯沿区域须清晰呈现恰好9颗琥珀色结晶颗粒。玻璃表面附着冷凝水珠及寒雾。采用强效微距产品布光（macro product lighting），呈现锐利反射与浅景深（shallow depth of field）。

文字内容：最左上方添加一行纤细白色标语：烘焙新品  清凉上新。其正下方设置超大号粗体块状中文主标题，分两行排布：首行为白色，“海盐焦糖”；次行为深藏青色，“拿铁”。主标题下方添加一枚圆角蓝色渐变胶囊按钮，内含白色文字：“限时尝鲜  第二杯半价”。底部黑色页脚条中央，以宽间距白色大写英文字母居中排布：“BAKERY LAB”。

字体风格：采用厚重几何无衬线体中文字符，具有方正、块状、略带未来感的视觉特征。主标题须极大、干净、字间距极紧，并施加轻微阴影以增强层次分离。促销胶囊按钮需呈现具光泽感的蓝至青色渐变（blue-to-cyan gradient），并带圆角。

视觉风格：超写实（hyper-realistic）商业食品摄影（commercial food photography）融合平面广告设计（graphic advertising design）；冰晶质感（icy crystal aesthetics），深咖啡棕、焦糖琥珀色、明快纯白与冷调蓝色之间形成高对比。不得添加水印、额外标识或指定四块文字区域以外的任何其他文字。

2117903200341231581.promptEn: A breathtaking crystal strawberry sculpted entirely from flawless transparent crystal glass, with intricate faceted surfaces that refract rainbow light like a precious gemstone. Tiny crystal seeds sparkle like diamonds across the surface, while the emerald-green leaves are carved from translucent jade crystal with delicate veins. The strawberry glows softly from within, creating mesmerizing light caustics and colorful reflections on a polished black marble surface. Ultra-realistic glass textures, luxurious jewelry craftsmanship, macro photography, cinematic studio lighting, shallow depth of field, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, elegant, premium luxury aesthetic, 8K, masterpiece.
2117903200341231581.promptZh: 一颗令人叹为观止的水晶草莓，完全由无瑕透明水晶玻璃雕琢而成，表面布满精细刻面，如珍贵宝石般折射出彩虹色光芒。微小的水晶籽粒如钻石般在表面熠熠生辉，而翠绿色的叶片则由半透明玉石水晶雕刻而成，叶脉纤细精巧。草莓由内而外散发柔和辉光，在抛光黑色大理石表面上投射出迷人的光线焦散（caustics）与缤纷反射。超写实玻璃材质纹理，奢华珠宝级工艺，微距摄影（macro photography），电影感影棚布光（cinematic studio lighting），浅景深（shallow depth of field），超高细节（hyper-detailed），照片级写实（photorealistic），优雅，高端奢华美学，8K，杰作。

2117903200341231582.promptEn: pizza floating in deep space, featuring a perfectly baked golden crust forming the planetary edge, oceans of bubbling melted mozzarella cheese, rivers of rich tomato sauce, lush forests of fresh basil, towering mountains of pepperoni, mushrooms, olives, roasted peppers, and parmesan cliffs. Tiny glowing cities are built into the pizza surface with warm lights shining through the crust. A ring of crispy breadsticks and herbs gracefully orbits the planet like Saturn's rings. Countless stars, colorful nebulae, and distant galaxies surround the scene, while cinematic sunlight illuminates the melted cheese with irresistible realism. Hyper-realistic food textures, ultra-detailed, fantasy world-building, volumetric lighting, dramatic composition, vibrant colors, 8K, masterpiece, photorealistic, breathtaking cosmic food art.
2117903200341231582.promptZh: 披萨悬浮于深邃太空之中，呈现一颗完美烘烤的金黄色饼边作为行星边缘，沸腾冒泡的马苏里拉奶酪构成海洋，浓郁番茄酱形成河流，新鲜罗勒长成茂密森林，意大利辣香肠耸立为高山，还有蘑菇、橄榄、烤甜椒与帕尔马干酪构成的悬崖。披萨表面嵌入无数微小发光城市，温暖光芒透过饼底透出。一圈酥脆面包棒与香草优雅环绕这颗“披萨行星”，宛如土星环。无数星辰、五彩星云及遥远星系环绕整个场景，电影感阳光（cinematic lighting）照亮融化的奶酪，呈现出令人无法抗拒的真实感。超写实（hyper-realistic）食物质感，极致细节（ultra-detailed），奇幻世界构建（fantasy world-building），体积光（volumetric lighting），戏剧性构图（dramatic composition），鲜艳色彩（vibrant colors），8K，杰作（masterpiece），照片级写实（photorealistic），震撼人心的宇宙美食艺术（breathtaking cosmic food art）。

2117903200341231583.promptEn: Create an ultra-premium editorial studio portrait of a young Black man in clean left-facing side profile, shown from mid-thigh to head against a seamless dark charcoal black background. The subject is a young Black man with short natural black hair and smooth medium-dark brown skin, standing upright with a calm, serious, composed expression, eyes looking straight ahead to the left, lips relaxed, jawline defined, and posture elegant. He wears a fitted navy blue short-sleeve button-up shirt with fine vertical pinstripes, tucked into tailored black trousers, with one visible hand resting in his trouser pocket and a black wristwatch on that wrist. Use a refined fashion-editorial look with realistic skin texture, crisp fabric detail, subtle highlights on the cheekbone, nose bridge, ear, neck, and forearm, and soft shadow falloff. Lighting should feel premium but not flashy: a large soft key light from the front-left, gentle rim separation from the background, controlled contrast, no harsh studio glare. Compose vertically in a 2:3 frame, subject positioned slightly left of center with negative space on the right, full side silhouette clearly readable. Photorealistic, high-end magazine portrait, shallow but natural depth of field, sharp focus on face and upper body, matte dark backdrop, no text, no props besides the single wristwatch, no extra people, no watermark.
2117903200341231583.promptZh:
创作一幅超高端杂志风格影棚人像，画面主体为一名年轻黑人男性，以干净利落的左侧正侧面轮廓呈现，构图范围从大腿中部至头顶，背景为无缝深炭黑色。  
主体为一名年轻黑人男性，留着短而自然的黑色头发，肤色为光滑的中等偏深棕色；他直立站立，神情平静、严肃、沉稳，双眼平视左方，嘴唇放松，下颌线清晰分明，姿态优雅。  
他身穿一件合身的藏青色短袖纽扣衬衫，布面带有细腻的纵向细条纹，衬衫下摆束入剪裁精良的黑色长裤；一只可见的手自然插在裤袋中，该手腕佩戴一只黑色腕表。  
采用精致的时尚杂志（fashion-editorial）风格，呈现真实的皮肤质感（photorealistic）、清晰锐利的织物细节、颧骨、鼻梁、耳廓、颈部及前臂处的微妙高光，以及柔和的阴影过渡（shadow falloff）。  
布光需体现高端质感但不浮夸：主光源为来自前左方的大面积柔光（soft key light），辅以轻柔的轮廓光（rim light）实现与背景的清晰分离，整体对比度受控，无刺眼的影棚眩光（studio glare）。  
竖构图，画幅比例为2:3；人物略偏画面中心左侧，右侧保留负空间（negative space），确保完整的侧影轮廓清晰可辨。  
照片级写实（photorealistic），高端杂志人像（high-end magazine portrait），景深（depth of field）较浅但自然，面部与上半身焦点锐利，哑光深色背景，画面中无文字、无道具（仅保留单只腕表）、无其他人物、无水印。
2117903200341231583.author: Abkr Sadiq

2117903200341231584.promptEn: Create a photorealistic vertical 4:5 smartphone selfie portrait at blue hour on an outdoor balcony. A young East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark brown tousled hair with soft face-framing bangs is framed from the chest up with a wide-angle front-camera perspective, her right arm extended toward the camera so the sleeve is large in the foreground. She looks off to the viewer’s right with a calm, slightly wistful expression, glossy lips, natural makeup, visible skin texture, subtle cheek highlights, and realistic pores. She wears a cream ribbed off-shoulder long-sleeve knit top, a delicate thin necklace, and small dark green hoop earrings. Lighting: deep blue twilight sky and clouds behind her, dark silhouetted trees and balcony/building lights in the background, but her face and upper body are lit by close soft phone fill/HDR flash, preserving natural skin tone, gentle specular highlights on nose, lips, cheeks, and collarbones, and a clear separation between warm foreground skin and cool blue environment. Composition: subject centered slightly right, head near upper third, shoulders diagonal, balcony railing and dark rooftops receding behind, shallow depth of field with mild phone-camera distortion, high dynamic range, crisp realistic detail, no beauty-filter plastic skin. Add a minimalist editorial overlay at the bottom left: exactly 2 text lines reading “WILDCORE / VOL.01” and “TEST 02 / V01 / BLUE-HOUR FILL / NATURAL SKIN”; include exactly 2 graphic elements: one thin white horizontal rule stretching across the lower frame and one short orange dash at the left under the first line. Use clean small uppercase white sans-serif typography, cinematic lifestyle photography, natural color grading, no watermark, no extra text.
2117903200341231584.promptZh: 在蓝色时刻（blue hour）户外阳台拍摄一张照片级写实（photorealistic）的竖构图4:5智能手机自拍人像。一位年轻的东亚女性，齐肩深棕色蓬松发，额前有柔和修饰脸型的刘海，以广角（wide-angle）前置摄像头视角取景，画面框选其胸部以上，右臂伸向镜头，使袖子在前景中显得宽大。她目光望向观者右侧，神情平静而略带感伤，唇部光泽润泽，妆容自然，皮肤纹理清晰可见，颧骨处有微妙高光，毛孔真实可辨。她身穿米色罗纹露肩长袖针织上衣、一条纤细的精致项链，以及一对小巧的墨绿色圆环耳环。布光：背景为深蓝色暮光天空与云层，远处是剪影状的暗色树木及阳台/建筑灯光；但她的面部与上半身由近距离柔光手机补光/HDR闪光灯照亮，保留自然肤色，在鼻尖、嘴唇、脸颊与锁骨处呈现柔和的镜面高光（specular highlights），并形成温暖的前景肤色与冷调蓝色环境之间的清晰分离。构图：人物略微偏右居中，头部靠近画面上三分之一处，双肩呈对角线姿态，阳台栏杆与深色屋顶在后方退远，景深（depth of field）较浅，并带有轻微的手机摄像头畸变，高动态范围（HDR），细节锐利真实，无美颜滤镜导致的塑料感肌肤。在画面左下角添加极简主义杂志风格（editorial）叠加元素：严格包含两行文字，第一行为 “WILDCORE / VOL.01”，第二行为 “TEST 02 / V01 / BLUE-HOUR FILL / NATURAL SKIN”；严格包含两个图形元素：一条细白色横线贯穿画面底部边框，以及一个短橙色短横线，位于第一行文字左侧正下方。使用干净、细小、全大写、白色无衬线字体，电影感生活方式摄影（cinematic lifestyle photography），自然色彩分级（natural color grading），无水印，无额外文字。
2117903200341231584.author: WILDCORE

2117903200341231585.promptEn:
Goal: Create a high-impact Japanese YouTube thumbnail about automatically generating video captions/telops with AI, featuring a dramatic comparison from Vrew to Claude Code.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal thumbnail, 1200×675 style, optimized for YouTube. Use a dark blurred video-editing timeline interface as the full background, with purple and blue timeline tracks and small clip blocks visible but out of focus.

Layout: Put a huge bold Japanese headline across the top reading AIでテロップを自動作成. The letters should be white with thick black outline and an additional thin white outer stroke, slightly tilted and tightly spaced for maximum impact. Place one large white speech-bubble complaint box on the left-middle with a black outline and a small pointer at the bottom right. Inside it, use bold black Japanese text for the complaint and a red emphasized final line with a yellow underline: 誤字脱字多すぎるし、テロップはズレまくってるし、変なところで改行するし、そのくせにそれ以外のことは何もできないって...\nVrewマジで使えんw. Place two app-style logo tiles in the center-right: exactly 2 logos total. Logo 1 is a cyan-blue rounded square Vrew-like icon with a white V mark, located near the center, partially overlapped by a small orange pixelated mascot/bug shape. Logo 2 is a larger orange-red rounded square Claude-like icon with a white radial starburst, located to the upper right, with a shiny gold crown tilted on its top-right corner. Add a small white label under the orange icon reading Claude Code in bold black text. Between the two logos, add exactly 1 curved red arrow with a white outline pointing from the blue logo toward the orange logo.

Bottom text: Fill the bottom third with one enormous Japanese conclusion phrase reading これで全て解決. Make it thick rounded display lettering with a bright yellow gradient fill, heavy black outline, and glowing white outer stroke. The text should overlap the background and partly sit in front of the center graphics, creating a loud thumbnail composition.

Visual style: Japanese viral tech thumbnail, extremely bold contrast, dense composition, exaggerated outlines, drop shadows, white glow effects, saturated colors, black background atmosphere, urgent and humorous tone. Make all Japanese text crisp, legible, and correctly spelled.

Discrete elements to include: exactly 1 top headline, exactly 1 speech bubble, exactly 2 app logos, exactly 1 orange mascot/bug shape, exactly 1 red curved arrow, exactly 1 gold crown, exactly 1 Claude Code label, and exactly 1 huge bottom headline. Do not add extra logos, people, watermarks, or unrelated text.
2117903200341231585.author: 河村 風真｜Fuma Kawamura

2117903200341231586.promptEn:
Goal: Create a whimsical hyper-realistic 2-column by 3-row photo collage showing a tiny miniature young man on a sunny beach, interacting with oversized summer objects as if he is a toy-sized person in a real world.

Canvas: Vertical collage, 768×1152 style aspect ratio, six equal rectangular panels separated by clean white gutters. Bright midday beach lighting, shallow depth of field, blue ocean horizon and sandy beach background in every panel.

Main subject: The same miniature young man appears in all 6 panels, about toy-sized, with a handsome youthful face, short dark wavy hair, light skin, wearing a burgundy button-up shirt, black pants, and white sneakers. Keep his identity and outfit consistent across the collage. Use a miniature young man as the recurring subject.

Panel count and contents: Use exactly 6 panels.
1. Top-left: A giant human hand tilts a small pink bucket, pouring a mound of dry sand over and around the tiny man while he sits on the beach with both hands raised in surprise.
2. Top-right: The tiny man sits inside a giant pink frosted donut-shaped float in splashing ocean water, wearing a blue snorkel mask/tube and yellow flippers, while a large human hand steadies the float from the right.
3. Middle-left: The tiny man crouches on the sand and pulls a rope tied around an enormous spiral seashell, as if trying to drag it.
4. Middle-right: A large human hand holds a red-and-green popsicle on a wooden stick; the tiny man clings to the popsicle with his arms and legs, as if hugging it.
5. Bottom-left: A giant waffle cone held by a human hand drips melting pink ice cream over the tiny man, who sits on a puddle of pink ice cream with both hands raised.
6. Bottom-right: The tiny man lounges in a miniature beach chair under a small yellow-and-white umbrella, wearing dark sunglasses, while a large human hand offers him a blue-orange juice box with a white straw.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic macro photography, playful forced-perspective miniature scene, crisp details on sand grains, realistic skin texture on the oversized hands, vivid beach colors, cinematic sunlight, natural shadows, glossy water splashes, realistic scale contrast, high-resolution editorial collage.

Constraints: No text, captions, logos, or watermarks. Keep the same character, clothing, and beach environment in every panel. Make the objects oversized relative to the miniature person, with believable contact shadows and realistic interactions.
2117903200341231586.author: Nomi AI

2117903200341231587.promptEn: Create a polished vertical anime fan-art illustration of Minamo, an elegant young female summoner inspired by early-2000s fantasy RPG heroine costume design. Show her from mid-thigh upward in a soft three-quarter frontal pose, gently smiling with calm blue eyes and shoulder-length wavy rose pink hair with subtle blue-tinted tips blowing lightly to the right. She wears an asymmetrical white sleeveless kimono-style top crossing over the chest, a visible black strap at the side, detached wide white sleeves tied with small black ribbon lacing, a bright yellow floral obi with turquoise ornamental patterns, pink trim, a large pink flower ornament at the center, two small dangling pink flowers, and long turquoise tassels. Pair it with a deep navy pleated hakama-style skirt decorated with faint pink cherry blossom patterns near the lower area. Her accessories are small turquoise earrings. In her left hand at the image edge, include exactly one ornate summoner staff: a tall blue shaft with a pink grip section, gold rings and fittings, a blue tassel at the bottom, and a large partial golden circular lattice head with a turquoise gem visible near the top-left edge. Use a bright airy white-to-pale-cyan background with exactly no scenery, only soft glowing blue bokeh dots and tiny floating sparkles. Style: high-quality modern anime illustration, delicate linework, glossy eyes, soft skin shading, pastel lighting, subtle rim light, clean composition, elegant fantasy mood. 2117903200341231591.promptEn: Hyper-realistic vertical full-body outdoor fashion portrait. Subject: Slender and elegant figure, warm and fair skin, exquisite features, almond-shaped deep brown eyes, soft arched eyebrows, refined nose bridge, natural rose-red lip color. Friendly, quiet, and approachable expression—not an intentional pose. Minimalist makeup: glowing natural skin, light peach blush, thin brown eyeliner, soft eyelashes, neutral eye shadow, bright coral pink lip color. Real skin texture, faint pores, exquisite facial highlights, smooth and realistic color transitions. Most of the hair falls over the left shoulder and flows along the front of the torso; another long section flows behind the right arm. Fine strands of hair around the forehead and cheeks suggest a slight outdoor breeze. Soft edge lighting highlights individual hair strands without artificial gloss. Tonal skin-tone beige soft lining—exquisite tonal effect, no transparency. Fits the body, stops at the natural waistline, with real tension, small folds, and visible lace relief. High-waisted ivory or warm cream wide-leg trousers—the waistband fits just below the camisole, elegant front pleats open into loose vertical folds, wide trouser legs, flowing drape. Slightly warm off-white rather than pure white; delicate woven texture, soft shadows within the folds, natural wrinkles at the waist and hips. Accessories: Small shiny gold pendant necklace—a rounded abstract pendant on a fine chain located on the upper chest. Delicate and low-key stud earrings. A thin gold bracelet on each wrist, and another extra-fine bracelet near one wrist. Short clean nails painted in a light neutral color. Hands are anatomically accurate: relaxed fingers, real joints, natural spacing. Scene: Quiet traditional Jiangnan water town or historical ancient village alley. An old rectangular grey slate road stretching from the lower foreground to the distance—uneven and weathered, irregular gaps, faint moss, small cracks, low-key beige-grey variations. The slate road serves as a strong leading line to guide the eye deep into the alley. Left side: A tall light-colored plaster wall close to the camera—delicate stains, discoloration, signs of aging. Behind the woman's left shoulder: A dark wooden doorway under an exquisite traditional roofed corridor with carved structural details. On the left edge, there are lush green shrubs growing in a rough raised stone flower pot. Right side: A white plaster building with dark roof tiles, an embedded doorway, stone foundations, and a narrow overhanging eave—the building extends toward the central background to form a soft-focus blurred corridor. In the upper background, there are several mature green trees rising above the roofs—low-key olive green and sage green naturally blend into the cream walls and grey roofs. Shallow depth of field: The woman is sharp and clear, the nearest architectural edges retain some texture, and distant doorways/roofs/vegetation turn into creamy bokeh spots. Retains enough recognizable architectural structure to convey a real historical ancient village atmosphere. Lighting: Soft diffused late morning sunlight from the upper left and front, filtered through light clouds—with exquisite highlights on the forehead, cheeks, bridge of the nose, collarbone, shoulders, lace top, and forearms. There is a restrained warm rim light on the edges of the hair. Soft open shadows under the jaw, hair, and trouser folds. No harsh direct sunlight or strong cast shadows. Color Tones: Cream white, nude beige, light stone grey, weathered charcoal grey, low-key green, soft brown, restrained gold. Glowing warm skin tones, no orange saturation. Soft cinematic tones, smooth highlight transitions, slightly low-key background colors, transparent and elegant contrast. Camera: Waist to chest height, full frame 85mm, f/2–f/2.8, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on eyes and lace texture, smooth background separation. High-end lifestyle fashion or exquisite travel photography quality—natural, elegant, romantic, sophisticated. Negative: No text, no logo, no watermark, no extra people, no modern vehicles, no street signs, no wire clutter, no exaggerated glamour makeup, no plastic-looking skin, no deformed fingers, no repeated limbs, no deformed architecture, no over-saturated colors, no artificial HDR, no strong studio lighting.

2117903200341231616.promptEn: Create a 1970s black-and-white close-up portrait in a windswept outdoor setting, black and white noise . Camera/look: eye-level, front ¾ view (~30° off-axis); 85–105 mm portrait perspective; vertical 2:3, tight head-and-shoulders crop; shallow DoF f/2.8–f/4; subject centered . Lighting: hard natural sunlight from upper camera-left with minimal fill; crisp shadows; subtle rim on hair; sky as bright mid-tone background; no blown highlights.Pose & expression: subject faces camera, chin slightly down, lips parted with a cigarette held between them; gaze relaxed/half-lidded; hair blown across the face by wind, partially covering one eye.Wardrobe & styling: dark collared shirt with open neck; thin black neck scarf tied loosely; no logos/jewelry.Grade: high-contrast monochrome with rich blacks, bright highlights, medium–heavy film grain (Tri-X/HP5 vibe), slight halation, faint vignette; keep skin texture natural (no plastic smoothing).Composition: simple sky background, no extra props; clean verticals; ensure sharp focus on near eye and cigarette.Output: high-resolution, editorial/classic cinema mood; no text or watermarks.
2117903200341231616.promptZh:
创作一幅1970年代黑白特写（close-up）肖像，户外场景，风势强劲，画面带有黑白噪点（black and white noise）。  
相机/视角：平视高度（eye-level），正面偏三分之四视角（front ¾ view，约30°离轴）；85–105 mm人像焦段透视（portrait perspective）；竖构图2:3比例，紧凑的头肩构图（tight head-and-shoulders crop）；浅景深（shallow DoF），光圈f/2.8–f/4；主体居中（subject centered）。  
布光：强烈自然阳光，来自相机左上方（upper camera-left），补光极少；阴影清晰锐利（crisp shadows）；发丝边缘有微妙轮廓光（subtle rim on hair）；天空作为明亮中灰调背景（bright mid-tone background）；无过曝高光（no blown highlights）。  
姿态与表情：主体直视镜头，下颌略低，双唇微张，一支香烟夹于唇间；目光放松/半睁（gaze relaxed/half-lidded）；头发被风吹拂至面部，部分遮挡一只眼睛。  
服饰与造型：深色带领衬衫，领口敞开；细黑色颈巾松散系结；无品牌标识/首饰（no logos/jewelry）。  
调色：高对比度单色（high-contrast monochrome），浓郁纯黑、明亮高光，中至重度胶片颗粒（medium–heavy film grain，Tri-X/HP5 风味），轻微晕染（slight halation），隐约暗角（faint vignette）；保留皮肤真实质感（no plastic smoothing）。  
构图：简洁天空背景，无额外道具；垂直线干净利落；确保近侧眼睛与香烟清晰对焦（sharp focus on near eye and cigarette）。  
输出：高分辨率（high-resolution），兼具杂志级/经典电影感（editorial/classic cinema mood）；不添加文字或水印（no text or watermarks）。

2117903200341231617.promptEn:

Boss: A colossal armored crab enemy dominates the upper-right and center of the scene. It has exactly 2 huge raised claws, multiple segmented legs, a hard blue-brown shell, glowing highlights, and an intimidating face. The boss is firing a brilliant cyan-white magical beam from a glowing orb between its claws down toward the heroes, creating a massive impact flare at the center.

Heroes: Show exactly 3 playable characters in the foreground, all facing the crab boss. 1) KAITO, a dark-haired male swordsman in armor, center-left, bracing with a glowing sword against the beam. 2) RINA, a long dark-haired female mage or support fighter, center-right, holding a staff or wand with green-blue magic. 3) YUNA, a blonde female mage in a flowing blue robe, far left, holding a staff and casting a protective blue barrier around the party. Make the party look strong and heroic, like a premium gacha RPG battle scene.

User interface: Add a polished fantasy RPG battle UI overlay. Top-left boss panel contains a small crab portrait icon, the label “BOSS : ENEMY”, the boss name “アビサル・クロウ Lvl 68”, a long red/orange HP bar, and the HP text “1,450,000/1,450,000 HP”. Bottom-left party status panel lists exactly 3 character rows with portraits, names, levels, HP, MP, and colored bars: “KAITO Lvl 65 HP 4820/5500 MP 120/120”, “RINA Lvl 63 HP 3550/3900 MP 280/300”, and “YUNA Lvl 62 HP 3800/4000 MP 310/320”. Right side command menu contains exactly 5 stacked beveled buttons labeled ATTACK, SKILL, ITEM, DEFEND, OVERDRIVE, with ATTACK highlighted in orange. Above the command menu, add the small location label “岩の廃墟”. Bottom-center attack name plaque with ornate gold trim displays “蟹光線”.

Visual style: Highly polished AAA anime fantasy illustration, sharp character silhouettes, cinematic action composition, intense motion, volumetric light, magical particles, reflective armor, detailed crab texture, ornate gold UI frames, crisp readable text, no watermark, no extra characters, no extra menu options.

Include exactly 15 visible birds or gull silhouettes scattered across the sky. Use a cinematic 16:9 composition, low-angle epic scale, high contrast chiaroscuro, deep navy and teal shadows, warm gold highlights, foaming turquoise waves, ornate linework, graphic-novel fantasy concept art style, highly detailed but painterly, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341231618.promptZh: 创作一幅戏剧性的宽屏暗黑奇幻（dark-fantasy）插画，主题为“巨海泰坦与信使”：一位庞大古老的海洋泰坦自暴风雨肆虐的海面中升起，正面向左下角一处嶙峋悬崖上伫立的一位渺小兜帽信使。该泰坦是一位由风化岩石与鳞片状铠甲板构成的巨型肌肉人形海神，面容严峻、蓄须，双目发光，头冠呈犄角状或珊瑚状脊棱，肩背布满棘刺，胸前、肩部、手臂、腰带及腕部饰有繁复发光的金色符文/天体纹样（runic/celestial patterns）。海水自泰坦的肩部、手臂、胡须与躯干奔涌而下；狂暴的白色浪峰在其腰际与手掌周围猛烈拍击。信使身形微小，身披黑色斗篷，剪影轮廓分明，长发与斗篷在风中剧烈飘扬，高举一根明亮的圆形金色权杖或信标，直指泰坦。场景背景为远左方的古代滨海废墟神庙与断裂石柱；天空为深青黑（teal-black）雷暴天色，密布层次分明的云层，斜向雨痕纵横，右侧闪耀着刺目闪电，左上方云层裂开一道壮丽缝隙，金色阳光束（sun rays）从中倾泻而出。天空中须精确分布15只可见的飞鸟或海鸥剪影。采用电影感16:9构图（cinematic 16:9 composition）、低角度史诗尺度（low-angle epic scale）、高对比度明暗对照法（high contrast chiaroscuro）、深海军蓝与青绿色阴影（deep navy and teal shadows）、暖金色高光（warm gold highlights）、泛泡沫的青绿色海浪（foaming turquoise waves）、繁复精细的线条刻画（ornate linework）、图像小说风格的奇幻概念艺术（graphic-novel fantasy concept art style），高度细节化但具绘画感（highly detailed but painterly），画面中无文字、无水印。

2117903200341231619.promptEn: Create a soft pastel anime illustration of a shy squid-themed maid girl sitting on the edge of a high bed in a bright minimalist bedroom, viewed from a low angle so her oversized platform shoes dominate the foreground and her face looks down toward the viewer. She is a petite teenage anime girl with short black bob hair with pink-dyed inner ends, pale skin, sleepy half-lidded eyes, and a slightly embarrassed expression. Her outfit is a black-and-white frilly maid-inspired dress with an off-shoulder cut, long detached black sleeves with white trim, a white ruffled apron edge, black garter straps, white knee socks, puffy white leg warmers, and chunky black Mary Jane platform heels with pink trim. Use mint turquoise and soft pink throughout the design. Include exactly 7 visible squid/octopus motifs: one mint squid hat perched on her maid headband, one mint squid hair clip, one mint squid emblem on her chest, one mint squid plush held in her lap, one mint squid print on her sock, one pink octopus emblem on the shoe, and one mint squid graphic on the drink cup. Include exactly 4 visible bows: a mint bow at her collar, a mint bow on her sleeve, a pink bow at the top of her sock, and a pink bow on her leg warmer. Place her in a clean pastel room with pale blue walls, white ceiling, white furniture, a pale blue mattress, a round white side table with a pink band, and a transparent drink cup with ice and a pink straw on the table. Add soft background props: a white door with a pale blue keyhole-like poster, a low white cabinet or desk with stacked books and a pink-framed object. The style should be high-quality Japanese anime character art, delicate linework, airy lighting, low contrast, glossy highlights, subtle blush, clean cel shading, soft white negative space, and a cute futuristic kawaii aesthetic. Use a vertical 2:3 composition, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.
2117903200341231619.promptZh: 用柔和的粉彩色调绘制一幅动漫风格插画，主角是一位害羞的章鱼主题女仆少女，坐在明亮极简主义卧室中一张高床的边缘，采用低角度（low angle）构图，使她 oversized 的厚底鞋占据画面前景，而她的脸则微微向下俯视观者。她是一位娇小的青少年动漫女孩，留着黑色齐耳短发，发梢内侧染成粉色；肤色苍白，眼睛呈慵懒半睁状，神情略带羞涩。她的服装是一套黑白配色、荷叶边装饰的女仆风连衣裙，采用露肩剪裁；配有两条分离式长黑袖，袖口饰有白色滚边；围裙边缘为白色褶边；腿部配有黑色吊袜带、白色及膝袜、蓬松的白色护腿，以及厚底黑色玛丽珍鞋，鞋缘镶有粉色装饰。整体设计中贯穿薄荷青绿色与柔粉色。画面中需精确呈现 7 个可见的章鱼/鱿鱼图案：一枚薄荷青绿色鱿鱼造型发卡戴在女仆头饰上；一枚薄荷青绿色鱿鱼造型发夹；一枚薄荷青绿色鱿鱼徽章位于胸前；一只薄荷青绿色鱿鱼毛绒玩具置于她怀中；一只薄荷青绿色鱿鱼图案印于及膝袜上；一只粉色章鱼徽章贴于鞋面；一只薄荷青绿色鱿鱼图形印在饮品杯上。画面中需精确呈现 4 个可见的蝴蝶结：一枚薄荷青绿色蝴蝶结系于领口；一枚薄荷青绿色蝴蝶结缀于袖口；一枚粉色蝴蝶结位于及膝袜顶端；一枚粉色蝴蝶结系于护腿上。她置身于一间洁净的粉彩房间中：墙壁为浅蓝色，天花板为纯白色，家具为纯白色，床垫为浅蓝色；床边有一张圆形白色边桌，桌身环绕一条粉色环带；桌上放置一只透明饮品杯，杯中有冰块与一根粉色吸管。背景添加柔和的道具：一扇白色门，门上贴有一张形似浅蓝色钥匙孔的海报；一张低矮的白色柜子或书桌，上面堆叠着书籍，另有一件粉色相框装裱的物品。整体风格应为高品质日本动漫角色绘画（Japanese anime character art），线条细腻精致，光线通透轻盈，低对比度，带有光泽高光（glossy highlights），脸颊泛起微妙红晕（subtle blush），赛璐珞着色干净利落（clean cel shading），留白为柔和的纯白色（soft white negative space），整体呈现可爱又具未来感的卡哇伊美学（cute futuristic kawaii aesthetic）。采用竖版 2:3 构图，画面中不得出现文字、水印或额外人物。

2117903200341231620.promptEn:
Goal: Create a bright shoujo manga-style one-page collage showing a cheerful teen idol girl filming social-media selfies on a sunny seaside cafe terrace.

Canvas: Vertical A4 manga page, full color, soft pastel palette, no black panel borders; use six irregular rounded panels separated by thick white gutters, with cute sticker doodles in the margins. High-detail anime illustration, sparkling highlights, airy summer atmosphere, blue sky and ocean visible beyond balcony railings.

Main character: A cute anime girl with cotton-candy pink twin-tail hair, large pink eyes, small flower hair clips, expressive rosy cheeks, and a lively idol-like personality. She wears a translucent lavender sailor-collar blouse with puffy sleeves, a purple bow at the collar, a layered ruffled short skirt, and a large pale-blue waist ribbon tied in a bow. Keep the same character design consistent in every panel.

Layout: Include exactly 6 panels. Panel 1, large upper-left: close-up selfie angle, the girl holds a pink smartphone decorated with white cherry blossoms toward the viewer, smiling with mouth open on a balcony under a blue sky; sun doodle and small sparkles nearby. Panel 2, upper-right: full-body pose, she stands on one leg and winks while holding a selfie stick with the same phone attached, terrace tables and plants behind her, heart and music-note doodles. Panel 3, middle-left: side view at a small cafe table, she leans forward adjusting or checking the phone on a small tabletop tripod; include a lemon drink with straw; add a speech bubble reading よしっ. Panel 4, middle-right: she stands thoughtfully by the balcony with hands near chest, ocean and potted plants behind; add a thought bubble reading うーん... and a small countdown bubble reading 3... 2... 1.... Panel 5, lower-left: close-up three-quarter view, she smiles and holds the phone while raising one finger as if announcing another take; add a red handwritten speech bubble reading もう一枚!, plus tiny beach/palm doodles. Panel 6, lower-right: she sits on the terrace floor or low seat near a table with the lemon drink, winking and making a playful finger pose, ocean view in the background, hearts, flowers, sparkles, and tiny wing doodles.

Visible repeated elements: exactly 6 appearances of the same girl, exactly 3 visible pink smartphone setups or phones held prominently in panels 1, 2, 3, and 5 if partially repeated as the same device; exactly 3 text bubbles with Japanese text plus 1 countdown bubble; include cute doodles such as 3 hearts, 4 flowers, 1 sun, 1 palm tree, 1 music note, 1 winged icon, and small sparkle marks.

Visual style: Highly polished Japanese AI manga illustration, soft watercolor-like lighting, clean line art, pastel lavender and pink color harmony, glossy eyes, delicate fabric transparency and ruffles, warm sunlight, depth of field, cheerful influencer-vlog mood. Avoid realism, avoid dark shadows, avoid extra characters, avoid logos or watermarks.
2117903200341231620.author: あけび

2117903200341231621.promptEn: Create a square digital 3D illustration of a stylized deformed human girl bust portrait on a deep black background. The character is shown from the upper torso up, turned slightly three-quarters to the viewer’s left, with a large head, small chin, short neck, slim shoulders, and a mildly annoyed or unimpressed expression. She has heavy-lidded eyes looking sideways to the left, downturned brows, a tiny nose, and a small closed frown. Her hair is an abstract sculptural bob made of thick rounded ribbon-like masses: one large sweeping bang across the forehead, two puffy side locks, and rounded layered hair volumes behind the ears. Remove natural object-specific colors and render the entire character as smooth matte clay-like forms with luminous gradients instead of outlines: blend hot pink, violet, cyan, soft blue, peach, and mint green across the skin, hair, and clothing so all parts share the same iridescent color language. Dress her in a simple short-sleeve hooded top with a soft rounded hood opening and rolled sleeve cuffs, also made from the same smooth inflated abstract shapes. Use soft studio lighting, subtle ambient occlusion in the creases, velvety subsurface shading, high-quality 3D render detail, and a dreamy toy-sculpture aesthetic. Composition should place the face in the upper center, torso cropped near the lower edge, with generous black negative space and no scenery. Add a small elegant handwritten signature and date in the bottom-right corner reading July 25, 2026 and Oyagi.
2117903200341231621.promptZh: 创建一幅正方形数字3D插画，描绘一位风格化变形的人类少女半身像（仅上躯干以上），背景为深黑色。角色呈略微三分之四角度朝向观者左侧，头大、下巴小、脖颈短、肩部纤细，神情略带不耐烦或不屑。她双眼沉重微眯，目光斜向左方；眉毛下压；鼻头小巧；嘴唇微闭，呈细小的下撇式皱眉。她的发型为抽象雕塑感的波波头，由厚实、圆润、丝带状的体块构成：前额一道宽阔流畅的刘海，两侧各一簇蓬松发束，耳后则为层叠圆润的发量体积。去除所有自然物体固有色，将整具角色渲染为光滑哑光、陶土质感（clay-like）的形体，以发光渐变（luminous gradients）替代轮廓线：在皮肤、头发与服装上融合热粉红（hot pink）、紫罗兰色（violet）、青色（cyan）、柔蓝（soft blue）、蜜桃色（peach）与薄荷绿（mint green），使所有部位共享同一虹彩（iridescent）色彩语言。她身穿一件简约短袖连帽上衣，帽口柔软圆润，袖口卷边，同样由光滑充气式抽象形体构成。采用柔和影棚布光（studio lighting），褶皱处添加细腻环境遮蔽（ambient occlusion），呈现天鹅绒般次表面散射（subsurface shading），高精度3D渲染细节，整体呈现梦幻玩具雕塑（toy-sculpture）美学。构图将面部置于上方中央，躯干于画面底边附近裁切，留出大量黑色负空间，不添加任何场景元素。右下角添加一枚小巧雅致的手写签名与日期，文字为“July 25, 2026”和“Oyagi”。

2117903200341231622.promptEn: Create an ultra-realistic, high-end professional lifestyle portrait of a stylish young African man seated confidently behind a clean white desk in a modern office studio. He is centered in the frame, facing the camera with a calm, confident, approachable expression, his chin resting lightly on one hand. He has warm medium-brown skin, short neat black cropped hair, clear-framed eyeglasses, natural facial features, and smooth professional grooming. Dress him in a textured light blue overshirt or smart casual jacket over a dark charcoal-blue crew-neck shirt, with a silver metal wristwatch and a simple silver ring visible. Place an open silver laptop on the right foreground edge of the white desk, partially cropped, and keep his other hand relaxed on the tabletop. The background is a softly blurred dark gray textured wall with exactly two office decor elements: a small green plant in a white pot on the left rear shelf and a black angled desk lamp glowing warmly on the right. Use premium corporate portrait photography lighting: soft diffused key light from the front, gentle highlights on the face and glasses, subtle shadow depth, shallow depth of field, crisp facial detail, natural skin texture, realistic reflections, 85mm portrait lens look, clean composition, muted cool color palette, no text, no watermark, no extra people.
2117903200341231622.promptZh: 创作一幅超写实、高端专业的时尚生活人像，画面主体是一位风格出众的年轻非洲男性，自信地坐在现代办公摄影棚内一张洁净的白色办公桌后。他居中构图，正对镜头，神情沉稳、自信且平易近人，下颌轻轻 rests在一只手的手背上。他拥有温暖的中等棕色肤色、整齐利落的黑色短发、透明镜框眼镜、自然的面部轮廓，以及精致得体的职业化仪容。身着一件质感丰富的浅蓝色罩衫或商务休闲夹克，内搭深炭灰色圆领衬衫；手腕上佩戴一只银色金属腕表，左手无名指可见一枚简约银戒。白色办公桌右前方边缘放置一台打开的银色笔记本电脑，部分入画并轻微裁切；另一只手自然放松置于桌面。背景为柔和虚化的深灰色肌理墙面，仅包含两件办公装饰元素：左侧后方置物架上摆放一株白色花盆栽种的小型绿色植物，右侧设一盏黑色斜角台灯，散发温暖微光。采用高端企业人像摄影布光：正面柔和漫射主光（soft diffused key light），面部与镜片呈现细腻高光，阴影层次微妙，景深（depth of field）较浅，面部细节锐利清晰，皮肤纹理真实自然，反光效果逼真，呈现85mm人像镜头（85mm portrait lens）视觉风格，构图简洁干净，整体采用低饱和冷色调配色方案，画面中不含文字、无水印、无人物以外的其他人物。
2117903200341231622.author: Abkr Sadiq

2117903200341231623.promptEn: Create a photorealistic low-angle summer street photo of a startled black cat standing directly under a vintage Japanese hand-cranked shaved-ice machine, with a mound of bright white crushed ice piling on the cat’s head like a snowy hat while ice flakes spray and fall around its face. The cat has wide green-yellow eyes, an open tiny mouth with small fangs visible, wet whiskers, and a red collar with a small gold bell. The shaved-ice machine is tall, weathered, and painted teal-blue, with ornate metal legs framing the cat, a large circular crank wheel on the upper right, and a cylindrical ice-shaving drum above the cat. At the top of the machine is a decorative sign with the red kanji 氷 surrounded by blue wave motifs and small red flowers. On the left side in the background, include exactly 1 hanging fabric banner angled in the breeze, printed vertically with かき氷 in red and blue wave graphics near the bottom. Set the scene outdoors under a vivid blue sky with scattered fluffy white clouds, strong midday sunlight, crisp shadows, sparkling ice particles, realistic fur detail, shallow depth of field, and a humorous candid snapshot feeling. Use a square 1:1 composition, the cat centered in the lower half, the shaved-ice machine towering above it, no extra animals, no extra people, and no watermark.
2117903200341231623.promptZh: 创作一张照片级写实（photorealistic）的低角度夏日街景照片：一只受惊的黑猫正直立站在一台复古日本手摇刨冰机正下方，一大团亮白色的碎冰堆在猫头上，宛如一顶雪帽，同时冰屑向四周喷溅并飘落在猫脸周围。猫的眼睛睁得很大，呈黄绿色，微张着小嘴，露出细小的獠牙，胡须湿润，颈上系着一条红色项圈，挂着一枚小巧的金色铃铛。刨冰机高大、饱经风霜，通体漆成青绿色（teal-blue），繁复的金属支架将猫框于其中；右上方装有一个大型圆形手摇轮，猫正上方则是一个圆柱形刨冰滚筒。机器顶端有一块装饰性标牌，中央为红色汉字“氷”，四周环绕蓝色波浪纹样与几朵小型红色花朵。背景左侧远处，需恰好出现1条悬垂布质横幅，随微风轻斜，其上竖排印有红色日文“かき氷”，底部配有蓝色波浪图形。场景设定于户外，天空湛蓝明丽，点缀着几朵蓬松的白色云朵；正午阳光强烈，阴影清晰锐利，冰粒熠熠生辉；猫毛细节高度真实；景深（depth of field）浅；整体呈现幽默而自然的抓拍快照感。采用正方形1:1构图，猫位于画面下半部分中央，刨冰机高耸于猫上方；画面中不得出现额外动物、额外人物，亦不得添加水印。
2117903200341231623.author: カーブミラー

2117903200341231624.promptEn:
Goal: Create a realistic vertical mobile-night-photography triptych of the same young woman during a late-night city walk, with the feeling of three consecutive casual snapshots captured on a phone.

Canvas: A tall vertical 9:16 image divided into exactly 3 equal horizontal photo panels stacked top to bottom, edge-to-edge with no captions, borders, logos, or watermark.

Subject: The same young East Asian woman in her early 20s with long loose dark brown hair, natural makeup, soft smile, slim build appears in all 3 panels. She wears a fitted gray sleeveless tank top, loose light blue jeans, and a small black leather shoulder bag with thin straps. Keep her face consistent across all panels.

Setting: Late-night urban sidewalk beside a glossy white rectangular-tile wall on the right, with a quiet road, crosswalk markings, metal poles, railings, glass reflections, distant apartment windows, traffic lights, and streetlights on the left. Use mixed cool and warm street lighting, reflective white tiles, wet-looking highlights, and soft city bokeh in the background.

Panel count and poses: Use exactly 3 panels. Panel 1, top: medium shot from behind and slightly to the side as she walks along the sidewalk, turning her head back over her shoulder toward the camera with a gentle smile. Panel 2, middle: closer portrait, she faces the camera and reaches one open hand toward the lens to block it playfully; the hand is large and motion-blurred in the foreground while her smiling face remains visible behind it. Panel 3, bottom: seated crouching pose beside the tiled wall, knees bent, one elbow resting on her knee and cheek leaning on her hand, looking up at the camera with a relaxed affectionate smile; black shoulder bag visible near her side.

Camera and style: Hyper-realistic candid smartphone night mode photography, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, 28mm wide-angle mobile lens feel, slight handheld perspective, high ISO but clean, realistic motion blur only on the reaching hand, cinematic urban lighting, soft highlights on hair and tiles, muted gray-blue night palette with warm amber reflections.

Constraints: Keep the scene text-free. Do not add extra people. Do not change clothing between panels. Maintain believable anatomy, consistent facial identity, and realistic phone-photo composition.
2117903200341231624.promptZh:
目标：创作一幅写实风格的竖版手机夜间摄影三联画，描绘同一位年轻女性深夜在城市街道上漫步的场景，呈现用手机拍摄的三张连续、随意快照的感觉。

画布：一幅高竖向 9:16 比例图像，精确划分为自上而下堆叠的 3 个等高水平照片面板，面板之间无缝拼接，无文字说明、边框、标志或水印。

主体：同一位二十出头的东亚年轻女性，留着长而松散的深棕色头发，妆容自然，面带柔和微笑，身材纤细；她在全部 3 个面板中均出现。她身穿合身的灰色无袖背心、宽松的浅蓝色牛仔裤，肩挎一只小型黑色皮革单肩包，包带纤细。确保她在所有面板中的面部特征保持一致。

场景：深夜的城市人行道，右侧为光洁的白色矩形瓷砖墙面，左侧为安静的道路、斑马线标记、金属灯杆、栏杆、玻璃反光、远处公寓窗户、交通信号灯及路灯。采用冷暖混合的街道照明、具反射性的白色瓷砖、呈湿润感的高光，以及背景中柔和的城市焦外虚化（bokeh）。

面板数量与姿态：严格使用 3 个面板。  
面板 1（顶部）：中景，从后方略偏侧角度拍摄，她沿人行道行走，同时将头微微转回肩后望向镜头，面带轻柔微笑。  
面板 2（中部）：更近的肖像构图，她正对镜头，伸出一只张开的手掌朝向镜头，俏皮地遮挡镜头；手掌位于前景，尺寸较大且带有运动模糊（motion blur），而她微笑的面容仍清晰可见于手掌后方。  
面板 3（底部）：倚靠瓷砖墙边的蹲坐姿态，双膝弯曲，一只肘部支在膝上，脸颊轻靠手背，仰头望向镜头，面带放松而深情的微笑；黑色单肩包可见于她身侧。

相机与风格：超写实（hyper-realistic）抓拍风格的智能手机夜景模式摄影，呈现自然的皮肤质感、浅景深（depth of field）、28mm 广角（wide-angle）移动设备镜头观感、轻微手持视角、高 ISO 但画面干净，仅在伸向镜头的手部呈现真实的运动模糊（motion blur），电影感布光（cinematic lighting）、发丝与瓷砖上的柔和高光、以灰蓝色为主调的静谧夜色配色，辅以琥珀色暖调反光。

限制条件：画面全程不添加任何文字。不得添加额外人物。各面板中服装不得更改。须保持解剖结构可信、面部身份一致，以及符合真实手机摄影的构图逻辑。

2117903200341231625.promptEn: Create a cinematic, realistic anime-style night scene at a Japanese summer shrine festival. In the foreground left, show a young woman in profile from the waist up, wearing a dark navy yukata with pale purple bellflower floral patterns and a large obi bow at the back; her dark hair is pinned in a loose bun with delicate hair ornaments, and she gazes upward with parted lips, softly illuminated by fireworks. In the foreground right, show a young man in a dark casual yukata or festival shirt, turned partly away but looking back toward the woman; he has tousled black hair and wears a tilted fox festival mask on the side/top of his head. Above them, one large golden firework blooms in the deep blue-black sky, with fine sparkling trails and faint smoke. The background is a wet stone shrine approach receding into the distance, reflecting red and warm lantern lights, with a torii gate centered far back, small festival stalls and tiny figures along the path, dark trees on both sides, and a quiet romantic mood after leaving the busy festival. Use dramatic backlighting, moody shadows, shallow depth of field, highly detailed fabric texture, realistic faces, painterly cinematic rendering, vertical 4:5 composition, no text, no watermark. Key customizable details: dark navy, pale purple bellflowers, fox festival mask, golden, Japanese shrine festival at night.
2117903200341231625.promptZh: 创作一幅电影感（cinematic）、写实风格的动漫风日本夏日神社祭典夜景。前景左侧，以腰部以上侧面像呈现一位年轻女性，身穿深藏青色浴衣，上面印有淡紫色紫苑花图案，背后系着一个大型腰带蝴蝶结；她将乌黑长发松松挽成发髻，配以精致发饰，微微仰头、轻启双唇，面容被烟花柔光轻柔照亮。前景右侧，呈现一位身着深色休闲浴衣或祭典衬衫的年轻男性，身体略侧向后方，但回头望向女子；他头发微乱、乌黑，头顶一侧斜戴着一只狐狸造型祭典面具。他们上方，一枚硕大的金色烟花在深蓝近黑的夜空中盛放，拖曳出细腻闪烁的光痕，并伴有淡淡烟霭。背景为一条湿漉漉的石砌神社参道，向远方纵深延伸，倒映着红暖色灯笼光芒；远处中央矗立一座鸟居，参道两侧分布着小型祭典摊位与微小人影，两旁是幽暗树木，整体氛围宁静而浪漫，仿佛刚从喧闹祭典中悄然离开。采用戏剧性逆光（dramatic backlighting）、情绪化阴影（moody shadows）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、高度精细的织物纹理（highly detailed fabric texture）、写实人脸（realistic faces）、富有绘画感的电影级渲染（painterly cinematic rendering）、竖构图 4:5 比例，画面中无文字、无水印。可定制关键细节：深藏青色、淡紫色紫苑花、狐狸造型祭典面具、金色、日本神社夜间祭典。
