2117903200341231681.promptEn:
Goal: Create a polished 3D scientific educational infographic titled DNA Nucleotides, showing a close-up view of a DNA double helix with labeled nucleotide bases and molecular structure.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 composition, bright white laboratory-style background with soft depth-of-field molecular clusters in pale blue, lavender, mint, and purple around the edges. Use a clean, high-resolution textbook/medical visualization style with realistic glossy translucent spheres and rods, soft shadows, and shallow depth of field.

Layout: Center the title at the top in large dark navy bold type, with the subtitle A close-up view of the DNA double helix directly beneath in smaller medium-blue type. Fill the frame with a large twisting DNA double helix running from the left foreground through the center to the right side, with a second orange strand crossing diagonally through the lower right foreground. Keep the central base-pair region open and readable for labels.

Subject details: Render the DNA as a molecular ball-and-stick model combined with translucent bead-like backbone surfaces. The sugar-phosphate backbone should be two twisting chains made of semi-transparent bluish-gray spheres with orange/gold connector rods and small red atoms. In the center, show exactly 4 labeled nucleotide bases: Adenine (A) in green at upper left center, Thymine (T) in purple at upper right center, Guanine (G) in blue at lower left center, and Cytosine (C) in orange at lower right center. Adenine pairs with Thymine across the top using dotted pale blue hydrogen bonds, and Guanine pairs with Cytosine below using three dotted pale blue hydrogen-bond rows. Molecular rings should be flat aromatic ring structures with small colored atom spheres and white hydrogen atoms.

Text content and labels: Include exactly 7 callout labels with thin black pointer lines: “Adenine (A)” in green pointing to the green upper-left base; “Thymine (T)” in purple pointing to the purple upper-right base; “Guanine (G)” in blue pointing to the blue lower-left base; “Cytosine (C)” in orange pointing to the orange lower-right base; “Sugar-phosphate backbone” in black pointing to the right-side helical backbone; “Hydrogen bonds” in black pointing to the dotted bond lines between base pairs; and “Emerging RNA” in orange pointing to the orange strand crossing the lower foreground. Use crisp sans-serif typography and avoid crowding.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed scientific 3D render, glossy translucent molecular beads, realistic refraction, soft bokeh background, professional biology textbook infographic, balanced educational clarity and cinematic depth.

Constraints: Use exactly the 4 nucleotide labels and exactly the 3 structural labels listed above; do not add extra labels, icons, captions, legends, watermarks, or borders. Keep all text sharp and correctly spelled.
2117903200341231681.author: wren

2117903200341231682.promptEn: Create a wide cinematic gothic anime illustration of exactly one melancholic young woman, unnamed gothic girl, sitting alone on a rough concrete staircase in a ruined urban setting. She has messy black short wavy bob hair with heavy bangs partly covering her eyes, pale skin, a distant downcast expression, and a slightly slouched seated pose with her knees bent and hands resting near her lap. Her outfit is a dramatic layered gothic dress: one black off-shoulder bodice, one voluminous white skirt covered in black ink-like splatter patterns, black ruffled trim, black stockings, and exactly two oversized glossy black lace-up combat boots in the foreground; add a few sharp deep red ribbon-like streaks on the dress for contrast. The environment contains exactly one long diagonal concrete staircase filling the lower half of the frame, stained walls behind her, abstract ruined architectural silhouettes, heavy rain-washed grime, dripping black paint, and explosive ink splashes across the left and upper right areas. Use a mostly monochrome palette of black, white, and gray with only small red accents, high-contrast grunge textures, watercolor wash, charcoal sketch lines, splattered sumi-e ink, distressed paper grain, and dramatic moody lighting. Compose her in the upper-right third, with the staircase receding diagonally from lower left to upper right, shallow depth of field on the nearest stair edge, and a bleak atmospheric feeling of isolation. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.
2117903200341231682.promptZh: 创作一幅宽幅电影感（cinematic）哥特风动漫插画，画面中仅有且恰好一位忧郁的年轻女子，一位无名的哥特少女，独自坐在一处废弃城市环境中粗糙的混凝土楼梯上。她拥有一头凌乱的黑色短波浪齐耳发（bob hair），厚重的刘海部分遮住双眼；肤色苍白；神情恍惚、目光低垂；坐姿略显松垮，双膝弯曲，双手置于近膝部的腿上。她的服饰是一套富有戏剧性的层叠式哥特裙装：一件黑色单肩紧身胸衣（off-shoulder bodice）；一条蓬松的白色裙摆，其上布满如黑色墨迹般的泼溅图案；裙边饰有黑色荷叶边；穿着黑色连裤袜；前景中恰好出现两双超大号、高光泽、黑色系带战斗靴（combat boots）；裙装上添加数道尖锐而浓烈的深红色丝带状色带，以形成视觉对比。环境包含恰好一条长长的对角线走向混凝土楼梯，占据画面下半部分；她身后是污渍斑驳的墙壁；抽象化的损毁建筑剪影；厚重的雨水冲刷后的污垢；滴落的黑色颜料；以及在画面左侧与右上方区域爆发式飞溅的墨点。整体采用以黑、白、灰为主的单色系配色方案，仅含少量红色点缀；高对比度的粗粝质感（grunge textures）；水彩晕染（watercolor wash）；炭笔速写线条（charcoal sketch lines）；泼洒式水墨（splattered sumi-e ink）；做旧纸张纹理（distressed paper grain）；以及富于戏剧性的阴郁光影（dramatic moody lighting）。构图上，将人物置于画面右上三分之一处；楼梯呈对角线从左下方向右上方延伸；最近一级楼梯边缘使用浅景深（shallow depth of field）；整体氛围 bleak，传递出强烈的孤独感与疏离感。画面中不出现文字、无水印、无额外人物。
2117903200341231682.author: nema

2117903200341231683.promptEn: Create a monochrome manga-style illustration in a wide 16:9 frame. A young Japanese woman with short straight black bob with bangs sits centered at a cluttered wooden desk, facing the viewer while writing on a document with a pen in her right hand. She wears a loose light work jacket over a plain T-shirt and has a quiet, serious, slightly worried expression, with large detailed anime eyes and soft facial features. The scene is an office or storage room filled with moving boxes and paperwork: show exactly 16 cardboard boxes visible in the background and foreground, arranged as stacks on both left and right sides; exactly 2 black metal storage trunks with silver corner protectors and latches, one on the left and one on the right; exactly 5 loose paper sheets on the desk around the main document; and exactly 2 tall paper stacks, one on each side near the foreground. Behind her is a large bright window with simple rectangular trim, mostly blank white light. Use clean black-and-white manga line art, screentone shading, fine hatching, crisp ink outlines, detailed hair highlights, realistic desk perspective, and a calm cinematic composition. Keep the image text-free except for faint illegible handwriting lines on the papers. No color, no watermark, no speech bubbles.
2117903200341231683.promptZh: 以宽幅16:9画幅创作一幅单色漫画风格（manga-style）插画。一位年轻的日本女性坐在杂乱的木质办公桌前，居中构图，面向观者，右手持笔正在文件上书写。她留着齐刘海的黑色直短发（齐耳短发），身穿宽松浅色工装夹克，内搭纯色T恤，神情安静、严肃，略带忧虑，拥有大而细致的动漫风格眼睛（anime eyes）和柔和的面部轮廓。场景为一间办公室或储藏室，堆满搬家纸箱与文件资料：背景与前景中须清晰呈现共16个纸板箱，左右两侧分别堆叠摆放；左右两侧各放置1个黑色金属储物箱（black metal storage trunk），箱体配有银色包角（silver corner protectors）与搭扣（latches），共2个；桌面上主文件周围散落5张零散纸张；前景左右两侧各立起1叠高纸堆（tall paper stack），共2叠。她身后是一扇大型明亮窗户，窗框为简洁的矩形结构，大部分区域为纯白空白光效。采用干净利落的黑白漫画线稿（manga line art）、网点 shading（screentone shading）、精细排线（fine hatching）、清晰墨线轮廓（crisp ink outlines）、细致的发丝高光（detailed hair highlights）、写实的桌面透视（realistic desk perspective）以及沉静的电影感构图（cinematic composition）。画面除纸张上隐约可见、无法辨识的潦草手写线条（faint illegible handwriting lines）外，不添加任何文字。禁用彩色、禁用水印、禁用对话框（speech bubbles）。
2117903200341231683.author: 粕谷 謙一｜DaVinci認定トレーナー×AI活用

2117903200341231684.promptEn:
Goal: Create a dark cinematic presentation board for a worldbuilding / image-generation workflow, showing how a consistent fantasy character, locations, and props are built image by image.

Canvas: Wide 4:3 composition on a nearly black background with rounded rectangular cards arranged in a clean grid, soft gaps, subtle shadows, and a muted premium UI feel.

Layout: Use exactly 6 visible cards. Card 1 is a tall text card on the upper left. Card 2 is a large wide character card on the upper right. Cards 3 and 4 are two medium landscape location cards across the middle row. Cards 5 and 6 are two smaller prop cards along the lower left and lower center, with a third lower-right character card partially visible/cropped at the edge if the canvas framing allows. Each image card has a small dark pill label in the top-left corner.

Text content: On the upper-left text card, include small spaced uppercase text “ONE WORLD” near the top. In the lower half, include the headline “Built image by image” and the body text “A character, her locations, and the props she carries — generated separately, holding one look.” Use clean modern sans-serif typography, white headline, muted gray body text.

Visible labeled image cards: 5 fully visible labeled image cards plus 1 text card. The labels are: 2 cards labeled “Character,” 2 cards labeled “Location,” and 2 cards labeled “Prop” if the lower-right crop is included; otherwise keep the main visible set as 1 Character, 2 Location, and 2 Prop. Do not add extra labels.

Subject details: The main character is a pale young blonde medieval archer girl with braided hair, serious expression, wool cloak and leather quiver of arrows. Place her in a snowy stone castle courtyard, holding a long wooden bow, with cold blue-gray lighting and shallow cinematic depth of field. The locations show a grim Nordic medieval winter world: one frozen harbor with Viking-style longships trapped in ice, torchlight, mountains and snow; one fortified snowy military camp with tents, wooden palisades, watchtowers, smoke rising, and stormy clouds. The props show exactly 2 close-up items: a weathered leather pouch or wrist guard marked with pale runic symbols and small bones, and a row of antler or horn pieces in snow with blurred background.

Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic dark fantasy, desaturated blue-gray winter palette, falling snow, realistic textures, high detail, moody natural lighting, consistent medieval wardrobe and materials across all cards. Rounded card corners, elegant spacing, no bright colors.

Constraints: Keep the interface minimal and editorial, like a premium AI image-generation case study. Preserve the exact headline and body copy. Avoid logos, watermarks, charts, anime style, modern objects, or extra UI clutter.
2117903200341231684.author: 宮本 達朗@中小企業向けのAI活用・DX伴走

2117903200341231685.promptEn: Photorealistic cinematic studio portrait of a young woman with fair skin, long wavy diamond hair parted precisely in the center, striking pale blue eyes, subtle natural freckles and realistic skin texture, neutral calm expression, looking directly into the camera. She wears a simple oversized white crew-neck sweatshirt. Framed as a centered head-and-shoulders to upper-torso portrait, symmetrical composition, eye-level camera, 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field. Dark navy-blue studio background with a soft blue glow behind her, dramatic two-tone lighting: warm orange/amber rim light from the left side illuminating her hair and cheek, cool blue fill light from the right, creating a cinematic orange-and-blue color contrast. Soft diffused key light, realistic hair strands, natural facial proportions, extremely detailed skin, subtle shadows, professional editorial photography, high dynamic range, crisp focus on the eyes, soft background bokeh, moody atmospheric lighting, ultra-photorealistic, 4K.
2117903200341231685.promptZh: 照片级写实（photorealistic）电影感（cinematic）影棚人像，一位肤色白皙的年轻女性，长而波浪状的钻石发色（diamond hair），中分， striking pale blue eyes（ striking pale blue eyes），自然淡雅的雀斑与真实肌肤纹理，神情中性而平静，直视镜头。她身穿一件简约 oversized 白色圆领卫衣。构图为居中构图的头部至肩部、略带胸部上半身人像，对称式构图，平视视角相机，85mm 人像镜头，浅景深（shallow depth of field）。深海军蓝影棚背景，其后泛出柔和蓝色光晕；戏剧性双色布光：左侧暖橙色/琥珀色轮廓光（rim light）照亮她的发丝与脸颊，右侧冷蓝色补光（fill light），营造电影感橙蓝色彩对比。柔光漫射主光（key light），真实发丝细节，自然面部比例，极致精细的肌肤表现，细腻阴影，专业杂志级摄影（professional editorial photography），高动态范围（HDR），双眼锐利清晰对焦（crisp focus on the eyes），背景焦外虚化（bokeh），情绪化氛围布光（moody atmospheric lighting），超照片级写实（ultra-photorealistic），4K。

2117903200341231686.promptEn: Create a realistic vertical 3:4 mirror selfie in a softly lit minimalist bathroom. A young woman with fair skin poses naturally while holding a dark smartphone up in front of her face to photograph her reflection, smiling subtly and looking toward the phone screen. She has a wavy dark brown high ponytail tied with a black bow, wispy face-framing bangs, and tortoiseshell sunglasses resting on top of her head. Her outfit has exactly 5 visible fashion elements: 1) cream ribbed V-neck knit sweater vest, 2) crisp white collared button-up shirt underneath with slightly puffed rolled sleeves, 3) beige pleated mini skirt, 4) slim brown leather wristwatch on her phone-holding wrist, 5) slim brown leather wristwatch on her crossed arm. Use a warm neutral color palette and cozy academia / soft preppy styling. The bathroom background should include exactly 2 decor items: 1) a neatly folded white towel on a ledge behind her, 2) a small green potted plant in a simple white pot on the stone counter. Use beige stone tiles, clean modern lines, soft diffused daylight from the side, shallow depth of field, phone-camera realism, editorial soft-glam retouching, natural skin texture, gentle highlights, no harsh flash, no text, no watermark. Customize: dark brown, cream, beige, dark charcoal, warm beige.
2117903200341231686.promptZh: 创建一幅写实的竖构图3:4镜面自拍，场景为柔和照明的极简主义浴室。一位肤色白皙的年轻女性自然摆姿，双手持一部深色智能手机置于面前，拍摄自己在镜中的倒影；她微微微笑，目光望向手机屏幕。她留着波浪状深棕色高马尾，以黑色蝴蝶结束发，额前有轻盈飘逸的修饰脸型的刘海，玳瑁色太阳镜搁在头顶。她的穿搭包含恰好5个可见的时尚元素：1）米色罗纹V领针织背心，2）内搭一件挺括的白色立领衬衫，袖口微蓬并向上卷至小臂，3）米色百褶迷你裙，4）一只纤细的棕色皮革腕表戴在持手机的手腕上，5）另一只纤细的棕色皮革腕表戴在交叠于身前的手臂上。采用暖调中性色彩方案，风格融合舒适学院风（cozy academia）与柔和预科生风（soft preppy）。浴室背景中须包含恰好2件装饰物品：1）一条叠放整齐的白色毛巾置于她身后的置物架上，2）一株小型绿色盆栽，盛于素雅白色陶盆中，摆放在石质台面上。使用米色石材瓷砖、简洁现代的线条、来自侧方的柔和漫射日光、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、手机摄像头真实感（phone-camera realism）、杂志级柔光华丽修图（editorial soft-glam retouching）、自然肌肤纹理（natural skin texture）、柔和高光（gentle highlights）、无强烈闪光（no harsh flash）、无文字（no text）、无水印（no watermark）。定制配色：深棕色、米色、米 beige、深炭灰色、暖米 beige。

2117903200341231687.promptEn: Create a cinematic photorealistic fantasy portrait of a proud anthropomorphic hamster warrior general standing on a rocky cliff at sunset. The hamster is chubby and golden-brown with a cream belly, realistic soft fur, tiny rounded ears, long whiskers, small dark confident eyes, and a smug satisfied smile. It stands upright in a heroic low-angle composition with both small arms crossed over its chest, looking slightly upward and to the right as if surveying a battlefield. Dress it in ornate ancient warlord armor: two dark bronze shoulder pauldrons with gold trim and swirling engraved patterns, layered leather/metal chest details, a red scarf at the neck, and a dark crimson cape hanging behind the left side. The setting is an epic mountain overlook with rugged rocks in the foreground and distant hazy mountains. The sky is filled with dramatic orange-gold sunset clouds, with the sun low near the right horizon creating warm rim light around the hamster’s fur and armor. Use ultra-detailed CGI realism, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, warm color grading, heroic fantasy movie atmosphere, no text, no watermark. Optional subject customization: anthropomorphic hamster warrior general, ornate ancient bronze warlord armor, dark crimson, arms crossed with a smug proud smile, rocky mountain cliff at golden sunset.
2117903200341231687.promptZh: 创作一幅电影感（cinematic）照片级写实（photorealistic）奇幻肖像画：一位骄傲的拟人化仓鼠战士将军，伫立于日落时分的嶙峋悬崖之上。这只仓鼠体态圆润，毛色为金棕色，腹部呈奶油色，毛发逼真柔软，双耳小巧浑圆，胡须细长，双眼乌黑而神采自信，嘴角挂着一丝自得而满足的微笑。采用英雄式低角度构图（heroic low-angle composition），仓鼠直立而立，双臂微小却有力地交叉于胸前，目光微微上扬并略偏右方，仿佛正在俯瞰一片战场。为其穿戴繁复华丽的古代军阀铠甲：两肩各配一副深青铜色护肩（pauldrons），边缘饰以金色镶边与漩涡状浮雕纹样；胸甲由层叠的皮革与金属细节构成；颈间系一条红色围巾；左后方垂落一袭深绯红色披风（dark crimson cape）。场景设定为气势恢宏的山巅观景台——前景是粗粝嶙峋的岩石，远景则为朦胧起伏的群山。天空布满戏剧性的橙金色日落云霞，太阳低悬于画面右侧地平线附近，为仓鼠的毛发与铠甲勾勒出温暖的轮廓光（rim light）。整体采用超精细CGI写实风格、电影感布光（cinematic lighting）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、暖色调调色（warm color grading）、英雄式奇幻电影氛围（heroic fantasy movie atmosphere），画面中不含文字、无水印。可选主体定制项：拟人化仓鼠战士将军、繁复华丽的古代青铜军阀铠甲、深绯红色、双臂交叉并面带自得骄傲的微笑、金色日落下的岩石山崖。

2117903200341231688.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cute LINE sticker sheet featuring a chibi cat-eared girl and a small penguin mascot, arranged as nine separate transparent-style stickers on a clean white background.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, high resolution, white background, sticker-pack preview layout with a 3 by 3 grid. Each sticker has soft pastel colors, thick clean outlines, subtle white sticker edging, tiny sparkles or hearts, and rounded kawaii proportions.

Character details: The main character is a small chibi anime girl with fluffy long white hair with pale pink tips, cat ears, large blue eyes, a cozy oversized blue hoodie, short skirt or shorts, and small shoes. She appears with a round dark-blue penguin mascot with a white face and yellow beak/feet. Expressions are cheerful, shy, apologetic, excited, sleepy, and affectionate.

Sticker count and labels: Include exactly 9 discrete stickers, each with handwritten Japanese text in bright pastel colors above or near the characters:
1. Top left: Girl waving happily beside penguin, text 「おはよ〜」 in yellow-orange.
2. Top center: Girl bowing or nodding with penguin at her side, text 「ありがとう！」 in orange.
3. Top right: Girl hugging or holding penguin close, text 「なかよくしよ」 in blue.

8. Bottom center: Girl lying or sitting cozily under a blue blanket with penguin, text 「おやすみ〜」 in purple.
9. Bottom right: Girl jumping excitedly with penguin, text 「またね！」 in orange.

Visual style: Polished Japanese kawaii LINE sticker style, soft watercolor-like shading, pastel blue and pink palette, expressive faces, playful hand-lettering, compact sticker compositions, no background scenery.

Constraints: Keep all nine stickers clearly separated and evenly spaced in a 3x3 grid. Preserve the Japanese text exactly as written. Do not add extra stickers, captions, logos, watermark, borders, or UI elements.

2117903200341231689.promptEn:

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, glossy high-saturation idol-variety-show design, no borders, full-bleed background. Use sparkling lights, lens flares, confetti-like glints, pastel pink, cyan, purple, and yellow.

She has soft ash-blonde/light brown bobbed hair with side bun braids, flower hair clips, pale skin, large sparkling blue eyes, rosy cheeks, and a surprised excited open-mouth expression with one sweat drop. She wears a loose pastel hoodie in blue, lavender, and pink with subtle star patterns. Text elements: Add a comic burst speech bubble on the left side reading 「レア景品だけ 引き当てられる!?」 in bold hot-pink Japanese text with yellow outline. Add a bottom broadcast banner: left marquee block reading 「新番組」 in yellow on pink lights, and large text across the bottom reading 「今夜8時スタート！」 with the number 8 oversized in yellow/orange, blue and pink supporting text, white outlines, and strong drop shadows.

Visual style: Polished modern anime illustration, glossy promotional key visual, cute idol TV-show aesthetic, extremely sparkly, soft gradients, rim lighting, clean line art, detailed eyes, high contrast and high readability. Keep all visible text in Japanese exactly as specified. Avoid extra logos, watermarks, or unrelated characters.

2117903200341231690.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vertical celebratory 4-panel anime manga illustration about a cute moon-themed princess reacting to a video view count milestone.

Canvas: Tall vertical webcomic format, about 9:16 aspect ratio, with four stacked rectangular panels separated by thick dark borders. Use bright, polished gpt-image-2 style anime rendering, clean line art, soft gradients, expressive chibi proportions, and energetic manga effects.

Main character: A small chibi anime princess with short bobbed blue-purple hair, large sparkling blue eyes with star highlights, rosy cheeks, and a gold tiara topped with a blue heart gem. She wears a royal purple-blue winter princess outfit: cape/robe with gold trim and star patterns, fluffy white fur collar and cuffs, decorative bow at the chest, layered white skirt, black thigh-high socks, and blue shoes. Keep her design consistent across all four panels.

Panel count and layout: Use exactly 4 panels.
1. Top panel: Cozy room at night with a window showing a red moon in a starry sky, purple curtains, snowflake decorations, a mug on the desk, a smartphone in the character’s hand, and a purple book/card on the right. The character looks curious and thoughtful while checking the phone. Add one large round speech bubble on the left containing the text RED MOON\n再生数\nいくつかな？. Include a small purple question mark near the right side.
2. Second panel: Extreme close-up of the character’s surprised face, mouth open, eyes wide, with a purple radial speed-line background. Add exactly one jagged speech bubble on the left containing え!?!?. Add one yellow surprise sparkle near the bubble.
3. Third panel: The character is seated or bouncing in shock, both hands raised, mouth open, small blue sweat-drop marks near her head, red/pink radial burst background. Add exactly one large jagged speech bubble occupying the left half, with huge bold red milestone text 1.2万\n再生ええええ; make the number the largest element in the panel.
4. Bottom panel: Full-body joyful celebration pose, the character leaps forward with both arms spread wide, eyes closed in a huge smile. Background shows the large red moon outside the broken-looking panel frame, confetti, sparkles, snowflakes, paper shards, and energetic celebratory lines. Add exactly one large cloud-shaped speech bubble in the lower-left containing oversized bold red text ありがとうー！.

Visual style: Cute Japanese anime/manga chibi illustration, saturated purples and reds, glossy highlights, soft blush, dynamic comic motion lines, festive atmosphere, crisp outlines, high-detail clothing ornaments, playful celebratory tone.

Constraints: Preserve exactly four panels and exactly four main speech bubbles, one per panel. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, or unrelated text. Keep all visible text large, legible, and integrated into manga-style bubbles.

2117903200341231691.promptEn:

She wears a simple white camisole. Her expression is calm, fresh, and natural, looking toward the camera.

Place one amber glass skincare bottle on the right foreground with a gold label reading “VITAMIN C SERUM” and smaller text “BRIGHTENING & GLOW BOOSTING” plus “30ml e 1.01 fl.oz.” Include exactly 2 visible orange elements in this panel: 1 large cut orange half in the lower-left foreground and 1 whole/partial orange behind the bottle on the right. Place one amber dropper bottle on a small clear glass pedestal at the left foreground, with the white dropper top visible and the same gold “VITAMIN C SERUM” label. Include exactly 5 visible orange elements in this panel: 1 whole orange on the far left, 1 cut orange half/slice at the lower left, 1 orange wedge near the center foreground, 1 large cut orange slice in the lower-right foreground, and 1 whole/partial orange on the far right. Add a few green leaves around the oranges and warm bokeh highlights in the background.

2117903200341231692.promptEn:
Goal: Create a bold experimental product poster for a design-object announcement, combining an extreme cropped typography background with a thermal receipt layout overlay.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, off-white outer margin around a saturated hot-pink rectangular field. Use a clean print-design composition with slight risograph/thermal-paper grain and subtly imperfect ink edges.

Layout: Place one huge cream-white uppercase background title reading TABLE LAMP, spanning nearly the full width across the upper third; crop the letters heavily at the left and right edges so the title feels oversized and partially hidden. Center-right, overlay exactly one tall narrow cream thermal receipt running from near the top to near the bottom, with zigzag torn edges at the top and bottom. Add one thin vertical microtext line beside the receipt, rotated 90 degrees, reading like an archive/design ID. Along the bottom of the pink field place exactly two separate cream barcode blocks, one at bottom left and one at bottom right. The receipt itself contains exactly one black barcode near its bottom.

Receipt details: The receipt header has a large condensed black title TABLE LAMP. Under it, include the subtitle “AESTHETICS, SWITCHED ON”. Fill the receipt with monospaced thermal-printer text, dashed divider lines, and pseudo-transaction metadata. Include design-spec lines such as design registration number, date, time, terminal, transaction, attendant, product, object type, form study, material study, surface finish, light quality, curve ratio, form revision, assembly check, aesthetic value, archive index, subtotal, tax, payment method, authorization, thank-you note, return policy, and “KEEP THIS LIGHT RECEIPT”. Highlight exactly one line in a translucent pink marker strip: “GRAND TOTAL--BEAUTY, SWITCHED ON”.

Subject image on receipt: At the lower half of the receipt, print exactly one cute glossy flower-shaped table lamp illustration with a pink fluted pedestal stem, six rounded pink petals, a blue inner glow, a small orange-red circular center, and a thin pale power cord trailing left. Keep it centered above the receipt barcode.

Typography and style: Use condensed bold sans-serif for the massive background title, monospaced receipt type for all receipt text, black ink on warm cream paper, and a fashionable editorial graphic-design aesthetic. Main colors are hot pink, cream white, black, soft pink, blue, and orange-red. The image should feel like a modern poster generated from the structural idea of a thermal-paper receipt, not a realistic store receipt photo.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 visible barcodes total: 2 large background barcode blocks and 1 receipt barcode. Use exactly 1 receipt, exactly 1 product illustration, and exactly 1 highlighted grand-total line. Do not add people, logos, watermarks, QR codes, extra products, or extra receipts.

2117903200341231693.promptEn:

Use exactly 5 frames: two equal panels across the top row, one wide panoramic panel spanning the full middle row, and two equal panels across the bottom row. 他将一柄直剑垂直高举向天，剑身化作一道刺目耀眼的金白色能量光束的中轴线，劈开苍穹之上一扇巨硕的天门或石质巨门。

裂隙四周环绕着剧烈迸发的闪电、弧形等离子体、飞溅火花、扬起尘雾、炽亮裂痕，以及悬浮半空的碎裂岩块；画面中可见的主要元素计为：1 名剑客、1 把高举之剑、1 条中央光束、2 片分离的门扇，以及大量散落的碎片残骸。

2117903200341231698.promptEn: Mid-century theatrical cartoon still promotional Hollywood movie trailer banner featuring a daring adventurer with tousled brown hair and a confident smile, wearing an open safari shirt and leather jacket, and a spirited heroine with wind-swept dark hair and bright eyes, wearing a practical yet stylish khaki outfit, seated together on a weathered crate inside a exotic jungle camp. 2117903200341231698.promptZh: 中世纪（Mid-century）戏剧化卡通风格静态宣传图，用于好莱坞电影预告片横幅：一位大胆的冒险家，棕色头发凌乱，面带自信微笑，身穿敞开的狩猎衬衫和皮夹克；一位充满活力的女主角，深色头发被风吹拂，双眼明亮，身着实用又时尚的卡其色服装；二人并肩坐在异域丛林营地内一只饱经风霜的木箱上。以轻松诙谐、富于冒险精神且幽默乐观的方式呈现二人的互动，确保两位角色全身清晰可见、姿态放松，并明显地彼此呼应，流露出共同的兴奋感。人物设计采用夸张的1950年代早期动画漫画（animation caricature）风格：轮廓线为干净利落的黑色描边（black contour lines），解剖结构高度简化（sharply simplified anatomy），剪影优雅而呈锐角（elegant angular silhouettes），眉毛富有表现力（expressive eyebrows），面部造型风格化（stylized facial shapes），手势优雅（graceful hand gestures），表情欢快且易于辨识（cheerful readable expressions）。整幅图像以统一的传统赛璐珞动画（cel-animation）美学渲染，背景亦遵循与角色一致的风格化视觉语言，使用平涂不透明色彩（flat opaque colors）、极简的硬边阴影（minimal hard-edged shading）、简化的家具与陈设（simplified furniture and décor）、微妙的手绘质感（subtle hand-painted texture）、受控的透视（controlled perspective）以及清晰有力的戏剧化构图（crisp theatrical staging）。采用大胆的冒险主题配色方案：温暖卡其色（warm khaki）、深绿色（deep green）、柔金色（soft gold）与米白色（cream），整体氛围机智风趣、魅力十足、视觉明快（visually snappy）。

2117903200341231699.promptEn: Create an ultra-premium street basketball sneaker advertising poster for an original brand called VANTAGE X, designed as a Cannes-level key visual that fuses luxury product photography, aggressive black-ink sports illustration, and explosive urban editorial typography. Preserve the exact core structure and camera logic of the image: one monumental hyper-real high-top basketball sneaker dominates the lower foreground in an extreme low-angle perspective, while a giant hand-drawn basketball player erupts across the upper background in a violent forward-driving action pose. The final image must now combine stronger Orbit impact, tighter Transit system control, and bolder Port-level concept integration, so the shoe feels like the source of all motion, power, and graphic force in the poster. Core composition: Use a tall vertical poster with one oversized sneaker in the lower-left to lower-center foreground, pushed slightly closer to the viewer for greater visual pressure. The toe box, side emblem, collar, laces, and outsole must feel monumental and tactile, as if the shoe is stepping directly into the viewer’s space. Behind and above it, place one huge black-ink sketch basketball player in an extreme explosive drive, jump, or pre-dunk attack moment, twisting through the frame with sharp momentum. Add one smaller secondary sketched player in the mid-background for layered court rhythm. The shoe must be the first thing seen; the illustrated players act as amplified motion ghosts generated by the shoe’s energy. Orbit impact enhancement: Increase the visual aggression of the foreground shoe. Make the sole impact at the base feel like it detonates the composition through bold black brush bursts, ink spray, fractured motion streaks, and launch-like ground energy. Tighten the distance between camera and shoe so the product feels heavier, closer, and more dominant. The poster must hit instantly with a “one step breaks the frame” sensation. Transit system enhancement: Keep the same skeletal layout, but unify the entire visual language into a mature black-and-white street-illustration system with one controlled hero product color event. The background athlete linework, speed lines, sketch shading, annotation marks, headline typography, secondary text, and impact splashes must all follow one disciplined graphic grammar: consistent ink weight, consistent roughness, consistent motion direction, and coordinated negative-space balance. The whole piece must feel like an official international sports campaign poster, not a collage of separate ideas. Port concept enhancement: Push the concept so the athlete’s motion visibly originates from the sneaker. Let selected ink lines, force strokes, and motion arcs extend from the shoe edges, outsole, and side emblem into the illustrated player’s limbs and trajectory, creating a clear idea that the player’s explosive action is being driven by the sneaker itself. The giant player can be captured in a more extreme airborne breakthrough or pre-slam moment, with the action lines visually tethered back to the shoe. The concept must feel bold and intelligent, not gimmicky. Product design: Design the shoe as a premium globally market-ready high-top street basketball sneaker from VANTAGE X. Use a bold colorway of metallic bronze-gold, matte black, off-white, and subtle silver technical accents. The upper should combine structured leather, engineered support panels, padded ankle protection, reinforced lace wings, sculpted heel geometry, and performance-driven outsole logic. Add an original VANTAGE X emblem on the lateral side. The shoe must feel elite, urban, muscular, and collectible. Material realism: Render the sneaker with exceptional realism and sharp commercial detail. The bronze-gold leather must feel smooth, rich, and premium with controlled highlights. Black areas must feel deep and performance-oriented with distinct texture separation. Show crisp stitching, lace weave, rubber density, sole grip, collar padding, and precise panel edges. The product must feel expensive, durable, and technically believable. Illustration style: Render the players and court world in expressive black ink sketch style with editorial sports aggression: raw contour lines, scratch shading, manga-like force marks, speed streaks, splatter accents, rough court geometry, and brush-impact sweeps. The drawn world should remain powerful but clearly secondary to the shoe. Keep the illustration highly art-directed, not messy. Typography and copy: Add fully original English typography integrated into the composition. Use one powerful headline such as “OWN THE ASPHALT” or “RISE ABOVE IMPACT,” rendered in a sharp custom street-sport editorial style. Add a refined support line such as “Engineered for explosive lift, locked grip, and court-born dominance.” Include a small premium VANTAGE X brand mark. Typography must feel dynamic, urban, aggressive, and compositionally precise. No copied wording, no generic font block. Background and environment: Keep the environment mostly white and minimal, constructed from perspective court lines, urban fragments, black ink slashes, motion scratches, and negative space. Use explosive black brushwork near the shoe base to anchor the product and visually launch the athlete upward. The environment must feel graphic and fast, never cluttered. Lighting: Use premium studio lighting on the sneaker, with soft directional highlights from upper-left and front-left, giving the metallic bronze-gold surfaces a luxurious glow. The illustration can remain flatter and more graphic, but should align with the shoe’s motion and shadow logic. The contrast between hyper-real product lighting and raw ink energy is essential. Color direction: Keep the overall palette tightly controlled: white field, black illustration system, bronze-gold hero product surfaces, black technical components, off-white sole accents, and minimal silver highlights. The shoe must remain the dominant color event in the frame. 2117903200341231723.promptEn:
Goal: Create a grayscale Japanese manga page about Hamster who suddenly came back, featuring a quiet traditional room, a tiny hamster, and a beautiful long-haired man in a kimono gently trying to coax it.

Add a small footer centered at the bottom reading 「はむwithOpus4.6」.

Layout: Use exactly 5 panels arranged from top to bottom. Panel 1 is a wide establishing panel across the top, showing a traditional Japanese veranda and garden. Panel 2 row has two side-by-side panels: left wider panel with the man seen from behind sitting on the veranda facing the hamster; right narrower panel with a closer view of the man by the sliding door. Panel 3 is a wide horizontal close-up panel of the man speaking softly. Panel 4 is a final wide, low horizontal panel showing the hamster rolling over.

Panel details: Panel 1: an empty tatami-and-wood Japanese room opening onto a sunlit garden with hydrangeas, leafy trees, a bamboo fence, and a stone lantern. On the right, an open shoji doorway reveals shelves with books and stacked items inside. On the wooden veranda near the right side sits a small round hamster. Above it place a vertical ellipsis 「・・・・・・」. Dappled sunlight and leaf shadows fall across the floor.

Panel 2 left: the long-haired man sits with his back to the viewer on the veranda, wearing a loose dark haori over a pale kimono. He has very long pale hair braided down his back. The tiny hamster faces him from several feet away. The garden foliage fills the background. Panel 2 right: close portrait of the man standing or leaning by the shoji frame, one hand touching the sliding door. He has pale messy bangs partly covering tired, gentle eyes, a long side braid, a composed slightly melancholic expression, and elegant facial features. Add a vertical speech balloon with 「・・・・・・おや。」.

Panel 3: wide close-up of the man from chest up, angled slightly left, with soft white bokeh/snowlike dots in the background. His expression is kind, calm, and mildly concerned. Use exactly 2 vertical speech balloons: left balloon text 「話したくなくても、ここにいるよ。」 and right balloon text 「・・・・・・話したくなったら、ここにいるよ。」.

Panel 4: minimal pale background with floor line, showing the fluffy hamster lying on its side/back after rolling over, small motion lines near its body. It has round glossy black eyes, tiny ears, soft fur, and an adorably defeated expression. Add large vertical Japanese sound effect text 「ころん」 on the right.

Subject details: The male character should look like an ethereal adult bishounen with very pale blond or white long messy hair, a thick braid over one shoulder or down his back, slim build, and wearing a white kimono with a dark haori. The hamster should be a small round fluffy white hamster with black eyes.

Visual style: Fine monochrome manga line art, elegant shoujo proportions, delicate crosshatching, soft gray washes, detailed botanical background, peaceful atmosphere, subtle humor, readable Japanese lettering, no color.

Constraints: Use exactly 5 panels, exactly 1 hamster, exactly 1 human character, exactly 5 visible text elements inside the story panels: 「・・・・・・」, 「・・・・・・おや。」, 「話したくなくても、ここにいるよ。」, 「・・・・・・話したくなったら、ここにいるよ。」, and 「ころん」. The lighting uses a soft warm golden side-front light, forming a warm highlight on the face and shoulder. The background is minimalist, softened, and low-contrast. The overall style is between realistic photography and delicate painting, with a calm, gorgeous, restrained, and mysterious temperament, avoiding a cheesy photo studio ancient costume feel.
2117903200341231725.promptZh: 创建一幅9:16竖构图的古风时尚人像。一位成年年轻女性以特写（close-up）半身构图呈现。她的身体大幅转向左前方，肩部与背部首先进入画面，面部则从肩头回眸直视镜头，形成鲜明的“回眸一瞥”（glance back over the shoulder）姿态。相机距离较近，焦点锁定在双眼、鼻梁、嘴唇及肩部。人物一手轻搭于肩部或衣料边缘，指尖自然微弯，强化出含蓄而略带张力的姿态。她肤质白皙细腻，眼眸呈浅灰绿色或浅琥珀色，眼妆为柔和雾感的橙棕色（soft-mist orange-brown eye makeup），下眼睑自然泛红，鼻梁与面颊散布细小雀斑，唇色如软豆沙桃粉（soft bean-paste peach lips），额间饰有一枚小巧的红色花卉纹样。发式为高髻或半髻，乌黑长发松挽而上，配以华美中式头饰：鎏金结构、绿松石釉彩、珠串、花朵、流苏与精巧发簪；鬓角与额前散落大量卷曲碎发与纤细绒毛，轻拂面颊。服饰主调为旧白色古绢与古风织锦，纹样以青绿色与橙红色为主，宽松衣料随意披覆肩头。布光采用柔和暖金色侧前光（soft warm golden side-front light），在面部与肩部形成温暖高光（warm highlight）。背景极简、柔焦（softened）、低对比度（low-contrast）。整体风格介于写实摄影（realistic photography）与细腻绘画（delicate painting）之间，气质沉静、华美、内敛而神秘，避免俗气的影楼风古装感（cheesy photo studio ancient costume feel）。
2117903200341231725.author: mo Ki

2117903200341231726.promptEn: Create a soft, detailed anime-style illustration of a young girl sitting on a wooden park bench beside a calm pond in a lush Japanese garden. The girl is centered slightly left, with warm brown hair in twin low pigtails tied with white ribbon bows, large gentle brown eyes, a small smile, and a peaceful, shy posture with both hands folded on her lap. She wears a light blue sleeveless dress with tiny white floral patterns, a white cardigan, tan strappy sandals, and a small pale yellow crossbody satchel. The setting is a bright spring or early summer park with dappled sunlight, dense green trees, flowering plants, grasses, lily pads, and a reflective pond behind her. Include exactly one wooden arched bridge in the mid-background crossing the water, exactly one small pavilion or gazebo on the far right bank, exactly one large tree trunk on the far left foreground, and exactly one small wooden sign at the lower left with simple Japanese characters and a pink flower symbol. Use a square canvas, warm daylight, soft watercolor-like rendering, delicate linework, rich foliage detail, sparkling reflections on the water, and a wholesome nostalgic mood. Avoid modern city elements, extra characters, logos, watermarks, or random added text beyond the small sign.
2117903200341231726.promptZh: 创作一幅柔和、细腻的动漫风格插画：一位年轻女孩坐在日本园林中平静池塘旁的木制公园长椅上。女孩位于画面略偏左的中心位置，暖棕色头发扎成两个低马尾，系着白色丝带蝴蝶结；眼睛大而温柔，呈棕色；嘴角微扬，流露浅笑；姿态宁静而羞涩，双手交叠置于膝上。她身穿浅蓝色无袖连衣裙，裙面点缀细小的白色花卉图案；外搭白色开衫；脚穿米色细带凉鞋；斜挎一只淡黄色小型单肩包。场景设定在明媚的春日或初夏公园，阳光透过树叶形成斑驳光影（dappled sunlight），四周绿树葱郁，繁花盛开，草叶丰茂，睡莲浮于水面，身后是一片倒影清晰的池塘。中景背景处须精确绘制一座木制拱桥横跨水面；远景右侧河岸须精确绘制一座小型亭子或观景阁；远景左侧前景须精确绘制一棵粗壮的大型树干；画面左下角须精确绘制一块小型木制标牌，上面印有简洁的日文字符及一朵粉色花朵符号。采用正方形画布，温暖日光（warm daylight），水彩质感般的柔和渲染（soft watercolor-like rendering），精细线条（delicate linework），茂密丰富的植物细节（rich foliage detail），水面泛起闪烁的倒影（sparkling reflections on the water），整体氛围纯真怀旧（wholesome nostalgic mood）。禁止出现现代城市元素、额外人物、商标、水印，或除该小型标牌外的任何随机添加文字。
2117903200341231726.author: まゆひらa

2117903200341231727.promptEn: A middle-aged golden retriever lies peacefully beside a calm mountain lake at golden hour, quietly watching a small flock of birds cross the glowing sunset sky. Just to his left, a smouldering campfire burns inside a natural ring of stones, casting warm amber firelight across the edges of his golden fur. Thin, realistic smoke drifts upward into the cool evening air. A deep green camping tent sits nearby in the foreground, partially illuminated by the fire. The lake is almost still, reflecting the orange-gold sky and distant tree-covered mountains. Pine trees frame the campsite while the low setting sun creates beautiful rim light around the dog and long soft reflections across the water. Hyperrealistic outdoor photography, cinematic golden-hour lighting, eye-level perspective, 24mm wide-angle lens, low foreground composition, realistic golden retriever anatomy, extremely detailed natural fur texture, subtle volumetric haze, realistic campfire glow, natural smoke physics, crisp foreground subject with softly receding background, atmospheric depth, warm amber highlights contrasted with cooler forest shadows, premium cinematic color grading, peaceful contemplative mood, authentic wilderness camping photography, no people, no text, no artificial fantasy elements, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, 16:9 landscape composition.
2117903200341231727.author: Nagarjuna Creates

2117903200341231728.promptEn: Create a narrative layout based on the theme (person, environment, object, date, phrase) following a 'Partial perception—White space pause—Full entry' structure. The first impression must be two soft image sets sandwiching a large white paper block, with a quiet editorial pause of black text in the middle. The upper part uses an asymmetrical three-grid collage: two close-up fragments on one side and a larger immersive detail on the other, using bold cropping to establish atmosphere through tactile fragments. The lower part features a wide main scene where the subject is seen from behind or in motion, maintaining a sense of accidental recording with ample environment and bokeh. The central white space provides breathing room: top-left has two levels of short sentences in restrained book font; bottom-right features an oversized freehand title with variable thickness, dry brush edges, and loose connections to create a gestural feel. Images are unified in natural sunlight with low-saturation green/cyan film tones, creamy whites, low contrast, and fine grain. Use light paper fiber textures and printing marks on the white background. Connect the photos and paper with narrow white lines to elevate the contrast between soft photography and decisive black handwriting.
2117903200341231728.promptZh: 基于主题（人物、环境、对象、日期、短语）构建叙事性版式，遵循“局部感知—留白停顿—完整呈现”结构。第一印象须为两组柔和图像夹着一大块纯白纸面，中央以黑色文字呈现静谧的编辑式停顿。上半部分采用非对称三格拼贴：一侧为两个特写（close-up）碎片，另一侧为一幅更大、更具沉浸感的细节画面，通过大胆裁切，以触感化的碎片建立氛围。下半部分呈现一幅宽幅主场景，主体以背影或动态姿态出现，保持偶然记录般的自然感，环境开阔，并带有焦外虚化（bokeh）。中央白色留白区域提供呼吸空间：左上角以克制的书籍字体排布两层级简短句子；右下角则呈现一个超大手写标题，笔画粗细多变、干笔飞白边缘、笔画连接松散，营造手势书写（gestural）质感。所有图像统一采用自然日光照明，呈现低饱和度的青绿色/青蓝色胶片色调（green/cyan film tones）、柔润的白色、低对比度与细腻颗粒感（fine grain）。白色背景上叠加轻盈的纸张纤维纹理与印刷痕迹（printing marks）。用窄细的白色线条连接照片与纸面，强化柔焦摄影与果决黑色手写字体之间的对比。
2117903200341231728.author: 小小东

2117903200341231729.promptEn:
Goal: Create a square 2x2 editorial photo-collage where real street-style fashion portraits are combined with oversized hand-drawn black ink sketch versions of the same subjects on a plain beige/gray wall, like a creative “photo to doodle illustration” transformation showcase.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image divided into exactly 4 equal panels with thin white gutters between panels. Each panel has a minimal urban backdrop: smooth concrete wall, gray floor, soft natural light, muted beige and gray tones, realistic shadows, and editorial fashion photography quality.

Layout: Use exactly 4 panels:
1. Top-left panel: one stylish woman leaning against a beige wall on the left, wearing sunglasses, a loose white button-up shirt, blue jeans, white sneakers, and a black shoulder bag, holding a takeaway coffee. To her right, draw a large black pen sketch version of her sitting casually with one leg raised, holding a phone, with headphones around the neck. Add small doodled hearts, stars, and motion marks around the sketch. Place one small rounded-corner inset photo thumbnail near the bottom center-right with a white border.
2. Top-right panel: one woman in a white oversized shirt dress and white sneakers leaning on one leg beside a short black bollard, holding a magazine/newspaper in one hand and a takeaway coffee in the other, wearing sunglasses and a black shoulder bag. To her right, draw a large playful black ink sketch of the same woman standing on one leg with the other leg kicked back, holding a coffee and raising a magazine labeled “VOGUE.” Add small hearts, stars, and motion lines. Place one small rounded-corner inset photo thumbnail near the bottom left with a white border.
3. Bottom-left panel: two streetwear fashion subjects leaning against a wall, both wearing dark caps, sunglasses, oversized neutral jackets, dark baggy pants, and sneakers, each holding takeaway coffee. To their right, draw a large black ink sketch version of the same two people standing side by side in similar poses and outfits. Add small hearts, stars, and motion marks. Place one small rounded-corner inset photo thumbnail near the bottom left with a white border.
4. Bottom-right panel: one sporty woman standing on the left in a white crop top, loose white sweatpants, white sneakers, headphones, sunglasses, and a small black shoulder bag, looking down at a phone. To her right, draw a large black ink sketch version of her dancing or posing with one arm raised high and one leg bent, wearing the same headphones and outfit. Add small hearts, stars, and motion marks. Place one small rounded-corner inset photo thumbnail near the bottom left with a white border.

Subject style: Ultra-realistic editorial fashion photography for the real people, natural skin tones, accurate fabric texture, casual candid poses, modern street-style styling. The illustration portions should look like loose hand-drawn fashion sketches in black pencil/ink directly on the wall, with expressive linework, crosshatching, imperfect contours, and sketchy shading.

Text content: The only readable text should be the sketch magazine title VOGUE in the top-right panel. Avoid any other logos, captions, watermarks, or extra typography.

Customizable details: Keep the overall concept as real fashion portraits beside oversized wall-sketch alter egos; use warm beige gray concrete; keep the clothing palette white, denim, black, taupe, and gray neutrals; render in ultra-realistic editorial photography mixed with loose black ink fashion illustration.

Constraints: Exactly 4 panels, exactly 4 inset thumbnails total, exactly 5 real photographed people total across the collage, exactly 5 large sketched people total across the collage. Maintain clean square collage composition, soft daylight, high-resolution detail, no extra panels, no frame around the whole image, no watermark.
2117903200341231729.author: Alina Ai

2117903200341231730.promptEn:
Goal: Create a clean Japanese promotional thumbnail/banner for a GPT Image 2 tutorial about using reference images to keep the same person consistent.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal banner, 1200×675 style, soft pale blue and white background with large organic blob shapes. Use a polished educational course-thumbnail aesthetic, airy spacing, high readability, no harsh shadows.

Layout: Split composition with a realistic portrait on the left occupying about 40% of the canvas, and a text-heavy information panel on the right occupying about 60%. The right side has a large white rounded organic shape as the main text area. Add small decorative dotted grids in the top-right and bottom-left corners, a light diagonal hatch pattern near the lower-right edge, and coral accent marks beside the headline.

Subject details: On the left, show one smiling Japanese woman in her late 20s to early 30s, photographed from the waist/chest up, facing the camera. She has shoulder-length softly layered black hair, natural makeup, warm friendly expression, and wears a peach sheer button-up shirt over a white ribbed camisole with a delicate gold necklace. Background behind her is bright, soft-focus, and slightly green-white like daylight through a window.

Text content: Include exactly 4 text blocks on the right: 1) a dark navy rounded pill at the top reading 「GPT Image 2 実践編 ③」; 2) a large navy Japanese headline reading 「基準画像を\n作った、その次は？」 with a coral underline under the final phrase; 3) a thin outlined rectangle subtitle reading 「人物固定の具体的な使い方」 with 「具体的な」 highlighted in coral; 4) a bottom checklist row with a pale blue circular check icon followed by 「毎回どの基準画像を使う？」. Keep all Japanese text crisp, centered within its area, and use elegant Mincho-style serif for the main headline with modern sans-serif for smaller labels.

Color palette: Deep navy text, pale powder blue background, white panels, peach/coral accents matching the woman's shirt, and light blue-gray icon details.

Constraints: Use exactly one person, exactly four text blocks, exactly one check icon, and exactly three main decorative accent types: dotted grids, coral rays/underline, and diagonal hatching. Avoid extra logos, watermarks, English translations, or additional text.
2117903200341231730.promptZh:
目标：为一篇关于使用参考图像保持人物一致性的 GPT Image 2 教程，制作一张简洁的日式宣传缩略图/横幅。

画布：16:9 横向横幅，1200×675 尺寸风格，背景为柔和的浅蓝色与白色，配以大型有机色块形状。采用精致的教育类课程缩略图（course-thumbnail）美学风格，留白通透、可读性高，无生硬阴影。

构图：左右分栏式布局，左侧为写实人像，约占画布 40%；右侧为信息密集的文字面板，约占画布 60%。右侧主文字区为一个大型白色圆角有机形状。在右上角与左下角添加小型装饰性点阵网格，在右下边缘附近添加浅色对角线斜纹（diagonal hatch）图案，并在标题旁添加珊瑚色（coral）强调标记。

主体细节：左侧呈现一位面带微笑的日本女性，年龄约二十八至三十二岁，取腰/胸部以上半身肖像，正对镜头。她留有齐肩、柔顺分层的黑色短发，妆容自然，神情温暖友善；身穿桃粉色半透明纽扣衬衫，内搭白色罗纹背心，佩戴一条精致的金色项链。其身后背景明亮、焦外虚化（bokeh），略呈青白色调，模拟日光透过窗户的效果。

文字内容：右侧须包含且仅包含 4 个文字区块：1）顶部一个深海军蓝圆角胶囊形标签，内文为「GPT Image 2 実践編 ③」；2）一个大号海军蓝日文主标题，内容为「基準画像を\n作った、その次は？」，末尾短语「その次は？」下方加珊瑚色下划线；3）一个细边框矩形副标题，内容为「人物固定の具体的な使い方」，其中「具体的な」三字以珊瑚色高亮；4）底部一行勾选列表，含一个浅蓝色圆形对勾图标，后接文字「毎回どの基準画像を使う？」。所有日文文字须清晰锐利、在其所属区域内居中对齐；主标题使用优雅的明朝体（Mincho-style）衬线字体，其余小字号标签则使用现代无衬线字体（sans-serif）。

色彩方案：深海军蓝文字、浅粉蓝色背景、白色面板、与女性衬衫相呼应的桃粉色/珊瑚色点缀色，以及浅蓝灰色图标细节。

约束条件：画面中须且仅含一人、四段文字区块、一个对勾图标，以及三种主要装饰性强调元素：点阵网格（dotted grids）、珊瑚色射线/下划线（coral rays/underline）、对角线斜纹（diagonal hatching）。禁止添加额外 Logo、水印、英文翻译或任何其他文字。
2117903200341231730.author: 千田結穂（せんだゆいほ）

2117903200341231731.promptEn:
Goal: Create a dense editorial cultural-exhibition poster about Dunhuang Rhythms, combining Dunhuang mural fragments, music-and-dance archive typography, and layered museum ephemera.

Canvas: Tall vertical poster, approximately 2:3 ratio, aged warm beige rice-paper background with visible grain, stains, torn edges, faded ink, and pasted-collage seams. Overall mood is scholarly, archaeological, and highly designed, with intentional clutter but a strong grid.

Layout: Use an asymmetric high-density collage. On the far left, place four enormous stacked black Chinese calligraphy characters reading 「壁上乐舞」, occupying nearly the full height, distressed and ink-textured. Beside the large characters, add a narrow vertical Chinese subtitle reading 「敦煌壁画中的乐舞与文明」. At the top center-left, add a small bilingual series label: 「丝路映像 系列展」 with “Silk Road Imaging Series” underneath. At the top right, place the main English title in elegant serif capitals: “DUNHUANG RHYTHMS”, with the smaller subtitle “Fragments of Murals and Music” below.

Main imagery: Use exactly 6 visible mural/image fragments, all in faded Dunhuang cave-painting colors of turquoise, cinnabar red, ochre, black, and parchment beige: 1) a large upper-right flying apsara musician fragment with flowing ribbons crossing diagonally; 2) a lower-left torn fragment showing three mural musicians or dancers; 3) a mid-right small rectangular fragment of a standing dancer; 4) a mid-lower ornate floral scroll pattern fragment; 5) a large bottom-right close-up of a female bodhisattva or apsara face with jewelry and flowing ribbons; 6) a right-edge partial vertical mural strip cropped off the page. Make the fragments look like scanned ancient wall paintings with cracks, missing plaster, chipped edges, and uneven opacity.

Information blocks: Add many thin vertical Chinese text columns like museum notes and archival captions around the collage, especially along the far left margin, middle columns, and lower center. Include exactly 4 primary info panels: 1) a right-side date and venue panel with “2026 09.05 SAT / 2027 01.16 SUN”, Chinese venue text, and “Hexi Culture Center Shanghai”; 2) a lower-left educational panel listing “Instruments” and “Dance Poses” with a small line drawing of an instrument; 3) a bottom-left organizer/credits panel with Host, Co-operation, and Visual Design lines; 4) a lower-right cave caption panel reading “Cave 285, South Wall Music and Dance Scene (detail)” with Chinese above it.

Typography and style: Mix oversized rough black Chinese brush type, refined Western serif uppercase, small Chinese Song/Ming-style vertical text, and tiny English museum captions. Use black, dark brown, muted red stamp ink, and occasional faded grid marks. Add small red seal stamps, thin archival diagrams, faint measurement lines, and marginal annotations. The design should feel like a contemporary museum poster, editorial magazine spread, and historical archive board fused together.

Constraints: Preserve a clear exhibition-poster hierarchy despite the dense collage. Do not make it modern glossy; keep everything matte, aged, weathered, and printed on textured paper. Use no photorealistic people outside the mural fragments, no 3D effects, no bright neon colors, and no empty clean white background. The most prominent readable texts should be 「壁上乐舞」, 敦煌壁画中的乐舞与文明, “DUNHUANG RHYTHMS”, and the date range 2026 09.05 / 2027 01.16.
2117903200341231731.author: Larus Canus

2117903200341231732.promptEn: Create a vertical black-and-white manga illustration of an elegant female knight in a dramatic action pose, shown from mid-thigh upward in a 2:3 portrait composition. She has very light silver-blonde hair rendered as white manga highlights, extremely long flowing hair sweeping left across the frame, sharp anime eyes, a calm serious expression, and one visible dangling earring. She wears ornate dark fantasy armor with exactly 6 major visible outfit elements: a sculpted breastplate, a high decorated collar, one large right shoulder pauldron, one armored right gauntlet, a layered waist skirt with belts, and thigh armor with filigree decorations. She grips exactly 1 long katana-like sword diagonally across the foreground with both hands, the blade and hilt cutting through the composition from lower right toward upper left. Surround her with swirling black brush strokes, ink splatters, speed lines, torn ribbon-like shapes, and flying debris, creating a stormy battle aura. Use pure monochrome manga style with no color, intense contrast, dense hatching, crosshatching, screentone textures, glossy black shadows, crisp white highlights, intricate armor engraving, dynamic hair strands, and highly detailed linework. The background should be abstract and chaotic rather than scenic, with circular motion strokes behind her head and heavy black ink masses at the corners. No text, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no color accents.
2117903200341231732.promptZh: 创作一幅垂直构图的黑白漫画插画，描绘一位优雅的女性骑士，以富戏剧性的动作姿态呈现，画面截取自大腿中部向上，在 2:3 的人像比例构图中。她拥有极浅的银金色头发，以纯白漫画高光（manga highlights）表现；发丝极长、飘逸流动，向画面左侧横扫而出；双眼为锐利的动漫风格（anime eyes），神情沉静而严肃；右耳佩戴一枚可见的垂坠式耳环。她身着繁复的暗黑奇幻风格（dark fantasy）盔甲，盔甲共包含且仅包含 6 个主要可见服饰部件：雕琢精细的胸甲（breastplate）、高耸且饰有纹样的领口（collar）、一枚大型右侧肩甲（right shoulder pauldron）、一只覆甲的右手护手（right gauntlet）、多层结构的腰裙（waist skirt）并配有皮带、以及饰有镂空雕花（filigree）纹样的大腿护甲（thigh armor）。她双手紧握一柄修长的类武士刀（katana-like sword），刀身与刀柄呈对角线贯穿前景，由画面右下方向左上方斜切构图。环绕其周身布满旋转的黑色笔刷笔触、墨点飞溅（ink splatters）、速度线（speed lines）、如撕裂丝带般的不规则形状，以及纷飞的碎屑，营造出暴烈激战的气场（stormy battle aura）。整体采用纯粹单色漫画风格（monochrome manga style），禁用任何色彩；强调极致对比度（intense contrast）、浓密排线（hatching）、交叉排线（crosshatching）、网点纹理（screentone textures）、油亮深黑阴影（glossy black shadows）、锐利纯白高光（crisp white highlights）、盔甲上精细入微的雕刻纹路（intricate armor engraving）、富有动感的发丝线条（dynamic hair strands），以及高度精细的线稿（highly detailed linework）。背景须为抽象而混乱的形态，不可具象写实；其头部后方辅以环形动态笔触（circular motion strokes），画面四角则堆叠厚重的纯黑墨块（heavy black ink masses）。画面中不得出现文字、对话框（speech bubbles）、水印（watermark）或任何彩色点缀（color accents）。
2117903200341231732.author: レティシア・ノエル

2117903200341231733.promptEn:
Goal: Create a polished 4-picture storyboard advertising luxury red nail polish, with the same square glass bottle, deep red lacquer, and metallic gold cap presented as a premium beauty campaign.

Canvas: One wide horizontal collage divided into exactly 4 equal rectangular frames in a clean 2x2 grid, no gaps or captions. Use ultra-realistic commercial beauty photography, glossy lighting, high-end cosmetics styling, sharp focus, rich reds and golds.

Frame count and content: Exactly 4 frames:
1. Top-left frame: close-up classical glamour portrait of a young fair-skinned woman with long light brown/blonde hair, elegant red lipstick, soft smoky eye makeup, and glossy red manicured nails. She holds the red nail polish bottle beside her face with both hands. Background is luxurious draped red satin fabric.
2. Top-right frame: symmetrical studio beauty portrait of a young fair-skinned woman against a deep burgundy background. She holds the red polish bottle near her cheek while her other hand displays long almond-shaped red nails near her lips. Emphasize flawless skin, red lipstick, and a gold bottle cap.
3. Bottom-left frame: macro product hero shot of the nail polish bottle standing upright on reflective surface, surrounded by red satin folds and red gemstone-like crystals. A manicured hand with red nails hovers above or touches the gold cap, making the product feel luxurious and tactile.
4. Bottom-right frame: lifestyle application scene in an elegant cream-and-gold bathroom. A young fair-skinned blonde woman in a white sleeveless top applies the red nail polish to her fingernails while holding the bottle. Show marble or beige walls, warm vanity lights, gold fixtures, and a softly premium spa atmosphere.

Subject details: The bottle should remain consistent across all frames: square transparent glass base, vivid ruby red lacquer, tall reflective gold cylindrical cap, premium cosmetic proportions. Nails should be glossy red, almond-shaped, and carefully manicured. Faces should look refined, elegant, and beauty-advertising ready.

Visual style: Blend classical luxury cosmetics advertising, red satin glamour, macro product photography, and aspirational lifestyle imagery. Use rich contrast, soft skin retouching, specular highlights on glass and metal, and warm flattering light.

Constraints: No text, no logos, no watermark, no extra products, no distorted hands, keep the product centered or clearly visible in every frame, maintain consistent red-and-gold brand identity throughout the 4-frame storyboard.
2117903200341231733.author: ​Maya

2117903200341231734.promptEn:
Goal: Create a premium cinematic character bible sheet for a futuristic female motorcycle racer, branded Future Vibes AI, with a bold motorsport concept and high-fashion action styling.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 white studio sheet with gritty black smoke, mud splatter, ink brush accents, and sharp editorial layout. Use a high-contrast palette of jet black, racing red, electric blue, gunmetal grey, and mud brown.

Layout: Left third is a large dynamic action illustration of the rider leaning forward on a black sport motorcycle blasting through mud and debris. Center third is a clean turnaround lineup of the same woman in full racing gear. Right third is a vertical details column with four close-up callout panels. Bottom center shows a color palette. Bottom right contains the slogan.

Main title and identity text: Huge expressive blue brush-lettering at top left reading “FUTURE VIBES AI”. Under it, small black text reads “THE RIDER” and “NUMBER 07”. Bottom right slogan in aggressive brush lettering reads “NO LIMITS.” in black and “FULL THROTTLE” in electric blue, with black underline strokes and ink splatter.

Character details: The rider is a young athletic woman with medium tan skin, expressive dark eyes, strong eyebrows, natural lips, and long black hair tied in a high ponytail. She wears a black leather motorcycle racing suit with red and blue graphic accents, armored shoulders, elbows, knees, gloves, boots, and the number 07 repeated on the suit. Her look is confident, cinematic, premium, and photorealistic with fashion editorial lighting.

Counted visible character/motorcycle views: Use exactly 5 main full/large views: 1 large action motorcycle riding pose on the left, 1 front-standing turnaround pose, 1 side-standing turnaround pose, 1 rear-standing turnaround pose, and 1 close-up helmeted portrait in the details panel. The center turnaround must show 3 standing full-body poses: front, side, and back.

Details column: Add exactly 4 rectangular close-up callout panels stacked vertically on the right. Panel 1: helmet close-up with visor and custom red-blue graphics, labeled “HELMET CUSTOM GRAPHICS”. Panel 2: gloved hand gripping the motorcycle throttle, labeled “RACING GLOVES GRIP + CONTROL”. Panel 3: chest plate and number badge close-up, labeled “NUMBER 07 CHEST PLATE”. Panel 4: boot and lower suit close-up with mud and leather texture, labeled “MUD SPLATTER LEATHER TEXTURE DETAILS”.

Color palette: Bottom center, include exactly 5 paint-brush swatches labeled: JET BLACK, RACING RED, ELECTRIC BLUE, GUNMETAL GREY, MUD BROWN.

Design style: Photorealistic cinematic rendering mixed with graphic design sheet presentation, crisp studio cutouts, realistic leather texture, mud splatter, smoke clouds, dynamic debris, sharp typography, premium motorsport branding, and energetic blue brush script. Keep the layout clean and readable, with no extra panels, no extra riders, no watermark, and no unrelated text.

2117903200341231735.promptEn: High-fashion conceptual studio portrait of a stylish young man standing confidently against a seamless vivid red background, wearing an oversized cream ribbed sweatshirt, loose knee-length distressed denim shorts, and chunky black sneakers, arms folded across his chest, legs slightly apart, calm and confident expression. Create an extreme horizontal time-stretch motion effect pulling the entire left side of his body and clothing toward the left: stretch the sweatshirt sleeves, torso fabric, denim shorts, hair and silhouette into long flowing translucent fabric fibers and fine motion trails, while keeping his face, sunglasses, crossed arms, central torso, legs and shoes sharp, clean and anatomically realistic. The stretched fabric should look like physical textile fibers being dragged through space, with hundreds of layered strands, subtle transparency and realistic folds dissolving into motion blur. Strong studio lighting, vivid red monochrome backdrop and floor, dramatic shadows, crisp textile texture, cinematic contrast, experimental fashion photography, surreal kinetic movement, luxury streetwear editorial campaign, analog film grain, photorealistic skin, high detail, professional 35mm fashion photography, dynamic full-body composition, vertical 4:5.
2117903200341231735.promptZh: 高级时装概念影棚肖像（studio lighting），一位时尚年轻男性自信站立于无缝鲜红色背景前，身穿 oversized 米色罗纹连帽衫、宽松及膝做旧牛仔短裤和厚底黑色运动鞋，双臂交叉置于胸前，双腿微微分开，神情沉着而自信。营造极致横向时间拉伸（time-stretch）动态效果，将他身体及服装的整个左侧向左拖拽：拉伸连帽衫袖子、躯干衣料、牛仔短裤、头发与剪影，使之化为绵长流动的半透明织物纤维与细腻动态轨迹；同时保持其面部、太阳镜、交叉双臂、躯干中线、双腿与鞋子锐利清晰、干净利落且符合人体解剖结构的写实感（photorealistic）。被拉伸的织物应呈现真实纺织纤维在空间中被拖曳的物理质感，包含数百层叠加的纤丝、微妙的半透明性以及逼真的褶皱，并逐渐消融为动态模糊（motion blur）。强影棚布光（studio lighting），鲜红单色背景与地面，富有戏剧性的阴影，清晰锐利的织物纹理，电影感对比度（cinematic contrast），实验性时尚摄影，超现实动能运动（surreal kinetic movement），高端街头服饰杂志广告大片（luxury streetwear editorial campaign），模拟胶片颗粒（film grain），照片级写实（photorealistic）肌肤质感，高细节，专业 35mm 时尚摄影，充满动感的全身构图，竖版 4:5。

2117903200341231736.promptEn:
9 hyper-realistic enamel badges, 4x5 layout, minimalist Eastern aesthetics x Song Dynasty style x modern premium cultural products; cream, dark teal, celadon, and cinnabar color scheme, large areas of negative space, thin gold borders, flat color blocks, exquisite enamel texture.

1 medium-sized character badge: based on the woman in the reference photo, with double-bun hairstyle, white dress, delicate and natural expression, with a minimalist Eastern landscape background of lake water, arched bridge, distant mountains, and weeping willows.

8 small badges: landscape folding fan, lotus flower, celadon vase, classical window lattice, small boat, cinnabar seal, "Elegant," and "DeepBlue".

Overall restrained, elegant, primitive, and premium, resembling Song Dynasty art exhibition merchandise, avoiding cartoonish, candy-colored, or modern souvenir vibes.
2117903200341231736.promptZh:
9 枚超写实（hyper-realistic）珐琅徽章，4×5 排版，极简东方美学 × 宋代风格 × 现代高端文化产品；奶油色、深青绿色、青瓷色与朱砂色配色方案，大面积留白，细金边，平涂色块，精致珐琅质感。

1 枚中号人物徽章：以参考图中的女性为原型，双髻发型，白色衣裙，神情细腻自然，背景为极简东方山水——湖水、拱桥、远山与垂柳。

8 枚小徽章：山水折扇、莲花、青瓷瓶、古典窗棂、小舟、朱砂印章、“Elegant”、“DeepBlue”。

整体克制、雅致、古朴且高端，形似宋代艺术展纪念商品，避免卡通感、糖果色或现代旅游纪念品气息。

2117903200341231737.promptEn: Create a photorealistic vertical portrait of a ball-jointed doll displayed inside an antique dark wooden glass cabinet, styled like a high-end doll collection photograph. The scene contains exactly 2 dolls: 1 main seated doll in sharp focus in the foreground and 1 smaller blurred doll reflected or visible in the background behind the glass. The main doll is a delicate porcelain-like girl doll with visible ball joints at the wrists and knees, pale skin, a small soft mouth, large glossy green eyes, and long wavy platinum blonde hair with wispy bangs. She wears a deep burgundy Victorian lolita dress with puff sleeves, black lace cuffs and hem, a white collar, a black bow at the chest, small front buttons, and a matching burgundy bonnet trimmed with black lace. Pose her seated slightly angled, hands gently folded in her lap, head subtly tilted, looking directly at the viewer with a serene melancholic expression. Surround her with ornate carved dark wood, glass reflections, brass decorative details, and a small metal plaque at the bottom of the cabinet reading Bambole Italiane Firenze. Use warm dim museum lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic reflections on the glass, rich shadows, soft bokeh background, and an elegant gothic antique atmosphere. No modern objects, no watermark, no extra text beyond the plaque.
2117903200341231737.promptZh: 创作一幅照片级写实（photorealistic）的竖构图人像，画面主体为一只球形关节玩偶（ball-jointed doll），陈列于一座古董深色木质玻璃展柜内，风格仿照高端玩偶收藏摄影。场景中严格包含2只玩偶：1只为主角，以清晰对焦（sharp focus）呈现于前景，呈坐姿；另1只为较小尺寸，在背景中透过玻璃反射或直接可见，处于明显虚化状态。主角玩偶为精致的类瓷质少女玩偶，手腕与膝盖处清晰可见球形关节，肤色苍白，嘴唇小巧柔和，双目硕大、富有光泽、呈翠绿色，长发浓密波浪、铂金色，额前带有轻盈飘逸的刘海。她身着深酒红色维多利亚风洛丽塔连衣裙，泡泡袖设计，黑色蕾丝袖口与裙摆，白色领口，胸前系黑色蝴蝶结，正面配有细小纽扣，头戴同色酒红色无边软帽，帽缘饰以黑色蕾丝。姿态为略带角度的端坐姿势，双手轻柔交叠置于膝上，头部微微倾斜，目光直视观者，神情宁静而略带忧郁。玩偶周围环绕繁复雕花的深色木材、玻璃反光、黄铜装饰细节，以及展柜底部一块小型金属铭牌，铭文为“Bambole Italiane Firenze”。采用温暖昏暗的博物馆照明（warm dim museum lighting）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、玻璃表面真实反射（realistic reflections on the glass）、浓郁阴影（rich shadows）、柔美焦外虚化（soft bokeh）背景，整体营造出典雅哥特式古董氛围（elegant gothic antique atmosphere）。画面中不得出现任何现代物品，不得添加水印，除铭牌外不得出现额外文字。

2117903200341231738.promptEn: Create a realistic high-resolution food photography image of unaju, Japanese grilled eel over rice served in a rectangular black lacquered bento box with a thin red inner rim, placed on a warm dark wooden restaurant table. The box is filled with white rice and topped edge-to-edge with exactly 4 long grilled eel fillets arranged horizontally in parallel, slightly overlapping, coated in a glossy caramel-brown tare sauce with visible char marks, tiny blistered skin texture, subtle grill lines, and faint skewer marks. The eel should look moist, oily, and sizzling, with bright specular highlights and appetizing lacquered reflections. Use a close-up three-quarter overhead angle, shallow depth of field, natural warm restaurant lighting, and rich contrast. In the softly blurred background include exactly 3 supporting table items: a small white side dish at the upper left with pale pickles or garnish, a dark cylindrical cup near the upper center, and a black soup bowl at the upper right containing clear broth and a small green herb leaf. Keep the focus sharply on the eel and lacquer box, with no people, no utensils, no text, and no watermark.
2117903200341231738.promptZh: 创作一幅逼真、高分辨率的食物摄影图像，主题为鳗鱼饭（unaju）：日本烤鳗鱼盖在米饭上，盛放在一个长方形黑色漆器便当盒中，盒内边缘有一圈细窄的红色镶边；便当盒置于一家餐厅温暖深色木质餐桌之上。盒内盛满白米饭，其上从左至右紧密铺满恰好4条长条形烤鳗鱼片，水平并列排列、略微重叠；鳗鱼表面裹着一层油亮的焦糖棕色酱汁（tare sauce），清晰可见炭烤痕迹、微小鼓起的鱼皮纹理、细腻的烤架纹路以及淡淡的竹签穿刺痕迹。鳗鱼应呈现湿润、油润且滋滋作响的质感，带有明亮的镜面高光（specular highlights）和诱人光泽的漆器般反射（lacquered reflections）。采用特写（close-up）三分之四俯拍角度、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、自然温暖的餐厅照明（natural warm restaurant lighting）以及浓郁对比度（rich contrast）。背景需柔和虚化（bokeh），其中恰好包含3件辅助性桌面物品：左上方一只小型白色小碟，内盛浅色腌菜或装饰配料；正上方偏中位置一只深色圆柱形杯子；右上方一只黑色汤碗，内盛清澈高汤及一枚小型绿色香草叶。画面焦点须精准落在鳗鱼与漆器便当盒上，不得出现人物、餐具、文字或水印。
2117903200341231738.author: いにしえ@AI Director / Creator / Engineer｜Will Oldgram

2117903200341231739.promptEn: Create a nostalgic Japanese summer greeting-card illustration in a traditional ukiyo-e / shin-hanga watercolor style. The scene shows one adorable realistic hamster as the central subject, standing on a shaded wooden veranda by the sea, wearing a wide straw hat with a blue ribbon and holding a clear blue glass ramune soda bottle with the label “ラムネ” and smaller text “冷やしの味”. The hamster has warm golden-brown and cream fur, glossy black eyes, tiny pink nose, small open smiling mouth, and soft detailed whiskers. Behind it is a bright summer beach landscape with turquoise ocean waves, sandy shore, one small white sailboat, distant green hills, and a seaside town with tiny houses. Frame the top with dark bamboo blinds and hanging cords, and place a glass wind chime at upper left containing exactly two orange goldfish; below it hangs a rectangular paper strip reading “涼風至”. Include exactly two main morning glory flower clusters in the foreground, one at lower left with blue and purple blossoms and one at lower right near a folded paper fan with floral patterns. Add a wooden sign on the right reading “名勝 海水浴場”, and a vertical label at bottom left reading “日本の夏”. In the sky area, write vertical calligraphy “暑中お見舞い申し上げます” with a small red smiling sun doodle nearby and a red seal stamp containing “大正十五年 夏”. Use aged cream paper texture, faded ink, visible grain, rough deckle border, muted vintage colors, soft natural light, and delicate hand-painted linework. Keep the composition square, cozy, whimsical, and authentically Japanese, with all text integrated as hand-brushed calligraphy and no modern objects besides the retro soda bottle.
2117903200341231739.promptZh: 以传统浮世绘（ukiyo-e）/ 新版画（shin-hanga）水彩风格创作一幅怀旧的日本夏日贺卡插画。画面中央主体是一只可爱的写实风格仓鼠，站在临海的阴凉木质走廊上，头戴一顶宽檐草帽，帽带为蓝色丝带，双手捧着一瓶透明蓝色玻璃瓶装弹珠汽水，瓶身标签为“ラムネ”，下方有较小文字“冷やしの味”。仓鼠毛色温暖，呈金棕色与米白色相间，眼睛乌黑发亮，鼻尖粉嫩小巧，嘴巴微张、笑容可掬，胡须柔软且细节丰富。仓鼠身后是一幅明亮的夏日海滩风景：青绿色海水泛着波浪，金色沙滩延展，远处停泊一艘白色小帆船，再远处是苍翠山丘与海滨小镇，小镇中散布着若干微缩房屋。画面顶部以深色竹制卷帘及垂挂绳索框构；左上方悬挂一只玻璃风铃，内含恰好两条橙色金鱼；风铃下方垂挂一条矩形纸条，上书“涼風至”。前景中需精确布置两簇牵牛花：一簇位于左下角，花朵为蓝色与紫色；另一簇位于右下角，靠近一把绘有花卉图案的折纸扇。右侧立有一块木牌，刻有“名勝 海水浴場”；左下角底部附一条竖排标签，上书“日本の夏”。天空区域以竖排书法书写“暑中お見舞い申し上げます”，旁侧点缀一枚红色简笔笑脸太阳，并加盖一枚红色印章，印文为“大正十五年 夏”。整体采用泛黄奶油色纸张肌理、褪色墨迹、清晰可见的纸张纤维、粗粝的手撕毛边（deckle border）、柔和复古色调、自然柔光（soft natural light）以及细腻的手绘线条（delicate hand-painted linework）。构图须为正方形，氛围温馨、奇趣盎然，且地道纯正地体现日本风情；所有文字均须以手写刷字（hand-brushed calligraphy）形式自然融入画面，除复古汽水瓶外不得出现任何现代物品。

2117903200341231740.promptEn: Create an intimate close-up portrait of a young woman with a stylized semi-realistic CGI/anime-realism look blended with photographic skin detail. She has deep crimson red shoulder-length messy hair swept across her forehead, loose strands framing her face, pale skin, large glossy hazel-green eyes, long lashes, dark winged eyeliner, softly arched worried eyebrows, a small nose, and slightly parted natural pink lips. Her expression is shy, anxious, and tender, looking slightly off to the viewer’s right rather than directly at the camera. Add visible anime-style blush marks: exactly 18 diagonal pink strokes across both cheeks and the bridge of the nose, with 8 strokes on the viewer-left cheek area, 2 shorter strokes over the nose bridge, and 8 strokes on the viewer-right cheek area. Frame her from bare shoulders upward in a tight vertical portrait, face filling most of the canvas, with the top of the hair close to the upper edge and shoulders softly visible at the bottom. Use shallow depth of field, soft moody indoor lighting from the upper left, subtle catchlights in the eyes, realistic pores and skin texture, gentle subsurface scattering, cinematic contrast, muted dark gray-brown background blur, and a high-end character-render-meets-photography finish. Keep the image clean with no text, no accessories, and no extra characters.
2117903200341231740.promptZh: 创作一幅亲密的特写（close-up）肖像，描绘一位年轻女性，风格为风格化的半写实CGI/动漫写实主义（anime-realism），融合摄影级皮肤细节。她拥有一头深绯红色及肩长发，凌乱地扫过额头，几缕松散发丝勾勒出脸部轮廓；肤色苍白；眼睛大而水润，呈榛绿色；睫毛纤长；眼线为深色飞翼式；眉毛柔和上扬，略带忧虑；鼻梁小巧；双唇自然粉嫩，微微张开。她的神情羞涩、焦虑又温柔，视线略微偏向观者右侧，而非直视镜头。添加可见的动漫风格红晕标记：在双颊与鼻梁上共绘制18条斜向粉色笔触——观者左侧脸颊区域恰好8条，鼻梁上方2条较短笔触，观者右侧脸颊区域恰好8条。构图采用紧致的竖幅人像，画面从裸露的肩膀以上截取，面部占据画布大部分空间，发顶贴近画面上边缘，肩膀在画面底部柔和呈现。使用浅景深（depth of field），左上方投射柔和而富有情绪感的室内光线，瞳孔中加入细微的反光点（catchlights），呈现真实的毛孔与皮肤纹理，辅以轻柔的次表面散射（subsurface scattering），电影感对比度（cinematic contrast），背景为低饱和度的暗灰褐色虚化（blur），整体呈现高端角色渲染与摄影质感融合的完成效果。保持画面干净，不添加文字、配饰或额外人物。
2117903200341231740.author: KISA aka Copenzafan.eth

2117903200341231741.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vertical Japanese anime-style diagnostic poster titled 隠した感情, presenting “hidden emotion print layers” for one girl character, with a central neutral portrait and two contrasting emotional versions printed behind her in blue and red.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, aged cream paper background with rough torn-paper collage edges, ink stains, halftone dots, faint scratches, stamped textures, and layered risograph/screenprint effects. Use a limited palette of navy blue, deep red, black line art, and warm off-white.

Layout: Large Japanese headline across the top left, with a small English subtitle beneath it reading “EMOTION PRINT LAYERS” and a handwritten cursive word “Layers” near the title. Under the subtitle, add a small Japanese tagline: “みんなに見せる顔と、本当のわたしは、ちょっと違うんだ。” The center foreground contains the main character in clean black-and-white line art, overlapping both colored background layers. Behind her are exactly 2 large monochrome emotion portraits: one blue portrait on the left and one red portrait on the right. Add exactly 2 torn label cards: a blue card at lower left and a red card at mid-lower right. Add exactly 3 small white rabbit motifs: one tiny rabbit icon near the red top corner, one plush-like rabbit at the bottom left, and one plush-like rabbit at the bottom right.

Subject details: The character is a delicate anime girl with very long pale blonde hair, soft gray eyes, blush, floral hair ornaments, small rabbit hair clip, earrings, and a lacy white camisole dress. The central portrait shows her shyly winking with one eye open, shoulders turned slightly, gentle blush, loose flowing hair and floral accessories. The blue left background portrait shows the same girl looking inward and melancholic, resting her hand near her mouth, with a quiet closed-off pose. The red right background portrait shows the same girl energetic and extroverted, smiling with open mouth and pointing directly toward the viewer.
