2117903200341231743.promptEn:
Generate a very narrow and long vertical editorial visual based on the End of Heat solar term. Let the external large color field, central warm white paper page, and the retracted theme window form three clear planar spaces. First, derive two structural colors from the state contrast and emotional temperature of the theme, covering the vast majority of the screen with a hard horizontal boundary. In the embedded window, repeat this set of divisions in the same direction and in a reduced proportion; the outer field is brighter and emptier, the inner window is deeper and denser, and paper white serves as the layer with the highest brightness of the whole painting. The weight of the screen is concentrated in the middle, the upper part retains a wide title area, and the lower part leaves a stretched emotional landing point. The edges of the paper are straight, no heavy floating shadows are used, and a wide annotation band is kept under the window.

Extract a continuous and recognizable core form from the direction, process, structural connection, and time change of the theme, organize it into a single oblique axis running through the middle, making it cross at least two boundaries from inside the window, pressing on the frame, entering the white space of the paper, and extending to the external color field. The cross-border form remains complete and continuous, the endpoints crossing the edge retain the clearest recognizable outline, and local details are moderately compressed; local forms go from dense to sparse along the oblique axis, and other auxiliary objects are reduced to quiet small geometric focal points, stably remaining inside the window and close to the color field boundary. Let the horizontal color boundary, vertical frame, rectangular paper, and inner window maintain a strict orthogonal order; only the core theme gets the right to break the rules, establishing space with accurate occlusion relationships rather than relying on perspective or dramatic projections.

Arrange a few homologous echoes on one edge of the theme's momentum: enlarge, crop, and reduce the transparency and contrast of the core form, strongly defocusing it until only soft color blocks remain, partially extending out of the canvas; the central subject remains clear, and the other side remains clean, giving the planar color field a shallow sense of air and memory. Color maintains a clear area order, with two structural colors together occupying about 80% of the screen. The theme's mediating color crosses two fields and stitches together cold/warm or state differences. A small-area emphasis color appears only twice at a long distance: at the visual focus inside the window and at the text gesture outside the paper. The specific hues change with the theme, but the brightness relationship remains stable with paper white being the highest, a few deep outlines pressing on the structure, and the emphasis color winning by saturation rather than area.

The text system continues the order and cross-border relationship of the image. The main title uses a slender, sharp, highly contrasting stroke, and exquisite editorial serif skeleton; Chinese adopts a thin and book-like typeface with relaxed spacing. Transform a keyword into a continuous free handwritten thin line, gently passing through or adjoining the printed title, forming a private handwriting that echoes the oblique axis of the theme. Explanatory information is indented at the bottom of the paper, listed in two groups of small fonts and date-type micro-words. The bottom edge outside the paper can use a set of handwritten text with long closing strokes to carry the second emphasis color, leaving only minimal metadata at the very bottom. Let titles, images, annotations, and footers decrease in density in sequence, not allowing text to press on the core recognition edges.

Process objects with non-directional soft daylight and low shadows, so the theme retains limited real material while still obeying planar color blocks. The entire image is covered with very light art paper fibers, fine printing dots, and low-contrast scanning particles; textures in the paper and window are slightly more obvious, and the outer pure color field is more restrained. The edges of objects allow for tiny printing softening and color bleeding, while key outlines and typeforms remain clean. The final image first presents a white paper window in a two-color long format and a theme form growing continuously from inside to outside the window, then reveals defocused edge shadows, exquisite headers, handwritten intervention, and micro-annotations, forming a modern paper-print visual where strict editorial order and a fresh sense of time coexist.

2117903200341231747.promptEn: Create an ultra-premium restaurant advertising poster that merges Orbit-style compositional force with Transit-style international polish, preserving the exact structural logic of a bold color-block menu poster while refining it into a cleaner, sharper, more globally premium flagship campaign. Use a tall vertical layout divided into three large graphic color fields with strong angled transitions, where each color block acts as a compositional stage for a specific hero dish or combo. The final artwork must feel bold, graphic, craveable, modern, and Cannes-level commercial, with the food and color planes fused into one precise design system. Do not copy any original text, logo, pricing, or wording. Core composition: Use a vertical poster layout with three major stacked sections connected by strong diagonal or slanted color-block cuts. Top section: a premium blue field featuring one hero stir-fried rice noodle bowl. Middle section: a deep black-charcoal field featuring one larger family combo or shared meal composition. Bottom section: a rich red or terracotta-red field featuring a second hero noodle bowl. The transitions between color fields must feel sharper, more directional, and more deliberate, so the eye travels through the poster in one continuous graphic rhythm. Orbit enhancement: Push the structural energy of the color blocks much harder. The diagonal cuts between blue, black, and red should feel more assertive, almost slicing through the page and directing the viewer’s attention from top hero bowl, through the middle combo, into the lower bowl. The placement of bowls, chopsticks, and side dishes should echo these diagonal vectors, so the food itself appears orchestrated by the color geometry. The poster should feel more immediate and more visually aggressive from a distance. Transit enhancement: Refine the entire poster into an international flagship restaurant-advertising language. Use purer, more controlled color fields, cleaner typography spacing, calmer negative space, and more elegant hierarchy. The blue should feel fresher and more premium, the black deeper and more sophisticated, and the red more refined and less noisy. The result should feel like a global fast-casual or modern Asian dining brand campaign rather than a crowded local promo poster. Food and color-block integration: This is the most important feature. The dishes must feel inseparable from the color fields. Each bowl must sit in its section with exact compositional intention, using plate placement, garnish direction, chopstick angle, and nearby side elements to reinforce the graphic planes. The color blocks should not be passive backgrounds; they must actively frame, support, and sharpen the food presentation. Top hero bowl: Show a premium soy-glazed or stir-fried rice noodle bowl with glossy noodles, sliced roasted pork or chicken, red pepper strips, broccoli, scallions, and rich dark sauce sheen. The bowl should feel fresh, balanced, and immediately appetizing against the vivid blue field. Middle combo section: Show a richer, more abundant combo arrangement in the black-charcoal section: one deep bowl or clay pot with braised meat and noodles, plus one or two supporting side dishes such as soup, dipping bowl, or appetizer plate. The composition should feel generous but controlled, like a hero combo set for sharing. The darker section should make the warm food highlights glow more dramatically. Bottom hero bowl: Show a second noodle variation with deeper glaze, richer meat topping, greens, scallions, and carefully layered garnish. This lower bowl should feel slightly heavier and more indulgent, anchored powerfully against the red field. Typography system: Use bold, modern, highly legible menu typography integrated precisely into each section. Main dish names should be large, confident, and clean. Price blocks should sit inside compact contrasting graphic capsules or bold painted labels. Supporting copy must be short, sharp, and minimal. All wording must be fully original and fictional. Typography must align with the color-block structure and never float loosely. Lighting: Use bright premium food-commercial lighting with warm directional clarity and controlled highlights. The noodles must show moist elasticity, the meat should catch caramelized gloss, and vegetables should remain fresh and crisp. Keep the lighting polished and appetizing, but clean enough that the graphic composition remains dominant. Material rendering: Render noodles with springy tension and sauce sheen, meats with rich caramelized texture, vegetables with natural freshness, eggs or tofu if included with convincing surface detail, ceramic bowls with subtle glaze reflections, and chopsticks with elegant wood texture. The color fields should feel matte, flat, and graphically strong, contrasting with the realism of the food. Background and cleanliness: Keep the entire poster highly controlled and clean. No unnecessary pattern overload, no cluttered prop styling, no random elements outside the color-block logic. The graphic planes and food should carry the entire story. Color system: Use a disciplined premium palette of saturated but controlled blue, deep black-charcoal, refined terracotta-red, noodle gold, roast mahogany, scallion green, citrus green accents, and small off-white typography. The color blocks must feel bolder and more premium, while the warm food tones unify the poster. Image finish: The final poster must feel like a world-class flagship restaurant campaign: bold, directional, graphic, product-led, internationally polished, and instantly memorable. Preserve sharp food detail, precise color-block edges, elegant typography hierarchy, and immaculate commercial retouching. 8k, premium restaurant advertising quality. Negative prompt: copied text, copied pricing, copied logo, cluttered layout, weak color blocks, muddy food texture, limp noodles, greasy mess, random props, poor typography hierarchy, dirty background, black blotches, low-resolution food detail

Across the sky, place one enormous spiral galaxy dominating the upper left and center, tilted diagonally, with a bright warm white-orange core and swirling pink, violet, blue, and gold nebula arms. On the upper right, show exactly 4 spherical celestial bodies: 1 large ringed gas giant with subtle purple-brown bands and a thin Saturn-like ring system, plus 3 smaller moons nearby, one above-left of the giant, one left-lower of that moon, and one overlapping near the lower-left edge of the giant. 2117903200341231753.promptEn: Create a dramatic fantasy manga-style battle scene in a vertical 4:5 composition. The golem is built from thousands of irregular gray-brown stone blocks and broken masonry, with patches of green moss and hanging vines between the rocks. It has glowing cyan-blue magical eyes and exactly 4 visible glowing blue rune cores: one in the center of its chest, one on its forehead, one on its right shoulder, and one on its left forearm. Its massive left hand reaches forward toward the viewer with oversized stone fingers, while the other arm is pulled back in a fist as if charging an attack. Surround them with swirling stylized dust clouds and speed-line smoke ribbons, rendered like inked manga effects: exactly 8 major white dust plumes curling around the scene, with black outlines and dynamic motion arcs. 2117903200341231753.promptZh: 以垂直 4:5 构图创作一幅戏剧性的奇幻漫画（manga）风格战斗场景。一座巨大的远古石像傀儡（golem）矗立于荒废神庙庭院中，俯视一名孤身披甲的战士；画面采用低角度电影感视角（cinematic angle），强化石像傀儡的庞然巨物感。该石像傀儡由成千上万块不规则的灰褐色石块与碎裂砌体堆叠而成，石缝间缀有青绿色苔藓与垂挂藤蔓。它双眼散发青蓝色（cyan-blue）魔法辉光，并恰好拥有 4 颗可见的发光蓝色符文核心（rune cores）：一颗位于胸口正中央，一颗在额头，一颗在右肩，一颗在左前臂。其庞大的左手向前伸展、朝向观者，手指巨大如石柱；另一条手臂则向后收拢成拳，仿佛正蓄力发动攻击。前景中，呈现一名背对观者的凡人战士：身着深色中世纪盔甲与长靴，披一条长而破败的藏青近黑（navy-black）斗篷，边缘饰以金边；右手持剑，左小臂架起一面圆盾，呈防御姿态直面巨像。环绕二者，添加漩涡状风格化尘云与速度线烟带，以手绘漫画（manga）墨线效果呈现：恰好 8 股主要的白色尘柱盘绕场景四周，均带黑色轮廓与充满动感的运动弧线。另加入飞溅的碎石、龟裂的石块残骸、断裂的石柱、散落的废墟及覆满苔藓的瓦砾，铺陈于地面。背景为鲜明明亮的湛蓝色天空，点缀零散白云，远方可见数座坍塌的石塔。视觉风格：高度精细的动漫奇幻插画（anime fantasy illustration），锐利纯黑墨线勾勒（sharp black ink outlines），漫画式交叉排线（comic-book crosshatching），动态透视（dynamic perspective），高饱和色彩（saturated colors），强烈阳光（strong sunlight），高对比度（high contrast），史诗级动作能量（epic action energy），无文字，无水印。使用一名身着暗色盔甲、披破败藏青近黑斗篷并持剑的孤身战士，一座覆盖苔藓、嵌有青蓝色符文核心的巨型石像傀儡，一座沐浴于湛蓝晴空下的古老荒废神庙庭院，青蓝色（cyan blue），以及数股大型白色漫画风格漩涡尘柱。

2117903200341231754.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vertical Japanese restaurant lunch menu poster for a casual diner, warm and slightly retro, with appetizing food photography and large brush-style Japanese typography.

Canvas: Portrait poster, approximately 4:5 ratio, parchment beige background with subtle paper texture, thin gold border, red and gold decorative accents, leaf motifs in the corners, and a festive Japanese pattern strip along the far left edge.

Header: At the top, place a large calligraphic headline reading ランチメニュー; make the first word black and the second word deep red. Underline it with a rough gold brush stroke. In the upper-right corner, add a red circular seal containing white Japanese text: 「心を込めた おいしい ひととき」, with small pale pink flower decorations nearby.

Main layout: Create exactly five horizontal menu rows separated by thin beige lines. Each row has a circular icon on the left, a bold Japanese dish name in black calligraphy in the middle-left, and a realistic food photo panel filling the right half. Use warm restaurant tabletop lighting and wooden table surfaces in the photos.

Menu rows, exactly 5 items:
1. Red circle icon with a plum blossom, label 「ハンバーグ定食」, photo of a glossy demi-glace hamburger steak set with rice bowl, miso soup, broccoli, carrot, and garnish.
2. Gold circle icon with gyoza dumplings, label 「ジャンボ餃子定食」, photo of large pan-fried gyoza arranged in a row with rice, dipping sauce, soup, and pickles.
3. Green circle icon with a chicken silhouette, label 唐揚げ定食, photo of fried chicken karaage set with shredded cabbage, lemon wedge, rice, soup, and cucumber pickles; make the fried chicken look slightly uncanny and overly bulbous as if AI-generated.
4. Purple circle icon with a pig silhouette, label 「生姜焼き定食」, photo of pork ginger stir-fry with onions, shredded cabbage, tomato, rice, miso soup, and pickles.
5. Blue circle icon with a rice bowl, label 「中華丼」, photo of Chinese-style rice bowl topped with shrimp, quail eggs, vegetables, black fungus, thick glossy sauce, plus a small soup bowl.

Notice strip: Beneath the five rows, add a centered bordered beige notice box reading 「※定食ランチにはご飯・汁物付き」, with small gold leaf ornaments on both sides.

Bottom information area: Create a cream-colored panel with two large information blocks. On the left, a brown clock icon and label 「営業時間」 above the time 9:00〜16:30. On the right, a red fork-and-spoon icon and label 「ランチタイム」 above the time 12:00〜14:00. Separate the two blocks with a thin vertical divider.

Footer: Add a deep red footer band with subtle gold brush decorations and small sparkle accents. Center white Japanese closing text: ゆったりくつろげる空間で、皆さまのご来店を心よりお待ちしております。

Visual style: Polished Japanese print flyer, izakaya/family restaurant aesthetic, warm reds, browns, cream, and gold, high-resolution food photography mixed with decorative vector elements, clean grid alignment. Keep all Japanese text legible and avoid adding extra menu items or extra text.

2117903200341231756.promptZh: 以提供的 2D 公寓平面图为精确布局参考，将其转化为逼真的俯视 3D 洋娃娃屋（dollhouse）风格住宅可视化效果图。保留相同的房间布局、墙体位置、门窗开口，以及相同的八个标注功能区：2 间卧室、1 间厨房、1 个起居区、1 间浴室、2 个壁橱和 1 个洗衣/烘干间。将原本扁平的黑白符号转化为配备家具的 3D 房间：浅色木纹地板、厚重深色的外墙与内墙、米色/奶油色中性装饰、写实风格家具、敞开的木质门、可见且挂有衣物的壁橱、配有浴缸/淋浴间、马桶和洗漱台的浴室、带橱柜及岛台座椅的厨房、起居区内的沙发与椅子，以及两间卧室内的床与床头柜。采用抬高的等距视角（isometric）/俯视（top-down）相机角度，使整套公寓在单张图像中完整可见，并采用干净利落的建筑渲染布光（architectural-render lighting）、柔和阴影（soft shadows）及纯白影棚背景（white studio background）。平面图上的文字需尽量精简；仅在必要时保留“wash/dry”标签作为可见文字。整体风格：照片级写实（photorealistic）室内设计渲染图，整洁、现代、温馨且不杂乱。

2117903200341231757.promptEn:
9:16 vertical, modern East Asian woman's dream 3D papercut art, modern oriental papercut art, layered paper cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, layered shadow box, epic oriental papercraft fantasy, contemporary oriental art poster. 

The theme is 'She walks from the lights of Hongyadong to the river.'

The core narrative is: a young East Asian woman walks slowly from a layered paper-carved mountain city and lantern corridors towards the riverside steps, facing the river water, night wind, distant bridge, and moonlight. She emerges from the depths of the prosperous and noisy lights into the wider, open edge of the river, as if finally seeing the destination she truly wants to reach after the bustle.

The main character is an adult East Asian female visually aged about 25, clear-headed, independent, mysterious, and elegant, with a sense of calm after passing through prosperity. The character has a clear oval face, slender almond eyes slightly raised, and a restrained and focused expression. The character does not look at the camera, using a back or side-back narrative posture as the emotional core.

Hairstyle and accessories: black long hair low-tied, the hair tail extending into slender flowing paper art ribbons, wearing light gold lamp patterns and small flower branch hair accessories. The headwear is light and exquisite, not complex or high.

Clothing: deep crimson, warm gold, and ivory layered paper art long skirt, the hem and sash have extremely fine hollow structures of pavilions, lights, railings, waves, and city patterns. The outer sash is long and light, spreading out in a large area to the back and side-back. The clothing must have clear paper thickness, fine cut edges, fiber texture, slight creases, and a museum-level paper sculpture craft feel. The sash and skirt are like a whole piece of complex hollow paper-carved scroll.

The dream carrier is: a mountain city paper art pavilion group and riverside corridor.

Dream imagery includes: stilt houses, lights, long steps, river surface, distant bridge, birds, full moon, distant city light sea. All buildings, people, river water, sky, bridges, lanterns, railings, and plants must be unified in a high-completion 3D paper sculpture language, not realistic photography, not ordinary CG night scenes.

The overall paper-cut structure uses: multi-layer stage style.

Composition and character movement: The left and upper part of the screen is a huge paper-carved mountain city growing vertically along the cliff wall. Layers of stilt houses, pavilions, corridors, terraces, railings, lanterns, and small bridges overlap from the foreground to the distance, forming an extremely complex and orderly vertical space. The right side is the open river surface, distant bridge, city skyline, and full moon night sky, forming a clear opening and closing relationship. The character is located on the riverside steps at the bottom left-center, body facing the river and the distance, walking slowly down or staying quietly, becoming the narrative focus connecting the 'prosperous mountain city' and the 'open river surface.'

The mountain city architecture must clearly refer to the Hongyadong style mountain stilt house group, but completely paper-cut: multi-layered wooden pavilions, dense lattices, layered corridors, cantilevered platforms, winding stairs, cornices, red lanterns, and warm light window scenes interweave, forming an overwhelming sense of vertical growth and strong depth. The architectural density is very high, but the order is clear; foreground buildings can be cropped by the frame to enhance the sense of spatial pressure and presence.

Continuous paper art railings, lanterns, stone steps, platforms, and a few paper-carved plant silhouettes can appear in the foreground and middle ground as a frame for viewers to enter the mountain city. The right side river is open, the water has detailed paper-carved ripples and moonlight reflections, a bridge in the distance spans the river with lights on, and the distant city light sea forms dense light spots. A full moon and scattered birds are visible in the night sky; the moonlight is cold, forming a cold-warm contrast with the warm lights of the mountain city.

The overall color scheme is: deep crimson, warm gold, deep cyan-blue, and ivory, with a small amount of ink black for balance. Deep crimson for the pavilion bodies, character's main skirt, railings, and lantern structures; warm gold for lights, lattices, outlines, and local highlights; deep cyan-blue for the night sky, river water, and background shadows; ivory for hollow sashes, building highlights, moonlight, and some decorative paper layers. The overall colors are gorgeous and transparent, with obvious cold-warm contrast, but not muddy or dirty, do not overall black out.

Lighting and paper texture: Warm gold lights emanate from inside the pavilions, interweaving with the cold blue night and moonlight, paper layers of buildings partially glowing, river surface reflecting lights and moonlight. Paper thickness, cut patterns, hollow railings, lattices, lantern edges, and character clothing details must be extremely rich and clear. Enhance real paper fiber, slight creases, inter-layer shadows, edge translucency, and multi-layered paper sculpture structures, making the entire image look like a high-completion large East Asian paper sculpture art installation.

The overall image has a sense of an East Asian dream mountain city, paper-cut night tour, riverside moonlight, female growth narrative, and high-end art poster. The focus is not just 'Hongyadong night scene' but the emotional transition from 'prosperous lights to the open river.' The mountain city must be prosperous, complex, and grow upward in layers; the river surface must be open, cold, and leave breathing room; the character must become the emotional anchor from bustle to silence.

Supplementary requirements: Strengthen the vertical space of the mountain city and the prosperity of the lights, the character is in the foreground or middle foreground but must not destroy the overall architectural pressure and depth; the entire scene must be unified as paper-cut, not just paper-art characters and realistic background.

2117903200341231758.promptEn: Create a cinematic vertical surreal miniature construction scene: a colossal vanilla soft-serve ice cream cone towers from a snowy white landscape like an architectural megaproject, centered in frame. The cone is a realistic golden waffle cone with deep grid texture, and the enormous spiral of glossy white soft-serve rises above it in stacked ridges, snowy and creamy at the same time. 六位宁芙分别为：  
1）前景左侧最远处一位金发宁芙，坐姿靠近观者，单膝微抬，身着白色垂坠式长裙，肩带镶金；

5）一位绿发宁芙，跪坐于泉边，身着淡绿色长裙；  
6）一位银白色长发宁芙，坐于最右侧花丛之中，身着淡紫白相间长裙，一手轻轻抚于胸前。

整体氛围应宁静、魔幻、田园诗般美好（serene, magical, and idyllic），宛如《泉畔休憩的宁芙 第三号》（Nymphs Resting by the Spring No. 3）。重点呈现高度打磨的奇幻动漫3D插画（highly polished fantasy anime 3D illustration）、温暖的金色晨光（warm golden morning sunlight）与闪烁高光（sparkling highlights）、带有瀑布的魔法森林泉水、凉亭与远方城堡，以及柔和粉彩色系长裙、翠绿 foliage（叶丛）、青绿色泉水与金色建筑。尽可能采用全身构图（full-body composition），姿态优雅，解剖结构精良（refined anatomy），赤足，画面中无文字、无水印、无现代物品，横幅全景比例为16:9。

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, bright pastel resort atmosphere, high-resolution glossy product photography mixed with delicate anime illustration. Background is a softly blurred outdoor swimming pool at a luxury summer resort with turquoise water, white parasols, lounge chairs, palm greenery, blue sky, and glowing bokeh.

Main subject: A cute seated anime girl figurine centered slightly right, smiling and looking at the viewer. She has pale pink hair with aqua-blue tips, sparkling blue-pink eyes, translucent glossy skin, and a joyful summer expression. Her pose is seated with both long legs forward, one hand raised near her face in a playful gesture. She wears a frilly pastel sailor-inspired swimsuit dress in white, pink, and aqua, with off-shoulder ruffle sleeves, a large pink chest bow, blue corset lacing, flower accents, translucent frills, ankle-strap platform sandals, hair clips, a small flower hair ornament, and shell/star accessories.

Parfait figure base: The character sits on a large transparent shaved-ice-style clear base shaped like a splashing pool parfait. Use glittering crystalline ice, translucent aqua and pink syrup gradients, star-shaped crystals, water-splash arcs, glossy resin texture, and a circular clear display stand at the bottom. The dessert base should feel like a collectible figure display, not a real food photograph.

Counted decorative elements to include: 1 miniature pastel parasol inserted into the parfait on the left, 1 metal dessert spoon angled upward on the right, 1 pink-and-clear inflatable swim ring at the lower right, 2 seashell decorations near the front right, 1 large pink hibiscus flower near the left cup area, 1 clear parfait glass/cup shape partially visible behind the legs, 1 small acrylic display plaque at the bottom right, and many tiny star crystals embedded in the ice but keep the foreground star crystals visibly distinct.

Text layout: Place large glowing Japanese title text at the upper left reading のぞむ. Under it, add the English subtitle “SUMMER PARFAIT FIGURE”. Below that, place a pink ribbon label reading 住み着きました. Under the ribbon, add the flavor line “＊ POOL PARFAIT Ver. ＊”. On the small bottom-right plaque, repeat four centered lines: “のぞむ”, “SUMMER PARFAIT FIGURE”, “住み着きました”, and “POOL PARFAIT Ver.”. Use elegant serif lettering for English, soft rounded glowing lettering for Japanese, white and pastel blue text with a magical glow.

Visual style: Ultra-cute Japanese anime merchandise illustration, pastel blue and pink palette, transparent resin, glass, shaved ice, sparkles, lens bloom, soft sunlight, glossy highlights, delicate details, magical summer collectible figure advertisement. Add small doodle stars and sparkles around the title. The overall mood is refreshing, sweet, luxurious, and limited-edition.

Constraints: Keep the figure fully visible from head to sandals, preserve the exact poster-like composition with text on the upper left and plaque on the lower right, avoid dark colors, avoid horror or realism, no extra characters, no watermark, no messy unreadable typography.

2117903200341231766.promptEn: Present a relaxed, hand-drawn observation map centered on any subject: a large area of clean white paper as the primary space. The subject matter is broken down into several small physical-like graphics, cross-sections, interconnected small items, short repetitive objects, and partial close-ups, scattered across the upper and middle sections of the page. They do not form a rigid grid but are connected by loose line spacing similar to horizontal reading, staggered white space, and handwritten phrases, creating an intimate rhythm like taste, touch, sound, or movement recorded on the fly. Small graphics use theme-derived materials and colors, maintaining small dimensions, rounded contours, slight perspective, and hand-painted coloring traces. Local details like particles, charred edges, crumbs, textures, or cross-sectional details are preserved; they should not become uniform icons but should feel like physical notes between picture book food illustrations and journal stickers. Text is the skeleton of the image: using thin black handwritten lines with a pseudonymous or childlike feel, loose character spacing, slightly jumping baselines, short words interspersed around graphics, some strings close to graphic edges, and some floating independently in the white space. A smaller signature-like explanation can be placed at the bottom. Colors are derived from the theme itself, with white paper occupying the largest area and thin black text carrying the information. 2117903200341231769.promptEn:
Goal: Create a polished advertising storyboard sheet for a 15-second Fanta Orange commercial titled FANTA ORANGE PLANET, with the subtitle A Universe Made of Freshness and small line “15 Seconds Commercial.”

Canvas: Wide 3:2 landscape presentation board on a white background, clean agency storyboard layout. Use a bold top header area, then a 5-column by 2-row grid containing exactly 10 storyboard panels. Each panel has a cinematic orange sci-fi image on top and a white caption block beneath it with a scene number, timecode, bold scene title, and short description. Thin light-gray grid lines, crisp typography, premium commercial pitch-deck feel.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed, glossy, high-energy beverage commercial concept art. Dominant colors are vivid orange, golden yellow, citrus green accents, deep cosmic blues, and white highlights. Use sparkling carbonation bubbles, floating orange slices, ice cubes, juice splashes, glowing citrus particles, soda rivers, and dramatic backlighting throughout. The brand should feel playful, fresh, explosive, and fantastical.

Header text: Large navy italic uppercase title “FANTA ORANGE PLANET” on the left. To the right, orange text “A Universe Made of Freshness” and black text “15 Seconds Commercial.”

Layout and panel count: Include exactly 10 numbered panels, arranged left to right across the top row as 01–05 and left to right across the bottom row as 06–10. Each panel must include its visible timecode and scene title.

Panel details:
1. “01” timecode “0.0–1.5s”, title “THE ORANGE PLANET”: A dark cosmic space slowly transforms into a vibrant orange universe. A giant glowing orange fruit floats like a planet, surrounded by tiny citrus particles and sparkling golden light.
2. “02” timecode “1.5–3.0s”, title “A WORLD OF CITRUS”: Extreme macro shot of the orange planet surface. The texture of orange peel becomes a beautiful landscape with citrus mountains, glowing juice rivers, and tiny bubbles floating in the atmosphere.
3. “03” timecode “3.0–4.5s”, title “THE ARRIVAL”: A giant Fanta orange can enters the orange planet orbit surrounded by floating ice crystals, orange slices, fresh leaves, and sparkling carbonation bubbles.
4. “04” timecode “4.5–6.0s”, title “CITRUS EXPLOSION”: The Fanta can opens dramatically. A massive wave of orange soda explodes like a golden ocean across the planet surface. Citrus waterfalls appear everywhere.
5. “05” timecode “6.0–7.5s”, title “ENTER THE FLAVOR”: Camera flies through the Orange Planet. Orange slices become floating islands, carbonation bubbles become glowing planets, and rivers of sparkling soda flow through the landscape.
6. “06” timecode “7.5–9.0s”, title “PURE FUN ENERGY”: Tiny fantasy characters explore the orange world, sliding on soda waves, jumping across ice crystals, and celebrating inside the colorful citrus universe.
7. “07” timecode “9.0–10.5s”, title “THE HEART OF FRESHNESS”: A giant Fanta can rises from the center of the planet. Orange juice waves spiral around the can while sunlight creates a magical golden glow.
8. “08” timecode “10.5–12.0s”, title “FROZEN MOMENT”: Everything freezes in mid-air. Orange slices, ice cubes, soda droplets, bubbles, and citrus particles create a perfect circular composition around the product.
9. “09” timecode “12.0–13.5s”, title “HERO PRODUCT”: A chilled Fanta can stands on a glowing orange crystal platform. Behind it, the entire Orange Planet rotates slowly with sparkling atmosphere.
10. “10” timecode “13.5–15.0s”, title “BRAND SIGNATURE”: Clean white radiant background with the large FANTA logo centered, orange bubbles around it, and the tagline OPEN A WORLD OF FUN below in curved orange lettering.

Constraints: Use exactly 10 panels and no extra panels. Keep the storyboard captions legible and in English. Make the product can and logo look like a recognizable orange soda brand advertisement without adding unrelated brands, watermarks, or extra UI elements.

2117903200341231775.promptZh: 在阳光斑驳的远古森林中创作一幅电影感奇幻写实（cinematic fantasy realism）场景：左前方近景为一名年轻的人类冒险者——一位睁大双眼的男孩的特写（close-up）三分之二侧脸，他正蹲伏或跪坐，仰头惊叹，嘴唇微张，仿佛在问：“你在跟我说话吗？” 他拥有一头凌乱的深棕色头发，温暖肤色上沾着细小的森林尘埃，神情生动的棕色眼睛，身着磨损的深色皮革冒险者护甲，护甲带有层叠式肩甲、皮带、搭扣、金属扣件，并在其身后隐约可见剑柄轮廓。画面右侧与视线齐平处悬浮着恰好一只微小的精灵——一位纤巧的金发女性精灵，长着尖耳，发髻蓬松，发间插着几朵小白花，身穿由叶片构成的米白与淡绿色花瓣裙，身体前倾，伸出一只手伸向男孩。该精灵恰好拥有两片硕大半透明的昆虫状翅膀，翅脉纤细呈金色；赤足，脚踝佩戴藤蔓脚链；身后拖曳着数缕发光丝线，末端凝结成光滴。围绕两位角色布满数十颗暖金色萤火虫般的光点与魔法尘埃微粒，以精灵周身为最密集。采用浅景深（shallow depth of field），背景为柔和虚化的绿色森林，高耸的树干、青苔、枝叶，以及透过林冠洒落的焦外虚化（bokeh）阳光。布光采用金色背光（golden backlight）与轮廓光（rim light），令精灵翅膀边缘泛起辉光，呈现真实肌肤高光，并营造梦幻而魔幻的氛围。构图：正方形画幅，男孩面部居左且占据约半幅画面，精灵悬浮于右上方并面朝男孩，二人目光交汇构成情感焦点。风格：超精细照片级写实（photorealistic）奇幻电影剧照（fantasy film still），高动态范围（HDR），自然材质质感，柔和电影感色彩分级（soft cinematic color grading），无文字，无水印，无额外精灵或其他角色。

2117903200341231776.promptEn: 9:16 vertical version, modern oriental female dreamscape dimensional papercut art, modern oriental papercut art, layered paper cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, poetic female dreamscape. The theme of the work is 'She walks into the unfinished page of a Dunhuang mural.' A visual 24-year-old oriental adult female, mysterious, elegant, quiet and determined, walking alone along long steps in a paper-carved cave. The character has a clear oval face, slender almond eyes slightly raised, and a quiet, focused expression. Long black hair is half-draped and half-tied, with strands naturally connecting to Feitian-style paper ribbons, wearing light gold floating clouds and small flower branch hair accessories. The character wears a multi-layered paper art long dress composed of ochre, stone green, peacock blue and gold. The hem features Feitian, caisson, sand patterns and Crescent Spring-style hollow patterns. The outer layer of silk ribbons flutters lightly behind her in the wind. The clothing has clear paper thickness, fiber texture, cut edges and dense hollow structures. The scene uses a relatively simple multi-layered stage-style composition, not crowded with mural characters. The main subject is a huge, nested Dunhuang-style paper-carved cave entrance. The arched door frame occupies the main space of the picture, with a large caisson paper-carved pattern at the top as a visual anchor. Only a few Feitian paper carvings and mural character silhouettes are kept on the left and right of the door, creating a sense of a dream of civilization, but avoiding complex crowding. The character is located in a small position at the lower center of the screen, facing away or two-thirds side-facing away from the camera, walking towards the huge door along several wide paper art steps. The scale of the character is significantly smaller than the door to emphasize the massive scale of the cave. Through the door, you can directly see another opened Dunhuang dream: vast golden sand dunes, curved blue water like the Crescent Spring, distant mountains, paper art clouds and a thin moon in the sky. The dunes and water surface are formed by multiple layers of paper, and the space is open and clean, without too many buildings. The overall colors are brighter and clearer than traditional Dunhuang colors: dominated by high-saturation but high-end peacock blue, stone green, ochre and warm sand gold, with an appropriate amount of cinnabar orange-red as a visual highlight. The outer layer of the door uses ochre and gold, the middle layer adds stone green and peacock blue, the distant desert uses warm gold and light ochre, and the Crescent Spring uses a bright blue-green. Colors are clearly separated from each other, without a uniform brownish-yellow filter, not gray or dirty. The lighting uses a transition from warm inside the cave to brighter outside. Golden celestial light shines from the direction of the distant dunes and Crescent Spring, passing through the paper-carved door and falling on the steps and the character's silhouette, forming a clear but soft guiding light. The edges of the caisson, Feitian, door frame and character's ribbons have a delicate translucent feel, while the dark areas still maintain layers of peacock blue, stone green and ochre. All caves, caissons, Feitian, sand dunes, Crescent Spring, clouds, characters and clothing must be unified into a high-level dimensional paper carving language. Strengthen the real paper fibers, paper layer thickness, hand-cut edges, slight creases and inter-layer projections. The whole piece is like a high-end Dunhuang-themed paper carving art installation, rather than a common mural illustration. The overall mood is: ancient, mysterious, quiet, vast, civilization is reawakening. The focus of the picture is 'Behind a huge doorway, another page of the ancient world is reopened', the composition is simple and powerful, the character is small, the space is large, and the colors are bright and transparent. Negative prompt: real-life photography, ordinary anime, plastic 3D, resin, clay, felt, children's handmade, ordinary Dunhuang tourism illustration, too many mural characters, accumulated decorations, overcrowded screen, oversized characters, large number of Buddha statues stacked, cave too dark, brownish-yellow filter, overall gray, dirty colors, saturation too low, dead black in shadows, inconspicuous Crescent Spring, sand dune space too small, doorway too small, messy paper layers, blurred paper edges, material separation between character and background, text, Logo, watermark.

The hamster is centered-right, large and close-up, with golden fur on the head and back, white cheeks and body, round ears, glossy black eyes, tiny pink nose, and visible little paws resting on the table.

Panel 1: The hamster looks annoyed and unimpressed, facing forward with narrowed eyes and a small stern mouth. The microphone sits to the hamster’s left, angled toward it but not being touched. Add bold Japanese meme text along the lower center of this panel reading チッ うるせぇな. Style the text as thick rounded characters, green fill, white outline, subtle dark shadow.

Panel 2: The same hamster now leans toward the microphone and holds it with one tiny paw, looking performatively cheerful and apologetic with wide eyes and a small open smiling mouth. Add bold Japanese meme text along the lower center reading 反省してま〜す. Style this text as thick rounded characters, blue fill, white outline, subtle dark shadow.

Subject details: Use a hamster with golden orange and white plush fur, highly detailed individual hairs, small whiskers, soft chubby body, and expressive cartoon-like eyes while keeping the rest photorealistic. The microphone is black with a metal mesh grille, cable trailing off the lower left, and a compact black stand.

布局：两个面板均显示覆盖画面底部三分之一的蓝色桌布、米色幕布背景，以及位于左侧的小型桌面麦克风支架上的黑色有线手持麦克风。仓鼠位于画面右中部，体型较大且为特写（close-up），头部与背部为金色毛发，脸颊与身体为白色，耳朵圆润，眼睛乌黑发亮，鼻头粉嫩小巧，两只小爪子清晰可见并 resting 在桌面上。

面板1：仓鼠面露恼怒与不屑，正视前方，双眼微眯，嘴角微抿呈严肃状。麦克风置于仓鼠左侧，朝向仓鼠但未被触碰。在此面板下部中央添加粗体日文表情包文字：“チッ うるせぇな”。文字样式为粗圆字体，绿色填充，白色描边，带细微深色阴影。

面板2：同一只仓鼠此刻身体前倾靠近麦克风，并用一只小爪子握住麦克风，表情夸张地显得 cheerful 且充满歉意——双眼睁大，嘴巴微张呈微笑状。在该面板下部中央添加粗体日文表情包文字：“反省してま〜す”。文字样式为粗圆字体，蓝色填充，白色描边，带细微深色阴影。

主体细节：仓鼠毛色为金橙与白色相间的毛绒质感，毛发高度精细，根根分明；配有细小胡须；身体柔软圆润；眼睛富有表现力、呈卡通化风格，其余部分保持照片级写实（photorealistic）。麦克风为黑色，配金属网状拾音头，线缆自画面左下角延伸而出，支架为紧凑型黑色底座。

视觉风格：日系网络表情包截图风格，以真实感十足的可爱动物 parody 新闻发布会致歉场景；仓鼠与麦克风处于 crisp focus（锐利对焦）；构图简洁干净；不出现额外角色、无商标、无水印、除两段标题文字外无其他文字。

Show the mask design as a collection of exactly 7 physical helmets stored in an old teal wooden cabinet: 1 main helmet on the upper shelf, 1 partial helmet cropped at the far upper-left edge, 1 large open helmet at the lower-left front, 1 broken/open helmet behind it, 1 tilted helmet in the lower center, 1 helmet at the lower-right rear, and 1 front-right helmet containing a small black cat. Preserve the red leather, black eye openings, metal studs, silver side fins, cracked seams, and worn handcrafted look from the reference, but make all helmets tangible objects with realistic scuffs and damage.

Add a new environment: a decayed teal wooden closet or cabinet interior with chipped paint, dark shadows, worn planks, grime, and moody cinematic lighting. Add exactly 3 small aged photographs pinned or hanging on the right wall. Use a dark teal-and-red color grade, shallow atmospheric shadows, subtle film grain, and high-detail photorealism. Keep the composition vertical, intimate, and slightly eerie, as if discovered inside an abandoned room. Avoid adding people, text, logos, or extra helmets beyond the 7 listed.
2117903200341231791.promptZh: 以提供的参考图像为设计来源，将红色带尖刺的皮革头盔/面具转化为一个写实 grounded 的静物场景（still-life scene），而非动作肖像（action portrait）。移除佩戴者及运动轨迹（motion trails）。将面具设计呈现为共 7 个实体头盔，存放于一个老旧的青绿色木质橱柜中：上层搁板放置 1 个主头盔；左上角远端边缘裁切显示 1 个局部头盔；左下前侧放置 1 个大型开口头盔；其后方放置 1 个破损/开口头盔；下部中央放置 1 个倾斜头盔；右下后方放置 1 个头盔；右前方放置 1 个头盔，内部容纳一只小型黑猫。保留参考图中的红色皮革、黑色眼部开孔、金属铆钉、银色侧鳍、开裂接缝以及手工制作的磨损质感，但使所有头盔均呈现为具有真实划痕与损伤的实体物件。\n\n添加全新环境：一个衰败的青绿色木质壁橱或橱柜内部，表面油漆剥落、阴影浓重、木板磨损、积满污垢，并采用电影感布光（cinematic lighting）。在右侧墙面精准添加 3 张小型陈旧照片，以图钉固定或悬挂方式呈现。采用深青绿色与红色的色调分级（color grade）、浅景深的大气阴影（shallow atmospheric shadows）、细微胶片颗粒（film grain）以及高细节照片级写实（photorealistic）效果。构图保持竖版、私密且略带诡异氛围，仿佛在一间废弃房间内偶然发现。禁止添加人物、文字、标识（logos）或超出所列 7 个之外的额外头盔。

2117903200341231792.promptEn: Ultra-clean automotive poster design featuring a [CAR], perfect side profile, positioned low and centered in the frame. A small refined [BRAND] badge/logo sits near the upper corner, with a short slogan reading “[SLOGAN]” in tiny modernist uppercase typography. A dramatic diagonal burst of layered [COLORS] speed stripes slices across the composition from upper corner to lower center, creating motion and visual rhythm. Warm ivory paper background with expansive negative space. Crisp technical illustration, precise proportions, subtle screen-print texture, fine ink outlines, minimal shadows, gallery-quality graphic design. Thin paint drips and color trails descending beneath the ground plane. Swiss modernist automotive poster, refined vector precision, museum poster quality, aspect ratio 4:5.
2117903200341231792.promptZh: 超洁净汽车海报设计， featuring 一款 [CAR]，完美侧视图，位置低且居中于画面。一个精致小巧的 [BRAND] 徽章/标志位于上角附近，配有一句简短标语 “[SLOGAN]”，采用极小号现代主义大写字体（modernist uppercase typography）。一道富有戏剧性的对角线分层 [COLORS] 速度条纹（speed stripes）从上角斜贯至画面下中心，营造动感与视觉节奏。暖象牙色纸张背景，留白广阔。清晰锐利的技术插画（technical illustration），比例精准，带有微妙的丝网印刷质感（screen-print texture），精细墨线勾勒（ink outlines），阴影极简，具备画廊级平面设计（gallery-quality graphic design）水准。细长颜料滴落痕迹与色彩拖尾沿地平线下方垂落。瑞士现代主义汽车海报（Swiss modernist automotive poster），精炼的矢量精度（vector precision），博物馆级海报品质（museum poster quality），画幅比 4:5。

2117903200341231793.promptEn: Create a vertical anime-style gothic portrait illustration of a beautiful androgynous young man lying diagonally on deep crimson, black-patterned fabric, hugging a worn tan teddy bear close to his chest. The character has silvery white tousled medium-length hair with long bangs covering part of one eye and a short side ponytail tied behind the ear, pale skin, soft pink eyes, long lashes, and a faint mischievous smile with slightly parted lips. Dress him in a formal dark burgundy-black suit jacket, white dress shirt, black ribbon bow tie, and white gloves, with dramatic glossy folds and sharp tailoring. The teddy bear is tan and plush, with exactly one black button eye visible, one pale square eye patch over the other eye, a small black nose, simple stitched mouth, rounded ears, two arms, and two legs. Surround them with sewing and dollmaking details on the fabric: exactly one open pair of scissors on the left edge, exactly two dark thread spools with metallic rims at the top-right and bottom-right corners, thin loose threads, lace trim along the right side, and exactly four red flower blossoms plus scattered small red petals. Use a close-up tilted composition, the character's face near the upper center and the teddy bear centered, with warm golden rim light across the hair and face, cool cyan edge accents in the shadows, rich reds and blacks, high contrast, painterly brush texture, crisp line art, intricate hair strands, luxurious gothic mood, intimate and slightly eerie atmosphere. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.
2117903200341231793.promptZh: 创作一幅垂直构图的动漫风格哥特式肖像插画，描绘一位美丽而中性的年轻男子，斜卧在深绯红色、带有黑色图案的织物上，怀中紧紧抱着一只磨损的米色泰迪熊。角色拥有银白色蓬松的中长发，额前垂落长长的刘海，遮住一只眼睛，耳后束着一个短侧马尾；肤色苍白，眼睛呈柔和的粉红色，睫毛纤长，嘴角带着一抹淡淡的狡黠微笑，双唇微微分开。他身穿正式的深酒红近黑色西装外套、白色正装衬衫、黑色丝带蝴蝶结及白色手套，服装具有戏剧性的高光褶皱与利落剪裁。泰迪熊为米色毛绒材质，仅露出一只黑色纽扣眼，另一只眼睛上覆盖着一块浅色方形眼罩，配有小巧的黑色鼻子、简笔缝线嘴、圆润的耳朵、两条手臂与两条腿。在织物周围布置缝纫与玩偶制作细节：左侧边缘恰好放置一把张开的剪刀，右上角与右下角各有一个深色线轴（带金属包边），织物上散落着细而松脱的线头，右侧边缘饰有蕾丝花边，并恰好分布四朵红色花朵及零星散落的小红花瓣。采用特写（close-up）倾斜构图，角色面部靠近画面正上方中央，泰迪熊居于画面中心；发丝与面部边缘施以温暖的金色轮廓光（rim light），阴影处点缀冷调青蓝色边缘光（edge accents），整体以浓郁的红色与黑色为主，高对比度，富有绘画感的笔触质感，清晰锐利的线稿，精细刻画的每一缕发丝，奢华的哥特式氛围，亲密而略带诡异的气息。画面中不出现文字、水印或额外人物。

2117903200341231794.promptEn:
Goal: Create a clean browser-page screenshot showing a Chinese case-study section that presents a large bilingual infographic poster about an urban systems map.

Canvas: Landscape screenshot, about 917×833 px, white webpage background, cropped so the very top shows the tail end of a Chinese paragraph and the bottom cuts off part of the poster. Use crisp UI-like rendering, not a full browser chrome.

Webpage layout: At the top-left of the visible section, show a small framed picture emoji/icon followed by the bold Chinese heading “精选案例”, with a thin gray horizontal divider line underneath spanning most of the width. Below it, show a bold subsection title: “案例一：信息图可视化”. Under that title place one large infographic image centered with narrow margins.

Main poster: Design an information-dense bilingual atlas poster titled “城市生命系统图谱” with the English subtitle “Urban Metabolism Atlas”. Under the title add the small bilingual tagline “城市是一個有生命的系統 / The City is a Living System”. The poster should look like a professional architectural/urban-planning infographic: off-white background, navy headline text, thin gray panel borders, small bilingual labels, diagrammatic icons, and an isometric cutaway city illustration occupying the central majority.

Poster top elements: On the upper left, include a compass rose marked N and a scale bar labeled “Scale” with tick marks 0, 50, 100, 200, 500m. Near the top center, include a boxed “System Legend” with exactly 10 colored line samples labeled: Electricity, Gas, Heating, Communication, Traffic, Logistics, Data Flow, People Flow, Clean Water, Wastewater. On the upper right, include one small inset map card labeled “Location”, showing a simplified city map with green parks, blue waterways, gray streets, and a red boundary.

Central city illustration: Show a dense isometric smart city with many high-rise towers, mid-rise blocks, roads with cars and buses, a blue canal or river, bridges, street trees, plazas, underground metro tunnels and utility pipes visible in a cutaway at the bottom. Include small details such as a drone, airplane, rooftop solar panels, transit stations, pedestrians, and service vehicles. Use thin colored network lines running through the city to imply water, energy, data, logistics, and transit flows. Add exactly 5 visible circular numbered callout markers in the central scene: 6 on a building, 3 near a road/transport corridor, 8 near the right street edge, 9 in a green plaza, and 10 near an underground tunnel/canal edge.

Side information cards: Place exactly 6 visible rounded rectangular system cards around the city, each with a colored numbered badge, bilingual title, small bullet labels, and mini diagrams. Left column has 3 cards: 1 “能源系统 / Energy Grid” with solar panels, battery storage, EV charging, and a car; 2 “城市水循环 / Water Cycle” with water plant, rainwater collection, sewage treatment, reclaimed water, and groundwater diagrams; 3 “交通网络 / Transportation” with a subway train, bus, roads, bicycle icon, and route lines. Right column has 3 cards: 6 “建筑内部系统 / Building Systems” with a cutaway building showing floors, HVAC, fire safety, BMS control, and pipes; 7 “公共服务 / Public Services” with hospital, school, fire station, police station, and community service icons; 8 “食物与物流 / Food & Logistics” with warehouse, cold chain, last-mile delivery, truck, boxes, and robot delivery. Keep the lower portions of the left and right columns slightly cropped by the screenshot edge, matching a captured page view.

Visual style: Highly detailed semi-realistic isometric illustration mixed with technical infographic design, muted grays and whites with navy typography, accent colors yellow, cyan, red, purple, orange, and green. Text should be mostly legible at headline level but many small labels can be tiny. Maintain the feeling of an authentic Chinese web article showcasing an example image.

Constraints: Do not add browser address bars, watermarks, floating toolbars, or extra social-media UI. Preserve the Chinese headings on the webpage and the bilingual poster title hierarchy. The image should look like a screenshot of a generated infographic embedded in a documentation page.

2117903200341231795.promptEn:
Ultra-detailed cinematic anime-inspired fashion illustration of a handsome young man in his early 20s, captured from an extreme low-angle, near-ground perspective, recreating the dramatic perspective and stylish editorial composition of the reference.

He has thick, naturally wavy jet-black hair, slightly tousled and swept back, expressive deep-brown eyes, strong masculine eyebrows, a sharp defined jawline, prominent cheekbones, straight nose, and a confident, relaxed expression as he looks down toward the camera.

He wears a sophisticated deep emerald-green oversized long coat with flowing fabric and subtle satin texture, layered over a soft ivory high-neck shirt, warm taupe wide-leg tailored trousers, and premium cream-and-forest-green chunky sneakers. His hands are casually tucked into his trouser pockets, giving him an effortless, confident masculine presence.

The nearest sneaker is dramatically enlarged in the foreground, almost touching the camera, creating strong fisheye-like perspective and cinematic depth. His long coat spreads naturally across the floor, with beautifully rendered folds and soft shadows.

Beside him sits a sleek black-and-white tuxedo cat wearing stylish amber-gold sunglasses, calmly looking toward the camera, adding a playful luxury-fashion element.

Color palette: emerald green, ivory, warm taupe, cream, subtle gold and deep charcoal accents — completely different from the reference's lavender-gray palette.

Background: minimalist warm cream studio environment with a clean seamless floor, soft diffused sunlight, subtle golden ambient glow, delicate shadows, and plenty of negative space.

Art style: premium modern anime illustration, semi-realistic handsome male character, sophisticated fashion editorial, painterly digital artwork, highly detailed facial features, realistic fabric texture and folds, elegant linework, cinematic lighting, subtle rim lighting, refined muted luxury colors, polished magazine-cover quality.

Composition: full-body portrait, extreme ground-level camera, dramatic foreshortening, oversized foreground sneaker, tall imposing silhouette, cat positioned beside the man's leg, vertical 4:5 composition.

Mood: effortlessly handsome, confident, elegant, fashionable, mysterious, youthful, cinematic.

Negative prompt: text, watermark, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted feet, duplicate character, blurry face, poor anatomy, awkward proportions, low detail.
2117903200341231795.promptZh:
超精细、电影感布光（cinematic lighting）的动漫风格时尚插画，描绘一位二十出头的英俊青年，采用极低角度、近地面视角拍摄，复刻参考图中富有戏剧性的透视与时尚杂志级构图。

他拥有一头浓密、天然微卷的乌黑头发，略显凌乱并向后梳理；眼神深邃灵动，为深棕色；眉毛浓密有力，尽显男性气概；下颌线清晰锐利；颧骨高挺；鼻梁笔直；神情自信而放松，目光微微向下投向镜头。

他身穿一件精致的深翡翠绿色 oversized 长款大衣，面料垂坠流动，带有细腻的缎面质感；内搭柔软的象牙白高领衬衫；下着暖灰褐色阔腿修身西裤；脚踩一双高级奶油色与森林绿拼接的厚底运动鞋。双手随意插在西裤口袋中，散发出毫不费力却极具力量感的男性气场。

前景中离镜头最近的一只运动鞋被戏剧性放大，几乎触碰到镜头，营造出强烈的鱼眼式透视效果与电影感纵深。他修长的大衣自然铺展于地面，褶皱刻画精美，阴影柔和细腻。

他身侧坐着一只线条流畅的黑白配色燕尾服猫，佩戴时尚的琥珀金色太阳镜，神态沉静地望向镜头，为画面增添一抹俏皮而奢华的时尚气息。

色彩方案：翡翠绿、象牙白、暖灰褐、奶油色，辅以微妙的金色与深炭灰色点缀——整体配色与参考图中的薰衣草灰调截然不同。

背景：极简主义暖奶油色影棚环境，地面干净无缝；光线为柔和漫射阳光，伴有细腻的金色环境辉光、精巧的阴影过渡，以及大量留白空间。

艺术风格：高端现代动漫插画，半写实风格的英俊男性角色，高级时尚杂志级视觉呈现，绘画感数字艺术作品，面部细节高度精细，织物纹理与褶皱真实可信，线条优雅考究，电影感布光（cinematic lighting），微妙的轮廓光（rim lighting），精致克制的轻奢色调，具备 polished 杂志封面级品质。

构图：全身人像，极低地面视角，强烈透视缩短（foreshortening），前景运动鞋夸张放大，人物剪影高大而具有压迫感，猫位于男子腿部一侧，竖版 4:5 构图。

氛围：毫不费力的帅气、自信、优雅、时尚、神秘、青春洋溢、电影感十足。

负面提示词：文字、水印、标识、额外肢体、手部畸形、足部扭曲、重复人物、面部模糊、解剖结构错误、比例失调、细节不足。

2117903200341231796.promptEn: Create a close-up cinematic portrait photograph of a young East Asian woman turning her head over her bare shoulder and looking directly into the camera with a calm, slightly introspective expression. Frame her from the upper chest to the top of the head in a vertical 4:5 composition, face slightly left of center, shoulder in the foreground, neck elongated, head tilted subtly downward and back toward the viewer. She has dark brown-black hair loosely pinned up in a messy bun with fine stray strands across the forehead, temples, cheek, and nape, catching the light. Define the facial structure clearly: oval face, soft jawline, delicate cheekbones, straight natural brows, almond-shaped dark brown eyes with small catchlights, a softly rounded nose bridge and tip, natural full lips, visible skin pores, faint under-eye texture, tiny beauty marks on the cheek and neck, and realistic uneven skin sheen. Use warm late-afternoon directional backlight from behind the right side, with soft chiaroscuro across the face: a golden rim light outlining the hair, cheek, shoulder, and neck, gentle shadow on the far side of the face, specular highlights on the eyes and lips, and no flat frontal lighting. She wears a thin gray spaghetti-strap top, only the strap and bare shoulder visible. Background is an indistinct warm gray-brown interior or shaded outdoor wall, heavily blurred with shallow depth of field, subtle haze, soft bokeh, and a filmic natural color grade. Make it look like an intimate 85mm lens portrait on full-frame camera, very shallow depth of field, natural grain, imperfect organic realism, fine flyaway hairs, no plastic skin, no overly clean beauty retouching, no text, no watermark, no extra people.
2117903200341231796.promptZh: 创作一幅特写（close-up）电影感（cinematic）人像摄影，画面主体为一位年轻的东亚女性，她正将头转向自己裸露的肩膀后方，并直视镜头，神情平静、略带内省。采用竖构图、4:5画幅比例，取景范围从上胸部至头顶；面部略偏画面左侧中心，肩部位于前景，颈部拉长，头部微微向下并向观者方向后仰。她拥有一头深棕近黑色的头发，松散地盘成一个凌乱的发髻，额前、太阳穴、脸颊及颈后有细碎的散落发丝，在光线下泛出微光。清晰刻画面部结构：椭圆形脸型、柔和的下颌线、精致的颧骨、自然笔直的眉毛、杏仁状深棕色眼睛（带有细小的高光点）、鼻梁与鼻尖圆润柔和、嘴唇自然丰盈、皮肤可见毛孔、眼下纹理轻微、脸颊与颈部有细小的痣，以及真实而不均一的皮肤光泽。采用右侧后方投来的温暖午后方向性逆光（directional backlight），面部呈现柔和的明暗对比（chiaroscuro）：金色轮廓光（rim light）勾勒出发丝、脸颊、肩部与颈部轮廓；面部远侧覆以轻柔阴影；双眼与唇部呈现镜面高光（specular highlights）；避免平直正面照明。她身穿一件薄款灰色细肩带背心，仅露出肩带与裸露的肩部。背景为模糊不清的暖灰褐色室内空间或遮荫户外墙面，经极浅景深（shallow depth of field）大幅虚化，伴有微妙雾感、柔和焦外虚化（bokeh）及电影感（filmic）自然色彩调校。整体效果应模拟全画幅相机搭配85mm镜头拍摄的私密人像：景深（depth of field）极浅、带有自然胶片颗粒感、追求不完美的有机真实感（imperfect organic realism）、呈现细微的飞散发丝（flyaway hairs）、杜绝塑料质感肌肤、避免过度洁净的美颜修图（beauty retouching），画面中不得出现文字、水印或额外人物。

2117903200341231797.promptEn: Create an ultra-realistic black-and-white lifestyle portrait of a young Black man sitting on the right side of a wide indoor windowsill beside a tabby cat, captured in a quiet, intimate moment with no text. The man has short close-cropped hair and a calm gentle expression, wearing a plain white oversized T-shirt, dark denim shorts, white low-top sneakers, a wristwatch, and a ring. He sits leaning slightly back against the window frame with his arms crossed, legs extended downward and ankles loosely crossed, looking down toward the cat with a soft smile. The cat sits upright on the left side of the sill, facing the man and looking up at him. Use a vertical portrait composition, full body visible from head to shoes, with a large industrial-style window behind them divided by dark metal mullions; outside the glass, show softly blurred apartment buildings, balconies, trees, and bright daylight. The interior is minimal, with a deep white windowsill, plain wall, smooth floor, and gentle natural window light. Style the image as a candid documentary fashion photograph, high-resolution monochrome, realistic skin texture, soft contrast, shallow depth of field, peaceful atmosphere, quiet companionship, no props beyond the watch and ring, no watermark, no captions.
2117903200341231797.promptZh: 创作一幅超写实的黑白生活人像，画面中一位年轻的黑人男性坐在宽大室内窗台右侧，身旁伴有一只虎斑猫，捕捉其安静而亲密的瞬间，画面中无任何文字。该男子留着短寸发，神情平静温和，身穿一件纯白色宽松T恤、深色牛仔短裤、白色低帮运动鞋，佩戴一只腕表和一枚戒指。他微微向后倚靠在窗框上，双臂交叉，双腿自然下垂，脚踝松散交叠，低头望向猫，面带柔和微笑。猫则端坐于窗台左侧，面朝男子，仰头注视着他。采用竖幅人像构图，完整呈现从头部至鞋尖的全身形象；背景为一扇大型工业风格窗户，由深色金属竖梃分隔；玻璃窗外呈现柔和虚化的公寓楼、阳台、树木及明亮的日光。室内陈设极简：纯白且厚实的窗台、素色墙面、光滑地面，以及柔和的自然窗光。整体风格设定为纪实风时尚摄影（documentary fashion photograph），高分辨率单色影像，真实细腻的皮肤质感，柔和对比度，浅景深（shallow depth of field），宁静氛围，静谧的陪伴感；除腕表与戒指外不添加任何道具；无水印，无字幕。

2117903200341231798.promptEn: Create a flagship commercial advertising poster for an original ready-to-drink coffee brand named "RISE SHOT". Use ultra-realistic commercial lifestyle photography, not illustration, not 3D render. Merge Transit restraint with Orbit energy while converting all headline and campaign text into English only. Keep the same core structural logic: a bright modern office meeting room with softly blurred charts and presentation boards in the background; one elegant young professional woman standing slightly right of center, smiling with calm confidence while holding a slim coffee can near her face; in front of her, a monochrome grayscale tired office-version figure sits behind an open laptop, representing pre-coffee fatigue; three color-variant coffee cans are aligned in the lower-left foreground; a bold oversized English headline occupies the upper-left to upper-center area; a red angled English campaign tag sits near the lower center. The final image must feel like a Cannes-level FMCG office-energy campaign: witty, aspirational, clean, premium, and product-led. Style lock: ultra-realistic commercial product-and-portrait photography, premium office lifestyle advertising, bright soft daylight interior, clean corporate aesthetic, sharp packaging realism, strong typography hierarchy, contemporary global campaign design. Core composition: vertical poster layout, one standing woman in the mid-right hero zone, one seated grayscale alter-ego figure centered lower-middle behind a laptop, one hero can in the woman’s hand near shoulder height, three SKU cans aligned in the lower-left foreground, large English headline at the top, minimal brand mark in the upper-right, one red callout strip near the lower center. The in-hand coffee can and the bottom SKU lineup must remain the true product heroes, while the woman acts as the aspirational energy bridge. Transit logic: simplify the desk surface, reduce background chart detail, keep the room bright and quiet, shorten all copy, and let the can, the woman, and the before-after contrast carry the campaign. Avoid a cluttered office-ad feeling. Use negative space, clean hierarchy, and disciplined layout to create flagship impact. Orbit logic: build a subtle but clear visual flow from the top headline into the standing woman’s face, then to the can in her hand, down through the grayscale seated figure, and finally into the three cans at bottom left. Add only a very restrained transition effect between the grayscale and color states, such as faint light fragments or minimal tonal drift, to imply motion and transformation without visual noise. Concept logic: show the contrast between "low-energy work mode" and "switched-on performance mode" within one premium frame. The grayscale seated figure feels drained, mentally flat, and stuck at work, while the standing color figure feels refreshed, sharp, productive, and effortlessly confident after coffee. The transition should feel clean, elegant, and believable. Female character: one realistic young adult office woman with natural anatomy, correct shoulders, neck, arms, and hand proportions, natural five fingers, clear finger joints, realistic skin texture, subtle pores, natural lip texture, soft under-eye detail, and believable hair strands. She wears a light tailored blazer over a minimal office top. Expression: relaxed, knowing smile, bright but not exaggerated. Pose: upright, elegant, one arm bent naturally holding the can, body slightly angled, gaze subtly upward-left with confident satisfaction. Alter-ego seated figure: one realistic grayscale office-worn female figure seated behind a laptop at the desk, leaning on one hand with visible fatigue and boredom. Keep her desaturated, softly sculpted, and cleanly integrated into the scene. She should feel like the same person in an earlier drained state, not a separate character. Lighting: soft premium office daylight from upper-left front with gentle ambient fill across the room. The standing woman and coffee can receive the clearest and brightest light. The seated grayscale figure is slightly flatter and dimmer but still readable. Use delicate highlight control on the aluminum cans, hair, blazer folds, laptop edge, and desk surface. No harsh shadows, no muddy haze. Materials and realism: highly realistic slim aluminum coffee cans with commissioned printed labels, subtle metallic reflections, visible rim highlights, and a premium satin finish. Clean matte desk surface with only minimal papers and office items. Soft-focus charts and graphs behind. Clothing shows natural fabric folds and light texture. Skin remains natural, de-AI, and photographic. Color strategy: warm ivory and soft beige office background, cool pale-gray blazer tones, rich can accent colors such as amber gold, forest green, and deep red, plus a strong red campaign tag. The grayscale seated figure provides the main contrast device. Keep the palette disciplined, modern, and premium. Typography and layout: use original English text only, never copy any existing wording. Add a bold top headline such as “ONE SIP. FULL IMPACT.” with a small supporting line like “Switch on. Stay sharp.” Place a red angled tag near the lower center with short copy such as "QUICK BOOST / READY NOW". Add a minimal brand logo in the upper-right. Typography must feel bold, global, and structured, but always secondary to the coffee can and character action. Atmosphere: sharp, witty, modern office confidence, productivity boost, premium convenience coffee, polished workplace aspiration, clean and instantly readable. Quality and physical rules: extremely sharp hero can, readable labels, realistic metallic material, correct hand anatomy, five fingers only, natural face proportions, clean separation between standing figure and grayscale seated figure, believable perspective, no clutter, no cheap flyer feel, no muddy whites, no dead black patches, no distorted laptop, no warped cans, no broken text, no extra limbs. The coffee product must remain visually dominant. Negative prompt: copied brand name, copied slogan, copied packaging text, celebrity face, deformed hands, extra fingers, fused fingers, warped can shape, unreadable label, plastic skin, bad anatomy, messy office, cluttered desk, muddy lighting, low-resolution packaging, cartoon rendering, CGI look, illustration style, chaotic composition, weak product hierarchy, grayscale figure overpowering product, random props, dirty background.

Canvas: Vertical 9:16 image, divided into exactly 4 equal panels by clean white borders, with warm cinematic night photography, shallow depth of field, realistic lens bokeh, and glowing paper lanterns.

Panel 4, bottom right: rear three-quarter view of the character walking away through the lantern-lit crowd, turning slightly with a cute satisfied smile; no food in hand.

Visual style: High-end photorealistic 3D mascot photography, ultra-detailed materials, glossy ceramic/plastic surfaces, realistic fabric texture on the yukata, warm color grading, cinematic depth of field, vertical social-media collage composition.

Constraints: Include exactly 1 recurring character, exactly 4 panels, exactly 3 visible food items across the first three panels, and exactly 2 white bell flowers on the head stem in every panel. Do not add text, captions, logos, watermarks, speech bubbles, or extra characters in focus.

She has long wavy dark brown hair, soft expressive eyes, a calm wistful expression, and wears a cream cardigan over a teal blouse with a long navy skirt and brown shoes. The classroom is warmly lit by late-afternoon sunlight pouring through exactly three large window sections on the right wall, with sheer white curtains glowing and drifting slightly; outside, show a wet school courtyard, greenery, and an old school building reflected in rain puddles. Include exactly one chalkboard on the back-left wall with faint chalk writing and pinned papers, exactly two wooden desks in the foreground and right side, one open sketchbook with architectural drawings on the front desk, jars of brushes, books, stacked papers, small framed paintings, a plaster bust, stools, and aged wooden floorboards. The key magical element is the girl's shadow stretching across the floor and transforming into a luminous miniature galaxy train: a silver-white train with multiple connected cars curving through a star-filled cosmic river on the classroom floor, complete with glowing rails, constellations, tiny planets, nebula dust, sparkles, floating paper fragments, and delicate bridges or station-like structures. Blend realism and fantasy seamlessly so the cosmic train appears to emerge from the dark shadow beneath her feet. Use detailed Japanese anime painterly style, rich environmental storytelling, soft golden rim light, volumetric sunbeams, rain-afterglow atmosphere, intricate highlights, deep navy cosmic blues contrasted with warm amber classroom light, high detail, vertical composition, no watermark, no readable modern signage, no extra characters.
2117903200341231802.promptZh:
创作一幅电影感（cinematic）的竖构图日系动漫风格插画，描绘一场雨后的安静老式美术教室：一名少女侧坐在教室左侧一张磨损的木制课桌边缘。她拥有一头长而微卷的深棕色头发，眼神柔和富有表现力，神情平静而略带怅惘；身穿米色开衫，内搭青绿色衬衫，下着深海军蓝长裙与棕色鞋子。  
教室被午后暖阳温柔照亮，阳光透过右侧墙壁上恰好三扇大型窗格倾泻而入，薄透的白色窗帘泛着柔光、微微飘动；窗外可见湿润的校园庭院、葱郁绿植，以及倒映在积水中的古老校舍。  
后左墙设有一块黑板，上面有淡淡的粉笔字迹与几张 pinned papers（钉住的纸张）；前景与右侧各摆放一张木制课桌；前排课桌上摊开一本素描本，内页绘有建筑草图；另有画笔罐、书籍、叠放的纸张、小幅装框画作、一座石膏半身像、圆凳，以及年代感十足的木质地板。  
画面核心奇幻元素是少女投在地面的影子——它延展而出，并幻化为一列发光的微型银河列车：一列银白色列车由多节车厢相连，在教室地板上蜿蜒穿行于繁星密布的宇宙之河中，配有发光轨道、星座图案、微小行星、星云尘埃、闪烁光点、飘浮的纸片碎片，以及纤巧的桥梁或车站状结构。  
现实主义与幻想元素须无缝融合，使这列宇宙列车仿佛自然地从她脚下那片幽暗阴影中浮现而出。  
采用细腻的日系动漫绘画风格（Japanese anime painterly style），强调丰富的环境叙事（environmental storytelling），辅以柔和的金色轮廓光（rim light），体积感阳光光束（volumetric sunbeams），雨后余晖氛围（rain-afterglow atmosphere），精致高光（intricate highlights），深海军蓝（deep navy）宇宙色调与温暖琥珀色（warm amber）教室光线形成强烈对比，细节丰富，竖向构图，无水印，无任何可读的现代标识，无额外人物。

2117903200341231803.promptEn:
Create an original psychological dark-surrealist scene in a colossal underground archive. Endless shelves of sealed black books rise like skyscrapers and vanish into fog. In the central aisle, a solitary human figure in bone-white clothing kneels before one open book on the floor. No words are visible. From the blank pages rises a delicate life-size figure made entirely of dense black smoke, standing face-to-face with the kneeling person. The smoke figure has no eyes or mouth; instead, its chest contains a small locked crimson door. Thin threads connect that door to the kneeling person’s hands, suggesting a secret self finally acknowledged.

Vertical 9:16 framing, towering shelves create a narrow symmetrical canyon, high-angle shaft of cold silver light, the two figures positioned small in the lower center, immense oppressive scale above them. Black paper, aged stone, floating ash, volumetric fog, subtle polished-floor reflections, premium photorealistic dark concept art, refined editorial composition, quiet dread and introspection rather than horror spectacle.

Color palette: obsidian black, graphite, bone white, cold silver, a single muted crimson accent at the tiny door.

Constraints: entirely original metaphor; blank book pages with absolutely no writing; no recognizable person; no text, symbols, logos, signatures, borders, or watermark.

Avoid: visible letters or runes, portrait close-up, split face, black substance on skin, glowing eyes, gore, skulls, conventional ghosts, fantasy wizard styling, imitation of any named artist.
2117903200341231803.promptZh:
创作一幅原创的心理学暗黑超现实主义场景，设定在一座巨大的地下档案馆中。无数排密封的黑色书籍构成的书架如摩天大楼般耸立，向上延伸并消隐于雾气之中。在中央过道上，一名身穿骨白色服装的人形独自跪在地板上的一本打开的书前。书页上没有任何文字可见。从空白书页中升起一个纤细、等身大小的黑色浓烟构成的人形，与跪地者面对面站立。该烟雾人形没有眼睛或嘴巴；取而代之的是，其胸口嵌有一扇微小的、上锁的深红色门。数根细线从这扇门延伸至跪地者双手，暗示一个终于被承认的秘密自我。

竖构图，9:16 比例；高耸书架形成狭窄、对称的峡谷式空间；一道来自高处的冷银色光线（cold silver light）垂直投射；两人形位于画面下部中央，尺寸微小，其上方则呈现巨大而压抑的空间尺度。材质表现：黑色纸张、陈旧石材、悬浮灰烬、体积雾（volumetric fog）、微妙的抛光地面倒影（polished-floor reflections）；高品质照片级写实（photorealistic）暗黑概念艺术（dark concept art）；精炼的编辑级构图（editorial composition）；情绪基调为静默的恐惧（quiet dread）与内省（introspection），而非恐怖奇观（horror spectacle）。

色彩方案：黑曜石黑（obsidian black）、石墨灰（graphite）、骨白（bone white）、冷银色（cold silver），以及仅在那扇微小门上出现的一抹低饱和度深红色（muted crimson）点缀。

约束条件：必须为完全原创的隐喻；书页必须绝对空白，不可有任何书写内容；不可出现可识别的真实人物；不可包含任何文字、符号、标识、签名、边框或水印。

禁止出现：可见字母或符文（runes）、特写（close-up）、半脸分割（split face）、皮肤表面附着黑色物质、发光的眼睛（glowing eyes）、血腥（gore）、骷髅（skulls）、传统幽灵形象、奇幻巫师风格（fantasy wizard styling），以及对任何署名艺术家（named artist）的模仿。

2117903200341231804.promptEn:
Goal: Create a clean anime-style vertical 4-panel Japanese manga comic about a schoolboy trying to study while a cat interrupts him, ending with him happily petting the cat instead of studying.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, white outer margin, four horizontal rectangular panels stacked top to bottom with thick black borders and narrow white gutters. Soft cel-shaded anime coloring, simple clean line art, cozy bedroom setting, slightly polished AI-anime look.

Characters: A teenage Japanese schoolboy named unnamed boy, short black hair, navy gakuran school uniform with gold buttons, expressive face. A white domestic cat with pink inner ears and pale yellow eyes, cute and mischievous.

Setting: Same bedroom desk in all 4 panels. Wooden desk at left/center, gray adjustable desk lamp on the left, open spiral notebook and pencil on the desk, bed with pale blue blanket and pillow in the background, light blue curtain, beige wall, blue desk chair. Keep camera mostly side-facing and consistent across panels.

Panel count and layout: Exactly 4 panels.
1. Panel 1: The boy sits at the desk writing seriously in a spiral notebook with a pencil, looking worried and sweating slightly. The desk lamp shines over the desk. Add one thought bubble at the upper right containing 明日のテスト、ヤバいな…. Add three small writing sound effects near the notebook, reading 「カリ…」, 「カリ…」, 「カリッ…」.
2. Panel 2: The white cat suddenly jumps or climbs onto the open notebook, stretching across the page and blocking the boy's writing. The boy recoils in surprise with mouth open and blush/sweat. Add one jagged speech bubble at the right containing わっ!?. Add one rounded speech bubble near the cat containing 「なでて〜」. Add one large cat sound effect near the cat reading 「ぬんっ」.
3. Panel 3: The cat sits upright on the notebook facing the boy. The boy leans forward with both cheeks resting in his hands, looking conflicted and slightly annoyed but softening. Add one thought bubble at the right containing …どいてくれないかな. Add one small vertical speech bubble between boy and cat containing 「……」.
4. Panel 4: The boy gives in and pets the cat, smiling warmly with blush while the cat lies curled contentedly on top of the notebook. Pencil lies unused on the desk. Add one speech bubble near the boy containing …ま、いっか。. Add two petting/satisfaction sound effects: 「ぐ！」 near the cat's head and 「すやすや」 near the sleeping cat.

Visible text count: Include exactly 12 visible text elements total: 4 main boy bubbles/thoughts, 1 cat speech bubble, 1 ellipsis bubble, 3 writing SFX, 1 cat entrance SFX, and 2 final petting/sleeping SFX. Use Japanese vertical manga lettering inside bubbles where appropriate.

Visual style: Cute slice-of-life school manga, clear readable panel composition, expressive faces, modest motion lines, light shadows, warm indoor colors, no halftone texture, no heavy rendering, no watermark, no extra panels, no extra characters.

2117903200341231806.promptEn: Ultra-realistic professional commercial product photography of a premium glass perfume bottle placed on a polished black marble table inside a luxurious modern hotel lobby. In the background, a large floor-to-ceiling window overlooks a beautiful modern city skyline during golden hour, with warm sunlight naturally entering the room. The bottle is positioned perfectly in the center of the composition with realistic studio-quality reflections on the glass and marble surface. A few delicate white flowers and minimal luxury accessories are arranged naturally around the product without distracting from it. Soft warm sunlight creates realistic highlights along the edges of the bottle while subtle professional fill lighting keeps the product perfectly exposed. Natural shadows, realistic glass refraction, accurate reflections, physically accurate materials, authentic photography imperfections, shallow depth of field, realistic background bokeh, premium beauty campaign aesthetic, high-end commercial photography, shot on a professional full-frame camera with an 85mm lens, natural cinematic color grading, extremely detailed, photorealistic, 8K resolution, sharp product focus, realistic proportions, vertical 9:16 composition, no fantasy elements, no surreal effects, no floating objects, no distorted packaging, no extra text, no watermark.
2117903200341231806.promptZh: 高端玻璃香水瓶的超写实专业商业产品摄影，香水瓶置于豪华现代酒店大堂内一块抛光黑色大理石桌面上。香水瓶采用精致通透的玻璃设计、优雅金属瓶盖，瓶内液体清晰可见，表面带有细微冷凝水珠，包装洁净且彰显高端品质。背景为一整面落地窗，窗外是黄金时刻（golden hour）下美丽的现代城市天际线，温暖阳光自然洒入室内。香水瓶精准居于画面正中央构图，玻璃瓶身与大理石桌面均呈现真实影棚级反射效果。数朵精致白花及少量极简奢华配饰自然环绕产品摆放，不喧宾夺主。柔和暖光在瓶身边缘形成真实高光，同时辅以细腻专业的补光，使产品曝光完美均衡。自然阴影、真实玻璃折射、准确反射、物理属性真实的材质表现、符合真实摄影的轻微瑕疵、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、背景焦外虚化（bokeh）、高端美妆广告美学（premium beauty campaign aesthetic）、高端商业摄影（high-end commercial photography）、使用专业全画幅相机搭配85mm镜头拍摄、自然电影感色彩分级（natural cinematic color grading）、细节极度丰富、照片级写实（photorealistic）、8K分辨率、产品主体锐利聚焦、比例真实可信、竖构图9:16、无幻想元素、无超现实效果、无悬浮物体、无包装形变、无额外文字、无水印。

2117903200341231807.promptEn: Create a square, ultra-realistic food photograph of a steaming bowl of shoyu ramen on a rustic wooden table in a cozy ramen shop. The camera is close to the bowl at a slightly elevated front angle, using shallow depth of field: the front ramen toppings and bowl rim are crisp while the rear of the bowl, spoon, and warm wood background fall into soft bokeh. Use natural window light from the upper left, warm brown and golden tones, glossy broth highlights, subtle steam haze, and a high-clarity modern smartphone-photo look. The ramen is served in one dark speckled ceramic bowl with an earthy black-brown glaze and tan rim rings. Include exactly 7 visible topping or serving elements: 1 large sheet of dark green nori standing vertically on the left, 1 halved soft-boiled egg with glossy orange yolk at front left, 1 large round slice of pale chashu pork at the front, 1 small white narutomaki fish cake with a pink spiral near the spoon, 3 tan bamboo shoot strips across the back-left noodles, 1 mound of sliced green scallions in the center, and 1 pale ceramic-and-wood ramen spoon resting across the right rear rim filled with amber broth. Show thin yellow noodles curling through clear brown soy broth with small oil droplets. Background is only the textured wooden tabletop and softly blurred warm interior tones; no people, no text, no logos, no extra utensils, no chopsticks.
2117903200341231807.promptZh: 创作一张正方形、超写实风格的食物摄影图片，画面主体是一碗热气腾腾的酱油拉面，置于一家温馨拉面店中质朴的木质桌面上。相机贴近碗体，采用略高于碗沿的前侧俯角构图，并使用浅景深（shallow depth of field）：碗前方的拉面配料与碗沿清晰锐利，而碗后方、汤匙及温暖的木质背景则呈现柔和焦外虚化（bokeh）。采用左上方自然窗光照明，整体色调为暖棕色与金色，汤面呈现油亮高光，伴有细微蒸汽薄雾，成像风格为高清晰度、现代智能手机摄影质感（high-clarity modern smartphone-photo look）。拉面盛装于一只深色斑点陶瓷碗中，釉色为质朴的黑褐色，碗沿呈米褐色环带。画面中须精确包含7个可见的配料或盛具元素：1片深绿色海苔（nori）竖立于左侧；1颗对半切开的溏心蛋，位于左前方，蛋黄油亮呈橙色；1大片淡色叉烧猪肉（chashu pork），圆润厚实，置于正前方；1小块白色鱼糕（narutomaki），带粉色螺旋纹样，靠近汤匙位置；3条米褐色笋干条（bamboo shoot strips）横跨后左方面条区域；1小堆切碎的青葱（green scallions）堆叠于画面中央；1把浅色陶瓷与木柄结合的拉面汤匙（ramen spoon），斜搁于右后侧碗沿，勺中盛满琥珀色汤汁。细黄色面条在清透的棕褐色酱油汤中自然卷曲，汤面浮有细小油滴。背景仅限富有纹理感的木质桌面及柔和虚化的暖调室内环境；画面中不得出现人物、文字、商标、额外餐具或筷子。

2117903200341231808.promptEn: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic studio portrait of an adult Black man in his late 20s seated confidently in a premium black leather armchair against a deep matte-black studio background. The subject faces the camera directly with a calm, composed, professional expression, short neatly trimmed black hair, clean-shaven face, and natural skin texture. Dress him in a crisp white long-sleeve dress shirt, fitted black waistcoat, slim black necktie, black dress trousers, and a silver metal wristwatch with a black round dial on his right wrist. Pose: relaxed but authoritative, torso angled slightly toward camera, right forearm resting on the chair arm with the hand near his lap, left arm relaxed with the hand resting on the seat edge, legs casually apart. Use a medium three-quarter seated crop from upper thighs to head, centered composition, portrait orientation. Lighting should be high-end studio photography: soft key light from front-left, gentle fill on the face, subtle rim separation, controlled highlights on the leather chair, and smooth falloff into the black background. Make the image look like a premium executive portrait shot with a professional full-frame camera, sharp facial detail, realistic fabric folds, glossy leather texture, shallow depth of field, natural color grading, no visible logos, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341231808.promptZh: 创作一幅超写实、电影感（cinematic）的影棚肖像画，描绘一位二十多岁晚期的成年黑人男性，自信地坐在一张高端黑色真皮扶手椅上，背景为深哑光黑色影棚背景。主体正对镜头，神情平静、沉着、专业，留有修剪整齐的短黑发，面部刮净，皮肤纹理自然。他身穿一件挺括的白色长袖正装衬衫、合身的黑色马甲、窄款黑色领带、黑色正装西裤，右手腕佩戴一只银色金属腕表，表盘为黑色圆形。姿态：放松但富有权威感，躯干略微朝向镜头倾斜，右前臂搁在扶手椅扶手上，手靠近大腿；左臂自然放松，手搭在座椅边缘；双腿随意分开。采用中景三分之二坐姿构图（从大腿上部至头部），居中构图，竖版人像比例。布光应为高端影棚摄影风格：前左侧柔和主光（soft key light），面部辅以轻柔补光（gentle fill），轮廓边缘呈现微妙的分离光（subtle rim separation），皮革扶手椅表面高光受控，光线平滑过渡融入黑色背景。画面须呈现高端企业高管肖像照质感，使用专业全画幅相机拍摄效果：面部细节锐利，织物褶皱真实，皮革质感光亮，浅景深（shallow depth of field），自然色彩分级（natural color grading），无可见品牌标识、无文字、无水印。

2117903200341231809.promptZh: 在透明或纯白色背景上绘制一幅干净的动漫风格（anime-style）角色插画，构图为腰部以上（waist-up composition）。主体是一位开朗活泼的年轻女性AI主播偶像（AI-tuber idol），拥有浓烈鲜明的深紫色头发，扎成高侧马尾（high side ponytail），发丝自然垂落、富有流动感，并带有光泽高光（glossy highlights）；眼睛为金琥珀色（golden amber eyes）；面带明亮开怀的笑容，脸颊泛起淡淡红晕（light blush）；姿态亲切友好、热情迎人。她微微面向观者，位于画布偏右侧位置；左臂向左侧伸展，手掌张开，仿佛正在展示某物。她身穿一件青绿色（teal）T恤，胸前印有醒目的白色大字“AITuber”，T恤下摆束进高腰浅色牛仔短裤（pale denim shorts）或牛仔裤（jeans）中；外搭一件亮青色（bright cyan）超大蓬松夹克（oversized puffy jacket），夹克上有多个粉红色圆角补丁（large pink rounded patches）及宽大的蓝色袖口（wide blue cuffs）。配饰需精确包含三种可见类型：一枚黄色发夹（yellow hair clip）别在刘海处，上面印有字母“AI”；一只耳朵上佩戴多枚小型金色圆环耳环（small gold hoop earrings）；马尾根部用一只深色发圈（dark scrunchie）束起。采用精致现代的日系动漫渲染（polished modern Japanese anime rendering）、清晰锐利的线稿（crisp line art）、鲜艳饱和的色彩（vibrant saturated colors）、柔和的赛璐珞阴影（soft cel-shading）、细致刻画的发丝（detailed hair strands）、闪亮的眼睛（shiny eyes）、干净均匀的肤色（clean skin tones），整体呈现轻快充满能量的VTuber主视觉（VTuber key visual）风格。背景须保持空白、无杂乱元素，适配透明通道（suitable for transparency）；不得添加任何场景、其他人物或水印。

The subject is a young oriental woman with a visual age of approximately 20–26 years old, clearly an adult, with a gentle and noble face, a soft oval face shape, a naturally full forehead, a plump and soft mid-face, a delicate and smooth jawline, elegant brows and eyes, clear and spirited eyes with a naturally slender shape, a smooth and elegant nose, naturally plump lips, harmonious and pleasing features, and an overall gentle, bright, and affluent appearance.
