The clothing is a pine-flower yellow waist-high Ruqun, paired with a bean-green embroidered upper garment and an ivory white shawl. The upper garment has small light-colored floral embroidery and fine gold thread patterns, the shawl is thin, soft, and drapes naturally, and the skirt color is bright and fresh. The clothing colors are mainly bean green, pine-flower yellow, and ivory white, bright and warm, but without making the subject's skin tone look yellow; the subject's facial skin tone remains clean and natural.

The pose is a half-body close-up, the person is standing by the corridor, one hand naturally raised near the collarbone and lapel, the other hand naturally hanging in front of the waist/abdomen, the posture is relaxed and stretched, with a dignified and beautiful demeanor.

The scene is a morning light courtyard, wooden corridor, marigold bonsai, and warm white sunlight. A cluster of marigolds is visible in the foreground and side, while the background consists of wooden pillars, the corridor, warm white lanterns, and a blurred courtyard view. Warm white morning sunlight shines in from the side and back, forming soft rim lighting and natural facial fill lighting; the overall scene is bright and transparent with soft flower shadows and a shallow depth of field in the background to avoid distraction.

85mm portrait lens, realistic photographic texture, high-end ancient-style noble lady portrait, clear details of the subject's eyes, eyelashes, lip makeup, embroidery, and hair accessories, the image is warm and clear, with a morning atmosphere and a sense of life.
2117903200341231810.promptZh:
9:16 竖构图，明亮唯美的古风贵族女子肖像，东方古典女性半身特写（close-up），晨光庭院廊道场景，人物立于木质廊道旁，身体自然微侧，头部轻柔地朝向镜头倾斜，目光温柔而明亮地直视镜头，唇角微扬，整体气质温暖、明丽、柔和且亲切，透出教养良好贵族女子的清晰而高贵的气韵。

主体为一名东方年轻女性，视觉年龄约20–26岁，明显成年，面容温婉高贵，脸型柔和呈椭圆形，额头自然饱满，中面部丰润柔和，下颌线纤巧平滑，眉眼优雅，双目清亮有神、天生细长，鼻梁流畅雅致，双唇自然丰盈，五官和谐悦目，整体呈现温婉、明丽而富足的观感。

妆容为「金盏花晨露暖光妆」。底妆清透细腻，肤色洁净通透，保留自然柔润的肌肤质感；眼妆采用暖金色杏色、浅桃杏色及少量柔棕色晕染过渡，眼中央点缀细腻暖金色珠光，眼尾自然拉长；腮红选用柔杏橙色，轻扫面中与苹果肌，营造清新感；鼻梁与鼻尖呈现细腻明亮的晨露光泽，高光克制不油腻；唇妆为奶茶杏粉色水润唇，唇珠自然清晰，整体呈现温暖、明丽且水润的妆后气质。

发型为乌黑长发松挽，顶部自然蓬松，后部为柔润饱满的发髻，发丝顺滑垂落于颈后；佩戴金盏花发簪、小枚白玉发簪及少量珍珠珠串流苏，配长款珍珠耳饰；整体发饰精巧雅致，毫不夸张。

服饰为松花黄高腰襦裙，搭配豆绿色绣花上衣与象牙白披帛；上衣饰有浅色小花刺绣及精细金线纹样，披帛轻薄柔软、自然垂坠，裙色明快清新；服饰主色调为豆绿、松花黄与象牙白，明快温暖，但不致使人物肤色泛黄；人物面部肤色始终保持洁净自然。

姿态为半身特写（close-up），人物立于廊道旁，一手自然抬至锁骨与驳领附近，另一手自然垂于腰腹前方，体态松弛舒展，仪态端庄优美。

场景为晨光庭院，木质廊道，金盏花盆景，暖白色阳光；前景与侧方可见一簇金盏花，背景为木柱、廊道、暖白色灯笼及虚化的庭院景致；暖白色晨光从侧后方洒入，形成柔和轮廓光（rim lighting）与自然面部补光（fill lighting）；整体画面明亮通透，花影柔和，背景采用浅景深（depth of field）以避免干扰主体。

85mm 人像镜头，写实摄影质感，高端古风贵族女子肖像，人物眼部、睫毛、唇妆、刺绣与发饰细节清晰，画面温暖通透，洋溢晨间氛围与生活气息。

2117903200341231811.promptEn: Create a vertical whimsical storybook illustration in a soft pastel watercolor style. A serene maiden with very long sandy blonde hair stands centered on a rounded green meadow hill, wearing a flowing simple white robe with wide sleeves, hands clasped in prayer at her chest, tiny black dot eyes, rosy cheeks, and a calm expression. Add a warm glowing halo behind her head, partly encircled by a delicate small floral wreath. Surround her with exactly 12 cute white rabbits with pink inner ears and blush cheeks: 6 rabbits in the middle row behind or beside the maiden on the hill, and 6 larger rabbits in the foreground meadow, all in slightly different upright poses. Fill the meadow with many thin green stems, small white daisies, tiny pink flowers, and sparse leaves. Above the scene, create a large arching garland of green vines and pink roses across the top, with dangling leaves and blossoms. Place exactly 1 tiny floating white ghost-like spirit at the top center under the vine arch, and scatter tiny star sparkles and miniature flower petals across the warm beige background. Use fine ink outlines, muted cream, blush pink, sage green, and warm gold tones, with a gentle magical glow, symmetrical composition, lots of empty airy space above the character, and a dreamy fairy-tale atmosphere. No text, no border, no watermark.
2117903200341231811.promptZh: 创作一幅垂直构图的奇想风（whimsical）童话故事书插画，采用柔和粉彩水彩风格（soft pastel watercolor style）。一位宁静的少女立于画面中央，站在一座圆润的绿色草地小丘上；她拥有一头极长的沙金色长发，身着一袭飘逸简约的白色长袍，袖子宽大，双手在胸前合十祈祷，眼睛为细小的黑色圆点，双颊泛起玫瑰色红晕，神情安详。在她头部后方添加一个温暖发光的光环（glowing halo），光环部分被一枚精致小巧的花环（floral wreath）环绕。围绕少女布置恰好12只可爱白兔，每只兔子内耳呈粉色、双颊泛红：其中6只中等大小的兔子位于小丘中段，分布在少女身后或身侧；另6只体型稍大的兔子位于前景草地上，所有兔子均呈略微不同的直立姿态。草地上布满纤细的绿色草茎、小白雏菊、微小的粉色花朵以及稀疏的叶片。画面顶部绘制一条大型弧形花环（arching garland），由青翠藤蔓（green vines）与粉玫瑰（pink roses）交织而成，垂落着叶片与盛开的花朵。在藤蔓花环正下方顶端中央位置，放置恰好1只微小的、如幽灵般漂浮的白色精灵（ghost-like spirit）。在温暖米 beige 色背景上，散落细小的星形闪光（star sparkles）与微型花瓣（flower petals）。整体使用精细墨线勾勒（fine ink outlines），主色调为柔和的米奶油色（cream）、胭脂粉（blush pink）、鼠尾草绿（sage green）与暖金色（warm gold），呈现轻柔的魔法光晕（gentle magical glow），构图对称（symmetrical composition），人物上方留出大量空旷通透的空间（empty airy space），营造梦幻般的童话氛围（dreamy fairy-tale atmosphere）。画面不含文字、无边框、无水印。

2117903200341231812.promptEn:
Goal: Create a luxury Arabian fashion editorial triptych featuring a young Black male model with deep brown skin, short dark hair mostly hidden by the headscarf, symmetrical face, calm expression, and realistic slim-to-average build in traditional Gulf attire.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 fashion collage, approximately 768x1152, divided by clean white borders into exactly 3 portrait panels: 1 large full-body panel on the left occupying about half the width and full height, and 2 stacked panels on the right occupying the other half.

Subject styling: The model wears a pristine white thobe/kandura with a high collar and concealed placket, a red-and-white checkered keffiyeh/shemagh draped over the shoulders, a black agal on top, polished black dress shoes in the full-body shot, and a silver luxury wristwatch on the left wrist. Keep the clothing elegant, crisp, modest, and realistic, with subtle fabric folds and premium tailoring.

Panel details: Include exactly 3 portraits of the same person. Panel 1, left: full-body standing portrait, front-facing, hands clasped low in front, black shoes visible, calm confident expression. Panel 2, top right: medium close-up from upper torso, one hand adjusting or touching the collar near the chest, wristwatch visible, direct gaze. Panel 3, bottom right: seated three-quarter portrait, one elbow resting on the knee, hand near chin in a thoughtful pose, other hand relaxed with wristwatch visible, direct gaze.

Setting and lighting: Use a warm luxury studio interior inspired by Arabian architecture, with smooth brown plaster walls, soft arched alcoves, muted beige floor, and no clutter. Lighting is cinematic and editorial: soft key light from the front-left, gentle shadows, warm brown/gold tones, shallow depth of field in the background, realistic skin texture, polished magazine-quality retouching without over-smoothing.

Visual style: High-end fashion photography, realistic proportions, natural face, premium editorial mood, sharp focus on the subject, soft background blur, balanced contrast, warm neutral color palette, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Constraints: The collage must contain exactly 3 panels and exactly 1 person repeated consistently across all panels. Maintain the same facial identity, age, skin tone, clothing, headwear, and watch throughout all 3 portraits. Avoid extra people, extra accessories, sunglasses, facial hair changes, exaggerated beauty edits, distorted hands, or inconsistent garments.

2117903200341231813.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cinematic 6-panel character concept sheet showing the same older male character, an unnamed distinguished older man, reimagined across different genres and settings while keeping his face, age, posture, and stern expression consistent.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 image divided into a clean 3 columns by 2 rows grid, with thin white dividers between panels. Each panel is a realistic waist-up portrait, centered composition, high-end photographic lighting, shallow depth of field, detailed skin texture, gray wavy hair, short gray beard, serious direct gaze, hands often in pockets or relaxed at sides.

Subject details: The man is in his late 60s to early 70s, tall and dignified, rugged but refined face, silver-gray swept-back wavy hair, neatly trimmed gray beard and mustache, light skin, calm authoritative presence, looking toward the camera in all panels. Keep his facial identity identical across all six images.

Panel layout and exact count: Include exactly 6 discrete portraits:
1. Top left: Victorian or early 20th-century gentleman in a dark three-piece suit with waistcoat, tie, pocket watch chain, white pocket square, standing in an elegant private library or study with tall bookshelves, heavy curtains, warm window light, wooden desk, framed photo, and antique decor.
2. Top center: Modern noir version wearing a black turtleneck and long dark overcoat, hands in pockets, standing in a narrow wet city alley at night with streetlights, reflective pavement, cool blue-gray lighting, cinematic urban mood.
3. Top right: Ancient Roman or fantasy statesman wearing a deep burgundy cloak/tunic with ornate clasps, leather bracers, decorative belt, standing among stone columns and classical architecture, warm muted historical lighting.
4. Bottom left: Futuristic sci-fi commander wearing a sleek dark navy high-collar uniform with minimalist seams, standing in a clean metallic spaceship corridor or advanced laboratory with white glowing light strips and cool gray surfaces.
5. Bottom center: Post-apocalyptic survivor wearing a worn olive jacket, layered dark sweater, scarf, weathered practical clothing, standing in a dusty desert industrial wasteland with ruins, pipes, construction frames, and a hazy beige sky.
6. Bottom right: Contemporary luxury version wearing a fitted navy suit over a dark open-collar shirt with pocket square, hands in pockets, standing in an upscale dim lounge or hotel interior with dark paneling, warm lamps, sofa, and elegant moody decor.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic cinematic photography, consistent character likeness, premium film still quality, natural proportions, detailed fabrics, atmospheric backgrounds, dramatic but believable lighting, rich contrast, sharp subject with softly blurred background.

Constraints: No text, no logos, no captions, no watermark. Preserve the exact 3-by-2 grid and exactly six genre interpretations of the same man. Avoid changing his age, ethnicity, beard, hairstyle, or facial structure between panels. Use serious, dignified, cinematic and photorealistic high-budget film still.

2117903200341231814.promptEn: Create a delicate close-up fantasy portrait of an elegant young woman in a three-dimensional layered watercolor paper art style. The composition is vertical, cropped tightly around the face and shoulders, with her face centered slightly right, looking directly at the viewer with large luminous sapphire blue eyes, long lashes, soft pink lips, porcelain skin, and a calm gentle smile. Her silvery ash-brown hair is wispy and windblown, with fine strands sweeping across the left side of the image. Surround her with exactly 6 prominent paper-cut floral elements: 1 large blue-and-white flower forming a dramatic hat-like crown at the top, 1 white rose-like bloom in the upper right, 1 purple-and-white flower near the right cheek, 1 pale violet flower cluster behind the left shoulder, 1 white blossom with golden stamens near the lower left shoulder, and 1 small white rose cluster on the lower left. Add torn, curled strips of layered watercolor paper wrapping diagonally around her head and shoulders, colored in indigo, periwinkle, white, translucent gray, and metallic gold-speckled beige. Emphasize tactile paper texture: torn deckled edges, folded petals, layered cutouts, raised shadows, fibrous watercolor paper grain, and subtle sparkling pigment. Use a soft high-key white background with faint lavender and blue washes, airy bokeh, tiny white speckles, and gentle diffused light from the upper left. Visual style should blend elegant anime-inspired beauty illustration, realistic watercolor, paper sculpture collage, and luminous editorial portrait art. Keep the palette cool and refined with cobalt blue, soft violet, pearl white, warm beige gold, and pale skin tones. No text, no watermark, no harsh outlines, no extra characters.
2117903200341231814.promptZh: 创作一幅精致的特写（close-up）奇幻肖像画，描绘一位优雅的年轻女性，采用三维分层水彩纸艺术风格。构图呈竖版，紧密裁切至面部与肩部，人物面部略微偏右居中，直视观者，拥有大而明亮的青宝石蓝色眼睛、纤长睫毛、柔粉色双唇、瓷白肌肤，以及平静温柔的微笑。她银灰褐色的秀发轻盈飘逸、随风拂动，细缕发丝横扫画面左侧。在她周身精准布置6个醒目的剪纸花卉元素：1朵大型蓝白相间的花朵，于顶部构成戏剧性帽状花冠；1朵白色玫瑰状花朵，位于右上方；1朵紫白相间的花朵，靠近右脸颊；1簇淡紫花朵，位于左肩后方；1朵带金色花蕊的白色花朵，靠近左下方肩部；以及1簇小型白色玫瑰，位于左下角。添加撕裂卷曲的分层水彩纸条，以对角线方式环绕其头部与肩部，颜色包括靛蓝色、天蓝色、白色、半透明灰色，以及带有金属金点的米 beige 色。着重表现可触感的纸张质感：撕裂的毛边（deckled edges）、折叠的花瓣、分层剪裁的镂空、凸起的阴影、纤维状水彩纸纹理，以及细微闪烁的颜料颗粒。背景采用柔和高调的纯白色，晕染极淡的薰衣草色与蓝色水彩，空气感焦外虚化（bokeh），散布微小白色光点，并以左上方投来的柔和漫射光（diffused light）照明。视觉风格应融合优雅的动漫风（anime-inspired）美人插画、写实水彩、纸雕拼贴（paper sculpture collage）与光彩夺目的杂志级肖像艺术（editorial portrait art）。整体配色保持清冷雅致，主色调为钴蓝色、柔紫色、珠白色、暖米金色及浅淡肤色。不添加文字，不添加水印，不使用生硬轮廓线，不出现额外人物。

2117903200341231815.promptEn:
Ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a handsome young man in his early 20s, captured in an intimate candid editorial style, inspired by the reference image’s composition and warm cinematic atmosphere but featuring a completely original person.
He has thick, naturally wavy dark-black hair, slightly tousled and falling naturally across his forehead, deep expressive brown eyes, strong well-defined eyebrows, a straight sculpted nose, prominent cheekbones, a sharp masculine jawline, naturally defined lips, and subtle clean stubble. His expression is calm, confident, thoughtful, and effortlessly charming.
He is wearing a loose, premium white linen shirt, slightly unbuttoned at the collar, with natural fabric wrinkles and realistic texture. He is sitting casually beside a large vintage café/window doorway, turning his face slightly toward the warm sunlight.
Composition: vertical portrait, medium close-up to waist-up framing, subject positioned slightly off-center, looking toward the side rather than directly at the camera. Foreground contains soft out-of-focus green leaves, creating beautiful natural depth and framing the subject.
Lighting: gorgeous late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight streaming from the side, warm highlights across his face and hair, gentle natural shadows, subtle rim light, realistic skin texture, soft cinematic contrast.
Background: dark, elegant café interior visible through the doorway, heavily blurred, warm brown and black tones, subtle practical lights, shallow depth of field.
Photography: luxury fashion editorial photography, 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, extremely shallow depth of field, natural bokeh, realistic skin pores, detailed hair strands, authentic linen texture, subtle film grain, sophisticated color grading, photorealistic, cinematic, high dynamic range, premium magazine aesthetic, candid and effortless mood, 8K ultra-detailed realism.
Avoid: cartoon, anime, plastic skin, excessive retouching, distorted face, unnatural eyes, extra fingers, oversaturated colors, artificial-looking hair, exaggerated muscles, text, watermark.
2117903200341231815.promptZh:
超写实电影感肖像画，描绘一位二十出头的英俊青年，以亲密自然的纪实杂志风格（editorial style）拍摄，构图与温暖电影感氛围（cinematic atmosphere）受参考图像启发，但人物为完全原创。

他拥有一头浓密、天然微卷的乌黑头发，略显凌乱，自然垂落于额头；深邃富有表现力的棕色眼睛；浓密清晰的眉毛；笔直而轮廓分明的鼻子；高挺的颧骨；棱角分明的男性化下颌线；线条自然清晰的嘴唇；以及细腻干净的短须。他的神情平静、自信、沉思，且散发着毫不费力的魅力。

他身穿一件宽松的优质白色亚麻衬衫，领口微微解开，布料呈现自然褶皱与真实质感。他随意坐在一家大型复古咖啡馆/窗边门洞旁，脸部微微转向温暖的阳光。

构图：竖幅人像，中景特写（medium close-up）至腰部以上取景，主体略微偏离画面中心，视线朝向侧面而非正对镜头。前景为柔和失焦的绿色叶片，营造出优美的自然纵深感，并自然框住主体。

光线：绝美的傍晚黄金时刻（golden-hour）侧光倾泻而入，在其面部与发丝上形成温暖高光，阴影柔和自然，带有微妙的轮廓光（rim light），皮肤纹理真实，对比度柔和且具电影感（cinematic contrast）。

背景：透过门洞可见幽暗雅致的咖啡馆室内，高度虚化，色调为温暖的棕与黑，点缀着细微的实用光源（practical lights），景深（depth of field）极浅。

摄影风格：高端时尚纪实杂志摄影（luxury fashion editorial photography），85mm人像镜头，光圈f/1.8，景深（depth of field）极浅，自然焦外虚化（bokeh），真实可见的皮肤毛孔，发丝细节丰富，亚麻面料质感真实，细微胶片颗粒（film grain），精妙的色彩分级（color grading），照片级写实（photorealistic），电影感（cinematic），高动态范围（HDR），高端杂志美学（premium magazine aesthetic），纪实自然且毫不费力的情绪氛围（candid and effortless mood），8K超精细写实（8K ultra-detailed realism）。

避免：卡通风格、动漫风格、塑料感皮肤、过度修图、面部变形、眼睛不自然、多余手指、过度饱和的色彩、人工感头发、夸张肌肉、文字、水印。

2117903200341231816.promptEn: Create a refined hand-drawn portrait illustration of a handsome South Asian man in his late 20s with thick wavy black hair, strong brows, almond eyes, a straight nose, full lips, and a neatly trimmed dark beard. Show him from the chest up in a thoughtful three-quarter pose, head turned slightly to the viewer’s right, eyes looking off to the side, with his right index finger resting lightly against his lips and chin. Dress him in a soft pastel pink traditional kurta with a matching draped shawl, including delicate embroidered floral borders on the shawl, subtle fabric folds, small front buttons, and a high band collar. Use a realistic pencil-and-charcoal portrait style with fine graphite linework, visible crosshatching, soft gray facial shading, and selective muted watercolor coloring only on the clothing. Keep the skin and hair mostly monochrome graphite, with detailed texture in the hair and beard. Background should be a plain warm off-white paper texture, softly lit with no props, no text, no watermark, and no extra figures. The mood should be calm, elegant, introspective, and romantic, like a high-quality fashion portrait sketch.
2117903200341231816.promptZh: 创作一幅精致的手绘肖像插画，描绘一位二十多岁晚期的英俊南亚男性：浓密波浪形黑发、浓眉、杏仁眼、笔直鼻梁、饱满嘴唇、修剪整齐的深色胡 beard。以胸以上构图，采用沉思感的三分之四角度（three-quarter pose），头部微微转向观者右侧，目光斜向一侧，右手食指轻触嘴唇与下巴。身着柔和粉彩色（pastel pink）传统古尔塔（kurta），配同色系垂坠式披肩（shawl），披肩边缘饰有精细刺绣花卉边纹，布料呈现微妙褶皱，前襟有细小纽扣，领口为高立领（high band collar）。采用写实风格的铅笔与炭笔（pencil-and-charcoal）肖像技法：细腻的石墨线条（graphite linework）、可见的交叉排线（crosshatching）、柔和的灰色面部明暗过渡（facial shading）、衣物部分仅作选择性低饱和度水彩着色（muted watercolor coloring）。皮肤与头发主体保持单色石墨表现，头发与胡 beard 需刻画细致纹理。背景为纯色暖调米白纸张质感（warm off-white paper texture），采用柔和布光（soft lighting），无道具、无文字、无水印、无额外人物。整体氛围应宁静、优雅、内省且浪漫，如同一幅高品质时尚肖像速写（high-quality fashion portrait sketch）。

2117903200341231817.promptEn: A photorealistic golden-hour street-style selfie of a young woman walking through a charming Mediterranean village. She has long, silky auburn-brown hair parted in the center, softly framing her face, with natural glossy lips, warm peach blush, subtle eyeliner, and a calm confident expression while looking directly into the camera. She is wearing a vibrant orange textured summer dress with puff sleeves, a ruched sweetheart neckline, fitted waist, and flowing skirt, paired with a delicate pendant necklace, small earrings, and a bracelet. Her arm is extended toward the camera holding a smartphone, creating a natural selfie perspective. The narrow village street is surrounded by beautiful whitewashed houses with blue-trimmed windows, wooden doors, stone sidewalks, warm architectural details, and lush citrus trees filled with ripe oranges overhead. Clear blue sky, warm sunlight illuminating her face and hair, soft long shadows, cozy Mediterranean vacation atmosphere. Natural smartphone photography, realistic perspective, subtle lens distortion, shallow depth of field, warm cinematic color grading, highly detailed hair and skin texture, authentic candid travel aesthetic, crisp focus, soft golden highlights, vertical 4:5 composition, ultra-realistic.
2117903200341231817.promptZh: 一张照片级写实（photorealistic）的黄金时刻（golden-hour）街拍风格自拍照，画面中一位年轻女性正漫步于一座迷人的地中海村庄。她拥有一头柔顺丝滑的赤褐色长发，中分发型，发丝轻柔地勾勒出她的脸庞；嘴唇自然光泽，双颊泛着温暖的蜜桃色腮红，眼线淡雅精致，神情沉静而自信，目光直视镜头。她身穿一条明艳橙色的夏季连衣裙，面料富有肌理感：泡泡袖、褶皱心形领口、收腰剪裁与飘逸裙摆；搭配一条精致吊坠项链、小巧耳饰与一只腕镯。她的一只手臂伸向镜头，手持一部智能手机，营造出自然的自拍视角。狭窄的村中小径两侧环绕着美丽的粉刷白墙房屋，窗框为蓝色，木门古朴，石板人行道，建筑细节温暖宜人，头顶上方是枝繁叶茂的柑橘树，果实累累、橙子饱满成熟。天空湛蓝清澈，暖阳洒落，照亮她的面庞与发丝，投下柔和修长的阴影，洋溢着惬意的地中海度假氛围。采用自然智能手机摄影风格，真实透视，轻微镜头畸变，浅景深（shallow depth of field），暖调电影感色彩分级（cinematic color grading），发丝与肌肤纹理高度精细，呈现真实随性的旅行美学（authentic candid travel aesthetic），焦点锐利清晰，柔美金色高光（soft golden highlights），竖构图 4:5 比例，超写实（ultra-realistic）。

2117903200341231818.promptEn: Create an ultra-realistic luxury studio portrait of a young adult Black man seated confidently in a deep burgundy tufted leather wingback armchair with rolled arms and brass nailhead trim. He faces the camera directly with a calm, composed expression, relaxed posture, one hand resting on the chair arm and the other on his thigh. He has short neatly trimmed black hair, smooth natural skin tone, and sharp realistic facial detail. Dress him in a crisp white dress shirt, burgundy buttoned waistcoat, black satin tie, black trousers, and a gold wristwatch. Use a dark burgundy studio backdrop that blends with the leather chair for a refined monochrome luxury feel. Lighting should be professional editorial portrait lighting: soft key light from front-left, subtle fill, gentle highlights on the leather texture, natural catchlights in the eyes, realistic shadows, high dynamic range, polished but not overly retouched. Frame as a vertical three-quarter seated portrait from head to upper legs, centered composition, 2:3 aspect ratio, shallow depth of field, premium magazine cover quality, no text, no logo, no watermark.
2117903200341231818.promptZh: 创作一幅超写实的奢华影棚人像，描绘一位年轻成年黑人男性自信地坐在一张深酒红色绗缝皮革翼背扶手椅上，该椅子带有卷曲扶手和黄铜钉扣镶边。他正对镜头，神情沉着从容，姿态放松：一只手搁在扶手上，另一只手放在大腿上。他留着短而整齐修剪的黑色头发，肤色平滑自然，面部细节锐利真实。他身穿挺括的白色正装衬衫、酒红色纽扣马甲、黑色缎面领带、黑色西裤，以及一只金色腕表。背景采用深酒红色影棚幕布，与皮革座椅色调相融，营造出精致的单色奢华氛围。布光需采用专业杂志人像布光（editorial portrait lighting）：柔和的主光来自左前方，辅以微妙的补光，皮革纹理呈现轻柔高光，眼睛中呈现自然眼神光（catchlights），阴影真实可信，高动态范围（HDR），整体质感精修到位但不过度修饰。构图为竖版三分之二 seated portrait（从头部至大腿上部），居中构图，2:3 画幅比例，浅景深（shallow depth of field），达到高端杂志封面品质，无文字、无标识、无水印。

2117903200341231820.promptEn:
Create a vertical 2:3 educational storyboard infographic, 5 horizontal scenes, cinematic realistic 3D science visualization, exactly like a professional educational video storyboard.

TOPIC: HOW LIGHTNING HAPPENS
Duration: 15 seconds

1 | 0:00–0:03 — STORM CLOUDS
Visual: Huge dark storm clouds forming above a landscape.
Action: Clouds grow rapidly with electric particles inside.
VO: “Lightning begins inside powerful storm clouds.”
SFX: Wind and distant thunder.
Camera: Slow aerial push in.
Transition: Light Flash.

2 | 0:03–0:06 — ELECTRIC CHARGE
Visual: Close-up inside cloud showing positive and negative charges separating.
Action: Blue and orange particles move to opposite sides.
Labels: POSITIVE CHARGE, NEGATIVE CHARGE.
VO: “Ice and water particles separate electric charges inside the cloud.”
SFX: Electric crackle.
Camera: Macro tracking.
Transition: Energy Glow.

3 | 0:06–0:09 — CHARGE BUILDS
Visual: Dark cloud above the ground, bright electrical energy increasing.
Action: Electric particles move downward toward Earth.
VO: “As the charge becomes stronger, electricity searches for a path.”
SFX: Rising electrical hum.
Camera: Tilt from cloud toward ground.
Transition: Quick Flash.

4 | 0:09–0:12 — LIGHTNING STRIKE
Visual: Bright lightning bolt connects cloud to ground.
Action: Lightning travels rapidly downward.
Label: LIGHTNING.
VO: “A powerful electrical discharge creates a lightning bolt.”
SFX: Loud thunder crack.
Camera: Fast Pull Back.
Transition: White Flash.

5 | 0:12–0:15 — THUNDERSTORM
Visual: Wide storm landscape with lightning and rain.
Action: Lightning flashes while rain falls below.
VO: “The sudden heating of air also creates the sound of thunder.”
SFX: Deep thunder rolling.
Camera: Wide aerial pull back.
Transition: Smooth Fade.

Bottom: NARRATOR (VO): Clear, calm, educational male voice.

2117903200341231827.promptEn:
Turn the reference photo into a travel souvenir enamel pin badge. Compose it as a SCENE, not a single isolated object.

Subject hierarchy: the defining landscape, terrain or landmark of the photo forms the main body of the badge and occupies most of its area. If a person appears prominently in the photo, keep them in the badge as a small, simplified figure at true relative scale within that landscape — the person is an accent, the landscape is the subject.Preserve the original spatial relationship and scale between the figure and the surroundings.

How to render the person: flat enamel color blocks matching their real clothing and hair color from the photo. The face is a smooth plain area of light skin-tone enamel with no drawn facial features — do NOT render the person as a dark or black silhouette, and do NOT black out the face or head. Skin reads as a warm light enamel color, clearly lighter than the clothing.Styling: thin polished gold outline around the silhouette and along every internal divider, glossy enamel color fill, gentle even lighting with only a soft sheen on the gold lines, very subtle drop shadow. Outer contour follows the scene's own shape, not a plain rectangle.

Background: flat dark navy coarse linen texture. Badge centered, filling about 60% of the frame.Avoid: black silhouette figure, blacked-out face, dark featureless head, portrait close-up, detailed facial features, person dominating the badge, cropping out the landscape, three-quarter angle, macro product photography, heavy specular glare, cartoon, realistic scene, text, watermark.
2117903200341231827.promptZh:
将参考照片转化为一枚旅行纪念搪瓷徽章（enamel pin badge）。将其构图设计为一个“场景（SCENE）”，而非单一孤立物体。

主体层级关系：照片中最具定义性的风景、地貌或地标构成徽章的主体，并占据徽章绝大部分面积。若照片中有人物显著出现，则将其保留在徽章中，作为该风景内按真实相对比例缩小的简化人形——人物仅为点缀，风景才是主体。须保留人物与周围环境原有的空间关系和比例尺度。

人物渲染方式：使用扁平化搪瓷色块，颜色严格匹配照片中人物的实际服装与发色。面部为光滑均匀的浅肤色搪瓷区域，不绘制任何面部特征——切勿将人物渲染为深色或黑色剪影，亦不可将面部或头部涂黑。肤色呈现为暖调浅色搪瓷，明显比服装颜色更浅。造型风格：人形轮廓及所有内部分割线均采用纤细抛光金边；搪瓷色块填充呈高光质感；整体采用柔和均匀布光，仅在金边处呈现轻微柔亮光泽；投影极淡。徽章外轮廓依场景自身形状而定，非标准矩形。

背景：平滑深海军蓝粗麻纹理。徽章居中放置，约占画面面积的60%。  
禁止事项：黑色剪影人物、面部涂黑、暗色无特征头部、特写（close-up）、精细面部刻画、人物主导徽章、裁切掉风景、三分之二角度（three-quarter angle）、微距产品摄影（macro product photography）、强烈镜面高光（heavy specular glare）、卡通风格、写实场景、文字、水印。

She holds a futuristic microphone near her mouth, with bright cyan soundwave ribbons and angular waveform shapes spiraling around her body.

2. Pose Study: In the upper-right, include exactly 4 dynamic full-body/action pose drawings: “UNLEASH” with the singer blasting a jagged blue waveform from the microphone, “LEAP” with her airborne and twisting while performing, “LOW SHOT” crouched and pointing the glowing microphone forward, and “COOL DOWN” standing relaxed with hands in pockets and jacket hanging loose.

Visual style: Gritty semi-realistic anime concept art, painterly brush texture, crisp ink-like highlights, dramatic rim lighting, glossy black fabrics, luminous cyan electric effects, sketchbook production-sheet presentation, hand-drawn white lettering. Use the accent color electric cyan blue throughout the soundwaves, headset lights, hair streaks, microphone grille, and star hairpin.

Text content: Use handwritten white English labels exactly as visible: “1. TURNAROUND & FACES,” “MINI TURNAROUND,” “SILHOUETTE STUDY,” “EXPRESSION STUDY,” “2. POSE STUDY,” “UNLEASH,” “LEAP,” “LOW SHOT,” “COOL DOWN,” “3. DETAIL STUDY,” “VISOR HEADSET & FACE,” “GLOWING STAR HAIRPIN,” “JACKET TRIM & HARDWARE,” “GLOVE & SILVER RINGS,” and “GLOWING MIC & WAVEFORM.”

Constraints: Keep the background black, avoid a clean white model-sheet look, do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, or unrelated props. Maintain exactly 3 mini turnaround poses, 3 silhouettes, 4 expression portraits, 4 pose-study drawings, and 5 detail panels.

2117903200341231829.promptEn: Create a premium cinematic travel poster featuring an ultra-detailed photorealistic isometric miniature diorama of Santorini, Greece. Center the scene as a floating collectible-scale island sculpture with steep dark volcanic cliffs, a circular caldera bay of deep blue water, and a soft natural shadow underneath. Build the miniature with dense whitewashed Cycladic houses stacked along the cliffs, narrow stairways, winding paths, terraces, small courtyards, flowering bougainvillea, beige stone walls, and bright cobalt-blue accents. Include exactly 6 prominent blue-domed churches, exactly 3 traditional windmills, and exactly 8 visible boats: 4 sailboats spread across the bay, 1 small motorboat in open water, and 3 small boats near the harbor. The water should be realistic with subtle ripples, turquoise shallows near the harbor, and darker navy tones in the center. Use warm late-afternoon Mediterranean sunlight, crisp shadows, high depth of detail, realistic miniature scale, and a polished luxury travel-advertisement finish. Typography: at the top, set a large elegant high-contrast serif title reading SANTORINI in dark navy with wide letter spacing; beneath it, smaller spaced uppercase text reading GREECE; below that, a thin gold divider line with a small centered diamond; then a tiny uppercase caption reading AEGEAN ISLAND DIORAMA • 2026. 2117903200341231840.promptEn:
Using uploaded face as reference. A mind-bending surrealist mixed-media portrait featuring uploaded face as reference, captured in a pristine studio setting with a neutral gradient grey background and soft, diffuse softbox lighting. The composition utilizes a split-reality technique where the left side of the subject is rendered in hyper-realistic 8k photography with visible skin pores, subsurface scattering, and lifelike textures, while the right side abruptly transitions into a rough, gestural charcoal and graphite pencil sketch on white paper. The subject's realistic right hand crosses the chest, holding a yellow wooden pencil with a sharp tip, physically drawing the sketched outline of the jaw and neck, creating a meta-fictional loop of self-creation. The subject wears a dark charcoal long-sleeve crewneck shirt that morphs from heavy, draped fabric on the left into loose, scribbled hatch lines and unfinished contour strokes on the right.

The image features a shallow depth of field focused on the pencil tip and the transition line, combining the aesthetics of high-end commercial portraiture with raw, artistic sketching, reminiscent of Ben Heine's 'Pencil vs Camera' style, highly intricate textures, volumetric lighting, and photorealistic raytracing.
2117903200341231840.promptZh: 以上传的面部为参考。一幅令人脑洞大开的超现实主义混合媒介肖像，以上传的面部为参考，在纯净的影棚环境中拍摄，背景为中性渐变灰色，采用柔和、漫射式的柔光箱布光（softbox lighting）。构图采用“分裂现实”（split-reality）技法：主体左侧以超写实（hyper-realistic）8k摄影风格呈现，清晰可见皮肤毛孔、次表面散射（subsurface scattering）及逼真的纹理；右侧则突然转变为粗犷、富有表现力的炭笔与石墨铅笔速写，绘制于白纸上。主体写实的右手横跨胸前，握着一支黄色木质铅笔，笔尖锋利，正实实在在地描绘右侧所呈现的下颌线与颈部轮廓，由此构建出一个关于自我创造的元虚构（meta-fictional）闭环。主体身穿深灰炭色长袖圆领衫，衣物左侧呈现厚重垂坠的织物质感，右侧则幻化为松散潦草的排线（hatch lines）与未完成的轮廓线条。\n\n图像采用浅景深（depth of field），焦点集中于铅笔尖端与左右两侧的过渡分界线上，融合高端商业人像摄影（high-end commercial portraiture）的美学与原始粗放的艺术速写风格，令人联想到本·海恩（Ben Heine）的《铅笔 vs 相机》（'Pencil vs Camera'）系列；画面细节高度繁复精细，运用体积光（volumetric lighting），并采用照片级写实（photorealistic）光线追踪（raytracing）。

Add tiny hand-drawn black doodles around the café—small hearts, steam lines, stars, coffee beans, arrows, and simple decorative marks—to create a playful contemporary scrapbook feeling.
2117903200341231843.promptZh:
创作一个迷人的极简主义3D微缩咖啡馆场景，灵感源自温馨的手工纸艺与黏土（paper-and-clay）美学。将一座小巧而精心设计的咖啡店置于大幅肌理感米白色纸张背景的正下方中央位置，四周留出大量干净的空白空间。

该咖啡店应呈现为手工制作的微缩咖啡馆：一座小型奶油色店面，配以温暖木质吧台、迷你意式浓缩咖啡机、咖啡杯、糕点、咖啡豆、小型菜单板、悬挂式招牌、盆栽植物、小圆凳以及细腻的咖啡馆装饰。添加几位微缩顾客正在享用咖啡，以及一位站在吧台后的咖啡师；整体须保持可爱、精致且不杂乱。

采用柔和的象牙白、米色、暖棕色、低饱和鼠尾草绿（sage green）以及微妙的赤陶色（terracotta）作为点缀色，并搭配逼真的柔和阴影（soft shadows）与轻柔的自然光（natural lighting）。在咖啡馆—small hearts周围添加若干微缩手绘黑色涂鸦——蒸汽线（steam lines）、星星、咖啡豆、箭头以及简洁的装饰性标记，营造出俏皮而当代的剪贴簿（scrapbook）氛围。

2117903200341231844.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cinematic sci-fi storyboard contact sheet showing a tense emergency inside a Mars colony during a red dust storm, in the style of high-budget film stills with anamorphic widescreen framing.

Canvas: A single 16:9 horizontal image divided into exactly 8 rectangular widescreen panels arranged in a clean 2-column by 4-row grid. Use thin white dividers between panels and no captions, no logos, no visible text except tiny incidental signage.

Setting and mood: a domed human colony on Mars during a violent red dust storm. The entire sheet should feel dark, dramatic, and cinematic, with heavy red-orange atmosphere, emergency lighting, volumetric dust, glass reflections, and realistic production design.

Panel count and layout: Include exactly 8 distinct frames:
1. Top-left: Wide exterior establishing shot of a futuristic city or research base protected by a transparent dome on a barren Martian landscape, distant towers glowing through a massive red storm cloud.
2. Top-right: Close-up silhouette of a large human hand pressing against or emerging behind a dusty translucent surface, almost abstract, surrounded by swirling red dust.
3. Second row left: Symmetrical view down a cylindrical metal tunnel or airlock corridor with circular ribs, red emergency lights, and small suited figures far in the distance.
4. Second row right: Close-up of a frightened astronaut inside a helmet visor, face lit by red alarms and a bright headlamp flare, with a blurred figure running in the background.
5. Third row left: Interior biodome or greenhouse walkway with trees and dense vegetation under orange emergency haze, railings in the foreground, a doorway at the right edge.
6. Third row right: Two astronauts in bulky suits running down a dark industrial corridor toward a group ahead, red alarm lights and motion blur emphasizing urgency.
7. Bottom-left: Low-angle view under a curved glass or transparent dome ceiling with red warning lights, flying debris, scratches, cracks, and storm particles battering the surface.
8. Bottom-right: Close-up from above or through glass of a dark human hand pressed flat against a dusty transparent panel, with faint cracks, condensation, and glowing red reflections around it.

Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic stills, gritty hard sci-fi, realistic astronauts and architecture, shallow depth of field in close-ups, strong contrast, smoky atmosphere, anamorphic lens flares, subtle film grain, deep blacks, saturated rust-red palette with occasional white headlamp highlights.

Constraints: Maintain exact 8-panel grid, no comic speech bubbles, no explanatory labels, no extra frames, no cartoon style. Make every panel feel like a different shot from the same suspenseful film sequence about a breach or crisis threatening the Mars colony.
2117903200341231844.author: Mystique Licorne 🇨🇦

2117903200341231845.promptEn: Create a photorealistic vertical winter portrait of a young Japanese woman outdoors in a city park, framed from chest up and looking directly into the camera with a gentle, quiet smile. She has dark brown medium-length slightly messy hair with wispy bangs and loose flyaway strands glowing in backlight, warm brown eyes, natural makeup, soft skin texture, and subtle freckles across her cheeks and nose. She is wearing an oversized thick ribbed fuzzy knit sweater in warm gray taupe, with very long sleeves pulled over both hands as she cups her cheeks. Use a shallow depth of field with blurred green hedge leaves in the foreground at the bottom and a softly defocused urban background with tall buildings and round bokeh lights. Lighting should feel like late winter afternoon golden hour: strong sun behind her head creating a bright rim light around her hair, warm highlights, soft shadows on the face, and a calm intimate mood. Shoot in a realistic 85mm portrait lens style, f/1.4, natural color grading, high detail on eyes, hair, and knit texture, vertical 2:3 composition, no text, no watermark, no extra people.
2117903200341231845.promptZh: 创作一幅照片级写实（photorealistic）的竖构图冬季人像，画面主体为一位年轻的日本女性，身处城市公园户外环境中；构图截取胸部以上，她直视镜头，面带轻柔而安静的微笑。她拥有一头中等长度、略显凌乱的深棕色头发，带有轻盈的刘海和几缕随风飘散的发丝，在逆光下泛着微光；眼睛呈温暖的棕色，妆容自然，皮肤质感柔和，双颊与鼻梁上散布着细微雀斑。她身穿一件 oversized 款式的厚实罗纹毛绒针织衫，颜色为暖调灰褐色（warm gray taupe），袖子极长，双手完全被袖口包裹，正以袖口托住双颊。采用浅景深（shallow depth of field）：画面底部前景为虚化的绿色树篱叶片，背景则为柔和失焦的城市景观，包含高耸的建筑群与圆形焦外虚化（bokeh）光斑。布光需呈现晚冬午后黄金时刻（golden hour）氛围：强阳光自她后方投射，在发丝边缘勾勒出明亮的轮廓光（rim light），面部呈现温暖高光与柔和阴影，整体情绪宁静而私密。拍摄风格模拟真实 85mm 人像镜头，光圈 f/1.4，自然色彩调校，眼部、发丝与针织纹理细节高度清晰；竖向 2:3 构图，画面不含文字、无水印、无其他人物。

2117903200341231846.promptEn:
Use the uploaded photo as the composition, pose, wardrobe, lighting, and studio-style reference.

Create an ultra-realistic professional studio portrait of an adult man, framed from approximately mid-thigh upward. Position him slightly off-center, standing in a relaxed three-quarter pose while facing the camera. Have both hands naturally tucked into his trouser pockets, with his shoulders relaxed and posture upright and confident. Give him a warm, subtle smile that communicates professionalism, approachability, and quiet confidence.

Dress him in a perfectly tailored rich chocolate-brown two-piece suit with a structured single-breasted blazer and matching trousers. Underneath, add a solid black button-up dress shirt, neatly tucked in with the collar closed and no tie. Complete the outfit with a sleek black leather belt with a minimal dark metallic buckle and a sophisticated black-and-silver wristwatch.

Give him a clean, neat low fade haircut with naturally textured short hair on top and a precise but realistic hairline. Keep the grooming polished and natural. No necklace, chain, earrings, rings, lapel pins, or excessive accessories.

Use a seamless warm chocolate-brown studio background, slightly darker than the suit, with a smooth subtle gradient and gentle falloff toward the edges. Maintain a sophisticated monochromatic brown-and-black color palette.

Use soft professional studio lighting with a large diffused key light illuminating the face from the front/side, gentle fill light to preserve natural skin detail, and subtle separation between the subject and background. Create soft realistic shadows around the jawline and suit while maintaining flattering facial highlights.

Capture realistic skin texture, individual hair detail, natural fabric texture, sharp blazer tailoring, subtle watch reflections, and accurate proportions. Use an 85mm portrait-lens aesthetic, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the face and eyes, cinematic tonal depth, premium corporate editorial photography, photorealistic detail, and high-end magazine-quality finishing.

Aspect ratio: 2:3 portrait.
2117903200341231846.promptZh:
以上传的照片为构图、姿态、服饰、布光及影棚风格（studio lighting）参考。

创作一幅超写实的专业影棚人像（studio portrait），描绘一名成年男性，画面取景范围约为大腿中部以上。将他置于画面略偏中心的位置，呈放松的三分之四（three-quarter）站姿，面朝镜头。双手自然插入裤袋，双肩放松，体态挺拔且自信。赋予他一抹温暖而含蓄的微笑，传递出专业感、亲和力与沉静的自信。

着装为一套剪裁精良的浓郁巧克力棕色两件套西装，包括结构感强的单排扣修身西装外套与同色西裤。内搭一件纯黑色纽扣正装衬衫，衣摆整齐束入裤腰，领口闭合，不系领带。配一条利落的黑色皮革腰带，搭配极简风格的深色金属扣，以及一款精致的黑银配色腕表。

发型为干净利落的低渐变（low fade）短发，顶部头发保留自然纹理，发际线精准且真实。整体仪容修饰精致而自然。不佩戴项链、链条、耳饰、戒指、翻领别针或任何过度装饰性配饰。

背景采用无缝暖调巧克力棕色影棚背景（studio background），颜色略深于西装，表面平滑并带有细微渐变，边缘处呈现柔和衰减（gentle falloff）。整体保持高雅的单色棕黑（monochromatic brown-and-black）配色方案。

采用柔和的专业影棚布光（studio lighting）：以一盏大型柔光主光源（key light）从前侧方向照亮面部；辅以轻柔的补光（fill light），以保留自然的皮肤细节；并施加微妙的轮廓分离光（separation light），使人物与背景之间形成清晰区分。在下颌线周围及西装表面营造柔和真实的阴影，同时维持面部高光的讨喜效果。

呈现逼真的皮肤质感、每一根独立的发丝细节、自然的面料纹理、锐利分明的西装外套剪裁、腕表表面细腻的反光，以及准确的人体比例。采用85mm人像镜头（portrait-lens）美学风格、浅景深（depth of field）、面部与双眼锐利对焦、电影感影调深度（cinematic tonal depth）、高端企业级杂志编辑摄影（premium corporate editorial photography）、照片级写实（photorealistic）细节，以及高端时尚杂志品质（high-end magazine-quality）成片效果。

画幅比例：2:3 竖构图。

2117903200341231848.promptEn:
Ultra-realistic cinematic black-and-white editorial portrait of a strikingly handsome young man in his early 20s, seated casually on the floor in a moody minimalist studio, closely inspired by the reference image’s composition, framing, pose, lighting, and atmospheric mood, but featuring a completely original male character.
He has a naturally attractive realistic face, thick slightly wavy jet-black hair falling messily around his forehead and ears, strong well-defined eyebrows, deep expressive dark-brown eyes, a straight sculpted nose, prominent cheekbones, sharp masculine jawline, subtle natural stubble, and realistic skin texture with fine pores and imperfections.
He sits with one knee raised toward the camera, the other leg bent naturally, one elbow resting on his knee with his hand gently supporting his face, creating a relaxed, introspective expression. His gaze is directed slightly toward the camera with a calm, mysterious, emotionally intense look.
He wears a dark oversized distressed denim jacket over a simple black fitted T-shirt, loose light-gray ripped jeans with large torn knees and naturally frayed threads, and heavy black leather combat boots with thick rugged soles. Natural fabric wrinkles, stitching, denim texture, worn leather and realistic folds are highly detailed.
Dark charcoal studio background, subtle textured wall, low-key dramatic lighting from one side, soft highlights across his face and hair, deep natural shadows, cinematic contrast, monochrome grayscale photography, subtle film grain, sophisticated fashion-editorial aesthetic, shallow depth of field, realistic proportions, authentic candid feeling.
Full-body vertical composition, 4:5 aspect ratio, camera positioned slightly below eye level, 50mm photography look, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, professional fashion photography, no text, no watermark, no logos, completely original person.
2117903200341231848.promptZh:
超写实电影感黑白时尚杂志肖像，一位相貌极为英俊的二十岁出头年轻男性，随意坐在情绪化极简风格摄影棚的地板上；构图、取景、姿态、布光及氛围均紧密参照参考图像，但人物为完全原创的男性角色。  
他拥有一张天然富有吸引力且高度写实的面容：浓密微卷的乌黑头发凌乱地垂落在额头与耳际；眉骨强健、轮廓清晰；深邃富表现力的深棕色双眸；笔直而如雕塑般立体的鼻梁；高耸的颧骨；棱角分明的阳刚下颌线；若有似无的自然胡茬；皮肤质感真实，呈现细腻毛孔与细微瑕疵。  
他单膝屈起朝向镜头，另一条腿自然弯曲；一只肘部搁在屈起的膝上，手掌轻托面颊，营造出放松而内省的表情；目光略朝向镜头，神情沉静、神秘，情感张力十足。  
他身着一件深色 oversized 做旧牛仔夹克，内搭简约修身黑色T恤；下穿宽松浅灰色破洞牛仔裤，膝盖处有大面积撕裂，边缘自然毛边；脚蹬厚重黑色皮革军靴，鞋底厚实粗犷。面料自然褶皱、缝线细节、牛仔布纹理、磨损皮革质感及真实衣褶均高度精细刻画。  
深炭灰色摄影棚背景，墙面带有微妙肌理；单侧低照度戏剧性布光（dramatic lighting），面部与发丝泛出柔和高光，阴影深邃自然，电影感对比（cinematic contrast），单色灰度摄影（monochrome grayscale photography），细微胶片颗粒（film grain），精致考究的时尚杂志编辑美学（fashion-editorial aesthetic），浅景深（shallow depth of field），比例真实，呈现真实抓拍感（authentic candid feeling）。  
全身竖构图，4:5 画幅比，相机位置略低于 eye level，50mm 摄影视角（50mm photography look），超精细，照片级写实（photorealistic），专业时尚摄影（professional fashion photography），无文字，无水印，无标识，人物完全原创。

2117903200341231849.promptEn: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic fashion editorial portrait of a young woman with shoulder-length black hair, wispy bangs, and round eyeglasses sitting curled up inside a large dark cylindrical industrial tunnel or pipe. The camera looks straight into the circular pipe from the open end, creating a strong centered composition with the subject seated low in the middle, knees drawn up tightly, feet together, and arms folded casually across the tops of her knees. She wears a fitted black short-sleeve T-shirt, loose black pants, and black canvas sneakers with white laces and white soles. Her expression is calm and slightly confident, with direct eye contact and a subtle closed-mouth smile. The tunnel interior is black, glossy, rough-textured metal with visible scuffs, scratches, and wet-looking highlights. Surround the subject with dramatic circular motion-blur light trails following the pipe’s circumference: warm amber, orange, and occasional white streaks, especially near the outer rim, while the center remains sharp. Use moody low-key lighting with a warm rim light catching the hair and arms, soft frontal fill on the face, deep shadows around the pipe edges, and a high-contrast editorial look. Compose as a vertical 4:5 image, wide-angle lens perspective, symmetrical circular framing, subject centered, crisp realistic skin texture, natural proportions, detailed fabric, no text, no logos, no watermark. Make it feel like a high-end urban fashion photograph shot inside a dark industrial pipe with long-exposure light painting.
2117903200341231849.promptZh: 创作一幅超照片级写实（photorealistic）的电影感时尚杂志肖像画，描绘一位年轻女性：齐肩黑色长发、轻盈蓬松的刘海、佩戴圆形眼镜，蜷坐在一条巨大幽暗的圆柱形工业隧道或管道内部。相机正对管道敞开的一端直视其内部，形成强烈居中构图——主体低坐于画面正中央，双膝紧收上提、双脚并拢，双臂随意交叠于膝盖上方。她身穿合身的黑色短袖T恤、宽松黑色长裤，以及黑色帆布运动鞋，鞋带与鞋底为白色。她的神情沉静而略带自信，目光直视镜头，唇角微扬呈含蓄闭口微笑。隧道内壁为黑色、高光反亮、粗粝质感的金属表面，可见明显刮痕、擦痕及湿漉漉的高光区域。以戏剧性环形动态模糊光轨环绕主体，光轨沿管道内壁圆周延展：暖琥珀色、橙色及偶尔穿插的白色光 streaks（光条），尤以外圈边缘最为显著，而画面中心区域保持锐利清晰。采用阴郁低调（low-key）布光（cinematic lighting）：温暖轮廓光（rim light）勾勒发丝与手臂轮廓，面部受柔和正面补光，管道边缘笼罩深重阴影，整体呈现高对比度时尚杂志风格（editorial look）。构图为竖版 4:5 比例，广角（wide-angle）镜头视角，对称式圆形取景，主体严格居中；肌肤纹理清晰真实，人体比例自然，织物细节丰富；画面不含文字、无品牌标识、无水印。整体效果应如一张高端都市时尚摄影，拍摄于幽暗工业管道内部，辅以长时间曝光（long-exposure）光绘技法。
2117903200341231849.author: Laraib Fatima‎

2117903200341231850.promptEn: Create a dreamy watercolor portrait of a beautiful young South Asian woman standing gracefully in a lush flower garden. She is shown from about mid-thigh upward, centered slightly left, facing the viewer with a soft calm smile and warm brown eyes. She has long, loose, dark brown wavy hair with sunlit highlights, parted naturally in the middle, with a few delicate strands around her face. She wears an elegant sheer pastel blush pink and lavender floral sari with translucent layers, subtle embroidered borders, and soft botanical patterns, along with gold jewelry: two large dangling jhumka earrings, a fine necklace, stacked bangles, and a delicate ring. Her hands rest gently together at her waist, creating a poised, serene pose. Surround her with an abundant romantic garden of roses and soft blossoms in pink, cream, white, coral, and pale yellow, with leafy green foliage; include a softly blurred stone garden pavilion or temple-like structure in the upper background. Use warm golden backlighting from the upper left, glowing rim light through her hair, gentle dappled sunlight, luminous skin tones, and a soft atmospheric haze. Render the entire image as traditional watercolor on textured paper, with loose wet-on-wet washes, blooming pigment edges, delicate ink-like detail only on the face and jewelry, soft splashes, granulation, and high-key pastel colors. Composition should be vertical 3:4, romantic, ethereal, elegant, and highly detailed in the face while the flowers and background remain painterly and impressionistic. No text, no watermark, no modern objects, no harsh outlines.
2117903200341231850.promptZh: 创作一幅梦幻水彩肖像画，描绘一位美丽的年轻南亚女性，优雅地伫立于繁花似锦的花园中。画面呈现她自大腿中部以上的上半身，构图略微偏左居中，她正面向观者，面带柔和宁静的微笑，眼眸呈温暖的棕色。她拥有一头浓密、松散、深棕色的波浪长发，发丝在阳光下泛着亮光，自然中分，几缕纤细发丝轻柔地垂落在脸颊周围。她身着一袭雅致的半透明浅粉与淡紫相间的花卉图案纱丽，层层叠叠、轻盈通透，边缘饰有细腻刺绣，整体布满柔和的植物纹样；同时佩戴金色首饰：一对硕大的垂坠式朱穆卡耳环（jhumka）、一条精致项链、多只叠戴手镯，以及一枚纤巧戒指。她的双手在腰间轻轻交叠，姿态端庄而安详。以丰盛浪漫的花园环绕她——盛开的玫瑰与柔美花朵交织成粉色、乳白、纯白、珊瑚色及淡黄色的花海，其间点缀葱郁的绿色枝叶；背景上方隐约可见一座柔焦处理的石制花园亭阁或类寺庙结构。采用左上方投来的温暖金色逆光，使她的发丝边缘泛起轮廓光（rim light），辅以柔和斑驳的阳光、晶莹润泽的肤色，以及一层轻盈的大气薄雾。整幅图像以传统水彩绘制于带纹理纸张之上：运用松动的湿画法（wet-on-wet）晕染、颜料自然扩散形成的晕染边缘（blooming pigment edges）、仅在面部与首饰处添加如墨线般精细的线条细节、轻盈飞溅的水彩点、颗粒感（granulation），以及高明度的粉彩色调（pastel colors）。构图采用竖版3:4比例，风格浪漫、空灵、典雅；面部刻画高度精细，而花卉与背景则保持写意性与印象派（impressionistic）笔触。画面中不得出现文字、水印或任何现代物品，亦不可有生硬轮廓线。
2117903200341231850.author: Arina Ai

2117903200341231851.promptEn:
Goal: Create a highly detailed photorealistic miniature food transformation storyboard showing a cheeseburger turning into a tiny fast-food café diorama on a glossy tabletop.

Canvas: Square collage layout with exactly 5 vertical 9:16 panels separated by thin black borders: 3 panels across the top row and 2 panels centered on the bottom row. Use a bright softly lit room with a blurred window in the background, white glossy tabletop, realistic reflections, shallow depth of field, warm daylight, cinematic miniature photography.

Panel sequence: Panel 1 shows a realistic juicy cheeseburger on the tabletop, with a golden sesame-seed bun, crispy green lettuce, tomato, melted cheese, thick beef patty, and bottom bun; a human finger touches/pushes the burger from the right side to initiate the transformation. Panel 2 shows the burger beginning to transform, still mostly intact, with small mechanical gears and circular parts appearing between the tomato and cheese layers, suggesting hidden machinery inside. Panel 3 shows the burger partially opened and converted into a miniature restaurant interior, with bun fragments forming the outer shell, lettuce, cheese, tomato slices, and patty pieces still visible around the edges, and a tiny illuminated café counter inside. 2117903200341231852.promptEn: Create a vertical storybook paper-cut diorama illustration in warm autumn light: a tiny golden-brown hamster stands at the threshold of an arched doorway made from exactly 3 oversized maple leaves, counted as 1 muted green left leaf, 1 tall ochre center leaf forming the peak, and 1 golden-orange right leaf. The hamster, a small fluffy hamster, is seen from behind in three-quarter view, with round ears, black bead eye, tiny paws lifted, soft fur, and a small white tail, gazing into a glowing miniature autumn forest. Inside the leaf arch, show exactly 1 winding leaf-covered path, 2 dark tree trunks framing the sides, layered orange hills in the distance, and several falling maple leaves silhouetted against a bright sunset sky. Outside the doorway, use a matte sage-green paper-textured background and floor, with botanical cut-paper decorations around the frame: exactly 2 tall leafy sprigs on the left side and exactly 2 tall leafy sprigs on the right side, plus scattered flat autumn leaves on the ground. 2117903200341231852.promptZh: 在温暖的秋日光线中，创作一幅竖版绘本风格的剪纸立体场景插画：一只微小的金棕色仓鼠站在由恰好3片超大枫叶构成的拱形门廊入口处，这3片叶子分别为：1片哑光绿色的左侧叶子、1片形成拱顶的高耸赭色中心叶子，以及1片金橙色的右侧叶子。仓鼠是一只毛茸茸的小仓鼠，以三分之四视角从背后呈现，圆耳、黑色珠状眼睛、前爪微微抬起、毛发柔软、尾巴小巧且呈白色，正凝望着门内一片发光的微型秋日森林。在枫叶拱门内部，展现恰好1条蜿蜒覆盖落叶的小径、2根深色树干分列两侧作为边框、远处层叠的橙色山丘，以及数片飘落的枫叶剪影映衬于明亮的日落天空之下。门廊外部采用哑光鼠尾草绿纸纹背景与地面，并在画面边框周围布置植物主题的剪纸装饰：左侧恰好2枝高大的多叶枝条，右侧也恰好2枝高大的多叶枝条，地面则散落若干扁平的秋日落叶。整个场景应呈现手工制作的质感，使用带纹理的纸材，清晰可见叶脉、压印纤维、柔和阴影；暖金色光线自门内倾泻而出，并在前景地面投下仓鼠修长的投影。整体采用温馨季节性配色：鼠尾草绿、赭色、琥珀色、焦橙色与柔金色。不添加文字、无水印、无照片级写实（photorealistic）塑料感；保持奇趣感、触感真实、柔和电影感（cinematic）、构图居中。

2117903200341231853.promptEn:
Goal: Create a premium cinematic action storyboard collage for a short Hollywood-style fight sequence starring a rugged dark-haired South Asian male action hero.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster-like collage, approximately 900 x 1200 px, divided by thin white borders into exactly 7 cinematic panels. Use a dark, gritty, photorealistic IMAX blockbuster look with high contrast, shallow depth of field, smoky warehouse atmosphere, wet-black wardrobe highlights, dramatic overhead industrial lighting, and realistic motion blur.

Setting: A large abandoned industrial warehouse at night with concrete floors, steel beams, metal shelving, barrels, crates, ladders, haze, dust, sparks, and harsh rectangular lights in the background. The overall color grade is charcoal black, steel gray, muted brown, and cool white highlights.

Main character: The same male hero appears consistently in every panel: early-to-mid 30s, athletic build, medium tan skin, intense brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows, black slightly messy medium-length hair falling over the forehead, short full beard and mustache, sharp jawline, serious expression. He wears a fitted black tactical T-shirt, black leather or tactical jacket, black pants, and black belt throughout. Do not change his face, hair, age, or wardrobe between panels.

Panel layout and exact content count: Include exactly 7 panels total:
1. Top wide panel: The hero stands in the center of a tense standoff, facing three male attackers in dark jackets. One attacker is seen from behind on the far left foreground, one stands behind the hero on the left, and one faces him on the right foreground. The hero looks focused and ready to fight.
2. Second wide panel: Extreme close-up portrait of the hero's face, filling most of the frame, intense direct eye contact, damp hair strands over forehead, blurred dark background.
3. Third row left angled panel: The hero throws a powerful punch or elbow strike at an attacker, with sparks, dust, motion blur, and the attacker recoiling.
4. Third row right angled panel: The hero is surrounded by three attackers in a dynamic fighting stance, arms extended, ready to counter multiple incoming strikes.
5. Fourth wide panel: The hero kneels over a defeated attacker on the warehouse floor, one hand pinning him down, while other unconscious bodies lie in the background.
6. Bottom left panel: The hero walks forward confidently down the warehouse aisle, adjusting or gripping his black jacket with both hands, defeated men lying on the floor behind him.
7. Bottom right panel: Tight dramatic close-up of the hero's face, cropped on one side, intense eyes and serious expression, dark blurred background.

Action details: Show exactly 3 main attackers in the confrontation and group-fight panels, all adult men in dark clothing. Across the later panels, show multiple defeated bodies on the floor but keep them secondary and slightly blurred. The mood should suggest a fast, brutal 15-second compressed fight montage rather than a static portrait.

Visual style: Photorealistic live-action film stills, AAA action movie production value, ultra-realistic skin texture, cinematic lighting, high dynamic range, anamorphic depth of field, subtle film grain, no comic or illustration style. Use crisp facial details in close-ups and controlled motion blur in fight panels.

Text and constraints: No captions, no logos, no watermark, no UI elements. Keep the collage borders clean and white. Maintain the same hero identity and outfit in all 7 panels. The atmosphere should feel explosive, aggressive, and continuously moving.

2117903200341231854.promptZh: 创作一幅精致的动漫风格肖像插画，描绘一位年轻女子，身处宁静的欧洲乡村小镇，以略微正面斜角视角呈现。她站在阳光照耀的石板小径中央，小径两侧是质朴的灰泥木架结构房屋，她温柔地望向观者，面带柔和、平静的微笑。她拥有一头长长的栗棕色秀发，额前垂着松散的刘海，一侧肩头垂落一条粗厚的侧边辫子；眼睛明亮湛蓝，佩戴一副纤细的圆形金属框眼镜。身着传统阿尔卑斯山地区裙装（dirndl）：白色泡泡袖上衣，领口呈带荷叶边的方领；深绿色合身紧身胸衣，表面带有细腻刺绣纹理；酒红色鞋带式交叉系带，穿过金属扣眼；森林绿色宽摆围裙裙，于腰间系成蝴蝶结。她的左手在画面左下边缘持一只带金属提手的木桶；右臂自然垂落于身侧。背景须精确呈现五个主要环境元素：左侧一堵老屋墙，墙上带百叶窗；她身后一道处于阴影中的门洞；墙边一盆枝叶繁茂的盆栽植物；一条狭窄的鹅卵石小径向远处纵深延伸；右侧地平线上一座虚化的教堂尖塔。采用温暖的上午晚些时候阳光，发丝与肩部施加柔和的轮廓光（rim light），景深（depth of field）柔和，布料褶皱细节丰富，肌肤明暗过渡自然，高品质动漫渲染（high-quality anime rendering），真实可信的乡村氛围，竖构图 3:4 比例，画面中无文字，无水印。

2117903200341231857.promptZh: 创作一幅照片级写实（photorealistic）的竖构图海滩人像，画面主体为一名二十岁出头的东亚年轻女性，伫立于明艳青绿色（turquoise）海水之畔，头顶是晴朗湛蓝的夏日天空。人物呈腰部以上取景，以三分之四背面姿态站立，头部转向镜头，面带柔和而自信的浅笑，眼神放松。她头戴一顶宽檐天然草编太阳帽，编织纹理通透可见，帽檐为深海军蓝；一只手轻触帽檐靠近脸颊的位置。乌黑长发松散地挽成低马尾式凌乱发髻，几缕细碎发丝飘散于面颊周围，略带微风拂过的动感。草帽在她的面部、颈部、肩部及上背部投下细腻的点状格纹阴影。她身着一件白色露肩镂空蕾丝夏季上衣，饰有花卉图案雕花刺绣；单侧肩头隐约可见两条纤细的银色泳衣肩带。背景：下半部分为浅青绿色海水；左侧地平线处是一座柔焦处理的远距离小岛；湛蓝天空中恰好分布着3处小巧、柔软的白色云朵区域。采用明亮正午阳光，呈现温暖自然的肤色，面部与草帽纹理清晰锐利对焦，景深（depth of field）浅，具备真实镜头压缩感（realistic lens compression），整体洋溢轻盈热带度假氛围，高分辨率杂志级摄影（high-resolution editorial photography），竖向9:16构图。

2117903200341231858.promptEn: Create a highly detailed fantasy architectural product shot of an entire miniature city carved inside one continuous curved ribbon of translucent white alabaster marble, shaped like a large open shell or looping stone band standing upright on a dark teal studio surface. 2117903200341231858.promptZh: 创作一幅高度精细的奇幻建筑产品摄影图：一座完整的微缩城市被雕刻在一条连续弯曲的半透明白色雪花石膏大理石带中，该石带呈大型张开贝壳状或环形石带状，垂直立于深青绿色影棚表面之上。整座城市应呈现为一个奢华的巴洛克风格地中海微型王国，由同一块石材自然生长而成：光滑的白色露台、拱形拱廊、微小阶梯、桥梁、柱廊、阳台、散发暖光的窗户，以及如金缮（kintsugi）般贯穿石材的纤细金色脉络镶嵌。包含恰好5个主要地标元素：1座位于左上方的大型圆形穹顶天文观测宫，其屋顶装有黄铜制浑天仪环；1座位于右上方的高耸灯塔式塔楼；1座位于中心右侧露台上的较小圆形塔楼，其顶部装有黄铜制星盘；1座靠近画面下部中央的小型穹顶凉亭；以及1条沿左下方延伸的长拱形引水渠/画廊。在城市中融入青绿色水景：3处可见水池与3道在露台间倾泻而下的瀑布。在各露台上遍布微型柏树、微小花园、开花灌木、苔藓及花盆，但须确保建筑主体性突出。天文仪器、精细接缝及精致装饰线条均采用纤薄抛光黄铜材质。布光需具电影感（cinematic lighting）与博物馆级（museum-like）质感：窗户透出温暖金色光芒，雕塑后方则为冷调青绿色环境光；背景为平滑的深青绿色渐变，带柔和雾化效果。以超精细微距摄影（macro photograph）风格渲染，呈现一件可收藏的建筑雕塑作品：视角为略高于水平线的三分之四视角（three-quarter view），细节清晰繁复，石材具备半透明次表面发光（subsurface glow）效果，水池表面呈现抛光湿润反射（polished wet reflections），浅景深（shallow depth of field），画面中无人物、无文字、无水印。

2117903200341231859.promptZh: 创作一幅竖构图的时尚杂志风格人像，画面主体为一位年轻女性，置身于灰蒙蒙雾气弥漫的摄影棚中。画面中需精确呈现同一女性的两个形象：左侧居中位置为一个全身像，她正向前行走；右侧则融合一幅放大的半透明特写（close-up）胸像，作为背景的一部分。该女性拥有一头深棕色头发，松散地盘起，面颊两侧垂落几缕柔和的碎发；眼睛浅色，眉毛自然，妆容极简，耳戴小巧的钉状耳钉，神情平静淡然，目光直视镜头。服饰为：一件浅玫瑰粉色的纽扣衬衫，袖子随意卷至前臂；一条高腰奶油色阔腿裤，带有褶皱；一双干净的白色运动鞋；一只手插在裤袋中，另一只手自然垂落。背景与地面均为带纹理的烟灰色，脚边及画面下部弥漫着低矮的白色薄雾，部分遮掩右侧的大幅背景人像。布光柔和、漫射、电影感（cinematic）、略带冷调，阴影轻柔，皮肤质感真实。构图须呈现优雅、梦幻且专业的视觉效果，类似高端摄影棚合成影像，整体采用低饱和度的粉彩色调，空间纵深感浅淡，不添加文字、水印或额外人物。

2117903200341231861.promptEn: Create a highly realistic cinematic macro product-photo collage showing a tiny pastel baby-blue retro vending machine labeled MiniAI Tech on a clean white convenience-store counter, with a softly blurred retail background of shelves, refrigerators, snacks, signage, and checkout equipment. Arrange exactly 5 vertical photo panels in a clean white collage: 3 panels across the top row and 2 larger panels centered on the bottom row, separated by thin white gutters. The vending machine is glossy, rounded-corner, toy-sized, with white side panels, a glowing rounded name sign at the top, a clear front display window full of miniature cans and bottles, tiny product selection buttons under each row, a black digital price display reading “100”, a small blue payment screen, a card slot, a coin slot, and a rectangular pickup tray near the bottom. Show a step-by-step interaction sequence across the 5 panels: panel 1 shows a human hand inserting a coin or pressing the payment area while the closed machine is fully stocked; panel 2 shows a finger pressing a drink-selection button on the front; panel 3 shows the transparent front revealing small internal robotic gears, belts, and dispensing mechanisms moving behind rows of colorful miniature drinks; panel 4 shows a hand reaching into the lower dispensing area and pulling out a tiny green soda bottle; panel 5 shows the hand holding the tiny bottle close to camera, labeled Sprite, with the machine and open clear pickup door blurred behind it. Use shallow depth of field, soft store lighting, photorealistic reflections on plastic and glass, realistic skin texture and manicured nails, macro scale cues, crisp focus on the active hand/product in each panel, and a cute premium miniature product aesthetic. Keep all visible machine branding consistent, avoid extra logos except the drink label, no watermark, no cartoon styling.
2117903200341231861.promptZh:
创作一幅高度写实的电影感（cinematic）微距（macro）产品摄影拼贴图：一台粉彩婴儿蓝复古自动售货机，机身标注“MiniAI Tech”，置于洁净纯白的便利店柜台之上，背景为柔和虚化的零售场景，包括货架、冰箱、零食、标牌及收银设备。

以洁净纯白底色排布恰好5张竖向照片面板，构成拼贴构图：顶部一行排列3张面板，底部一行居中排列2张尺寸更大的面板，各面板之间以细窄白色间隙（gutter）分隔。

该售货机表面光亮，边角圆润，尺寸如玩具大小；两侧为白色侧板；顶部设一发光圆角铭牌；正面为通透展示窗，内满置微型罐装与瓶装饮料；每排饮品下方配有微小的产品选择按钮；黑色数字价格屏显示 “100”；另配小型蓝色支付屏幕、刷卡槽、投币口，以及靠近底部的矩形取货托盘。

五张面板依序呈现人机交互步骤：

面板1：一只人手正插入硬币或按压支付区域，此时售货机处于关闭状态，内部商品满载；  
面板2：一根手指正按压售货机正面某款饮品的选择按钮；  
面板3：透明前窗展现内部细节——微缩机器人齿轮、传送带及出货机构正在彩色微型饮料排后运转；  
面板4：一只手伸入下部出货区，从中取出一支微小的绿色汽水瓶；  
面板5：同一只手将这支微小汽水瓶持至镜头近前，瓶身清晰标注“Sprite”，售货机本体及已开启的透明取货门则处于景深（depth of field）外虚化状态。

整体采用浅景深（shallow depth of field）、便利店柔光（soft store lighting）、塑料与玻璃表面的照片级写实（photorealistic）反光、真实肌肤纹理与精心修护的指甲、微距（macro）尺度提示元素；每张面板中，当前活跃的手部或产品须保持锐利焦点（crisp focus）；整体呈现可爱而高端的微型产品美学（cute premium miniature product aesthetic）。

所有可见的售货机品牌标识须保持一致；除饮品标签外，不得添加额外标识；不加水印；禁用卡通风格（cartoon styling）。

2117903200341231862.promptEn: Create a stunning high-end artistic portrait of a young woman, preserving a realistic facial identity with an oval face, soft fair skin, hazel-green eyes, straight dark brown hair, and a gentle natural smile. Style her as a sophisticated contemporary mixed-media fashion portrait: she wears a deep navy blazer over a white blouse with an oversized soft bow at the collar, a wide dark blue velvet headband, and ornate dangling silver-and-pearl earrings. Frame her from the chest up, centered and facing forward, with calm eye contact and elegant posture. Surround her with expressive watercolor and acrylic floral elements on textured cream paper: exactly 5 prominent flowers are visible — 1 large blue flower on the lower left, 1 red-pink flower partly behind it, 1 pale pink blossom on the upper right, 1 white-pink blossom on the mid-right, and 1 purple flower cluster near the lower right shoulder. Add blue, violet, rose, beige, and gold paint washes, splatters, brush strokes, and a few vertical drips around the edges, blending the portrait into the painterly background. Use luminous soft studio lighting, refined skin detail, semi-realistic digital painting mixed with watercolor collage, premium editorial beauty portrait mood, delicate gold flecks, shallow depth, high resolution, no text, no watermark, no extra people.
2117903200341231862.promptZh: 创作一幅惊艳的高端艺术人像，描绘一位年轻女性，保留其真实的面部特征：鹅蛋脸、柔润白皙的肌肤、榛绿色眼睛、笔直深棕色秀发，以及温柔自然的微笑。以精致当代混合媒介时尚人像（contemporary mixed-media fashion portrait）风格呈现：她身着深海军蓝西装外套，内搭白色衬衫，衣领处系一枚 oversized 柔软蝴蝶结；佩戴宽幅深蓝色天鹅绒发带；耳垂悬挂繁复华丽的银色与珍珠吊坠耳饰。构图采用胸以上正面居中取景，目光平静直视镜头，姿态优雅。背景为肌理感奶油色纸面，融入富有表现力的水彩与丙烯花卉元素：画面中清晰可见恰好 5 朵突出的花——左下角一朵大型蓝色花朵，其后半遮掩一朵红粉色花朵，右上角一朵浅粉色花朵，中右位置一朵白粉色花朵，右肩下方附近一簇紫色花团。边缘区域添加蓝色、紫罗兰色、玫瑰色、米 beige 色与金色的颜料晕染、飞溅色点、笔触痕迹及数道垂直流痕，使人物肖像与绘画感背景自然融合。采用明亮柔和的影棚布光（studio lighting），细腻刻画肌肤质感，融合半写实数字绘画（semi-realistic digital painting）与水彩拼贴（watercolor collage）技法，呈现高端杂志级美妆人像（premium editorial beauty portrait）氛围，点缀精巧金箔微粒（delicate gold flecks），浅景深（shallow depth），高分辨率（high resolution），画面无文字、无水印、无人物以外的其他人物。
2117903200341231862.author: Hania Ai

2117903200341231863.promptEn: Create a surreal, ultra-realistic miniature cinematic sick-day scene on a wooden tabletop at golden hour. A tiny young woman, a tired young woman, sits on top of an oversized red-and-orange medicine box labeled “POWER CAPS,” wrapped in a soft gray blanket over a cream shirt and plaid pajama pants, wearing white sneakers. She looks exhausted and slightly feverish, holding a small spoon in one hand and a small bowl or cup of medicine in the other, gazing downward with a quiet unwell expression. Surround her with giant everyday recovery objects scaled much larger than her: exactly 1 oversized digital thermometer leaning vertically on the left showing “38.5 °C” with a sad face icon, exactly 1 yellow sticky note above her reading “Get Well Soon” with a red heart, exactly 1 large cream ceramic mug in the back reading “Take Care” with a smiling sun illustration, exactly 1 clear glass of water on the right filled with sparkling bubbles, exactly 1 blue medicine box labeled “Panadol Advance” in the right foreground, exactly 1 amber pill bottle on the lower right with a white label reading “Rest Hydrate Feel Better” and a red heart, exactly 1 blister pack in the front holding 10 white tablets, exactly 1 loose white capsule on the tabletop, and exactly 5 crumpled white tissues scattered around the scene. Use warm backlit sunlight streaming through a window, soft bokeh trees outside, shallow depth of field, realistic textures on paper, plastic, ceramic, glass, foil, wood grain, and fabric. Make it feel like a tiny cinematic diorama photographed with a macro lens, cozy but melancholic, with realistic shadows, reflections, scale contrast, and no extra objects or text beyond the specified labels. Use warm, caring, tired, cinematic lighting and a slightly low front macro angle composition.
2117903200341231863.promptZh: 在黄金时刻（golden hour）的木质桌面上，创作一幅超现实、超写实的微缩电影感病中场景。一位娇小的年轻女性——一位疲惫的年轻女性——坐在一个 oversized 红橙色药盒顶部，药盒上印有 “POWER CAPS,”；她裹着一条柔软的灰色毛毯，内搭米色衬衫与格子睡裤，脚穿白色运动鞋。她神情疲惫、略带低烧，一手握着一把小勺，另一手端着一只盛有药物的小碗或小杯，目光低垂，流露出安静而不适的神情。围绕她布置若干被放大至远超其体型的日常康复物品：左侧垂直立着 1 支 oversized 数字体温计，屏幕显示“38.5 °C”，并配有悲伤表情图标；正上方贴着 1 张黄色便签，上面写着 “Get Well Soon”，并绘有一颗红色爱心；后方放置 1 只 oversized 米色陶瓷马克杯，杯身印有 “Take Care” 及一枚笑脸太阳插画；右侧摆着 1 杯清水，玻璃杯通透，水中充满闪烁气泡；右前景处放着 1 盒蓝色药盒，标有 “Panadol Advance”；右下角置 1 瓶琥珀色药瓶，瓶身白色标签上印有 “Rest Hydrate Feel Better” 并配有一颗红色爱心；前景中央平铺 1 片药板（blister pack），内含 10 粒白色药片；桌面上另散落 1 粒松脱的白色胶囊；场景各处共散落 5 团揉皱的白色纸巾。采用透过窗户倾泻而入的温暖逆光（backlit sunlight），窗外树木呈现柔和焦外虚化（bokeh），景深（depth of field）较浅；纸张、塑料、陶瓷、玻璃、锡箔、木纹与织物等材质均需呈现真实质感。整体效果应如一枚微缩电影感立体模型（diorama），以微距镜头（macro lens）拍摄而成，氛围温馨却略带忧郁，阴影与反射真实自然，尺度对比鲜明，除指定标签外不添加任何额外物体或文字。采用温暖、关怀、倦怠而富有电影感布光（cinematic lighting），构图采用略低视角的正面微距角度（front macro angle）。
2117903200341231863.author: Alina Ai

2117903200341231864.promptEn:
Photorealistic lifestyle portrait of a young adult woman sitting casually on old stone steps in a lush, peaceful botanical park. She has long, straight dark brown hair with a center part, natural elegant makeup, defined eyebrows, warm brown eyes, subtle gold hoop earrings, and a delicate gold pendant necklace. She is wearing a loose, light-gray button-up shirt with rolled sleeves and matching relaxed-fit gray trousers, paired with clean white low-top sneakers. She sits cross-legged while holding a pencil and writing in a small spiral notebook resting on her lap, looking directly into the camera with a calm, gentle, confident expression.

Beside her is a black casual backpack and a clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw. Behind her are mature trees, dense green foliage, a rustic wooden park bench, and a small traditional wooden gazebo. Warm late-afternoon sunlight filters naturally through the leaves, creating soft golden highlights, realistic dappled shadows, and beautiful background bokeh. Cinematic photography, natural skin texture, realistic fabric details, shallow depth of field, 50mm lens, f/2.0, eye-level composition, soft warm color grading, high dynamic range, editorial lifestyle photography, ultra-realistic, highly detailed, authentic candid atmosphere, vertical portrait composition, 4:5 aspect ratio.
2117903200341231864.promptZh: 照片级写实（photorealistic）生活方式人像：一位年轻成年女性随意坐在郁郁葱葱、宁静祥和的植物园中古老的石阶上。她拥有一头长而顺直的深棕色头发，中分，妆容自然优雅，眉毛轮廓清晰，眼睛呈温暖的棕色，佩戴小巧的金色圆环耳饰，颈间挂着一条精致的金色吊坠项链。她身穿一件宽松的浅灰色纽扣衬衫，袖口挽至小臂，下搭同色系宽松剪裁的灰色长裤，脚踩一双洁净的白色低帮运动鞋。她盘腿而坐，手持一支铅笔，在置于膝上的小型螺旋笔记本中书写，目光直视镜头，神情平静、柔和且自信。\n\n她身旁放着一只黑色休闲双肩背包，以及一只装有冰咖啡的透明塑料杯，杯中插着一根吸管。她身后是枝干粗壮的树木、茂密的青翠 foliage（叶丛）、一座质朴的木质公园长椅，以及一座小型传统木结构凉亭。温暖的午后夕阳透过树叶自然洒落，在画面中形成柔和的金色高光、真实细腻的斑驳阴影，以及优美的背景焦外虚化（bokeh）。电影感摄影（cinematic photography）、自然肌肤质感、真实布料细节、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、50mm镜头、f/2.0光圈、平视构图（eye-level composition）、柔暖色调分级（soft warm color grading）、高动态范围（high dynamic range）、杂志风格生活方式摄影（editorial lifestyle photography）、超写实（ultra-realistic）、高度精细（highly detailed）、真实自然的抓拍氛围（authentic candid atmosphere）、竖幅人像构图（vertical portrait composition）、4:5画幅比（aspect ratio）。
2117903200341231864.author: Maha

2117903200341231865.promptEn: Create a stunning ultra-realistic high-resolution close-up portrait of a young woman with long dark brown hair with warm copper highlights, centered in a vertical 3:4 frame. She faces the camera with a calm, confident expression and a subtle closed-mouth smile, gazing directly forward through perfectly round gold-rimmed sunglasses with dark reflective lenses. The lenses must clearly reflect a golden outdoor park scene with trees, a pathway, and low sunlight. Use dramatic warm golden-hour lighting with strong diagonal bands of sunlight and shadow crossing her forehead, sunglasses, cheeks, lips, neck, and sweater, as if filtered through blinds or tree branches. Her skin should look natural and luminous with realistic pores and soft highlights; lips are glossy deep red. She wears a chunky ribbed deep crimson red turtleneck sweater, visible from shoulders to chest, plus pearl drop earrings on both ears. Add exactly 2 small decorative embroidered pins on the turtleneck: 1 tiny red heart on the viewer-left side and 1 tiny white dove on the viewer-right side. Background is dark, warm brown, softly blurred, with shallow depth of field and no visible environment details. Hair should be voluminous, loose, and glossy, framing the face with individual strands catching orange rim light. Cinematic editorial fashion photography, 85mm lens look, sharp focus on face and glasses, rich contrast, warm amber tones, photorealistic textures, no extra text except a subtle cursive signature reading Enaya in the bottom-right corner.
2117903200341231865.promptZh: 创作一幅惊艳的超写实高分辨率特写（close-up）人像，描绘一位年轻女性，她拥有一头浓密的深棕色长发，发丝带有温暖的赤铜色高光，人物居中置于竖构图3:4画幅内。她正对镜头，神情沉静而自信，唇部微扬呈含蓄的闭口微笑，目光笔直向前，透过一副完美圆形的金边太阳镜凝视——镜片为深色反光材质。镜片中必须清晰映出一幅金色户外公园场景，包含树木、小径及低角度阳光。采用富有戏剧感的暖调黄金时刻布光（golden-hour lighting），强对比的斜向光束与阴影带横跨她的前额、太阳镜、脸颊、嘴唇、颈部及毛衣，仿佛经百叶窗或树枝间隙过滤而成。她的肌肤需呈现自然通透质感，具备真实可见的毛孔与柔和高光；双唇为光泽感浓郁的深红色。她身穿一件厚实罗纹深猩红色高领毛衣，从肩部至胸部清晰可见，并佩戴一对珍珠吊坠耳环。在高领毛衣上精准添加2枚小型装饰性刺绣胸针：一枚微小的红色心形图案位于观者左侧，一枚微小的白色鸽子图案位于观者右侧。背景为深暖棕色，柔焦虚化，景深（depth of field）极浅，无任何可辨识的环境细节。头发蓬松丰盈、自然垂落且富有光泽，发丝轮廓分明，个别发丝边缘泛出橙色轮廓光（rim light）。整体风格为电影感（cinematic）时尚杂志摄影（editorial fashion photography），呈现85mm镜头视觉效果，面部与眼镜锐利聚焦（sharp focus），对比度饱满，色调以温暖琥珀色为主，纹理照片级写实（photorealistic），除右下角一处纤细手写体签名“Enaya”外，画面不添加任何额外文字。
2117903200341231865.author: Arina Ai

2117903200341231866.promptEn: Create a polished anime-style vertical illustration of exactly two teenage girls walking side by side through a narrow Japanese shopping street at dusk after rain. The left girl has short fluffy pale blonde hair, red eyes, a cheerful open-mouth smile, and is gesturing upward with one raised index finger as if chatting excitedly; she wears a loose white blouse, an unbuttoned red cardigan, a dark pleated skirt, black ankle socks, white sneakers, and a light shoulder bag. The right girl has long straight black hair, violet-blue eyes, a calm slightly curious expression, and holds the strap of a black shoulder bag; she wears a navy short-sleeve blouse with light trim, high-waisted blue pleated shorts, black ankle socks, and black sneakers. Show them full body, centered in the foreground, mid-step, with natural anime proportions and soft expressive faces. The setting is a cozy urban Japanese backstreet lined with small shops, warm glowing windows, plants, bicycles, vending machines, utility poles, signs, and overhead power lines. 2117903200341231879.promptEn: Create a Cannes-level flagship advertising poster for an original stacked crisp brand named CRAVELOOP, featuring the hero product Smoky Paprika Stacked Crisps. Build the image with strong Orbit circulation and refined Transit reduction, creating a bold, globally polished premium snack campaign. Core composition: Use a vertical poster set against a deep moody forest-green background with subtle texture, soft atmospheric depth, and cinematic spotlighting. Keep the layout clean and powerful with three essential zones: 1. a giant looping crisp roller-coaster at center 2. one large upright CRAVELOOP can on the right as the official product anchor 3. one tightly edited ingredient platform at the lower left The overall image must feel dramatic, craveable, and highly controlled. Orbit structure: Design the composition so the eye moves in a clear closed loop: headline -> crisp roller-coaster -> product can -> lower-left ingredient platform -> back upward into the roller-coaster. Use the rising curve of the crisps, the opened can lid, the scattered crisp direction, and the angle of the lower-left ingredient labels to reinforce this circulation. The roller-coaster must feel like the emotional engine of the poster, while the can remains the clearest commercial hero. Hero visual logic: At the center, build an elegant roller-coaster track entirely from perfectly aligned stacked crisps, including one strong rising arc and one full loop. The crisps must feel ultra-realistic, evenly layered, delicately seasoned, golden, crisp-edged, and physically believable. A tiny red coaster cart rides on the track as a subtle storytelling accent, but it should remain secondary and not turn the poster into a toy scene. Product hero: On the right, place one oversized CRAVELOOP can standing upright with the lid partially opened, revealing a neat stack of crisps inside. The packaging should feel premium, real, shelf-ready, and globally publishable, using a disciplined red-orange, cream, and golden palette. The can must be sharply lit, highly legible, and visually stable enough to counterbalance the motion of the roller-coaster. Packaging text: Use original on-pack wording such as: CRAVELOOP SMOKY PAPRIKA STACKED CRISPS Refined supporting lines: “REAL POTATO CUT” “BOLD SPICE FINISH” Keep the front-of-pack hierarchy clean and premium, with no cluttered claims. Typography system: At the upper left, place one concise original campaign headline in expressive oversized type: “CRUNCH IN MOTION” Use a refined combination of warm golden emphasis and clean white supporting text, with strong hierarchy and premium spacing. Keep it shorter and cleaner than a retail ad headline so the poster feels more international and flagship. Transit reduction: Edit the lower-left ingredient area down to only the most essential flavor cues: - raw potatoes - paprika seasoning - a small supporting accent such as chili rings Use only 2-3 tiny art-directed ingredient labels in elegant micro typography. Remove excess props, extra bowls, and unnecessary callouts. The ingredient platform should support the story without competing with the main product and roller-coaster. Lower strip: If a footer is used, keep it extremely restrained. Replace any loud promotional banner with one short premium line in small typography: “Stacked for the long crave.” No sales language, no retail clutter, no aggressive CTA button feel. Lighting and atmosphere: Use premium commercial lighting with warm highlights on the crisps, sculpted reflections on the can, subtle seasoning sparkle, controlled shadows on the lower platform, and enough depth separation to make the loop, can, and ingredient base feel dimensional. The scene should feel cinematic but clean. Color direction: Deep forest green, near-black shadow tones, golden crisp yellow, paprika red-orange, restrained cream typography, and warm brown ingredient accents. Keep the palette rich and disciplined. The red-orange can should act as the key brand beacon. Visual style: Ultra-realistic commercial food photography, flagship FMCG campaign quality, believable crisp texture, elegant seasoning detail, premium packaging realism, clean art direction, strong hierarchy, and no clutter. The final image must feel like a global snack-brand launch visual, not a supermarket flyer. Mood: Bold, immersive, craveable, graphic, premium, internationally branded, high-impact, cleanly theatrical. Negative prompt: cheap supermarket flyer, cluttered ingredient platform, too many props, low-detail crisps, warped roller-coaster, unreadable can design, excessive claim text, cartoon snack styling, muddy background, weak lighting, flat composition, plastic-looking chips, noisy footer banner, low-end promo aesthetic

2117903200341231888.promptZh: 创作一幅高度写实、具有电影感（cinematic）的旅行人像：一位时尚年轻男性，深色卷发，浅胡茬，中等偏深的古铜色皮肤，于黄金时刻（golden hour）日落时分，轻松坐在一处滨海悬崖上古老粗粝的石阶上。他在竖构图画面的下半部分居中，双腿分开而坐，手肘支在膝盖上，双手松散交握，目光望向右侧，神情平静而自信。他身穿一件宽松的米色亚麻纽扣衬衫，带有细密纵向条纹；搭配米色阔腿亚麻长裤、白色运动鞋、飞行员太阳镜和一只黑色腕表。他身后是一片戏剧性的地中海风格岩质海岸线——右侧悬崖层叠远去，左侧为平静海面，前景有低矮灌木与干燥的滨海植被，太阳靠近地平线，在水面上投下明亮的金色倒影。天空布满暖橙色云朵，并弥漫着柔和的大气薄雾。采用自然逆光（backlighting）、发丝与肩部轮廓处温暖的轮廓光（rim light）、逼真的皮肤质感、中等偏浅景深（depth of field）、细腻的石材纹理、柔和的胶片感对比度（filmic contrast）、暖橙色与琥珀色调色（color grading），整体呈现高端生活方式摄影（lifestyle photography）美学。竖幅人像构图，2:3画幅比例，平视角度拍摄，略带中焦镜头（telephoto）视觉感受，画面中无文字、无水印、无其他人物。
2117903200341231888.author: Faymas

2117903200341231889.promptEn: Create a polished vertical anime illustration of a Japanese high school girl standing inside a bright convenience store beside a refrigerated drink shelf. She is the single main subject, shown from mid-thigh up, facing slightly left while looking off to the left with a soft curious expression and parted lips. She has glossy black hair with wispy bangs and exactly 2 long braids falling over her chest, warm brown eyes, fair skin with gentle blush, and thin round wire-frame glasses. Her school uniform has exactly 5 visible clothing components: a short-sleeved white sailor blouse, a navy sailor collar, white striped trim, a large deep red ribbon bow at the chest, and a dark navy pleated skirt. Add exactly 3 main accessories/held objects: round glasses on her face, a large navy shoulder school bag hanging from her left shoulder, and a clear plastic bottled tea drink with a pale yellow-green label held in both hands. Place her next to a right-side refrigerated shelf filled with neatly arranged bottled drinks and small Japanese-style price tags, with the labels softly detailed but not meant to be readable. The background should show a convenience-store entrance or window with bright daylight, blurred greenery and street shapes outside, and cool reflective interior surfaces. Use high-quality modern anime, semi-realistic lighting, delicate linework, soft painterly shading, shallow depth of field, luminous backlighting, subtle rim light on the hair, natural skin tones, crisp focus on the girl, and a calm summer-after-school atmosphere. Use a vertical 2:3 composition, no text overlay, no watermark, no extra characters.
2117903200341231889.promptZh: 创作一幅精致的竖版动漫插画，描绘一名日本高中女生站在明亮的便利店内、冷藏饮料货架旁。她是画面中唯一的主体，以大腿中部以上视角呈现，身体微微朝左，目光望向左方，神情柔和而好奇，双唇微启。她拥有一头亮泽的黑色秀发，带有轻盈飘逸的刘海，胸前垂落两条长度一致的长辫；眼睛呈暖棕色，肤色白皙并泛着淡淡的红晕，佩戴一副细圆框眼镜。她的校服共包含恰好五种可见的服饰元素：短袖白色水手风上衣、深蓝色水手领、白色条纹镶边、胸前一枚硕大的深红色丝带蝴蝶结，以及一条深藏青色百褶裙。添加恰好三件主要配饰或手持物品：脸上佩戴的圆形眼镜、悬挂在左肩上的大型深蓝色单肩学生包，以及双手捧着的一瓶透明塑料装茶饮，瓶身标签呈淡黄绿色。将她置于右侧冷藏货架旁，货架上整齐陈列着瓶装饮料及小巧的日式价签，价签细节柔和可辨但无需清晰可读。背景应展现便利店入口或玻璃窗，窗外是明亮的白昼天光、虚化的绿色植物与街道轮廓，室内则呈现清凉反光的表面质感。采用高品质现代动漫风格，半写实布光（semi-realistic lighting），细腻线条（delicate linework），柔和绘画感阴影（soft painterly shading），浅景深（shallow depth of field），明亮逆光（luminous backlighting），发丝边缘带有微妙的轮廓光（subtle rim light），自然肤色（natural skin tones），人物面部与上半身保持锐利焦点（crisp focus on the girl），整体氛围宁静，充满夏日放学后的闲适感。采用竖向2:3构图，不添加文字覆盖层，无水印，无额外人物。
2117903200341231889.author: Harf_Done

2117903200341231890.promptEn: Create a polished anime-style half-body portrait of a cheerful schoolgirl character on a pure black background. She has very long bright golden blonde hair with thick layered bangs, loose hair flowing down her back, and one high side ponytail sweeping to the right. Her eyes are large vivid emerald green, with a happy open-mouth smile, light blush on both cheeks, and clean black line art. Pose her facing the viewer in a confident friendly stance: her left hand raised beside her face making a V peace sign, her right hand resting on her hip, shoulders slightly angled. Dress her in a Japanese school uniform: a fitted royal blue blazer with exactly 5 visible gold hexagonal buttons total, counted as 2 on the raised left sleeve cuff, 1 on the front center of the blazer, and 2 on the right sleeve cuff; underneath include a white collared shirt, tan sweater vest with ribbed V-neck trim, a purple necktie with diagonal gold stripes, and a green pleated skirt visible at the bottom. Add a distinctive red chemical-structure hair accessory above the side ponytail: a thin red stem from the hair leading to two connected hexagonal molecular rings with small glowing red node dots, plus the red letters “NH” on the right side. Use crisp cel-shaded anime rendering with smooth gradients, glossy highlights in hair and eyes, subtle fabric folds, accurate hands, and a clean high-resolution square composition centered on the character. No extra background elements, no watermark, no additional text except the “NH” on the hair ornament.
2117903200341231890.promptZh: 创作一幅精致的动漫风格半身肖像画，描绘一位面带笑容的日本女学生角色，背景为纯黑色。她拥有一头极长、明亮的金发，刘海厚实且呈多层剪裁，长发自然垂落于背后，右侧扎起一个高侧马尾并朝右方飘扬。她的眼睛大而生动，呈鲜翠绿色（emerald green），嘴角上扬露出开心的露齿微笑，双颊泛起淡淡红晕，线条干净利落，采用纯黑线稿（black line art）。人物正面朝向观者，姿态自信友善：左手举至脸旁，比出“V”字和平手势；右手叉腰；双肩略呈倾斜角度。她身穿日式校服：一件合身的皇家蓝色（royal blue）西装外套，外套上共可见5枚金色六边形纽扣（gold hexagonal buttons）——其中2枚位于左袖口（raised left sleeve cuff）向上翻折处，1枚位于外套前襟正中央，另2枚位于右袖口翻折处；内搭一件白色有领衬衫、一件米色针织背心（tan sweater vest），背心带有罗纹V字领饰边（ribbed V-neck trim）；一条紫色领带（purple necktie），其上印有斜向金色条纹（diagonal gold stripes）；下身是一条绿色百褶裙（green pleated skirt），裙摆清晰可见。在侧马尾上方佩戴一枚醒目的红色化学结构造型发饰：一根纤细的红色茎状结构从发间延伸而出，连接两个彼此相连的六边形分子环，环上点缀若干微小的发光红色节点（glowing red node dots）；右侧附有红色字母“NH”。整体采用清晰锐利的赛璐珞着色（cel-shaded）动漫渲染风格，搭配柔和渐变（smooth gradients）、发丝与眼眸上的高光（glossy highlights）、布料细微褶皱（subtle fabric folds）、精准刻画的手部（accurate hands），以及构图居中、干净利落、高分辨率（high-resolution）的正方形画面（square composition）。背景不得添加任何额外元素，不可加水印，除发饰上的 “NH” 外，画面中不得出现其他文字。
