2117903200341231891.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vertical 3-by-3 tutorial-style progression sheet showing the same young woman’s portrait being developed from a faint construction drawing into a polished realistic graphite pencil sketch on clean white drawing paper.

Canvas: Portrait-oriented white paper background, 4:5 aspect ratio, divided into exactly 9 equal rectangular panels arranged in a 3 columns x 3 rows grid. The grid divisions are very subtle, created by slight tonal differences in the paper rather than visible borders.

Subject: The same front-facing young woman appears centered in every panel from the shoulders up. She has dark brown hair rendered in graphite, thick softly arched eyebrows, almond-shaped light eyes, a straight delicate nose, full lips with a faint closed-mouth smile, an oval face, and a calm elegant expression. Her hairstyle is a voluminous loose updo with wispy curled strands falling beside both cheeks. She wears dangling earrings and an off-shoulder dark dress or neckline that forms a soft V shape across the bottom of the portrait.

Panel count and progression: Include exactly 9 portrait panels. Panel 1, top left: extremely faint initial construction sketch with an oval head, centerline, horizontal facial guide lines, rough neck, shoulders, and hair mass. Panel 2, top center: light clean line art with facial features, hair outline, earrings, shoulders, and neckline established. Panel 3, top right: early shaded portrait with more developed eyes, lips, hair texture, earrings, and dark neckline beginning. Panel 4, middle left: stronger graphite rendering, fuller hair shading, clearer facial planes, eyes, lips, shoulders, and dress. Panel 5, middle center: refined realistic portrait with balanced midtone shading, detailed hair strands, defined earrings, and darker neckline. Panel 6, middle right: nearly finished portrait with high contrast hair, smooth skin shading, detailed eyes, and darker clothing. Panel 7, bottom left: finished graphite portrait with polished face and hair, strong neckline shadow, and soft shoulder shading. Panel 8, bottom center: finished portrait variant with slightly smoother lighting and crisp facial detail. Panel 9, bottom right: final polished portrait, high realism, clean graphite values, detailed hair, earrings, expressive eyes, soft skin transitions, and dark off-shoulder garment.

Visual style: Extremely realistic traditional graphite pencil drawing, monochrome black-and-white, visible pencil grain, delicate crosshatching and smudged blending, soft eraser highlights, clean white drawing paper texture. The top-left panel should be very pale and sketchy, and each subsequent panel should gradually increase in contrast, detail, and realism until the final bottom-right portrait looks complete.

Constraints: Keep the woman’s identity, proportions, pose, expression, hairstyle, jewelry, and clothing consistent across all 9 panels. No text labels, no watermark, no colored ink, no digital UI elements, no extra objects, and no background scenery.

2117903200341231892.promptEn: Create a dramatic monochrome fantasy illustration of Orthrus, a massive two-headed hellhound charging straight toward the viewer through a dense ancient forest. The creature has exactly 2 snarling canine heads: the left head faces forward with jaws wide open, long fangs exposed, tongue visible, ears raised and spiked fur bristling; the right head is slightly behind and turned to the right, also roaring with sharp teeth bared. Give the beast a muscular wolf-like body, thick shaggy black-gray fur, huge clawed front paws lunging over fallen logs, a curling tail visible on the left, and heavy metal collars, rings, and chain links around both necks. Set the scene in a chaotic woodland with tall tree trunks, tangled branches, leaf litter, splintered deadwood, rocks, and dust or debris kicked up under its paws. Use an intense low frontal perspective, close crop, dynamic motion, and a sense of imminent attack. Render in gritty black-and-white ink, charcoal, and graphite crosshatching, with dense scratchy linework, high contrast, rough paper texture, expressive dark shadows, no color, no text, no border, no watermark. Emphasize ferocity, mythological horror, and hand-drawn dark fantasy concept art in a square composition.
2117903200341231892.promptZh: 创作一幅戏剧性的单色奇幻插画，描绘地狱双头犬俄耳图斯（Orthrus）：一只体型庞大的双头地狱猎犬，正径直冲向观者，穿行于茂密的远古森林之中。该生物恰好拥有两个咆哮的犬类头颅：左侧头颅正面向前，巨口大张，露出细长的獠牙，舌头清晰可见，双耳竖立，尖刺般的毛发根根竖起；右侧头颅略靠后方，朝右偏转，同样在怒吼，锋利的牙齿完全暴露。赋予这头巨兽一副肌肉虬结、形似狼的躯体，覆盖浓密蓬乱的黑灰色毛发；它那硕大的带爪前肢正奋力跃过倒伏的树干；左后方可见一条卷曲的尾巴；两只脖颈上均套有沉重的金属项圈、圆环与锁链节段。场景设定于一片混乱的林地：高耸的树干、盘绕交错的枝杈、层层叠叠的落叶、碎裂的枯木、嶙峋的岩石，以及被它奔踏激起的尘土或碎屑。采用强烈而低矮的正面视角（low frontal perspective），画面紧密裁切（close crop），呈现动态运动感（dynamic motion），并营造出迫在眉睫的攻击态势（imminent attack）。以粗粝的黑白墨线、炭笔与铅笔交叉排线（crosshatching）进行绘制，线条密集而刮擦感强烈（scratchy linework），高对比度（high contrast），纸面肌理粗糙（rough paper texture），阴影表现富于表现力且深重（expressive dark shadows），无任何色彩、无文字、无边框、无水印。着重强调凶暴感、神话式恐怖（mythological horror）与手绘风格的暗黑奇幻概念艺术（hand-drawn dark fantasy concept art），采用正方形构图（square composition）。

2117903200341231893.promptEn: Create a dreamy vertical storybook illustration in the style of reverse-painted stained glass, with translucent layered color, fine gold filigree outlines, soft watercolor texture, and luminous reflections. The scene shows a sleepy round hamster waking up in a deep quilted cream bed beside a tall old window on a rainy morning; the hamster has tan-and-white fur, tiny paws on the blanket, rosy nose, glossy black eyes, and is winking sleepily. Outside the rain-streaked window is a misty blue-gray European gothic city with steep rooftops, towers, warm yellow lit windows, fog, and storm clouds. Inside the room, use a cozy celestial theme: a puffy cream comforter embroidered with gold stars and crescent moons, blue patchwork accents, a small plush sheep tucked beside the hamster, and warm lamplike highlights contrasting with the cold rainy exterior. Include exactly 3 translucent glass fish floating in the air near the window: 1 large fish to the right of center, 1 small fish lower left, and 1 tiny fish beneath the large fish. Include exactly 5 small floating glass bubbles and exactly 1 glowing glass star between the fish. Add exactly 2 crystal globes: 1 large hanging bauble on the left containing delicate golden branches, and 1 tabletop globe on the right containing a crescent moon and stars. Add exactly 1 dangling crescent-moon crystal ornament chain on the upper right. Add delicate white flowers in a vase on the right windowsill and dark leafy plants blurred in the lower-left foreground. The palette should be misty powder blue, pearl cream, muted gold, and soft warm amber; lighting should feel like quiet rainy dawn, cozy and magical. Use a vertical 2:3 composition, highly detailed, sparkling glass highlights, soft depth of field, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341231893.promptZh: 创作一幅梦幻般的竖版童话书插画，风格为反向绘制的彩色玻璃（reverse-painted stained glass），具有半透明分层色彩、精细的金色细丝纹样（filigree）轮廓、柔和的水彩质感（watercolor texture）以及明亮的反射光（luminous reflections）。画面描绘一只圆滚滚的仓鼠在雨天清晨于厚实绗缝的米色床铺上惺忪醒来，床铺紧邻一扇高大的老式窗户；仓鼠毛色为棕白相间，小爪子搭在被子上，鼻尖粉嫩，双眼乌黑发亮，正慵懒地眨着眼。窗外是雨痕斑驳的玻璃窗，映出雾气弥漫的蓝灰色欧洲哥特式城市：陡峭的屋顶、高耸的塔楼、透出暖黄色灯光的窗格、薄雾与雷雨云。室内采用温馨的星空主题：蓬松的米色被子上以金线绣有星星与新月图案，点缀蓝布拼贴细节；一只毛绒小羊安静地依偎在仓鼠身侧；暖色调如台灯般的高光与窗外阴冷的雨景形成对比。在窗边空中精确布置3条半透明玻璃鱼：1条较大的鱼位于画面中心偏右，1条较小的鱼位于左下角，1条极小的鱼悬于大鱼正下方。精确添加5个漂浮的小型玻璃气泡，以及1颗发光的玻璃星，位置介于各鱼之间。精确添加2颗水晶球：1颗大型悬挂饰球位于左侧，内含精致的金色枝杈；1颗桌面摆设球位于右侧，内含新月与群星。精确添加1串新月形水晶挂饰链，悬挂于右上方。右侧窗台上摆放一只插有纤细白色花朵的花瓶；左下前景处为虚化的深色叶状植物。整体配色应为雾感淡粉蓝色（misty powder blue）、珠光米白（pearl cream）、低饱和度金色（muted gold）与柔暖琥珀色（soft warm amber）；光影氛围需呈现静谧雨晨之感，温馨而富有魔法气息。采用竖版2:3构图，高度细致，玻璃高光闪烁，景深（depth of field）柔和，无文字，无水印。

2117903200341231894.promptEn:
Goal: Create a dark futuristic Chinese workflow infographic slide showing how to turn written content plus images into an advanced editable PPT, with a premium tech presentation aesthetic.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal slide, deep navy/black background with subtle circuit-line texture, thin glowing border, cyan and gold neon accents, soft bloom highlights, clean corporate SaaS style.

Main headline: Centered at the top, use 文稿 + 配图 → 高级可编辑PPT. Highlight “文稿” in gold, “配图” in cyan, and the rest in white. Add a small cyan lens flare under the headline.

Top workflow layout: Place exactly 3 large rounded rectangular cards across the upper half, connected by a glowing horizontal process line and arrows that run left to right.
1. Card 1: Yellow numbered circle “1”, title “ChatGPT”, subtitle “理清文字结构”, large gold chat-bubble icon with three dots.
2. Card 2: Cyan numbered circle “2”, title “Image2”, subtitle “生成整页视觉稿”, small mock visual preview containing exactly 3 inner panels: a landscape image, a mini bar-chart/text panel, and a second landscape image.
3. Card 3: Yellow numbered circle “3”, title “GPT-6”, subtitle “拆层成可编辑PPT”, layered floating blue sheets over a gold base icon.

Central demonstration: In the lower middle-left, create one large tilted PPT slide mockup with rounded corners and glow. Slide title text: 未来城市：智能与可持续的融合. Slide subtitle: 技术创新 · 绿色发展 · 生态共生. Inside the slide, show a cinematic mountain lake landscape at sunset, plus a small inset city skyline image on the right.

Metric row inside the slide: Show exactly 3 metric items along the bottom of the slide: “35% 能源效率提升” with a clipboard icon in cyan, “60% 碳排放降低” with a shield/check icon in gold, and “2026 全面落地目标” with a globe icon in gold.

Layer conversion effect: To the right of the central slide, show the slide splitting into multiple translucent editable layers, about 7 visible stacked panels, with flowing cyan and gold data particles moving from the slide into the layers.

Editable output list: On the right side, create exactly 4 stacked rounded cards connected by thin lines to the separated layers:
1. “标题文本” with smaller text “副标题文本”, icon: large letter T.
2. “流程图节点” with smaller text “可编辑 · 可调整”, icon: flowchart nodes.
3. “图片占位符” with smaller text “替换 · 缩放 · 裁剪”, icon: image placeholder.
4. “布局与样式” with smaller text “母版 · 主题 · 动画”, icon: layout grid.

Bottom slogan: Centered near the bottom, in gold Chinese characters with dot separators, use 好看 · 能改 · 复用.

Visual style: High-resolution presentation infographic, crisp vector-like UI, luminous cyan and warm gold strokes, glassmorphism cards, subtle depth and perspective, modern Chinese typography, clean spacing, no people, no logos, no watermark. Keep all listed text legible and preserve the exact counts: 3 top workflow cards, 3 metric items, 4 editable-output cards, and 7 visible separated layer panels.

2117903200341231895.promptEn:
Create an ultra-realistic food photography collage in a 2×2 grid, showing the complete process of making fluffy American pancakes, matching the reference composition.

Top-left: A wooden kitchen table with a large white ceramic bowl filled with smooth pancake batter, surrounded by neatly arranged ingredients: a small bowl containing one raw egg, a cup of white flour, a small dish with butter, a glass jar of milk, a small bowl of baking powder, a cracked eggshell, and a metal whisk. Warm natural kitchen lighting, realistic textures, clean overhead composition.

Top-right: Close-up of a black non-stick frying pan on a stovetop. A hand wearing a beige oven glove holds a ladle and pours thick pale pancake batter into the center of the hot pan. Visible steam and tiny butter droplets around the pan. Warm wooden kitchen background, realistic cooking action.

Bottom-left: Two thick fluffy pancakes cooking in the same black skillet. One pancake is golden brown and partially cooked, while the other is being flipped with a spatula. Subtle steam rising from the pan, realistic bubbles and crispy edges, warm natural lighting.

Bottom-right: Final serving of several thick, fluffy, golden-brown American pancakes stacked beautifully on a plate, showing soft airy layers and perfectly browned surfaces. Appetizing close-up food photography, warm tones, realistic texture and subtle highlights.

Style: photorealistic, premium food photography, natural warm kitchen lighting, realistic ingredients, shallow depth of field where appropriate, detailed textures, authentic cooking atmosphere, clean 2×2 split composition, consistent cookware and ingredients across all panels, high detail, 8K, no text, no labels, no watermark.

2117903200341231896.promptEn: Create a cinematic ultra-realistic aerial wide shot of a grand medieval Gothic stone castle standing alone on a rocky hilltop in a vast natural highland landscape. The castle has weathered gray masonry, crenellated curtain walls, arched gatehouse, a stone bridge and winding dirt road leading to the entrance, red vertical banners, narrow lancet windows, steep dark slate roofs, and an inner courtyard. Include exactly 10 prominent roofed vertical structures: 5 large round curtain-wall towers with conical slate roofs around the perimeter, 4 tall corner turrets on the central keep, and 1 smaller rear spire. 为他穿着一套优雅的米色/乳白色亚麻西装，包括一件剪裁宽松的修身西装外套与高腰褶皱西裤。内搭一件黑色敞领衬衫，最上方纽扣解开，呈现精致复古风格。配一条纤细黑色皮带，搭配抛光金色扣头，以及一只经典金色表盘腕表。整体造型需保持考究、阳刚、极简，并真实还原1980年代风格。

将场景置于一条受迈阿密海滩（Miami Beach）启发的华丽林荫大道上，周围环绕高耸棕榈树、粉彩色调装饰艺术（Art Deco）建筑、户外咖啡馆、复古汽车，以及远处柔和虚化的行人。背景中置入一栋粉白相间的装饰艺术风格酒店建筑，以强化南滩（South Beach）复古氛围。

采用温暖的午后晚期阳光，人物轮廓呈现金色边缘光（golden rim lighting），阴影柔和，镜头光晕（lens flare）细腻，电影感高光（cinematic highlights）在黑色车身表面自然反射，并施以温暖怀旧的胶片色调（film color grade）。添加真实肌肤纹理、自然面部细节、清晰锐利的亚麻面料质感、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、柔和氛围焦外虚化（bokeh）、细微胶片颗粒（film grain），以及高端杂志级摄影（editorial photography）质感。

在右上角添加手写体米色文字 “1980’s”，并配以松散风格的下划线笔触。

风格：复古奢华时尚广告大片、1980年代迈阿密美学、电影感杂志摄影（cinematic editorial photography）、温暖模拟胶片观感（warm analog film look）、真实DSLR画质、50mm镜头、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、超精细刻画、自然人体比例、照片级写实（photorealistic）。

画面比例：4:5 竖构图。

2117903200341231904.promptEn: Create a photorealistic square social-media product shot of a young female streamer in a cozy gaming setup, shot with a slightly wide-angle close perspective from above desk height. She is seated in a gaming chair, leaning toward the camera with an excited open-mouth smile, holding one graded trading card slab prominently in both hands close to the lens. Her look: young woman with wavy black hair with purple streaks, freckles, nose stud, hoop earrings, choker, black cropped top and loose black off-shoulder hoodie. The graded slab should have a clear plastic case, a top label reading “NEXUS GRADE,” a large “10” grade box, a small barcode and serial number, and the card art should show a dramatic red-orange robot/monster battle card titled GIGATRON. Place exactly 5 visible trading-card/product elements: 1 graded slab in her hands, 1 unopened booster pack on the desk, 1 opened silver foil wrapper on the desk, and 2 loose cards on the desk, one dark pirate-themed card and one colorful cute creature card. The booster pack should read DOGINAL DOGS LEGENDS RISE OF THE PACK. The background is a streamer room with exactly 2 large monitors showing fantasy landscapes, 1 black boom-arm microphone with foam windscreen on the right, 1 glowing ring light partially visible in the upper right, 1 RGB keyboard, 1 gaming chair, and 1 iced pink drink with straw on the desk. Use moody purple and blue RGB lighting mixed with warm screen glow, shallow depth of field but keep the woman’s face and the graded slab sharp, realistic skin texture, authentic cluttered desk, cinematic marketing-still composition. The overall mood should feel like influencer livestream content for a collectible card game product launch. Use neon purple-blue streamer lighting with warm monitor glow and a high-detail photorealistic wide-angle smartphone-style shot. Avoid extra fingers, unreadable main labels, warped slab edges, duplicate microphones, or additional cards beyond the specified 5 product elements.
2117903200341231904.promptZh: 创建一张照片级写实（photorealistic）的方形社交媒体产品图，画面主体为一位年轻女性游戏主播，身处温馨的游戏场景中；采用略带广角（wide-angle）的近距离俯拍视角，拍摄高度略高于桌面。她坐在一把游戏椅上，身体前倾朝向镜头，露出兴奋的张嘴笑容，双手显著地捧着一枚已评级的交易卡封装板（graded trading card slab），紧贴镜头。她的形象：年轻女性，波浪状黑发带紫色挑染，雀斑，鼻环，圆环耳饰，项圈，黑色短款上衣，外搭宽松黑色露肩连帽衫。该评级封装板应为透明塑料外壳，顶部标签印有“NEXUS GRADE,”，一个醒目的“10”分级框，一个小条形码及序列号；卡面图案为一张戏剧性的红橙色机器人/怪兽对战卡，标题为 GIGATRON。画面中须精确呈现 5 个可见的交易卡/产品元素：1 枚由她双手持握的评级封装板、1 个置于桌面上的未拆封补充包、1 个置于桌面上的已拆开银色锡箔包装、2 张散放在桌面上的单卡——其中一张为暗黑海盗主题卡，另一张为色彩缤纷的可爱生物主题卡。补充包正面印有 DOGINAL DOGS LEGENDS RISE OF THE PACK。背景为一间主播房间，内含恰好 2 台显示奇幻风景的大尺寸显示器、右侧一支带泡沫防风罩的黑色悬臂式麦克风、右上方部分可见一支发光环形灯、一台 RGB 键盘、一把游戏椅，以及桌面上一杯插着吸管的粉红色冰饮。整体采用忧郁紫蓝色 RGB 灯光，混合温暖的屏幕辉光；景深（depth of field）较浅，但需确保女子面部与评级封装板清晰锐利；皮肤纹理真实自然；桌面呈现真实杂乱感；构图具备电影感营销静帧（cinematic marketing-still composition）风格。整体氛围应契合收藏类卡牌游戏新品发布的网红直播内容调性。使用霓虹紫蓝色主播灯光，搭配温暖的显示器辉光，并以高细节、照片级写实（photorealistic）、广角（wide-angle）、智能手机风格的拍摄方式呈现。避免出现多余手指、主标签无法辨识、封装板边缘畸变、重复出现的麦克风，或超出指定数量（5 个）的额外卡牌元素。

2117903200341231905.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cinematic 3x3 photo collage showing quiet everyday moments from the life of a Japanese high school girl, with pale colors, soft sunlight, and a nostalgic film-still atmosphere.

Canvas: Landscape collage, 1200x900 aspect ratio, divided into exactly 9 equal rectangular panels in a 3 columns by 3 rows grid. Use thin clean white gutters between panels. Overall look should feel like screenshots from an indie coming-of-age movie shot on 35mm film.

Subject: The recurring character is a Japanese teenage girl with long messy black hair, pale skin, delicate features, and a tired dreamy expression. She wears a simple white short-sleeve school blouse with a dark pleated skirt, white socks, and black loafers. Her mood is quiet, introspective, sleepy, and slightly melancholic, never posed like a fashion shoot.

Panel count and layout: Include exactly 9 discrete panels:
1. Top left: close-up of the girl lying in bed under white sheets in soft morning window light, only her face and messy hair visible, sleepy eyes looking toward camera.
2. Top center: wide scenic view from a hillside town overlooking a sparkling inland sea, rooftops, utility poles, distant islands and mountains under a pale blue sky.
3. Top right: side-profile medium close-up of the girl outdoors on a school rooftop or terrace, wearing a white blouse, face tilted upward into bright sunlight, wind moving her hair, blue sky behind her.
4. Middle left: downward crop of her legs walking on sunlit asphalt, dark pleated skirt hem, white socks, black loafers, long sharp shadow stretching across the road.
5. Middle center: classroom scene with the girl seated by a bright window, elbow on desk, chin resting on her hand, holding a pen over a notebook, other students blurred in the background.
6. Middle right: close-up still life on a wooden school desk: open notebook with small writing, clear mechanical pencil, black school bag, and one small white bunny plush keychain hanging from the bag.
7. Bottom left: close-up of the girl eating ramen in a casual restaurant, holding chopsticks with noodles lifted above a white bowl, warm interior bokeh lights, her eyes glancing sideways.
8. Bottom center: empty bedroom at sunset with unmade bed in the foreground, curtains, window, orange sun low outside, soft dusty golden light filling the room.
9. Bottom right: dark nighttime close-up of the girl lying in bed under blankets, face lit by a smartphone screen, looking tired and absorbed.

Visual style: pale pastel colors, low contrast, soft haze, realistic Japanese cinema photography, natural skin texture, slight film grain, gentle lens bloom, imperfect candid framing. Use shallow depth of field in character panels, natural backlight, sun flares, and subdued highlights. The overall palette should be airy whites, muted grays, washed blues, warm sunset amber, and soft shadow tones.

Constraints: Keep the same girl recognizable across all panels. Make it photorealistic, not anime or illustration. Avoid text overlays, captions, logos, watermarks, exaggerated makeup, glamour posing, or overly saturated colors. The collage should feel like a coherent diary of one ordinary day, from morning bed to school, town views, food, sunset bedroom, and late-night phone use.
2117903200341231905.author: ちょうどいいAIクリエイター

2117903200341231906.promptEn: Create a vertical cinematic portrait photo of a young East Asian woman in a romantic ancient Chinese hanfu style, sitting barefoot on a stone railing beside a lotus pond at sunset. She wears a flowing translucent pale pink silk hanfu with layered gauze sleeves, delicate floral embroidery, a soft peach-pink inner bodice, and long draping fabric pooling around her legs. Her black hair is styled loosely up with wispy bangs and small pink-and-white floral hair ornaments and ribbons. She smiles gently at the camera with a soft, dreamy expression while holding one large pink lotus flower on a long green stem in both hands. The setting is a classical Chinese garden pavilion corridor: dark wooden doorway and pillar on the right, gray stone wall and railing on the left, a pond filled with green lotus leaves and scattered blossoms behind her, distant pavilion silhouette and trees across the water. Warm golden sunset light glows low on the horizon, reflecting across the pond and backlighting the sheer fabric, creating a hazy nostalgic atmosphere. Include vertical Chinese calligraphy on the right wooden pillar reading 荷风送香气. Use an analog film look with visible grain, slight softness, warm faded colors, subtle lens flare, gentle overexposure near the sun, and a small orange film date stamp near the lower left edge reading 05 21 '99. Composition should be full-body seated, centered slightly right, portrait orientation 9:16, intimate and elegant, with no modern objects, no extra people, no watermark, and no distorted hands or feet.
2117903200341231906.promptZh: 创作一幅竖构图的电影感（cinematic）肖像照，画面主体为一位年轻东亚女性，身着浪漫风格的中国古代汉服（hanfu），赤足坐在日落时分的荷花池畔石栏上。她身穿飘逸通透的浅粉色丝绸汉服，袖子为多层薄纱材质，饰有精致花卉刺绣；内搭柔美的桃粉色紧身胸衣，长幅布料自然垂落，在她双腿周围堆叠铺展。她的黑发松散地挽起，额前垂着轻盈的碎发，头饰为小巧的粉白相间花卉发簪与丝带。她面朝镜头，嘴角微扬，神情柔和梦幻，双手捧着一朵硕大的粉红色荷花，花茎修长翠绿。背景为中国古典园林中的亭台回廊：右侧为深色木质门框与立柱，左侧为青灰色石墙与石栏，她身后是一池碧绿荷叶与零星绽放的荷花，水面上倒映着远处亭台的剪影与树影。温暖的金色夕阳低悬于地平线，余晖洒满池面，并穿透轻薄衣料形成逆光效果（backlighting），营造出朦胧怀旧的氛围。在右侧木柱上添加竖排中文书法，内容为“荷风送香气”。整体呈现模拟胶片（analog film）质感：可见胶片颗粒（grain）、轻微柔焦（softness）、暖色调褪色效果（faded colors）、细微镜头眩光（lens flare）、太阳附近区域柔和过曝（gentle overexposure），左下角边缘附一枚橙色胶片日期印章，显示“05 21 '99”。构图采用全身坐姿，人物略微偏右居中，竖版比例9:16，风格亲密而典雅；画面中不得出现任何现代物品、额外人物、水印，且双手与双脚不可畸变。

2117903200341231907.promptEn:
Goal: Create a hyper-realistic futuristic medical engineering visualization of an exploded transparent artificial human heart, presented like a premium bioengineering product render with technical callouts.

Canvas: 4:3 horizontal image, dark laboratory background, glossy black reflective floor, cinematic rim lighting, shallow depth of field, cool blue highlights and warm amber internal glow. The heart floats centered above the floor with a soft reflection beneath it.

Main subject: A transparent biomechanical anatomical heart labeled as next-generation bioengineered artificial heart. The central heart body is made of clear glass-like biocompatible polymer, with visible internal tubes, valves, microfluidic channels, circuit traces, miniature mechanical pumps, red and blue glowing vascular pathways, and amber illuminated electronic modules. Use realistic refraction, caustics, chrome screws, polished metal rings, and black carbon-fiber structural components.

Exploded layout: Show exactly 13 major separated component groups around the central heart: 1 central transparent heart chamber; 2 left outer clear curved shell; 3 left black carbon-fiber rib panel; 4 left inner transparent curved support layer; 5 upper-left aorta connector ring assembly; 6 upper central transparent aorta and vessel towers; 7 upper-right pulmonary artery connector ring assembly; 8 right-side cylindrical port and interface rings; 9 right black carbon-fiber rib panel; 10 right transparent circuit-interface module with amber glow; 11 right outer clear curved shell; 12 far-right small transparent cap/lens; 13 multiple small floating screws and bolts aligned around the exploded parts. Keep all parts suspended in precise horizontal layers, as if disassembled for inspection.

Technical annotations: Add thin white/gray leader lines and small uppercase sci-fi typography. Include exactly 7 visible callout labels: 1 “AORTA” with subtext “HIGH-FLOW / BIOCOMPATIBLE / POLYMER”; 2 “RIGHT ATRIUM” with subtext “MICRO-FLUIDIC / CHANNELS”; 3 “CARBON-FIBER RIB STRUCTURE” with subtext “ULTRA-LIGHT / HIGH-STRENGTH”; 4 “VENTRICLE” with subtext “BIO-MIMETIC / PUMP CHAMBER”; 5 “PULMONARY ARTERY” with subtext “PRESSURE REGULATING / VALVE”; 6 “BIO-CIRCUIT INTERFACE” with subtext “NEURAL SYNC / WIRELESS POWER / REAL-TIME MONITORING”; 7 “MICRO-FLUID CHANNELS” with subtext “NANO-SCALE / SELF-CLEANING / FLOW OPTIMIZATION”. Place these labels around the heart without covering key details.

Footer text: In the bottom left, small spaced lettering reads HUMANITY\nA STRONGER TOMORROW. In the bottom right, add a tiny schematic line icon and text reading BIOENGINEERING\nFOR A HEALTHIER WORLD.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed photorealistic 3D render, luxury industrial design, transparent medical device, carbon fiber texture, chrome hardware, glass refraction, glowing red and blue tubes, amber circuit light, high contrast, clean futuristic interface typography, technical diagram aesthetic, 8k quality.

Constraints: No people, no hands, no blood or gore, no cartoon styling, no messy background, no extra large titles. Keep the anatomy recognizable as a human heart while emphasizing transparent futuristic engineering.
2117903200341231907.author: 关木

2117903200341231908.promptEn: Create a clean, photorealistic product-design workspace scene showing an AI-assisted transformation from sketch to finished object. Use a wide 16:9 canvas with soft natural daylight, pastel mint-green wall, realistic shadows from window light, and a modern maker-studio aesthetic. On the left, place a sheet of rough off-white textured drawing paper standing upright on a blue gridded cutting mat, held at the top with one small strip of orange tape; the paper shows a detailed graphite construction sketch of a mushroom-shaped ceramic table lamp, including vertical and horizontal guide lines, a domed shade, a short neck, rounded bulbous base, hatch shading, and a ground shadow. In front of the sketch are exactly 2 drawing tools: one black pencil angled diagonally and one white rectangular eraser. Across the center, add a translucent futuristic UI visualization: exactly 4 semi-transparent glass panels receding from left to right, each showing the lamp evolving from rough sketch to cleaner render to simplified 3D form, with pale cyan outlines and a subtle blue glow. Add exactly 3 interface overlays: one bottom-left rounded rectangle with three horizontal slider controls, one upper-right rectangular crop/selection frame around a dome preview, and one bright blue glowing cursor arrow pointing at the lamp evolution. On the right, place the final physical glossy warm-white ceramic lamp on a rectangular speckled stone platform: a smooth hemispherical dome shade, small brass stem, softly glowing warm light under the shade, and a round bulbous base matching the sketch. Surround the scene with studio props: leafy green plants partially visible at the upper left and upper right, a white cup holding paintbrushes at the far right, a small round tray with a red-orange block in the lower right, and stacked sample boards or notebooks in the lower left. The blue cutting mat should cover the tabletop with precise grid lines, reinforcing a design-prototyping environment. No visible text, no logos, no watermark; emphasize the concept of turning a hand sketch into a finished product through transparent AI editing layers.

2117903200341231909.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cinematic anime game announcement key visual for 月蝕綺譚, featuring a cheerful young swordswoman in front of a dark lunar eclipse.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal poster, 1200x675 composition, dark navy night-sky background with high contrast red and gold accents.

Layout: Place the character on the right half, cropped from mid-thigh upward, leaning slightly forward with confident energy. Put the large vertical Japanese title on the left in metallic gold calligraphy, with a red crescent brushstroke behind it and small vertical romanization reading “LUNA OCCULTA” beside the title. Add the release line 9月19日 正式リリース予定 in gold along the lower left. In the upper center-left, show one large black solar/lunar eclipse disk with a glowing crimson corona.

Subject details: One anime swordswoman, teenage to young adult, bright smile, large brown eyes, fair skin, long black hair in a high ponytail flowing dramatically leftward, tied with a red ribbon whose two long tails stream in the wind. She wears a vivid pink short-sleeved kimono-style ninja/samurai top with black trim, a wide black obi belt tied with a small gold cord bow, black forearm guards, and a short dark underlayer visible at the hem. She grips one katana horizontally across her waist with both hands; the handle is black with subtle diamond wrapping and the blade/scabbard extends toward the lower right.

Visible counted elements: Include exactly 1 character, 1 katana, 1 red hair ribbon with 2 trailing ribbon tails, 1 eclipse, 1 red crescent brushstroke behind the title, 1 vertical title block, 1 small vertical romanization label, and 1 release-date text line. Scatter exactly 24 glowing pink petal shapes across the scene, with the largest cluster on the right side and a few drifting near the title; add exactly 8 tiny orange ember flecks for depth.

Visual style: Polished modern anime illustration, crisp linework, dramatic rim lighting, saturated pink petals, glossy black hair highlights, subtle wind motion, dark fantasy promotional poster atmosphere, clean readable typography, no watermark, no logos other than the specified text.
2117903200341231909.promptZh:
目标：为游戏《月蝕綺譚》创作一幅电影感（cinematic）动漫风格游戏发布主视觉图，画面主体为一名站在暗色月食背景前的开朗年轻剑士。

画布：宽幅16:9横向海报，构图尺寸1200×675，深海军蓝（navy）夜空背景，高对比度的红色与金色点缀。

构图：人物置于画面右半侧，从大腿中部向上裁切，身体略向前倾，姿态充满自信活力。大幅纵向日文标题置于左侧，以金属质感金色书法字体呈现，标题后衬一道红色新月状笔触，标题旁附小型纵向罗马音标注 “LUNA OCCULTA”。左下角沿边缘添加金色发行信息文字“9月19日 正式リリース予定”。画面左上偏中位置呈现一枚大型黑色日/月食圆盘，边缘环绕发光的深红日冕（crimson corona）。

主体细节：一名动漫风格剑士，年龄介于青少年至青年之间，面带明媚笑容，双眼大而明亮呈棕色，肤色白皙，长黑发高高束成马尾，发丝强烈向左飘扬，以红色发带系扎，两条细长发带尾端随风飞舞。她身着明艳粉色短袖和风忍者/武士风格上衣，配黑色镶边；腰系宽幅黑色腰带（obi），以小巧金色绳结蝴蝶结固定；前臂佩戴黑色护臂；下摆处隐约可见深色内搭短衣。她双手横握一柄武士刀（katana）于腰际，刀柄为黑色，表面带有细腻菱形缠绕纹路；刀身与刀鞘整体朝向画面右下方延伸。

可见且需精确计数的元素：严格包含1名角色、1柄武士刀（katana）、1条红色发带（含2条飘动的发带尾端）、1个日/月食天体、1道衬于标题后的红色新月状笔触、1组纵向标题区块、1个小型纵向罗马音标注、1行发行日期文字。全场景散落共24枚泛光粉色花瓣，其中最大簇集中于画面右侧，少量花瓣飘近标题区域；另添加恰好8颗微小橙色余烬光点（ember flecks），增强空间纵深感。

视觉风格：精修现代动漫插画（modern anime illustration），线条清晰锐利（crisp linework），轮廓光（rim lighting）富有戏剧张力，粉色花瓣饱和度高，黑发呈现高光质感（glossy black hair highlights），风势动态（wind motion）细腻可感，整体氛围为暗黑幻想（dark fantasy）风格宣传海报，文字排版干净易读（clean readable typography），无水印，除指定文字外不出现任何其他标志（logo）。
2117903200341231909.author: 🍺 イケハヤ@「月蝕綺譚」開発

2117903200341231910.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cinematic photorealistic architectural cutaway scene of a glass apartment building viewed through a handheld magnifying glass, with annotated floor-by-floor labels.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 image, ultra-detailed evening cityscape at sunset after rain. A waterfront modern glass building stands beside a reflective river or lake, with distant skyline, warm orange sun near the horizon, blue storm clouds, and a faint rainbow on the left.

Main composition: In the extreme foreground, a human hand holds a large round magnifying glass at the right edge. The lens dominates the center of the frame and contains sharp focus, visible rim distortion, and many raindrops on the glass. Inside the magnified circle, the front building is crisp and enlarged, revealing a transparent nine-floor cross-section with people, furniture, and warm interior lights. Outside the lens, the same building and city are slightly softer and less magnified, emphasizing the optical effect. Water reflections, wet rocks, plants, and a few small fish near the clear shallows appear along the bottom.

Building details: A tall modern steel-and-glass rectangular building on piloti columns at the waterline, with warm yellow interior lighting and transparent walls. Show exactly 9 stacked visible levels, each as a distinct room or activity scene with tiny realistic people.

Floor labels and annotations: Place thin white leader lines from the rooms to clean white text on the right side inside or beside the magnifying glass. Include exactly these 9 labeled floors, top to bottom:
1. “9F · Rooftop Garden” with subtext “Tea under string lights · Evening sky”; show people seated among plants and string lights on an open roof terrace.
2. “8F · Lounge” with subtext “Friends talking · Warm ambient lights”; show a cozy social lounge with sofas and people chatting.
3. “7F · Workshop Lab” with subtext “Careful inspection · Tools neatly arranged”; show a maker workshop with shelves, tools, and a person working at a bench.
4. “6F · Child's Room” with subtext “Story time · Toys on the floor”; show a warm kids’ room with an adult and child, toys scattered.
5. “5F · Mini Gym” with subtext “Treadmill run · Evening workout”; show exercise machines, one person running, another working out.
6. “4F · Reading Room” with subtext “Quiet notes · Bookshelves and desk lamp”; show bookshelves, desk, lamp, and a seated reader.

2117903200341231911.promptEn: Create a photorealistic retro 1980s synthwave podcast portrait of a smiling white male host in his 30s with blue eyes, short messy brown mullet hair, light stubble, and a friendly grin seated close to camera at a desk, facing forward with relaxed crossed arms. He wears a bold neon windbreaker in teal, hot pink, purple, and black geometric panels, a white T-shirt, and a black digital wristwatch. Place a large vintage silver broadcast microphone on a black boom arm centered in the foreground, with small SHURE branding visible. The background is a dim studio filled with 1980s nostalgia: a bright neon triangle sign behind him reading Thursday AI in pink cursive and cyan tube lights, a stack of exactly 4 cassette tapes on the left labeled “SYNTHWAVE”, “HITS 1984”, “MIXTAPE”, and “GOOD VIBES”, a retro boombox beneath them, and on the right an old CRT television showing a vaporwave sunset with palm trees and a blue grid horizon. Add one framed lightning-bolt poster above the TV. Use saturated magenta and cyan rim lighting, warm skin tones, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, slight dust and scratches, worn rounded photo border, high-detail studio photography, square-ish vertical crop, nostalgic vaporwave color palette, no extra people, no modern devices, no watermark.

2117903200341231912.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cinematic anime movie-style 3x3 contact sheet featuring a sweet brown-haired gothic lolita heroine in an elegant rose-filled palace interior, with each panel looking like a still frame from the same romantic fantasy film.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 image divided into exactly 9 equal rectangular panels in a 3 columns by 3 rows grid. Use thin white gutters between panels. Each panel has a delicate ornamental film-frame border with tiny rose motifs, corner flourishes, faint guide lines, and small decorative marks, like premium anime key visuals.

Character design: A young anime girl with very long wavy warm chestnut brown hair, amber-gold eyes, soft blush, and a cheerful gentle expression. She wears a burgundy and cream gothic lolita dress: cropped burgundy jacket or cardigan, ivory ruffled blouse, large red ribbon at the collar with a rose brooch, layered cream lace skirt with burgundy plaid overskirt, bows, ribbons, frills, white lace socks, and dark platform Mary Jane shoes. Add a large burgundy rose-and-ribbon hair ornament with gold chains and dangling clover-like charms. Overall palette: warm rose red, ivory cream, gold, soft brown, and glowing peach light.

Setting and mood: A luxurious cathedral-like palace hall or conservatory filled with roses, tall arched windows, chandeliers, marble floors, ornate furniture, candles, and golden sunlight. Red rose petals float through the air in every panel. Lighting is dreamy, warm, backlit, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, highly polished anime illustration quality.

Panel layout, exactly 9 shots:
1. Top-left: full-body establishing shot of the girl standing centered in a grand arched hall, dress fully visible, roses and sunlight around her.
2. Top-center: close-up front portrait, smiling brightly and reaching one hand toward the viewer, hair flowing, petals in foreground.
3. Top-right: side-profile bust shot facing right, ponytail and long hair streaming behind her against a pale city or palace skyline through the windows.
4. Middle-left: rear three-quarter shot from behind, emphasizing the volume and curls of her long hair and burgundy outfit, golden palace interior blurred behind.
5. Middle-center: seated or leaning-at-table portrait, chin resting on hand, gentle smile, books, roses, framed paintings, and candlelit decor behind her.
6. Middle-right: dynamic dancing or twirling shot, eyes happily closed, skirt flaring wide, one arm extended, petals sweeping across the frame.
7. Bottom-left: extreme close-up detail of the hair ornament: burgundy rose, satin ribbon, gold chains, and dangling charms attached to her hair.
8. Bottom-center: close-up detail of her lower legs and shoes walking on glossy marble, white socks with bows, dark platform Mary Janes, scattered rose petals reflected on the floor.
9. Bottom-right: close-up over-the-shoulder portrait, she turns back toward the viewer with a soft smile, roses and warm lights behind her.

Visual style: High-end Japanese anime illustration, movie trailer stills, delicate linework, intricate clothing detail, luminous skin, silky hair rendering, soft cinematic depth of field, warm romantic fantasy atmosphere, elegant and polished like a promotional PV storyboard.

Constraints: Keep the same character, outfit, hairstyle, and accessories consistent across all 9 panels. Do not add dialogue, captions, logos, subtitles, watermarks, or extra characters. Maintain a cohesive film-still sequence rather than nine unrelated illustrations. Use ultra-detailed, cinematic, soft-focus anime key visual.

2117903200341231913.promptEn: Create an ultra-detailed vertical anime fantasy illustration of exactly one elegant female samurai princess, unnamed, shown in dramatic side profile at extreme close range. She has long flowing pink hair, delicate green eyes, glossy lips, and an intense calm expression. She wears an extravagant layered red, black, purple, white, and gold floral kimono covered in sakura, chrysanthemum, brocade, tassels, beads, gold embroidery, lacquer ornaments, and ornate hairpins. Composition: a low-angle cinematic perspective with exactly one katana dominating the foreground, held diagonally from the bottom edge toward her hand near the upper center; the blade is mirror-polished and glowing, while the scabbard or spine is richly decorated with gold filigree, red flowers, black lacquer, and jewel-like details. Her near hand reaches toward the viewer beside the blade, with long manicured nails. Background: an impossibly ornate night festival palace city filled with golden lanterns, black-and-gold folding screens, sakura blossoms, hanging ornaments, bridges, and sparkling particles; include exactly one full moon, exactly one coiling golden dragon near the moon, exactly one white crane flying on the right, exactly one tiger motif on a folding screen at lower left, and three visible multi-tier pagoda towers. Style: high-resolution gpt-image-2 anime key visual, maximalist Japanese fantasy, luminous gold highlights, pink petals drifting, prismatic lens flares, sharp face detail, shallow depth of field on the foreground sword, hyper-intricate textures, jewel-like lighting, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341231913.promptZh: 创作一幅超精细的竖版动漫奇幻插画，画面中仅有一位优雅的女性武士公主，未命名，以极具戏剧性的侧面特写呈现，构图采用极近距离视角。她拥有长长的飘逸粉发、精致的绿色眼眸、光泽饱满的双唇，以及一种强烈而沉静的表情。她身着一件奢华繁复的多层和服，主色调为红、黑、紫、白与金色，饰有樱花、菊花、锦缎、流苏、珠串、金线刺绣、漆器饰件及华丽发簪。构图：采用低角度电影感视角（cinematic perspective），前景中仅有一把武士刀（katana）占据主导地位，刀身呈对角线方向，自画面底边斜向上延伸至她靠近画面上方中央的手部；刀刃镜面抛光并散发微光，刀鞘或刀脊则以金丝细工（filigree）、红色花朵、黑色漆器及宝石般精细的装饰元素精心装点。她靠近观者的那只手伸向画面前方、位于刀身旁，指尖修长且精心修饰。背景：一座极致繁复的夜间祭典风格宫殿都市，遍布金色灯笼、黑金配色的折叠屏风、飘落的樱花、悬挂饰物、拱桥及闪烁粒子；须包含且仅包含一轮满月、一条盘绕于满月附近的金色神龙、一只在画面右侧飞翔的白鹤、一幅位于左下角折叠屏风上的虎纹图案，以及三座清晰可见的多层宝塔。风格：高分辨率 gpt-image-2 动漫主视觉（anime key visual），极致主义日本奇幻风格（maximalist Japanese fantasy），明亮的金色高光（luminous gold highlights），粉色花瓣飘散（pink petals drifting），棱镜式镜头光晕（prismatic lens flares），面部细节锐利清晰（sharp face detail），前景武士刀区域采用浅景深（shallow depth of field），纹理极度精细（hyper-intricate textures），宝石质感布光（jewel-like lighting），画面中无文字、无水印。

2117903200341231914.promptEn:
Goal: Create an elegant anime character design sheet for a handsome rabbit gentleman, a pale silver-haired male with tall white rabbit ears, shown as a refined fantasy noble with moon-and-clock motifs.

Canvas: Wide horizontal character reference sheet, soft lavender-gray background, delicate celestial UI-frame decorations, thin white geometric lines, dangling stars, moons, clock circles, leafy botanical silhouettes, and a pastel palette of navy, ivory, lavender, silver, and muted violet.

Layout: Use exactly 3 full-body turnaround views on the left: 1 side profile facing left, 1 front view, and 1 back view. On the right, include exactly 2 large portrait panels: the upper portrait shows a calm, cool expression while holding a pocket-watch chain near his face; the lower portrait shows a shy blushing expression with one hand near his neck and one rabbit ear drooping forward. Between the full-body views and portraits, include exactly 6 vertical detail close-up panels: 1 cravat and brooch at the collar, 1 ear and earring detail, 1 pocket watch and chain detail, 1 cuff embroidery detail, 1 coat hem embroidery detail, and 1 fluffy tail plus boot detail. Add exactly 1 vertical color palette strip on the far left with 6 round swatches: deep blue, off-white, lavender, charcoal black, pale pink, and white, plus small crescent icons below it.

Subject details: The character is a slim, tall, elegant young man with very pale skin, long messy layered silver-white hair, narrow lavender-gray eyes, soft eyelashes, and long white rabbit ears with pale pink inner fur. His expression is aloof, melancholic, and beautiful. He wears a formal fantasy outfit: a dark navy long tailcoat with silver piping, asymmetrical ivory shoulder cape draped over one side, high white ruffled shirt, pale lavender cravat tied with an oval gemstone brooch, charcoal vest, fitted black trousers, white gloves, black knee-high heeled boots, decorative chains, a pocket watch, clock-face ornaments, crescent and star accents, and leaf embroidery along the cuffs and lower coat panels. The back view must show the cape, split coat tails, harness-like waist straps, and a small round white fluffy rabbit tail.

Visual style: Highly polished Japanese anime illustration, character sheet / concept art presentation, delicate linework, clean cel shading blended with soft painterly gradients, porcelain skin, intricate clothing ornamentation, elegant otome-game aesthetic, dreamy moonlit atmosphere, muted pastel lighting, crisp details in the close-up panels.

Text content: No readable title text or labels; use decorative bars and interface-like shapes only.

Constraints: Keep the image as a single cohesive character reference sheet, not a comic. Preserve the exact counts of views, portrait panels, detail panels, and color swatches. Avoid extra characters, avoid modern streetwear, avoid heavy saturated colors, and do not add watermark or logo.

2117903200341231915.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vertical museum-style fashion poster inspired by Dunhuang flying apsaras, combining a realistic mythic dancer with oversized Chinese typography.

Canvas: Tall vertical 9:16 poster, warm ivory paper background, clean negative space, no border or watermark.

Layout: Place four huge dark teal Chinese characters in bold blocky poster type: top row has exactly 2 characters, 敦煌, spanning nearly the full width; bottom row has exactly 2 characters, 飞天, oversized and partially behind/in front of the figure for a layered editorial look. Add one small slogan block at the lower left with exactly 2 short lines of dark teal Chinese text: 穿越千年的\n飞天之美。.

Subject details: A single elegant Dunhuang flying apsara dancer floats diagonally from lower left toward upper right, torso and face visible on the right side, one arm extended horizontally to the left. She has porcelain skin, serene upward gaze, red lips, delicate facial features, and ornate black hair in high double buns with gold floral hair ornaments. She wears antique gold earrings, bracelets, armlets, and a decorative necklace, plus a cropped teal-and-rust silk top and layered translucent flowing skirts.

Fabric and motion: Use exactly 3 major flowing silk ribbon groups: one teal ribbon sweeping behind the extended arm, one rust-red ribbon crossing from left to center, and one long rust-red ribbon curling down toward the bottom edge. The translucent skirt spreads across the lower left with painterly beige, teal, and terracotta textures, suggesting wind and flight.

Visual style: High-end contemporary Chinese cultural poster, cinematic realistic 3D fashion photography mixed with Dunhuang mural color palette, soft natural light, refined shadows, matte paper texture, teal typography, terracotta and jade fabrics, elegant composition, dramatic scale contrast between figure and type.

Constraints: Keep the typography legible and dominant, preserve exactly four large headline characters and one two-line small slogan, avoid extra text, avoid modern accessories, avoid cropped face, avoid cluttered background.

2117903200341231916.promptEn: Create a hyper-realistic museum-style product photograph of a single ancient terracotta ceramic vase centered on a pure black background. The vessel is tall and ovoid with a narrow foot, rounded shoulders, and a wide flared rim, made of reddish-brown weathered clay with heavy age patina, mineral deposits, chips, scratches, white abrasions, and fine cracks. Add carved ornamental decoration: one continuous geometric band around the neck just below the rim and raised swirling vine-like relief patterns on the body. The front right side has one large jagged vertical rupture exposing the hollow interior, with multiple broken clay shards still attached around the opening; the opening runs from the upper shoulder down toward the lower body and shows a warm copper-orange hammered, dimpled inner surface catching light. Use dramatic studio lighting from the upper left and subtle warm internal/reflected glow inside the broken cavity, emphasizing rough ceramic texture, fractured edges, depth, and archaeological realism. Composition is a straight-on three-quarter product view, full vase visible with slight shadow at the base, high contrast, sharp focus, ultra-detailed, no labels, no people, no extra objects, no watermark.
2117903200341231916.promptZh: 创作一幅超写实（hyper-realistic）博物馆风格的产品静物摄影，画面中央为一只古代陶土陶瓷花瓶，置于纯黑色背景之上。该器物高挑、呈卵形，底部收窄为小足，肩部圆润，口沿宽大外撇；材质为红褐色风化黏土，表面覆盖厚重的年代包浆、矿物沉积、缺损、刮痕、白色磨蚀痕迹及细微裂纹。器表饰有雕刻纹样：口沿下方颈部环绕一条连续几何纹带；器身主体浮雕凸起的卷曲藤蔓状纹饰。器物正面右方有一道大型锯齿状纵向破裂，暴露出中空内腔；破裂处边缘仍附着多片断裂陶片；裂口自上肩部向下延伸至下腹，内壁呈现温暖的铜橙色、锤打凹凸质感表面，在光线照射下熠熠生辉。采用戏剧性影棚布光（studio lighting），主光源来自左上方，并辅以柔和暖调的内部/反射辉光，照亮破损腔体内部，着重凸显粗粝陶质肌理、断裂边缘、空间纵深感与考古学真实感。构图为正向三分之四角度产品视角，整只花瓶完整入画，底部略带投影；高对比度、焦点锐利、超精细细节；画面中无标签、无人物、无额外物件、无水印。

2117903200341231917.promptEn:
Goal: Create a luxurious square Japanese travel advertisement for an autumn hot spring and gourmet tour sale, aimed at social media promotion.

Canvas: 1:1 square poster, high-resolution, rich warm autumn palette of crimson, gold, amber, cream, and deep brown. Use a premium travel-agency flyer style with layered photo collage panels, diagonal cuts, ornate Japanese paper textures, gold accents, and subtle drop shadows.

Layout: Build a dense collage with exactly 6 main photo areas: 1) upper-left large outdoor rotenburo hot spring with steaming water, natural rocks, a lantern, vivid red maple trees, a lake and mountains in the distance; 2) upper-right close-up of a lavish crab dish in a black tray with steam and side dishes; 3) mid-right close-up of marbled wagyu beef being lifted by chopsticks beside a rice bowl with chestnuts or gingko nuts; 4) lower-left cozy ryokan guest room with tatami, low table, cushions, warm lamps, shoji screens, and autumn scenery outside; 5) lower-right scenic lake and autumn mountain landscape; 6) small background food/seasonal detail panels near the top with mushrooms and vegetables. Separate the panels with clean diagonal cream or gold borders.

Central typography: Place a large cream washi-paper polygon label in the center. On it, use oversized Japanese calligraphy-style headline text reading 秋の食と温泉旅セール. Make “秋” red-to-orange gradient, “食” gold gradient, and the remaining characters dark brown. Add two decorative maple leaves around the headline. Beneath it, add smaller Japanese text: 「秋限定のごほうび旅」 with thin horizontal lines on both sides.

Offer area: Under the central label, create a deep red patterned price banner with gold trim. Show a small rounded box reading 2泊3日. Next to it, display the large price 39,800円〜 in shiny gold serif numerals with white highlights and dark shadow. Add small gold emphasis marks near the price.

Benefits and call-to-action: Below the price, add a cream rounded plaque with fork, knife, and hot spring icons, followed by text 「食事付き・温泉満喫」. At the bottom center, add a glossy red rounded button with gold outline reading 予約受付中 ＞.

Additional Japanese copy: Include exactly 5 supporting text blocks around the poster: upper-left white handwritten text 「この秋、心もおなかも満たされる。」 with a thin underline; upper-right vertical text on a cream strip 「旬を味わう、贅沢なひととき」; left vertical text over the ryokan panel 「特別な秋を、旅へ。」; lower-left small white text 「日本の美しい秋に、会いに行こう。」; lower-right white text 「行きたかったあの場所へ。」 above a simple white travel-agency logo mark and tagline 「もっと、心が動く旅を。」 plus tiny English text “TRAVEL for a richer tomorrow”.

Visual style: Photorealistic travel photography blended with polished Japanese advertising design. Emphasize steam rising from the hot spring and hot foods, glossy food textures, crisp autumn foliage, warm indoor lighting, elegant Japanese calligraphy, and premium gold-red sale graphics.

Constraints: Keep all Japanese text legible and placed as described. Use no people. Do not add extra prices, logos, QR codes, or unrelated text. Maintain a balanced luxury-tourism composition with strong central hierarchy.

2117903200341231918.promptEn: Transform the reference photograph into a delicate hand-drawn travel journal illustration while preserving the original composition, architecture, people, trees, grass, road, and overall perspective. Use a traditional colored-pencil and watercolor sketch aesthetic on warm, slightly aged cream paper. Keep the buildings recognizable but simplify them into expressive hand-drawn shapes, with visible pencil strokes, loose watercolor washes, subtle paper grain, imperfect outlines, and gentle cross-hatching. Preserve the peaceful rainy-day atmosphere, soft overcast sky, warm beige and muted buildings, fresh green lawn, scattered people walking with umbrellas, wet pavement, trees, benches, puddles, and distant cars. Use a muted vintage travel-sketch palette with natural imperfections and understated colors. Place the illustration in the lower portion of the page with generous cream-colored negative space around it. Add elegant handwritten typography above: ‘Rainy Days’, and below: — Quiet moments —. Minimal, nostalgic, artistic travel magazine aesthetic, analog photography transformed into a personal sketchbook memory, sophisticated and authentic, no photorealism.
2117903200341231918.promptZh: 将参考照片转化为一幅精致的手绘旅行日记插画，同时保留原始构图、建筑、人物、树木、草地、道路及整体透视关系。采用传统彩色铅笔与水彩速写（colored-pencil and watercolor sketch）美学风格，绘制于暖调、略带陈旧感的米色纸张（cream paper）上。建筑需保持可辨识性，但简化为富有表现力的手绘形状，呈现清晰可见的铅笔笔触（pencil strokes）、松动的水彩晕染（watercolor washes）、微妙的纸张纹理（paper grain）、不完美的轮廓线（imperfect outlines）以及轻柔的交叉排线（cross-hatching）。保留宁静的雨天氛围：柔和的阴天（soft overcast sky）、暖米色与低饱和度的建筑、鲜绿的草坪、撑伞漫步的零散行人、湿润的路面、树木、长椅、水洼及远处的汽车。使用低饱和度的复古旅行速写配色方案（muted vintage travel-sketch palette），强调自然瑕疵与含蓄色彩。插画置于页面下部区域，四周留出大量米色负空间（cream-colored negative space）。在插画上方添加优雅的手写体文字：“Rainy Days”；下方添加：“— Quiet moments —”。极简、怀旧、富艺术感的旅行杂志美学（minimal, nostalgic, artistic travel magazine aesthetic），模拟模拟摄影（analog photography）转化为个人速写本记忆（personal sketchbook memory）的效果，格调精致且真实，杜绝照片写实主义（photorealism）。

2117903200341231919.promptEn: Create a high-resolution, ultra-realistic studio composition in a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio showing exactly two subjects: one real young woman and one 3D bobblehead caricature version of the same woman standing beside her. The real woman is tall and positioned on the right, with long slightly messy dark brown wavy hair, wispy bangs, round thin-rimmed eyeglasses, a calm but mildly scolding expression, and a casual confident pose. She wears a light blue short-sleeve polo shirt with a small button placket, high-waisted loose white wide-leg pants, white socks, and white sneakers. Her left hand rests at her hip while holding a plain white baseball cap, and her right arm bends forward with her index finger pointing down toward the caricature. The caricature stands on the left at about one-third the real woman’s height, with an oversized head, tiny body, large glossy expressive eyes behind matching round glasses, the same long dark wavy hair and bangs, a cute mischievous smile, and a slightly bashful pose with both hands tucked behind her back. Dress the caricature in the same outfit: light blue polo shirt, white high-waisted pants, and white sneakers. Use a young East Asian woman with long dark brown wavy hair, wispy bangs, and round glasses, light blue, white, standing with one hand on hip holding a white cap and the other hand pointing down, and cute mischievous smile looking upward. 2117903200341231922.promptEn:
Goal: Create a clean game-asset concept sheet for a stylized conifer tree labeled TREE01, designed for conversion into a 3D model.

Canvas: Wide horizontal concept-art sheet on a plain light gray background, soft studio lighting, no environment, no decorative border. Use muted natural colors and a painterly semi-realistic fantasy game style.

Layout: Show exactly 4 tree depictions: 1 large front view on the left, 1 large side view in the center, 1 large back view on the right, and 1 smaller game-scale view near the bottom center. Add exactly 2 scale references: a vertical height ruler beside the large front tree labeled 9 m, and a gray human silhouette beside the small game view with a short vertical ruler labeled 1.8 m. Place view labels under the trees: FRONT, "SIDE", "BACK", and "GAME VIEW".

Subject details: The tree is a tall spruce or fir with a rugged straight trunk, visible gray-brown cracked bark, exposed root flares at the base, and layered drooping branch tiers. The foliage is dense but irregular, made of jagged clustered needle masses in desaturated olive green, dark pine green, and shadowed charcoal green. The silhouette is triangular and natural, with a pointed crown, asymmetric branch lengths, some bare branch sections visible near the trunk, and broad lower boughs tapering upward. The side view should look narrower with overlapping branches, while the back view should reveal similar foliage massing and trunk structure from behind. The small game view should repeat the same tree design at reduced scale, next to the human silhouette for proportion.

Typography and annotations: Put the asset code in the upper-left corner in a simple serif typeface, large and black. Use small black serif labels beneath each view. Rulers are thin dark gray vertical lines with small caps and understated measurement text.

Constraints: Keep the sheet uncluttered and orthographic, with consistent scale among the three large views. Use exactly the 4 tree depictions and 2 scale references described, avoid extra plants, rocks, UI elements, textures, logos, watermarks, or background scenery.
2117903200341231922.promptZh:
目标：为一款风格化的针叶树（标注为 TREE01）创建一张干净的游戏资产概念图，专为转换为 3D 模型而设计。

画布：宽幅横向概念图，纯浅灰色背景，柔和影棚布光（studio lighting），无环境元素，无装饰性边框。使用低饱和度的自然色系，采用富有绘画感的半写实奇幻游戏风格（painterly semi-realistic fantasy game style）。

布局：精确展示 4 幅树的图示：左侧一幅大型正视图，中央一幅大型侧视图，右侧一幅大型背视图，以及底部中央附近一幅较小尺寸的游戏比例视图。添加恰好 2 个比例参照：在大型正视图旁放置一根垂直高度标尺，标注“9 m”；在小型游戏视图旁放置一个灰色人体剪影，并在其旁配一根短垂直标尺，标注“1.8 m”。在各棵树下方放置视图标签：“FRONT”、“SIDE”、“BACK”和“GAME VIEW”。

主体细节：该树为高大的云杉或冷杉，具有粗犷笔直的树干、可见的灰褐色开裂树皮、基部外露的根盘（root flares），以及呈层叠状下垂的枝条层级。 foliage（枝叶）浓密但不规则，由锯齿状簇生针叶团块构成，颜色为去饱和的橄榄绿、深松绿及阴影中的炭黑绿。整体轮廓呈自然三角形，树冠尖锐，枝条长度不对称，靠近树干处可见部分裸露枝段，下层枝条宽阔，向上逐渐收窄。侧视图应显得更窄，枝条呈现重叠效果；背视图则需从后方展现相似的枝叶体量分布与树干结构。小型游戏视图须以缩小比例复现同一棵树的设计，并紧邻人体剪影以体现比例关系。

字体与注释：将资产代码置于左上角，使用简洁的衬线体（serif typeface），字号较大，颜色为黑色。各视图下方使用小号黑色衬线体（serif）标签。标尺为细暗灰色垂直线，带小型大写字母（small caps）及低调的测量文字。

约束条件：保持整张图版简洁、正交（orthographic），三幅大型视图之间比例一致。严格使用所描述的 4 幅树图示与 2 个比例参照，禁止添加额外植物、岩石、UI 元素、纹理、标识、水印或背景景物。

A softly intimate photorealistic lifestyle portrait of an adult East Asian woman relaxing on a light beige fabric sofa, composed in a vertical 2:3 frame. 2117903200341231956.promptEn:
Create a vertical 3:4 editorial memory poster inspired by the uploaded photograph. Divide the composition into two horizontal sections: the top 50% preserves the original photograph with its recognizable subject, identity, pose, clothing, background, natural lighting, and realistic details. Do not redraw or stylize the top section.

The bottom 50% becomes a warm, hand-drawn illustrated scrapbook inspired by the photograph. Fill it with 7–9 small illustrations representing memorable details from the original scene, including the subject’s clothing, hairstyle, accessories, surrounding plants, flowers, trees, architecture, weather, activities, and other relevant objects. Arrange the illustrations in a balanced, playful collage with varied sizes and natural spacing.

ILLUSTRATION STYLE: Hand-drawn colored-pencil and watercolor sketches, delicate ink outlines, visible pencil strokes, imperfect artistic textures, soft coloring, charming doodles, tiny hearts, stars, arrows, and hand-drawn decorative accents. Use a warm cream-colored textured paper background with a nostalgic journal aesthetic.

COLOR PALETTE: Derive colors from the original photograph. Use soft, natural tones with subtle vintage warmth, earthy colors, and gentle highlights.

TYPOGRAPHY: Add a small handwritten title at the top of the illustrated section and a short, sentimental handwritten caption near the bottom. Keep the lettering elegant, lowercase, and naturally integrated into the artwork. Generate wording inspired by the photograph rather than using fixed text.

COMPOSITION RULES:
•Strict vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.
•Top and bottom sections occupy exactly 50% each.
•A perfectly straight horizontal division between sections.
•Original photograph remains photorealistic and unchanged.
•Bottom section contains illustrations related specifically to the uploaded image.
•Maintain a cohesive, handmade travel-journal or lifestyle-scrapbook aesthetic.
•High-quality textures, intricate sketch details, harmonious spacing, and professional editorial design.

IMPORTANT: Adapt every illustration, color, and handwritten caption to the uploaded photograph. Do not reuse objects or themes from reference examples unless they are relevant to the actual image. No extra photographs, no 3D elements, no glossy digital art, and no cluttered layout.

Result: A heartwarming, personalized photo-and-illustration poster that feels like a page from a beautifully illustrated personal diary.

2117903200341231961.promptEn:
Photorealistic cinematic contact sheet in a perfect 1:1 square format, arranged as a clean 2x2 grid of four separate photographs. Thin white gutters separate the panels. Each panel is a complete, independently readable outdoor scene with a natural pose, a different outfit in every panel, and consistent photographic lighting, colour grading and film grain.

Subject: use the supplied reference image as the identity reference. Preserve the subject’s facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions and recognizable identity across all four panels. The subject may be human, alien, creature, robot or any original character; adapt anatomy, clothing and interactions naturally to the chosen design.

Setting: a beautiful natural landscape in late afternoon, with rolling green hills, a calm lake, scattered wildflowers, distant mountains and a partly cloudy sky. The mood is relaxed, spontaneous and documentary-like: an ordinary day spent outdoors, not a staged fashion campaign.

Panel 1, top left — “Morning Hike”: the subject walks along a dirt trail through tall grass, looking slightly ahead with a calm, curious expression. One hand holds a lightweight backpack strap and the other brushes aside a low branch. Natural walking posture, relaxed shoulders and believable stride. Outfit: sage-green technical jacket, dark hiking trousers, trail shoes and a small canvas backpack. Soft morning light, dew on grass, distant hills in the background. Camera at chest height, 35mm lens, eye-level composition.

Panel 2, top right — “Lakeside Pause”: the subject stands at the edge of a calm lake, facing the water in profile. One hand holds a folded map while the other rests naturally at their side. Weight is balanced evenly, feet shoulder-width apart, expression thoughtful and quietly amused. Outfit: cream cable-knit sweater, light-wash jeans, waterproof boots and a rust-coloured scarf. Gentle reflections on the lake, reeds in the foreground, mountains softened by haze. Camera at chest height, 35mm lens, natural full-body framing.

Panel 3, bottom left — “Picnic Break”: the subject sits cross-legged on a checked picnic blanket in a grassy clearing, holding a sandwich with both hands and taking a relaxed bite. A thermos, fruit and a small basket sit nearby. Shoulders relaxed, eyes bright with enjoyment, small natural smile. Outfit: mustard-yellow oversized shirt, beige trousers, canvas sneakers and a light denim jacket tied around the waist. Dappled sunlight through nearby trees, soft shadows on the blanket. Camera at seated eye level, 35mm lens, candid composition.

Panel 4, bottom right — “Sunset Walk Home”: the subject walks back along a grassy path toward the camera, carrying a folded blanket over one shoulder and a small basket in the other hand. They glance toward the horizon with a relaxed, contented expression. Natural mid-stride movement, clothing moving gently in the breeze. A stunning adult East Asian woman aged 23-25, delicate small oval face, softly narrowed jawline, round small chin, clear cold white porcelain skin, light pink blush.

Bright clear grey-blue almond eyes, natural double eyelids, fine lying silkworms, long curled lashes, light grey-brown eyebrows, slender straight nose bridge, small nose tip.

Soft full rose-pink lips, slight moist gloss, lips naturally slightly parted, expression cold and gentle, eyes quietly looking directly at the lens.

Refined harmonious facial features, retaining natural skin texture, avoiding exaggerated influencer face.

[Hairstyle - Core Focus]

Extremely dense fluffy light silver-grey linen-colored long hair, with pale champagne grey and cold silver luster.

Hair length extends to waist, top of head is fluffy, roots have natural airy feel.

Thin fluffy air bangs, some broken strands naturally cover forehead.

Long hair presents soft large arc waves, abundant volume, side long curls naturally draped over shoulders and chest.

Some silver-grey strands gently blown by breeze, a few thin long strands crossing cheeks and near lips.

Hair has clear individual strands, natural fluffiness and real weight, avoiding wig texture.

[Clothing]

Soft fine ribbed knit fabric, simple round neck, fitting natural body contour.

Clothing color is light and soft, with real knit texture and natural wrinkles.

[Person Pose]

Person faces camera frontally, body slightly tilted, shoulders relaxed.

One hand on left side of frame naturally raised, fingers gently curved, knuckles near chin and below lips, forming lazy face-resting pose.

Other hand raised next to hair, gently pinching a bundle of silver-grey long curls.

Head slightly tilted, gaze direct into lens, expression calm and gentle.

Fingers naturally slender, accurate joint structure.

[Background]

Simple modern cold blue-grey indoor space, light grey-blue walls, dark grey cabinet doors and natural shadows.

Clean background, no complex furniture or decorations.

Person centered in frame, silver-grey long curls occupying both sides of frame, background retains slight natural blur.

[Lighting & Photography]

Soft cold white side-front natural light, face bright, skin presenting clear cold white.

Silver-grey long hair illuminated by soft light, producing delicate silver-white and champagne-grey reflections.

Face retains natural light grey shadows, eyes have clear soft reflection points.

Overall low saturation cold blue-grey grading, soft contrast, slight optical soft focus, real camera grain.

Equivalent 50mm portrait lens, close-up half-body composition, eye-level height, clear face, real depth of field.

2117903200341231966.promptEn: A confident adult male stands in profile, his face framed by a neatly trimmed full beard that seamlessly fades into his sideburns and dark hair. His hair is cut short with a fade on the sides and left two to three inches long on top, styled back into a textured quiff with matte styling clay, revealing thick, straight to slightly wavy strands with natural variations and minor flyaways catching the light. He wears a pair of round, dark charcoal sunglasses and a loose-fitting warm white linen shirt paired with matching trousers. His stance is deliberately posed yet relaxed as he leans back with shifted weight and level shoulders. His left hand is casually inserted into his front trouser pocket with only the thumb slightly visible, while his right hand rests fully concealed in his opposite pocket, completing his barefoot, sophisticated summer look. He is positioned in the foreground leaning against the weathered frame of open painted wood French doors, where rough, patchy, chipped cream paint reveals dark brown wood grain beneath. He stands on large, warm terracotta sand-colored square tiles featuring subtle grout lines. Just beyond him in the midground sits a vintage wrought iron balcony railing detailed with ornate circular and scroll patterns. The deep spatial background opens up to a slightly soft but breathtaking view of a pristine, calm soft blue sea reflecting the sky, dotted with three to four anchored sailboats boasting bright white hulls and masts, all set against distant rolling coastal hills clustered with white Mediterranean-style buildings. The scene is bathed in bright, highly directional natural golden hour sunlight hitting from a 45-degree side-back angle, evoking a warm, relaxed, affluent summer evening on the coast. This single hard light source creates stunning preserved rim lighting along the left side of his face, neck, shoulder, and the deep folds of his linen shirt, while casting harsh, medium-length deep black shadows with defined edges from his body onto the open door and from the doorframe onto the tiled floor. The complementary palette balances the warm whites and terracottas against the soft blue sea and deep charcoal shadows with minimal ambient fill, maintaining a high-contrast, atmospheric mood. Shot as a realistic, tack-sharp digital editorial lifestyle photograph using a 50mm or 85mm lens at f/5.6 with a 1/500s shutter speed and ISO 100, the straight-on perspective utilizes a medium depth of field with minimal grain, featuring clean post-processing with warm golden-orange and teal color grading, enhanced clarity on the linen fibers and weathered wood textures, slightly lifted blacks, and framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.
2117903200341231966.promptZh:
一位自信的成年男性侧身而立，面部由修剪整齐的浓密胡须勾勒，胡须自然渐变融入鬓角与深色头发。他的头发两侧剪短呈渐变（fade）效果，顶部保留两至三英寸长度，用哑光造型泥向后打造富有纹理感的蓬松发型（quiff），展现出粗硬、直发至略带波浪的发丝，发质具有天然变化，少量碎发在光线下微微泛亮。他佩戴一副圆形深炭灰色太阳镜，身穿宽松暖白色亚麻衬衫，下搭同色系亚麻长裤。姿态刻意摆拍却显得松弛：身体微微后倾，重心偏移，双肩水平。左手随意插进前方裤袋，仅拇指略微露出；右手则完全藏于对侧口袋中，整体赤足，呈现精致考究的夏日造型。  
他位于前景，倚靠在一扇敞开的法式木门框上，门框为经岁月侵蚀的彩绘木材，表面奶油色油漆斑驳剥落、碎裂，露出其下深棕色木质纹理。他站立于大片暖色调赤陶色沙色方形地砖之上，砖面带有细微的填缝线。  
中景紧邻其后，是一段复古锻铁阳台栏杆，饰有繁复的圆形与卷草纹样。  
深远的空间背景展开一幅略带柔焦（soft）却令人屏息的景象：一片洁净平静的柔蓝色大海映照着天空，海面点缀着三至四艘停泊的帆船，船体与桅杆均为明亮纯白；远景是连绵起伏的海岸丘陵，其上错落分布着数座白色地中海风格建筑。  
整个场景沐浴在明亮、高度定向的自然黄金时刻（golden hour）阳光之中，光线以45度侧后方角度投射，营造出温暖、闲适、富足的滨海夏夜氛围。这一单一硬光源在他面部左侧、颈部、肩部以及亚麻衬衫深褶处形成惊艳而清晰的轮廓光（rim lighting），同时在其身体与门框上投下浓重、中等长度、边缘锐利的深黑色阴影——身体阴影落在敞开的门面上，门框阴影则投于地砖地面。  
互补色系平衡了暖白色与赤陶色，与柔蓝色海面及深炭灰阴影相映成趣；环境补光极少，整体维持高对比度、富有氛围感的情绪基调。  
本图以写实风格、锐利无比（tack-sharp）的数字杂志级生活方式摄影（editorial lifestyle photograph）方式拍摄，使用50mm或85mm镜头，光圈f/5.6，快门速度1/500秒，ISO 100；采用正面视角（straight-on perspective），景深（depth of field）适中，颗粒感极低；后期处理干净利落，采用暖金色-橙色与青绿色（teal）调色方案，强化亚麻纤维与风化木材的纹理细节，暗部轻微提亮（slightly lifted blacks），画面构图采用3:4画幅比。

2117903200341231970.promptEn: A muscular male with short textured hair and a groomed beard stands fully in frame, exuding a confident, posed demeanor with a direct gaze, neutral eyebrows, and a closed mouth. He is sharply dressed in a fitted navy blue button-down shirt, crisp white trousers secured by a brown leather belt, and brown woven leather loafers, accessorized with a men's wristwatch and beaded bracelets. Facing the camera straight on with his weight casually shifted and shoulders level, he leans against the focal point of his environment. His relaxed left hand rests naturally on a car's window sill, his fingers slightly curled inwards, while his right hand gently holds a pair of dark aviator sunglasses by the frames near his belt buckle. He interacts directly with a pristine, sage green metallic Aston Martin Vantage sports car dominating the midground, featuring a large front grille and bronze-colored alloy wheels. The deep, layered spatial environment rests on a solid slate grey tiled floor. To the left, a pristine clear glass balustrade with minimal metal structural posts overlooks the scenery, while to the right stands a weathered, light tan and grey rough stone wall, distinguished by roughly hewn rectangular blocks, irregular joints, natural stone pitting, and a patchy matte finish. Thriving green pine tree needles partially enter the top right foreground, framing a deep background of a mountainous landscape with rolling green hills and scattered white buildings. The scene captures a high-end, luxurious, yet polished European coastal lifestyle mood, saturated in a split-complementary color palette where sage green, navy blue, crisp white, and slate grey heavily dominate. Bright, single-source natural daylight diffuses softly from above, casting medium contrast and a neutral light temperature across the scene. Short, soft-edged gray shadows fall gently under the subject and the car on the slate tiles, while subtle specular highlights gleam off the Aston Martin's metallic paint and the man's forehead and nose, balanced by a gentle ambient fill. Captured as a tack-sharp, grain-free digital commercial photograph, the image mimics the sophisticated, clean visual style of GQ Magazine and luxury automotive lifestyle photography. It is shot on a 50mm lens at f/5.6 for a moderate depth of field, utilizing ISO 100 and a 1/250s shutter speed, complete with subtle post-processing color grading to enhance the sage and navy tones, crisp contrast applied to the clothing, and slightly lifted shadows for a flawlessly clean aesthetic, all perfectly framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.

2117903200341231972.promptEn: A confident young adult male sits relaxed in the right side of the frame, angled straight toward the camera while leaning slightly to his right, featuring short, gently wavy brown hair smoothly styled back to frame a neutral, unsmiling mouth and a calm, deliberately posed expression beneath classic round tortoiseshell sunglasses. He is dressed in a crisp, off-white linen t-shirt and light beige trousers, with a dark navy-blue sweater casually draped and tied over his relaxed shoulders, while his left hand rests casually on his right thigh with the index finger gently extended along the leg, catching the light on a simple gold band worn on his ring finger. His right arm rests horizontally across the car's cognac center console armrest with the hand positioned naturally just out of the bottom frame, allowing the wrist to prominently display a silver chronograph watch. He is situated inside the pristine interior of a high-end luxury vehicle, enveloped by perfectly smooth, satin-finished Cognac brown leather seats featuring perforated center details and silver metallic accents on the headrest in the upper right midground. In the left foreground, the car door panel displays cognac leather merging seamlessly with a black upper trim, cleanly divided by a vivid blue LED ambient light strip and equipped with sleek silver metallic seat adjustment buttons. A deep spatial depth pulls the eye past the interior and out the window to the top left, revealing a weathered, classic European city street scene lined with green trees, parked cars, and light beige multi-story architecture along a paved road. The sophisticated, affluent atmosphere is entirely illuminated by soft, diffused natural daylight streaming through the window from a single 90-degree side direction, a neutral-temperature light that casts short, gray shadows with soft gradual edges across the right side of the subject's face, neck, and the right-side car interior, while preserving clean, luminous highlights on the left side of his face, the smooth leather headrest, the polished silver watch, and the metallic car controls. The split-complementary color profile perfectly balances warm cognac browns against the off-white clothing and navy accents with moderate saturation and high contrast, culminating in a highly realistic digital photograph that embodies a clean, old money editorial aesthetic, captured straight-on with a 35mm lens at an f/4.0 aperture and ISO 200 for a tack-sharp, grain-free finish that holds a deep depth of field across both the subject and the distant street view, utilizing subtle post-processing color grading to enhance the warm interior and cool exterior tones, all organically framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.
2117903200341231972.promptZh: 一位自信的年轻成年男性放松地坐在画面右侧，身体正对镜头并略微向右倾斜，留着短而柔顺的棕色微卷发，向后整齐梳理，衬托出中性、不带笑容的嘴唇，以及镜片后平静而刻意摆拍的表情——他佩戴着经典的圆形玳瑁色太阳镜。他身穿一件挺括的米白色亚麻T恤和浅米色长裤，深海军蓝毛衣随意搭在放松的肩头并系好；他的左手自然搁在右大腿上，食指轻轻沿腿部伸展，指尖捕捉到光线，映亮了无名指上一枚简约的金戒指。他的右臂水平横放在汽车棕褐色中央扶手箱的扶手上，手掌自然摆放，略低于画面底部边缘，使手腕清晰展现一只银色计时码表（chronograph watch）。他身处一辆高端豪华汽车一尘不染的内饰之中，被完美平滑、丝绒质感的棕褐色皮革座椅所环绕——座椅中央带有打孔细节，头枕顶部饰有银色金属点缀，位于画面右上方中景位置。左前方为车门饰板，棕褐色皮革与黑色上部饰条无缝衔接，二者之间由一条鲜明的蓝色LED氛围灯带清晰分隔，并配有流畅的银色金属座椅调节按钮。纵深强烈的空间感引导视线穿过车内，延伸至画面左上方窗外，呈现出一条饱经风霜的经典欧洲城市街道：绿树成行，路边停着车辆，浅米色多层建筑沿铺装道路延展。整个画面弥漫着精致而富足的氛围，完全由柔和、漫射的自然日光照明——光线从单侧90度方向透过车窗倾泻而入，色温中性，于主体面部右侧、颈部及车内右侧投下短小、灰调、边缘柔和渐变的阴影，同时在面部左侧、光滑的皮革头枕、抛光银色腕表及金属车载控制面板上保留干净明亮的高光。分裂互补色（split-complementary color）配色方案精准平衡了温暖的棕褐色（cognac browns）与米白服饰及海军蓝点缀，饱和度适中、对比度高，最终成就一幅高度写实的数字摄影图像，体现洁净、老钱风（old money）杂志编辑美学；采用35mm镜头正面直拍，光圈f/4.0、ISO 200，实现锐利无比、无颗粒感的成像效果，并在整个画面——从主体到远处街景——保持深远的景深（depth of field）；通过细腻的后期调色（color grading）强化内饰暖调与室外冷调的对比，整体以3:4画幅比例自然构图。

2117903200341231973.promptEn: Ultra-photorealistic romantic night party couple photo, candid flash photography, real photograph not illustration. Create an intimate night-time couple portrait outdoors at a stylish evening party or garden event. The mood is romantic, warm, playful, affectionate, and candid, like a real disposable-camera or flash Instagram memory. A handsome young man stands behind the woman, hugging her tightly around the waist with both arms. He wears a black suit jacket or black blazer over a white shirt, elegant but slightly relaxed. He has dark curly hair, warm fair-to-olive skin, clean masculine features, and a soft affectionate expression. He kisses the woman gently on the cheek with his eyes closed, creating a natural romantic moment. The woman stands in front of him, leaning back into his embrace, smiling brightly with her eyes closed. She looks joyful, loved, and slightly shy. She has long dark glossy wavy hair falling over her shoulders, warm glowing skin, natural makeup, soft glossy lips, and delicate jewelry. She wears a black sparkly evening dress with thin straps, elegant neckline, subtle sequins or beaded texture, fitted feminine silhouette, classy and romantic. The man’s hands are visible around her waist, natural and protective, with realistic finger anatomy and believable pressure on the dress fabric. The couple should look close, affectionate, and comfortable, not stiff or posed. Lighting: direct night flash photography with warm ambient background lights. Flash should illuminate their faces and outfits, with realistic highlights on skin, hair, sequins, hands, and jewelry. Background is darker with soft orange garden lights, deep green foliage, patio chairs, warm event atmosphere, and subtle film grain. Keep the flash bright but not overexposed. Camera: realistic compact camera or phone flash photo, vertical 4:5 or 3:4 framing, slight candid imperfection, sharp faces, natural skin texture, realistic motion-free detail, subtle flash shadows behind the couple. Background: dark outdoor garden party or terrace at night, soft leafy trees, warm string lights or lantern glow, patio seating slightly blurred, intimate private event feeling. Mood: romantic cheek kiss, protective hug, elegant black evening outfits, joyful couple energy, night flash aesthetic, candid celebrity afterparty photo, warm love story. Negative prompt: low quality, cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic skin, waxy faces, generic AI faces, distorted hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, bad kiss anatomy, lips misplaced, awkward hug, stiff bodies, warped faces, uneven eyes, bad teeth, blurry faces, overexposed flash, red-eye, messy background, text, watermark, logo, cheap dress, unrealistic sequins, bad anatomy, duplicate arms, extra people
