2117903200341232280.promptEn:
Goal: Create a warm, emotional autobiographical single-page manga/illustrated essay about a kind dermatologist who has literally become an anthropomorphic toucan, combining skincare advice, gentle self-reflection, and everyday notes.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 page, off-white textured watercolor paper with thin hand-drawn panel borders, soft muted colors, delicate ink linework, Japanese slice-of-life zine aesthetic, cozy and slightly nostalgic.

Main character: An anthropomorphic toucan doctor with a large yellow-orange-and-black beak, blue-green head feathers, expressive round eye, and dark bird hands. He wears a white lab coat over a muted teal shirt in indoor scenes, and a dusty pink hoodie with a backpack in outdoor scenes. The hoodie back has a small circular emblem with Japanese writing. His mood is calm, thoughtful, humble, and kind.

Layout: Use exactly 6 main comic panels plus 1 decorative footer strip. Panel 1 is a large top panel occupying about the upper third: the toucan doctor sits at a wooden desk in a sunlit study, writing in an open notebook. Include a desk lamp, stacked books, papers pinned to the wall, leafy window, potted plant, coffee mug with a flower, and a taped Polaroid-style photo at left showing the same toucan in a pink hoodie holding a sign. Panel 2 is a small lower-left close-up of a gloved hand pointing at a small skin-chart note on a clipboard. Panel 3 is a small center panel showing the toucan in profile by a leafy window holding the flower mug, with a rounded speech/thought bubble. Panel 4 is a small lower-right notebook panel with a paperclip and pen, showing a checklist with three checked items. Panel 5 is a wide forest panel: the toucan in pink hoodie looks through binoculars among pale green trees and falling leaves, with reflective handwritten text at left. Panel 6 is a wide rooftop/city panel: the toucan sits from behind on a ledge facing a pale city skyline, with a paper airplane in the sky, plant pot, mug, small faucet or pipe, taped note at right, and speech bubble near the character. Footer strip at the very bottom contains exactly 5 small captioned icons: a microscope, a laptop computer, a camera, a coffee cup, and a handwritten thank-you note with a tiny heart.

Text content: Add Japanese handwritten captions in a soft ink style, using this text as the overall copy: 皮膚科のこと、日常のこと。ちょっとした気づきのメモ。今日も、誰かの役に立つひとつを。知識は命。わかりやすくて、ためになる。それがいちばんうれしい。肌は、正直。暮らしのサインが、ちゃんと出る。専門のこと、むずかしいこともやさしく届けたいんだよね。今日のメモ つたえる つくる つながる ぜんぶ、だいじ。いいものはちゃんと、静かに、つづいていく。流行より、本質を見たい。皮膚は、暮らしの鏡。整えることは、自分をたいせつにすること。今日も、自分にも誰かにも、やさしくね。さぁ、次はどんな話を届けようかな。ものづくりと発信で、ちょっといい明日を。研究も好き。AIも相棒。旅と自然にインプット。珈琲でリセット。Thank you! いつもありがとう。 Keep the text handwritten, slightly imperfect, and integrated naturally into the panels rather than typeset.

Style constraints: Fine pen-and-watercolor illustration, visible paper grain, soft beige shadows, muted teal/green/pink palette, cozy desk clutter, gentle sunlight, no glossy digital rendering, no harsh outlines, no photorealism. Keep the tone poetic and quietly encouraging. Use anthropomorphic toucan dermatologist as the central figure, warm reflective Japanese diary manga, muted watercolor beige, teal, dusty pink, soft green, warm ochre, and skincare wisdom, daily observations, kindness, and thoughtful creation.

2117903200341232287.promptEn: Create a cinematic photorealistic medieval fantasy scene titled Audience with the King: inside a vast Gothic throne hall, a seated king is seen from behind in the lower right foreground, facing two dignified petitioners standing before him. The two central figures are a female knight in full polished silver plate armor with ornate engravings, chainmail details, gauntlets, boots, sword at her side, and a pale white cloak, and a tall prince or nobleman wearing an immaculate white military-style ceremonial suit with gold embroidery, gold buttons, epaulettes, braided chains, belt, and a white cape. The nobleman has long dark wavy hair; the knight has blonde hair tied up. Count exactly 3 main foreground characters: the king, the armored female knight, and the white-clad nobleman. Count exactly 8 background guards or courtiers, arranged symmetrically in dark armor and formal medieval dress along both sides behind the central pair, holding spears or standing at attention. The king wears a dark navy and gold brocade robe and an ornate golden crown, seated on a black-and-gold carved throne with gilded finials and scrollwork. The hall has towering pointed arches, a bright stained-glass lancet window centered in the background, tall dark blue banners with gold heraldic crests, candlelit candelabras, smoky atmospheric light rays, marble columns, and a glossy black-and-white patterned stone floor reflecting the figures. Use dramatic backlighting from the window, warm candle highlights, deep shadows, shallow cinematic depth of field, ultra-detailed costumes, realistic fabric, metal reflections, and a solemn royal-audience mood. Composition should be vertical 4:5, eye-level from slightly behind the king, with the two petitioners centered and full body visible. No text, no watermark, no modern objects.
2117903200341232287.promptZh: 创作一幅电影感（cinematic）照片级写实（photorealistic）的中世纪奇幻场景，标题为《觐见国王》：场景位于一座宏伟的哥特式王座大厅内部，画面右下前景处，一位端坐的国王以背影示人，面朝前方两名庄重肃立的请愿者。两名居中人物分别为：一名身着全套抛光银色板甲的女骑士，甲胄饰有繁复雕纹，配有锁子甲细节、护手、战靴，腰佩长剑，披一条苍白的白色斗篷；以及一名高挑的王子或贵族，身着一袭洁净无瑕的白色军礼服式典礼正装，缀有金线刺绣、金色纽扣、肩章、编结链饰、腰带及白色披风。贵族拥有一头浓密的深色波浪长发；女骑士则为金发，束于头顶。画面中须严格包含3位主要前景人物：国王、全副武装的女骑士、身着白衣的贵族。背景中须严格包含8名卫兵或朝臣，身着深色铠甲与正式中世纪服饰，沿中央二人身后两侧对称排列，手持长矛或肃立待命。国王身披深海军蓝与金色提花长袍，头戴华美金冠，端坐于一座黑金相间的雕花王座之上，王座顶部饰有镀金尖顶与卷草纹样。大厅内耸立着高大的尖拱，背景正中是一扇明亮的彩色玻璃尖券窗，两侧悬挂高大的深蓝色旗帜，其上印有金色纹章徽记；烛台燃烛照明，光线透过烟雾形成大气光束；大理石廊柱林立；地面为光洁的黑白相间图案石砖，清晰映出人物倒影。采用来自彩窗的戏剧性逆光（dramatic backlighting）、烛光带来的暖色高光（warm candle highlights）、浓重阴影（deep shadows）、浅景深（shallow cinematic depth of field）、超精细服饰刻画（ultra-detailed costumes）、真实布料质感（realistic fabric）、金属反光（metal reflections），整体氛围庄严肃穆，呈现皇家觐见之仪典感。构图采用竖版4:5比例，视点为平视（eye-level），略位于国王后方；两名请愿者居于画面中央，全身完整可见。画面中不得出现文字、水印或任何现代物品。

2117903200341232291.promptEn: Create a highly detailed fantasy cyberpunk cityscape at night titled Neon Dream City: a romantic canal city with Venetian architecture fused with futuristic glass towers, glowing magenta and cyan lights, and a luminous full moon in a deep blue starry sky. Use a square 1:1 canvas, cinematic wide-angle view from water level, with a grand arched stone bridge covered in dense pink flowering vines crossing the center of the image. Show exactly 4 visible boats: one gondola docked at the lower left by a warmly lit arched building entrance, one small gondola near the center under the bridge, one larger foreground gondola at the lower right carrying seated silhouettes with bright cyan underglow, and one dark moored boat at the far right edge. Include exactly 5 prominent glowing jellyfish holograms or aquarium-like displays: one tall jellyfish in a tower capsule on the left skyline, one jellyfish inside a pink dome near the center-left skyline, one floating jellyfish sign high in the middle distance, one large jellyfish display in the right-side arched window, and one small jellyfish display near the far right lower window. The city should contain ornate balconies, domed conservatories, spires, skyscrapers, streetlamps, tiny silhouetted pedestrians on the bridge, and pink blossoms cascading from both sides. The canal water must be calm but rippled, reflecting intense neon cyan, magenta, violet, and warm orange lights in long vertical streaks. Mood: dreamy, romantic, magical, futuristic, ultra-detailed digital painting, sharp architectural detail, volumetric moonlight, glowing mist, rich contrast, no text, no logo, no watermark.
2117903200341232291.promptZh: 创作一幅高度精细的幻想赛博朋克城市夜景，标题为《霓虹梦境城》：一座浪漫的运河城市，融合威尼斯式建筑与未来主义玻璃摩天大楼，洋溢着洋红色（magenta）和青色（cyan）光芒，并在深蓝色繁星点点的夜空中悬挂一轮明亮的满月。采用正方形 1:1 画布，以水面高度为视点的电影感广角（wide-angle）构图。画面中央是一座宏伟的拱形石桥，桥身覆盖浓密的粉红色开花藤蔓。画面中须精确呈现 4 艘可见船只：一艘贡多拉船停靠于左下角一座暖光照明的拱形建筑入口旁；一艘小型贡多拉船位于画面中央、拱桥正下方；一艘较大的前景贡多拉船位于右下角，船上有数个坐姿剪影人物，船底散发明亮青色（cyan）辉光；一艘深色系泊船位于画面最右侧边缘。须精确呈现 5 个醒目发光水母全息影像或类水族馆式展示装置：左侧天际线一座塔楼胶囊舱内有一只高大的水母；中心偏左天际线附近一座粉红色穹顶内有一只水母；中景高处悬浮一只水母标识；右侧一处拱形窗内设有一只大型水母展示装置；最右侧下方窗边设有一只小型水母展示装置。城市中应包含华丽阳台、圆顶温室、尖塔、摩天大楼、路灯、桥上微小的行人剪影，以及从画面两侧倾泻而下的粉红色花朵。运河水面须平静但泛有细微涟漪，倒映出强烈霓虹青色（cyan）、洋红色（magenta）、紫罗兰色（violet）与暖橙色（warm orange）灯光，形成纵向延伸的长条状光 streaks。氛围：梦幻、浪漫、魔幻、未来感、超精细数字绘画（ultra-detailed digital painting）、锐利的建筑细节（sharp architectural detail）、体积感月光（volumetric moonlight）、发光薄雾（glowing mist）、丰富对比度（rich contrast），无文字、无标志、无水印。

2117903200341232292.promptEn:
Use the uploaded portrait only as the identity and hairstyle reference. Accurately preserve the person’s real facial identity, face shape, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, hair volume, and natural real-life appearance. Do not copy the original clothes, background, lighting, pose, or image quality from the uploaded portrait.

Create a highly realistic cinematic double-exposure portrait in a vertical 9:16 composition. The scene is set at a golden sunset beach with a calm ocean horizon, glowing orange sunlight, soft waves, and a dreamy purple-pink sky.

The final image should have two layers of the same person. The main layer is a large transparent side-profile portrait occupying the upper and middle part of the image, facing slightly upward with a soft natural smile, elegant facial expression, realistic skin texture, and long flowing hair. The face should blend naturally into the sunset sky and ocean light, creating a poetic cinematic double-exposure effect.

The second layer shows the same person as a smaller realistic half-body portrait near the lower center of the frame, standing or sitting in front of the ocean sunset. She wears an elegant dark gray off-shoulder / strapless top with simple jewelry, natural makeup, soft glossy lips, and a calm romantic expression. The clothing should be tasteful, refined, and cinematic.

Add glowing golden particles and sparkling light dust flowing through the hair area of the large portrait, like tiny fireflies or stardust, blending into the warm sunset glow. The particles should look magical but still realistic, not cartoonish. Use soft cinematic lighting, warm golden rim light, gentle shadows, natural skin texture, high dynamic range, realistic ocean reflections, subtle film grain, premium editorial photography style.

Make the image dreamy, romantic, cinematic, elegant, and high-end. No text, no logo, no watermark, no Chinese characters, no random letters.

Negative Prompt：

watermark, logo, text, Chinese characters, random letters, low quality, blurry face, distorted face, fake skin, plastic skin, over-smoothed skin, anime, cartoon, illustration, AI-looking face, bad anatomy, deformed hands, extra fingers, duplicate face, messy composition, harsh outline, overexposure, oversaturated colors, unnatural smile, broken double exposure, bad hair detail, noisy artifacts, pixelated image.
2117903200341232292.promptZh:
仅将上传的肖像用作人物身份和发型参考。精准保留该人物真实的面部身份、脸型、面部特征、肤色、发型、发量及自然真实的生活外观。不得复制上传肖像中的原始服装、背景、布光、姿态或图像质量。

创作一幅高度写实、具有电影感的双重曝光（double-exposure）人像，采用竖构图 9:16 比例。场景设定于金色日落时分的海滩，背景为平静的海平线、泛着橙色光芒的夕阳、轻柔的波浪，以及梦幻般的紫粉色天空。

最终图像应包含同一人物的两个图层。主图层为一幅大型半透明侧脸轮廓人像，占据画面中上部区域，人物微微仰头，面带柔和自然的微笑，神情优雅，皮肤质感真实，长发飘逸流动；面部需自然融入日落天空与海面光线之中，营造出诗意的电影感双重曝光（double-exposure）效果。

第二图层为同一人物的较小尺寸写实半身人像，位于画面下部中央附近，以站立或坐姿出现在海洋日落前景中；她身着一件优雅的深灰色露肩/无肩带（off-shoulder / strapless）上衣，佩戴简约首饰，妆容自然，唇部呈现柔和光泽感，神情沉静而浪漫；服装须高雅考究，富有电影感（cinematic）。

在大型人像的发丝区域添加发光的金色微粒与闪烁的光尘，如微小萤火虫或星尘般流动，与温暖的日落辉光自然融合；这些微粒须呈现魔幻感但依然保持真实，不可卡通化。采用柔和的电影感布光（cinematic lighting）、温暖的金色轮廓光（rim light）、轻柔阴影、自然皮肤纹理、高动态范围（HDR）、真实海洋反光、细微胶片颗粒（film grain），以及高端杂志级（premium editorial photography）摄影风格。

使图像整体呈现梦幻、浪漫、电影感（cinematic）、优雅且高端的气质。不得含文字、标识、水印、中文字符或任意随机字母。

负面提示词（Negative Prompt）：

水印、标识、文字、中文字符、随机字母、低质量、面部模糊、面部扭曲、假肤质、塑料感皮肤、过度磨皮、动漫风、卡通、插画、AI感面容、解剖结构错误、手部畸形、多余手指、重复人脸、构图杂乱、生硬轮廓线、过曝、色彩过度饱和、不自然微笑、双重曝光失效、发丝细节差、噪点伪影、像素化图像。

2117903200341232293.promptZh: 主体：窗边的草莓。人物/表情：女性，自然垂落的长黑发，轻盈的刘海与细软散落的发丝，通透肌肤，自然妆容，呈现肌肤纹理与淡淡雀斑，目光柔和望向镜头，神情温婉中略带俏皮，双唇自然微启。服装/姿态：洁净的白色短袖夏季制服，轻薄衬衫面料，深蓝色丝带领结，优雅着装且裸露面积极少，姿态放松自然，单手将一颗红艳草莓送至唇边，定格于即将轻咬的瞬间。背景/光线：明亮的室内窗台，简洁纯净的背景，充满日常气息的空间，来自窗户的柔和自然光，隐约阴影，轻盈通透的夏日氛围。构图/镜头：9:16 竖幅构图，特写（close-up）半身肖像，略微偏中心构图，亲密而自然的拍摄距离，等效 85mm 人像表达，浅景深（depth of field），背景柔焦（bokeh）的摄影表达，随性抓拍感。质感/风格：柔焦胶片照片风格（soft film photo style），淡雅粉彩色调，自然色彩略带轻微色偏，低对比度，柔滑高光，细腻颗粒感，微妙晕光（halation），轻微暗角（vignetting），高清且温柔梦幻的成像效果。负面提示：低画质、手部不自然、面部扭曲、多余手指、过度皮肤修饰、强对比度、浓妆、暴露式服装、文字、标识、水印。

2117903200341232295.promptEn: Create a cinematic vertical portrait of a young boy with messy curly brown hair leaning casually against a rough, dark concrete alley wall, his hands in his pockets and one knee slightly bent. He wears black-framed glasses, a dark rolled-sleeve button-up shirt over a black T-shirt, olive cargo pants, black sneakers with white laces and side stripe, a black wristwatch, and a small silver pendant necklace. The environment is a gritty narrow urban alley with cracked textured walls, dusty ground, and warm low-angle golden light coming from the left. On the wall behind him, cast a single huge menacing shadow shaped like a wolf or werewolf with pointed ears, long snout, visible teeth, and a shaggy body, looming dramatically over the child; make the shadow soft-edged but clearly recognizable. Use dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic photography, high detail in fabric and wall texture, moody dark tones, warm highlights, subtle haze, and a suspenseful fantasy atmosphere. The boy should appear calm and confident despite the frightening shadow. Face details may be obscured or minimally visible, but keep the pose, outfit, and wolf-shadow composition clear. No text, no watermark.
2117903200341232295.promptZh: 创作一幅电影感（cinematic）的竖构图人像：一名头发蓬乱、卷曲、呈棕色的少年，随意倚靠在一条粗糙、深色的混凝土小巷墙壁上，双手插在口袋里，一只膝盖微微弯曲。他戴着黑色镜框眼镜，身穿一件深色翻袖纽扣衬衫，内搭黑色T恤，橄榄绿工装裤，黑色运动鞋配白色鞋带与侧面条纹，手腕戴一只黑色腕表，颈间挂着一枚小巧的银色吊坠项链。环境为一条粗粝狭窄的城市小巷，墙面布满裂纹且肌理丰富，地面覆有灰尘，左侧投来温暖的低角度金色光线。他身后的墙面上，投射出一个巨大而令人不安的阴影，形似狼或狼人——尖耳、长吻、利齿清晰可见、毛发蓬乱，以极具压迫感的姿态笼罩着少年；该阴影边缘需柔和但轮廓明确可辨。采用戏剧性明暗对比布光（chiaroscuro lighting）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、写实摄影风格（realistic photography），服装与墙面纹理高度精细，整体色调阴郁深沉，高光处温暖，画面略带微妙薄雾（subtle haze），营造悬疑奇幻氛围（suspenseful fantasy atmosphere）。少年神情须显得平静而自信，尽管身后有这骇人阴影。面部细节可被遮挡或仅作极简呈现，但姿态、服饰及狼形阴影的构图必须清晰明确。画面中不得出现文字，不得添加水印。

He wears a light blue linen button-up shirt with open collar and rolled sleeves, beige slim chinos, and white leather sneakers; black classic sunglasses, short neatly styled dark hair, warm medium skin tone, confident casual expression. Crisp natural leaf shadows cast on a pale wall in the background, high-key neutral palette, soft warm color grading, subtle film-like grain. Shallow depth of field, sharp subject, soft bokeh in background, balanced contrast, detailed fabric texture and skin tones, realistic reflections on sunglasses. Cinematic lifestyle fashion photography, high resolution, f/2.8, ISO 100, natural sunlight golden-hour feel, slight vignette, clean modern aesthetic.
2117903200341232296.promptZh: 照片级写实（photorealistic）杂志风格人像，一位放松的年轻男子坐在极简主义白色石阶上，沐浴在柔和的方向性阳光中；三分之三全身构图（three-quarter full-body composition），居中构图，台阶形成引导线（leading lines）。他身穿浅蓝色亚麻纽扣衬衫，衣领敞开、袖口卷至小臂，搭配米色修身斜纹棉布裤（beige slim chinos）和白色皮革运动鞋；佩戴黑色经典款太阳镜，短发、深色、打理整齐，中等暖调肤色，神情自信而随意。背景浅色墙面上投射出清晰自然的树叶阴影，高调中性配色（high-key neutral palette），柔和暖色调色（soft warm color grading），略带胶片感颗粒（subtle film-like grain）。浅景深（shallow depth of field），主体锐利，背景焦外虚化（bokeh），对比度均衡，面料纹理与肤色细节丰富，太阳镜表面呈现真实反光。电影感生活方式时尚摄影（cinematic lifestyle fashion photography），高分辨率，f/2.8，ISO 100，自然阳光黄金时刻氛围（natural sunlight golden-hour feel），轻微暗角（slight vignette），干净现代美学（clean modern aesthetic）。

2117903200341232298.promptEn: Create a highly saturated dark-pop anime fantasy illustration of a Cheshire Cat inspired cat girl perched sideways on a thick tree branch in an enchanted forest at sunset. The character has an oversized mischievous feline head with purple and orange fur markings, large pointed ears with pink-blue inner ears, one huge glowing red-orange eye open, the other eye winking, long white whiskers, and a very wide toothy grin with sharp triangular teeth. Her body is humanoid but petite, wearing a gothic black puff-sleeve dress with white ruffled trim, a small black neck bow, lace details, and glossy black platform lace-up boots. Add exactly 5 prominent outfit elements: black puff-sleeve dress, white ruffled cuffs, black neck bow, striped arm sleeve, glossy platform boots. The visible legs wear bold horizontal striped thigh-high stockings in alternating pale blue, navy, cream, and warm peach tones. One arm has a vivid striped sleeve in red, pink, cyan, orange, and yellow, ending in a fluffy white cat paw glove with a ruffled cuff and small gold button. Include one huge curling fluffy tail sweeping across the lower foreground, colored with alternating purple and orange bands. Composition: vertical portrait, dynamic low-angle view, the character leaning forward playfully from the branch with legs dangling toward the viewer; one paw rests near the boots, the enormous tail frames the bottom. Background: tangled dark tree branches, glowing golden sun behind the head creating strong rim light, and stained-glass-like multicolored foliage in teal, magenta, yellow, orange, and violet. Visual style: glossy niji anime dark pop illustration, ultra-detailed linework, dramatic backlighting, neon color grading, high contrast shadows, luminous highlights, painterly texture, whimsical but slightly sinister Alice-in-Wonderland mood. Use electric purple, orange, cyan, gold, magenta, and black. No text, no watermark, no frame, no extra characters.
2117903200341232298.promptZh: 创作一幅高饱和度的暗黑流行（dark-pop）动漫奇幻插画，描绘一只受柴郡猫启发的猫娘，侧身坐在魔法森林中一根粗壮的树枝上，时间是日落时分。角色拥有一颗比例夸张、顽皮狡黠的猫科动物头颅，毛色纹样为紫色与橙色；长有硕大的尖耳，耳内为粉蓝色；一只巨大且发着红橙色荧光的眼睛睁开，另一只眼睛则在眨眼；长而洁白的胡须；咧开一个极宽的露齿笑容，露出锋利的三角形牙齿。她的身体呈拟人化但娇小玲珑，身穿哥特风黑色泡泡袖连衣裙，配白色荷叶边饰边、小巧的黑色颈结、蕾丝细节，以及亮面黑色厚底系带靴。需明确呈现恰好5个突出的服饰元素：黑色泡泡袖连衣裙、白色荷叶边袖口、黑色颈结、条纹臂套、亮面厚底靴。可见的双腿穿着大胆的横向条纹过膝袜，颜色交替为浅蓝、深海军蓝、米白与暖桃色。其中一条手臂覆盖鲜艳条纹袖套，色序为红色、粉色、青色、橙色与黄色，末端是一只毛茸茸的白色猫爪手套，配荷叶边袖口与一枚小巧金色纽扣。画面中需包含一条巨大卷曲蓬松的尾巴，横扫至画面前景下方，以交替的紫色与橙色环带着色。构图：竖幅人像（vertical portrait），采用富有动感的低角度视角（low-angle view）；角色从树枝上俏皮前倾，双腿朝向观者自然垂落；一只猫爪搁在靴子附近，巨尾则框住画面底部。背景：盘绕交错的幽暗树杈、角色头部后方透出光芒万丈的金色夕阳，形成强烈轮廓光（rim light），以及如彩绘玻璃般斑斓的树叶，色调涵盖青绿色、洋红色、黄色、橙色与紫罗兰色。视觉风格：光泽感十足的Niji动漫暗黑流行（dark pop）插画，超精细线稿（ultra-detailed linework），戏剧性逆光（dramatic backlighting），霓虹色调分级（neon color grading），高对比度阴影（high contrast shadows），明亮发光的高光（luminous highlights），绘画质感纹理（painterly texture），兼具奇想与一丝阴森气息的《爱丽丝梦游仙境》氛围（whimsical but slightly sinister Alice-in-Wonderland mood）。配色使用电光紫、橙色、青色、金色、洋红色与黑色。不添加文字、无水印、无边框、无额外人物。

2117903200341232299.promptEn: Create a hyper-realistic surreal cinematic vertical artwork of a solitary young adult man standing completely still in the exact center of an enormous infinite white room. He faces the camera frontally with a calm, unreadable expression, hands in the pockets of a long black wool overcoat layered over a black hoodie, black trousers, and black sneakers. Use a softly blurred anonymous face while keeping the pose and body realistic. Around him, gravity-defying glossy black water rises upward from the reflective floor in elegant liquid arcs and twisting splash forms, like dark ink sculpted into waves on both sides of his body, with many suspended droplets and beads frozen midair. Above him and receding deep into the background, show exactly 35 open black umbrellas floating upside-down or suspended in rows at varying depths, including one very large umbrella centered above his head, with curved J handles visible; the umbrellas create a tunnel-like perspective. Heavy rain falls vertically throughout the scene from ceiling to floor, streaking across the frame. The environment is minimalist and monochrome: bright white luminous walls, glossy mirror-like floor, faint vertical light panels along the sides, deep perspective vanishing point behind the subject, and strong reflections of the man, umbrellas, raindrops, and black water on the wet floor. Visual style: ultra-realistic, high-detail, surreal fashion editorial, dark cinematic mood, cool gray-white lighting, sharp central subject, slight depth-of-field blur on distant umbrellas and foreground splashes, dramatic contrast between black clothing/liquid and the white room. Composition: vertical 3:4 portrait, centered symmetry, full-body view, low-to-mid camera height, no text, no logos, no watermark.
2117903200341232299.promptZh:
创作一幅超写实（hyper-realistic）的超现实主义电影感（surreal cinematic）竖构图艺术作品：一名孤独的年轻成年男性完全静止地立于一间巨大无限延展的纯白房间正中央。他正面直视镜头，神情平静而难以解读；身穿一件长款黑色羊毛大衣，内搭黑色连帽衫，下着黑色长裤与黑色运动鞋；双手插在大衣口袋中。面部采用柔和虚化处理，呈现匿名感，但姿态与身体结构保持高度写实。  
环绕他周身，反重力的光亮黑色水体自镜面般反光的地面向上涌起，形成优雅的液态弧线与扭曲飞溅形态，宛如深色墨汁被塑造成波浪，分列其身体两侧；空中悬浮着大量凝滞于半空的水滴与水珠。  
他头顶上方及向背景深处延伸处，精确呈现35把张开的黑色雨伞——它们倒置漂浮或以不同纵深排列成行，其中一把尺寸格外巨大的雨伞正位于他头顶中央，可见弯曲的J形伞柄；这些雨伞共同构成隧道般的透视结构。  
整幅画面中，大雨自天花板垂直倾泻至地面，在画框中拉出清晰雨痕。  
环境极简且单色：明亮发光的纯白墙壁、镜面般光洁的地板、两侧隐约可见的垂直灯带、主体后方深远的透视消失点，以及湿滑地板上对男子、雨伞、雨滴与黑色水体的强烈倒影。  
视觉风格：超写实（ultra-realistic）、高细节（high-detail）、超现实时尚杂志风（surreal fashion editorial）、电影感阴郁氛围（dark cinematic mood）、冷调灰白色布光（cool gray-white lighting）、主体中心锐利清晰（sharp central subject）、远处雨伞与前景水花略带景深虚化（slight depth-of-field blur on distant umbrellas and foreground splashes）、黑色服饰/液体与纯白空间之间形成强烈对比（dramatic contrast between black clothing/liquid and the white room）。  
构图：竖版3:4人像比例、严格居中对称、全身视角、相机高度为低至中等、无文字、无标识、无水印。

2117903200341232300.promptEn: Create a breathtaking hyper-realistic cinematic digital artwork of a stylish young man sitting alone on the hood of a glossy black luxury sports car in the middle of a vast empty desert during a surreal total solar eclipse. The man is centered in the foreground, facing the camera, seated casually on the front hood with one leg crossed downward and both hands tucked in his pockets. He has short dark styled hair and wears a rugged brown suede jacket over a black turtleneck or high-neck shirt, loose black cargo pants, black leather boots, a silver chain necklace, bracelets, and subtle luxury accessories. The sports car is low, sleek, and aggressive, shown from the front three-quarter angle with a reflective black body, sharp LED headlights glowing warm amber, visible right-side wheel, dark tinted windows, and sand dust coating the lower panels. Behind him, show rolling desert dunes and distant rocky mountains under a dark golden sky. A massive black eclipsed sun hangs in the upper left background with an intense glowing orange corona, casting dramatic rim light around the subject. Add swirling rings and streams of golden sand across the sky and around the car, with exactly two large visible sand vortex arcs: one sweeping from the lower left across the middle toward the upper right, and one curling in the upper right sky. Include many small glowing ember particles and sparks floating throughout the frame, especially near the foreground and eclipse. Use a warm orange, bronze, and black color palette, high contrast, volumetric dust, cinematic depth of field, ultra-detailed textures, dramatic backlighting, realistic shadows, glossy reflections, and a vertical portrait composition. Make the scene epic, mysterious, luxurious, and apocalyptic, with no text, no logos, and no extra people.
2117903200341232300.promptZh: 创作一幅令人叹为观止的超写实（hyper-realistic）电影感（cinematic）数字艺术作品：一位时尚的年轻男子独自坐在一辆光亮黑色豪华跑车引擎盖上，身处广袤空旷沙漠的中央，背景是一场超现实的日全食（total solar eclipse）。男子居于前景正中，面朝镜头，随意坐于车头引擎盖上，一条腿向下交叉，双手插在口袋中。他留着短而有型的深色头发，身穿一件粗犷的棕色绒面革夹克，内搭黑色高领毛衣或高领衬衫，下穿宽松黑色工装裤、黑色皮靴，佩戴银色链式项链、手镯及低调奢华配饰。该跑车低矮、流畅且富有攻击性，以正面三分之四角度呈现，车身呈反光黑色，锐利LED大灯散发温暖琥珀色光芒，右侧车轮清晰可见，车窗为深色镀膜，车身下部覆盖薄层沙尘。他身后是起伏的沙漠沙丘与远处嶙峋山峦，天空呈暗金色。一枚巨大的黑色日食太阳悬于左上方背景，周围环绕炽烈发光的橙色日冕，投射出强烈的轮廓光（rim light）勾勒人物身形。天空与跑车周围加入旋转的金砂环带与金砂流，画面中须精确呈现两条大型可见沙尘涡旋弧线：一条自左下方向中段延伸至右上方，另一条盘旋于右上天空。画面中遍布大量微小发光余烬粒子与火花，尤其密集分布于前景及日食周边。采用暖橙色、青铜色与黑色为主色调，高对比度，体积感沙尘（volumetric dust），电影感景深（depth of field），超精细纹理（ultra-detailed textures），戏剧性逆光（dramatic backlighting），真实阴影（realistic shadows），光泽反射（glossy reflections），竖幅人像构图（vertical portrait composition）。整体场景需呈现恢弘、神秘、奢华与末世感，不得出现文字、标识（logos）或额外人物。

Use the uploaded portrait only as the identity reference. Strictly preserve the subject’s face shape, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, hair length, and natural hair color. Do not copy the original portrait’s clothes, background, lighting, pose, or image quality.

Create a realistic dreamy outdoor portrait on a rope swing in a lush flower garden, vertical 3:4 composition. The subject is turning back slightly while sitting on the swing, hair gently flowing in the wind, wearing a soft white flowing summer dress. 2117903200341232308.promptEn:
Use the reference image as the base for the character design and depict "professional-grade character line art setting materials used in commercial anime production sites."

Accurately maintain the character's face, hairstyle, hair color, eyes, contour, body type, silhouette, costume design, head-to-body ratio, and overall impression.

Absolutely do not break the character's identity. Do not redraw as a different character.

It is not a completed illustration. It is not concept art. It is not a poster.

The purpose is setting materials for drawing sharing intended for animators, animation directors, and in-betweeners.

The screen is a setting material layout on a white background. Arrange multiple line drawings organized as a material page.

Include the following:
- Front face
- Three-quarter face
- Profile face
- Expression variations
- Close-up of eyes
- Hair flow check
- Full body front
- Full body back
- Arm and hand shape check
- Costume details
- Shoe design
- Accessory structure

Depict the character only with clean anime line art.
Do not color. Do not use flat fills. Do not use thick painting. Do not render.

The lines should be thin, organized pencil line drawings or cleanup lines like those at Japanese TV anime production sites.
Not too rough. Do not use manga lines. Do not overdo the sketch feel.

Prioritize readability and structural understanding as setting materials for the production site.

Naturally add small handwritten notes, arrows, part instructions, simple annotations, costume structure notes, hair flow instructions, etc., within the page.

The layout has an atmosphere like Japanese anime setting material collections from the 1990s to 2000s.
Information density is high, but it is organized and easy to read. Allow natural margins as a page.

The entire page has the atmosphere of an actual scanned setting material collection. Naturally add minor paper texture, a slight print feel, copy paper feel, and scan feel.

Prioritize looking like "actual production materials" rather than a completed work of art.
2117903200341232308.promptZh:
以参考图像为基础进行角色设计，描绘“商业动画制作现场所使用的专业级角色线稿设定资料”。

精准保持角色的面部、发型、发色、眼睛、轮廓、体型、剪影、服装设计、头身比及整体印象。

绝对不可破坏角色的身份特征。不可重绘为其他角色。

这不是完成插画，不是概念图，也不是海报。

其用途是面向动画师、动画导演及中间画师的绘图共享用设定资料。

画面为白色背景上的设定资料排版，将多张线稿有组织地排列成一页资料页。

需包含以下内容：
- 正面脸
- 三分之四侧面脸
- 侧面脸
- 表情变化
- 特写（close-up）眼睛
- 发流检查
- 全身正面
- 全身背面
- 手臂与手形检查
- 服装细节
- 鞋子设计
- 配饰结构

仅以干净的动漫风格线稿（anime line art）描绘角色。  
不着色。不使用平涂填充（flat fills）。不使用厚涂（thick painting）。不渲染（render）。

线条应为纤细、规整的铅笔线稿或类似日本电视动画制作现场所用的清理线（cleanup lines）。  
不可过于粗犷。不可使用漫画风格线（manga lines）。不可过度强调草稿感（sketch feel）。

优先确保作为制作现场设定资料的可读性与结构理解性。

自然添加少量手写注释、箭头、部件说明、简易标注、服装结构笔记、发流指示等，置于页面内。

排版氛围应仿照1990年代至2000年代日本动画设定资料集（setting material collections）。  
信息密度高，但组织清晰、易于阅读。页面保留自然留白。

整页呈现真实扫描所得设定资料集的氛围。自然添加细微纸张纹理、轻微印刷感、复印纸质感及扫描感（scan feel）。

优先呈现“实际制作资料”的观感，而非完成的艺术作品。

2117903200341232309.promptEn:
Design a branded technical infographic of a [SNACK] that overlays architectural-style annotations onto a realistic product photograph or photoreal render. Place everything on a pure white studio background, with black ink linework as the primary technical language and strategic [BRAND COLOR] accents (engineer-sketch energy on premium packaging).

Layer the following annotations on top of the product:
• Labels calling out every key component
• An internal cross-section that reveals layering, structure, or internal design
• Dimensions, measurements, and product specifications
• Material callouts listing composition and quantities
• Arrows pointing to primary features and structural details
• A small schematic or sectional diagram showing mechanical / design logic
• Sustainability callouts
Set the product name in bold font inside a hand-drawn annotation box with an accent-color border, anchored in an upper corner as the title.

Style and layout rules:
• Keep the realistic product fully visible underneath all the linework
• Annotations should read as sketched, technical, and architectural
• About 70-80% black linework for primary technical lines, 20-30% [BRAND COLOR] for accent highlights
• Balanced composition with generous negative space
• Educational food-engineering tone with premium brand polish
• Drop a subtle brand logo mark in one corner

Visual style: minimal technical-illustration aesthetic, black linework with accent color over realistic imagery, precise but with a slightly hand-drawn feel.
Color palette: white background, black annotation lines and text, [BRAND COLOR] reserved for accents and key callouts only.
Output: 1080×1080, ultra-crisp, optimized for social feeds, no watermark.
2117903200341232309.promptZh:
设计一款品牌化技术信息图，展示一款 [SNACK]，在逼真产品照片或照片级渲染图上叠加建筑风格注释。所有元素置于纯白色影棚背景之上，以黑色墨线（ink linework）作为主要技术语言，并辅以战略性 [BRAND COLOR] 色点缀（体现工程师手绘能量的高端包装质感）。

在产品图像之上分层添加以下注释：
• 标注每一项关键组件的标签
• 一个内部剖视图，揭示分层结构、构造或内部设计
• 尺寸、测量值及产品规格参数
• 材料标注，列出成分组成与用量
• 箭头指向主要功能特征与结构细节
• 一幅小型示意图或剖面图，展示机械原理／设计逻辑
• 可持续性相关标注

将产品名称以粗体字置于手绘风格注释框内，该框带强调色边框，并锚定于画面左上角或右上角作为标题。

风格与版式规范：
• 确保真实产品图像在全部墨线注释之下完全可见
• 所有注释应呈现为手绘感、技术感与建筑感兼具的风格
• 主要技术线条中约 70–80% 使用黑色墨线，20–30% 使用 [BRAND COLOR] 色作为强调高亮
• 构图均衡，留有充足负空间（negative space）
• 语调兼具食品工程领域的教育性与高端品牌的精致感（premium brand polish）
• 在某一角落轻巧嵌入品牌标志（brand logo mark）

视觉风格：极简技术插画美学（minimal technical-illustration aesthetic），以黑色墨线搭配强调色覆盖于真实影像之上，精准严谨，但略带手绘质感。

色彩方案：白色背景；黑色注释线条与文字；[BRAND COLOR] 色仅用于强调色点缀与关键标注。

输出规格：1080×1080 像素，超高清锐利（ultra-crisp），专为社交平台信息流优化，无水印。

2117903200341232310.promptEn: Create a square anime illustration in a high-contrast monochrome manga style with vivid hot-pink accents. Show a mysterious young woman seated sideways on a wooden chair at a rustic counter inside a dim retro cyberpunk tea room or café. She has very long silver-white hair tied into a high ponytail that cascades behind her, pale skin, sharp bangs, and one glowing pink eye visible as she gazes to the left with a calm, aloof expression, resting her chin on one hand. Dress her in a bright hot-pink kimono-style top with wide sleeves, a light obi bow at the waist, and a long pale pleated skirt. The café background is dense with dark wooden panels, framed futuristic control screens, tiny interface diagrams, signs, cables, and a hanging lamp with a glowing pink bulb. On the counter place exactly five tea items: one large white teapot on the far left, two small teacups near it, one steaming mug in front of the character, and one small teapot or kettle on a rear shelf to the right. Surround the composition with exactly four clusters of white lilies: upper left corner, upper right corner, lower left corner, and lower right edge. Add sweeping ribbon-like pink energy trails and brush strokes crossing the image diagonally, with several white streaks and ink splatters, giving motion and magical atmosphere. Use thick black linework, sketchy crosshatching, limited palette of black, white, gray, and neon pink, detailed manga shading, dramatic lighting, slightly tilted perspective, ornate cluttered background, no readable modern watermark, no extra characters.
2117903200341232310.promptZh: 以高对比度黑白漫画（manga）风格创作一幅正方形动漫插画，搭配鲜明的亮粉红色（hot-pink）点缀。画面中，一位神秘的年轻女子侧身坐在一间昏暗复古赛博朋克（cyberpunk）茶室或咖啡馆内质朴吧台旁的木椅上。她拥有极长的银白色头发，扎成高马尾垂于身后；肤色苍白；刘海锋利；仅左眼可见，泛着粉红色微光，目光向左凝视，神情平静而疏离，下巴轻 resting 在一只手上。她身穿亮粉红色（hot-pink）和风上衣，袖子宽大；腰间系一条浅色腰带（obi）蝴蝶结；下着一条修长的浅色百褶裙。咖啡馆背景密集布满深色木饰板、镶框的未来感控制屏幕、微小界面示意图、标识牌、线缆，以及一盏悬挂式吊灯，灯泡泛出粉红色光芒。吧台上须精确摆放五件茶具：最左侧一只大型白色茶壶，其旁两小只茶杯，角色正前方一只正在冒热气的马克杯，右侧后方架子上一只小型茶壶或水壶。画面四周须环绕四簇白百合：左上角、右上角、左下角及右下边缘。添加数条如丝带般流动的粉红色能量轨迹与笔触，呈对角线贯穿画面，并穿插若干白色飞白线条与墨点飞溅效果，营造动感与魔法氛围。采用粗重黑色线稿（thick black linework）、速写式交叉排线（sketchy crosshatching）、限定调色盘（limited palette）——仅含黑、白、灰与霓虹粉（neon pink），辅以精细漫画（manga）式阴影、戏剧性布光（dramatic lighting）、略带倾斜的透视（slightly tilted perspective）、繁复华丽且杂乱的背景（ornate cluttered background），不可出现可读的现代水印（no readable modern watermark），且不得添加额外人物。

2117903200341232311.promptEn: Generate a high-aesthetic gourmet recipe graphic note poster, with the theme "[Dish Name]". [Overall Style] Fresh and healing gourmet infographic style, integrating: popular social media recipe layout, Japanese notebook feel, light hand-painted UI elements, and food magazine style. Overall visual: Warm cream background (off-white / light milk coffee), bright but not dazzling colors, vivid and tempting food colors, clean and tidy layout, suitable for vertical mobile reading. [Core Visual Structure] 1. Top Title Area - oversized font for dish name - paired with hand-drawn small icons (chili / heart / star / steam etc.) - add an appetizing slogan. 2. Main Visual Food Image - a super tempting close-up of the finished product - food is the visual center - obvious glossiness and heat - emphasize the "just out of the pot" feeling - lens has food photography quality. 3. Ingredient Preparation Module - uses card layout - shows main ingredients - each ingredient with small icon/photo - labeled quantities - neat and clear layout. 4. Preparation Steps Module - uses step numbering (1, 2, 3...) - each step includes: small step photo, short text description - arrows connecting the process - easy to understand at a glance - photos have a real cooking feel. 5. Tips Module - uses: hand-drawn note style, dashed borders, small light bulb icons. 6. Bottom Atmosphere Copy. [Visual Details] Abundant hand-drawn element embellishments, cute arrows, graffiti lines, rounded corner cards, slight paper texture, soft shadows, high information density but not cluttered. [Image Quality Requirements] High definition, high detail, extremely tempting food, suitable for social media covers, suitable for graphic notes, 4K food photography quality. [Emphasis] No AI painting feel, no low-quality illustration feel, no over-cartoonishness; should look more like: "High-quality graphic notes produced by a professional food blogger."
2117903200341232311.promptZh: 生成一张高审美的美食食谱图文笔记海报，主题为“[Dish Name]”。[Overall Style] 新鲜治愈系美食信息图风格，融合：主流社交媒体食谱排版、日式手账氛围、轻量手绘风 UI 元素、美食杂志风格。整体视觉：暖调米色背景（偏白/浅拿铁色），明亮但不刺眼的色彩，鲜活诱人的食物配色，干净整洁的版式，适配竖版手机阅读。[Core Visual Structure] 1. 顶部标题区——超大字号呈现菜品名称——搭配手绘小图标（辣椒 / 心形 / 星星 / 热气等）——添加令人食欲大开的标语。2. 主视觉食物图像——成品的特写（close-up）——食物为视觉中心——明显光泽感与热气感——强调“刚出锅”的临场感——镜头具备美食摄影（food photography）质感。3. 食材准备模块——采用卡片式布局——展示主要食材——每种食材配小图标或实拍图——标注用量——排版整齐清晰。4. 制作步骤模块——采用步骤编号（1、2、3……）——每步包含：小尺寸步骤实拍图、简短文字说明——用箭头连接流程——一目了然、易于理解——图片具有真实烹饪氛围。5. 小贴士模块——采用：手绘笔记风格、虚线边框、小灯泡图标。6. 底部氛围文案。[Visual Details] 大量手绘元素装饰，可爱箭头、涂鸦线条、圆角卡片、轻微纸张纹理、柔和阴影，信息密度高但不杂乱。[Image Quality Requirements] 高清、高细节、极度诱人的食物呈现，适合作为社交媒体封面图，适用于图文笔记场景，达 4K 美食摄影（4K food photography）品质。[Emphasis] 无 AI 绘画感、无低质插画感、不过度卡通化；整体效果应更贴近：“由专业美食博主制作的高品质图文笔记。”

2117903200341232318.promptEn: A candid street photograph of a young woman walking through a Shanghai longtang alley beneath criss-crossed overhead clotheslines, authentic daily life photography, natural candid moment. Half-body framing, slight upward angle — she tilts her head up with a bright unguarded expression as a piece of laundry grazes her shoulder. East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, slightly elongated eye corners — eyes raised with a gleam of surprised amusement, lashes catching the lane light. Straight refined nose with a delicate bridge. Skin tone fair to light beige — skin subsurface scattering visible under diffused alley light, specular micro-highlights on cheekbones and nose ridge, fine foundation powder grain perceptible. Light summer makeup, faint coral lip, mascara only, natural finish. She wears a white cotton broderie anglaise mini dress with a square neck and short puff sleeves, lightly lined and breathable. Platform espadrille sandals. A tiny pearl-clasp shoulder bag hangs delicately at her hip. Overhead: strings of neighborhood laundry hang between the upper-floor windows — faded floral shirts, children's clothes, an old striped towel — the real unfiltered domestic texture of longtang life. The narrow alley walls of dark old brick close on both sides, worn and patched. Through the thin strip of sky visible above the lane between the rooflines and the hanging laundry, the faint blurred crown of a modern residential tower breaks softly through — present as a quiet reminder of the city beyond the lane. Two or three stray hairs lifted by the upward movement and faint lane air, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical. Overcast shade-diffused summer daylight channeled down through the narrow lane, even soft illumination, no harsh shadows — the deep old bricks take on a warm amber tone. Spontaneous, mid-laugh energy, unguarded natural expression — the Shanghai girl caught between her perfect posture and a moment of pure delight. 2117903200341232318.promptZh: 一张抓拍风格的街头摄影：一位年轻女子穿行于上海弄堂小巷中，头顶是纵横交错的晾衣绳，真实呈现日常生活场景，自然、未经摆拍的瞬间。半身构图，略带仰角——她微微仰起头，神情明亮而毫无防备，一件晾晒的衣物轻轻擦过她的肩头。东亚裔年轻女性，二十岁出头。杏仁形双眼，天生双眼皮，眼尾略长；双眼向上抬起，流露惊喜与愉悦的神采，睫毛在弄堂光线中泛出微光。鼻梁挺直而精致，鼻梁纤巧。肤色为白皙至浅米色——在柔和漫射的弄堂光线下可见皮肤次表面散射（subsurface scattering），颧骨与鼻梁上呈现细腻的镜面微高光（specular micro-highlights），粉底颗粒感清晰可辨。淡雅夏日妆容，唇色为淡淡珊瑚色，仅涂睫毛膏，呈现自然妆效。身着白色棉质雕花布（broderie anglaise）迷你连衣裙，方领设计，短蓬袖，轻薄衬里，透气舒适。厚底麻底凉鞋（platform espadrille sandals）。一只小巧珍珠搭扣单肩包轻巧垂落于髋部。头顶上方：邻里衣物悬挂在二楼窗间绳索上——褪色的碎花衬衫、儿童衣物、一条旧条纹毛巾——真实、未经修饰的弄堂生活肌理。狭窄小巷两侧是深色老旧砖墙，斑驳磨损，修补痕迹明显。透过屋檐与悬挂衣物之间窄窄一道天空，远处一座现代住宅塔楼的模糊顶部轮廓若隐若现——作为弄堂之外城市存在的静默提示。两三缕发丝因抬头动作与微弱弄堂气流自然扬起，非对称、非几何化，体现真实而不加修饰的瑕疵感。阴天漫射的夏日日光经由狭窄巷道垂直倾泻而下，整体光线均匀柔和，无强烈阴影——深色老砖在光线下泛出温暖琥珀色调。即兴迸发、笑至中途的能量感，毫无防备的自然神情——这位上海女孩正介于完美体态与纯粹欢愉的瞬间之间。阴影区域带有微妙的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒（film grain），呈现摄影噪点质感，而非 CG 渲染般的平滑感。画幅比例 2:3。无水印，无文字叠加，非卡通风格，非数字绘画，非插画，非动漫风格。

She has long brown hair in a high ponytail, blowing dramatically with the motion. Her face should be obscured by a soft square blur for privacy. Use a driver golf club with a dark club head.

Layout and exact panel count: Include exactly 4 numbered action panels with small white Chinese labels in the upper-left corner of each panel: 1. 「站位准备」 showing the golfer at address position, feet apart, club head near the ball on the grass; 2. 「上杆顶点」 showing the top of the backswing, arms raised overhead, body arched, skirt and hair moving; 3. 「击球瞬间」 showing the impact moment, club sweeping through the ball, dirt and grass exploding toward the camera, strong motion blur on the club head; 4. 「收杆定格」 showing the follow-through finish, club swung around behind her, hair flying, grass and soil particles still suspended in the air.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic sports photography, cinematic high-speed shutter mixed with subtle motion blur, dramatic low-angle perspective that makes the golfer appear tall and powerful, bright midday sunlight, crisp shadows, saturated natural colors, energetic dynamic capture, shallow depth of field near the grass.

Constraints: Keep exactly 4 panels and exactly the 4 listed labels, no extra captions, no logos, no watermark, no product-ad layout, no shopping-poster styling.

姿态：端坐，一腿略向前伸，手肘 resting 在王座扶手上，手指自然放松。神情沉静而具主宰感。头部微垂，目光透过镀霜反光的高级铬合金太阳镜直视镜头。  
服饰：奢华深海军蓝长外套，层叠飘逸下摆随寒风流动；纯白高领高领针织衫；剪裁合体的冰灰色长裤；抛光黑色皮革靴，饰有霜冻金属细节。一条纤细银链，坠有一枚发光冰晶吊坠，散发柔和蓝白色能量。  
环境：王座下方为广袤冻结风暴漩涡，无垠北极云海向无限远处延展。天空中悬浮着浮冰巨碑与破碎的天界冰宫遗迹。极光波浪无声掠过大气层。  
布光：来自上方的冷冽神圣白光，叠加自冻结王座裂隙中升起的蓝色极光底光（aurora underglow）。强轮廓光（rim lighting）清晰勾勒身形边缘。太阳镜镜面与冰面呈现细腻反光。  
特效：漂浮冰屑、水晶尘埃、冻结能量粒子、缓慢飘移的极光缎带。无烟雾。无火焰。无霓虹。  
氛围：一位被遗忘的天界冰霜王朝之远古冰封帝王。寂静，孤绝，绝对掌控，永恒寒凛权威。  
超精细 8K RAW，IMAX 70mm 写实感（photorealistic），35mm 镜头，深焦（deep focus），极致锐利（extreme sharpness），无模糊，无薄雾，无 CGI 感，电影杰作级品质。

Lighting: strong natural sunlight entering through nearby classroom windows, creating authentic window-frame shadows across the wall and floor. Soft highlight rolloff, realistic skin sheen, accurate exposure, natural contrast, no HDR effect, no cinematic grading.

2117903200341232346.promptZh:
照片级写实（photorealistic）的抓拍肖像：一位年轻的东亚女性站在洁净浅灰色教室墙壁前，时间是傍晚时分的阳光下。保持自然的面部外观，包括柔和轮廓的椭圆形脸型、柔和的下颌线、真实的鼻部形态、均衡的眼部位置、细微的不对称性、真实的皮肤质感、可见的毛孔以及自然的肤色。不使用美颜滤镜、不进行修图、不添加风格化处理。

她拥有一头长及肩下的深棕近黑色头发，发量自然丰盈，带有被阳光照亮的轻盈散落发丝。佩戴一副大而圆的黑色醋酸纤维眼镜，镜片具有真实的反光效果和透明镜片光学特性。

服饰：合身的鼠灰色棉质T恤，呈现真实的布料纹理与自然褶皱；炭灰色百褶半裙；纤细的黑色腰带；一只简约的单肩包自然垂挂在一侧肩上。整体呈现休闲学生风，低调且可信。

姿态：随意站立，背部轻轻倚靠墙壁，一侧肩膀略靠近镜头，双手自然放松，头部微微向下倾斜，同时保持与镜头的直接眼神接触。姿态放松，表情平静，流露安静的自信，肢体语言自然。

环境：空旷的教室走廊或教室一角，墙面平滑中性，干扰元素极少，地面有柔和的倒影，整体氛围干净、富有学术气息。无人群，无装饰物。

光线：强烈的自然阳光从附近教室窗户射入，在墙面与地面上投下真实的窗框阴影。高光过渡柔和，皮肤光泽真实，曝光准确，对比度自然，不启用HDR效果，不采用电影感调色（cinematic grading）。

相机：专业纪实风格摄影，等效85mm镜头，平视视角，竖构图，浅景深（shallow depth of field），具备真实的光学瑕疵，轻微传感器噪点，自然的色彩科学，呈现真实的摄影质感。

构图：取景范围为上半身至大腿中部，主体略微偏离画面中心，墙面留有大量负空间，整体呈现干净极简美学，韩式校园摄影氛围，兼具抓拍感与精致感，追求极致写实，解剖结构真实，比例符合现实，光线物理特性自然，无CGI（计算机生成图像）感。

2117903200341232347.promptEn: Generate an infographic image of any food item, combining a realistic photograph or photoreal render with technical annotation overlays placed directly on top. Include: key component labels, internal cutaway or exploded-view outlines, measurements and scale markers, material callouts and quantities, arrows indicating function or flow, simple schematic or sectional diagrams where relevant. Place the food name as a title inside a hand-drawn annotation box in one corner. The real object should remain clearly visible beneath the annotations. Annotations should feel sketched, technical, and architectural. Clean composition with balanced negative space, educational museum-exhibit / engineering-manual vibe. 2117903200341232347.promptZh: 生成一张任意食物的资讯图表（infographic）图像，将逼真的照片或照片级渲染图（photoreal render）与直接叠加其上的技术注释图层相结合。使用纯黑色墨水风格的线条绘图和文字（技术绘图笔 / 建筑草图风格），背景为纯白色影棚（studio）背景。需包含：关键组成部分的标签、内部剖视图（cutaway）或爆炸图（exploded-view）轮廓线、尺寸标注与比例标尺（scale markers）、材质说明（material callouts）及用量（quantities）、指示功能或流向的箭头、在相关处添加简易示意图（schematic diagram）或剖面图（sectional diagram）。将食物名称作为标题，置于画面一角的手绘风格注释框（hand-drawn annotation box）内。真实物体须在注释图层下方清晰可见。所有注释应呈现手绘感、技术感与建筑感。构图简洁，留白均衡，整体氛围类似教育类博物馆展陈（museum-exhibit）或工程手册（engineering-manual）。仅使用纯白背景与纯黑注释线条及文字，不使用任何颜色。输出尺寸：1080×1080，超高清锐利（ultra-crisp），无水印。

2117903200341232349.promptZh: 受动漫启发的半写实风格肖像画，描绘一位时尚的年轻韩国女性：她留着一头乌黑亮泽的短发波波头，一侧耳朵后别着头发；戴着一副精致的圆形镜框眼镜；神情温柔而自信。她身穿一件 oversized 的淡紫罗兰色上衣，袖子卷至小臂；下身搭配一条飘逸的象牙白 A 字型中长裙。全身构图，姿态随意自然，站姿放松。她身后是一幅艺术感拼贴画，包含手绘的单色人物习作、松散的铅笔素描、漫画分镜、俏皮涂鸦、星星、爱心、漩涡纹样以及手写笔记，有机地散落在背景中。当代动漫时尚插画风格，融合墨水与铅笔质感，线条干净利落，辅以微妙的赛璐珞阴影（cel shading），纯白色背景，杂志封面美学（magazine-cover aesthetic），高度精细，超锐利（ultra-sharp），色彩明快又优雅，8K 杰作。

2117903200341232350.promptEn:
Goal: Create a wide cinematic aerial establishing shot of a fantastical baroque city inspired by Alice in Wonderland, with a visible camera-path guide drawn on top.
Canvas: 16:9 landscape image, high-resolution, viewed from a high oblique drone angle looking across a dense cityscape.
Scene: A sprawling whimsical city of ornate towers, bridges, canals, plazas, rooftop gardens, domes, spires, checkerboard terraces, playing-card motifs, heart emblems, keyhole-shaped gateways, teacup-like balconies, and candy-colored rooftops. The architecture should be extremely detailed, luxurious, and slightly surreal, mixing Victorian, Gothic, baroque, and fairytale styles. Include turquoise canals running between buildings and multiple elevated walkways connecting towers. Soft clouds and mist surround the edges of the city, giving a floating dreamlike atmosphere.
Key landmarks: Include exactly 5 prominent fantasy landmarks: 1) a large keyhole gate with black-and-white checkerboard plaza and heart decorations in the lower-left/mid-left area, 2) a tall churchlike spire with a heart clock facade in the upper-left area, 3) a cylindrical tower decorated with black playing-card suit symbols near the upper-middle/right area, 4) a grand round tower on the far upper-right crowned by a large red mushroom cap with white spots, 5) several turquoise canal basins and bridges through the center-left city blocks.
Camera path overlay: Draw one thick, bright red, smooth curved path line over the city. The line starts in the lower-left street/plaza area, snakes through the middle of the frame with two broad bends, then curves upward and ends at the upper-right mushroom-crown tower. The red path should look like a simple hand-drawn route guide, sitting clearly on top of the image, with rounded ends and consistent thickness. It should be the only annotation.
Visual style: Ultra-detailed fantasy concept art, cinematic lighting, realistic depth and scale, soft atmospheric haze, pastel stone buildings with teal water, pink and red accents, intricate rooftops and terraces, magical city exploration vibe.
Constraints: No people in close-up, no text labels, no UI elements, no watermark. Keep the red route line prominent and unbroken from lower-left to upper-right.
2117903200341232350.promptZh:
目标：创作一幅宽幅电影感 aerial 建立镜头（establishing shot），展现一座受《爱丽丝梦游仙境》启发的奇幻巴洛克风格城市，并在画面上方叠加一条可见的摄像机运动路径引导线。  
画布：16:9 横向图像，高分辨率，以高倾斜角无人机视角俯瞰一片密集的城市景观。  
场景：一座广阔而奇想的城市，拥有繁复装饰的塔楼、桥梁、运河、广场、屋顶花园、穹顶、尖塔、棋盘格状露台、扑克牌主题元素、心形徽章、钥匙孔形状的门洞、茶杯造型的阳台，以及糖果色屋顶。建筑须极度精细、奢华且略带超现实感，融合维多利亚式、哥特式、巴洛克式与童话风格。包含流经楼宇之间的青绿色运河，以及多条连接塔楼的架空步道。柔和的云朵与薄雾环绕城市边缘，营造出漂浮般的梦幻氛围。  
关键地标：精确包含 5 个标志性奇幻地标：1）位于左下/中左区域的一座大型钥匙孔门洞，门前为黑白棋盘格广场，并配有心形装饰；2）位于左上区域的一座高耸教堂式尖塔，其立面为心形钟面；3）位于中上/右上区域附近的一座圆柱形塔楼，表面饰有黑色扑克花色符号；4）位于最右上远方的一座宏伟圆形塔楼，顶端冠以一朵硕大的红色蘑菇帽，表面布满白色斑点；5）数处青绿色运河水池与桥梁，贯穿中左区域的城市街区。  
摄像机路径叠加层：在城市上方绘制一条粗壮、明亮的红色、平滑弯曲的路径线。该线起始于左下街道/广场区域，蜿蜒穿过画面中央，含两个宽阔弯折，随后向上弯曲，终点止于右上蘑菇冠塔楼。这条红色路径应呈现为简洁的手绘式路线引导线，清晰叠置于图像最上层，两端呈圆角，粗细均匀。此为图中唯一标注。  
视觉风格：超精细奇幻概念艺术，电影感布光（cinematic lighting），真实的空间纵深与尺度感，柔和的大气薄雾（atmospheric haze），粉彩质感石质建筑配青绿色水域，粉红与红色点缀，复杂精妙的屋顶与露台，充满魔法城市探索气息。  
约束条件：不得出现人物特写（close-up），不得添加文字标签、用户界面元素或水印。确保红色路线线从左下至右上始终醒目且连续不断。

2117903200341232351.promptEn:
Goal: Create a highly detailed square anime illustration of the chaotic “inside of GPT image generation” as a manga production war room, halfway between rough imagination and realistic execution. The scene should feel like a frantic deadline night for AI-generated manga art.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, dense three-wall diorama perspective, warm indoor lighting, shallow depth of field but with many readable sticky notes and diagrams. The left side should feel more sketchy and conceptual, the right side more polished and realistic.

Main subjects: Show exactly 2 exhausted chibi anime girls at the center table: 1 black-haired bunny-ear girl slumped face-down on the desk, crying and overwhelmed, and 1 silver-haired cat-ear girl frantically drawing manga panels with both hands raised in panic. Add exactly 1 small translucent blue ghost mascot floating behind them, looking worried.

Environment and layout: A wooden worktable fills the foreground and center, covered with manga manuscripts, storyboard sheets, red correction marks, sticky notes, crumpled paper balls, coffee, pens, a laptop, a tablet, books, and a small plant. Behind the desk are three upright gray cardboard partitions covered in planning notes, workflow diagrams, manga references, and pinned sheets. The overall room should look handcrafted, like a miniature cardboard studio set photographed realistically.

Visible repeated elements to include: exactly 2 main anime characters, exactly 1 ghost mascot, exactly 3 vertical backdrop panels, exactly 1 open laptop on the left side of the desk, exactly 1 black tablet on the right side of the desk, exactly 1 black coffee mug near the front center, exactly 1 hourglass at the front left, exactly 1 potted plant near the left wall, exactly 1 tall stack of finished manuscript pages at the front right, exactly 9 crumpled paper balls scattered across the table and floor area, and many loose manga pages flying through the air.

Text and board details: Use Japanese handwritten labels and sticky notes as decorative worldbuilding. Include a large vertical sign on the left panel with 投稿前夜, a red deadline sign with 締切, central notes about whether AI manga can communicate emotion, reader guidance lines, emotion selection, and a pipeline diagram from SNS to landing page to final manuscript to review to diffusion. On the right wall, include signs about whether the work is truly readable, why reactions feel weak, and how to make the brain generate emotion. Add small red warning sticky notes, checklist boxes, and manga-panel thumbnails.

Style: Ultra-detailed anime diorama illustration, realistic tabletop materials, paper texture, pencil and ink manga pages, soft beige-gray cardboard walls, warm desk lighting, subtle motion blur on flying papers, expressive chibi faces, high-density visual storytelling, cozy but frantic deadline atmosphere. Use a mix of clean anime character rendering and realistic product-photography lighting.

Constraints: Keep the composition crowded but coherent, with the two characters clearly centered. Do not add extra main characters. Make the Japanese writing look handwritten on paper notes, not digital UI text. Avoid logos, watermarks, or modern interface overlays except for the single open laptop.

2117903200341232352.promptEn: Create a polished anime-style illustration of two fantasy humanoid characters stretching on tatami mats inside a sunlit traditional Japanese dojo or training room. The scene shows exactly two main characters sitting on the floor in wide-legged forward stretches: on the left, a fox-eared youth with messy blond hair, tan fox ears, a red-and-black oversized plaid hoodie, black shorts, and black lace-up boots, leaning forward to reach one boot; on the right, a pale dragon-themed youth with fluffy white hair, small translucent blue horns, pointed elf-like ears, a long iridescent white-blue dragon tail curled behind them, a semi-transparent pale blue patterned tunic tied with blue ribbons, dark blue leggings, and white sneakers, reaching toward one shoe. Use a blond fox-eared youth in a red plaid hoodie and a white-haired bubble dragon youth with a shimmering tail. Add exactly four visible soap bubbles: one large iridescent bubble behind the fox character, one large iridescent bubble behind and between the two characters, and two small floating bubbles above them. The room has wooden beams, sliding glass windows, mirrored wall panels, shelves with exercise equipment, posters, and a mountain landscape visible outside through bright windows. Lighting should be warm late-morning sunlight with long soft shadows, sparkling highlights on bubbles, and glossy iridescent reflections on the dragon tail and clothing. Composition is a wide horizontal 4:3 view from low floor level, emphasizing depth across the tatami mats. 2117903200341232354.promptEn: Create a nostalgic 1990s Japanese OVA anime cel scene on a school rooftop in a 16:9 frame, with soft analog film grain, slight VHS blur, muted blue color grading, hand-painted backgrounds, and thin ink outlines. Show exactly two teenage students sitting side by side on the concrete rooftop near the lower center of the image: one dark navy gakuran school uniform boy on the left with short black hair, knees bent, holding chopsticks and a small lunch box, and one cream sailor blouse with navy collar, large navy bow, and long blue pleated skirt girl on the right with shoulder-length dark hair, also holding chopsticks and a lunch box. Their faces are intentionally obscured by two soft square pixelated blur blocks, one over each face, while their poses remain natural and calm. Behind them is a rooftop chain-link fence spanning the width of the frame, a low concrete parapet, distant school rooftop structures, a cylindrical silver water tank on a metal platform at the right, and a bright clear deep blue sky with a few pale clouds. Use a low eye-level camera angle from across the rooftop ledge, leaving a large empty concrete foreground occupying the lower third. The mood should feel quiet, intimate, and retro, like a paused frame from a 90s slice-of-life anime OVA. Avoid modern digital sharpness, avoid text, avoid logos, and keep the composition simple with exactly two visible people and exactly two lunch boxes.
2117903200341232354.promptZh:
在16:9画幅中，创作一幅怀旧的1990年代日本OVA动画赛璐珞（cel）风格场景，地点为学校天台；画面带有柔和的胶片颗粒（film grain）、轻微的VHS模糊（VHS blur）、低饱和度的蓝色调色（muted blue color grading）、手绘背景（hand-painted backgrounds）以及纤细的墨线勾边（thin ink outlines）。  
画面正下方偏中心位置的混凝土天台地面上，恰好并排坐着两名青少年学生：  
左侧是一名身穿深藏青色学兰（gakuran）校服的男生，黑发短发，双膝弯曲，手持筷子与一只小型便当盒；  
右侧是一名身穿米白色水手衫、深蓝色领口、硕大深蓝色蝴蝶结及长款藏青色百褶裙的女生，黑发及肩，同样手持筷子与一只便当盒。  
二人面部均被两个柔软的方形像素化模糊块（soft square pixelated blur blocks）刻意遮挡，各覆盖一张脸，但肢体姿态自然、沉静。  
他们身后是一道横贯画面宽度的天台铁丝网围栏、一道低矮的混凝土女儿墙、远处可见的其他校舍天台结构、右方金属支架上一只圆柱形银色水箱，以及一片明亮澄澈的深蓝色天空，其间点缀几缕浅淡云朵。  
采用低视角（low eye-level camera angle），镜头从天台边缘对面平视取景，画面前景留出大片空旷的混凝土区域，占据画面底部三分之一。  
整体氛围应宁静、私密且复古，宛如一部90年代日常系（slice-of-life）动画OVA中暂停的一帧。  
避免现代数字图像的锐利感（modern digital sharpness），避免出现文字（text），避免出现商标（logos），构图须简洁——画面中仅允许出现两人与两只便当盒。

2117903200341232355.promptEn:
Goal: Create a luxury fashion editorial collage for a Riviera eveningwear collection titled LUMIÈRE D’AZUR, combining one large cinematic lifestyle image with a film-contact-sheet of outfit variations.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 composition, split roughly 52% left hero image and 48% right lookbook grid. Use warm golden-hour lighting, high-end magazine styling, rich contrast, and a polished photorealistic fashion campaign look.

Layout: Left side shows one large editorial scene: an elegant woman standing on an ornate wrought-iron balcony above the French Riviera coastline, with blue sea, yachts, cliffs, harbor buildings, and hazy sunset sky in the background. Place the headline in very large white high-fashion serif capitals across the upper left, with subtle shadow and generous letter spacing. Right side shows a black analog film contact sheet with visible sprocket holes, orange Kodak-style edge markings, frame numbers, and thin black dividers.

Discrete elements: Include exactly 10 visible fashion model images total: 1 large hero model on the left and 9 smaller lookbook frames on the right arranged in a 3 by 3 grid. The 9 right-side frames are: top left navy blue deep-V velvet blazer suit; top center emerald green satin wrap dress; top right burnt orange tailored pantsuit; middle left rust orange velvet blazer suit; middle center emerald green wrap dress with hand on hip; middle right burgundy sequined wrap dress; bottom left copper-orange suit with hands on hips; bottom center emerald green flowing dress; bottom right navy blue suit jacket. Do not add extra frames.

Subject details: The left hero model is a poised adult woman with dark hair in a sleek low bun, wearing a dramatic black evening gown covered in ornate gold embroidery and beadwork, sheer long sleeves, a fitted bodice, and a full skirt. She holds a small black clutch with gold trim and wears subtle jewelry. Her face should be softly anonymized or intentionally blurred, as if privacy-protected, while the clothing and environment remain sharp. The right-side models also have softly blurred faces while outfits stay crisp.

Visual style: Cinematic photorealism, luxury resort fashion campaign, Vogue-style editorial, warm Mediterranean color palette, crisp fabrics, glossy highlights, shallow depth of field on the background, refined composition. Emphasize deep navy, emerald green, burgundy, rust orange, black, and metallic gold.

Text and details: The only prominent readable title is LUMIÈRE D’AZUR. Film edge markings may resemble Kodak Portra 400 and small frame numbers but should function as decorative contact-sheet typography rather than main copy.

Constraints: Keep the split-screen collage structure, exactly 1 hero scene plus exactly 9 contact-sheet looks, no logos, no watermark, no extra headline text, no distorted hands, no duplicate limbs, no cartoon style.

2117903200341232359.promptEn:
Goal: Create an information-dense anime character appreciation sheet filled edge-to-edge with expressive drawings of one adorable gothic-lolita girl, as if made by an obsessed fan. The overall feeling is cute overload, frantic admiration, and high-detail character design notes.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 portrait canvas, white paper background, dense collage layout with no borders. Use a hand-drawn sketchbook aesthetic with watercolor/marker rendering, ink outlines, soft gray shading, pale pink hearts, blue accent hearts, sparkles, arrows, exclamation marks, and handwritten Japanese praise notes scattered everywhere.

Main character: A young anime girl named unnamed gothic-lolita girl with glossy black long wavy twin-tail or half-up hair, thick bangs, soft blush, large pinkish eyes, and a delicate doll-like face. Her face should be intentionally left as a soft blurred/obscured oval in several larger portraits, while smaller detail drawings may show expressive eyes and mouth. She wears a black frilly gothic-lolita dress with pale blue ribbon accents, lace trim, puff sleeves, layered skirt, heart charm details, white frilled socks, and chunky black Mary Jane platform shoes. Main accent color is powder blue. Mood is overwhelmingly affectionate and cute.

Layout: Place exactly 20 discrete character/detail illustrations around the canvas, overlapping slightly but readable. Count and include these 20 visible elements: 1 central full-body standing pose holding an open white folding fan; 2 large upper-left bust portrait with blurred face; 3 small top-center head-and-shoulders portrait with blurred face; 4 top-right close-up of elegant hands with black lace cuffs and pale nails; 5 upper-right shy bust portrait with fingers near mouth and blurred face; 6 upper-right close-up of one sparkling pink eye; 7 left-middle chibi sitting while hugging a pink plush toy; 8 left-middle side-profile bust showing long hair and blue bow; 9 lower-left close-up of one pink eye; 10 lower-left close-up of a raised hand gesture with cuff; 11 lower-center small bust focused on hair bow and chest ribbon with blurred face; 12 bottom-left large cropped bust portrait with blurred face; 13 bottom-middle large cropped bust with hand near cheek and blurred face; 14 right-middle close-up of the bodice ribbon and waist bow; 15 small right-middle crying chibi head; 16 small right-lower crying chibi head with open mouth; 17 lower-right large shy bust with both hands covering cheeks and blurred face; 18 lower-center-right kneeling or seated half-body pose with hand near lips, visible face, looking bashful; 19 bottom-center back-view hair and outfit detail showing the rear hair ribbons and dress back; 20 bottom-right tiny blushing chibi face with tears.

Handwritten text content: Add many casual Japanese handwritten fan notes, keeping them decorative and energetic. Include a huge top-left headline reading なのかが 世界一かわいい...!!!. Also include scattered notes similar to: 「存在が…尊い…!!」, 「この手が好きすぎる…」, 「天使だよ…」, 「ビジュ強すぎ問題」, 「大好き」, 「全身かわいすぎて無理…!!!」, 「笑顔…最高!!!」, 「守ってあげたい…!!!」, 「横顔も好きすぎる!!!」, 「リボンもフリルも完璧すぎる…」, 「ハートの金具が天才的…!!!」, 「もうほんとに好きすぎるっ!!!」, 「だいすき!!!」, 「尊すぎて語彙力消失!!!」, 「可愛さ大洪水…!!!」, 「なのかしか勝たん!!!」. Write them loosely by hand in black ink with pink highlights, arrows, and hearts.

Visual style: Highly polished anime illustration mixed with rough handwritten annotation energy; detailed shiny hair strands, lace, ruffles, bows, and accessories; soft blush tones; expressive chibi faces; pink and blue hearts throughout. The page should feel packed, chaotic, affectionate, and cute, but still balanced around the central full-body figure.

Constraints: No photo realism, no 3D render, no clean corporate layout, no empty background, no watermark. Keep the collage dense and count exactly 20 illustrated elements.

2117903200341232361.promptEn: Create an extremely noisy, hyper-detailed cyberpunk rainy-night train platform in Shinjuku, Tokyo. The camera is at platform height looking diagonally down a crowded platform toward a sleek black glass commuter train arriving on the right, its rounded front glowing with white headlights, blue under-light, magenta reflections, steam or mist near the rails, and a front destination display reading Shinjuku and 03. The scene is packed with commuters in dark raincoats under exactly 32 visible transparent umbrellas, all covered in water droplets and reflecting neon blue, cyan, purple, and hot pink light. Wet tiled pavement, tactile yellow platform strips, puddles, rail grooves, overhead beams, cables, and dense urban infrastructure should all be sharply textured and visually noisy, with rain streaks everywhere. Add 6 prominent glowing information elements: 1 huge translucent cyan-and-magenta route map hologram in the upper left labeled Shinjuku with Japanese station text and a pink transit line; 1 yellow exit sign on the far left reading Exit S2 for Shinjuku Shibuya; 1 small yellow platform direction sign near the center; 1 cyan overhead platform sign reading 03; 1 bright magenta station sign on the train front; and 1 cluster of distant vertical neon advertisements on the right-side city background. Goal: Create a bold illustrated travel poster for New York City with an anime street-fashion heroine towering over a rainy nighttime Manhattan street, mixing photoreal urban landmarks with comic sticker doodles and punchy typography.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, high-resolution, full-bleed. Dark blue dusk sky fading into warm city lights and wet reflective pavement. Energetic youth-culture advertising composition.

Layout: Left third is dominated by a stacked headline in huge condensed uppercase block letters. Center background shows the Empire State Building lit up, with Manhattan skyscrapers behind it. Right half features a full-body anime girl standing in an exaggerated low-angle heroic pose, one foot very large in the foreground. Bottom and side areas are filled with sticker-like NYC icons and doodles.

Main text: Large headline at upper left reads exactly: “YOUR NEW YORK ADVENTURE STARTS HERE”. Use white for “YOUR,” “ADVENTURE,” and “HERE,” yellow for “NEW YORK,” and hot pink for “STARTS.” Below it, handwritten script reads exactly: “Ride the subway. Hit the streets. Taste the city.” with “subway” in cyan and “city” in hot pink. Add small sticker text blocks reading exactly: “NYC IT HITS DIFFERENT,” “NYC ♥ ALL DAY. EVERY DAY. LIVE IT. LOVE IT.,” and “BIG DREAMS BIGGER CITY.” Add a round subway badge near the Empire State Building reading “NEW YORK CITY” around the rim, a large “7” in the center, and “SUBWAY” underneath.

Character details: The main character is one young anime woman, cheerful and confident, with bright cyan-blue hair with magenta-pink tips, short bob haircut, big expressive eyes, and a small smile. She waves with her raised right hand and holds a steaming hot dog in her left hand. Outfit: oversized yellow-and-black bomber jacket with patches and graffiti marks, black cropped top, black baggy cargo pants with zipper details and pink “Brooklyn” graffiti on one leg, layered necklaces, earrings, rings, and chunky cream high-top sneakers with pink heart and black accents. Jacket includes visible pink “NYC” lettering and yellow graphic patches.

Counted visual elements: Include exactly 1 main anime girl, 1 Empire State Building, 1 steaming hot dog in her hand, 1 oversized foreground hot dog sticker at bottom left, 1 yellow taxi sticker riding a blue wave, 1 small pizza-slice sticker near the upper right, 1 large pizza-slice sticker on the right, 1 Chrysler Building doodle, 1 bearded pigeon with sunglasses and a cap at bottom right, 1 pink heart doodle above the girl, 1 yellow star near the left center, 2 pink star stickers, and 1 pink heart sticker near the “NYC it hits different” label.

Visual style: Hybrid anime illustration and gritty urban poster design; saturated cyan, yellow, hot pink, black, and cream palette; thick black ink outlines; halftone texture; hand-drawn sticker borders; subtle film grain; splattered ink and small bird silhouettes. City background should feel cinematic and semi-realistic, while the character and stickers are crisp comic/anime art.

Atmosphere: Adventurous, playful, iconic, and aspirational, like a modern NYC tourism poster for young travelers. Wet streets reflect taxi lights and skyline glow. Add steam from the hot dog and tiny radiating lines around the heart doodle.

Constraints: Keep all visible text legible and spelled correctly. Do not add logos, watermarks, QR codes, or extra paragraphs of text. Preserve the exact poster hierarchy: headline on left, character on right, Empire State Building centered behind, sticker collage around the bottom and sides.

2117903200341232370.promptEn: Create a photorealistic luxury wedding portrait of a cute British Shorthair cat as the groom, sitting upright on a garden aisle. The cat has plush gray tabby fur, round golden eyes, a small pink nose, alert ears, and a calm slightly curious expression while looking directly at the camera. Dress the cat in a formal white ruffled collar with a large ivory satin bow tie and one cream rose boutonniere pinned at the chest. Behind and slightly to the right, place a translucent white bridal veil standing upright like an invisible bride, edged with lace; on the veil area add a glowing white abstract Capafy-style logo made from one central diamond/star node connected to 6 round nodes. The setting is an elegant old European garden wedding venue: a stone path covered with pale rose petals, abundant pink, peach, and cream roses on both sides, classical stone statues and urns, an arched stone doorway in the background, tall trees and greenery forming a shaded canopy. Use warm golden-hour backlighting, soft bokeh, realistic fur detail, natural wedding-photography skin/fabric-style realism applied to cat fur and satin, shallow depth of field, cinematic romantic atmosphere, high-end editorial wedding photo look. Vertical 4:5 composition, cat centered slightly left, veil/logo centered right, foreground roses softly blurred, no text, no watermark, no humans.
2117903200341232370.promptZh: 创作一幅照片级写实（photorealistic）的奢华婚礼肖像：一只可爱的英国短毛猫担任新郎，端坐于花园通道中央。猫咪拥有蓬松的灰色虎斑毛发、圆润的金色眼睛、小巧的粉红色鼻子、警觉竖立的耳朵，神情平静而略带好奇，直视镜头。为猫咪佩戴正式的白色褶边领圈，配一枚硕大的象牙色缎面蝴蝶结，并在胸前别一枚奶油色玫瑰胸花（boutonniere）。在其后方偏右位置，放置一袭半透明白色婚纱头纱，如一位隐形新娘般垂直挺立，头纱边缘饰有蕾丝；在头纱区域添加一枚发光的白色抽象 Capafy 风格标志，由一个居中的钻石/星形节点向外连接六个圆形节点。场景设定为一座典雅的欧洲古风花园婚礼场地：一条铺满淡粉色玫瑰花瓣的石径，两侧盛放大量粉色、蜜桃色与奶油色玫瑰，点缀古典石雕人像与石瓮，背景为拱形石门，高大树木与繁茂绿植形成遮荫天幕。采用温暖的黄金时刻逆光（golden-hour backlighting）、柔焦焦外虚化（bokeh）、逼真的毛发细节、适用于猫毛与缎面材质的自然婚礼摄影级肌肤/织物写实感（natural wedding-photography skin/fabric-style realism）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、电影感浪漫氛围（cinematic romantic atmosphere）、高端杂志风格婚礼摄影质感（high-end editorial wedding photo look）。竖构图，比例 4:5；猫咪居中略偏左，头纱/标志居中偏右；前景玫瑰柔和虚化；画面中无文字、无水印、无人类。

2117903200341232371.promptEn:
Goal: Create a photorealistic wide-angle interior design visualization of a small child’s bedroom decorated with IKEA furniture, including annotation callouts naming each new item.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 image, photographed from the doorway or front-right corner of the room with a slightly elevated eye-level perspective, showing the entire bedroom from left desk area to right bed and closet doors.

Room details: Beige walls, beige carpet, white trim, a large window with white blinds on the left wall, white double closet doors on the right wall, warm natural daylight mixed with soft lamp light. Keep the room tidy, realistic, and practical for a young child.

Layout and furniture: On the far left wall place a white LÄRANDE desk with a gray rolling desk chair, pencil cups, and a small book or tablet on top. Under the window and along the back wall place a black cube storage unit labeled KALLAX toy storage, filled with exactly 3 gray fabric bins across the bottom row, books, toy vehicles, and small toys. Above the toy storage hang a framed dinosaur print. To the right of the toy storage place a dark wood STORKLINTA dresser with exactly 3 large drawers, small plants, a framed photo, and a small lamp on top. On the right side place a white twin SLÄKT bed with a white headboard, blue quilt, dinosaur-patterned pillow and sheets, positioned lengthwise toward the viewer. Place a black arched floor lamp behind the bed near the dresser. Add a green children’s road-map play rug centered on the carpet between the desk, storage, and bed.

Annotation callouts: Add exactly 7 white rounded-rectangle labels with black text and thin gray borders, each with a white arrow pointing to the relevant item. The labels must read exactly: 1) “LÄRANDE desk” pointing to the desk, 2) “KALLAX toy storage” pointing to the black cube storage, 3) “DRÖNA bins” pointing to the gray fabric bins, 4) “STORKLINTA dresser” pointing to the dresser, 5) “HEKTAR floor lamp” pointing to the black floor lamp, 6) “SLÄKT headboard” pointing to the white headboard, 7) “SLÄKT bed” pointing to the footboard or bed frame.

Visual style: Realistic smartphone interior photo with clean AI home-staging polish, warm cozy lighting, accurate perspective, subtle shadows, readable labels, no people, no clutter, no watermark.
2117903200341232371.promptZh:
目标：创建一张照片级写实（photorealistic）广角（wide-angle）室内设计可视化图像，展现一间布置有宜家（IKEA）家具的小孩卧室，并附带标注说明框（annotation callouts），为每件新物品命名。

画布：横幅 4:3 图像，从房间门道或前右角拍摄，视角略高于人眼水平，完整呈现整个卧室，从左侧书桌区域延伸至右侧床铺及衣柜门。

房间细节：米色墙面、米色地毯、白色踢脚线；左侧墙面设有一扇大窗，配有白色百叶帘；右侧墙面设有一对白色双开式衣柜门；光线为温暖自然日光与柔和台灯光混合。保持房间整洁、真实、适合幼儿使用。

布局与家具：最左侧墙面放置一张白色LÄRANDE书桌，配灰色可滚动办公椅、笔筒，以及置于桌面的一本小书或平板电脑。在窗下及后墙沿线放置一个黑色KALLAX玩具储物柜，底部一排整齐摆放恰好3个灰色布艺收纳箱（DRÖNA bins），上层摆放书籍、玩具车及小型玩具。玩具储物柜上方悬挂一幅装框的恐龙主题版画。玩具储物柜右侧放置一款深色木纹STORKLINTA五斗柜，含恰好3个大抽屉，柜面摆放小型绿植、一幅装框照片及一盏小台灯。右侧区域放置一张白色SLÄKT单人床，配白色床头板、蓝色被子、恐龙图案抱枕与床单，床体纵向朝向观者摆放。床后靠近五斗柜处放置一盏黑色拱形落地灯（HEKTAR floor lamp）。在书桌、储物柜与床之间的地毯中央铺设一张绿色儿童道路地图主题游戏地垫。

标注说明框：添加恰好7个白色圆角矩形标签，黑色文字，细灰色边框，每个标签均配一根白色箭头，指向对应物品。标签文字须严格如下：1) “LÄRANDE desk” 指向书桌；2) “KALLAX玩具储物柜” 指向黑色立方体储物柜；3) “DRÖNA收纳箱” 指向灰色布艺收纳箱；4) “STORKLINTA五斗柜” 指向五斗柜；5) “HEKTAR落地灯” 指向黑色落地灯；6) “SLÄKT床头板” 指向白色床头板；7) “SLÄKT床架” 指向床尾板或床架主体。

视觉风格：真实感智能手机室内摄影效果，具备干净利落的AI家居陈列（home-staging）润饰质感，温暖舒适照明（warm cozy lighting），精准透视（accurate perspective），细腻阴影（subtle shadows），标签清晰可读，画面中无人物、无杂乱物品、无水印。

2117903200341232372.promptZh: 超奢华时尚杂志封面，一位富有远见的年轻精英从容坐于雕塑感黑色皮革休闲椅上，姿态放松却气场强大，目光柔和而自信，发质富有纹理的卷发，剪裁合体的超大号黑色西装，极简主义时尚美学，现代创意总监气质。温暖米 beige 单色背景，巨型字体自然融入构图，考究的留白，形态与建筑感之间的优雅平衡，高端设计类杂志风格。电影感影棚布光（cinematic studio lighting），柔和的定向阳光投下轻柔阴影，肌肤纹理丰富，照片级写实（photorealistic）细节，奢华品牌美学，高端时尚广告大片质感，低饱和大地色系调色，斯堪的纳维亚极简主义（Scandinavian minimalism）融合当代艺术指导（contemporary art direction），《Vogue》级别构图（Vogue-level composition），极致干净的字体排版（ultra-clean typography placement），景深（depth of field），真实感（realism），微妙对比（subtle contrast），85mm 镜头，浅景深（shallow depth of field），杂志级杰作（editorial masterpiece），屡获殊荣的创意指导（award-winning creative direction），8K 超高细节（8K ultra-detailed），永恒的精致感（timeless sophistication）。

2117903200341232373.promptEn:
Goal: Create a wide Japanese promotional thumbnail/banner for GPT Image 2 cooking image prompts, designed like a cute handmade recipe-craft collage.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9-ish social media banner, warm cream paper background with subtle fabric texture, rounded sticker-like shapes, soft shadows, red and dark teal color palette, high readability.

Main headline area: At the top, place a huge bold title reading “GPT Image 2” with “GPT Image” in dark teal and the number “2” in bright red, all with thick white sticker outlines and slight drop shadow. Below it, add a large Japanese headline reading “料理画像プロンプト32例”, with “料理画像” and “32” in red and the remaining text in dark teal, also outlined in white. Under the headline, add a dark teal rounded pill banner with white Japanese text: “写真・参考画像・オリキャラからレシピカードまで”.

Mascot and decorations: Add exactly 3 appearances of a cute beige stitched cat mascot with red round glasses and a small red wand: one large mascot standing at the upper right, one tiny mascot near the bottom of the first recipe card, and one large mascot on the right movie-poster card. Add exactly 2 small red yarn-tree decorations near the top left and top right, plus small golden sparkle icons around the headline.

Bottom layout: Create exactly 4 rounded rectangular showcase cards in a row across the lower half, separated by exactly 3 red triangular arrow markers pointing right between the cards. Each card has a dark teal label tab with white text at the top.

Card 1: Label tab “レシピカード”. Show a clean recipe card layout with a photo of tomato basil pasta on the left and Japanese recipe text on the right. The title should read “トマトとバジルのパスタ”, followed by a small ingredient list with bullet-like lines. Include the tiny mascot at the lower right of this card.

Card 2: Label tab “料理写真”. Show a warm professional food photograph of stacked pancakes topped with berries, whipped cream, mint, and syrup, centered in the card.

Card 3: Label tab “写真集ページ”. Show an open photo book spread with exactly 2 visible food photos: a salad on the left page and a stew or soup bowl on the right page, with small Japanese captions beneath each photo.

Card 4: Label tab “映画ポスター風”. Create a cinematic kitchen-poster style card with large Japanese copy “キッチンから、幸せを。” at the top left, a warm kitchen background, a pot of orange soup at the bottom, and the large cat mascot standing on the right.

Visual style: Bright, cute, polished Japanese blog-thumbnail design; realistic food photos inside craft-paper frames; sticker outlines, rounded corners, subtle shadows, soft beige background, clean hierarchy. Keep the composition dense but readable, with no extra cards, no extra arrows, and no watermark.

2117903200341232374.promptEn: An ultra-detailed 8K black and white macro portrait of a young man, zoomed in tight on his eye, cheekbone, and lips. Bright sunlight splits into soft, wavy luminous lines rippling across his skin like underwater reflections. The light flows diagonally, wrapping around facial contours in dreamlike patterns, with shadows dissolving into smooth mid-gray tones. Skin rendered in photographic detail: visible pores, faint freckles, slight stubble, natural texture catching glowing light. Lips softly highlighted, eye reflecting fragments of luminous waves. Macro camera framing, razor-thin depth of field: one sharp ridge of illuminated skin, the rest melting into velvety blur. The flowing light gives a surreal, glassy aesthetic grounded in photorealism. Background fades into soft gray gradients. Fine cinematic grain overlays the frame. Intimate, emotionally evocative monochrome portrait.
2117903200341232374.promptZh: 一幅超精细的8K黑白微距肖像，描绘一位年轻男子，画面极度聚焦于他的眼睛、颧骨与嘴唇。明亮的阳光分裂成柔和、波浪状的发光线条，在其皮肤上如水下倒影般荡漾。光线呈对角线流动，以梦幻般的图案包裹面部轮廓，阴影则消融为平滑的中灰色调。皮肤以摄影级细节呈现：可见毛孔、淡淡的雀斑、细微的胡茬，天然纹理捕捉着辉光。嘴唇被柔和提亮，眼睛映出发光波纹的碎片。微距相机构图，景深（depth of field）极浅：仅有一道被照亮的皮肤棱线清晰锐利，其余部分则融化为天鹅绒般的虚化。流动的光线赋予画面一种根植于照片写实主义（photorealism）的超现实、玻璃质感美学。背景渐变为柔和的灰色渐变。细腻的电影感颗粒（cinematic grain）覆盖整个画面。一幅私密、富有情感感染力的单色肖像。

2117903200341232375.promptEn: Create a highly detailed cinematic steampunk fantasy portrait of a cute small Shih Tzu standing full body in the center of the frame, looking directly at the viewer with large glossy dark eyes and a calm heroic expression. The dog has fluffy cream and tan fur, long floppy ears, a rounded muzzle, and a plume-like tail curling behind its right side. Dress it as an ornate Victorian airship pilot: exactly 6 main outfit/accessory elements are visible — 1 brown leather aviator cap with brass goggles on top, 1 fitted brown leather jacket with cream shearling collar and cuffs, 1 layered waistcoat and shirt with tiny brass buttons, 1 diagonal strap and belt system with pouches, 1 pair of tailored dark trousers, and 1 pair of worn brown lace-up boots. Add numerous tiny brass gears, compass-like medallions, chains, buckles, pins, and clockwork ornaments on the jacket and belts, but keep the dog’s face unobstructed. Set the scene in a wide golden steampunk city and airship dock with wet reflective cobblestone pavement, ornate brass machinery, pipes, towers, glowing round windows, railings, steam vents, and warm golden lights. Place one large blurred zeppelin airship in the upper right background, with industrial towers and round mechanical structures fading into mist on the left and center background. Use dramatic warm backlighting, soft fog, floating golden dust sparks, shallow depth of field, realistic fur texture, polished brass reflections, rich brown and gold color grading, ultra-detailed 3D/photoreal fantasy styling, symmetrical centered composition, low eye-level camera angle, 4:3 landscape aspect ratio. No text, no watermark, no extra animals, no cropped feet.
2117903200341232375.promptZh: 创作一幅高度精细、电影感（cinematic）的蒸汽朋克（steampunk）奇幻肖像画：一只可爱的小型西施犬（Shih Tzu）以全身姿态立于画面正中央，直视观者，拥有硕大、水亮、深色的眼睛，神情沉静而英勇。该犬毛发蓬松，呈奶油色与浅褐色相间，双耳长而下垂，吻部圆润，尾巴如羽状般向其右侧卷曲。为其装扮成繁复华丽的维多利亚风格飞艇（airship）驾驶员，共清晰呈现6个主要服饰/配饰元素：1顶棕色皮革飞行员帽，帽顶配有黄铜护目镜；1件合身棕色皮革夹克，领口与袖口镶有奶油色羊剪绒；1套叠穿马甲与衬衫，缀有细小黄铜纽扣；1套斜跨式肩带与腰带系统，配有多个小包；1条剪裁合体的深色长裤；1双磨损的棕色系带靴。在夹克与腰带上添加大量微缩黄铜齿轮、罗盘式徽章、链条、搭扣、胸针及机械钟表风格装饰，但确保犬只面部完全无遮挡。场景设定于一座宽阔的金色蒸汽朋克城市与飞艇码头：地面为湿润反光的鹅卵石铺装，布满雕花黄铜机械、管道、塔楼、泛光的圆形窗、栏杆、蒸汽排气口，以及暖金色灯光。右上方背景中置入一艘大型虚化飞艇（zeppelin），左方与中央背景则为渐隐于薄雾中的工业塔楼与圆形机械结构。采用富有戏剧性的暖色逆光（backlighting）、柔和雾气、漂浮的金色尘埃微粒与火花、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、逼真毛发质感、抛光黄铜反射效果、浓郁棕金色调（rich brown and gold color grading）、超精细3D/照片级写实（photoreal）奇幻风格、对称居中构图（symmetrical centered composition）、低视角平视镜头（low eye-level camera angle）、4:3横幅宽高比（4:3 landscape aspect ratio）。画面中不得出现文字、水印、额外动物或被裁切的脚部。

2117903200341232376.promptEn: Create a vertical anime-style fashion illustration of a mysterious young woman standing confidently in the aisle of a ruined Gothic cathedral during a sunlit rainstorm. She has deep purple medium-length hair partly hidden by a transparent hood, her face softly obscured in shadow for an anonymous model look. Outfit: a glossy black cropped zip-up jacket with a high black turtleneck underneath, black short shorts, a slim belt, hands tucked into jacket pockets, and tall thigh-high stiletto boots in shiny dark purple-black patent leather. Over the outfit, she wears a dramatic transparent hooded raincoat made of clear vinyl, ankle-length and flaring outward like a cape, decorated with exactly 14 visible purple rose motifs connected by thin gray vine stems and leaves: 2 roses on the upper sleeves, 3 on the left front panel, 3 on the right front panel, 4 near the lower hem, and 2 partially visible along the side folds. The coat should resemble stained glass, with black seam outlines, reflective wet highlights, sparkling raindrops, and luminous edges. Environment: an abandoned cathedral interior with tall pointed arches, broken stone roof opening to a bright cloudy blue sky, ruined walls, mossy pillars, stained-glass windows in the background, wooden pews on both sides, cracked wet stone floor, puddles reflecting the figure, and rain falling through the roof in long vertical streaks.
