2117903200341232377.promptEn:
Goal: Create a warm fantasy manga page about forest children listening to elf and dwarf music, in a hand-painted storybook manga style. Use Japanese for all dialogue and narration, with vertical manga lettering.

Canvas: One vertical comic page, about 3:4 aspect ratio, centered on a pale cream background with a thin black page border. Inside the page, use fine black panel gutters and watercolor-like fantasy illustration with dense foliage, flowers, dappled sunlight, and golden-green tones.

Layout: Use exactly 5 comic panels. Panel 1 is a wide full-width top panel. Panel 2 is a wide full-width middle panel. Panel 3 is the lower-left panel of a split row. Panel 4 is the lower-right panel of the same split row. Panel 5 is a wide full-width final panel at the bottom. Add small musical-note symbols in panels 2 and 4.

Characters: Include exactly 6 recurring characters: 1 tall blonde elf woman with pointed ears, flower hair ornaments, elegant white-and-green embroidered dress, holding a lute; 1 stout bearded dwarf man with pointed ears, round cap, layered travel clothes, and a small hand drum; 1 small tan-haired animal-eared child; 1 blonde elf girl child; 1 dark-haired human boy in a blue tunic and red scarf; and 1 braided brown-haired dwarf girl child with a decorated headband. The elf woman is a gentle blonde elf woman playing a lute; the dwarf musician is a cheerful red-bearded dwarf playing a hand drum. Keep the children expressive, wide-eyed, and delighted.

Panel details and text: Panel 1 shows the dwarf and elf seated under trees performing music while children gather around them; use exactly 2 speech bubbles: one from the elf saying 風がそよぎ 木々がうたう 大地の恵みに ありがとう, and one from a child saying "わっっっは！いい歌だ！". Panel 2 shows close-up reactions of the children from left to right, smiling and clasping hands as music floats around; use exactly 4 speech bubbles: "きれいな 音色だね…", "おじさんの リズムが すっごく楽しい！", "ふたりの音が ぴったり 合ってる！", and "もっと 聴きたいな！". Panel 3, lower-left, shows the six characters walking away together along a sunny forest path toward a cozy village house; use exactly 2 speech bubbles: "うん！" and "ねえみんなも 一緒に歌おうよ！". Panel 4, lower-right, shows the elf and dwarf playing side by side, smiling warmly; use exactly 2 speech bubbles: "音楽は ぶつけ合いじゃなく 橋になるんだな" and "ええ 一緒に奏でると 心が通うの". Panel 5 shows the elf and dwarf seated in a flower-filled clearing, surrounded by the four children listening happily; include exactly 2 vertical narration boxes: left box says "小さな村に、 音楽と笑顔が あふれる日々が 続いていきました。" and right box says "エルフの優しい旋律と ドワーフの楽しいリズム、 そしてみんなの歌声が ひとつになってーー". Add a small decorative final caption at bottom left reading "❀おわり❀".

Visual style: Detailed Japanese fantasy manga with watercolor textures, ink outlines, ornate clothing, soft faces, expressive eyes, luminous forest atmosphere, fairytale village background, warm sunlight, and gentle wholesome mood. Avoid modern objects, avoid extra panels, avoid extra characters, and keep all text inside the specified bubbles or narration boxes.

2117903200341232383.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cinematic anime key visual of Mount Takao Crow Tengu troupe, a young yokai warrior ensemble posing at a mountain shrine during sunset.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, full-body group portrait, warm golden-hour lighting, highly detailed fantasy anime illustration with painterly backgrounds and crisp character rendering.

Setting: A stone path at a traditional Japanese mountain shrine surrounded by tall cedar trees. In the background, place a large wooden torii gate with a thick shimenawa rope and hanging tassels, overlooking a distant town and layered mountains under an orange sunset sky. On the right, include a wooden shrine building with a curved tiled roof, paper talismans, rope ornaments, and a glowing lantern decorated with a black crow silhouette. Use mossy stones, small grasses, shrine lanterns, and long evening shadows for atmosphere.

Characters: Show exactly 7 crow-tengu inspired youths standing together in the foreground, all wearing coordinated red kimono-style tops, black hakama or long pleated skirts, geta sandals or traditional sandals, black feathered wings, small horn-like ornaments, and subtle pointed ears. Their faces should be covered by soft rectangular blur masks as anonymized placeholders, except where visible styling is needed.

Character count and placement:
1. Leftmost petite girl with twin buns and side locks, hands on hips, red robe and black hakama, small black wings.
2. Tall slim young man just left of center, long dark brown hair, sword at his waist, relaxed confident stance, red kimono and black hakama.
3. Short child in the front center, hands on hips, diagonal strap across the chest holding a small cylindrical case, red top and black skirt-like hakama.
4. Small younger child behind the center, partially hidden, short dark hair with little horn ornaments, red outfit and black wings.
5. Slender girl just right of center with long dark purple hair, holding a vertical paper talisman or wooden charm with Japanese calligraphy, red robe and black hakama.
6. Confident girl right of center with brown twin ponytails tied with red ribbons, arms crossed, red kimono with one high side slit revealing one leg wrap, black wings and many dangling bead ornaments.
7. Rightmost serious young man with messy black hair, black scarf, arms crossed, red robe over black hakama, sword at the hip, dark wings.

Costume details: Use deep vermilion red robes with small white crest embroidery on the chest, black sashes, bead charms, tassels, sword cords, scroll cases, and talisman accessories. Keep the group unified like a traditional tengu clan or mountain-school team, but give each character distinct hair, posture, and accessories.

Visual style: Dramatic anime fantasy realism, intricate linework, warm rim light from the setting sun, amber highlights, soft atmospheric haze, detailed shrine architecture, no modern objects, no UI, no text captions, no watermark.

2117903200341232384.promptEn: Create a high-quality cinematic double-exposure paper-tear collage portrait of a beautiful young South Asian woman with long silky dark brown hair, wearing an elegant deep teal embroidered traditional salwar kameez with gold detailing, matching trousers, and a sheer teal dupatta. Include exactly 2 depictions of the woman: 1 oversized close-up portrait in the upper torn-paper layer and 1 full-body walking figure in the lower street scene. 2117903200341232384.promptZh: 创作一幅高质量电影感（cinematic）双重曝光纸张撕裂拼贴肖像画，描绘一位美丽的年轻南亚女性，她拥有柔顺的深棕色长发，身着优雅的深青绿色刺绣传统萨尔瓦尔卡梅兹（salwar kameez），配以金色细节装饰、同色系长裤，以及一层薄透的青绿色杜帕塔（dupatta）。画面为竖构图，比例3:4，由一条锯齿状撕纸边缘水平横贯画面中央，呈对角线走向，将图像分为上下两部分。上半部分呈现一幅巨大的空灵特写（close-up）肖像，从肩部以上充满整个画幅，女子微微低头并侧转头部，肤色自然柔和，中分亮泽秀发，佩戴繁复华丽的金色朱姆卡耳环（jhumka earrings），背景为虚化的中性城市景观。下半部分呈现同一女子的全身形象，她正朝镜头方向行走在黄金时刻（golden hour）湿漉漉的城市街道中央，背景中有虚化的汽车、发光的车头灯、雾气缭绕的楼宇，以及远处温暖的阳光。保持真实的人体比例、电影感景深（depth of field）、富有情绪的暖色调布光（moody warm lighting）、具有倒影效果的沥青路面、微妙的焦外虚化（bokeh），以及精致的时尚杂志编辑风格（fashion editorial look）。画面中须严格包含该女子的2个形象：1个位于上方撕纸层中的超大尺寸特写（close-up）肖像，以及1个位于下方街景中的全身行走人像。不添加任何文字、水印、额外人物，亦不可采用卡通风格。

2117903200341232385.promptEn: Expressive watercolor and ink portrait of a young woman with voluminous auburn curls loosely gathered by the wind, dressed in an oversized cream cotton shirt. She turns slightly toward the viewer with a calm, thoughtful gaze, delicate features, scattered freckles, and luminous gray-blue eyes. Created in a contemporary mixed-media illustration style with fluid watercolor washes, organic pigment blooms, dynamic ink splashes, subtle paint drips, and textured brushwork. Soft transparent color layers blend naturally into a clean white canvas, featuring artistic bleeding edges, spontaneous splatter details, and an elegant handcrafted fine-art aesthetic. High detail, airy composition, gallery-quality illustration.
2117903200341232385.promptZh: 富有表现力的水彩与墨水肖像画，描绘一位年轻女性，她拥有蓬松的赤褐色卷发，被微风轻轻吹拂而松散地聚拢；身着一件 oversized 米色棉质衬衫。她微微侧身面向观者，神情平静而沉思，五官精致，脸上散布着雀斑，双眸呈明亮的灰蓝色。采用当代混合媒介插画风格（contemporary mixed-media illustration style）创作：水彩晕染（watercolor washes）流畅自然，颜料呈有机扩散状（organic pigment blooms），墨水泼溅（ink splashes）充满动感，颜料滴落（paint drips）细腻微妙，笔触富有肌理感（textured brushwork）。柔和透明的色彩层自然融合于洁净的白色画布之上，呈现艺术化的洇染边缘（artistic bleeding edges）、即兴的喷溅细节（spontaneous splatter details），以及优雅的手工精细艺术美感（elegant handcrafted fine-art aesthetic）。高细节（high detail），通透构图（airy composition），美术馆级插画（gallery-quality illustration）。

Ultra-realistic cinematic night portrait photography of a beautiful young woman standing at a luxury marble bathroom vanity in a high-rise penthouse overlooking a dazzling city skyline at night. She wears a glossy crimson-red off-shoulder satin top and relaxed cream-colored lounge pants. Long dark hair falls naturally across part of her face, creating a mysterious, effortless beauty aesthetic. She leans forward with both hands resting on the marble countertop, gazing softly into the mirror with a confident, intimate expression.
The scene is captured through a mirror reflection, showing both her reflected face and the back of her shoulder in the foreground. Floor-to-ceiling windows reveal a breathtaking cityscape filled with glowing skyscrapers, colorful neon lights, and sparkling urban bokeh. Warm indoor lighting mixes with cool city lights, creating rich contrast and depth.
Luxury skincare bottles, perfumes, cosmetics, and fresh flowers are scattered across the marble vanity, adding an upscale lifestyle atmosphere. A subtle flash reflection appears on the glass, producing dreamy starburst light effects and enhancing the candid social-media aesthetic.
Hyper-realistic skin texture, natural makeup, soft facial features, cinematic shadows, shallow depth of field, realistic reflections, premium fashion editorial style, luxury lifestyle photography, moody ambiance, high detail, ultra-sharp focus, professional full-frame camera, 50mm lens, f/1.8, HDR, magazine-quality image, Instagram influencer aesthetic, sophisticated urban elegance, vertical composition, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K resolution.
2117903200341232386.promptZh:
超写实电影感（cinematic）夜间人像摄影：一位美丽的年轻女性站在高层顶层公寓的奢华大理石浴室梳妆台前，窗外是璀璨夺目的城市天际线夜景。她身穿光泽感强烈的深红偏袒式缎面短上衣和宽松的米色休闲长裤。浓密乌黑的长发自然垂落，部分遮掩面部，营造出神秘而毫不费力的美感。她微微前倾，双手轻放于大理石台面上，目光柔和地望向镜中，神情自信而私密。

画面通过镜面反射呈现，既可见她镜中的面容，又可见前景中她肩部后方的轮廓。落地窗贯穿 floor-to-ceiling，展现令人屏息的城市景观——灯火通明的摩天大楼、五彩斑斓的霓虹灯，以及闪耀的城市焦外虚化（bokeh）。室内暖光与城市冷光交融，形成丰富对比与景深（depth of field）。

奢华护肤瓶、香水、化妆品及新鲜花卉散落在大理石梳妆台上，增添高端生活方式氛围。玻璃表面浮现一抹微妙的闪光反射，产生梦幻般的星芒光效（starburst light effects），强化真实自然的社交媒体（social-media）美学风格。

2117903200341232388.promptEn:
Goal: Create a widescreen screenshot-style image of a dark ComfyUI node graph demonstrating GPT image editing from a text instruction embedded in a mask.

Canvas: 1200×580 horizontal frame, dark charcoal grid background, cropped like a real workflow editor screenshot. Use crisp UI panels with rounded corners, subtle shadows, small sans-serif interface text, and colored connection cables.

Layout: Arrange exactly 7 visible workflow nodes from left to right across the canvas. Include 4 nodes on the left, 1 large central processing node, and 2 output/preview nodes on the right. Show blue image sockets and green mask sockets connected by curved wires.

Nodes and contents:
1. Top-left node titled “Load Image (from Outputs)”. It shows a green rectangular preview filled with a repeating circle/arc geometric pattern, size label “1536 × 1024”, and small controls including image selector, auto-refresh toggle, and refresh button.
2. Upper-middle-left node titled “Load Image”. It shows a white rectangular preview with thin black repeating overlapping circle pattern, size label “1536 × 1024”. Connect its blue IMAGE output to the central node image input.
3. Lower-middle-left node titled “Load Image (as Mask)”. It shows a dark preview with red pixel-like text reading “hello chatgpt” on the first line and “please make the image green” on the second line. The channel dropdown says “red”. Connect its green MASK output to the central node mask input.
4. Bottom-left node titled “Load Comfy Clipspace Mask”. Include controls labeled clipspace_file “latest” and invert_mask toggle, plus small image and mask sockets. This node is visible but not the main connection.
5. Center node titled “OpenAI GPT Image Direct”. It has inputs labeled image and mask; outputs labeled images, mask, and revised_prompts. The prompt textbox contains follow the instructions in the mask. Settings visible: model gpt-image-2, quality medium, size 1536x1024, custom_width 1024, custom_height 1024, n 1, output_format png. Connect its blue images output to Save Image, and its gray/green mask or revised prompt output down to Preview as Text.
6. Upper-right node titled “Save Image”. It shows filename_prefix “ComfyUI” and a result preview: the same circular pattern now colored bright green, with the black text instruction overlaid in the upper-left reading “hello chatgpt” and “please make the image green”; size label “1536 × 1024”.
7. Lower-right node titled “Preview as Text”, partially cropped at the bottom edge, connected from the central node’s revised_prompts output; show a small “source” label and a “Preview” area.

Visual style: Realistic UI screenshot, dark theme, subtle grid, rounded black-gray panels, white and gray interface labels, blue and green socket dots, curved blue/green connector lines. The generated image previews should look flat and procedural rather than photorealistic.

Constraints: Keep the exact workflow concept readable: a white patterned input image plus a mask containing text instructions produces a green patterned output. Do not add people, branding outside ComfyUI/OpenAI labels, extra nodes, or decorative elements.

2117903200341232389.promptEn:
Goal: Create a vertical Chinese business infographic poster explaining that AI image generation now achieves high Chinese text accuracy, transforming messy text into clear deliverables.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 poster, clean white background, playful hand-drawn editorial style with orange, green, black, and gray accents. Use thick sketch outlines, rounded speech bubbles, energetic doodle marks, and a friendly tech-explainer tone.

Layout: Center the composition around one large smartphone mockup showing a clean Chinese report page. On the left, show a gray “before” document panel full of garbled symbols and unreadable Chinese-like text. On the right, show a cheerful cartoon designer sitting behind a laptop, holding a stylus, with an excited fist pose. Add a large bright green check mark overlapping the lower center of the phone and foreground. Add a green circular badge in the upper right and an orange speech bubble below it. Put a large bottom headline inside an orange hand-drawn outline bubble.

Text content: Use exactly 5 main text areas. 1) Left gray speech bubble: “以前：乱码”. 2) Upper-right green badge: “95% 准确率”. 3) Right orange speech bubble: “现在：清晰”. 4) Phone screen title: “项目总结报告”. 5) Bottom headline: “中文准确率95%”.

Phone screen details: Show an iPhone-like black smartphone with notch and status bar time 9:41. Inside the report page, include 4 stacked content sections separated by thin gray dividers. Section 1 has an orange target icon and heading “项目目标”, followed by short Chinese body text about improving user experience, optimizing product functions, and strengthening system stability. Section 2 has a blue bar-chart icon and heading “关键成果”, followed by 3 bullet points: user satisfaction increased 32%, system performance improved 45%, issue response time shortened 50%. Section 3 has a green check icon and heading “主要结论”, followed by body text saying the project achieved expected goals and laid a solid foundation. Section 4 has a yellow lightbulb icon and heading “下一步计划”, followed by body text about continuous optimization and expanding application scenarios.

Left “before” area: Render a gray browser/document card with a top bar and multiple lines of broken characters, question marks, punctuation, and scattered Chinese characters, clearly unreadable. Add messy paper sheets, scribbles, and an envelope icon near the bottom left to emphasize disorganized documents.

Right character details: Create a cute young male cartoon designer with curly brown hair, fair skin, orange sweater, and simple expressive pose; the face may be left blank or softly obscured. He holds a black stylus in one hand and sits behind a gray laptop with a round sticker reading “设计师”. On the desk add exactly 3 foreground accessories: a spiral notebook with simple layout sketches and small color blocks, a black pen, and a white mug with an orange heart.

Visual style: Friendly Chinese social-media explainer poster, semi-flat vector illustration mixed with marker-like hand-drawn lines, soft shadows, rounded shapes, high readability, vibrant green check mark and orange headline emphasis. Keep the composition busy but legible, with no photorealism.

Constraints: Preserve the Chinese text exactly as specified, keep the smartphone report text crisp and readable, use exactly one central phone, one left messy document card, one designer character, one green check mark, one green badge, one orange speech bubble, and one bottom headline. Do not add watermarks, logos, QR codes, or extra main claims.

2117903200341232390.promptEn: Create a highly detailed vertical historical illustration of an old Chinese silk and brocade shop, titled conceptually Shen Family Silk Shop. The scene is viewed from inside the richly carved wooden shop looking out toward a sunlit traditional street. Use a refined painterly style with realistic proportions, intricate linework, warm sepia and muted gold tones, like a late-Qing/Republic-era historical illustration. Canvas is tall portrait, about 9:16. Show exactly 3 prominent human figures: 1 front-left male silk merchant in a dark brown traditional robe, hair tied in a topknot, leaning over a counter and lifting an ornate brocade roll; 1 midground male assistant or customer in a blue robe holding an open ledger and brush; 1 right-side woman outside the doorway in a red-orange robe holding a basket. Their faces should be deliberately obscured by smooth rectangular tan blur blocks with no facial features. In the background street, include a few softly painted pedestrians and traditional white-walled buildings with curved tiled roofs, kept small and atmospheric. The main object is a large unrolled silk brocade on the counter in blue-green and antique gold, covered with dense phoenix, cloud, floral, and scrolling patterns, metallic highlights, and embroidered texture. The shop interior should contain carved wooden shelves on the left packed with many visible fabric bolts, stacked folded textiles, rolled silk bundles, lacquered boxes, and small drawers; add hanging lanterns, carved lattice windows, painted wall panels, a bead curtain or tasseled shade near the doorway, and soft sunlight entering from the right. On the counter include exactly 8 types of visible shop objects: an abacus, a ceramic tea cup, a small porcelain bowl, paper tags and receipts, a string-tied bundle of documents, a metal lockbox, a decorative textile chest, and measuring tools. Emphasize antique craftsmanship, layered textiles, dust motes, warm backlighting, and dense historical detail. Avoid modern objects, electric lighting, readable signage, western clothing, and any clean digital UI elements.
2117903200341232390.promptZh: 创作一幅高度精细的竖版历史插画，描绘一家古老的中国丝绸与锦缎店铺，概念性标题为“沈氏丝绸店”。画面视角位于雕花繁复的木质店铺内部，向外眺望阳光明媚的传统街道。采用典雅的绘画风格，人物比例写实，线条细腻繁复，色调以温暖的棕褐色（sepia）与柔和的古金色（muted gold）为主，风格类似晚清至民国时期的历史插画。画布为高竖构图，比例约为9:16。画面中须精确呈现3个显著的人物形象：1位位于左前方的男性丝绸商人，身着深棕色传统长袍，发髻束于头顶，正俯身柜台，双手托起一卷华美锦缎；1位位于中景的男性助手或顾客，身着蓝色长袍，手持摊开的账簿与毛笔；1位位于右侧门框外的女性，身着红橙色长袍，手提一只竹篮。三人面部须以光滑矩形的浅褐色模糊块（tan blur blocks）刻意遮挡，不呈现任何五官细节。背景街道中需加入数名柔和晕染的行人，以及若干白墙黛瓦、屋脊微翘、覆以弧形青瓦的传统建筑，尺寸宜小，营造氛围感。画面核心物体为铺展于柜台上的大幅未卷起丝绸锦缎，主色为蓝绿色与古金色，满布凤凰、祥云、花卉及卷草纹样，饰有金属光泽高光与刺绣质感纹理。店铺内景左侧应设雕花木架，密布多卷可见布匹、叠放整齐的织物、捆扎的丝卷、漆器匣子及小型抽屉；另需添加悬挂式灯笼、雕花格窗、彩绘墙面镶板、门侧垂挂的珠帘或流苏遮阳帘，以及自右侧斜射入内的柔和阳光。柜台上须清晰呈现恰好8类店铺物品：算盘、陶瓷茶杯、小瓷碗、纸质标签与收据、绳捆文书束、金属锁箱、装饰性织物箱、量具。整体强调古法工艺感、织物层次感、浮尘微粒（dust motes）、暖色逆光（warm backlighting）及密集的历史细节。严禁出现现代物品、电灯照明、可辨识文字招牌、西式服装，以及任何洁净的数字界面（UI）元素。

2117903200341232391.promptEn: Create a dark cinematic fantasy battle illustration in a gritty semi-realistic painterly style. The scene is set in a ruined stone corridor at night, with broken masonry, black shadows, and a narrow cobblestone floor. In the foreground, show the back of a large dwarf warrior with long reddish-brown braided hair, heavy engraved metal shoulder armor, leather straps, and a hammer or axe handle gripped at the right edge; keep this foreground figure intentionally out of focus to create depth. In the midground, depict exactly two combatants locked in a dramatic clash: one enormous green-skinned orc warlord with tusks, pointed ears, scarred muscular arms, spiked dark armor, and a massive chipped battle axe raised in his left hand; and one agile young human knight with windblown blond hair, sharp determined expression, ornate dark armor, a torn black cape streaming behind him, and a sword braced against the orc at chest level. Add a bright orange-white spark burst where the sword strikes the orc armor, with flying embers and metal fragments radiating through the darkness. Use high contrast chiaroscuro lighting, warm sparks against cold green-black shadows, intricate armor detail, dynamic motion, dramatic perspective from behind the dwarf observer, shallow depth of field, no modern objects. Include a small elegant signature and date in the bottom-right corner reading June 8, 2026 and Oyagi.
2117903200341232391.promptZh: 创作一幅暗黑系电影感（cinematic）奇幻战斗插画，采用粗粝的半写实绘画风格（painterly style）。场景设定在夜晚一条损毁的石砌走廊中，布满碎裂的石块、浓重的黑色阴影，以及狭窄的鹅卵石地面。前景中，呈现一名高大矮人战士的背影：他留着长而红褐色的编发，身披厚重雕纹金属肩甲，配有皮革束带，右手紧握一柄战锤或战斧的柄部，位于画面右侧边缘；此前景人物需刻意虚化，以营造景深（depth of field）。中景中，精准描绘两名正在激烈交锋的战士：其一为一名体型魁梧的绿色皮肤兽人领主，长有獠牙与尖耳，双臂肌肉虬结且布满伤疤，身着带尖刺的深色铠甲，左手高举一柄巨大且刃口崩缺的战斧；其二为一名身手矫健的年轻人类骑士，金发被疾风扬起，神情锐利而坚毅，身着繁复雕饰的深色铠甲，身后拖曳着一面撕裂的黑色斗篷，手中长剑横架于胸前，正抵住兽人铠甲。在长剑击中兽人铠甲之处，添加一道明亮的橙白色火花迸发效果，伴随飞溅的火星与金属碎屑向四周黑暗中辐射散开。整体采用高对比度明暗对照法（chiaroscuro lighting），以温暖的火花映衬冷调的青绿色与黑色阴影，铠甲细节精微繁复，动作张力十足，构图视角取自矮人观察者后方，景深（depth of field）浅薄，画面中不得出现任何现代物品。右下角添加一处小巧雅致的签名与日期，内容为“June 8, 2026”和“Oyagi”。

2117903200341232392.promptEn:
Transform the uploaded face reference photo into a candid cinematic 35mm film photograph.

The face is the highest priority element. Preserve the person's exact facial identity, gender, age range, ethnicity, facial proportions, skin texture, eye details, hairstyle, hair color, facial structure, and natural expression from the reference photo. Do not alter or reinterpret the person's gender or defining facial characteristics.

Depict the subject sitting inside a subway train car, looking directly at the camera with a thoughtful, moody, introspective expression. The subject is naturally adjusting a white wired earphone in one ear, creating an authentic candid moment.

The image should feel like a spontaneous photograph captured by a stranger during a quiet commute. Natural posture, realistic body language, and subtle emotion are essential.

Wardrobe: realistic everyday fashion appropriate to the subject's gender and style. Casual jacket, sweater, hoodie, coat, or streetwear-inspired outfit. Keep the styling natural, timeless, and believable.

Lighting: soft ambient subway lighting mixed with warm golden highlights. The entire image should feature a distinct warm golden-yellow color grading inspired by vintage cinema and 1990s film photography.

Background: realistic subway train interior with metallic textures, windows, seats, poles, and subtle reflections. The background should remain softly blurred while maintaining recognizable subway details.

Atmosphere: nostalgic, cinematic, urban, emotional, and realistic. The image should feel like a lost frame from a 1990s coming-of-age film.

Composition: wide cinematic aspect ratio, medium shot, shallow depth of field, natural framing, razor-sharp focus on the face while the subway interior remains softly blurred.

Authentic Kodak 35mm film photography, vintage analog film grain, subtle motion imperfections, realistic skin texture, cinematic color grading, masterpiece, best quality, highly detailed, 8k.

Negative prompt: altered gender, gender swap, different face, distorted face, bad anatomy, extra limbs, duplicate person, unrealistic skin, cartoon, anime, CGI look, watermark, text, logo, modern smartphone selfie.
2117903200341232392.promptZh:
将上传的面部参考照片转化为一张自然抓拍风格的电影感35mm胶片摄影照片。

面部是最优先的元素。完整保留人物精确的面部身份、性别、年龄范围、种族、面部比例、皮肤质感、眼部细节、发型、发色、面部结构以及参考照片中的自然表情。不得修改或重新诠释人物的性别或决定性面部特征。

描绘主体坐在地铁车厢内，直视镜头，神情沉思、忧郁、内省。主体正自然地将一只白色有线耳机插入一只耳朵，营造出真实自然的抓拍瞬间。

图像应呈现出一种由陌生人在安静通勤途中偶然捕捉到的即兴摄影感。自然姿态、真实肢体语言与细腻情绪至关重要。

服饰：符合主体性别与个人风格的真实日常穿搭。休闲夹克、毛衣、连帽衫、大衣或受街头文化启发的造型。保持整体造型自然、经典且可信。

布光：柔和的地铁环境光混合温暖的金色高光。整幅图像需呈现鲜明的暖金色调（color grading），灵感源自复古电影与1990年代胶片摄影。

背景：真实的地铁车厢内部场景，包含金属质感、车窗、座椅、扶杆及细微反光。背景需保持柔和虚化（bokeh），同时仍可清晰辨认地铁细节。

氛围：怀旧、电影感、都市感、情感充沛且真实。图像应宛如一部1990年代青春成长题材电影中遗失的一帧画面。

构图：宽幅电影感画幅（cinematic aspect ratio）、中景（medium shot）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、自然取景（natural framing）、面部锐利聚焦（razor-sharp focus on the face），而地铁内部则保持柔和虚化（bokeh）。

真实柯达（Kodak）35mm胶片摄影风格、复古模拟胶片颗粒（film grain）、细微运动瑕疵、真实皮肤质感、电影感色彩分级（cinematic color grading）、杰作、最佳画质、高度细节化、8k。

负面提示词：性别更改、性别互换、不同面孔、面部扭曲、解剖结构错误、多余肢体、重复人物、不真实皮肤、卡通、动漫、CGI效果、水印、文字、标志、现代智能手机自拍照。

Layout and pose count: Include exactly 15 distinct poses, one per panel, arranged left to right, top to bottom:

2117903200341232400.promptZh: 创作一幅竖构图的动漫风格插画，描绘一名无脸的女学生独自站在雨中，采用高俯视角度拍摄，仿佛镜头正从上方俯瞰她。她拥有一头长而飘逸的银灰色秀发，身穿整洁的日式校服：深蓝色西装外套、白色衬衫、绿色条纹领带、百褶深蓝色短裙、黑色紧身袜，以及光亮的黑色乐福鞋。她的面部被刻意以柔和的方形模糊效果或无特征的马赛克遮挡，但姿态依然温婉沉静，微微仰头向上凝望。她手持一把大型透明乙烯基材质雨伞，伞骨为可见的金属结构，手柄呈弯曲状且为黑色；伞面布满雨滴，并带有晶莹闪烁的高光。场景设定在一场大雨过后的湿滑石板步道上，水洼中倒映着明亮的蓝天、白云、四周的葱郁绿植，以及一道斜向横跨画面前景下方的彩虹倒影。右侧添加一道深色栏杆，右上方投下枝叶繁茂的绿色阴影，画面中散布着零星雨滴、涟漪，以及如镜面般清晰的路面倒影。整体采用精致的日式动漫／轻小说封面视觉风格（Japanese anime / light-novel key visual style），水效刻画高度细致，呈现清透的蓝灰色雨天氛围（luminous blue-gray rainy atmosphere），云隙间透出柔和阳光（soft sunlight breaking through clouds），构图富有电影感（cinematic composition），线条细腻精巧（delicate linework），画面中不出现任何文字或水印。

2117903200341232401.promptEn:
Goal: Create a realistic smartphone photo of a lined notebook page on a wooden desk, showing a handwritten software/data-structure homework answer sheet in slightly messy but believable black gel-pen handwriting. The page title should be centered near the top as 第五章答案. Make it look like an actual photo submitted for class, with small imperfections, uneven writing, mild page curvature, shadows, and perspective distortion.

Canvas and camera: Vertical 3:4 photo, shot from above at a slight angle. The main notebook page fills most of the frame, tilted very slightly. The lighting is warm indoor desk lighting, with soft shadows and a realistic phone-camera look, not a flat scan.

Scene details: Use an open notebook with pale gray horizontal ruled lines and rounded page corners. A partial previous page is visible along the left edge. The notebook rests on a medium-brown wooden desk. On the right side, place a black transparent-bodied gel pen vertically near the lower-right edge, and a small white eraser with gray smudges near the upper-right corner. Add a few tiny eraser crumbs or paper debris scattered around the eraser. Keep the page off-white with subtle texture.

Handwritten content: Use Chinese handwritten notes mixed with math and C-style pseudocode. The handwriting should be neat enough to read but intentionally slightly casual and uneven, with natural spacing and occasional slant variation. Write exactly 3 numbered answer sections:

1. Section 1 contains exactly 2 subitems:
   - “(1) 叶结点数 = (k-1)m + 1。”
   - “(2) 最多结点数 = (k^h - 1)/(k - 1)，最少结点数 = k(h-1)+1。”

2. Section 2 defines WPL and contains a short explanation plus exactly 5 pseudocode lines. Write:
   - “WPL：遍历二叉树，遇到叶子就加 weight × depth，”
   - “根深度为 0。”
   - “代码大意:”
   Then center or indent the following 5 code lines beneath it:
   - “if(root == NULL) return 0;”
   - “if(!root->left && !root->right)”
   - “return root->weight * depth;”
   - “return WPL(root->left, depth+1) +”
   - “WPL(root->right, depth+1);”

3. Section 3 contains exactly 5 handwritten lines describing binary tree and forest conversion:
   - “二叉树根为 A，左子树 B-D-E-H,”
   - “右子树 C-F，其中 F下有 I、G，I下有 M,”
   - “M下有 K，G下有 J，J下有 L。”
   - “森林按左孩子右兄弟关系转换即可。”
   The section number “3.” should start on the left margin, with the text continuing across the lower half of the page.

Visual style: Photorealistic, natural shadows, realistic lined paper, black ink, casual student handwriting. The writing should look handwritten rather than printed or typeset. Slightly imperfect alignment with ruled lines is desirable.

Constraints: Do not add extra diagrams, stamps, watermarks, decorative graphics, or typed fonts. Keep exactly 3 numbered sections, exactly 2 subitems in section 1, exactly 5 pseudocode lines in section 2, and the listed Chinese homework text only.

2117903200341232402.promptEn: Create a highly detailed vertical anime illustration set on a sunny Harajuku fashion street, in front of pastel boutique storefronts and gothic fashion shops. Show exactly two young women seated at a small round glass café table: on the left, a sweet lolita girl with blonde twin-drill pigtails, oversized pastel lace bows, a frilly pink-and-lavender Angelic Pretty style dress, lace gloves, pink platform shoes, and pastel shopping bags; on the right, a wa-gothic girl with long black hair with purple highlights, an ornate floral kanzashi hairpiece with red tassels, a black kimono-inspired gothic lolita dress with purple floral patterns, sheer lace sleeves, corset belts, layered necklaces, black platform boots, and a dark Atelier Pierrot shopping bag. Both faces should be obscured by soft square blur blocks, as if anonymized in a street snapshot. The table must contain exactly four visible desserts/drinks: 1) a heart-topped strawberry shortcake on a plate, 2) a tall matcha parfait with green soft serve, mochi and red bean, 3) a pink cream soda or strawberry float with a cherry and straw, and 4) a folded rainbow crepe drizzled with chocolate and sprinkles. Include exactly five prominent readable background signs: 1) a pink heart shop sign reading “Angelic Pretty,” 2) a street arch reading “HARAJUKU,” 3) a black shop sign reading “ATELIER PIERROT,” 4) a chalkboard café menu sign with hearts and dessert items, and 5) a black wa-gothic sign with the large Japanese character “和” and the word “GOTHIC.” Use a dreamy GPT-image-2 anime aesthetic with intricate lace, ribbons, jewelry, glass reflections, sunlight, pastel pink storefronts, crowded pedestrian street depth, blue sky, and high-fashion magazine composition. Camera angle is slightly above table height, vertical 2:3 framing, characters filling the foreground, detailed desserts centered, Harajuku street receding into the background. Style should be polished, luminous, hyper-detailed, cute yet elegant, with no watermark and no extra characters seated at the table.
2117903200341232402.promptZh: 在阳光明媚的原宿时尚街道上，创作一幅高度精细的竖版动漫插画，背景为柔和粉彩色调的精品店橱窗和哥特风时装店。画面中需精确呈现两位年轻女性坐在一张小型圆形玻璃咖啡馆桌旁：左侧是一位甜系洛丽塔风格少女，金色双螺旋麻花辫，佩戴超大号柔粉色蕾丝蝴蝶结，身穿荷叶边粉紫色Angelic Pretty风格连衣裙，搭配蕾丝手套、粉色厚底鞋，以及柔粉色购物袋；右侧是一位和风哥特少女，长黑发带有紫色挑染，头戴繁复花卉纹样簪子（kanzashi），缀有红色流苏，身穿黑色和风灵感哥特洛丽塔连衣裙，饰有紫色花卉图案、透明蕾丝袖、束腰腰带、多层项链，脚踩黑色厚底靴，手提深色Atelier Pierrot购物袋。两人面部须以柔和方形模糊块遮挡，模拟街拍快照中的匿名化处理效果。桌面上必须清晰可见四款甜点/饮品：1）盘中摆放的草莓奶油蛋糕，顶部装饰心形奶油；2）高杯抹茶芭菲，含绿色软冰淇淋、麻薯与红豆；3）粉红色奶油苏打或草莓浮冰，配樱桃与吸管；4）折叠彩虹可丽饼，淋巧克力酱并撒彩糖粒。背景中须精确呈现五块醒目且文字清晰可读的招牌：1）粉色心形店铺招牌，文字为“Angelic Pretty,”；2）街道拱门招牌，文字为“HARAJUKU,”；3）黑色店铺招牌，文字为“ATELIER PIERROT,”；4）黑板风格咖啡馆菜单招牌，绘有心形图案与甜点项目；5）黑色和风哥特风格招牌，中央为大幅日文字符“和”，下方标注英文单词“GOTHIC.”。整体风格采用梦幻感GPT-image-2动漫美学（GPT-image-2 anime aesthetic），强调繁复蕾丝、缎带、珠宝细节、玻璃反光、阳光漫射、柔粉店铺立面、行人熙攘的街道纵深感、湛蓝天空，以及高端时尚杂志构图（high-fashion magazine composition）。拍摄角度略高于桌面高度，采用竖向2:3画幅比例，人物占据前景，精致甜点居中呈现，原宿街道向背景深处延伸。整体风格须精致、明亮、超精细（hyper-detailed）、可爱又优雅，不得添加水印，桌上不得出现额外人物。

2117903200341232403.promptEn:
Create a vertical cinematic tutorial comparison poster showing the same urban street scene repeated in five horizontal panels, each panel demonstrating a different film genre color grading style. The scene is a busy small city street at sunset, with cars, motorcycles, cyclists, shop buildings, electric poles, tangled overhead wires, and warm evening sky. Keep the camera angle exactly the same in every panel, like a fixed street photography shot.

Each horizontal strip should have a different cinematic mood and color tone:

Panel 1: SUSPENSE - cool blue shadows, dark contrast, slightly mysterious atmosphere, tense and moody lighting.
Panel 2: ACTION - warm orange sunset tone, high contrast, energetic cinematic look, dramatic highlights.
Panel 3: CRIME - cold teal blue grading, darker exposure, gritty urban feeling, realistic shadows.
Panel 4: ROMANCE - soft golden warm tone, gentle contrast, nostalgic sunset mood, dreamy atmosphere.
Panel 5: DRAMA - muted purple blue evening tone, emotional cinematic lighting, soft shadows and serious mood.
Add bold white uppercase text on the right side of each panel: SUSPENSE, ACTION, CRIME, ROMANCE, DRAMA. Use clean modern sans serif typography with slight glow or subtle shadow. Separate each panel with thin white horizontal borders. Make it look like a professional filmmaking color grading tutorial thumbnail, cinematic, realistic, high detail, urban street photography, 9:16 vertical composition.
Negative Prompt: cartoon, anime, painting, low quality, blurry, distorted buildings, extra text, wrong spelling, messy typography, overexposed, unrealistic colors, duplicated cars, warped street, bad perspective, random objects, low resolution, watermark

2117903200341232404.promptEn: Create an ultra-realistic square portrait of a young woman standing outdoors at night on a wet dark stone pavement, centered from mid-thigh upward. She has sleek long dark hair braided over one shoulder, wears a fitted black leather biker jacket with silver zippers and red plaid pants, with dangling silver earrings. Her hands are gently cupped in front of her chest, holding a small glowing neon yellow butterfly that emits warm radiant light onto her palms, jacket, and face. Behind her is a deep navy night-sky backdrop filled with bright neon doodles: exactly 2 large crescent moons, one cyan on the upper left and one pale yellow on the upper right; exactly 10 outlined neon stars in cyan, pink, and yellow scattered around; and exactly 8 small glowing dot lights in cyan, pink, and yellow. Use cinematic photorealism, shallow depth of field, glossy leather highlights, realistic skin and fabric texture, strong neon rim lighting, high contrast, soft bloom around all neon elements, and a dreamy magical atmosphere. Keep the composition symmetrical and clean, with the butterfly as the main light source and the woman looking down toward it. No text, no watermark, no extra people.
2117903200341232404.promptZh: 创作一幅超写实的正方形肖像画，描绘一位年轻女子夜晚站在湿漉漉的深色石板地面上，构图居中，画面范围从她大腿中部向上。她拥有一头柔顺修长的黑发，编成一条辫子垂于一侧肩头；身穿合身的黑色皮质机车夹克，配有银色拉链，下穿红色格纹长裤，耳垂上悬挂着银色流苏耳饰。她的双手轻柔地捧在胸前，托着一只微微发光的霓虹黄色蝴蝶，蝴蝶散发出温暖而明亮的辉光，照亮她的掌心、夹克和面部。她身后是一片深海军蓝的夜空背景，布满明亮的霓虹涂鸦：左上方恰好有2枚新月形图案，一枚为青色，一枚为浅黄色；周围恰好分布着10颗轮廓清晰的霓虹星星，颜色为青色、粉色与黄色；另有恰好8颗微小的发光圆点，颜色亦为青色、粉色与黄色。采用电影感写实风格（cinematic photorealism）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、皮革高光质感（glossy leather highlights）、逼真的肌肤与织物纹理（realistic skin and fabric texture）、强烈的霓虹边缘光（neon rim lighting）、高对比度（high contrast）、所有霓虹元素周围呈现柔和辉光（soft bloom）、以及梦幻而魔幻的氛围（dreamy magical atmosphere）。构图保持对称与简洁，蝴蝶作为主光源，女子目光低垂凝视蝴蝶。画面中不得出现文字、水印或额外人物。

2117903200341232405.promptEn: Create a cinematic surreal fine-art scene inspired by a luminous cello sonata, with a cello standing upright on the left side of a shallow reflective water floor. The instrument is dark amber varnished wood with realistic curves, strings, bridge, endpin, and glossy highlights, surrounded by glowing golden-white ribbons of music and tiny sparkling particles that stream outward from its body in a graceful wave across the image. On the right side, place a solitary human figure in dark silhouette, sitting cross-legged and contemplative on the wet floor, facing the instrument and the light. Behind the figure is a huge warm circular moon or sun disk glowing through tall translucent architectural panels, creating a peaceful, breathing atmosphere. The setting is an expansive indoor dreamscape with vertical glass walls, misty teal-gray shadows, rainlike hanging droplets suspended from thin threads, and a mirrorlike flooded floor reflecting the cello, figure, moon, and light trails. Use a wide 16:9 composition, low horizon, dramatic contrast between cool blue-gray darkness and warm gold illumination, volumetric light, soft haze, ultra-detailed cinematic realism, poetic magical realism, elegant orchestral mood, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341232405.promptZh: 创作一幅受明亮大提琴奏鸣曲启发的电影感超现实精细艺术（fine-art）场景：左侧，一把大提琴直立于浅层反光水面地板上。乐器为深琥珀色漆面木材，具有真实曲线、琴弦、琴桥、尾柱及高光光泽表面；其周身环绕着发光的金白色音乐缎带与细小闪烁粒子，如优雅波浪般自琴体向外流淌贯穿全图。右侧，置一孤寂人形剪影，身着深色衣装，盘腿静坐于湿润地面，面向乐器与光源，神情沉思内省。人形后方，一轮巨大温暖的圆形月亮或太阳圆盘透过高耸半透明建筑面板透射而出，营造出宁静、呼吸般的氛围。场景设于开阔室内梦境空间，配有垂直玻璃墙、雾状青灰阴影、如雨滴般悬垂于纤细丝线上的水珠，以及镜面般泛滥的水面地板——倒映出大提琴、人形、月轮及光迹。采用宽幅16:9构图（16:9 composition）、低地平线（low horizon）、冷蓝灰暗部与暖金色光照之间形成强烈戏剧性对比（dramatic contrast）、体积光（volumetric light）、柔焦薄雾（soft haze）、超精细电影感写实主义（ultra-detailed cinematic realism）、诗意魔幻现实主义（poetic magical realism）、典雅管弦乐氛围（elegant orchestral mood），画面不含文字（no text）、无水印（no watermark）。

2117903200341232406.promptEn: Create a high-end black neo-Chinese fashion magazine cover illustration in a vertical 9:16 composition. Show a poised young woman standing in a minimalist architectural set, viewed from a slightly low angle for a powerful editorial presence. She has long loose black hair, slightly wind-tousled and a cold, aloof, confident attitude, with the face softly obscured or painterly rather than overly beautified. Dress her in a structured black new-Chinese trench-coat robe with a high collar, wrap front, wide sleeves, tied waist sash, long flowing skirt panels, subtle glossy geometric splicing, and faint bamboo embroidery on one hip. Her left hand rests on a sharp gray concrete parapet while her right hand lightly grips the lapel near her chest. Use cool daylight, crisp shadows, and a pale gray-blue wall background with a large diagonal beam of light across the upper left. The color palette is strictly black, charcoal, slate gray, and cold blue-white highlights. Style it as premium fashion editorial photography mixed with refined digital illustration: dramatic fabric folds, semi-gloss black surfaces, realistic proportions, cinematic contrast, clean negative space, no visible text, no logo, no watermark. Emphasize cold, elegant, slightly arrogant, and avant-garde.
2117903200341232406.promptZh: 创作一幅高端黑色新中式时尚杂志封面插画，竖构图，比例为9:16。画面呈现一位仪态端庄的年轻女性，立于极简主义建筑场景中，采用略低角度（low angle）拍摄，以营造强烈的时尚编辑感。她拥有一头长而松散的黑发，略带风拂凌乱感，神情冷峻、疏离而自信，面部处理偏柔和朦胧或具绘画感（painterly），而非过度美化。她身着一件结构感强的黑色新中式风战壕大衣式长袍：高领、前襟裹绕式设计、宽袖、束腰绸带、垂坠飘逸的长裙摆、微妙的光泽几何拼接细节，以及臀部一侧若隐若现的竹纹刺绣。她的左手轻搭在一道锋利的灰白色混凝土矮墙（parapet）上，右手则轻握胸前衣襟翻领处。采用清冷日光照明，阴影清晰锐利；背景为浅灰蓝色墙面，并有一道宽阔的斜向光束自左上方倾泻而下。整体配色严格限定为黑色、炭灰色、石板灰及冷调蓝白色高光。风格融合高端时尚杂志摄影（premium fashion editorial photography）与精炼数字插画（refined digital illustration）：布料褶皱富有戏剧性（dramatic fabric folds）、黑色表面呈半光泽（semi-gloss black surfaces）、人体比例写实（realistic proportions）、具备电影感对比度（cinematic contrast）、留白干净（clean negative space），画面中不出现任何文字、无品牌标识、无水印。着重传达冷感、优雅、略带傲慢与前卫先锋气质。

2117903200341232408.promptEn:
Title: Elegant Serenity
Subject: A young woman with striking green eyes, soft facial features, and light brown hair tied back with a few loose strands framing her face. She has a neutral, calm expression looking directly at the camera.
Clothing & Accessories: Wearing a simple black long-sleeve top and a delicate, thin gold necklace with a tiny pendant.

In the background, there is a wooden table with terracotta pots, small ceramic figurines, dried lavender, and eucalyptus leaves. The wall features framed botanical sketches and a large abstract canvas. A warm, natural light streams in from a window.

2117903200341232408.promptZh:
标题：优雅宁静  
主体：一位年轻女性，拥有引人注目的绿色眼睛、柔和的面部轮廓，浅棕色头发向后扎起，几缕松散发丝轻柔地垂落在脸庞两侧；神情中性而平静，直视镜头。  
服装与配饰：身穿一件简约黑色长袖上衣，佩戴一条纤细精致的金色项链，吊坠小巧。

2117903200341232411.promptEn:
A natural candid moment captured in authentic daily life photography, shot at extreme close range inside a 1933 Shanghai industrial complex. The camera presses intimately close to the subject's face, which rests against a vast rust-stained cast iron wall whose surface dominates the frame — a landscape of deep ochre, burnt umber, and oxidized copper-green patina alive with peeling rust flakes, ancient bolt-heads, and streaked mineral deposits.

The young Japanese woman appears to be in her early twenties, her fair translucent cool-beige skin — somewhere in the NC10 to NC15 range — rendered with visible skin subsurface scattering beneath the hard directional window light, warmth diffusing softly beneath the surface. Specular micro-highlights catch precisely on her cheekbones and along her narrow nose ridge, and fine foundation powder grain is perceptible in the brightest zones of her skin. Her almond-shaped eyes carry soft natural single eyelids, and her refined nose tip holds a clean, delicate line against the corroded iron behind her.

The leather jacket collar is barely visible at the lower edge of the frame, its dark material grazing the jaw line in an unplanned, not geometrically symmetrical way. Two or three stray hairs from her fine straight black hair have been displaced by the faintest air movement, lying loosely across her cheek and temple — a natural imperfection that grounds the image in a real, unrepeatable instant. Her head tilts slightly back, her eyes closed, her expression drawn inward into some private quiet state. The grid pattern of a nearby window casts strong, high-contrast bars of light and shadow directly across her face, fracturing it into warm illuminated planes and deep cool shadow.

The light is hard and architectural, sourced from industrial-paned glass somewhere off-frame, creating a theatrical chiaroscuro that feels accidental rather than arranged. Subtle ISO 400 film grain is visible throughout the shadow areas — photographic noise texture, not CG render smoothness — embedding the image in an analog sensibility that honors the century-old space around her. Aspect ratio 2:3. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.
2117903200341232411.promptZh:
真实日常摄影风格捕捉的自然抓拍瞬间，拍摄于1933年上海工业厂房内部，采用极近距离（extreme close range）构图。相机紧贴被摄者面部，其面颊倚靠在一面巨大、锈迹斑斑的铸铁墙面上，墙面占据整个画面——这是一片由深赭石色、烧褐色与氧化铜绿色铜锈构成的肌理景观，表面布满剥落的锈片、古老的螺栓头以及条状矿物沉积。

这位年轻的日本女性约二十出头，肤色为清透冷调米 beige（介于NC10至NC15色号之间），在硬朗的方向性窗光（hard directional window light）照射下，可见皮肤下的次表面散射（subsurface scattering）效果，暖意柔和地弥散于表皮之下。高光（specular micro-highlights）精准落在她的颧骨及窄挺鼻梁上，最明亮区域的肌肤上还可辨识出细腻的粉底颗粒感（foundation powder grain）。她呈杏仁形的双眼带有柔和自然的单眼皮，精致的鼻尖线条干净利落，在身后腐蚀斑驳的铸铁映衬下更显纤巧。

皮革夹克领口仅在画面底部边缘隐约可见，深色材质以非计划性、非几何对称的方式轻擦过下颌线。她细直乌黑的发丝中有两三根被最轻微的气流扰动，松散地横卧于面颊与太阳穴之上——这一自然瑕疵将画面牢牢锚定于某个真实、不可复现的瞬间。她的头部微微后仰，双目闭合，神情向内收敛，沉浸于某种私密而宁静的状态。附近一扇窗户的网格结构在她脸上投下强烈、高对比度的明暗条纹，将面部切割为温暖明亮的受光面与幽深冷调的阴影区。

光线坚硬而具有建筑感（architectural），源自画外某处工业风格玻璃窗，营造出戏剧性的明暗对照法（chiaroscuro），却呈现出偶然而非刻意安排的观感。阴影区域中弥漫着细微的ISO 400胶片颗粒（film grain）——这是摄影噪点质感（photographic noise texture），而非CG渲染式的平滑感——使整幅图像浸润于模拟影像（analog）的感知语境之中，致敬其周遭百年历史空间的真实质地。画幅比例2:3。无水印，无文字叠加，非卡通风格，非数字绘画（digitally painted），非插画（illustration），非动漫（anime）。

Show exactly four main objects arranged left to right: 1) a small vintage tabletop image-printing press labeled “illo” in lowercase on its front, with a crank on the left, rollers on top, and a sheet of paper emerging from the lower front; the printed sheet contains one simple landscape picture with a black sun/circle, black mountains, and pink diagonal shading; 2) a cute small robot mascot in the center with a rounded square head, black screen face, two white oval eyes, tiny body, arms, legs, and one antenna ending in a pink circle; 3) a chunky rectangular battery/power pack on the right labeled “Codex” with smaller text “subscription”, two top terminals colored black and pink, and a pink lightning bolt above it; 4) a small wall outlet/power block at the far right with one socket and one button-like top knob. 2117903200341232435.promptEn:
Goal: Create a clean whiteboard hand-drawn explainer illustration about turning messy tool overload into reusable GPT image skills. Use a playful black marker sketch style with selective red-orange accents and a few yellow highlights.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal canvas, white background, generous margins, centered composition. Hand-drawn black outlines, slightly imperfect marker strokes, minimal shading, no photorealism.

Title: At the top center, write the large handwritten headline 挖场景，造 Skills. Use bold black brush lettering, underline it with one red-orange curved stroke, and add two small red-orange emphasis marks on each side of the title.

Layout: Arrange the story as a left-to-right workflow with three main illustrated scenes connected by bold black arrows. Scene 1 on the left shows confusion and too many tools; scene 2 in the center shows analyzing the work scenario; scene 3 on the right shows a simplified skill-building pipeline.

Scene 1: Draw a confused young person with short black hair scratching their head, a question mark beside them, and a scribbly frustration cloud above. They stand behind a large open box labeled 更多工具. The box is overflowing with exactly 18 small red-orange cartoon crawfish/lobsters as a metaphor for too many tools: 15 visible inside or on the rim of the box and 3 outside near the bottom/left edges. Each crawfish has simple black eyes, claws, and segmented bodies. Add small motion lines around the box.

Scene 2: Draw the same young person leaning over a table with a magnifying glass, studying a paper workflow map. The paper contains a hand-drawn process diagram with exactly 10 small rounded rectangles/nodes, thin black connector arrows, and a few red dashed boxes and red arrows marking important points. Add a small sticky note on the lower left of the paper. In front of the table, place a rectangular label card reading 工作场景.

Scene 3: Draw the same young person smiling and holding or leaning on the first card of a pipeline. The pipeline contains exactly 4 visible cards/icons arranged horizontally: card 1 with a magnifying glass icon and label 挖场景; card 2 with a toolbox/wrench icon and label 造 Skill; card 3 with an upward bar chart and red rising arrow icon labeled 持续优化; card 4 is a small rounded square success card with a red-orange checkmark, surrounded by short yellow radiating lines and sparkle marks. Connect the cards with bold black arrows.

Visual style: Simple black-and-white whiteboard illustration, friendly Notion-like doodle proportions, rounded characters, thick marker outlines, sparse red-orange accent color on crawfish, arrows, tools, underlines, and chart arrow. Keep the background empty and uncluttered.

Constraints: Preserve the left-to-right narrative and the exact counts of the three main scenes, 18 crawfish/lobsters, 10 workflow nodes, and 4 pipeline cards. Do not add extra panels, logos, watermarks, or dense explanatory text.

2117903200341232443.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cinematic anime manga-style action comic page showing a magical duel at a moonlit Shinto shrine, with two rival sorcerers facing off using contrasting energy powers.

Canvas: Square 1:1 comic page with a thin white outer margin and four rounded-rectangle panels separated by white gutters. Use clean inked line art, cel-shaded anime coloring, dramatic night lighting, cool blue shadows, and glowing spell effects.

Layout: Use exactly 4 panels. Panel 1 is a wide establishing shot across the full top half-width area, showing the shrine courtyard under a crescent moon. Panel 2 is another wide horizontal panel beneath it, a close action standoff. Panels 3 and 4 are two smaller equal-width panels along the bottom row.

Characters: Two young adult Japanese-style fantasy sorcerers. The left character is a female spellcaster named purple-robed shrine mage, wearing layered black and deep purple kimono-style robes, a purple sash, sandals, and dark hair tied back with purple ribbons; she casts glowing magenta paper talismans and violet barrier magic. The right character is a male spellcaster named green-robed wind sorcerer, wearing a dark green kimono robe with gold trim, loose hakama pants, sandals, short dark tousled hair, and glowing golden ring-like charms around his hands; he controls pale white wind spirals and golden energy loops. Keep both faces slightly simplified or softly obscured, not detailed portraits.

Panel details: Panel 1: wide establishing view of the shrine courtyard at night, stone paving, stairs, torii gates, lanterns, trees, shrine buildings, and a bright crescent moon centered high in the sky; the female mage stands on the left with violet talismans, the male wind sorcerer stands on the right with golden rings, both poised before the duel. Panel 2: close-up action composition, female on the left thrusting one hand forward while magenta paper talismans swirl around her, male on the right raising one hand defensively while a huge white wind vortex sweeps across the frame from right to left, with golden rings around his wrists. Panel 3: bottom-left impact panel, the female mage projects a bright purple circular portal or shield, while the male sorcerer counters with a sweeping golden wind arc that strikes the barrier, scattering dust, leaves, and sparks. Panel 4: bottom-right aftermath panel, both characters stand farther apart in the shrine courtyard; a vertical glowing purple oval barrier floats between them, the male watches from the right with golden hand loops, the moon and shrine steps visible behind them.

Visual style: polished anime comic illustration, dynamic perspective, expressive cloth motion, speed lines, glowing particles, transparent magical rings, high contrast between violet magic and golden wind, detailed shrine architecture, rounded black panel borders, no speech bubbles, no captions, no readable text, no logos, no watermark.

Customization: Set the environment as a moonlit Shinto shrine courtyard, the female magic color as violet magenta, and the male magic color as gold and pale white.

Behind her, place one glossy black grand piano half-submerged in the lake with its lid open, reflecting moonlit teal highlights; water should cascade and splash over the piano strings and rim as if the instrument is part of the lake. In the foreground water, include exactly one ornate silver dagger or short sword with a jeweled gold-and-turquoise hilt lying partly submerged, hinting at betrayal. Add exactly two golden fish swimming on the right side, exactly six white water lilies with yellow centers distributed across the lake surface, and many dark green lily pads. The water should form magical circular currents around the musician and piano, filled with sparkling golden motes, tiny glowing musical-note-like trails, turquoise reflections, and luminous ripples. Mood: romantic, mysterious, tragic, inspired by Carl Reinecke’s Undine Sonata, where the flute feels like the voice of a dangerous water spirit and the piano feels like protective dark water. 2117903200341232446.promptZh:
创作一幅电影感（cinematic）奇幻插画，描绘水精灵（undine）——一位站在幽暗魔法德式森林湖泊中的齐腰深水里的长笛演奏者，时间是黄昏。她身着飘逸半透明的蓝绿色长裙，裙摆如丝绸般与漩涡状水流融为一体，湿漉漉的布料泛着微光，袖口缀有精致珠饰；她拥有一头长长的波浪状棕发，发间点缀着细小的蓝色花朵；她的面部被刻意模糊处理，呈现为一个柔和中性的方形虚化（square blur），无任何五官特征。她将一支银质音乐会长笛水平横置于唇边吹奏。  
在她身后，湖中半淹没着一架亮黑色三角钢琴，琴盖敞开，映出月光下的青绿色（teal）高光；湖水正从琴弦与琴缘倾泻飞溅，仿佛这架乐器本就是湖泊的一部分。  
前景水面中，精确放置一把华丽银质匕首或短剑，其柄部镶嵌黄金与绿松石宝石，部分没入水中，暗示背叛。  
右侧水中恰好游动着两条金色鱼；湖面散布着恰好六朵白色睡莲，花心为明黄色；此外还有大量深绿色睡莲叶。  
水面围绕演奏者与钢琴形成魔法般的环形水流，其中充满闪烁的金色微粒、微小发光的音符状轨迹（musical-note-like trails）、青绿色（turquoise）倒影以及明亮涟漪。  
湖泊四周环绕着高耸阴暗的常绿针叶树、覆满青苔的树干、浓郁的森林绿色（forest greens）、薄雾，以及自林冠间隙斜射而下的清冷阳光光束（shafts of cool sunlight）。  
氛围：浪漫、神秘、悲怆，灵感源自卡尔·赖内克（Carl Reinecke）的《水妖奏鸣曲》（Undine Sonata）——长笛声宛如危险水灵之语，钢琴声则似守护性的幽暗水域。  
采用超精细绘画写实风格（ultra-detailed painterly realism）、戏剧性宽幅16:9构图（dramatic wide 16:9 composition）、高对比度青绿色与金色调色（high contrast teal-and-gold color grading）、体积光（volumetric light）、清晰锐利的水效（crisp water effects），画面中不含文字、无水印。

2117903200341232455.promptEn:
Goal: Create a wide 21:9 storyboard image for a 15-second Japanese 2D anime cooking short about making tonjiru set meal. The image should look like a very rough pencil storyboard drawn quickly by hand, messy and unfinished, with black graphite lines on a white background, no color, no clean inking, no shading beyond loose scribbles, and visible sketch construction marks.

Canvas: Ultra-wide horizontal 21:9 composition, divided into exactly 12 rectangular storyboard panels arranged in a 3-row by 4-column grid. Use thin hand-drawn panel borders with slight wobble. Keep the whole sheet monochrome and rough.

Layout and panel count: Show exactly 12 discrete cooking shots, left to right, top to bottom:
1. Close-up of hands slicing a daikon radish or large white root vegetable on a cutting board with a chef knife; several round slices on the left.
2. Close-up of a hand and knife cutting small crescent slices of another vegetable, with chopped pieces piled to the right.
3. Bowl of water or stock seen from the side/top, with sliced green onions or vegetable rings falling into the liquid.
4. Hands placing irregular cubes of konjac or tofu-like ingredients into a rectangular tray; one round vegetable piece held above the tray.
5. Close-up of thin pork strips being sliced on a cutting board with a large knife; cut strips stacked on the left.
6. Pot or pan close-up with pork being stirred by chopsticks in a shallow layer of liquid or oil.
7. Top view of a handled pot filled with chunky vegetables and meat, chopsticks stirring through the mixture.
8. Close-up of liquid broth being poured from a pitcher into a pot full of ingredients.
9. Simmering pot with visible bubbles, steam, root vegetables and tofu/konjac chunks; a ladle or skimmer enters from the upper right.
10. Ladle lifting a mound of miso paste or seasoning over the steaming pot while chopsticks or a spoon help dissolve it.
11. Soup being ladled into a bowl, with chopped green onions falling from above as garnish.
12. Final serving shot: a bowl of finished tonjiru topped with green onion rings and chunky ingredients, with a small bowl of white rice placed to the left rear.

Visual style: Extremely rough Japanese animation storyboard pencil sketch, rushed human drawing, dirty construction lines, uneven perspective, loose energetic strokes, simple anatomy for hands, minimal background, no polished illustration. Use cinematic close-ups and cooking-action framing. The overall feeling should be like production storyboard thumbnails for an anime food scene.

Constraints: No captions, no speech bubbles, no printed text, no color, no photorealism, no clean line art, no watercolor, no 3D render. Keep all 12 panels clearly separated and preserve the exact 3 by 4 storyboard grid.

2117903200341232458.promptEn: Hyper-realistic avant-garde fashion editorial of the uploaded person, preserving exact facial identity, proportions, and skin tone with absolute accuracy. The subject is seated on a distorted, sculptural deep-purple form resembling a melted bean bag, partially blending into the floor. The pose is intentionally constructed to emphasize perspective: one leg extends forward toward the camera, with the foot closest to the lens appearing larger due to perspective distortion, while the other leg remains bent and grounded. The forward shoe becomes a dominant visual anchor in the frame. The torso leans slightly backward with a subtle curve, shoulders relaxed but controlled. Hands rest loosely between the thighs, maintaining an editorial stiffness. The overall posture feels deliberate, asymmetrical, and slightly surreal. Wardrobe remains avant-garde: an oversized deep-purple trench coat with exaggerated proportions—elongated sleeves, sculptural collar, and strong silhouette. The coat is worn slightly off-shoulder to break symmetry. White wide-leg trousers maintain sharp, architectural folds. Footwear becomes a key focal point: chunky luxury sneakers in white with deep purple accents, positioned prominently toward the camera. The front shoe is closest to the lens, appearing visually larger with crisp detail, sharp texture, and strong lighting emphasis. Sole thickness is slightly exaggerated for a surreal, high-fashion effect. The second shoe remains slightly behind, partially de-emphasized. Set design is a surreal monochromatic purple cyclorama with subtle tonal inconsistencies. The seating form appears partially melted into the floor, enhancing the avant-garde mood. Lighting is directional and experimental: a strong off-center spotlight creates a halo behind the subject, while the foreground (especially the forward shoe) catches sharper highlights. A soft rim light separates the silhouette. Shadows are slightly stretched and imperfect, enhancing the surreal editorial tone. Camera setup is critical: low-angle shot combined with a slightly wide lens (35mm–50mm) to exaggerate perspective. The camera is positioned closer to the forward foot, making the shoe visually dominant while the face remains sharp and recognizable. Slight Dutch tilt adds tension. Expression is calm, detached, and editorial—minimal emotion, distant gaze. Color grading: deep, moody purples with controlled variation, clean but slightly muted whites, natural skin tones with subtle desaturation. Maintain high contrast but allow slight imperfection in gradients. Final output: ultra-detailed, 8K, photorealistic yet surreal, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, high-fashion avant-garde editorial quality, strong depth perspective with foreground emphasis on footwear.
2117903200341232458.promptZh: 超写实（hyper-realistic）前卫时尚杂志大片风格，呈现上传人物的精确面部身份、身体比例和肤色，确保绝对准确。主体坐在一个扭曲的、雕塑感强烈的深紫色造型物上，该造型物形似融化的豆袋椅，并部分与地面融合。姿态经过刻意构建以强调透视：一条腿向前伸展朝向镜头，脚部最靠近镜头，因透视畸变而显得更大；另一条腿保持弯曲并稳稳着地。前方的鞋子成为画面中主导性的视觉锚点。躯干略微后倾，带有微妙的曲线，双肩放松但受控。双手松散地置于大腿之间，维持杂志大片特有的克制感。整体姿态显得刻意、不对称且略带超现实感。服装保持前卫风格：一件 oversized 深紫色风衣，比例夸张——袖子加长、领部具雕塑感、轮廓鲜明。风衣略呈单肩穿着，以打破对称性。白色阔腿裤保留锐利、建筑感十足的褶皱。鞋履成为关键视觉焦点：白色厚底奢侈运动鞋，配以深紫色细节，显著朝向镜头摆放。前方的鞋子最靠近镜头，视觉上更大，细节清晰、纹理锐利，并接受强烈布光强调。鞋底厚度略作夸张处理，营造超现实、高端时尚效果。第二只鞋略靠后，视觉上被弱化。场景设计为超现实单色紫色环形背景（cyclorama），带有细微的色调不一致性。坐具造型看似部分融化于地面，强化前卫氛围。布光具有方向性与实验性：一束强烈的偏心聚光灯在主体身后形成光晕，前景（尤其是前方鞋子）则捕捉更锐利的高光。柔和的轮廓光（rim light）勾勒出剪影边缘。阴影略被拉长且不完美，增强超现实杂志大片质感。相机设置至关重要：低角度拍摄，搭配略广的镜头（35mm–50mm），以夸张透视效果。相机位置靠近前方脚部，使鞋子在视觉上占据主导，同时人脸仍保持清晰可辨。轻微荷兰角（Dutch tilt）增添张力。表情平静、疏离、具杂志大片感——情绪极简，目光遥远。调色：浓郁阴郁的紫色，控制得当的色调变化；纯净但略哑光的白色；自然肤色，辅以细微去饱和（subtle desaturation）。保持高对比度，但在渐变中允许轻微不完美。最终输出：超精细细节，8K，照片级写实（photorealistic）却兼具超现实感，竖构图 4:5 画幅，高端时尚前卫杂志大片品质，强纵深透视，前景重点突出鞋履。

2117903200341232460.promptEn: Create a highly detailed vertical cinematic concept art scene set in a snowy cyberpunk Japanese mountain city at night. Include exactly 3 definition rows with icons: robot icon row “여러 인간과 동시에 일하는 AI 에이전트”; brain icon row “자체 기억(memory), 스킬(skills), 자격증명(credentials)을 보유”; Slack logo-inspired colored icon row “Slack 같은 협업 공간에 상주하며 팀 목표를 지원”. Bottom example pill: “예: 팀 채널에서 데이터 분석을 함께 진행”.

Section 3: Number badge “3” and title “팀에 생산적으로 참여하려면”. Left side contains exactly 3 rounded cards: card 1 with head and sticky-note icon, title “지속적 메모리”, description “목표를 기억하고 실행을 조정”; card 2 with shield and key icon, title “인간과 분리된 자격증명”, description “안전한 권한과 예측 가능한 가드레일”; card 3 with database and magnifying-glass icon, title “넓고 지속적인 정보 접근”, description “조직이 원하는 방식을 이해하고 행동”. Below those cards add a star callout: “기술만으로는 부족하다 → 팀의 운영 방식과 공통 규범도 필요”. Right side shows a Slack-like chat screenshot titled “# data-analysis” with a purple sidebar and exactly 5 visible chat messages from these senders: “민지 (분석 리드)”, “Claude (Data Analyst)”, “호준 (PM)”, “Claude (Data Analyst)”, and a small final status/message area. Left illustration: exactly 3 people sitting with laptops around a dotted shared workspace diagram containing document, chat, and code icons. 2117903200341232470.promptEn: Create a warm cinematic anime-style forest scene in a vertical 2:3 composition. A cheerful young girl, about 7 years old, runs toward the viewer along a winding cobblestone path through a lush enchanted woodland. She has dark brown hair in two braided pigtails tied with small red ribbons, bright expressive brown eyes, rosy cheeks, and a wide joyful smile. She wears a large woven straw sunhat, a cream short-sleeve blouse with a rounded collar, a blue pinafore dress with large white polka dots, white socks, and brown Mary Jane shoes. Exactly two cats run beside her: one orange tabby cat on the left with a raised striped tail and happy open mouth, and one black-and-white tuxedo cat on the right with a white chest, white paws, raised tail, and bright eyes. The forest is dense and magical, filled with tall trees, leafy green undergrowth, mossy stones, wild daisies, tiny pink flowers, and clusters of red mushrooms with white spots along both sides of the path. Golden morning sunlight streams diagonally through the canopy, creating visible sunbeams, glowing dust motes, soft haze, and dappled light across the stones and characters. Use detailed Studio Ghibli-inspired hand-painted animation aesthetics, soft painterly textures, rich greens and warm yellows, charming character design, dynamic forward motion, low eye-level camera angle, shallow depth of field in the background, and a wholesome fairytale atmosphere. No text, no watermark, no modern objects, no extra people, and exactly two cats.
2117903200341232470.promptZh: 以垂直构图（2:3）创作一幅温暖、富有电影感（cinematic）的动漫风格森林场景。一名约7岁、神情欢快的小女孩沿着一条蜿蜒的鹅卵石小径，朝观者方向奔跑，穿行于一片繁茂而充满魔力的林地之中。她有一头深棕色头发，编成两条辫子，末端系着小小的红色丝带；眼睛是明亮有神的棕色，双颊泛红，嘴角绽开灿烂喜悦的笑容。她头戴一顶宽檐编织草帽，身穿米白色短袖上衣，领口呈圆弧形；外搭一件蓝色背带裙，裙面布满硕大的白色波点；脚穿白色短袜与棕色玛丽珍鞋。恰好有两只猫紧随其左右奔跑：左侧是一只橘色虎斑猫，尾巴高高翘起并带有条纹，嘴巴微张、神态欢愉；右侧是一只黑白相间的礼服猫（tuxedo cat），胸前与四爪为白色，尾巴高翘，双眼炯炯有神。森林浓密而奇幻，高耸的树木林立，枝叶繁茂的绿色灌木丛遍布其间，地面铺满青苔覆盖的岩石，点缀着野雏菊、娇小的粉红色花朵，以及沿小径两侧成簇生长的红底白点蘑菇。金色的晨光斜穿过树冠，在林间投下清晰可见的光束，空气中漂浮着发光的微尘，弥漫着柔和薄雾，斑驳光影洒落在石径与人物身上。采用吉卜力工作室（Studio Ghibli）风格启发的精细手绘动画美学（hand-painted animation aesthetics），质感柔和如绘画（painterly textures），色彩以浓郁的绿色与温暖的黄色为主，角色设计讨喜迷人，整体呈现向前跃动的动态感（dynamic forward motion），采用低视角（low eye-level）镜头，背景使用浅景深（shallow depth of field），氛围纯真美好，宛若童话（wholesome fairytale atmosphere）。画面中不得出现文字、水印、现代物品或额外人物，且猫的数量必须恰好为两只。

2117903200341232471.promptEn: Create a vertical cinematic fantasy fashion portrait of a young East Asian woman, unnamed floral fairy muse, standing in a dark enchanted garden at night. She has pale porcelain skin, delicate features, soft red lips, and a calm melancholic gaze directed toward the viewer. Her black hair is styled in a loose romantic updo with wispy bangs and tendrils around her face, decorated with tiny blossoms. She wears an elaborate couture gown made from translucent layered petals, gauze, tulle, and organic vine-like filigree, with a fitted bodice and flowing skirt in charcoal black, smoky blue, blush pink, ivory, and deep crimson. Surround her with exactly five major oversized flower forms: one large dark blue translucent bloom behind the upper left, one large ivory-and-pink bloom above her head, one vivid red-pink bloom at the upper right, one pale pink bloom at the lower left, and one smoky grey-blue petal mass flowing from the lower right. Add many fine golden vine tendrils, sparkling pollen-like particles, tiny blossoms, and sheer ribbon-like petals swirling around her body as if suspended in slow motion. Use dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with a soft key light on her face and shoulders, glowing highlights on the translucent petals, and a deep nearly black background with faint bokeh and dust motes. Style should be hyper-detailed, ethereal, elegant, painterly-realistic, high-fashion editorial fantasy photography, shallow depth of field, vertical 2:3 composition, centered subject, no text, no watermark, no extra people.
2117903200341232471.promptZh: 创作一幅竖构图的电影感（cinematic）奇幻时尚肖像画，描绘一位年轻的东亚女性，一位无名的花卉仙子缪斯，伫立于夜晚幽暗的魔法花园中。她拥有白瓷般的肌肤、精致的五官、柔润的红唇，目光平静而忧郁，直视观者。她的黑发被盘成松散浪漫的发髻，额前垂着轻盈的刘海，脸颊周围散落着细软发丝，并点缀着细小的花朵。她身着一件繁复的高级定制礼服，由半透明层叠花瓣、薄纱、塔夫绸及仿有机藤蔓状镂空雕花构成，紧身胸衣与飘逸裙摆相配，裙色为炭黑色、烟蓝色、绯红粉、象牙白与深绯红。在她周身精准布置五朵大型花卉造型：左上方一朵硕大通透的深蓝色花朵；头顶上方一朵象牙白与粉色调和的花朵；右上方一朵明艳的红粉色花朵；左下方一朵淡粉色花朵；右下方一朵烟灰蓝调的花瓣团块，如流水般倾泻而出。添加大量纤细的金色藤蔓卷须、如花粉般闪烁的微粒、细小花朵，以及如丝带般轻盈的半透明花瓣，环绕其身，仿佛悬浮于慢动作之中。采用强烈的明暗对比（chiaroscuro）布光，面部与肩部以柔和主光源（key light）照亮，半透明花瓣上呈现发光高光，背景为深邃近黑，带有微弱的焦外虚化（bokeh）与浮尘微粒。整体风格需极度精细（hyper-detailed）、空灵（ethereal）、优雅（elegant）、绘画写实（painterly-realistic）、高端时尚杂志风格（high-fashion editorial）的奇幻摄影（fantasy photography），浅景深（shallow depth of field），竖向2:3构图，主体居中，不添加文字，无水印，无人物以外的其他人物。

2117903200341232472.promptEn:
Create a whimsical, hand-painted storybook-style illustration inspired by three candid travel photos arranged vertically in a collage. Preserve the exact composition, poses, and framing from the reference: a young woman with long straight dark brown hair wearing an oversized off-white button-up shirt, black smartwatch, and round sunglasses, standing waist-deep in lush green tea plantations. The first panel shows her facing slightly left while gently brushing the tea leaves with both hands. The second panel captures her from behind with both arms stretched outward, walking peacefully through the tea bushes. The third panel shows her turned slightly to the right, smiling softly while touching the leaves.

Transform the realistic tea estate into a dreamy, colorful illustrated landscape with rolling hills, playful stylized trees, blooming wildflowers, and vibrant foliage. Use soft pastel tones, rich greens, warm yellows, blush pinks, and teal accents. Add whimsical doodle elements around the composition such as hearts, stars, clouds, sunshine, sparkles, tiny flowers, and hand-drawn decorative marks on a warm cream paper background. Maintain the same vertical three-panel layout with generous spacing, rounded organic shapes, textured brush strokes, and a cozy children’s book aesthetic. The illustration should feel joyful, peaceful, and magical, with clean outlines, subtle paper texture, high detail, and a charming gouache/watercolor-inspired finish. No text, no watermark, high-resolution, portrait orientation.
2117903200341232472.promptZh: 创作一幅奇趣盎然、手绘风格的图画书式插画，灵感源自三张即兴旅行照片——它们以垂直拼贴形式排列。严格保留参考图的构图、人物姿态与取景：一位年轻女性，留着长而顺直的深棕色头发，身穿 oversized 米白色纽扣衬衫，佩戴黑色智能手表和圆形太阳镜，站在郁郁葱葱的绿色茶园中，水位及腰。第一格画面中，她微微侧身向左，双手轻柔拂过茶树嫩叶；第二格画面从背后捕捉她双臂自然张开、平静穿行于茶树丛中的身影；第三格画面中她略向右转头，面带柔和微笑，指尖轻触茶叶。\n\n将写实的茶园场景转化为梦幻缤纷的手绘风景：连绵起伏的山丘、活泼风格化的树木、盛放的野花与生机勃勃的浓艳 foliage（叶丛）。采用柔和的粉彩色调，搭配浓郁的绿色、温暖的黄色、绯红粉色与青绿色点缀。在构图四周添加奇趣涂鸦元素，例如心形、星形、云朵、阳光、闪光粒子、微小花朵，以及手绘风格的装饰性笔触，全部置于暖米色纸基底之上。保持相同的垂直三格布局，格间留有充裕间距，图形轮廓圆润有机，笔触富有肌理感，整体呈现温馨亲切的儿童图画书美学。整幅插画应洋溢着欢快、宁静与魔幻氛围，线条清晰干净，隐约透出纸张纹理，细节丰富，最终呈现如广告颜料（gouache）/水彩（watercolor）风格的迷人质感。画面中不出现任何文字，无水印，高分辨率，竖版构图。

2117903200341232474.promptZh: 创作一幅柔和、明亮的动漫风格（anime-style）夏日插画：一位年轻女孩赤脚坐在传统日式房间的榻榻米地板上，以略微偏后方的侧身视角呈现。她留着短而蓬松的薄荷绿渐变色齐耳短发，几缕发丝随微风轻扬；眼睛大而温柔，呈绿色；神情平静而梦幻，仰望着靠近敞开式走廊（veranda）悬挂的一只小型玻璃风铃。她身穿一件 oversized 的纯白色短袖T恤和深海军蓝短裤，坐姿放松自然，一膝微抬，另一条腿屈起。房间内设有木质推拉门框、障子纸拉门（shoji-style panels），门口通向明亮的庭院及远处波光粼粼的大海；左侧有一幅轻盈飘动的纯白薄纱窗帘；温暖的阳光束洒落在榻榻米上。画面前景除女孩外，须严格包含两个主体物件：右侧一台叶片呈半透明蓝色的立式电风扇；正上方中央附近悬挂一只玻璃风铃，其顶部垂下一小条纸质吊饰。室外可见郁郁葱葱的绿树、繁茂的灌木丛、一道栏杆，以及在强烈夏日光照下泛着朦胧蓝调的海平线。整体采用细腻的水彩融合动漫美学（watercolor-and-anime aesthetic）、粉彩色调（pastel colors）、柔化线条（soft linework）、发光逆光（glowing backlight）、漂浮的尘埃微粒（floating dust motes）、斑驳的树叶投影（dappled leaf shadows）、高调曝光（high-key exposure）、怀旧宁静氛围（nostalgic peaceful mood），竖构图 4:5 比例，无文字，无水印，无额外人物。

2117903200341232475.promptEn:
A cinematic street fashion editorial portrait of a stylish young man standing casually at the corner of a quiet urban intersection on a bright sunny afternoon. His posture is relaxed with one shoulder lightly touching the pole, one hand tucked inside the pocket of his oversized charcoal gray cargo trousers, while his legs are loosely crossed at the ankles. The other hand casually holds a smartphone by his side.
The subject wears an oversized vintage washed brown graphic sweatshirt with subtle distressed typography and faded cream printed artwork across the chest. The relaxed fit gives a contemporary Korean streetwear aesthetic. He pairs it with loose charcoal gray cargo pants featuring utility stitching and oversized pockets. On his feet are classic white and deep red Nike sneakers with matching red details. A thin silver chain necklace rests naturally around his neck, and a black leather shoulder bag hangs from one shoulder. He wears oversized rectangular black sunglasses, adding a calm, confident editorial expression while looking directly toward the camera.
His hair is medium length, thick, slightly messy, and naturally wavy with textured volume, softly illuminated by direct sunlight. His facial expression remains neutral and effortless, conveying quiet confidence.
The environment features a realistic American style city street with wide concrete sidewalks, crosswalk markings, traffic lights displaying a red pedestrian stop signal, utility poles, overhead cables, parked cars, green trees, brick buildings, and additional one way signs receding into the distance. The street is clean, quiet, and naturally active without feeling crowded.
Strong midday sunlight creates crisp shadows across the pavement, producing realistic contrast while maintaining balanced skin tones. The blue sky is completely clear, enhancing the fresh daytime atmosphere.
The composition places the subject slightly off center beneath the prominent street sign, using the sidewalk and road as natural leading lines that draw attention toward him. Vertical framing emphasizes both the environment and the fashion styling.
Photographed on a full frame camera with a 50mm lens, f/2.8, ISO 100, natural daylight, shallow depth of field with subtle background separation while keeping much of the street environment recognizable.
Style: premium fashion editorial, Korean streetwear, urban lifestyle photography, cinematic realism, documentary aesthetic, natural candid pose, photorealistic, ultra detailed fabric textures, realistic skin texture, sharp focus, subtle film grain, rich natural colors, HDR, 8K, luxury magazine quality, Instagram editorial style.

2117903200341232476.promptEn:
Subject:
Leaping into the morning

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. A facial appearance that combines girlish lightness with adult cleanliness. Long black hair flows softly backward in the morning breeze, with bangs and strands around the face swaying naturally. Bright ivory-beige toned fair skin with a smooth texture containing a hint of pink. Soft highlights on cheeks, nose tip, shoulders, and collarbones. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eye makeup, long thin eyelashes, natural eye bags, and soft arched light brown eyebrows. Lips have a translucent pink-beige gloss. The expression is a natural, open smile looking up at the morning sky.

Clothing/Pose:
A simple white top worn under a thin sheer shirt with a mix of pale pink and ivory. The shirt lets the morning light through, with sleeves and hem spreading lightly in the wind. Black high-waist miniskirt, thin black belt, and black lace-up short boots. Captured at the moment of jumping just above the water surface. The body is slightly open to the right of the screen, with the person's right arm extended high towards the sky. The left arm is spread naturally towards the bottom left with relaxed fingers. One leg is slightly bent, and the other is extended downward, creating small water splashes at the feet.

Background/Light:
Early morning lakeside or shallow water. Clear blue sky with white clouds and bubbles of various sizes floating upward. Distant low mountain range and green shoreline. The main light source is the morning sun from the bottom back, backlighting the legs, hair, shoulders, and edges of the sheer shirt. Soft reflected light from the water and sky enters the face, with thin natural shadows. The water reflects the sky, clouds, and the person's legs and boots faintly.

Composition/Camera:
Portrait 2:3. Low-angle full-body portrait. The person is placed slightly above the center of the frame, showing the whole body. Water surface and reflections are left at the bottom, with a large margin for the blue sky and bubbles at the top. The camera looks up from a low position near the water surface. Slightly wide-angle but with minimal distortion. Focus is on the face and upper body, with the distant mountains softened.

Texture/Style:
Realistic morning fashion photography. Carefully depicts natural skin texture, fine hair strands, translucency of the sheer material, layering of the skirt fabric, leather texture of the boots, and water splashes and reflections. Bright and transparent color tones, morning sun that isn't overly blown out, and light lens flare. A photorealistic expression as if actually shot outdoors, not an AI illustration.

Negative:
Excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, blown-out faces, unnatural smiles, extra or missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, unnatural floating, poor contact between feet and water, misaligned reflections, shadows inconsistent with the light source, physical failure of skirts or shirts, unnecessary people, text, logos, watermarks.

采用侧脸视角，50mm镜头，浅景深（shallow depth of field），自然阴天布光（natural overcast lighting），真实肌肤质感（realistic skin texture），被风吹拂的短波浪发，微妙的情绪表达，优雅的肩背包，现代都市时尚风格，柔和的电影感对比度（soft cinematic contrast），高动态范围（high dynamic range），超照片级写实（ultra-photorealistic），杂志级时尚摄影（editorial fashion photography），杂志封面品质（magazine cover quality），徕卡（Leica）影像风格，柯达Portra（Kodak Portra）色调启发，面部细节锐利清晰（crisp facial details），平移摄影（panning photography）效果，长曝光动态模糊（long exposure motion blur），极简构图（minimal composition），高端艺术级街头摄影（premium fine-art street photography），8K，获奖级摄影（award-winning photography）。

相机设置：  
索尼A7R V，50mm f/1.4镜头，f/1.8光圈，ISO 100，1/15秒快门速度，平视构图（eye-level composition），自然环境光（natural ambient light），超高细节（ultra-high detail）。

色彩处理：  
选择性上色（仅黄色大衣），单色城市背景，灰度人群（grayscale crowd），电影感黑白背景（cinematic black-and-white background），丰富的金色织物纹理（rich golden fabric texture）。

2117903200341232484.promptEn:
Goal: Create a clean three-view character reference sheet for a cute chibi cat-girl mascot named green cat chibi.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 white background, no text, no props, no shadows, evenly spaced character turnaround lineup.

Layout: Show exactly 3 full-body views of the same character: 1 front view on the left, 1 left-facing side profile in the center, and 1 back view on the right. Keep all three figures the same height and scale, with simple standing poses and arms relaxed at the sides.

Character details: The character is a small plush-like chibi with a large round head, tiny body, short legs, and white furry hands and feet. She has leaf green bob-cut hair with rounded bangs, darker green tips, glossy highlights, one small curled ahoge strand on top, and large pointed cat ears with pale inner fur and white fluffy ear tufts. In the front view, she has oversized glossy green eyes, long black eyelashes, a tiny cat mouth, soft pink cheek blush, and a gentle cute expression. The side view shows the small protruding nose and rounded muzzle profile. The back view shows the rounded bob haircut covering the head and neck, both cat ears, and the ahoge.

Outfit and body: Dress the character in a plain oversized short-sleeve T-shirt in medium green, hanging like a simple tunic over the small body. No patterns, logos, buttons, shoes, or accessories. The visible fur on face, arms, legs, paws, and tail is pure white with subtle pale gray-green shading.

Tail: Include exactly 1 fluffy white cat tail on each view, matching the perspective: curved upward beside the body in the front view, curling behind the body in the side view, and extending from the lower back and sweeping to the right in the back view.

Visual style: Japanese kawaii character-design sheet, soft digital illustration, clean black sketch-like outlines, gentle cel shading, watercolor-like green gradients in the hair, rounded simplified anatomy, polished but hand-drawn Clip Studio Paint feel.

Constraints: Keep the design consistent across all 3 views, preserve the same outfit and proportions, avoid background elements, avoid extra poses, avoid labels, avoid realistic anatomy, and do not add any additional characters.

2117903200341232485.promptEn: Create a highly realistic vertical festival portrait of a beautiful Japanese woman in her early 20s at a summer evening fireworks festival in Japan. She is shown from the waist up in a candid three-quarter pose, standing slightly turned away but looking back over her shoulder directly at the camera with a warm natural smile. She has soft brown-black hair in a loose low updo with wispy bangs and face-framing strands, decorated with two chrysanthemum-style hair flowers, one pale cream and one pink. She wears a pale cream yukata with delicate purple and lavender floral patterns, a large beige obi bow tied at the back, and holds a small floral drawstring kinchaku pouch by its cords in one hand. The background is a lively matsuri street with exactly two rows of illuminated food stalls on the left and right, glowing red-and-white lanterns, crowded festivalgoers in yukata walking away from camera, and mid-rise city buildings in the distance. Above her, fill the twilight blue sky with multiple large fireworks bursts in pink, purple, white, and gold, including at least three prominent explosions across the top of the frame. Use warm lantern light on her face and yukata, soft bokeh and slight background blur, realistic skin texture, natural makeup, cinematic depth of field, handheld street photography feel, high detail, photorealistic gpt-image-2 style. Emphasize romantic, festive, vivid, and lifelike. Use a vertical 4:5 composition, eye-level perspective, subject centered slightly left, fireworks forming a bright halo behind her head, no text, no watermark, no distorted hands, no extra fingers.
2117903200341232485.promptZh: 创作一幅高度写实的竖构图节日肖像画，描绘一位二十岁出头的美丽日本女性，身处日本夏日夜晚的烟花节现场。画面呈现她腰部以上的半身像，采用自然抓拍式的三分之四角度：她微微侧身背对镜头，却回眸直视相机，面带温暖而自然的微笑。她拥有一头柔顺的棕黑色秀发，松散地盘成低发髻，额前垂落轻盈的空气刘海，两侧有修饰脸型的碎发，并以两朵菊花造型发饰点缀——一朵为浅米白色，一朵为粉红色。她身穿浅米白色的浴衣，其上印有精致淡雅的紫罗兰色与薰衣草色花卉纹样；背后系着一只大号米色宽腰带（obi）蝴蝶结；右手握着一只小型花卉图案的绳抽式小袋（kinchaku pouch），袋绳垂于指间。背景是一条热闹的祭典街道：左侧与右侧各整齐排列两排亮灯的美食摊位，红白相间的灯笼熠熠生辉，身着浴衣的游客熙攘而行、朝远离镜头的方向走去，远处可见中等高度的城市建筑群。在她头顶上方，布满暮色蓝调的天空中绽放多枚大型烟花，色彩包括粉红、紫、白与金，其中至少三处醒目爆炸效果横跨画面顶部。人物面部与浴衣受暖色调灯笼光照亮，背景采用柔和焦外虚化（bokeh）并略带模糊，皮肤纹理真实细腻，妆容自然，电影感景深（cinematic depth of field），呈现手持街头摄影（handheld street photography）风格，细节丰富，照片级写实（photorealistic）gpt-image-2 风格。整体强调浪漫、欢庆、鲜活与逼真。采用竖向 4:5 构图，平视视角，主体略微偏左居中，烟花在她头部后方形成明亮光晕，画面中无文字、无水印、双手无畸变、无多余手指。
