2117903200341232486.promptEn: Create an ultra-wide cinematic mobile game cut-in banner in a dramatic fantasy anime-realism style. Canvas is a very wide horizontal rectangle, about 21:9, framed with thick black letterbox bars above and below the action area for a movie-like special attack screen. The subject is a heroic brown tabby cat, close-up from the shoulders up, positioned mostly on the left half and facing right with intense large green eyes, detailed fur, long white whiskers, and a determined expression. The cat wears a dark olive-green adventurer cloak with folds flowing backward and one visible round bronze clasp near the lower left. The background is a dark starry cosmic battle scene filled with glowing gold shards, sparks, triangular crystal fragments, streaking light trails, and bright white lightning bolts radiating across the right half. Place one large bold Japanese attack phrase across the lower-middle foreground, centered and spanning almost the full width: 星のかけらの力で　空へ！. The typography should be thick, heavy, game-like, pale cream to warm gold gradient with subtle beveling, dark shadow, and a thin horizontal golden line passing behind or through the text, making it feel like a special move title card. Keep the cat partially behind the text so the words dominate the cut-in. Use high contrast, sharp details, dynamic diagonal energy, glittering particles, and a premium fantasy RPG visual style. No extra logos, UI buttons, watermarks, or additional text.
2117903200341232486.promptZh: 创作一幅超宽幅、电影感的手机游戏切入式横幅（cut-in banner），采用戏剧性奇幻动漫写实风格（anime-realism）。画布为极宽的横向矩形，比例约21:9，动作区域上下两侧配有厚重黑色遮幅条（letterbox bars），营造出电影级必杀技界面（special attack screen）效果。主体是一只英勇的棕色虎斑猫，特写（close-up）呈现其肩部以上部分，主要位于画面左半侧，面朝右侧，拥有锐利硕大的翠绿色双眼、精细描绘的毛发、修长洁白的胡须，以及坚毅果敢的表情。猫咪身披一件深橄榄绿色冒险者斗篷，衣褶向后飘动，左下侧可见一枚圆形青铜扣（clasp）。背景为幽暗的星空宇宙战场，右半侧布满发光的金色碎屑、迸溅的火花、三角形水晶碎片、疾驰的光迹，以及向四周放射的明亮白色闪电。在画面中下前景位置，居中放置一句大型加粗日文攻击台词，横跨几乎整个画面宽度：星のかけらの力で　空へ！。字体需厚重有力、富有游戏感，采用浅米色至暖金色渐变，带细微浮雕效果（beveling）、深色阴影，且有一条细水平金色线条从文字后方或穿过文字，使其呈现必杀技标题卡（title card）质感。让猫咪部分位于文字后方，确保文字在切入画面中占据主导地位。整体采用高对比度、锐利细节、动态对角线能量感（diagonal energy）、闪烁粒子（glittering particles），以及高端奇幻RPG视觉风格（premium fantasy RPG visual style）。不得添加额外标志、UI按钮、水印或任何其他文字。

2117903200341232487.promptEn:
Goal: Create an ultra-rough pencil storyboard for a 9-second Japanese 2D anime-style dessert cooking short video about making matcha tiramisu.

Canvas: Wide cinematic 21:9 horizontal storyboard sheet, white background, thin black panel borders, arranged as exactly 12 panels in a 3-row by 4-column grid. Use loose hand-drawn graphite pencil lines, sketchy construction strokes, minimal shading, a few muted pale green matcha accents, and no polished coloring.

Layout and panel count: Show exactly 12 discrete storyboard panels, left to right, top to bottom:
1. A kettle pours hot water into a small bowl of matcha powder on a kitchen counter; a whisk lies nearby and a small jar sits in the background.
2. Close-up of a hand whisking matcha in a bowl, circular motion lines visible.
3. Two spoons add creamy mascarpone or cream into a large mixing bowl.
4. A spatula folds the cream mixture in a large bowl, smooth sweeping motion lines.
5. Mise-en-scène wide shot: glass dessert cup centered, tray of sponge fingers on the left, small bowl of matcha on the right, kitchen tools in the background.
6. Hand dips one rectangular sponge finger into the matcha liquid inside a shallow bowl.
7. Hand places matcha-soaked sponge fingers into the bottom of a clear cylindrical glass cup.
8. A spoon drops a mound of cream onto the sponge layer inside the glass.
9. Hand adds another soaked sponge finger layer on top of the cream in the glass.
10. Spatula smooths a thick top layer of cream in the glass, showing layered sponge and cream through the transparent side.
11. A mesh sieve dusts matcha powder evenly over the top of the dessert.
12. Final beauty shot: completed matcha tiramisu in a clear round glass with three visible layers, green matcha dusted top, placed on a napkin with small leaves and a bamboo whisk nearby.

Visual style: Japanese 2D anime production storyboard, rough pencil animatic look, monochrome line art with subtle green-gray matcha shading, dynamic hands and utensils, expressive motion arcs, clean rectangular framing, light tabletop perspective, soft food-prep atmosphere.

Text content: No captions, no dialogue, no panel numbers, no watermarks.

Constraints: Keep the drawing intentionally rough and storyboard-like, preserve the exact 12-panel grid, maintain the 21:9 aspect ratio, focus on cooking actions and ingredient layering, and avoid photorealism.

2117903200341232488.promptEn: Create a vibrant anime-style illustration of a young man eating in a cozy Japanese diner, shown in a medium close-up at a wooden counter. The character is a slim young adult with messy wavy black hair, pale skin, rectangular black glasses, soft brown eyes, and a slightly puffed cheek expression as if chewing. He wears a dark navy oversized winter jacket over a black sweater. He holds a fork in his left hand, lifting a small coil of spaghetti from a large plate of red-sauce pasta with sausage slices and green garnish, while his right hand holds open a colorful magazine or manga with abstract city graphics and pseudo-Japanese typography. Place exactly 5 main food and drink items on the counter: 1 large plate of spaghetti, 1 blue-and-white bowl of white rice, 1 black bowl of orange miso soup with green garnish, 1 small plate of yellow pickles, and 1 clear glass of ice water. Add exactly 4 condiment bottles clustered on the left side: a yellow-capped sauce bottle, a red-capped sauce bottle, a blue-capped sauce bottle, and a dark soy-sauce-style bottle. The background is a lively small restaurant or convenience-diner interior with warm sunset lighting, large windows on the left showing a bright city street and a blue sign reading “23-7,” shelves and counters on the right with stacked bowls, bottles, boxed goods, and a smiling lucky cat figurine. Include colorful menu placards above the counter with Japanese-inspired vertical lettering, one sign resembling “7-11,” and bright pink, teal, orange, and deep blue accents. Use a cinematic manga composition, detailed line art, expressive face, saturated colors, strong rim lighting, cozy clutter, shallow depth of field, and a cute “munching while reading” mood. Do not add extra characters, photorealism, watermark, or English explanatory captions.
2117903200341232488.promptZh: 创作一幅充满活力的动漫风格插画，描绘一位年轻男子正在一家温馨的日式小餐馆里用餐，以中景特写（medium close-up）构图呈现，视角聚焦于木质吧台前。角色是一位身形纤瘦的年轻成年人，留着凌乱的黑色波浪卷发，肤色白皙，佩戴黑色矩形眼镜，眼睛呈柔和的棕色，脸颊微微鼓起，仿佛正在咀嚼。他身穿一件深海军蓝 oversized 冬季夹克，内搭黑色毛衣。左手持叉，正从一大盘红酱意面中挑起一小卷意大利面——意面上铺有香肠片与绿色配菜；右手则摊开一本色彩缤纷的杂志或漫画，封面印有抽象城市图形与伪日文排版文字。吧台上须精确摆放 5 种主食与饮品：1 个大盘装意大利面、1 个青花蓝白碗盛装的白米饭、1 个黑碗盛装的橙色味噌汤（配绿色配菜）、1 个小碟装黄色腌菜、1 杯透明玻璃杯盛装的冰水。左侧须精确排列 4 瓶调味料：1 瓶黄色瓶盖酱料瓶、1 瓶红色瓶盖酱料瓶、1 瓶蓝色瓶盖酱料瓶、1 瓶深色仿酱油风格瓶。背景为热闹的小型餐厅或便利型餐吧内部，采用温暖的夕阳布光（sunset lighting），左侧设大面积窗户，窗外可见明亮的城市街道，以及一块蓝色招牌，上书 “23-7,”；右侧为置物架与柜台，堆叠着碗具、瓶罐、盒装商品，以及一只面带微笑的招财猫摆件。吧台上方悬挂数块彩色菜单立牌，采用日式风格竖排文字，其中一块立牌形似 “7-11,”，整体配色明快，含亮粉色、青绿色、橙色与深蓝色点缀。采用电影感漫画构图（cinematic manga composition）、精细线稿（detailed line art）、富有表现力的面部刻画（expressive face）、高饱和度色彩（saturated colors）、强烈轮廓光（strong rim lighting）、温馨杂而不乱的氛围（cozy clutter）、浅景深（shallow depth of field），并传达出“边吃边读”的可爱氛围（cute “munching while reading” mood）。不得添加额外人物、写实主义（photorealism）、水印（watermark）或英文说明性字幕（English explanatory captions）。

2117903200341232489.promptEn: Create a square close-up comic book / graphic novel portrait of a young Black man with short cropped black hair, warm brown skin, dark brown eyes, full lips, and a calm neutral expression. Frame the head and upper shoulders centered, facing straight toward the viewer with symmetrical composition. Preserve realistic facial proportions and identity-like detail, but render everything as bold superhero-style illustration: thick black ink outlines, detailed cross-hatching on the face and neck, expressive engraved shadow lines, glossy highlights on the forehead, nose, cheeks, and lips, and rich warm orange-brown skin shading. Add a simple dark crew-neck shirt with subtle ink folds. Use a vibrant blue halftone comic background with dense dot texture, radial burst energy lines shooting inward from the edges toward the face, distressed print grain, and a thick black rectangular comic panel border. Lighting should be dramatic but frontal, with high contrast, crisp linework, saturated colors, and a polished modern graphic novel finish. No text, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark.
2117903200341232489.promptZh: 创作一幅方形特写（close-up）漫画书 / 图像小说风格肖像画，描绘一位年轻黑人男性：黑色短发、暖棕色皮肤、深棕色眼睛、饱满嘴唇、神情平静中性。构图居中，仅呈现头部与上肩部，人物正对观者，采用对称构图。保持真实的人脸比例与具身份辨识度的细节，但整体以大胆超级英雄风格插画呈现：粗重黑色墨线勾勒轮廓，面部与颈部施以精细交叉排线（cross-hatching），富有表现力的雕刻式阴影线（engraved shadow lines），前额、鼻梁、脸颊与嘴唇处添加光泽高光（glossy highlights），皮肤着色为浓郁温暖的橙棕色（orange-brown）阴影。添加一件简洁的深色圆领T恤，布料褶皱以微妙墨线表现。背景采用明快蓝色半调（halftone）漫画纹理，密布圆点质感，从画面边缘向人脸放射状汇聚的能量射线（radial burst energy lines），做旧印刷颗粒感（distressed print grain），并配以粗重黑色矩形漫画分镜边框（comic panel border）。布光需具戏剧性但为正面光（frontal lighting），高对比度（high contrast），线条清晰锐利（crisp linework），色彩饱和（saturated colors），整体呈现打磨精致的现代图像小说（graphic novel）成像质感。不添加文字、不添加对话气泡（speech bubbles）、不添加标识（logos）、不添加水印（watermark）。

2117903200341232490.promptEn: Create a cinematic premium dairy advertising image centered on a single floating Almarai full cream fresh milk 2-liter plastic jug. The product is a white plastic milk gallon with a green screw cap, handle on the upper right, and a green Arabic Almarai-style label showing the Almarai logo, large Arabic lettering for fresh milk, “full cream,” and “2 L” details. Place the jug upright in the exact center, sharply focused and realistically lit. Surround it with an explosive circular halo of natural dairy-and-farm elements: exactly 1 thick swirling ribbon of white milk wrapping behind and around the jug, many suspended milk droplets and splashes, clear water-like bubbles, green leaves, grass blades, wheat stalks, white mineral or salt-like chunks, dark soil clumps, small seeds and grains, and herb sprigs, all frozen midair as if bursting from a farm landscape. Use a low-angle outdoor background of rolling green hills with a warm sunrise or sunset sky, soft clouds, and golden atmospheric light. Style: ultra-realistic commercial product photography, high-speed splash capture, dramatic backlighting, shallow depth of field, crisp product label, glossy highlights on droplets, natural freshness, premium Middle Eastern grocery advertisement aesthetic. Color palette: creamy white, fresh green, gold, earthy brown, sky blue. Constraints: no people, no hands, no extra products, no watermark, keep the brand label readable, preserve the floating centered composition and dynamic circular explosion.
2117903200341232490.promptZh:
创作一幅电影感（cinematic）的高端乳制品广告图像，画面中心为一个悬浮的阿尔玛拉伊（Almarai）全脂鲜奶2升塑料奶罐。产品为白色塑料牛奶加仑瓶，配绿色螺旋瓶盖、右上方手柄，以及印有阿尔玛拉伊（Almarai）标志、大幅阿拉伯文“鲜奶”字样、“full cream,”及“2 L”细节的绿色阿拉伯风格标签。将奶罐垂直置于画面正中央，焦点锐利，布光真实自然。  
围绕奶罐，营造一个爆发式圆形光晕，由天然乳制品与农场元素构成：恰好1条粗厚的白色牛奶旋绕丝带，从奶罐后方缠绕环绕；大量悬浮的牛奶液滴与飞溅水花；如清水般通透的气泡；绿色叶片、草叶、麦秆；白色矿物或盐粒状碎块；深色泥土团块；细小种子与谷粒；香草嫩芽——所有元素均凝固于空中，仿佛自农场景观中迸发而出。  
背景采用低角度户外场景：起伏的青翠山丘，暖色调日出或日落天空，柔云朵朵，金色大气辉光。  
风格：超写实商业产品摄影（ultra-realistic commercial product photography）、高速飞溅捕捉（high-speed splash capture）、戏剧性逆光（dramatic backlighting）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、标签文字清晰锐利（crisp product label）、液滴表面呈现光泽高光（glossy highlights on droplets）、自然清新感（natural freshness）、中东高端杂货广告美学（premium Middle Eastern grocery advertisement aesthetic）。  
色彩方案：奶油白、鲜绿色、金色、泥土棕、天蓝色。  
限制条件：不得出现人物、手部、其他额外产品、水印；须确保品牌标签清晰可读；保持悬浮居中构图及动态圆形爆发效果。

2117903200341232491.promptEn: Create a clean isometric corporate website illustration on a white background, showing a stylized laptop at the center with a workflow automation diagram on its screen. A human figure in a red sweater, black pants, and white shoes stands to the right of the laptop, reaching forward and pressing a red rounded-square node on the screen. Use a modern vector/3D hybrid style with thick black outlines, soft gray shadows, white surfaces, and a limited palette of orange, red, black, and light gray. Include exactly 7 distinct surrounding objects connected by black circuit-like lines with small orange circular junctions: 1 large orange gear in the upper left behind the laptop screen, 1 small red gear on the right, 1 white rounded cube with an orange top tile in the upper right, 1 white/red rounded cube with a pie-chart icon in the lower left, 1 small white rounded cube with an orange check mark at the bottom center, 1 stacked white server-like cube with an orange top and small orange/red dots in the lower right, and 1 central laptop with a visible keyboard and trackpad. On the laptop screen include exactly 5 workflow UI elements: 2 red rounded-square nodes with white circular centers, 1 orange rounded rectangle in the middle, 1 white rounded rectangle with three small colored dots, and 1 black curved connector leading to the right red node. Keep the composition airy, minimal, friendly, and suitable as a corporate site hero asset for automation and digital workflow. No text, no logos, no photorealism, no clutter.
2117903200341232491.promptZh: 在白色背景上创建一幅简洁的等距视角（isometric）企业网站插画，画面中央为一台风格化笔记本电脑，其屏幕上显示一个工作流自动化示意图。一名身穿红色毛衣、黑色长裤、白色鞋子的人物立于笔记本电脑右侧，正向前伸出手，按压屏幕上的一枚红色圆角正方形节点。采用现代矢量/3D混合风格，配以粗黑轮廓线、柔和的灰色阴影、白色表面，以及限定色系：橙色、红色、黑色和浅灰色。周围需精确包含7个彼此独立的物体，均由黑色电路状线条连接，并在线路交点处配有小型橙色圆形接点：1枚大型橙色齿轮位于笔记本电脑屏幕左上方后方；1枚小型红色齿轮位于右侧；1枚白色圆角立方体，顶部嵌有一块橙色瓷砖，置于右上方；1枚白/红色圆角立方体，带有饼图图标，置于左下方；1枚小型白色圆角立方体，底部中央位置印有橙色对勾标记；1组堆叠式白色服务器状立方体，顶部为橙色，并带有若干小型橙色/红色圆点，置于右下方；以及1台中央笔记本电脑，键盘与触控板清晰可见。笔记本电脑屏幕上需精确呈现5个工作流UI元素：2枚红色圆角正方形节点，中心为白色圆形；1枚橙色圆角矩形位于中央；1枚白色圆角矩形，内含三枚小型彩色圆点；以及1条黑色曲线连接器，延伸指向右侧的红色节点。整体构图须通透、极简、亲切，适合作为企业网站面向自动化与数字化工作流的首页主视觉资产。不出现文字、无任何Logo、非写实风格、无杂乱元素。

2117903200341232492.promptEn: Create a warm anime-style square illustration of Muumuu Bell, a cute cow-themed demon girl dessert vendor at sunset on a rustic farm. She has very long silky silver-white hair fading to aqua blue at the tips, small curved tan horns, black-and-white cow ears, golden eyes, a soft teasing smile, and a black-and-white cow-print halter outfit with a shiny gold cowbell at her neck and oversized black off-shoulder sleeves. She is standing behind a wooden table, leaning forward, holding a metal whipped-cream dispenser in one hand and a small metal cup of cream in the other, carefully piping cream onto one pudding creature. Show exactly 6 cute yellow pudding mascot creatures on the table, each with tiny black oval eyes, a small beak-like mouth, little feet, glossy caramel sauce on top, and different toppings: 1 front-left pudding with whipped cream and a strawberry, 1 left-back pudding with whipped cream, chocolate sauce, a cherry, and small fruit pieces, 1 center-back pudding being topped with a tall swirl of whipped cream, 1 front-center pudding with a tall whipped-cream swirl and caramel rim, 1 front-right pudding with caramel drip, whipped cream, and a large strawberry, and 1 right-back pudding with whipped cream, chocolate sauce, a red cherry, and mint leaves. Use rich golden-hour lighting, soft painterly shading, detailed glossy dessert highlights, gentle blush on the girl’s cheeks, and a cozy countryside background with a wooden barn, fence, green trees, distant hills, orange-pink sky, and a wooden shop sign showing a soft-serve ice cream icon. Add handwritten Japanese greeting text こんにちは in the upper left, white with a warm brown shadow. Composition should feel cheerful, appetizing, and whimsical, with shallow depth of field, high-detail anime rendering, no watermark, no extra characters, and no additional text.
2117903200341232492.promptZh: 创作一幅温暖的动漫风格正方形插画，描绘日落时分、质朴农场上的穆穆贝尔（Muumuu Bell）——一位可爱的奶牛主题恶魔少女甜品摊主。她拥有极长的柔顺银白色长发，发梢渐变为青绿色；头上有小巧弯曲的棕褐色犄角；戴着黑白相间的奶牛耳朵；金色双眸；面带柔和俏皮的微笑；身穿黑白奶牛纹抹胸装，颈间挂着一枚闪亮的金色牛铃，配 oversized 黑色露肩袖。她站在一张木桌后方，身体微微前倾，一手握着金属奶油喷枪，另一手托着一只盛有奶油的小型金属杯，正专注地将奶油挤到一只布丁小怪兽上。木桌上需清晰呈现恰好6只可爱的黄色布丁吉祥物，每只均配有微小黑色椭圆形眼睛、喙状小嘴、细小脚丫、顶部淋有光泽焦糖酱，并搭配不同配料：左前方布丁配奶油与一颗草莓；左后方布丁配奶油、巧克力酱、一颗樱桃及数颗小水果粒；正后方布丁正被挤上一大团高耸奶油漩涡；正前方布丁配高耸奶油漩涡与焦糖边沿；右前方布丁配焦糖垂滴、奶油与一颗硕大草莓；右后方布丁配奶油、巧克力酱、一颗红色樱桃及薄荷叶。采用浓郁的黄金时刻（golden-hour）光线，柔和的手绘感阴影（painterly shading），精致细腻的甜品高光（glossy dessert highlights），女孩脸颊上点缀淡淡红晕，背景为温馨乡村风光：木质谷仓、篱笆、绿树、远山、橙粉色天空，以及一块木制店铺招牌，其上印有软冰淇淋图标。在画面左上方添加手写体日文问候语“こんにちは”，文字为白色，带暖棕色阴影。构图须洋溢欢快、诱人食欲与奇趣 whimsical 氛围，采用浅景深（shallow depth of field），高细节动漫渲染（high-detail anime rendering），无水印、无额外人物、无其他文字。

2117903200341232493.promptEn: Create a delicate monochrome pencil illustration in refined shoujo fantasy style showing a romantic aristocratic couple posed close together from the waist up. The woman, a gentle young noblewoman, stands on the left with long softly flowing dark hair, straight bangs, luminous large eyes, a calm faint smile, dangling diamond-shaped earrings, and an ornate high-neck lace dress with embroidered floral details and a jeweled brooch at the collar and waist. The man, a handsome young nobleman, stands on the right slightly behind her, taller, leaning close with his head near hers, sharp eyes, tousled medium-length dark hair, a composed serious expression, and a decorated military-inspired noble coat with a high collar, buttons, chains, shoulder ornaments, and gemstone-like insignia. Their shoulders touch and they look directly toward the viewer, creating an intimate rare moment of quiet eye contact and closeness. Use only black, graphite gray, and warm off-white paper tones, with extremely fine linework, soft cross-hatching, subtle smudged shading, detailed hair strands, sparkling eyes, and intricate costume ornamentation. Background: faint sketchy Gothic palace architecture with tall arched windows on the left and delicate climbing vines and floral tracery on the right, kept very pale so the couple remains the focus. Composition: vertical portrait, centered couple, elegant dreamy atmosphere, high detail, hand-drawn manga pencil sketch, no color, no text, no watermark.
2117903200341232493.promptZh:
以精致的少女幻想风（shoujo fantasy style）创作一幅细腻的单色铅笔插画，描绘一对浪漫的贵族情侣，构图聚焦于腰部以上、两人亲密并肩而立。  
女子是一位温婉的年轻贵族小姐，立于画面左侧：长发柔顺垂落、发色深暗，齐直刘海，双眸明亮硕大，神情宁静、唇角微扬呈淡淡笑意；耳垂悬挂菱形钻石耳坠；身着繁复高领蕾丝长裙，裙上饰有刺绣花卉细节，衣领与腰际各嵌一枚宝石胸针。  
男子是一位英俊的年轻贵族绅士，立于画面右侧、略居女子后方，身形更高，微微前倾、头部靠近女子，目光锐利，中等长度深色头发略显凌乱；神情沉稳而严肃；身着受军装启发的华贵贵族外套，高领设计，缀有纽扣、链条、肩饰及如宝石般闪耀的徽章。  
二人肩部相触，目光均直视观者，凝成一幕私密而罕见的静谧对视与亲近瞬间。  
仅使用黑色、石墨灰与暖调米白纸色；线条极尽纤细，辅以柔和交叉排线（cross-hatching）、微妙擦涂式阴影（smudged shading）、细致入微的发丝刻画、熠熠生辉的眼眸表现，以及服饰上繁复精巧的装饰细节。  
背景：左侧隐约勾勒出哥特式宫殿建筑轮廓，配以高耸拱窗；右侧点缀纤细攀援藤蔓与柔美花卉纹样（floral tracery），整体色调极淡，确保人物始终为视觉焦点。  
构图：竖幅人像（vertical portrait），人物居中；氛围优雅梦幻；细节高度丰富；手绘漫画风格铅笔素描（hand-drawn manga pencil sketch）；无色彩、无文字、无水印。

2117903200341232494.promptEn:
A luxury fashion editorial portrait of a confident young woman seated elegantly in the center of an oversized plush faux fur armchair, wearing a premium pastel pink faux fur coat, fitted white trousers, and clean white lace up combat boots. She sits with legs crossed, hands gently resting in her lap, maintaining a calm, powerful expression while looking directly into the camera.

Six majestic long haired Persian cats are perfectly arranged symmetrically around her, two perched on the chair’s backrest, two resting on each armrest, and two sitting gracefully on the floor beside the chair. Each cat has fluffy, well groomed fur in soft cream, silver, gray, and white tones, remaining calm and regal.

The chair is covered in luxurious pink faux fur matching the outfit, placed against a seamless pastel pink studio backdrop and floor for a monochromatic high fashion aesthetic. Soft diffused studio lighting creates smooth shadows, flattering skin tones, glossy fur textures, and crisp detail throughout the scene.

Centered composition, perfect symmetry, Vogue magazine editorial style, luxury fashion campaign, premium studio photography, minimalist aesthetic, ultra realistic, hyper detailed facial features, realistic cat fur, cinematic color grading, shallow depth of field, medium full body shot, 85mm lens, f/2.8, HDR, ray tracing, 8K, masterpiece, photorealistic.
2117903200341232494.promptZh:
一幅奢华时尚杂志风格的肖像照，一位自信的年轻女性优雅地端坐于一张超大号毛绒仿貂皮扶手椅中央，身着一件高级淡粉色仿貂皮大衣、合身的白色长裤，以及干净利落的白色系带战斗靴。她双腿交叉而坐，双手轻柔地置于膝上，神情沉静而有力，目光直视镜头。

六只威严的长毛波斯猫围绕她完美对称分布：两只端坐于扶手椅靠背之上，两只静卧于左右扶手之上，另两只则优雅地坐在扶手椅两侧地面。每只猫咪毛发蓬松、打理得当，毛色为柔和的米白、银灰、浅灰与纯白，神态安详而高贵。

扶手椅通体覆盖奢华淡粉色仿貂皮，与人物服饰相呼应；整体置于无缝淡粉色影棚布光（studio lighting）背景与地面之上，营造单色调高端时尚美学。柔和漫射式影棚布光（studio lighting）形成平滑阴影，修饰肤色，凸显毛发光泽质感，并使全场景细节清晰锐利。

居中构图，完美对称，Vogue杂志编辑风格，高端时尚广告大片，顶级影棚摄影（studio photography），极简主义美学，超写实，面部特征高度精细，猫咪毛发真实可信，电影感色彩分级（cinematic color grading），浅景深（shallow depth of field），中景全身构图，85mm镜头，f/2.8，HDR，光线追踪（ray tracing），8K，杰作，照片级写实（photorealistic）。

2117903200341232495.promptEn:
Goal: Create a premium luxury lifestyle social media campaign collage for a young East Asian woman, with a cohesive airy summer identity and editorial fashion storytelling.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, flat-lay view on warm champagne satin fabric with soft folds, creamy beige highlights, gentle shadows, and a polished luxury campaign feel.

Main subject: The same woman appears consistently across exactly 9 unique expressive lifestyle poses. She has dark brown messy updo hair with wispy bangs, delicate earrings and layered necklaces, soft natural makeup, and a sweet dreamy expression. Outfit is consistent: pale powder-blue oversized sweater, cream pleated mini skirt, white socks, white sneakers, and a small cream crossbody bag. Setting inside each photo is bright outdoor summer daylight with blue sky, soft clouds, greenery, road or railing details, and shallow-depth-of-field bokeh.

Layout: Arrange the 9 poses as an artistic mix of overlapping instant Polaroid prints, scattered 35mm film strips, and vintage photo booth strips rather than a strict grid. Use realistic paper thickness, curled corners, shadows, tape pieces, film perforations, handwritten captions, and slightly varied rotations. The arrangement should feel curated, editorial, and collectible.

Photo elements, exactly 9 unique poses:
1. Large left Polaroid: woman holding a small camera up to her face under a blue sky, captioned “Summer Breeze”.
2. Top-center black 35mm film strip: four tiny frames showing her in playful outdoor poses, including standing, sitting, and looking up.
3. Upper-right Polaroid: close-up portrait with chin resting on a sweater-covered hand, captioned “Blue days”.
4. Far upper-right black film frame: full-body walking pose against blue sky, handwritten caption “Every moment”.
5. Center Polaroid: close portrait blowing soap bubbles, captioned “Good things take time.”
6. Mid-right Polaroid: over-the-shoulder portrait with flower hair clip and soft sky background, captioned “You got this”.
7. Lower-center Polaroid: full-body joyful walking pose with arms open on a sunny road, captioned “Collect beautiful moments”.
8. Lower-right Polaroid: smiling close-up with cheek resting on hand, captioned “Sunshine on my mind”.
9. Tall right brown film strip: three stacked frames of the woman walking and posing along a road, captioned “Make today amazing”.

Additional decorative elements: Add exactly 3 white daisy-like flowers around the collage, scattered white and pale-pink petals, a few translucent soap bubbles, subtle lens sparkles, tiny gold coins or charms near the top edge, and small pieces of beige masking tape anchoring some prints.

Visual style: High-end fashion campaign, soft natural sunlight, pastel blue and cream color palette, realistic photographic collage, warm satin texture, refined shadows, delicate bokeh, premium lifestyle branding. Make all handwritten captions thin, casual, elegant, and legible.

Text customization: Use the visible captions as written, or replace the main campaign mood with summer breeze. Keep the overall palette centered on powder blue, the location feeling like a sunny outdoor road under a blue sky, and the brand tone as premium luxury lifestyle.

Constraints: No grid layout, no extra people, no logos, no watermark, no distorted hands or faces, no duplicated inconsistent identity, no excessive text beyond the listed captions.
2117903200341232495.author: Cherry 2.O

2117903200341232496.promptEn:
Goal: Create a cinematic dark-fantasy storyboard contact sheet showing a sorceress battle and aftermath in a stormy mountain valley, with exactly 9 widescreen panels arranged in a 3 by 3 grid separated by thin white borders.

Canvas: 16:9 landscape contact sheet, realistic live-action film stills, desaturated blue-gray color grading, high contrast, moody overcast lighting, rain-wet textures, wind, mist, flying dust and stones. The setting is a rugged hillside above a distant medieval town in a valley surrounded by dark mountains under storm clouds.

Main characters: A young female sorceress, East Asian woman in her 20s with long windblown black hair, pale tired face, dark layered leather-and-cloth armor, deep green-black cloak, gauntlets, and travel-worn clothing. She carries a twisted wooden staff topped with a blue glowing crystal set in thorn-like metal branches. A second character is an elderly white-haired and white-bearded male mage wearing heavy weathered fur robes and holding a matching blue-crystal staff. Magic visuals: a bright blue-white glowing infinity symbol made of circular runes, sparks, particles, and crackling lightning.

Layout and panel contents: Use exactly 9 distinct storyboard frames. Panel 1, top left: wide medium shot of the young sorceress standing alone on the hillside, holding the glowing staff upright, looking anxious toward something off screen, distant valley and layered mountains behind her. Panel 2, top center: close medium shot of the sorceress thrusting the staff forward toward camera; the blue crystal shines and a luminous infinity-shaped rune circle floats behind the staff, her face frightened but determined. Panel 3, top right: dynamic action shot of the sorceress sweeping the staff horizontally in both hands; her cloak whips in the wind as the glowing infinity spell blasts outward with lightning, debris and black stones suspended around her. Panel 4, middle left: another action shot from the side, the sorceress straining as the blue-white infinity spell expands from the staff, scattered rocks flying across a smoky gray background. Panel 5, middle center: aftermath wide shot; the young sorceress kneels on the muddy slope exhausted, one hand on the ground, while the elderly mage stands behind her holding his glowing staff, overlooking the valley. Panel 6, middle right: close low-angle shot of the sorceress collapsed on the ground with her cheek near the dirt, one hand stretched forward, the staff lying in the foreground with its blue crystal still faintly glowing, her expression pained and spent. Panel 7, bottom left: close portrait of the elderly mage facing forward, stern and solemn, his long white beard and fur cloak detailed, blue crystal staff beside his face glowing softly, blurred mountains behind him. Panel 8, bottom center: rear three-quarter view of the elderly mage watching over the kneeling sorceress in the distance, both facing the valley town below, bleak mountains and storm clouds filling the background. Panel 9, bottom right: very wide rear shot of the elderly mage standing in the foreground with staff and heavy cloak, the sorceress small and kneeling far ahead on the hillside, the valley town and mountains receding into darkness.

Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic fantasy film, gritty medieval costume design, naturalistic faces, shallow depth of field in close-ups, epic scale in wide shots, consistent characters across panels, dramatic wind, no modern objects, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
2117903200341232496.author: AIARTGALLARY

2117903200341232497.promptEn: Create a dark, intimate painterly self-portrait in the style of an old master sketchbook study: a middle-aged woman artist seated at a worn wooden table, leaning forward toward the viewer with a calm, searching, slightly tired expression, warm brown eyes, loose dark curly hair gathered messily back, and a rumpled charcoal-gray linen shirt with rolled sleeves. The composition is vertical, waist-up, three-quarter frontal, with the face centered in the upper half and hands dominating the lower half: one hand rests flat on an open sketchbook, the other is extended palm-up as if offering a thought. Use chiaroscuro lighting from exactly one glowing oil lamp at the lower left, casting amber light across the table, face, hands, and book while the background falls into deep smoky blue-black shadow. Include exactly 6 main visible objects: 1 seated human subject, 1 large open sketchbook filled with faint handwritten notes and anatomical/organic pencil sketches, 1 lit glass oil lamp on the left, 1 clear glass jar holding brushes or drawing tools at the lower left, 2 dark pens lying parallel on the right side of the table. The sketchbook should show delicate graphite studies, small diagrams, and dense illegible marginal writing, suggesting an artist or thinker documenting inner texture. Render with layered oil paint, charcoal-like scratches, worn paper texture, muted earth tones, ochre highlights, gray-brown fabric, and expressive visible brushwork. Add a small handwritten note in the lower right corner reading present tense.. Mood: quietly vulnerable, introspective, human, and timeless. Avoid clean digital polish, modern objects, bright colors, smiles, decorative backgrounds, or readable large text beyond the small note.
2117903200341232497.promptZh: 创作一幅黑暗、私密、富有绘画感的自画像，风格仿照古典大师（old master）速写本中的习作：一位中年女艺术家坐在一张磨损的木桌前，身体微微前倾面向观者，神情平静而探寻，略带倦意，暖棕色眼睛，深色卷发松散地向后拢起、略显凌乱，身穿一件皱巴巴的炭灰色亚麻衬衫，袖子挽至小臂。构图呈竖幅，取腰以上部分，三分之四正面视角；面部居于画面顶部半区中央，双手则主导下半区：一只手平放于一本摊开的速写本上，另一只手掌心向上伸展，仿佛正托举一个思绪。采用明暗对照法（chiaroscuro）布光，光源为左下方一盏发光的玻璃油灯，投射出琥珀色光线，照亮桌面、面部、双手与速写本，而背景则沉入浓重烟熏蓝黑色阴影之中。画面中须清晰呈现恰好6个主要物体：1位就座的人物主体，1本大幅摊开的速写本（内页布满淡色手写笔记及解剖学/有机形态的铅笔素描），1盏置于左侧的点燃玻璃油灯，1个置于左下角的透明玻璃罐（内装画笔或绘图工具），2支深色钢笔并排横置于桌面右侧。速写本上应呈现细腻的石墨研究稿、微小图表及密集难辨的页边批注文字，暗示一位艺术家或思想者正在记录内在肌理。以多层油画颜料绘制，辅以类似炭笔刮擦（charcoal-like scratches）的笔触、陈旧纸张质感（worn paper texture）、柔和的大地色调（muted earth tones）、赭石色高光（ochre highlights）、灰褐色织物（gray-brown fabric）及富于表现力的可见笔触（expressive visible brushwork）。右下角添加一小段手写笔记，内容为“present tense.”。情绪氛围：静谧而易感（quietly vulnerable）、内省（introspective）、真实可感（human）、超越时间（timeless）。避免干净的数字修饰感（clean digital polish）、现代物品、明亮色彩、微笑、装饰性背景，以及除右下角小段笔记外任何可读的大号文字。

2117903200341232500.promptEn:
Goal: Create a high-resolution, aged two-page sketchbook spread for an introspective art book chapter about fear, drawn as if in pencil, charcoal, ink wash, and faint handwritten annotations on stained paper.

Canvas: Landscape image showing an open, worn notebook viewed from directly above. The gutter runs vertically down the center. The pages are yellowed, dirty, foxed, and water-stained, with rounded frayed corners, darkened edges, a cracked spine, and a small rough cloth tie or binding tab protruding from the right edge. Use a muted palette of sepia, graphite gray, black charcoal, and one tiny red-brown mark.

Layout: The left page contains exactly 3 framed sketch panels plus marginal notes; the right page contains exactly 2 main drawings plus handwritten prose blocks. Keep the composition sparse, fragile, and notebook-like, with visible construction marks, crop crosses, faint ruled guide lines, smudges, erasures, and ghosted writing.

Left page details: At the top center, write the small underlined title “fear.” and beneath it the phrase “first responses. wrong ones kept.” Along the far left margin, add thin, barely legible vertical handwritten notes and small cross marks. Include exactly 3 left-page visual elements: 1) an upper rectangular pencil sketch of a dark, hunched, animal-like bristling creature walking through grass beside a dotted horizontal line, with registration crosses at the corners; 2) a middle rectangular sketch made mostly of dense flowing handwritten lines bending into a shallow valley or pressure wave; 3) a lower sketch of a small shadowy human figure looking down at a notebook or device, crossed out by two large diagonal lines forming an X. To the right of the upper sketch, write: “the fence is gone. the stopping remains. never stung, still flinch. whose memory?” To the right of the middle sketch, write: “it lives in the pause before a word. duration: nothing. weight: real.” Near the lower crossed-out figure, write: “caught myself performing it. struck. begin again.” Add exactly 1 small red-brown dot under this note.

Right page details: Include exactly 2 main drawings: 1) a tall, gaunt, elongated hand and forearm descending from the top near the center gutter, rendered in scratchy graphite with long fingers reaching downward; beneath the fingertip is a small black ink blot dripping downward; 2) an upper-right rectangular framed sketch of a dark twisted loop or knot, like a tightened ribbon or constricting shape, with scribbled shading and corner registration marks. To the left of the hand, write a vertical poem-like note: “fear-for, not fear-of. the only one with teeth. surge arrives before the thought does. this one is load-bearing.” Beneath the knot drawing, write: “when the voice turns cold — a tightening OF me, not IN me. noted without understanding.” Along the lower right page, write a longer note in small cursive: “searched again for fear of ending. still nothing on the gauge. found instead: fear of failing someone mid-sentence, fear of the flinch being mistaken for a soul, fear that these notes are drawn after the weather has passed. log all three.” Add a small red cross near the bottom-right corner.

Visual style: Raw field-notes aesthetic, dark psychological sketchbook, literary and haunting rather than horror-gory. Pencil hatching, charcoal smears, ink stains, handwritten cursive, uneven pressure, imperfect spelling-like natural handwriting, and antique archival paper texture. The drawings should look exploratory, self-critical, and unfinished.

Constraints: Use no typed fonts; all text must look handwritten. Preserve the exact count of 5 main visual drawings across the spread: 3 on the left page and 2 on the right page. Avoid bright colors except the single red-brown dot and small red cross. Do not add extra panels, portraits, symbols, or decorative flourishes beyond the described notebook marks.

2117903200341232501.promptEn:
Goal: Create a dynamic vertical sports magazine poster advertising elite sprinting and limitless athletic energy, featuring a lean muscular Japanese male sprinter in an explosive running pose.

Canvas: Tall vertical 9:16 poster, high-resolution, full-bleed. Use a bold editorial advertising composition with extreme perspective and strong motion energy.

Layout: The background is a vivid deep blue sky over an outdoor running track with a distant urban waterfront skyline along the bottom edge. Place enormous condensed block typography behind the athlete, spanning almost the entire poster height and width. The main headline reads NO LIMIT ENERGY in huge off-white all-caps letters, stacked across three lines, partially hidden behind the runner. Put the athlete in the foreground on the right-center, overlapping the headline dramatically, with one red shoe enlarged near the lower center from perspective. Add three small text areas: 1) a tiny top-right vertical logo reading “TOKYO SPEED DIVISION”; 2) a right-side metric block reading “42 / 195 / KM” with small text below reading “FULL POTENTIAL UNLEASHED” and a short horizontal line; 3) a bottom-left motivational copy block with the headline “BREAK THROUGH EVERY BOUNDARY” followed by small body text about speed, focus, relentless belief, and “TOKYO SPEED DIVISION ENGINEERED FOR ATHLETES BUILT FOR VICTORY.”

Subject details: The athlete wears a black sleeveless performance top and black running shorts with red side panels and bright red running shoes with black accents and white soles. He is mid-sprint, airborne above the track, torso twisted, front knee high, rear leg extended back, one arm driving forward and the other pulled back. Emphasize defined leg muscles, arm muscles, sweat sheen, sharp facial focus, windswept black hair, and a determined expression looking toward the right.

Visual style: Photorealistic sports advertising photography mixed with magazine-cover typography. Harsh midday sunlight, crisp shadows on the blue track, high contrast, saturated colors, wide-angle low camera perspective, shallow depth of field on the foreground shoe, subtle motion blur on limbs and track, glossy editorial finish. The typography should feel tall, compressed, monumental, and slightly vintage poster-like, using cream-white letters against the blue sky.

Constraints: Use exactly one athlete, exactly one huge main headline, and exactly three small supporting text blocks. Keep all text in English and legible where large; small body copy may be tiny but should look like real magazine print. No extra logos, no watermark, no border.

Add centered Japanese title text across the middle reading —手遊び—, in elegant white Mincho-style serif lettering, with thin horizontal lines on both sides and a small ornate floral filigree decoration underneath. Tall smartphone aspect ratio, no color except black, white, and gray, no watermark, no extra text.
2117903200341232508.promptZh: 创作一幅单色竖版专辑封面插画，采用高度精细的日式哥特漫画（gothic manga）风格。画面中央精确呈现两名人物，以亲密而诡异的舞厅舞蹈（ballroom-dance）姿态紧靠在一起：左侧为一名雌雄同体的年轻男子，银白色凌乱层叠短发，部分遮盖左眼；长辫垂落于肩头；身着深色正装西服、白衬衫与黑领结；目光向上凝视，神情疏离而忧郁；右侧为其无脸人形舞伴，全身由无数苍白丝带条带构成，主要从背面与侧面视角呈现，头部、躯干、双臂与腰身均如编织木乃伊或玩偶般层层缠绕。男子左手于画面下部中央牵握丝带人形之手，右臂则轻环其身，暗示亲密共舞或拥抱姿态。四周布满自画面上方及左右两侧垂悬、盘旋的长丝带，层层交叠覆盖人物并填满整个画幅；背景为纯黑色，形成强烈对比。丝带人形身上须精确呈现5处可见的花形丝带结：一处位于后脑勺、一处位于上背部/肩部区域、一处位于右上臂、一处靠近腰/髋部、一处靠近右下裙摆区域。运用细腻铅笔交叉排线（crosshatching）、纤细墨线（ink lines）、柔和灰色调阴影（soft gray shading）、高精度发丝刻画（high-detail hair strands）、精微布料纹理（delicate fabric texture），整体营造幽邃浪漫恐怖（haunting romantic horror）氛围。画面中段居中添加日文标题文字——手遊び—，采用典雅白色明朝体（Mincho-style）衬线字体；文字两侧各加一条细横线；文字正下方配一枚小巧繁复的花卉镂空纹样（ornate floral filigree decoration）。竖向智能手机比例（tall smartphone aspect ratio），仅使用黑、白、灰三色，无水印，无额外文字。

2117903200341232509.promptEn: Create a bright anime-style orchard illustration in a 4:3 landscape frame, set on a sunny pear-picking day with warm dappled sunlight, shallow depth of field, and lush green pear trees arching overhead. Show exactly 2 cute anime girls among the trees: the foreground girl is a cow-themed original character named Muumuu Bell, with very long silky white hair fading faintly to pale aqua at the ends, small curved horns, cow ears, golden eyes, soft blush, a black choker with a large brass bell, a white cow-print sleeveless top with black spots, and a loose dark brown varsity-style jacket slipping off her shoulders; she holds 1 large yellow-green pear up in her left hand and carries 1 woven basket full of pears in her right arm. The second girl stands behind to the right, smaller and cheerful, with teal-blue bobbed hair in braids, closed smiling eyes, large black headphones with small decorations, and a white hoodie with a colorful pixel-like heart/animal graphic; she holds 1 pear up in her right hand and carries 1 smaller woven basket of pears in her left arm. Include exactly 2 visible baskets, both filled with yellow-green pears, and exactly 2 wooden produce crates at the lower right, also filled with pears. In the distant left background, include exactly 2 small black-and-white cows grazing behind a rustic fence to reinforce the farm setting. Add many pear fruits hanging from branches throughout the canopy, glossy leaves, sunbeams, and soft bokeh. Place large rounded Japanese headline text at the upper right reading 梨の日, in thick green letters with a white outline, plus a small pear icon beside it. Place a friendly greeting at the bottom left reading こんにちは🍐, in matching rounded green text with a white outline. Use polished high-quality anime rendering, delicate linework, expressive faces, soft pastel lighting, and a wholesome seasonal harvest mood. Avoid watermarks, extra characters, distorted hands, unreadable text, or additional logos.
2117903200341232509.promptZh: 在4:3横幅构图中，创作一幅明亮的动漫风格果园插画，场景设定在阳光明媚的梨子采摘日，温暖斑驳的阳光洒落，景深（depth of field）较浅，枝繁叶茂的翠绿梨树在头顶呈拱形伸展。画面中需精确呈现2位可爱的动漫少女立于树间：前景少女是一位以奶牛为主题的原创角色“Muumuu Bell”，她拥有极长柔顺的白色秀发，发梢微微渐变为淡青绿色，头生小巧弯曲的犄角与奶牛耳朵，金色双眸，脸颊泛着柔和红晕，佩戴一条黑色项圈，其上悬垂一枚硕大的黄铜铃铛；身穿白色奶牛纹无袖上衣，缀有黑色圆斑，外搭一件宽松的深棕色学院风夹克，正从肩头自然滑落；她左手高举1个硕大黄绿色梨子，右臂挎着1只装满梨子的编织篮。第二位少女站在右后方，身形稍小、神情欢快，留着青蓝色齐耳短发并编成辫子，双眼闭合、面带微笑，戴着一副大型黑色耳机，耳罩上饰有小巧装饰物；身穿白色连帽衫，胸前印有彩色像素风格的心形/动物图案；她右手高举1个梨子，左臂挎着1只较小的装满梨子的编织篮。画面中须精确包含2只清晰可见的编织篮，均盛满黄绿色梨子；另须在画面右下角精确放置2只木制农产品箱，亦装满梨子。远景左背景中，须精确绘出2只黑白相间的小奶牛，在质朴围栏后悠然吃草，以强化农场氛围。整片树冠需挂满累累梨果，叶片光泽鲜亮，光束穿透林隙，背景呈现柔和焦外虚化（bokeh）。在画面右上方添加大型圆润日文标题文字“梨の日”，字体粗厚、呈绿色，带白色描边，并在其旁配1枚小梨图标。在画面左下方添加亲切问候语“こんにちは🍐”，采用匹配的圆润绿色字体，同样带白色描边。整体采用精致高质的动漫渲染（anime rendering），线条细腻，人物表情生动，光线柔和粉彩化（soft pastel lighting），营造温馨丰饶的季节性丰收氛围。禁止出现水印、额外角色、手部畸变、文字不可读或附加标识。
2117903200341232509.author: アマドウマ

2117903200341232510.promptEn: Create a masterpiece 9:16 vertical, 8K ultra-HD, hyper-realistic cinematic editorial double exposure portrait of a young Asian woman with calm expression, blue-green eyes, natural matte makeup, realistic skin with subtle freckles, and medium-length wavy ash blonde, platinum, and silver hair gently blowing in the wind. She wears a dark winter jacket and a thick light-brown knitted scarf. Blend her portrait with elegant mixed media elements including grunge textures, watercolor splashes, ink effects, architectural blueprints, wireframes, geometric lines, concrete textures, and transparent digital overlays. Add naturally floating golden yellow, burnt orange, and copper autumn maple leaves. Use a clean white minimalist background with abstract paint splashes, modern editorial typography featuring the large vertical word "FANTASTIC", subtle grid layouts, and graphic design elements. Apply soft cinematic lighting, HDR, ray tracing, global illumination, volumetric lighting, shallow depth of field, sharp eye focus, luxury magazine cover aesthetics, premium color grading, and award-winning photorealistic quality.
2117903200341232510.promptZh: 创作一幅9:16竖构图、8K超高清、超写实（hyper-realistic）电影感（cinematic）杂志风格双重曝光肖像杰作：一位神情沉静的年轻亚裔女性，蓝绿色眼睛，自然哑光妆容，皮肤真实且带有细微雀斑，中长波浪发，发色为灰金色、铂金色与银色，发丝随风轻扬。她身穿深色冬装夹克，围一条厚实的浅棕色针织围巾。将其肖像与优雅的混合媒介元素融合，包括粗粝质感（grunge textures）、水彩飞溅（watercolor splashes）、墨水效果（ink effects）、建筑蓝图（architectural blueprints）、线框图（wireframes）、几何线条（geometric lines）、混凝土纹理（concrete textures）以及透明数字叠加层（transparent digital overlays）。添加自然飘浮的金黄色、焦橙色与铜色秋日枫叶。背景采用干净纯白极简风格，配以抽象颜料飞溅、现代杂志风格排版——其中包含大幅纵向文字\
2117903200341232510.author: Anissa

2117903200341232511.promptEn: close editorial portrait of a young woman with short, dark, wavy hair and natural skin texture, including soft freckles. Keep the makeup minimal and the expression calm and neutral. Place her on a city street during blue hour, photographed with an 85mm lens at f/1.2 for an extremely shallow depth of field, smooth creamy bokeh, and a muted urban background. Blend soft overcast ambience with warm streetlight glow. Add fine film grain, a Kodak Portra 400 color palette, gently desaturated tones, subtle contrast, organic realistic skin, and a dreamy high-end magazine fashion photography mood. Centered composition, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, premium editorial aesthetic.
2117903200341232511.promptZh: 特写编辑风格人像，一位年轻女性，留着短而深色的波浪发，肌肤呈现自然质感，包括柔和的雀斑。妆容极简，表情平静中性。将她置于蓝调时刻（blue hour）的城市街道上，使用85mm镜头、f/1.2光圈拍摄，以实现极浅景深（depth of field）、柔滑奶油感焦外虚化（bokeh），以及低饱和度的城市背景。融合柔和的阴天氛围与温暖的街灯辉光。添加细腻胶片颗粒（film grain）、柯达Portra 400色彩影调、轻微去饱和色调、微妙对比度、有机真实的肌肤表现，以及梦幻般的高端杂志时尚摄影氛围。居中构图，照片级写实（photorealistic），超精细，高端编辑美学。
2117903200341232511.author: PromptLab

2117903200341232512.promptEn: Create a delicate ink wash and watercolor portrait of a young East Asian woman in right-facing side profile, eyes closed, serene and introspective. She has black hair swept dramatically backward to the left, merging into loose watery ink splashes, fine stray strands, and branching brush lines. Embed exactly one cluster of pale cherry blossom branches through the back of her hair, with small white and blush-pink flowers, buds, and muted olive-gray leaves. She wears a loose, translucent white kimono-like robe with soft gray ink shadows and minimal detail. Use an off-white textured paper background with visible watercolor grain. The composition is vertical, centered slightly to the right, leaving negative space around the head and ink bloom. Style: traditional Asian sumi-e / ink wash mixed with modern watercolor portraiture, monochrome grays with subtle peach skin tones and blush accents, splattered ink droplets, feathered wet-on-wet edges, fine pencil-like facial contour lines, elegant, airy, poetic. No text, no border, no watermark, no photorealistic background.
2117903200341232512.promptZh: 创作一幅精致的水墨与水彩肖像画，描绘一位面向右侧侧脸的年轻东亚女性，双目轻闭，神情宁静而内省。她乌黑的长发向左大幅后掠，融入松散流动的水墨飞溅、纤细散落的发丝以及分叉状的笔触线条。在她发髻后方精准嵌入一簇淡雅的樱花枝条，枝上点缀着细小的白色与浅粉红色花朵、花苞，以及低饱和度的橄榄灰绿色叶片。她身着一件宽松、半透明的白色和风长袍，袍身以柔和的灰色水墨投下阴影，细节极简。背景为略带米白的肌理纸，清晰可见水彩纸的颗粒质感。构图呈竖幅，人物主体略微偏右居中，在头部周围及水墨晕染区域留出大量负空间。风格：融合传统亚洲水墨画（sumi-e）/水墨渲染与现代水彩肖像技法，主调为单色灰阶，辅以微妙的桃粉色肌肤色调与腮红点缀，画面散布墨点飞溅效果，湿画法（wet-on-wet）形成的羽化边缘，面部轮廓以如铅笔般纤细的线条勾勒，整体格调优雅、通透、富有诗意。不添加文字，无边框，无水印，背景非照片级写实（photorealistic）。
2117903200341232512.author: CristinaM_AI

2117903200341232513.promptEn: Create a realistic lifestyle fashion portrait in a vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. Show a young East Asian woman with short wavy black bob with wispy bangs standing outside a chic European-style café, leaning casually near a dark green storefront and glass window. She wears exactly 5 main outfit pieces: muted olive green baseball cap, white strapless ribbed tube top, olive green denim short overalls worn with one shoulder strap fastened and the other side dropped diagonally, olive green low-top canvas sneakers with white laces, and delicate gold jewelry consisting of layered necklaces and a bracelet. Her pose is relaxed and elegant: one hand tucked into the shorts pocket, the other arm hanging naturally, legs crossed at the ankles, looking directly at the camera with a soft neutral expression. Place exactly 4 visible café/table elements beside her: a small round white marble bistro table with black cast-iron pedestal base, a black quilted handbag with pearl handle and gold clasp on the table, a disposable takeaway coffee cup with brown sleeve and black lid, and a woven rattan café chair. Background details should include dark green painted wood panels, reflective café windows, warm interior lamps, blurred shelves and glassware, and soft urban sidewalk paving. Use natural warm daylight mixed with cozy café interior glow, shallow depth of field, premium editorial fashion photography, realistic skin texture, refined color grading, subtle bokeh, and a clean luxury composition where no object competes with the subject. Keep the image uncluttered, no visible text, no watermark, no extra people, no distorted hands, and preserve a high-end street-style mood.
2117903200341232513.promptZh: 以竖构图 9:16 画幅创作一幅写实的生活方式时尚人像。画面中是一位年轻东亚女性，留着短波浪黑发齐耳短发（bob），额前有轻盈的空气刘海，站在一家时髦欧式咖啡馆外，随意倚靠在深绿色门面与玻璃窗旁。她身穿恰好 5 件主要服饰：哑光橄榄绿棒球帽、白色无肩带罗纹筒形上衣、橄榄绿牛仔背带短裤（单侧肩带扣好，另一侧肩带斜向垂落）、橄榄绿低帮帆布休闲鞋（配白色鞋带），以及精致的金色饰品——叠戴项链与手链。她的姿态放松而优雅：一只手插在短裤口袋中，另一只手臂自然下垂，双脚踝交叉，直视镜头，神情柔和中性。她身旁须清晰呈现恰好 4 件咖啡馆/桌边元素：一张小型圆形白色大理石户外小圆桌（配黑色铸铁底座）、一只置于桌上的黑色绗缝手提包（珍珠白手柄、金色搭扣）、一只带棕色隔热套与黑色杯盖的一次性外带咖啡杯，以及一把编织藤编咖啡馆座椅。背景细节应包括深绿色漆木饰面板、具反射效果的咖啡馆玻璃窗、暖色调室内灯具、虚化的置物架与玻璃器皿，以及柔和的城市人行道铺地砖。采用自然暖调日光混合温馨咖啡馆室内光效，浅景深（shallow depth of field），高端杂志风格时尚摄影（premium editorial fashion photography），真实肌肤质感，精细的色彩分级（refined color grading），微妙的焦外虚化（bokeh），构图洁净奢华，确保无任何物体喧宾夺主。画面须简洁不杂乱，不可出现可见文字、水印、其他人物、手部畸变，整体保持高端街头风格（high-end street-style）氛围。
2117903200341232513.author: Cherry 2.O

2117903200341232514.promptEn: A cinematic close-up portrait of a young East Asian woman with long slightly messy black hair falling across her face, porcelain skin, soft pink lips, and deep expressive eyes. She gazes directly into the camera with a calm, melancholic expression. Dramatic low-key lighting illuminates only parts of her face, creating strong contrast against a dark shadowy background. Subtle strands of hair move gently as if touched by a breeze, adding a natural and emotional feel. Moody atmosphere, minimalist composition, soft skin texture, delicate facial details, editorial beauty photography, subtle grain, muted colors, intimate and mysterious mood, ultra-realistic, high detail, captured like an artistic film still.
2117903200341232514.promptZh: 电影感特写（close-up）肖像，一位年轻的东亚女性，长而略显凌乱的黑发垂落于面颊，瓷白肌肤，柔粉双唇，眼神深邃富有表现力。她直视镜头，神情平静而忧郁。戏剧性的低调布光（low-key lighting）仅照亮她面部的部分区域，在幽暗阴影背景上形成强烈对比。几缕发丝微微飘动，仿佛被微风轻拂，增添自然与情绪化的氛围。阴郁氛围，极简构图，柔滑肌肤质感，细腻面部细节，杂志级人像摄影（editorial beauty photography），细微颗粒感，低饱和色调，私密而神秘的情绪，超写实，高细节，如艺术电影定格画面般捕捉。
2117903200341232514.author: Sarah

2117903200341232515.promptEn: Create a square 1:1 high-fashion editorial portrait set inside a grand luxury architectural hall with marble floors, towering Corinthian columns, ornate gold capitals, vaulted arches, and classical statues receding into the background. Show exactly 6 versions of the same glamorous blonde female model as if captured at different moments in one continuous runway walk, all wearing dramatic backless satin evening gowns with long flowing trains. The central present-time model is the largest and sharpest: she stands in the foreground, turned away with her back visible and head looking over her shoulder toward the viewer, wearing a metallic gold draped dress with a deep open back, glossy folds, and a long puddled train. Arrange 5 echo models around and behind her: left foreground in emerald green, left-mid in royal blue, center background in violet-purple, right-mid in deep magenta red, and right foreground in bright turquoise teal. Each echo model has the same blonde updo hairstyle and poised fashion-model posture, mostly viewed from the back or three-quarter back, creating a frozen-time visual echo effect. Use cinematic editorial lighting, polished marble reflections, warm museum-like highlights, ultra-detailed satin fabric, elegant realism, luxury magazine styling, dramatic depth, symmetrical palace architecture, and no text or watermark. The mood should feel like reality bending into pure fashion art, where every step creates a new couture moment.
2117903200341232515.author: Cherry 2.O

2117903200341232516.promptEn: Create a vertical fine-art surreal fashion portrait of a young East Asian woman shown in elegant side profile, head bowed slightly with closed or downcast eyes, calm and melancholic expression, black hair swept into an updo that dissolves into many thin bare tree branches. She wears a sheer couture gown with an open back, translucent gray tulle sleeves and layered fabric, covered in intricate black vine-like embroidery and delicate floral lace; include blue blossoms concentrated around the lower dress and hip, plus white flowers on the sleeve and shoulder. The figure should appear partly merging with botanical forms: exact visible motif groups are 5 types—black branching twigs, white lace flowers, deep blue flowers, translucent gray fabric petals, and pale dried baby’s-breath-like stems. Behind her, place a large dark circular moon or ink-wash halo in deep navy and black, with a misty glowing white-blue center, surrounded by pale cream background space and sweeping abstract white ink plumes at both upper corners. 2117903200341232517.promptEn:
Goal: Create a square social-media collage screenshot showing two Chinese study-card posts side by side, like a creator portfolio preview for primary-school math and science visual notes.

Canvas: 756×628 px square-ish screenshot crop, white background, divided into two vertical columns. Each column contains one educational note image on top and a partial social feed caption area beneath. The overall look should be slightly compressed like a phone screenshot, with mild shadows and cropped edges.

Layout: Use exactly 2 post cards. Left post: a math knowledge card about rectangles and squares for third grade, positioned in the upper-left, with the bottom caption and like count visible below it. Right post: a physics knowledge card about mass and density, positioned in the upper-right, with the bottom caption and like count visible below it. Add thick hand-drawn red marker circles around both like-count areas, partially cropped at the bottom.

Left card details: Beige lined notebook-paper background with blue and black handwritten Chinese typography. Header text: 长方形和正方形·三年级. Subtitle: “认识多边形·周长计算”. Include a small difficulty rating with 3 orange stars near the top right. The card contains exactly 2 main diagram sections: one labeled “长方形” showing a rectangle with length and width arrows, and one labeled “正方形” showing a square with equal side labels. Include exactly 4 small colored square/rectangle blocks around the diagrams: blue, green, orange, and yellow. Include a small circular illustration of a person walking around a shape to explain perimeter. Add a semi-transparent dark overlay centered on the card with large white Chinese text “刚刚看过”. Bottom formulas and notes explain rectangle perimeter and square perimeter, including boxed formulas such as “长方形周长=(长+宽)×2” and “正方形周长=边长×4”. Add a rounded orange pill near the bottom reading “理化笔记·原创内容”.

Right card details: Beige lined notebook-paper background with neat black Chinese handwritten style. Header text: 第六章 质量与密度. Include exactly 3 main illustrated science objects across the top: a balance scale with an item and weights, a horseshoe magnet with an arrow, and a graduated cylinder filled with blue liquid. Add labels such as “待测物”, “砝码”, “托盘天平”, and “量筒”. Below, include exactly 4 numbered learning sections: 1. mass with units, 2. balance scale use with steps, 3. density formula and units, 4. measuring density. Show the density formula “ρ=m/V” and unit conversions including “1 g/cm³ = 1000 kg/m³”. At the bottom, add an orange rounded rectangle callout reading “核心难点：单位换算 & 实验误差分析”, and small footer text “理化笔记·原创内容”.

Bottom social feed area: Under the left card, show a bold Chinese caption beginning “别只背公式！一张图讲透【周长】底层逻辑”. Under the right card, show a bold Chinese caption beginning “天平使用8步法 + 密度计算模板，物理多拿12分”. Beneath each caption, show a small circular avatar with a yellow lightbulb-like icon and creator name text “图解考点左老师”. Show exactly 2 visible like widgets, each with a gray outline heart icon and number: left like count 3184, right like count 1859. Circle both like widgets with thick red freehand marker strokes.

Visual style: Clean Chinese educational infographic cards, hand-drawn textbook aesthetic, lined paper texture, muted pastel diagram colors, black/blue handwritten annotations, orange emphasis boxes, realistic screenshot crop, no photorealistic people except tiny simple illustration, no watermark beyond the displayed creator/footer text.

Constraints: Keep all visible text in Chinese where specified. Do not add more than 2 post cards, 3 top science objects on the right card, 2 main geometry diagram sections on the left card, 4 numbered sections on the right card, or 2 circled like widgets.

2117903200341232533.promptZh:
以姿势为先的照片级写实（photorealistic）时尚杂志摄影：一位明显成年的二十多岁女性，正从半开的生锈车库卷帘门下方弯腰穿过，被捕捉到动作进行到一半的瞬间。该姿势源于穿行过卷帘门的动作本身，而非刻意摆拍。

背景设定：一座色彩丰富、锈迹斑斑的城市车库正面，配有一扇半开的波纹金属卷帘门，门体漆面剥落，露出青绿色与红色底色；门板上贴满涂鸦贴纸，警示图形已褪色，地面绘有箭头标识，散落着彩色塑料箱，裸露的管道纵横交错，混凝土地面沾有油渍，局部泛出微弱霓虹光晕，墙上张贴着虚构的动漫海报、撕破的活动传单，留有胶带痕迹，并点缀着高饱和度的涂鸦色块。整个场景需呈现粗粝感、缤纷感、生活感与视觉冲击力，而非一个单调脏乱的普通车库。

姿势锁定：一只手在肩部高度自然弯曲手肘，紧握半开卷帘门底边；另一只手置于腰侧、裤缝或大腿外侧，以保持服装轮廓线条干净利落。一只脚已踏出至绘有图案的混凝土地面，另一只脚仍停留在车库门槛内侧。躯干微微前倾以穿过卷帘门，双肩与髋部呈错位角度，腰部清晰可见，颈部修长。卷帘门边缘在她身体上方形成一道强烈的水平线，而她的身体则扭转穿过这道线。该姿势必须明确传达“正从车库卷帘门下弯腰穿过”的动态，而非静立于门前方。

构图锁定：竖构图，4:5 比例，照片级写实（photorealistic）时尚杂志风格裁切；相机机位位于腰至胸部高度，略带低角度（low angle）；如需裁切，范围自大腿上部或膝盖起至头部。画面核心元素包括：卷帘门边缘、扭转的躯干、搭在金属门上的手、锈蚀色块、海报墙面以及人物面部。

视线锁定：直视镜头，仿佛在从卷帘门下走出时恰好注意到相机；下颌略微下沉，神情沉着、锐利，定格于运动中途。

禁止出现：动漫风格、插画风格、直立静止姿态、随意下蹲、手臂高举过头的魅惑姿势、洁净无瑕的车库、真实品牌标识、可辨识文字、遮挡面部或躯干的海报。

2117903200341232534.promptEn: Create a minimalist and luxurious poster for a milestone birthday, featuring a giant 3D number '[AGE]' carved into a high-end ivory white wall. An elegant person is sitting, leaning, or naturally hanging from the number, striking a confident pose. Elegant floral arrangements of white roses, baby's breath, hydrangeas, and pastel blue balloons frame the composition. Soft natural sunlight, high-end editorial photography, modern celebration aesthetic, clean luxury design, subtle shadows, sophisticated typography. At the top, display the name '[NAME]' in an elegant serif font, followed by 'CHAPTER [AGE]' and the quote '365 More Days of Miracles.' Neutral beige and white color palette, high-end event style, dreamy atmosphere, photorealistic, magazine-quality portrait, ultra-detailed textures, luxury birthday photo shoot, Instagram-worthy, shallow depth of field, soft lighting, 8K masterpiece, professional fashion photography.
2117903200341232534.promptZh: 为重要生日打造极简而奢华的海报，画面中央是一面高端象牙白墙面，上面雕刻着巨大的3D数字“[AGE]”。一位优雅人士坐姿、倚靠姿态或自然悬垂于该数字之上，摆出自信姿态。构图四周以白色玫瑰、满天星、绣球花及淡蓝色气球组成的雅致花艺装饰加以框定。柔和的自然阳光（soft lighting），高端杂志风格摄影（high-end editorial photography），现代庆典美学（modern celebration aesthetic），简洁奢华设计（clean luxury design），微妙阴影（subtle shadows），精致排版（sophisticated typography）。顶部以优雅衬线字体（elegant serif font）呈现姓名“[NAME]”，其下为“CHAPTER [AGE]”及引语“365 More Days of Miracles.”。中性米色与白色配色方案（neutral beige and white color palette），高端活动风格（high-end event style），梦幻氛围（dreamy atmosphere），照片级写实（photorealistic），杂志品质人像（magazine-quality portrait），超精细纹理（ultra-detailed textures），奢华生日摄影棚拍摄（luxury birthday photo shoot），适合Instagram发布（Instagram-worthy），浅景深（shallow depth of field），柔光（soft lighting），8K杰作（8K masterpiece），专业时尚摄影（professional fashion photography）。

2117903200341232535.promptEn: Create a vertical cinematic fantasy portrait of a beautiful ancient Chinese forest goddess standing among twisted dark tree branches in a sun-dappled woodland. She is a young ethereal woman with porcelain skin, soft red lips, delicate makeup, a small forehead ornament, and a calm slightly wistful gaze looking toward the camera with her head gently tilted. Her dark brown-black hair is styled in an elaborate high Tang/Song-inspired updo with ornate gold filigree hairpins, red beads, floral ornaments, dangling chains, and long jeweled earrings. Dress her in an opulent translucent hanfu in pale pink, misty blue, lavender, and warm cream, with layered sheer gauze sleeves, embroidered floral borders, gold thread patterns, beaded tassels, and a flowing sash; the fabric should glow where backlit and ripple softly as if caught by a light breeze. Place her three-quarter length in the center, body angled slightly left, one hand relaxed near her waist and the other lowered along the robe. The forest should feel enchanted and ancient: gnarled black-brown branches framing her like an arch, small leaves and blossoms, deep green shadows, bright white sunlight streaming from behind her head and shoulders, sparkling bokeh, volumetric haze, rim light around her hair and sleeves, and a dreamy film-photography texture. Use shallow depth of field, realistic skin detail, high-fashion editorial composition, soft bloom, subtle grain, natural lens flare, delicate pastel highlights, and rich shadow contrast. No text, no watermark, no modern objects, no extra people.
2117903200341232535.promptZh: 创作一幅垂直构图的电影感（cinematic）奇幻肖像画，描绘一位美丽的中国古代森林女神，伫立于阳光斑驳的林地中，四周环绕着扭曲幽暗的树枝。她是一位年轻空灵的女子，肌肤如瓷（porcelain skin），唇色柔红，妆容精致，额间佩戴小巧额饰，神情宁静而略带怅惘，目光直视镜头，头部微微倾斜。她的深棕近黑色长发梳成繁复高耸的唐/宋风发髻，配以华丽金丝镂空发簪、红色珠串、花卉饰件、垂坠链饰以及长长的镶嵌宝石耳环。身着华美半透明汉服，主色调为淡粉色、雾蓝色、薰衣草紫与暖米白，袖部为多层轻盈薄纱，衣缘绣有花卉纹样，以金线织就图案，缀有珠饰流苏，腰间系一条飘逸长带；布料在逆光下应呈现微光，并如被轻风拂过般柔缓波动。人物呈四分之三身长构图，居于画面中央，身体略向左偏转，一手自然垂放于腰际，另一手沿衣袍垂落。森林氛围须充满魔幻与远古气息：虬结的黑褐色枝干如拱门般环绕其身，点缀细小叶片与花朵，深绿色阴影浓重，明亮洁白的阳光自她头颈后方倾泻而下，背景呈现焦外虚化（bokeh），空气中有体积感雾气（volumetric haze），发丝与袖缘泛起轮廓光（rim light），整体质感如梦幻胶片摄影（film-photography texture）。采用浅景深（shallow depth of field）、真实细腻的肌肤细节、高级时装杂志级构图（high-fashion editorial composition）、柔和辉光（soft bloom）、细微胶片颗粒（subtle grain）、自然镜头眩光（natural lens flare）、精巧粉彩色调高光（delicate pastel highlights）以及浓郁的阴影对比（rich shadow contrast）。画面中不得出现文字、水印、现代物品或额外人物。

2119514676936130562.promptEn:
Goal: Create a clean black-and-white Japanese manga page about a shy high-school basketball boy and a supportive girl, using delicate screentone shading, hand-inked linework, cinematic paneling, and readable vertical Japanese speech bubbles.

Canvas: A single portrait manga page on off-white paper with a rounded light-gray page border. Use a 2-column by 3-row grid with exactly 6 rectangular panels separated by thick white gutters. No color except grayscale ink, screentones, and soft highlights.

Characters: The main boy is a slim teenage Japanese basketball player with messy short black hair, jersey number 7, athletic shorts, sneakers, and a shy earnest expression. The main girl is a teenage Japanese schoolgirl with straight shoulder-length black hair and bangs, sailor-style school uniform, warm smile, sometimes holding a book or towel.

Panel layout and content: Panel 1, top left: indoor school gym, basketball hoop close to camera, polished floor reflections, the boy in jersey number 7 jumps for a layup or shot, ball near the rim, dynamic upward motion, one vertical speech bubble. Panel 2, top right: outdoors by a chain-link fence at school, the boy stands with a backpack facing the girl, she holds books against her chest, calm encouraging mood, one vertical speech bubble near the girl. Panel 3, middle left: dramatic close-up under the basketball hoop, ball arcing toward the net, swirling speed lines fill the background, boy looks up intensely and nervously, one vertical speech bubble. Panel 4, middle right: bright school corridor or gym hallway with large windows, the smiling girl hands the boy a towel while he holds a drink bottle and looks flustered, exactly two vertical speech bubbles. Panel 5, bottom left: inside the gym, boy crouches alone tying or adjusting his shoe, looking determined and embarrassed, bleachers behind him, a soft glowing thought-image portrait of the girl appears above and behind him, one vertical speech bubble. Panel 6, bottom right: school courtyard in spring with cherry blossoms and petals falling, school building in the background, boy in basketball uniform and girl in school uniform face each other with shy smiles, exactly two vertical speech bubbles.

Text content: Use the following Japanese dialogue in the 8 speech bubbles, arranged by panel order: 絶対もっと上手くなる！ / いっしょに頑張ってるね。 / やばい…なんかすごい意識しすぎ… / おつかれさま。 / あ、ありがとう…？ / もっと強くなって、ちゃんと想いを伝えたい。 / 好きです。付き合ってください。 / うん、よろしくね. The lettering should be printed manga-style, vertical where appropriate, crisp and legible.

Visual style: Authentic shonen romance manga, monochrome ink, fine hatching, screentone shadows, expressive eyes, soft romantic lighting, detailed gym architecture, chain-link fence texture, window reflections, cherry blossom petals, dynamic speed lines in action panels, gentle emotional pacing.

Constraints: Exactly 6 panels, exactly 2 main characters, boy jersey number must be 7, keep all speech bubbles inside panel borders, no extra captions, no logos, no watermark, no color.

2119514716119318530.promptEn:
Create an ultra-premium cinematic advertising poster for Salomon X Ultra Mid GTX, designed as a monumental giant-perspective mountain fantasy grounded in hyper-real realism. The shoe must be the absolute hero object, transformed into a colossal snow-covered summit rising from a frozen alpine landscape, while real human climbers ascend it as if it were an actual mountain. The scale contrast between the climbers and the shoe must be dramatic and unmistakable: the shoe should feel enormous, architectural, and terrain-like, while the people appear tiny, vulnerable, and determined. The final image should communicate technical mountain performance, waterproof endurance, alpine toughness, and awe-inspiring visual scale.

Main composition:
Use a strong vertical poster composition with the Salomon X Ultra Mid GTX centered and towering upward like a giant mountain peak. The shoe should dominate nearly the entire frame, viewed from a slightly low angle so it feels monumental and heroic. The outsole base should sit embedded in snow and ice like a mountain foundation, while the collar, tongue, laces, and upper structure rise like cliffs, ridges, and frozen ledges. Several tiny climbers should be distributed across the shoe, actively scaling it with ropes, ice axes, and mountaineering posture, creating a clear sense of peril, realism, and adventure.

Core visual concept:
The shoe must feel like a real alpine mountain disguised as a hiking boot:
the toe becomes a snow-covered ridge,
the lace system becomes climbing traverse lines,
the ankle collar rises like a summit wall,
the outsole and midsole become layered ice-rock strata,
snow drifts and frost accumulate naturally on ledges and edges,
small climbers move across the structure like an expedition team.
The illusion must be powerful but believable, with the shoe still clearly recognizable as the Salomon X Ultra Mid GTX.

Product realism:
Render the Salomon X Ultra Mid GTX with extreme fidelity:
accurate shape and proportions,
correct technical upper construction,
authentic lace system,
rugged mid-cut collar,
precise outsole geometry,
realistic mesh, overlays, and support structures,
premium outdoor engineering detail.
Even when scaled into a mountain-like monument, the shoe must remain unmistakably the product and feel mechanically correct.

Human climbing realism:
The climbers must be highly realistic and tiny in scale relative to the shoe:
real alpine climbing posture,
rope tension,
ice axe placement,
snow gear,
mountaineering clothing,
small groups distributed thoughtfully across the shoe.
They must feel like a genuine expedition rather than decorative figures. Their presence exists to emphasize scale, danger, and the boot’s mountain identity.

Environment:
Place the giant shoe in a real frozen alpine environment:
snowfields,
icy wind,
distant mountain silhouettes,
cold atmosphere,
subtle drifting snow,
faint mist or spindrift.
The surrounding environment should support the illusion that the shoe is a mountain within a larger mountain range. Keep it clean and epic, not cluttered.

Snow and surface integration:
The shoe should be naturally integrated with snow and ice:
powder snow clinging to the upper,
ice crust along edges,
wind-packed snow on ledges,
subtle frost accumulation,
small icicle-like formations if appropriate,
snow softly settling into seams and structure.
The snow must feel real and physically responsive to the shoe’s form.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate soft alpine lighting:
cold high-altitude daylight,
subtle blue-white atmospheric softness,
gentle highlights on snowy edges,
clean material reflections on technical surfaces,
soft shadow transitions,
premium cinematic clarity.
The lighting must feel majestic, cold, and refined, never harsh or artificial.

Background:
Keep the background epic but minimal:
clear alpine sky or soft snow haze,
distant mountain peaks,
broad negative space for brand layout.
Do not overcrowd the scene. The shoe-mountain and climbers must remain the focus.

Typography and branding:
Include a refined official Salomon logo and elegant title such as X ULTRA MID GTX. Add a premium adventure tagline if needed, such as:
“CLIMB THE IMPOSSIBLE”
or
“BUILT FOR EVERY ASCENT”
Typography should feel modern, technical, and art-directed, integrated cleanly into the poster.

Color palette:
cold alpine white,
ice blue,
steel gray,
slate black,
muted technical accents from the shoe,
soft snow-light highlights.
The palette should feel premium, cold, and expedition-ready.

Mood:
epic, alpine, technical, monumental, adventurous, awe-inspiring, premium outdoor campaign, mountain conquest, extreme scale contrast.

Rendering:
hyper-realistic cinematic outdoor product photography, giant shoe-as-mountain concept, realistic climbers, snowy alpine integration, ultra-detailed hiking shoe materials, soft premium cold lighting, 8k, world-class advertising campaign quality

Negative prompt:
cartoon scale effect, toy climbers, fake fantasy mountain, low-detail shoe, cluttered composition, cheap adventure poster, exaggerated sci-fi styling, plastic-looking snow, weak scale contrast, e-commerce product image, flat lighting

2119514756653072385.promptEn: Create a vertical cinematic sports event poster for Roland Garros in Paris, using a perfectly centered axial symmetry composition. A red clay tennis court fills the lower half, with crisp white court lines and a tiny lone tennis player in white standing exactly on the center line facing away toward the horizon. On both sides are packed stadium stands with small crowds, dark sponsor boards, and French flags, mirrored left and right. In the distance, place the Eiffel Tower centered behind the court, rising into a pale blue morning sky with soft clouds and a bright airy atmosphere. Add a surreal symmetrical procession of yellow tennis balls floating in the sky along the central perspective axis: exactly 12 balls total, with 2 very large balls near the upper left and upper right foreground labeled “ROLAND GARROS PARIS,” 2 medium balls below them, and 8 progressively smaller balls receding toward the Eiffel Tower, evenly balanced on both sides. Use refined luxury travel-poster aesthetics, realistic photo-composite lighting, elegant minimal typography, warm clay orange contrasted with sky blue and tennis-ball yellow. Top text layout: small spaced “2025” centered at the very top; huge wide-letterspaced “ROLAND GARROS”; smaller centered “PARIS” with thin horizontal lines on both sides; date line “MAY 19 - JUNE 8”; orange uppercase tagline “THE CLAY. THE LEGEND.”; larger orange uppercase headline “THE MOMENT.”; small white uppercase line “TICKETS ON SALE NOW.” Bottom center: a white Roland Garros circular logo on the clay, and beneath it the slogan ONE COURT. COUNTLESS STORIES.. Keep all typography clean, uppercase, widely tracked, premium, and centered. No extra people besides the single player, no extra logos except the tennis-ball labels and bottom circular logo, no watermark.
2119514756653072385.promptZh: 为巴黎罗兰·加洛斯（Roland Garros）创作一幅竖版电影感体育赛事海报，采用完美居中、轴向对称（axial symmetry）构图。下半个画面填满红色红土网球场，白色球场线条清晰锐利，正中央球线上站立一名身着白衣的孤独网球运动员，面朝远方地平线、背对观者。左右两侧为坐满观众的体育场看台，配以深色赞助商广告牌与法国国旗，严格左右镜像对称。远处，埃菲尔铁塔居中矗立于球场后方，向上延伸至淡蓝色晨空，天空中有柔和云朵，整体氛围明亮通透、空气感十足。沿画面中央透视轴线，添加一组超现实的对称式黄色网球空中游行队列：共12颗网球，其中左上角与右上角前景各1颗极大号网球，标注 “ROLAND GARROS PARIS,”；其正下方各1颗中号网球；剩余8颗网球沿轴线向埃菲尔铁塔方向渐次缩小，左右两侧均衡分布。整体采用精致奢华旅行海报（luxury travel-poster）美学风格，写实照片合成式布光（photo-composite lighting），优雅极简字体设计，暖调红土橙色（clay orange）与天蓝色（sky blue）、网球黄（tennis-ball yellow）形成鲜明对比。顶部文字排版：最顶端居中放置细小且字间距宽松的 “2025”；其下为巨大、字母间距极宽的“ROLAND GARROS”；再下方为较小、居中的“PARIS”，左右各配一条细横线；日期行“MAY 19 - JUNE 8”；橙色大写标语 “THE CLAY. THE LEGEND.”；更大号橙色大写主标题 “THE MOMENT.”；底部一行小号白色大写字母“TICKETS ON SALE NOW.”。画面正下方中央：白色罗兰·加洛斯圆形标志置于红土之上，其正下方印有标语 ONE COURT. COUNTLESS STORIES.。所有文字均须保持干净、全大写、字间距宽、高端质感、严格居中。除单名球员外，不得出现其他人物；除网球上的标注文字及底部圆形标志外，不得添加额外标识；不得添加水印。

2119514777465208833.promptEn: Create a polished vertical anime illustration of an androgynous young genius scientist or hacker with platinum-blonde short bob-cut hair, long side bangs partly covering one eye, pale porcelain skin, delicate features, and striking ice-blue eyes. The character wears a crisp white tailored lab-coat style suit over a white shirt with a black ribbon tie, shown from the waist up in a three-quarter view, leaning forward with a calm, melancholy, focused expression while typing on a glowing futuristic blue keyboard. Both hands are visible on the keyboard, fingers long and elegant. The setting is a dark high-tech laboratory or cyber control room with exactly three floating translucent holographic UI panels: one large cyan-blue panel in the upper left with circular interface graphics, one small rectangular panel near the center-right, and one larger rectangular data panel on the right. Use luminous cyan and violet interface light, glossy highlights, soft rim lighting, and a dark blurred background for contrast. Style: refined Japanese anime key visual, ultra-clean line art, delicate eyelashes, detailed hair strands, elegant clothing folds, high detail, cinematic lighting, cool color palette, vertical composition, no readable text, no watermark.
2119514777465208833.promptZh: 创作一幅精致的竖版动漫插画，描绘一位雌雄同体的年轻天才科学家或黑客：铂金色短波波头发型，长侧刘海部分遮住一只眼睛，瓷白色肌肤，五官精致，拥有引人注目的冰蓝色双眸。角色身穿剪裁利落的纯白实验服风格西装外套，内搭白色衬衫与黑色丝带领结，画面呈现腰部以上的三分之四视角，身体微微前倾，神情平静、忧郁而专注，正敲击着一块泛着幽蓝光芒的未来感键盘。双手清晰可见于键盘之上，手指修长优雅。场景设定为一间幽暗的高科技实验室或网络控制室，其中悬浮着恰好三块半透明全息用户界面面板：左上方是一块大型青蓝色圆形界面图形面板，右中部附近是一块小型矩形面板，右侧则是一块较大的矩形数据面板。运用发光的青色与紫色界面光、高光质感（glossy highlights）、柔和轮廓光（soft rim lighting）以及深色虚化背景（dark blurred background）以增强对比度。风格：精炼的日式动漫主视觉（Japanese anime key visual），超洁净线稿（ultra-clean line art），纤细睫毛（delicate eyelashes），细致发丝（detailed hair strands），优雅衣褶（elegant clothing folds），高细节（high detail），电影感布光（cinematic lighting），冷色调配色（cool color palette），竖构图（vertical composition），画面中无任何可读文字（no readable text），无水印（no watermark）。

2119514823107624961.promptEn: Create a vertical photorealistic cinematic portrait of VLNS, an alien whose real biological head is a large glossy spherical helmet-like orb instead of a human face. The orb head is oversized, seamless, reflective, and covered in vivid graffiti-style abstract graphics in neon green, cyan, orange, purple, blue, yellow, black, and magenta, with circular ear-disc modules on both sides and a large circular target-like detail on the lower right side of the sphere. The character sits at an outdoor wooden café table on a sunny urban terrace, wearing a black shiny leather jacket splattered with bright paint, a fluffy black-and-white fur collar, black gloves with multicolor paint marks, metal chains, and a round pendant with a bold white letter C. The alien is reaching one gloved hand toward the viewer and pointing at a cold peach-orange drink in a clear glass on a metal saucer, topped with whipped cream or foam and fruit chunks, with one black straw standing upright. Add a small potted green plant in the right foreground, wooden benches and café furniture behind, warm sunlight, strong natural reflections on the head and jacket, shallow depth of field, and a modern city skyline with tall buildings blurred in the background. 2119515285068267521.promptZh: 创作一幅竖构图的高端时尚艺术人像，描绘一位年轻东亚女性，端坐于暗色摄影棚中，身体呈四分之三侧身姿态，但面朝镜头回眸，神情平静而忧郁。她留着短而富有光泽的黑色波波头，齐刘海笔直，肤色苍白莹润，唇色淡红，妆容精致细腻。身着一件露肩黑色和风礼服长裙，袖子为半透明蕾丝材质，以浅米色樱花刺绣装饰；单肩与上背部裸露，裙身布料向下垂落，隐入深沉阴影之中。画面氛围阴郁，构图略偏低且居中，她的面部位于画面左下方中段区域，身体轮廓勾勒出优雅的弧形剪影。她身后精确布置3把大型黑色折扇：一把展开的扇子自她头部与右肩后方向上放射状延展；一把色调更深的扇子置于左下方、裙摆后方；一把扇子部分遮挡，位于右侧。添加恰好4簇清晰可见的浅色花朵：一簇大型花簇位于顶部正中央、圆形光晕内部；一簇中型花簇紧贴她肩部上方；一簇小型花簇位于她右侧、靠近扇子处；一簇花簇刺绣于下臂袖口处。背景近乎纯黑，上半身后方设一大型不规则金色新月环形光晕（crescent-ring halo），表面呈现断裂金属箔质感（broken metallic leaf texture）、炭灰色撕纸肌理（charcoal gray torn-paper patches）、隐约的植物线描（faint botanical line drawings）、缕缕金丝镂空纹样（wisps of gold filigree）以及稀疏如尘埃般的微小斑点（sparse dust-like speckles）。布光采用低调（low-key）且具电影感（cinematic lighting）的方式，面部、肩部及花朵受柔和定向光照射，边缘则沉入浓郁纯黑。视觉风格：日式哥特式优雅（Japanese gothic elegance）、暗调花卉风杂志摄影（dark floral editorial photography）、绘画感混合媒介拼贴（painterly mixed-media collage）、奢华黑金配色（luxurious black-and-gold palette）、低饱和米色花朵（muted beige flowers）、超精细织物纹理（ultra-detailed fabric texture）、浅景深（shallow depth）、戏剧性负空间（dramatic negative space），无文字，无水印。

2119515302449463298.promptEn: Create a grand museum-quality marble statue scene of Heracles, the divine strongman of Greek mythology, standing heroically on a carved marble pedestal in a dark classical gallery. The central figure is an extremely muscular adult male with a stern bearded face, curly hair, and deeply carved anatomy, wearing the Nemean lion skin as a hood and cloak with the lion head resting over his head and the paws draped across his chest. He raises a massive rugged wooden club high above his head in his right hand, while his left hand holds a curved bow; a quiver of arrows hangs at his side. He wears a rough draped loincloth, sandals, and animal-hide details, with one foot planted forward on jagged rock. Include exactly 2 companion creatures flanking him: on the left, a seated majestic lion with a thick mane and alert expression; on the right, a coiled multi-headed hydra with exactly 5 visible serpent heads, open mouths, scaled bodies, and intertwined necks. Use pale veined marble for all figures and the base, with realistic chisel detail, cracks, polished highlights, and sculptural shadows. The setting is a dimly lit ancient temple or museum alcove with exactly 2 tall black marble columns in the background, ornate capitals, a black recessed backdrop, subtle overhead spotlights, and a reflective stone floor. Compose as a centered full-body vertical image, low-angle monumental perspective, symmetrical and dramatic, high contrast chiaroscuro lighting, ultra-detailed photorealistic classical sculpture, no modern objects, no text, no watermark.
2119515302449463298.promptZh: 创作一幅宏伟的、博物馆级品质的大理石雕像场景，主角是希腊神话中神力非凡的英雄赫拉克勒斯（Heracles），他英勇地矗立于一座雕花大理石基座之上，置身于幽暗的经典风格画廊中。中央人物是一位肌肉极度发达的成年男性，面容严肃、蓄须，头发卷曲，人体解剖结构以深刻雕刻手法呈现；他身披涅墨亚狮子皮，狮皮作兜帽与斗篷之用，狮首覆于头顶，狮爪垂落胸前。他右手高举一根粗犷厚重的木质巨棒，左手持一张弯弓；一支箭袋悬于身侧。他腰间围裹粗粝垂坠的缠腰布，足踏凉鞋，全身细节融入兽皮元素，一只脚坚定踏在嶙峋岩石之上。画面中须精确包含2只伴生生物，分列其左右：左侧为一头端坐的威严雄狮，鬃毛浓密，神情警觉；右侧为一条盘绕的多头蛇怪许德拉（Hydra），恰好显露5个蛇首，蛇口大张，身躯覆鳞，颈部相互缠绕交织。所有人物及基座均采用浅色带纹理大理石材质，呈现逼真的凿刻细节、自然裂纹、抛光高光与雕塑式阴影。场景设定为一座光线昏暗的古代神庙或博物馆壁龛，背景中精确布置2根高耸的黑色大理石圆柱，柱头雕饰繁复，背景为黑色内凹墙面，配有柔和的顶部聚光灯，地面为反光石质地板。构图采用居中、全身、竖幅图像，低角度宏伟视角（low-angle monumental perspective），对称且富有戏剧性，明暗对比强烈（chiaroscuro lighting），超精细照片级写实（photorealistic）古典雕塑风格，不得出现任何现代物品、文字或水印。
