2119520340211220481.promptEn:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the clothing research board, create a clean full-body anime character design sheet for a slender young man in a breathable Japanese summer outfit. Transform the referenced woven, translucent summer kimono/haori ideas into an elegant modern illustration rather than a screenshot or collage.

Character: Draw one standing bishounen-style male figure with messy white hair, pale skin, and a calm slightly shy expression, facing forward in a relaxed pose with one hand resting near the waist.

Outfit: Include exactly 5 visible outfit elements: 1) a white lightweight summer kimono/yukata with a subtle small repeating woven pattern, 2) a dark navy obi, 3) a sheer black gauze haori with visible transparency and fine weave texture, 4) a simple decorative cord with a small red bead, and 5) traditional black geta sandals with dark red straps.

Style: Delicate Japanese anime fashion concept art, soft pencil-and-watercolor linework, refined fabric texture, airy summer feeling, neutral white background, full body centered with generous margins.

Constraints: Do not reproduce the phone UI, search result cards, website labels, or Japanese chat text from the reference. Use the reference only to infer the summer kimono material, transparency, and period-inspired mood. No extra props, no background scenery, no additional characters, no watermark.
2119520340211220481.promptZh:
以 REFERENCE_0 作为服装调研板，为一名身形修长的年轻男性设计一张干净、完整的动漫角色全身设计图，穿着透气的日式夏日装束。将参考图中编织感、半透明的夏日和服/羽织（haori）概念，转化为一幅优雅的现代插画，而非截图或拼贴。

角色：绘制一位站立的美少年（bishounen）风格男性角色，发色为凌乱的白色，肤色苍白，神情平静略带羞涩，正面朝向，姿态放松，一手自然垂放于腰侧。

服装：需清晰呈现恰好 5 个服装元素：1）一件白色轻薄夏日和服/浴衣（yukata），表面带有细腻重复的编织纹理图案；2）一条深藏青色（navy）腰带（obi）；3）一件通透的黑色薄纱羽织（haori），具备明显透明感与精细的织物纹理；4）一根简洁的装饰绳，末端缀有一颗小红珠；5）一双传统黑色下駄（geta）木屐，配深红色绑带。

风格：精致的日式动漫时尚概念图（Japanese anime fashion concept art），柔和的铅笔与水彩线条（pencil-and-watercolor linework），考究的布料质感（refined fabric texture），轻盈的夏日氛围（airy summer feeling），中性纯白背景，全身像居中构图，四周留有充足边距（generous margins）。

限制条件：不得复现参考图中的手机界面（phone UI）、搜索结果卡片（search result cards）、网站标签（website labels）或日文聊天文字（Japanese chat text）。仅可从参考图中推断夏日和服的材质、透明度及时代氛围（period-inspired mood）。不可添加额外道具、背景场景、其他人物或水印。

2119520354501214209.promptEn: Create an ultra-realistic, premium lifestyle studio portrait of an adult standing in a relaxed, natural pose against a seamless warm gray studio background. The subject is smiling naturally while looking slightly upward and off-camera, conveying optimism, confidence, and approachability. The subject wears a layered casual-smart outfit consisting of an olive green bomber jacket over a light beige hoodie, dark slim-fit jeans, and clean light gray high-top sneakers. A minimalist black backpack is worn over one shoulder, with one hand comfortably holding the shoulder strap while the other arm rests naturally by the side. Capture the subject from head to toe with balanced body proportions and realistic anatomy. Maintain a relaxed posture with feet comfortably apart and natural weight distribution. Use soft professional studio lighting with subtle shadows, producing even skin tones and gentle contrast. Preserve realistic skin texture, natural facial details, and authentic clothing fabric textures. The bomber jacket should have a matte finish, while the hoodie appears soft and slightly textured. Style the portrait like a premium commercial fashion campaign for a modern lifestyle or travel brand. Keep the composition clean and uncluttered with generous negative space around the subject. Photographed using a Sony A7R V with an 85mm f/1.8 lens, ultra-high resolution, HDR, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus, realistic color grading, magazine-quality editorial photography, 8K, highly detailed, photorealistic, professional commercial lighting. Aspect Ratio: 4:5 vertical.
2119520354501214209.promptZh: 创作一幅超写实、高端生活方式影棚人像，画面中一位成年人以轻松自然的姿态站立于无缝暖灰色影棚背景前。人物面带自然微笑，目光微微上扬并略偏离镜头，传递出乐观、自信与亲和力。人物身着层次分明的休闲-轻正装搭配：橄榄绿色飞行员夹克外搭浅米色连帽衫，下穿深色修身牛仔裤，脚踩干净的浅灰色高帮运动鞋。肩背一只极简黑色双肩包，一只手自然握住单侧肩带，另一只手臂自然垂于身侧。采用全身构图，呈现均衡的身体比例与真实的人体解剖结构。保持放松体态：双脚舒适分开，体重自然分布。使用柔和的专业影棚布光（studio lighting），辅以微妙阴影，实现均匀肤色与柔和对比度。保留真实皮肤质感、自然面部细节及服装面料的真实纹理：飞行员夹克呈现哑光质感，连帽衫则显得柔软且略带纹理。整体风格参照现代生活方式或旅行品牌的高端商业时尚广告大片。构图简洁清爽，人物四周留有充裕的负空间。拍摄设备为索尼 A7R V 搭配 85mm f/1.8 镜头，超高清分辨率，HDR，浅景深（depth of field），锐利焦点（razor-sharp focus），真实色彩分级（realistic color grading），杂志级编辑摄影（magazine-quality editorial photography），8K，高度精细，照片级写实（photorealistic），专业商业布光（professional commercial lighting）。画幅比例：4:5 竖构图。

2119520411606663170.promptEn: Create a studio portrait on a vertical 4:5 canvas with a plain dark gray seamless background and soft, realistic photography lighting. Show one real young adult Asian man standing slightly left of center, full body visible, wearing an oversized black hoodie, a white undershirt peeking out, loose light-wash denim shorts, white crew socks, and white-and-red sneakers. He has short textured black hair with straight fringe and black rectangular glasses, a mildly confused, skeptical expression, and he looks to his right toward the empty space. His posture is relaxed with arms down, feet planted, and shoulders slightly turned. Above his head, add exactly 2 black hand-drawn question marks, one larger and one smaller, as doodle accents. To the right of him, create his mischievous doodle shadow as if drawn in rough black charcoal or marker directly on the background: a cartoon version of the same man, larger and more energetic, grinning widely with oversized glasses, wearing a hoodie, shorts, socks, and sneakers. The doodle shadow is in a playful dancing pose with one knee raised, one foot on the ground, both arms up making peace signs; include exactly 2 visible peace-sign hands. Add expressive sketch marks around the doodle: exactly 3 small exclamation strokes above the doodle head, exactly 1 tiny question mark near the left raised hand, exactly 5 curved motion marks around the arms, leg, and body, and a scribbled dark ground shadow under the doodle foot. Style the doodle with loose, messy, crosshatched black lines, semi-transparent enough to read as a drawn shadow but bold enough to stand out. Keep the real person photorealistic and the doodle shadow 2D hand-sketched, with no other objects, no watermark, and no extra text.
2119520411606663170.promptZh:
在竖构图 4:5 画布上创作一幅影棚人像，背景为纯色深灰色无缝背景，采用柔和、写实的摄影布光（realistic photography lighting）。画面中呈现一位真实的年轻亚洲男性，略微偏左居中站立，全身可见；他穿着 oversized 黑色连帽衫，内搭白色打底衫露出衣领，下装为宽松浅水洗牛仔短裤，脚穿白色圆筒袜和红白配色运动鞋。他留着短而有质感的黑色头发，齐刘海，佩戴黑色矩形眼镜，神情略带困惑与怀疑，目光看向右侧空处。姿态放松：双臂自然垂落，双脚稳立地面，双肩微微转向右侧。  
在他头顶上方，添加恰好 2 个手绘黑色问号（?），一大一小，作为涂鸦式点缀。  
在他右侧，以粗粝的黑色炭笔或记号笔风格，在背景上直接绘制他的顽皮涂鸦式投影：一个卡通化版本的同一人物，体型更大、更具活力，咧嘴大笑，戴着超大眼镜，同样穿着连帽衫、短裤、袜子和运动鞋。该涂鸦投影呈俏皮舞蹈姿态——单膝高抬，单脚踩地，双臂高举并比出和平手势（peace signs）；需清晰呈现恰好 2 只比出和平手势的手。  
在涂鸦周围添加表现性速写线条：  
- 涂鸦头部正上方，恰好 3 根小型感叹号式短划线；  
- 左侧抬起的手附近，恰好 1 个微小问号；  
- 手臂、腿部及躯干周围，恰好 5 条弯曲的动态轨迹线；  
- 涂鸦踩地的那只脚下方，添加一团潦草绘制的深色地面投影。  
涂鸦整体采用松散、凌乱、交叉排线（crosshatched）的黑色线条绘制，半透明度适中——既能被识别为手绘投影，又足够醒目突出。  
真实人物须保持照片级写实（photorealistic），涂鸦投影则为二维手绘速写风格，画面中不得出现其他物体、水印或额外文字。

创作一幅超写实的全身高端生活方式影棚人像（studio portrait），画面主体为一名年轻成年黑人男性，居中站立于无缝浅灰色影棚背景前。他正对镜头，神情平静淡然，双肩放松，双手随意插在短裤侧袋中。姿态自然自信，双脚间距约与肩同宽。

2119520496893640705.promptEn: Create a literary magazine cover style poster about Nanjing, good morning. Use a wide horizontal 16:9 canvas with a muted pale olive-green background and lots of quiet negative space. Place the main typographic weight in the upper-right: huge black Chinese calligraphic serif characters reading 南京,早安, thick, elegant, slightly oppressive like inked magazine masthead typography. Directly beneath the headline, add a thin horizontal rule on both sides of a small Chinese subtitle reading “城市清晨问候特辑”, and to the right add italic English text “Good Morning, Nanjing”. On the right-middle, set the date 2026.07.25 in refined black serif numerals, with smaller Chinese text below: “星期六　农历六月十三”, then a tiny centered dash. Below that, create a compact almanac-style information block with a small red sun icon and the label “今日宜忌”, dotted divider lines, and exactly 2 circular badges: one labeled “宜” followed by “散心、看树、尝鲜”, and one labeled “忌” followed by “仓促、发呆过头、错过晨光”. At the bottom-right, add spaced small caps English “CITY MORNING GREETINGS”, a diagonal slash, and a small Chinese quote: “把日子过成诗 / 把清晨过成喜欢的样子”. In the lower-left, depict the theme object as naive crayon drawing rather than realism: exactly 2 illustrated food objects, a decorative handheld fan and a plate of sliced salted duck with orange egg-like centers. The fan should be ornate, rounded, outlined in dark green, filled with childlike swirls, flowers, cloud motifs, yellow, blue, white, and green crayon scribbles, with a brown handle and teal tassel. The plate should be a simple blue-outlined oval containing several thick slices of duck rendered with rough white, brown, orange, and red crayon strokes. Add small playful doodles around them: one red star, one green circle, one yellow squiggle, one tiny green vine flourish, three short white accent strokes, and a few small blue dash marks near the plate. Overall style: calm editorial cover, literary magazine layout, refined black typography contrasted with innocent wax-crayon illustration, minimal color palette, soft paper texture, no photorealism, no extra objects, no watermark.

Style should be polished Japanese anime key visual art with luminous backlighting, glossy highlights on hair and fabric, soft painterly clouds, saturated summer colors, delicate linework, and slight imperfect AI-art roughness in hair strands and outlines. Add a tiny unreadable white artist-signature scribble in the lower right corner, but no other text. Mood: dizzy summer daydream, gentle and wistful.
2119520540799614977.promptZh: 创作一幅明亮、高细节的日本动漫风格插画，描绘一位年轻女孩站在阳光明媚的乡村道路上，采用低角度略带广角（wide-angle）的视角，构图居中，呈现从大腿以上部位的全身像。她拥有一头长而飘逸的浅灰金色长发，正向右侧剧烈飘动；眼睛大而呈琥珀棕色；神情平静略带空茫；佩戴一副红色圆形眼镜。她身穿一件宽松的浅天蓝色短袖衬衫裙，领口呈圆弧形，正面有纽扣，腰部有收褶缝线，裙摆随风轻扬。添加恰好4件主要个人物品/服饰元素：一顶超大号编织草编太阳帽，边缘呈参差不齐的装饰性毛边，由她抬起的左手持握；一副红色圆形眼镜；一条浅蓝色连衣裙；一本深红色硬壳封面书籍，夹在她的右腋下。背景为鲜活的夏日乡村风光：一条泥土小径、青翠山丘与远处的蔚蓝山脉、一座小型村庄（恰好可见6栋房屋），以及位于左前方前景的一片向日葵花丛（恰好清晰可见5朵向日葵花头）。天空为澄澈的蓝色，点缀着高耸的白色积云（cumulus clouds），右上角有强烈的太阳光晕（sun flare）。风格应为精致打磨的日本动漫主视觉艺术（Japanese anime key visual art），具备明亮的逆光（luminous backlighting）、发丝与布料上的光泽高光（glossy highlights）、柔和的手绘感云朵（soft painterly clouds）、饱和度高的夏日色调（saturated summer colors）、细腻的线条（delicate linework），以及发丝与轮廓线上轻微的AI绘画特有的粗粝感（slight imperfect AI-art roughness）。右下角添加一个极小、无法辨识的白色艺术家签名涂鸦（artist-signature scribble），不得出现其他任何文字。氛围：眩晕般的夏日白日梦（dizzy summer daydream），温柔而怅惘（gentle and wistful）。

2119520570440761346.promptEn: Create a monochrome, photorealistic cinematic portrait of a graceful young Japanese woman in traditional kimono, shown from the back and shoulders up as she turns her head toward the viewer with a calm, faint smile. She has glossy black hair styled in an elegant low updo with loose face-framing strands and a decorative floral kanzashi hair ornament with dangling tassels on the left side. She wears a refined pale gray kimono with subtle embroidered cherry blossom patterns on the sleeve and shoulder, plus a large tied obi bow visible at her lower back. Frame her inside a large circular moon-gate window, with dark interior edges forming a round vignette and slim vertical lattice panels at both sides. Beyond the window is a softly blurred Japanese Zen garden with raked sand patterns, scattered rocks, low shrubs, and bright diffused daylight filtering through trees. Use black-and-white photography style, soft natural backlight, delicate skin tones, shallow depth of field, high detail in hair and fabric, elegant composition, serene atmosphere, 3/4 rear view, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. No text, no watermark, no modern objects.
2119520570440761346.promptZh: 创作一幅单色、照片级写实（photorealistic）的电影感肖像（cinematic portrait），描绘一位身着传统和服的优雅日本年轻女性，画面仅呈现其背部及肩部以上，她正缓缓转头面向观者，神情平静，唇边浮起一抹淡淡微笑。她拥有一头乌黑亮泽的秀发，盘成精致低髻，额前与两颊垂落几缕松散发丝以修饰脸型，左侧佩戴一枚装饰性花卉簪（kanzashi）发饰，缀有垂坠流苏。她身穿一件素雅浅灰色和服，袖口与肩部饰有细腻刺绣的樱花图案，并在下背部可见一枚硕大系结式宽腰带（obi）蝴蝶结。人物被框定于一扇大型圆形月洞门窗之内，窗框内缘呈深色，形成圆形暗角（vignette），两侧各有一组纤细竖向格栅板。窗户外是一处柔焦处理的日式禅意庭院：耙制出纹理的白沙、错落分布的石块、低矮灌木，以及透过树隙洒落的明亮漫射日光。采用黑白摄影风格（black-and-white photography style）、柔和自然逆光（soft natural backlight）、细腻肌肤质感（delicate skin tones）、浅景深（shallow depth of field）、发丝与织物纹理高度精细（high detail in hair and fabric）、构图典雅（elegant composition）、氛围宁静（serene atmosphere）、三分之四后侧视角（3/4 rear view）、竖构图 4:5 画幅比例（vertical 4:5 aspect ratio）。画面中不得出现文字、水印或任何现代物品。

2119520658953158657.promptEn:
Using the uploaded photo as the identity reference, create an ultra-realistic professional studio portrait while preserving the subject's exact facial identity, facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, transparent eyeglasses, beard, body proportions, and natural features. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter the face beyond subtle professional retouching.

The subject is seated confidently on a modern wooden stool with one leg crossed over the other. The left elbow rests comfortably on the knee while the left index finger lightly touches the temple in a thoughtful, confident pose. The right hand rests naturally across the crossed leg. Maintain direct eye contact with the camera and a calm, composed facial expression.

Dress the subject in a premium deep burgundy traditional kaftan with matching trousers, featuring clean tailoring, subtle embroidered detailing along the front placket, and a chest pocket. Keep elegant black leather loafers and a sophisticated black-and-gold wristwatch visible.

Place the subject in a modern minimalist studio featuring a textured grey concrete wall with subtle industrial character. Position a small wooden side cabinet beside the subject with a decorative marble-pattern ceramic vase placed on top. Keep the background uncluttered and softly blurred to maintain focus on the subject.

Use soft cinematic studio lighting with a large octabox as the key light positioned at approximately 45 degrees, balanced by gentle fill lighting to create smooth skin tones and natural shadows. Add a subtle warm rim light behind the subject to create depth and separation from the background.

Capture with a Sony A7R V and an 85mm f/1.4 GM lens at f/2.0, ISO 100, 1/200s. Produce a shallow depth of field with crisp facial details, realistic skin texture, natural colour grading, high dynamic range, and luxury editorial-quality sharpness.

The final image should feel timeless, elegant, professional, and premium, suitable for a high-end fashion editorial or executive branding campaign. Maintain realistic proportions, authentic lighting, and photorealistic quality throughout.

Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (Instagram portrait)
Style: Ultra-realistic, luxury editorial, professional studio photography, cinematic lighting, 8K, photorealistic.
2119520658953158657.promptZh:
以上传的照片作为身份参考，创建一幅超写实的专业影棚人像（studio photography），完整保留被摄者的精确面部身份、面部结构、肤色、发型、透明眼镜、胡须、身体比例及自然特征。不得进行美化、风格化处理，或对脸部进行任何超出细微专业润饰的修改。

被摄者自信地坐在一张现代木质圆凳上，一条腿自然交叠于另一条腿之上。左肘舒适地 resting 在膝盖上，左手食指轻轻触碰太阳穴，呈现沉思而自信的姿态；右手自然搭在交叠的腿上。保持与镜头的直接眼神接触，面部表情平静而从容。

为被摄者穿着一件高级深酒红色传统长袍（kaftan），配同色长裤，剪裁利落，前襟有细腻刺绣装饰，并设有一个胸袋。保留优雅的黑色皮革乐福鞋，以及一只精致的黑金配色腕表，确保清晰可见。

将被摄者置于一间现代极简风格影棚中，背景为带有细微工业质感的肌理灰混凝土墙面。被摄者身旁放置一个小型木质边柜，柜顶摆放一只装饰性大理石纹陶瓷花瓶。背景保持简洁无杂乱，并作柔和虚化（bokeh），以确保视觉焦点集中于被摄者。

采用柔和的电影感布光（cinematic lighting）与影棚布光（studio lighting）结合：主光源为一只大型八角柔光箱（octabox），置于约45度角位置；辅以轻柔的补光，以呈现均匀的肤色与自然阴影。在被摄者后方添加一道微妙的暖色轮廓光（rim light），增强画面纵深感与主体和背景的分离感。

使用索尼 A7R V 相机搭配 85mm f/1.4 GM 镜头，参数设置为 f/2.0、ISO 100、1/200s。呈现浅景深（depth of field），面部细节锐利清晰，皮肤纹理真实可感，色彩分级自然，高动态范围（HDR），并具备高端时尚杂志级的奢华锐度。

最终成像应呈现永恒感、优雅感、专业感与高端质感，适用于高端时尚杂志专题或高管个人品牌形象宣传。全程保持真实的身体比例、真实的光线表现，以及照片级写实（photorealistic）品质。

画幅比例：4:5（Instagram 竖版）
风格：超写实、奢华时尚杂志风、专业影棚摄影、电影感布光（cinematic lighting）、8K、照片级写实（photorealistic）

2119520712845770753.promptEn: Create a vertical photorealistic fashion cosplay portrait in a bright minimalist room: a young woman with long black twin-tail hair with subtle purple streaks poses on the left side against a plain off-white wall, doing cute claw hands like a playful cat. She wears a navy blue plaid gothic-lolita school-idol mini dress with frilled shoulder straps, layered ruffle skirt, sheer black tulle hem, a large white bow on the chest, white thigh-high stockings, and chunky black Mary Jane platform shoes; add small hair clips, ribbons, and a delicate necklace. On the wall to her right, draw a large black hand-drawn manga “graffiti shadow” version of the same girl, about life-size and slightly taller than her, in rough energetic sketch lines as if inked directly on the wall. The sketch character should be exaggerated chibi-anime style with twin tails, matching frilly plaid outfit and bow, wild open mouth, angry-cute expression, raised claw hands, one leg kicked up, and dynamic motion marks. Include exactly 7 simple doodle accents around the sketch: 2 stars, 2 hearts, 2 small puff clouds, and 1 exclamation mark cluster. Strong diagonal sunlight and window-frame shadows fall across the wall and pale wood floor, creating a soft realistic editorial photo mood. Keep the real girl detailed and photographic, the wall drawing flat black pencil/ink lines, no color in the sketch, no text, no watermark. Use navy blue plaid, long black with subtle purple streaks, cute claw hands, rough black manga graffiti shadow, and strong diagonal sunlight with window shadows.
2119520712845770753.promptZh: 竖构图照片级写实（photorealistic）时尚角色扮演肖像，场景为明亮极简主义房间：一名年轻女子站在画面左侧，背靠素雅的米白色墙壁，留着长及腰际的黑色双马尾发型，发丝间透出细微的紫色挑染；她摆出俏皮猫咪般的可爱爪爪手（cute claw hands）。她身穿深蓝色格纹哥特洛丽塔风校园偶像迷你裙，肩带缀有荷叶边，裙身采用多层褶皱设计，下摆为透明黑色薄纱（tulle），胸前系着一只硕大的白色蝴蝶结，双腿穿着白色过膝袜，脚踩厚底黑色玛丽珍鞋（Mary Jane platform shoes）；另添加小巧发夹、丝带与一条精致项链作为配饰。在她右侧墙壁上，绘制一幅与本人等大略高、以粗犷有力手绘线条呈现的黑色漫画“涂鸦阴影”（graffiti shadow）风格人物——仿佛直接用墨水在墙上挥就。该涂鸦人物采用夸张的Q版动漫（chibi-anime）风格：双马尾、同款荷叶边格纹服饰与蝴蝶结，张大嘴巴，神情既生气又可爱，双爪高举，单腿高高踢起，并配有动态速度线（motion marks）。围绕该涂鸦，精确添加7个简洁涂鸦式点缀元素：2颗星形、2颗心形、2朵小蓬松云、1簇感叹号。强烈斜射的日光与窗框投影横贯墙面与浅色木地板，营造柔和而真实的杂志编辑摄影（editorial photo）氛围。确保真人形象细节丰富、高度写实如摄影，而墙上的涂鸦仅以扁平化纯黑铅笔/墨线（pencil/ink lines）呈现，无任何色彩、无文字、无水印。使用关键元素：深蓝色格纹（navy blue plaid）、长黑发带细微紫挑染（long black with subtle purple streaks）、可爱爪爪手（cute claw hands）、粗犷黑色漫画涂鸦阴影（rough black manga graffiti shadow）、强斜向日光搭配窗影（strong diagonal sunlight with window shadows）。

2119520740872110081.promptEn: Create a polished anime-style portrait illustration of a cute young woman wearing a summery lace-up knit outfit. She has long flowing light chestnut brown hair in loose twin ponytails with airy curled ends, soft side bangs, large sparkling blue eyes, rosy cheeks, and a shy slightly parted-lips expression. Her outfit is a pale mint sleeveless ribbed summer knit halter crop top with a high ruffled mock neck, bare shoulders, a diamond-shaped chest cutout with white crisscross lacing, and a small white ribbon bow at the center; add sheer pale pink detachable puff sleeves tied at the upper arms with small bows, plus light blue high-waisted skinny jeans with subtle distressed rips. Include two visible dangling earrings, one on each ear, with small blue triangular charms. Pose her seated or leaning lightly on a white dresser with both hands resting near the edges, upper body centered, waist-up to upper-thigh framing. Keep the composition vertical, high detail, elegant and wholesome, with no text, no watermark, and no extra characters.
2119520740872110081.promptZh: 创作一幅精致的动漫风格肖像插画，描绘一位可爱的年轻女性，身穿夏日风系带针织装。她拥有一头柔顺的浅栗棕色长发，松散地扎成双马尾，发尾轻盈卷曲；额前有柔和的侧刘海；眼睛大而闪亮，呈蓝色；双颊泛着红晕；神情羞涩，嘴唇微微张开。她的服装是一件浅薄荷色无袖罗纹夏季针织挂脖短上衣，领口为高褶皱假领，露出双肩；胸前呈菱形镂空设计，以白色交叉系带装饰；正中央系着一枚白色丝带蝴蝶结；另配有半透明浅粉色可拆卸泡泡袖，用小蝴蝶结系于上臂；下装为浅蓝色高腰修身牛仔裤，带有细微做旧破洞效果。耳部佩戴一对垂坠式耳饰，左右耳各一，耳饰吊坠为小巧的蓝色三角形挂件。人物姿态为坐姿或轻轻倚靠在一张白色梳妆台边缘，双手自然置于台面两侧，上半身居中构图，画面取景范围为腰线以上至大腿上部。背景为一间明亮的纯白房间，左侧是一扇散发柔和微光的窗户，配以轻盈透光的窗帘；台面为白色；右侧摆放一只透明玻璃花瓶，内插数朵小白花。整体采用细腻线条（delicate linework）、柔和粉彩色调（soft pastel colors）、眼眸与发丝上的光泽高光（glossy highlights）、自然淡雅的腮红（gentle blush）、明亮通透的日光（luminous daylight）、细微闪烁光点（subtle sparkles），呈现清新浪漫的少女漫画（shoujo anime）美学风格。画面保持竖构图、高细节（high detail）、优雅且健康向上（elegant and wholesome），不添加文字、水印及额外人物。

2119520772232921090.promptEn: A cinematic evening café portrait of a stylish young East Asian couple sitting across from each other at a cozy wooden table beside a floor-to-ceiling window, sharing a quiet, intimate moment. The man wears a fitted black knit sweater, resting his chin on his hand while gazing warmly at the woman with a gentle smile. The woman wears a soft cream knit sweater, resting her chin on her sleeve as she looks back at him with a calm, affectionate expression. The table holds elegant white ceramic coffee cups with latte art, a rich chocolate cake slice, and minimalist café tableware. Beyond the window, a breathtaking waterfront city skyline glows with colorful lights reflecting across the water, creating a dreamy urban nightscape. Warm ambient café lighting blends with cool blue city lights, producing a cozy, romantic atmosphere. Soft reflections on the glass, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, cinematic color grading, luxury lifestyle editorial, intimate storytelling composition, ultra-photorealistic DSLR photography, 85mm lens, f/1.4, HDR, 8K, highly detailed skin texture, premium fashion magazine aesthetic, cozy modern café, elegant date-night mood.
2119520772232921090.promptZh: 电影感（cinematic）傍晚咖啡馆肖像画，一对时尚的年轻东亚情侣坐在温馨的木质桌旁，彼此对坐，窗外是落地窗，共享安静而亲密的时刻。男子身穿合身的黑色针织毛衣，手托下巴，目光温暖地凝视着女子，脸上带着柔和的微笑。女子身穿柔软的米白色针织毛衣，手肘支在桌上，下巴 resting on her sleeve（原文如此，保留），回望着他，神情平静而充满爱意。桌上摆放着优雅的白色陶瓷咖啡杯，杯面有拉花图案，一块浓郁的巧克力蛋糕切片，以及极简风格的咖啡馆餐具。窗外，令人叹为观止的滨水城市天际线闪耀着五彩灯光，倒映在水面上，营造出梦幻般的都市夜景。温暖的咖啡馆环境光与清冷的蓝色城市灯光交融，烘托出舒适而浪漫的氛围。玻璃上呈现柔和的反光，浅景深（shallow depth of field），奶油般柔滑的焦外虚化（bokeh），电影感色彩分级（cinematic color grading），奢华生活方式杂志风格（luxury lifestyle editorial），富有亲密叙事感的构图（intimate storytelling composition），超照片级写实（ultra-photorealistic）单反相机摄影（DSLR photography），85mm镜头，f/1.4光圈，HDR，8K分辨率，高度精细的皮肤纹理，高端时尚杂志美学（premium fashion magazine aesthetic），舒适现代的咖啡馆，优雅的约会夜晚氛围（elegant date-night mood）。

2119520822908502017.promptEn: High-fashion editorial photography of a Hollywood female model standing full-body on an infinite shallow mirror-like water surface at night beneath a dark velvet starry sky. She wears a black sequined deep-V couture gown with a thigh-high slit and sheer flowing train, walking calmly toward the camera with a poised, cinematic expression, wet hem trailing and one leg visible. The horizon is low and distant with dark mountain silhouettes, the scene lit by soft moonlight and subtle fashion-shoot rim lighting. The water does not show a normal reflection; instead, from her feet toward the foreground it becomes a long, vibrant liquid rainbow reflection that morphs into an enormous painted portrait of her face beneath the surface. The reflected face is centered in the lower foreground, with red lips, soft eyes, and painterly skin tones, distorted by gentle ripples like oil paint on water. Use exactly one standing model and one giant face-reflection, with a single continuous rainbow stream connecting them. Colors in the reflection include saturated cyan, turquoise, magenta, violet, orange, yellow, red, and deep blue, spreading organically in glossy waves. The girl wears an orange long-sleeve dress, a white frilled apron, a white bonnet with an orange bow, white socks, and pale blue Mary Jane shoes; her long wavy blonde hair streams backward, and puffs of white transformation smoke surround her dress and trail behind her. The villain wears a blue jester hood with two floppy points tipped by red balls, glowing red eyes, a skull-like gray face, sharp teeth, a purple ruffled collar and cuffs, a blue tunic with red buttons, orange tights, red curled boots, and a dark cape. Between them, show exactly 1 rainbow spiral magic projectile, glowing like a colorful vortex with red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, and magenta trails, flying from the villain’s pointed finger toward the girl. Include exactly 1 large full moon centered high in the sky, partly veiled by dark purple storm clouds. Include exactly 1 closed wooden treasure chest with brass bands and a central lock in the lower right-middle foreground. Include 7 prominent gravestones: 1 large tilted stone on the far left, 1 rounded stone near the center behind the girl, 1 small dark stone behind the treasure chest, 1 narrow stone just right of the villain, 1 large tilted stone at the far right foreground, and 2 additional partially obscured stones in the midground. The graveyard ground should be dark, muddy, and rocky with scattered tufts of grass, bare twisted trees on both sides, and a gothic horror atmosphere. Use dynamic composition, cinematic lighting, strong rim light from the moon, saturated anime colors, crisp linework, detailed fabric folds, expressive faces, and motion blur only in the smoke and magic trails. No captions, no UI, no watermark, no extra characters. Use a 16:9 landscape canvas. The overall mood should be spooky but adventurous, inspired by retro side-scrolling dark fantasy game art transformed into a polished modern anime illustration.

The entire face, hair, hands, and visible skin are rendered in grayscale (black and white graphite), showcasing extremely detailed HB, 2B, 4B, and 6B pencil shading, cross-hatching, soft blending, feather shading, and smooth tonal transitions to create a hand-drawn, museum-quality fine art appearance. Individual hair strands are visible. Selective color is applied only to her clothing (the multi-colored dupatta and pink kameez), which is rendered in a matte, watercolor-like soft dusty rose pink and muted lavender, with the original floral and geometric patterns and textures detailed in graphite and color. Small, natural catchlights are present in her eyes. The lighting is soft, diffused studio light. The composition is elegant and calm, resembling a luxury editorial sketch. Shot on a Canon EOS R5, 85mm lens. 8K resolution, high fidelity, masterwork, photorealistic pencil drawing. No face swapping or beauty filters.
2119523462891520002.promptZh: 一幅超写实（hyper-realistic）、柔和的石墨铅笔素描插画，采用选择性上色（selective color），精准捕捉 image_0.png 中女子的相貌、面部特征、表情、年龄及浓密黑色长发。主体为胸像至半身肖像，居中构图，背景为极简的米白色绘图纸，带有细微纸纹与隐约可见的铅笔笔触。整张面孔、头发、双手及所有可见皮肤均以灰度（黑白石墨）呈现，运用极其精细的 HB、2B、4B 与 6B 铅笔进行排线（cross-hatching）、柔化晕染（soft blending）、羽状 shading（feather shading）及平滑的色调过渡（smooth tonal transitions），营造出手绘感强烈、博物馆级品质的精细艺术效果；单根发丝清晰可辨。仅对其服饰（多彩披肩 dupatta 与粉色卡梅兹 kameez）施加选择性上色：以哑光质感、水彩风格的柔和灰玫瑰粉（soft dusty rose pink）与低饱和薰衣草紫（muted lavender）呈现，原始花卉与几何图案及纹理则由石墨与彩色共同细致刻画。双眼含自然微小的高光（catchlights）。布光柔和、漫射，为影棚灯光（studio light）。构图优雅沉静，形似高端时尚杂志（luxury editorial）风格的素描。使用佳能 EOS R5 相机搭配 85mm 镜头拍摄。8K 分辨率，高保真（high fidelity），大师级作品（masterwork），照片级写实（photorealistic）铅笔画。无人脸替换（face swapping）或美颜滤镜（beauty filters）。

2119523522438053890.promptEn:
Goal: Create a photorealistic comparison grid of eight distinct young East Asian women’s ID-style headshots, emphasizing clearly different facial features while keeping the same general styling.

Canvas: Wide horizontal image in a 16:9 aspect ratio, clean white studio background, divided into exactly 8 equal portrait panels arranged in a 4-column by 2-row grid. Use thin light-gray divider lines between panels, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Subject details: Show exactly 8 separate head-and-shoulders portraits, each facing directly forward and looking into the camera with a calm neutral expression. All are young adult East Asian women with fair skin, long dark brown to black wavy hair, soft see-through bangs, natural makeup, a white knit sweater, and a delicate small necklace. Make each face visibly unique: 1) oval face with balanced eyes and soft lips, 2) slightly rounder face with wider eyes and gentler cheeks, 3) narrower face with straighter brows and smaller mouth, 4) brighter wide-eyed face with slightly shorter bangs, 5) longer face with heavier waves and more serious gaze, 6) petite heart-shaped face with softer jaw and subtle pout, 7) round face with fuller cheeks and larger eyes, 8) slim face with longer hair framing the cheeks and a composed expression.

Visual style: High-resolution realistic studio photography, soft even front lighting, minimal shadows, natural skin texture, clean beauty portrait retouching, sharp focus on eyes, subtle hair detail, consistent camera distance and crop across all panels.

Customizable elements: Use 8 portraits in a 4 columns by 2 rows grid, featuring young East Asian women with long dark wavy hair with see-through bangs wearing white knit sweaters with delicate small necklaces.

Constraints: Do not make the faces identical; each portrait must have a distinct face shape, eye shape, brow style, nose, mouth, and overall facial balance. Keep the clothing, background, lighting, and pose consistent so the facial differences are the main comparison point.
2119523522438053890.promptZh:
目标：创建一张照片级写实（photorealistic）的对比网格图，包含八位相貌迥异的东亚年轻女性的证件照风格半身肖像，重点突出彼此清晰可辨的面部特征，同时保持整体造型风格一致。

画布：宽幅横向图像，长宽比为16:9，纯白影棚背景；画面均分为恰好8个等大的竖构图面板，以4列×2行的网格形式排列；面板之间用细浅灰色分隔线隔开；不添加任何文字、标志或水印。

人物细节：呈现恰好8张独立的肩部以上肖像，每人正对镜头、直视相机，表情平静中性。所有人物均为东亚裔年轻成年女性，肤色白皙，留长及肩的深棕至黑色波浪发，带有轻薄透光的刘海，化自然妆容，身穿白色针织毛衣，佩戴精致小巧的项链。确保每张面孔明显独特：1）椭圆形脸，双眼比例均衡、嘴唇柔和；2）略偏圆润的脸型，双眼较宽、脸颊线条更柔和；3）较窄的脸型，眉毛呈直线状、嘴型较小；4）神采明亮、双眼较大，刘海略短；5）脸型偏长，发卷更浓密，目光更严肃；6）娇小的心形脸，下颌线条柔和、微微嘟唇；7）圆脸，脸颊更饱满、眼睛更大；8）瘦长脸型，长发垂落两侧包裹脸颊，神情沉着镇定。

视觉风格：高分辨率、写实主义影棚摄影（studio photography），柔和均匀的正面布光（front lighting），阴影极淡，呈现自然肌肤质感，采用干净利落的美妆人像修图（beauty portrait retouching），双眼锐利聚焦（sharp focus on eyes），发丝细节细腻微妙（subtle hair detail），所有面板保持一致的拍摄距离与裁切比例（camera distance and crop）。

可定制元素：采用4列×2行网格布局的8张肖像，人物为留长及肩深色波浪发、带透光刘海的东亚年轻女性，身穿白色针织毛衣，佩戴精致小巧的项链。

约束条件：不得使各张面孔雷同；每张肖像必须具备独特的脸型、眼型、眉形、鼻型、嘴型及整体面部比例平衡；服装、背景、布光与姿态须完全一致，以确保面部差异成为唯一核心对比要素。

2119523539982827522.promptEn:
Create an ultra-realistic 3D pop-art comic poster collage featuring the same young woman consistently across every panel. She has long, naturally wavy dark brown hair with soft curtain bangs, warm fair-to-medium skin, delicate facial features, expressive brown eyes, and a calm, confident expression.

She is wearing a fitted cream/beige ribbed long-sleeve collared polo shirt with a small dark embroidered horse logo, paired with high-waisted beige trousers and a classic brown leather belt with a gold buckle.

Design the image as a dynamic multi-panel comic-book collage with thick black borders separating each frame. Include several different poses and angles of the same woman: a close-up portrait, a three-quarter profile, a relaxed standing pose, and a smaller seated/back-facing pose. The central portrait should be the main focus and significantly larger than the surrounding panels.

Use a stylish urban graffiti background with colorful comic-book panels, halftone dot textures, pink and yellow graphic sections, and a bold blue-red-yellow explosion pattern. Maintain realistic skin texture, detailed hair strands, natural facial proportions, realistic fabric texture, cinematic lighting, sharp focus, and polished editorial photography quality while preserving the graphic pop-art aesthetic.

Composition: vertical poster, full-body and half-body framing mixed across panels, symmetrical and visually balanced layout, central subject dominant, clean black panel outlines, no extra thumbnail image, no duplicated reference photo, no unwanted text, no watermark.

Style: ultra-realistic photography + premium 3D pop-art comic aesthetic, highly detailed, vibrant, cinematic, crisp, professional fashion editorial, 8K quality.
2119523539982827522.promptZh:
创作一幅超写实3D波普艺术漫画海报拼贴画，整幅作品中每个画格均一致呈现同一位年轻女性。她拥有一头自然微卷的深棕色长发与柔和的齐刘海，肤色温暖、介于白皙至中等之间，五官精致，棕色眼睛富有表现力，神情沉静而自信。

她身穿一件合身的米色/浅褐色罗纹长袖立领polo衫，胸前绣有小巧的深色马形徽标；下搭高腰浅褐色长裤，配一条经典棕色皮革腰带，腰带扣为金色。

将画面设计为动感十足的多画格漫画书拼贴风格，各画格之间以粗黑边框分隔。包含该女性多个不同姿态与视角：一张特写（close-up）肖像、一个三分之四侧脸视角、一个放松的站立姿态，以及一个较小尺寸的坐姿/背对视角。中央肖像应作为视觉焦点，显著大于周围其他画格。

背景采用时尚都市涂鸦风格，融合彩色漫画画格、半调网点纹理（halftone dot textures）、粉红与明黄色图形区块，以及醒目的蓝-红-黄爆炸图案。须保持真实肌肤质感、细致发丝、自然面部比例、逼真布料纹理、电影感布光（cinematic lighting）、锐利焦点（sharp focus）及精修过的杂志级摄影品质（editorial photography quality），同时保留鲜明的图形化波普艺术（pop-art）美学。

构图：竖版海报，各画格混合采用全身与半身取景，布局对称且视觉均衡，主体居中并占据主导地位，黑色画格轮廓清晰干净，不添加额外缩略图、不重复使用参考照片、不出现非预期文字、无水印。

风格：超写实摄影（ultra-realistic photography）＋高端3D波普艺术漫画美学（premium 3D pop-art comic aesthetic），高度精细，色彩明艳，富有电影感（cinematic），清晰锐利（crisp），专业时尚杂志编辑风（professional fashion editorial），8K画质。

2119523582303354882.promptZh: 照片级写实（photorealistic）正方形 1:1 特写（close-up）图像：一只成年右手用拇指和食指捏住一枚中国一元硬币，五根手指解剖结构准确，无多余手指。硬币位于画面左中部附近，正面朝向镜头，呈现真实的银色金属质感、带凹凸纹路的边缘高光、浮雕花卉图案，以及清晰可辨的“1 元”字样。食指弯曲于硬币上方，拇指从下方托住硬币；其余手指自然卷曲收向掌心。背景为柔和虚化的办公桌：左下角有一台黑色键盘，最左侧可见电脑显示器边缘，浅色木质桌面，手后方有一盆绿色盆栽，右侧摆放深色办公物品。采用浅景深（depth of field）、自然室内光线、真实皮肤毛孔、指甲、褶皱及柔和阴影。构图保持随意自然，类似智能手机摄影风格，手部与硬币锐利聚焦，背景呈焦外虚化（bokeh）。约束条件：画面中仅出现一只手、恰好五根手指、恰好一枚硬币，无解剖变形，无重复手指，无水印。

2119523612779167746.promptEn:
Goal: Create a dark gothic hand-painted infographic poster titled THE AI STACK, showing an interconnected personal AI-tool stack as a mysterious occult network.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, black and charcoal textured canvas with visible rough brush strokes, scratched chalk marks, muted cream ink, and subtle sepia highlights. The mood is eerie, nocturnal, vintage, and slightly haunted.

Layout: Place a large central circular node labeled CLAUDE with a simple eight-point starburst symbol inside it. Four rounded rectangular tool cards connect to the central node with pale hand-drawn cables and small circular connector dots. Use exactly 4 outer cards: top-left card labeled CODEX with a browser-window code icon, top-right card labeled GPT IMAGE 2 with a framed landscape/image icon, bottom-left card labeled ANTIGRAVITY with a starry mountain or sparkling night icon, and bottom-right card labeled HERMES with a crossed-arrows or janitor-like routing symbol. Keep all text in uppercase, widely spaced, distressed serif/typewriter lettering.

Scene details: Add a glowing full moon centered above the main node, a small spiderweb and tiny spider in the upper-left corner, a dark gothic castle silhouette in the right background, fog and smoky clouds along the bottom, a wilted flower with a bent stem leaning across the left side of the central node, one fallen brown leaf near the base of the flower, and an antique skeleton key lying at the bottom right. Include a tiny creator handle centered at the bottom: @AunySillyMe.

Visual style: Painterly gothic chalkboard illustration, rough impasto texture, off-white linework on black, muted gold-brown accents on the dead flower and leaf, softly glowing moon, handmade imperfect borders, no clean vector polish.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 central circle, exactly 4 connected outer cards, exactly 4 outer tool labels, exactly 1 moon, exactly 1 spiderweb, exactly 1 spider, exactly 1 wilted flower, exactly 1 fallen leaf, exactly 1 castle silhouette, and exactly 1 key. Do not add extra cards, extra tools, bright colors, modern UI gloss, or photorealism.
2119523612779167746.promptZh:
目标：创作一幅暗黑哥特风格手绘信息图海报，标题为《THE AI STACK》，将一个相互连接的个人人工智能工具栈描绘成一张神秘的神秘学（occult）网络。

画布：正方形 1:1 构图，黑色与炭笔质感画布，可见粗犷的手刷笔触、刮擦式粉笔标记、柔和的米奶油色墨水，以及微妙的棕褐色（sepia）高光。整体氛围诡异、夜行性、复古，并略带幽灵感。

布局：在画面中央放置一个大型圆形节点，标注文字为 CLAUDE，内部绘有一个简洁的八芒星爆射符号（eight-point starburst symbol）。四个圆角矩形工具卡片通过浅色手绘电缆及微小圆形连接点与中央节点相连。严格使用恰好 4 张外围卡片：左上卡片标注 CODEX，内含浏览器窗口代码图标；右上卡片标注 GPT IMAGE 2，内含装框风景/图像图标；左下卡片标注 ANTIGRAVITY，内含繁星山脉或闪烁夜空图标；右下卡片标注 HERMES，内含交叉箭头或类似清洁工风格的路由符号。所有文字均使用大写字母、字间距宽、带有磨损效果的衬线体/打字机字体（serif/typewriter lettering）。

场景细节：在主节点正上方居中绘制一枚发光的满月；左上角添加一小片蛛网及一只微小蜘蛛；右侧背景中加入一座暗黑哥特式城堡剪影；底部沿边缘布置雾气与烟状云团；一朵枯萎花朵连同弯曲花茎斜倚于中央节点左侧；一朵掉落的棕色叶片置于花朵茎基附近；一把古董骷髅钥匙平放于右下角。底部正中添加极小的创作者署名：@AunySillyMe。

视觉风格：绘画感哥特式黑板插画（gothic chalkboard illustration），厚涂肌理（impasto texture），黑色底上使用偏白线条勾勒，枯萎花朵与叶片点缀哑光金棕色（gold-brown）强调色，满月呈柔和辉光，手工绘制的不完美边框，杜绝干净矢量（vector）质感。

约束条件：严格使用恰好 1 个中央圆形节点、恰好 4 张相连的外围卡片、恰好 4 个外围工具标签、恰好 1 枚月亮、恰好 1 片蛛网、恰好 1 只蜘蛛、恰好 1 朵枯萎花朵、恰好 1 片掉落叶片、恰好 1 座城堡剪影、恰好 1 把钥匙。禁止添加额外卡片、额外工具、明亮色彩、现代 UI 光泽感或照片写实主义（photorealism）。

2119523650313994241.promptEn: Create a luminous vertical anime-style close-up portrait of a joyful young woman in a sunlit garden. The subject is a gentle golden-haired girl, shown from the shoulders up in a three-quarter view, turning toward the viewer with a warm open smile and soft rosy cheeks. She has honey-blonde long, voluminous curly hair with many loose ringlets, flyaway strands, and delicate backlit edges glowing in the sunlight. Her large sparkling amber-gold eyes contain bright star-like highlights and reflective bokeh, with long lashes and a dreamy expression. She wears a simple white blouse or dress with soft folds, mostly visible at the shoulders. The background is an out-of-focus magical garden with green foliage and small white flowers, drenched in golden-hour sunlight from the upper left. Add floating dust motes, circular bokeh, tiny glitter particles, and multiple star-shaped sparkles around the hair and face. Use soft painterly anime rendering, highly detailed hair strands, warm pastel colors, shallow depth of field, cinematic rim light, ethereal atmosphere, and an uplifting springtime mood. Vertical portrait composition, 2:3 aspect ratio, no text, no watermark, no border.
2119523650313994241.promptZh: 创作一幅明亮的竖版动漫风格特写（close-up）肖像画，描绘一位在阳光明媚花园中欢欣雀跃的年轻女子。主体是一位温婉的金发少女，以肩部以上构图、三分之四视角呈现，面朝观者，展露温暖而开朗的笑容，双颊泛起柔和的玫瑰色红晕。她拥有一头蜜金色长发，蓬松卷曲，布满大量松散的螺旋卷发、飘逸的碎发，以及被阳光透射出柔光的纤细发丝边缘。她的眼睛硕大闪亮，呈琥珀金色，瞳孔中带有明亮星状高光与反射式焦外虚化（bokeh），睫毛修长，神情梦幻。她身穿一件简约的白色上衣或连衣裙，衣料柔软褶皱自然，主要可见于肩部区域。背景为失焦的魔法花园，绿意盎然的枝叶与细小的白花交织，沐浴在左上方洒落的黄金时刻（golden-hour）阳光之中。添加漂浮的尘埃微粒、圆形焦外虚化（bokeh）、细小的闪光粒子，以及围绕发丝与面部的多颗星形闪光。采用柔和的手绘感动漫渲染（painterly anime rendering），发丝刻画高度精细，配色为温暖的粉彩色调，景深（depth of field）浅，电影感轮廓光（rim light），空灵缥缈的氛围，洋溢着振奋人心的春日气息。竖版人像构图，2:3画幅比例，无文字，无水印，无边框。

2119523747210805250.promptEn: Create a vertical epic fantasy poster illustration in a painterly watercolor-and-ink style, like a high-detail concept-art book cover. The scene shows a colossal ancient stone tower rising from a dark lake and misty forest valley, centered perfectly on the canvas. The tower is covered with black vines, blue glowing crystalline flowers, gothic arches, stairs, balconies, and ruined masonry. A tiny cloaked human figure stands on the central staircase about two-thirds down the tower, emphasizing immense scale. Around the tower are exactly 8 horizontal magical halo rings, stacked from upper to lower levels: 3 pale gold-white rings near the upper tower, 2 violet-lavender rings in the middle, 1 dark blue-black ring below them, 1 black ring near the figure, and 1 red ring near the base gate. At the top, the structure widens into a massive hammer-like gothic crossbar with two enormous ornate cylindrical end caps, carved with metallic latticework and skeletal filigree; on top of it sits a distant blue-lit castle city with spires, pine trees, and a glowing trident-shaped symbol in the sky. Behind the castle, form a subtle double-exposure face in the clouds: one huge watchful eye and brow looking down from the upper left, blended into stormy blue-gray clouds. The background is a vast misty mountain landscape with pine forests, pagodas, waterfalls, cliffside bridges, ruined arches, birds, fog, and tiny warm lights. Use a palette of desaturated parchment beige, storm gray, deep indigo, black, silver, icy blue, faint violet, and small red embers near the bottom. Add aged paper texture, splattered ink edges, ornate fantasy detail, cinematic lighting, symmetrical composition, and a solemn mythic mood. 2119524306693210114.promptEn:
[DESTINATION] = [CITY NAME]

Create a charming vertical 4:5 mid-century travel picture-book illustration of [DESTINATION], inspired by playful 1950s–60s European city books.

Depict the city as an affectionate, imperfect travel memory—not a map, postcard, architectural rendering, landmark collage, or cinematic panorama.

Include:
• 1 distinctive primary landmark
• 1 smaller secondary landmark
• 1 distant/partially hidden local feature
• 1 recognizable local vehicle
• 3–5 subtle everyday city details
• 5–6 ordinary people doing simple local activities

Compress these naturally into one imaginary street, plaza, park, or waterfront. Keep the primary landmark slightly off-center, with open foreground, shallow theatrical depth, gentle curves, and generous museum-white negative space. The city should be recognizable without feeling geographically accurate.

STYLE:
Hand-drawn picture-book illustration with loose charcoal/navy ink, trembling contours, crooked architecture, uneven proportions, sparse windows, simplified silhouettes, occasional double strokes, and minimal detail. Use the fewest lines necessary. Slightly awkward, intelligent, warm, humorous, and handmade.

PEOPLE:
Simple expressive figures with oversized heads, thin legs, narrow bodies, tiny faces, tilted accessories, and awkward but readable gestures. Show ordinary local life, not celebrities, models, stereotypes, or tourist clichés.

COLOR:
Use a restrained 6–7 color destination-specific palette with flat matte gouache shapes, uneven brush edges, white gaps, slight misregistration, and occasional color spilling beyond ink. Mostly unpainted sky/paper. No gradients or realistic shading.

MEMORY DISTORTION:
Gently compress geography and distort scale: distant landmarks may appear nearby, roads may curve strangely, buildings may overlap, and people/vehicles may be slightly oversized or undersized. Keep it balanced, affectionate, and culturally respectful.

OPTIONAL TEXT:
“[DESTINATION]” in small uneven hand-drawn capitals near the bottom. No slogans, dates, labels, logos, or promotional text.

AVOID:
Photorealism, map-like accuracy, landmark checklists, aerial views, cinematic lighting, technical perspective, dense crowds, detailed ornament, polished vector art, CGI, 3D rendering, gradients, sepia/beige paper, artificial aging, distressed textures, and hyper-detailed watercolor.

Overall feeling: [DESTINATION] remembered lovingly-recognizable, spacious, human, humorous, slightly improbable, and beautifully imperfect.

2119525608781332481.promptEn: Create an ultra-premium stylized 3D adventure poster in a vertical composition, preserving the core visual logic of a cute heroic explorer discovering treasure inside a dangerous cave. The image must feel cinematic, suspenseful, playful, and highly polished, like a flagship animated adventure campaign poster. Place one chibi-style fantasy explorer at the upper-middle area, standing on rough descending stone steps inside a dark cavern, holding a flaming torch in one hand and a short sword in the other. The character must feel brave, expressive, and charming, with a slightly oversized head, compact heroic body, clear readable silhouette, and fully coherent stylized anatomy. A huge expedition backpack rises behind the character, loaded with rolled blankets, straps, buckles, tools, and tiny adventure accessories, making the figure feel small but determined. Core composition: use a strict vertical poster layout. The explorer stands near the upper center on descending rocky steps. The lower center contains an open treasure chest overflowing with gold coins, gems, and rich magical light, becoming the primary warm focal source in the lower half. The stone steps lead the eye downward from the explorer to the glowing treasure. On the right side of the cavern wall, a gigantic dragon eye emerges from darkness, larger and more imposing, half-hidden in shadow, staring toward the explorer and the viewer with chilling intensity. The dragon eye must be a dominant tension anchor, with a sharper, more focused pupil highlight and stronger sense of intelligent presence. Small skulls, an old sword, scattered treasure, and cave relics may appear along the rock edges, but they must remain secondary and controlled. Orbit-enhanced threat presence: increase the scale and psychological power of the dragon eye so it feels like a vast ancient creature is embedded inside the cave darkness. The iris must have richer reptilian texture, the eyelids should feel heavy and watchful, and the eye highlight should be crisp enough to make the gaze feel alive. The presence of the eye should intensify the feeling that the explorer has stepped into a sacred forbidden chamber. Transit-enhanced cinematic mood: push the overall palette and atmosphere toward a colder, more filmic cave tone. Shift the environment into deeper cave blue-black, mineral charcoal, cool slate, and muted stone-gray. Let the torch and treasure chest remain the only concentrated warm light sources, creating a stronger warm-vs-cold contrast. Reduce any unnecessary warmth in the cave environment so the image feels more mysterious, more expensive, and more like an international animated feature poster. Style and visual language: ultra-detailed stylized 3D animation, premium animated feature poster quality, cinematic fantasy adventure, cute-but-epic storytelling, polished family adventure campaign, high-end CG rendering, impeccable material detail, world-class commercial poster finish, flagship movie-quality mood. Character design and anatomy: design a completely original chibi explorer with a rounded expressive face, wide alert eyes, small nose, open adventurous smile, short tousled hair peeking from under a simple fantasy helmet, and a compact heroic body. The pose should feel active and slightly forward-moving, one foot planted on a higher step, the other lower, body turned subtly toward the treasure while the head reacts to the lurking danger. Hands must be fully readable and anatomically coherent even in stylized form, with correct finger count and clear grip logic on torch and sword. Costume should include leather boots, a short tunic, belt, metal shoulder or arm accents, gloves, and travel-ready details. Lighting: use a refined dual-light system with strong warm torchlight and treasure glow contrasted against deep cold cave darkness. The torch creates a warm orange key light on the explorer’s face, armor, and backpack edges. The treasure chest emits a rich golden underglow that lights the steps, coins, and lower cave walls. Add subtle cool ambient fill from the cave darkness so forms remain readable without losing the nocturnal tension. The dragon eye should glow with controlled amber menace from within shadow. Lighting must feel cinematic, volumetric, and highly dimensional, with soft haze and atmospheric depth. Material rendering: the cave rocks must feel rough, damp, ancient, and heavy, with chipped edges, mineral texture, dust, and subtle moisture. Gold coins must feel metallic, reflective, and abundant, with varied orientation and believable thickness. Gems should feel jewel-like and luminous in small controlled accents. The treasure chest must feel like aged wood reinforced with weathered metal hardware. The backpack must feel heavy, tactile, and handmade, with stitched leather, fabric bedrolls, straps, and attached adventure gear. The torch flame must feel believable, with layered orange-yellow fire and subtle smoke. The dragon eye must show wet organic depth, reptilian iris pattern, dark scaled eyelids, and a threatening glossy surface. Color system: build the image around deep cave blue-black, charcoal, mineral slate, and cold shadow tones, contrasted with concentrated amber, gold, fire orange, and copper highlights. Keep the warm colors tightly localized to the torch, treasure chest, coins, and dragon eye glow. The emotional result should feel adventurous, magical, suspenseful, and deeply cinematic. Environment and storytelling: the cave must feel like a hidden underground ruin with stone steps, narrow ledges, rough walls, and ancient danger. Add only a few carefully chosen storytelling props: skulls, an old buried sword, scattered treasure, broken relics, and faint cave dust. Keep the scene clean, readable, and controlled. The explorer should feel like they have just discovered the treasure while realizing an enormous creature is watching. Typography and poster layout: preserve the logic of poster text placement. Add a fully original fantasy adventure title lockup at the lower left, bold and graphic, with a custom Chinese-style headline and a smaller English subtitle beneath it, fully fictional and not copied from any source. Add a small original platform-style ID or release mark at the lower right in minimal clean typography. Keep all text sparse, integrated, and professionally designed as part of the poster composition. Image quality and physical constraints: extreme sharpness, premium depth layering, cinematic atmospheric perspective, readable silhouette hierarchy, coherent stylized anatomy, no broken hands, no extra fingers, no deformed limbs, no muddy dark areas, no black blotches, no cheap fantasy clutter, no weak focal structure. The final result must feel like a world-class animated adventure key visual ready for commercial promotion. Negative prompt: real brand names, copied title text, copied platform text, watermark, signature, broken anatomy, extra fingers, missing fingers, malformed hands, distorted face, dead eyes, muddy cave shadows, black blotches, chaotic treasure clutter, fake fire, plastic rocks, cheap cartoon look, low-resolution texture, weak dragon eye, cluttered composition, unreadable silhouette

2119525774896742402.promptEn: Create a breathtaking cinematic fantasy scene titled “The Painter Who Finished the Sky.” At sunset, a lone artist stands high on the rooftop of an old European city, viewed mostly from behind, holding a wooden painter’s palette in one hand and a fine paintbrush raised toward the sky in the other. Dark clouds gradually become magnificent glowing sunset clouds in gold, amber, peach and soft blue. Color flows from the sky down through the city as though reality itself is being painted. Historic buildings regain warm natural colors. Windows begin glowing. Flowers bloom across balconies. Green vines appear along old stone walls. Birds emerge naturally from the painted sky and fly into the real world. Warm sunlight pours dramatically through the streets below and reflects across rain-soaked cobblestones. The right half of the city is now completely transformed into an extraordinary golden-hour world filled with warmth, life and beauty, while the far left remains cold and monochrome. The boundary between the two worlds should feel magical and organic—not like a simple split-screen effect. Individual brushstrokes, particles of light and subtle trails of pigment should visibly transition into real clouds, architecture, flowers and sunlight. Far below, small groups of people have stopped in the streets and on balconies, looking upward in wonder as they realize the sky and city are being transformed above them. The artist is carefully painting one final tiny unfinished patch of darkness near the top of the sky. 2119526072436473858.promptZh: 创作一幅宽幅16:9的动漫风格音乐封面画作，场景设定在弧形蓝白相间的地球上方的外层空间。主体为1位漂浮着的青少年女孩，神情忧郁，肤色苍白，留着凌乱的黑色短发并带有粉红色挑染，眼睛为红色，佩戴一枚粉色X形发夹；身穿印有简洁白色猫脸图案的 oversized 黑色T恤、黑色短裤或短裙，双腿裸露。她呈对角线方向漂浮于画面中，双手持握1把薄荷绿色电贝斯吉他，琴颈为木质，琴弦清晰可见，吉他整体呈从画面下中部斜向右上部的倾斜角度。在她右侧并排漂浮着1只毛茸茸的白色猫咪，双眼闭合，尾巴高高翘起，呈现失重且宁静的状态。画面中须精确包含4件与音乐相关的物件：她手中所持的1把贝斯吉他、左上方与右上方各1个小型方形红黑配色便携式扬声器（扬声器中央为圆形红色驱动单元）、右下方1个黑色电脑键盘（边缘带霓虹粉色轮廓）。使用多条长而循环往复的粉红色音频线缆，以轨道路径般的弧线环绕整个构图。背景为繁星点点的漆黑宇宙，画面正上方中央延展着一团色彩鲜明的星云——炽热粉红、橙色、紫色与蓝色交织；另有明亮的星芒、细小的闪烁光点、少量漂浮的水晶碎片，以及纤细的轨道线。光影效果需富有戏剧性与电影感（cinematic lighting），采用洋红色轮廓光（rim light）、冷调蓝色地球辉光（Earth glow）、高对比度阴影（high contrast shadows）、干净利落的赛璐珞着色（cel-shaded）动漫渲染风格、精细的线稿（detailed line art）、吉他表面呈现光泽高光（glossy highlights），整体氛围梦幻而忧伤，契合J-pop专辑封面气质。画面中不得出现标题文字、标识（logo）或水印（watermark）。
2119526072436473858.author: ふぁーねりあん / Fahnerian

2119526081873657857.promptEn: Create a charming cinematic 3D animated macro scene in a Pixar-like style: 5 glossy red cartoon ants with oversized expressive eyes march in a line down a narrow stone channel like a miniature canyon path. The front ant is closest to the camera, smiling and pushing a tiny wooden sled made from two parallel twig runners and cross sticks, carrying one large shiny golden yellow berry or seed. Behind it are exactly 4 more red ants following along the same path: one directly behind the leader, one behind that, one farther up the slope, and one tiny ant barely visible in the upper-right background. The ants have rounded segmented bodies, thin legs, curved antennae, friendly faces, and toy-like orange-red shells. The environment is a sunlit garden floor with weathered gray stone walls on both sides of the channel, small patches of moss, tall green blades of grass, and soft natural shadows. Use a vertical 9:16 composition, low macro camera angle looking slightly downhill toward the sled, shallow depth of field with the foreground ant and yellow object sharp while background ants and plants blur gently. Lighting should be warm midday sunlight with cinematic highlights, vibrant colors, whimsical adventure mood, high-quality 3D render, no text, no watermark, no humans.
2119526081873657857.promptZh: 以皮克斯（Pixar）风格创作一幅迷人的电影感3D动画微距场景：5只亮泽的红色卡通蚂蚁，长着夸张富有表现力的眼睛，排成一列，沿着一条狭窄的石质沟槽行进，沟槽形如微型峡谷小径。最前方的蚂蚁离镜头最近，面带微笑，正推动一辆微小的木制雪橇——雪橇由两根平行的细枝作滑板、数根横置小棍构成，上面载着一颗硕大、闪亮、金黄色的浆果或种子。它身后紧跟着恰好4只红色蚂蚁，沿同一条路径行进：一只紧随领头蚁之后，一只在其后方，一只位于坡道更上方处，还有一只极小的蚂蚁几乎仅在右上方背景中隐约可见。这些蚂蚁拥有圆润分节的身体、纤细的腿、弯曲的触角、友善的面部表情，以及玩具般的橙红色甲壳。环境设定为阳光普照的花园地面，沟槽两侧是风化灰石墙，点缀着小片青苔、高耸翠绿的草叶，以及柔和自然的阴影。采用竖构图9:16比例，以低角度微距镜头略微俯拍朝向雪橇方向；景深（depth of field）较浅，前景蚂蚁与黄色物体清晰锐利，而背景中的蚂蚁与植物则呈现柔和虚化（bokeh）。布光采用温暖的正午阳光，辅以电影感高光（cinematic highlights），色彩鲜明饱满，整体氛围充满奇趣冒险感；高品质3D渲染；画面中无文字、无水印、无人类形象。

2119526132335329281.promptEn: Create a vertical anime-style illustration of a young woman sleeping peacefully on a bed in an almost pitch-black room. The scene is viewed from a slightly elevated diagonal angle, showing her full body curled on her side across rumpled white sheets. She has dark navy-black medium-long hair tied loosely in a low ponytail with loose bangs framing her face, closed eyes, soft eyelashes, and a relaxed sleepy expression with slightly parted lips. She wears pale sky blue long-sleeve button-up pajamas with white piping, a small chest pocket, and matching loose pants; her bare feet are visible near the bottom of the frame. A thick white blanket is draped over her waist and legs, catching cool blue shadows. Behind her are exactly 3 visible pink pillows: one large pillow behind her head, one large pillow to the right, and one smaller partially visible pillow farther right. The bed has white wrinkled sheets with pale blue-gray shadows and a few pink areas at the edges. The background beyond the bed is a flat deep black wall or darkness, emphasizing the bed as the only illuminated area. Use dramatic low-key lighting with soft highlights on the bedding and face, strong black negative space, subtle blue-gray shading, and a hand-drawn modern anime illustration style with clean ink lines, painterly crosshatching, muted pastel colors, realistic folds, and a quiet intimate nighttime mood. Add a small handwritten artist signature reading HALF_DONE in the lower right corner. No extra furniture, no windows, no lamps, no text other than the signature.
2119526132335329281.promptZh: 创作一幅竖构图的动漫风格插画，描绘一位年轻女子在近乎全黑的房间里安详熟睡于床上。画面采用略高于水平线的斜角俯视视角，完整呈现她侧卧蜷缩于凌乱白色床单上的全身姿态。她拥有一头中长、深海军蓝近黑色的秀发，松散地扎成低马尾，额前垂落几缕碎发勾勒面部轮廓；双眼闭合，睫毛纤柔，神情放松慵懒，双唇微微张开。她身穿浅天蓝色长袖纽扣式睡衣，衣缘饰有白色滚边，胸前带一个小型口袋，下装为同色系宽松睡裤；赤足清晰可见，位于画面底部边缘。一条厚实的白色毛毯覆盖其腰腹与双腿，映出清冷的蓝色阴影。她身后恰好可见三枚粉色枕头：一枚较大枕头置于头后，一枚较大枕头位于右侧，另有一枚较小枕头部分露出，位置更靠右。床铺铺着白色褶皱床单，泛着浅蓝灰调阴影，边缘略染几处粉晕。床铺后方背景为纯平深黑色墙面或虚空，凸显床铺为画面中唯一被照亮的区域。采用戏剧性的低调布光（low-key lighting），在床品与面部投下柔和高光，强调浓重的黑色负空间（negative space），辅以细腻的蓝灰色渐变阴影；整体呈现手绘感现代动漫插画风格（hand-drawn modern anime illustration style），线条干净利落（clean ink lines），辅以绘画性交叉排线（painterly crosshatching），配色为低饱和度粉彩色调（muted pastel colors），布料褶皱写实自然，营造静谧私密的深夜氛围。右下角添加一小段手写体艺术家签名，内容为 HALF_DONE。画面中不得出现额外家具、窗户、灯具，除签名外不得含任何其他文字。

2119526164946042882.promptEn:
Goal: Create a stylized animated-film character design sheet for a severe aristocratic villain, showing consistent costume and facial design from multiple angles.

Canvas: Wide horizontal character reference sheet, approximately 16:9, with an off-white studio background and clean white margins. Split the page into two main panels: a large left panel for full-body turnarounds and a narrower right panel for a dramatic portrait close-up.

Layout: Include exactly 4 character depictions total: 1 front full-body view on the left, 1 side profile full-body view in the center, 1 rear full-body view on the right side of the large panel, and 1 large close-up head-and-shoulders portrait in the separate right panel. Add a thin vertical column of small red decorative lettering along the far left margin, reading like abstract production-sheet text.

Subject details: The character is extremely tall, gaunt, and angular, with a long pale greenish-gray face, sharp hooked nose, heavy red under-eye shadows, drooping eyelids, yellow-green eyes, thin downturned lips, an elongated chin, and exaggerated large red ears. He has messy black hair swept over one eye, with loose stringy strands falling across the face. His expression is stern, tired, suspicious, and aristocratic.

Costume: Dress him in a dramatic deep crimson and black plaid long tailcoat with broad squared shoulders, high collar, oversized lapels, black buttons, tapered waist, and long pointed tails. Under it he wears a dark red waistcoat, white shirt collar, and a large burgundy cravat. He has narrow muted olive-green striped trousers cropped above polished black formal shoes. The rear view should emphasize the long structured back of the coat and the plaid grid wrapping around the shoulders.

Visual style: High-end 3D animation concept art with painterly digital rendering, exaggerated caricature proportions, sharp graphic shapes, elegant gothic mood, subtle gradients, clean silhouette design, and polished studio lighting. Use saturated reds and blacks against pale skin and muted green clothing accents. The portrait close-up should be more detailed, with visible brush strokes in the hair, skin planes, eye bags, ears, and collar.

Constraints: Keep the character design identical across all 4 depictions. Do not add props, scenery, logos, or extra characters. Keep the background minimal and uncluttered, like a professional animation production turnaround sheet.
2119526164946042882.author: Shira Wiggles

2119526187423318017.promptEn: Create a vertical high-fashion cinematic beauty poster featuring a young East Asian woman with porcelain skin, long wavy black hair, soft glossy lips, and expressive brown eyes. The composition is a close-up portrait cropped so only the left half of her face and upper torso dominate the left two-thirds of the canvas, with the right side reserved for typography on a deep electric-blue studio background. She wears a white satin off-shoulder blouse with pale pink lace trim, a delicate silver pendant necklace, and one small gold rounded earring. Place exactly 1 large deep red rose tucked into her hair above her right ear. Add exactly 1 horizontal rectangular inset on the right-center showing a close crop of both eyes, aligned over the blue background. Use elegant editorial lighting, luminous skin retouching, cool blue color grading, subtle film grain, and faint horizontal light streak/glitch blur effects crossing the portrait and typography. Text layout: at the upper right, stack exactly 4 tall condensed uppercase English words, each spaced out vertically: LONGING / PURE / DESIRE / EYES. Pair the first three with small Chinese captions and place one Chinese phrase below the eye inset: 渴望 / 纯粹 / 心动 / 会说话的眼睛. At the lower right, set the main quote in very tall thin white serif lettering with slight blur and glow: Could you still live in my eyes. Add exactly 1 tiny uppercase footer near the bottom right reading BE SEEN. BE REMEMBERED. ONLY IN MY EYES.. Keep the mood romantic, mysterious, luxurious, and melancholic, with the model looking directly at the viewer; no extra people, no logos, no watermark.
2119526187423318017.promptZh: 创作一幅竖构图的高端时尚电影感（cinematic）美人海报，主角是一位东亚年轻女性，肌肤如瓷（porcelain skin），长发乌黑、波浪卷曲，双唇柔润亮泽，棕色双眸富有表现力。构图采用特写（close-up）人像，仅截取她面部左侧半边及上半身，占据画布左三分之二区域；右侧留白，用于排版文字，背景为深电光蓝（deep electric-blue）影棚纯色背景。她身穿一件白色缎面露肩上衣，领口与袖缘饰有浅粉色蕾丝花边；佩戴一条纤细银质吊坠项链，右耳戴一枚小巧圆润的金色耳钉。在她右耳上方的发间，精准插入一朵硕大的深红色玫瑰。在画面右侧中央位置，添加一个水平矩形嵌入式小图，仅特写（close-up）呈现她的双眼，该小图需与蓝色背景对齐。采用优雅的杂志级布光（editorial lighting）、通透提亮的肌肤修图（luminous skin retouching）、冷调蓝色彩分级（cool blue color grading）、细微胶片颗粒（film grain），以及数道微弱的横向光条/故障模糊（glitch blur）效果，横贯人物肖像与文字区域。文字排版：于右上方，纵向堆叠四个高窄体大写英文单词，彼此垂直等距排列：LONGING / PURE / DESIRE / EYES；前三个单词各自配以小幅中文标注，且在眼部位小图正下方另置一句中文短语：渴望 / 纯粹 / 心动 / 会说话的眼睛。于右下角，以极高而纤细的白色衬线字体（serif lettering）呈现主引文，略带模糊与辉光效果：Could you still live in my eyes。在右下角近底部处，添加一行极小号大写页脚文字：BE SEEN. BE REMEMBERED. ONLY IN MY EYES. 整体氛围须浪漫、神秘、奢华且略带忧郁；模特直视观者；画面中不得出现额外人物、品牌标识或水印。
2119526187423318017.author: serein

2119526201151275009.promptEn: Create a polished anime-style vertical portrait illustration of a cute kemonomimi maid girl leaning toward the viewer in a bright Victorian room. The subject is a young cat-eared girl with silvery ash gray twin-tail hair, soft curled side locks tied with small black ribbons, large fluffy cat ears with pale fur and pink inner ears, and big pinkish purple sparkling eyes. She has a small gentle smile, rosy cheeks, a soft childlike face, and glossy highlights on her hair and eyes. She wears a classic black-and-white maid outfit: black long-sleeved dress, white rounded collar, black bow at the neck, white frilled apron, puffed white shoulder frills, white cuffs, and a large white ruffled maid headband. Pose her in a close-up three-quarter view, upper body filling most of the frame, leaning forward with her head slightly tilted and one hand extended toward the camera in a friendly wave with five visible fingers. Place her in front of tall sunlit window panels with cream curtains, carved dark wooden trim, faint patterned wallpaper, and soft greenery visible outside. Use warm morning backlight streaming through the windows, delicate rim light on the ears and hair, bright high-key highlights, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, and a clean highly detailed Japanese anime illustration style with smooth linework, vibrant pastel lighting, and no text or watermark. Composition should be vertical 3:4, intimate and cute, with the character centered and cropped around the waist.
2119526201151275009.promptZh:
创作一幅精致的动漫风格竖版人像插画，描绘一位可爱的兽耳女仆少女，身体微微前倾面向观者，置身于明亮的维多利亚风格房间中。  
主角是一位年轻猫耳少女，拥有银灰褐色双马尾长发，两侧柔软卷曲的鬓发用小巧黑色丝带系住；毛茸茸的大猫耳覆盖浅色绒毛，耳内呈粉红色；双眼硕大，呈粉紫色，闪烁着晶莹光芒。  
她面带轻柔微笑，双颊泛起红晕，面容稚嫩柔和，发丝与眼眸上带有光泽高光。  
她身穿经典黑白配色女仆装：黑色长袖连衣裙、白色圆领、颈间黑色蝴蝶结、白色荷叶边围裙、蓬松白色肩饰、白色袖口，以及一枚宽大的白色褶皱女仆头饰。  
采用特写（close-up）三分之二视角构图，上半身占据画面大部分区域；她身体前倾，头部略作倾斜，一只手朝向镜头友好挥手，五指清晰可见。  
背景为高大的阳光洒入的窗格，配有米色窗帘、雕花深色木质窗框、隐约可见花纹的壁纸，窗外透出柔和绿植。  
运用温暖晨光从窗外透入形成的逆光（backlight），在耳朵与发丝边缘营造细腻轮廓光（rim light），明亮高调（high-key）高光，柔和阴影，浅景深（depth of field），整体呈现干净、高度精细的日式动漫插画风格：线条流畅，粉彩色调灯光鲜活明丽，画面不含文字或水印。  
构图比例为竖版3:4，氛围亲密可爱，人物居中，取景范围裁切至腰部附近。

2119526275407233025.promptEn: Create a cinematic photorealistic scene of an old rural Japanese train station platform at golden hour after rain, viewed from inside the covered platform hall looking outward toward the tracks. The architecture is weathered and nostalgic: dark wooden beams, peeling plaster walls, old metal columns, large gridded windows and doors, worn benches, timetable boards, posters, and glossy wet concrete floors reflecting warm sunset light. Include exactly 4 people: 1 uniformed station attendant on the far left in silhouette updating or reading a large paper timetable on the wall, 1 elderly man sitting alone on a wooden bench near the center-left with a black rolling suitcase beside him, 1 uniformed station staff member walking away through the middle corridor carrying a clipboard or folder, and 1 young traveler standing on the platform at right with a backpack facing an approaching modern train. Add a large round analog station clock high on the left wall showing about 9:45, a brightly lit beverage vending machine near the back-left, stacked newspapers or crates in the lower-left foreground, and a single modern train arriving on the right track with headlights on. The scene should feel quiet, melancholic, and realistic, with warm orange sunset streaming from the right, distant mountains beyond the tracks, visible power lines, long shadows, soft haze, detailed textures, natural depth of field, and no added captions or watermarks. Use a wide 3:2 horizontal composition, ultra-detailed documentary photography style, shot on 35mm lens, with warm cinematic sunset reflections and a nostalgic atmosphere in an old Japanese train station.
2119526275407233025.promptZh: 在黄金时刻（golden hour）雨后，创作一幅电影感照片级写实（photorealistic）场景：一座老旧的日本乡村火车站站台，视角位于有顶棚的站台候车厅内，朝外眺望铁轨方向。建筑饱经风霜、充满怀旧气息：深色木质横梁、剥落的灰泥墙面、老旧金属立柱、大型网格状窗与门、磨损的长椅、列车时刻表牌、海报，以及泛着温暖日落光芒的湿滑混凝土地面（具有镜面反射效果）。画面中须精确包含4个人物：① 最左侧远处一名身着制服的车站工作人员，呈剪影姿态，正在更新或阅读墙上一张大幅纸质时刻表；② 中左部一张木制长椅上独坐一位老年男性，身旁放着一只黑色拉杆箱；③ 一名身着制服的车站职员正从中央通道步行离开，手执写字板或文件夹；④ 右侧站台上站立一名年轻旅客，背着双肩包，面朝一列正驶近的现代列车。添加以下细节：左侧高处墙面上悬挂一枚大型圆形模拟式车站时钟，显示时间约为9:45；后左方附近设一台明亮发光的饮料自动贩卖机；左下前景处堆叠着报纸或纸箱；右侧轨道上一列现代列车正进站，车头灯已开启。整个场景应呈现静谧、忧郁而真实的氛围：温暖橙色的日落光线自右侧倾泻而入，铁轨尽头可见远山，空中清晰可见电线，投下悠长阴影，空气弥漫柔和薄雾，材质纹理高度精细，景深（depth of field）自然，画面中不得添加任何字幕或水印。采用宽幅3:2横向构图，超精细纪实摄影风格，使用35mm镜头拍摄，强调温暖电影感（cinematic）日落反光与旧日本火车站的怀旧氛围。
2119526275407233025.author: HsYr

2119526276912988161.promptEn: Create a cinematic fashion photograph of a young woman walking confidently through a fast-moving urban environment, captured in elegant side profile. She has short, naturally tousled dark-brown hair swept backward by the wind and wears a sophisticated minimalist black outfit with a structured jacket, carrying a sleek black handbag. Her expression is calm, focused, and slightly thoughtful as she looks ahead. The entire background is transformed into dramatic horizontal motion blur, with streaks of warm amber, golden yellow, muted teal, and deep green city lights rushing behind her, creating a strong sense of movement while her face remains relatively sharp and detailed. 2122223397512450049.promptEn:
STORY

Panel 1

Warm cloudy evening after light rain.

A small neighborhood park glows under golden sunset light.

Children are laughing and playing together.

In the distance, the long-haired girl sits alone on a swing.

The empty swing beside her slowly moves in the wind.

Camera note:
Wide establishing shot.

⸻

Panel 2

Close-up.

The girl watches the other children from afar while quietly spinning her handmade paper windmill.

A faint sad smile appears.

Camera note:
Slow push-in.

⸻

Panel 3

A sudden gust of wind lifts the paper windmill from her hands.

It flies across the park.

The girl stands and runs after it.

Camera note:
Tracking shot.

⸻

Panel 4

The windmill lands near a group of children playing.

The girl hesitates and freezes.

She is too shy to approach them.

From her perspective the group feels intimidating and distant.

Camera note:
Low-angle emotional POV.

⸻

Panel 5

One of the children notices the windmill.

Instead of simply returning it, the group carefully repairs a torn corner and decorates it with colorful drawings and messages.

The girl watches in surprise.

Camera note:
Medium emotional shot.

⸻

Panel 6

The kindest child walks toward her with a warm smile and gently offers the windmill back.

The group invites her to join them.

Camera note:
Soft close-up.

⸻

Panel 7

The girl’s eyes fill with tears.

For the first time she smiles openly.

She runs toward the group while clutching the repaired windmill.

Camera note:
Dynamic running shot with sunset backlight.

⸻

Panel 8

Final emotional wide shot.

The girl and her new friends laugh together beneath glowing sunset clouds.

The once-empty swing gently moves in the background.

The repaired windmill spins in the warm evening breeze.

Mood:
{argument name="mood" default="Bittersweet, heartwarming, unforgettable"}.

Camera note:
Large cinematic ending frame.

Create a breathtaking premium {argument name="style" default="anime film development board"} that tells a deeply emotional story about {argument name="theme" default="loneliness, kindness, and finding friendship"}.

2122223683081637890.promptEn:
Create a beautiful, cinematic travel photograph of a person sitting comfortably on a small wooden stool in front of a world-famous landmark, creating a detailed hand-drawn artwork of the landmark on a large sketchbook.

The person is seen from behind or at a slight side angle, holding a pencil or colored pencil and carefully sketching the landmark while looking up at the real architecture for reference. An open sketchbook, scattered colored pencils, a few wax crayons, and a small art bag rest beside them.

The landmark is the main attraction: Show the actual landmark prominently in the background, with authentic architecture, accurate proportions, original colors, and recognizable details. The artwork on the person’s sketchbook should closely resemble the real landmark, creating a beautiful visual connection between the artist’s drawing and reality.

Art style: Realistic travel photography blended with a delicate colored-pencil and wax-crayon aesthetic. Visible pencil strokes, textured paper, soft hand-drawn shading, and subtle artistic imperfections.

Atmosphere: Warm golden-hour sunlight, gentle shadows, a peaceful breeze, and a dreamy yet believable travel atmosphere. Include small environmental details that reflect the landmark’s real location and culture.

Composition: Vertical 4:5 format, premium travel magazine cover, the seated artist in the foreground, the sketchbook clearly visible, and the magnificent landmark rising in the background.

Color palette: Warm beige, muted pastels, earthy tones, and naturally vibrant colors inspired by the destination.

The final image should feel artistic, emotional, peaceful, and visually captivating, like a beautiful memory captured while travelling.

Avoid distorted landmarks, fictional architecture, exaggerated fantasy elements, extra fingers, messy compositions, and artificial-looking textures. Keep the person, drawing materials, and landmark natural and realistic.
2122223683081637890.promptZh:
创作一张美丽、富有电影感的旅行摄影照片：一位人物舒适地坐在一个小木凳上，正对着一处世界著名地标，在一本大型素描本上细致手绘该地标。

人物以背影或略微侧向的角度呈现，手持铅笔或彩色铅笔，一边抬头凝视真实的建筑作为参考，一边专注地勾勒地标。一本摊开的素描本、散落的彩色铅笔、几支蜡笔以及一只小型美术包，静置于其身旁。

地标是画面的核心焦点：在背景中清晰、醒目地展现真实地标，呈现其准确的建筑结构、真实比例、原始色彩与可辨识的细节。人物素描本上的手绘作品应高度还原真实地标，从而在艺术家的画作与现实之间构建出优美的视觉呼应。

艺术风格：融合写实旅行摄影与细腻的彩色铅笔及蜡笔绘画美学。可见清晰的铅笔笔触、纸张肌理、柔和的手绘阴影，以及微妙的艺术性不完美感。

氛围：温暖的黄金时刻阳光、轻柔的阴影、宁静的微风，以及如梦似幻却真实可信的旅行氛围。加入反映该地标实际所在地与文化特征的小型环境细节。

构图：竖版 4:5 比例，高品质旅行杂志封面风格；人物坐于前景，素描本清晰可见，宏伟地标巍然矗立于背景之中。

色彩方案：温暖的米 beige 色调、柔和的粉彩、大地色系，以及源自目的地自然风貌的鲜活色彩。

最终图像应呈现出艺术性、情感性、宁静感与视觉吸引力，宛如一段旅途中的美好记忆被瞬间定格。

避免出现扭曲的地标、虚构的建筑、夸张的幻想元素、多余的手指、杂乱的构图，以及人工感过强的纹理。确保人物、绘画工具与地标均保持自然、真实。
